verses.translation: wid iumnen s wayen i k d irsen, akked wayen id irsen, uqbel ik, u, $ef laxeôt, nitni, pputebbten.

verses.translation: Widak, di nnhaya n Mass nnsen, widak, d isaâdiyen.

verses.translation: Wid ijehlen, s tidep, iâuva fellasen ma tnubav ten, ne$ ur ten tnubav. Ur ppamnen.

verses.translation: Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, akked imeééu$en nnsen. Irs le$yaô $ef allen nnsen. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.

verses.text: Ger yimdanen, llan wid iqqaôen: "numen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru”; nitni, ur llin d lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ger yimdanen, llan wid iqqaôen: "numen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru”; nitni, ur llin d lmumnin.

verses.text: La xedâen Öebbi akked wid iumnen. Ur xedâen siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.
verses.translation: La xedâen Öebbi akked wid iumnen. Ur xedâen siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.

verses.text: Aîan deg ulawen nnsen; Irna yasen Öebbi aîan. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan, ilmend n wayen skiddiben.
verses.translation: Aîan deg ulawen nnsen; Irna yasen Öebbi aîan. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan, ilmend n wayen skiddiben.

verses.text: Ma nnan asen: "ur ssefsadet di tmurt"! A d inin: "nekwni d wid, kan, ipleqqimen".
verses.translation: Ma nnan asen: "ur ssefsadet di tmurt"! A d inin: "nekwni d wid, kan, ipleqqimen".

verses.text: Day maççi d nitni, s tidep, ay d ifessaden, maca ur faqen?
verses.translation: Day maççi d nitni, s tidep, ay d ifessaden, maca ur faqen?

verses.text: Ma nnan asen: "amnet, akken umnen medden"! A d inin: "day a namen, akken umnen ije$lufen"? Day maççi d nitni, s tidep, ay d ije$lufen, maca ur éôin.
verses.translation: Ma nnan asen: "amnet, akken umnen medden"! A d inin: "day a namen, akken umnen ije$lufen"? Day maççi d nitni, s tidep, ay d ije$lufen, maca ur éôin.

verses.text: Ma mmugren d wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mara yilin weêêedsen, ar ccwaîen nnsen, ad inin: "nekwni yidwen! Nekwni la nettihi kan".
verses.translation: Ma mmugren d wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mara yilin weêêedsen, ar ccwaîen nnsen, ad inin: "nekwni yidwen! Nekwni la nettihi kan".

verses.text: Öebbi ad Ittihi fellasen. Isnerna yasen lbwe$v nnsen; ddebdeben.
verses.translation: Öebbi ad Ittihi fellasen. Isnerna yasen lbwe$v nnsen; ddebdeben.

verses.text: Widak, d wid iu$en ttelfan s nnhaya; ur d issasay ssuq nnsen, ur pwanhan.
verses.translation: Widak, d wid iu$en ttelfan s nnhaya; ur d issasay ssuq nnsen, ur pwanhan.

verses.translation: Tevôa yidsen am win issa$en times. Mi tnewweô ayen i s d izzin, Öebbi Iddem tafat nnsen, Iooa ten di tillas, ur pwalin.

verses.translation: Âaégen, gugmen, dre$len; ihi, nitni ur d ppu$alen s abrid.

verses.text: Ne$ am usigna igenni, degs tillas, tirmegt, lebôaq. Pparran ivudan nnsen deg imeééu$en nnsen, mgal ssiâqat; ad nnestaôen si tmeppant. Öebbi Izzi i ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ne$ am usigna igenni, degs tillas, tirmegt, lebôaq. Pparran ivudan nnsen deg imeééu$en nnsen, mgal ssiâqat; ad nnestaôen si tmeppant. Öebbi Izzi i ijehliyen.

verses.text: Qôib i sen iêwi lebôaq, iéôi. Yal tikelt ideg i sen icâal, ad ddun syis. Mi sen ixsi, ad êebsen. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, ad asen Ikkes timesliwt akked yiéôi nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Qôib i sen iêwi lebôaq, iéôi. Yal tikelt ideg i sen icâal, ad ddun syis. Mi sen ixsi, ad êebsen. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, ad asen Ikkes timesliwt akked yiéôi nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: A yimdanen! Âabdet Mass nnwen ikwen Ixelqen, kunwi, akked wid i kwen id izwaren, amar a pêezzbem;
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Âabdet Mass nnwen ikwen Ixelqen, kunwi, akked wid i kwen id izwaren, amar a pêezzbem;

verses.translation: i wen Irran tamurt d usu, igenni d lebni; id Isse$li d aman seg igenni, Issuffe$ ed yissen ppemôa, d ôôeéq i kunwi. Ihi, ur pparrat tanudda i Öebbi, u kunwi teéôam.

verses.translation: Ma tellam di ccekk, $ef wayen id Nessers ar umdan nne£, awit ed tasuôep i p icban. Neccdet ed inagan nnwen, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep.

verses.translation: Ma ur tessawvem, u, war ccekk, ur tessawavem, êezzbet i tmes isseô$an imdanen, id$a$en, ippuheggan i ijehliyen.

verses.text: Becceô wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Yal tikelt ara ppuôeéqen, si ppemôa nnsen, ad inin: "d aya is neppuôeéq, uqbel". Ippunefk asen i ten icban. Din, jjwao nnsen d ayen iûfan. Degsen ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Becceô wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Yal tikelt ara ppuôeéqen, si ppemôa nnsen, ad inin: "d aya is neppuôeéq, uqbel". Ippunefk asen i ten icban. Din, jjwao nnsen d ayen iûfan. Degsen ad wekkôen.

verses.translation: Ih, ur Ikukra ara Öebbi, a d Ifk amedya n tizip, ne$ ip i$elben. Wid iumnen éôan neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass nnsen. Wanag wid ijehlen qqaôen: "acu Ib$a Öebbi s umedya agi"? Yis, Itellif aîas; yis, Inehhu aîas. Ur Itellif yis, siwa iballa$en;

verses.translation: wid ipôuéun lemâahda n Öebbi, deffir lmitaq iS, issemfaôaqen ayen id Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, issefsaden di tmurt. Widak d imexsuôen.

verses.translation: Amek ara tnekôem Öebbi? Tellam temmuten, Issader kwen id. Sinna, a kwen Ine$, sinna, a kwen id Issider, sinna, $uôeS a ppu$alem.

verses.translation: D Neppa i wen Ixelqen ayen akw illan di tmurt; sinna, Izzi ar igenni, Iwqem it d ûa igenwan. Neppa, Issen yal cci.

verses.translation: Mi Inna Mass ik, i lmalayek: "Nek ad Rre$ aneûûaf di tmurt". Nnant aS: "day a Pperrev, degs, win ara isfesden degs, ara izzizlen idamen? Wanag, nekwenti nesbuccuâ K s ccekôan, u Neôôequ yaK". Inna: "Nek, èôi$ ayen ur teéôimt".

verses.translation: Isseêfev akw ismawen i Adem. Sinna, Issken iten i lmalayek, Inna: "efkemt iyI d ismawen n wigi, ma kunemti d sut tidep".

verses.translation: Nnant: "gedha s yisseK! Ur nessin, siwa i a$ Teslemdev. Keçç, s tidep, d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab".

verses.translation: Inna: "a Adem, efk asent ismawen nnsen". Mi sent imla ismawen nnsen, Inna: "day ur a kwent Nni$ ara: Nek Ssne$ tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan, u èôi$ ayen d teqqaôem, akked wayen teppeffrem"?

verses.translation: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem"! Knant, siwa Iblis. Iugi, u isme$weô iman is. Illa seg ijehliyen.

verses.translation: Nenna: "a Adem, ezde$ keçç akked tmeîîut ik, di Loennet, eççet segs, s tawant, ayen i wen ihwan. Ur ppaéet ar ttejôa yagi, mulac a ppilim d imednas".

verses.translation: Ikellex iten Cciîan fellas. Issuffe$ iten id seg wanda llan. Nenna: "ûûubbet, d icenga bbwaygarawen. I kunwi, di tmurt, i$imi akked zzhu, siwa tallit".

verses.translation: Adem iîîef awalen n Mass is. Issuref as. Neppa, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu.

verses.translation: Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.

verses.translation: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is ikwen Öeéqe$. Eîîfet di lemâahda W, ad Ïîfe$ di lemâahda nnwen. D nek iwumi ara têezzbem.

verses.translation: Amnet s wayen id Sserse$, itebbten ayen illan $uôwen. Ur ppilit d imezwura ara t iagwin. Ur ppa$et, s issekniyen iW, ayen ôxisen. D nek iwumi ara têezzbem.

verses.translation: Ur slusut, i tidep, tikerkas. Ur teffret tidep, u kunwi teéôam.

verses.translation: èéallet, zekkit, îîinzet akked wid iîîinizen.

verses.translation: Day a ppamôem ise$ i medden, a ppeppum iman nnwen? U kunwi teqqaôem Tazmamt. Day ur tefhimem ara?

verses.translation: Ssutret lemâawna n ûûbeô akked téallit. Ih, dayen iwaâôen, siwa i imeéluven,

verses.translation: wid iêûan ar ad mlilen akked Mass nnsen, u $uôeS, nitni, war ccekk, ad u$alen.

verses.translation: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is ikwen Öeéqe$. Nek, Smenyafe$ kwen i imavalen.

verses.translation: Ëezzbet i wass ideg ur ippuoazi yiwen deg umkan n wayev, s wacemma. Ur tepwaqbal ccafuâa segs, ur tepwaîîaf, segs, le$ôama, ur ten ppaâwanen.

verses.translation: Mi kwen Nsellek seg ugdud n Ferâun, sâaddayen fellawen aâaqeb adiran. Zellun arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Ayagi d taluft tabarart, s$uô Mass nnwen.

verses.translation: Mi, yiswen, Nessemfaôeq ill, Nsellek ikwen, Ne$meq agdud n Ferâun, kunwi la tepwalim.

verses.translation: Mi Nga lemâahda i Musa, kuéet wavan; sinna, deffir es, teddam d uâajmi. Kunwi d imednas.

verses.translation: Sinna, deffir waya, Nsemmeê awen, amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.translation: Mi Nefka, i Musa, Tazmamt akked ufraz, amar a ppeppwanhum.

verses.translation: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Kunwi, s tidep, tdensem iman nnwen, mi teddam d uâajmi. Ssutret ssmaê i Uxellaq nnwen; mmin$et, ppif i kunwi ar Uxellaq nnwen. Issuref awen. Neppa, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu".

verses.text: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur neppamen yisek, d awez$i, alamma nwala Öebbi, âinani". Tewwet ikwen id ssiâqa, kunwi tepwalim.
verses.translation: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur neppamen yisek, d awez$i, alamma nwala Öebbi, âinani". Tewwet ikwen id ssiâqa, kunwi tepwalim.

verses.translation: Sinna, Nerra kwen id, deffir tmeppant nnwen, amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.translation: S usigna, Nerra yawen tili. Nessers awen d lmenna, ifeôôuoen: "eççet si téidanin is ikwen N$at". Ur a£ dnisen, maca densen iman nnsen.

verses.text: Mi Nenna: "kecmet tamdint agi, eççet degs, s tawant, ayen i wen ihwan; kecmet si tebburt, s lekni; init: nendem. Ad awen Nsemmeê tuccva nnwen, a Nernu i iâaôviyen".
verses.translation: Mi Nenna: "kecmet tamdint agi, eççet degs, s tawant, ayen i wen ihwan; kecmet si tebburt, s lekni; init: nendem. Ad awen Nsemmeê tuccva nnwen, a Nernu i iâaôviyen".

verses.translation: Wid idensen bedlen awal, ur d win i sen nnan. Nessers ed, i wid idensen, tawa$it seg igenni, ilmend n tucmitin nnsen.

verses.translation: Mi issuter Musa aman i ugdud is, Nenna: "ewwet aéôu, s uâkkwaz ik". Feggvent ed, segs, mrawsnat tliwa. Yal wa iéôa anda ara issew. "Eççet, esswet, si ôôeéq n Öebbi. Ur ssefsadet di tmurt am imjaêen".

verses.text: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur nesteqnaâ bippa s yiwen n lqut. Nuj a$ Mass ik, ad a$ d Issuffe$ ayen d teggar tmurt: tizzegzewt is, axyaô is, ticcert is, laâds is, lebûel is". Inna: "teb$am a pbedlem ayen ilhan s wayen ixuûen? Üûubbet ar Maûeô, a n tafem, war ccekk, ayen tessutrem". I$li d fellasen ddell akked ééelt. Sebbeben d urrif n Öebbi. Ayagi, acku llan ugin issekniyen n Öebbi, neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi âuûan, u zgaren tilas.
verses.translation: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur nesteqnaâ bippa s yiwen n lqut. Nuj a$ Mass ik, ad a$ d Issuffe$ ayen d teggar tmurt: tizzegzewt is, axyaô is, ticcert is, laâds is, lebûel is". Inna: "teb$am a pbedlem ayen ilhan s wayen ixuûen? Üûubbet ar Maûeô, a n tafem, war ccekk, ayen tessutrem". I$li d fellasen ddell akked ééelt. Sebbeben d urrif n Öebbi. Ayagi, acku llan ugin issekniyen n Öebbi, neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi âuûan, u zgaren tilas.

verses.text: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, imasiêiyen, iûabiyen, kra iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad sâun arraz ar Mass nnsen, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, imasiêiyen, iûabiyen, kra iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad sâun arraz ar Mass nnsen, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: Mi Nga laâqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eîîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, mmektit ed i illan degs, amar a pêezzbem".
verses.translation: Mi Nga laâqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eîîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, mmektit ed i illan degs, amar a pêezzbem".

verses.text: Sinna, deffir waya, twexxôem. Lemmer maççi d lfevl n Öebbi fellawen, akked uêunu S, a ppilim seg imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Sinna, deffir waya, twexxôem. Lemmer maççi d lfevl n Öebbi fellawen, akked uêunu S, a ppilim seg imexsuôen.

verses.text: Ni$ tessnem wid, segwen, iccven di Ssebt. Nenna yasen: "ilit d iddawen imaâfan"!
verses.translation: Ni$ tessnem wid, segwen, iccven di Ssebt. Nenna yasen: "ilit d iddawen imaâfan"!

verses.text: Nerra p d amedya i imuddiren akked wid i ten id ineûfen, u d aâggen i wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Nerra p d amedya i imuddiren akked wid i ten id ineûfen, u d aâggen i wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "Öebbi, s tidep, Iumeô awen d a ppezlum tafunast". Nnan: "day a tettihiv fella$"? Inna: "ad iyi Isseô Öebbi! Ur ppili$ seg at war tussna".
verses.translation: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "Öebbi, s tidep, Iumeô awen d a ppezlum tafunast". Nnan: "day a tettihiv fella$"? Inna: "ad iyi Isseô Öebbi! Ur ppili$ seg at war tussna".

verses.text: Nnan: "nuj a$ ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen anta p". Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: tafunast ur wessret, ur meééiyet, garasen. Xedmet i wen d ippumôen".
verses.translation: Nnan: "nuj a$ ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen anta p". Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: tafunast ur wessret, ur meééiyet, garasen. Xedmet i wen d ippumôen".

verses.text: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen ini s". Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: d tafunast tawôa$t, ini imfeooeo, ad iaâoeb w ip iwalan".
verses.translation: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen ini s". Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: d tafunast tawôa$t, ini imfeooeo, ad iaâoeb w ip iwalan".

verses.text: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen anta p. £uône$, s tidep, tistan ppemcabint. Ih, ma Ib$a Öebbi, a nepwanhu".
verses.translation: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen anta p. £uône$, s tidep, tistan ppemcabint. Ih, ma Ib$a Öebbi, a nepwanhu".

verses.text: Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: d tafunast ur taâtib si tyerza n tmurt, ne$ si tissit n yigran, tûeêêa, ur tepwacôev". Nnan as: "tura, tebbwiv d tidep". Zlan p. Qôib ur ewqimen.
verses.translation: Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: d tafunast ur taâtib si tyerza n tmurt, ne$ si tissit n yigran, tûeêêa, ur tepwacôev". Nnan as: "tura, tebbwiv d tidep". Zlan p. Qôib ur ewqimen.

verses.text: Mi ten$am yiwen, wa irra p id $ef wa. Öebbi Issuffe$ ed ayen teppeffrem.
verses.translation: Mi ten$am yiwen, wa irra p id $ef wa. Öebbi Issuffe$ ed ayen teppeffrem.

verses.text: Nenna: "ewwtet ep s kra ines". Akka i Issidir Öebbi lmeggtin. Issenâat awen issekniyen iS, amar a pfehmem.
verses.translation: Nenna: "ewwtet ep s kra ines". Akka i Issidir Öebbi lmeggtin. Issenâat awen issekniyen iS, amar a pfehmem.

verses.text: Sinna, deffir waya, qquôen wulawen nnwen; cuban aéôu, ne$ kteô, di ta$eôt. Ih, llan iéôa iseg d pfeggiven isaffen. Llan, s tidep, wid ipceqqiqen, teff$en d waman segsen. S tidep, llan wid i$ellin si tugwdi n Öebbi. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Sinna, deffir waya, qquôen wulawen nnwen; cuban aéôu, ne$ kteô, di ta$eôt. Ih, llan iéôa iseg d pfeggiven isaffen. Llan, s tidep, wid ipceqqiqen, teff$en d waman segsen. S tidep, llan wid i$ellin si tugwdi n Öebbi. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Day tôe$bem a kwen amnen? Ni$ arbaâ, segsen, ssemêasen i wawal n Öebbi, sinna, mi t fehmen, ad as bedlen udem, u nitni éôan.
verses.translation: Day tôe$bem a kwen amnen? Ni$ arbaâ, segsen, ssemêasen i wawal n Öebbi, sinna, mi t fehmen, ad as bedlen udem, u nitni éôan.

verses.text: Mi mmugren wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mi qqimen garasen, qqaôen: "day ad asen tinim ayen i wen Imla Öebbi, a kwen nna$en yis, ar Mass nnwen? Day ur tepmeyyizem ara"?
verses.translation: Mi mmugren wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mi qqimen garasen, qqaôen: "day ad asen tinim ayen i wen Imla Öebbi, a kwen nna$en yis, ar Mass nnwen? Day ur tepmeyyizem ara"?

verses.text: Ne$ ur éôin ara, Öebbi Issen ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaôen.
verses.translation: Ne$ ur éôin ara, Öebbi Issen ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaôen.

verses.text: Garasen, at war ta$uôi, ur nessin Tazmamt, siwa ayen nnwan. Nitni $ilen kan.
verses.translation: Garasen, at war ta$uôi, ur nessin Tazmamt, siwa ayen nnwan. Nitni $ilen kan.

verses.text: A tawa$it n wid ipparun Tazmamt s ifassen nnsen, sinna, qqaôen: "ayagi s$uô Öebbi", iwakken ad a$en, yis, ayen ôxisen! A tawa$it nnsen, ilmend n wayen uran ifassen nnsen! A tawa$it nnsen, $ef wayen keppben!
verses.translation: A tawa$it n wid ipparun Tazmamt s ifassen nnsen, sinna, qqaôen: "ayagi s$uô Öebbi", iwakken ad a$en, yis, ayen ôxisen! A tawa$it nnsen, ilmend n wayen uran ifassen nnsen! A tawa$it nnsen, $ef wayen keppben!

verses.text: Nnan: "ur a$ tepnal tmes, d awez$i, siwa kra n wussan". Ini: "day teîîfem lemâahda s$uô Öebbi? Öebbi, d awez$i, ur Izeggil lemâahda S. Ne$ teqqaôem, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
verses.translation: Nnan: "ur a$ tepnal tmes, d awez$i, siwa kra n wussan". Ini: "day teîîfem lemâahda s$uô Öebbi? Öebbi, d awez$i, ur Izeggil lemâahda S. Ne$ teqqaôem, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?

verses.text: Xaîi, win ikesben tucmip, u tennev as tuccva s…, widak, d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Xaîi, win ikesben tucmip, u tennev as tuccva s…, widak, d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, widak, d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, widak, d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Mi Nga laâqed i At Isôail: "ur âabdet siwa Öebbi. Elhut ar imawlan, ar llzem nnwen, ar igujilen, ar igellilen. Init i medden, awal imaânen. èéÈallet, zekkit". Sinna, twexxôem, siwa kra segwen, u, kunwi, tnumrem.
verses.translation: Mi Nga laâqed i At Isôail: "ur âabdet siwa Öebbi. Elhut ar imawlan, ar llzem nnwen, ar igujilen, ar igellilen. Init i medden, awal imaânen. èéÈallet, zekkit". Sinna, twexxôem, siwa kra segwen, u, kunwi, tnumrem.

verses.text: Mi wen Nga laâqed nnwen: "ur zzazalet idim nnwen, ur pemssuffu$et seg ixxamen nnwen". D$a twefqem, kunwi d inagan.
verses.translation: Mi wen Nga laâqed nnwen: "ur zzazalet idim nnwen, ur pemssuffu$et seg ixxamen nnwen". D$a twefqem, kunwi d inagan.

verses.text: Sinna, kunwi d wid immin$en, tessuff$em arbaâ segwen, seg ixxamen nnsen. Tezzim asen s ibekkaven akked taâdawt. Ma usan kwen id, d imeêbas, tfeddum ten. Irna, ipwagdel awen usuffe$ nnsen. Day tumnem deg uêric n Tezmamt, tnekôem wayev? Anwa ay d arraz n wid, segwen, ixedmen aya, ma maççi d ddell, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u, ass n tnekra, ad ppunefken i uâaqeb uqsiê mavi? Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Sinna, kunwi d wid immin$en, tessuff$em arbaâ segwen, seg ixxamen nnsen. Tezzim asen s ibekkaven akked taâdawt. Ma usan kwen id, d imeêbas, tfeddum ten. Irna, ipwagdel awen usuffe$ nnsen. Day tumnem deg uêric n Tezmamt, tnekôem wayev? Anwa ay d arraz n wid, segwen, ixedmen aya, ma maççi d ddell, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u, ass n tnekra, ad ppunefken i uâaqeb uqsiê mavi? Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Widak d wid iu$en tudert n ddunit s laxeôt, ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur ppusellken.
verses.translation: Widak d wid iu$en tudert n ddunit s laxeôt, ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur ppusellken.

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Nuzen ed imazanen, deffir es. Nefka abeggen i Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Null it s ôôuê iqedsen. Yal tikelt ideg ara kwen id ias umazan, s wayen ur awen nehwi, tesme$wôem iman nnwen. Kra teskaddbem ten, kra ten$am ten.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Nuzen ed imazanen, deffir es. Nefka abeggen i Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Null it s ôôuê iqedsen. Yal tikelt ideg ara kwen id ias umazan, s wayen ur awen nehwi, tesme$wôem iman nnwen. Kra teskaddbem ten, kra ten$am ten.

verses.text: Nnan: "ulawen nne$ qquôen". Xaîi, Ixza ten Öebbi, ilmend n tijehli nnsen. Drus iten wid iumnen.
verses.translation: Nnan: "ulawen nne$ qquôen". Xaîi, Ixza ten Öebbi, ilmend n tijehli nnsen. Drus iten wid iumnen.

verses.text: Mi ten id tusa Tezmamt, s$uô Öebbi, d atebbet n wayen illan $uôsen, - u llan, iu$ lêal, ssuturen ad $elben wid ijehlen - mi ten id iusa wayen ssnen, ugin t. Ad Inâal Öebbi ijehliyen!
verses.translation: Mi ten id tusa Tezmamt, s$uô Öebbi, d atebbet n wayen illan $uôsen, - u llan, iu$ lêal, ssuturen ad $elben wid ijehlen - mi ten id iusa wayen ssnen, ugin t. Ad Inâal Öebbi ijehliyen!

verses.text: I icmet wayen i$ef zzenzen iman nnsen! Ugin ayen id Issers Öebbi. Ëesden mi id Issers Öebbi, si lfevl iS, i win i S ihwan n yimdanen iS. Sebbeben urrif ar wayev. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb isdullun.
verses.translation: I icmet wayen i$ef zzenzen iman nnsen! Ugin ayen id Issers Öebbi. Ëesden mi id Issers Öebbi, si lfevl iS, i win i S ihwan n yimdanen iS. Sebbeben urrif ar wayev. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb isdullun.

verses.text: Ma nnan asen: "amnet s wayen id Issers Öebbi"! A d inin: "numen s wayen id irsen $uône$". Nekôen ayen i t id itebâan, u neppa d tidep, d atebbet n wayen illan $uôsen. Ini: "acimi tneqqem lambiyya n Öebbi, zik, ma d lmumnin ay tellam"?
verses.translation: Ma nnan asen: "amnet s wayen id Issers Öebbi"! A d inin: "numen s wayen id irsen $uône$". Nekôen ayen i t id itebâan, u neppa d tidep, d atebbet n wayen illan $uôsen. Ini: "acimi tneqqem lambiyya n Öebbi, zik, ma d lmumnin ay tellam"?

verses.text: Ni$ iusa kwen id Musa, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir es, teddam akked uâajmi. Kunwi d imednas.
verses.translation: Ni$ iusa kwen id Musa, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir es, teddam akked uâajmi. Kunwi d imednas.

verses.text: Mi Nga laâqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eîîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, u ssemêesset". Nnan d: "nesla u nâuûa". Ikecm asen uâajmi ar wul, si tjehli nnsen. Ini: "dir it wayen i wen iumeô liman nnwen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
verses.translation: Mi Nga laâqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eîîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, u ssemêesset". Nnan d: "nesla u nâuûa". Ikecm asen uâajmi ar wul, si tjehli nnsen. Ini: "dir it wayen i wen iumeô liman nnwen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".

verses.text: Ini: "maday, ar Öebbi, axxam aneggaru i kunwi kan, ur pkkan ara imdanen, mennit tameppant, ma tessawalem tidep"!
verses.translation: Ini: "maday, ar Öebbi, axxam aneggaru i kunwi kan, ur pkkan ara imdanen, mennit tameppant, ma tessawalem tidep"!

verses.text: D awez$i, ur p pmennin, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnsen. Öebbi Issen imednas.
verses.translation: D awez$i, ur p pmennin, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnsen. Öebbi Issen imednas.

verses.text: A ten tafev, war ccekk, êemmlen tameddurt sennig medden, sennig imcurak. Atan yiwen segsen, issaram ad idder agim iseggwasen. Te$wzi n laâmeô is, ur as tessifrir aâaqeb. Öebbi Ipwali ayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: A ten tafev, war ccekk, êemmlen tameddurt sennig medden, sennig imcurak. Atan yiwen segsen, issaram ad idder agim iseggwasen. Te$wzi n laâmeô is, ur as tessifrir aâaqeb. Öebbi Ipwali ayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Ini: "anwa illan d acengu n Jebrayen"? D neppa, s tidep, it id issersen $ef wul ik, s leb$i n Öebbi. D atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d nnhaya u d abecceô n lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ini: "anwa illan d acengu n Jebrayen"? D neppa, s tidep, it id issersen $ef wul ik, s leb$i n Öebbi. D atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d nnhaya u d abecceô n lmumnin.

verses.text: Win illan d acengu n Öebbi, lmalayek iS, imazanen iS, Jebrayen, Mikail…, ihi, Öebbi d acengu ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Win illan d acengu n Öebbi, lmalayek iS, imazanen iS, Jebrayen, Mikail…, ihi, Öebbi d acengu ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ni$ Nessers ak d issekniyen iberrzen. I ten inekôen, siwa iballa$en.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nessers ak d issekniyen iberrzen. I ten inekôen, siwa iballa$en.

verses.text: Day yal tikelt ideg ara gen laâqed, a t ixdaâ urbaâ segsen? Ih, tegwti segsen, ur uminen.
verses.translation: Day yal tikelt ideg ara gen laâqed, a t ixdaâ urbaâ segsen? Ih, tegwti segsen, ur uminen.

verses.text: Mi ten id iusa umazan s$uô Öebbi, itebbet ayen illan $uôsen, arbaâ n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, rran Tazmamt n Öebbi s azagur nnsen, amzun ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Mi ten id iusa umazan s$uô Öebbi, itebbet ayen illan $uôsen, arbaâ n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, rran Tazmamt n Öebbi s azagur nnsen, amzun ur ssinen.

verses.text: Ddan akked wayen xedmen ccwaîen mgal tagelda n Sliman. Sliman ur ijhil. Maca ccwaîen jehlen. Sseêfaven i medden ssêur, akked wayen id irsen, di Babil, ar lmalayek Harut akked Marut. Ur sselmaden yiwen, mebla ma nnan: "nekwni n$ewwu kan, ur jehhel"! ÊÊÊËefven, $uôsen, amek ara ssemfaôaqen argaz akked tmeîîut is. Ur îîurun yiwen syis, siwa ma Ib$a Öebbi. ÊÊÊËefven ara ten ivuôôen, ur ten ineffaâ. Ni$ éôan ar win i p iu$en, ur as illi umur di laxeôt. War ccekk, ard ucmit wayen is zzenzen leôwaê nnsen, lemmer éôin!
verses.translation: Ddan akked wayen xedmen ccwaîen mgal tagelda n Sliman. Sliman ur ijhil. Maca ccwaîen jehlen. Sseêfaven i medden ssêur, akked wayen id irsen, di Babil, ar lmalayek Harut akked Marut. Ur sselmaden yiwen, mebla ma nnan: "nekwni n$ewwu kan, ur jehhel"! ÊÊÊËefven, $uôsen, amek ara ssemfaôaqen argaz akked tmeîîut is. Ur îîurun yiwen syis, siwa ma Ib$a Öebbi. ÊÊÊËefven ara ten ivuôôen, ur ten ineffaâ. Ni$ éôan ar win i p iu$en, ur as illi umur di laxeôt. War ccekk, ard ucmit wayen is zzenzen leôwaê nnsen, lemmer éôin!

verses.text: Lemmer, s tidep, uminen u êezzben, ad ifrir warraz s$uô Öebbi, lemmer ssinen.
verses.translation: Lemmer, s tidep, uminen u êezzben, ad ifrir warraz s$uô Öebbi, lemmer ssinen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur qqaret: "Âass a$ d", init: "Wali a$ d", u ssemêesset. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur qqaret: "Âass a$ d", init: "Wali a$ d", u ssemêesset. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ur b$in ara ijehliyen, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, akked imcurak, ad awen d irs kra n lxiô, s$uô Mass nnwen. Öebbi Ismenyaf, s uêunu S, win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Ur b$in ara ijehliyen, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, akked imcurak, ad awen d irs kra n lxiô, s$uô Mass nnwen. Öebbi Ismenyaf, s uêunu S, win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Ur Nessemsay assekni, ne$ ur t Nesseppu, mebla ma Nebbwi d win it yifen, ne$ i t icban. Day ur teéôiv ara Öebbi Izmer i yal cci?
verses.translation: Ur Nessemsay assekni, ne$ ur t Nesseppu, mebla ma Nebbwi d win it yifen, ne$ i t icban. Day ur teéôiv ara Öebbi Izmer i yal cci?

verses.text: Day ur teéôiv ara, ar n Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Ur tesâim, war Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.
verses.translation: Day ur teéôiv ara, ar n Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Ur tesâim, war Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.

verses.text: Ne$ teb$am a ppesteqsim Amazan nnwen, akken ippusteqsa, zik, Musa? Win ibeddlen liman s tijehli, innetlaf ar yir abrid.
verses.translation: Ne$ teb$am a ppesteqsim Amazan nnwen, akken ippusteqsa, zik, Musa? Win ibeddlen liman s tijehli, innetlaf ar yir abrid.

verses.text: Si leêsed nnsen, aîas seg wAt Tezmamt, mi sen d tban tidep, budden awen tijehli, mbaâd liman nnwen. Ssemêet, ssemsut, ar d Ias Öebbi s lameô iS. Ni$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Si leêsed nnsen, aîas seg wAt Tezmamt, mi sen d tban tidep, budden awen tijehli, mbaâd liman nnwen. Ssemêet, ssemsut, ar d Ias Öebbi s lameô iS. Ni$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: èéallet, zekkit. Ayen ara tezzewrem n lxiô i iman nnwen, a t tafem ar Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ayen akw txeddmem.
verses.translation: èéallet, zekkit. Ayen ara tezzewrem n lxiô i iman nnwen, a t tafem ar Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ayen akw txeddmem.

verses.text: Nnan: "ur ikeççem Loennet, siwa win illan d uday, ne$ d amasiêi". D wagi ay d asirem nnsen. Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tidep".
verses.translation: Nnan: "ur ikeççem Loennet, siwa win illan d uday, ne$ d amasiêi". D wagi ay d asirem nnsen. Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tidep".

verses.text: Xaîi, win iunzen i Öebbi, u d aâôvi, ad isâu arraz is, ar Mass is. Ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: Xaîi, win iunzen i Öebbi, u d aâôvi, ad isâu arraz is, ar Mass is. Ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: Nnan wudayen: "imasiêiyen ur sennden s acemma". Nnan imasiêiyen: "udayen ur sennden s acemma". U nitni la qqaôen Tazmamt. Akka, wid ur nessin ara, nnan am nitni. Ad Iêudd Öebbi, garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.
verses.translation: Nnan wudayen: "imasiêiyen ur sennden s acemma". Nnan imasiêiyen: "udayen ur sennden s acemma". U nitni la qqaôen Tazmamt. Akka, wid ur nessin ara, nnan am nitni. Ad Iêudd Öebbi, garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.

verses.text: Anwa idensen sennig wid igedlen, di leowamaâ n Öebbi, asmekti n yisem iS, u lhan d deg ussexôeb nnsen? Widak, ur iwata ara a ten kecmen, siwa ma s tugwdi. I nitni, ddell di ddunit, u aâaqeb abarar di laxeôt.
verses.translation: Anwa idensen sennig wid igedlen, di leowamaâ n Öebbi, asmekti n yisem iS, u lhan d deg ussexôeb nnsen? Widak, ur iwata ara a ten kecmen, siwa ma s tugwdi. I nitni, ddell di ddunit, u aâaqeb abarar di laxeôt.

verses.text: N Öebbi agmuv akked utaram. Ar wanda tezzim, din Udem n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: N Öebbi agmuv akked utaram. Ar wanda tezzim, din Udem n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Nnan: "Öebbi Isâa mmi S". Gedha s yiS! Ni$ ineS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Akw, péallan i Neppa,
verses.translation: Nnan: "Öebbi Isâa mmi S". Gedha s yiS! Ni$ ineS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Akw, péallan i Neppa,

verses.text: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Ma Iseyya lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.
verses.translation: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Ma Iseyya lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.

verses.text: Nnan wid ur nessin: "a lemmer ad a$ d Immeslay Öebbi, ne$ ad a$ d ias ussekni"! Akka ay nnan wid i ten id izwaren, am awalen nnsen. Ppemcabin wulawen nnsen. Ni$ Nbeggen ed issekniyen i ugdud ipputebbten.
verses.translation: Nnan wid ur nessin: "a lemmer ad a$ d Immeslay Öebbi, ne$ ad a$ d ias ussekni"! Akka ay nnan wid i ten id izwaren, am awalen nnsen. Ppemcabin wulawen nnsen. Ni$ Nbeggen ed issekniyen i ugdud ipputebbten.

verses.text: Ih, Nuzen ik id, s tidep, d abcir, u d aneddaô. Ur ippili fellak usteqsi $ef at wu$ud.
verses.translation: Ih, Nuzen ik id, s tidep, d abcir, u d aneddaô. Ur ippili fellak usteqsi $ef at wu$ud.

verses.text: Ur k pôavin wudayen ne$ imasiêiyen, alamma teddiv d ddin nnsen. Ini: "d nehhu n Öebbi ay d nehhu". Ma teddiv akked usirem nnsen, deffir wayen ik ed iusan n tmusni, ur k ipfukku, si Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.
verses.translation: Ur k pôavin wudayen ne$ imasiêiyen, alamma teddiv d ddin nnsen. Ini: "d nehhu n Öebbi ay d nehhu". Ma teddiv akked usirem nnsen, deffir wayen ik ed iusan n tmusni, ur k ipfukku, si Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.

verses.text: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, qqaôen p leqôaya iwatan. Widak umnen yis. Wid i p iugin, widak d imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, qqaôen p leqôaya iwatan. Widak umnen yis. Wid i p iugin, widak d imexsuôen.

verses.text: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is i kwen £ate$. Nek, Smenyafe$ kwen i imavalen.
verses.translation: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is i kwen £ate$. Nek, Smenyafe$ kwen i imavalen.

verses.text: Ëezzbet i wass ideg ur ippuqeîîi yiwen, deg umkan n wayev, s wacemma; ur tepwaqbal le$ôama segs, ur t tenfaâ ccafuâa, ur ppusellken.
verses.translation: Ëezzbet i wass ideg ur ippuqeîîi yiwen, deg umkan n wayev, s wacemma; ur tepwaqbal le$ôama segs, ur t tenfaâ ccafuâa, ur ppusellken.

verses.text: Ibôahim, mi t Ijeôôeb Mass is, s wawalen, iu$ awal. Inna: "Nek, a k Rre$ d win ara inehhun medden". Inna: "u si tarwa w"? Inna: "lemâahda W ur taâna ara imednas".
verses.translation: Ibôahim, mi t Ijeôôeb Mass is, s wawalen, iu$ awal. Inna: "Nek, a k Rre$ d win ara inehhun medden". Inna: "u si tarwa w"? Inna: "lemâahda W ur taâna ara imednas".

verses.text: Mi Nerra Axxam d lemqam i yimdanen, u d amkan n laman: "erret lemqam n Ibôahim d loamaâ"! Nâuhed i Ibôahim akked Ismaâil: "zzizdget Axxam iW, i wid idewwiôen, wid ip$imin, wid iîîinizen, wid ikennun".
verses.translation: Mi Nerra Axxam d lemqam i yimdanen, u d amkan n laman: "erret lemqam n Ibôahim d loamaâ"! Nâuhed i Ibôahim akked Ismaâil: "zzizdget Axxam iW, i wid idewwiôen, wid ip$imin, wid iîîinizen, wid ikennun".

verses.text: Mi inna Ibôahim: "a Mass iw! Err wagi d tamdint n laman, £it imezda$ is s ppemôat; wid, segsen, iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru". Inna: "win ijehlen, a t Ooe$ ad izhu cwiî, sinna, a t Nehôe$ ar uâaqeb n tmes. A tu$alin tucmip"!
verses.translation: Mi inna Ibôahim: "a Mass iw! Err wagi d tamdint n laman, £it imezda$ is s ppemôat; wid, segsen, iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru". Inna: "win ijehlen, a t Ooe$ ad izhu cwiî, sinna, a t Nehôe$ ar uâaqeb n tmes. A tu$alin tucmip"!

verses.text: Ibôahim akked Ismaâil, mi ssalayen leêyuv n Uxxam: "a Mass nne$! Eqbel s$uône$, Keçç, s tidep, d Win Isellen, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ibôahim akked Ismaâil, mi ssalayen leêyuv n Uxxam: "a Mass nne$! Eqbel s$uône$, Keçç, s tidep, d Win Isellen, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Err ane$ d imvuâen iK, u, si dderya nne$, lois ar aK ianzen. Mel a$ isekkiren nne$, Ssuref a$. Keçç, s tidep, Tessurufev, Tepêunuv.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Err ane$ d imvuâen iK, u, si dderya nne$, lois ar aK ianzen. Mel a$ isekkiren nne$, Ssuref a$. Keçç, s tidep, Tessurufev, Tepêunuv.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Azen asen d amazan segsen, ad asen iqqaô issekniyen iK, ad asen isseêfev Tazmamt akked ûûwab, a ten izzizdeg. Keçç, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Azen asen d amazan segsen, ad asen iqqaô issekniyen iK, ad asen isseêfev Tazmamt akked ûûwab, a ten izzizdeg. Keçç, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".

verses.text: Anwa iugin ddin n Ibôahim, siwa win iccemten iman is? Ni$ Nefren it di ddunit. Di laxeôt, neppa, war ccekk, seg iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Anwa iugin ddin n Ibôahim, siwa win iccemten iman is? Ni$ Nefren it di ddunit. Di laxeôt, neppa, war ccekk, seg iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Mi s Inna Mass is: "anez"! Inna: "unze$ aS i Mass imavalen".
verses.translation: Mi s Inna Mass is: "anez"! Inna: "unze$ aS i Mass imavalen".

verses.text: Iweûûa yis Ibôahim arraw is - akken Iaâqub -: "a yarraw iw, Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren awen ddin, ur ppemmtet siwa ma tunzem".
verses.translation: Iweûûa yis Ibôahim arraw is - akken Iaâqub -: "a yarraw iw, Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren awen ddin, ur ppemmtet siwa ma tunzem".

verses.text: Ne$ tellam d inagan mi d ters tmeppant ar Yaâqub, mi inna i tarwa s: "anwa ara tâabdem deffir i"? Nnan: "a naâbed Öebbi k, u Öebbi n lejdud ik: Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq. Öebbi Yiwen. Nekwni nunez aS".
verses.translation: Ne$ tellam d inagan mi d ters tmeppant ar Yaâqub, mi inna i tarwa s: "anwa ara tâabdem deffir i"? Nnan: "a naâbed Öebbi k, u Öebbi n lejdud ik: Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq. Öebbi Yiwen. Nekwni nunez aS".

verses.text: Wigi d lois i iâaddan. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur kwen steqsayen $ef wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Wigi d lois i iâaddan. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur kwen steqsayen $ef wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Nnan: "ilit d udayen ne$ d imasiêiyen, a ppepwanhum". Ini: "Xaîi, maca ddin n Ibôahim, imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak".
verses.translation: Nnan: "ilit d udayen ne$ d imasiêiyen, a ppepwanhum". Ini: "Xaîi, maca ddin n Ibôahim, imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak".

verses.text: Init: "numen s Öebbi akked wayen id irsen $uône$, wayen id irsen ar Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, ayen ippunefken i Musa, Âisa, ayen ippunefken i lambiyya, s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur nessemgarrad yiwen segsen, nekwni nunez aS".
verses.translation: Init: "numen s Öebbi akked wayen id irsen $uône$, wayen id irsen ar Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, ayen ippunefken i Musa, Âisa, ayen ippunefken i lambiyya, s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur nessemgarrad yiwen segsen, nekwni nunez aS".

verses.text: Ma umnen ayen icuban ayen tumnem, atnan pwanhan. Ma wexxôen, haaten kan di lefôaq. Iqadd ik Öebbi, segsen. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ma umnen ayen icuban ayen tumnem, atnan pwanhan. Ma wexxôen, haaten kan di lefôaq. Iqadd ik Öebbi, segsen. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ssbi$a, n Öebbi. Anwa yifen Öebbi i ssbi$a? Nekwni d iâabbaden iS.
verses.translation: Ssbi$a, n Öebbi. Anwa yifen Öebbi i ssbi$a? Nekwni d iâabbaden iS.

verses.text: Ini: "day ad a$ tnamrem $ef Öebbi, u Neppa d Mass nne$, u d Mass nnwen? I nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Nekwni d izedganen iS".
verses.translation: Ini: "day ad a$ tnamrem $ef Öebbi, u Neppa d Mass nne$, u d Mass nnwen? I nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Nekwni d izedganen iS".

verses.text: Ne$ a d tinim: "s tidep, Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, llan d udayen, ne$ d imasiêiyen"? Ini: "Anwa i isnen sennig akw, d kunwi ne$ d Öebbi"? Anwa i idensen sennig win iffren ccada, i isâa s$uô Öebbi? Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ne$ a d tinim: "s tidep, Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, llan d udayen, ne$ d imasiêiyen"? Ini: "Anwa i isnen sennig akw, d kunwi ne$ d Öebbi"? Anwa i idensen sennig win iffren ccada, i isâa s$uô Öebbi? Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Asatu agi iâadda. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur fellawen asteqsi $ef wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Asatu agi iâadda. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur fellawen asteqsi $ef wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Ad inin ije$lufen, ger medden: "acu iten iswexxôen si lqibla nnsen, u$uô llan péallan"? Ini: "N Öebbi agmuv akked utaram. Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim".
verses.translation: Ad inin ije$lufen, ger medden: "acu iten iswexxôen si lqibla nnsen, u$uô llan péallan"? Ini: "N Öebbi agmuv akked utaram. Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim".

verses.text: Akka ay kwen Nerra d lois alemmas, iwakken a ppilim d inagan n medden, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen. Nerra lqibla u$uô teppezziv, iwakken kan a Néeô anwa iddan d Umazan, anwa iu$alen ar deffir. D lhejna, siwa i wid Inha Öebbi. Ur Iveggiâ Öebbi liman nnwen. Ih, Öebbi, i yimdanen, d Umâin, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Akka ay kwen Nerra d lois alemmas, iwakken a ppilim d inagan n medden, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen. Nerra lqibla u$uô teppezziv, iwakken kan a Néeô anwa iddan d Umazan, anwa iu$alen ar deffir. D lhejna, siwa i wid Inha Öebbi. Ur Iveggiâ Öebbi liman nnwen. Ih, Öebbi, i yimdanen, d Umâin, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ni$ Nwala, tezziv udem ik ar igenni. A k Nawi ar lqibla ara tôaviv. Ezzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen $uôes. Ih, wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, éôan p d tidep s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nwala, tezziv udem ik ar igenni. A k Nawi ar lqibla ara tôaviv. Ezzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen $uôes. Ih, wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, éôan p d tidep s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Xas a d tawiv, i wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, yal assekni, ur tezzin ar lqibla k. Keçç, ur tezzi ar lqibla nnsen. Kra segsen, ur tezzin ar lqibla n wiyav. Ma teddiv akked usirem nnsen, mbaâd ma tusa k id, s$uône£, tussna, a ppiliv, imiren, seg imednas.
verses.translation: Xas a d tawiv, i wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, yal assekni, ur tezzin ar lqibla k. Keçç, ur tezzi ar lqibla nnsen. Kra segsen, ur tezzin ar lqibla n wiyav. Ma teddiv akked usirem nnsen, mbaâd ma tusa k id, s$uône£, tussna, a ppiliv, imiren, seg imednas.

verses.text: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt ssnen p, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. War ccekk, arbaâ segsen teffren tidep, u nitni éôan.
verses.translation: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt ssnen p, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. War ccekk, arbaâ segsen teffren tidep, u nitni éôan.

verses.text: Tidep s$uô Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.
verses.translation: Tidep s$uô Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.

verses.text: I yal yiwen, loiha u$uô izzi. Sâut timenyugert ar lxiô. Anda teddam, ad Yili Öebbi yidwen akw. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: I yal yiwen, loiha u$uô izzi. Sâut timenyugert ar lxiô. Anda teddam, ad Yili Öebbi yidwen akw. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ansi d tusiv, ezzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Neppat, ih, d tidep s$uô Mass ik. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ansi d tusiv, ezzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Neppat, ih, d tidep s$uô Mass ik. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ansi d tef$ev, zzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen nnwen $uôes, iwakken ur kwen pnamaren imdanen, siwa wid idensen, segsen. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI. Ad awen Time$ l$it iW, amar a ppepwanhum.
verses.translation: Ansi d tef$ev, zzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen nnwen $uôes, iwakken ur kwen pnamaren imdanen, siwa wid idensen, segsen. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI. Ad awen Time$ l$it iW, amar a ppepwanhum.

verses.text: Akken i wen Nuzen Amazan segwen, immal awen issekniyen nne£, izzizdig ikwen, isselmad awen Tazmamt, akked ûûwab; isselmad awen ayen ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Akken i wen Nuzen Amazan segwen, immal awen issekniyen nne£, izzizdig ikwen, isselmad awen Tazmamt, akked ûûwab; isselmad awen ayen ur tessinem.

verses.text: Mmektit iyI d, a kwen id Mmekti$. Snemmret iyI, ur jehlet.
verses.translation: Mmektit iyI d, a kwen id Mmekti$. Snemmret iyI, ur jehlet.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ssutret tallalt, s ûûbeô akked téallit. Ih, Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ssutret tallalt, s ûûbeô akked téallit. Ih, Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.

verses.text: Ur qqaôet mmuten wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi. Xaîi d imuddiren, maca ur teêûim ara.
verses.translation: Ur qqaôet mmuten wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi. Xaîi d imuddiren, maca ur teêûim ara.

verses.text: War ccekk, a kwen Njeôôeb s kra usigwed, n llaé, n nneqs n wayla, n leôwaê, n l$ellat. Ssefreê iûebôiyen;
verses.translation: War ccekk, a kwen Njeôôeb s kra usigwed, n llaé, n nneqs n wayla, n leôwaê, n l$ellat. Ssefreê iûebôiyen;

verses.text: Wid, ma u$en tawa$it, qqaôen: "nekwni n Öebbi, nekwni, a nu$al $uôeS".
verses.translation: Wid, ma u$en tawa$it, qqaôen: "nekwni n Öebbi, nekwni, a nu$al $uôeS".

verses.text: Widak, fellasen téilla s$uô Mass nnsen, akked uêunu. Widak d wid ipwanhan.
verses.translation: Widak, fellasen téilla s$uô Mass nnsen, akked uêunu. Widak d wid ipwanhan.

verses.text: Ih, ÛÜafa akked Meôwa, seg isekkiren n Öebbi. Win iêuoen s Axxam, ne$ iéuô it, ulac u$ilif fellas, ma izzi yasent. Yif it win izzin, s leb$i s. Ih, Öebbi Ippara tajmilt, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ih, ÛÜafa akked Meôwa, seg isekkiren n Öebbi. Win iêuoen s Axxam, ne$ iéuô it, ulac u$ilif fellas, ma izzi yasent. Yif it win izzin, s leb$i s. Ih, Öebbi Ippara tajmilt, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Nessers ubeggen akked nnhaya, mbaâd ma Nbeggen it i yimdanen, di Tezmamt, widak, Ixza iten Öebbi, xzan ten wid ixezzun.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Nessers ubeggen akked nnhaya, mbaâd ma Nbeggen it i yimdanen, di Tezmamt, widak, Ixza iten Öebbi, xzan ten wid ixezzun.

verses.text: Kkes ed wid inedmen u xedmen ayen ilhan, u beggnen d. Widak, ad asen Ssurfe$. Nek Ssurufe$, Pêunu$.
verses.translation: Kkes ed wid inedmen u xedmen ayen ilhan, u beggnen d. Widak, ad asen Ssurfe$. Nek Ssurufe$, Pêunu$.

verses.text: Ih, wid ijehlen u mmuten d ijehliyen, widak, fellasen xezzu n Öebbi, lmalayek, akked yimdanen, meôôa.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen u mmuten d ijehliyen, widak, fellasen xezzu n Öebbi, lmalayek, akked yimdanen, meôôa.

verses.text: Degs ad wekkôen. Ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur illi w ara ten id iwalin.
verses.translation: Degs ad wekkôen. Ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur illi w ara ten id iwalin.

verses.text: Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Aênin Ipêunun.
verses.translation: Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Aênin Ipêunun.

verses.text: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan: afraz ger yiv akked wass, lbabuô ippazalen di yill, s wayen infâan medden, ayen id Issers Öebbi n waman, seg igenni - Issidir yissen tamurt, deffir tmeppant is, Issenkar, degs, yal lweêc -, abeddel n wavu akked usigna i imuêepmen ad yili ger igenni akked tmurt. War cekk, ard issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
verses.translation: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan: afraz ger yiv akked wass, lbabuô ippazalen di yill, s wayen infâan medden, ayen id Issers Öebbi n waman, seg igenni - Issidir yissen tamurt, deffir tmeppant is, Issenkar, degs, yal lweêc -, abeddel n wavu akked usigna i imuêepmen ad yili ger igenni akked tmurt. War cekk, ard issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.

verses.text: Ger yimdanen, llan wid ippadamen tanudda, war Öebbi. Ëemmlen ten akken Ippuêemmel Öebbi. Wid iumnen zaden akken êemmlen Öebbi. Awufan wid idensen, mi walan aâaqeb, ad éôen ar tazmert akw n Öebbi, u Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.
verses.translation: Ger yimdanen, llan wid ippadamen tanudda, war Öebbi. Ëemmlen ten akken Ippuêemmel Öebbi. Wid iumnen zaden akken êemmlen Öebbi. Awufan wid idensen, mi walan aâaqeb, ad éôen ar tazmert akw n Öebbi, u Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.

verses.text: Mara zekkôen uvfiôen nnsen, wid ipwatebâan, u walan aâaqeb, u tfukk yidsen lemxalîa,
verses.translation: Mara zekkôen uvfiôen nnsen, wid ipwatebâan, u walan aâaqeb, u tfukk yidsen lemxalîa,

verses.text: ad inin uvfiôen: "a lemmer a nu$al, a ten nzekkeô akken i $ zekkôen"! Akka ay sen Issken Öebbi igiten nnsen. A yamxix nnsen, ur d teff$en si tmes!
verses.translation: ad inin uvfiôen: "a lemmer a nu$al, a ten nzekkeô akken i $ zekkôen"! Akka ay sen Issken Öebbi igiten nnsen. A yamxix nnsen, ur d teff$en si tmes!

verses.text: A yimdanen! Eççet seg wayen iêellen, imaânen, di tmurt. Ur teddut di lateô n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Eççet seg wayen iêellen, imaânen, di tmurt. Ur teddut di lateô n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ippameô awen kan tuccva, lâaô; a ppinim, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Ippameô awen kan tuccva, lâaô; a ppinim, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.

verses.text: Ma nnan asen: "ddut akked wayen id Issers Öebbi", a d inin: "xaîi, a neddu akked wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$". I ma llan imezwura nnsen ur meyyzen acemma, ur pwanhan?
verses.translation: Ma nnan asen: "ddut akked wayen id Issers Öebbi", a d inin: "xaîi, a neddu akked wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$". I ma llan imezwura nnsen ur meyyzen acemma, ur pwanhan?

verses.text: Amedya n wid ijehlen, d amedya n win u$uô ppu$un, seg akken ur issel, siwa i usu$u akked uberreê. D iâeééugen, d igugam, d ider$alen, nitni ur pmeyyizen.
verses.translation: Amedya n wid ijehlen, d amedya n win u$uô ppu$un, seg akken ur issel, siwa i usu$u akked uberreê. D iâeééugen, d igugam, d ider$alen, nitni ur pmeyyizen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Eççet si téidanin ikwen N$at. Snemmret Öebbi, ma d Neppa ay tâabdem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Eççet si téidanin ikwen N$at. Snemmret Öebbi, ma d Neppa ay tâabdem.

verses.text: I awen Igdel Öebbi, siwa loifa, idamen, aksum n yilef, akked îêegga i war Öebbi. Win terra tmara, ur ib$i, ur izgir tilas, ur illi d abekkav is. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: I awen Igdel Öebbi, siwa loifa, idamen, aksum n yilef, akked îêegga i war Öebbi. Win terra tmara, ur ib$i, ur izgir tilas, ur illi d abekkav is. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Issers Öebbi, si Tezmamt, ppa$en yis ayen ôxisen, widak, siwa times ara ççen, deg iâabbav nnsen. Ur asen Ipmeslay Öebbi, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Issers Öebbi, si Tezmamt, ppa$en yis ayen ôxisen, widak, siwa times ara ççen, deg iâabbav nnsen. Ur asen Ipmeslay Öebbi, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Widak, d wid iu$en ttelfan s nnhaya, aâaqeb s ssmaê. Acu ara ten iûebbôen si tmes?
verses.translation: Widak, d wid iu$en ttelfan s nnhaya, aâaqeb s ssmaê. Acu ara ten iûebbôen si tmes?

verses.text: Akka, acku Issers ed Öebbi Tazmamt, s tidep. Ih, wid imgarraden $ef Tezmamt, haaten di lfiôaq u$miq.
verses.translation: Akka, acku Issers ed Öebbi Tazmamt, s tidep. Ih, wid imgarraden $ef Tezmamt, haaten di lfiôaq u$miq.

verses.text: Ise$, maççi ma tezzim udmawen nnwen, ar ugmuv akked utaram. Maca, ise$ d wid iumnen s Öebbi, s wass aneggaru, s lmalayek, s Tazmamt, s lambiyya. U ppaken ayla, $ef lemêibba S, i llzem, igujilen, igellilen, win d ibbwi ubrid, imapparen, akw i uberru n waklan. D wid ipéallan, ipzekkin, ippaîîafen di lemâahda nnsen, ma âahden, iûebôiyen di lmeêna akked twa$it, di tegwnip n ccqa. D wigi i illan di tidep, d wigi i ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Ise$, maççi ma tezzim udmawen nnwen, ar ugmuv akked utaram. Maca, ise$ d wid iumnen s Öebbi, s wass aneggaru, s lmalayek, s Tazmamt, s lambiyya. U ppaken ayla, $ef lemêibba S, i llzem, igujilen, igellilen, win d ibbwi ubrid, imapparen, akw i uberru n waklan. D wid ipéallan, ipzekkin, ippaîîafen di lemâahda nnsen, ma âahden, iûebôiyen di lmeêna akked twa$it, di tegwnip n ccqa. D wigi i illan di tidep, d wigi i ipêezziben.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen ppaô n tmegrav. Lêeôô s lêeôô, akli s wakli, nnta s nnta. Win iwumi isemmeê gma s kra: îlaba s lewqama, feddu s lewqama. Ayagi, d sshala s$uô Mass nnwen, akked uêunu. Win iff$en abrid, deffir waya, ad isâaddi aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen ppaô n tmegrav. Lêeôô s lêeôô, akli s wakli, nnta s nnta. Win iwumi isemmeê gma s kra: îlaba s lewqama, feddu s lewqama. Ayagi, d sshala s$uô Mass nnwen, akked uêunu. Win iff$en abrid, deffir waya, ad isâaddi aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: I kunwi, ppaô d tameddurt, a yuâqilen. Amar a pêezzbem.
verses.translation: I kunwi, ppaô d tameddurt, a yuâqilen. Amar a pêezzbem.

verses.text: Iura fellawen: ma tusa d tmeppant, ar yiwen degwen, ma iooa d lxiô, a t ifk i imawlan is, akked llzem, s lqanun. D ayen ilezmen i wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Iura fellawen: ma tusa d tmeppant, ar yiwen degwen, ma iooa d lxiô, a t ifk i imawlan is, akked llzem, s lqanun. D ayen ilezmen i wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Win it ibeddlen mbaâd ma isla yas, abekkav is siwa $ef wid it ipbeddilen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Win it ibeddlen mbaâd ma isla yas, abekkav is siwa $ef wid it ipbeddilen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ur idnib win iten issemûalaêen acku iugad rrya, ne$ abekkav, s$uô win ippuweûûan. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ur idnib win iten issemûalaêen acku iugad rrya, ne$ abekkav, s$uô win ippuweûûan. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen uéummu, akken iura $ef imezwura nnwen, amar a pêezzbem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen uéummu, akken iura $ef imezwura nnwen, amar a pêezzbem.

verses.text: Ussan ipwaêesben. Win iuvnen segwen ne$ illan ippinig, annect n wussan nniven. Wid i s izemren, feddu ad cceççen igellil. Win izaden lxiô, ilha yas. Ma tuéamem, ppif i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.
verses.translation: Ussan ipwaêesben. Win iuvnen segwen ne$ illan ippinig, annect n wussan nniven. Wid i s izemren, feddu ad cceççen igellil. Win izaden lxiô, ilha yas. Ma tuéamem, ppif i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.

verses.text: Aggur n ÔÖemvan, ideg d irs Leqwôan, d nnhaya i medden, d abeggen n nnhaya akked ufraz. Win segwen iwalan illul ed waggur, a t iuzum. Win iuvnen ne$ illan ippinig, annect n wussan nniven. Öebbi Ib$a yawen sshala, ur awen Ib$a ara cedda. A pfukem tallit, a pkabrem Öebbi imi kwen Inha, amar a ppesnemmrem.
verses.translation: Aggur n ÔÖemvan, ideg d irs Leqwôan, d nnhaya i medden, d abeggen n nnhaya akked ufraz. Win segwen iwalan illul ed waggur, a t iuzum. Win iuvnen ne$ illan ippinig, annect n wussan nniven. Öebbi Ib$a yawen sshala, ur awen Ib$a ara cedda. A pfukem tallit, a pkabrem Öebbi imi kwen Inha, amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.text: Ma steqsan k, imdanen iW, fellI, Nek Qeôbe$. Pjawabe$ i unuju n yimsuter, ma ipper iyI. Ihi, ad iyI d jawben, ad amnen yissI, amar ad pwanhun.
verses.translation: Ma steqsan k, imdanen iW, fellI, Nek Qeôbe$. Pjawabe$ i unuju n yimsuter, ma ipper iyI. Ihi, ad iyI d jawben, ad amnen yissI, amar ad pwanhun.

verses.text: Iêell awen, deg iv uéummu, a pqeôôbem ar tlawin nnwen. Nitenti d lebsa nnwen, kunwi d lebsa nnsent. Iéôa Öebbi ar tellam tepkellixem iman nnwen. Issuref awen, Isemmeê awen. Tura qeôôbet $uôsent, nadit ayen i wen Iura Öebbi. Eççet, esswet, ar pferzem lxiv amellal, si lxiv aberkan, di tafrara. Sinna, uéummet ar yiv. Ur pqeôôibet $uôsent, ma tâazlem iman nnwen di lowamaâ. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi. Ur pqeôôibet $uôsent! Akka i Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS i yimdanen, amar ad êezzben.
verses.translation: Iêell awen, deg iv uéummu, a pqeôôbem ar tlawin nnwen. Nitenti d lebsa nnwen, kunwi d lebsa nnsent. Iéôa Öebbi ar tellam tepkellixem iman nnwen. Issuref awen, Isemmeê awen. Tura qeôôbet $uôsent, nadit ayen i wen Iura Öebbi. Eççet, esswet, ar pferzem lxiv amellal, si lxiv aberkan, di tafrara. Sinna, uéummet ar yiv. Ur pqeôôibet $uôsent, ma tâazlem iman nnwen di lowamaâ. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi. Ur pqeôôibet $uôsent! Akka i Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS i yimdanen, amar ad êezzben.

verses.text: Ur ppemyeççat ayla nnwen, garawen, d aêerfi, ur t ppaket i yimêaddan, iwakken a ppeççem amur, seg wayla n medden, di lmenkweô, u kunwi teéôam.
verses.translation: Ur ppemyeççat ayla nnwen, garawen, d aêerfi, ur t ppaket i yimêaddan, iwakken a ppeççem amur, seg wayla n medden, di lmenkweô, u kunwi teéôam.

verses.text: La k steqsayen $ef tlalit n waggur. Ini: "d lewqat i medden, u i lêio". Ise$, maççi d anekcum ar ixxamen si zdeffir nnsent. Maca, ise$ d aêezzeb i Öebbi. Kecmet ixxamen si tebbura nnsen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.
verses.translation: La k steqsayen $ef tlalit n waggur. Ini: "d lewqat i medden, u i lêio". Ise$, maççi d anekcum ar ixxamen si zdeffir nnsent. Maca, ise$ d aêezzeb i Öebbi. Kecmet ixxamen si tebbura nnsen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.

verses.text: Nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi wid i kwen ipna$en. Ur zegret tilas. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.
verses.translation: Nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi wid i kwen ipna$en. Ur zegret tilas. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.

verses.text: Nna$et pen anda ten tufam, ssuff$et pen seg wanda i kwen ssuff$en. Ahewwel iwâaô kteô umennu$. Ur ten nepna$et ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam, siwa ma nnu$en kwen degs. Ma nnu$en kwen, nna$et pen. Akka aqeîîi ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Nna$et pen anda ten tufam, ssuff$et pen seg wanda i kwen ssuff$en. Ahewwel iwâaô kteô umennu$. Ur ten nepna$et ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam, siwa ma nnu$en kwen degs. Ma nnu$en kwen, nna$et pen. Akka aqeîîi ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ma fukken, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ma fukken, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Nna$et pen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iu$al ddin i Öebbi. Ma fukken, ur pna$et, siwa imednas.
verses.translation: Nna$et pen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iu$al ddin i Öebbi. Ma fukken, ur pna$et, siwa imednas.

verses.text: Aggur iôqan s waggur iôqan. Tiririt n ppaô $ef wayen ippugedlen. Win ikwen id ibbwven, awvet ep, akken ikwen id ibbwev. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi ar wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Aggur iôqan s waggur iôqan. Tiririt n ppaô $ef wayen ippugedlen. Win ikwen id ibbwven, awvet ep, akken ikwen id ibbwev. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi ar wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Ssedqet deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur d ppawit tawa$it, s ifassen nnwen. Maânet. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Ssedqet deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur d ppawit tawa$it, s ifassen nnwen. Maânet. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Öuêet ar lêio akked lâumôa, i Öebbi. Ma têeûlem, ssadaqa tushilt. Ur pseîîilet iqweôôa nnwen, ar ppawev tikci s amkan is. Win iuvnen, segwen, ne$ ihlek aqeôôu s, ad ifdu s uéummu, ne$ ssadaqa, ne$ iseflan. Mi tellam di laman, win izuôen ur iêuo, ad iseddeq ayen i s isehlen. Win ur nufa ara, ad iuéum krav wussan di lêio, ûa wussan ar tu$alin, akken ad awven mraw. Ayagi i win ur nesâi tawacult illan ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, cfut ar Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.
verses.translation: Öuêet ar lêio akked lâumôa, i Öebbi. Ma têeûlem, ssadaqa tushilt. Ur pseîîilet iqweôôa nnwen, ar ppawev tikci s amkan is. Win iuvnen, segwen, ne$ ihlek aqeôôu s, ad ifdu s uéummu, ne$ ssadaqa, ne$ iseflan. Mi tellam di laman, win izuôen ur iêuo, ad iseddeq ayen i s isehlen. Win ur nufa ara, ad iuéum krav wussan di lêio, ûa wussan ar tu$alin, akken ad awven mraw. Ayagi i win ur nesâi tawacult illan ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, cfut ar Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.

verses.text: Lêio deg wagguren ipwassnen. Win iâazmen, degsen, ad iêuo, ihi, di lêio ur telli tuzzuft, ne$ ayen n dir, ne$ nnmara. Ayen txedmem n lxiô, Iéôa t Öebbi. Awit aâwin, maca aâwin amxallef d aêezzeb. Ëezzbet iyI a yuâqilen!
verses.translation: Lêio deg wagguren ipwassnen. Win iâazmen, degsen, ad iêuo, ihi, di lêio ur telli tuzzuft, ne$ ayen n dir, ne$ nnmara. Ayen txedmem n lxiô, Iéôa t Öebbi. Awit aâwin, maca aâwin amxallef d aêezzeb. Ëezzbet iyI a yuâqilen!

verses.text: Uu ili u$ilif fellawen ma tessarmem lfevl s$uô Mass nnwen. Mi d tûubbem si Aâôafat, mmektit ed Öebbi, ppama n lemqam iôqan. Mmektit eP id, akken i kwen Inha, wanag tellam, uqbel, seg im$eôôqen.
verses.translation: Uu ili u$ilif fellawen ma tessarmem lfevl s$uô Mass nnwen. Mi d tûubbem si Aâôafat, mmektit ed Öebbi, ppama n lemqam iôqan. Mmektit eP id, akken i kwen Inha, wanag tellam, uqbel, seg im$eôôqen.

verses.text: Sinna, ddut anda ddan medden, ssutret ssmaê i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Sinna, ddut anda ddan medden, ssutret ssmaê i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Mi tfukkem isekkiren nnwen, mmektit ed Öebbi, akken d tesmektayem imezwura nnwen, ne$ kteô. Ger imdanen, wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Efk a$ di ddunit". Ur ppawin amur di laxeôt.
verses.translation: Mi tfukkem isekkiren nnwen, mmektit ed Öebbi, akken d tesmektayem imezwura nnwen, ne$ kteô. Ger imdanen, wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Efk a$ di ddunit". Ur ppawin amur di laxeôt.

verses.text: Llan, garasen, wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Efk a$ di ddunit, ise$, di laxeôt, ise$. Esseô a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes".
verses.translation: Llan, garasen, wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Efk a$ di ddunit, ise$, di laxeôt, ise$. Esseô a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes".

verses.text: Widak, ad awin amur seg wayen kesben. Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
verses.translation: Widak, ad awin amur seg wayen kesben. Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

verses.text: Mmektit ed Öebbi, deg ussan iâuden. Win i$awlen di sin wussan, ur icciv ara; win iâaîlen, ur icciv ara, ma illa d win ipêezziben. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut, ar $uôeS ara tepwafesrem.
verses.translation: Mmektit ed Öebbi, deg ussan iâuden. Win i$awlen di sin wussan, ur icciv ara; win iâaîlen, ur icciv ara, ma illa d win ipêezziben. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut, ar $uôeS ara tepwafesrem.

verses.text: Yiwen ger imdanen, iâoeb ik umeslay is, $ef tmeddurt n ddunit. Irra Öebbi d Anagi, $ef wayen illan deg ul is. U neppa iqseê i tilla.
verses.translation: Yiwen ger imdanen, iâoeb ik umeslay is, $ef tmeddurt n ddunit. Irra Öebbi d Anagi, $ef wayen illan deg ul is. U neppa iqseê i tilla.

verses.text: Mi izzi, ad ikkat di tmurt, iwakken ad issefsed degs, ad isqucc igran akked lmal. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara asefsed.
verses.translation: Mi izzi, ad ikkat di tmurt, iwakken ad issefsed degs, ad isqucc igran akked lmal. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara asefsed.

verses.text: Ma nnan as: "êezzeb i Öebbi"! A t tekcem lqwedôa ubekkav. Ad isteqnaâ s Loahennama. A yir usu!
verses.translation: Ma nnan as: "êezzeb i Öebbi"! A t tekcem lqwedôa ubekkav. Ad isteqnaâ s Loahennama. A yir usu!

verses.text: Ger imdanen, win izzenzen iman is, issaram llza n Öebbi. Öebbi d Umâin ar imdanen.
verses.translation: Ger imdanen, win izzenzen iman is, issaram llza n Öebbi. Öebbi d Umâin ar imdanen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Kecmet di tifrat s lekmal is, ur teddut d lateô n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Kecmet di tifrat s lekmal is, ur teddut d lateô n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ma teccvem, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôwen, cfut Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ma teccvem, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôwen, cfut Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Day a pôaoun kan, ad asen d Ias Öebbi, akked lmalayek, di tili usigna? Ad iûaô lameô. Ar Öebbi ara u$alen lumuô.
verses.translation: Day a pôaoun kan, ad asen d Ias Öebbi, akked lmalayek, di tili usigna? Ad iûaô lameô. Ar Öebbi ara u$alen lumuô.

verses.text: Steqsi At Isôail, acêal issekniyen iberrzen i sen Nefka. I win ipbeddilen tikci n Öebbi, deffir tisin is $uôes, ihi, Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.
verses.translation: Steqsi At Isôail, acêal issekniyen iberrzen i sen Nefka. I win ipbeddilen tikci n Öebbi, deffir tisin is $uôes, ihi, Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.

verses.text: Wid ijehlen, ccebêen asen tameddurt n ddunit. Ttihin $ef wid iumnen. Wid ipêezziben ad ilin sennig sen, ass n tnekra. Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, s lufa.
verses.translation: Wid ijehlen, ccebêen asen tameddurt n ddunit. Ttihin $ef wid iumnen. Wid ipêezziben ad ilin sennig sen, ass n tnekra. Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, s lufa.

verses.text: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois. Iuzen ed Öebbi lambiyya ad beccôen, ad nabin. Issers ed, yidsen, Tazmamt s tidep, iwakken ad Iêudd ger medden, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden. I imgarraden fellas, siwa wid iwumi teppunefk, mbaâd ma iusa ten id ubeggen. Ppemyasamen. Inha Öebbi wid iumnen deg wayen n tidep, i$ef mgarraden, s tsriê iS. Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois. Iuzen ed Öebbi lambiyya ad beccôen, ad nabin. Issers ed, yidsen, Tazmamt s tidep, iwakken ad Iêudd ger medden, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden. I imgarraden fellas, siwa wid iwumi teppunefk, mbaâd ma iusa ten id ubeggen. Ppemyasamen. Inha Öebbi wid iumnen deg wayen n tidep, i$ef mgarraden, s tsriê iS. Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim.

verses.text: Day t$ilem a pkecmem Loennet, wanag ur kwen id iusi wayen id iusan ar wid i kwen id izwaren? Mmugren d lmeêna, ccqa, zzelzla, armi inna umazan akked wid iumnen yides: "melmi laânaya n Öebbi"? Day, s tidep, ur d teqôib ara laânaya n Öebbi?
verses.translation: Day t$ilem a pkecmem Loennet, wanag ur kwen id iusi wayen id iusan ar wid i kwen id izwaren? Mmugren d lmeêna, ccqa, zzelzla, armi inna umazan akked wid iumnen yides: "melmi laânaya n Öebbi"? Day, s tidep, ur d teqôib ara laânaya n Öebbi?

verses.text: Steqsan k $ef wayen ara fken. Ini: "ayen ara tefkem n lxiô, i imawlan, i llzem, i igujilen, i igellilen, i w ar d iawi ubrid". Ayen ara txedmem n lxiô, war ccekk, Iéôa t Öebbi.
verses.translation: Steqsan k $ef wayen ara fken. Ini: "ayen ara tefkem n lxiô, i imawlan, i llzem, i igujilen, i igellilen, i w ar d iawi ubrid". Ayen ara txedmem n lxiô, war ccekk, Iéôa t Öebbi.

verses.text: Iura fellawen umennu$, u neppa d ayen tkeôhem. Ahat tkeôhem ayen ilhan i kunwi, ahat têemmlem ayen n dir i kunwi. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Iura fellawen umennu$, u neppa d ayen tkeôhem. Ahat tkeôhem ayen ilhan i kunwi, ahat têemmlem ayen n dir i kunwi. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.

verses.text: La k steqsayen ma ad yili umennu$ deg waggur iôqan. Ini: "amennu$ degs, d abekkav. Abekkav it i$elben, ar Öebbi, d assefôe$ $ef ubrid n Öebbi, d ankaô is, u d ankaô n Loamaâ n Lêaôam; d assuffe$, segs, imezda$ is". Ahewwel i$leb amennu$. Zgan a kwen pna$en, alamma swexxôen kwen, ma zemren, si ddin nnwen. Win, segwen, iff$en i ddin is, ad immet d ajehli. Widak, mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeôt. Widak, d at tmes, degs, nitni, ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: La k steqsayen ma ad yili umennu$ deg waggur iôqan. Ini: "amennu$ degs, d abekkav. Abekkav it i$elben, ar Öebbi, d assefôe$ $ef ubrid n Öebbi, d ankaô is, u d ankaô n Loamaâ n Lêaôam; d assuffe$, segs, imezda$ is". Ahewwel i$leb amennu$. Zgan a kwen pna$en, alamma swexxôen kwen, ma zemren, si ddin nnwen. Win, segwen, iff$en i ddin is, ad immet d ajehli. Widak, mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeôt. Widak, d at tmes, degs, nitni, ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Ih, wid iumnen, win iunagen u juhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, widak ggunin aêunu n Öebbi. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, win iunagen u juhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, widak ggunin aêunu n Öebbi. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: La k steqsayen $ef ccôab akked leqwmeô. Ini: "degsen abekkav meqqwôen, akked ibu$ar i medden. Abekkav nnsen i$leb ibu$ar nsen". La k steqsayen, acu ara seddqen. Ini: "ayen iugaren". Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a pmeyyzem
verses.translation: La k steqsayen $ef ccôab akked leqwmeô. Ini: "degsen abekkav meqqwôen, akked ibu$ar i medden. Abekkav nnsen i$leb ibu$ar nsen". La k steqsayen, acu ara seddqen. Ini: "ayen iugaren". Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a pmeyyzem

verses.text: af ddunit akked laxeôt. La k steqsayen $ef igujilen. Ini: "ppif ma txedmem asen lxiô. Ma txulvem ten, d atmaten nnwen". Öebbi Ifrez ger ufessad akked uâaôvi. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, a kwen Icebbwel. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: af ddunit akked laxeôt. La k steqsayen $ef igujilen. Ini: "ppif ma txedmem asen lxiô. Ma txulvem ten, d atmaten nnwen". Öebbi Ifrez ger ufessad akked uâaôvi. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, a kwen Icebbwel. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ur ppa$et timcurak alamma umnent. Taklit iumnen tif tamcarekt, xas taâoeb ikwen. Ur pnasabet imcurak alamma umnen. Akli iumnen yif amcarek, xas iaâoeb ikwen. Widak, neccden ar tmes. Öebbi Inecced ar Loennet akked ssmaê, ma Irad. Ipbeggin issekniyen iS i medden, amar a d mmektin.
verses.translation: Ur ppa$et timcurak alamma umnent. Taklit iumnen tif tamcarekt, xas taâoeb ikwen. Ur pnasabet imcurak alamma umnen. Akli iumnen yif amcarek, xas iaâoeb ikwen. Widak, neccden ar tmes. Öebbi Inecced ar Loennet akked ssmaê, ma Irad. Ipbeggin issekniyen iS i medden, amar a d mmektin.

verses.text: La k steqsayen $ef tarda. Ini: "d aîan. Âazlet tilawin di tarda, ur pqeôôibet $uôsent alamma ûfant. Mi ûfant, qeôôbet $uôsent, akken i wen Iumeô Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi Iêemmel wid iutuben, Iêemmel wid izzizdigen.
verses.translation: La k steqsayen $ef tarda. Ini: "d aîan. Âazlet tilawin di tarda, ur pqeôôibet $uôsent alamma ûfant. Mi ûfant, qeôôbet $uôsent, akken i wen Iumeô Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi Iêemmel wid iutuben, Iêemmel wid izzizdigen.

verses.text: Tilawin nnwen d aêôiq n tyerza nnwen. Melmi teb$am, aset s aêôiq nnwen. Zzewret lxiô i yiman nnwen, êezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar kunwi a T temmagrem. Becceô lmumnin.
verses.translation: Tilawin nnwen d aêôiq n tyerza nnwen. Melmi teb$am, aset s aêôiq nnwen. Zzewret lxiô i yiman nnwen, êezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar kunwi a T temmagrem. Becceô lmumnin.

verses.text: Ur ssekcamet Öebbi mara teggallem a ppizdigem, a pêezzbem, a ppessemûalêem medden. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ur ssekcamet Öebbi mara teggallem a ppizdigem, a pêezzbem, a ppessemûalêem medden. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ur kwen Ipqissi ara Öebbi $ef tgallit $ef awal. Maca, a kwen Iqiss $ef wayen kesben wulawen nnwen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.
verses.translation: Ur kwen Ipqissi ara Öebbi $ef tgallit $ef awal. Maca, a kwen Iqiss $ef wayen kesben wulawen nnwen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.

verses.text: Wid iggullen ur pqeôôiben ar tlawin nnsen, ad gganin kué wagguren. Ma bedlen ôôay, ihi, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Wid iggullen ur pqeôôiben ar tlawin nnsen, ad gganin kué wagguren. Ma bedlen ôôay, ihi, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ma âazmen berru, ihi, Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ma âazmen berru, ihi, Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Timnufaq ad aôount krav tardiwin. Ur asent iêell ara ad ffrent ayen Ixleq Öebbi, di tâabbav nnsent, ma umnent s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Ma b$an irgazen nnsent ad mûalaêen, izzewr iten lêal a tent id rren, di lmudda nni. Akken pwalasent ay ppalasent, s lqanun. I yirgazen, asurif $er loiha nnsent. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Timnufaq ad aôount krav tardiwin. Ur asent iêell ara ad ffrent ayen Ixleq Öebbi, di tâabbav nnsent, ma umnent s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Ma b$an irgazen nnsent ad mûalaêen, izzewr iten lêal a tent id rren, di lmudda nni. Akken pwalasent ay ppalasent, s lqanun. I yirgazen, asurif $er loiha nnsent. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Berru, sin iberdan; tiririt, s lqanun; aserreê s lewqama. Ur awen iêell ara a ppedmem kra, seg wayen i sent tefkam - siwa ma ugaden ur pqadaôen ara tilas n Öebbi. Ma tugadem ur pqadaôen ara tilas n Öebbi, ulac u$ilif fellasen $ef wayen is ara d tefdu iman is. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi, ur tent zegret. Wid izegren tilas n Öebbi, widak, d imednas.
verses.translation: Berru, sin iberdan; tiririt, s lqanun; aserreê s lewqama. Ur awen iêell ara a ppedmem kra, seg wayen i sent tefkam - siwa ma ugaden ur pqadaôen ara tilas n Öebbi. Ma tugadem ur pqadaôen ara tilas n Öebbi, ulac u$ilif fellasen $ef wayen is ara d tefdu iman is. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi, ur tent zegret. Wid izegren tilas n Öebbi, widak, d imednas.

verses.text: Ma ibra yas, ur as têell, imiren, alamma tu$ argaz nniven. Ma ibra yas, ulac u$ilif fellasen ma u$alen ar din, ma walan qudôen tilas n Öebbi. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi. Ibeggen itent i ugdud issnen.
verses.translation: Ma ibra yas, ur as têell, imiren, alamma tu$ argaz nniven. Ma ibra yas, ulac u$ilif fellasen ma u$alen ar din, ma walan qudôen tilas n Öebbi. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi. Ibeggen itent i ugdud issnen.

verses.text: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sâaddant tallit nnsent, erret pent id, s lqanun, ne$ serrêet asent, s lqanun. Ur tent pparat s uêeppem, a ppeccvem. Win ixedmen akka, idens iman is. Ur ppuraret s issekniyen n Öebbi. Mmektit ed ayen i kwen I$at Öebbi, akked wayen i wen d Issers si Tezmamt, akw si ûûwab. Ipnabi kwen yis. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Issen yal cci.
verses.translation: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sâaddant tallit nnsent, erret pent id, s lqanun, ne$ serrêet asent, s lqanun. Ur tent pparat s uêeppem, a ppeccvem. Win ixedmen akka, idens iman is. Ur ppuraret s issekniyen n Öebbi. Mmektit ed ayen i kwen I$at Öebbi, akked wayen i wen d Issers si Tezmamt, akw si ûûwab. Ipnabi kwen yis. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Issen yal cci.

verses.text: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sâaddant tallit nnsent, ur asent tekset ad a$ent irgazen nnsent, ma mwafaqen s lqanun. Ar waya ay pwanecden wid, segwen, iumnen s Öebbi, akked wass aneggaru. Ppif akka, i tezdeg akked ûûfawa nnwen. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sâaddant tallit nnsent, ur asent tekset ad a$ent irgazen nnsent, ma mwafaqen s lqanun. Ar waya ay pwanecden wid, segwen, iumnen s Öebbi, akked wass aneggaru. Ppif akka, i tezdeg akked ûûfawa nnwen. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.

verses.text: Tiyimmatin ad ssuîvent arraw nnsent, sin iseggwasen mden, i win ib$an ad itim ussuîev. £ef ubabat, lmakla akked lebsa nnsent, s lqanun. Ur ipwakellaf yiman siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Tarwa ur teîîuôôu imma s, ur teîîuôôu baba s. I uweôôat, am akka. Ma b$an ad kksen tuîîva, mcawaôen, ulac u$ilif fellasen. Ma teb$am tamôebbit, a ppessuîîev tarwa nnwen, ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma txelûem ayen i wen ilaqen, s lqanun. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Tiyimmatin ad ssuîvent arraw nnsent, sin iseggwasen mden, i win ib$an ad itim ussuîev. £ef ubabat, lmakla akked lebsa nnsent, s lqanun. Ur ipwakellaf yiman siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Tarwa ur teîîuôôu imma s, ur teîîuôôu baba s. I uweôôat, am akka. Ma b$an ad kksen tuîîva, mcawaôen, ulac u$ilif fellasen. Ma teb$am tamôebbit, a ppessuîîev tarwa nnwen, ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma txelûem ayen i wen ilaqen, s lqanun. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Wid, segwen, issuff$en taôwiêt, u ooan d tilawin, ad aôount kué wagguren akked mraw wussan. Mi sâaddant tallit nnsent, ulac u$ilif fellawen deg wayen xedment deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Wid, segwen, issuff$en taôwiêt, u ooan d tilawin, ad aôount kué wagguren akked mraw wussan. Mi sâaddant tallit nnsent, ulac u$ilif fellawen deg wayen xedment deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma tennam d a pxevbem tilawin, ne$ ma teffrem. Iéôa Öebbi, ar tesmektayem tent id. Maca, ur asent âahdet, di tbavnit, siwa ma tennam awal uwqim. Ur ferrut $ef lemlak, alamma ibbwev lajel iuran. Cfut ar Öebbi Iéôa i illan degwen. Ëadret iman nnwen segS. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.
verses.translation: Ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma tennam d a pxevbem tilawin, ne$ ma teffrem. Iéôa Öebbi, ar tesmektayem tent id. Maca, ur asent âahdet, di tbavnit, siwa ma tennam awal uwqim. Ur ferrut $ef lemlak, alamma ibbwev lajel iuran. Cfut ar Öebbi Iéôa i illan degwen. Ëadret iman nnwen segS. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.

verses.text: Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma tebram i tlawin ur tennulem, ne$ iwumi ur tefkim lwajeb. Efket asent tikci iweqmen. Asâay s tezmert is, igellil s tezmert is. D lwajeb i iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma tebram i tlawin ur tennulem, ne$ iwumi ur tefkim lwajeb. Efket asent tikci iweqmen. Asâay s tezmert is, igellil s tezmert is. D lwajeb i iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Ma tebram asent, uqbel a tent tennalem, u, iu$ lêal, tefkam asent lwajeb, ihi, azgen n wayen i sent tefkam, siwa ma semêent, ne$ isemmeê usemsaô n jjwao. Ssmaê iqôeb nezzeh ar uêezzeb. Ur tepput lfevl garawen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ma tebram asent, uqbel a tent tennalem, u, iu$ lêal, tefkam asent lwajeb, ihi, azgen n wayen i sent tefkam, siwa ma semêent, ne$ isemmeê usemsaô n jjwao. Ssmaê iqôeb nezzeh ar uêezzeb. Ur tepput lfevl garawen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ëarbet $ef téilla, u taéallit talemmast. Beddet i Öebbi, s wannuz.
verses.translation: Ëarbet $ef téilla, u taéallit talemmast. Beddet i Öebbi, s wannuz.

verses.text: Ma tugadem, s ibeddi, ne$ di rrekba. Ma tellam di laman, mmektit ed Öebbi, akken i wen Isselmed ayen ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Ma tugadem, s ibeddi, ne$ di rrekba. Ma tellam di laman, mmektit ed Öebbi, akken i wen Isselmed ayen ur tessinem.

verses.text: Wid segwen issuff$en taôwiêt, u ooan d tilawin, ad asent vemnen aseggwas n wuççi, ur tent ssuffu$en. Ma ff$ent, ulac u$ilif fellawen, deg wayen xedment, deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Wid segwen issuff$en taôwiêt, u ooan d tilawin, ad asent vemnen aseggwas n wuççi, ur tent ssuffu$en. Ma ff$ent, ulac u$ilif fellawen, deg wayen xedment, deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: I tembwurab taqviât, s lqanun. D lwajeb $ef wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: I tembwurab taqviât, s lqanun. D lwajeb $ef wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS, amar a pêemûem.
verses.translation: Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS, amar a pêemûem.

verses.text: Day ur twalav ara wid iff$en, seg ixxamen nnsen, d igima, ugaden tameppant. Inna yasen Öebbi: "emmtet"! Sinna, Issader ten id. S tidep, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl $ef yimdanen, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.
verses.translation: Day ur twalav ara wid iff$en, seg ixxamen nnsen, d igima, ugaden tameppant. Inna yasen Öebbi: "emmtet"! Sinna, Issader ten id. S tidep, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl $ef yimdanen, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.

verses.text: Nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Win iôevlen aôeîîal umâin i Öebbi, ad as t id Irr s lufa. Öebbi Ippaîaf, Ismiri. £uôeS a ppu$alem.
verses.translation: Win iôevlen aôeîîal umâin i Öebbi, ad as t id Irr s lufa. Öebbi Ippaîaf, Ismiri. £uôeS a ppu$alem.

verses.text: Day ur twalav ara imvebbôen seg wAt Isôail, deffir Musa? Mi nnan i nnbi nnsen: "azen a$ d agellid, a nenna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi". Inna: "ma iura fellawen umennu$, day a ppagim a ppenna$em"? Nnan: "ur a$ issefk ara a neqqim ur nepna$ ara, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ni$ ssuff$en a$ d, nekwni akked tarwa nne$, seg ixxamen nne$". Mi iura fellasen umennu$, wexxôen, siwa drus segsen. Öebbi Issen imednas.
verses.translation: Day ur twalav ara imvebbôen seg wAt Isôail, deffir Musa? Mi nnan i nnbi nnsen: "azen a$ d agellid, a nenna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi". Inna: "ma iura fellawen umennu$, day a ppagim a ppenna$em"? Nnan: "ur a$ issefk ara a neqqim ur nepna$ ara, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ni$ ssuff$en a$ d, nekwni akked tarwa nne$, seg ixxamen nne$". Mi iura fellasen umennu$, wexxôen, siwa drus segsen. Öebbi Issen imednas.

verses.text: Inna yasen nnbi nnsen: "Ni$ Öebbi, s tidep, Iuzen awen d Ïalut, d agellid". Nnan: "amek ara yili d agellid nne$? Nezwar it akken neklal tagelda. Ur as ippunefk wayla". Inna: "Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren it garawen, u Irna yas aîas n tmusni akked loeppa". Ippak Öebbi tagelda S i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Inna yasen nnbi nnsen: "Ni$ Öebbi, s tidep, Iuzen awen d Ïalut, d agellid". Nnan: "amek ara yili d agellid nne$? Nezwar it akken neklal tagelda. Ur as ippunefk wayla". Inna: "Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren it garawen, u Irna yas aîas n tmusni akked loeppa". Ippak Öebbi tagelda S i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Inna yasen, nnbi nnsen: "s tidep, assekni n tgelda s, d tisin $uôwen usenduq. Degs talwit s$uô Mass nnwen, akked wayen id igwran, seg wayen id teooa twacult n Musa, akked tin n Haôun. A t id awint lmalayek. Ih, deg waya, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
verses.translation: Inna yasen, nnbi nnsen: "s tidep, assekni n tgelda s, d tisin $uôwen usenduq. Degs talwit s$uô Mass nnwen, akked wayen id igwran, seg wayen id teooa twacult n Musa, akked tin n Haôun. A t id awint lmalayek. Ih, deg waya, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".

verses.text: Mi iffe$ Ïalut, s lâaskeô, inna: "Öebbi, s tidep, a kwen Ijeôôeb s wasif. Win iswan segs, ur illi yidi. Win ur neswi, neppa, s tidep, yidi. Kkes ed win iswan cwiî, deg ufus is". Swan segs, siwa ixeîîayen segsen. Mi zegren, neppa akked wid iumnen yides, nnan: "ur nezmir assa, i Oalut akked lâaskeô is". Nnan wid issarmen ar nitni ad mlilen d Öebbi: "acêal d abrid, îayfa tameééyant te$leb îayfa tameqwôant, ma Irad Öebbi". Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.
verses.translation: Mi iffe$ Ïalut, s lâaskeô, inna: "Öebbi, s tidep, a kwen Ijeôôeb s wasif. Win iswan segs, ur illi yidi. Win ur neswi, neppa, s tidep, yidi. Kkes ed win iswan cwiî, deg ufus is". Swan segs, siwa ixeîîayen segsen. Mi zegren, neppa akked wid iumnen yides, nnan: "ur nezmir assa, i Oalut akked lâaskeô is". Nnan wid issarmen ar nitni ad mlilen d Öebbi: "acêal d abrid, îayfa tameééyant te$leb îayfa tameqwôant, ma Irad Öebbi". Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.

verses.text: Mi qublen Oalut akked lâaskeô is, nnan: "a Mass nne$! Azen a$ d ûûbeô, Tebbet isurifen nne$, Awes a$ mgal agdud ijehliyen".
verses.translation: Mi qublen Oalut akked lâaskeô is, nnan: "a Mass nne$! Azen a$ d ûûbeô, Tebbet isurifen nne$, Awes a$ mgal agdud ijehliyen".

verses.text: Irad Öebbi, rebêen ten. Dawed in$a Oalut. Ifka yas Öebbi tagelda akked ûûwab. Isselmed as seg wayen i S ihwan. Lemmer ur Issemnamar ara Öebbi, imdanen, a ppefsed tmurt. Maca, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl $ef imavalen.
verses.translation: Irad Öebbi, rebêen ten. Dawed in$a Oalut. Ifka yas Öebbi tagelda akked ûûwab. Isselmed as seg wayen i S ihwan. Lemmer ur Issemnamar ara Öebbi, imdanen, a ppefsed tmurt. Maca, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl $ef imavalen.

verses.text: Atnan issekniyen n Öebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tidep. Keçç, war ccekk, seg imazanen.
verses.translation: Atnan issekniyen n Öebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tidep. Keçç, war ccekk, seg imazanen.

verses.text: Imazanen agi, Nesmenyaf kra i wiyav. Garasen, wid iwumi Immeslay Öebbi. Issuli kra segsen, tiseddaôin. Nefka abeggen i Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, u Nekfa t s ôôuê iôqan. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur ppemyen$an wid i ten id ivefôen, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôsen. Maca, mgarraden. Segsen wid iumnen, segsen wid ijehlen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur ppemyen$an, maca Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
verses.translation: Imazanen agi, Nesmenyaf kra i wiyav. Garasen, wid iwumi Immeslay Öebbi. Issuli kra segsen, tiseddaôin. Nefka abeggen i Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, u Nekfa t s ôôuê iôqan.
