Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur ppemyen$an wid i ten id ivefôen, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôsen. Maca, mgarraden. Segsen wid iumnen, segsen wid ijehlen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur ppemyen$an, maca Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen ikwen N$at, uqbel tisin n wass ideg ur telli ttjara, ne$ tiddukla, ne$ ccafuâa. Ijehliyen, d nitni ay d imednas.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen ikwen N$at, uqbel tisin n wass ideg ur telli ttjara, ne$ tiddukla, ne$ ccafuâa. Ijehliyen, d nitni ay d imednas.

verses.text: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amuddir, Imezgi. Ur Ipnuddum, ur Iggan. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Anwa akka ara icufâan $uôeS, siwa ma s tsriê iS? Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ur êemûen kra, si tmusni S, siwa ayen i S ihwan. Lewsaâ usgeld iS, d tamurt akked igenwan. Ur T issaâtab uêareb fellasen. Neppa, d Aâlayan, d Ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amuddir, Imezgi. Ur Ipnuddum, ur Iggan. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Anwa akka ara icufâan $uôeS, siwa ma s tsriê iS? Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ur êemûen kra, si tmusni S, siwa ayen i S ihwan. Lewsaâ usgeld iS, d tamurt akked igenwan. Ur T issaâtab uêareb fellasen. Neppa, d Aâlayan, d Ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Ddin maççi s yi$il. Ni$ tepwafôez lewqama si l$welîa. Win iugin iôebbiten n tkerkas u iumen s Öebbi, ihi, iîîef afus ioehden, ur nceqqeq. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ddin maççi s yi$il. Ni$ tepwafôez lewqama si l$welîa. Win iugin iôebbiten n tkerkas u iumen s Öebbi, ihi, iîîef afus ioehden, ur nceqqeq. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Öebbi d Bab n wid iumnen. Issuffe$ iten id si tillas ar tafat. Imawlan n wid ijehlen, d iôebbiten n tkerkas. Ssuff$en ten id si tafat ar tillas. Widak, d at tmes, nitni, degs ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Öebbi d Bab n wid iumnen. Issuffe$ iten id si tillas ar tafat. Imawlan n wid ijehlen, d iôebbiten n tkerkas. Ssuff$en ten id si tafat ar tillas. Widak, d at tmes, nitni, degs ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Day ur twalav ara win inumren Ibôahim $ef Mass is, acku Ifka yas Öebbi tagelda? Mi inna Ibôahim: "Mass iw d win Issidiren, Ineqqen", inna d: "nek ssidire$, neqqe$". Inna Ibôahim: "ihi, Öebbi Issenqaô ed iîij seg ugmuv; keçç, ssenqeô it id seg utaram"! Inneêcam win ijehlen. Öebbi ur Inehhu yara agdud imednas.
verses.translation: Day ur twalav ara win inumren Ibôahim $ef Mass is, acku Ifka yas Öebbi tagelda? Mi inna Ibôahim: "Mass iw d win Issidiren, Ineqqen", inna d: "nek ssidire$, neqqe$". Inna Ibôahim: "ihi, Öebbi Issenqaô ed iîij seg ugmuv; keçç, ssenqeô it id seg utaram"! Inneêcam win ijehlen. Öebbi ur Inehhu yara agdud imednas.

verses.text: Ne$ am win iâaddan di temdint tilemt, thudd wakali. Inna: «amek ara d Issider Öebbi tagi, deffir tmeppant is?» In$a t Öebbi twinas iseggwasen, sinna, Issenker it, Inna: «acêal teqqimev?» Inna d: «qqime$ ibwass, ne$ ur ibbwiv wass». Inna: «xaîi, teqqimev twinas iseggwasen. Muqel lqut ik akked tissit ik, ur xûiôen. Muqel a$yul ik. A k Nerr d assekni i medden. Muqel i$san amek ara ten Nessemlil, sinna, ad asen Nessels aksum». Mi ipputebbet, inna: «éôi$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci».
verses.translation: Ne$ am win iâaddan di temdint tilemt, thudd wakali. Inna: «amek ara d Issider Öebbi tagi, deffir tmeppant is?» In$a t Öebbi twinas iseggwasen, sinna, Issenker it, Inna: «acêal teqqimev?» Inna d: «qqime$ ibwass, ne$ ur ibbwiv wass». Inna: «xaîi, teqqimev twinas iseggwasen. Muqel lqut ik akked tissit ik, ur xûiôen. Muqel a$yul ik. A k Nerr d assekni i medden. Muqel i$san amek ara ten Nessemlil, sinna, ad asen Nessels aksum». Mi ipputebbet, inna: «éôi$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci».

verses.text: U mi inna Ibôahim: «a Mass iw! Ssenâat iyi amek tessidirev lmeggtin». Inna: «day ur tuminev ara?» Inna: «xaîi, maca iwakken ad ithedden wul iw». Inna: «ihi, îîef kué igvav, awi ten id $uôek, sinna, err, di yal i$il, amur segsen. Sinna, siwel asen, a d asen dumatu. Cfu ar Öebbi d Uohid, d Uûwib».
verses.translation: U mi inna Ibôahim: «a Mass iw! Ssenâat iyi amek tessidirev lmeggtin». Inna: «day ur tuminev ara?» Inna: «xaîi, maca iwakken ad ithedden wul iw». Inna: «ihi, îîef kué igvav, awi ten id $uôek, sinna, err, di yal i$il, amur segsen. Sinna, siwel asen, a d asen dumatu. Cfu ar Öebbi d Uohid, d Uûwib».

verses.text: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, cuban aâqqa id igren sa tyedrin. Di yal taydrep, twinas iâqqayen. Öebbi Issugut i win i S Ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, cuban aâqqa id igren sa tyedrin. Di yal taydrep, twinas iâqqayen. Öebbi Issugut i win i S Ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur seddan, i wayen ssedqen, tiyta ne$ rregmat, ad awin arraz nnsen s$uô Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur seddan, i wayen ssedqen, tiyta ne$ rregmat, ad awin arraz nnsen s$uô Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: Awal imaânen akked ssmaê, ifen aseddeq i vefôent rregmat. Öebbi d Asâay, Iêellem.
verses.translation: Awal imaânen akked ssmaê, ifen aseddeq i vefôent rregmat. Öebbi d Asâay, Iêellem.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ssemsayet ssadaqa nnwen, s tiyta akked rregmat. Am win iseddqen ayla s, iwakken a t walin medden, ur iumin s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Icuba taéôut i i$umm wakal. Iwwet fellas uzayev, iooa p d asuki. Ur sfaydin acemma seg wayen bbwin. Öebbi ur Inehhu ara agdud ijehliyen.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur ssemsayet ssadaqa nnwen, s tiyta akked rregmat. Am win iseddqen ayla s, iwakken a t walin medden, ur iumin s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Icuba taéôut i i$umm wakal. Iwwet fellas uzayev, iooa p d asuki. Ur sfaydin acemma seg wayen bbwin. Öebbi ur Inehhu ara agdud ijehliyen.

verses.text: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen, ssaramen ad Iôavi Öebbi, u tebbten iman nnsen, cuban leonan di ti$ilt. Iwwet fellas ugeffur, ifka d sin imuren n l$ella s. Ma ur iwwit fellas ugeffur, d nnda. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen, ssaramen ad Iôavi Öebbi, u tebbten iman nnsen, cuban leonan di ti$ilt. Iwwet fellas ugeffur, ifka d sin imuren n l$ella s. Ma ur iwwit fellas ugeffur, d nnda. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Yiwen degwen, ma tusa t id tewser, u $uôes tarwa tuôhift, day ad issirem ad isâu leonan n tezdayin akked tfeôôant, isaffen ppazzalen ddaw as, degs, i neppa, yal ppemôa? Têuza t tnifift degs times, iô$a. Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a pmeyyzem.
verses.translation: Yiwen degwen, ma tusa t id tewser, u $uôes tarwa tuôhift, day ad issirem ad isâu leonan n tezdayin akked tfeôôant, isaffen ppazzalen ddaw as, degs, i neppa, yal ppemôa? Têuza t tnifift degs times, iô$a. Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a pmeyyzem.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen imaânen i teîfem, seg wayen i wen d Nessuffe$ si tmurt. Ur fernet ucmit, segs, ayen ur teppadamem siwa ma s tuqna n wallen, a t tseddqem. Cfut ar Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen imaânen i teîfem, seg wayen i wen d Nessuffe$ si tmurt. Ur fernet ucmit, segs, ayen ur teppadamem siwa ma s tuqna n wallen, a t tseddqem. Cfut ar Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.

verses.text: Cciîan iâahed awen tiggulelt, iumeô awen lâaô. Öebbi Iâahed awen ssmaê s$uôeS akked lfevl. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Cciîan iâahed awen tiggulelt, iumeô awen lâaô. Öebbi Iâahed awen ssmaê s$uôeS akked lfevl. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ippak ûûwab i win i S Ihwan. Win iwumi ippunefk ûûwab, ni$ ippunefk as aîas n lxiô. Siwa uâqilen i ismektayen.
verses.translation: Ippak ûûwab i win i S Ihwan. Win iwumi ippunefk ûûwab, ni$ ippunefk as aîas n lxiô. Siwa uâqilen i ismektayen.

verses.text: Ayen tefkam useddeq, ne$ teqqnem n tuqqna, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa t. Ur llin imâiwnen i imednas.
verses.translation: Ayen tefkam useddeq, ne$ teqqnem n tuqqna, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa t. Ur llin imâiwnen i imednas.

verses.text: Ma tefkam ssadaqat âinani, ilha. Yif it ma s tuffra, u ma tefkam tent i ime$ban. Ad pwakksent kra si tucmitin nnwen. Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ma tefkam ssadaqat âinani, ilha. Yif it ma s tuffra, u ma tefkam tent i ime$ban. Ad pwakksent kra si tucmitin nnwen. Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ur fellak a ten tenhuv. Maca Öebbi Inehhu win i S Ihwan. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, i iman nnwen. Ur tefkim siwa $ef udem n Öebbi. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, a kwen id iu$al, u kunwi ur kwen dennisen.
verses.translation: Ur fellak a ten tenhuv. Maca Öebbi Inehhu win i S Ihwan. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, i iman nnwen. Ur tefkim siwa $ef udem n Öebbi. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, a kwen id iu$al, u kunwi ur kwen dennisen.

verses.text: I ime$ban ifelsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur nezmir ad inigen di tmurt; wur nessin, inwa ten d imeôkantiyen, seg wakken êekmen. A ten tâaqlev ar tiddi nnsen: ur ssuturen imdanen s nnbec. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, s tidep, Öebbi Iéôa t.
verses.translation: I ime$ban ifelsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur nezmir ad inigen di tmurt; wur nessin, inwa ten d imeôkantiyen, seg wakken êekmen. A ten tâaqlev ar tiddi nnsen: ur ssuturen imdanen s nnbec. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, s tidep, Öebbi Iéôa t.

verses.text: Wid ifkan ayla nnsen deg iv, deg wass, s tuffra u âinani, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: Wid ifkan ayla nnsen deg iv, deg wass, s tuffra u âinani, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: Wid iteppen rrba, ur d pnekkaren siwa am ara d kren win issexbibev Cciîan, mi t innul. Ayagi, acku nnan: «ttjara am rrba kan». Öebbi Iêell ttjara, Igdel rrba. Win n tusa lewûaya s$uô Mass is, d$a ixva, ines ayen iâaddan. Lameô is ar Öebbi. Wid iu$alen, widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Wid iteppen rrba, ur d pnekkaren siwa am ara d kren win issexbibev Cciîan, mi t innul. Ayagi, acku nnan: «ttjara am rrba kan». Öebbi Iêell ttjara, Igdel rrba. Win n tusa lewûaya s$uô Mass is, d$a ixva, ines ayen iâaddan. Lameô is ar Öebbi. Wid iu$alen, widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Ad Imêu Öebbi rrba, ad Isbuôket ssadaqa. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara yal ajehli amednub.
verses.translation: Ad Imêu Öebbi rrba, ad Isbuôket ssadaqa. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara yal ajehli amednub.

verses.text: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u péallan, u pzekkin, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u péallan, u pzekkin, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Eooet ayen d igwran si rrba, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Eooet ayen d igwran si rrba, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

verses.text: Ma ur tewqimem ara, êûut ara kwen Inna$ Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma tnedmem, nnwen ôaselmal. Ur denniset, ur pwadenset.
verses.translation: Ma ur tewqimem ara, êûut ara kwen Inna$ Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma tnedmem, nnwen ôaselmal. Ur denniset, ur pwadenset.

verses.text: I win illan di lhejna, aôout liser. Ma tseddqem, yif it i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.
verses.translation: I win illan di lhejna, aôout liser. Ma tseddqem, yif it i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.

verses.text: Ëezzbet i wass n tu$alin nnwen ar Öebbi. Imiren, yal yiwen ad as ippunefk wayen ikseb; nitni ur pwadensen.
verses.translation: Ëezzbet i wass n tu$alin nnwen ar Öebbi. Imiren, yal yiwen ad as ippunefk wayen ikseb; nitni ur pwadensen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tesâam îlaba ar lajel ipwassnen, arut ep. A p iaru umaru segwen, s ûûfawa. Ur ippagwi umaru a p iaru, akken i s Isselmed Öebbi. Ad iaru ayen ar as yini umeîîalbu. Ad iêezzeb i Öebbi, Mass is. Ur issenqas acemma segs. Ma illa umeîîalbu d abuhal, ne$ d uôhif, ne$ ur izmir ad yini neppa, ihi, ad yini umeddakwel is s ûûfawa. Sbeddet sin inagan seg irgazen nnwen. Ma ur llin ara sin irgazen, argaz akked snat n tlawin, seg wid tôuvam ad cehhden. Ma te$lev yiwet segsent, tayev a d temmekti. Ur ppagwin inagan, ma pwanecden. Ur stehzayet a p tarum, meééiyet ne$ meqqwôet, ar lajel is. Ayagi iwzen kteô ar Öebbi, iwata kteô i ccada, iwulem kteô ad awen ikkes ccekk. Kkes ed ssuq i tefram imiren garawen; ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma ur t turim ara. Awit inagan deg uzenzi nnwen. Ur ippili ujuôu $ef umaru ne$ $ef unagi. Ma tjuôem, ihi, dir ikwen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi Isselmad ikwen. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tesâam îlaba ar lajel ipwassnen, arut ep. A p iaru umaru segwen, s ûûfawa. Ur ippagwi umaru a p iaru, akken i s Isselmed Öebbi. Ad iaru ayen ar as yini umeîîalbu. Ad iêezzeb i Öebbi, Mass is. Ur issenqas acemma segs. Ma illa umeîîalbu d abuhal, ne$ d uôhif, ne$ ur izmir ad yini neppa, ihi, ad yini umeddakwel is s ûûfawa. Sbeddet sin inagan seg irgazen nnwen. Ma ur llin ara sin irgazen, argaz akked snat n tlawin, seg wid tôuvam ad cehhden. Ma te$lev yiwet segsent, tayev a d temmekti. Ur ppagwin inagan, ma pwanecden. Ur stehzayet a p tarum, meééiyet ne$ meqqwôet, ar lajel is. Ayagi iwzen kteô ar Öebbi, iwata kteô i ccada, iwulem kteô ad awen ikkes ccekk. Kkes ed ssuq i tefram imiren garawen; ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma ur t turim ara. Awit inagan deg uzenzi nnwen. Ur ippili ujuôu $ef umaru ne$ $ef unagi. Ma tjuôem, ihi, dir ikwen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi Isselmad ikwen. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.

verses.text: Ma d iminigen ay tellam, ur tufim amaru, a ppeppunefk ôôhina. Ma ifka yiwen segwen lamana i wayev, win iwumi teppunefk, a p irr i win i s ifkan lamana s. Ad iêezzeb i Öebbi, Mass is. Ur ppeffret ccada. Win ip iffren, ihi, neppa, idneb wul is. Öebbi Iéôa ay txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ma d iminigen ay tellam, ur tufim amaru, a ppeppunefk ôôhina. Ma ifka yiwen segwen lamana i wayev, win iwumi teppunefk, a p irr i win i s ifkan lamana s. Ad iêezzeb i Öebbi, Mass is. Ur ppeffret ccada. Win ip iffren, ihi, neppa, idneb wul is. Öebbi Iéôa ay txeddmem.

verses.text: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ama tesseknem i illan deg iman nnwen, ne$ te$bam t, a kwen Iêaseb Öebbi fellas. Ad Isemmeê i win i S Ihwan, ad Iâaqeb win i S Ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ama tesseknem i illan deg iman nnwen, ne$ te$bam t, a kwen Iêaseb Öebbi fellas. Ad Isemmeê i win i S Ihwan, ad Iâaqeb win i S Ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Iumen Umazan s wayen id iusan, $uôes, s$uô Mass is. Lmumnin, akw, umnen s Öebbi akked lmalayek iS, Tizmamin iS, imazanen iS. Ur nesemgirrid yiwen ger imazanen iS. Nnan: «nesla, nunez. Ssmaê iK a Mass nne$! £uôeK tu$alin.
verses.translation: Iumen Umazan s wayen id iusan, $uôes, s$uô Mass is. Lmumnin, akw, umnen s Öebbi akked lmalayek iS, Tizmamin iS, imazanen iS. Ur nesemgirrid yiwen ger imazanen iS. Nnan: «nesla, nunez. Ssmaê iK a Mass nne$! £uôeK tu$alin.

verses.text: Ur Ipkellif Öebbi yiman, siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ines wayen ikseb, mgal is wayen iddem. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Pqassa ma neppu, ne$ neccev. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Sbibbi taâkkwemt akken ip Tesbabbev i wid i $ d izwaren. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Sbibbi ayen iwumi ur nezmir. Semmeê ane$, Suref a$, Ëun fellane$. Keçç d Bab nne$, Srebê a$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ur Ipkellif Öebbi yiman, siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ines wayen ikseb, mgal is wayen iddem. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Pqassa ma neppu, ne$ neccev. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Sbibbi taâkkwemt akken ip Tesbabbev i wid i $ d izwaren. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Sbibbi ayen iwumi ur nezmir. Semmeê ane$, Suref a$, Ëun fellane$. Keçç d Bab nne$, Srebê a$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Alm.
ayahs.translation: Alm.

ayahs.text: Appan Tezmamt, ur degs ccekk, d nnhaya i wid ipêezziben;
ayahs.translation: Appan Tezmamt, ur degs ccekk, d nnhaya i wid ipêezziben;

ayahs.text: wid iumnen s tbavnit, ipéallan, ipseddiqen seg wayen iten N$at;
ayahs.translation: wid iumnen s tbavnit, ipéallan, ipseddiqen seg wayen iten N$at;

ayahs.text: wid iumnen s wayen i k d irsen, akked wayen id irsen, uqbel ik, u, $ef laxeôt, nitni, pputebbten.
ayahs.translation: wid iumnen s wayen i k d irsen, akked wayen id irsen, uqbel ik, u, $ef laxeôt, nitni, pputebbten.

ayahs.text: Widak, di nnhaya n Mass nnsen, widak, d isaâdiyen.
ayahs.translation: Widak, di nnhaya n Mass nnsen, widak, d isaâdiyen.

ayahs.text: Wid ijehlen, s tidep, iâuva fellasen ma tnubav ten, ne$ ur ten tnubav. Ur ppamnen.
ayahs.translation: Wid ijehlen, s tidep, iâuva fellasen ma tnubav ten, ne$ ur ten tnubav. Ur ppamnen.

ayahs.text: Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, akked imeééu$en nnsen. Irs le$yaô $ef allen nnsen. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.
ayahs.translation: Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, akked imeééu$en nnsen. Irs le$yaô $ef allen nnsen. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.

ayahs.text: Ger yimdanen, llan wid iqqaôen: "numen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru”; nitni, ur llin d lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ger yimdanen, llan wid iqqaôen: "numen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru”; nitni, ur llin d lmumnin.

ayahs.text: La xedâen Öebbi akked wid iumnen. Ur xedâen siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.
ayahs.translation: La xedâen Öebbi akked wid iumnen. Ur xedâen siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.

ayahs.text: Aîan deg ulawen nnsen; Irna yasen Öebbi aîan. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan, ilmend n wayen skiddiben.
ayahs.translation: Aîan deg ulawen nnsen; Irna yasen Öebbi aîan. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan, ilmend n wayen skiddiben.

ayahs.text: Ma nnan asen: "ur ssefsadet di tmurt"! A d inin: "nekwni d wid, kan, ipleqqimen".
ayahs.translation: Ma nnan asen: "ur ssefsadet di tmurt"! A d inin: "nekwni d wid, kan, ipleqqimen".

ayahs.text: Day maççi d nitni, s tidep, ay d ifessaden, maca ur faqen?
ayahs.translation: Day maççi d nitni, s tidep, ay d ifessaden, maca ur faqen?

ayahs.text: Ma nnan asen: "amnet, akken umnen medden"! A d inin: "day a namen, akken umnen ije$lufen"? Day maççi d nitni, s tidep, ay d ije$lufen, maca ur éôin.
ayahs.translation: Ma nnan asen: "amnet, akken umnen medden"! A d inin: "day a namen, akken umnen ije$lufen"? Day maççi d nitni, s tidep, ay d ije$lufen, maca ur éôin.

ayahs.text: Ma mmugren d wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mara yilin weêêedsen, ar ccwaîen nnsen, ad inin: "nekwni yidwen! Nekwni la nettihi kan".
ayahs.translation: Ma mmugren d wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mara yilin weêêedsen, ar ccwaîen nnsen, ad inin: "nekwni yidwen! Nekwni la nettihi kan".

ayahs.text: Öebbi ad Ittihi fellasen. Isnerna yasen lbwe$v nnsen; ddebdeben.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi ad Ittihi fellasen. Isnerna yasen lbwe$v nnsen; ddebdeben.

ayahs.text: Widak, d wid iu$en ttelfan s nnhaya; ur d issasay ssuq nnsen, ur pwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Widak, d wid iu$en ttelfan s nnhaya; ur d issasay ssuq nnsen, ur pwanhan.

ayahs.text: Tevôa yidsen am win issa$en times. Mi tnewweô ayen i s d izzin, Öebbi Iddem tafat nnsen, Iooa ten di tillas, ur pwalin.
ayahs.translation: Tevôa yidsen am win issa$en times. Mi tnewweô ayen i s d izzin, Öebbi Iddem tafat nnsen, Iooa ten di tillas, ur pwalin.

ayahs.text: Âaégen, gugmen, dre$len; ihi, nitni ur d ppu$alen s abrid.
ayahs.translation: Âaégen, gugmen, dre$len; ihi, nitni ur d ppu$alen s abrid.

ayahs.text: Ne$ am usigna igenni, degs tillas, tirmegt, lebôaq. Pparran ivudan nnsen deg imeééu$en nnsen, mgal ssiâqat; ad nnestaôen si tmeppant. Öebbi Izzi i ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ am usigna igenni, degs tillas, tirmegt, lebôaq. Pparran ivudan nnsen deg imeééu$en nnsen, mgal ssiâqat; ad nnestaôen si tmeppant. Öebbi Izzi i ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Qôib i sen iêwi lebôaq, iéôi. Yal tikelt ideg i sen icâal, ad ddun syis. Mi sen ixsi, ad êebsen. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, ad asen Ikkes timesliwt akked yiéôi nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Qôib i sen iêwi lebôaq, iéôi. Yal tikelt ideg i sen icâal, ad ddun syis. Mi sen ixsi, ad êebsen. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, ad asen Ikkes timesliwt akked yiéôi nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Âabdet Mass nnwen ikwen Ixelqen, kunwi, akked wid i kwen id izwaren, amar a pêezzbem;
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Âabdet Mass nnwen ikwen Ixelqen, kunwi, akked wid i kwen id izwaren, amar a pêezzbem;

ayahs.text: i wen Irran tamurt d usu, igenni d lebni; id Isse$li d aman seg igenni, Issuffe$ ed yissen ppemôa, d ôôeéq i kunwi. Ihi, ur pparrat tanudda i Öebbi, u kunwi teéôam.
ayahs.translation: i wen Irran tamurt d usu, igenni d lebni; id Isse$li d aman seg igenni, Issuffe$ ed yissen ppemôa, d ôôeéq i kunwi. Ihi, ur pparrat tanudda i Öebbi, u kunwi teéôam.

ayahs.text: Ma tellam di ccekk, $ef wayen id Nessers ar umdan nne£, awit ed tasuôep i p icban. Neccdet ed inagan nnwen, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep.
ayahs.translation: Ma tellam di ccekk, $ef wayen id Nessers ar umdan nne£, awit ed tasuôep i p icban. Neccdet ed inagan nnwen, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep.

ayahs.text: Ma ur tessawvem, u, war ccekk, ur tessawavem, êezzbet i tmes isseô$an imdanen, id$a$en, ippuheggan i ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ma ur tessawvem, u, war ccekk, ur tessawavem, êezzbet i tmes isseô$an imdanen, id$a$en, ippuheggan i ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Becceô wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Yal tikelt ara ppuôeéqen, si ppemôa nnsen, ad inin: "d aya is neppuôeéq, uqbel". Ippunefk asen i ten icban. Din, jjwao nnsen d ayen iûfan. Degsen ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Becceô wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Yal tikelt ara ppuôeéqen, si ppemôa nnsen, ad inin: "d aya is neppuôeéq, uqbel". Ippunefk asen i ten icban. Din, jjwao nnsen d ayen iûfan. Degsen ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Ih, ur Ikukra ara Öebbi, a d Ifk amedya n tizip, ne$ ip i$elben. Wid iumnen éôan neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass nnsen. Wanag wid ijehlen qqaôen: "acu Ib$a Öebbi s umedya agi"? Yis, Itellif aîas; yis, Inehhu aîas. Ur Itellif yis, siwa iballa$en;
ayahs.translation: Ih, ur Ikukra ara Öebbi, a d Ifk amedya n tizip, ne$ ip i$elben. Wid iumnen éôan neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass nnsen. Wanag wid ijehlen qqaôen: "acu Ib$a Öebbi s umedya agi"? Yis, Itellif aîas; yis, Inehhu aîas. Ur Itellif yis, siwa iballa$en;

ayahs.text: wid ipôuéun lemâahda n Öebbi, deffir lmitaq iS, issemfaôaqen ayen id Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, issefsaden di tmurt. Widak d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: wid ipôuéun lemâahda n Öebbi, deffir lmitaq iS, issemfaôaqen ayen id Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, issefsaden di tmurt. Widak d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Amek ara tnekôem Öebbi? Tellam temmuten, Issader kwen id. Sinna, a kwen Ine$, sinna, a kwen id Issider, sinna, $uôeS a ppu$alem.
ayahs.translation: Amek ara tnekôem Öebbi? Tellam temmuten, Issader kwen id. Sinna, a kwen Ine$, sinna, a kwen id Issider, sinna, $uôeS a ppu$alem.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i wen Ixelqen ayen akw illan di tmurt; sinna, Izzi ar igenni, Iwqem it d ûa igenwan. Neppa, Issen yal cci.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i wen Ixelqen ayen akw illan di tmurt; sinna, Izzi ar igenni, Iwqem it d ûa igenwan. Neppa, Issen yal cci.

ayahs.text: Mi Inna Mass ik, i lmalayek: "Nek ad Rre$ aneûûaf di tmurt". Nnant aS: "day a Pperrev, degs, win ara isfesden degs, ara izzizlen idamen? Wanag, nekwenti nesbuccuâ K s ccekôan, u Neôôequ yaK". Inna: "Nek, èôi$ ayen ur teéôimt".
ayahs.translation: Mi Inna Mass ik, i lmalayek: "Nek ad Rre$ aneûûaf di tmurt". Nnant aS: "day a Pperrev, degs, win ara isfesden degs, ara izzizlen idamen? Wanag, nekwenti nesbuccuâ K s ccekôan, u Neôôequ yaK". Inna: "Nek, èôi$ ayen ur teéôimt".

ayahs.text: Isseêfev akw ismawen i Adem. Sinna, Issken iten i lmalayek, Inna: "efkemt iyI d ismawen n wigi, ma kunemti d sut tidep".
ayahs.translation: Isseêfev akw ismawen i Adem. Sinna, Issken iten i lmalayek, Inna: "efkemt iyI d ismawen n wigi, ma kunemti d sut tidep".

ayahs.text: Nnant: "gedha s yisseK! Ur nessin, siwa i a$ Teslemdev. Keçç, s tidep, d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab".
ayahs.translation: Nnant: "gedha s yisseK! Ur nessin, siwa i a$ Teslemdev. Keçç, s tidep, d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Adem, efk asent ismawen nnsen". Mi sent imla ismawen nnsen, Inna: "day ur a kwent Nni$ ara: Nek Ssne$ tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan, u èôi$ ayen d teqqaôem, akked wayen teppeffrem"?
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Adem, efk asent ismawen nnsen". Mi sent imla ismawen nnsen, Inna: "day ur a kwent Nni$ ara: Nek Ssne$ tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan, u èôi$ ayen d teqqaôem, akked wayen teppeffrem"?

ayahs.text: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem"! Knant, siwa Iblis. Iugi, u isme$weô iman is. Illa seg ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem"! Knant, siwa Iblis. Iugi, u isme$weô iman is. Illa seg ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Nenna: "a Adem, ezde$ keçç akked tmeîîut ik, di Loennet, eççet segs, s tawant, ayen i wen ihwan. Ur ppaéet ar ttejôa yagi, mulac a ppilim d imednas".
ayahs.translation: Nenna: "a Adem, ezde$ keçç akked tmeîîut ik, di Loennet, eççet segs, s tawant, ayen i wen ihwan. Ur ppaéet ar ttejôa yagi, mulac a ppilim d imednas".

ayahs.text: Ikellex iten Cciîan fellas. Issuffe$ iten id seg wanda llan. Nenna: "ûûubbet, d icenga bbwaygarawen. I kunwi, di tmurt, i$imi akked zzhu, siwa tallit".
ayahs.translation: Ikellex iten Cciîan fellas. Issuffe$ iten id seg wanda llan. Nenna: "ûûubbet, d icenga bbwaygarawen. I kunwi, di tmurt, i$imi akked zzhu, siwa tallit".

ayahs.text: Adem iîîef awalen n Mass is. Issuref as. Neppa, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Adem iîîef awalen n Mass is. Issuref as. Neppa, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Nenna: "ûûubbet segs, akken ma tellam. War ccekk, a kwen id tas nnhaya s$uôI". Wid iddan d nnhaya, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Nenna: "ûûubbet segs, akken ma tellam. War ccekk, a kwen id tas nnhaya s$uôI". Wid iddan d nnhaya, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is ikwen Öeéqe$. Eîîfet di lemâahda W, ad Ïîfe$ di lemâahda nnwen. D nek iwumi ara têezzbem.
ayahs.translation: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is ikwen Öeéqe$. Eîîfet di lemâahda W, ad Ïîfe$ di lemâahda nnwen. D nek iwumi ara têezzbem.

ayahs.text: Amnet s wayen id Sserse$, itebbten ayen illan $uôwen. Ur ppilit d imezwura ara t iagwin. Ur ppa$et, s issekniyen iW, ayen ôxisen. D nek iwumi ara têezzbem.
ayahs.translation: Amnet s wayen id Sserse$, itebbten ayen illan $uôwen. Ur ppilit d imezwura ara t iagwin. Ur ppa$et, s issekniyen iW, ayen ôxisen. D nek iwumi ara têezzbem.

ayahs.text: Ur slusut, i tidep, tikerkas. Ur teffret tidep, u kunwi teéôam.
ayahs.translation: Ur slusut, i tidep, tikerkas. Ur teffret tidep, u kunwi teéôam.

ayahs.translation: èéallet, zekkit, îîinzet akked wid iîîinizen.

ayahs.translation: Day a ppamôem ise$ i medden, a ppeppum iman nnwen? U kunwi teqqaôem Tazmamt. Day ur tefhimem ara?

ayahs.text: Ssutret lemâawna n ûûbeô akked téallit. Ih, dayen iwaâôen, siwa i imeéluven,
ayahs.translation: Ssutret lemâawna n ûûbeô akked téallit. Ih, dayen iwaâôen, siwa i imeéluven,

ayahs.translation: wid iêûan ar ad mlilen akked Mass nnsen, u $uôeS, nitni, war ccekk, ad u$alen.

ayahs.text: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is ikwen Öeéqe$. Nek, Smenyafe$ kwen i imavalen.
ayahs.translation: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is ikwen Öeéqe$. Nek, Smenyafe$ kwen i imavalen.

ayahs.text: Ëezzbet i wass ideg ur ippuoazi yiwen deg umkan n wayev, s wacemma. Ur tepwaqbal ccafuâa segs, ur tepwaîîaf, segs, le$ôama, ur ten ppaâwanen.
ayahs.translation: Ëezzbet i wass ideg ur ippuoazi yiwen deg umkan n wayev, s wacemma. Ur tepwaqbal ccafuâa segs, ur tepwaîîaf, segs, le$ôama, ur ten ppaâwanen.

ayahs.text: Mi kwen Nsellek seg ugdud n Ferâun, sâaddayen fellawen aâaqeb adiran. Zellun arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Ayagi d taluft tabarart, s$uô Mass nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Mi kwen Nsellek seg ugdud n Ferâun, sâaddayen fellawen aâaqeb adiran. Zellun arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Ayagi d taluft tabarart, s$uô Mass nnwen.

ayahs.text: Mi, yiswen, Nessemfaôeq ill, Nsellek ikwen, Ne$meq agdud n Ferâun, kunwi la tepwalim.
ayahs.translation: Mi, yiswen, Nessemfaôeq ill, Nsellek ikwen, Ne$meq agdud n Ferâun, kunwi la tepwalim.

ayahs.text: Mi Nga lemâahda i Musa, kuéet wavan; sinna, deffir es, teddam d uâajmi. Kunwi d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Mi Nga lemâahda i Musa, kuéet wavan; sinna, deffir es, teddam d uâajmi. Kunwi d imednas.

ayahs.text: Sinna, deffir waya, Nsemmeê awen, amar a ppesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, deffir waya, Nsemmeê awen, amar a ppesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: Mi Nefka, i Musa, Tazmamt akked ufraz, amar a ppeppwanhum.
ayahs.translation: Mi Nefka, i Musa, Tazmamt akked ufraz, amar a ppeppwanhum.

ayahs.text: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Kunwi, s tidep, tdensem iman nnwen, mi teddam d uâajmi. Ssutret ssmaê i Uxellaq nnwen; mmin$et, ppif i kunwi ar Uxellaq nnwen. Issuref awen. Neppa, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu".
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Kunwi, s tidep, tdensem iman nnwen, mi teddam d uâajmi. Ssutret ssmaê i Uxellaq nnwen; mmin$et, ppif i kunwi ar Uxellaq nnwen. Issuref awen. Neppa, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu".

ayahs.text: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur neppamen yisek, d awez$i, alamma nwala Öebbi, âinani". Tewwet ikwen id ssiâqa, kunwi tepwalim.
ayahs.translation: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur neppamen yisek, d awez$i, alamma nwala Öebbi, âinani". Tewwet ikwen id ssiâqa, kunwi tepwalim.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Nerra kwen id, deffir tmeppant nnwen, amar a ppesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Nerra kwen id, deffir tmeppant nnwen, amar a ppesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: S usigna, Nerra yawen tili. Nessers awen d lmenna, ifeôôuoen: "eççet si téidanin is ikwen N$at". Ur a£ dnisen, maca densen iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: S usigna, Nerra yawen tili. Nessers awen d lmenna, ifeôôuoen: "eççet si téidanin is ikwen N$at". Ur a£ dnisen, maca densen iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Mi Nenna: "kecmet tamdint agi, eççet degs, s tawant, ayen i wen ihwan; kecmet si tebburt, s lekni; init: nendem. Ad awen Nsemmeê tuccva nnwen, a Nernu i iâaôviyen".
ayahs.translation: Mi Nenna: "kecmet tamdint agi, eççet degs, s tawant, ayen i wen ihwan; kecmet si tebburt, s lekni; init: nendem. Ad awen Nsemmeê tuccva nnwen, a Nernu i iâaôviyen".

ayahs.text: Wid idensen bedlen awal, ur d win i sen nnan. Nessers ed, i wid idensen, tawa$it seg igenni, ilmend n tucmitin nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Wid idensen bedlen awal, ur d win i sen nnan. Nessers ed, i wid idensen, tawa$it seg igenni, ilmend n tucmitin nnsen.

ayahs.text: Mi issuter Musa aman i ugdud is, Nenna: "ewwet aéôu, s uâkkwaz ik". Feggvent ed, segs, mrawsnat tliwa. Yal wa iéôa anda ara issew. "Eççet, esswet, si ôôeéq n Öebbi. Ur ssefsadet di tmurt am imjaêen".
ayahs.translation: Mi issuter Musa aman i ugdud is, Nenna: "ewwet aéôu, s uâkkwaz ik". Feggvent ed, segs, mrawsnat tliwa. Yal wa iéôa anda ara issew. "Eççet, esswet, si ôôeéq n Öebbi. Ur ssefsadet di tmurt am imjaêen".

ayahs.text: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur nesteqnaâ bippa s yiwen n lqut. Nuj a$ Mass ik, ad a$ d Issuffe$ ayen d teggar tmurt: tizzegzewt is, axyaô is, ticcert is, laâds is, lebûel is". Ayagi, acku llan ugin issekniyen n Öebbi, neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi âuûan, u zgaren tilas.
ayahs.translation: Mi tennam: "a Musa! Ur nesteqnaâ bippa s yiwen n lqut. Nuj a$ Mass ik, ad a$ d Issuffe$ ayen d teggar tmurt: tizzegzewt is, axyaô is, ticcert is, laâds is, lebûel is". Inna: "teb$am a pbedlem ayen ilhan s wayen ixuûen? Üûubbet ar Maûeô, a n tafem, war ccekk, ayen tessutrem". I$li d fellasen ddell akked ééelt. Sebbeben d urrif n Öebbi. Ayagi, acku llan ugin issekniyen n Öebbi, neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi âuûan, u zgaren tilas.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, imasiêiyen, iûabiyen, kra iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad sâun arraz ar Mass nnsen, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, imasiêiyen, iûabiyen, kra iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad sâun arraz ar Mass nnsen, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Mi Nga laâqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eîîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, mmektit ed i illan degs, amar a pêezzbem".
ayahs.translation: Mi Nga laâqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eîîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, mmektit ed i illan degs, amar a pêezzbem".

ayahs.text: Sinna, deffir waya, twexxôem. Lemmer maççi d lfevl n Öebbi fellawen, akked uêunu S, a ppilim seg imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, deffir waya, twexxôem. Lemmer maççi d lfevl n Öebbi fellawen, akked uêunu S, a ppilim seg imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ tessnem wid, segwen, iccven di Ssebt. Nenna yasen: "ilit d iddawen imaâfan"!
ayahs.translation: Ni$ tessnem wid, segwen, iccven di Ssebt. Nenna yasen: "ilit d iddawen imaâfan"!

ayahs.text: Nerra p d amedya i imuddiren akked wid i ten id ineûfen, u d aâggen i wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Nerra p d amedya i imuddiren akked wid i ten id ineûfen, u d aâggen i wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "Öebbi, s tidep, Iumeô awen d a ppezlum tafunast". Nnan: "day a tettihiv fella$"? Inna: "ad iyi Isseô Öebbi! Ur ppili$ seg at war tussna".
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "Öebbi, s tidep, Iumeô awen d a ppezlum tafunast". Nnan: "day a tettihiv fella$"? Inna: "ad iyi Isseô Öebbi! Ur ppili$ seg at war tussna".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "nuj a$ ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen anta p". Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: tafunast ur wessret, ur meééiyet, garasen. Xedmet i wen d ippumôen".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "nuj a$ ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen anta p". Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: tafunast ur wessret, ur meééiyet, garasen. Xedmet i wen d ippumôen".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen ini s". Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: d tafunast tawôa$t, ini imfeooeo, ad iaâoeb w ip iwalan".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen ini s". Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: d tafunast tawôa$t, ini imfeooeo, ad iaâoeb w ip iwalan".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen anta p. £uône$, s tidep, tistan ppemcabint. Ih, ma Ib$a Öebbi, a nepwanhu".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "nuj ar Mass ik, ad a$ d Ibeggen anta p. £uône$, s tidep, tistan ppemcabint. Ih, ma Ib$a Öebbi, a nepwanhu".

ayahs.text: Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: d tafunast ur taâtib si tyerza n tmurt, ne$ si tissit n yigran, tûeêêa, ur tepwacôev". Nnan as: "tura, tebbwiv d tidep". Zlan p. Qôib ur ewqimen.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "Neppa, s tidep, la Iqqaô: d tafunast ur taâtib si tyerza n tmurt, ne$ si tissit n yigran, tûeêêa, ur tepwacôev". Nnan as: "tura, tebbwiv d tidep". Zlan p. Qôib ur ewqimen.

ayahs.text: Mi ten$am yiwen, wa irra p id $ef wa. Öebbi Issuffe$ ed ayen teppeffrem.
ayahs.translation: Mi ten$am yiwen, wa irra p id $ef wa. Öebbi Issuffe$ ed ayen teppeffrem.

ayahs.text: Nenna: "ewwtet ep s kra ines". Akka i Issidir Öebbi lmeggtin. Issenâat awen issekniyen iS, amar a pfehmem.
ayahs.translation: Nenna: "ewwtet ep s kra ines". Akka i Issidir Öebbi lmeggtin. Issenâat awen issekniyen iS, amar a pfehmem.

ayahs.text: Sinna, deffir waya, qquôen wulawen nnwen; cuban aéôu, ne$ kteô, di ta$eôt. Ih, llan iéôa iseg d pfeggiven isaffen. Llan, s tidep, wid ipceqqiqen, teff$en d waman segsen. S tidep, llan wid i$ellin si tugwdi n Öebbi. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, deffir waya, qquôen wulawen nnwen; cuban aéôu, ne$ kteô, di ta$eôt. Ih, llan iéôa iseg d pfeggiven isaffen. Llan, s tidep, wid ipceqqiqen, teff$en d waman segsen. S tidep, llan wid i$ellin si tugwdi n Öebbi. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Day tôe$bem a kwen amnen? Ni$ arbaâ, segsen, ssemêasen i wawal n Öebbi, sinna, mi t fehmen, ad as bedlen udem, u nitni éôan.
ayahs.translation: Day tôe$bem a kwen amnen? Ni$ arbaâ, segsen, ssemêasen i wawal n Öebbi, sinna, mi t fehmen, ad as bedlen udem, u nitni éôan.

ayahs.text: Mi mmugren wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mi qqimen garasen, qqaôen: "day ad asen tinim ayen i wen Imla Öebbi, a kwen nna$en yis, ar Mass nnwen? Day ur tepmeyyizem ara"?
ayahs.translation: Mi mmugren wid iumnen, ad inin: "numen". Mi qqimen garasen, qqaôen: "day ad asen tinim ayen i wen Imla Öebbi, a kwen nna$en yis, ar Mass nnwen? Day ur tepmeyyizem ara"?

ayahs.text: Ne$ ur éôin ara, Öebbi Issen ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaôen.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ ur éôin ara, Öebbi Issen ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaôen.

ayahs.text: Garasen, at war ta$uôi, ur nessin Tazmamt, siwa ayen nnwan. Nitni $ilen kan.
ayahs.translation: Garasen, at war ta$uôi, ur nessin Tazmamt, siwa ayen nnwan. Nitni $ilen kan.

ayahs.text: A tawa$it n wid ipparun Tazmamt s ifassen nnsen, sinna, qqaôen: "ayagi s$uô Öebbi", iwakken ad a$en, yis, ayen ôxisen! A tawa$it nnsen, ilmend n wayen uran ifassen nnsen! A tawa$it nnsen, $ef wayen keppben!
ayahs.translation: A tawa$it n wid ipparun Tazmamt s ifassen nnsen, sinna, qqaôen: "ayagi s$uô Öebbi", iwakken ad a$en, yis, ayen ôxisen! A tawa$it nnsen, ilmend n wayen uran ifassen nnsen! A tawa$it nnsen, $ef wayen keppben!

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ur a$ tepnal tmes, d awez$i, siwa kra n wussan". Ini: "day teîîfem lemâahda s$uô Öebbi? Öebbi, d awez$i, ur Izeggil lemâahda S. Ne$ teqqaôem, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ur a$ tepnal tmes, d awez$i, siwa kra n wussan". Ini: "day teîîfem lemâahda s$uô Öebbi? Öebbi, d awez$i, ur Izeggil lemâahda S. Ne$ teqqaôem, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?

ayahs.text: Xaîi, win ikesben tucmip, u tennev as tuccva s…, widak, d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi, win ikesben tucmip, u tennev as tuccva s…, widak, d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, widak, d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, widak, d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Mi Nga laâqed i At Isôail: "ur âabdet siwa Öebbi. Elhut ar imawlan, ar llzem nnwen, ar igujilen, ar igellilen. Init i medden, awal imaânen. èéÈallet, zekkit". Sinna, twexxôem, siwa kra segwen, u, kunwi, tnumrem.
ayahs.translation: Mi Nga laâqed i At Isôail: "ur âabdet siwa Öebbi. Elhut ar imawlan, ar llzem nnwen, ar igujilen, ar igellilen. Init i medden, awal imaânen. èéÈallet, zekkit". Sinna, twexxôem, siwa kra segwen, u, kunwi, tnumrem.

ayahs.text: Mi wen Nga laâqed nnwen: "ur zzazalet idim nnwen, ur pemssuffu$et seg ixxamen nnwen". D$a twefqem, kunwi d inagan.
ayahs.translation: Mi wen Nga laâqed nnwen: "ur zzazalet idim nnwen, ur pemssuffu$et seg ixxamen nnwen". D$a twefqem, kunwi d inagan.

ayahs.text: Sinna, kunwi d wid immin$en, tessuff$em arbaâ segwen, seg ixxamen nnsen. Tezzim asen s ibekkaven akked taâdawt. Ma usan kwen id, d imeêbas, tfeddum ten. Irna, ipwagdel awen usuffe$ nnsen. Day tumnem deg uêric n Tezmamt, tnekôem wayev? Anwa ay d arraz n wid, segwen, ixedmen aya, ma maççi d ddell, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u, ass n tnekra, ad ppunefken i uâaqeb uqsiê mavi? Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, kunwi d wid immin$en, tessuff$em arbaâ segwen, seg ixxamen nnsen. Tezzim asen s ibekkaven akked taâdawt. Ma usan kwen id, d imeêbas, tfeddum ten. Irna, ipwagdel awen usuffe$ nnsen. Day tumnem deg uêric n Tezmamt, tnekôem wayev? Anwa ay d arraz n wid, segwen, ixedmen aya, ma maççi d ddell, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u, ass n tnekra, ad ppunefken i uâaqeb uqsiê mavi? Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Widak d wid iu$en tudert n ddunit s laxeôt, ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur ppusellken.
ayahs.translation: Widak d wid iu$en tudert n ddunit s laxeôt, ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur ppusellken.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Nuzen ed imazanen, deffir es. Nefka abeggen i Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Null it s ôôuê iqedsen. Yal tikelt ideg ara kwen id ias umazan, s wayen ur awen nehwi, tesme$wôem iman nnwen. Kra teskaddbem ten, kra ten$am ten.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Nuzen ed imazanen, deffir es. Nefka abeggen i Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Null it s ôôuê iqedsen. Yal tikelt ideg ara kwen id ias umazan, s wayen ur awen nehwi, tesme$wôem iman nnwen. Kra teskaddbem ten, kra ten$am ten.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ulawen nne$ qquôen". Xaîi, Ixza ten Öebbi, ilmend n tijehli nnsen. Drus iten wid iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ulawen nne$ qquôen". Xaîi, Ixza ten Öebbi, ilmend n tijehli nnsen. Drus iten wid iumnen.

ayahs.text: Mi ten id tusa Tezmamt, s$uô Öebbi, d atebbet n wayen illan $uôsen, - u llan, iu$ lêal, ssuturen ad $elben wid ijehlen - mi ten id iusa wayen ssnen, ugin t. Ad Inâal Öebbi ijehliyen!
ayahs.translation: Mi ten id tusa Tezmamt, s$uô Öebbi, d atebbet n wayen illan $uôsen, - u llan, iu$ lêal, ssuturen ad $elben wid ijehlen - mi ten id iusa wayen ssnen, ugin t. Ad Inâal Öebbi ijehliyen!

ayahs.text: I icmet wayen i$ef zzenzen iman nnsen! Ugin ayen id Issers Öebbi. Ëesden mi id Issers Öebbi, si lfevl iS, i win i S ihwan n yimdanen iS. Sebbeben urrif ar wayev. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb isdullun.
ayahs.translation: I icmet wayen i$ef zzenzen iman nnsen! Ugin ayen id Issers Öebbi. Ëesden mi id Issers Öebbi, si lfevl iS, i win i S ihwan n yimdanen iS. Sebbeben urrif ar wayev. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb isdullun.

ayahs.text: Ma nnan asen: "amnet s wayen id Issers Öebbi"! A d inin: "numen s wayen id irsen $uône$". Nekôen ayen i t id itebâan, u neppa d tidep, d atebbet n wayen illan $uôsen. Ini: "acimi tneqqem lambiyya n Öebbi, zik, ma d lmumnin ay tellam"?
ayahs.translation: Ma nnan asen: "amnet s wayen id Issers Öebbi"! A d inin: "numen s wayen id irsen $uône$". Nekôen ayen i t id itebâan, u neppa d tidep, d atebbet n wayen illan $uôsen. Ini: "acimi tneqqem lambiyya n Öebbi, zik, ma d lmumnin ay tellam"?

ayahs.text: Ni$ iusa kwen id Musa, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir es, teddam akked uâajmi. Kunwi d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ iusa kwen id Musa, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir es, teddam akked uâajmi. Kunwi d imednas.

ayahs.text: Mi Nga laâqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eîîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, u ssemêesset". Nnan d: "nesla u nâuûa". Ikecm asen uâajmi ar wul, si tjehli nnsen. Ini: "dir it wayen i wen iumeô liman nnwen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
ayahs.translation: Mi Nga laâqed yidwen, Nessuli adrar sennig wen: "eîîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, u ssemêesset". Nnan d: "nesla u nâuûa". Ikecm asen uâajmi ar wul, si tjehli nnsen. Ini: "dir it wayen i wen iumeô liman nnwen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".

ayahs.text: Ini: "maday, ar Öebbi, axxam aneggaru i kunwi kan, ur pkkan ara imdanen, mennit tameppant, ma tessawalem tidep"!
ayahs.translation: Ini: "maday, ar Öebbi, axxam aneggaru i kunwi kan, ur pkkan ara imdanen, mennit tameppant, ma tessawalem tidep"!

ayahs.text: D awez$i, ur p pmennin, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnsen. Öebbi Issen imednas.
ayahs.translation: D awez$i, ur p pmennin, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnsen. Öebbi Issen imednas.

ayahs.text: A ten tafev, war ccekk, êemmlen tameddurt sennig medden, sennig imcurak. Atan yiwen segsen, issaram ad idder agim iseggwasen. Te$wzi n laâmeô is, ur as tessifrir aâaqeb. Öebbi Ipwali ayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: A ten tafev, war ccekk, êemmlen tameddurt sennig medden, sennig imcurak. Atan yiwen segsen, issaram ad idder agim iseggwasen. Te$wzi n laâmeô is, ur as tessifrir aâaqeb. Öebbi Ipwali ayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "anwa illan d acengu n Jebrayen"? D neppa, s tidep, it id issersen $ef wul ik, s leb$i n Öebbi. D atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d nnhaya u d abecceô n lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "anwa illan d acengu n Jebrayen"? D neppa, s tidep, it id issersen $ef wul ik, s leb$i n Öebbi. D atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d nnhaya u d abecceô n lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Win illan d acengu n Öebbi, lmalayek iS, imazanen iS, Jebrayen, Mikail…, ihi, Öebbi d acengu ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Win illan d acengu n Öebbi, lmalayek iS, imazanen iS, Jebrayen, Mikail…, ihi, Öebbi d acengu ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nessers ak d issekniyen iberrzen. I ten inekôen, siwa iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nessers ak d issekniyen iberrzen. I ten inekôen, siwa iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Day yal tikelt ideg ara gen laâqed, a t ixdaâ urbaâ segsen? Ih, tegwti segsen, ur uminen.
ayahs.translation: Day yal tikelt ideg ara gen laâqed, a t ixdaâ urbaâ segsen? Ih, tegwti segsen, ur uminen.

ayahs.text: Mi ten id iusa umazan s$uô Öebbi, itebbet ayen illan $uôsen, arbaâ n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, rran Tazmamt n Öebbi s azagur nnsen, amzun ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Mi ten id iusa umazan s$uô Öebbi, itebbet ayen illan $uôsen, arbaâ n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, rran Tazmamt n Öebbi s azagur nnsen, amzun ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Ddan akked wayen xedmen ccwaîen mgal tagelda n Sliman. Sliman ur ijhil. Maca ccwaîen jehlen. Sseêfaven i medden ssêur, akked wayen id irsen, di Babil, ar lmalayek Harut akked Marut. Ur sselmaden yiwen, mebla ma nnan: "nekwni n$ewwu kan, ur jehhel"! ÊÊÊËefven, $uôsen, amek ara ssemfaôaqen argaz akked tmeîîut is. Ur îîurun yiwen syis, siwa ma Ib$a Öebbi. ÊÊÊËefven ara ten ivuôôen, ur ten ineffaâ. Ni$ éôan ar win i p iu$en, ur as illi umur di laxeôt. War ccekk, ard ucmit wayen is zzenzen leôwaê nnsen, lemmer éôin!
ayahs.translation: Ddan akked wayen xedmen ccwaîen mgal tagelda n Sliman. Sliman ur ijhil. Maca ccwaîen jehlen. Sseêfaven i medden ssêur, akked wayen id irsen, di Babil, ar lmalayek Harut akked Marut. Ur sselmaden yiwen, mebla ma nnan: "nekwni n$ewwu kan, ur jehhel"! ÊÊÊËefven, $uôsen, amek ara ssemfaôaqen argaz akked tmeîîut is. Ur îîurun yiwen syis, siwa ma Ib$a Öebbi. ÊÊÊËefven ara ten ivuôôen, ur ten ineffaâ. Ni$ éôan ar win i p iu$en, ur as illi umur di laxeôt. War ccekk, ard ucmit wayen is zzenzen leôwaê nnsen, lemmer éôin!

ayahs.text: Lemmer, s tidep, uminen u êezzben, ad ifrir warraz s$uô Öebbi, lemmer ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer, s tidep, uminen u êezzben, ad ifrir warraz s$uô Öebbi, lemmer ssinen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur qqaret: "Âass a$ d", init: "Wali a$ d", u ssemêesset. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur qqaret: "Âass a$ d", init: "Wali a$ d", u ssemêesset. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ur b$in ara ijehliyen, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, akked imcurak, ad awen d irs kra n lxiô, s$uô Mass nnwen. Öebbi Ismenyaf, s uêunu S, win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Ur b$in ara ijehliyen, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, akked imcurak, ad awen d irs kra n lxiô, s$uô Mass nnwen. Öebbi Ismenyaf, s uêunu S, win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Ur Nessemsay assekni, ne$ ur t Nesseppu, mebla ma Nebbwi d win it yifen, ne$ i t icban. Day ur teéôiv ara Öebbi Izmer i yal cci?
ayahs.translation: Ur Nessemsay assekni, ne$ ur t Nesseppu, mebla ma Nebbwi d win it yifen, ne$ i t icban. Day ur teéôiv ara Öebbi Izmer i yal cci?

ayahs.text: Day ur teéôiv ara, ar n Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Ur tesâim, war Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Day ur teéôiv ara, ar n Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Ur tesâim, war Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: Ne$ teb$am a ppesteqsim Amazan nnwen, akken ippusteqsa, zik, Musa? Win ibeddlen liman s tijehli, innetlaf ar yir abrid.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ teb$am a ppesteqsim Amazan nnwen, akken ippusteqsa, zik, Musa? Win ibeddlen liman s tijehli, innetlaf ar yir abrid.

ayahs.text: Si leêsed nnsen, aîas seg wAt Tezmamt, mi sen d tban tidep, budden awen tijehli, mbaâd liman nnwen. Ssemêet, ssemsut, ar d Ias Öebbi s lameô iS. Ni$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Si leêsed nnsen, aîas seg wAt Tezmamt, mi sen d tban tidep, budden awen tijehli, mbaâd liman nnwen. Ssemêet, ssemsut, ar d Ias Öebbi s lameô iS. Ni$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: èéallet, zekkit. Ayen ara tezzewrem n lxiô i iman nnwen, a t tafem ar Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ayen akw txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: èéallet, zekkit. Ayen ara tezzewrem n lxiô i iman nnwen, a t tafem ar Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ayen akw txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ur ikeççem Loennet, siwa win illan d uday, ne$ d amasiêi". D wagi ay d asirem nnsen. Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tidep".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ur ikeççem Loennet, siwa win illan d uday, ne$ d amasiêi". D wagi ay d asirem nnsen. Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tidep".

ayahs.text: Xaîi, win iunzen i Öebbi, u d aâôvi, ad isâu arraz is, ar Mass is. Ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi, win iunzen i Öebbi, u d aâôvi, ad isâu arraz is, ar Mass is. Ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Nnan wudayen: "imasiêiyen ur sennden s acemma". Nnan imasiêiyen: "udayen ur sennden s acemma". U nitni la qqaôen Tazmamt. Akka, wid ur nessin ara, nnan am nitni. Ad Iêudd Öebbi, garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.
ayahs.translation: Nnan wudayen: "imasiêiyen ur sennden s acemma". Nnan imasiêiyen: "udayen ur sennden s acemma". U nitni la qqaôen Tazmamt. Akka, wid ur nessin ara, nnan am nitni. Ad Iêudd Öebbi, garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.

ayahs.text: Anwa idensen sennig wid igedlen, di leowamaâ n Öebbi, asmekti n yisem iS, u lhan d deg ussexôeb nnsen? Widak, ur iwata ara a ten kecmen, siwa ma s tugwdi. I nitni, ddell di ddunit, u aâaqeb abarar di laxeôt.
ayahs.translation: Anwa idensen sennig wid igedlen, di leowamaâ n Öebbi, asmekti n yisem iS, u lhan d deg ussexôeb nnsen? Widak, ur iwata ara a ten kecmen, siwa ma s tugwdi. I nitni, ddell di ddunit, u aâaqeb abarar di laxeôt.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi agmuv akked utaram. Ar wanda tezzim, din Udem n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi agmuv akked utaram. Ar wanda tezzim, din Udem n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "Öebbi Isâa mmi S". Gedha s yiS! Ni$ ineS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Akw, péallan i Neppa,
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "Öebbi Isâa mmi S". Gedha s yiS! Ni$ ineS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Akw, péallan i Neppa,

ayahs.text: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Ma Iseyya lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.
ayahs.translation: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Ma Iseyya lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.

ayahs.text: Nnan wid ur nessin: "a lemmer ad a$ d Immeslay Öebbi, ne$ ad a$ d ias ussekni"! Akka ay nnan wid i ten id izwaren, am awalen nnsen. Ppemcabin wulawen nnsen. Ni$ Nbeggen ed issekniyen i ugdud ipputebbten.
ayahs.translation: Nnan wid ur nessin: "a lemmer ad a$ d Immeslay Öebbi, ne$ ad a$ d ias ussekni"! Akka ay nnan wid i ten id izwaren, am awalen nnsen. Ppemcabin wulawen nnsen. Ni$ Nbeggen ed issekniyen i ugdud ipputebbten.

ayahs.text: Ih, Nuzen ik id, s tidep, d abcir, u d aneddaô. Ur ippili fellak usteqsi $ef at wu$ud.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Nuzen ik id, s tidep, d abcir, u d aneddaô. Ur ippili fellak usteqsi $ef at wu$ud.

ayahs.text: Ur k pôavin wudayen ne$ imasiêiyen, alamma teddiv d ddin nnsen. Ini: "d nehhu n Öebbi ay d nehhu". Ma teddiv akked usirem nnsen, deffir wayen ik ed iusan n tmusni, ur k ipfukku, si Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Ur k pôavin wudayen ne$ imasiêiyen, alamma teddiv d ddin nnsen. Ini: "d nehhu n Öebbi ay d nehhu". Ma teddiv akked usirem nnsen, deffir wayen ik ed iusan n tmusni, ur k ipfukku, si Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, qqaôen p leqôaya iwatan. Widak umnen yis. Wid i p iugin, widak d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, qqaôen p leqôaya iwatan. Widak umnen yis. Wid i p iugin, widak d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is i kwen £ate$. Nek, Smenyafe$ kwen i imavalen.
ayahs.translation: A yAt Isôail! Mmektit ed l$it iW, is i kwen £ate$. Nek, Smenyafe$ kwen i imavalen.

ayahs.text: Ëezzbet i wass ideg ur ippuqeîîi yiwen, deg umkan n wayev, s wacemma; ur tepwaqbal le$ôama segs, ur t tenfaâ ccafuâa, ur ppusellken.
ayahs.translation: Ëezzbet i wass ideg ur ippuqeîîi yiwen, deg umkan n wayev, s wacemma; ur tepwaqbal le$ôama segs, ur t tenfaâ ccafuâa, ur ppusellken.

ayahs.text: Ibôahim, mi t Ijeôôeb Mass is, s wawalen, iu$ awal. Inna: "Nek, a k Rre$ d win ara inehhun medden". Inna: "u si tarwa w"? Inna: "lemâahda W ur taâna ara imednas".
ayahs.translation: Ibôahim, mi t Ijeôôeb Mass is, s wawalen, iu$ awal. Inna: "Nek, a k Rre$ d win ara inehhun medden". Inna: "u si tarwa w"? Inna: "lemâahda W ur taâna ara imednas".

ayahs.text: Mi Nerra Axxam d lemqam i yimdanen, u d amkan n laman: "erret lemqam n Ibôahim d loamaâ"! Nâuhed i Ibôahim akked Ismaâil: "zzizdget Axxam iW, i wid idewwiôen, wid ip$imin, wid iîîinizen, wid ikennun".
ayahs.translation: Mi Nerra Axxam d lemqam i yimdanen, u d amkan n laman: "erret lemqam n Ibôahim d loamaâ"! Nâuhed i Ibôahim akked Ismaâil: "zzizdget Axxam iW, i wid idewwiôen, wid ip$imin, wid iîîinizen, wid ikennun".

ayahs.text: Mi inna Ibôahim: "a Mass iw! Err wagi d tamdint n laman, £it imezda$ is s ppemôat; wid, segsen, iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru". Inna: "win ijehlen, a t Ooe$ ad izhu cwiî, sinna, a t Nehôe$ ar uâaqeb n tmes. A tu$alin tucmip"!
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Ibôahim: "a Mass iw! Err wagi d tamdint n laman, £it imezda$ is s ppemôat; wid, segsen, iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru". Inna: "win ijehlen, a t Ooe$ ad izhu cwiî, sinna, a t Nehôe$ ar uâaqeb n tmes. A tu$alin tucmip"!

ayahs.text: Ibôahim akked Ismaâil, mi ssalayen leêyuv n Uxxam: "a Mass nne$! Eqbel s$uône$, Keçç, s tidep, d Win Isellen, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ibôahim akked Ismaâil, mi ssalayen leêyuv n Uxxam: "a Mass nne$! Eqbel s$uône$, Keçç, s tidep, d Win Isellen, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Err ane$ d imvuâen iK, u, si dderya nne$, lois ar aK ianzen. Mel a$ isekkiren nne$, Ssuref a$. Keçç, s tidep, Tessurufev, Tepêunuv.
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Err ane$ d imvuâen iK, u, si dderya nne$, lois ar aK ianzen. Mel a$ isekkiren nne$, Ssuref a$. Keçç, s tidep, Tessurufev, Tepêunuv.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Azen asen d amazan segsen, ad asen iqqaô issekniyen iK, ad asen isseêfev Tazmamt akked ûûwab, a ten izzizdeg. Keçç, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Azen asen d amazan segsen, ad asen iqqaô issekniyen iK, ad asen isseêfev Tazmamt akked ûûwab, a ten izzizdeg. Keçç, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".

ayahs.text: Anwa iugin ddin n Ibôahim, siwa win iccemten iman is? Ni$ Nefren it di ddunit. Di laxeôt, neppa, war ccekk, seg iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Anwa iugin ddin n Ibôahim, siwa win iccemten iman is? Ni$ Nefren it di ddunit. Di laxeôt, neppa, war ccekk, seg iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Mi s Inna Mass is: "anez"! Inna: "unze$ aS i Mass imavalen".
ayahs.translation: Mi s Inna Mass is: "anez"! Inna: "unze$ aS i Mass imavalen".

ayahs.text: Iweûûa yis Ibôahim arraw is - akken Iaâqub -: "a yarraw iw, Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren awen ddin, ur ppemmtet siwa ma tunzem".
ayahs.translation: Iweûûa yis Ibôahim arraw is - akken Iaâqub -: "a yarraw iw, Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren awen ddin, ur ppemmtet siwa ma tunzem".

ayahs.text: Ne$ tellam d inagan mi d ters tmeppant ar Yaâqub, mi inna i tarwa s: "anwa ara tâabdem deffir i"? Nnan: "a naâbed Öebbi k, u Öebbi n lejdud ik: Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq. Öebbi Yiwen. Nekwni nunez aS".
ayahs.translation: Ne$ tellam d inagan mi d ters tmeppant ar Yaâqub, mi inna i tarwa s: "anwa ara tâabdem deffir i"? Nnan: "a naâbed Öebbi k, u Öebbi n lejdud ik: Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq. Öebbi Yiwen. Nekwni nunez aS".

ayahs.text: Wigi d lois i iâaddan. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur kwen steqsayen $ef wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Wigi d lois i iâaddan. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur kwen steqsayen $ef wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ilit d udayen ne$ d imasiêiyen, a ppepwanhum". Ini: "Xaîi, maca ddin n Ibôahim, imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ilit d udayen ne$ d imasiêiyen, a ppepwanhum". Ini: "Xaîi, maca ddin n Ibôahim, imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak".

ayahs.text: Init: "numen s Öebbi akked wayen id irsen $uône$, wayen id irsen ar Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, ayen ippunefken i Musa, Âisa, ayen ippunefken i lambiyya, s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur nessemgarrad yiwen segsen, nekwni nunez aS".
ayahs.translation: Init: "numen s Öebbi akked wayen id irsen $uône$, wayen id irsen ar Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, ayen ippunefken i Musa, Âisa, ayen ippunefken i lambiyya, s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur nessemgarrad yiwen segsen, nekwni nunez aS".

ayahs.text: Ma umnen ayen icuban ayen tumnem, atnan pwanhan. Ma wexxôen, haaten kan di lefôaq. Iqadd ik Öebbi, segsen. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ma umnen ayen icuban ayen tumnem, atnan pwanhan. Ma wexxôen, haaten kan di lefôaq. Iqadd ik Öebbi, segsen. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ssbi$a, n Öebbi. Anwa yifen Öebbi i ssbi$a? Nekwni d iâabbaden iS.
ayahs.translation: Ssbi$a, n Öebbi. Anwa yifen Öebbi i ssbi$a? Nekwni d iâabbaden iS.

ayahs.text: Ini: "day ad a$ tnamrem $ef Öebbi, u Neppa d Mass nne$, u d Mass nnwen? I nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Nekwni d izedganen iS".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "day ad a$ tnamrem $ef Öebbi, u Neppa d Mass nne$, u d Mass nnwen? I nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Nekwni d izedganen iS".

ayahs.text: Ne$ a d tinim: "s tidep, Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, llan d udayen, ne$ d imasiêiyen"? Ini: "Anwa i isnen sennig akw, d kunwi ne$ d Öebbi"? Anwa i idensen sennig win iffren ccada, i isâa s$uô Öebbi? Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ a d tinim: "s tidep, Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, llan d udayen, ne$ d imasiêiyen"? Ini: "Anwa i isnen sennig akw, d kunwi ne$ d Öebbi"? Anwa i idensen sennig win iffren ccada, i isâa s$uô Öebbi? Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Asatu agi iâadda. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur fellawen asteqsi $ef wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Asatu agi iâadda. Ines ayen ikseb, nnwen ayen tkesbem. Ur fellawen asteqsi $ef wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ad inin ije$lufen, ger medden: "acu iten iswexxôen si lqibla nnsen, u$uô llan péallan"? Ini: "N Öebbi agmuv akked utaram. Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim".
ayahs.translation: Ad inin ije$lufen, ger medden: "acu iten iswexxôen si lqibla nnsen, u$uô llan péallan"? Ini: "N Öebbi agmuv akked utaram. Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim".

ayahs.text: Akka ay kwen Nerra d lois alemmas, iwakken a ppilim d inagan n medden, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen. Nerra lqibla u$uô teppezziv, iwakken kan a Néeô anwa iddan d Umazan, anwa iu$alen ar deffir. D lhejna, siwa i wid Inha Öebbi. Ur Iveggiâ Öebbi liman nnwen. Ih, Öebbi, i yimdanen, d Umâin, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay kwen Nerra d lois alemmas, iwakken a ppilim d inagan n medden, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen. Nerra lqibla u$uô teppezziv, iwakken kan a Néeô anwa iddan d Umazan, anwa iu$alen ar deffir. D lhejna, siwa i wid Inha Öebbi. Ur Iveggiâ Öebbi liman nnwen. Ih, Öebbi, i yimdanen, d Umâin, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nwala, tezziv udem ik ar igenni. A k Nawi ar lqibla ara tôaviv. Ezzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen $uôes. Ih, wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, éôan p d tidep s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nwala, tezziv udem ik ar igenni. A k Nawi ar lqibla ara tôaviv. Ezzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen $uôes. Ih, wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, éôan p d tidep s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Xas a d tawiv, i wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, yal assekni, ur tezzin ar lqibla k. Keçç, ur tezzi ar lqibla nnsen. Kra segsen, ur tezzin ar lqibla n wiyav. Ma teddiv akked usirem nnsen, mbaâd ma tusa k id, s$uône£, tussna, a ppiliv, imiren, seg imednas.
ayahs.translation: Xas a d tawiv, i wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, yal assekni, ur tezzin ar lqibla k. Keçç, ur tezzi ar lqibla nnsen. Kra segsen, ur tezzin ar lqibla n wiyav. Ma teddiv akked usirem nnsen, mbaâd ma tusa k id, s$uône£, tussna, a ppiliv, imiren, seg imednas.

ayahs.text: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt ssnen p, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. War ccekk, arbaâ segsen teffren tidep, u nitni éôan.
ayahs.translation: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt ssnen p, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. War ccekk, arbaâ segsen teffren tidep, u nitni éôan.

ayahs.text: Tidep s$uô Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.
ayahs.translation: Tidep s$uô Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.

ayahs.text: I yal yiwen, loiha u$uô izzi. Sâut timenyugert ar lxiô. Anda teddam, ad Yili Öebbi yidwen akw. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: I yal yiwen, loiha u$uô izzi. Sâut timenyugert ar lxiô. Anda teddam, ad Yili Öebbi yidwen akw. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ansi d tusiv, ezzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Neppat, ih, d tidep s$uô Mass ik. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ansi d tusiv, ezzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Neppat, ih, d tidep s$uô Mass ik. Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ansi d tef$ev, zzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen nnwen $uôes, iwakken ur kwen pnamaren imdanen, siwa wid idensen, segsen. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI. Ad awen Time$ l$it iW, amar a ppepwanhum.
ayahs.translation: Ansi d tef$ev, zzi udem ik ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Anida tellam, zzit udmawen nnwen $uôes, iwakken ur kwen pnamaren imdanen, siwa wid idensen, segsen. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI. Ad awen Time$ l$it iW, amar a ppepwanhum.

ayahs.text: Akken i wen Nuzen Amazan segwen, immal awen issekniyen nne£, izzizdig ikwen, isselmad awen Tazmamt, akked ûûwab; isselmad awen ayen ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Akken i wen Nuzen Amazan segwen, immal awen issekniyen nne£, izzizdig ikwen, isselmad awen Tazmamt, akked ûûwab; isselmad awen ayen ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: Mmektit iyI d, a kwen id Mmekti$. Snemmret iyI, ur jehlet.
ayahs.translation: Mmektit iyI d, a kwen id Mmekti$. Snemmret iyI, ur jehlet.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ssutret tallalt, s ûûbeô akked téallit. Ih, Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ssutret tallalt, s ûûbeô akked téallit. Ih, Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.

ayahs.text: Ur qqaôet mmuten wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi. Xaîi d imuddiren, maca ur teêûim ara.
ayahs.translation: Ur qqaôet mmuten wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi. Xaîi d imuddiren, maca ur teêûim ara.

ayahs.text: War ccekk, a kwen Njeôôeb s kra usigwed, n llaé, n nneqs n wayla, n leôwaê, n l$ellat. Ssefreê iûebôiyen;
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, a kwen Njeôôeb s kra usigwed, n llaé, n nneqs n wayla, n leôwaê, n l$ellat. Ssefreê iûebôiyen;

ayahs.text: Wid, ma u$en tawa$it, qqaôen: "nekwni n Öebbi, nekwni, a nu$al $uôeS".
ayahs.translation: Wid, ma u$en tawa$it, qqaôen: "nekwni n Öebbi, nekwni, a nu$al $uôeS".

ayahs.text: Widak, fellasen téilla s$uô Mass nnsen, akked uêunu. Widak d wid ipwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Widak, fellasen téilla s$uô Mass nnsen, akked uêunu. Widak d wid ipwanhan.

ayahs.text: Ih, ÛÜafa akked Meôwa, seg isekkiren n Öebbi. Win iêuoen s Axxam, ne$ iéuô it, ulac u$ilif fellas, ma izzi yasent. Yif it win izzin, s leb$i s. Ih, Öebbi Ippara tajmilt, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ÛÜafa akked Meôwa, seg isekkiren n Öebbi. Win iêuoen s Axxam, ne$ iéuô it, ulac u$ilif fellas, ma izzi yasent. Yif it win izzin, s leb$i s. Ih, Öebbi Ippara tajmilt, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Nessers ubeggen akked nnhaya, mbaâd ma Nbeggen it i yimdanen, di Tezmamt, widak, Ixza iten Öebbi, xzan ten wid ixezzun.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Nessers ubeggen akked nnhaya, mbaâd ma Nbeggen it i yimdanen, di Tezmamt, widak, Ixza iten Öebbi, xzan ten wid ixezzun.

ayahs.text: Kkes ed wid inedmen u xedmen ayen ilhan, u beggnen d. Widak, ad asen Ssurfe$. Nek Ssurufe$, Pêunu$.
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed wid inedmen u xedmen ayen ilhan, u beggnen d. Widak, ad asen Ssurfe$. Nek Ssurufe$, Pêunu$.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen u mmuten d ijehliyen, widak, fellasen xezzu n Öebbi, lmalayek, akked yimdanen, meôôa.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen u mmuten d ijehliyen, widak, fellasen xezzu n Öebbi, lmalayek, akked yimdanen, meôôa.

ayahs.text: Degs ad wekkôen. Ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur illi w ara ten id iwalin.
ayahs.translation: Degs ad wekkôen. Ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur illi w ara ten id iwalin.

ayahs.text: Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Aênin Ipêunun.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Aênin Ipêunun.

ayahs.text: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan: afraz ger yiv akked wass, lbabuô ippazalen di yill, s wayen infâan medden, ayen id Issers Öebbi n waman, seg igenni - Issidir yissen tamurt, deffir tmeppant is, Issenkar, degs, yal lweêc -, abeddel n wavu akked usigna i imuêepmen ad yili ger igenni akked tmurt. War cekk, ard issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan: afraz ger yiv akked wass, lbabuô ippazalen di yill, s wayen infâan medden, ayen id Issers Öebbi n waman, seg igenni - Issidir yissen tamurt, deffir tmeppant is, Issenkar, degs, yal lweêc -, abeddel n wavu akked usigna i imuêepmen ad yili ger igenni akked tmurt. War cekk, ard issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.

ayahs.text: Ger yimdanen, llan wid ippadamen tanudda, war Öebbi. Ëemmlen ten akken Ippuêemmel Öebbi. Wid iumnen zaden akken êemmlen Öebbi. Awufan wid idensen, mi walan aâaqeb, ad éôen ar tazmert akw n Öebbi, u Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: Ger yimdanen, llan wid ippadamen tanudda, war Öebbi. Ëemmlen ten akken Ippuêemmel Öebbi. Wid iumnen zaden akken êemmlen Öebbi. Awufan wid idensen, mi walan aâaqeb, ad éôen ar tazmert akw n Öebbi, u Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Mara zekkôen uvfiôen nnsen, wid ipwatebâan, u walan aâaqeb, u tfukk yidsen lemxalîa,
ayahs.translation: Mara zekkôen uvfiôen nnsen, wid ipwatebâan, u walan aâaqeb, u tfukk yidsen lemxalîa,

ayahs.text: ad inin uvfiôen: "a lemmer a nu$al, a ten nzekkeô akken i $ zekkôen"! Akka ay sen Issken Öebbi igiten nnsen. A yamxix nnsen, ur d teff$en si tmes!
ayahs.translation: ad inin uvfiôen: "a lemmer a nu$al, a ten nzekkeô akken i $ zekkôen"! Akka ay sen Issken Öebbi igiten nnsen. A yamxix nnsen, ur d teff$en si tmes!

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Eççet seg wayen iêellen, imaânen, di tmurt. Ur teddut di lateô n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Eççet seg wayen iêellen, imaânen, di tmurt. Ur teddut di lateô n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ippameô awen kan tuccva, lâaô; a ppinim, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Ippameô awen kan tuccva, lâaô; a ppinim, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: Ma nnan asen: "ddut akked wayen id Issers Öebbi", a d inin: "xaîi, a neddu akked wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$". I ma llan imezwura nnsen ur meyyzen acemma, ur pwanhan?
ayahs.translation: Ma nnan asen: "ddut akked wayen id Issers Öebbi", a d inin: "xaîi, a neddu akked wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$". I ma llan imezwura nnsen ur meyyzen acemma, ur pwanhan?

ayahs.text: Amedya n wid ijehlen, d amedya n win u$uô ppu$un, seg akken ur issel, siwa i usu$u akked uberreê. D iâeééugen, d igugam, d ider$alen, nitni ur pmeyyizen.
ayahs.translation: Amedya n wid ijehlen, d amedya n win u$uô ppu$un, seg akken ur issel, siwa i usu$u akked uberreê. D iâeééugen, d igugam, d ider$alen, nitni ur pmeyyizen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Eççet si téidanin ikwen N$at. Snemmret Öebbi, ma d Neppa ay tâabdem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Eççet si téidanin ikwen N$at. Snemmret Öebbi, ma d Neppa ay tâabdem.

ayahs.text: I awen Igdel Öebbi, siwa loifa, idamen, aksum n yilef, akked îêegga i war Öebbi. Win terra tmara, ur ib$i, ur izgir tilas, ur illi d abekkav is. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: I awen Igdel Öebbi, siwa loifa, idamen, aksum n yilef, akked îêegga i war Öebbi. Win terra tmara, ur ib$i, ur izgir tilas, ur illi d abekkav is. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Issers Öebbi, si Tezmamt, ppa$en yis ayen ôxisen, widak, siwa times ara ççen, deg iâabbav nnsen. Ur asen Ipmeslay Öebbi, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iteffren ayen id Issers Öebbi, si Tezmamt, ppa$en yis ayen ôxisen, widak, siwa times ara ççen, deg iâabbav nnsen. Ur asen Ipmeslay Öebbi, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Widak, d wid iu$en ttelfan s nnhaya, aâaqeb s ssmaê. Acu ara ten iûebbôen si tmes?
ayahs.translation: Widak, d wid iu$en ttelfan s nnhaya, aâaqeb s ssmaê. Acu ara ten iûebbôen si tmes?

ayahs.text: Akka, acku Issers ed Öebbi Tazmamt, s tidep. Ih, wid imgarraden $ef Tezmamt, haaten di lfiôaq u$miq.
ayahs.translation: Akka, acku Issers ed Öebbi Tazmamt, s tidep. Ih, wid imgarraden $ef Tezmamt, haaten di lfiôaq u$miq.

ayahs.text: Ise$, maççi ma tezzim udmawen nnwen, ar ugmuv akked utaram. Maca, ise$ d wid iumnen s Öebbi, s wass aneggaru, s lmalayek, s Tazmamt, s lambiyya. U ppaken ayla, $ef lemêibba S, i llzem, igujilen, igellilen, win d ibbwi ubrid, imapparen, akw i uberru n waklan. D wid ipéallan, ipzekkin, ippaîîafen di lemâahda nnsen, ma âahden, iûebôiyen di lmeêna akked twa$it, di tegwnip n ccqa. D wigi i illan di tidep, d wigi i ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Ise$, maççi ma tezzim udmawen nnwen, ar ugmuv akked utaram. Maca, ise$ d wid iumnen s Öebbi, s wass aneggaru, s lmalayek, s Tazmamt, s lambiyya. U ppaken ayla, $ef lemêibba S, i llzem, igujilen, igellilen, win d ibbwi ubrid, imapparen, akw i uberru n waklan. D wid ipéallan, ipzekkin, ippaîîafen di lemâahda nnsen, ma âahden, iûebôiyen di lmeêna akked twa$it, di tegwnip n ccqa. D wigi i illan di tidep, d wigi i ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen ppaô n tmegrav. Lêeôô s lêeôô, akli s wakli, nnta s nnta. Win iwumi isemmeê gma s kra: îlaba s lewqama, feddu s lewqama. Ayagi, d sshala s$uô Mass nnwen, akked uêunu. Win iff$en abrid, deffir waya, ad isâaddi aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen ppaô n tmegrav. Lêeôô s lêeôô, akli s wakli, nnta s nnta. Win iwumi isemmeê gma s kra: îlaba s lewqama, feddu s lewqama. Ayagi, d sshala s$uô Mass nnwen, akked uêunu. Win iff$en abrid, deffir waya, ad isâaddi aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: I kunwi, ppaô d tameddurt, a yuâqilen. Amar a pêezzbem.
ayahs.translation: I kunwi, ppaô d tameddurt, a yuâqilen. Amar a pêezzbem.

ayahs.text: Iura fellawen: ma tusa d tmeppant, ar yiwen degwen, ma iooa d lxiô, a t ifk i imawlan is, akked llzem, s lqanun. D ayen ilezmen i wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Iura fellawen: ma tusa d tmeppant, ar yiwen degwen, ma iooa d lxiô, a t ifk i imawlan is, akked llzem, s lqanun. D ayen ilezmen i wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Win it ibeddlen mbaâd ma isla yas, abekkav is siwa $ef wid it ipbeddilen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Win it ibeddlen mbaâd ma isla yas, abekkav is siwa $ef wid it ipbeddilen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ur idnib win iten issemûalaêen acku iugad rrya, ne$ abekkav, s$uô win ippuweûûan. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ur idnib win iten issemûalaêen acku iugad rrya, ne$ abekkav, s$uô win ippuweûûan. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen uéummu, akken iura $ef imezwura nnwen, amar a pêezzbem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Iura fellawen uéummu, akken iura $ef imezwura nnwen, amar a pêezzbem.

ayahs.text: Ussan ipwaêesben. Win iuvnen segwen ne$ illan ippinig, annect n wussan nniven. Wid i s izemren, feddu ad cceççen igellil. Win izaden lxiô, ilha yas. Ma tuéamem, ppif i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.
ayahs.translation: Ussan ipwaêesben. Win iuvnen segwen ne$ illan ippinig, annect n wussan nniven. Wid i s izemren, feddu ad cceççen igellil. Win izaden lxiô, ilha yas. Ma tuéamem, ppif i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.

ayahs.text: Aggur n ÔÖemvan, ideg d irs Leqwôan, d nnhaya i medden, d abeggen n nnhaya akked ufraz. Win segwen iwalan illul ed waggur, a t iuzum. Win iuvnen ne$ illan ippinig, annect n wussan nniven. Öebbi Ib$a yawen sshala, ur awen Ib$a ara cedda. A pfukem tallit, a pkabrem Öebbi imi kwen Inha, amar a ppesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: Aggur n ÔÖemvan, ideg d irs Leqwôan, d nnhaya i medden, d abeggen n nnhaya akked ufraz. Win segwen iwalan illul ed waggur, a t iuzum. Win iuvnen ne$ illan ippinig, annect n wussan nniven. Öebbi Ib$a yawen sshala, ur awen Ib$a ara cedda. A pfukem tallit, a pkabrem Öebbi imi kwen Inha, amar a ppesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: Ma steqsan k, imdanen iW, fellI, Nek Qeôbe$. Pjawabe$ i unuju n yimsuter, ma ipper iyI. Ihi, ad iyI d jawben, ad amnen yissI, amar ad pwanhun.
ayahs.translation: Ma steqsan k, imdanen iW, fellI, Nek Qeôbe$. Pjawabe$ i unuju n yimsuter, ma ipper iyI. Ihi, ad iyI d jawben, ad amnen yissI, amar ad pwanhun.

ayahs.text: Iêell awen, deg iv uéummu, a pqeôôbem ar tlawin nnwen. Nitenti d lebsa nnwen, kunwi d lebsa nnsent. Iéôa Öebbi ar tellam tepkellixem iman nnwen. Issuref awen, Isemmeê awen. Tura qeôôbet $uôsent, nadit ayen i wen Iura Öebbi. Eççet, esswet, ar pferzem lxiv amellal, si lxiv aberkan, di tafrara. Sinna, uéummet ar yiv. Ur pqeôôibet $uôsent, ma tâazlem iman nnwen di lowamaâ. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi. Ur pqeôôibet $uôsent! Akka i Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS i yimdanen, amar ad êezzben.
ayahs.translation: Iêell awen, deg iv uéummu, a pqeôôbem ar tlawin nnwen. Nitenti d lebsa nnwen, kunwi d lebsa nnsent. Iéôa Öebbi ar tellam tepkellixem iman nnwen. Issuref awen, Isemmeê awen. Tura qeôôbet $uôsent, nadit ayen i wen Iura Öebbi. Eççet, esswet, ar pferzem lxiv amellal, si lxiv aberkan, di tafrara. Sinna, uéummet ar yiv. Ur pqeôôibet $uôsent, ma tâazlem iman nnwen di lowamaâ. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi. Ur pqeôôibet $uôsent! Akka i Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS i yimdanen, amar ad êezzben.

ayahs.text: Ur ppemyeççat ayla nnwen, garawen, d aêerfi, ur t ppaket i yimêaddan, iwakken a ppeççem amur, seg wayla n medden, di lmenkweô, u kunwi teéôam.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppemyeççat ayla nnwen, garawen, d aêerfi, ur t ppaket i yimêaddan, iwakken a ppeççem amur, seg wayla n medden, di lmenkweô, u kunwi teéôam.

ayahs.text: La k steqsayen $ef tlalit n waggur. Ini: "d lewqat i medden, u i lêio". Ise$, maççi d anekcum ar ixxamen si zdeffir nnsent. Maca, ise$ d aêezzeb i Öebbi. Kecmet ixxamen si tebbura nnsen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.
ayahs.translation: La k steqsayen $ef tlalit n waggur. Ini: "d lewqat i medden, u i lêio". Ise$, maççi d anekcum ar ixxamen si zdeffir nnsent. Maca, ise$ d aêezzeb i Öebbi. Kecmet ixxamen si tebbura nnsen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.

ayahs.text: Nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi wid i kwen ipna$en. Ur zegret tilas. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.
ayahs.translation: Nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi wid i kwen ipna$en. Ur zegret tilas. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.

ayahs.text: Nna$et pen anda ten tufam, ssuff$et pen seg wanda i kwen ssuff$en. Ahewwel iwâaô kteô umennu$. Ur ten nepna$et ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam, siwa ma nnu$en kwen degs. Ma nnu$en kwen, nna$et pen. Akka aqeîîi ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Nna$et pen anda ten tufam, ssuff$et pen seg wanda i kwen ssuff$en. Ahewwel iwâaô kteô umennu$. Ur ten nepna$et ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam, siwa ma nnu$en kwen degs. Ma nnu$en kwen, nna$et pen. Akka aqeîîi ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ma fukken, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ma fukken, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Nna$et pen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iu$al ddin i Öebbi. Ma fukken, ur pna$et, siwa imednas.
ayahs.translation: Nna$et pen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iu$al ddin i Öebbi. Ma fukken, ur pna$et, siwa imednas.

ayahs.text: Aggur iôqan s waggur iôqan. Tiririt n ppaô $ef wayen ippugedlen. Win ikwen id ibbwven, awvet ep, akken ikwen id ibbwev. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi ar wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Aggur iôqan s waggur iôqan. Tiririt n ppaô $ef wayen ippugedlen. Win ikwen id ibbwven, awvet ep, akken ikwen id ibbwev. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi ar wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Ssedqet deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur d ppawit tawa$it, s ifassen nnwen. Maânet. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Ssedqet deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur d ppawit tawa$it, s ifassen nnwen. Maânet. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Öuêet ar lêio akked lâumôa, i Öebbi. Ma têeûlem, ssadaqa tushilt. Ur pseîîilet iqweôôa nnwen, ar ppawev tikci s amkan is. Win iuvnen, segwen, ne$ ihlek aqeôôu s, ad ifdu s uéummu, ne$ ssadaqa, ne$ iseflan. Mi tellam di laman, win izuôen ur iêuo, ad iseddeq ayen i s isehlen. Win ur nufa ara, ad iuéum krav wussan di lêio, ûa wussan ar tu$alin, akken ad awven mraw. Ayagi i win ur nesâi tawacult illan ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, cfut ar Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: Öuêet ar lêio akked lâumôa, i Öebbi. Ma têeûlem, ssadaqa tushilt. Ur pseîîilet iqweôôa nnwen, ar ppawev tikci s amkan is. Win iuvnen, segwen, ne$ ihlek aqeôôu s, ad ifdu s uéummu, ne$ ssadaqa, ne$ iseflan. Mi tellam di laman, win izuôen ur iêuo, ad iseddeq ayen i s isehlen. Win ur nufa ara, ad iuéum krav wussan di lêio, ûa wussan ar tu$alin, akken ad awven mraw. Ayagi i win ur nesâi tawacult illan ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, cfut ar Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Lêio deg wagguren ipwassnen. Win iâazmen, degsen, ad iêuo, ihi, di lêio ur telli tuzzuft, ne$ ayen n dir, ne$ nnmara. Ayen txedmem n lxiô, Iéôa t Öebbi. Awit aâwin, maca aâwin amxallef d aêezzeb. Ëezzbet iyI a yuâqilen!
ayahs.translation: Lêio deg wagguren ipwassnen. Win iâazmen, degsen, ad iêuo, ihi, di lêio ur telli tuzzuft, ne$ ayen n dir, ne$ nnmara. Ayen txedmem n lxiô, Iéôa t Öebbi. Awit aâwin, maca aâwin amxallef d aêezzeb. Ëezzbet iyI a yuâqilen!

ayahs.text: Uu ili u$ilif fellawen ma tessarmem lfevl s$uô Mass nnwen. Mi d tûubbem si Aâôafat, mmektit ed Öebbi, ppama n lemqam iôqan. Mmektit eP id, akken i kwen Inha, wanag tellam, uqbel, seg im$eôôqen.
ayahs.translation: Uu ili u$ilif fellawen ma tessarmem lfevl s$uô Mass nnwen. Mi d tûubbem si Aâôafat, mmektit ed Öebbi, ppama n lemqam iôqan. Mmektit eP id, akken i kwen Inha, wanag tellam, uqbel, seg im$eôôqen.

ayahs.text: Sinna, ddut anda ddan medden, ssutret ssmaê i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, ddut anda ddan medden, ssutret ssmaê i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Mi tfukkem isekkiren nnwen, mmektit ed Öebbi, akken d tesmektayem imezwura nnwen, ne$ kteô. Ger imdanen, wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Efk a$ di ddunit". Ur ppawin amur di laxeôt.
ayahs.translation: Mi tfukkem isekkiren nnwen, mmektit ed Öebbi, akken d tesmektayem imezwura nnwen, ne$ kteô. Ger imdanen, wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Efk a$ di ddunit". Ur ppawin amur di laxeôt.

ayahs.text: Llan, garasen, wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Efk a$ di ddunit, ise$, di laxeôt, ise$. Esseô a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes".
ayahs.translation: Llan, garasen, wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Efk a$ di ddunit, ise$, di laxeôt, ise$. Esseô a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes".

ayahs.text: Widak, ad awin amur seg wayen kesben. Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
ayahs.translation: Widak, ad awin amur seg wayen kesben. Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

ayahs.text: Mmektit ed Öebbi, deg ussan iâuden. Win i$awlen di sin wussan, ur icciv ara; win iâaîlen, ur icciv ara, ma illa d win ipêezziben. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut, ar $uôeS ara tepwafesrem.
ayahs.translation: Mmektit ed Öebbi, deg ussan iâuden. Win i$awlen di sin wussan, ur icciv ara; win iâaîlen, ur icciv ara, ma illa d win ipêezziben. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut, ar $uôeS ara tepwafesrem.

ayahs.text: Yiwen ger imdanen, iâoeb ik umeslay is, $ef tmeddurt n ddunit. Irra Öebbi d Anagi, $ef wayen illan deg ul is. U neppa iqseê i tilla.
ayahs.translation: Yiwen ger imdanen, iâoeb ik umeslay is, $ef tmeddurt n ddunit. Irra Öebbi d Anagi, $ef wayen illan deg ul is. U neppa iqseê i tilla.

ayahs.text: Mi izzi, ad ikkat di tmurt, iwakken ad issefsed degs, ad isqucc igran akked lmal. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara asefsed.
ayahs.translation: Mi izzi, ad ikkat di tmurt, iwakken ad issefsed degs, ad isqucc igran akked lmal. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara asefsed.

ayahs.text: Ma nnan as: "êezzeb i Öebbi"! A t tekcem lqwedôa ubekkav. Ad isteqnaâ s Loahennama. A yir usu!
ayahs.translation: Ma nnan as: "êezzeb i Öebbi"! A t tekcem lqwedôa ubekkav. Ad isteqnaâ s Loahennama. A yir usu!
