ayahs.text: Ger imdanen, win izzenzen iman is, issaram llza n Öebbi. Öebbi d Umâin ar imdanen.
ayahs.translation: Ger imdanen, win izzenzen iman is, issaram llza n Öebbi. Öebbi d Umâin ar imdanen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Kecmet di tifrat s lekmal is, ur teddut d lateô n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Kecmet di tifrat s lekmal is, ur teddut d lateô n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ma teccvem, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôwen, cfut Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ma teccvem, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôwen, cfut Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Day a pôaoun kan, ad asen d Ias Öebbi, akked lmalayek, di tili usigna? Ad iûaô lameô. Ar Öebbi ara u$alen lumuô.
ayahs.translation: Day a pôaoun kan, ad asen d Ias Öebbi, akked lmalayek, di tili usigna? Ad iûaô lameô. Ar Öebbi ara u$alen lumuô.

ayahs.text: Steqsi At Isôail, acêal issekniyen iberrzen i sen Nefka. I win ipbeddilen tikci n Öebbi, deffir tisin is $uôes, ihi, Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: Steqsi At Isôail, acêal issekniyen iberrzen i sen Nefka. I win ipbeddilen tikci n Öebbi, deffir tisin is $uôes, ihi, Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Wid ijehlen, ccebêen asen tameddurt n ddunit. Ttihin $ef wid iumnen. Wid ipêezziben ad ilin sennig sen, ass n tnekra. Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, s lufa.
ayahs.translation: Wid ijehlen, ccebêen asen tameddurt n ddunit. Ttihin $ef wid iumnen. Wid ipêezziben ad ilin sennig sen, ass n tnekra. Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, s lufa.

ayahs.text: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois. Iuzen ed Öebbi lambiyya ad beccôen, ad nabin. Issers ed, yidsen, Tazmamt s tidep, iwakken ad Iêudd ger medden, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden. I imgarraden fellas, siwa wid iwumi teppunefk, mbaâd ma iusa ten id ubeggen. Ppemyasamen. Inha Öebbi wid iumnen deg wayen n tidep, i$ef mgarraden, s tsriê iS. Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois. Iuzen ed Öebbi lambiyya ad beccôen, ad nabin. Issers ed, yidsen, Tazmamt s tidep, iwakken ad Iêudd ger medden, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden. I imgarraden fellas, siwa wid iwumi teppunefk, mbaâd ma iusa ten id ubeggen. Ppemyasamen. Inha Öebbi wid iumnen deg wayen n tidep, i$ef mgarraden, s tsriê iS. Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, s abrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Day t$ilem a pkecmem Loennet, wanag ur kwen id iusi wayen id iusan ar wid i kwen id izwaren? Mmugren d lmeêna, ccqa, zzelzla, armi inna umazan akked wid iumnen yides: "melmi laânaya n Öebbi"? Day, s tidep, ur d teqôib ara laânaya n Öebbi?
ayahs.translation: Day t$ilem a pkecmem Loennet, wanag ur kwen id iusi wayen id iusan ar wid i kwen id izwaren? Mmugren d lmeêna, ccqa, zzelzla, armi inna umazan akked wid iumnen yides: "melmi laânaya n Öebbi"? Day, s tidep, ur d teqôib ara laânaya n Öebbi?

ayahs.text: Steqsan k $ef wayen ara fken. Ini: "ayen ara tefkem n lxiô, i imawlan, i llzem, i igujilen, i igellilen, i w ar d iawi ubrid". Ayen ara txedmem n lxiô, war ccekk, Iéôa t Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Steqsan k $ef wayen ara fken. Ini: "ayen ara tefkem n lxiô, i imawlan, i llzem, i igujilen, i igellilen, i w ar d iawi ubrid". Ayen ara txedmem n lxiô, war ccekk, Iéôa t Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Iura fellawen umennu$, u neppa d ayen tkeôhem. Ahat tkeôhem ayen ilhan i kunwi, ahat têemmlem ayen n dir i kunwi. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Iura fellawen umennu$, u neppa d ayen tkeôhem. Ahat tkeôhem ayen ilhan i kunwi, ahat têemmlem ayen n dir i kunwi. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: La k steqsayen ma ad yili umennu$ deg waggur iôqan. Ini: "amennu$ degs, d abekkav. Abekkav it i$elben, ar Öebbi, d assefôe$ $ef ubrid n Öebbi, d ankaô is, u d ankaô n Loamaâ n Lêaôam; d assuffe$, segs, imezda$ is". Ahewwel i$leb amennu$. Zgan a kwen pna$en, alamma swexxôen kwen, ma zemren, si ddin nnwen. Win, segwen, iff$en i ddin is, ad immet d ajehli. Widak, mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeôt. Widak, d at tmes, degs, nitni, ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: La k steqsayen ma ad yili umennu$ deg waggur iôqan. Ini: "amennu$ degs, d abekkav. Abekkav it i$elben, ar Öebbi, d assefôe$ $ef ubrid n Öebbi, d ankaô is, u d ankaô n Loamaâ n Lêaôam; d assuffe$, segs, imezda$ is". Ahewwel i$leb amennu$. Zgan a kwen pna$en, alamma swexxôen kwen, ma zemren, si ddin nnwen. Win, segwen, iff$en i ddin is, ad immet d ajehli. Widak, mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeôt. Widak, d at tmes, degs, nitni, ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iumnen, win iunagen u juhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, widak ggunin aêunu n Öebbi. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, win iunagen u juhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, widak ggunin aêunu n Öebbi. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: La k steqsayen $ef ccôab akked leqwmeô. Ini: "degsen abekkav meqqwôen, akked ibu$ar i medden. Abekkav nnsen i$leb ibu$ar nsen". La k steqsayen, acu ara seddqen. Ini: "ayen iugaren". Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a pmeyyzem
ayahs.translation: La k steqsayen $ef ccôab akked leqwmeô. Ini: "degsen abekkav meqqwôen, akked ibu$ar i medden. Abekkav nnsen i$leb ibu$ar nsen". La k steqsayen, acu ara seddqen. Ini: "ayen iugaren". Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a pmeyyzem

ayahs.text: af ddunit akked laxeôt. La k steqsayen $ef igujilen. Ini: "ppif ma txedmem asen lxiô. Ma txulvem ten, d atmaten nnwen". Öebbi Ifrez ger ufessad akked uâaôvi. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, a kwen Icebbwel. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: af ddunit akked laxeôt. La k steqsayen $ef igujilen. Ini: "ppif ma txedmem asen lxiô. Ma txulvem ten, d atmaten nnwen". Öebbi Ifrez ger ufessad akked uâaôvi. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, a kwen Icebbwel. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ur ppa$et timcurak alamma umnent. Taklit iumnen tif tamcarekt, xas taâoeb ikwen. Ur pnasabet imcurak alamma umnen. Akli iumnen yif amcarek, xas iaâoeb ikwen. Widak, neccden ar tmes. Öebbi Inecced ar Loennet akked ssmaê, ma Irad. Ipbeggin issekniyen iS i medden, amar a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppa$et timcurak alamma umnent. Taklit iumnen tif tamcarekt, xas taâoeb ikwen. Ur pnasabet imcurak alamma umnen. Akli iumnen yif amcarek, xas iaâoeb ikwen. Widak, neccden ar tmes. Öebbi Inecced ar Loennet akked ssmaê, ma Irad. Ipbeggin issekniyen iS i medden, amar a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: La k steqsayen $ef tarda. Ini: "d aîan. Âazlet tilawin di tarda, ur pqeôôibet $uôsent alamma ûfant. Mi ûfant, qeôôbet $uôsent, akken i wen Iumeô Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi Iêemmel wid iutuben, Iêemmel wid izzizdigen.
ayahs.translation: La k steqsayen $ef tarda. Ini: "d aîan. Âazlet tilawin di tarda, ur pqeôôibet $uôsent alamma ûfant. Mi ûfant, qeôôbet $uôsent, akken i wen Iumeô Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi Iêemmel wid iutuben, Iêemmel wid izzizdigen.

ayahs.text: Tilawin nnwen d aêôiq n tyerza nnwen. Melmi teb$am, aset s aêôiq nnwen. Zzewret lxiô i yiman nnwen, êezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar kunwi a T temmagrem. Becceô lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Tilawin nnwen d aêôiq n tyerza nnwen. Melmi teb$am, aset s aêôiq nnwen. Zzewret lxiô i yiman nnwen, êezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar kunwi a T temmagrem. Becceô lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ur ssekcamet Öebbi mara teggallem a ppizdigem, a pêezzbem, a ppessemûalêem medden. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ur ssekcamet Öebbi mara teggallem a ppizdigem, a pêezzbem, a ppessemûalêem medden. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ur kwen Ipqissi ara Öebbi $ef tgallit $ef awal. Maca, a kwen Iqiss $ef wayen kesben wulawen nnwen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.
ayahs.translation: Ur kwen Ipqissi ara Öebbi $ef tgallit $ef awal. Maca, a kwen Iqiss $ef wayen kesben wulawen nnwen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.

ayahs.text: Wid iggullen ur pqeôôiben ar tlawin nnsen, ad gganin kué wagguren. Ma bedlen ôôay, ihi, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Wid iggullen ur pqeôôiben ar tlawin nnsen, ad gganin kué wagguren. Ma bedlen ôôay, ihi, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ma âazmen berru, ihi, Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ma âazmen berru, ihi, Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Timnufaq ad aôount krav tardiwin. Ur asent iêell ara ad ffrent ayen Ixleq Öebbi, di tâabbav nnsent, ma umnent s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Ma b$an irgazen nnsent ad mûalaêen, izzewr iten lêal a tent id rren, di lmudda nni. Akken pwalasent ay ppalasent, s lqanun. I yirgazen, asurif $er loiha nnsent. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Timnufaq ad aôount krav tardiwin. Ur asent iêell ara ad ffrent ayen Ixleq Öebbi, di tâabbav nnsent, ma umnent s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Ma b$an irgazen nnsent ad mûalaêen, izzewr iten lêal a tent id rren, di lmudda nni. Akken pwalasent ay ppalasent, s lqanun. I yirgazen, asurif $er loiha nnsent. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Berru, sin iberdan; tiririt, s lqanun; aserreê s lewqama. Ur awen iêell ara a ppedmem kra, seg wayen i sent tefkam - siwa ma ugaden ur pqadaôen ara tilas n Öebbi. Ma tugadem ur pqadaôen ara tilas n Öebbi, ulac u$ilif fellasen $ef wayen is ara d tefdu iman is. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi, ur tent zegret. Wid izegren tilas n Öebbi, widak, d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Berru, sin iberdan; tiririt, s lqanun; aserreê s lewqama. Ur awen iêell ara a ppedmem kra, seg wayen i sent tefkam - siwa ma ugaden ur pqadaôen ara tilas n Öebbi. Ma tugadem ur pqadaôen ara tilas n Öebbi, ulac u$ilif fellasen $ef wayen is ara d tefdu iman is. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi, ur tent zegret. Wid izegren tilas n Öebbi, widak, d imednas.

ayahs.text: Ma ibra yas, ur as têell, imiren, alamma tu$ argaz nniven. Ma ibra yas, ulac u$ilif fellasen ma u$alen ar din, ma walan qudôen tilas n Öebbi. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi. Ibeggen itent i ugdud issnen.
ayahs.translation: Ma ibra yas, ur as têell, imiren, alamma tu$ argaz nniven. Ma ibra yas, ulac u$ilif fellasen ma u$alen ar din, ma walan qudôen tilas n Öebbi. D tigi ay d tilas n Öebbi. Ibeggen itent i ugdud issnen.

ayahs.text: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sâaddant tallit nnsent, erret pent id, s lqanun, ne$ serrêet asent, s lqanun. Ur tent pparat s uêeppem, a ppeccvem. Win ixedmen akka, idens iman is. Ur ppuraret s issekniyen n Öebbi. Mmektit ed ayen i kwen I$at Öebbi, akked wayen i wen d Issers si Tezmamt, akw si ûûwab. Ipnabi kwen yis. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Issen yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sâaddant tallit nnsent, erret pent id, s lqanun, ne$ serrêet asent, s lqanun. Ur tent pparat s uêeppem, a ppeccvem. Win ixedmen akka, idens iman is. Ur ppuraret s issekniyen n Öebbi. Mmektit ed ayen i kwen I$at Öebbi, akked wayen i wen d Issers si Tezmamt, akw si ûûwab. Ipnabi kwen yis. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Issen yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sâaddant tallit nnsent, ur asent tekset ad a$ent irgazen nnsent, ma mwafaqen s lqanun. Ar waya ay pwanecden wid, segwen, iumnen s Öebbi, akked wass aneggaru. Ppif akka, i tezdeg akked ûûfawa nnwen. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Ma tebram i tlawin, u sâaddant tallit nnsent, ur asent tekset ad a$ent irgazen nnsent, ma mwafaqen s lqanun. Ar waya ay pwanecden wid, segwen, iumnen s Öebbi, akked wass aneggaru. Ppif akka, i tezdeg akked ûûfawa nnwen. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: Tiyimmatin ad ssuîvent arraw nnsent, sin iseggwasen mden, i win ib$an ad itim ussuîev. £ef ubabat, lmakla akked lebsa nnsent, s lqanun. Ur ipwakellaf yiman siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Tarwa ur teîîuôôu imma s, ur teîîuôôu baba s. I uweôôat, am akka. Ma b$an ad kksen tuîîva, mcawaôen, ulac u$ilif fellasen. Ma teb$am tamôebbit, a ppessuîîev tarwa nnwen, ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma txelûem ayen i wen ilaqen, s lqanun. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Tiyimmatin ad ssuîvent arraw nnsent, sin iseggwasen mden, i win ib$an ad itim ussuîev. £ef ubabat, lmakla akked lebsa nnsent, s lqanun. Ur ipwakellaf yiman siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Tarwa ur teîîuôôu imma s, ur teîîuôôu baba s. I uweôôat, am akka. Ma b$an ad kksen tuîîva, mcawaôen, ulac u$ilif fellasen. Ma teb$am tamôebbit, a ppessuîîev tarwa nnwen, ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma txelûem ayen i wen ilaqen, s lqanun. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Wid, segwen, issuff$en taôwiêt, u ooan d tilawin, ad aôount kué wagguren akked mraw wussan. Mi sâaddant tallit nnsent, ulac u$ilif fellawen deg wayen xedment deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Wid, segwen, issuff$en taôwiêt, u ooan d tilawin, ad aôount kué wagguren akked mraw wussan. Mi sâaddant tallit nnsent, ulac u$ilif fellawen deg wayen xedment deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma tennam d a pxevbem tilawin, ne$ ma teffrem. Iéôa Öebbi, ar tesmektayem tent id. Maca, ur asent âahdet, di tbavnit, siwa ma tennam awal uwqim. Ur ferrut $ef lemlak, alamma ibbwev lajel iuran. Cfut ar Öebbi Iéôa i illan degwen. Ëadret iman nnwen segS. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.
ayahs.translation: Ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma tennam d a pxevbem tilawin, ne$ ma teffrem. Iéôa Öebbi, ar tesmektayem tent id. Maca, ur asent âahdet, di tbavnit, siwa ma tennam awal uwqim. Ur ferrut $ef lemlak, alamma ibbwev lajel iuran. Cfut ar Öebbi Iéôa i illan degwen. Ëadret iman nnwen segS. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.

ayahs.text: Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma tebram i tlawin ur tennulem, ne$ iwumi ur tefkim lwajeb. Efket asent tikci iweqmen. Asâay s tezmert is, igellil s tezmert is. D lwajeb i iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma tebram i tlawin ur tennulem, ne$ iwumi ur tefkim lwajeb. Efket asent tikci iweqmen. Asâay s tezmert is, igellil s tezmert is. D lwajeb i iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Ma tebram asent, uqbel a tent tennalem, u, iu$ lêal, tefkam asent lwajeb, ihi, azgen n wayen i sent tefkam, siwa ma semêent, ne$ isemmeê usemsaô n jjwao. Ssmaê iqôeb nezzeh ar uêezzeb. Ur tepput lfevl garawen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ma tebram asent, uqbel a tent tennalem, u, iu$ lêal, tefkam asent lwajeb, ihi, azgen n wayen i sent tefkam, siwa ma semêent, ne$ isemmeê usemsaô n jjwao. Ssmaê iqôeb nezzeh ar uêezzeb. Ur tepput lfevl garawen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ëarbet $ef téilla, u taéallit talemmast. Beddet i Öebbi, s wannuz.
ayahs.translation: Ëarbet $ef téilla, u taéallit talemmast. Beddet i Öebbi, s wannuz.

ayahs.text: Ma tugadem, s ibeddi, ne$ di rrekba. Ma tellam di laman, mmektit ed Öebbi, akken i wen Isselmed ayen ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Ma tugadem, s ibeddi, ne$ di rrekba. Ma tellam di laman, mmektit ed Öebbi, akken i wen Isselmed ayen ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: Wid segwen issuff$en taôwiêt, u ooan d tilawin, ad asent vemnen aseggwas n wuççi, ur tent ssuffu$en. Ma ff$ent, ulac u$ilif fellawen, deg wayen xedment, deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Wid segwen issuff$en taôwiêt, u ooan d tilawin, ad asent vemnen aseggwas n wuççi, ur tent ssuffu$en. Ma ff$ent, ulac u$ilif fellawen, deg wayen xedment, deg iman nnsent, di lqanun. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: I tembwurab taqviât, s lqanun. D lwajeb $ef wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: I tembwurab taqviât, s lqanun. D lwajeb $ef wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS, amar a pêemûem.
ayahs.translation: Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS, amar a pêemûem.

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara wid iff$en, seg ixxamen nnsen, d igima, ugaden tameppant. Inna yasen Öebbi: "emmtet"! Sinna, Issader ten id. S tidep, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl $ef yimdanen, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara wid iff$en, seg ixxamen nnsen, d igima, ugaden tameppant. Inna yasen Öebbi: "emmtet"! Sinna, Issader ten id. S tidep, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl $ef yimdanen, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.

ayahs.text: Nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi. Cfut ar Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Win iôevlen aôeîîal umâin i Öebbi, ad as t id Irr s lufa. Öebbi Ippaîaf, Ismiri. £uôeS a ppu$alem.
ayahs.translation: Win iôevlen aôeîîal umâin i Öebbi, ad as t id Irr s lufa. Öebbi Ippaîaf, Ismiri. £uôeS a ppu$alem.

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara imvebbôen seg wAt Isôail, deffir Musa? Mi nnan i nnbi nnsen: "azen a$ d agellid, a nenna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi". Inna: "ma iura fellawen umennu$, day a ppagim a ppenna$em"? Nnan: "ur a$ issefk ara a neqqim ur nepna$ ara, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ni$ ssuff$en a$ d, nekwni akked tarwa nne$, seg ixxamen nne$". Mi iura fellasen umennu$, wexxôen, siwa drus segsen. Öebbi Issen imednas.
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara imvebbôen seg wAt Isôail, deffir Musa? Mi nnan i nnbi nnsen: "azen a$ d agellid, a nenna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi". Inna: "ma iura fellawen umennu$, day a ppagim a ppenna$em"? Nnan: "ur a$ issefk ara a neqqim ur nepna$ ara, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ni$ ssuff$en a$ d, nekwni akked tarwa nne$, seg ixxamen nne$". Mi iura fellasen umennu$, wexxôen, siwa drus segsen. Öebbi Issen imednas.

ayahs.text: Inna yasen nnbi nnsen: "Ni$ Öebbi, s tidep, Iuzen awen d Ïalut, d agellid". Nnan: "amek ara yili d agellid nne$? Nezwar it akken neklal tagelda. Ur as ippunefk wayla". Inna: "Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren it garawen, u Irna yas aîas n tmusni akked loeppa". Ippak Öebbi tagelda S i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Inna yasen nnbi nnsen: "Ni$ Öebbi, s tidep, Iuzen awen d Ïalut, d agellid". Nnan: "amek ara yili d agellid nne$? Nezwar it akken neklal tagelda. Ur as ippunefk wayla". Inna: "Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren it garawen, u Irna yas aîas n tmusni akked loeppa". Ippak Öebbi tagelda S i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Inna yasen, nnbi nnsen: "s tidep, assekni n tgelda s, d tisin $uôwen usenduq. Degs talwit s$uô Mass nnwen, akked wayen id igwran, seg wayen id teooa twacult n Musa, akked tin n Haôun. A t id awint lmalayek. Ih, deg waya, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
ayahs.translation: Inna yasen, nnbi nnsen: "s tidep, assekni n tgelda s, d tisin $uôwen usenduq. Degs talwit s$uô Mass nnwen, akked wayen id igwran, seg wayen id teooa twacult n Musa, akked tin n Haôun. A t id awint lmalayek. Ih, deg waya, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".

ayahs.text: Mi iffe$ Ïalut, s lâaskeô, inna: "Öebbi, s tidep, a kwen Ijeôôeb s wasif. Win iswan segs, ur illi yidi. Win ur neswi, neppa, s tidep, yidi. Kkes ed win iswan cwiî, deg ufus is". Swan segs, siwa ixeîîayen segsen. Mi zegren, neppa akked wid iumnen yides, nnan: "ur nezmir assa, i Oalut akked lâaskeô is". Nnan wid issarmen ar nitni ad mlilen d Öebbi: "acêal d abrid, îayfa tameééyant te$leb îayfa tameqwôant, ma Irad Öebbi". Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.
ayahs.translation: Mi iffe$ Ïalut, s lâaskeô, inna: "Öebbi, s tidep, a kwen Ijeôôeb s wasif. Win iswan segs, ur illi yidi. Win ur neswi, neppa, s tidep, yidi. Kkes ed win iswan cwiî, deg ufus is". Swan segs, siwa ixeîîayen segsen. Mi zegren, neppa akked wid iumnen yides, nnan: "ur nezmir assa, i Oalut akked lâaskeô is". Nnan wid issarmen ar nitni ad mlilen d Öebbi: "acêal d abrid, îayfa tameééyant te$leb îayfa tameqwôant, ma Irad Öebbi". Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.

ayahs.text: Mi qublen Oalut akked lâaskeô is, nnan: "a Mass nne$! Azen a$ d ûûbeô, Tebbet isurifen nne$, Awes a$ mgal agdud ijehliyen".
ayahs.translation: Mi qublen Oalut akked lâaskeô is, nnan: "a Mass nne$! Azen a$ d ûûbeô, Tebbet isurifen nne$, Awes a$ mgal agdud ijehliyen".

ayahs.text: Irad Öebbi, rebêen ten. Dawed in$a Oalut. Ifka yas Öebbi tagelda akked ûûwab. Isselmed as seg wayen i S ihwan. Lemmer ur Issemnamar ara Öebbi, imdanen, a ppefsed tmurt. Maca, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl $ef imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Irad Öebbi, rebêen ten. Dawed in$a Oalut. Ifka yas Öebbi tagelda akked ûûwab. Isselmed as seg wayen i S ihwan. Lemmer ur Issemnamar ara Öebbi, imdanen, a ppefsed tmurt. Maca, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl $ef imavalen.

ayahs.text: Atnan issekniyen n Öebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tidep. Keçç, war ccekk, seg imazanen.
ayahs.translation: Atnan issekniyen n Öebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tidep. Keçç, war ccekk, seg imazanen.

ayahs.text: Imazanen agi, Nesmenyaf kra i wiyav. Garasen, wid iwumi Immeslay Öebbi. Issuli kra segsen, tiseddaôin. Nefka abeggen i Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, u Nekfa t s ôôuê iôqan. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur ppemyen$an wid i ten id ivefôen, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôsen. Maca, mgarraden. Segsen wid iumnen, segsen wid ijehlen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur ppemyen$an, maca Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
ayahs.translation: Imazanen agi, Nesmenyaf kra i wiyav. Garasen, wid iwumi Immeslay Öebbi. Issuli kra segsen, tiseddaôin. Nefka abeggen i Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, u Nekfa t s ôôuê iôqan. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur ppemyen$an wid i ten id ivefôen, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôsen. Maca, mgarraden. Segsen wid iumnen, segsen wid ijehlen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur ppemyen$an, maca Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen ikwen N$at, uqbel tisin n wass ideg ur telli ttjara, ne$ tiddukla, ne$ ccafuâa. Ijehliyen, d nitni ay d imednas.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen ikwen N$at, uqbel tisin n wass ideg ur telli ttjara, ne$ tiddukla, ne$ ccafuâa. Ijehliyen, d nitni ay d imednas.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amuddir, Imezgi. Ur Ipnuddum, ur Iggan. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Anwa akka ara icufâan $uôeS, siwa ma s tsriê iS? Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ur êemûen kra, si tmusni S, siwa ayen i S ihwan. Lewsaâ usgeld iS, d tamurt akked igenwan. Ur T issaâtab uêareb fellasen. Neppa, d Aâlayan, d Ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amuddir, Imezgi. Ur Ipnuddum, ur Iggan. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Anwa akka ara icufâan $uôeS, siwa ma s tsriê iS? Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ur êemûen kra, si tmusni S, siwa ayen i S ihwan. Lewsaâ usgeld iS, d tamurt akked igenwan. Ur T issaâtab uêareb fellasen. Neppa, d Aâlayan, d Ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Ddin maççi s yi$il. Ni$ tepwafôez lewqama si l$welîa. Win iugin iôebbiten n tkerkas u iumen s Öebbi, ihi, iîîef afus ioehden, ur nceqqeq. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ddin maççi s yi$il. Ni$ tepwafôez lewqama si l$welîa. Win iugin iôebbiten n tkerkas u iumen s Öebbi, ihi, iîîef afus ioehden, ur nceqqeq. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Öebbi d Bab n wid iumnen. Issuffe$ iten id si tillas ar tafat. Imawlan n wid ijehlen, d iôebbiten n tkerkas. Ssuff$en ten id si tafat ar tillas. Widak, d at tmes, nitni, degs ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi d Bab n wid iumnen. Issuffe$ iten id si tillas ar tafat. Imawlan n wid ijehlen, d iôebbiten n tkerkas. Ssuff$en ten id si tafat ar tillas. Widak, d at tmes, nitni, degs ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara win inumren Ibôahim $ef Mass is, acku Ifka yas Öebbi tagelda? Mi inna Ibôahim: "Mass iw d win Issidiren, Ineqqen", inna d: "nek ssidire$, neqqe$". Inna Ibôahim: "ihi, Öebbi Issenqaô ed iîij seg ugmuv; keçç, ssenqeô it id seg utaram"! Inneêcam win ijehlen. Öebbi ur Inehhu yara agdud imednas.
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara win inumren Ibôahim $ef Mass is, acku Ifka yas Öebbi tagelda? Mi inna Ibôahim: "Mass iw d win Issidiren, Ineqqen", inna d: "nek ssidire$, neqqe$". Inna Ibôahim: "ihi, Öebbi Issenqaô ed iîij seg ugmuv; keçç, ssenqeô it id seg utaram"! Inneêcam win ijehlen. Öebbi ur Inehhu yara agdud imednas.

ayahs.text: Ne$ am win iâaddan di temdint tilemt, thudd wakali. Inna: «amek ara d Issider Öebbi tagi, deffir tmeppant is?» In$a t Öebbi twinas iseggwasen, sinna, Issenker it, Inna: «acêal teqqimev?» Inna d: «qqime$ ibwass, ne$ ur ibbwiv wass». Inna: «xaîi, teqqimev twinas iseggwasen. Muqel lqut ik akked tissit ik, ur xûiôen. Muqel a$yul ik. A k Nerr d assekni i medden. Muqel i$san amek ara ten Nessemlil, sinna, ad asen Nessels aksum». Mi ipputebbet, inna: «éôi$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci».
ayahs.translation: Ne$ am win iâaddan di temdint tilemt, thudd wakali. Inna: «amek ara d Issider Öebbi tagi, deffir tmeppant is?» In$a t Öebbi twinas iseggwasen, sinna, Issenker it, Inna: «acêal teqqimev?» Inna d: «qqime$ ibwass, ne$ ur ibbwiv wass». Inna: «xaîi, teqqimev twinas iseggwasen. Muqel lqut ik akked tissit ik, ur xûiôen. Muqel a$yul ik. A k Nerr d assekni i medden. Muqel i$san amek ara ten Nessemlil, sinna, ad asen Nessels aksum». Mi ipputebbet, inna: «éôi$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci».

ayahs.text: U mi inna Ibôahim: «a Mass iw! Ssenâat iyi amek tessidirev lmeggtin». Inna: «day ur tuminev ara?» Inna: «xaîi, maca iwakken ad ithedden wul iw». Inna: «ihi, îîef kué igvav, awi ten id $uôek, sinna, err, di yal i$il, amur segsen. Sinna, siwel asen, a d asen dumatu. Cfu ar Öebbi d Uohid, d Uûwib».
ayahs.translation: U mi inna Ibôahim: «a Mass iw! Ssenâat iyi amek tessidirev lmeggtin». Inna: «day ur tuminev ara?» Inna: «xaîi, maca iwakken ad ithedden wul iw». Inna: «ihi, îîef kué igvav, awi ten id $uôek, sinna, err, di yal i$il, amur segsen. Sinna, siwel asen, a d asen dumatu. Cfu ar Öebbi d Uohid, d Uûwib».

ayahs.text: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, cuban aâqqa id igren sa tyedrin. Di yal taydrep, twinas iâqqayen. Öebbi Issugut i win i S Ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, cuban aâqqa id igren sa tyedrin. Di yal taydrep, twinas iâqqayen. Öebbi Issugut i win i S Ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur seddan, i wayen ssedqen, tiyta ne$ rregmat, ad awin arraz nnsen s$uô Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur seddan, i wayen ssedqen, tiyta ne$ rregmat, ad awin arraz nnsen s$uô Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Awal imaânen akked ssmaê, ifen aseddeq i vefôent rregmat. Öebbi d Asâay, Iêellem.
ayahs.translation: Awal imaânen akked ssmaê, ifen aseddeq i vefôent rregmat. Öebbi d Asâay, Iêellem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ssemsayet ssadaqa nnwen, s tiyta akked rregmat. Am win iseddqen ayla s, iwakken a t walin medden, ur iumin s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Icuba taéôut i i$umm wakal. Iwwet fellas uzayev, iooa p d asuki. Ur sfaydin acemma seg wayen bbwin. Öebbi ur Inehhu ara agdud ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur ssemsayet ssadaqa nnwen, s tiyta akked rregmat. Am win iseddqen ayla s, iwakken a t walin medden, ur iumin s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Icuba taéôut i i$umm wakal. Iwwet fellas uzayev, iooa p d asuki. Ur sfaydin acemma seg wayen bbwin. Öebbi ur Inehhu ara agdud ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen, ssaramen ad Iôavi Öebbi, u tebbten iman nnsen, cuban leonan di ti$ilt. Iwwet fellas ugeffur, ifka d sin imuren n l$ella s. Ma ur iwwit fellas ugeffur, d nnda. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Wid ipseddiqen ayla nnsen, ssaramen ad Iôavi Öebbi, u tebbten iman nnsen, cuban leonan di ti$ilt. Iwwet fellas ugeffur, ifka d sin imuren n l$ella s. Ma ur iwwit fellas ugeffur, d nnda. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Yiwen degwen, ma tusa t id tewser, u $uôes tarwa tuôhift, day ad issirem ad isâu leonan n tezdayin akked tfeôôant, isaffen ppazzalen ddaw as, degs, i neppa, yal ppemôa? Têuza t tnifift degs times, iô$a. Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a pmeyyzem.
ayahs.translation: Yiwen degwen, ma tusa t id tewser, u $uôes tarwa tuôhift, day ad issirem ad isâu leonan n tezdayin akked tfeôôant, isaffen ppazzalen ddaw as, degs, i neppa, yal ppemôa? Têuza t tnifift degs times, iô$a. Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a pmeyyzem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen imaânen i teîfem, seg wayen i wen d Nessuffe$ si tmurt. Ur fernet ucmit, segs, ayen ur teppadamem siwa ma s tuqna n wallen, a t tseddqem. Cfut ar Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Seddqet seg wayen imaânen i teîfem, seg wayen i wen d Nessuffe$ si tmurt. Ur fernet ucmit, segs, ayen ur teppadamem siwa ma s tuqna n wallen, a t tseddqem. Cfut ar Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.

ayahs.text: Cciîan iâahed awen tiggulelt, iumeô awen lâaô. Öebbi Iâahed awen ssmaê s$uôeS akked lfevl. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Cciîan iâahed awen tiggulelt, iumeô awen lâaô. Öebbi Iâahed awen ssmaê s$uôeS akked lfevl. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ippak ûûwab i win i S Ihwan. Win iwumi ippunefk ûûwab, ni$ ippunefk as aîas n lxiô. Siwa uâqilen i ismektayen.
ayahs.translation: Ippak ûûwab i win i S Ihwan. Win iwumi ippunefk ûûwab, ni$ ippunefk as aîas n lxiô. Siwa uâqilen i ismektayen.

ayahs.text: Ayen tefkam useddeq, ne$ teqqnem n tuqqna, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa t. Ur llin imâiwnen i imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ayen tefkam useddeq, ne$ teqqnem n tuqqna, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa t. Ur llin imâiwnen i imednas.

ayahs.text: Ma tefkam ssadaqat âinani, ilha. Yif it ma s tuffra, u ma tefkam tent i ime$ban. Ad pwakksent kra si tucmitin nnwen. Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ma tefkam ssadaqat âinani, ilha. Yif it ma s tuffra, u ma tefkam tent i ime$ban. Ad pwakksent kra si tucmitin nnwen. Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ur fellak a ten tenhuv. Maca Öebbi Inehhu win i S Ihwan. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, i iman nnwen. Ur tefkim siwa $ef udem n Öebbi. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, a kwen id iu$al, u kunwi ur kwen dennisen.
ayahs.translation: Ur fellak a ten tenhuv. Maca Öebbi Inehhu win i S Ihwan. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, i iman nnwen. Ur tefkim siwa $ef udem n Öebbi. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, a kwen id iu$al, u kunwi ur kwen dennisen.

ayahs.text: I ime$ban ifelsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur nezmir ad inigen di tmurt; wur nessin, inwa ten d imeôkantiyen, seg wakken êekmen. A ten tâaqlev ar tiddi nnsen: ur ssuturen imdanen s nnbec. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, s tidep, Öebbi Iéôa t.
ayahs.translation: I ime$ban ifelsen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur nezmir ad inigen di tmurt; wur nessin, inwa ten d imeôkantiyen, seg wakken êekmen. A ten tâaqlev ar tiddi nnsen: ur ssuturen imdanen s nnbec. Ayen tefkam n lxiô, s tidep, Öebbi Iéôa t.

ayahs.text: Wid ifkan ayla nnsen deg iv, deg wass, s tuffra u âinani, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Wid ifkan ayla nnsen deg iv, deg wass, s tuffra u âinani, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Wid iteppen rrba, ur d pnekkaren siwa am ara d kren win issexbibev Cciîan, mi t innul. Ayagi, acku nnan: «ttjara am rrba kan». Öebbi Iêell ttjara, Igdel rrba. Win n tusa lewûaya s$uô Mass is, d$a ixva, ines ayen iâaddan. Lameô is ar Öebbi. Wid iu$alen, widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iteppen rrba, ur d pnekkaren siwa am ara d kren win issexbibev Cciîan, mi t innul. Ayagi, acku nnan: «ttjara am rrba kan». Öebbi Iêell ttjara, Igdel rrba. Win n tusa lewûaya s$uô Mass is, d$a ixva, ines ayen iâaddan. Lameô is ar Öebbi. Wid iu$alen, widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Ad Imêu Öebbi rrba, ad Isbuôket ssadaqa. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara yal ajehli amednub.
ayahs.translation: Ad Imêu Öebbi rrba, ad Isbuôket ssadaqa. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara yal ajehli amednub.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u péallan, u pzekkin, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u péallan, u pzekkin, ad awin arraz nnsen ar Mass nnsen; ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Eooet ayen d igwran si rrba, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Eooet ayen d igwran si rrba, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

ayahs.text: Ma ur tewqimem ara, êûut ara kwen Inna$ Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma tnedmem, nnwen ôaselmal. Ur denniset, ur pwadenset.
ayahs.translation: Ma ur tewqimem ara, êûut ara kwen Inna$ Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma tnedmem, nnwen ôaselmal. Ur denniset, ur pwadenset.

ayahs.text: I win illan di lhejna, aôout liser. Ma tseddqem, yif it i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.
ayahs.translation: I win illan di lhejna, aôout liser. Ma tseddqem, yif it i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.

ayahs.text: Ëezzbet i wass n tu$alin nnwen ar Öebbi. Imiren, yal yiwen ad as ippunefk wayen ikseb; nitni ur pwadensen.
ayahs.translation: Ëezzbet i wass n tu$alin nnwen ar Öebbi. Imiren, yal yiwen ad as ippunefk wayen ikseb; nitni ur pwadensen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tesâam îlaba ar lajel ipwassnen, arut ep. A p iaru umaru segwen, s ûûfawa. Ur ippagwi umaru a p iaru, akken i s Isselmed Öebbi. Ad iaru ayen ar as yini umeîîalbu. Ad iêezzeb i Öebbi, Mass is. Ur issenqas acemma segs. Ma illa umeîîalbu d abuhal, ne$ d uôhif, ne$ ur izmir ad yini neppa, ihi, ad yini umeddakwel is s ûûfawa. Sbeddet sin inagan seg irgazen nnwen. Ma ur llin ara sin irgazen, argaz akked snat n tlawin, seg wid tôuvam ad cehhden. Ma te$lev yiwet segsent, tayev a d temmekti. Ur ppagwin inagan, ma pwanecden. Ur stehzayet a p tarum, meééiyet ne$ meqqwôet, ar lajel is. Ayagi iwzen kteô ar Öebbi, iwata kteô i ccada, iwulem kteô ad awen ikkes ccekk. Kkes ed ssuq i tefram imiren garawen; ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma ur t turim ara. Awit inagan deg uzenzi nnwen. Ur ippili ujuôu $ef umaru ne$ $ef unagi. Ma tjuôem, ihi, dir ikwen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi Isselmad ikwen. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tesâam îlaba ar lajel ipwassnen, arut ep. A p iaru umaru segwen, s ûûfawa. Ur ippagwi umaru a p iaru, akken i s Isselmed Öebbi. Ad iaru ayen ar as yini umeîîalbu. Ad iêezzeb i Öebbi, Mass is. Ur issenqas acemma segs. Ma illa umeîîalbu d abuhal, ne$ d uôhif, ne$ ur izmir ad yini neppa, ihi, ad yini umeddakwel is s ûûfawa. Sbeddet sin inagan seg irgazen nnwen. Ma ur llin ara sin irgazen, argaz akked snat n tlawin, seg wid tôuvam ad cehhden. Ma te$lev yiwet segsent, tayev a d temmekti. Ur ppagwin inagan, ma pwanecden. Ur stehzayet a p tarum, meééiyet ne$ meqqwôet, ar lajel is. Ayagi iwzen kteô ar Öebbi, iwata kteô i ccada, iwulem kteô ad awen ikkes ccekk. Kkes ed ssuq i tefram imiren garawen; ulac u$ilif fellawen, ma ur t turim ara. Awit inagan deg uzenzi nnwen. Ur ippili ujuôu $ef umaru ne$ $ef unagi. Ma tjuôem, ihi, dir ikwen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi Isselmad ikwen. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ma d iminigen ay tellam, ur tufim amaru, a ppeppunefk ôôhina. Ma ifka yiwen segwen lamana i wayev, win iwumi teppunefk, a p irr i win i s ifkan lamana s. Ad iêezzeb i Öebbi, Mass is. Ur ppeffret ccada. Win ip iffren, ihi, neppa, idneb wul is. Öebbi Iéôa ay txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ma d iminigen ay tellam, ur tufim amaru, a ppeppunefk ôôhina. Ma ifka yiwen segwen lamana i wayev, win iwumi teppunefk, a p irr i win i s ifkan lamana s. Ad iêezzeb i Öebbi, Mass is. Ur ppeffret ccada. Win ip iffren, ihi, neppa, idneb wul is. Öebbi Iéôa ay txeddmem.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ama tesseknem i illan deg iman nnwen, ne$ te$bam t, a kwen Iêaseb Öebbi fellas. Ad Isemmeê i win i S Ihwan, ad Iâaqeb win i S Ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ama tesseknem i illan deg iman nnwen, ne$ te$bam t, a kwen Iêaseb Öebbi fellas. Ad Isemmeê i win i S Ihwan, ad Iâaqeb win i S Ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Iumen Umazan s wayen id iusan, $uôes, s$uô Mass is. Lmumnin, akw, umnen s Öebbi akked lmalayek iS, Tizmamin iS, imazanen iS. Ur nesemgirrid yiwen ger imazanen iS. Nnan: «nesla, nunez. Ssmaê iK a Mass nne$! £uôeK tu$alin.
ayahs.translation: Iumen Umazan s wayen id iusan, $uôes, s$uô Mass is. Lmumnin, akw, umnen s Öebbi akked lmalayek iS, Tizmamin iS, imazanen iS. Ur nesemgirrid yiwen ger imazanen iS. Nnan: «nesla, nunez. Ssmaê iK a Mass nne$! £uôeK tu$alin.

ayahs.text: Ur Ipkellif Öebbi yiman, siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ines wayen ikseb, mgal is wayen iddem. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Pqassa ma neppu, ne$ neccev. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Sbibbi taâkkwemt akken ip Tesbabbev i wid i $ d izwaren. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Sbibbi ayen iwumi ur nezmir. Semmeê ane$, Suref a$, Ëun fellane$. Keçç d Bab nne$, Srebê a$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ur Ipkellif Öebbi yiman, siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ines wayen ikseb, mgal is wayen iddem. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Pqassa ma neppu, ne$ neccev. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Sbibbi taâkkwemt akken ip Tesbabbev i wid i $ d izwaren. A Mass nne$! Ur a$ Sbibbi ayen iwumi ur nezmir. Semmeê ane$, Suref a$, Ëun fellane$. Keçç d Bab nne$, Srebê a$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen.

verses.text: Alm.
verses.translation: Alm.

verses.text: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amuddir, Imezgi.
verses.translation: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amuddir, Imezgi.

verses.text: Issers ak d Tazmamt s tidep, d atebbet n wayen ip id izwaren. Issers ed Tuôa akked Linoil,
verses.translation: Issers ak d Tazmamt s tidep, d atebbet n wayen ip id izwaren. Issers ed Tuôa akked Linoil,

verses.text: uqbel, d nnhaya i medden. Issers ed Leqwôan. Ih, wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, fellasen aâaqeb uqûiê. Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.
verses.translation: uqbel, d nnhaya i medden. Issers ed Leqwôan. Ih, wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, fellasen aâaqeb uqûiê. Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.

verses.text: Ih, Öebbi ur aS iffir wacemma di tmurt, ne$ deg igenni.
verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi ur aS iffir wacemma di tmurt, ne$ deg igenni.

verses.text: D Neppa i wen Ippaken udem, di tâabbav, akken i S ihwa. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: D Neppa i wen Ippaken udem, di tâabbav, akken i S ihwa. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Neppa i k ed Issersen Tazmamt, degs issekniyen uvhiôen, nitni d tayimmap n Tezmamt. Wiyav d licwaô. D$a, wid iwumi mmalen wulawen, teddun akked wayen illan d licwaô, ssaramen ahewwel, ssaramen asefhem is. I Issnen asefhem is, siwa Öebbi. Qqaôen imawlan n tmusni: "numen yis. S$uô Mass nne$ akw". Id ismektayen, siwa uâqilen.
verses.translation: Neppa i k ed Issersen Tazmamt, degs issekniyen uvhiôen, nitni d tayimmap n Tezmamt. Wiyav d licwaô. D$a, wid iwumi mmalen wulawen, teddun akked wayen illan d licwaô, ssaramen ahewwel, ssaramen asefhem is. I Issnen asefhem is, siwa Öebbi. Qqaôen imawlan n tmusni: "numen yis. S$uô Mass nne$ akw". Id ismektayen, siwa uâqilen.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Ur Smili ulawen nne$, mbaâd ma Tenhiv a$. Efk a$ d, s$uôeK, aêunu. Ih, Keçç, ard Am$it.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Ur Smili ulawen nne$, mbaâd ma Tenhiv a$. Efk a$ d, s$uôeK, aêunu. Ih, Keçç, ard Am$it.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, ara Ijemmlen medden, ass i$ef ur illi ccekk. S tidep, Öebbi ur Izeggel lemâahda.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, ara Ijemmlen medden, ass i$ef ur illi ccekk. S tidep, Öebbi ur Izeggel lemâahda.

verses.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur sen d ippawi acemma, ar Öebbi, wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Widak, d nitni ay d isufa n tmes.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur sen d ippawi acemma, ar Öebbi, wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Widak, d nitni ay d isufa n tmes.

verses.text: D tin n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen nne£. Iwwet iten Öebbi, ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Öebbi Iwâaô i uâaqeb.
verses.translation: D tin n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen nne£. Iwwet iten Öebbi, ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Öebbi Iwâaô i uâaqeb.

verses.text: Ini i wid ijehlen: "a ppepwa$elbem, a ppepwafesrem di Loahennama". A yir usu!
verses.translation: Ini i wid ijehlen: "a ppepwa$elbem, a ppepwafesrem di Loahennama". A yir usu!

verses.text: Ni$ d assekni, i kunwi, mi mlalent snat trebbuyaâ. Yiwet tepna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi; tayev d tajehlit, twala d snat, s yiéôi s. Öebbi Ippak afus, s tallalt iS, i win i S ihwan. Deg wayagi, s tidep, aselmed i wid ipwalin.
verses.translation: Ni$ d assekni, i kunwi, mi mlalent snat trebbuyaâ. Yiwet tepna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi; tayev d tajehlit, twala d snat, s yiéôi s. Öebbi Ippak afus, s tallalt iS, i win i S ihwan. Deg wayagi, s tidep, aselmed i wid ipwalin.

verses.text: D tucbiêt ay d tedheô i yimdanen leêmala n ccehwiyyat: tilawin, tarwa, iâammuôen ibararen n ddheb akked lfeîîa, iâawdiwen n ccetla, lmal, akal. Ayagi, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit. Öebbi, $uôeS amkan lâali, n tu$alin.
verses.translation: D tucbiêt ay d tedheô i yimdanen leêmala n ccehwiyyat: tilawin, tarwa, iâammuôen ibararen n ddheb akked lfeîîa, iâawdiwen n ccetla, lmal, akal. Ayagi, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit. Öebbi, $uôeS amkan lâali, n tu$alin.

verses.text: Ini: "ad awen mle$ i yifen aya? I wid ipêezziben, ar Mass nnsen, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, tilawin iûfan, akked llza s$uô Öebbi". Öebbi Ipwali imdanen;
verses.translation: Ini: "ad awen mle$ i yifen aya? I wid ipêezziben, ar Mass nnsen, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, tilawin iûfan, akked llza s$uô Öebbi". Öebbi Ipwali imdanen;

verses.text: wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Nekwni, s tidep, numen. Ihi, Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, Sellek a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes".
verses.translation: wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Nekwni, s tidep, numen. Ihi, Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, Sellek a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes".

verses.text: Iûebôiyen, imawlan n tidep, imvuâen, wid ipseddiqen, wid iste$fiôen di tafrara.
verses.translation: Iûebôiyen, imawlan n tidep, imvuâen, wid ipseddiqen, wid iste$fiôen di tafrara.

verses.text: Icuhhed Öebbi ar ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa. Akken lmalayek, akked imawlan n tmusni. Ibedd i lmizan. Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Icuhhed Öebbi ar ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa. Akken lmalayek, akked imawlan n tmusni. Ibedd i lmizan. Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ih, ddin ar Öebbi d annuz. Ur mgarraden wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, armi deffir n tisin n tussna $uôsen, wa iqheô wa. Wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
verses.translation: Ih, ddin ar Öebbi d annuz. Ur mgarraden wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, armi deffir n tisin n tussna $uôsen, wa iqheô wa. Wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

verses.text: Ma nuqmen k, ini: "unze$ aS i Öebbi. Akken, wid iddan yidi. Ini i wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, akked at war tussna: "ma tunzem"? Ma unzen, ihi, pwanhan. Ma wexxôen, ay fellak siwa anabi. Öebbi Ipwali imdanen.
verses.translation: Ma nuqmen k, ini: "unze$ aS i Öebbi. Akken, wid iddan yidi. Ini i wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, akked at war tussna: "ma tunzem"? Ma unzen, ihi, pwanhan. Ma wexxôen, ay fellak siwa anabi. Öebbi Ipwali imdanen.

verses.text: Ih, wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, u pna$en lambiyya, war ssebba, u pna$en wid seg yimdanen ippamôen lmizan, becceô iten s uâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ih, wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, u pna$en lambiyya, war ssebba, u pna$en wid seg yimdanen ippamôen lmizan, becceô iten s uâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Widak, d wid iwumi mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxert. Ur sâin isellaken.
verses.translation: Widak, d wid iwumi mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxert. Ur sâin isellaken.

verses.text: Day ur twalav ara wid iwumi ippunefk kra si Tezmamt, la ssuturen, i Tezmamt n Öebbi, aêuddu garasen? Sinna, ad iwexxeô urbaâ segsen, u nitni pnamaren.
verses.translation: Day ur twalav ara wid iwumi ippunefk kra si Tezmamt, la ssuturen, i Tezmamt n Öebbi, aêuddu garasen? Sinna, ad iwexxeô urbaâ segsen, u nitni pnamaren.

verses.text: Ayagi, acku nnan: "ur a$ teppep tmes, siwa kra n wussan". I$uôô iten, di ddin nnsen, wayen id snulfuyen.
verses.translation: Ayagi, acku nnan: "ur a$ teppep tmes, siwa kra n wussan". I$uôô iten, di ddin nnsen, wayen id snulfuyen.

verses.text: Amek ihi, ma Njemmel iten, ass ideg, ur degs ccekk, yal yiwen ad i$ellet ayen ikseb, nitni ur ppudensen.
verses.translation: Amek ihi, ma Njemmel iten, ass ideg, ur degs ccekk, yal yiwen ad i$ellet ayen ikseb, nitni ur ppudensen.

verses.text: Ini: "a Öebbi, Agellid n tgelda, Teppakev tagelda i win i K ihwan, Teppeksev tagelda i win i K ihwan, Tepâuzzuv win i K ihwan, Tesdulluv win i K ihwan. Lxiô deg ufus i K. Ih, Keçç, Tzemrev i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ini: "a Öebbi, Agellid n tgelda, Teppakev tagelda i win i K ihwan, Teppeksev tagelda i win i K ihwan, Tepâuzzuv win i K ihwan, Tesdulluv win i K ihwan. Lxiô deg ufus i K. Ih, Keçç, Tzemrev i yal cci.

verses.text: Tessekcamev iv deg wass. Tessekcamev ass deg iv. Tessuffu$ev amuddir si lmegget. Tessuffu$ev lmegget seg umuddir. Tep$itiv win i K ihwan, war aktili".
verses.translation: Tessekcamev iv deg wass. Tessekcamev ass deg iv. Tessuffu$ev amuddir si lmegget. Tessuffu$ev lmegget seg umuddir. Tep$itiv win i K ihwan, war aktili".

verses.text: Lmumnin ur pparan ijehliyen d iêbiben nnsen, war lmumnin. Win ixedmen aya, ur illi, s wacemma, ar Öebbi. Kkes ed aêezzeb i têezzbem iman nnwen segsen. Iâaggen awen Öebbi s yiman iS. Tu$alin ar Öebbi.
verses.translation: Lmumnin ur pparan ijehliyen d iêbiben nnsen, war lmumnin. Win ixedmen aya, ur illi, s wacemma, ar Öebbi. Kkes ed aêezzeb i têezzbem iman nnwen segsen. Iâaggen awen Öebbi s yiman iS. Tu$alin ar Öebbi.

verses.text: Ini: "ama teffrem i illan deg idmaren nnwen, ne$ tessnaâtem t, Öebbi Iéôa t". Iéôa i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ini: "ama teffrem i illan deg idmaren nnwen, ne$ tessnaâtem t, Öebbi Iéôa t". Iéôa i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ass ideg yal iman ad iaf irs ed, wayen ixdem n lxiô, akked wayen ixdem n cceôô, ad issirem a ppili, garas yides, tallit $ezzifen! Iâaggen awen Öebbi, af yiman iS. Öebbi d Umâin ar imdanen.
verses.translation: Ass ideg yal iman ad iaf irs ed, wayen ixdem n lxiô, akked wayen ixdem n cceôô, ad issirem a ppili, garas yides, tallit $ezzifen! Iâaggen awen Öebbi, af yiman iS. Öebbi d Umâin ar imdanen.

verses.text: Ini: "ma têemmlem Öebbi, ddut yidi. A kwen Iâuzz Öebbi, ad awen Isemmeê ibekkaven nnwen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
verses.translation: Ini: "ma têemmlem Öebbi, ddut yidi. A kwen Iâuzz Öebbi, ad awen Isemmeê ibekkaven nnwen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

verses.text: Ini: "ssemêesset i Öebbi akked Umazan". Ma wexxôen, ihi Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ini: "ssemêesset i Öebbi akked Umazan". Ma wexxôen, ihi Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ih, Öebbi Ismenyaf, i imavalen, Adem, Nuê, tawacult n Ibôahim, tawacult n Âimôan.
verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi Ismenyaf, i imavalen, Adem, Nuê, tawacult n Ibôahim, tawacult n Âimôan.

verses.text: Wa iurew wa. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Wa iurew wa. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Mi tenna tmeîîut n Âimôan: "a Mass iw! Wekkle$ aK ayen illan di tâabbuî iw, d lewkala, Eqbel s$uôi. Keçç, ih, d win Isellen, d Amusnaw".
verses.translation: Mi tenna tmeîîut n Âimôan: "a Mass iw! Wekkle$ aK ayen illan di tâabbuî iw, d lewkala, Eqbel s$uôi. Keçç, ih, d win Isellen, d Amusnaw".

verses.text: Mi p id turew, tenna: "a Mass iw! Urwe$ p id d nnta". - Öebbi Iéôa, sennig akw, d acu d turew. Ddkeô, maççi am nnta. - "Nek semma$ as Meryem, rri$ p seddaw tecvaî iK, neppat akked tarwa s, mgal Cciîan imenfi".
verses.translation: Mi p id turew, tenna: "a Mass iw! Urwe$ p id d nnta". - Öebbi Iéôa, sennig akw, d acu d turew. Ddkeô, maççi am nnta. - "Nek semma$ as Meryem, rri$ p seddaw tecvaî iK, neppat akked tarwa s, mgal Cciîan imenfi".

verses.text: Iôêeb yis Mass is, asteôêeb ilhan; Isgem ip, tigmi ilhan; Ikwellef ip i Zakariyya. Yal tikelt ara iôuê $uôes Zakariyya ar lmiêreb, a n iaf tesâa ôôeéq. Inna: "a Meryem! Ansi i m d ikka waya"? Tenna: "s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Iôeééeq win i S ihwan, war aktili".
verses.translation: Iôêeb yis Mass is, asteôêeb ilhan; Isgem ip, tigmi ilhan; Ikwellef ip i Zakariyya. Yal tikelt ara iôuê $uôes Zakariyya ar lmiêreb, a n iaf tesâa ôôeéq. Inna: "a Meryem! Ansi i m d ikka waya"? Tenna: "s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Iôeééeq win i S ihwan, war aktili".

verses.text: D$a Zakariyya inuj $uô Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d, s$uôeK, tarwa ifazen. Keçç, s tidep, Tsellev i unuju".
verses.translation: D$a Zakariyya inuj $uô Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d, s$uôeK, tarwa ifazen. Keçç, s tidep, Tsellev i unuju".

verses.text: Mi ibedd, ipéalla di lmeêreb, ssawlent as d lmalayek: "Ibecceô ik Öebbi s Yaêia, d atebbet n wawal n Öebbi, d ssid, d azedgan, d nnbi, seg iâaôviyen".
verses.translation: Mi ibedd, ipéalla di lmeêreb, ssawlent as d lmalayek: "Ibecceô ik Öebbi s Yaêia, d atebbet n wawal n Öebbi, d ssid, d azedgan, d nnbi, seg iâaôviyen".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic? Ni$ wessre$, tameîîut iw d tiâiqeôt". Inna: "akka, Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic? Ni$ wessre$, tameîîut iw d tiâiqeôt". Inna: "akka, Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d assekni". Inna: "assekni ik, ur tepmeslayev i medden krav wussan. As$al kan. Mmekti d aîas Mass ik, sbuccaâ iT tameddit, tafrara".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d assekni". Inna: "assekni ik, ur tepmeslayev i medden krav wussan. As$al kan. Mmekti d aîas Mass ik, sbuccaâ iT tameddit, tafrara".

verses.text: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren ikem, Izzazdeg ikem, Ismenyaf ikem i tlawin imavalen.
verses.translation: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren ikem, Izzazdeg ikem, Ismenyaf ikem i tlawin imavalen.

verses.text: A Meryem! Anez i Mass im, knu yaS, îîinez akked wid iîîinizen".
verses.translation: A Meryem! Anez i Mass im, knu yaS, îîinez akked wid iîîinizen".

verses.text: Ayagi si tmucuha i iffren, Nweêêa yak t. Ur telliv yidsen, mi jebden taseqqaôt, anwa segsen ara itkelfen $ef Meryem. Ur telliv yidsen mi mqellaâen.
verses.translation: Ayagi si tmucuha i iffren, Nweêêa yak t. Ur telliv yidsen, mi jebden taseqqaôt, anwa segsen ara itkelfen $ef Meryem. Ur telliv yidsen mi mqellaâen.

verses.text: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Öebbi, s tidep, Ibecceô ikem s wawal s$uôeS, ism is: lmasiê Âisa, mmi s n Meryem; mucaâ di ddunit akked laxert; seg iqôiben.
verses.translation: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Öebbi, s tidep, Ibecceô ikem s wawal s$uôeS, ism is: lmasiê Âisa, mmi s n Meryem; mucaâ di ddunit akked laxert; seg iqôiben.

verses.text: A d ipmeslay i medden, si dduê, am unqaqôi, ad yili seg iâaôviyen".
verses.translation: A d ipmeslay i medden, si dduê, am unqaqôi, ad yili seg iâaôviyen".

verses.text: Tenna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic, ur iyi innul urgaz"? Inna: "akka. Öebbi Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ma Iseyya lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili".
verses.translation: Tenna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic, ur iyi innul urgaz"? Inna: "akka. Öebbi Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ma Iseyya lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili".

verses.text: Ad as Isselmed Tazmamt, ûûwab, Tuôa, Linoil.
verses.translation: Ad as Isselmed Tazmamt, ûûwab, Tuôa, Linoil.

verses.text: D amazan ar At Isôail: "ni$ nek usi$ d, $uôwen, s issekniyen s$uô Mass nnwen. Nek ad awen d xelqe$, s talaxt, ayen icban afôux, ad ûuve$ degs, ad iu$al d afôux, ma Ib$a Öebbi. Ad sseêlu$ ader$al, amuvin n lbeôû, a d ssidre$ lmeggtin, ma Ib$a Öebbi. Ad awen ini$ d acu teppeppem, akked wayen txezznem deg ixxamen nnwen. Deg waya, s tidep, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
verses.translation: D amazan ar At Isôail: "ni$ nek usi$ d, $uôwen, s issekniyen s$uô Mass nnwen. Nek ad awen d xelqe$, s talaxt, ayen icban afôux, ad ûuve$ degs, ad iu$al d afôux, ma Ib$a Öebbi. Ad sseêlu$ ader$al, amuvin n lbeôû, a d ssidre$ lmeggtin, ma Ib$a Öebbi. Ad awen ini$ d acu teppeppem, akked wayen txezznem deg ixxamen nnwen. Deg waya, s tidep, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

verses.text: A d tebbte$ iyi d izwaren di Tuôa, ad awen êelle$ kra n wayen illan ipwagdel awen. Usi$ d, $uôwen, s ussekni, s$uô Mass nnwen. Ëezbet i Öebbi, a$et iyi awal.
verses.translation: A d tebbte$ iyi d izwaren di Tuôa, ad awen êelle$ kra n wayen illan ipwagdel awen. Usi$ d, $uôwen, s ussekni, s$uô Mass nnwen. Ëezbet i Öebbi, a$et iyi awal.

verses.text: Öebbi, s tidep, d Mass iw, u d Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eP, d wagi ay d abrid uwqim".
verses.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, d Mass iw, u d Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eP, d wagi ay d abrid uwqim".

verses.text: Mi israê Âisa tijehli s$uôsen, inna: "anwi ay d imâiwnen iw ar Öebbi"? Nnan as d lexwan: "nekwni d imâiwnen n Öebbi. Numen s Öebbi, eched ar nekwni d imvuâen.
verses.translation: Mi israê Âisa tijehli s$uôsen, inna: "anwi ay d imâiwnen iw ar Öebbi"? Nnan as d lexwan: "nekwni d imâiwnen n Öebbi. Numen s Öebbi, eched ar nekwni d imvuâen.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Numen s wayen id Tessersev, nedda d umazan, Aru ya$ seg inagan".
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Numen s wayen id Tessersev, nedda d umazan, Aru ya$ seg inagan".

verses.text: Undin. Iundi Öebbi. Öebbi Yif akw imendayen.
verses.translation: Undin. Iundi Öebbi. Öebbi Yif akw imendayen.

verses.text: Mi s Inna Öebbi: "a Âisa! Nek ad Ddme$ ôôuê ik, a k id Ssali$ $uôI, a k id Ssiferre$ seg wid ijehlen, ad Rre$, wid iddan yidek, sennig wid ijehlen, ar ass n tnekra". Sinna, tu$alin nnwen $uôI, ad Ëudde$, garawen, $ef wayen i$ef teppemgarradem.
verses.translation: Mi s Inna Öebbi: "a Âisa! Nek ad Ddme$ ôôuê ik, a k id Ssali$ $uôI, a k id Ssiferre$ seg wid ijehlen, ad Rre$, wid iddan yidek, sennig wid ijehlen, ar ass n tnekra". Sinna, tu$alin nnwen $uôI, ad Ëudde$, garawen, $ef wayen i$ef teppemgarradem.

verses.text: Ma d wid ijehlen, a ten Âaqbe$ di ddunit, di laxert, aâaqeb aqeûêan. Ur asen ppilin isellaken.
verses.translation: Ma d wid ijehlen, a ten Âaqbe$ di ddunit, di laxert, aâaqeb aqeûêan. Ur asen ppilin isellaken.

verses.text: Wanag wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Ifk arrazen nnsen. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara imednas.
verses.translation: Wanag wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Ifk arrazen nnsen. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara imednas.

verses.text: Ayagi i ak Nemmal seg issekniyen, akked usmekti uûwib.
verses.translation: Ayagi i ak Nemmal seg issekniyen, akked usmekti uûwib.

verses.text: Ih, amedya n Âisa, ar Öebbi, am umedya n Adem. Ixelq it seg wakal, sinna, Inna yas: "ili"! Illa.
verses.translation: Ih, amedya n Âisa, ar Öebbi, am umedya n Adem. Ixelq it seg wakal, sinna, Inna yas: "ili"! Illa.

verses.text: Tidep, s$uô Mass ik. Ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.
verses.translation: Tidep, s$uô Mass ik. Ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.

verses.text: I win i k inumren fellas, deffir wayen i k id iusan n tussna, ini: "yyaw a nenced tarwa nne$, tarwa nnwen, tilawin nne$, tilawin nnwen, iman nne$, iman nnwen. Sinna, a nemmesgill, a nd²âu ad Ixzu Öebbi ikeddaben.
verses.translation: I win i k inumren fellas, deffir wayen i k id iusan n tussna, ini: "yyaw a nenced tarwa nne$, tarwa nnwen, tilawin nne$, tilawin nnwen, iman nne$, iman nnwen. Sinna, a nemmesgill, a nd²âu ad Ixzu Öebbi ikeddaben.

verses.text: Ih, tagi d tamacahup n tidep, ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi, Neppa, war ccekk, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ih, tagi d tamacahup n tidep, ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi, Neppa, war ccekk, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ma wexxren, ihi Öebbi Issen ifessaden.
verses.translation: Ma wexxren, ihi Öebbi Issen ifessaden.

verses.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Yyaw ar wawal azduklan garane$ yidwen. A naâbed siwa Öebbi, ur aS nepcarak acemma; ur pparan, kra segne$ kra, d iôebbiten, war Öebbi". Ma wexxôen, init: "cehhdet ar nekwni d imvuâen".
verses.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Yyaw ar wawal azduklan garane$ yidwen. A naâbed siwa Öebbi, ur aS nepcarak acemma; ur pparan, kra segne$ kra, d iôebbiten, war Öebbi". Ma wexxôen, init: "cehhdet ar nekwni d imvuâen".

verses.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi temnamarem $ef Ibôahim? Ur n risent Tuôa akked Linoil, armi deffir es, day ur tmeyyzem ara?
verses.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi temnamarem $ef Ibôahim? Ur n risent Tuôa akked Linoil, armi deffir es, day ur tmeyyzem ara?

verses.text: Kunwi, atan temnamarem $ef wayen tessnem. Ihi, acimi temnamarem $ef wayen ur tessinem? Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Kunwi, atan temnamarem $ef wayen tessnem. Ihi, acimi temnamarem $ef wayen ur tessinem? Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.

verses.text: Ur illi Ibôahim d uday ne$ d amasiêi, maca illa d amvuâ imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak.
verses.translation: Ur illi Ibôahim d uday ne$ d amasiêi, maca illa d amvuâ imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak.

verses.text: Ih, imdanen iqeôben nezzeh ar Ibôahim, war ccekk, d wid i t ivefôen, akked Nnbi agi, akked wid iumnen. Öebbi d Bab n lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ih, imdanen iqeôben nezzeh ar Ibôahim, war ccekk, d wid i t ivefôen, akked Nnbi agi, akked wid iumnen. Öebbi d Bab n lmumnin.

verses.text: Arbaâ, seg At Tezmamt, ib$a a kwen itlef. Ara telfen siwa iman nnsen, ur éôin.
verses.translation: Arbaâ, seg At Tezmamt, ib$a a kwen itlef. Ara telfen siwa iman nnsen, ur éôin.

verses.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tugim issekniyen n Öebbi, u kunwi tepwalim?
verses.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tugim issekniyen n Öebbi, u kunwi tepwalim?

verses.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teslusum, i tidep, ayen idensen, u teppeffrem tidep, kunwi teêûam?
verses.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teslusum, i tidep, ayen idensen, u teppeffrem tidep, kunwi teêûam?

verses.text: Arbaâ, seg At Tezmamt, inna: "amnet mi iuli wass, s wayen id irsen ar wid iumnen, nekôet tameddit". Amendeô ma a d u$alen.
verses.translation: Arbaâ, seg At Tezmamt, inna: "amnet mi iuli wass, s wayen id irsen ar wid iumnen, nekôet tameddit". Amendeô ma a d u$alen.

verses.text: Ppamnet kan win ivefôen ddin nnwen. Ini: "ih, nnhaya d nnhaya n Öebbi. A ppeppunefk i yiwen am wayen i wen ippunefken". Ne$ a kwen namren af Mass nnwen. Ini: "lfevl, s tidep, deg ufus n Öebbi, Ippak it i win i S ihwan". Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ppamnet kan win ivefôen ddin nnwen. Ini: "ih, nnhaya d nnhaya n Öebbi. A ppeppunefk i yiwen am wayen i wen ippunefken". Ne$ a kwen namren af Mass nnwen. Ini: "lfevl, s tidep, deg ufus n Öebbi, Ippak it i win i S ihwan". Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Iâateq aêunu S i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Iâateq aêunu S i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Seg wAt Tezmamt, illa win, xas teooiv as adrim aîas, ad ak t id irr. Illa wayev segsen, ma teooiv as adinar, ur ak t id ippara, alamma tezgiv $uôes. Akka, acku nitni nnan: "ur a$ d ppawven at war tussna". U ggaren d tikerkas $ef Öebbi, u nitni éôan.
verses.translation: Seg wAt Tezmamt, illa win, xas teooiv as adrim aîas, ad ak t id irr. Illa wayev segsen, ma teooiv as adinar, ur ak t id ippara, alamma tezgiv $uôes. Akka, acku nitni nnan: "ur a$ d ppawven at war tussna". U ggaren d tikerkas $ef Öebbi, u nitni éôan.

verses.text: Xaîi! Win iîîfen di lemâahda s, u iêezzeb…ihi, Öebbi Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Xaîi! Win iîîfen di lemâahda s, u iêezzeb…ihi, Öebbi Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Ih, wid ippa$en s lemâahda n Öebbi akked tgallit nnsen, ayen ôxisen, widak, ur ppawin amur di laxert, ur asen Ipmeslay Öebbi, ur ten id Ipmuqul, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ippa$en s lemâahda n Öebbi akked tgallit nnsen, ayen ôxisen, widak, ur ppawin amur di laxert, ur asen Ipmeslay Öebbi, ur ten id Ipmuqul, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ih, arbaâ segsen ssexsaôen Tazmamt s yilsawen nnsen, iwakken a p$ilem n Tezmamt, ayen ur nelli n Tezmamt. Qqaôen: "aya s$uô Öebbi", u neppa ur illi s$uô Öebbi. U qqaren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, u nitni éôan.
verses.translation: Ih, arbaâ segsen ssexsaôen Tazmamt s yilsawen nnsen, iwakken a p$ilem n Tezmamt, ayen ur nelli n Tezmamt. Qqaôen: "aya s$uô Öebbi", u neppa ur illi s$uô Öebbi. U qqaren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, u nitni éôan.

verses.text: Ur ippunefk ara i umdan iwumi Ifka Öebbi Tazmamt, ûûwab, u Irra t d nnbi, ad iu$al ad yini i medden: "ilit d imdanen iw, war Öebbi". Maca: "ilit d iselmaden, imi tesselmadem Tazmamt, u tlemdem".
verses.translation: Ur ippunefk ara i umdan iwumi Ifka Öebbi Tazmamt, ûûwab, u Irra t d nnbi, ad iu$al ad yini i medden: "ilit d imdanen iw, war Öebbi". Maca: "ilit d iselmaden, imi tesselmadem Tazmamt, u tlemdem".

verses.text: Ur awen Iumeô ara a pperrem lmalayek akked lambiyya, d imawlan. Day awen Iameô tijehli, mbaâd ma tellam d imvuâen?
verses.translation: Ur awen Iumeô ara a pperrem lmalayek akked lambiyya, d imawlan. Day awen Iameô tijehli, mbaâd ma tellam d imvuâen?

verses.text: Mi Iîîef Öebbi laâqed n lambiyya: "s tidep, Fki$ awen si Tezmamt akw si ûûwab, sinna, iusa kwen id umazan, i itebbten ayen illan $uôwen. Amnet yis, âiwnet ep". Inna: "tâazmem u tqeblem, f waya, laâqed iW"? Nnan as: "naâzem". Inna: "ihi, cehhdet, Nek, yidwen, seg inagan".
verses.translation: Mi Iîîef Öebbi laâqed n lambiyya: "s tidep, Fki$ awen si Tezmamt akw si ûûwab, sinna, iusa kwen id umazan, i itebbten ayen illan $uôwen. Amnet yis, âiwnet ep". Inna: "tâazmem u tqeblem, f waya, laâqed iW"? Nnan as: "naâzem". Inna: "ihi, cehhdet, Nek, yidwen, seg inagan".

verses.text: Wid iwexxôen, deffir waya, nitni d iballa$en.
verses.translation: Wid iwexxôen, deffir waya, nitni d iballa$en.

verses.text: Day b$an ddin ur nelli n Öebbi? U Neppa, unzen aS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan, b$an ne$ ugin. £uôeS, tu$alin nnsen.
verses.translation: Day b$an ddin ur nelli n Öebbi? U Neppa, unzen aS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan, b$an ne$ ugin. £uôeS, tu$alin nnsen.

verses.text: Ini: "numen s Öebbi, akked wayen id irsen $uône$, akked wayen id irsen ar Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, ayen ippunefken i Musa, Âisa, akked lambiyya, s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur nesmenyaf yiwen degsen. Nekwni nunez aS".
verses.translation: Ini: "numen s Öebbi, akked wayen id irsen $uône$, akked wayen id irsen ar Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, ayen ippunefken i Musa, Âisa, akked lambiyya, s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur nesmenyaf yiwen degsen. Nekwni nunez aS".

verses.text: Win ib$an ddin, war annuz, ur ipwaqbal s$uôes. U neppa, di laxert, seg imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Win ib$an ddin, war annuz, ur ipwaqbal s$uôes. U neppa, di laxert, seg imexsuôen.

verses.text: Amek ara Inhu Öebbi agdud inekôen deffir liman is, u cehhden ar Amazan d tidep, u iusa ten id ubeggen? Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
verses.translation: Amek ara Inhu Öebbi agdud inekôen deffir liman is, u cehhden ar Amazan d tidep, u iusa ten id ubeggen? Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

verses.text: Widak, aqeîîi nnsen d ddell s$uô Öebbi, d lmalayek, akked imdanen meôôa.
verses.translation: Widak, aqeîîi nnsen d ddell s$uô Öebbi, d lmalayek, akked imdanen meôôa.

verses.text: Degs ad wekkôen; ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur stiseren.
verses.translation: Degs ad wekkôen; ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur stiseren.

verses.text: Kkes ed wid iu$alen nedmen, deffir waya, u xedmen ayen ilhan. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Kkes ed wid iu$alen nedmen, deffir waya, u xedmen ayen ilhan. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, deffir liman nnsen, sinna, rnan di tijehli, ur tepwaqbal nndama nnsen. Widak d im$eôôqen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, deffir liman nnsen, sinna, rnan di tijehli, ur tepwaqbal nndama nnsen. Widak d im$eôôqen.

verses.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, u mmuten d ijehliyen, ur ipwaqbal s$uô yiwen degsen, azal n tmurt n ddheb, a t id ifdu. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan, ur sâin amâiwen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, u mmuten d ijehliyen, ur ipwaqbal s$uô yiwen degsen, azal n tmurt n ddheb, a t id ifdu. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan, ur sâin amâiwen.

verses.text: Ur teppawvem ar ppuba, d awez$i, alamma tseddqem seg wayen têemmlem. Kra n wayen tseddqem n cci, ihi, Öebbi Iéôa t.
verses.translation: Ur teppawvem ar ppuba, d awez$i, alamma tseddqem seg wayen têemmlem. Kra n wayen tseddqem n cci, ihi, Öebbi Iéôa t.

verses.text: Yal lqut illa iêell i At Isôail, siwa ayen igdel Isôail i iman is, uqbel a d ters Tuôa. Ini: "awit ed Tuôa, $eôt ep, ma tessawalem tidep".
verses.translation: Yal lqut illa iêell i At Isôail, siwa ayen igdel Isôail i iman is, uqbel a d ters Tuôa. Ini: "awit ed Tuôa, $eôt ep, ma tessawalem tidep".

verses.text: Wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, deffir waya, nitni d imednas.
verses.translation: Wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, deffir waya, nitni d imednas.

verses.text: Ini: "Inna d Öebbi tidep; ddut d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep, ur nelli seg imcurak".
verses.translation: Ini: "Inna d Öebbi tidep; ddut d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep, ur nelli seg imcurak".

verses.text: Ih, axxam amezwaru, i irsen i medden, war ccekk, d win n Bekka. Iôqa, d nnhaya i imavalen.
verses.translation: Ih, axxam amezwaru, i irsen i medden, war ccekk, d win n Bekka. Iôqa, d nnhaya i imavalen.

verses.text: Degs issekniyen iberrzen; d axxam n Ibôahim. Win it ikecmen, atan di laman. I Öebbi, iwata ad êuoen medden s Axxam, ma zemren a t awven. Win iugin, ihi, Rebbi ur Iêwao ara imavalen.
verses.translation: Degs issekniyen iberrzen; d axxam n Ibôahim. Win it ikecmen, atan di laman. I Öebbi, iwata ad êuoen medden s Axxam, ma zemren a t awven. Win iugin, ihi, Rebbi ur Iêwao ara imavalen.

verses.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tnekôem issekniyen n Öebbi"? Öebbi d Anagi n wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tnekôem issekniyen n Öebbi"? Öebbi d Anagi n wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teîîeôôifem, wid iumnen, seg ubrid n Öebbi? Tessaramem t iaâwej, u kunwi d inagan". Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teîîeôôifem, wid iumnen, seg ubrid n Öebbi? Tessaramem t iaâwej, u kunwi d inagan". Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em awal i urbaâ, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, a kwen rren d ijehliyen, deffir liman nnwen.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em awal i urbaâ, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, a kwen rren d ijehliyen, deffir liman nnwen.

verses.text: Amek tnekôem, u kunwi $ôan awen d issekniyen n Öebbi, u, garawen, Amazan iS? Win iîîfen di Öebbi, ni$ ipwanha s abrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Amek tnekôem, u kunwi $ôan awen d issekniyen n Öebbi, u, garawen, Amazan iS? Win iîîfen di Öebbi, ni$ ipwanha s abrid uwqim.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, akken Iklal aêezzeb. Ur ppemmtet alamma tunzem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, akken Iklal aêezzeb. Ur ppemmtet alamma tunzem.

verses.text: Eîfet akw di teêmilt n Öebbi, ur ppemfaôaqet. Mmektit ed ayen ikwen I$at Öebbi. Mi tellam d icenga, Issemlal ulawen nnwen. S l$it iS, tu$alem d atmaten. Tellam $ef rrif n maylellif n tmes, Isellek ikwen segs. Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS, amendeô ma a ppepwanhum.
verses.translation: Eîfet akw di teêmilt n Öebbi, ur ppemfaôaqet. Mmektit ed ayen ikwen I$at Öebbi. Mi tellam d icenga, Issemlal ulawen nnwen. S l$it iS, tu$alem d atmaten. Tellam $ef rrif n maylellif n tmes, Isellek ikwen segs. Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS, amendeô ma a ppepwanhum.

verses.text: Amar ad yili, segwen, lois i ineccden ar lxiô, ippamôen lqanun, itekksen ayen n dir. Widak d imerbaê.
verses.translation: Amar ad yili, segwen, lois i ineccden ar lxiô, ippamôen lqanun, itekksen ayen n dir. Widak d imerbaê.

verses.text: Ur ppilit am wid imfaôaqen, u mgarraden, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôsen. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan,
verses.translation: Ur ppilit am wid imfaôaqen, u mgarraden, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôsen. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan,

verses.text: ass ideg ara imlulen wudmawen, ara ibriken wudmawen. Wanag wid iwumi ara ibriken wudmawen nnsen: "tnekôem, deffir liman nnwen? Jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tnekôem".
verses.translation: ass ideg ara imlulen wudmawen, ara ibriken wudmawen. Wanag wid iwumi ara ibriken wudmawen nnsen: "tnekôem, deffir liman nnwen? Jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tnekôem".

verses.text: Wanag wid iwumi ara a imlulen wudmawen nnsen, ad ilin deg uêunu n Öebbi. Nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Wanag wid iwumi ara a imlulen wudmawen nnsen, ad ilin deg uêunu n Öebbi. Nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.

verses.text: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Öebbi. Neqqaô ak ten id, s tidep. Ur Ib$i Öebbi ddens i imavalen.
verses.translation: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Öebbi. Neqqaô ak ten id, s tidep. Ur Ib$i Öebbi ddens i imavalen.

verses.text: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ar Öebbi tu$alin n lumuô.
verses.translation: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ar Öebbi tu$alin n lumuô.

verses.text: Tifem akw leoyus id iff$en i medden. Teppamôem lqanun, teppekksem ayen n dir, tumnem s Öebbi. Ppif, i At Tezmamt, lemmer uminen. Garasen lmumnin; tegwti degsen d iballa$en.
verses.translation: Tifem akw leoyus id iff$en i medden. Teppamôem lqanun, teppekksem ayen n dir, tumnem s Öebbi. Ppif, i At Tezmamt, lemmer uminen. Garasen lmumnin; tegwti degsen d iballa$en.

verses.text: Cwiî kan ara kwen vuôôen. Ma nnu$en kwen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur sâun amâiwen.
verses.translation: Cwiî kan ara kwen vuôôen. Ma nnu$en kwen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur sâun amâiwen.

verses.text: Iwwet iten ddell anda ma llan, siwa wid iîîfen di teêmilt n Öebbi, u di teêmilt n medden. Lqan urrif n Öebbi, u te$li d tiggulelt fellasen. Ayagi, acku llan nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, la neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi âuûan u zgaren tilas.
verses.translation: Iwwet iten ddell anda ma llan, siwa wid iîîfen di teêmilt n Öebbi, u di teêmilt n medden. Lqan urrif n Öebbi, u te$li d tiggulelt fellasen. Ayagi, acku llan nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, la neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi âuûan u zgaren tilas.

verses.text: Ur aâdilen. Illa lois, seg At Tezmamt, i iqqaôen issekniyen n Öebbi deg iv, u nitni kennun.
verses.translation: Ur aâdilen. Illa lois, seg At Tezmamt, i iqqaôen issekniyen n Öebbi deg iv, u nitni kennun.

verses.text: Umnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, ppamôen lqanun, tekksen ayen n dir, pêirin ar lxiô. Widak seg iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Umnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, ppamôen lqanun, tekksen ayen n dir, pêirin ar lxiô. Widak seg iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Ayen xedmen n lxiô, ur asen ipwankaô. Öebbi Issen wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Ayen xedmen n lxiô, ur asen ipwankaô. Öebbi Issen wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur asen d ippawi acemma, ar Öebbi, wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur asen d ippawi acemma, ar Öebbi, wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Amedya n wayen pseôôifen di tmeddurt n ddunit agi, am umedya n wavu, degs abruri. Iêuza iger n ugdud idensen iman is. Isnegr it. Ur ten Idnis Öebbi; d iman nnsen ay dennisen.
verses.translation: Amedya n wayen pseôôifen di tmeddurt n ddunit agi, am umedya n wavu, degs abruri. Iêuza iger n ugdud idensen iman is. Isnegr it. Ur ten Idnis Öebbi; d iman nnsen ay dennisen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d iêbiben, wur nelli segwen. Ur zgalen a kwen hewwlen. B$an a kwen hejjnen. Ni$ ibda d lbwe$v seg imawen nnsen. Ayen iffren deg ulawen nnsen, i$elb it. Ni$ Nbeggen awen ed issekniyen, ma tepmeyyizem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d iêbiben, wur nelli segwen. Ur zgalen a kwen hewwlen. B$an a kwen hejjnen. Ni$ ibda d lbwe$v seg imawen nnsen. Ayen iffren deg ulawen nnsen, i$elb it. Ni$ Nbeggen awen ed issekniyen, ma tepmeyyizem.

verses.text: Atan kunwi d wid i ten iêemmlen, ur kwen êemmlen. Tumnem di Tezmamt, s lekmal is. Ma mmugren kwen, ad inin: "numen". Mi $aben, ad $eééen ivudan nnsen si zzâaf fellawen. Ini: "emmtet si zzâaf nnwen"! Ih, Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Atan kunwi d wid i ten iêemmlen, ur kwen êemmlen. Tumnem di Tezmamt, s lekmal is. Ma mmugren kwen, ad inin: "numen". Mi $aben, ad $eééen ivudan nnsen si zzâaf fellawen. Ini: "emmtet si zzâaf nnwen"! Ih, Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: Ma iusa kwen id ise$, a ten isnu$ben. Ma tevôa yidwen tucmip, ad feôêen yis. Ma tûebôem, u têezbem, ur kwen teîîuôôu s wacemma, tandit nnsen. Ni$ Izzi Öebbi i wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ma iusa kwen id ise$, a ten isnu$ben. Ma tevôa yidwen tucmip, ad feôêen yis. Ma tûebôem, u têezbem, ur kwen teîîuôôu s wacemma, tandit nnsen. Ni$ Izzi Öebbi i wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Mi teff$ev, ûûbeê zik, si twacult ik, temmalev i lmumnin imukan umennu$, Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Mi teff$ev, ûûbeê zik, si twacult ik, temmalev i lmumnin imukan umennu$, Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Mi qôib feclent snat n trebbuyaâ nnwen, u Öebbi d Bab nnsent. Iwata i yal lmumen, ad ippkel $ef Öebbi.
verses.translation: Mi qôib feclent snat n trebbuyaâ nnwen, u Öebbi d Bab nnsent. Iwata i yal lmumen, ad ippkel $ef Öebbi.

verses.text: Ni$ Iâiwen ikwen Öebbi di Badô, mi tellam tendellem. Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar a ppesnemmrem.
verses.translation: Ni$ Iâiwen ikwen Öebbi di Badô, mi tellam tendellem. Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.text: Mi tenniv i lmumnin: "day ur testeqnaâm ara, mi kwen Iâiwen Öebbi s krav igima n lmalayek, id irsen"?
verses.translation: Mi tenniv i lmumnin: "day ur testeqnaâm ara, mi kwen Iâiwen Öebbi s krav igima n lmalayek, id irsen"?

verses.text: Xaîi, ma tûebôem u têezzbem, ma $ewwsen d fellawen, a kwen Iâiwen Mass nnwen, s smus igima n lmalayek ikkaten.
verses.translation: Xaîi, ma tûebôem u têezzbem, ma $ewwsen d fellawen, a kwen Iâiwen Mass nnwen, s smus igima n lmalayek ikkaten.

verses.text: Ur Iga akka Öebbi, siwa i ubecceô nnwen, ad rtiêen yis wulawen nnwen. Rrbeê s$uô Öebbi kan, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ur Iga akka Öebbi, siwa i ubecceô nnwen, ad rtiêen yis wulawen nnwen. Rrbeê s$uô Öebbi kan, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Iwakken ad Iôé arbaâ n wid ijehlen, ne$ a ten Iééaâ, ad u$alen nne$wnin.
verses.translation: Iwakken ad Iôé arbaâ n wid ijehlen, ne$ a ten Iééaâ, ad u$alen nne$wnin.

verses.text: Ur k iaâna lameô s wacemma. Ad asen Issuref, ne$ a ten Iâaqeb, nitni d imednas.
verses.translation: Ur k iaâna lameô s wacemma. Ad asen Issuref, ne$ a ten Iâaqeb, nitni d imednas.

verses.text: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan. Ipâaqab win i S ihwan. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan. Ipâaqab win i S ihwan. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur teppet rrba ipzeggiden, tepzeggid. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur teppet rrba ipzeggiden, tepzeggid. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.

verses.text: Ëezzbet ilmend n tmes i ippuheggan i ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ëezzbet ilmend n tmes i ippuheggan i ijehliyen.

verses.text: A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan, amar ad yili uêunu fellawen.
verses.translation: A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan, amar ad yili uêunu fellawen.

verses.text: £iwlet ar ssmaê s$uô Mass nnwen, akked Loennet iwsâan am tmurt akked igenwan. Teppuhegga d i wid ipêezziben,
verses.translation: £iwlet ar ssmaê s$uô Mass nnwen, akked Loennet iwsâan am tmurt akked igenwan. Teppuhegga d i wid ipêezziben,

verses.text: wid ipseddiqen - sâan ne$ xuûûen -, wid isnusun reffu, wid ipsemmiêen i medden - Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam -,
verses.translation: wid ipseddiqen - sâan ne$ xuûûen -, wid isnusun reffu, wid ipsemmiêen i medden - Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam -,

verses.text: wid, ma xedmen tucmip, ne$ densen iman nnsen, a d mmektin Öebbi, ad ste$fôen $ef ibekkaven nnsen. Anwa Ipsemmiêen ibekkaven siwa Öebbi? Ur pgerninen deg wayen xedmen, u nitni éôan.
verses.translation: wid, ma xedmen tucmip, ne$ densen iman nnsen, a d mmektin Öebbi, ad ste$fôen $ef ibekkaven nnsen. Anwa Ipsemmiêen ibekkaven siwa Öebbi? Ur pgerninen deg wayen xedmen, u nitni éôan.

verses.text: Widak, akafi nnsen d ssmaê n Mass nnsen, akked leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. D arraz igerzen i wid issewqamen.
verses.translation: Widak, akafi nnsen d ssmaê n Mass nnsen, akked leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. D arraz igerzen i wid issewqamen.

verses.text: Âaddant tedyanin uqbel nnwen. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d wid id iggaren tikerkas.
verses.translation: Âaddant tedyanin uqbel nnwen. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d wid id iggaren tikerkas.

verses.text: Wagi d abeggen i medden, d nnhaya akked unecced i wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Wagi d abeggen i medden, d nnhaya akked unecced i wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Ur ppifcilet, ur $webnet, d kunwi i iaâlayen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
verses.translation: Ur ppifcilet, ur $webnet, d kunwi i iaâlayen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

verses.text: Ma iêuza kwen lada, ni$ lada i t icban iêuza agdud. Ussan agi Nerra ten, ger medden, d tidwal, iwakken ad Yissin Öebbi wid iumnen, ad Iddem segwen inagan. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara imednas.
verses.translation: Ma iêuza kwen lada, ni$ lada i t icban iêuza agdud. Ussan agi Nerra ten, ger medden, d tidwal, iwakken ad Yissin Öebbi wid iumnen, ad Iddem segwen inagan. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara imednas.

verses.text: Iwakken ad Ijeôôeb Öebbi wid iumnen, u ad Isqucc ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Iwakken ad Ijeôôeb Öebbi wid iumnen, u ad Isqucc ijehliyen.

verses.text: Day t$ilem a pkecmem Loennet, wanag ur Iéôi ara Öebbi wid ijuhden segwen, ur Issin ara iûebôiyen?
verses.translation: Day t$ilem a pkecmem Loennet, wanag ur Iéôi ara Öebbi wid ijuhden segwen, ur Issin ara iûebôiyen?

verses.text: Ni$ tepmennim tameppant, uqbel a p id temmagrem. Ni$ twalam p, kunwi tepmuqulem.
verses.translation: Ni$ tepmennim tameppant, uqbel a p id temmagrem. Ni$ twalam p, kunwi tepmuqulem.

verses.text: Muêemmed d Amazan kan. Ni$ âaddan imazanen, uqbel is. Ma immut ne$ ipwan$a, day a ppu$alem ar deffir? Win ara iu$alen ar deffir, ur iîîuôôu Öebbi s wacemma. Öebbi ad Ikafi wid isnemmiren.
verses.translation: Muêemmed d Amazan kan. Ni$ âaddan imazanen, uqbel is. Ma immut ne$ ipwan$a, day a ppu$alem ar deffir? Win ara iu$alen ar deffir, ur iîîuôôu Öebbi s wacemma. Öebbi ad Ikafi wid isnemmiren.

verses.text: Ur ipmeppat umdan siwa ma Irad Öebbi, di lajel iuran. Win ib$an akafi n ddunit, ad as t Nefk. Win ib$an akafi n laxeôt, ad as t Nefk. A Nkafi wid isnemmiren.
verses.translation: Ur ipmeppat umdan siwa ma Irad Öebbi, di lajel iuran. Win ib$an akafi n ddunit, ad as t Nefk. Win ib$an akafi n laxeôt, ad as t Nefk. A Nkafi wid isnemmiren.

verses.text: Acêal n lambiyya i innu$en, idda yidsen urbaâ iqwan, ur fcilen seg wayen iten issaâtben, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur xuzen, ur fkin mayna. Öebbi Iêemmel iûebôiyen.
verses.translation: Acêal n lambiyya i innu$en, idda yidsen urbaâ iqwan, ur fcilen seg wayen iten issaâtben, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur xuzen, ur fkin mayna. Öebbi Iêemmel iûebôiyen.

verses.text: Awal nnsen, siwa mi nnan: "a Mass nne$! Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, akked tugut nne$ di lameô nne$. Tebbet isurifen nne$, Sserbeê ane$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen".
verses.translation: Awal nnsen, siwa mi nnan: "a Mass nne$! Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, akked tugut nne$ di lameô nne$. Tebbet isurifen nne$, Sserbeê ane$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen".

verses.text: Ifka yasen Öebbi akafi n ddunit, akked ukafi lâali n laxert. Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam.
verses.translation: Ifka yasen Öebbi akafi n ddunit, akked ukafi lâali n laxert. Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em awal i wid ijehlen, a kwen rren ar deffir, a ppu$alem txesôem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em awal i wid ijehlen, a kwen rren ar deffir, a ppu$alem txesôem.

verses.text: Xaîi! Öebbi d Bab nnwen. Neppa, Yif akw imâiwnen.
verses.translation: Xaîi! Öebbi d Bab nnwen. Neppa, Yif akw imâiwnen.

verses.text: A Nessekcem tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen, imi curken i Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d irs ara udabu. Axxam nnsen d times. A yir tanezdu$t i imednas!
verses.translation: A Nessekcem tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen, imi curken i Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d irs ara udabu. Axxam nnsen d times. A yir tanezdu$t i imednas!

verses.text: Ni$ Issawel awen Öebbi tidep, di lemâahda S, mi ten tesnegrem, s tsriê iS. Armi, mi tfeclem, temnamarem f lameô, taâûam mbaâd ma Issken awen d ayen têemmlem. Garawen wid ib$an ddunit, garawen wid ib$an laxert. Sinna, Issebâad ikwen fellasen, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb. Ni$ Isemmeê awen. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl i lmumnin.
