verses.translation: Ni$ Issawel awen Öebbi tidep, di lemâahda S, mi ten tesnegrem, s tsriê iS. Armi, mi tfeclem, temnamarem f lameô, taâûam mbaâd ma Issken awen d ayen têemmlem. Garawen wid ib$an ddunit, garawen wid ib$an laxert. Sinna, Issebâad ikwen fellasen, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb. Ni$ Isemmeê awen. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl i lmumnin.

verses.text: Mi tulim ur d tezzim, u Nnbi inecced ikwen ar ineggura nnwen. Ineûûef awen a$ilif s wayev, iwakken ur t$webnem $ef wayen i wen iôuêen, akked wayen ikwen iu$en. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Mi tulim ur d tezzim, u Nnbi inecced ikwen ar ineggura nnwen. Ineûûef awen a$ilif s wayev, iwakken ur t$webnem $ef wayen i wen iôuêen, akked wayen ikwen iu$en. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Sinna, deffir u$ilif, Issers awen d laman, ives id i$lin $ef urbaâ segwen. Ni$ arbaâ pêebbiôen $ef yiman nnsen, nnwan, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur nelli d tidep, nnwaya n at war tussna. Qqaôen: "day illa wayen i $ iaânan, di lameô"? Ini: "s tidep, lameô akw i Öebbi". Teffren, deg iman nnsen, ayen ur ak mmalen. Qqaôen: "lemmer illi wayen i $ iaânan, di lameô, ur nepwan$a dagi". Ini: "xas ma tellam deg ixxamen nnwen, wid i$ef tura tmen$iwt, a ten tawev s imîeôêen nnsen. Iwakken ad Ijeôôeb Öebbi i illan deg idmaren nnwen, ad Izzizdeg i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Sinna, deffir u$ilif, Issers awen d laman, ives id i$lin $ef urbaâ segwen. Ni$ arbaâ pêebbiôen $ef yiman nnsen, nnwan, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur nelli d tidep, nnwaya n at war tussna. Qqaôen: "day illa wayen i $ iaânan, di lameô"? Ini: "s tidep, lameô akw i Öebbi". Teffren, deg iman nnsen, ayen ur ak mmalen. Qqaôen: "lemmer illi wayen i $ iaânan, di lameô, ur nepwan$a dagi". Ini: "xas ma tellam deg ixxamen nnwen, wid i$ef tura tmen$iwt, a ten tawev s imîeôêen nnsen. Iwakken ad Ijeôôeb Öebbi i illan deg idmaren nnwen, ad Izzizdeg i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: Ih, wid segwen iwexxôen asmi mlalent trebbuyaâ, d Cciîan kan iten iccacven, ilmend n kra n wayen kesben. Ni$ Isemmeê asen Öebbi. Akka, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.
verses.translation: Ih, wid segwen iwexxôen asmi mlalent trebbuyaâ, d Cciîan kan iten iccacven, ilmend n kra n wayen kesben. Ni$ Isemmeê asen Öebbi. Akka, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ppilit am wid ijehlen. Nnan i watmaten nnsen iunagen di tmurt, ne$ ipna$en: "lemmer llin $uône$, ur mmuten, ur twan$an". Ad Irr Öebbi, ayagi, d aneggaf deg ulawen nnsen! Öebbi Issidir, Ineqq. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur ppilit am wid ijehlen. Nnan i watmaten nnsen iunagen di tmurt, ne$ ipna$en: "lemmer llin $uône$, ur mmuten, ur twan$an". Ad Irr Öebbi, ayagi, d aneggaf deg ulawen nnsen! Öebbi Issidir, Ineqq. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ma tepwan$am deg ubrid n Öebbi, ne$ temmutem, ssmaê n Öebbi akked uêunu, war ccekk, ifen ayen la jemâan.
verses.translation: Ma tepwan$am deg ubrid n Öebbi, ne$ temmutem, ssmaê n Öebbi akked uêunu, war ccekk, ifen ayen la jemâan.

verses.text: Ma temmutem ne$ tepwan$am, war ccekk, ar Öebbi ara tepwafesrem.
verses.translation: Ma temmutem ne$ tepwan$am, war ccekk, ar Öebbi ara tepwafesrem.

verses.text: S uêunu n Öebbi, têelmev $uôsen. Lemmer tqeûêev, tes$aôev ul ik, ad baâden fellak. Semmeê asen, ssuter ad ppusemmêen, ciweô iten $ef lameô. Mi tseyyiv, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Iêemmel wid ippkalen.
verses.translation: S uêunu n Öebbi, têelmev $uôsen. Lemmer tqeûêev, tes$aôev ul ik, ad baâden fellak. Semmeê asen, ssuter ad ppusemmêen, ciweô iten $ef lameô. Mi tseyyiv, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Iêemmel wid ippkalen.

verses.text: Ma Iâiwen ikwen Öebbi, ur kwen irennu yiwen. Ma Iooa kwen, anwa illan a kwen iâiwen, deffir eS? £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ma Iâiwen ikwen Öebbi, ur kwen irennu yiwen. Ma Iooa kwen, anwa illan a kwen iâiwen, deffir eS? £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.

verses.text: Ur issefk ara i nnbi ad idnes. Win idensen, a d ias s wayen idnes, ass n tnekra. Sinna, yal wa, ad as ippunefk wayen ikseb. Nitni, ur ten pmeôôiôen.
verses.translation: Ur issefk ara i nnbi ad idnes. Win idensen, a d ias s wayen idnes, ass n tnekra. Sinna, yal wa, ad as ippunefk wayen ikseb. Nitni, ur ten pmeôôiôen.

verses.text: Day win iddan d llza n Öebbi am win isebebben urrif n Öebbi, u tanezdu$t is d Loahennama? A taggara tucmip!
verses.translation: Day win iddan d llza n Öebbi am win isebebben urrif n Öebbi, u tanezdu$t is d Loahennama? A taggara tucmip!

verses.text: Ur aâdilen ar Öebbi. Öebbi Ipwali acu xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ur aâdilen ar Öebbi. Öebbi Ipwali acu xeddmen.

verses.text: Ni$ Öebbi I$at lmumnin, mi sen d Iuzen Amazan segsen, immal asen issekniyen iS, izzizdig iten, isseêfav asen Tazmamt akked ûûwab, ulamma llan, zik, di ttelfan n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Ni$ Öebbi I$at lmumnin, mi sen d Iuzen Amazan segsen, immal asen issekniyen iS, izzizdig iten, isseêfav asen Tazmamt akked ûûwab, ulamma llan, zik, di ttelfan n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ma tu$em tiyta, ni$ terram p berdayen. Tennam: "ansi waya"? Ini: "aya seg iman nnwen". Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ma tu$em tiyta, ni$ terram p berdayen. Tennam: "ansi waya"? Ini: "aya seg iman nnwen". Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ayen ikwen iwwten, ass n temlilit n trebbuyaâ, s tsriê n Öebbi. Iwakken ad Iéeô anwi ay d lmumnin,
verses.translation: Ayen ikwen iwwten, ass n temlilit n trebbuyaâ, s tsriê n Öebbi. Iwakken ad Iéeô anwi ay d lmumnin,

verses.text: u ad Iéeô anwi ay d ixabiten. Nnan asen: "yyaw, nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi, ne$ éedmet". Nnan: "lemmer nessin a nenna$, yili nedda n yidwen". Assen, nitni, ar tijehli, ne$ $eô liman, ay qeôben kteô. Qqaren, s yimawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa ayen teffren.
verses.translation: u ad Iéeô anwi ay d ixabiten. Nnan asen: "yyaw, nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi, ne$ éedmet". Nnan: "lemmer nessin a nenna$, yili nedda n yidwen". Assen, nitni, ar tijehli, ne$ $eô liman, ay qeôben kteô. Qqaren, s yimawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa ayen teffren.

verses.text: Wid innan i watmaten nnsen, u nitni qqimen: "lemmer i $ ssemêessen, ur pwan$en". Ini: "sdarit iman nnwen si tmeppant, ma tessawalem tidep ".
verses.translation: Wid innan i watmaten nnsen, u nitni qqimen: "lemmer i $ ssemêessen, ur pwan$en". Ini: "sdarit iman nnwen si tmeppant, ma tessawalem tidep ".

verses.text: Ur p$ili mmuten wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi. Xaîi, d imuddiren. Ad ppuôeéqen ar Mass nnsen.
verses.translation: Ur p$ili mmuten wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi. Xaîi, d imuddiren. Ad ppuôeéqen ar Mass nnsen.

verses.text: Ad feôêen s wayen i sen Ifka Öebbi, si lfevl iS. Zhan, imi wid deffir sen, mazal ur ten id nelêiq, ur ppagawaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: Ad feôêen s wayen i sen Ifka Öebbi, si lfevl iS. Zhan, imi wid deffir sen, mazal ur ten id nelêiq, ur ppagawaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: Zhan s l$it n Öebbi, akked lfevl. Öebbi ur Iveggiâ arraz n lmumnin;
verses.translation: Zhan s l$it n Öebbi, akked lfevl. Öebbi ur Iveggiâ arraz n lmumnin;

verses.text: wid id ijawben i Öebbi akked Umazan, mbaâd ma sâaddan lêif. Arraz ameqwôaêan i wid, segsen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, u êezzben;
verses.translation: wid id ijawben i Öebbi akked Umazan, mbaâd ma sâaddan lêif. Arraz ameqwôaêan i wid, segsen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, u êezzben;

verses.text: wid iwumi nnan medden: "ni$ mlalen fellawen imdanen, ihi, agwadet pen". D$a isnerna liman nnsen, nnan: "Iqadd a$ Öebbi, Awkil Amxallef".
verses.translation: wid iwumi nnan medden: "ni$ mlalen fellawen imdanen, ihi, agwadet pen". D$a isnerna liman nnsen, nnan: "Iqadd a$ Öebbi, Awkil Amxallef".

verses.text: U$alen d s l$it n Öebbi akked lfevl, ur ten innul cceôô; ddan d llza n Öebbi. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: U$alen d s l$it n Öebbi akked lfevl, ur ten innul cceôô; ddan d llza n Öebbi. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Akka kan ay d Cciîan. Issagwad s imeddukwal is. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
verses.translation: Akka kan ay d Cciîan. Issagwad s imeddukwal is. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

verses.text: Ur k $webbnen wid ip$awalen ar tijehli. Nitni, s tidep, ur vvuôôen Öebbi, s wacemma. Ib$a Öebbi ur asen Iteg amur di laxert. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ur k $webbnen wid ip$awalen ar tijehli. Nitni, s tidep, ur vvuôôen Öebbi, s wacemma. Ib$a Öebbi ur asen Iteg amur di laxert. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ih, wid iu$en tijehli s liman, ur vvuôôen Öebbi s wacemma. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iu$en tijehli s liman, ur vvuôôen Öebbi s wacemma. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ur êeppben wid ijehlen, ar telha yasen, lmudda i sen Nefka. Nefka yasen kan lmudda, iwakken ad rnun ibekkaven. Fellasen aâaqeb isdullun.
verses.translation: Ur êeppben wid ijehlen, ar telha yasen, lmudda i sen Nefka. Nefka yasen kan lmudda, iwakken ad rnun ibekkaven. Fellasen aâaqeb isdullun.

verses.text: Ur illi di leb$i n Öebbi, ad Ioo lmumnin di liêala nnwen, alamma Ifrez axabit seg umâin. Ur illi di leb$i n Öebbi, ad awen Imel tabavnit. Maca, Iferren Öebbi wid i S ihwan, d imazanen iS. Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked imazanen iS. Ma tumnem, u têezzbem, a ppawim arraz ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Ur illi di leb$i n Öebbi, ad Ioo lmumnin di liêala nnwen, alamma Ifrez axabit seg umâin. Ur illi di leb$i n Öebbi, ad awen Imel tabavnit. Maca, Iferren Öebbi wid i S ihwan, d imazanen iS. Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked imazanen iS. Ma tumnem, u têezzbem, a ppawim arraz ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Ur êeppben wid ipcuêêun deg wayen i sen Ifka Öebbi, si lfevl iS, ard lxiô nnsen. Xaîi, d cceôô nnsen. Ayen cuêêen a ten iarez seg umgaôv, ass n tnekra. I Öebbi, lweôt n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ur êeppben wid ipcuêêun deg wayen i sen Ifka Öebbi, si lfevl iS, ard lxiô nnsen. Xaîi, d cceôô nnsen. Ayen cuêêen a ten iarez seg umgaôv, ass n tnekra. I Öebbi, lweôt n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ni$ Isla Öebbi i wawal n wid innan: "s tidep, Öebbi d igellil, nekwni d isâayen". A Naru ayen nnan, akked wayen n$an n lambiyya, war ssebba. Ad asen Nini: "jeôôbet aâaqeb ujajiê".
verses.translation: Ni$ Isla Öebbi i wawal n wid innan: "s tidep, Öebbi d igellil, nekwni d isâayen". A Naru ayen nnan, akked wayen n$an n lambiyya, war ssebba. Ad asen Nini: "jeôôbet aâaqeb ujajiê".

verses.text: Ayagi, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnwen. Öebbi ur Ipdennis imdanen.
verses.translation: Ayagi, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnwen. Öebbi ur Ipdennis imdanen.

verses.text: Wid innan: "Ih, Öebbi Iâahed a$ ur neppamen s Umazan, alamma issenâat a$ d asfel, ara teçç tmes". Ini: "ni$ usan kwen id imazanen, uqbel iw, s ubeggen, akw s wayen d tennam. Ihi, acimi i ten ten$am, ma tessawalem tidep"?
verses.translation: Wid innan: "Ih, Öebbi Iâahed a$ ur neppamen s Umazan, alamma issenâat a$ d asfel, ara teçç tmes". Ini: "ni$ usan kwen id imazanen, uqbel iw, s ubeggen, akw s wayen d tennam. Ihi, acimi i ten ten$am, ma tessawalem tidep"?

verses.text: Ma skaddben k, ni$ skaddben imazanen, uqbel ik, usan d s ubeggen, Ihellilen, akked Tezmamt timnewweôt.
verses.translation: Ma skaddben k, ni$ skaddben imazanen, uqbel ik, usan d s ubeggen, Ihellilen, akked Tezmamt timnewweôt.

verses.text: Yal iman ad ijeôôeb tameppant. Ass n tnekra, ad awen ippunefk, kan, warraz nnwen. Win isellken si tmes, ikecmen Loennet, ni$ irbeê. Tameddurt, di ddunit, d zzhu kan ip$uôôun.
verses.translation: Yal iman ad ijeôôeb tameppant. Ass n tnekra, ad awen ippunefk, kan, warraz nnwen. Win isellken si tmes, ikecmen Loennet, ni$ irbeê. Tameddurt, di ddunit, d zzhu kan ip$uôôun.

verses.text: A ppeppujeôôbem deg wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen. Ad wwten aîas degwen, wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akked imcurak. Ma tûebôem u têezzbem, ayagi, s tidep, d ayen isselêayen lumuô.
verses.translation: A ppeppujeôôbem deg wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen. Ad wwten aîas degwen, wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akked imcurak. Ma tûebôem u têezzbem, ayagi, s tidep, d ayen isselêayen lumuô.

verses.text: Mi Iîîef Öebbi laâqed n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt: "a p tbeggnem i medden, ur p teppeffrem". Rran p deffir izugar nnsen, u$en yis, ayen irxisen. I icmet wayen u$en!
verses.translation: Mi Iîîef Öebbi laâqed n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt: "a p tbeggnem i medden, ur p teppeffrem". Rran p deffir izugar nnsen, u$en yis, ayen irxisen. I icmet wayen u$en!

verses.text: Ur p$ili ad sellken, seg uâaqeb, wid ifeôêen s wayen fkan, u b$an a ten ccekôen $ef wayen ur xdimen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ur p$ili ad sellken, seg uâaqeb, wid ifeôêen s wayen fkan, u b$an a ten ccekôen $ef wayen ur xdimen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, akked umgirred n yiv akked wass, d issekniyen i uâqilen;
verses.translation: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, akked umgirred n yiv akked wass, d issekniyen i uâqilen;

verses.text: Wid id ismektayen Öebbi s ibeddi, s i$imi, s tuééla. Pmeyyizen lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan. A Mass nne$! Ur Texliqev aya d aêerfi. Gedha s yiseK! Sellek a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes.
verses.translation: Wid id ismektayen Öebbi s ibeddi, s i$imi, s tuééla. Pmeyyizen lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan. A Mass nne$! Ur Texliqev aya d aêerfi. Gedha s yiseK! Sellek a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Ni$, s tidep, Keçç, Texziv win Teskecmev ar tmes. Ur llin wid ara isellken imednas.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Ni$, s tidep, Keçç, Texziv win Teskecmev ar tmes. Ur llin wid ara isellken imednas.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! S tidep, nesla i uneccad, la inecced ar liman: "amnet s Mass nnwen"! Numen. A Mass nne$! Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, Kkes ane$ tucmitin nne$, Ssiwev a$, ar ssmaê iK, akked wid zeddigen.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! S tidep, nesla i uneccad, la inecced ar liman: "amnet s Mass nnwen"! Numen. A Mass nne$! Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, Kkes ane$ tucmitin nne$, Ssiwev a$, ar ssmaê iK, akked wid zeddigen.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Efk ane$ ayen i a$ Tâahdev s imazanen iK; ur a$ Xezzu ass n tnekra. Keçç, s tidep, ur Tzeglev lemâahda.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Efk ane$ ayen i a$ Tâahdev s imazanen iK; ur a$ Xezzu ass n tnekra. Keçç, s tidep, ur Tzeglev lemâahda.

verses.text: Irra yasen Mass nnsen: "Nek ur Veggiâe$ igi n win, segwen, issewqamen, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta. Wa ikka d seg wa. Wid iunagen, u ssuff$en ten seg ixxamen nnsen, iâatben deg ubrid iW, innu$en, ipwan$an, war ccekk, ad asen Kkse$ tucmitin nnsen, a ten Skecme$ ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen". D akafi s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, $uôeS akafi amxallef.
verses.translation: Irra yasen Mass nnsen: "Nek ur Veggiâe$ igi n win, segwen, issewqamen, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta. Wa ikka d seg wa. Wid iunagen, u ssuff$en ten seg ixxamen nnsen, iâatben deg ubrid iW, innu$en, ipwan$an, war ccekk, ad asen Kkse$ tucmitin nnsen, a ten Skecme$ ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen". D akafi s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, $uôeS akafi amxallef.

verses.text: Ur k ipqelliq lexdaâ n wid ijehlen di temdint.
verses.translation: Ur k ipqelliq lexdaâ n wid ijehlen di temdint.

verses.text: Cwiî n zzhu, sinna, axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A yir usu!
verses.translation: Cwiî n zzhu, sinna, axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A yir usu!

verses.text: Maca, i wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen: leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, d inebgawen n Öebbi. U d wayen illan ar Öebbi, d amxallef i izedganen.
verses.translation: Maca, i wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen: leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, d inebgawen n Öebbi. U d wayen illan ar Öebbi, d amxallef i izedganen.

verses.text: Ih, seg wAt Tezmamt, wid iumnen s Öebbi, s wayen akw i wen ed irsen, akked s wayen i sen d irsen. Unzen i Öebbi, ur u$en ara s issekniyen n Öebbi, ayen ôxisen. I widak, arraz s$uô Mass nnsen. Ni$ Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
verses.translation: Ih, seg wAt Tezmamt, wid iumnen s Öebbi, s wayen akw i wen ed irsen, akked s wayen i sen d irsen. Unzen i Öebbi, ur u$en ara s issekniyen n Öebbi, ayen ôxisen. I widak, arraz s$uô Mass nnsen. Ni$ Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Üebôet, aznet ûûbeô, begset, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Üebôet, aznet ûûbeô, begset, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.

ayahs.text: Alm.
ayahs.translation: Alm.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amuddir, Imezgi.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amuddir, Imezgi.

ayahs.text: Issers ak d Tazmamt s tidep, d atebbet n wayen ip id izwaren. Issers ed Tuôa akked Linoil,
ayahs.translation: Issers ak d Tazmamt s tidep, d atebbet n wayen ip id izwaren. Issers ed Tuôa akked Linoil,

ayahs.text: uqbel, d nnhaya i medden. Issers ed Leqwôan. Ih, wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, fellasen aâaqeb uqûiê. Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.
ayahs.translation: uqbel, d nnhaya i medden. Issers ed Leqwôan. Ih, wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, fellasen aâaqeb uqûiê. Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi ur aS iffir wacemma di tmurt, ne$ deg igenni.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi ur aS iffir wacemma di tmurt, ne$ deg igenni.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i wen Ippaken udem, di tâabbav, akken i S ihwa. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i wen Ippaken udem, di tâabbav, akken i S ihwa. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Neppa i k ed Issersen Tazmamt, degs issekniyen uvhiôen, nitni d tayimmap n Tezmamt. Wiyav d licwaô. D$a, wid iwumi mmalen wulawen, teddun akked wayen illan d licwaô, ssaramen ahewwel, ssaramen asefhem is. I Issnen asefhem is, siwa Öebbi. Qqaôen imawlan n tmusni: "numen yis. S$uô Mass nne$ akw". Id ismektayen, siwa uâqilen.
ayahs.translation: Neppa i k ed Issersen Tazmamt, degs issekniyen uvhiôen, nitni d tayimmap n Tezmamt. Wiyav d licwaô. D$a, wid iwumi mmalen wulawen, teddun akked wayen illan d licwaô, ssaramen ahewwel, ssaramen asefhem is. I Issnen asefhem is, siwa Öebbi. Qqaôen imawlan n tmusni: "numen yis. S$uô Mass nne$ akw". Id ismektayen, siwa uâqilen.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Ur Smili ulawen nne$, mbaâd ma Tenhiv a$. Efk a$ d, s$uôeK, aêunu. Ih, Keçç, ard Am$it.
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Ur Smili ulawen nne$, mbaâd ma Tenhiv a$. Efk a$ d, s$uôeK, aêunu. Ih, Keçç, ard Am$it.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, ara Ijemmlen medden, ass i$ef ur illi ccekk. S tidep, Öebbi ur Izeggel lemâahda.
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, ara Ijemmlen medden, ass i$ef ur illi ccekk. S tidep, Öebbi ur Izeggel lemâahda.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur sen d ippawi acemma, ar Öebbi, wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Widak, d nitni ay d isufa n tmes.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur sen d ippawi acemma, ar Öebbi, wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Widak, d nitni ay d isufa n tmes.

ayahs.text: D tin n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen nne£. Iwwet iten Öebbi, ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Öebbi Iwâaô i uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: D tin n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen nne£. Iwwet iten Öebbi, ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Öebbi Iwâaô i uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Ini i wid ijehlen: "a ppepwa$elbem, a ppepwafesrem di Loahennama". A yir usu!
ayahs.translation: Ini i wid ijehlen: "a ppepwa$elbem, a ppepwafesrem di Loahennama". A yir usu!

ayahs.text: Ni$ d assekni, i kunwi, mi mlalent snat trebbuyaâ. Yiwet tepna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi; tayev d tajehlit, twala d snat, s yiéôi s. Öebbi Ippak afus, s tallalt iS, i win i S ihwan. Deg wayagi, s tidep, aselmed i wid ipwalin.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ d assekni, i kunwi, mi mlalent snat trebbuyaâ. Yiwet tepna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi; tayev d tajehlit, twala d snat, s yiéôi s. Öebbi Ippak afus, s tallalt iS, i win i S ihwan. Deg wayagi, s tidep, aselmed i wid ipwalin.

ayahs.text: D tucbiêt ay d tedheô i yimdanen leêmala n ccehwiyyat: tilawin, tarwa, iâammuôen ibararen n ddheb akked lfeîîa, iâawdiwen n ccetla, lmal, akal. Ayagi, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit. Öebbi, $uôeS amkan lâali, n tu$alin.
ayahs.translation: D tucbiêt ay d tedheô i yimdanen leêmala n ccehwiyyat: tilawin, tarwa, iâammuôen ibararen n ddheb akked lfeîîa, iâawdiwen n ccetla, lmal, akal. Ayagi, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit. Öebbi, $uôeS amkan lâali, n tu$alin.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ad awen mle$ i yifen aya? I wid ipêezziben, ar Mass nnsen, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, tilawin iûfan, akked llza s$uô Öebbi". Öebbi Ipwali imdanen;
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ad awen mle$ i yifen aya? I wid ipêezziben, ar Mass nnsen, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, tilawin iûfan, akked llza s$uô Öebbi". Öebbi Ipwali imdanen;

ayahs.text: wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Nekwni, s tidep, numen. Ihi, Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, Sellek a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes".
ayahs.translation: wid iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Nekwni, s tidep, numen. Ihi, Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, Sellek a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes".

ayahs.text: Iûebôiyen, imawlan n tidep, imvuâen, wid ipseddiqen, wid iste$fiôen di tafrara.
ayahs.translation: Iûebôiyen, imawlan n tidep, imvuâen, wid ipseddiqen, wid iste$fiôen di tafrara.

ayahs.text: Icuhhed Öebbi ar ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa. Akken lmalayek, akked imawlan n tmusni. Ibedd i lmizan. Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Icuhhed Öebbi ar ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa. Akken lmalayek, akked imawlan n tmusni. Ibedd i lmizan. Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ih, ddin ar Öebbi d annuz. Ur mgarraden wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, armi deffir n tisin n tussna $uôsen, wa iqheô wa. Wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ddin ar Öebbi d annuz. Ur mgarraden wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, armi deffir n tisin n tussna $uôsen, wa iqheô wa. Wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

ayahs.text: Ma nuqmen k, ini: "unze$ aS i Öebbi. Akken, wid iddan yidi. Ini i wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, akked at war tussna: "ma tunzem"? Ma unzen, ihi, pwanhan. Ma wexxôen, ay fellak siwa anabi. Öebbi Ipwali imdanen.
ayahs.translation: Ma nuqmen k, ini: "unze$ aS i Öebbi. Akken, wid iddan yidi. Ini i wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, akked at war tussna: "ma tunzem"? Ma unzen, ihi, pwanhan. Ma wexxôen, ay fellak siwa anabi. Öebbi Ipwali imdanen.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, u pna$en lambiyya, war ssebba, u pna$en wid seg yimdanen ippamôen lmizan, becceô iten s uâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, u pna$en lambiyya, war ssebba, u pna$en wid seg yimdanen ippamôen lmizan, becceô iten s uâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Widak, d wid iwumi mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxert. Ur sâin isellaken.
ayahs.translation: Widak, d wid iwumi mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxert. Ur sâin isellaken.

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara wid iwumi ippunefk kra si Tezmamt, la ssuturen, i Tezmamt n Öebbi, aêuddu garasen? Sinna, ad iwexxeô urbaâ segsen, u nitni pnamaren.
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara wid iwumi ippunefk kra si Tezmamt, la ssuturen, i Tezmamt n Öebbi, aêuddu garasen? Sinna, ad iwexxeô urbaâ segsen, u nitni pnamaren.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, acku nnan: "ur a$ teppep tmes, siwa kra n wussan". I$uôô iten, di ddin nnsen, wayen id snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, acku nnan: "ur a$ teppep tmes, siwa kra n wussan". I$uôô iten, di ddin nnsen, wayen id snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Amek ihi, ma Njemmel iten, ass ideg, ur degs ccekk, yal yiwen ad i$ellet ayen ikseb, nitni ur ppudensen.
ayahs.translation: Amek ihi, ma Njemmel iten, ass ideg, ur degs ccekk, yal yiwen ad i$ellet ayen ikseb, nitni ur ppudensen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a Öebbi, Agellid n tgelda, Teppakev tagelda i win i K ihwan, Teppeksev tagelda i win i K ihwan, Tepâuzzuv win i K ihwan, Tesdulluv win i K ihwan. Lxiô deg ufus i K. Ih, Keçç, Tzemrev i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a Öebbi, Agellid n tgelda, Teppakev tagelda i win i K ihwan, Teppeksev tagelda i win i K ihwan, Tepâuzzuv win i K ihwan, Tesdulluv win i K ihwan. Lxiô deg ufus i K. Ih, Keçç, Tzemrev i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Tessekcamev iv deg wass. Tessekcamev ass deg iv. Tessuffu$ev amuddir si lmegget. Tessuffu$ev lmegget seg umuddir. Tep$itiv win i K ihwan, war aktili".
ayahs.translation: Tessekcamev iv deg wass. Tessekcamev ass deg iv. Tessuffu$ev amuddir si lmegget. Tessuffu$ev lmegget seg umuddir. Tep$itiv win i K ihwan, war aktili".

ayahs.text: Lmumnin ur pparan ijehliyen d iêbiben nnsen, war lmumnin. Win ixedmen aya, ur illi, s wacemma, ar Öebbi. Kkes ed aêezzeb i têezzbem iman nnwen segsen. Iâaggen awen Öebbi s yiman iS. Tu$alin ar Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Lmumnin ur pparan ijehliyen d iêbiben nnsen, war lmumnin. Win ixedmen aya, ur illi, s wacemma, ar Öebbi. Kkes ed aêezzeb i têezzbem iman nnwen segsen. Iâaggen awen Öebbi s yiman iS. Tu$alin ar Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ama teffrem i illan deg idmaren nnwen, ne$ tessnaâtem t, Öebbi Iéôa t". Iéôa i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ama teffrem i illan deg idmaren nnwen, ne$ tessnaâtem t, Öebbi Iéôa t". Iéôa i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg yal iman ad iaf irs ed, wayen ixdem n lxiô, akked wayen ixdem n cceôô, ad issirem a ppili, garas yides, tallit $ezzifen! Iâaggen awen Öebbi, af yiman iS. Öebbi d Umâin ar imdanen.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg yal iman ad iaf irs ed, wayen ixdem n lxiô, akked wayen ixdem n cceôô, ad issirem a ppili, garas yides, tallit $ezzifen! Iâaggen awen Öebbi, af yiman iS. Öebbi d Umâin ar imdanen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ma têemmlem Öebbi, ddut yidi. A kwen Iâuzz Öebbi, ad awen Isemmeê ibekkaven nnwen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ma têemmlem Öebbi, ddut yidi. A kwen Iâuzz Öebbi, ad awen Isemmeê ibekkaven nnwen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ssemêesset i Öebbi akked Umazan". Ma wexxôen, ihi Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ssemêesset i Öebbi akked Umazan". Ma wexxôen, ihi Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi Ismenyaf, i imavalen, Adem, Nuê, tawacult n Ibôahim, tawacult n Âimôan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi Ismenyaf, i imavalen, Adem, Nuê, tawacult n Ibôahim, tawacult n Âimôan.

ayahs.text: Wa iurew wa. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Wa iurew wa. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Mi tenna tmeîîut n Âimôan: "a Mass iw! Wekkle$ aK ayen illan di tâabbuî iw, d lewkala, Eqbel s$uôi. Keçç, ih, d win Isellen, d Amusnaw".
ayahs.translation: Mi tenna tmeîîut n Âimôan: "a Mass iw! Wekkle$ aK ayen illan di tâabbuî iw, d lewkala, Eqbel s$uôi. Keçç, ih, d win Isellen, d Amusnaw".

ayahs.text: Mi p id turew, tenna: "a Mass iw! Urwe$ p id d nnta". - Öebbi Iéôa, sennig akw, d acu d turew. Ddkeô, maççi am nnta. - "Nek semma$ as Meryem, rri$ p seddaw tecvaî iK, neppat akked tarwa s, mgal Cciîan imenfi".
ayahs.translation: Mi p id turew, tenna: "a Mass iw! Urwe$ p id d nnta". - Öebbi Iéôa, sennig akw, d acu d turew. Ddkeô, maççi am nnta. - "Nek semma$ as Meryem, rri$ p seddaw tecvaî iK, neppat akked tarwa s, mgal Cciîan imenfi".

ayahs.text: Iôêeb yis Mass is, asteôêeb ilhan; Isgem ip, tigmi ilhan; Ikwellef ip i Zakariyya. Yal tikelt ara iôuê $uôes Zakariyya ar lmiêreb, a n iaf tesâa ôôeéq. Inna: "a Meryem! Ansi i m d ikka waya"? Tenna: "s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Iôeééeq win i S ihwan, war aktili".
ayahs.translation: Iôêeb yis Mass is, asteôêeb ilhan; Isgem ip, tigmi ilhan; Ikwellef ip i Zakariyya. Yal tikelt ara iôuê $uôes Zakariyya ar lmiêreb, a n iaf tesâa ôôeéq. Inna: "a Meryem! Ansi i m d ikka waya"? Tenna: "s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Iôeééeq win i S ihwan, war aktili".

ayahs.text: D$a Zakariyya inuj $uô Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d, s$uôeK, tarwa ifazen. Keçç, s tidep, Tsellev i unuju".
ayahs.translation: D$a Zakariyya inuj $uô Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d, s$uôeK, tarwa ifazen. Keçç, s tidep, Tsellev i unuju".

ayahs.text: Mi ibedd, ipéalla di lmeêreb, ssawlent as d lmalayek: "Ibecceô ik Öebbi s Yaêia, d atebbet n wawal n Öebbi, d ssid, d azedgan, d nnbi, seg iâaôviyen".
ayahs.translation: Mi ibedd, ipéalla di lmeêreb, ssawlent as d lmalayek: "Ibecceô ik Öebbi s Yaêia, d atebbet n wawal n Öebbi, d ssid, d azedgan, d nnbi, seg iâaôviyen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic? Ni$ wessre$, tameîîut iw d tiâiqeôt". Inna: "akka, Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic? Ni$ wessre$, tameîîut iw d tiâiqeôt". Inna: "akka, Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d assekni". Inna: "assekni ik, ur tepmeslayev i medden krav wussan. As$al kan. Mmekti d aîas Mass ik, sbuccaâ iT tameddit, tafrara".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d assekni". Inna: "assekni ik, ur tepmeslayev i medden krav wussan. As$al kan. Mmekti d aîas Mass ik, sbuccaâ iT tameddit, tafrara".

ayahs.text: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren ikem, Izzazdeg ikem, Ismenyaf ikem i tlawin imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Öebbi, s tidep, Ifren ikem, Izzazdeg ikem, Ismenyaf ikem i tlawin imavalen.

ayahs.text: A Meryem! Anez i Mass im, knu yaS, îîinez akked wid iîîinizen".
ayahs.translation: A Meryem! Anez i Mass im, knu yaS, îîinez akked wid iîîinizen".

ayahs.text: Ayagi si tmucuha i iffren, Nweêêa yak t. Ur telliv yidsen, mi jebden taseqqaôt, anwa segsen ara itkelfen $ef Meryem. Ur telliv yidsen mi mqellaâen.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi si tmucuha i iffren, Nweêêa yak t. Ur telliv yidsen, mi jebden taseqqaôt, anwa segsen ara itkelfen $ef Meryem. Ur telliv yidsen mi mqellaâen.

ayahs.text: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Öebbi, s tidep, Ibecceô ikem s wawal s$uôeS, ism is: lmasiê Âisa, mmi s n Meryem; mucaâ di ddunit akked laxert; seg iqôiben.
ayahs.translation: Mi s nnant lmalayek: "a Meryem! Öebbi, s tidep, Ibecceô ikem s wawal s$uôeS, ism is: lmasiê Âisa, mmi s n Meryem; mucaâ di ddunit akked laxert; seg iqôiben.

ayahs.text: A d ipmeslay i medden, si dduê, am unqaqôi, ad yili seg iâaôviyen".
ayahs.translation: A d ipmeslay i medden, si dduê, am unqaqôi, ad yili seg iâaôviyen".

ayahs.text: Tenna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic, ur iyi innul urgaz"? Inna: "akka. Öebbi Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ma Iseyya lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili".
ayahs.translation: Tenna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic, ur iyi innul urgaz"? Inna: "akka. Öebbi Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ma Iseyya lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili".

ayahs.text: Ad as Isselmed Tazmamt, ûûwab, Tuôa, Linoil.
ayahs.translation: Ad as Isselmed Tazmamt, ûûwab, Tuôa, Linoil.

ayahs.text: D amazan ar At Isôail: "ni$ nek usi$ d, $uôwen, s issekniyen s$uô Mass nnwen. Nek ad awen d xelqe$, s talaxt, ayen icban afôux, ad ûuve$ degs, ad iu$al d afôux, ma Ib$a Öebbi. Ad sseêlu$ ader$al, amuvin n lbeôû, a d ssidre$ lmeggtin, ma Ib$a Öebbi. Ad awen ini$ d acu teppeppem, akked wayen txezznem deg ixxamen nnwen. Deg waya, s tidep, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
ayahs.translation: D amazan ar At Isôail: "ni$ nek usi$ d, $uôwen, s issekniyen s$uô Mass nnwen. Nek ad awen d xelqe$, s talaxt, ayen icban afôux, ad ûuve$ degs, ad iu$al d afôux, ma Ib$a Öebbi. Ad sseêlu$ ader$al, amuvin n lbeôû, a d ssidre$ lmeggtin, ma Ib$a Öebbi. Ad awen ini$ d acu teppeppem, akked wayen txezznem deg ixxamen nnwen. Deg waya, s tidep, d assekni i kunwi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

ayahs.text: A d tebbte$ iyi d izwaren di Tuôa, ad awen êelle$ kra n wayen illan ipwagdel awen. Usi$ d, $uôwen, s ussekni, s$uô Mass nnwen. Ëezbet i Öebbi, a$et iyi awal.
ayahs.translation: A d tebbte$ iyi d izwaren di Tuôa, ad awen êelle$ kra n wayen illan ipwagdel awen. Usi$ d, $uôwen, s ussekni, s$uô Mass nnwen. Ëezbet i Öebbi, a$et iyi awal.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, s tidep, d Mass iw, u d Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eP, d wagi ay d abrid uwqim".
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, d Mass iw, u d Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eP, d wagi ay d abrid uwqim".

ayahs.text: Mi israê Âisa tijehli s$uôsen, inna: "anwi ay d imâiwnen iw ar Öebbi"? Nnan as d lexwan: "nekwni d imâiwnen n Öebbi. Numen s Öebbi, eched ar nekwni d imvuâen.
ayahs.translation: Mi israê Âisa tijehli s$uôsen, inna: "anwi ay d imâiwnen iw ar Öebbi"? Nnan as d lexwan: "nekwni d imâiwnen n Öebbi. Numen s Öebbi, eched ar nekwni d imvuâen.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Numen s wayen id Tessersev, nedda d umazan, Aru ya$ seg inagan".
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Numen s wayen id Tessersev, nedda d umazan, Aru ya$ seg inagan".

ayahs.text: Undin. Iundi Öebbi. Öebbi Yif akw imendayen.
ayahs.translation: Undin. Iundi Öebbi. Öebbi Yif akw imendayen.

ayahs.text: Mi s Inna Öebbi: "a Âisa! Nek ad Ddme$ ôôuê ik, a k id Ssali$ $uôI, a k id Ssiferre$ seg wid ijehlen, ad Rre$, wid iddan yidek, sennig wid ijehlen, ar ass n tnekra". Sinna, tu$alin nnwen $uôI, ad Ëudde$, garawen, $ef wayen i$ef teppemgarradem.
ayahs.translation: Mi s Inna Öebbi: "a Âisa! Nek ad Ddme$ ôôuê ik, a k id Ssali$ $uôI, a k id Ssiferre$ seg wid ijehlen, ad Rre$, wid iddan yidek, sennig wid ijehlen, ar ass n tnekra". Sinna, tu$alin nnwen $uôI, ad Ëudde$, garawen, $ef wayen i$ef teppemgarradem.

ayahs.text: Ma d wid ijehlen, a ten Âaqbe$ di ddunit, di laxert, aâaqeb aqeûêan. Ur asen ppilin isellaken.
ayahs.translation: Ma d wid ijehlen, a ten Âaqbe$ di ddunit, di laxert, aâaqeb aqeûêan. Ur asen ppilin isellaken.

ayahs.text: Wanag wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Ifk arrazen nnsen. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara imednas.
ayahs.translation: Wanag wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Ifk arrazen nnsen. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara imednas.

ayahs.text: Ayagi i ak Nemmal seg issekniyen, akked usmekti uûwib.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi i ak Nemmal seg issekniyen, akked usmekti uûwib.

ayahs.text: Ih, amedya n Âisa, ar Öebbi, am umedya n Adem. Ixelq it seg wakal, sinna, Inna yas: "ili"! Illa.
ayahs.translation: Ih, amedya n Âisa, ar Öebbi, am umedya n Adem. Ixelq it seg wakal, sinna, Inna yas: "ili"! Illa.

ayahs.text: Tidep, s$uô Mass ik. Ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.
ayahs.translation: Tidep, s$uô Mass ik. Ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.

ayahs.text: I win i k inumren fellas, deffir wayen i k id iusan n tussna, ini: "yyaw a nenced tarwa nne$, tarwa nnwen, tilawin nne$, tilawin nnwen, iman nne$, iman nnwen. Sinna, a nemmesgill, a nd²âu ad Ixzu Öebbi ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: I win i k inumren fellas, deffir wayen i k id iusan n tussna, ini: "yyaw a nenced tarwa nne$, tarwa nnwen, tilawin nne$, tilawin nnwen, iman nne$, iman nnwen. Sinna, a nemmesgill, a nd²âu ad Ixzu Öebbi ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: Ih, tagi d tamacahup n tidep, ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi, Neppa, war ccekk, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ih, tagi d tamacahup n tidep, ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi, Neppa, war ccekk, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ma wexxren, ihi Öebbi Issen ifessaden.
ayahs.translation: Ma wexxren, ihi Öebbi Issen ifessaden.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Yyaw ar wawal azduklan garane$ yidwen. A naâbed siwa Öebbi, ur aS nepcarak acemma; ur pparan, kra segne$ kra, d iôebbiten, war Öebbi". Ma wexxôen, init: "cehhdet ar nekwni d imvuâen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Yyaw ar wawal azduklan garane$ yidwen. A naâbed siwa Öebbi, ur aS nepcarak acemma; ur pparan, kra segne$ kra, d iôebbiten, war Öebbi". Ma wexxôen, init: "cehhdet ar nekwni d imvuâen".

ayahs.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi temnamarem $ef Ibôahim? Ur n risent Tuôa akked Linoil, armi deffir es, day ur tmeyyzem ara?
ayahs.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi temnamarem $ef Ibôahim? Ur n risent Tuôa akked Linoil, armi deffir es, day ur tmeyyzem ara?

ayahs.text: Kunwi, atan temnamarem $ef wayen tessnem. Ihi, acimi temnamarem $ef wayen ur tessinem? Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Kunwi, atan temnamarem $ef wayen tessnem. Ihi, acimi temnamarem $ef wayen ur tessinem? Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: Ur illi Ibôahim d uday ne$ d amasiêi, maca illa d amvuâ imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi Ibôahim d uday ne$ d amasiêi, maca illa d amvuâ imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak.

ayahs.text: Ih, imdanen iqeôben nezzeh ar Ibôahim, war ccekk, d wid i t ivefôen, akked Nnbi agi, akked wid iumnen. Öebbi d Bab n lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ih, imdanen iqeôben nezzeh ar Ibôahim, war ccekk, d wid i t ivefôen, akked Nnbi agi, akked wid iumnen. Öebbi d Bab n lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Arbaâ, seg At Tezmamt, ib$a a kwen itlef. Ara telfen siwa iman nnsen, ur éôin.
ayahs.translation: Arbaâ, seg At Tezmamt, ib$a a kwen itlef. Ara telfen siwa iman nnsen, ur éôin.

ayahs.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tugim issekniyen n Öebbi, u kunwi tepwalim?
ayahs.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tugim issekniyen n Öebbi, u kunwi tepwalim?

ayahs.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teslusum, i tidep, ayen idensen, u teppeffrem tidep, kunwi teêûam?
ayahs.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teslusum, i tidep, ayen idensen, u teppeffrem tidep, kunwi teêûam?

ayahs.text: Arbaâ, seg At Tezmamt, inna: "amnet mi iuli wass, s wayen id irsen ar wid iumnen, nekôet tameddit". Amendeô ma a d u$alen.
ayahs.translation: Arbaâ, seg At Tezmamt, inna: "amnet mi iuli wass, s wayen id irsen ar wid iumnen, nekôet tameddit". Amendeô ma a d u$alen.

ayahs.text: Ppamnet kan win ivefôen ddin nnwen. Ini: "ih, nnhaya d nnhaya n Öebbi. A ppeppunefk i yiwen am wayen i wen ippunefken". Ne$ a kwen namren af Mass nnwen. Ini: "lfevl, s tidep, deg ufus n Öebbi, Ippak it i win i S ihwan". Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ppamnet kan win ivefôen ddin nnwen. Ini: "ih, nnhaya d nnhaya n Öebbi. A ppeppunefk i yiwen am wayen i wen ippunefken". Ne$ a kwen namren af Mass nnwen. Ini: "lfevl, s tidep, deg ufus n Öebbi, Ippak it i win i S ihwan". Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Iâateq aêunu S i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Iâateq aêunu S i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Seg wAt Tezmamt, illa win, xas teooiv as adrim aîas, ad ak t id irr. Illa wayev segsen, ma teooiv as adinar, ur ak t id ippara, alamma tezgiv $uôes. Akka, acku nitni nnan: "ur a$ d ppawven at war tussna". U ggaren d tikerkas $ef Öebbi, u nitni éôan.
ayahs.translation: Seg wAt Tezmamt, illa win, xas teooiv as adrim aîas, ad ak t id irr. Illa wayev segsen, ma teooiv as adinar, ur ak t id ippara, alamma tezgiv $uôes. Akka, acku nitni nnan: "ur a$ d ppawven at war tussna". U ggaren d tikerkas $ef Öebbi, u nitni éôan.

ayahs.text: Xaîi! Win iîîfen di lemâahda s, u iêezzeb…ihi, Öebbi Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! Win iîîfen di lemâahda s, u iêezzeb…ihi, Öebbi Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ippa$en s lemâahda n Öebbi akked tgallit nnsen, ayen ôxisen, widak, ur ppawin amur di laxert, ur asen Ipmeslay Öebbi, ur ten id Ipmuqul, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ippa$en s lemâahda n Öebbi akked tgallit nnsen, ayen ôxisen, widak, ur ppawin amur di laxert, ur asen Ipmeslay Öebbi, ur ten id Ipmuqul, ass n tnekra, ur ten Izzizdig. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ih, arbaâ segsen ssexsaôen Tazmamt s yilsawen nnsen, iwakken a p$ilem n Tezmamt, ayen ur nelli n Tezmamt. Qqaôen: "aya s$uô Öebbi", u neppa ur illi s$uô Öebbi. U qqaren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, u nitni éôan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, arbaâ segsen ssexsaôen Tazmamt s yilsawen nnsen, iwakken a p$ilem n Tezmamt, ayen ur nelli n Tezmamt. Qqaôen: "aya s$uô Öebbi", u neppa ur illi s$uô Öebbi. U qqaren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, u nitni éôan.

ayahs.text: Ur ippunefk ara i umdan iwumi Ifka Öebbi Tazmamt, ûûwab, u Irra t d nnbi, ad iu$al ad yini i medden: "ilit d imdanen iw, war Öebbi". Maca: "ilit d iselmaden, imi tesselmadem Tazmamt, u tlemdem".
ayahs.translation: Ur ippunefk ara i umdan iwumi Ifka Öebbi Tazmamt, ûûwab, u Irra t d nnbi, ad iu$al ad yini i medden: "ilit d imdanen iw, war Öebbi". Maca: "ilit d iselmaden, imi tesselmadem Tazmamt, u tlemdem".

ayahs.text: Ur awen Iumeô ara a pperrem lmalayek akked lambiyya, d imawlan. Day awen Iameô tijehli, mbaâd ma tellam d imvuâen?
ayahs.translation: Ur awen Iumeô ara a pperrem lmalayek akked lambiyya, d imawlan. Day awen Iameô tijehli, mbaâd ma tellam d imvuâen?

ayahs.text: Mi Iîîef Öebbi laâqed n lambiyya: "s tidep, Fki$ awen si Tezmamt akw si ûûwab, sinna, iusa kwen id umazan, i itebbten ayen illan $uôwen. Amnet yis, âiwnet ep". Inna: "tâazmem u tqeblem, f waya, laâqed iW"? Nnan as: "naâzem". Inna: "ihi, cehhdet, Nek, yidwen, seg inagan".
ayahs.translation: Mi Iîîef Öebbi laâqed n lambiyya: "s tidep, Fki$ awen si Tezmamt akw si ûûwab, sinna, iusa kwen id umazan, i itebbten ayen illan $uôwen. Amnet yis, âiwnet ep". Inna: "tâazmem u tqeblem, f waya, laâqed iW"? Nnan as: "naâzem". Inna: "ihi, cehhdet, Nek, yidwen, seg inagan".

ayahs.text: Wid iwexxôen, deffir waya, nitni d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Wid iwexxôen, deffir waya, nitni d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Day b$an ddin ur nelli n Öebbi? U Neppa, unzen aS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan, b$an ne$ ugin. £uôeS, tu$alin nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Day b$an ddin ur nelli n Öebbi? U Neppa, unzen aS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan, b$an ne$ ugin. £uôeS, tu$alin nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "numen s Öebbi, akked wayen id irsen $uône$, akked wayen id irsen ar Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, ayen ippunefken i Musa, Âisa, akked lambiyya, s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur nesmenyaf yiwen degsen. Nekwni nunez aS".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "numen s Öebbi, akked wayen id irsen $uône$, akked wayen id irsen ar Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, ayen ippunefken i Musa, Âisa, akked lambiyya, s$uô Mass nnsen. Ur nesmenyaf yiwen degsen. Nekwni nunez aS".

ayahs.text: Win ib$an ddin, war annuz, ur ipwaqbal s$uôes. U neppa, di laxert, seg imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Win ib$an ddin, war annuz, ur ipwaqbal s$uôes. U neppa, di laxert, seg imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Amek ara Inhu Öebbi agdud inekôen deffir liman is, u cehhden ar Amazan d tidep, u iusa ten id ubeggen? Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
ayahs.translation: Amek ara Inhu Öebbi agdud inekôen deffir liman is, u cehhden ar Amazan d tidep, u iusa ten id ubeggen? Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

ayahs.text: Widak, aqeîîi nnsen d ddell s$uô Öebbi, d lmalayek, akked imdanen meôôa.
ayahs.translation: Widak, aqeîîi nnsen d ddell s$uô Öebbi, d lmalayek, akked imdanen meôôa.

ayahs.text: Degs ad wekkôen; ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur stiseren.
ayahs.translation: Degs ad wekkôen; ur ippifsus fellasen uâaqeb, ur stiseren.

ayahs.text: Kkes ed wid iu$alen nedmen, deffir waya, u xedmen ayen ilhan. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed wid iu$alen nedmen, deffir waya, u xedmen ayen ilhan. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, deffir liman nnsen, sinna, rnan di tijehli, ur tepwaqbal nndama nnsen. Widak d im$eôôqen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, deffir liman nnsen, sinna, rnan di tijehli, ur tepwaqbal nndama nnsen. Widak d im$eôôqen.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, u mmuten d ijehliyen, ur ipwaqbal s$uô yiwen degsen, azal n tmurt n ddheb, a t id ifdu. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan, ur sâin amâiwen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, u mmuten d ijehliyen, ur ipwaqbal s$uô yiwen degsen, azal n tmurt n ddheb, a t id ifdu. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan, ur sâin amâiwen.

ayahs.text: Ur teppawvem ar ppuba, d awez$i, alamma tseddqem seg wayen têemmlem. Kra n wayen tseddqem n cci, ihi, Öebbi Iéôa t.
ayahs.translation: Ur teppawvem ar ppuba, d awez$i, alamma tseddqem seg wayen têemmlem. Kra n wayen tseddqem n cci, ihi, Öebbi Iéôa t.

ayahs.text: Yal lqut illa iêell i At Isôail, siwa ayen igdel Isôail i iman is, uqbel a d ters Tuôa. Ini: "awit ed Tuôa, $eôt ep, ma tessawalem tidep".
ayahs.translation: Yal lqut illa iêell i At Isôail, siwa ayen igdel Isôail i iman is, uqbel a d ters Tuôa. Ini: "awit ed Tuôa, $eôt ep, ma tessawalem tidep".

ayahs.text: Wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, deffir waya, nitni d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, deffir waya, nitni d imednas.

ayahs.text: Ini: "Inna d Öebbi tidep; ddut d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep, ur nelli seg imcurak".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "Inna d Öebbi tidep; ddut d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep, ur nelli seg imcurak".

ayahs.text: Ih, axxam amezwaru, i irsen i medden, war ccekk, d win n Bekka. Iôqa, d nnhaya i imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, axxam amezwaru, i irsen i medden, war ccekk, d win n Bekka. Iôqa, d nnhaya i imavalen.

ayahs.text: Degs issekniyen iberrzen; d axxam n Ibôahim. Win it ikecmen, atan di laman. I Öebbi, iwata ad êuoen medden s Axxam, ma zemren a t awven. Win iugin, ihi, Rebbi ur Iêwao ara imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Degs issekniyen iberrzen; d axxam n Ibôahim. Win it ikecmen, atan di laman. I Öebbi, iwata ad êuoen medden s Axxam, ma zemren a t awven. Win iugin, ihi, Rebbi ur Iêwao ara imavalen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tnekôem issekniyen n Öebbi"? Öebbi d Anagi n wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi tnekôem issekniyen n Öebbi"? Öebbi d Anagi n wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teîîeôôifem, wid iumnen, seg ubrid n Öebbi? Tessaramem t iaâwej, u kunwi d inagan". Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acimi teîîeôôifem, wid iumnen, seg ubrid n Öebbi? Tessaramem t iaâwej, u kunwi d inagan". Ur I$fil Öebbi $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em awal i urbaâ, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, a kwen rren d ijehliyen, deffir liman nnwen.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em awal i urbaâ, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, a kwen rren d ijehliyen, deffir liman nnwen.

ayahs.text: Amek tnekôem, u kunwi $ôan awen d issekniyen n Öebbi, u, garawen, Amazan iS? Win iîîfen di Öebbi, ni$ ipwanha s abrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Amek tnekôem, u kunwi $ôan awen d issekniyen n Öebbi, u, garawen, Amazan iS? Win iîîfen di Öebbi, ni$ ipwanha s abrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, akken Iklal aêezzeb. Ur ppemmtet alamma tunzem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, akken Iklal aêezzeb. Ur ppemmtet alamma tunzem.

ayahs.text: Eîfet akw di teêmilt n Öebbi, ur ppemfaôaqet. Mmektit ed ayen ikwen I$at Öebbi. Mi tellam d icenga, Issemlal ulawen nnwen. S l$it iS, tu$alem d atmaten. Tellam $ef rrif n maylellif n tmes, Isellek ikwen segs. Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS, amendeô ma a ppepwanhum.
ayahs.translation: Eîfet akw di teêmilt n Öebbi, ur ppemfaôaqet. Mmektit ed ayen ikwen I$at Öebbi. Mi tellam d icenga, Issemlal ulawen nnwen. S l$it iS, tu$alem d atmaten. Tellam $ef rrif n maylellif n tmes, Isellek ikwen segs. Akka i wen Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen iS, amendeô ma a ppepwanhum.

ayahs.text: Amar ad yili, segwen, lois i ineccden ar lxiô, ippamôen lqanun, itekksen ayen n dir. Widak d imerbaê.
ayahs.translation: Amar ad yili, segwen, lois i ineccden ar lxiô, ippamôen lqanun, itekksen ayen n dir. Widak d imerbaê.

ayahs.text: Ur ppilit am wid imfaôaqen, u mgarraden, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôsen. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan,
ayahs.translation: Ur ppilit am wid imfaôaqen, u mgarraden, deffir n tisin ubeggen $uôsen. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan,

ayahs.text: ass ideg ara imlulen wudmawen, ara ibriken wudmawen. Wanag wid iwumi ara ibriken wudmawen nnsen: "tnekôem, deffir liman nnwen? Jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tnekôem".
ayahs.translation: ass ideg ara imlulen wudmawen, ara ibriken wudmawen. Wanag wid iwumi ara ibriken wudmawen nnsen: "tnekôem, deffir liman nnwen? Jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tnekôem".

ayahs.text: Wanag wid iwumi ara a imlulen wudmawen nnsen, ad ilin deg uêunu n Öebbi. Nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Wanag wid iwumi ara a imlulen wudmawen nnsen, ad ilin deg uêunu n Öebbi. Nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Öebbi. Neqqaô ak ten id, s tidep. Ur Ib$i Öebbi ddens i imavalen.
ayahs.translation: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Öebbi. Neqqaô ak ten id, s tidep. Ur Ib$i Öebbi ddens i imavalen.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ar Öebbi tu$alin n lumuô.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ar Öebbi tu$alin n lumuô.

ayahs.text: Tifem akw leoyus id iff$en i medden. Teppamôem lqanun, teppekksem ayen n dir, tumnem s Öebbi. Ppif, i At Tezmamt, lemmer uminen. Garasen lmumnin; tegwti degsen d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Tifem akw leoyus id iff$en i medden. Teppamôem lqanun, teppekksem ayen n dir, tumnem s Öebbi. Ppif, i At Tezmamt, lemmer uminen. Garasen lmumnin; tegwti degsen d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Cwiî kan ara kwen vuôôen. Ma nnu$en kwen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur sâun amâiwen.
ayahs.translation: Cwiî kan ara kwen vuôôen. Ma nnu$en kwen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur sâun amâiwen.

ayahs.text: Iwwet iten ddell anda ma llan, siwa wid iîîfen di teêmilt n Öebbi, u di teêmilt n medden. Lqan urrif n Öebbi, u te$li d tiggulelt fellasen. Ayagi, acku llan nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, la neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi âuûan u zgaren tilas.
ayahs.translation: Iwwet iten ddell anda ma llan, siwa wid iîîfen di teêmilt n Öebbi, u di teêmilt n medden. Lqan urrif n Öebbi, u te$li d tiggulelt fellasen. Ayagi, acku llan nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, la neqqen lambiyya, war ssebba. Ayagi, imi âuûan u zgaren tilas.

ayahs.text: Ur aâdilen. Illa lois, seg At Tezmamt, i iqqaôen issekniyen n Öebbi deg iv, u nitni kennun.
ayahs.translation: Ur aâdilen. Illa lois, seg At Tezmamt, i iqqaôen issekniyen n Öebbi deg iv, u nitni kennun.

ayahs.text: Umnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, ppamôen lqanun, tekksen ayen n dir, pêirin ar lxiô. Widak seg iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Umnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, ppamôen lqanun, tekksen ayen n dir, pêirin ar lxiô. Widak seg iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Ayen xedmen n lxiô, ur asen ipwankaô. Öebbi Issen wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Ayen xedmen n lxiô, ur asen ipwankaô. Öebbi Issen wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur asen d ippawi acemma, ar Öebbi, wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, ur asen d ippawi acemma, ar Öebbi, wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Amedya n wayen pseôôifen di tmeddurt n ddunit agi, am umedya n wavu, degs abruri. Iêuza iger n ugdud idensen iman is. Isnegr it. Ur ten Idnis Öebbi; d iman nnsen ay dennisen.
ayahs.translation: Amedya n wayen pseôôifen di tmeddurt n ddunit agi, am umedya n wavu, degs abruri. Iêuza iger n ugdud idensen iman is. Isnegr it. Ur ten Idnis Öebbi; d iman nnsen ay dennisen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d iêbiben, wur nelli segwen. Ur zgalen a kwen hewwlen. B$an a kwen hejjnen. Ni$ ibda d lbwe$v seg imawen nnsen. Ayen iffren deg ulawen nnsen, i$elb it. Ni$ Nbeggen awen ed issekniyen, ma tepmeyyizem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d iêbiben, wur nelli segwen. Ur zgalen a kwen hewwlen. B$an a kwen hejjnen. Ni$ ibda d lbwe$v seg imawen nnsen. Ayen iffren deg ulawen nnsen, i$elb it. Ni$ Nbeggen awen ed issekniyen, ma tepmeyyizem.

ayahs.text: Atan kunwi d wid i ten iêemmlen, ur kwen êemmlen. Tumnem di Tezmamt, s lekmal is. Ma mmugren kwen, ad inin: "numen". Mi $aben, ad $eééen ivudan nnsen si zzâaf fellawen. Ini: "emmtet si zzâaf nnwen"! Ih, Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.
ayahs.translation: Atan kunwi d wid i ten iêemmlen, ur kwen êemmlen. Tumnem di Tezmamt, s lekmal is. Ma mmugren kwen, ad inin: "numen". Mi $aben, ad $eééen ivudan nnsen si zzâaf fellawen. Ini: "emmtet si zzâaf nnwen"! Ih, Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.

ayahs.text: Ma iusa kwen id ise$, a ten isnu$ben. Ma tevôa yidwen tucmip, ad feôêen yis. Ma tûebôem, u têezbem, ur kwen teîîuôôu s wacemma, tandit nnsen. Ni$ Izzi Öebbi i wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ma iusa kwen id ise$, a ten isnu$ben. Ma tevôa yidwen tucmip, ad feôêen yis. Ma tûebôem, u têezbem, ur kwen teîîuôôu s wacemma, tandit nnsen. Ni$ Izzi Öebbi i wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Mi teff$ev, ûûbeê zik, si twacult ik, temmalev i lmumnin imukan umennu$, Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Mi teff$ev, ûûbeê zik, si twacult ik, temmalev i lmumnin imukan umennu$, Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Mi qôib feclent snat n trebbuyaâ nnwen, u Öebbi d Bab nnsent. Iwata i yal lmumen, ad ippkel $ef Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Mi qôib feclent snat n trebbuyaâ nnwen, u Öebbi d Bab nnsent. Iwata i yal lmumen, ad ippkel $ef Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Iâiwen ikwen Öebbi di Badô, mi tellam tendellem. Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar a ppesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Iâiwen ikwen Öebbi di Badô, mi tellam tendellem. Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar a ppesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: Mi tenniv i lmumnin: "day ur testeqnaâm ara, mi kwen Iâiwen Öebbi s krav igima n lmalayek, id irsen"?
ayahs.translation: Mi tenniv i lmumnin: "day ur testeqnaâm ara, mi kwen Iâiwen Öebbi s krav igima n lmalayek, id irsen"?

ayahs.text: Xaîi, ma tûebôem u têezzbem, ma $ewwsen d fellawen, a kwen Iâiwen Mass nnwen, s smus igima n lmalayek ikkaten.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi, ma tûebôem u têezzbem, ma $ewwsen d fellawen, a kwen Iâiwen Mass nnwen, s smus igima n lmalayek ikkaten.

ayahs.text: Ur Iga akka Öebbi, siwa i ubecceô nnwen, ad rtiêen yis wulawen nnwen. Rrbeê s$uô Öebbi kan, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ur Iga akka Öebbi, siwa i ubecceô nnwen, ad rtiêen yis wulawen nnwen. Rrbeê s$uô Öebbi kan, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad Iôé arbaâ n wid ijehlen, ne$ a ten Iééaâ, ad u$alen nne$wnin.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad Iôé arbaâ n wid ijehlen, ne$ a ten Iééaâ, ad u$alen nne$wnin.

ayahs.text: Ur k iaâna lameô s wacemma. Ad asen Issuref, ne$ a ten Iâaqeb, nitni d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ur k iaâna lameô s wacemma. Ad asen Issuref, ne$ a ten Iâaqeb, nitni d imednas.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan. Ipâaqab win i S ihwan. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan. Ipâaqab win i S ihwan. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur teppet rrba ipzeggiden, tepzeggid. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur teppet rrba ipzeggiden, tepzeggid. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.

ayahs.text: Ëezzbet ilmend n tmes i ippuheggan i ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ëezzbet ilmend n tmes i ippuheggan i ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan, amar ad yili uêunu fellawen.
ayahs.translation: A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan, amar ad yili uêunu fellawen.

ayahs.text: £iwlet ar ssmaê s$uô Mass nnwen, akked Loennet iwsâan am tmurt akked igenwan. Teppuhegga d i wid ipêezziben,
ayahs.translation: £iwlet ar ssmaê s$uô Mass nnwen, akked Loennet iwsâan am tmurt akked igenwan. Teppuhegga d i wid ipêezziben,

ayahs.text: wid ipseddiqen - sâan ne$ xuûûen -, wid isnusun reffu, wid ipsemmiêen i medden - Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam -,
ayahs.translation: wid ipseddiqen - sâan ne$ xuûûen -, wid isnusun reffu, wid ipsemmiêen i medden - Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam -,

ayahs.text: wid, ma xedmen tucmip, ne$ densen iman nnsen, a d mmektin Öebbi, ad ste$fôen $ef ibekkaven nnsen. Anwa Ipsemmiêen ibekkaven siwa Öebbi? Ur pgerninen deg wayen xedmen, u nitni éôan.
ayahs.translation: wid, ma xedmen tucmip, ne$ densen iman nnsen, a d mmektin Öebbi, ad ste$fôen $ef ibekkaven nnsen. Anwa Ipsemmiêen ibekkaven siwa Öebbi? Ur pgerninen deg wayen xedmen, u nitni éôan.

ayahs.text: Widak, akafi nnsen d ssmaê n Mass nnsen, akked leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. D arraz igerzen i wid issewqamen.
ayahs.translation: Widak, akafi nnsen d ssmaê n Mass nnsen, akked leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. D arraz igerzen i wid issewqamen.

ayahs.text: Âaddant tedyanin uqbel nnwen. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d wid id iggaren tikerkas.
ayahs.translation: Âaddant tedyanin uqbel nnwen. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d wid id iggaren tikerkas.

ayahs.text: Wagi d abeggen i medden, d nnhaya akked unecced i wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Wagi d abeggen i medden, d nnhaya akked unecced i wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Ur ppifcilet, ur $webnet, d kunwi i iaâlayen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppifcilet, ur $webnet, d kunwi i iaâlayen, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

ayahs.text: Ma iêuza kwen lada, ni$ lada i t icban iêuza agdud. Ussan agi Nerra ten, ger medden, d tidwal, iwakken ad Yissin Öebbi wid iumnen, ad Iddem segwen inagan. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ma iêuza kwen lada, ni$ lada i t icban iêuza agdud. Ussan agi Nerra ten, ger medden, d tidwal, iwakken ad Yissin Öebbi wid iumnen, ad Iddem segwen inagan. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara imednas.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad Ijeôôeb Öebbi wid iumnen, u ad Isqucc ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad Ijeôôeb Öebbi wid iumnen, u ad Isqucc ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Day t$ilem a pkecmem Loennet, wanag ur Iéôi ara Öebbi wid ijuhden segwen, ur Issin ara iûebôiyen?
ayahs.translation: Day t$ilem a pkecmem Loennet, wanag ur Iéôi ara Öebbi wid ijuhden segwen, ur Issin ara iûebôiyen?

ayahs.text: Ni$ tepmennim tameppant, uqbel a p id temmagrem. Ni$ twalam p, kunwi tepmuqulem.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ tepmennim tameppant, uqbel a p id temmagrem. Ni$ twalam p, kunwi tepmuqulem.

ayahs.text: Muêemmed d Amazan kan. Ni$ âaddan imazanen, uqbel is. Ma immut ne$ ipwan$a, day a ppu$alem ar deffir? Win ara iu$alen ar deffir, ur iîîuôôu Öebbi s wacemma. Öebbi ad Ikafi wid isnemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Muêemmed d Amazan kan. Ni$ âaddan imazanen, uqbel is. Ma immut ne$ ipwan$a, day a ppu$alem ar deffir? Win ara iu$alen ar deffir, ur iîîuôôu Öebbi s wacemma. Öebbi ad Ikafi wid isnemmiren.

ayahs.text: Ur ipmeppat umdan siwa ma Irad Öebbi, di lajel iuran. Win ib$an akafi n ddunit, ad as t Nefk. Win ib$an akafi n laxeôt, ad as t Nefk. A Nkafi wid isnemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Ur ipmeppat umdan siwa ma Irad Öebbi, di lajel iuran. Win ib$an akafi n ddunit, ad as t Nefk. Win ib$an akafi n laxeôt, ad as t Nefk. A Nkafi wid isnemmiren.

ayahs.text: Acêal n lambiyya i innu$en, idda yidsen urbaâ iqwan, ur fcilen seg wayen iten issaâtben, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur xuzen, ur fkin mayna. Öebbi Iêemmel iûebôiyen.
ayahs.translation: Acêal n lambiyya i innu$en, idda yidsen urbaâ iqwan, ur fcilen seg wayen iten issaâtben, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur xuzen, ur fkin mayna. Öebbi Iêemmel iûebôiyen.

ayahs.text: Awal nnsen, siwa mi nnan: "a Mass nne$! Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, akked tugut nne$ di lameô nne$. Tebbet isurifen nne$, Sserbeê ane$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen".
ayahs.translation: Awal nnsen, siwa mi nnan: "a Mass nne$! Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, akked tugut nne$ di lameô nne$. Tebbet isurifen nne$, Sserbeê ane$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen".

ayahs.text: Ifka yasen Öebbi akafi n ddunit, akked ukafi lâali n laxert. Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam.
ayahs.translation: Ifka yasen Öebbi akafi n ddunit, akked ukafi lâali n laxert. Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em awal i wid ijehlen, a kwen rren ar deffir, a ppu$alem txesôem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em awal i wid ijehlen, a kwen rren ar deffir, a ppu$alem txesôem.

ayahs.text: Xaîi! Öebbi d Bab nnwen. Neppa, Yif akw imâiwnen.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! Öebbi d Bab nnwen. Neppa, Yif akw imâiwnen.

ayahs.text: A Nessekcem tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen, imi curken i Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d irs ara udabu. Axxam nnsen d times. A yir tanezdu$t i imednas!
ayahs.translation: A Nessekcem tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen, imi curken i Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d irs ara udabu. Axxam nnsen d times. A yir tanezdu$t i imednas!

ayahs.text: Ni$ Issawel awen Öebbi tidep, di lemâahda S, mi ten tesnegrem, s tsriê iS. Armi, mi tfeclem, temnamarem f lameô, taâûam mbaâd ma Issken awen d ayen têemmlem. Garawen wid ib$an ddunit, garawen wid ib$an laxert. Sinna, Issebâad ikwen fellasen, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb. Ni$ Isemmeê awen. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl i lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Issawel awen Öebbi tidep, di lemâahda S, mi ten tesnegrem, s tsriê iS. Armi, mi tfeclem, temnamarem f lameô, taâûam mbaâd ma Issken awen d ayen têemmlem. Garawen wid ib$an ddunit, garawen wid ib$an laxert. Sinna, Issebâad ikwen fellasen, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb. Ni$ Isemmeê awen. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl i lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Mi tulim ur d tezzim, u Nnbi inecced ikwen ar ineggura nnwen. Ineûûef awen a$ilif s wayev, iwakken ur t$webnem $ef wayen i wen iôuêen, akked wayen ikwen iu$en. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Mi tulim ur d tezzim, u Nnbi inecced ikwen ar ineggura nnwen. Ineûûef awen a$ilif s wayev, iwakken ur t$webnem $ef wayen i wen iôuêen, akked wayen ikwen iu$en. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Sinna, deffir u$ilif, Issers awen d laman, ives id i$lin $ef urbaâ segwen. Ni$ arbaâ pêebbiôen $ef yiman nnsen, nnwan, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur nelli d tidep, nnwaya n at war tussna. Qqaôen: "day illa wayen i $ iaânan, di lameô"? Ini: "s tidep, lameô akw i Öebbi". Teffren, deg iman nnsen, ayen ur ak mmalen. Qqaôen: "lemmer illi wayen i $ iaânan, di lameô, ur nepwan$a dagi". Ini: "xas ma tellam deg ixxamen nnwen, wid i$ef tura tmen$iwt, a ten tawev s imîeôêen nnsen. Iwakken ad Ijeôôeb Öebbi i illan deg idmaren nnwen, ad Izzizdeg i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, deffir u$ilif, Issers awen d laman, ives id i$lin $ef urbaâ segwen. Ni$ arbaâ pêebbiôen $ef yiman nnsen, nnwan, $ef Öebbi, ayen ur nelli d tidep, nnwaya n at war tussna. Qqaôen: "day illa wayen i $ iaânan, di lameô"? Ini: "s tidep, lameô akw i Öebbi". Teffren, deg iman nnsen, ayen ur ak mmalen. Qqaôen: "lemmer illi wayen i $ iaânan, di lameô, ur nepwan$a dagi". Ini: "xas ma tellam deg ixxamen nnwen, wid i$ef tura tmen$iwt, a ten tawev s imîeôêen nnsen. Iwakken ad Ijeôôeb Öebbi i illan deg idmaren nnwen, ad Izzizdeg i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid segwen iwexxôen asmi mlalent trebbuyaâ, d Cciîan kan iten iccacven, ilmend n kra n wayen kesben. Ni$ Isemmeê asen Öebbi. Akka, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid segwen iwexxôen asmi mlalent trebbuyaâ, d Cciîan kan iten iccacven, ilmend n kra n wayen kesben. Ni$ Isemmeê asen Öebbi. Akka, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ppilit am wid ijehlen. Nnan i watmaten nnsen iunagen di tmurt, ne$ ipna$en: "lemmer llin $uône$, ur mmuten, ur twan$an". Ad Irr Öebbi, ayagi, d aneggaf deg ulawen nnsen! Öebbi Issidir, Ineqq. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur ppilit am wid ijehlen. Nnan i watmaten nnsen iunagen di tmurt, ne$ ipna$en: "lemmer llin $uône$, ur mmuten, ur twan$an". Ad Irr Öebbi, ayagi, d aneggaf deg ulawen nnsen! Öebbi Issidir, Ineqq. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ma tepwan$am deg ubrid n Öebbi, ne$ temmutem, ssmaê n Öebbi akked uêunu, war ccekk, ifen ayen la jemâan.
ayahs.translation: Ma tepwan$am deg ubrid n Öebbi, ne$ temmutem, ssmaê n Öebbi akked uêunu, war ccekk, ifen ayen la jemâan.

ayahs.text: Ma temmutem ne$ tepwan$am, war ccekk, ar Öebbi ara tepwafesrem.
ayahs.translation: Ma temmutem ne$ tepwan$am, war ccekk, ar Öebbi ara tepwafesrem.

ayahs.text: S uêunu n Öebbi, têelmev $uôsen. Lemmer tqeûêev, tes$aôev ul ik, ad baâden fellak. Semmeê asen, ssuter ad ppusemmêen, ciweô iten $ef lameô. Mi tseyyiv, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Iêemmel wid ippkalen.
ayahs.translation: S uêunu n Öebbi, têelmev $uôsen. Lemmer tqeûêev, tes$aôev ul ik, ad baâden fellak. Semmeê asen, ssuter ad ppusemmêen, ciweô iten $ef lameô. Mi tseyyiv, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Iêemmel wid ippkalen.

ayahs.text: Ma Iâiwen ikwen Öebbi, ur kwen irennu yiwen. Ma Iooa kwen, anwa illan a kwen iâiwen, deffir eS? £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ma Iâiwen ikwen Öebbi, ur kwen irennu yiwen. Ma Iooa kwen, anwa illan a kwen iâiwen, deffir eS? £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ur issefk ara i nnbi ad idnes. Win idensen, a d ias s wayen idnes, ass n tnekra. Sinna, yal wa, ad as ippunefk wayen ikseb. Nitni, ur ten pmeôôiôen.
ayahs.translation: Ur issefk ara i nnbi ad idnes. Win idensen, a d ias s wayen idnes, ass n tnekra. Sinna, yal wa, ad as ippunefk wayen ikseb. Nitni, ur ten pmeôôiôen.

ayahs.text: Day win iddan d llza n Öebbi am win isebebben urrif n Öebbi, u tanezdu$t is d Loahennama? A taggara tucmip!
ayahs.translation: Day win iddan d llza n Öebbi am win isebebben urrif n Öebbi, u tanezdu$t is d Loahennama? A taggara tucmip!

ayahs.text: Ur aâdilen ar Öebbi. Öebbi Ipwali acu xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ur aâdilen ar Öebbi. Öebbi Ipwali acu xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Öebbi I$at lmumnin, mi sen d Iuzen Amazan segsen, immal asen issekniyen iS, izzizdig iten, isseêfav asen Tazmamt akked ûûwab, ulamma llan, zik, di ttelfan n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Öebbi I$at lmumnin, mi sen d Iuzen Amazan segsen, immal asen issekniyen iS, izzizdig iten, isseêfav asen Tazmamt akked ûûwab, ulamma llan, zik, di ttelfan n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ma tu$em tiyta, ni$ terram p berdayen. Tennam: "ansi waya"? Ini: "aya seg iman nnwen". Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ma tu$em tiyta, ni$ terram p berdayen. Tennam: "ansi waya"? Ini: "aya seg iman nnwen". Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ayen ikwen iwwten, ass n temlilit n trebbuyaâ, s tsriê n Öebbi. Iwakken ad Iéeô anwi ay d lmumnin,
ayahs.translation: Ayen ikwen iwwten, ass n temlilit n trebbuyaâ, s tsriê n Öebbi. Iwakken ad Iéeô anwi ay d lmumnin,

ayahs.text: u ad Iéeô anwi ay d ixabiten. Nnan asen: "yyaw, nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi, ne$ éedmet". Nnan: "lemmer nessin a nenna$, yili nedda n yidwen". Assen, nitni, ar tijehli, ne$ $eô liman, ay qeôben kteô. Qqaren, s yimawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa ayen teffren.
ayahs.translation: u ad Iéeô anwi ay d ixabiten. Nnan asen: "yyaw, nna$et deg ubrid n Öebbi, ne$ éedmet". Nnan: "lemmer nessin a nenna$, yili nedda n yidwen". Assen, nitni, ar tijehli, ne$ $eô liman, ay qeôben kteô. Qqaren, s yimawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa ayen teffren.

ayahs.text: Wid innan i watmaten nnsen, u nitni qqimen: "lemmer i $ ssemêessen, ur pwan$en". Ini: "sdarit iman nnwen si tmeppant, ma tessawalem tidep ".
ayahs.translation: Wid innan i watmaten nnsen, u nitni qqimen: "lemmer i $ ssemêessen, ur pwan$en". Ini: "sdarit iman nnwen si tmeppant, ma tessawalem tidep ".

ayahs.text: Ur p$ili mmuten wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi. Xaîi, d imuddiren. Ad ppuôeéqen ar Mass nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ur p$ili mmuten wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi. Xaîi, d imuddiren. Ad ppuôeéqen ar Mass nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ad feôêen s wayen i sen Ifka Öebbi, si lfevl iS. Zhan, imi wid deffir sen, mazal ur ten id nelêiq, ur ppagawaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Ad feôêen s wayen i sen Ifka Öebbi, si lfevl iS. Zhan, imi wid deffir sen, mazal ur ten id nelêiq, ur ppagawaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Zhan s l$it n Öebbi, akked lfevl. Öebbi ur Iveggiâ arraz n lmumnin;
ayahs.translation: Zhan s l$it n Öebbi, akked lfevl. Öebbi ur Iveggiâ arraz n lmumnin;

ayahs.text: wid id ijawben i Öebbi akked Umazan, mbaâd ma sâaddan lêif. Arraz ameqwôaêan i wid, segsen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, u êezzben;
ayahs.translation: wid id ijawben i Öebbi akked Umazan, mbaâd ma sâaddan lêif. Arraz ameqwôaêan i wid, segsen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, u êezzben;

ayahs.text: wid iwumi nnan medden: "ni$ mlalen fellawen imdanen, ihi, agwadet pen". D$a isnerna liman nnsen, nnan: "Iqadd a$ Öebbi, Awkil Amxallef".
ayahs.translation: wid iwumi nnan medden: "ni$ mlalen fellawen imdanen, ihi, agwadet pen". D$a isnerna liman nnsen, nnan: "Iqadd a$ Öebbi, Awkil Amxallef".

ayahs.text: U$alen d s l$it n Öebbi akked lfevl, ur ten innul cceôô; ddan d llza n Öebbi. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: U$alen d s l$it n Öebbi akked lfevl, ur ten innul cceôô; ddan d llza n Öebbi. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Akka kan ay d Cciîan. Issagwad s imeddukwal is. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
ayahs.translation: Akka kan ay d Cciîan. Issagwad s imeddukwal is. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

ayahs.text: Ur k $webbnen wid ip$awalen ar tijehli. Nitni, s tidep, ur vvuôôen Öebbi, s wacemma. Ib$a Öebbi ur asen Iteg amur di laxert. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ur k $webbnen wid ip$awalen ar tijehli. Nitni, s tidep, ur vvuôôen Öebbi, s wacemma. Ib$a Öebbi ur asen Iteg amur di laxert. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iu$en tijehli s liman, ur vvuôôen Öebbi s wacemma. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iu$en tijehli s liman, ur vvuôôen Öebbi s wacemma. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ur êeppben wid ijehlen, ar telha yasen, lmudda i sen Nefka. Nefka yasen kan lmudda, iwakken ad rnun ibekkaven. Fellasen aâaqeb isdullun.
ayahs.translation: Ur êeppben wid ijehlen, ar telha yasen, lmudda i sen Nefka. Nefka yasen kan lmudda, iwakken ad rnun ibekkaven. Fellasen aâaqeb isdullun.

ayahs.text: Ur illi di leb$i n Öebbi, ad Ioo lmumnin di liêala nnwen, alamma Ifrez axabit seg umâin. Ur illi di leb$i n Öebbi, ad awen Imel tabavnit. Maca, Iferren Öebbi wid i S ihwan, d imazanen iS. Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked imazanen iS. Ma tumnem, u têezzbem, a ppawim arraz ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi di leb$i n Öebbi, ad Ioo lmumnin di liêala nnwen, alamma Ifrez axabit seg umâin. Ur illi di leb$i n Öebbi, ad awen Imel tabavnit. Maca, Iferren Öebbi wid i S ihwan, d imazanen iS. Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked imazanen iS. Ma tumnem, u têezzbem, a ppawim arraz ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Ur êeppben wid ipcuêêun deg wayen i sen Ifka Öebbi, si lfevl iS, ard lxiô nnsen. Xaîi, d cceôô nnsen. Ayen cuêêen a ten iarez seg umgaôv, ass n tnekra. I Öebbi, lweôt n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ur êeppben wid ipcuêêun deg wayen i sen Ifka Öebbi, si lfevl iS, ard lxiô nnsen. Xaîi, d cceôô nnsen. Ayen cuêêen a ten iarez seg umgaôv, ass n tnekra. I Öebbi, lweôt n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Isla Öebbi i wawal n wid innan: "s tidep, Öebbi d igellil, nekwni d isâayen". A Naru ayen nnan, akked wayen n$an n lambiyya, war ssebba. Ad asen Nini: "jeôôbet aâaqeb ujajiê".
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Isla Öebbi i wawal n wid innan: "s tidep, Öebbi d igellil, nekwni d isâayen". A Naru ayen nnan, akked wayen n$an n lambiyya, war ssebba. Ad asen Nini: "jeôôbet aâaqeb ujajiê".

ayahs.text: Ayagi, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnwen. Öebbi ur Ipdennis imdanen.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnwen. Öebbi ur Ipdennis imdanen.

ayahs.text: Wid innan: "Ih, Öebbi Iâahed a$ ur neppamen s Umazan, alamma issenâat a$ d asfel, ara teçç tmes". Ini: "ni$ usan kwen id imazanen, uqbel iw, s ubeggen, akw s wayen d tennam. Ihi, acimi i ten ten$am, ma tessawalem tidep"?
ayahs.translation: Wid innan: "Ih, Öebbi Iâahed a$ ur neppamen s Umazan, alamma issenâat a$ d asfel, ara teçç tmes". Ini: "ni$ usan kwen id imazanen, uqbel iw, s ubeggen, akw s wayen d tennam. Ihi, acimi i ten ten$am, ma tessawalem tidep"?

ayahs.text: Ma skaddben k, ni$ skaddben imazanen, uqbel ik, usan d s ubeggen, Ihellilen, akked Tezmamt timnewweôt.
ayahs.translation: Ma skaddben k, ni$ skaddben imazanen, uqbel ik, usan d s ubeggen, Ihellilen, akked Tezmamt timnewweôt.

ayahs.text: Yal iman ad ijeôôeb tameppant. Ass n tnekra, ad awen ippunefk, kan, warraz nnwen. Win isellken si tmes, ikecmen Loennet, ni$ irbeê. Tameddurt, di ddunit, d zzhu kan ip$uôôun.
ayahs.translation: Yal iman ad ijeôôeb tameppant. Ass n tnekra, ad awen ippunefk, kan, warraz nnwen. Win isellken si tmes, ikecmen Loennet, ni$ irbeê. Tameddurt, di ddunit, d zzhu kan ip$uôôun.

ayahs.text: A ppeppujeôôbem deg wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen. Ad wwten aîas degwen, wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akked imcurak. Ma tûebôem u têezzbem, ayagi, s tidep, d ayen isselêayen lumuô.
ayahs.translation: A ppeppujeôôbem deg wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen. Ad wwten aîas degwen, wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akked imcurak. Ma tûebôem u têezzbem, ayagi, s tidep, d ayen isselêayen lumuô.

ayahs.text: Mi Iîîef Öebbi laâqed n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt: "a p tbeggnem i medden, ur p teppeffrem". Rran p deffir izugar nnsen, u$en yis, ayen irxisen. I icmet wayen u$en!
ayahs.translation: Mi Iîîef Öebbi laâqed n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt: "a p tbeggnem i medden, ur p teppeffrem". Rran p deffir izugar nnsen, u$en yis, ayen irxisen. I icmet wayen u$en!

ayahs.text: Ur p$ili ad sellken, seg uâaqeb, wid ifeôêen s wayen fkan, u b$an a ten ccekôen $ef wayen ur xdimen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ur p$ili ad sellken, seg uâaqeb, wid ifeôêen s wayen fkan, u b$an a ten ccekôen $ef wayen ur xdimen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, akked umgirred n yiv akked wass, d issekniyen i uâqilen;
ayahs.translation: Ih, di lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, akked umgirred n yiv akked wass, d issekniyen i uâqilen;

ayahs.text: Wid id ismektayen Öebbi s ibeddi, s i$imi, s tuééla. Pmeyyizen lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan. A Mass nne$! Ur Texliqev aya d aêerfi. Gedha s yiseK! Sellek a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes.
ayahs.translation: Wid id ismektayen Öebbi s ibeddi, s i$imi, s tuééla. Pmeyyizen lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan. A Mass nne$! Ur Texliqev aya d aêerfi. Gedha s yiseK! Sellek a$ seg uâaqeb n tmes.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Ni$, s tidep, Keçç, Texziv win Teskecmev ar tmes. Ur llin wid ara isellken imednas.
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Ni$, s tidep, Keçç, Texziv win Teskecmev ar tmes. Ur llin wid ara isellken imednas.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! S tidep, nesla i uneccad, la inecced ar liman: "amnet s Mass nnwen"! Numen. A Mass nne$! Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, Kkes ane$ tucmitin nne$, Ssiwev a$, ar ssmaê iK, akked wid zeddigen.
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! S tidep, nesla i uneccad, la inecced ar liman: "amnet s Mass nnwen"! Numen. A Mass nne$! Semmeê a$ ibekkaven nne$, Kkes ane$ tucmitin nne$, Ssiwev a$, ar ssmaê iK, akked wid zeddigen.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Efk ane$ ayen i a$ Tâahdev s imazanen iK; ur a$ Xezzu ass n tnekra. Keçç, s tidep, ur Tzeglev lemâahda.
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Efk ane$ ayen i a$ Tâahdev s imazanen iK; ur a$ Xezzu ass n tnekra. Keçç, s tidep, ur Tzeglev lemâahda.

ayahs.text: Irra yasen Mass nnsen: "Nek ur Veggiâe$ igi n win, segwen, issewqamen, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta. Wa ikka d seg wa. Wid iunagen, u ssuff$en ten seg ixxamen nnsen, iâatben deg ubrid iW, innu$en, ipwan$an, war ccekk, ad asen Kkse$ tucmitin nnsen, a ten Skecme$ ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen". D akafi s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, $uôeS akafi amxallef.
ayahs.translation: Irra yasen Mass nnsen: "Nek ur Veggiâe$ igi n win, segwen, issewqamen, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta. Wa ikka d seg wa. Wid iunagen, u ssuff$en ten seg ixxamen nnsen, iâatben deg ubrid iW, innu$en, ipwan$an, war ccekk, ad asen Kkse$ tucmitin nnsen, a ten Skecme$ ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen". D akafi s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, $uôeS akafi amxallef.

ayahs.text: Ur k ipqelliq lexdaâ n wid ijehlen di temdint.
ayahs.translation: Ur k ipqelliq lexdaâ n wid ijehlen di temdint.

ayahs.text: Cwiî n zzhu, sinna, axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A yir usu!
ayahs.translation: Cwiî n zzhu, sinna, axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A yir usu!

ayahs.text: Maca, i wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen: leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, d inebgawen n Öebbi. U d wayen illan ar Öebbi, d amxallef i izedganen.
ayahs.translation: Maca, i wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen: leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, d inebgawen n Öebbi. U d wayen illan ar Öebbi, d amxallef i izedganen.

ayahs.text: Ih, seg wAt Tezmamt, wid iumnen s Öebbi, s wayen akw i wen ed irsen, akked s wayen i sen d irsen. Unzen i Öebbi, ur u$en ara s issekniyen n Öebbi, ayen ôxisen. I widak, arraz s$uô Mass nnsen. Ni$ Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
ayahs.translation: Ih, seg wAt Tezmamt, wid iumnen s Öebbi, s wayen akw i wen ed irsen, akked s wayen i sen d irsen. Unzen i Öebbi, ur u$en ara s issekniyen n Öebbi, ayen ôxisen. I widak, arraz s$uô Mass nnsen. Ni$ Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Üebôet, aznet ûûbeô, begset, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Üebôet, aznet ûûbeô, begset, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar a prebêem.

verses.text: A yimdanen! Ëezzbet i Mass nnwen, ikwen Ixelqen seg yiwen n lxelq, u Ixelq ed segs ayugan is. Issuffe$ ed, segsen, aîas n yirgazen akked tlawin. Ëezzbet i Öebbi i$ef tepmesteqsayem, akw i tâabbuvin. Öebbi, s tidep, Izga Iquôaâ kwen.
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Ëezzbet i Mass nnwen, ikwen Ixelqen seg yiwen n lxelq, u Ixelq ed segs ayugan is. Issuffe$ ed, segsen, aîas n yirgazen akked tlawin. Ëezzbet i Öebbi i$ef tepmesteqsayem, akw i tâabbuvin. Öebbi, s tidep, Izga Iquôaâ kwen.

verses.text: Efket ayla nnsen i igujilen, ur pparat dduni deg umkan n lâali. Ur pparat ayla nnsen d ayla nnwen. Ih, wagi d abekkav ameqwôan.
verses.translation: Efket ayla nnsen i igujilen, ur pparat dduni deg umkan n lâali. Ur pparat ayla nnsen d ayla nnwen. Ih, wagi d abekkav ameqwôan.

verses.text: Ma tugadem ur tweznem ara ar igujilen, a$et ayen i wen ihwan n tlawin: snat, kravt, kuét. Ma tugadem ur tessaâdalem ara, yiwet kan, ne$ taklatin nnwen. Akka i iwulem, ur ppakwret.
verses.translation: Ma tugadem ur tweznem ara ar igujilen, a$et ayen i wen ihwan n tlawin: snat, kravt, kuét. Ma tugadem ur tessaâdalem ara, yiwet kan, ne$ taklatin nnwen. Akka i iwulem, ur ppakwret.

verses.text: Efket tuççit nnsent i tlawin, d tikci. Ma rrant awen d kra segs, s leb$i nnsent, ççet ep, s lfeôê akked llza.
verses.translation: Efket tuççit nnsent i tlawin, d tikci. Ma rrant awen d kra segs, s leb$i nnsent, ççet ep, s lfeôê akked llza.

verses.text: Ur ppaket i ije$lufen ayla nnwen, win i wen Ifka Öebbi i tmeddurt. Öeéqet pen segs, sselset pen, ééiédet awal nnwen $uôsen.
verses.translation: Ur ppaket i ije$lufen ayla nnwen, win i wen Ifka Öebbi i tmeddurt. Öeéqet pen segs, sselset pen, ééiédet awal nnwen $uôsen.

verses.text: Jeôôbet igujilen, alamma bbwven i jjwao. Ma tufam ten éewôen, efket asen ayla nnsen. Ur ten teppet s uveggaâ d usexseô, uqbel ad im$uôen. Ameôkanti ad iêezzeb, ame$bun ad içç s lekyasa. Mara sen tefkem ayla nnsen, s inagan fellas. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi i leêsab.
verses.translation: Jeôôbet igujilen, alamma bbwven i jjwao. Ma tufam ten éewôen, efket asen ayla nnsen. Ur ten teppet s uveggaâ d usexseô, uqbel ad im$uôen. Ameôkanti ad iêezzeb, ame$bun ad içç s lekyasa. Mara sen tefkem ayla nnsen, s inagan fellas. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi i leêsab.

verses.text: I yirgazen, amur seg wayen d ooan imawlan akked llzem. I tlawin amur seg wayen d ooan imawlan akked llzem. Ama cwiî, ne$ aîas, d amur ilezmen.
verses.translation: I yirgazen, amur seg wayen d ooan imawlan akked llzem. I tlawin amur seg wayen d ooan imawlan akked llzem. Ama cwiî, ne$ aîas, d amur ilezmen.

verses.text: Ma êedôen, i ufôaq, llzem, igujilen, igellilen, ôeéqet pen segs, tinem asen awal uûwib.
verses.translation: Ma êedôen, i ufôaq, llzem, igujilen, igellilen, ôeéqet pen segs, tinem asen awal uûwib.

verses.text: Ad agwaden wid id iooan, deffir sen, tarwa tagellilt. Ad agwaden fellasen. Ad êezzben i Öebbi, s wawal iweznen.
verses.translation: Ad agwaden wid id iooan, deffir sen, tarwa tagellilt. Ad agwaden fellasen. Ad êezzben i Öebbi, s wawal iweznen.

verses.text: Ih, wid iteppen, s ddens, ayla igujilen, la teppen kan times deg iâabbav nnsen, ad pwagren deg ujajiê.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iteppen, s ddens, ayla igujilen, la teppen kan times deg iâabbav nnsen, ad pwagren deg ujajiê.

verses.text: £ef tarwa nnwen, Iweûûa kwen Öebbi: i uqcic amur n snat tullas. Ma llant sennig snat n tullas, nnsent amur wis kué n lweôt. Ma yiwet i illan, ines uzgen. I imawlan is, i yal wa, amur wis sdis n wayen id iooa, ma isâa mmi s. Ma ur isâa ara mmi s, u weôten t imawlan is, amur wis kué i immas.
