ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! A$et awal i Öebbi. A$et awal i Umazan akked imawlan n lameô segwen. Ma temgarradem $ef lêaoa, erret ep ar Öebbi akked Umazan, ma tumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Ppif akka, d ppawil amxallef.

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara wid iumnen, zi$emma, s wayen ik ed irsen, d wayen id irsen, uqbel ik? B$an aêuddu iôebbiten n tkerkas, ulamma pwamôen a ten nekôen. Ib$a Cciîan a ten itlef ttelfan u$miq.
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara wid iumnen, zi$emma, s wayen ik ed irsen, d wayen id irsen, uqbel ik? B$an aêuddu iôebbiten n tkerkas, ulamma pwamôen a ten nekôen. Ib$a Cciîan a ten itlef ttelfan u$miq.

ayahs.text: Ma nnan asen: "aset ed ar wayen id Issers Öebbi, akw ar Umazan", a pwaliv ixabiten wexxôen ak, ugin.
ayahs.translation: Ma nnan asen: "aset ed ar wayen id Issers Öebbi, akw ar Umazan", a pwaliv ixabiten wexxôen ak, ugin.

ayahs.text: Amek ihi, ma u$en tiyta, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnsen, sinna, a d asen $uôek, ad ggalen s Öebbi: "neb$a kan lewqama akked lembwafqa".
ayahs.translation: Amek ihi, ma u$en tiyta, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnsen, sinna, a d asen $uôek, ad ggalen s Öebbi: "neb$a kan lewqama akked lembwafqa".

ayahs.text: Widak, Iéôa Öebbi i illan deg ulawen nnsen. Ihi, îîixeô asen, nabi iten, meslay iten, $ef iman nnsen, s wawal iqenâen.
ayahs.translation: Widak, Iéôa Öebbi i illan deg ulawen nnsen. Ihi, îîixeô asen, nabi iten, meslay iten, $ef iman nnsen, s wawal iqenâen.

ayahs.text: Ur d Nuzen Amazan, siwa kan iwakken ad as a$en awal, ma Irad Öebbi. Wid idensen iman nnsen, ma usan k id, d$a ssutren ssmaê i Öebbi, u issuter Umazan ad ppusemmêen, ad afen Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ur d Nuzen Amazan, siwa kan iwakken ad as a$en awal, ma Irad Öebbi. Wid idensen iman nnsen, ma usan k id, d$a ssutren ssmaê i Öebbi, u issuter Umazan ad ppusemmêen, ad afen Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Xaîi! S Mass ik, ur ppamnen, alamma rran k d amêaddi, deg wayen i$ef mgarraden. Sinna, ur ppafen, deg iman nnsen, ara ten ihewwlen, deg wayen id têuddev. Ad anzen yal annuz.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! S Mass ik, ur ppamnen, alamma rran k d amêaddi, deg wayen i$ef mgarraden. Sinna, ur ppafen, deg iman nnsen, ara ten ihewwlen, deg wayen id têuddev. Ad anzen yal annuz.

ayahs.text: Lemmer i sen Nuri: "mmin$et"! Ne$ "ff$et seg ixxamen nnwen"! Ur p xeddmen, siwa kra segsen. Ppif, i nitni, lemmer xdimen ayen u$uô pwanecden. D atebbet uûwib.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i sen Nuri: "mmin$et"! Ne$ "ff$et seg ixxamen nnwen"! Ur p xeddmen, siwa kra segsen. Ppif, i nitni, lemmer xdimen ayen u$uô pwanecden. D atebbet uûwib.

ayahs.text: Imiren ad asen Nefk, s$uône£, arraz ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Imiren ad asen Nefk, s$uône£, arraz ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: A ten Nenhu s abrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: A ten Nenhu s abrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Wid ippa$en awal i Öebbi akked Umazan, widak atnan ar wid I$at Öebbi ger lambiyya, wid issdaqen, ccuhada, ûûalêin. Ay telha tdukli d wigi!
ayahs.translation: Wid ippa$en awal i Öebbi akked Umazan, widak atnan ar wid I$at Öebbi ger lambiyya, wid issdaqen, ccuhada, ûûalêin. Ay telha tdukli d wigi!

ayahs.text: Wagi d lfevl s$uô Öebbi. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Wagi d lfevl s$uô Öebbi. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ëadret iman nnwen! èéedmet d igrawen, ne$ ééedmet akw.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëadret iman nnwen! èéedmet d igrawen, ne$ ééedmet akw.

ayahs.text: Ih, garawen win ipâaîîilen. Ma tu$em tiyta, ad yini: "I$at iyi Öebbi, ur lli$ yidsen, d anagi".
ayahs.translation: Ih, garawen win ipâaîîilen. Ma tu$em tiyta, ad yini: "I$at iyi Öebbi, ur lli$ yidsen, d anagi".

ayahs.text: Ma iusa kwen id lfevl s$uô Öebbi, ad yini, war ccekk, amzun ur telli tegmap garawen: "a lemmer lli$ yidsen, ad rebêe$ rrbeê ameqwôaêan"!
ayahs.translation: Ma iusa kwen id lfevl s$uô Öebbi, ad yini, war ccekk, amzun ur telli tegmap garawen: "a lemmer lli$ yidsen, ad rebêe$ rrbeê ameqwôaêan"!

ayahs.text: Ad nna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi wid izznuzun tameddurt n ddunit i laxert. Win ipna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi, immut ne$ irbeê, ad as Nefk arraz ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Ad nna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi wid izznuzun tameddurt n ddunit i laxert. Win ipna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi, immut ne$ irbeê, ad as Nefk arraz ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Acu kwen iu$en, ula tepna$em ara deg ubrid n Öebbi? Uôhifen seg irgazen, tilawin, igwerdan, i la iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Ssuffe$ ane$ si temdint agi ized$en imednas. Efk ane$ d bab s$uôeK, Efk ane$ d asettaô s$uôeK".
ayahs.translation: Acu kwen iu$en, ula tepna$em ara deg ubrid n Öebbi? Uôhifen seg irgazen, tilawin, igwerdan, i la iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Ssuffe$ ane$ si temdint agi ized$en imednas. Efk ane$ d bab s$uôeK, Efk ane$ d asettaô s$uôeK".

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen pna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Wid ijehlen pna$en deg ubrid iôebbiten n tkerkas. Nna$et imeddukwal n Cciîan. Ni$ tiêeôci n Cciîan d tuôhift.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen pna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Wid ijehlen pna$en deg ubrid iôebbiten n tkerkas. Nna$et imeddukwal n Cciîan. Ni$ tiêeôci n Cciîan d tuôhift.

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara wid iwumi nnan: "brut i ifassen, ééalet, zekkit"? Mi sen iura umennu$, arbaâ, segsen, ugaden imdanen, tugwdi n Öebbi, ne$ tugwdi i p i$elben. Qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Acimi i $ Turiv amennu$? A lemmer i t Teswexxôev cwiî"! Ini: "zzhu n ddunit d amnuc, tif it laxert i win ipêezziben. Ur tepwadensem ula s yiclem utemôiw".
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara wid iwumi nnan: "brut i ifassen, ééalet, zekkit"? Mi sen iura umennu$, arbaâ, segsen, ugaden imdanen, tugwdi n Öebbi, ne$ tugwdi i p i$elben. Qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Acimi i $ Turiv amennu$? A lemmer i t Teswexxôev cwiî"! Ini: "zzhu n ddunit d amnuc, tif it laxert i win ipêezziben. Ur tepwadensem ula s yiclem utemôiw".

ayahs.text: Anda tellam a kwen id tawev tmeppant, xas ma tellam di lebôuo ioehden. Ma iusa ten id yise$, ad inin: "wagi s$uô Öebbi". Ma tusa ten id tucmip, ad inin: "tagi s$uôek". Ini: "akw s$uô Öebbi". Acu iu$en agdud agi, ur izmir ad ifhem awalen?
ayahs.translation: Anda tellam a kwen id tawev tmeppant, xas ma tellam di lebôuo ioehden. Ma iusa ten id yise$, ad inin: "wagi s$uô Öebbi". Ma tusa ten id tucmip, ad inin: "tagi s$uôek". Ini: "akw s$uô Öebbi". Acu iu$en agdud agi, ur izmir ad ifhem awalen?

ayahs.text: Yal ise$ i k id iusan, s$uô Öebbi. Yal tucmip i k id iusan, s$uô iman ik. Nuzen ik id i medden, d Amazan. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Anagi.
ayahs.translation: Yal ise$ i k id iusan, s$uô Öebbi. Yal tucmip i k id iusan, s$uô iman ik. Nuzen ik id i medden, d Amazan. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Anagi.

ayahs.text: Win iu$en awal i Umazan, iu$ awal i Öebbi. Win iwexxôen, ur k id Nuzen d amêareb nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Win iu$en awal i Umazan, iu$ awal i Öebbi. Win iwexxôen, ur k id Nuzen d amêareb nnsen.

ayahs.text: Qqaôen: "annuz"! Mi k îîaxxôen, ad iêekku deg iv, urbaâ segsen, ayen ur d tenniv. Öebbi Ipparu ayen êekkun deg iv. Wexxeô asen, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Awkil.
ayahs.translation: Qqaôen: "annuz"! Mi k îîaxxôen, ad iêekku deg iv, urbaâ segsen, ayen ur d tenniv. Öebbi Ipparu ayen êekkun deg iv. Wexxeô asen, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Awkil.

ayahs.text: Day ur pmeyyizen ara Leqwôan? Lemmer illi si war Öebbi, ad afen degs aîas n wayen imgarraden.
ayahs.translation: Day ur pmeyyizen ara Leqwôan? Lemmer illi si war Öebbi, ad afen degs aîas n wayen imgarraden.

ayahs.text: Ma iusa ten lameô n laman ne$ n lxuf, a t berrêen. Lemmer i t ssawven i Umazan akked imawlan n lameô nnsen, ad xebôen wid, segsen, ib$an ad éôen. Lemmer maççi d lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S fellawen, a ppeddum d Cciîan, siwa kra kan.
ayahs.translation: Ma iusa ten lameô n laman ne$ n lxuf, a t berrêen. Lemmer i t ssawven i Umazan akked imawlan n lameô nnsen, ad xebôen wid, segsen, ib$an ad éôen. Lemmer maççi d lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S fellawen, a ppeddum d Cciîan, siwa kra kan.

ayahs.text: Nna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi. D iman ik kan ara tkellfev. Efk afud i lmumnin. Izmer Öebbi ad Issers tazmert n wid ijehlen. Öebbi Yif iten tazmert, Yif iten aâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: Nna$ deg ubrid n Öebbi. D iman ik kan ara tkellfev. Efk afud i lmumnin. Izmer Öebbi ad Issers tazmert n wid ijehlen. Öebbi Yif iten tazmert, Yif iten aâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Win icefâan ccafuâa ilhan, ad iawi, segs, amur. Win icefâan ccafuâa icemten, ad iawi, segs, sin imuren. Öebbi Izga Issenqad yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Win icefâan ccafuâa ilhan, ad iawi, segs, amur. Win icefâan ccafuâa icemten, ad iawi, segs, sin imuren. Öebbi Izga Issenqad yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ma nnan awen d: "azul"! Erret asen azul it yifen, ne$ erret asen t. Ih, Öebbi Izga Iêeppeb yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ma nnan awen d: "azul"! Erret asen azul it yifen, ne$ erret asen t. Ih, Öebbi Izga Iêeppeb yal cci.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, a kwen Issemlil, ass n tnekra, ur degs ccekk. Anwa i iqqaôen tidep sennig Öebbi?
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, a kwen Issemlil, ass n tnekra, ur degs ccekk. Anwa i iqqaôen tidep sennig Öebbi?

ayahs.text: Acu i kwen iu$en: tebvam $ef sin, $ef ixabiten? Izzaâ ten Öebbi ilmend n wayen kesben. Day teb$am a ppenhum win Itlef Öebbi? Win Itlef Öebbi, ur as teppafev abrid.
ayahs.translation: Acu i kwen iu$en: tebvam $ef sin, $ef ixabiten? Izzaâ ten Öebbi ilmend n wayen kesben. Day teb$am a ppenhum win Itlef Öebbi? Win Itlef Öebbi, ur as teppafev abrid.

ayahs.text: B$an a ppilim d ijehliyen am nitni, a ppemcabim. Ur sâut iêbiben segsen, alamma unagen deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ma wexxôen, îîfet pen, nna$et pen anda ten tufam, ur sâut segsen aêbib ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: B$an a ppilim d ijehliyen am nitni, a ppemcabim. Ur sâut iêbiben segsen, alamma unagen deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ma wexxôen, îîfet pen, nna$et pen anda ten tufam, ur sâut segsen aêbib ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: Kkes ed wid iusan ar ugdud ukud tesâam laâqed, ne$ i kwen id iusan, gguman wulawen nnsen a kwen nna$en, ne$ ad nna$en agdud nnsen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Ifka yasen adabu fellawen, a kwen nna$en. Ma âazlen iman nnsen segwen, ur kwen nnu$en, ssutren awen d tifrat, ur kwen Ippawi Öebbi $uôsen.
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed wid iusan ar ugdud ukud tesâam laâqed, ne$ i kwen id iusan, gguman wulawen nnsen a kwen nna$en, ne$ ad nna$en agdud nnsen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Ifka yasen adabu fellawen, a kwen nna$en. Ma âazlen iman nnsen segwen, ur kwen nnu$en, ssutren awen d tifrat, ur kwen Ippawi Öebbi $uôsen.

ayahs.text: A ppafem wiyav i ib$an tifrat yidwen, akked tifrat akked ugdud nnsen. Yal tikelt ideg ara ten rren ar lfetna, ad kecmen degs. Ma ur aâzilen ara iman nnsen segwen, ur awen ssutren ara tifrat, ur fukken ara amennu$, îîfet pen, nna$et pen anda ten tufam. Widak, Nefka yawen fellasen adabu n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: A ppafem wiyav i ib$an tifrat yidwen, akked tifrat akked ugdud nnsen. Yal tikelt ideg ara ten rren ar lfetna, ad kecmen degs. Ma ur aâzilen ara iman nnsen segwen, ur awen ssutren ara tifrat, ur fukken ara amennu$, îîfet pen, nna$et pen anda ten tufam. Widak, Nefka yawen fellasen adabu n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ur ippunefk ara i lmumen ad ine$ lmumen, siwa ma i$lev. Win in$an lmumen di le$wlav, ad iserreê i wakli iumnen, a ppeppunefk ddeyya i twacult is, siwa ma seddqen p. Ma illa seg ugdud acengu nnwen, u neppa d lmumen, ad iserreê i wakli iumnen. Ma illa seg ugdud ukud tesâam laâqed, a ppeppunefk ddeyya i twacult is, ad iserreê i wakli iumnen. Win ur nezmir ara, ad iuéum sin wagguren, wa deffir wa, d nndama i Öebbi. Öebbi Izga Iééeô, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ur ippunefk ara i lmumen ad ine$ lmumen, siwa ma i$lev. Win in$an lmumen di le$wlav, ad iserreê i wakli iumnen, a ppeppunefk ddeyya i twacult is, siwa ma seddqen p. Ma illa seg ugdud acengu nnwen, u neppa d lmumen, ad iserreê i wakli iumnen. Ma illa seg ugdud ukud tesâam laâqed, a ppeppunefk ddeyya i twacult is, ad iserreê i wakli iumnen. Win ur nezmir ara, ad iuéum sin wagguren, wa deffir wa, d nndama i Öebbi. Öebbi Izga Iééeô, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Win in$an lmumen s lemâamda, aqeîîi ines d Loahennama, degs ad iwekkeô. A d Izâaf Öebbi fellas, a t Ixzu, ad as d Iheggi aâaqeb abarar.
ayahs.translation: Win in$an lmumen s lemâamda, aqeîîi ines d Loahennama, degs ad iwekkeô. A d Izâaf Öebbi fellas, a t Ixzu, ad as d Iheggi aâaqeb abarar.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tennu$em deg ubrid n Öebbi, beggnet iman nnwen. Ur qqaôet i win i wen d ssutren tifrat: "ur telliv d lmumen"! Teb$am cci n tmeddurt n ddunit. £uô Öebbi, aîas u$iti. Akka ay tellam zik. Öebbi Ifeôôeo fellawen. Beggnet iman nnwen. Ih, Öebbi Izga Issen ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tennu$em deg ubrid n Öebbi, beggnet iman nnwen. Ur qqaôet i win i wen d ssutren tifrat: "ur telliv d lmumen"! Teb$am cci n tmeddurt n ddunit. £uô Öebbi, aîas u$iti. Akka ay tellam zik. Öebbi Ifeôôeo fellawen. Beggnet iman nnwen. Ih, Öebbi Izga Issen ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ur aâdilen ara wid iqqimen si lmumnin, siwa wid ivôuôan, akked wid ijuhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Ismenyaf Öebbi wid ijuhden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen, i wid iqqimen. Akw, Iwaââed asen Öebbi ûûam. Ifrez Öebbi imjuhad af wid iqqimen, s warraz ameqwôaêan,
ayahs.translation: Ur aâdilen ara wid iqqimen si lmumnin, siwa wid ivôuôan, akked wid ijuhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Ismenyaf Öebbi wid ijuhden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen, i wid iqqimen. Akw, Iwaââed asen Öebbi ûûam. Ifrez Öebbi imjuhad af wid iqqimen, s warraz ameqwôaêan,

ayahs.text: aseqôeb $uôeS, ssmaê, akked uêunu. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: aseqôeb $uôeS, ssmaê, akked uêunu. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ih, i wid iwumi ddment lmalayek leôwaê, u densen iman nnsen, ad inint: "anida tellam"? A d inin: "nella d uôhifen di tmurt". Ad inint: "day ur tewsiâ ara tmurt n Öebbi, a ppinigem degs"? Widak, axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!
ayahs.translation: Ih, i wid iwumi ddment lmalayek leôwaê, u densen iman nnsen, ad inint: "anida tellam"? A d inin: "nella d uôhifen di tmurt". Ad inint: "day ur tewsiâ ara tmurt n Öebbi, a ppinigem degs"? Widak, axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!

ayahs.text: Kkes ed uôhifen, argaz, tameîîut, agrud, ur nezmir i tsensert, ur nepwanhu s abrid.
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed uôhifen, argaz, tameîîut, agrud, ur nezmir i tsensert, ur nepwanhu s abrid.

ayahs.text: Widak, amar Öebbi ad asen Isemmeê. Öebbi Izga Ipqili, Ipsemmiê.
ayahs.translation: Widak, amar Öebbi ad asen Isemmeê. Öebbi Izga Ipqili, Ipsemmiê.

ayahs.text: Win iunagen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad iaf, di tmurt, aîas n ssôanat akked lufa. Win iff$en seg uxxam is, d iminig ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, sinna, temmuger it tmeppant, arraz is atan ar Öebbi. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Win iunagen deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad iaf, di tmurt, aîas n ssôanat akked lufa. Win iff$en seg uxxam is, d iminig ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, sinna, temmuger it tmeppant, arraz is atan ar Öebbi. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Mi teppeddum di tmurt, ulac u$ilif ma teééeméim taéallit, ma tugadem a d ééedmen fellawen wid ijehlen. Ih, ijehliyen banen d icenga nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Mi teppeddum di tmurt, ulac u$ilif ma teééeméim taéallit, ma tugadem a d ééedmen fellawen wid ijehlen. Ih, ijehliyen banen d icenga nnwen.

ayahs.text: Ma telliv garasen, tezwaôev asen i téallit, ilaq a ppili terbaât, segsen, yidek, s ibeddi, ad îîfen leslaê nnsen. Mi knan, ad ilin deffir wen. A d tas terbaât nniven ur neééul, ad ééalen yidek, ad êadren iman nnsen, akked leslaê nnsen. Ssarmen wid ijehlen, a p$eflem $ef leslaê nnwen akked lqecc nnwen, iwakken a d ééedmen fellawen, yiwet n ééedma. Ulac u$ilif ma tessersem leslaê nnwen, ma ihero ikwen ugeffur ne$ tuvnem. Ëëadret iman nnwen. Ih, Öebbi Ihegga, i ijehliyen, aâaqeb isdullun.
ayahs.translation: Ma telliv garasen, tezwaôev asen i téallit, ilaq a ppili terbaât, segsen, yidek, s ibeddi, ad îîfen leslaê nnsen. Mi knan, ad ilin deffir wen. A d tas terbaât nniven ur neééul, ad ééalen yidek, ad êadren iman nnsen, akked leslaê nnsen. Ssarmen wid ijehlen, a p$eflem $ef leslaê nnwen akked lqecc nnwen, iwakken a d ééedmen fellawen, yiwet n ééedma. Ulac u$ilif ma tessersem leslaê nnwen, ma ihero ikwen ugeffur ne$ tuvnem. Ëëadret iman nnwen. Ih, Öebbi Ihegga, i ijehliyen, aâaqeb isdullun.

ayahs.text: Mi tfukkem taéallit, mmektit ed Öebbi s ibeddi, s i$imi, s tuééla. Mi teppuvemnem, ééalet. Taéallit, ih, tura i lmumen, s lewqat is.
ayahs.translation: Mi tfukkem taéallit, mmektit ed Öebbi s ibeddi, s i$imi, s tuééla. Mi teppuvemnem, ééalet. Taéallit, ih, tura i lmumen, s lewqat is.

ayahs.text: Ur fecclet deg uvfaô n ugdud. Ma tmeênem, ula d nitni meênen am kunwi. Tessaramem, ar Öebbi, ayen ur ssaramen. Öebbi Izga Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ur fecclet deg uvfaô n ugdud. Ma tmeênem, ula d nitni meênen am kunwi. Tessaramem, ar Öebbi, ayen ur ssaramen. Öebbi Izga Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ih, Nessers ak d Tazmamt, s tidep, iwakken a pêuddev ger imdanen, s wayen i k id Issenâat Öebbi. Ur ppili d axûim n lxeyyan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Nessers ak d Tazmamt, s tidep, iwakken a pêuddev ger imdanen, s wayen i k id Issenâat Öebbi. Ur ppili d axûim n lxeyyan.

ayahs.text: Ssuter ssmaê i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ssuter ssmaê i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ur pnnavaê $ef wid ixeynen iman nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara win ixeynen, idenben.
ayahs.translation: Ur pnnavaê $ef wid ixeynen iman nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara win ixeynen, idenben.

ayahs.text: B$an ad ffren i medden, ur zmiren ad ffren i Öebbi. Neppa Illa yidsen mara d qqaôen, deg iv, awalen i$ef ur Iôuva. Öebbi Izga Izzi i wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: B$an ad ffren i medden, ur zmiren ad ffren i Öebbi. Neppa Illa yidsen mara d qqaôen, deg iv, awalen i$ef ur Iôuva. Öebbi Izga Izzi i wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Atan kunwi tnuvêem fellasen, di tmeddurt n ddunit. Anwa ara innavêen Öebbi fellasen, ass n tnekra? Ne$ anwa ar yilin fellasen d awkil?
ayahs.translation: Atan kunwi tnuvêem fellasen, di tmeddurt n ddunit. Anwa ara innavêen Öebbi fellasen, ass n tnekra? Ne$ anwa ar yilin fellasen d awkil?

ayahs.text: Win ixedmen cceôô, ne$ idnes iman is, sinna, issuter ssmaê i Öebbi, ad iaf Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Win ixedmen cceôô, ne$ idnes iman is, sinna, issuter ssmaê i Öebbi, ad iaf Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Win ibbwin abekkav, ibbwi it, kan, i iman is. Öebbi Izga Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Win ibbwin abekkav, ibbwi it, kan, i iman is. Öebbi Izga Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Win ifalîan ne$ ibbwin abekkav, irra p id $ef wur nexdim, ibbwi lâaô, akked ubekkav n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Win ifalîan ne$ ibbwin abekkav, irra p id $ef wur nexdim, ibbwi lâaô, akked ubekkav n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Lemmer maççi d lfevl n Öebbi fellak, akked uêunu S, iaâzem urbaâ, segsen, a k telfen. Ur tellifan siwa iman nnsen. Ur k îîuôôun s wacemma. Issers ak d Öebbi Tazmamt akked ûûwab. Isselmed ak ayen ur tessinev. Izga lfevl n Öebbi, fellak, d ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer maççi d lfevl n Öebbi fellak, akked uêunu S, iaâzem urbaâ, segsen, a k telfen. Ur tellifan siwa iman nnsen. Ur k îîuôôun s wacemma. Issers ak d Öebbi Tazmamt akked ûûwab. Isselmed ak ayen ur tessinev. Izga lfevl n Öebbi, fellak, d ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Aîas n wayen qqaôen ur imâin, siwa ayen iumôen ssadaqa, ne$ lqanun, ne$ lemûalêa ger medden. Win ixedmen aya, issarem ad Iôavi Öebbi, deqqal ad as Nefk arraz ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Aîas n wayen qqaôen ur imâin, siwa ayen iumôen ssadaqa, ne$ lqanun, ne$ lemûalêa ger medden. Win ixedmen aya, issarem ad Iôavi Öebbi, deqqal ad as Nefk arraz ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Win ixuûmen Amazan, mbaâd ma tepwabeggen as d nnhaya, iteddun d ubrid ur d wid n lmumnin, a t Neoo akken iooa. A t Nenheô ar Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!
ayahs.translation: Win ixuûmen Amazan, mbaâd ma tepwabeggen as d nnhaya, iteddun d ubrid ur d wid n lmumnin, a t Neoo akken iooa. A t Nenheô ar Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi ur Ipsemmiê ma ad aS carken. Ipsemmiê ayen nniven, i win i S ihwan. Win icurken i Öebbi, innetlef ttelfan u$miq.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi ur Ipsemmiê ma ad aS carken. Ipsemmiê ayen nniven, i win i S ihwan. Win icurken i Öebbi, innetlef ttelfan u$miq.

ayahs.text: La pnujun ar nnta, war Neppa. La pnujun kan ar Cciîan aballa$.
ayahs.translation: La pnujun ar nnta, war Neppa. La pnujun kan ar Cciîan aballa$.

ayahs.text: Ixza t Öebbi. Inna: "ad awi$ amur ippuêeppmen, seg imdanen ik.
ayahs.translation: Ixza t Öebbi. Inna: "ad awi$ amur ippuêeppmen, seg imdanen ik.

ayahs.text: A ten telfe$, a ten ssenêesse$, ad asen amôe$ ad gezmen imeééu$en ubeqôi, ad asen amôe$ ad bedlen lxelq n Öebbi". Win idmen Cciîan d bab, war Öebbi, ixseô lexsaôa n tidep.
ayahs.translation: A ten telfe$, a ten ssenêesse$, ad asen amôe$ ad gezmen imeééu$en ubeqôi, ad asen amôe$ ad bedlen lxelq n Öebbi". Win idmen Cciîan d bab, war Öebbi, ixseô lexsaôa n tidep.

ayahs.text: Ipâahad asen, issenêas iten. Ayen i sen iâahed Cciîan, d a$uôôu kan.
ayahs.translation: Ipâahad asen, issenêas iten. Ayen i sen iâahed Cciîan, d a$uôôu kan.

ayahs.text: Widak, axxam nnsen d Loahennama, ur ppafen, segs, tisensert.
ayahs.translation: Widak, axxam nnsen d Loahennama, ur ppafen, segs, tisensert.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Nessekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, i lebda. Lemâahda n Öebbi a ppevôu. Anwa issawalen tidep sennig Öebbi?
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Nessekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen, i lebda. Lemâahda n Öebbi a ppevôu. Anwa issawalen tidep sennig Öebbi?

ayahs.text: Ur illi s usirem nnwen, ne$ s win n At Tezmamt. Win ixedmen cceôô, ad ippuqeîîi fellas. Ur Ippaf, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi s usirem nnwen, ne$ s win n At Tezmamt. Win ixedmen cceôô, ad ippuqeîîi fellas. Ur Ippaf, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: Win ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta, u neppa iumen…, widak ad kecmen Loennet, ur pwadensen s yiclem utemôiw.
ayahs.translation: Win ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta, u neppa iumen…, widak ad kecmen Loennet, ur pwadensen s yiclem utemôiw.

ayahs.text: Anwa iûegmen ddin is sennig win iunzen i Öebbi, u neppa d laâûem, u idda d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep? Öebbi Irra Ibôahim d aêbib.
ayahs.translation: Anwa iûegmen ddin is sennig win iunzen i Öebbi, u neppa d laâûem, u idda d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep? Öebbi Irra Ibôahim d aêbib.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Izga Izzi i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Izga Izzi i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Steqsayen k $ef tlawin. Ini: "Öebbi ad awen Issefhem fellasent. Ayen i wen $ôan di Tezmamt, $ef tlawin tigujilin, iwumi ur tefkim ara i sent iuran, u teb$am a tent ta$em. Akked igwerdan imeéyanen. A pbeddem i igujilen s lmizan. Ayen akw txeddmem n lxiô, Öebbi, s tidep, Izga Iéôa t.
ayahs.translation: Steqsayen k $ef tlawin. Ini: "Öebbi ad awen Issefhem fellasent. Ayen i wen $ôan di Tezmamt, $ef tlawin tigujilin, iwumi ur tefkim ara i sent iuran, u teb$am a tent ta$em. Akked igwerdan imeéyanen. A pbeddem i igujilen s lmizan. Ayen akw txeddmem n lxiô, Öebbi, s tidep, Izga Iéôa t.

ayahs.text: Ma tugad tmeîîut ad as ibru, ne$ ad as iwexxeô urgaz is, ulac u$ilif fellasen ma ufan lemwafaqa garasen. Ppif lemwafaqa. Imdanen, deg iman nnsen d imceôôiyen. Ma tgerzem u têezzbem, Öebbi, s tidep, Izga Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ma tugad tmeîîut ad as ibru, ne$ ad as iwexxeô urgaz is, ulac u$ilif fellasen ma ufan lemwafaqa garasen. Ppif lemwafaqa. Imdanen, deg iman nnsen d imceôôiyen. Ma tgerzem u têezzbem, Öebbi, s tidep, Izga Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ur tezmirem a ppeddum s lmizan, ger tlawin, xas teb$am. Ihi, ur pmalet yal tumlin a p teooem, amzun d tamejgugelt. Ma tgam ayen ilhan, u têezzbem, s tidep, Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ur tezmirem a ppeddum s lmizan, ger tlawin, xas teb$am. Ihi, ur pmalet yal tumlin a p teooem, amzun d tamejgugelt. Ma tgam ayen ilhan, u têezzbem, s tidep, Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ma mfaôaqen, ad I$it Öebbi yal wa, s ôôeéq iS. Öebbi Izga d Ajemmal, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ma mfaôaqen, ad I$it Öebbi yal wa, s ôôeéq iS. Öebbi Izga d Ajemmal, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ni$ Nweûûa wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, u Nweûûa kwen, a pêezzbem i Öebbi. Ma tnekôem, ihi, n Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Izga d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ni$ Nweûûa wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, u Nweûûa kwen, a pêezzbem i Öebbi. Ma tnekôem, ihi, n Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Izga d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Awkil.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Awkil.

ayahs.text: Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes a yimdanen! A d Iawi wiyav. Öebbi Izga Izmer i waya.
ayahs.translation: Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes a yimdanen! A d Iawi wiyav. Öebbi Izga Izmer i waya.

ayahs.text: Win ib$an a$ellet n ddunit, ihi, ar Öebbi a$ellet n ddunit akked win n laxeôt. Öebbi Izga Issel, Ipwali.
ayahs.translation: Win ib$an a$ellet n ddunit, ihi, ar Öebbi a$ellet n ddunit akked win n laxeôt. Öebbi Izga Issel, Ipwali.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Teddut s lmizan, d inagan n Öebbi, xas $ef yiman nnwen, ne$ imawlan u llzem, ama d ameôkanti, ama d igellil. Izwar iten Öebbi. Ur teddut d lhawiyya, ur twezznem ara. Ma txutlem, ne$ twexxôem, ihi, Öebbi Izga Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Teddut s lmizan, d inagan n Öebbi, xas $ef yiman nnwen, ne$ imawlan u llzem, ama d ameôkanti, ama d igellil. Izwar iten Öebbi. Ur teddut d lhawiyya, ur twezznem ara. Ma txutlem, ne$ twexxôem, ihi, Öebbi Izga Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Amnet s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked Tezmamt id Issers i Umazan iS, akked Tezmamt id Issers, uqbel. Win inekôen Öebbi, lmalayek iS, Tizmamin iS, imazanen iS, akked wass aneggaru, ihi innetlaf ttelfan u$miq.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Amnet s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked Tezmamt id Issers i Umazan iS, akked Tezmamt id Issers, uqbel. Win inekôen Öebbi, lmalayek iS, Tizmamin iS, imazanen iS, akked wass aneggaru, ihi innetlaf ttelfan u$miq.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iumnen, sinna, nekôen, sinna, umnen, sinna, nekôen, sinna, zaden di nnkeô, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, ur ten Ippawi d ubrid.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, sinna, nekôen, sinna, umnen, sinna, nekôen, sinna, zaden di nnkeô, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, ur ten Ippawi d ubrid.

ayahs.text: Becceô ixabiten ar fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Becceô ixabiten ar fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Wid ipparan ijehliyen d iêbiben, war lmumnin, day ssarmen $uôsen tazmert? Tazmert, s tidep, ar Öebbi yakw.
ayahs.translation: Wid ipparan ijehliyen d iêbiben, war lmumnin, day ssarmen $uôsen tazmert? Tazmert, s tidep, ar Öebbi yakw.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nessers awen d, di Tezmamt: "ma teslam la nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, la ttihin fellasen, ur p$imit yidsen, alamma bedlen ameslay. Mulac a ppilim am nitni". Öebbi, s tidep, a d Issemlil ixabiten akked ijehliyen di Loahennama, meôôa.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nessers awen d, di Tezmamt: "ma teslam la nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, la ttihin fellasen, ur p$imit yidsen, alamma bedlen ameslay. Mulac a ppilim am nitni". Öebbi, s tidep, a d Issemlil ixabiten akked ijehliyen di Loahennama, meôôa.

ayahs.text: Wid i kwen iquôâan, ma Ifka yawen d Öebbi l$elb, a d inin: "day ur nella ara yidwen"? Ma illa wayen rebêen ijehliyen, ad inin: "day ur nêuôeb ara fellawen, nsellek ikwen si lmumnin"? Ad Iêudd Öebbi garawen, ass n tnekra. Ur Ippara ara Öebbi, i ijehliyen, abrid ar lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Wid i kwen iquôâan, ma Ifka yawen d Öebbi l$elb, a d inin: "day ur nella ara yidwen"? Ma illa wayen rebêen ijehliyen, ad inin: "day ur nêuôeb ara fellawen, nsellek ikwen si lmumnin"? Ad Iêudd Öebbi garawen, ass n tnekra. Ur Ippara ara Öebbi, i ijehliyen, abrid ar lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ih, ixabiten xedâen Öebbi. D Neppa iten Ixedâan. Ma kren d i téallit, a d kren d imaâguza, akken kan a ten id walin medden. Cwiî kan id smektayen Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ixabiten xedâen Öebbi. D Neppa iten Ixedâan. Ma kren d i téallit, a d kren d imaâguza, akken kan a ten id walin medden. Cwiî kan id smektayen Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Ur banen akka, ne$ akka; $eô wigi, ne$ $eô wiyav. Win Itlef Öebbi ur as teppafev abrid, d awez$i.
ayahs.translation: Ur banen akka, ne$ akka; $eô wigi, ne$ $eô wiyav. Win Itlef Öebbi ur as teppafev abrid, d awez$i.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat ijehliyen d iêbiben, war lmumnin. Day teb$am ad aS tefkem, i Öebbi, adabu ibanen, mgal kwen?
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat ijehliyen d iêbiben, war lmumnin. Day teb$am ad aS tefkem, i Öebbi, adabu ibanen, mgal kwen?

ayahs.text: Ih, ixabiten di lqaâa n wadda n tmes, ur asen teppafev asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ixabiten di lqaâa n wadda n tmes, ur asen teppafev asettaô.

ayahs.text: Kkes ed wid ituben, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, iîîfen di Öebbi, izzazdgen ddin nnsen ar Öebbi. Widak, ad ilin ar lmumnin. Deqqal a d Iawi Öebbi, i lmumnin, arraz ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed wid ituben, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, iîîfen di Öebbi, izzazdgen ddin nnsen ar Öebbi. Widak, ad ilin ar lmumnin. Deqqal a d Iawi Öebbi, i lmumnin, arraz ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Acu ara Ixdem Öebbi s uâaqeb nnwen, ma tesnemmrem, tumnem? Ni$ Öebbi Ippara tajmilt, Iéôa.
ayahs.translation: Acu ara Ixdem Öebbi s uâaqeb nnwen, ma tesnemmrem, tumnem? Ni$ Öebbi Ippara tajmilt, Iéôa.

ayahs.text: Ur Iêemmel ara Öebbi nnaâlat, siwa seg win ipwadensen. Öebbi Izga Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ur Iêemmel ara Öebbi nnaâlat, siwa seg win ipwadensen. Öebbi Izga Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ma txedmem lxiô âinani, ne$ teffrem t, ne$ tsemmêem abekkavu, Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, d Aêernuk.
ayahs.translation: Ma txedmem lxiô âinani, ne$ teffrem t, ne$ tsemmêem abekkavu, Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, d Aêernuk.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid inekôen Öebbi akked imazanen iS, u b$an ad ssemfaôqen Öebbi akked imazanen iS, qqaôen: "numen s kra, nenkeô kra". B$an ad awin abrid garasen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid inekôen Öebbi akked imazanen iS, u b$an ad ssemfaôqen Öebbi akked imazanen iS, qqaôen: "numen s kra, nenkeô kra". B$an ad awin abrid garasen.

ayahs.text: Widak, d ijehliyen n ûûeê. Nhegga, i ijehliyen, aâaqeb isdullun
ayahs.translation: Widak, d ijehliyen n ûûeê. Nhegga, i ijehliyen, aâaqeb isdullun

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen s Öebbi akked imazanen iS, ur ten ssemgarraden, widak, deqqal a ten id ias warraz nnsen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen s Öebbi akked imazanen iS, ur ten ssemgarraden, widak, deqqal a ten id ias warraz nnsen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: La k d ssuturen, At Tezmamt, ad asen d tessersev Tazmamt seg igenni. Ni$ ssutren, i Musa, sennig waya. Nnan as: "ssenâat a$ d Öebbi, a T nwali". Tebbwi ten ssiâqa, ilmend n ddens nnsen. Sinna, âabden aâjmi, mbaâd ma iusa ten id ubeggen. Nesemmeê asen aya. Nefka, i Musa, adabu n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: La k d ssuturen, At Tezmamt, ad asen d tessersev Tazmamt seg igenni. Ni$ ssutren, i Musa, sennig waya. Nnan as: "ssenâat a$ d Öebbi, a T nwali". Tebbwi ten ssiâqa, ilmend n ddens nnsen. Sinna, âabden aâjmi, mbaâd ma iusa ten id ubeggen. Nesemmeê asen aya. Nefka, i Musa, adabu n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Nessuli adrar sennig sen, ilmend n laâqed nnsen. Nenna yasen: "kecmet si tebburt s lekni". Nenna yasen: "ur txalafet ssebt". Neîîef segsen laâqed iûeêêan.
ayahs.translation: Nessuli adrar sennig sen, ilmend n laâqed nnsen. Nenna yasen: "kecmet si tebburt s lekni". Nenna yasen: "ur txalafet ssebt". Neîîef segsen laâqed iûeêêan.

ayahs.text: Imi neqven laâqed nnsen, u nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, u n$an lambiyya, war ssebba, u nnan: "ulawen nne$ duben". Xaîi, d Öebbi iten Isel$en, ilmend n tjehli nnsen. Drus kan i iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Imi neqven laâqed nnsen, u nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, u n$an lambiyya, war ssebba, u nnan: "ulawen nne$ duben". Xaîi, d Öebbi iten Isel$en, ilmend n tjehli nnsen. Drus kan i iumnen.

ayahs.text: Ilmend n nnekô nnsen, u gren d, $ef Meryem, acehrir abarar;
ayahs.translation: Ilmend n nnekô nnsen, u gren d, $ef Meryem, acehrir abarar;

ayahs.text: u nnan: "nekwni nen$a Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Amazan n Öebbi". Ur t n$in, ur t semmôen $ef umidag. D lexyal kan ger wallen nnsen. Ih, wid imgarraden fellas, atnan di ccekk fellas, ur éôin fellas acemma, teddun kan d nnwaya. Metbut, ur t nn$in.
ayahs.translation: u nnan: "nekwni nen$a Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Amazan n Öebbi". Ur t n$in, ur t semmôen $ef umidag. D lexyal kan ger wallen nnsen. Ih, wid imgarraden fellas, atnan di ccekk fellas, ur éôin fellas acemma, teddun kan d nnwaya. Metbut, ur t nn$in.

ayahs.text: Xaîi! Issuli t Öebbi $uôeS. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! Issuli t Öebbi $uôeS. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ur illi yiwen, seg wAt Tezmamt, ur numin yis, uqbel tameppant is. Ass n tnekra ad yili d anagi nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi yiwen, seg wAt Tezmamt, ur numin yis, uqbel tameppant is. Ass n tnekra ad yili d anagi nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ilmend n ddens n wudayen, Negdel asen tiéidanin i illan êellent asen, imi da$en, îîeôôifen aîas seg ubrid n Öebbi;
ayahs.translation: Ilmend n ddens n wudayen, Negdel asen tiéidanin i illan êellent asen, imi da$en, îîeôôifen aîas seg ubrid n Öebbi;

ayahs.text: u ssexdamen rrba, i illan tepwakkes asen, u teppen ayla n medden, d aêerfi. Nhegga d, i ijehliyen segsen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: u ssexdamen rrba, i illan tepwakkes asen, u teppen ayla n medden, d aêerfi. Nhegga d, i ijehliyen segsen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Maca, wid, segsen, izaden di tmusni, lmumnin iumnen s wayen ik ed irsen, akked wayen id irsen, uqbel ik, wid ibedden i téallit, wid ipzekkin, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, widak, ad asen Nefk arraz ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Maca, wid, segsen, izaden di tmusni, lmumnin iumnen s wayen ik ed irsen, akked wayen id irsen, uqbel ik, wid ibedden i téallit, wid ipzekkin, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, widak, ad asen Nefk arraz ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Ih, Nweêêa yak ed, akken Nweêêa i Nuê, akked lambiyya deffir es. Nweêêa i Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, Âisa, Yub, Yunes, Harun, Sliman. Nefka Ihellilen i Dawed.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Nweêêa yak ed, akken Nweêêa i Nuê, akked lambiyya deffir es. Nweêêa i Ibôahim, Ismaâil, Isêaq, Iaâqub, laâôac, Âisa, Yub, Yunes, Harun, Sliman. Nefka Ihellilen i Dawed.

ayahs.text: Akked lambiyya i$ef ik ed Neêka, uqbel; akked lambiyya, i$ef ur ak ed Neêki. S tidep, Immeslay Öebbi i Musa.
ayahs.translation: Akked lambiyya i$ef ik ed Neêka, uqbel; akked lambiyya, i$ef ur ak ed Neêki. S tidep, Immeslay Öebbi i Musa.

ayahs.text: Lambiyya ipbecciôen, inedôen, iwakken ur pnamaren medden $ef Öebbi, deffir imazanen. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Lambiyya ipbecciôen, inedôen, iwakken ur pnamaren medden $ef Öebbi, deffir imazanen. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Maca, Icuhhed Öebbi $ef wayen ik ed Issers, s tmusni S. Ad cehhdent lmalayek. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Anagi.
ayahs.translation: Maca, Icuhhed Öebbi $ef wayen ik ed Issers, s tmusni S. Ad cehhdent lmalayek. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Anagi.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, u îîeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi, ni$ nnetlafen ttelfan u$miq.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, u îîeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi, ni$ nnetlafen ttelfan u$miq.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen u densen, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, ur ten Ippawi d ubrid,
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen u densen, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, ur ten Ippawi d ubrid,

ayahs.text: siwa abrid n Loahennama, degs ad wekkôen, i lebda. Ayagi, Izga d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: siwa abrid n Loahennama, degs ad wekkôen, i lebda. Ayagi, Izga d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan, s tidep, s$uô Mass nnwen. Amnet, ppif i kunwi. Ma tugim, ihi n Öebbi, i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan, s tidep, s$uô Mass nnwen. Amnet, ppif i kunwi. Ma tugim, ihi n Öebbi, i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Ur sfuhruyet ddin nnwen. Ur qqaret, $ef Öebbi, siwa tidep. Lmasiê Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, d amazan kan n Öebbi; d awal iS i Irra ar Meryem, u d ôôuê s $uôeS. Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked imazanen iS, ur qqaôet: "krav"! Ëebset, ppif i kunwi. Öebbi d Yiwen kan n Öebbi. Gedha s yiS, ma ad Isâu mmi S! IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Awkil.
ayahs.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Ur sfuhruyet ddin nnwen. Ur qqaret, $ef Öebbi, siwa tidep. Lmasiê Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, d amazan kan n Öebbi; d awal iS i Irra ar Meryem, u d ôôuê s $uôeS. Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked imazanen iS, ur qqaôet: "krav"! Ëebset, ppif i kunwi. Öebbi d Yiwen kan n Öebbi. Gedha s yiS, ma ad Isâu mmi S! IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Nesteqnaâ s Öebbi d Awkil.

ayahs.text: Ur ismummi ara lmasiê, ma illa d amdan n Öebbi. Akken lmalayek tuqôibin. Wid ismummin a T âabden, u zuxxen, ad pwafessren akw $uôeS.
ayahs.translation: Ur ismummi ara lmasiê, ma illa d amdan n Öebbi. Akken lmalayek tuqôibin. Wid ismummin a T âabden, u zuxxen, ad pwafessren akw $uôeS.

ayahs.text: Wanag wid iumnen, u xedmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Ifk arraz nnsen, ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. Ma d wid ismummin u zuxxen, a ten Iâaqeb aâaqeb aqeôêan. Ur ppafen, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Wanag wid iumnen, u xedmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Ifk arraz nnsen, ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. Ma d wid ismummin u zuxxen, a ten Iâaqeb aâaqeb aqeôêan. Ur ppafen, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Ni$ iusa kwen id utebbet s$uô Mass nnwen, u Nessers awen ed tafat ibanen.
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Ni$ iusa kwen id utebbet s$uô Mass nnwen, u Nessers awen ed tafat ibanen.

ayahs.text: Wanag wid iumnen s Öebbi, i iîîfen degS, a ten Issekcem ar uêunu S akked lfevl. A ten Inhu $uôeS, deg ubrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Wanag wid iumnen s Öebbi, i iîîfen degS, a ten Issekcem ar uêunu S akked lfevl. A ten Inhu $uôeS, deg ubrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Cawôen k. Ini: "Öebbi Isfehm awen d $ef llzem. Ma immut urgaz, war tarwa, isâa taultmap, i neppat azgen n wayen id iooa. Neppa a p iwôet, ma ur tesâi tarwa. Ma snat ay llant, amur wis krav i yal ta, n wayen id iooa. Ma llan watmaten akked tessetmatin, i uqcic amur n snat n tullas". Ibeggen awen d Öebbi akken ur tepnnetlafem. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Cawôen k. Ini: "Öebbi Isfehm awen d $ef llzem. Ma immut urgaz, war tarwa, isâa taultmap, i neppat azgen n wayen id iooa. Neppa a p iwôet, ma ur tesâi tarwa. Ma snat ay llant, amur wis krav i yal ta, n wayen id iooa. Ma llan watmaten akked tessetmatin, i uqcic amur n snat n tullas". Ibeggen awen d Öebbi akken ur tepnnetlafem. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Eîîfet deg iâahden nnwen. Ëellen awen lmal n tejlibt, kkes ed wid i wen nnan. Ur awen têell ara ûûyada, mara têuoem. Öebbi, s tidep, Ippameô ayen i S ihwan.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Eîîfet deg iâahden nnwen. Ëellen awen lmal n tejlibt, kkes ed wid i wen nnan. Ur awen têell ara ûûyada, mara têuoem. Öebbi, s tidep, Ippameô ayen i S ihwan.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ssiôxiset isekkiren n Öebbi, aggur iôqan, îêegga, snaoeq, wid iteddun ar Uxxam n Lêaôam, saramen lfevl akked llza n Mass nnsen. Üegdet mi tfukkem. Xas tcuênem agdud i wen igedlen Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ur iwata ara a pzegrem tilas. Mâawanet ar yise$ akked uêezzeb, ur ppemâawanet ar ubekkav akked lbe$wv. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. S tidep, Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur ssiôxiset isekkiren n Öebbi, aggur iôqan, îêegga, snaoeq, wid iteddun ar Uxxam n Lêaôam, saramen lfevl akked llza n Mass nnsen. Üegdet mi tfukkem. Xas tcuênem agdud i wen igedlen Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ur iwata ara a pzegrem tilas. Mâawanet ar yise$ akked uêezzeb, ur ppemâawanet ar ubekkav akked lbe$wv. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. S tidep, Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.

verses.text: I wen ipwagedlen d loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, wayen ipwamezlen i war Öebbi, ayen ippuxenqen, ayen i pwaûerâan, ayen igrarben, ayen ippuberrzen, ayen içça lweêc - siwa ma tessawvem tezlam t -, îêegga i tezôa, aseqdec n tseqqaôt. Ayagi d ucmit. Assa, wid ijehlen uysen si ddin nnwen. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI. Assa, Nnekmale$ awen ddin nnwen, Tame$ awen l$it iW, Öuva$ awen annuz d ddin. Win terra tmara di tegwnip n llaé, ur iffi$ abrid, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: I wen ipwagedlen d loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, wayen ipwamezlen i war Öebbi, ayen ippuxenqen, ayen i pwaûerâan, ayen igrarben, ayen ippuberrzen, ayen içça lweêc - siwa ma tessawvem tezlam t -, îêegga i tezôa, aseqdec n tseqqaôt. Ayagi d ucmit. Assa, wid ijehlen uysen si ddin nnwen. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI. Assa, Nnekmale$ awen ddin nnwen, Tame$ awen l$it iW, Öuva$ awen annuz d ddin. Win terra tmara di tegwnip n llaé, ur iffi$ abrid, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A k steqsayen acu i sen iêellen. Ini: "iêell awen wayen imaânen. Ayen d teppawin s lewêuc ipûeggiden. Tesêefvem asen ayen i wen Isseêfev Öebbi. Eççet seg wayen i wen d îîfen, mmektit ed fellas isem n Öebbi". Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
verses.translation: A k steqsayen acu i sen iêellen. Ini: "iêell awen wayen imaânen. Ayen d teppawin s lewêuc ipûeggiden. Tesêefvem asen ayen i wen Isseêfev Öebbi. Eççet seg wayen i wen d îîfen, mmektit ed fellas isem n Öebbi". Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

verses.text: Assa, iêell awen wayen imaânen. Iêell awen lqut n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, - iêell asen lqut nnwen -; tilawin tiêuôiyin iumnen, tilawin tiêuôiyin seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, ma tefkam asent tuççit nnsent; d uwqimen maççi d ucmiten, ur teppeddum d temddukwal. Win iugin liman, mêan igiten is. Neppa, di laxeôt, seg imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Assa, iêell awen wayen imaânen. Iêell awen lqut n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, - iêell asen lqut nnwen -; tilawin tiêuôiyin iumnen, tilawin tiêuôiyin seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, ma tefkam asent tuççit nnsent; d uwqimen maççi d ucmiten, ur teppeddum d temddukwal. Win iugin liman, mêan igiten is. Neppa, di laxeôt, seg imexsuôen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tekkrem ar téallit, ssirdet udmawen nnwen, ifassen nnwen alamma d ti$wmaô, sâaddit ifassen illexsen $ef iqweôôa nnwen, ssirdet ivaôen nnwen ar twelza. Ma tellam s loanaba, zzizdget. Ma tuvnem ne$ tunagem, ne$ iusa d yiwen segwen si ccicma, ne$ tennulem tilawin, ur tufim aman, ddmet akal zeddigen, sâaddit ep $ef udmawen nnwen akked ifassen nnwen. Ur Ib$a ara Öebbi a kwen Iqelleq, maca Ib$a a kwen Izzizdeg, ad awen Itim l$it iS, amar a pesnemmrem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tekkrem ar téallit, ssirdet udmawen nnwen, ifassen nnwen alamma d ti$wmaô, sâaddit ifassen illexsen $ef iqweôôa nnwen, ssirdet ivaôen nnwen ar twelza. Ma tellam s loanaba, zzizdget. Ma tuvnem ne$ tunagem, ne$ iusa d yiwen segwen si ccicma, ne$ tennulem tilawin, ur tufim aman, ddmet akal zeddigen, sâaddit ep $ef udmawen nnwen akked ifassen nnwen. Ur Ib$a ara Öebbi a kwen Iqelleq, maca Ib$a a kwen Izzizdeg, ad awen Itim l$it iS, amar a pesnemmrem.

verses.text: Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, akked nnesba ikwen Inuseb, mi tennam: "nesla u nunez". Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, akked nnesba ikwen Inuseb, mi tennam: "nesla u nunez". Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen i illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Illit d ôôsem ar Öebbi, d inagan at lmizan. Ur kwen issencaf dd$el n ugdud, ur twezznem. Wezznet. Lmizan iqôeb aîas ar uêezzeb. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Illit d ôôsem ar Öebbi, d inagan at lmizan. Ur kwen issencaf dd$el n ugdud, ur twezznem. Wezznet. Lmizan iqôeb aîas ar uêezzeb. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Iâahed Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz ameqwôaêan, i wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan.
verses.translation: Iâahed Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz ameqwôaêan, i wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan.

verses.text: Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak d at ujajiê.
verses.translation: Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak d at ujajiê.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, amek agdud ipheggi iman is, ad isâaddi afus is fellawen. Iîîef akin ifassen nnsen, segwen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, amek agdud ipheggi iman is, ad isâaddi afus is fellawen. Iîîef akin ifassen nnsen, segwen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.

verses.text: Ni$ Irra Öebbi laâqed i At Isôail. Nessuffe$ ed, segsen, mrawsin imvebbôen. Inna Öebbi: "Nek yidwen ma téullem, tzekkam, tumnem s imazanen iW, u tâawnem ten, tôevlem i Öebbi aôeîîal igerzen. War ccekk, ad awen Kkse$ tucmitin nnwen, a kwen Skecme$ di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Win ijehlen segwen, deffir waya, ni$ innetlaf seg ubrid umâin".
verses.translation: Ni$ Irra Öebbi laâqed i At Isôail. Nessuffe$ ed, segsen, mrawsin imvebbôen. Inna Öebbi: "Nek yidwen ma téullem, tzekkam, tumnem s imazanen iW, u tâawnem ten, tôevlem i Öebbi aôeîîal igerzen. War ccekk, ad awen Kkse$ tucmitin nnwen, a kwen Skecme$ di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Win ijehlen segwen, deffir waya, ni$ innetlaf seg ubrid umâin".

verses.text: Imi ooan laâqed nnsen, Nexza ten, Nesgursel ulawen nnsen. Ssexsaôen inumak n wawalen, ppun amur n wayen i$ef pwafekkôen. Mazal a d temlilev d lexdaâ nnsen, siwa drus segsen. Semmeê asen u ssuref. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Imi ooan laâqed nnsen, Nexza ten, Nesgursel ulawen nnsen. Ssexsaôen inumak n wawalen, ppun amur n wayen i$ef pwafekkôen. Mazal a d temlilev d lexdaâ nnsen, siwa drus segsen. Semmeê asen u ssuref. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Wid iqqaôen: "nekwni d imasiêiyen", Nerra laâqed yidsen, ppun amur n wayen i$ef pwafekkôen. Nessker ed, garasen, taâdawt akked dd$el, ar ass n tnekra. Deqqal a ten Ixebbeô Öebbi $ef wayen la ûenâan.
verses.translation: Wid iqqaôen: "nekwni d imasiêiyen", Nerra laâqed yidsen, ppun amur n wayen i$ef pwafekkôen. Nessker ed, garasen, taâdawt akked dd$el, ar ass n tnekra. Deqqal a ten Ixebbeô Öebbi $ef wayen la ûenâan.

verses.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan nne£. Ad awen ibeggen aîas n wayen la teppeffrem, n Tezmamt. Ad Ipsemmiê i waîas. Ni$ tusa kwen id tafat s$uô Öebbi, akked Tezmamt ipbegginen.
verses.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan nne£. Ad awen ibeggen aîas n wayen la teppeffrem, n Tezmamt. Ad Ipsemmiê i waîas. Ni$ tusa kwen id tafat s$uô Öebbi, akked Tezmamt ipbegginen.

verses.text: Inehhu yis Öebbi, ar iberdan n tifrat, wid iôe$ben llza S. A ten Issuffe$ si tillas ar tafat, s tsriê iS. A ten Inhu s abrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Inehhu yis Öebbi, ar iberdan n tifrat, wid iôe$ben llza S. A ten Issuffe$ si tillas ar tafat, s tsriê iS. A ten Inhu s abrid uwqim.

verses.text: Ni$ jehlen wid innan: "Öebbi, s tidep, d lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem". Ini: "anwa isâan kra n lkwelf, s$uô Öebbi, ma ihwa yaS ad Ine$ lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem, imma s, akked wayen akw illan di tmurt"? N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ni$ jehlen wid innan: "Öebbi, s tidep, d lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem". Ini: "anwa isâan kra n lkwelf, s$uô Öebbi, ma ihwa yaS ad Ine$ lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem, imma s, akked wayen akw illan di tmurt"? N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Udayen akked imasiêiyen, nnan: "nekwni d tarwa n Öebbi, d wid Ismenyaf". Ini: "acimi, ihi, ikwen Ipâaqab $ef ibekkaven nnwen? Xaîi, kunwi d imexlaq am wiyav". Ad Isemmeê i win i S ihwan, ad Iâaqeb win i S ihwan. N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Taggara $uôeS.
verses.translation: Udayen akked imasiêiyen, nnan: "nekwni d tarwa n Öebbi, d wid Ismenyaf". Ini: "acimi, ihi, ikwen Ipâaqab $ef ibekkaven nnwen? Xaîi, kunwi d imexlaq am wiyav". Ad Isemmeê i win i S ihwan, ad Iâaqeb win i S ihwan. N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Taggara $uôeS.

verses.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan nne£, ad awen ibeggen, mi tâadda tallit war imazanen. Akka ur d teqqaôem ara: "ur a$ d iusi ubeccaô, ne$ uneddaô". Ihi, iusa kwen id ubeccaô, uneddaô. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan nne£, ad awen ibeggen, mi tâadda tallit war imazanen. Akka ur d teqqaôem ara: "ur a$ d iusi ubeccaô, ne$ uneddaô". Ihi, iusa kwen id ubeccaô, uneddaô. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi. Irra segwen lambiyya, Irra kwen d igeldan. Ifka yawen ayen ur Ifki i yiwen, deg imavalen.
verses.translation: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi. Irra segwen lambiyya, Irra kwen d igeldan. Ifka yawen ayen ur Ifki i yiwen, deg imavalen.

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Kecmet akal iôqan, i wen Iura Öebbi. Ur d ppu$alet $er deffir wen, a d tegwrim txesôem".
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Kecmet akal iôqan, i wen Iura Öebbi. Ur d ppu$alet $er deffir wen, a d tegwrim txesôem".

verses.text: Nnan: "a Musa! Degs agdud iâafriten, nekwni ur p nkeççem, d awez$i, alamma ff$en d segs. Mi d ff$en segs, a nekcem".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a Musa! Degs agdud iâafriten, nekwni ur p nkeççem, d awez$i, alamma ff$en d segs. Mi d ff$en segs, a nekcem".

verses.text: Sin irgazen, seg wid iugaden - Isâad iten Öebbi -, nnan: "kecmet $uôsen si tebburt; ma tkecmem, kunwi, ih, a prebêem. Ppeklet af Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
verses.translation: Sin irgazen, seg wid iugaden - Isâad iten Öebbi -, nnan: "kecmet $uôsen si tebburt; ma tkecmem, kunwi, ih, a prebêem. Ppeklet af Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".

verses.text: Nnan: "a Musa! Nekwni ur p nkeççem, d awez$i, skud mazal iten degs. Öuê, keçç d Mass ik, nna$et. Nekwni a neqqim dagi".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a Musa! Nekwni ur p nkeççem, d awez$i, skud mazal iten degs. Öuê, keçç d Mass ik, nna$et. Nekwni a neqqim dagi".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Ay melke$, nek, siwa iman iw akked gma; ihi, Semfaôeq a$ d ugdud".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Ay melke$, nek, siwa iman iw akked gma; ihi, Semfaôeq a$ d ugdud".

verses.text: Inna: "ihi, tamurt agi tepwagdel asen. Ukuéet iseggwasen ad menîaôen di lberr. Ur $webben $ef ugdud iballa$en".
verses.translation: Inna: "ihi, tamurt agi tepwagdel asen. Ukuéet iseggwasen ad menîaôen di lberr. Ur $webben $ef ugdud iballa$en".

verses.text: Eêku yasen, s tidep, taqûit n sin warrac n Adem, mi îêeggan i sin. S$uô yiwen tepwaqbel. S$uô wayev ur tepwaqbel ara. Inna: "war ccekk, a k n$e$". Inna: "Iqebbel kan Öebbi îêegga s$uô wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Eêku yasen, s tidep, taqûit n sin warrac n Adem, mi îêeggan i sin. S$uô yiwen tepwaqbel. S$uô wayev ur tepwaqbel ara. Inna: "war ccekk, a k n$e$". Inna: "Iqebbel kan Öebbi îêegga s$uô wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Ma ibbwev iyi d ufus ik, ad iyi ten$ev, nek, ur k id ippawev ufus iw, a k n$e$. Nek, ppagwade$ Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
verses.translation: Ma ibbwev iyi d ufus ik, ad iyi ten$ev, nek, ur k id ippawev ufus iw, a k n$e$. Nek, ppagwade$ Öebbi, Mass imavalen.

verses.text: Nek, b$i$ a ppawiv abekkav iw, akked ubekkav ik, a ppiliv seg wat tmes. Winna d aqeîîi imednas".
verses.translation: Nek, b$i$ a ppawiv abekkav iw, akked ubekkav ik, a ppiliv seg wat tmes. Winna d aqeîîi imednas".

verses.text: Iaâzem, deg iman is, ad ine$ gma s, d$a in$a t. Igwra d seg imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Iaâzem, deg iman is, ad ine$ gma s, d$a in$a t. Igwra d seg imexsuôen.

verses.text: Iuzen ed Öebbi tagerfa, tkeôôev akal, iwakken ad as tessenâat amek ara i$umm loeppa n gma s. Inna: "a ssexv iw! Ur bbwive$ ad ili$ am tgerfa yagi, ad $umme$ loeppa n gma". Igwra d seg wid inedmen.
verses.translation: Iuzen ed Öebbi tagerfa, tkeôôev akal, iwakken ad as tessenâat amek ara i$umm loeppa n gma s. Inna: "a ssexv iw! Ur bbwive$ ad ili$ am tgerfa yagi, ad $umme$ loeppa n gma". Igwra d seg wid inedmen.

verses.text: Ilmend n waya, Nura i At Isôail, ar win in$an amdan ur nen$i yiwen, ur nessefsed di tmurt, amzun in$a imdanen meôôa. Win issadren yiwen, amzun issader imdanen meôôa. Ni$ usan ten id imazanen nne£, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir waya, s tidep, aîas degsen ssuguten di tmurt.
verses.translation: Ilmend n waya, Nura i At Isôail, ar win in$an amdan ur nen$i yiwen, ur nessefsed di tmurt, amzun in$a imdanen meôôa. Win issadren yiwen, amzun issader imdanen meôôa. Ni$ usan ten id imazanen nne£, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir waya, s tidep, aîas degsen ssuguten di tmurt.

verses.text: Aqeîîi n wid ipna$en Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u ssenkaren asefsed di tmurt, siwa timen$iwt, ne$ asemmeô $ef umidag, ne$ anegzum ufus sya, uvaô sya, ne$ anfay si tmurt. Ayagi, d aqeîîi nnsen di ddunit. Di laxeôt, fellasen aâaqeb ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Aqeîîi n wid ipna$en Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u ssenkaren asefsed di tmurt, siwa timen$iwt, ne$ asemmeô $ef umidag, ne$ anegzum ufus sya, uvaô sya, ne$ anfay si tmurt. Ayagi, d aqeîîi nnsen di ddunit. Di laxeôt, fellasen aâaqeb ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Kkes ed wid inedmen, uqbel a pvebbôem fellasen. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Kkes ed wid inedmen, uqbel a pvebbôem fellasen. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, nadit a pqeôôbem $uôeS, nna$et deg ubrid iS, amar a prebêem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, nadit a pqeôôbem $uôeS, nna$et deg ubrid iS, amar a prebêem.

verses.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, xas ad sâun i illan akw di tmurt, rnu yas win i t icban, iwakken ad fdun, yis, iman nnsen seg uâaqeb, ass n tnekra, ur ipwaqbal segsen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, xas ad sâun i illan akw di tmurt, rnu yas win i t icban, iwakken ad fdun, yis, iman nnsen seg uâaqeb, ass n tnekra, ur ipwaqbal segsen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ad b$un a d ff$en si tmes, ur llin d wid id iteff$en. Fellasen aâaqeb imezgi.
verses.translation: Ad b$un a d ff$en si tmes, ur llin d wid id iteff$en. Fellasen aâaqeb imezgi.

verses.text: Amakwar, tamakwart, gezmet asen ifassen nnsen, d aqeîîi n wayen xedmen, d aâaqeb s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Amakwar, tamakwart, gezmet asen ifassen nnsen, d aqeîîi n wayen xedmen, d aâaqeb s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Win inedmen, deffir ddens is, u iu$al d aâôvi, ad as Issuref Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Win inedmen, deffir ddens is, u iu$al d aâôvi, ad as Issuref Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Day ur teéôiv ara n Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Ipâaqab win i S ihwan, Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Day ur teéôiv ara n Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Ipâaqab win i S ihwan, Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Ur k $weblen wid ip$awalen ar tijehli, seg wid iqqaôen numen, s imawen nnsen, ur uminen wulawen nnsen, seg wudayen issemêasen i tikerkas, issemêasen i ugdud nniven, ur d nusi $uôek. Pbeddilen awalen deffir ussefhem nnsen. Qqaôen: "ma ippunefk awen d waya, ddemt ep; ma ur awen d ippunefk ara, $uôwat"! Win Ib$a Öebbi a t Ihewwel, ur t tepsellikev, s wacemma, seg ufus n Öebbi. Widak, d wid iwumi ur Ib$a ara Öebbi, ad izdigen wulawen nnsen. Di ddunit ad pwaxzun. Di laxeôt fellasen aâaqeb abarar.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Ur k $weblen wid ip$awalen ar tijehli, seg wid iqqaôen numen, s imawen nnsen, ur uminen wulawen nnsen, seg wudayen issemêasen i tikerkas, issemêasen i ugdud nniven, ur d nusi $uôek. Pbeddilen awalen deffir ussefhem nnsen. Qqaôen: "ma ippunefk awen d waya, ddemt ep; ma ur awen d ippunefk ara, $uôwat"! Win Ib$a Öebbi a t Ihewwel, ur t tepsellikev, s wacemma, seg ufus n Öebbi. Widak, d wid iwumi ur Ib$a ara Öebbi, ad izdigen wulawen nnsen. Di ddunit ad pwaxzun. Di laxeôt fellasen aâaqeb abarar.

verses.text: Wid issemêasen i tikerkas, iteppen leêôam, ma usan k id, fru garasen, ne$ eoo iten. Ma teooiv ten, ur k îîuôôun s wacemma. Ma têuddev, êudd garasen s lmizan. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid iweznen.
verses.translation: Wid issemêasen i tikerkas, iteppen leêôam, ma usan k id, fru garasen, ne$ eoo iten. Ma teooiv ten, ur k îîuôôun s wacemma. Ma têuddev, êudd garasen s lmizan. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid iweznen.

verses.text: Amek ara k id asen, s aêuddu, u nitni sâan Tuôa, degs aêuddu n Öebbi? Sinna, deffir waya, ad wexxôen. Ur llin wigi si lmumnin.
verses.translation: Amek ara k id asen, s aêuddu, u nitni sâan Tuôa, degs aêuddu n Öebbi? Sinna, deffir waya, ad wexxôen. Ur llin wigi si lmumnin.

verses.text: Ih, Nessers ed Tuôa, degs nnhaya akked tafat, ferrun yis ger wudayen, lambiyya imvuâen. U iôabaniyen akked lecyux seg wayen jemâen, si Tezmamt n Öebbi, u llan d inagan is. Ur ppagwadet imdanen, agwadet iyI. Ur d ppa$et, s issekniyen iW, ayen ôxisen. Wid ur nepêuddu yara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ih, Nessers ed Tuôa, degs nnhaya akked tafat, ferrun yis ger wudayen, lambiyya imvuâen. U iôabaniyen akked lecyux seg wayen jemâen, si Tezmamt n Öebbi, u llan d inagan is. Ur ppagwadet imdanen, agwadet iyI. Ur d ppa$et, s issekniyen iW, ayen ôxisen. Wid ur nepêuddu yara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d ijehliyen.

verses.text: Nura yasen degs: ôôuê s ôôuê, tiî s tiî, anzaren s wanzaren, ameééu$ s umeééu$, tu$mest s tu$mest, leoruê ad ppuêesben. Win iooan, d le$ôama s. Wid ur nepêuddu yara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d imednas.
verses.translation: Nura yasen degs: ôôuê s ôôuê, tiî s tiî, anzaren s wanzaren, ameééu$ s umeééu$, tu$mest s tu$mest, leoruê ad ppuêesben. Win iooan, d le$ôama s. Wid ur nepêuddu yara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d imednas.

verses.text: Nuzen ed, deffir sen, Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuôa. Nefka yas Linoil, degs nnhaya akked tafat, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuôa. D nnhaya u d anabi i wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Nuzen ed, deffir sen, Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuôa. Nefka yas Linoil, degs nnhaya akked tafat, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuôa. D nnhaya u d anabi i wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: At Linoil, iwata ad êudden s wayen id Issers, degs, Öebbi. Wid ur nêudd ara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d iballa$en.
verses.translation: At Linoil, iwata ad êudden s wayen id Issers, degs, Öebbi. Wid ur nêudd ara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d iballa$en.

verses.text: Nessers ak d Tazmamt, s tidep, a d tebbet ayen ip id izwaren n Tezmamt. Nvemn ip. Ihi, êudd garasen s wayen id Issers Öebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen, beôôa n wayen i k id iusan n tidep. I yal wa, Nefka lqanun akked ubrid. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Irra kwen d yiwen n lois. Maca, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb $ef wayen i wen Ifka, mzizlet ar lxiô. Ar Öebbi tu$alin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen tellam temgarradem.
verses.translation: Nessers ak d Tazmamt, s tidep, a d tebbet ayen ip id izwaren n Tezmamt. Nvemn ip. Ihi, êudd garasen s wayen id Issers Öebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen, beôôa n wayen i k id iusan n tidep. I yal wa, Nefka lqanun akked ubrid. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Irra kwen d yiwen n lois. Maca, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb $ef wayen i wen Ifka, mzizlet ar lxiô. Ar Öebbi tu$alin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen tellam temgarradem.

verses.text: Ëudd garasen s wayen id Issers Öebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen. £uôek a k hewwlen $ef kra seg wayen i k d Issers Öebbi. Ma wexxôen, éeô ar Öebbi Ib$a kan a ten Iwwet $ef kra ibekkaven nnsen. Ih, aîas n medden d iballa$en.
verses.translation: Ëudd garasen s wayen id Issers Öebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen. £uôek a k hewwlen $ef kra seg wayen i k d Issers Öebbi. Ma wexxôen, éeô ar Öebbi Ib$a kan a ten Iwwet $ef kra ibekkaven nnsen. Ih, aîas n medden d iballa$en.

verses.text: Day b$an aêuddu n zzman n war tussna? Anwa yifen Öebbi d Amêaddi, i ugdud ineûêen liman?
verses.translation: Day b$an aêuddu n zzman n war tussna? Anwa yifen Öebbi d Amêaddi, i ugdud ineûêen liman?

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat, d iêbiben, udayen akked imasiêiyen. Garasen d iêbiben. Win, segwen, i ten irran d iêbiben, ad yili segsen. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat, d iêbiben, udayen akked imasiêiyen. Garasen d iêbiben. Win, segwen, i ten irran d iêbiben, ad yili segsen. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

verses.text: A pwaliv imuvan n wul, ppazzalen $uôsen, qqaôen asen: "nugad ay d itezzin fella$". Ahat a d Ias Öebbi s l$elb, ne$ s lameô s$uôeS. A d gwrin di nndama, $ef wayen ffren deg iman nnsen.
verses.translation: A pwaliv imuvan n wul, ppazzalen $uôsen, qqaôen asen: "nugad ay d itezzin fella$". Ahat a d Ias Öebbi s l$elb, ne$ s lameô s$uôeS. A d gwrin di nndama, $ef wayen ffren deg iman nnsen.

verses.text: A d inin wid iumnen: "day d wigi i iggullen s Öebbi, tagallit meqqwôen, ar nitni llan yidwen"? Mêan igiten nnsen, gwran d d imexsuôen.
verses.translation: A d inin wid iumnen: "day d wigi i iggullen s Öebbi, tagallit meqqwôen, ar nitni llan yidwen"? Mêan igiten nnsen, gwran d d imexsuôen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Win segwen iooan ddin is…, ihi, deqqal Öebbi a d Iawi agdud Iêemmel, i T iêemmlen; ad ôavin lmumnin, ad qesêen ar ijehliyen. Ad nna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur ppagwaden alummu n win iplummun. Ayagi d lfevl n Öebbi, Ippak it i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Win segwen iooan ddin is…, ihi, deqqal Öebbi a d Iawi agdud Iêemmel, i T iêemmlen; ad ôavin lmumnin, ad qesêen ar ijehliyen. Ad nna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur ppagwaden alummu n win iplummun. Ayagi d lfevl n Öebbi, Ippak it i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Imawlan nnwen siwa Öebbi akked Umazan iS, wid iumnen, wid ipéallan, pzekkin, u nitni îîinizen.
verses.translation: Imawlan nnwen siwa Öebbi akked Umazan iS, wid iumnen, wid ipéallan, pzekkin, u nitni îîinizen.

verses.text: Wid irran d imawlan nnsen, Öebbi, Amazan iS, akked wid iumnen…, ih, akabar n Öebbi, d nitni ara irebêen.
verses.translation: Wid irran d imawlan nnsen, Öebbi, Amazan iS, akked wid iumnen…, ih, akabar n Öebbi, d nitni ara irebêen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d iêbiben wid id ilhan, di ddin nnwen, s wurar d utihi, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akw seg ijehliyen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d iêbiben wid id ilhan, di ddin nnwen, s wurar d utihi, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akw seg ijehliyen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

verses.text: Ma teddnem i téallit, fellas ad mmaâlken, ad uraren. Ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nefhim.
verses.translation: Ma teddnem i téallit, fellas ad mmaâlken, ad uraren. Ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nefhim.

verses.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acu i$ef la $ ttehmem, siwa imi numen s Öebbi, akked wayen id Issers $uône$, akked wayen id Issers uqbel? Tegwti degwen d iballa$en".
verses.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acu i$ef la $ ttehmem, siwa imi numen s Öebbi, akked wayen id Issers $uône$, akked wayen id Issers uqbel? Tegwti degwen d iballa$en".

verses.text: Ini: "ad awen mle$ aqeîîi n Öebbi icemten sennig wagi? Wid Ixza Öebbi, sserfan T, Irra ten d iddawen, d ilfawen". Âabden iôebbiten n tkerkas. Widak, atnan di liêala tucmip mavi, di ttelfan u$miq seg ubrid uûwib.
verses.translation: Ini: "ad awen mle$ aqeîîi n Öebbi icemten sennig wagi? Wid Ixza Öebbi, sserfan T, Irra ten d iddawen, d ilfawen". Âabden iôebbiten n tkerkas. Widak, atnan di liêala tucmip mavi, di ttelfan u$miq seg ubrid uûwib.

verses.text: Mi d usan $uôwen, qqaôen: "numen". Ni$ kecmen d s tijehli, u nitni ff$en yis. Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen, ayen teffren.
verses.translation: Mi d usan $uôwen, qqaôen: "numen". Ni$ kecmen d s tijehli, u nitni ff$en yis. Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen, ayen teffren.

verses.text: La tepwaliv aîas, degsen, p$awalen ar ubekkav akked wanfal, teppen leêôam. I icmet wayen xeddmen!
verses.translation: La tepwaliv aîas, degsen, p$awalen ar ubekkav akked wanfal, teppen leêôam. I icmet wayen xeddmen!

verses.text: A lemmer i sen kksen iôabiyen akked lecyax, awal ubekkav akked wuççi n leêôam? I icmet wayen la ûenâen!
verses.translation: A lemmer i sen kksen iôabiyen akked lecyax, awal ubekkav akked wuççi n leêôam? I icmet wayen la ûenâen!

verses.text: Qqaôen wudayen: "iskkweô ufus n Öebbi". D ifassen nnsen i isekkwôen. Pwaxzan ilmend n wayen d qqaôen. Xaîi! Ifassen iS llin, Ip$iti akken i S ihwa. Ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu i waîas segsen, leb$wev akked tijehli. Nessker garasen cceêna, akked dd$el, ar ass n tnekra. Yal tikelt ara caâlen times i îôad, a p Issexsi Öebbi. Pnadin asefsed di tmurt. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara ifessaden.
verses.translation: Qqaôen wudayen: "iskkweô ufus n Öebbi". D ifassen nnsen i isekkwôen. Pwaxzan ilmend n wayen d qqaôen. Xaîi! Ifassen iS llin, Ip$iti akken i S ihwa. Ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu i waîas segsen, leb$wev akked tijehli. Nessker garasen cceêna, akked dd$el, ar ass n tnekra. Yal tikelt ara caâlen times i îôad, a p Issexsi Öebbi. Pnadin asefsed di tmurt. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara ifessaden.

verses.text: At Tezmamt, lemmer day umnen u êezzben, yili, war ccekk, Nekkes asen tucmitin nnsen, u Nesskecm iten ar leonanat isaâdiyen.
verses.translation: At Tezmamt, lemmer day umnen u êezzben, yili, war ccekk, Nekkes asen tucmitin nnsen, u Nesskecm iten ar leonanat isaâdiyen.

verses.text: Lemmer day îîifen di Tuôa akked Linoil, akked wayen i sen d irsen s$uô Mass nnsen, war ccekk, ad ççen sennig sen, akw seddaw ivaôen nnsen. Illa garasen lois iôeznen. Aîas, degsen, dirit wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Lemmer day îîifen di Tuôa akked Linoil, akked wayen i sen d irsen s$uô Mass nnsen, war ccekk, ad ççen sennig sen, akw seddaw ivaôen nnsen. Illa garasen lois iôeznen. Aîas, degsen, dirit wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: A yAmazan, mel ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik. Ma ur t temliv ara, ur tessawvev ara tabrap iS. Öebbi a k Ifukk si l$aci. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
verses.translation: A yAmazan, mel ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik. Ma ur t temliv ara, ur tessawvev ara tabrap iS. Öebbi a k Ifukk si l$aci. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur tellim deg wacemma, alamma teddam d Tuôa, Linoil, akked wayen i wen d irsen, s$uô Mass nnwen". Ayen i k d irsen s$uô Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu, i waîas segsen, leb$wev akked tijehli. Ur $webbel $ef ugdud ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur tellim deg wacemma, alamma teddam d Tuôa, Linoil, akked wayen i wen d irsen, s$uô Mass nnwen". Ayen i k d irsen s$uô Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu, i waîas segsen, leb$wev akked tijehli. Ur $webbel $ef ugdud ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, iûabiyen, imasiêiyen, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, iûabiyen, imasiêiyen, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: Ni$ Nga laâqed i At Isôail, Nuzen asen imazanen. Yal tikelt ara ten id ias umazan s wayen ur asen nehwi, wa a t skiddben, wa a t n$en.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nga laâqed i At Isôail, Nuzen asen imazanen. Yal tikelt ara ten id ias umazan s wayen ur asen nehwi, wa a t skiddben, wa a t n$en.

verses.text: £ilen ur ippili uhewwel. Dre$len, âaégen. Sinna, Issuref asen Öebbi. Sinna, aîas degsen dre$len, âaégen. Öebbi Ipwali acu xeddmen.
verses.translation: £ilen ur ippili uhewwel. Dre$len, âaégen. Sinna, Issuref asen Öebbi. Sinna, aîas degsen dre$len, âaégen. Öebbi Ipwali acu xeddmen.

verses.text: Ni$ jehlen wid iqqaôen: "Öebbi, s tidep, d lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem". U inna lmasiê: "a yAt Isôail! Âabdet Öebbi, Mass iw, d Mass nnwen". Ih, win icerken i Öebbi, Igdel as Öebbi Loennet. Axxam is d times. Ur llin isellaken i imednas.
verses.translation: Ni$ jehlen wid iqqaôen: "Öebbi, s tidep, d lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem". U inna lmasiê: "a yAt Isôail! Âabdet Öebbi, Mass iw, d Mass nnwen". Ih, win icerken i Öebbi, Igdel as Öebbi Loennet. Axxam is d times. Ur llin isellaken i imednas.

verses.text: Ni$ jehlen wid iqqaôen: "Ih, Öebbi d wis krav n krav". Ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi Yiwen. Ma ur xvin ara i wayen qqaôen, war ccekk, aâaqeb aqeôêan ad iêaz wid ijehlen segsen.
verses.translation: Ni$ jehlen wid iqqaôen: "Ih, Öebbi d wis krav n krav". Ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi Yiwen. Ma ur xvin ara i wayen qqaôen, war ccekk, aâaqeb aqeôêan ad iêaz wid ijehlen segsen.

verses.text: Day ur tuben ara ar Öebbi, u ssuturen aS ssmaê? Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Day ur tuben ara ar Öebbi, u ssuturen aS ssmaê? Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem, d amazan kan. Ni$ âaddan, uqbel is, imazanen. Imma s tessawal tidep. Llan teppen lqut. Wali amek i asen Nepbeggin issekniyen; sinna, wali amek la ppagwin.
verses.translation: Lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem, d amazan kan. Ni$ âaddan, uqbel is, imazanen. Imma s tessawal tidep. Llan teppen lqut. Wali amek i asen Nepbeggin issekniyen; sinna, wali amek la ppagwin.

verses.text: Ini: "day a ppaâbdem, war Öebbi, ayen ur nezmir a kwen ivuôô, ne$ a kwen infaâ"? Öebbi, Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ini: "day a ppaâbdem, war Öebbi, ayen ur nezmir a kwen ivuôô, ne$ a kwen infaâ"? Öebbi, Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur rennut, di ddin nnwen, ayen ur nelli d tidep. Ur teddut d lemcihwat n ugdud innetlafen zik, i itelfen aîas, u telfen seg ubrid uûwib.
verses.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur rennut, di ddin nnwen, ayen ur nelli d tidep. Ur teddut d lemcihwat n ugdud innetlafen zik, i itelfen aîas, u telfen seg ubrid uûwib.

verses.text: Pwaxzan wid ijehlen, seg wAt Isôail, s$uô iles n Dawed akked Âisa, mmi s n Meryem; ayagi, $ef wayen âuûan, u zgaren tilas.
verses.translation: Pwaxzan wid ijehlen, seg wAt Isôail, s$uô iles n Dawed akked Âisa, mmi s n Meryem; ayagi, $ef wayen âuûan, u zgaren tilas.

verses.text: Ur ppemyekkasen ayen xedmen n dir. I icmet wayen xeddmen!
verses.translation: Ur ppemyekkasen ayen xedmen n dir. I icmet wayen xeddmen!

verses.text: A pwaliv aîas segsen, ad xalven wid ijehlen. War ccekk, icmet wayen xedmen i iman nnsen. Ad Izâaf Öebbi fellasen. Nitni ad wekkôen deg uâaqeb.
verses.translation: A pwaliv aîas segsen, ad xalven wid ijehlen. War ccekk, icmet wayen xedmen i iman nnsen. Ad Izâaf Öebbi fellasen. Nitni ad wekkôen deg uâaqeb.

verses.text: Lemmer uminen s Öebbi, Nnbi, akked wayen i sen d irsen, ur ten pparan d iêbiben. Maca aîas, segsen, d iballa$en.
verses.translation: Lemmer uminen s Öebbi, Nnbi, akked wayen i sen d irsen, ur ten pparan d iêbiben. Maca aîas, segsen, d iballa$en.

verses.text: A ppafev icenga iqeûêanen mavi, n wid iumnen, d udayen akked wid ipcaraken. A ppafev wid iqeôben mavi, s lmaênana, ar wid iumnen, d wid innan: "nekwni d imasiêiyen". Ayagi, acku llan degsen ixelwiyen, iôehbaniyen, u nitni ur sme$wôen ara iman nnsen.
verses.translation: A ppafev icenga iqeûêanen mavi, n wid iumnen, d udayen akked wid ipcaraken. A ppafev wid iqeôben mavi, s lmaênana, ar wid iumnen, d wid innan: "nekwni d imasiêiyen". Ayagi, acku llan degsen ixelwiyen, iôehbaniyen, u nitni ur sme$wôen ara iman nnsen.

verses.text: Ma slan i wayen id iusan ar Umazan, a pwaliv allen nnsen ççuôent d imeîîi, seg wayen ufan n tidep. Qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Numen, Aru ya$ seg inagan.
verses.translation: Ma slan i wayen id iusan ar Umazan, a pwaliv allen nnsen ççuôent d imeîîi, seg wayen ufan n tidep. Qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Numen, Aru ya$ seg inagan.

verses.text: Acu i $ iu$en ur numin s Öebbi akked wayen i $ d iusan n tidep; ur nessarem a $ Issekcem, Mass nne$, s agdud iâaôviyen"?
verses.translation: Acu i $ iu$en ur numin s Öebbi akked wayen i $ d iusan n tidep; ur nessarem a $ Issekcem, Mass nne$, s agdud iâaôviyen"?

verses.text: A ten Ioazi Öebbi, $ef wayen d qqaôen, s leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. Wagi d aoazi n lâuûam.
verses.translation: A ten Ioazi Öebbi, $ef wayen d qqaôen, s leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. Wagi d aoazi n lâuûam.

verses.text: Wid ijehlen, u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak, d at Loahennama.
verses.translation: Wid ijehlen, u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak, d at Loahennama.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pgeddilet ayen imaânen i wen Iêell Öebbi. Ur zegret tilas. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pgeddilet ayen imaânen i wen Iêell Öebbi. Ur zegret tilas. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.

verses.text: Eççet seg wayen ikwen Iôéeq Öebbi, iêellen, imaânen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. YiS, kunwi, ay tumnem.
verses.translation: Eççet seg wayen ikwen Iôéeq Öebbi, iêellen, imaânen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. YiS, kunwi, ay tumnem.

verses.text: Ur kwen Ipqassa Öebbi $ef tgallit n tkerkas. Maca, a kwen Iqiss $ef tgallit n ûûeê. Takweffaôt is: a ppecceççem mraw ime$ban, akken tecceççam tawacult nnwen, ne$ a ten tesselsem, ne$ a pserêem i wakli. Win ur nwâa ara, ad iuéum krav wussan. D tagi ay d takweffaôt n tgallit nnwen, ma teggullem. Eîîfet di tgallit nnwen. Akka i wen d Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a ppesnemmrem.
verses.translation: Ur kwen Ipqassa Öebbi $ef tgallit n tkerkas. Maca, a kwen Iqiss $ef tgallit n ûûeê. Takweffaôt is: a ppecceççem mraw ime$ban, akken tecceççam tawacult nnwen, ne$ a ten tesselsem, ne$ a pserêem i wakli. Win ur nwâa ara, ad iuéum krav wussan. D tagi ay d takweffaôt n tgallit nnwen, ma teggullem. Eîîfet di tgallit nnwen. Akka i wen d Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ccôab, leqwmeô, tiâancuôin, taseqqaôt, d ayen kan icemten, seg igi n Cciîan. Ihi, veôôeft asen, amar a prebêem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ccôab, leqwmeô, tiâancuôin, taseqqaôt, d ayen kan icemten, seg igi n Cciîan. Ihi, veôôeft asen, amar a prebêem.

verses.text: Ib$a kan Cciîan ad isker ticenga akked dd$el garawen, s ccôab akked leqwmeô, a kwen iveôôef seg usmekti n Öebbi, akked téallit. Day ur tepfukkum ara?
verses.translation: Ib$a kan Cciîan ad isker ticenga akked dd$el garawen, s ccôab akked leqwmeô, a kwen iveôôef seg usmekti n Öebbi, akked téallit. Day ur tepfukkum ara?

verses.text: A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan. £uôwat! Ma twexxôem, cfut ar Amazan, iwata yas kan anabi ipbegginen.
verses.translation: A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan. £uôwat! Ma twexxôem, cfut ar Amazan, iwata yas kan anabi ipbegginen.

verses.text: Ur telli tiyta deg wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, $ef wayen ççan, ma êezzben, umnen, xedmen ayen ilhan, sinna êezzben, umnen, sinna, êezzben u maânen. Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam.
verses.translation: Ur telli tiyta deg wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, $ef wayen ççan, ma êezzben, umnen, xedmen ayen ilhan, sinna êezzben, umnen, sinna, êezzben u maânen. Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! War ccekk, a kwen Iweddeb Öebbi $ef wayen tepûeggidem s ifassen nnwen, u s ixtucen nnwen, iwakken ad Iéeô Öebbi anwa i T ippagwaden, di tbavnit. Win izegren tilas, deffir waya, fellas aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! War ccekk, a kwen Iweddeb Öebbi $ef wayen tepûeggidem s ifassen nnwen, u s ixtucen nnwen, iwakken ad Iéeô Öebbi anwa i T ippagwaden, di tbavnit. Win izegren tilas, deffir waya, fellas aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pûeggidet di zzyaôa nnwen. Win iûeggden segwen, u iâammed, aqeîîi: ad iseddeq, si lmal is, ayen in$a s ûûyada s, a d êudden, f waya, sin irgazen iêesbiyen segwen. D tikci ara iawven ar Lkaâba. Ne$ takweffaôt: ad icceçç ime$ban, ne$, ayen iswan aya, ad iuéum. Ad ijeôôeb vveôô n lameô is. Öebbi Isemmeê i wayen iâaddan. Win iu$alen a d Irr Öebbi segs ppaô. Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.
