D tikci ara iawven ar Lkaâba. Ne$ takweffaôt: ad icceçç ime$ban, ne$, ayen iswan aya, ad iuéum. Ad ijeôôeb vveôô n lameô is. Öebbi Isemmeê i wayen iâaddan. Win iu$alen a d Irr Öebbi segs ppaô. Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.

verses.text: Têell awen ûûyada n yill akked uççi s. D lqut i kunwi akw iminigen. Tepwagdel awen ûûyada di tmurt, skud aql akwen d zziyyaô. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, $uôeS ara tepwafesrem.
verses.translation: Têell awen ûûyada n yill akked uççi s. D lqut i kunwi akw iminigen. Tepwagdel awen ûûyada di tmurt, skud aql akwen d zziyyaô. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, $uôeS ara tepwafesrem.

verses.text: Irra Öebbi Lkaâba d axxam iôqan ipwabnan i l$aci, aggur iôqan, asfel, isenoaq, ayagi iwakken a ppeéôem ar Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg igenwan u di tmurt, u Öebbi Issen yal cci.
verses.translation: Irra Öebbi Lkaâba d axxam iôqan ipwabnan i l$aci, aggur iôqan, asfel, isenoaq, ayagi iwakken a ppeéôem ar Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg igenwan u di tmurt, u Öebbi Issen yal cci.

verses.text: Cfut iwâaô uâaqeb n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Cfut iwâaô uâaqeb n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Amazan, iwata yas kan unabi. Öebbi Iéôa ayen temmalem u ayen teppeffrem.
verses.translation: Amazan, iwata yas kan unabi. Öebbi Iéôa ayen temmalem u ayen teppeffrem.

verses.text: Ini: "ur iaâdil ara wayen n dir akked wayen imaânen", xas teswehm ik lkwetôa n wayen n dir. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, a yuâqilen, amar a prebêem.
verses.translation: Ini: "ur iaâdil ara wayen n dir akked wayen imaânen", xas teswehm ik lkwetôa n wayen n dir. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, a yuâqilen, amar a prebêem.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur steqsayet $ef t$awsiwin ara kwen icwe$ben, ma mlan awen tent. Ma testeqsam fellasent mara d iprusu Leqwôan, ad awen ppufessrent. Öebbi Isemmeê aya. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur steqsayet $ef t$awsiwin ara kwen icwe$ben, ma mlan awen tent. Ma testeqsam fellasent mara d iprusu Leqwôan, ad awen ppufessrent. Öebbi Isemmeê aya. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.

verses.text: Ni$ isteqsa fellasent ugdud, uqbel nnwen. Sinna, segsent, gwran d d ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ni$ isteqsa fellasent ugdud, uqbel nnwen. Sinna, segsent, gwran d d ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ur d Ifki Öebbi Baêiôa, ne$ Sayba, ne$ Waûila, ne$ Ëami. Maca, wid ijehlen gren d tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Tegwti degsen ur fhimen.
verses.translation: Ur d Ifki Öebbi Baêiôa, ne$ Sayba, ne$ Waûila, ne$ Ëami. Maca, wid ijehlen gren d tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Tegwti degsen ur fhimen.

verses.text: Ma nnan asen: "yyaw ar wayen id Issers Öebbi, u ar Umazan". Qqaôen: "beôka ya$ ayen id nufa, $ef waya, $eô imezwura nne$". I ma imezwura nnsen ur ssinen acemma, ur pwanhan?
verses.translation: Ma nnan asen: "yyaw ar wayen id Issers Öebbi, u ar Umazan". Qqaôen: "beôka ya$ ayen id nufa, $ef waya, $eô imezwura nne$". I ma imezwura nnsen ur ssinen acemma, ur pwanhan?

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Fellawen iman nnwen. Ur kwen iîîuôôu win innetlafen, ma tepwanham. Ar Öebbi, tu$alin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Fellawen iman nnwen. Ur kwen iîîuôôu win innetlafen, ma tepwanham. Ar Öebbi, tu$alin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ccada garawen, ma tusa d tmeppant ar yiwen segwen. Di lawan uweûûi, sin irgazen iêesbiyen, segwen, ne$ wiyav war segwen, ma tellam d iminigen di tmurt, u tusa kwen id twa$it n tmeppant. A ten qesden deffir téallit. Ma tcukkem, sgallet pen s Öebbi: "ur d nesfayday syis, xas iaâna llzem nne$, ur nteffer ccada n Öebbi, mulac, nekwni a nili seg imednab".

verses.translation: Ma ivehô ed fellasen denben, ad ppuneûfen s wiyav, si loiha n wid vuôôen imezwura. Ad ggalen s Öebbi: "ih, ccada nne$ tif ccada nnsen. Ur nzegger tilas, mulac, war ccekk, a nili seg imednas".

verses.text: Ass ideg ara Issemlil Öebbi imazanen, ad Yini: "acu i wen d jawben"? Ad inin: "ur telli tussna $uône$. D Keçç, s tidep, i Issnen tibavniyin".

Ur iyi ippunefk ara a d ini$ ayen i$ef ur sâi$ lêeqq. Lemmer i t id nni$, yili Teéôiv t. Tesnev i illan deg iman iw, ur ssine$ ayen illan deg iman iK. Keçç, s tidep, d Amusnaw n tbavniyin.

verses.text: I asen nni$, siwa ayen iyi d Tumôev: âabdet Öebbi, Mass iw, u Mass nnwen. Lli$ d anagi nnsen, skud lli$ garasen. Mi iyi n Tessuliv $uôeK, d Keçç i ten id Iquôâan. Keçç, d Anagi n yal cci.
verses.translation: I asen nni$, siwa ayen iyi d Tumôev: âabdet Öebbi, Mass iw, u Mass nnwen. Lli$ d anagi nnsen, skud lli$ garasen. Mi iyi n Tessuliv $uôeK, d Keçç i ten id Iquôâan. Keçç, d Anagi n yal cci.

verses.text: Ma Tâaqbev ten, ni$ d imdanen iK, ma Tsemmêev asen, Keçç, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".
verses.translation: Ma Tâaqbev ten, ni$ d imdanen iK, ma Tsemmêev asen, Keçç, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".

verses.text: Inna Öebbi: "wagi d ass ideg ara stenfâan imawlan n tidep, si tidep nnsen. I nitni leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen, i lebda". Iôuva ten Öebbi, u ôuvan T, d wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Inna Öebbi: "wagi d ass ideg ara stenfâan imawlan n tidep, si tidep nnsen. I nitni leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen, i lebda". Iôuva ten Öebbi, u ôuvan T, d wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, akked wayen illan degsen. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, akked wayen illan degsen. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Eîîfet deg iâahden nnwen. Ëellen awen lmal n tejlibt, kkes ed wid i wen nnan. Ur awen têell ara ûûyada, mara têuoem. Öebbi, s tidep, Ippameô ayen i S ihwan.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Eîîfet deg iâahden nnwen. Ëellen awen lmal n tejlibt, kkes ed wid i wen nnan. Ur awen têell ara ûûyada, mara têuoem. Öebbi, s tidep, Ippameô ayen i S ihwan.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ssiôxiset isekkiren n Öebbi, aggur iôqan, îêegga, snaoeq, wid iteddun ar Uxxam n Lêaôam, saramen lfevl akked llza n Mass nnsen. Üegdet mi tfukkem. Xas tcuênem agdud i wen igedlen Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ur iwata ara a pzegrem tilas. Mâawanet ar yise$ akked uêezzeb, ur ppemâawanet ar ubekkav akked lbe$wv. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. S tidep, Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur ssiôxiset isekkiren n Öebbi, aggur iôqan, îêegga, snaoeq, wid iteddun ar Uxxam n Lêaôam, saramen lfevl akked llza n Mass nnsen. Üegdet mi tfukkem. Xas tcuênem agdud i wen igedlen Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ur iwata ara a pzegrem tilas. Mâawanet ar yise$ akked uêezzeb, ur ppemâawanet ar ubekkav akked lbe$wv. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. S tidep, Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: I wen ipwagedlen d loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, wayen ipwamezlen i war Öebbi, ayen ippuxenqen, ayen i pwaûerâan, ayen igrarben, ayen ippuberrzen, ayen içça lweêc - siwa ma tessawvem tezlam t -, îêegga i tezôa, aseqdec n tseqqaôt. Ayagi d ucmit. Assa, wid ijehlen uysen si ddin nnwen. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI. Assa, Nnekmale$ awen ddin nnwen, Tame$ awen l$it iW, Öuva$ awen annuz d ddin. Win terra tmara di tegwnip n llaé, ur iffi$ abrid, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: I wen ipwagedlen d loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, wayen ipwamezlen i war Öebbi, ayen ippuxenqen, ayen i pwaûerâan, ayen igrarben, ayen ippuberrzen, ayen içça lweêc - siwa ma tessawvem tezlam t -, îêegga i tezôa, aseqdec n tseqqaôt. Ayagi d ucmit. Assa, wid ijehlen uysen si ddin nnwen. Ur ten ppagwadet, agwadet iyI. Assa, Nnekmale$ awen ddin nnwen, Tame$ awen l$it iW, Öuva$ awen annuz d ddin. Win terra tmara di tegwnip n llaé, ur iffi$ abrid, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A k steqsayen acu i sen iêellen. Ini: "iêell awen wayen imaânen. Ayen d teppawin s lewêuc ipûeggiden. Tesêefvem asen ayen i wen Isseêfev Öebbi. Eççet seg wayen i wen d îîfen, mmektit ed fellas isem n Öebbi". Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
ayahs.translation: A k steqsayen acu i sen iêellen. Ini: "iêell awen wayen imaânen. Ayen d teppawin s lewêuc ipûeggiden. Tesêefvem asen ayen i wen Isseêfev Öebbi. Eççet seg wayen i wen d îîfen, mmektit ed fellas isem n Öebbi". Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

ayahs.text: Assa, iêell awen wayen imaânen. Iêell awen lqut n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, - iêell asen lqut nnwen -; tilawin tiêuôiyin iumnen, tilawin tiêuôiyin seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, ma tefkam asent tuççit nnsent; d uwqimen maççi d ucmiten, ur teppeddum d temddukwal. Win iugin liman, mêan igiten is. Neppa, di laxeôt, seg imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Assa, iêell awen wayen imaânen. Iêell awen lqut n wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, - iêell asen lqut nnwen -; tilawin tiêuôiyin iumnen, tilawin tiêuôiyin seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, ma tefkam asent tuççit nnsent; d uwqimen maççi d ucmiten, ur teppeddum d temddukwal. Win iugin liman, mêan igiten is. Neppa, di laxeôt, seg imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tekkrem ar téallit, ssirdet udmawen nnwen, ifassen nnwen alamma d ti$wmaô, sâaddit ifassen illexsen $ef iqweôôa nnwen, ssirdet ivaôen nnwen ar twelza. Ma tellam s loanaba, zzizdget. Ma tuvnem ne$ tunagem, ne$ iusa d yiwen segwen si ccicma, ne$ tennulem tilawin, ur tufim aman, ddmet akal zeddigen, sâaddit ep $ef udmawen nnwen akked ifassen nnwen. Ur Ib$a ara Öebbi a kwen Iqelleq, maca Ib$a a kwen Izzizdeg, ad awen Itim l$it iS, amar a pesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tekkrem ar téallit, ssirdet udmawen nnwen, ifassen nnwen alamma d ti$wmaô, sâaddit ifassen illexsen $ef iqweôôa nnwen, ssirdet ivaôen nnwen ar twelza. Ma tellam s loanaba, zzizdget. Ma tuvnem ne$ tunagem, ne$ iusa d yiwen segwen si ccicma, ne$ tennulem tilawin, ur tufim aman, ddmet akal zeddigen, sâaddit ep $ef udmawen nnwen akked ifassen nnwen. Ur Ib$a ara Öebbi a kwen Iqelleq, maca Ib$a a kwen Izzizdeg, ad awen Itim l$it iS, amar a pesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, akked nnesba ikwen Inuseb, mi tennam: "nesla u nunez". Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
ayahs.translation: Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, akked nnesba ikwen Inuseb, mi tennam: "nesla u nunez". Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen i illan deg idmaren.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Illit d ôôsem ar Öebbi, d inagan at lmizan. Ur kwen issencaf dd$el n ugdud, ur twezznem. Wezznet. Lmizan iqôeb aîas ar uêezzeb. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Illit d ôôsem ar Öebbi, d inagan at lmizan. Ur kwen issencaf dd$el n ugdud, ur twezznem. Wezznet. Lmizan iqôeb aîas ar uêezzeb. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Iâahed Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz ameqwôaêan, i wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan.
ayahs.translation: Iâahed Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz ameqwôaêan, i wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan.

ayahs.text: Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak d at ujajiê.
ayahs.translation: Wid ijehlen u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak d at ujajiê.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, amek agdud ipheggi iman is, ad isâaddi afus is fellawen. Iîîef akin ifassen nnsen, segwen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, amek agdud ipheggi iman is, ad isâaddi afus is fellawen. Iîîef akin ifassen nnsen, segwen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Irra Öebbi laâqed i At Isôail. Nessuffe$ ed, segsen, mrawsin imvebbôen. Inna Öebbi: "Nek yidwen ma téullem, tzekkam, tumnem s imazanen iW, u tâawnem ten, tôevlem i Öebbi aôeîîal igerzen. War ccekk, ad awen Kkse$ tucmitin nnwen, a kwen Skecme$ di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Win ijehlen segwen, deffir waya, ni$ innetlaf seg ubrid umâin".
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Irra Öebbi laâqed i At Isôail. Nessuffe$ ed, segsen, mrawsin imvebbôen. Inna Öebbi: "Nek yidwen ma téullem, tzekkam, tumnem s imazanen iW, u tâawnem ten, tôevlem i Öebbi aôeîîal igerzen. War ccekk, ad awen Kkse$ tucmitin nnwen, a kwen Skecme$ di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Win ijehlen segwen, deffir waya, ni$ innetlaf seg ubrid umâin".

ayahs.text: Imi ooan laâqed nnsen, Nexza ten, Nesgursel ulawen nnsen. Ssexsaôen inumak n wawalen, ppun amur n wayen i$ef pwafekkôen. Mazal a d temlilev d lexdaâ nnsen, siwa drus segsen. Semmeê asen u ssuref. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Imi ooan laâqed nnsen, Nexza ten, Nesgursel ulawen nnsen. Ssexsaôen inumak n wawalen, ppun amur n wayen i$ef pwafekkôen. Mazal a d temlilev d lexdaâ nnsen, siwa drus segsen. Semmeê asen u ssuref. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Wid iqqaôen: "nekwni d imasiêiyen", Nerra laâqed yidsen, ppun amur n wayen i$ef pwafekkôen. Nessker ed, garasen, taâdawt akked dd$el, ar ass n tnekra. Deqqal a ten Ixebbeô Öebbi $ef wayen la ûenâan.
ayahs.translation: Wid iqqaôen: "nekwni d imasiêiyen", Nerra laâqed yidsen, ppun amur n wayen i$ef pwafekkôen. Nessker ed, garasen, taâdawt akked dd$el, ar ass n tnekra. Deqqal a ten Ixebbeô Öebbi $ef wayen la ûenâan.

ayahs.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan nne£. Ad awen ibeggen aîas n wayen la teppeffrem, n Tezmamt. Ad Ipsemmiê i waîas. Ni$ tusa kwen id tafat s$uô Öebbi, akked Tezmamt ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan nne£. Ad awen ibeggen aîas n wayen la teppeffrem, n Tezmamt. Ad Ipsemmiê i waîas. Ni$ tusa kwen id tafat s$uô Öebbi, akked Tezmamt ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Inehhu yis Öebbi, ar iberdan n tifrat, wid iôe$ben llza S. A ten Issuffe$ si tillas ar tafat, s tsriê iS. A ten Inhu s abrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Inehhu yis Öebbi, ar iberdan n tifrat, wid iôe$ben llza S. A ten Issuffe$ si tillas ar tafat, s tsriê iS. A ten Inhu s abrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Ni$ jehlen wid innan: "Öebbi, s tidep, d lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem". Ini: "anwa isâan kra n lkwelf, s$uô Öebbi, ma ihwa yaS ad Ine$ lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem, imma s, akked wayen akw illan di tmurt"? N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ jehlen wid innan: "Öebbi, s tidep, d lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem". Ini: "anwa isâan kra n lkwelf, s$uô Öebbi, ma ihwa yaS ad Ine$ lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem, imma s, akked wayen akw illan di tmurt"? N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Udayen akked imasiêiyen, nnan: "nekwni d tarwa n Öebbi, d wid Ismenyaf". Ini: "acimi, ihi, ikwen Ipâaqab $ef ibekkaven nnwen? Xaîi, kunwi d imexlaq am wiyav". Ad Isemmeê i win i S ihwan, ad Iâaqeb win i S ihwan. N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Taggara $uôeS.
ayahs.translation: Udayen akked imasiêiyen, nnan: "nekwni d tarwa n Öebbi, d wid Ismenyaf". Ini: "acimi, ihi, ikwen Ipâaqab $ef ibekkaven nnwen? Xaîi, kunwi d imexlaq am wiyav". Ad Isemmeê i win i S ihwan, ad Iâaqeb win i S ihwan. N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Taggara $uôeS.

ayahs.text: A yAt Tezmamt! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan nne£, ad awen ibeggen, mi tâadda tallit war imazanen. Akka ur d teqqaôem ara: "ur a$ d iusi ubeccaô, ne$ uneddaô". Ihi, iusa kwen id ubeccaô, uneddaô. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: A yAt Tezmamt! Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan nne£, ad awen ibeggen, mi tâadda tallit war imazanen. Akka ur d teqqaôem ara: "ur a$ d iusi ubeccaô, ne$ uneddaô". Ihi, iusa kwen id ubeccaô, uneddaô. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi. Irra segwen lambiyya, Irra kwen d igeldan. Ifka yawen ayen ur Ifki i yiwen, deg imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi. Irra segwen lambiyya, Irra kwen d igeldan. Ifka yawen ayen ur Ifki i yiwen, deg imavalen.

ayahs.text: A yagdud iw! Kecmet akal iôqan, i wen Iura Öebbi. Ur d ppu$alet $er deffir wen, a d tegwrim txesôem".
ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Kecmet akal iôqan, i wen Iura Öebbi. Ur d ppu$alet $er deffir wen, a d tegwrim txesôem".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Musa! Degs agdud iâafriten, nekwni ur p nkeççem, d awez$i, alamma ff$en d segs. Mi d ff$en segs, a nekcem".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Musa! Degs agdud iâafriten, nekwni ur p nkeççem, d awez$i, alamma ff$en d segs. Mi d ff$en segs, a nekcem".

ayahs.text: Sin irgazen, seg wid iugaden - Isâad iten Öebbi -, nnan: "kecmet $uôsen si tebburt; ma tkecmem, kunwi, ih, a prebêem. Ppeklet af Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
ayahs.translation: Sin irgazen, seg wid iugaden - Isâad iten Öebbi -, nnan: "kecmet $uôsen si tebburt; ma tkecmem, kunwi, ih, a prebêem. Ppeklet af Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Musa! Nekwni ur p nkeççem, d awez$i, skud mazal iten degs. Öuê, keçç d Mass ik, nna$et. Nekwni a neqqim dagi".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Musa! Nekwni ur p nkeççem, d awez$i, skud mazal iten degs. Öuê, keçç d Mass ik, nna$et. Nekwni a neqqim dagi".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Ay melke$, nek, siwa iman iw akked gma; ihi, Semfaôeq a$ d ugdud".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Ay melke$, nek, siwa iman iw akked gma; ihi, Semfaôeq a$ d ugdud".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ihi, tamurt agi tepwagdel asen. Ukuéet iseggwasen ad menîaôen di lberr. Ur $webben $ef ugdud iballa$en".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ihi, tamurt agi tepwagdel asen. Ukuéet iseggwasen ad menîaôen di lberr. Ur $webben $ef ugdud iballa$en".

ayahs.text: Eêku yasen, s tidep, taqûit n sin warrac n Adem, mi îêeggan i sin. S$uô yiwen tepwaqbel. S$uô wayev ur tepwaqbel ara. Inna: "war ccekk, a k n$e$". Inna: "Iqebbel kan Öebbi îêegga s$uô wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Eêku yasen, s tidep, taqûit n sin warrac n Adem, mi îêeggan i sin. S$uô yiwen tepwaqbel. S$uô wayev ur tepwaqbel ara. Inna: "war ccekk, a k n$e$". Inna: "Iqebbel kan Öebbi îêegga s$uô wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Ma ibbwev iyi d ufus ik, ad iyi ten$ev, nek, ur k id ippawev ufus iw, a k n$e$. Nek, ppagwade$ Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Ma ibbwev iyi d ufus ik, ad iyi ten$ev, nek, ur k id ippawev ufus iw, a k n$e$. Nek, ppagwade$ Öebbi, Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: Nek, b$i$ a ppawiv abekkav iw, akked ubekkav ik, a ppiliv seg wat tmes. Winna d aqeîîi imednas".
ayahs.translation: Nek, b$i$ a ppawiv abekkav iw, akked ubekkav ik, a ppiliv seg wat tmes. Winna d aqeîîi imednas".

ayahs.text: Iaâzem, deg iman is, ad ine$ gma s, d$a in$a t. Igwra d seg imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Iaâzem, deg iman is, ad ine$ gma s, d$a in$a t. Igwra d seg imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Iuzen ed Öebbi tagerfa, tkeôôev akal, iwakken ad as tessenâat amek ara i$umm loeppa n gma s. Inna: "a ssexv iw! Ur bbwive$ ad ili$ am tgerfa yagi, ad $umme$ loeppa n gma". Igwra d seg wid inedmen.
ayahs.translation: Iuzen ed Öebbi tagerfa, tkeôôev akal, iwakken ad as tessenâat amek ara i$umm loeppa n gma s. Inna: "a ssexv iw! Ur bbwive$ ad ili$ am tgerfa yagi, ad $umme$ loeppa n gma". Igwra d seg wid inedmen.

ayahs.text: Ilmend n waya, Nura i At Isôail, ar win in$an amdan ur nen$i yiwen, ur nessefsed di tmurt, amzun in$a imdanen meôôa. Win issadren yiwen, amzun issader imdanen meôôa. Ni$ usan ten id imazanen nne£, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir waya, s tidep, aîas degsen ssuguten di tmurt.
ayahs.translation: Ilmend n waya, Nura i At Isôail, ar win in$an amdan ur nen$i yiwen, ur nessefsed di tmurt, amzun in$a imdanen meôôa. Win issadren yiwen, amzun issader imdanen meôôa. Ni$ usan ten id imazanen nne£, s ubeggen. Sinna, deffir waya, s tidep, aîas degsen ssuguten di tmurt.

ayahs.text: Aqeîîi n wid ipna$en Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u ssenkaren asefsed di tmurt, siwa timen$iwt, ne$ asemmeô $ef umidag, ne$ anegzum ufus sya, uvaô sya, ne$ anfay si tmurt. Ayagi, d aqeîîi nnsen di ddunit. Di laxeôt, fellasen aâaqeb ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Aqeîîi n wid ipna$en Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u ssenkaren asefsed di tmurt, siwa timen$iwt, ne$ asemmeô $ef umidag, ne$ anegzum ufus sya, uvaô sya, ne$ anfay si tmurt. Ayagi, d aqeîîi nnsen di ddunit. Di laxeôt, fellasen aâaqeb ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Kkes ed wid inedmen, uqbel a pvebbôem fellasen. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed wid inedmen, uqbel a pvebbôem fellasen. Cfut ar Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, nadit a pqeôôbem $uôeS, nna$et deg ubrid iS, amar a prebêem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, nadit a pqeôôbem $uôeS, nna$et deg ubrid iS, amar a prebêem.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, xas ad sâun i illan akw di tmurt, rnu yas win i t icban, iwakken ad fdun, yis, iman nnsen seg uâaqeb, ass n tnekra, ur ipwaqbal segsen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, xas ad sâun i illan akw di tmurt, rnu yas win i t icban, iwakken ad fdun, yis, iman nnsen seg uâaqeb, ass n tnekra, ur ipwaqbal segsen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ad b$un a d ff$en si tmes, ur llin d wid id iteff$en. Fellasen aâaqeb imezgi.
ayahs.translation: Ad b$un a d ff$en si tmes, ur llin d wid id iteff$en. Fellasen aâaqeb imezgi.

ayahs.text: Amakwar, tamakwart, gezmet asen ifassen nnsen, d aqeîîi n wayen xedmen, d aâaqeb s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Amakwar, tamakwart, gezmet asen ifassen nnsen, d aqeîîi n wayen xedmen, d aâaqeb s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Win inedmen, deffir ddens is, u iu$al d aâôvi, ad as Issuref Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Win inedmen, deffir ddens is, u iu$al d aâôvi, ad as Issuref Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Day ur teéôiv ara n Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Ipâaqab win i S ihwan, Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Day ur teéôiv ara n Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan? Ipâaqab win i S ihwan, Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Ur k $weblen wid ip$awalen ar tijehli, seg wid iqqaôen numen, s imawen nnsen, ur uminen wulawen nnsen, seg wudayen issemêasen i tikerkas, issemêasen i ugdud nniven, ur d nusi $uôek. Pbeddilen awalen deffir ussefhem nnsen. Qqaôen: "ma ippunefk awen d waya, ddemt ep; ma ur awen d ippunefk ara, $uôwat"! Win Ib$a Öebbi a t Ihewwel, ur t tepsellikev, s wacemma, seg ufus n Öebbi. Widak, d wid iwumi ur Ib$a ara Öebbi, ad izdigen wulawen nnsen. Di ddunit ad pwaxzun. Di laxeôt fellasen aâaqeb abarar.
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Ur k $weblen wid ip$awalen ar tijehli, seg wid iqqaôen numen, s imawen nnsen, ur uminen wulawen nnsen, seg wudayen issemêasen i tikerkas, issemêasen i ugdud nniven, ur d nusi $uôek. Pbeddilen awalen deffir ussefhem nnsen. Qqaôen: "ma ippunefk awen d waya, ddemt ep; ma ur awen d ippunefk ara, $uôwat"! Win Ib$a Öebbi a t Ihewwel, ur t tepsellikev, s wacemma, seg ufus n Öebbi. Widak, d wid iwumi ur Ib$a ara Öebbi, ad izdigen wulawen nnsen. Di ddunit ad pwaxzun. Di laxeôt fellasen aâaqeb abarar.

ayahs.text: Wid issemêasen i tikerkas, iteppen leêôam, ma usan k id, fru garasen, ne$ eoo iten. Ma teooiv ten, ur k îîuôôun s wacemma. Ma têuddev, êudd garasen s lmizan. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid iweznen.
ayahs.translation: Wid issemêasen i tikerkas, iteppen leêôam, ma usan k id, fru garasen, ne$ eoo iten. Ma teooiv ten, ur k îîuôôun s wacemma. Ma têuddev, êudd garasen s lmizan. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid iweznen.

ayahs.text: Amek ara k id asen, s aêuddu, u nitni sâan Tuôa, degs aêuddu n Öebbi? Sinna, deffir waya, ad wexxôen. Ur llin wigi si lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Amek ara k id asen, s aêuddu, u nitni sâan Tuôa, degs aêuddu n Öebbi? Sinna, deffir waya, ad wexxôen. Ur llin wigi si lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ih, Nessers ed Tuôa, degs nnhaya akked tafat, ferrun yis ger wudayen, lambiyya imvuâen. U iôabaniyen akked lecyux seg wayen jemâen, si Tezmamt n Öebbi, u llan d inagan is. Ur ppagwadet imdanen, agwadet iyI. Ur d ppa$et, s issekniyen iW, ayen ôxisen. Wid ur nepêuddu yara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Nessers ed Tuôa, degs nnhaya akked tafat, ferrun yis ger wudayen, lambiyya imvuâen. U iôabaniyen akked lecyux seg wayen jemâen, si Tezmamt n Öebbi, u llan d inagan is. Ur ppagwadet imdanen, agwadet iyI. Ur d ppa$et, s issekniyen iW, ayen ôxisen. Wid ur nepêuddu yara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Nura yasen degs: ôôuê s ôôuê, tiî s tiî, anzaren s wanzaren, ameééu$ s umeééu$, tu$mest s tu$mest, leoruê ad ppuêesben. Win iooan, d le$ôama s. Wid ur nepêuddu yara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Nura yasen degs: ôôuê s ôôuê, tiî s tiî, anzaren s wanzaren, ameééu$ s umeééu$, tu$mest s tu$mest, leoruê ad ppuêesben. Win iooan, d le$ôama s. Wid ur nepêuddu yara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d imednas.

ayahs.text: Nuzen ed, deffir sen, Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuôa. Nefka yas Linoil, degs nnhaya akked tafat, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuôa. D nnhaya u d anabi i wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Nuzen ed, deffir sen, Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuôa. Nefka yas Linoil, degs nnhaya akked tafat, a d itebbet ayen it id izwaren di Tuôa. D nnhaya u d anabi i wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: At Linoil, iwata ad êudden s wayen id Issers, degs, Öebbi. Wid ur nêudd ara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: At Linoil, iwata ad êudden s wayen id Issers, degs, Öebbi. Wid ur nêudd ara s wayen id Issers Öebbi, widak d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Nessers ak d Tazmamt, s tidep, a d tebbet ayen ip id izwaren n Tezmamt. Nvemn ip. Ihi, êudd garasen s wayen id Issers Öebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen, beôôa n wayen i k id iusan n tidep. I yal wa, Nefka lqanun akked ubrid. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Irra kwen d yiwen n lois. Maca, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb $ef wayen i wen Ifka, mzizlet ar lxiô. Ar Öebbi tu$alin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen tellam temgarradem.
ayahs.translation: Nessers ak d Tazmamt, s tidep, a d tebbet ayen ip id izwaren n Tezmamt. Nvemn ip. Ihi, êudd garasen s wayen id Issers Öebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen, beôôa n wayen i k id iusan n tidep. I yal wa, Nefka lqanun akked ubrid. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Irra kwen d yiwen n lois. Maca, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb $ef wayen i wen Ifka, mzizlet ar lxiô. Ar Öebbi tu$alin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen tellam temgarradem.

ayahs.text: Ëudd garasen s wayen id Issers Öebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen. £uôek a k hewwlen $ef kra seg wayen i k d Issers Öebbi. Ma wexxôen, éeô ar Öebbi Ib$a kan a ten Iwwet $ef kra ibekkaven nnsen. Ih, aîas n medden d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Ëudd garasen s wayen id Issers Öebbi. Ur teddu d lhawiyyat nnsen. £uôek a k hewwlen $ef kra seg wayen i k d Issers Öebbi. Ma wexxôen, éeô ar Öebbi Ib$a kan a ten Iwwet $ef kra ibekkaven nnsen. Ih, aîas n medden d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Day b$an aêuddu n zzman n war tussna? Anwa yifen Öebbi d Amêaddi, i ugdud ineûêen liman?
ayahs.translation: Day b$an aêuddu n zzman n war tussna? Anwa yifen Öebbi d Amêaddi, i ugdud ineûêen liman?

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat, d iêbiben, udayen akked imasiêiyen. Garasen d iêbiben. Win, segwen, i ten irran d iêbiben, ad yili segsen. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat, d iêbiben, udayen akked imasiêiyen. Garasen d iêbiben. Win, segwen, i ten irran d iêbiben, ad yili segsen. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

ayahs.text: A pwaliv imuvan n wul, ppazzalen $uôsen, qqaôen asen: "nugad ay d itezzin fella$". Ahat a d Ias Öebbi s l$elb, ne$ s lameô s$uôeS. A d gwrin di nndama, $ef wayen ffren deg iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: A pwaliv imuvan n wul, ppazzalen $uôsen, qqaôen asen: "nugad ay d itezzin fella$". Ahat a d Ias Öebbi s l$elb, ne$ s lameô s$uôeS. A d gwrin di nndama, $ef wayen ffren deg iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: A d inin wid iumnen: "day d wigi i iggullen s Öebbi, tagallit meqqwôen, ar nitni llan yidwen"? Mêan igiten nnsen, gwran d d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: A d inin wid iumnen: "day d wigi i iggullen s Öebbi, tagallit meqqwôen, ar nitni llan yidwen"? Mêan igiten nnsen, gwran d d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Win segwen iooan ddin is…, ihi, deqqal Öebbi a d Iawi agdud Iêemmel, i T iêemmlen; ad ôavin lmumnin, ad qesêen ar ijehliyen. Ad nna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur ppagwaden alummu n win iplummun. Ayagi d lfevl n Öebbi, Ippak it i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Win segwen iooan ddin is…, ihi, deqqal Öebbi a d Iawi agdud Iêemmel, i T iêemmlen; ad ôavin lmumnin, ad qesêen ar ijehliyen. Ad nna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur ppagwaden alummu n win iplummun. Ayagi d lfevl n Öebbi, Ippak it i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Imawlan nnwen siwa Öebbi akked Umazan iS, wid iumnen, wid ipéallan, pzekkin, u nitni îîinizen.
ayahs.translation: Imawlan nnwen siwa Öebbi akked Umazan iS, wid iumnen, wid ipéallan, pzekkin, u nitni îîinizen.

ayahs.text: Wid irran d imawlan nnsen, Öebbi, Amazan iS, akked wid iumnen…, ih, akabar n Öebbi, d nitni ara irebêen.
ayahs.translation: Wid irran d imawlan nnsen, Öebbi, Amazan iS, akked wid iumnen…, ih, akabar n Öebbi, d nitni ara irebêen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d iêbiben wid id ilhan, di ddin nnwen, s wurar d utihi, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akw seg ijehliyen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d iêbiben wid id ilhan, di ddin nnwen, s wurar d utihi, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, akw seg ijehliyen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

ayahs.text: Ma teddnem i téallit, fellas ad mmaâlken, ad uraren. Ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nefhim.
ayahs.translation: Ma teddnem i téallit, fellas ad mmaâlken, ad uraren. Ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nefhim.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acu i$ef la $ ttehmem, siwa imi numen s Öebbi, akked wayen id Issers $uône$, akked wayen id Issers uqbel? Tegwti degwen d iballa$en".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Acu i$ef la $ ttehmem, siwa imi numen s Öebbi, akked wayen id Issers $uône$, akked wayen id Issers uqbel? Tegwti degwen d iballa$en".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ad awen mle$ aqeîîi n Öebbi icemten sennig wagi? Wid Ixza Öebbi, sserfan T, Irra ten d iddawen, d ilfawen". Âabden iôebbiten n tkerkas. Widak, atnan di liêala tucmip mavi, di ttelfan u$miq seg ubrid uûwib.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ad awen mle$ aqeîîi n Öebbi icemten sennig wagi? Wid Ixza Öebbi, sserfan T, Irra ten d iddawen, d ilfawen". Âabden iôebbiten n tkerkas. Widak, atnan di liêala tucmip mavi, di ttelfan u$miq seg ubrid uûwib.

ayahs.text: Mi d usan $uôwen, qqaôen: "numen". Ni$ kecmen d s tijehli, u nitni ff$en yis. Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen, ayen teffren.
ayahs.translation: Mi d usan $uôwen, qqaôen: "numen". Ni$ kecmen d s tijehli, u nitni ff$en yis. Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen, ayen teffren.

ayahs.text: La tepwaliv aîas, degsen, p$awalen ar ubekkav akked wanfal, teppen leêôam. I icmet wayen xeddmen!
ayahs.translation: La tepwaliv aîas, degsen, p$awalen ar ubekkav akked wanfal, teppen leêôam. I icmet wayen xeddmen!

ayahs.text: A lemmer i sen kksen iôabiyen akked lecyax, awal ubekkav akked wuççi n leêôam? I icmet wayen la ûenâen!
ayahs.translation: A lemmer i sen kksen iôabiyen akked lecyax, awal ubekkav akked wuççi n leêôam? I icmet wayen la ûenâen!

ayahs.text: Qqaôen wudayen: "iskkweô ufus n Öebbi". D ifassen nnsen i isekkwôen. Pwaxzan ilmend n wayen d qqaôen. Xaîi! Ifassen iS llin, Ip$iti akken i S ihwa. Ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu i waîas segsen, leb$wev akked tijehli. Nessker garasen cceêna, akked dd$el, ar ass n tnekra. Yal tikelt ara caâlen times i îôad, a p Issexsi Öebbi. Pnadin asefsed di tmurt. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara ifessaden.
ayahs.translation: Qqaôen wudayen: "iskkweô ufus n Öebbi". D ifassen nnsen i isekkwôen. Pwaxzan ilmend n wayen d qqaôen. Xaîi! Ifassen iS llin, Ip$iti akken i S ihwa. Ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu i waîas segsen, leb$wev akked tijehli. Nessker garasen cceêna, akked dd$el, ar ass n tnekra. Yal tikelt ara caâlen times i îôad, a p Issexsi Öebbi. Pnadin asefsed di tmurt. Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara ifessaden.

ayahs.text: At Tezmamt, lemmer day umnen u êezzben, yili, war ccekk, Nekkes asen tucmitin nnsen, u Nesskecm iten ar leonanat isaâdiyen.
ayahs.translation: At Tezmamt, lemmer day umnen u êezzben, yili, war ccekk, Nekkes asen tucmitin nnsen, u Nesskecm iten ar leonanat isaâdiyen.

ayahs.text: Lemmer day îîifen di Tuôa akked Linoil, akked wayen i sen d irsen s$uô Mass nnsen, war ccekk, ad ççen sennig sen, akw seddaw ivaôen nnsen. Illa garasen lois iôeznen. Aîas, degsen, dirit wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer day îîifen di Tuôa akked Linoil, akked wayen i sen d irsen s$uô Mass nnsen, war ccekk, ad ççen sennig sen, akw seddaw ivaôen nnsen. Illa garasen lois iôeznen. Aîas, degsen, dirit wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: A yAmazan, mel ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik. Ma ur t temliv ara, ur tessawvev ara tabrap iS. Öebbi a k Ifukk si l$aci. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: A yAmazan, mel ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik. Ma ur t temliv ara, ur tessawvev ara tabrap iS. Öebbi a k Ifukk si l$aci. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur tellim deg wacemma, alamma teddam d Tuôa, Linoil, akked wayen i wen d irsen, s$uô Mass nnwen". Ayen i k d irsen s$uô Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu, i waîas segsen, leb$wev akked tijehli. Ur $webbel $ef ugdud ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur tellim deg wacemma, alamma teddam d Tuôa, Linoil, akked wayen i wen d irsen, s$uô Mass nnwen". Ayen i k d irsen s$uô Mass ik, war ccekk, irennu, i waîas segsen, leb$wev akked tijehli. Ur $webbel $ef ugdud ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, iûabiyen, imasiêiyen, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, udayen, iûabiyen, imasiêiyen, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nga laâqed i At Isôail, Nuzen asen imazanen. Yal tikelt ara ten id ias umazan s wayen ur asen nehwi, wa a t skiddben, wa a t n$en.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nga laâqed i At Isôail, Nuzen asen imazanen. Yal tikelt ara ten id ias umazan s wayen ur asen nehwi, wa a t skiddben, wa a t n$en.

ayahs.text: £ilen ur ippili uhewwel. Dre$len, âaégen. Sinna, Issuref asen Öebbi. Sinna, aîas degsen dre$len, âaégen. Öebbi Ipwali acu xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: £ilen ur ippili uhewwel. Dre$len, âaégen. Sinna, Issuref asen Öebbi. Sinna, aîas degsen dre$len, âaégen. Öebbi Ipwali acu xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ jehlen wid iqqaôen: "Öebbi, s tidep, d lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem". U inna lmasiê: "a yAt Isôail! Âabdet Öebbi, Mass iw, d Mass nnwen". Ih, win icerken i Öebbi, Igdel as Öebbi Loennet. Axxam is d times. Ur llin isellaken i imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ jehlen wid iqqaôen: "Öebbi, s tidep, d lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem". U inna lmasiê: "a yAt Isôail! Âabdet Öebbi, Mass iw, d Mass nnwen". Ih, win icerken i Öebbi, Igdel as Öebbi Loennet. Axxam is d times. Ur llin isellaken i imednas.

ayahs.text: Ni$ jehlen wid iqqaôen: "Ih, Öebbi d wis krav n krav". Ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi Yiwen. Ma ur xvin ara i wayen qqaôen, war ccekk, aâaqeb aqeôêan ad iêaz wid ijehlen segsen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ jehlen wid iqqaôen: "Ih, Öebbi d wis krav n krav". Ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi Yiwen. Ma ur xvin ara i wayen qqaôen, war ccekk, aâaqeb aqeôêan ad iêaz wid ijehlen segsen.

ayahs.text: Day ur tuben ara ar Öebbi, u ssuturen aS ssmaê? Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Day ur tuben ara ar Öebbi, u ssuturen aS ssmaê? Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem, d amazan kan. Ni$ âaddan, uqbel is, imazanen. Imma s tessawal tidep. Llan teppen lqut. Wali amek i asen Nepbeggin issekniyen; sinna, wali amek la ppagwin.
ayahs.translation: Lmasiê, mmi s n Meryem, d amazan kan. Ni$ âaddan, uqbel is, imazanen. Imma s tessawal tidep. Llan teppen lqut. Wali amek i asen Nepbeggin issekniyen; sinna, wali amek la ppagwin.

ayahs.text: Ini: "day a ppaâbdem, war Öebbi, ayen ur nezmir a kwen ivuôô, ne$ a kwen infaâ"? Öebbi, Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "day a ppaâbdem, war Öebbi, ayen ur nezmir a kwen ivuôô, ne$ a kwen infaâ"? Öebbi, Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur rennut, di ddin nnwen, ayen ur nelli d tidep. Ur teddut d lemcihwat n ugdud innetlafen zik, i itelfen aîas, u telfen seg ubrid uûwib.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yAt Tezmamt! Ur rennut, di ddin nnwen, ayen ur nelli d tidep. Ur teddut d lemcihwat n ugdud innetlafen zik, i itelfen aîas, u telfen seg ubrid uûwib.

ayahs.text: Pwaxzan wid ijehlen, seg wAt Isôail, s$uô iles n Dawed akked Âisa, mmi s n Meryem; ayagi, $ef wayen âuûan, u zgaren tilas.
ayahs.translation: Pwaxzan wid ijehlen, seg wAt Isôail, s$uô iles n Dawed akked Âisa, mmi s n Meryem; ayagi, $ef wayen âuûan, u zgaren tilas.

ayahs.text: Ur ppemyekkasen ayen xedmen n dir. I icmet wayen xeddmen!
ayahs.translation: Ur ppemyekkasen ayen xedmen n dir. I icmet wayen xeddmen!

ayahs.text: A pwaliv aîas segsen, ad xalven wid ijehlen. War ccekk, icmet wayen xedmen i iman nnsen. Ad Izâaf Öebbi fellasen. Nitni ad wekkôen deg uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: A pwaliv aîas segsen, ad xalven wid ijehlen. War ccekk, icmet wayen xedmen i iman nnsen. Ad Izâaf Öebbi fellasen. Nitni ad wekkôen deg uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Lemmer uminen s Öebbi, Nnbi, akked wayen i sen d irsen, ur ten pparan d iêbiben. Maca aîas, segsen, d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer uminen s Öebbi, Nnbi, akked wayen i sen d irsen, ur ten pparan d iêbiben. Maca aîas, segsen, d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: A ppafev icenga iqeûêanen mavi, n wid iumnen, d udayen akked wid ipcaraken. A ppafev wid iqeôben mavi, s lmaênana, ar wid iumnen, d wid innan: "nekwni d imasiêiyen". Ayagi, acku llan degsen ixelwiyen, iôehbaniyen, u nitni ur sme$wôen ara iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: A ppafev icenga iqeûêanen mavi, n wid iumnen, d udayen akked wid ipcaraken. A ppafev wid iqeôben mavi, s lmaênana, ar wid iumnen, d wid innan: "nekwni d imasiêiyen". Ayagi, acku llan degsen ixelwiyen, iôehbaniyen, u nitni ur sme$wôen ara iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ma slan i wayen id iusan ar Umazan, a pwaliv allen nnsen ççuôent d imeîîi, seg wayen ufan n tidep. Qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Numen, Aru ya$ seg inagan.
ayahs.translation: Ma slan i wayen id iusan ar Umazan, a pwaliv allen nnsen ççuôent d imeîîi, seg wayen ufan n tidep. Qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Numen, Aru ya$ seg inagan.

ayahs.text: Acu i $ iu$en ur numin s Öebbi akked wayen i $ d iusan n tidep; ur nessarem a $ Issekcem, Mass nne$, s agdud iâaôviyen"?
ayahs.translation: Acu i $ iu$en ur numin s Öebbi akked wayen i $ d iusan n tidep; ur nessarem a $ Issekcem, Mass nne$, s agdud iâaôviyen"?

ayahs.text: A ten Ioazi Öebbi, $ef wayen d qqaôen, s leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. Wagi d aoazi n lâuûam.
ayahs.translation: A ten Ioazi Öebbi, $ef wayen d qqaôen, s leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. Wagi d aoazi n lâuûam.

ayahs.text: Wid ijehlen, u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak, d at Loahennama.
ayahs.translation: Wid ijehlen, u skaddben issekniyen nne£, widak, d at Loahennama.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pgeddilet ayen imaânen i wen Iêell Öebbi. Ur zegret tilas. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pgeddilet ayen imaânen i wen Iêell Öebbi. Ur zegret tilas. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.

ayahs.text: Eççet seg wayen ikwen Iôéeq Öebbi, iêellen, imaânen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. YiS, kunwi, ay tumnem.
ayahs.translation: Eççet seg wayen ikwen Iôéeq Öebbi, iêellen, imaânen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. YiS, kunwi, ay tumnem.

ayahs.text: Ur kwen Ipqassa Öebbi $ef tgallit n tkerkas. Maca, a kwen Iqiss $ef tgallit n ûûeê. Takweffaôt is: a ppecceççem mraw ime$ban, akken tecceççam tawacult nnwen, ne$ a ten tesselsem, ne$ a pserêem i wakli. Win ur nwâa ara, ad iuéum krav wussan. D tagi ay d takweffaôt n tgallit nnwen, ma teggullem. Eîîfet di tgallit nnwen. Akka i wen d Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a ppesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: Ur kwen Ipqassa Öebbi $ef tgallit n tkerkas. Maca, a kwen Iqiss $ef tgallit n ûûeê. Takweffaôt is: a ppecceççem mraw ime$ban, akken tecceççam tawacult nnwen, ne$ a ten tesselsem, ne$ a pserêem i wakli. Win ur nwâa ara, ad iuéum krav wussan. D tagi ay d takweffaôt n tgallit nnwen, ma teggullem. Eîîfet di tgallit nnwen. Akka i wen d Ipbeggin Öebbi issekniyen, amar a ppesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ccôab, leqwmeô, tiâancuôin, taseqqaôt, d ayen kan icemten, seg igi n Cciîan. Ihi, veôôeft asen, amar a prebêem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ccôab, leqwmeô, tiâancuôin, taseqqaôt, d ayen kan icemten, seg igi n Cciîan. Ihi, veôôeft asen, amar a prebêem.

ayahs.text: Ib$a kan Cciîan ad isker ticenga akked dd$el garawen, s ccôab akked leqwmeô, a kwen iveôôef seg usmekti n Öebbi, akked téallit. Day ur tepfukkum ara?
ayahs.translation: Ib$a kan Cciîan ad isker ticenga akked dd$el garawen, s ccôab akked leqwmeô, a kwen iveôôef seg usmekti n Öebbi, akked téallit. Day ur tepfukkum ara?

ayahs.text: A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan. £uôwat! Ma twexxôem, cfut ar Amazan, iwata yas kan anabi ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan. £uôwat! Ma twexxôem, cfut ar Amazan, iwata yas kan anabi ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Ur telli tiyta deg wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, $ef wayen ççan, ma êezzben, umnen, xedmen ayen ilhan, sinna êezzben, umnen, sinna, êezzben u maânen. Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam.
ayahs.translation: Ur telli tiyta deg wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, $ef wayen ççan, ma êezzben, umnen, xedmen ayen ilhan, sinna êezzben, umnen, sinna, êezzben u maânen. Öebbi Iêemmel lâuûam.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! War ccekk, a kwen Iweddeb Öebbi $ef wayen tepûeggidem s ifassen nnwen, u s ixtucen nnwen, iwakken ad Iéeô Öebbi anwa i T ippagwaden, di tbavnit. Win izegren tilas, deffir waya, fellas aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! War ccekk, a kwen Iweddeb Öebbi $ef wayen tepûeggidem s ifassen nnwen, u s ixtucen nnwen, iwakken ad Iéeô Öebbi anwa i T ippagwaden, di tbavnit. Win izegren tilas, deffir waya, fellas aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pûeggidet di zzyaôa nnwen. Win iûeggden segwen, u iâammed, aqeîîi: ad iseddeq, si lmal is, ayen in$a s ûûyada s, a d êudden, f waya, sin irgazen iêesbiyen segwen. D tikci ara iawven ar Lkaâba. Ne$ takweffaôt: ad icceçç ime$ban, ne$, ayen iswan aya, ad iuéum. Ad ijeôôeb vveôô n lameô is. Öebbi Isemmeê i wayen iâaddan. Win iu$alen a d Irr Öebbi segs ppaô. Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pûeggidet di zzyaôa nnwen. Win iûeggden segwen, u iâammed, aqeîîi: ad iseddeq, si lmal is, ayen in$a s ûûyada s, a d êudden, f waya, sin irgazen iêesbiyen segwen. D tikci ara iawven ar Lkaâba. Ne$ takweffaôt: ad icceçç ime$ban, ne$, ayen iswan aya, ad iuéum. Ad ijeôôeb vveôô n lameô is. Öebbi Isemmeê i wayen iâaddan. Win iu$alen a d Irr Öebbi segs ppaô. Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.

ayahs.text: Têell awen ûûyada n yill akked uççi s. D lqut i kunwi akw iminigen. Tepwagdel awen ûûyada di tmurt, skud aql akwen d zziyyaô. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, $uôeS ara tepwafesrem.
ayahs.translation: Têell awen ûûyada n yill akked uççi s. D lqut i kunwi akw iminigen. Tepwagdel awen ûûyada di tmurt, skud aql akwen d zziyyaô. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, $uôeS ara tepwafesrem.

ayahs.text: Irra Öebbi Lkaâba d axxam iôqan ipwabnan i l$aci, aggur iôqan, asfel, isenoaq, ayagi iwakken a ppeéôem ar Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg igenwan u di tmurt, u Öebbi Issen yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Irra Öebbi Lkaâba d axxam iôqan ipwabnan i l$aci, aggur iôqan, asfel, isenoaq, ayagi iwakken a ppeéôem ar Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg igenwan u di tmurt, u Öebbi Issen yal cci.

ayahs.text: Cfut iwâaô uâaqeb n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Cfut iwâaô uâaqeb n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Amazan, iwata yas kan unabi. Öebbi Iéôa ayen temmalem u ayen teppeffrem.
ayahs.translation: Amazan, iwata yas kan unabi. Öebbi Iéôa ayen temmalem u ayen teppeffrem.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur iaâdil ara wayen n dir akked wayen imaânen", xas teswehm ik lkwetôa n wayen n dir. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, a yuâqilen, amar a prebêem.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur iaâdil ara wayen n dir akked wayen imaânen", xas teswehm ik lkwetôa n wayen n dir. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, a yuâqilen, amar a prebêem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur steqsayet $ef t$awsiwin ara kwen icwe$ben, ma mlan awen tent. Ma testeqsam fellasent mara d iprusu Leqwôan, ad awen ppufessrent. Öebbi Isemmeê aya. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur steqsayet $ef t$awsiwin ara kwen icwe$ben, ma mlan awen tent. Ma testeqsam fellasent mara d iprusu Leqwôan, ad awen ppufessrent. Öebbi Isemmeê aya. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Iêellem.

ayahs.text: Ni$ isteqsa fellasent ugdud, uqbel nnwen. Sinna, segsent, gwran d d ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ isteqsa fellasent ugdud, uqbel nnwen. Sinna, segsent, gwran d d ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ur d Ifki Öebbi Baêiôa, ne$ Sayba, ne$ Waûila, ne$ Ëami. Maca, wid ijehlen gren d tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Tegwti degsen ur fhimen.
ayahs.translation: Ur d Ifki Öebbi Baêiôa, ne$ Sayba, ne$ Waûila, ne$ Ëami. Maca, wid ijehlen gren d tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Tegwti degsen ur fhimen.

ayahs.text: Ma nnan asen: "yyaw ar wayen id Issers Öebbi, u ar Umazan". Qqaôen: "beôka ya$ ayen id nufa, $ef waya, $eô imezwura nne$". I ma imezwura nnsen ur ssinen acemma, ur pwanhan?
ayahs.translation: Ma nnan asen: "yyaw ar wayen id Issers Öebbi, u ar Umazan". Qqaôen: "beôka ya$ ayen id nufa, $ef waya, $eô imezwura nne$". I ma imezwura nnsen ur ssinen acemma, ur pwanhan?

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Fellawen iman nnwen. Ur kwen iîîuôôu win innetlafen, ma tepwanham. Ar Öebbi, tu$alin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Fellawen iman nnwen. Ur kwen iîîuôôu win innetlafen, ma tepwanham. Ar Öebbi, tu$alin nnwen akw. A kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ccada garawen, ma tusa d tmeppant ar yiwen segwen. Di lawan uweûûi, sin irgazen iêesbiyen, segwen, ne$ wiyav war segwen, ma tellam d iminigen di tmurt, u tusa kwen id twa$it n tmeppant. A ten qesden deffir téallit. Ma tcukkem, sgallet pen s Öebbi: "ur d nesfayday syis, xas iaâna llzem nne$, ur nteffer ccada n Öebbi, mulac, nekwni a nili seg imednab".
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ccada garawen, ma tusa d tmeppant ar yiwen segwen. Di lawan uweûûi, sin irgazen iêesbiyen, segwen, ne$ wiyav war segwen, ma tellam d iminigen di tmurt, u tusa kwen id twa$it n tmeppant. A ten qesden deffir téallit. Ma tcukkem, sgallet pen s Öebbi: "ur d nesfayday syis, xas iaâna llzem nne$, ur nteffer ccada n Öebbi, mulac, nekwni a nili seg imednab".

ayahs.text: Ma ivehô ed fellasen denben, ad ppuneûfen s wiyav, si loiha n wid vuôôen imezwura. Ad ggalen s Öebbi: "ih, ccada nne$ tif ccada nnsen. Ur nzegger tilas, mulac, war ccekk, a nili seg imednas".
ayahs.translation: Ma ivehô ed fellasen denben, ad ppuneûfen s wiyav, si loiha n wid vuôôen imezwura. Ad ggalen s Öebbi: "ih, ccada nne$ tif ccada nnsen. Ur nzegger tilas, mulac, war ccekk, a nili seg imednas".

ayahs.text: Ppif akka iwakken a d awin ccada iwulmen, ad agwaden a ppili tgallit deffir tgallit nnsen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ssemêesset, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Ppif akka iwakken a d awin ccada iwulmen, ad agwaden a ppili tgallit deffir tgallit nnsen. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ssemêesset, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara Issemlil Öebbi imazanen, ad Yini: "acu i wen d jawben"? Ad inin: "ur telli tussna $uône$. D Keçç, s tidep, i Issnen tibavniyin".
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara Issemlil Öebbi imazanen, ad Yini: "acu i wen d jawben"? Ad inin: "ur telli tussna $uône$. D Keçç, s tidep, i Issnen tibavniyin".

ayahs.text: Mi Inna Öebbi: "a Âisa, mmi s n Meryem! Mmekti d i kwen £$ate$, keçç akked imma k, mi k Âiwne$ s ôôuê iôqan. Tepmmeslayev i medden si dduê, am unqaqôi. Mi k Slemde$ Tazmamt, ûûwab, Tuôa, Linoil. Mi tûenâav, si talaxt, ûûifa n ufrux, s– tsriê iW; tûuvev degs, tu$al d afôux, s– tsriê iW. Tesseêlayev agugam, amuvin n lberû, s– tsriê iW. Mi tessenkarev lmeggtin, s– tsriê iW. Mi Sbaâde$ fellak At Isôail, mi d tusiv $uôsen, s ubeggen, u nnan wid ijehlen segsen: "ayagi iban d ssêur kan".
ayahs.translation: Mi Inna Öebbi: "a Âisa, mmi s n Meryem! Mmekti d i kwen £$ate$, keçç akked imma k, mi k Âiwne$ s ôôuê iôqan. Tepmmeslayev i medden si dduê, am unqaqôi. Mi k Slemde$ Tazmamt, ûûwab, Tuôa, Linoil. Mi tûenâav, si talaxt, ûûifa n ufrux, s– tsriê iW; tûuvev degs, tu$al d afôux, s– tsriê iW. Tesseêlayev agugam, amuvin n lberû, s– tsriê iW. Mi tessenkarev lmeggtin, s– tsriê iW. Mi Sbaâde$ fellak At Isôail, mi d tusiv $uôsen, s ubeggen, u nnan wid ijehlen segsen: "ayagi iban d ssêur kan".

ayahs.text: Mi Weêêa$ i inmahalen: "amnet yissI, akw s umazan iW". Nnan: "numen. Echhed ar nekwni d imvuâen".
ayahs.translation: Mi Weêêa$ i inmahalen: "amnet yissI, akw s umazan iW". Nnan: "numen. Echhed ar nekwni d imvuâen".

ayahs.text: Mi nnan inmahalen: "a Âisa, mmi s n Meryem! Ma Izmer Mass ik ad a$ d Issers lmaida seg igenni"? Inna: "êezzbet i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
ayahs.translation: Mi nnan inmahalen: "a Âisa, mmi s n Meryem! Ma Izmer Mass ik ad a$ d Issers lmaida seg igenni"? Inna: "êezzbet i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "neb$a a neçç segs, a nevmen ulawen nne$, a néeô ar tenniv a$ d tidep, a nili d inagan iS".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "neb$a a neçç segs, a nevmen ulawen nne$, a néeô ar tenniv a$ d tidep, a nili d inagan iS".

ayahs.text: Inna Âisa, mmi s n Meryem: "a Öebbi, Mass nne$, Ssers a$ d lmaida, seg igenni, ad a$ tili d lâid i umezwaru u i uneggaru nne$, u d assekni s $uôeK. £it a$ d. Keçç, Tifev akw im$iten".
ayahs.translation: Inna Âisa, mmi s n Meryem: "a Öebbi, Mass nne$, Ssers a$ d lmaida, seg igenni, ad a$ tili d lâid i umezwaru u i uneggaru nne$, u d assekni s $uôeK. £it a$ d. Keçç, Tifev akw im$iten".

ayahs.text: Inna Öebbi: "ad awen p id Sserse$. Win ijehlen segwen, deffir waya, a t Âaqbe$ aâaqeb ur Sâadda$ i yiwen deg imavalen".
ayahs.translation: Inna Öebbi: "ad awen p id Sserse$. Win ijehlen segwen, deffir waya, a t Âaqbe$ aâaqeb ur Sâadda$ i yiwen deg imavalen".

ayahs.text: Mi Inna Öebbi: "a Âisa, mmi s n Meryem! D keçç i innan i l$aci: erret a$, nek akked imma, d sin iôebbiten war Öebbi"? Inna: "gedha s yiseK! Ur iyi ippunefk ara a d ini$ ayen i$ef ur sâi$ lêeqq. Lemmer i t id nni$, yili Teéôiv t. Tesnev i illan deg iman iw, ur ssine$ ayen illan deg iman iK. Keçç, s tidep, d Amusnaw n tbavniyin.
ayahs.translation: Mi Inna Öebbi: "a Âisa, mmi s n Meryem! D keçç i innan i l$aci: erret a$, nek akked imma, d sin iôebbiten war Öebbi"? Inna: "gedha s yiseK! Ur iyi ippunefk ara a d ini$ ayen i$ef ur sâi$ lêeqq. Lemmer i t id nni$, yili Teéôiv t. Tesnev i illan deg iman iw, ur ssine$ ayen illan deg iman iK. Keçç, s tidep, d Amusnaw n tbavniyin.

ayahs.text: I asen nni$, siwa ayen iyi d Tumôev: âabdet Öebbi, Mass iw, u Mass nnwen. Lli$ d anagi nnsen, skud lli$ garasen. Mi iyi n Tessuliv $uôeK, d Keçç i ten id Iquôâan. Keçç, d Anagi n yal cci.
ayahs.translation: I asen nni$, siwa ayen iyi d Tumôev: âabdet Öebbi, Mass iw, u Mass nnwen. Lli$ d anagi nnsen, skud lli$ garasen. Mi iyi n Tessuliv $uôeK, d Keçç i ten id Iquôâan. Keçç, d Anagi n yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ma Tâaqbev ten, ni$ d imdanen iK, ma Tsemmêev asen, Keçç, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".
ayahs.translation: Ma Tâaqbev ten, ni$ d imdanen iK, ma Tsemmêev asen, Keçç, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".

ayahs.text: Inna Öebbi: "wagi d ass ideg ara stenfâan imawlan n tidep, si tidep nnsen. I nitni leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen, i lebda". Iôuva ten Öebbi, u ôuvan T, d wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Inna Öebbi: "wagi d ass ideg ara stenfâan imawlan n tidep, si tidep nnsen. I nitni leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen, i lebda". Iôuva ten Öebbi, u ôuvan T, d wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, akked wayen illan degsen. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, akked wayen illan degsen. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: A neckeô Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan. Irra tillas, tafat. Sinna, wid ijehlen pparan tanudda i Mass nnsen.
verses.translation: A neckeô Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan. Irra tillas, tafat. Sinna, wid ijehlen pparan tanudda i Mass nnsen.

verses.text: Neppa, ikwen Ixelqen s talaxt, sinna, Iseyya lajel. £uôeS lajel ipwassnen. Deffir waya, kunwi la tepcukkum.
verses.translation: Neppa, ikwen Ixelqen s talaxt, sinna, Iseyya lajel. £uôeS lajel ipwassnen. Deffir waya, kunwi la tepcukkum.

verses.text: Neppa, d Öebbi deg igenwan, di tmurt. Issen sser nnwen, d wayen d teqqaôem. Iéôa ayen tkesbem.
verses.translation: Neppa, d Öebbi deg igenwan, di tmurt. Issen sser nnwen, d wayen d teqqaôem. Iéôa ayen tkesbem.

verses.text: Ur ten id ippas ussekni seg issekniyen n Mass nnsen, mebla ma ugin t.
verses.translation: Ur ten id ippas ussekni seg issekniyen n Mass nnsen, mebla ma ugin t.

verses.text: Ni$ skaddben tidep, mi ten id tusa. A ten id ias usali n wayen i$ef ttihin.
verses.translation: Ni$ skaddben tidep, mi ten id tusa. A ten id ias usali n wayen i$ef ttihin.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara acêal isuta, uqbel nnsen, ay Nekkes. Nesserked iten di tmurt akken ur kwen Nesserked. Nuzen asen aîas ugeffur, Nerra yasen isaffen, ppazzalen seddawat sen. Nesnegr iten ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Nxelq ed, deffir sen, sself nniven.
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara acêal isuta, uqbel nnsen, ay Nekkes. Nesserked iten di tmurt akken ur kwen Nesserked. Nuzen asen aîas ugeffur, Nerra yasen isaffen, ppazzalen seddawat sen. Nesnegr iten ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Nxelq ed, deffir sen, sself nniven.

verses.text: Xas ad ak ed Nessers Tazmamt, di lka$ev, ara nnalen s ifassen nnsen, war ccekk, a d inin wid ijehlen: "wagi, s tidep, siwa ssêur n ûûeê".
verses.translation: Xas ad ak ed Nessers Tazmamt, di lka$ev, ara nnalen s ifassen nnsen, war ccekk, a d inin wid ijehlen: "wagi, s tidep, siwa ssêur n ûûeê".

verses.text: Qqaôen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes lmelk". Lemmer a n Nessers lmelk, war ccekk, ad iûaô lameô, sinna, ur pganin.
verses.translation: Qqaôen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes lmelk". Lemmer a n Nessers lmelk, war ccekk, ad iûaô lameô, sinna, ur pganin.

verses.text: Lemmer i t Nerri d lmelk, yili Nerra t d argaz, ad as Nessels ayen plusun.
verses.translation: Lemmer i t Nerri d lmelk, yili Nerra t d argaz, ad as Nessels ayen plusun.

verses.text: Ni$ mmaâlken $ef imazanen, uqbel ik. Ayen i$ef ttihin, izzi i wid, segsen, immaâlken.
verses.translation: Ni$ mmaâlken $ef imazanen, uqbel ik. Ayen i$ef ttihin, izzi i wid, segsen, immaâlken.

verses.text: Ini: "ddut di tmurt, sinna walit amek tevôa d wid iskiddiben".
verses.translation: Ini: "ddut di tmurt, sinna walit amek tevôa d wid iskiddiben".

verses.text: Ini: "w i t ilan wayen akw illan di tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi". Iura, deg iman iS, aêunu. A kwen Issemlil i wass n tnekra, ur ccekk fellas. Wid isxesôen iman nnsen, ur ppamnen.
verses.translation: Ini: "w i t ilan wayen akw illan di tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi". Iura, deg iman iS, aêunu. A kwen Issemlil i wass n tnekra, ur ccekk fellas. Wid isxesôen iman nnsen, ur ppamnen.

verses.text: IneS i ized$en deg iv, deg wass. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: IneS i ized$en deg iv, deg wass. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ini: "day ara sâu$ bab, war Öebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan? Neppa Icceççay ur t cceççayen". Ini: "nek pwamôe$ d ad ili$ d amenzu ara ianzen. Ur ppilit seg imcurak".
verses.translation: Ini: "day ara sâu$ bab, war Öebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan? Neppa Icceççay ur t cceççayen". Ini: "nek pwamôe$ d ad ili$ d amenzu ara ianzen. Ur ppilit seg imcurak".

verses.text: Ini: "nek ugade$, ma aâûa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".
verses.translation: Ini: "nek ugade$, ma aâûa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".

verses.text: Win imenâan segs, assen, ni$ Iêun fellas. Wagi d rrebê n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Win imenâan segs, assen, ni$ Iêun fellas. Wagi d rrebê n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ma Isâadda Öebbi fellak cedda, ur p itekkes yiwen, siwa Neppa. Ma Isrebê ik, Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ma Isâadda Öebbi fellak cedda, ur p itekkes yiwen, siwa Neppa. Ma Isrebê ik, Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: D Neppa ay d Aqehhaô, sennig imdanen iS; d Neppa ay d Bab n ûûwab, i Iéôan.
verses.translation: D Neppa ay d Aqehhaô, sennig imdanen iS; d Neppa ay d Bab n ûûwab, i Iéôan.

verses.text: Ini: "anda p ccada sennig akw tiyav"? Ini: "Öebbi d Anagi gari yidwen. Iweêêa yi d Leqwôan agi, iwakken a kwen nabi$ yis, kunwi akked wid u$uô ibbwev. Day, kunwi, war ccekk, a pcehhdem ar, ar tama n Öebbi, llan iôebbiten nniven"? Ini: "ur cehhde$"! Ini: "Neppa d Öebbi, siwa Yiwen. Nek, rri$ akin ayen tepcarakem".
verses.translation: Ini: "anda p ccada sennig akw tiyav"? Ini: "Öebbi d Anagi gari yidwen. Iweêêa yi d Leqwôan agi, iwakken a kwen nabi$ yis, kunwi akked wid u$uô ibbwev. Day, kunwi, war ccekk, a pcehhdem ar, ar tama n Öebbi, llan iôebbiten nniven"? Ini: "ur cehhde$"! Ini: "Neppa d Öebbi, siwa Yiwen. Nek, rri$ akin ayen tepcarakem".

verses.text: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, ssnen p, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. Wid isxesôen iman nnsen, ihi, ur ppamnen.
verses.translation: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, ssnen p, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. Wid isxesôen iman nnsen, ihi, ur ppamnen.

verses.text: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebêen imednas.
verses.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebêen imednas.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara ten Nefser meôôa, sinna a Nini i wid icurken: "anda ten icriken nnwen, i la tâabdem"?
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Nefser meôôa, sinna a Nini i wid icurken: "anda ten icriken nnwen, i la tâabdem"?

verses.text: Deg uhewwel nnsen, siwa ma nnan d: "s Öebbi, Mass nne$, ur nelli d imcurak"!
verses.translation: Deg uhewwel nnsen, siwa ma nnan d: "s Öebbi, Mass nne$, ur nelli d imcurak"!

verses.text: Wali amek skaddben $ef yiman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen la d snulfuyen.
verses.translation: Wali amek skaddben $ef yiman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen la d snulfuyen.

verses.text: Garasen wid i k issemêasen. Nerra aêurrim $ef ulawen nnsen, iwakken ur t fehmen. Tiâééegt deg imeééu$en nnsen. Ma walan yal assekni, ur ppamnen yis. Alamma, ma usan d $uôek, a k namren, ad ak inin wid ijehlen: ayagi siwa tiêkayin imezwura.
verses.translation: Garasen wid i k issemêasen. Nerra aêurrim $ef ulawen nnsen, iwakken ur t fehmen. Tiâééegt deg imeééu$en nnsen. Ma walan yal assekni, ur ppamnen yis. Alamma, ma usan d $uôek, a k namren, ad ak inin wid ijehlen: ayagi siwa tiêkayin imezwura.

verses.text: Sîixxiôen segs, îîeôôifen segs. Ay squccun siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.
verses.translation: Sîixxiôen segs, îîeôôifen segs. Ay squccun siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.

verses.text: Lemmer a ten twaliv, mara bedden ar tmes, a d inin: a ssexv nne$! Awi $ irran, ur neskiddib issekniyen n Mass nne$! A nili si lmumnin.
verses.translation: Lemmer a ten twaliv, mara bedden ar tmes, a d inin: a ssexv nne$! Awi $ irran, ur neskiddib issekniyen n Mass nne$! A nili si lmumnin.

verses.text: Xaîi! Iban asen d wayen teffren, zik. Lemmer a d kren, ad u$alen ar wayen i sen ipwagedlen. Nitni, s tidep, d ikeddaben.
verses.translation: Xaîi! Iban asen d wayen teffren, zik. Lemmer a d kren, ad u$alen ar wayen i sen ipwagedlen. Nitni, s tidep, d ikeddaben.

verses.text: U qqaôen: "siwa tameddurt n ddunit i illan. Nekwni, ur fella$ tanekra".
verses.translation: U qqaôen: "siwa tameddurt n ddunit i illan. Nekwni, ur fella$ tanekra".

verses.text: Lemmer a pwaliv mara bedden ar Mass nnsen, ad Yini: "ni$ ayagi s tidep"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nne$"! Ad Yini: "ihi jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tejhilem".
verses.translation: Lemmer a pwaliv mara bedden ar Mass nnsen, ad Yini: "ni$ ayagi s tidep"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nne$"! Ad Yini: "ihi jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tejhilem".

verses.text: Ni$ xesôen wid iskaddben timlilit akked öÖebbi. Alamma, ma iusa ten id yimir, deqzalla, a d inin: "a yamxix nne$, $ef wayen ideg nestehza"! Nitni ad bibben tiâakkwumin nnsen $ef izugar nnsen. I icmet wayen bubben!
verses.translation: Ni$ xesôen wid iskaddben timlilit akked öÖebbi. Alamma, ma iusa ten id yimir, deqzalla, a d inin: "a yamxix nne$, $ef wayen ideg nestehza"! Nitni ad bibben tiâakkwumin nnsen $ef izugar nnsen. I icmet wayen bubben!

verses.text: Tameddurt n ddunit d urar kan akked lhawiyya. Axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, yif ip i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tepmeyyizem ara?
verses.translation: Tameddurt n ddunit d urar kan akked lhawiyya. Axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, yif ip i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tepmeyyizem ara?

verses.text: Ni$ Neéôa i$webben ik, s tidep, wayen qqaôen. Ihi, nitni ur k skiddiben. Maca imednas veggôen issekniyen n Öebbi.
verses.translation: Ni$ Neéôa i$webben ik, s tidep, wayen qqaôen. Ihi, nitni ur k skiddiben. Maca imednas veggôen issekniyen n Öebbi.

verses.text: Ni$ skaddben imazanen uqbel ik. Üebôen $ef wayen i ten skaddben, akked wayen i ten meêênen, armi i ten id iusa usellek nne£. Ur illi ubeddel i wawalen n Öebbi. Ni$ usan k id, kra isallen imazanen.
verses.translation: Ni$ skaddben imazanen uqbel ik. Üebôen $ef wayen i ten skaddben, akked wayen i ten meêênen, armi i ten id iusa usellek nne£. Ur illi ubeddel i wawalen n Öebbi. Ni$ usan k id, kra isallen imazanen.

verses.text: Ma ééay fellak uwexxeô nnsen, ma tzemôev a tessarmev aderbuz di tmurt, ne$ sellum s igenni, ad asen d tawiv assekni. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, a ten Issemlil ar nnhaya. Ur ppili seg wid ur nessin.
verses.translation: Ma ééay fellak uwexxeô nnsen, ma tzemôev a tessarmev aderbuz di tmurt, ne$ sellum s igenni, ad asen d tawiv assekni. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, a ten Issemlil ar nnhaya. Ur ppili seg wid ur nessin.

verses.text: Siwa wid isellen, ara d ijawben. Lmegtin a ten id Issker Öebbi, sinna, $uôeS tu$alin nnsen.
verses.translation: Siwa wid isellen, ara d ijawben. Lmegtin a ten id Issker Öebbi, sinna, $uôeS tu$alin nnsen.

verses.text: Qqaôen: "acimi ur as d irs ara ussekni s$uô Mass is"? Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer a d Issers assekni", maca tegwti degsen ur éôin.
verses.translation: Qqaôen: "acimi ur as d irs ara ussekni s$uô Mass is"? Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer a d Issers assekni", maca tegwti degsen ur éôin.

verses.text: Ur illi lweêc di tmurt, ne$ ufrux ippafgen s wafriwen is, ur nelli d leoyus am kunwi. Ur Nestehza, di Tezmamt, $ef wacemma. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, ad pwafessren.
verses.translation: Ur illi lweêc di tmurt, ne$ ufrux ippafgen s wafriwen is, ur nelli d leoyus am kunwi. Ur Nestehza, di Tezmamt, $ef wacemma. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, ad pwafessren.

verses.text: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, âaégen, gugmen, di tillas. Win i S ihwan i Öebbi, a t Itlef. Win i S ihwan, a t Iawi d ubrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, âaégen, gugmen, di tillas. Win i S ihwan i Öebbi, a t Itlef. Win i S ihwan, a t Iawi d ubrid uwqim.

verses.text: Ini: "twalam ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb n Öebbi, ne$ ma iusa kwen id yimir, day ar war Öebbi ara tnaâôem, ma tessawalem tidep?
verses.translation: Ini: "twalam ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb n Öebbi, ne$ ma iusa kwen id yimir, day ar war Öebbi ara tnaâôem, ma tessawalem tidep?

verses.text: Xaîi! £uôeS ara tnujem. Ad Issiferr ayen i$ef tnujem $uôeS, ma ihwa yaS, a ppeppum ayen tcurkem".
verses.translation: Xaîi! £uôeS ara tnujem. Ad Issiferr ayen i$ef tnujem $uôeS, ma ihwa yaS, a ppeppum ayen tcurkem".

verses.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed ar leoyus, uqbel ik. Nesâadda fellasen tilufa, ccqa, amar ad êiwten.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed ar leoyus, uqbel ik. Nesâadda fellasen tilufa, ccqa, amar ad êiwten.

verses.text: A lemmer êawten, mi ten id tusa tiyta nne£. Maca, qehôen wulawen nnsen. Cciîan Icebbeê asen ayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: A lemmer êawten, mi ten id tusa tiyta nne£. Maca, qehôen wulawen nnsen. Cciîan Icebbeê asen ayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Mi ppun ayen i sen d smmektin, Nelli yasen tibbura n yal cci, armi, mi feôêen s wayen i sen ippunefken, Newwet iten, deqzalla. D$a qevâen layas.
verses.translation: Mi ppun ayen i sen d smmektin, Nelli yasen tibbura n yal cci, armi, mi feôêen s wayen i sen ippunefken, Newwet iten, deqzalla. D$a qevâen layas.

verses.text: Pwakksen wid id igwran seg ugdud idensen. Ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
verses.translation: Pwakksen wid id igwran seg ugdud idensen. Ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.

verses.text: Ini: "twalam, ma Iddem awen Öebbi timesliwt nnwen, akked iéôi nnwen; ma Isle$ ulawen nnwen; anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ar awen ten id iawin"? Wali amek Nessefham issekniyen, u nitni, sinna, zzin akin.
verses.translation: Ini: "twalam, ma Iddem awen Öebbi timesliwt nnwen, akked iéôi nnwen; ma Isle$ ulawen nnwen; anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ar awen ten id iawin"? Wali amek Nessefham issekniyen, u nitni, sinna, zzin akin.

verses.text: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb n Öebbi, deqzalla, ne$ âinani? Day ara Ine$, siwa agdud imednas"?
verses.translation: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb n Öebbi, deqzalla, ne$ âinani? Day ara Ine$, siwa agdud imednas"?

verses.text: Ur d Nuzen imazanen, siwa i ubecceô, d unabi. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: Ur d Nuzen imazanen, siwa i ubecceô, d unabi. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, a ten iêaz uâaqeb, ilmend n wayen be$wven.
verses.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, a ten iêaz uâaqeb, ilmend n wayen be$wven.

verses.text: Ini: "ur awen qqare$ sâi$ igerrujen n Öebbi, ur ssine$ tabavnit; ur awen qqare$: nek, d lmelk. Nek, teddu$ kan akked wayen iyi d ippuweêêan". Ini: "day iaâdel uder$al d win ipwalin? Day ur d tepmeyyizem ara"?
verses.translation: Ini: "ur awen qqare$ sâi$ igerrujen n Öebbi, ur ssine$ tabavnit; ur awen qqare$: nek, d lmelk. Nek, teddu$ kan akked wayen iyi d ippuweêêan". Ini: "day iaâdel uder$al d win ipwalin? Day ur d tepmeyyizem ara"?

verses.text: Nabi yis wid iugaden ad pwafessren ar Mass nnsen. Ur sâin bab, war Neppa, ne$ amcafaâ. Amar ad êezzben.
verses.translation: Nabi yis wid iugaden ad pwafessren ar Mass nnsen. Ur sâin bab, war Neppa, ne$ amcafaâ. Amar ad êezzben.

verses.text: Ur ppara wid ipnujun $uô Mass nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit, pnadin udem iS. Ur fellak a ten têasbev deg wacemma, ur fellasen a k êasben, deg wacemma. Ma terriv ten, ihi, a ppiliv seg imednas.
verses.translation: Ur ppara wid ipnujun $uô Mass nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit, pnadin udem iS. Ur fellak a ten têasbev deg wacemma, ur fellasen a k êasben, deg wacemma. Ma terriv ten, ihi, a ppiliv seg imednas.

verses.text: Akka ay Nhewwel kra s wiyav, iwakken a d inin: "day d wigi i I$at Öebbi, garane$"? Day ur Issin ara Öebbi, sennig akw, wid isnemmiren?
verses.translation: Akka ay Nhewwel kra s wiyav, iwakken a d inin: "day d wigi i I$at Öebbi, garane$"? Day ur Issin ara Öebbi, sennig akw, wid isnemmiren?

verses.text: Ma usan k id wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£, ini: "tifrat fellawen"! Mass nnwen Iura, i iman iS, aêunu. Ihi, i win, segwen, ixedmen tucmip, ur iâammed, sin akin, isteôoaâ, u ixdem ayen ilhan, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ma usan k id wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£, ini: "tifrat fellawen"! Mass nnwen Iura, i iman iS, aêunu. Ihi, i win, segwen, ixedmen tucmip, ur iâammed, sin akin, isteôoaâ, u ixdem ayen ilhan, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen, iwakken a d iban ubrid ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen, iwakken a d iban ubrid ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Ini: "nek, ippugdel iyi ad âabde$ wid u$uô la tepnujum, war Öebbi". Ini: "ur teddu$ d lemcihwat nnwen, mulac ad nnetlafe$, ur ppili$ seg wid ipwanhan".
verses.translation: Ini: "nek, ippugdel iyi ad âabde$ wid u$uô la tepnujum, war Öebbi". Ini: "ur teddu$ d lemcihwat nnwen, mulac ad nnetlafe$, ur ppili$ seg wid ipwanhan".

verses.text: Ini: "nek, îîfe$ deg ubeggen n Mass iw. Teskaddbem t. Ur illi $uôi wayen u$uô têarem. Ih, aêuddu $eô Öebbi kan. Issawal tidep. Neppa Yif akw wid issenqaden".
verses.translation: Ini: "nek, îîfe$ deg ubeggen n Mass iw. Teskaddbem t. Ur illi $uôi wayen u$uô têarem. Ih, aêuddu $eô Öebbi kan. Issawal tidep. Neppa Yif akw wid issenqaden".

verses.text: Ini: "lemmer illi $uôi wayen u$uô têarem, yili iûaô lameô, gari yidwen". Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen imednas.
verses.translation: Ini: "lemmer illi $uôi wayen u$uô têarem, yili iûaô lameô, gari yidwen". Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen imednas.

verses.text: £uôeS tisura n tbavnit. Siwa Neppa itent Issnen. Iéôa i illan di lberr, di yill. Ur i$elli ifer siwa ma Iéôa t. Akken aâqqa di tillas n tmurt, tizzegzewt, ta$eôt, akw di tezmamt ipbegginen.
verses.translation: £uôeS tisura n tbavnit. Siwa Neppa itent Issnen. Iéôa i illan di lberr, di yill. Ur i$elli ifer siwa ma Iéôa t. Akken aâqqa di tillas n tmurt, tizzegzewt, ta$eôt, akw di tezmamt ipbegginen.

verses.text: D Neppa i wen ippaddamen leôwaê deg iv. Iéôa ay txeddmem, deg wass. Sinna, Ippara kwen id degs, iwakken ad ivôu lajel ipwassnen. Sinna, $uôeS tu$alin nnwen, sinna, a kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: D Neppa i wen ippaddamen leôwaê deg iv. Iéôa ay txeddmem, deg wass. Sinna, Ippara kwen id degs, iwakken ad ivôu lajel ipwassnen. Sinna, $uôeS tu$alin nnwen, sinna, a kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: D Neppa ay d Aqehhaô sennig imdanen iS. Ippazen ed $uôwen imêaraben, alamma, ma tusa d tmeppant ar yiwen segwen, ad ddmen ôôuê is, imceggâen nne£. Nitni ur stehzayen.
verses.translation: D Neppa ay d Aqehhaô sennig imdanen iS. Ippazen ed $uôwen imêaraben, alamma, ma tusa d tmeppant ar yiwen segwen, ad ddmen ôôuê is, imceggâen nne£. Nitni ur stehzayen.

verses.text: Sinna, ad u$alen ar Öebbi, Bab nnsen n tidep. Aêuddu, day maççi d ayla S? Neppa Yif akw akken Ip$awal ar uqeîîi.
verses.translation: Sinna, ad u$alen ar Öebbi, Bab nnsen n tidep. Aêuddu, day maççi d ayla S? Neppa Yif akw akken Ip$awal ar uqeîîi.

verses.text: Ini: "anwa ara kwen Isellken si tillas n lberr d yill, u$uô tnujem s uêiwet akked tugwdi"? "Ma Isellek a$ si tagi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".
verses.translation: Ini: "anwa ara kwen Isellken si tillas n lberr d yill, u$uô tnujem s uêiwet akked tugwdi"? "Ma Isellek a$ si tagi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".

verses.text: Ini: "Öebbi Isellek ikwen segs, akw si yal lhemm, sinna, kunwi la tepcarakem".
verses.translation: Ini: "Öebbi Isellek ikwen segs, akw si yal lhemm, sinna, kunwi la tepcarakem".

verses.text: Ini: "Neppa, Izmer ad awen d Iazen aâaqeb sennig wen, ne$ seddaw ivaôen nnwen. Ne$ a kwen Issemfaôaq, kra segwen ad jeôôben leqheô n wiyav". Wali amek id Nemmal issekniyen, amar ad meêûen.
verses.translation: Ini: "Neppa, Izmer ad awen d Iazen aâaqeb sennig wen, ne$ seddaw ivaôen nnwen. Ne$ a kwen Issemfaôaq, kra segwen ad jeôôben leqheô n wiyav". Wali amek id Nemmal issekniyen, amar ad meêûen.

verses.text: Iskaddeb it ugdud ik, u neppa d tidep. Ini: "ur awen lli$ d awkil.
verses.translation: Iskaddeb it ugdud ik, u neppa d tidep. Ini: "ur awen lli$ d awkil.

verses.text: Yal asali s lweqt is. A ppu$alem a ppeéôem".
verses.translation: Yal asali s lweqt is. A ppu$alem a ppeéôem".

verses.text: Ma twalav wid ipnamaren $ef issekniyen nne£, eoo iten, alamma bedlen anamer. Ma iseppu k Cciîan, mi d temmektiv, ur p$imi d ugdud imednas.
verses.translation: Ma twalav wid ipnamaren $ef issekniyen nne£, eoo iten, alamma bedlen anamer. Ma iseppu k Cciîan, mi d temmektiv, ur p$imi d ugdud imednas.

verses.text: Ur isefk ara i wid ipêezziben, a ten êasben deg wacemma. Maca d asmekti, amar ad êezzben.
verses.translation: Ur isefk ara i wid ipêezziben, a ten êasben deg wacemma. Maca d asmekti, amar ad êezzben.

verses.text: Eoo wid irran ddin nnsen d urar, d aqesseô. T$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Mmekti d yis, ard a ipwaîîef umdan $ef wayen ikseb. Ur isâi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ amcafaâ. Yal le$ôama ur tepwaqbal segs. Widak d wid ipwaîfen $ef wayen kesben. I nitni tissit iô$an, aâaqeb aqeôêan, ilmend n wayen la jehlen.
verses.translation: Eoo wid irran ddin nnsen d urar, d aqesseô. T$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Mmekti d yis, ard a ipwaîîef umdan $ef wayen ikseb. Ur isâi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ amcafaâ. Yal le$ôama ur tepwaqbal segs. Widak d wid ipwaîfen $ef wayen kesben. I nitni tissit iô$an, aâaqeb aqeôêan, ilmend n wayen la jehlen.

verses.text: Ini: "day a nâaô, war Öebbi, ayen ur a$ neneffaâ, ur a$ neîîuôôu? U a nu$al a nwexxeô, deffir nnhaya n Öebbi, am win $ewwan ccwaîen di tmurt, u ippuêeyyeô". Pnecciden t imeddukwal ar nnhaya: "yya $uône$"! Ini: "d nnhaya n Öebbi, s tidep, ay d nnhaya. Nepwameô a nanez i Mass imavalen".
verses.translation: Ini: "day a nâaô, war Öebbi, ayen ur a$ neneffaâ, ur a$ neîîuôôu? U a nu$al a nwexxeô, deffir nnhaya n Öebbi, am win $ewwan ccwaîen di tmurt, u ippuêeyyeô". Pnecciden t imeddukwal ar nnhaya: "yya $uône$"! Ini: "d nnhaya n Öebbi, s tidep, ay d nnhaya. Nepwameô a nanez i Mass imavalen".

verses.text: èéalet, êezzbet aS. £uôeS, Neppa, ara tepwafessrem.
verses.translation: èéalet, êezzbet aS. £uôeS, Neppa, ara tepwafessrem.

verses.text: D Neppa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ass ideg ara Yini: "ili"! Ad yili. Awal iS d tidep. IneS tagelda. Ass uûuvu n lbuq, Iéôa i iffren d wayen ivehôen. Neppa d Bab n ûûwab, i Iéôan.
verses.translation: D Neppa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ass ideg ara Yini: "ili"! Ad yili. Awal iS d tidep. IneS tagelda. Ass uûuvu n lbuq, Iéôa i iffren d wayen ivehôen. Neppa d Bab n ûûwab, i Iéôan.

verses.text: Mi inna Ibôahim i baba s, Azaô: "day a pperrev tiâancuôin d iôebbiten? Nek wala$ k, keçç akked ugdud ik, di ttelfan n ûûeê".
verses.translation: Mi inna Ibôahim i baba s, Azaô: "day a pperrev tiâancuôin d iôebbiten? Nek wala$ k, keçç akked ugdud ik, di ttelfan n ûûeê".

verses.text: Akka, Nessken i Ibôahim, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, iwakken ad yili seg wid itebbten.
verses.translation: Akka, Nessken i Ibôahim, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, iwakken ad yili seg wid itebbten.

verses.text: Mi t i$umm yiv, iwala itri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi ixsi, inna: "ur êemle$ ara wid ixessin".
verses.translation: Mi t i$umm yiv, iwala itri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi ixsi, inna: "ur êemle$ ara wid ixessin".

verses.text: Mi iwala iuli d waggur n tziri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi i$ab, inna: "ma ur iyi Inha ara Mass iw, ad ili$, war ccekk, seg ugdud im$eôôqen".
verses.translation: Mi iwala iuli d waggur n tziri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi i$ab, inna: "ma ur iyi Inha ara Mass iw, ad ili$, war ccekk, seg ugdud im$eôôqen".

verses.text: Mi iwala iîij ineqqeô ed, inna: "wagi d Mass iw, wagi meqqweô kteô". Mi i$li, inna: "a yagdud iw! Nek rri$ akkin ayen tepcarakem.
verses.translation: Mi iwala iîij ineqqeô ed, inna: "wagi d Mass iw, wagi meqqweô kteô". Mi i$li, inna: "a yagdud iw! Nek rri$ akkin ayen tepcarakem.

verses.text: Nek zzi$ udem iw ar Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, male$ ar tidep. Ur lli$, nek, seg imcurak".
verses.translation: Nek zzi$ udem iw ar Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, male$ ar tidep. Ur lli$, nek, seg imcurak".

verses.text: Ixuûem it ugdud is, inna: "day ad iyi txaûmem $ef Öebbi? Ni$ Inha yi; ur ugade$ ayen i S tcurkem, siwa ma illa wayen i S ihwan i Mass iw. Tussna n Mass iw tezdi yal cci, day ur d tesmektayem ara?
verses.translation: Ixuûem it ugdud is, inna: "day ad iyi txaûmem $ef Öebbi? Ni$ Inha yi; ur ugade$ ayen i S tcurkem, siwa ma illa wayen i S ihwan i Mass iw. Tussna n Mass iw tezdi yal cci, day ur d tesmektayem ara?

verses.text: Amek ara ugade$ ayen tepcarakem, ur tugadem mi kunwi tepcarakem, i Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu fellawen? Anwa, ger sin ikabaran, i iklalen laman, maday tessnem"?
verses.translation: Amek ara ugade$ ayen tepcarakem, ur tugadem mi kunwi tepcarakem, i Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu fellawen? Anwa, ger sin ikabaran, i iklalen laman, maday tessnem"?

verses.text: Wid iumnen, ur sselsen ddens i liman nnsen, widak ad ilin di laman, u nitni pwanhan.
verses.translation: Wid iumnen, ur sselsen ddens i liman nnsen, widak ad ilin di laman, u nitni pwanhan.

verses.text: D wagi ay d awal nne£. Nefka yas t i Ibôahim, mgal agdud is. Nessalay tiseddaôin, win i£ £ ihwan. Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: D wagi ay d awal nne£. Nefka yas t i Ibôahim, mgal agdud is. Nessalay tiseddaôin, win i£ £ ihwan. Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Nefka yas Isêaq akked Yaâqub. I sin, Nenha ten. Nenha, zik, Nuê akw, ger tarwa s, Dawed, Sliman, Yub, Yusef, Musa, Haôun, - Akka ay Nepkafi iâaôviyen -
verses.translation: Nefka yas Isêaq akked Yaâqub. I sin, Nenha ten. Nenha, zik, Nuê akw, ger tarwa s, Dawed, Sliman, Yub, Yusef, Musa, Haôun, - Akka ay Nepkafi iâaôviyen -

verses.text: Zakarya, Yeêya, Âisa, Ilyas, - akw seg iâaôviyen -
verses.translation: Zakarya, Yeêya, Âisa, Ilyas, - akw seg iâaôviyen -

verses.text: Ismaâil, Lyasâa, Yunes, Luî, - akw Nesmenyaf iten $ef imavalen -
verses.translation: Ismaâil, Lyasâa, Yunes, Luî, - akw Nesmenyaf iten $ef imavalen -

verses.text: akw seg ibabaten nnsen, si tarwa nnsen, akked watmaten nnsen. Nefren iten, u Nebbwi ten d ubrid uwqim.
verses.translation: akw seg ibabaten nnsen, si tarwa nnsen, akked watmaten nnsen. Nefren iten, u Nebbwi ten d ubrid uwqim.

verses.text: Tagi d nnhaya n Öebbi. Inehhu yis win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Lemmer curken, war ccekk, ad asen imêu wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Tagi d nnhaya n Öebbi. Inehhu yis win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Lemmer curken, war ccekk, ad asen imêu wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: D wigi iwumi d Nebbwi Tazmamt, ûûwab, akked lambiyya. Ma jehlen widak yis, ihi, Nekwni Nwekkel ip i ugdud ur njehhel yis.
verses.translation: D wigi iwumi d Nebbwi Tazmamt, ûûwab, akked lambiyya. Ma jehlen widak yis, ihi, Nekwni Nwekkel ip i ugdud ur njehhel yis.

verses.text: Wigi d wid Inha Öebbi. Ddu d nnhaya nnsen. Ini: "ur awen suture$, fellas, taqdiât. Neppa d asmekti kan i imavalen".
verses.translation: Wigi d wid Inha Öebbi. Ddu d nnhaya nnsen. Ini: "ur awen suture$, fellas, taqdiât. Neppa d asmekti kan i imavalen".

verses.text: Ur qudôen Öebbi azal n lqedô iS, mi qqaôen: "ur d Issers Öebbi acemma ar umdan". Ini: "anwa id Issersen Tazmamt, id ibbwi Musa, d tafat u d nnhaya i medden? Tepparam p di lkwa$ev i tesskanem. Aîas ay teppeffrem. Tlemdem ayen ur tessinem, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen". Ini: "D Öebbi". Sinna, anef asen ad uraren s nnmara nnsen.
verses.translation: Ur qudôen Öebbi azal n lqedô iS, mi qqaôen: "ur d Issers Öebbi acemma ar umdan". Ini: "anwa id Issersen Tazmamt, id ibbwi Musa, d tafat u d nnhaya i medden? Tepparam p di lkwa$ev i tesskanem. Aîas ay teppeffrem. Tlemdem ayen ur tessinem, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen". Ini: "D Öebbi". Sinna, anef asen ad uraren s nnmara nnsen.

verses.text: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers ip id teôqa, a ptebbet ayen ip id izwaren, a ppendeô tayimmap n temdinin akked wayen i s d izzin. Wid iumnen s laxeôt, umnen yis. Nitni bedden i téilla nnsen.
verses.translation: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers ip id teôqa, a ptebbet ayen ip id izwaren, a ppendeô tayimmap n temdinin akked wayen i s d izzin. Wid iumnen s laxeôt, umnen yis. Nitni bedden i téilla nnsen.

verses.text: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Ne$ inna: "ppuweêêa$ d", ur as d ippuweêêa wacemma? U win innan: "a d sserse$ am wayen id Issers Öebbi"? Lemmer a pwaliv imednas, di maylellif n tmeppant, u lmalayek élent ed ifassen nnsent: "ssuff$et ed tiôwiêin nnwen. Assa, a ppeppuqeîîim s uâaqeb isneêcamen, ilmend n wayen teqqaôem $ef Öebbi, ur d tidep. U tellam tessem$waôem iman nnwen, $ef issekniyen iS".
verses.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Ne$ inna: "ppuweêêa$ d", ur as d ippuweêêa wacemma? U win innan: "a d sserse$ am wayen id Issers Öebbi"?
