Lemmer a pwaliv imednas, di maylellif n tmeppant, u lmalayek élent ed ifassen nnsent: "ssuff$et ed tiôwiêin nnwen. Assa, a ppeppuqeîîim s uâaqeb isneêcamen, ilmend n wayen teqqaôem $ef Öebbi, ur d tidep. U tellam tessem$waôem iman nnwen, $ef issekniyen iS".

verses.text: Ni$ tusam a£ d, d ifôiden, akken ikwen Nexleq abrid amezwaru. Teooam deffir wen, ayen i wen Nefka. Ur Nwala, $uôwen, imcafâen nnwen, wid i tâabdem, nitni, d icriken nnwen. Ni$ temfaôaqem, u ooan kwen wid la tâabdem.
verses.translation: Ni$ tusam a£ d, d ifôiden, akken ikwen Nexleq abrid amezwaru. Teooam deffir wen, ayen i wen Nefka. Ur Nwala, $uôwen, imcafâen nnwen, wid i tâabdem, nitni, d icriken nnwen. Ni$ temfaôaqem, u ooan kwen wid la tâabdem.

verses.text: Öebbi, s tidep, Ifeôôec aâqqa, i$es. Issuffu$ ed amuddir si lmegget. Issuffu$ ed lmegget seg umuddir. Akka ay d Öebbi. Acimi tugim?
verses.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, Ifeôôec aâqqa, i$es. Issuffu$ ed amuddir si lmegget. Issuffu$ ed lmegget seg umuddir. Akka ay d Öebbi. Acimi tugim?

verses.text: Issenkar tafrara. Irra iv i ureyyeê, iîij d waggur i leêsab. D wagi ay d aseyyi n Uzmir, Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Issenkar tafrara. Irra iv i ureyyeê, iîij d waggur i leêsab. D wagi ay d aseyyi n Uzmir, Amusnaw.

verses.text: D Neppa i wen Irran itran, ad awen mlen abrid, di tillas n lberr akked yill. Ni$ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
verses.translation: D Neppa i wen Irran itran, ad awen mlen abrid, di tillas n lberr akked yill. Ni$ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud issnen.

verses.text: D Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiman afôid, sinna: amkan, tarusi. Ni$ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud ifehhmen.
verses.translation: D Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiman afôid, sinna: amkan, tarusi. Ni$ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud ifehhmen.

verses.text: D Neppa id Isrusun aman seg igenni. Nessuffu$ ed yissen yal im$an. Nessuffu$ ed yissen tizzegzewt. Nessuffu$ ed yissen iâaqqayen mbabben, iguza n ppmeô id ipûubbun si tezdayin, leonanat n tfeôôant, uzemmur, n ôemman, ppemcabin ne$ ur ppemcabin. Walit ppemôa nnsen mi d teffe$ tebbwa. Ih, deg waya, war ccekk, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: D Neppa id Isrusun aman seg igenni. Nessuffu$ ed yissen yal im$an. Nessuffu$ ed yissen tizzegzewt. Nessuffu$ ed yissen iâaqqayen mbabben, iguza n ppmeô id ipûubbun si tezdayin, leonanat n tfeôôant, uzemmur, n ôemman, ppemcabin ne$ ur ppemcabin. Walit ppemôa nnsen mi d teffe$ tebbwa. Ih, deg waya, war ccekk, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Rran i Öebbi, leonun d icriken, u Ixelq iten. Snulfan aS d arrac, tullas, ur éôin. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aâlay sennig wayen d qqaôen!
verses.translation: Rran i Öebbi, leonun d icriken, u Ixelq iten. Snulfan aS d arrac, tullas, ur éôin. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aâlay sennig wayen d qqaôen!

verses.text: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, amek ara Isâu mmi S, ur Isâi tameddakwelt? U Ixleq yal cci, u Neppa, yal cci, Issen it.
verses.translation: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, amek ara Isâu mmi S, ur Isâi tameddakwelt? U Ixleq yal cci, u Neppa, yal cci, Issen it.

verses.text: D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Ixleq yal cci, ihi âabdet eP. Neppa d Awkil n yal cci.
verses.translation: D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Ixleq yal cci, ihi âabdet eP. Neppa d Awkil n yal cci.

verses.text: Ur T tepsami tmu$li. Neppa Ipsami tamu$li. Neppa d Laîif, i Izôan.
verses.translation: Ur T tepsami tmu$li. Neppa Ipsami tamu$li. Neppa d Laîif, i Izôan.

verses.text: Ni$ iusa kwen id ara twalim, s$uô Mass nnwen. Win iwalan, i iman is; win idre$len, mgal is. Ur lli$ nek d amêareb nnwen.
verses.translation: Ni$ iusa kwen id ara twalim, s$uô Mass nnwen. Win iwalan, i iman is; win idre$len, mgal is. Ur lli$ nek d amêareb nnwen.

verses.text: Akka ay Nessefham issekniyen, iwakken ad inin: "tlemdev", iwakken a t Nbeggen i ugdud issnen.
verses.translation: Akka ay Nessefham issekniyen, iwakken ad inin: "tlemdev", iwakken a t Nbeggen i ugdud issnen.

verses.text: Ddu d wayen ik ed ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass ik; ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Eoo imcurak.
verses.translation: Ddu d wayen ik ed ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass ik; ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Eoo imcurak.

verses.text: Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur curken. Ur k Nerra d amêareb nnsen, ur telliv d awkil nnsen.
verses.translation: Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur curken. Ur k Nerra d amêareb nnsen, ur telliv d awkil nnsen.

verses.text: Ur naâlet wid u$uô la pnujun, war Öebbi. Axaîeô ad naâlen Öebbi, s lbe$wv, war tamusni. Akka ay Ncebbeê igiten is i yal lois. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, tu$alin nnsen; a ten Ixebbeô $ef wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ur naâlet wid u$uô la pnujun, war Öebbi. Axaîeô ad naâlen Öebbi, s lbe$wv, war tamusni. Akka ay Ncebbeê igiten is i yal lois. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, tu$alin nnsen; a ten Ixebbeô $ef wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Ggulen s Öebbi, tagalit meqqwôen, ar ma iusa ten id ussekni, ar ad amnen yis. Ini: "issekniyen ar Öebbi kan". Acu i kwen irran têussem ar, xas ma iusa ten id, ur ppamnen?
verses.translation: Ggulen s Öebbi, tagalit meqqwôen, ar ma iusa ten id ussekni, ar ad amnen yis. Ini: "issekniyen ar Öebbi kan". Acu i kwen irran têussem ar, xas ma iusa ten id, ur ppamnen?

verses.text: A Neppi ulawen nnsen, d yiéôi nnsen, akken ur uminen yis abrid amezwaru. A ten Neoo di lbe$wv nnsen, d ider$alen.
verses.translation: A Neppi ulawen nnsen, d yiéôi nnsen, akken ur uminen yis abrid amezwaru. A ten Neoo di lbe$wv nnsen, d ider$alen.

verses.text: Xas Nekwni Nessers asen d lmalayek, u mmeslayen asen d lmeggtin, u Nefser asen d, yal cci, zdat sen, ur ppamnen, siwa ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi. Maca, aîas degsen ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Xas Nekwni Nessers asen d lmalayek, u mmeslayen asen d lmeggtin, u Nefser asen d, yal cci, zdat sen, ur ppamnen, siwa ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi. Maca, aîas degsen ur ssinen.

verses.text: Akka ay Nerra, i yal nnbi, acengu. Ccwaîen, seg imdanen akw si leonun, ppemweêêin garasen awal uziyn i u$uôôu. Lemmer i S ihwi, i Mass ik, ur p xeddmen. Ihi, eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen,
verses.translation: Akka ay Nerra, i yal nnbi, acengu. Ccwaîen, seg imdanen akw si leonun, ppemweêêin garasen awal uziyn i u$uôôu. Lemmer i S ihwi, i Mass ik, ur p xeddmen. Ihi, eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen,

verses.text: iwakken ad mmalen $uôes ulawen n wid ur numin s laxeôt, a t ôavin, ad gemren ayen zerâen.
verses.translation: iwakken ad mmalen $uôes ulawen n wid ur numin s laxeôt, a t ôavin, ad gemren ayen zerâen.

verses.text: Day b$i$ amêaddi, war Öebbi? D Neppa i wen d Issersen Tazmamt, s ussefhem. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, éôan, ar neppat, ters ed s$uô Mass ik, s tidep. Ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.
verses.translation: Day b$i$ amêaddi, war Öebbi? D Neppa i wen d Issersen Tazmamt, s ussefhem. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, éôan, ar neppat, ters ed s$uô Mass ik, s tidep. Ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.

verses.text: Awal n Mass ik ibbwev, s tidep akked lmizan. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Awal n Mass ik ibbwev, s tidep akked lmizan. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ma tu$ev awal i tegwti n wid illan di tmurt, a k telfen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Teddun kan d wayen nwan. Nitni snulfuyen d kan.
verses.translation: Ma tu$ev awal i tegwti n wid illan di tmurt, a k telfen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Teddun kan d wayen nwan. Nitni snulfuyen d kan.

verses.text: Ih, Mass ik Issen sennig akw, anwi innetlafen seg ubrid iS. Neppa Issen sennig akw, anwi ipwanhan.
verses.translation: Ih, Mass ik Issen sennig akw, anwi innetlafen seg ubrid iS. Neppa Issen sennig akw, anwi ipwanhan.

verses.text: Eççet ayen i$ef d immekti isem n Öebbi, ma tumnem s issekniyen iS.
verses.translation: Eççet ayen i$ef d immekti isem n Öebbi, ma tumnem s issekniyen iS.

verses.text: Acu ikwen iu$en, ur teppeppem ara seg wayen i$ef d immekti isem n Öebbi? Ni$ Issfehm awen ayen i wen Igdel, siwa ma ipwaêeppem fellawen. Ih, aîas ay tellifen, s zzhu nnsen, war tussna. Ni$ Mass ik Iugar akw akken Issen wid izegren tilas.
verses.translation: Acu ikwen iu$en, ur teppeppem ara seg wayen i$ef d immekti isem n Öebbi? Ni$ Issfehm awen ayen i wen Igdel, siwa ma ipwaêeppem fellawen. Ih, aîas ay tellifen, s zzhu nnsen, war tussna. Ni$ Mass ik Iugar akw akken Issen wid izegren tilas.

verses.text: Ekkset abekkav uvhiô akked uffir. Ih, wid ibbwin abekkav, ad ppuqeîîin $ef wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ekkset abekkav uvhiô akked uffir. Ih, wid ibbwin abekkav, ad ppuqeîîin $ef wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Ur teppet ayen i$ef ur d immekti ara, isem n Öebbi. Ih, ayagi d ixmiô. Ih, ccwaîen pweêêin i imeddukwal nnsen, a kwen namren. Ma tu$em asen awal, kunwi, s tidep, tcurkem.
verses.translation: Ur teppet ayen i$ef ur d immekti ara, isem n Öebbi. Ih, ayagi d ixmiô. Ih, ccwaîen pweêêin i imeddukwal nnsen, a kwen namren. Ma tu$em asen awal, kunwi, s tidep, tcurkem.

verses.text: Ma win illan d lmegget, Nessider it id, Nga yas tafat, iteddu yis ger medden, day d amedya s, win illan di tillas, ur izmir ad iffe$ segsent. Akka, ippucebbeê i ijehliyen, wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ma win illan d lmegget, Nessider it id, Nga yas tafat, iteddu yis ger medden, day d amedya s, win illan di tillas, ur izmir ad iffe$ segsent. Akka, ippucebbeê i ijehliyen, wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Akka ay Nerra, ad ppandin di yal tamdint, ibe$wviyen is, uqsiêen mavi. Ppandin kan i iman nnsen, ur faqen.
verses.translation: Akka ay Nerra, ad ppandin di yal tamdint, ibe$wviyen is, uqsiêen mavi. Ppandin kan i iman nnsen, ur faqen.

verses.text: Ma iusa ten id ussekni, ad inin: "ur neppamen, alamma iusa ya$ d ayen id iusan ar imazanen n Öebbi". Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen, anida ara Ifk tabôap iS. Ad iôxisen, ar Öebbi, wid ibe$wven. Fellasen aâaqeb uqsiê, ilmend n wayen ppandin.
verses.translation: Ma iusa ten id ussekni, ad inin: "ur neppamen, alamma iusa ya$ d ayen id iusan ar imazanen n Öebbi". Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen, anida ara Ifk tabôap iS. Ad iôxisen, ar Öebbi, wid ibe$wven. Fellasen aâaqeb uqsiê, ilmend n wayen ppandin.

verses.text: Win Ib$a Öebbi a t Inhu, ad illi idmaren is ar wannuz. Win Ib$a a t Itlef, ad Irr idmaren is deyqen, têeyyôen, amzun ippaâôav ad iali s igenni. Akka i Ippara Öebbi axerwaâ i wid ur numin.
verses.translation: Win Ib$a Öebbi a t Inhu, ad illi idmaren is ar wannuz. Win Ib$a a t Itlef, ad Irr idmaren is deyqen, têeyyôen, amzun ippaâôav ad iali s igenni. Akka i Ippara Öebbi axerwaâ i wid ur numin.

verses.text: Wagi d abrid uwqim n Mass ik. Ni$ Nessefham issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.
verses.translation: Wagi d abrid uwqim n Mass ik. Ni$ Nessefham issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.

verses.text: I nitni, axxam n tifrat ar Mass nnsen. Neppa d Bab nnsen, $ef wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: I nitni, axxam n tifrat ar Mass nnsen. Neppa d Bab nnsen, $ef wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser meôôa: "a yagraw n leonun, ni$ tcerrâem deg imdanen"? A d inin imawlan nnsen, seg imdanen: "a Mass nne$! Kra segne$ $elten si kra, Nebbwev ar lajel nne$, i $ Terriv". Inna: "d times ay d tanezdu$t nnwen, ad degs twekkôem, siwa ma ur aS ihwi i Öebbi". Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser meôôa: "a yagraw n leonun, ni$ tcerrâem deg imdanen"? A d inin imawlan nnsen, seg imdanen: "a Mass nne$! Kra segne$ $elten si kra, Nebbwev ar lajel nne$, i $ Terriv". Inna: "d times ay d tanezdu$t nnwen, ad degs twekkôem, siwa ma ur aS ihwi i Öebbi". Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Akka ay Neppara kra imednas d iêbiben n kra, ilmend n wayen keppben.
verses.translation: Akka ay Neppara kra imednas d iêbiben n kra, ilmend n wayen keppben.

verses.text: "A yagraw n leonun d yimdanen, day ur kwen id usan ara imazanen segwen? Mmalen awen issekniyen iW, nedôen kwen $ef temlilit n wass nnwen agi". Nnan d: "ncehhed $ef yiman nne$". T$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Cehhden $ef yiman nnsen ar nitni, s tidep, llan d ijehliyen.
verses.translation: "A yagraw n leonun d yimdanen, day ur kwen id usan ara imazanen segwen? Mmalen awen issekniyen iW, nedôen kwen $ef temlilit n wass nnwen agi". Nnan d: "ncehhed $ef yiman nne$". T$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Cehhden $ef yiman nnsen ar nitni, s tidep, llan d ijehliyen.

verses.text: Akka, acku Mass ik ur Isquccu tamdint, s ddens, ma llan imezda$ is d i$wefliyen.
verses.translation: Akka, acku Mass ik ur Isquccu tamdint, s ddens, ma llan imezda$ is d i$wefliyen.

verses.text: I yal yiwen, tiseddarin seg wayen ixdem. Ur I$effel Mass ik $ef wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: I yal yiwen, tiseddarin seg wayen ixdem. Ur I$effel Mass ik $ef wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Mass ik d Asâay, d Bab uêunu. Ma ihwa yaS a kwen Ikkes, a d Inûef, deffir wen, ayen i S ihwan, akken ikwen id Ixleq si tarwa n ugdud nniven.
verses.translation: Mass ik d Asâay, d Bab uêunu. Ma ihwa yaS a kwen Ikkes, a d Inûef, deffir wen, ayen i S ihwan, akken ikwen id Ixleq si tarwa n ugdud nniven.

verses.text: Ih, ayen i wen ippuâahden, a d ias, war ccekk. Ur tezmirem, kunwi, a ppesfunngem.
verses.translation: Ih, ayen i wen ippuâahden, a d ias, war ccekk. Ur tezmirem, kunwi, a ppesfunngem.

verses.text: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tewâam, nek ad xedme$. Deqqal a ppeéôem iwumi ara telhu taggara n Uxxam". S tidep, ur rebêen imednas.
verses.translation: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tewâam, nek ad xedme$. Deqqal a ppeéôem iwumi ara telhu taggara n Uxxam". S tidep, ur rebêen imednas.

verses.text: Gan aS i Öebbi amur, seg wayen id Ifka n l$ella, akked lmal. Nnan: "wagi i Öebbi –- di tikta nnsen -, wagi i icriken nne$". Ayen gan i icriken nnsen, ur ippawev ar Öebbi. Ayen gan i Öebbi, neppa, ad yawev ar icriken nnsen. I icmet wayen id pêuddun!
verses.translation: Gan aS i Öebbi amur, seg wayen id Ifka n l$ella, akked lmal. Nnan: "wagi i Öebbi –- di tikta nnsen -, wagi i icriken nne$". Ayen gan i icriken nnsen, ur ippawev ar Öebbi. Ayen gan i Öebbi, neppa, ad yawev ar icriken nnsen. I icmet wayen id pêuddun!

verses.text: Akka ay cebbêen icriken nnsen, i waîas n yimcurak, timen$iwt n tarwa nnsen, iwakken a ten squccen, u ad irwi ddin nnsen, fellasen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur p xeddmen. Eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen.
verses.translation: Akka ay cebbêen icriken nnsen, i waîas n yimcurak, timen$iwt n tarwa nnsen, iwakken a ten squccen, u ad irwi ddin nnsen, fellasen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur p xeddmen. Eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen.

verses.text: Nnan: "lmal akked l$ella yagi ppugedlen, ur ten itepp, siwa win i $ ihwan". S tikta nnsen. Lmal iwumi gedlen iârar nnsen, lmal iwumi ur d ppadren fellasen, isem n Öebbi. D asnulfu mgal iS. A ten Iqeîîi $ef wayen d snulfuyen.
verses.translation: Nnan: "lmal akked l$ella yagi ppugedlen, ur ten itepp, siwa win i $ ihwan". S tikta nnsen. Lmal iwumi gedlen iârar nnsen, lmal iwumi ur d ppadren fellasen, isem n Öebbi. D asnulfu mgal iS. A ten Iqeîîi $ef wayen d snulfuyen.

verses.text: Qqaôen: "ayen illan deg iâabbav n lmal agi, i ddker nne$ kan, ipwagdel i tlawin nne$". Ma ilul ed immut, ad mlilen $uôes. A ten Iqeîîi $ef wayen d qqaôen. Neppa, s tidep, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Qqaôen: "ayen illan deg iâabbav n lmal agi, i ddker nne$ kan, ipwagdel i tlawin nne$". Ma ilul ed immut, ad mlilen $uôes. A ten Iqeîîi $ef wayen d qqaôen. Neppa, s tidep, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ni$ xesôen wid in$an arraw nnsen. D tiderwect, war tussna. Gedlen ayen i s iten I$at Öebbi, snulfan d mgal Öebbi. Ni$ nnetlafen, ur pwanhan.
verses.translation: Ni$ xesôen wid in$an arraw nnsen. D tiderwect, war tussna. Gedlen ayen i s iten I$at Öebbi, snulfan d mgal Öebbi. Ni$ nnetlafen, ur pwanhan.

verses.text: D Neppa id Ixelqen leonanat s iâricen, ne$ war iâricen, tizdayin, zerriâa n yal ûûenf, i wuççi; azemmur akked rreman ippemcabin, ne$ ur neppemcabi. Eççet si ppemôa nnsen, ma fkan d, efket leêqq is, ass u$ellet nnsen. Ur ssugutet. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid ipêawalen.
verses.translation: D Neppa id Ixelqen leonanat s iâricen, ne$ war iâricen, tizdayin, zerriâa n yal ûûenf, i wuççi; azemmur akked rreman ippemcabin, ne$ ur neppemcabi. Eççet si ppemôa nnsen, ma fkan d, efket leêqq is, ass u$ellet nnsen. Ur ssugutet. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid ipêawalen.

verses.text: Si lmal, aggway d wussu. Eççet seg wayen ikwen Iôéeq Öebbi. Ur teddut d iberdan n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Si lmal, aggway d wussu. Eççet seg wayen ikwen Iôéeq Öebbi. Ur teddut d iberdan n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ïamt tyugiwin, snat u$welmi, snat umâiz. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, ne$ d snat n nnta, ne$ d ayen illan deg iâabbav n snat n nnta? Xebbôet iyi d, s tussna, ma tessawalem tidep".
verses.translation: Ïamt tyugiwin, snat u$welmi, snat umâiz. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, ne$ d snat n nnta, ne$ d ayen illan deg iâabbav n snat n nnta? Xebbôet iyi d, s tussna, ma tessawalem tidep".

verses.text: Seg ile$wman, snat, seg ubeqôi, snat. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, ne$ d snat n nnta, ne$ d ayen illan deg iâabbav n snat n nnta, ne$ tellam d inagan mi kwen id Iweûûa Öebbi $ef waya"? Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, iwakken ad itlef imdanen, ur issin. Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
verses.translation: Seg ile$wman, snat, seg ubeqôi, snat. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, ne$ d snat n nnta, ne$ d ayen illan deg iâabbav n snat n nnta, ne$ tellam d inagan mi kwen id Iweûûa Öebbi $ef waya"? Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, iwakken ad itlef imdanen, ur issin. Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

verses.text: Ini: "ur ufi$ ipwagdel a t içç yiwen, deg wayen iyi d ippuweêêan, siwa ma illa d loifa, ne$ d idim immaren, ne$ d aksum n yilef - wagi, war ccekk, d lewsex -, ne$ îêegga s d$wel i war Öebbi. Win i$ef ippuêeppem, ur ib$i, ur ib$wiv, Mass ik, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ini: "ur ufi$ ipwagdel a t içç yiwen, deg wayen iyi d ippuweêêan, siwa ma illa d loifa, ne$ d idim immaren, ne$ d aksum n yilef - wagi, war ccekk, d lewsex -, ne$ îêegga s d$wel i war Öebbi. Win i$ef ippuêeppem, ur ib$i, ur ib$wiv, Mass ik, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: I wudayen, Negdel ayen akw isâan acaren, seg ubeqôi akked u$welmi, Negdel asen tassemt nnsen, siwa tin n iârar nnsen, iâabbav, akked wayen ipwaxelven akked i$san. Akka ay ten Nepkafi, ilmend n îîeôô nnsen. Nekwni, war ccekk, d At Tidep.
verses.translation: I wudayen, Negdel ayen akw isâan acaren, seg ubeqôi akked u$welmi, Negdel asen tassemt nnsen, siwa tin n iârar nnsen, iâabbav, akked wayen ipwaxelven akked i$san. Akka ay ten Nepkafi, ilmend n îîeôô nnsen. Nekwni, war ccekk, d At Tidep.

verses.text: Ma skaddben k, ini: "Mass nnwen d Bab uêunu iwsâan, ur ipwexxiô ssexv iS, af ugdud ibe$wviyen".
verses.translation: Ma skaddben k, ini: "Mass nnwen d Bab uêunu iwsâan, ur ipwexxiô ssexv iS, af ugdud ibe$wviyen".

verses.text: Ad inin imcurak: "lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, nekwni akked imezwura nne$, ur ncurek, ur negdel acemma". Akka ay skaddben imezwura nnsen, armi jeôôben ssexv nne£. Ini: "day tesâam tussna ar a$ d tesseknem? Teppeddum kan d nnwaya, kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan".
verses.translation: Ad inin imcurak: "lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, nekwni akked imezwura nne$, ur ncurek, ur negdel acemma". Akka ay skaddben imezwura nnsen, armi jeôôben ssexv nne£. Ini: "day tesâam tussna ar a$ d tesseknem? Teppeddum kan d nnwaya, kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan".

verses.text: Ini: "n Öebbi timenna tunûiêin. Lemmer i S ihwi, yili Inha kwen akw".
verses.translation: Ini: "n Öebbi timenna tunûiêin. Lemmer i S ihwi, yili Inha kwen akw".

verses.text: Ini: "awit ed inagan nnwen, ara icehhden ar Öebbi Igdel ayagi". Ma cehhden, ur cehhed yidsen. Ur teddu d lhawiyya n wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, akked wid ur numin s laxeôt, u pparan tanudda i Mass nnsen.
verses.translation: Ini: "awit ed inagan nnwen, ara icehhden ar Öebbi Igdel ayagi". Ma cehhden, ur cehhed yidsen. Ur teddu d lhawiyya n wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, akked wid ur numin s laxeôt, u pparan tanudda i Mass nnsen.

verses.text: Ini: "yyaw, ad ini$. I wen Igdel Mass nnwen: ur aS tepcarakem acemma; elhut ar imawlan nnwen; ur neqqet tarwa nnwen, di tigullelt - d Nekwni ara kwen Iôeéqen yidsen -, ur ppaéet ar lâaô, d uvhiô ne$ d uffir; ur neqqet amdan, d ayen Igdel Öebbi, siwa ma s lêeqq". Ar waya i kwen Iweûûa, amar a pfehmem.
verses.translation: Ini: "yyaw, ad ini$. I wen Igdel Mass nnwen: ur aS tepcarakem acemma; elhut ar imawlan nnwen; ur neqqet tarwa nnwen, di tigullelt - d Nekwni ara kwen Iôeéqen yidsen -, ur ppaéet ar lâaô, d uvhiô ne$ d uffir; ur neqqet amdan, d ayen Igdel Öebbi, siwa ma s lêeqq". Ar waya i kwen Iweûûa, amar a pfehmem.

verses.text: Ur pqeôôibet s ayla ugujil, siwa s wayen ilhan, alamma immeêtel. Weznet, ktilet s lewqama. Ur Nepkellif amdan siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ma thedôem d, weznet, xas ma $eô llzem nnwen. Qadôet lemâahda n Öebbi. Iweûûa kwen $ef waya, amar a d temmektim.
verses.translation: Ur pqeôôibet s ayla ugujil, siwa s wayen ilhan, alamma immeêtel. Weznet, ktilet s lewqama. Ur Nepkellif amdan siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ma thedôem d, weznet, xas ma $eô llzem nnwen. Qadôet lemâahda n Öebbi. Iweûûa kwen $ef waya, amar a d temmektim.

verses.text: D wagi ay d abrid iW uwqim, ddut degs. Ur teddut d iberdan ara kwen isîixôen seg ubrid iS. Iweûûa kwen $ef waya, amar a pêezzbem.
verses.translation: D wagi ay d abrid iW uwqim, ddut degs. Ur teddut d iberdan ara kwen isîixôen seg ubrid iS. Iweûûa kwen $ef waya, amar a pêezzbem.

verses.text: Sinna, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Tewqem i wid imaânen, tfeûûel yal cci, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Amar ad amnen s timlilit n Mass nnsen.
verses.translation: Sinna, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Tewqem i wid imaânen, tfeûûel yal cci, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Amar ad amnen s timlilit n Mass nnsen.

verses.text: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers ip id, teôqa. Ihi, ddut yides, êezzbet, amar fellawen aêunu.
verses.translation: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers ip id, teôqa. Ihi, ddut yides, êezzbet, amar fellawen aêunu.

verses.text: Ur d teqqaôem ara: "ters ed kan Tezmamt $eô sin leoyus, uqbel nne$, ur neéôi d acu sselmaden".
verses.translation: Ur d teqqaôem ara: "ters ed kan Tezmamt $eô sin leoyus, uqbel nne$, ur neéôi d acu sselmaden".

verses.text: Ne$ a d tinim: "lemmer id ters Tazmamt $uône$, yili nif iten akken nepwanha". Ni$ iusa kwen id ubeggen, s$uô Mass nnwen, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Anwa idensen sennig win iskaddben issekniyen n Öebbi, u iooa iten? A Nqeîîi wid iooan issekniyen nne£, s yir aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen la ppaooan.
verses.translation: Ne$ a d tinim: "lemmer id ters Tazmamt $uône$, yili nif iten akken nepwanha". Ni$ iusa kwen id ubeggen, s$uô Mass nnwen, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Anwa idensen sennig win iskaddben issekniyen n Öebbi, u iooa iten? A Nqeîîi wid iooan issekniyen nne£, s yir aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen la ppaooan.

verses.text: D acu pôaoun, siwa ma ten id asent lmalayek, ne$ a d Ias Mass ik, ne$ a d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik? Ass ideg ara d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik, ur infaâ umdan liman is, ma, iu$ lêal, ur iumin ara, ne$ ur iksib lxiô, di liman is. Ini: "gganit, nekwni, ih, la nepgani".
verses.translation: D acu pôaoun, siwa ma ten id asent lmalayek, ne$ a d Ias Mass ik, ne$ a d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik? Ass ideg ara d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik, ur infaâ umdan liman is, ma, iu$ lêal, ur iumin ara, ne$ ur iksib lxiô, di liman is. Ini: "gganit, nekwni, ih, la nepgani".

verses.text: Ih, wid ibvan ddin nnsen, u gan ikabaren, ur tepkkiv yidsen deg wacemma. Lameô nnsen ar Öebbi kan, sinna, a ten Ixebbeô $ef wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ibvan ddin nnsen, u gan ikabaren, ur tepkkiv yidsen deg wacemma. Lameô nnsen ar Öebbi kan, sinna, a ten Ixebbeô $ef wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Win id iusan s yise$, ines mraw i t icban; win id iusan s tucmip, ad ippuqeîîi s tin kan i p icban; nitni ur pwadensen.
verses.translation: Win id iusan s yise$, ines mraw i t icban; win id iusan s tucmip, ad ippuqeîîi s tin kan i p icban; nitni ur pwadensen.

verses.text: Ini: "nek, Inha iyi Mass iw, ar ubrid uwqim, d ddin n ddwam, win n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep, ur nelli seg imcurak".
verses.translation: Ini: "nek, Inha iyi Mass iw, ar ubrid uwqim, d ddin n ddwam, win n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep, ur nelli seg imcurak".

verses.text: Ini: "ih, taéallit iw, iseflan iw, tudert iw, tameppant iw, i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
verses.translation: Ini: "ih, taéallit iw, iseflan iw, tudert iw, tameppant iw, i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.

verses.text: Ur aS illi ucarek. Pwamôe$ d s waya: nek d amduâ amenzu".
verses.translation: Ur aS illi ucarek. Pwamôe$ d s waya: nek d amduâ amenzu".

verses.text: Ini: "day b$i$ mass, war Öebbi? U Neppa d Mass n yal cci". Ur ikesseb yal yiman, siwa mgal is. Ur ipbibbi win ibubben taâkkwemt n wayev. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen, tu$alin nnwen. Sinna, a kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen tellam temgaradem.
verses.translation: Ini: "day b$i$ mass, war Öebbi? U Neppa d Mass n yal cci". Ur ikesseb yal yiman, siwa mgal is. Ur ipbibbi win ibubben taâkkwemt n wayev. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen, tu$alin nnwen. Sinna, a kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen tellam temgaradem.

verses.text: D Neppa i kwen Irran d igensas di tmurt. Irra, kra segwen, tiseddaôin sennig wiyav, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb $ef wayen i wen Ifka. Ih, Mass ik Ip$awal deg uâaqeb. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: D Neppa i kwen Irran d igensas di tmurt. Irra, kra segwen, tiseddaôin sennig wiyav, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb $ef wayen i wen Ifka. Ih, Mass ik Ip$awal deg uâaqeb. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A neckeô Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan. Irra tillas, tafat. Sinna, wid ijehlen pparan tanudda i Mass nnsen.
ayahs.translation: A neckeô Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan. Irra tillas, tafat. Sinna, wid ijehlen pparan tanudda i Mass nnsen.

ayahs.text: Neppa, ikwen Ixelqen s talaxt, sinna, Iseyya lajel. £uôeS lajel ipwassnen. Deffir waya, kunwi la tepcukkum.
ayahs.translation: Neppa, ikwen Ixelqen s talaxt, sinna, Iseyya lajel. £uôeS lajel ipwassnen. Deffir waya, kunwi la tepcukkum.

ayahs.text: Neppa, d Öebbi deg igenwan, di tmurt. Issen sser nnwen, d wayen d teqqaôem. Iéôa ayen tkesbem.
ayahs.translation: Neppa, d Öebbi deg igenwan, di tmurt. Issen sser nnwen, d wayen d teqqaôem. Iéôa ayen tkesbem.

ayahs.text: Ur ten id ippas ussekni seg issekniyen n Mass nnsen, mebla ma ugin t.
ayahs.translation: Ur ten id ippas ussekni seg issekniyen n Mass nnsen, mebla ma ugin t.

ayahs.text: Ni$ skaddben tidep, mi ten id tusa. A ten id ias usali n wayen i$ef ttihin.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ skaddben tidep, mi ten id tusa. A ten id ias usali n wayen i$ef ttihin.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara acêal isuta, uqbel nnsen, ay Nekkes. Nesserked iten di tmurt akken ur kwen Nesserked. Nuzen asen aîas ugeffur, Nerra yasen isaffen, ppazzalen seddawat sen. Nesnegr iten ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Nxelq ed, deffir sen, sself nniven.
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara acêal isuta, uqbel nnsen, ay Nekkes. Nesserked iten di tmurt akken ur kwen Nesserked. Nuzen asen aîas ugeffur, Nerra yasen isaffen, ppazzalen seddawat sen. Nesnegr iten ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Nxelq ed, deffir sen, sself nniven.

ayahs.text: Xas ad ak ed Nessers Tazmamt, di lka$ev, ara nnalen s ifassen nnsen, war ccekk, a d inin wid ijehlen: "wagi, s tidep, siwa ssêur n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: Xas ad ak ed Nessers Tazmamt, di lka$ev, ara nnalen s ifassen nnsen, war ccekk, a d inin wid ijehlen: "wagi, s tidep, siwa ssêur n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Qqaôen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes lmelk". Lemmer a n Nessers lmelk, war ccekk, ad iûaô lameô, sinna, ur pganin.
ayahs.translation: Qqaôen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes lmelk". Lemmer a n Nessers lmelk, war ccekk, ad iûaô lameô, sinna, ur pganin.

ayahs.text: Lemmer i t Nerri d lmelk, yili Nerra t d argaz, ad as Nessels ayen plusun.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i t Nerri d lmelk, yili Nerra t d argaz, ad as Nessels ayen plusun.

ayahs.text: Ni$ mmaâlken $ef imazanen, uqbel ik. Ayen i$ef ttihin, izzi i wid, segsen, immaâlken.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ mmaâlken $ef imazanen, uqbel ik. Ayen i$ef ttihin, izzi i wid, segsen, immaâlken.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ddut di tmurt, sinna walit amek tevôa d wid iskiddiben".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ddut di tmurt, sinna walit amek tevôa d wid iskiddiben".

ayahs.text: Ini: "w i t ilan wayen akw illan di tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi". Iura, deg iman iS, aêunu. A kwen Issemlil i wass n tnekra, ur ccekk fellas. Wid isxesôen iman nnsen, ur ppamnen.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "w i t ilan wayen akw illan di tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi". Iura, deg iman iS, aêunu. A kwen Issemlil i wass n tnekra, ur ccekk fellas. Wid isxesôen iman nnsen, ur ppamnen.

ayahs.text: IneS i ized$en deg iv, deg wass. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: IneS i ized$en deg iv, deg wass. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ini: "day ara sâu$ bab, war Öebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan? Neppa Icceççay ur t cceççayen". Ini: "nek pwamôe$ d ad ili$ d amenzu ara ianzen. Ur ppilit seg imcurak".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "day ara sâu$ bab, war Öebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan? Neppa Icceççay ur t cceççayen". Ini: "nek pwamôe$ d ad ili$ d amenzu ara ianzen. Ur ppilit seg imcurak".

ayahs.text: Ini: "nek ugade$, ma aâûa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "nek ugade$, ma aâûa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".

ayahs.text: Win imenâan segs, assen, ni$ Iêun fellas. Wagi d rrebê n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Win imenâan segs, assen, ni$ Iêun fellas. Wagi d rrebê n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ma Isâadda Öebbi fellak cedda, ur p itekkes yiwen, siwa Neppa. Ma Isrebê ik, Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ma Isâadda Öebbi fellak cedda, ur p itekkes yiwen, siwa Neppa. Ma Isrebê ik, Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: D Neppa ay d Aqehhaô, sennig imdanen iS; d Neppa ay d Bab n ûûwab, i Iéôan.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa ay d Aqehhaô, sennig imdanen iS; d Neppa ay d Bab n ûûwab, i Iéôan.

ayahs.text: Ini: "anda p ccada sennig akw tiyav"? Ini: "Öebbi d Anagi gari yidwen. Iweêêa yi d Leqwôan agi, iwakken a kwen nabi$ yis, kunwi akked wid u$uô ibbwev. Day, kunwi, war ccekk, a pcehhdem ar, ar tama n Öebbi, llan iôebbiten nniven"? Ini: "ur cehhde$"! Ini: "Neppa d Öebbi, siwa Yiwen. Nek, rri$ akin ayen tepcarakem".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "anda p ccada sennig akw tiyav"? Ini: "Öebbi d Anagi gari yidwen. Iweêêa yi d Leqwôan agi, iwakken a kwen nabi$ yis, kunwi akked wid u$uô ibbwev. Day, kunwi, war ccekk, a pcehhdem ar, ar tama n Öebbi, llan iôebbiten nniven"? Ini: "ur cehhde$"! Ini: "Neppa d Öebbi, siwa Yiwen. Nek, rri$ akin ayen tepcarakem".

ayahs.text: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, ssnen p, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. Wid isxesôen iman nnsen, ihi, ur ppamnen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, ssnen p, akken ssnen arraw nnsen. Wid isxesôen iman nnsen, ihi, ur ppamnen.

ayahs.text: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebêen imednas.
ayahs.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebêen imednas.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara ten Nefser meôôa, sinna a Nini i wid icurken: "anda ten icriken nnwen, i la tâabdem"?
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Nefser meôôa, sinna a Nini i wid icurken: "anda ten icriken nnwen, i la tâabdem"?

ayahs.text: Deg uhewwel nnsen, siwa ma nnan d: "s Öebbi, Mass nne$, ur nelli d imcurak"!
ayahs.translation: Deg uhewwel nnsen, siwa ma nnan d: "s Öebbi, Mass nne$, ur nelli d imcurak"!

ayahs.text: Wali amek skaddben $ef yiman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen la d snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: Wali amek skaddben $ef yiman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen la d snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Garasen wid i k issemêasen. Nerra aêurrim $ef ulawen nnsen, iwakken ur t fehmen. Tiâééegt deg imeééu$en nnsen. Ma walan yal assekni, ur ppamnen yis. Alamma, ma usan d $uôek, a k namren, ad ak inin wid ijehlen: ayagi siwa tiêkayin imezwura.
ayahs.translation: Garasen wid i k issemêasen. Nerra aêurrim $ef ulawen nnsen, iwakken ur t fehmen. Tiâééegt deg imeééu$en nnsen. Ma walan yal assekni, ur ppamnen yis. Alamma, ma usan d $uôek, a k namren, ad ak inin wid ijehlen: ayagi siwa tiêkayin imezwura.

ayahs.text: Sîixxiôen segs, îîeôôifen segs. Ay squccun siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.
ayahs.translation: Sîixxiôen segs, îîeôôifen segs. Ay squccun siwa iman nnsen, ur faqen.

ayahs.text: Lemmer a ten twaliv, mara bedden ar tmes, a d inin: a ssexv nne$! Awi $ irran, ur neskiddib issekniyen n Mass nne$! A nili si lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer a ten twaliv, mara bedden ar tmes, a d inin: a ssexv nne$! Awi $ irran, ur neskiddib issekniyen n Mass nne$! A nili si lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Xaîi! Iban asen d wayen teffren, zik. Lemmer a d kren, ad u$alen ar wayen i sen ipwagedlen. Nitni, s tidep, d ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! Iban asen d wayen teffren, zik. Lemmer a d kren, ad u$alen ar wayen i sen ipwagedlen. Nitni, s tidep, d ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: U qqaôen: "siwa tameddurt n ddunit i illan. Nekwni, ur fella$ tanekra".
ayahs.translation: U qqaôen: "siwa tameddurt n ddunit i illan. Nekwni, ur fella$ tanekra".

ayahs.text: Lemmer a pwaliv mara bedden ar Mass nnsen, ad Yini: "ni$ ayagi s tidep"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nne$"! Ad Yini: "ihi jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tejhilem".
ayahs.translation: Lemmer a pwaliv mara bedden ar Mass nnsen, ad Yini: "ni$ ayagi s tidep"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nne$"! Ad Yini: "ihi jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tejhilem".

ayahs.text: Ni$ xesôen wid iskaddben timlilit akked öÖebbi. Alamma, ma iusa ten id yimir, deqzalla, a d inin: "a yamxix nne$, $ef wayen ideg nestehza"! Nitni ad bibben tiâakkwumin nnsen $ef izugar nnsen. I icmet wayen bubben!
ayahs.translation: Ni$ xesôen wid iskaddben timlilit akked öÖebbi. Alamma, ma iusa ten id yimir, deqzalla, a d inin: "a yamxix nne$, $ef wayen ideg nestehza"! Nitni ad bibben tiâakkwumin nnsen $ef izugar nnsen. I icmet wayen bubben!

ayahs.text: Tameddurt n ddunit d urar kan akked lhawiyya. Axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, yif ip i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tepmeyyizem ara?
ayahs.translation: Tameddurt n ddunit d urar kan akked lhawiyya. Axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, yif ip i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tepmeyyizem ara?

ayahs.text: Ni$ Neéôa i$webben ik, s tidep, wayen qqaôen. Ihi, nitni ur k skiddiben. Maca imednas veggôen issekniyen n Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Neéôa i$webben ik, s tidep, wayen qqaôen. Ihi, nitni ur k skiddiben. Maca imednas veggôen issekniyen n Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Ni$ skaddben imazanen uqbel ik. Üebôen $ef wayen i ten skaddben, akked wayen i ten meêênen, armi i ten id iusa usellek nne£. Ur illi ubeddel i wawalen n Öebbi. Ni$ usan k id, kra isallen imazanen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ skaddben imazanen uqbel ik. Üebôen $ef wayen i ten skaddben, akked wayen i ten meêênen, armi i ten id iusa usellek nne£. Ur illi ubeddel i wawalen n Öebbi. Ni$ usan k id, kra isallen imazanen.

ayahs.text: Ma ééay fellak uwexxeô nnsen, ma tzemôev a tessarmev aderbuz di tmurt, ne$ sellum s igenni, ad asen d tawiv assekni. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, a ten Issemlil ar nnhaya. Ur ppili seg wid ur nessin.
ayahs.translation: Ma ééay fellak uwexxeô nnsen, ma tzemôev a tessarmev aderbuz di tmurt, ne$ sellum s igenni, ad asen d tawiv assekni. Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, a ten Issemlil ar nnhaya. Ur ppili seg wid ur nessin.

ayahs.text: Siwa wid isellen, ara d ijawben. Lmegtin a ten id Issker Öebbi, sinna, $uôeS tu$alin nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Siwa wid isellen, ara d ijawben. Lmegtin a ten id Issker Öebbi, sinna, $uôeS tu$alin nnsen.

ayahs.text: Qqaôen: "acimi ur as d irs ara ussekni s$uô Mass is"? Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer a d Issers assekni", maca tegwti degsen ur éôin.
ayahs.translation: Qqaôen: "acimi ur as d irs ara ussekni s$uô Mass is"? Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer a d Issers assekni", maca tegwti degsen ur éôin.

ayahs.text: Ur illi lweêc di tmurt, ne$ ufrux ippafgen s wafriwen is, ur nelli d leoyus am kunwi. Ur Nestehza, di Tezmamt, $ef wacemma. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, ad pwafessren.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi lweêc di tmurt, ne$ ufrux ippafgen s wafriwen is, ur nelli d leoyus am kunwi. Ur Nestehza, di Tezmamt, $ef wacemma. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, ad pwafessren.

ayahs.text: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, âaégen, gugmen, di tillas. Win i S ihwan i Öebbi, a t Itlef. Win i S ihwan, a t Iawi d ubrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, âaégen, gugmen, di tillas. Win i S ihwan i Öebbi, a t Itlef. Win i S ihwan, a t Iawi d ubrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Ini: "twalam ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb n Öebbi, ne$ ma iusa kwen id yimir, day ar war Öebbi ara tnaâôem, ma tessawalem tidep?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "twalam ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb n Öebbi, ne$ ma iusa kwen id yimir, day ar war Öebbi ara tnaâôem, ma tessawalem tidep?

ayahs.text: Xaîi! £uôeS ara tnujem. Ad Issiferr ayen i$ef tnujem $uôeS, ma ihwa yaS, a ppeppum ayen tcurkem".
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! £uôeS ara tnujem. Ad Issiferr ayen i$ef tnujem $uôeS, ma ihwa yaS, a ppeppum ayen tcurkem".

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed ar leoyus, uqbel ik. Nesâadda fellasen tilufa, ccqa, amar ad êiwten.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed ar leoyus, uqbel ik. Nesâadda fellasen tilufa, ccqa, amar ad êiwten.

ayahs.text: A lemmer êawten, mi ten id tusa tiyta nne£. Maca, qehôen wulawen nnsen. Cciîan Icebbeê asen ayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: A lemmer êawten, mi ten id tusa tiyta nne£. Maca, qehôen wulawen nnsen. Cciîan Icebbeê asen ayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Mi ppun ayen i sen d smmektin, Nelli yasen tibbura n yal cci, armi, mi feôêen s wayen i sen ippunefken, Newwet iten, deqzalla. D$a qevâen layas.
ayahs.translation: Mi ppun ayen i sen d smmektin, Nelli yasen tibbura n yal cci, armi, mi feôêen s wayen i sen ippunefken, Newwet iten, deqzalla. D$a qevâen layas.

ayahs.text: Pwakksen wid id igwran seg ugdud idensen. Ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Pwakksen wid id igwran seg ugdud idensen. Ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "twalam, ma Iddem awen Öebbi timesliwt nnwen, akked iéôi nnwen; ma Isle$ ulawen nnwen; anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ar awen ten id iawin"? Wali amek Nessefham issekniyen, u nitni, sinna, zzin akin.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "twalam, ma Iddem awen Öebbi timesliwt nnwen, akked iéôi nnwen; ma Isle$ ulawen nnwen; anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ar awen ten id iawin"? Wali amek Nessefham issekniyen, u nitni, sinna, zzin akin.

ayahs.text: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb n Öebbi, deqzalla, ne$ âinani? Day ara Ine$, siwa agdud imednas"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb n Öebbi, deqzalla, ne$ âinani? Day ara Ine$, siwa agdud imednas"?

ayahs.text: Ur d Nuzen imazanen, siwa i ubecceô, d unabi. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Ur d Nuzen imazanen, siwa i ubecceô, d unabi. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, a ten iêaz uâaqeb, ilmend n wayen be$wven.
ayahs.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, a ten iêaz uâaqeb, ilmend n wayen be$wven.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur awen qqare$ sâi$ igerrujen n Öebbi, ur ssine$ tabavnit; ur awen qqare$: nek, d lmelk. Nek, teddu$ kan akked wayen iyi d ippuweêêan". Ini: "day iaâdel uder$al d win ipwalin? Day ur d tepmeyyizem ara"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur awen qqare$ sâi$ igerrujen n Öebbi, ur ssine$ tabavnit; ur awen qqare$: nek, d lmelk. Nek, teddu$ kan akked wayen iyi d ippuweêêan". Ini: "day iaâdel uder$al d win ipwalin? Day ur d tepmeyyizem ara"?

ayahs.text: Nabi yis wid iugaden ad pwafessren ar Mass nnsen. Ur sâin bab, war Neppa, ne$ amcafaâ. Amar ad êezzben.
ayahs.translation: Nabi yis wid iugaden ad pwafessren ar Mass nnsen. Ur sâin bab, war Neppa, ne$ amcafaâ. Amar ad êezzben.

ayahs.text: Ur ppara wid ipnujun $uô Mass nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit, pnadin udem iS. Ur fellak a ten têasbev deg wacemma, ur fellasen a k êasben, deg wacemma. Ma terriv ten, ihi, a ppiliv seg imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppara wid ipnujun $uô Mass nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit, pnadin udem iS. Ur fellak a ten têasbev deg wacemma, ur fellasen a k êasben, deg wacemma. Ma terriv ten, ihi, a ppiliv seg imednas.

ayahs.text: Akka ay Nhewwel kra s wiyav, iwakken a d inin: "day d wigi i I$at Öebbi, garane$"? Day ur Issin ara Öebbi, sennig akw, wid isnemmiren?
ayahs.translation: Akka ay Nhewwel kra s wiyav, iwakken a d inin: "day d wigi i I$at Öebbi, garane$"? Day ur Issin ara Öebbi, sennig akw, wid isnemmiren?

ayahs.text: Ma usan k id wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£, ini: "tifrat fellawen"! Mass nnwen Iura, i iman iS, aêunu. Ihi, i win, segwen, ixedmen tucmip, ur iâammed, sin akin, isteôoaâ, u ixdem ayen ilhan, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ma usan k id wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£, ini: "tifrat fellawen"! Mass nnwen Iura, i iman iS, aêunu. Ihi, i win, segwen, ixedmen tucmip, ur iâammed, sin akin, isteôoaâ, u ixdem ayen ilhan, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen, iwakken a d iban ubrid ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen, iwakken a d iban ubrid ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "nek, ippugdel iyi ad âabde$ wid u$uô la tepnujum, war Öebbi". Ini: "ur teddu$ d lemcihwat nnwen, mulac ad nnetlafe$, ur ppili$ seg wid ipwanhan".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "nek, ippugdel iyi ad âabde$ wid u$uô la tepnujum, war Öebbi". Ini: "ur teddu$ d lemcihwat nnwen, mulac ad nnetlafe$, ur ppili$ seg wid ipwanhan".

ayahs.text: Ini: "nek, îîfe$ deg ubeggen n Mass iw. Teskaddbem t. Ur illi $uôi wayen u$uô têarem. Ih, aêuddu $eô Öebbi kan. Issawal tidep. Neppa Yif akw wid issenqaden".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "nek, îîfe$ deg ubeggen n Mass iw. Teskaddbem t. Ur illi $uôi wayen u$uô têarem. Ih, aêuddu $eô Öebbi kan. Issawal tidep. Neppa Yif akw wid issenqaden".

ayahs.text: Ini: "lemmer illi $uôi wayen u$uô têarem, yili iûaô lameô, gari yidwen". Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "lemmer illi $uôi wayen u$uô têarem, yili iûaô lameô, gari yidwen". Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen imednas.

ayahs.text: £uôeS tisura n tbavnit. Siwa Neppa itent Issnen. Iéôa i illan di lberr, di yill. Ur i$elli ifer siwa ma Iéôa t. Akken aâqqa di tillas n tmurt, tizzegzewt, ta$eôt, akw di tezmamt ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: £uôeS tisura n tbavnit. Siwa Neppa itent Issnen. Iéôa i illan di lberr, di yill. Ur i$elli ifer siwa ma Iéôa t. Akken aâqqa di tillas n tmurt, tizzegzewt, ta$eôt, akw di tezmamt ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i wen ippaddamen leôwaê deg iv. Iéôa ay txeddmem, deg wass. Sinna, Ippara kwen id degs, iwakken ad ivôu lajel ipwassnen. Sinna, $uôeS tu$alin nnwen, sinna, a kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i wen ippaddamen leôwaê deg iv. Iéôa ay txeddmem, deg wass. Sinna, Ippara kwen id degs, iwakken ad ivôu lajel ipwassnen. Sinna, $uôeS tu$alin nnwen, sinna, a kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: D Neppa ay d Aqehhaô sennig imdanen iS. Ippazen ed $uôwen imêaraben, alamma, ma tusa d tmeppant ar yiwen segwen, ad ddmen ôôuê is, imceggâen nne£. Nitni ur stehzayen.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa ay d Aqehhaô sennig imdanen iS. Ippazen ed $uôwen imêaraben, alamma, ma tusa d tmeppant ar yiwen segwen, ad ddmen ôôuê is, imceggâen nne£. Nitni ur stehzayen.

ayahs.text: Sinna, ad u$alen ar Öebbi, Bab nnsen n tidep. Aêuddu, day maççi d ayla S? Neppa Yif akw akken Ip$awal ar uqeîîi.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, ad u$alen ar Öebbi, Bab nnsen n tidep. Aêuddu, day maççi d ayla S? Neppa Yif akw akken Ip$awal ar uqeîîi.

ayahs.text: Ini: "anwa ara kwen Isellken si tillas n lberr d yill, u$uô tnujem s uêiwet akked tugwdi"? "Ma Isellek a$ si tagi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "anwa ara kwen Isellken si tillas n lberr d yill, u$uô tnujem s uêiwet akked tugwdi"? "Ma Isellek a$ si tagi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".

ayahs.text: Ini: "Öebbi Isellek ikwen segs, akw si yal lhemm, sinna, kunwi la tepcarakem".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "Öebbi Isellek ikwen segs, akw si yal lhemm, sinna, kunwi la tepcarakem".

ayahs.text: Ini: "Neppa, Izmer ad awen d Iazen aâaqeb sennig wen, ne$ seddaw ivaôen nnwen. Ne$ a kwen Issemfaôaq, kra segwen ad jeôôben leqheô n wiyav". Wali amek id Nemmal issekniyen, amar ad meêûen.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "Neppa, Izmer ad awen d Iazen aâaqeb sennig wen, ne$ seddaw ivaôen nnwen. Ne$ a kwen Issemfaôaq, kra segwen ad jeôôben leqheô n wiyav". Wali amek id Nemmal issekniyen, amar ad meêûen.

ayahs.text: Iskaddeb it ugdud ik, u neppa d tidep. Ini: "ur awen lli$ d awkil.
ayahs.translation: Iskaddeb it ugdud ik, u neppa d tidep. Ini: "ur awen lli$ d awkil.

ayahs.text: Yal asali s lweqt is. A ppu$alem a ppeéôem".
ayahs.translation: Yal asali s lweqt is. A ppu$alem a ppeéôem".

ayahs.text: Ma twalav wid ipnamaren $ef issekniyen nne£, eoo iten, alamma bedlen anamer. Ma iseppu k Cciîan, mi d temmektiv, ur p$imi d ugdud imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ma twalav wid ipnamaren $ef issekniyen nne£, eoo iten, alamma bedlen anamer. Ma iseppu k Cciîan, mi d temmektiv, ur p$imi d ugdud imednas.

ayahs.text: Ur isefk ara i wid ipêezziben, a ten êasben deg wacemma. Maca d asmekti, amar ad êezzben.
ayahs.translation: Ur isefk ara i wid ipêezziben, a ten êasben deg wacemma. Maca d asmekti, amar ad êezzben.

ayahs.text: Eoo wid irran ddin nnsen d urar, d aqesseô. T$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Mmekti d yis, ard a ipwaîîef umdan $ef wayen ikseb. Ur isâi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ amcafaâ. Yal le$ôama ur tepwaqbal segs. Widak d wid ipwaîfen $ef wayen kesben. I nitni tissit iô$an, aâaqeb aqeôêan, ilmend n wayen la jehlen.
ayahs.translation: Eoo wid irran ddin nnsen d urar, d aqesseô. T$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Mmekti d yis, ard a ipwaîîef umdan $ef wayen ikseb. Ur isâi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ amcafaâ. Yal le$ôama ur tepwaqbal segs. Widak d wid ipwaîfen $ef wayen kesben. I nitni tissit iô$an, aâaqeb aqeôêan, ilmend n wayen la jehlen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "day a nâaô, war Öebbi, ayen ur a$ neneffaâ, ur a$ neîîuôôu? U a nu$al a nwexxeô, deffir nnhaya n Öebbi, am win $ewwan ccwaîen di tmurt, u ippuêeyyeô". Pnecciden t imeddukwal ar nnhaya: "yya $uône$"! Ini: "d nnhaya n Öebbi, s tidep, ay d nnhaya. Nepwameô a nanez i Mass imavalen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "day a nâaô, war Öebbi, ayen ur a$ neneffaâ, ur a$ neîîuôôu? U a nu$al a nwexxeô, deffir nnhaya n Öebbi, am win $ewwan ccwaîen di tmurt, u ippuêeyyeô". Pnecciden t imeddukwal ar nnhaya: "yya $uône$"! Ini: "d nnhaya n Öebbi, s tidep, ay d nnhaya. Nepwameô a nanez i Mass imavalen".

ayahs.text: èéalet, êezzbet aS. £uôeS, Neppa, ara tepwafessrem.
ayahs.translation: èéalet, êezzbet aS. £uôeS, Neppa, ara tepwafessrem.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ass ideg ara Yini: "ili"! Ad yili. Awal iS d tidep. IneS tagelda. Ass uûuvu n lbuq, Iéôa i iffren d wayen ivehôen. Neppa d Bab n ûûwab, i Iéôan.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ass ideg ara Yini: "ili"! Ad yili. Awal iS d tidep. IneS tagelda. Ass uûuvu n lbuq, Iéôa i iffren d wayen ivehôen. Neppa d Bab n ûûwab, i Iéôan.

ayahs.text: Mi inna Ibôahim i baba s, Azaô: "day a pperrev tiâancuôin d iôebbiten? Nek wala$ k, keçç akked ugdud ik, di ttelfan n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Ibôahim i baba s, Azaô: "day a pperrev tiâancuôin d iôebbiten? Nek wala$ k, keçç akked ugdud ik, di ttelfan n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Akka, Nessken i Ibôahim, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, iwakken ad yili seg wid itebbten.
ayahs.translation: Akka, Nessken i Ibôahim, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, iwakken ad yili seg wid itebbten.

ayahs.text: Mi t i$umm yiv, iwala itri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi ixsi, inna: "ur êemle$ ara wid ixessin".
ayahs.translation: Mi t i$umm yiv, iwala itri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi ixsi, inna: "ur êemle$ ara wid ixessin".

ayahs.text: Mi iwala iuli d waggur n tziri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi i$ab, inna: "ma ur iyi Inha ara Mass iw, ad ili$, war ccekk, seg ugdud im$eôôqen".
ayahs.translation: Mi iwala iuli d waggur n tziri, inna: "wagi d Mass iw". Mi i$ab, inna: "ma ur iyi Inha ara Mass iw, ad ili$, war ccekk, seg ugdud im$eôôqen".

ayahs.text: Mi iwala iîij ineqqeô ed, inna: "wagi d Mass iw, wagi meqqweô kteô". Mi i$li, inna: "a yagdud iw! Nek rri$ akkin ayen tepcarakem.
ayahs.translation: Mi iwala iîij ineqqeô ed, inna: "wagi d Mass iw, wagi meqqweô kteô". Mi i$li, inna: "a yagdud iw! Nek rri$ akkin ayen tepcarakem.

ayahs.text: Nek zzi$ udem iw ar Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, male$ ar tidep. Ur lli$, nek, seg imcurak".
ayahs.translation: Nek zzi$ udem iw ar Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, male$ ar tidep. Ur lli$, nek, seg imcurak".

ayahs.text: Ixuûem it ugdud is, inna: "day ad iyi txaûmem $ef Öebbi? Ni$ Inha yi; ur ugade$ ayen i S tcurkem, siwa ma illa wayen i S ihwan i Mass iw. Tussna n Mass iw tezdi yal cci, day ur d tesmektayem ara?
ayahs.translation: Ixuûem it ugdud is, inna: "day ad iyi txaûmem $ef Öebbi? Ni$ Inha yi; ur ugade$ ayen i S tcurkem, siwa ma illa wayen i S ihwan i Mass iw. Tussna n Mass iw tezdi yal cci, day ur d tesmektayem ara?

ayahs.text: Amek ara ugade$ ayen tepcarakem, ur tugadem mi kunwi tepcarakem, i Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu fellawen? Anwa, ger sin ikabaran, i iklalen laman, maday tessnem"?
ayahs.translation: Amek ara ugade$ ayen tepcarakem, ur tugadem mi kunwi tepcarakem, i Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu fellawen? Anwa, ger sin ikabaran, i iklalen laman, maday tessnem"?

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen, ur sselsen ddens i liman nnsen, widak ad ilin di laman, u nitni pwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen, ur sselsen ddens i liman nnsen, widak ad ilin di laman, u nitni pwanhan.

ayahs.text: D wagi ay d awal nne£. Nefka yas t i Ibôahim, mgal agdud is. Nessalay tiseddaôin, win i£ £ ihwan. Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: D wagi ay d awal nne£. Nefka yas t i Ibôahim, mgal agdud is. Nessalay tiseddaôin, win i£ £ ihwan. Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Nefka yas Isêaq akked Yaâqub. I sin, Nenha ten. Nenha, zik, Nuê akw, ger tarwa s, Dawed, Sliman, Yub, Yusef, Musa, Haôun, - Akka ay Nepkafi iâaôviyen -
ayahs.translation: Nefka yas Isêaq akked Yaâqub. I sin, Nenha ten. Nenha, zik, Nuê akw, ger tarwa s, Dawed, Sliman, Yub, Yusef, Musa, Haôun, - Akka ay Nepkafi iâaôviyen -

ayahs.text: Zakarya, Yeêya, Âisa, Ilyas, - akw seg iâaôviyen -
ayahs.translation: Zakarya, Yeêya, Âisa, Ilyas, - akw seg iâaôviyen -

ayahs.text: Ismaâil, Lyasâa, Yunes, Luî, - akw Nesmenyaf iten $ef imavalen -
ayahs.translation: Ismaâil, Lyasâa, Yunes, Luî, - akw Nesmenyaf iten $ef imavalen -

ayahs.text: akw seg ibabaten nnsen, si tarwa nnsen, akked watmaten nnsen. Nefren iten, u Nebbwi ten d ubrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: akw seg ibabaten nnsen, si tarwa nnsen, akked watmaten nnsen. Nefren iten, u Nebbwi ten d ubrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Tagi d nnhaya n Öebbi. Inehhu yis win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Lemmer curken, war ccekk, ad asen imêu wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Tagi d nnhaya n Öebbi. Inehhu yis win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Lemmer curken, war ccekk, ad asen imêu wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: D wigi iwumi d Nebbwi Tazmamt, ûûwab, akked lambiyya. Ma jehlen widak yis, ihi, Nekwni Nwekkel ip i ugdud ur njehhel yis.
ayahs.translation: D wigi iwumi d Nebbwi Tazmamt, ûûwab, akked lambiyya. Ma jehlen widak yis, ihi, Nekwni Nwekkel ip i ugdud ur njehhel yis.

ayahs.text: Wigi d wid Inha Öebbi. Ddu d nnhaya nnsen. Ini: "ur awen suture$, fellas, taqdiât. Neppa d asmekti kan i imavalen".
ayahs.translation: Wigi d wid Inha Öebbi. Ddu d nnhaya nnsen. Ini: "ur awen suture$, fellas, taqdiât. Neppa d asmekti kan i imavalen".

ayahs.text: Ur qudôen Öebbi azal n lqedô iS, mi qqaôen: "ur d Issers Öebbi acemma ar umdan". Ini: "anwa id Issersen Tazmamt, id ibbwi Musa, d tafat u d nnhaya i medden? Tepparam p di lkwa$ev i tesskanem. Aîas ay teppeffrem. Tlemdem ayen ur tessinem, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen". Ini: "D Öebbi". Sinna, anef asen ad uraren s nnmara nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ur qudôen Öebbi azal n lqedô iS, mi qqaôen: "ur d Issers Öebbi acemma ar umdan". Ini: "anwa id Issersen Tazmamt, id ibbwi Musa, d tafat u d nnhaya i medden? Tepparam p di lkwa$ev i tesskanem. Aîas ay teppeffrem. Tlemdem ayen ur tessinem, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen". Ini: "D Öebbi". Sinna, anef asen ad uraren s nnmara nnsen.

ayahs.text: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers ip id teôqa, a ptebbet ayen ip id izwaren, a ppendeô tayimmap n temdinin akked wayen i s d izzin. Wid iumnen s laxeôt, umnen yis. Nitni bedden i téilla nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers ip id teôqa, a ptebbet ayen ip id izwaren, a ppendeô tayimmap n temdinin akked wayen i s d izzin. Wid iumnen s laxeôt, umnen yis. Nitni bedden i téilla nnsen.

ayahs.text: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Ne$ inna: "ppuweêêa$ d", ur as d ippuweêêa wacemma? U win innan: "a d sserse$ am wayen id Issers Öebbi"? Lemmer a pwaliv imednas, di maylellif n tmeppant, u lmalayek élent ed ifassen nnsent: "ssuff$et ed tiôwiêin nnwen. Assa, a ppeppuqeîîim s uâaqeb isneêcamen, ilmend n wayen teqqaôem $ef Öebbi, ur d tidep. U tellam tessem$waôem iman nnwen, $ef issekniyen iS".
ayahs.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win d igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Ne$ inna: "ppuweêêa$ d", ur as d ippuweêêa wacemma? U win innan: "a d sserse$ am wayen id Issers Öebbi"? Lemmer a pwaliv imednas, di maylellif n tmeppant, u lmalayek élent ed ifassen nnsent: "ssuff$et ed tiôwiêin nnwen. Assa, a ppeppuqeîîim s uâaqeb isneêcamen, ilmend n wayen teqqaôem $ef Öebbi, ur d tidep. U tellam tessem$waôem iman nnwen, $ef issekniyen iS".

ayahs.text: Ni$ tusam a£ d, d ifôiden, akken ikwen Nexleq abrid amezwaru. Teooam deffir wen, ayen i wen Nefka. Ur Nwala, $uôwen, imcafâen nnwen, wid i tâabdem, nitni, d icriken nnwen. Ni$ temfaôaqem, u ooan kwen wid la tâabdem.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ tusam a£ d, d ifôiden, akken ikwen Nexleq abrid amezwaru. Teooam deffir wen, ayen i wen Nefka. Ur Nwala, $uôwen, imcafâen nnwen, wid i tâabdem, nitni, d icriken nnwen. Ni$ temfaôaqem, u ooan kwen wid la tâabdem.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, s tidep, Ifeôôec aâqqa, i$es. Issuffu$ ed amuddir si lmegget. Issuffu$ ed lmegget seg umuddir. Akka ay d Öebbi. Acimi tugim?
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, Ifeôôec aâqqa, i$es. Issuffu$ ed amuddir si lmegget. Issuffu$ ed lmegget seg umuddir. Akka ay d Öebbi. Acimi tugim?

ayahs.text: Issenkar tafrara. Irra iv i ureyyeê, iîij d waggur i leêsab. D wagi ay d aseyyi n Uzmir, Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Issenkar tafrara. Irra iv i ureyyeê, iîij d waggur i leêsab. D wagi ay d aseyyi n Uzmir, Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i wen Irran itran, ad awen mlen abrid, di tillas n lberr akked yill. Ni$ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i wen Irran itran, ad awen mlen abrid, di tillas n lberr akked yill. Ni$ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud issnen.

ayahs.text: D Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiman afôid, sinna: amkan, tarusi. Ni$ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud ifehhmen.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiman afôid, sinna: amkan, tarusi. Ni$ Nemmal issekniyen i ugdud ifehhmen.

ayahs.text: D Neppa id Isrusun aman seg igenni. Nessuffu$ ed yissen yal im$an. Nessuffu$ ed yissen tizzegzewt. Nessuffu$ ed yissen iâaqqayen mbabben, iguza n ppmeô id ipûubbun si tezdayin, leonanat n tfeôôant, uzemmur, n ôemman, ppemcabin ne$ ur ppemcabin. Walit ppemôa nnsen mi d teffe$ tebbwa. Ih, deg waya, war ccekk, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa id Isrusun aman seg igenni. Nessuffu$ ed yissen yal im$an. Nessuffu$ ed yissen tizzegzewt. Nessuffu$ ed yissen iâaqqayen mbabben, iguza n ppmeô id ipûubbun si tezdayin, leonanat n tfeôôant, uzemmur, n ôemman, ppemcabin ne$ ur ppemcabin. Walit ppemôa nnsen mi d teffe$ tebbwa. Ih, deg waya, war ccekk, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Rran i Öebbi, leonun d icriken, u Ixelq iten. Snulfan aS d arrac, tullas, ur éôin. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aâlay sennig wayen d qqaôen!
ayahs.translation: Rran i Öebbi, leonun d icriken, u Ixelq iten. Snulfan aS d arrac, tullas, ur éôin. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aâlay sennig wayen d qqaôen!

ayahs.text: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, amek ara Isâu mmi S, ur Isâi tameddakwelt? U Ixleq yal cci, u Neppa, yal cci, Issen it.
ayahs.translation: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, amek ara Isâu mmi S, ur Isâi tameddakwelt? U Ixleq yal cci, u Neppa, yal cci, Issen it.

ayahs.text: D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Ixleq yal cci, ihi âabdet eP. Neppa d Awkil n yal cci.
ayahs.translation: D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Ixleq yal cci, ihi âabdet eP. Neppa d Awkil n yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ur T tepsami tmu$li. Neppa Ipsami tamu$li. Neppa d Laîif, i Izôan.
ayahs.translation: Ur T tepsami tmu$li. Neppa Ipsami tamu$li. Neppa d Laîif, i Izôan.

ayahs.text: Ni$ iusa kwen id ara twalim, s$uô Mass nnwen. Win iwalan, i iman is; win idre$len, mgal is. Ur lli$ nek d amêareb nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ iusa kwen id ara twalim, s$uô Mass nnwen. Win iwalan, i iman is; win idre$len, mgal is. Ur lli$ nek d amêareb nnwen.

ayahs.text: Akka ay Nessefham issekniyen, iwakken ad inin: "tlemdev", iwakken a t Nbeggen i ugdud issnen.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay Nessefham issekniyen, iwakken ad inin: "tlemdev", iwakken a t Nbeggen i ugdud issnen.

ayahs.text: Ddu d wayen ik ed ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass ik; ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Eoo imcurak.
ayahs.translation: Ddu d wayen ik ed ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass ik; ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Eoo imcurak.

ayahs.text: Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur curken. Ur k Nerra d amêareb nnsen, ur telliv d awkil nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur curken. Ur k Nerra d amêareb nnsen, ur telliv d awkil nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ur naâlet wid u$uô la pnujun, war Öebbi. Axaîeô ad naâlen Öebbi, s lbe$wv, war tamusni. Akka ay Ncebbeê igiten is i yal lois. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, tu$alin nnsen; a ten Ixebbeô $ef wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ur naâlet wid u$uô la pnujun, war Öebbi. Axaîeô ad naâlen Öebbi, s lbe$wv, war tamusni. Akka ay Ncebbeê igiten is i yal lois. Sinna, ar Mass nnsen, tu$alin nnsen; a ten Ixebbeô $ef wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ggulen s Öebbi, tagalit meqqwôen, ar ma iusa ten id ussekni, ar ad amnen yis. Ini: "issekniyen ar Öebbi kan". Acu i kwen irran têussem ar, xas ma iusa ten id, ur ppamnen?
ayahs.translation: Ggulen s Öebbi, tagalit meqqwôen, ar ma iusa ten id ussekni, ar ad amnen yis. Ini: "issekniyen ar Öebbi kan". Acu i kwen irran têussem ar, xas ma iusa ten id, ur ppamnen?

ayahs.text: A Neppi ulawen nnsen, d yiéôi nnsen, akken ur uminen yis abrid amezwaru. A ten Neoo di lbe$wv nnsen, d ider$alen.
ayahs.translation: A Neppi ulawen nnsen, d yiéôi nnsen, akken ur uminen yis abrid amezwaru. A ten Neoo di lbe$wv nnsen, d ider$alen.

ayahs.text: Xas Nekwni Nessers asen d lmalayek, u mmeslayen asen d lmeggtin, u Nefser asen d, yal cci, zdat sen, ur ppamnen, siwa ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi. Maca, aîas degsen ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Xas Nekwni Nessers asen d lmalayek, u mmeslayen asen d lmeggtin, u Nefser asen d, yal cci, zdat sen, ur ppamnen, siwa ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi. Maca, aîas degsen ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Akka ay Nerra, i yal nnbi, acengu. Ccwaîen, seg imdanen akw si leonun, ppemweêêin garasen awal uziyn i u$uôôu. Lemmer i S ihwi, i Mass ik, ur p xeddmen. Ihi, eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen,
ayahs.translation: Akka ay Nerra, i yal nnbi, acengu. Ccwaîen, seg imdanen akw si leonun, ppemweêêin garasen awal uziyn i u$uôôu. Lemmer i S ihwi, i Mass ik, ur p xeddmen. Ihi, eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen,

ayahs.text: iwakken ad mmalen $uôes ulawen n wid ur numin s laxeôt, a t ôavin, ad gemren ayen zerâen.
ayahs.translation: iwakken ad mmalen $uôes ulawen n wid ur numin s laxeôt, a t ôavin, ad gemren ayen zerâen.

ayahs.text: Day b$i$ amêaddi, war Öebbi? D Neppa i wen d Issersen Tazmamt, s ussefhem. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, éôan, ar neppat, ters ed s$uô Mass ik, s tidep. Ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.
ayahs.translation: Day b$i$ amêaddi, war Öebbi? D Neppa i wen d Issersen Tazmamt, s ussefhem. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, éôan, ar neppat, ters ed s$uô Mass ik, s tidep. Ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.

ayahs.text: Awal n Mass ik ibbwev, s tidep akked lmizan. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Awal n Mass ik ibbwev, s tidep akked lmizan. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Neppa Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ma tu$ev awal i tegwti n wid illan di tmurt, a k telfen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Teddun kan d wayen nwan. Nitni snulfuyen d kan.
ayahs.translation: Ma tu$ev awal i tegwti n wid illan di tmurt, a k telfen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Teddun kan d wayen nwan. Nitni snulfuyen d kan.

ayahs.text: Ih, Mass ik Issen sennig akw, anwi innetlafen seg ubrid iS. Neppa Issen sennig akw, anwi ipwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Mass ik Issen sennig akw, anwi innetlafen seg ubrid iS. Neppa Issen sennig akw, anwi ipwanhan.

ayahs.text: Eççet ayen i$ef d immekti isem n Öebbi, ma tumnem s issekniyen iS.
ayahs.translation: Eççet ayen i$ef d immekti isem n Öebbi, ma tumnem s issekniyen iS.

ayahs.text: Acu ikwen iu$en, ur teppeppem ara seg wayen i$ef d immekti isem n Öebbi? Ni$ Issfehm awen ayen i wen Igdel, siwa ma ipwaêeppem fellawen. Ih, aîas ay tellifen, s zzhu nnsen, war tussna. Ni$ Mass ik Iugar akw akken Issen wid izegren tilas.
ayahs.translation: Acu ikwen iu$en, ur teppeppem ara seg wayen i$ef d immekti isem n Öebbi? Ni$ Issfehm awen ayen i wen Igdel, siwa ma ipwaêeppem fellawen. Ih, aîas ay tellifen, s zzhu nnsen, war tussna. Ni$ Mass ik Iugar akw akken Issen wid izegren tilas.

ayahs.text: Ekkset abekkav uvhiô akked uffir. Ih, wid ibbwin abekkav, ad ppuqeîîin $ef wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ekkset abekkav uvhiô akked uffir. Ih, wid ibbwin abekkav, ad ppuqeîîin $ef wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ur teppet ayen i$ef ur d immekti ara, isem n Öebbi. Ih, ayagi d ixmiô. Ih, ccwaîen pweêêin i imeddukwal nnsen, a kwen namren. Ma tu$em asen awal, kunwi, s tidep, tcurkem.
ayahs.translation: Ur teppet ayen i$ef ur d immekti ara, isem n Öebbi. Ih, ayagi d ixmiô. Ih, ccwaîen pweêêin i imeddukwal nnsen, a kwen namren. Ma tu$em asen awal, kunwi, s tidep, tcurkem.

ayahs.text: Ma win illan d lmegget, Nessider it id, Nga yas tafat, iteddu yis ger medden, day d amedya s, win illan di tillas, ur izmir ad iffe$ segsent. Akka, ippucebbeê i ijehliyen, wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ma win illan d lmegget, Nessider it id, Nga yas tafat, iteddu yis ger medden, day d amedya s, win illan di tillas, ur izmir ad iffe$ segsent. Akka, ippucebbeê i ijehliyen, wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Akka ay Nerra, ad ppandin di yal tamdint, ibe$wviyen is, uqsiêen mavi. Ppandin kan i iman nnsen, ur faqen.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay Nerra, ad ppandin di yal tamdint, ibe$wviyen is, uqsiêen mavi. Ppandin kan i iman nnsen, ur faqen.

ayahs.text: Ma iusa ten id ussekni, ad inin: "ur neppamen, alamma iusa ya$ d ayen id iusan ar imazanen n Öebbi". Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen, anida ara Ifk tabôap iS. Ad iôxisen, ar Öebbi, wid ibe$wven. Fellasen aâaqeb uqsiê, ilmend n wayen ppandin.
ayahs.translation: Ma iusa ten id ussekni, ad inin: "ur neppamen, alamma iusa ya$ d ayen id iusan ar imazanen n Öebbi". Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen, anida ara Ifk tabôap iS. Ad iôxisen, ar Öebbi, wid ibe$wven. Fellasen aâaqeb uqsiê, ilmend n wayen ppandin.

ayahs.text: Win Ib$a Öebbi a t Inhu, ad illi idmaren is ar wannuz. Win Ib$a a t Itlef, ad Irr idmaren is deyqen, têeyyôen, amzun ippaâôav ad iali s igenni. Akka i Ippara Öebbi axerwaâ i wid ur numin.
ayahs.translation: Win Ib$a Öebbi a t Inhu, ad illi idmaren is ar wannuz. Win Ib$a a t Itlef, ad Irr idmaren is deyqen, têeyyôen, amzun ippaâôav ad iali s igenni. Akka i Ippara Öebbi axerwaâ i wid ur numin.

ayahs.text: Wagi d abrid uwqim n Mass ik. Ni$ Nessefham issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.
ayahs.translation: Wagi d abrid uwqim n Mass ik. Ni$ Nessefham issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.

ayahs.text: I nitni, axxam n tifrat ar Mass nnsen. Neppa d Bab nnsen, $ef wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: I nitni, axxam n tifrat ar Mass nnsen. Neppa d Bab nnsen, $ef wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser meôôa: "a yagraw n leonun, ni$ tcerrâem deg imdanen"? A d inin imawlan nnsen, seg imdanen: "a Mass nne$! Kra segne$ $elten si kra, Nebbwev ar lajel nne$, i $ Terriv". Inna: "d times ay d tanezdu$t nnwen, ad degs twekkôem, siwa ma ur aS ihwi i Öebbi". Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser meôôa: "a yagraw n leonun, ni$ tcerrâem deg imdanen"? A d inin imawlan nnsen, seg imdanen: "a Mass nne$! Kra segne$ $elten si kra, Nebbwev ar lajel nne$, i $ Terriv". Inna: "d times ay d tanezdu$t nnwen, ad degs twekkôem, siwa ma ur aS ihwi i Öebbi". Ih, Mass ik d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Akka ay Neppara kra imednas d iêbiben n kra, ilmend n wayen keppben.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay Neppara kra imednas d iêbiben n kra, ilmend n wayen keppben.

ayahs.text: "A yagraw n leonun d yimdanen, day ur kwen id usan ara imazanen segwen? Mmalen awen issekniyen iW, nedôen kwen $ef temlilit n wass nnwen agi". Nnan d: "ncehhed $ef yiman nne$". T$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Cehhden $ef yiman nnsen ar nitni, s tidep, llan d ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: "A yagraw n leonun d yimdanen, day ur kwen id usan ara imazanen segwen? Mmalen awen issekniyen iW, nedôen kwen $ef temlilit n wass nnwen agi". Nnan d: "ncehhed $ef yiman nne$". T$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Cehhden $ef yiman nnsen ar nitni, s tidep, llan d ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Akka, acku Mass ik ur Isquccu tamdint, s ddens, ma llan imezda$ is d i$wefliyen.
ayahs.translation: Akka, acku Mass ik ur Isquccu tamdint, s ddens, ma llan imezda$ is d i$wefliyen.

ayahs.text: I yal yiwen, tiseddarin seg wayen ixdem. Ur I$effel Mass ik $ef wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: I yal yiwen, tiseddarin seg wayen ixdem. Ur I$effel Mass ik $ef wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Mass ik d Asâay, d Bab uêunu. Ma ihwa yaS a kwen Ikkes, a d Inûef, deffir wen, ayen i S ihwan, akken ikwen id Ixleq si tarwa n ugdud nniven.
ayahs.translation: Mass ik d Asâay, d Bab uêunu. Ma ihwa yaS a kwen Ikkes, a d Inûef, deffir wen, ayen i S ihwan, akken ikwen id Ixleq si tarwa n ugdud nniven.

ayahs.text: Ih, ayen i wen ippuâahden, a d ias, war ccekk. Ur tezmirem, kunwi, a ppesfunngem.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ayen i wen ippuâahden, a d ias, war ccekk. Ur tezmirem, kunwi, a ppesfunngem.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tewâam, nek ad xedme$. Deqqal a ppeéôem iwumi ara telhu taggara n Uxxam". S tidep, ur rebêen imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tewâam, nek ad xedme$. Deqqal a ppeéôem iwumi ara telhu taggara n Uxxam". S tidep, ur rebêen imednas.

ayahs.text: Gan aS i Öebbi amur, seg wayen id Ifka n l$ella, akked lmal. Nnan: "wagi i Öebbi –- di tikta nnsen -, wagi i icriken nne$". Ayen gan i icriken nnsen, ur ippawev ar Öebbi. Ayen gan i Öebbi, neppa, ad yawev ar icriken nnsen. I icmet wayen id pêuddun!
ayahs.translation: Gan aS i Öebbi amur, seg wayen id Ifka n l$ella, akked lmal. Nnan: "wagi i Öebbi –- di tikta nnsen -, wagi i icriken nne$". Ayen gan i icriken nnsen, ur ippawev ar Öebbi. Ayen gan i Öebbi, neppa, ad yawev ar icriken nnsen. I icmet wayen id pêuddun!

ayahs.text: Akka ay cebbêen icriken nnsen, i waîas n yimcurak, timen$iwt n tarwa nnsen, iwakken a ten squccen, u ad irwi ddin nnsen, fellasen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur p xeddmen. Eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay cebbêen icriken nnsen, i waîas n yimcurak, timen$iwt n tarwa nnsen, iwakken a ten squccen, u ad irwi ddin nnsen, fellasen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur p xeddmen. Eoo iten ar wayen d snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "lmal akked l$ella yagi ppugedlen, ur ten itepp, siwa win i $ ihwan". S tikta nnsen. Lmal iwumi gedlen iârar nnsen, lmal iwumi ur d ppadren fellasen, isem n Öebbi. D asnulfu mgal iS. A ten Iqeîîi $ef wayen d snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "lmal akked l$ella yagi ppugedlen, ur ten itepp, siwa win i $ ihwan". S tikta nnsen. Lmal iwumi gedlen iârar nnsen, lmal iwumi ur d ppadren fellasen, isem n Öebbi. D asnulfu mgal iS. A ten Iqeîîi $ef wayen d snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Qqaôen: "ayen illan deg iâabbav n lmal agi, i ddker nne$ kan, ipwagdel i tlawin nne$". Ma ilul ed immut, ad mlilen $uôes. A ten Iqeîîi $ef wayen d qqaôen. Neppa, s tidep, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Qqaôen: "ayen illan deg iâabbav n lmal agi, i ddker nne$ kan, ipwagdel i tlawin nne$". Ma ilul ed immut, ad mlilen $uôes. A ten Iqeîîi $ef wayen d qqaôen. Neppa, s tidep, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ni$ xesôen wid in$an arraw nnsen. D tiderwect, war tussna. Gedlen ayen i s iten I$at Öebbi, snulfan d mgal Öebbi. Ni$ nnetlafen, ur pwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ xesôen wid in$an arraw nnsen. D tiderwect, war tussna. Gedlen ayen i s iten I$at Öebbi, snulfan d mgal Öebbi. Ni$ nnetlafen, ur pwanhan.

ayahs.text: D Neppa id Ixelqen leonanat s iâricen, ne$ war iâricen, tizdayin, zerriâa n yal ûûenf, i wuççi; azemmur akked rreman ippemcabin, ne$ ur neppemcabi. Eççet si ppemôa nnsen, ma fkan d, efket leêqq is, ass u$ellet nnsen. Ur ssugutet. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid ipêawalen.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa id Ixelqen leonanat s iâricen, ne$ war iâricen, tizdayin, zerriâa n yal ûûenf, i wuççi; azemmur akked rreman ippemcabin, ne$ ur neppemcabi. Eççet si ppemôa nnsen, ma fkan d, efket leêqq is, ass u$ellet nnsen. Ur ssugutet. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid ipêawalen.

ayahs.text: Si lmal, aggway d wussu. Eççet seg wayen ikwen Iôéeq Öebbi. Ur teddut d iberdan n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Si lmal, aggway d wussu. Eççet seg wayen ikwen Iôéeq Öebbi. Ur teddut d iberdan n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu nnwen n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ïamt tyugiwin, snat u$welmi, snat umâiz. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, ne$ d snat n nnta, ne$ d ayen illan deg iâabbav n snat n nnta? Xebbôet iyi d, s tussna, ma tessawalem tidep".
ayahs.translation: Ïamt tyugiwin, snat u$welmi, snat umâiz. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, ne$ d snat n nnta, ne$ d ayen illan deg iâabbav n snat n nnta? Xebbôet iyi d, s tussna, ma tessawalem tidep".

ayahs.text: Seg ile$wman, snat, seg ubeqôi, snat. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, ne$ d snat n nnta, ne$ d ayen illan deg iâabbav n snat n nnta, ne$ tellam d inagan mi kwen id Iweûûa Öebbi $ef waya"? Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, iwakken ad itlef imdanen, ur issin. Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
ayahs.translation: Seg ile$wman, snat, seg ubeqôi, snat. Ini: "d sin n ddker i Igdel, ne$ d snat n nnta, ne$ d ayen illan deg iâabbav n snat n nnta, ne$ tellam d inagan mi kwen id Iweûûa Öebbi $ef waya"? Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, iwakken ad itlef imdanen, ur issin. Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur ufi$ ipwagdel a t içç yiwen, deg wayen iyi d ippuweêêan, siwa ma illa d loifa, ne$ d idim immaren, ne$ d aksum n yilef - wagi, war ccekk, d lewsex -, ne$ îêegga s d$wel i war Öebbi. Win i$ef ippuêeppem, ur ib$i, ur ib$wiv, Mass ik, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur ufi$ ipwagdel a t içç yiwen, deg wayen iyi d ippuweêêan, siwa ma illa d loifa, ne$ d idim immaren, ne$ d aksum n yilef - wagi, war ccekk, d lewsex -, ne$ îêegga s d$wel i war Öebbi. Win i$ef ippuêeppem, ur ib$i, ur ib$wiv, Mass ik, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: I wudayen, Negdel ayen akw isâan acaren, seg ubeqôi akked u$welmi, Negdel asen tassemt nnsen, siwa tin n iârar nnsen, iâabbav, akked wayen ipwaxelven akked i$san. Akka ay ten Nepkafi, ilmend n îîeôô nnsen. Nekwni, war ccekk, d At Tidep.
ayahs.translation: I wudayen, Negdel ayen akw isâan acaren, seg ubeqôi akked u$welmi, Negdel asen tassemt nnsen, siwa tin n iârar nnsen, iâabbav, akked wayen ipwaxelven akked i$san. Akka ay ten Nepkafi, ilmend n îîeôô nnsen. Nekwni, war ccekk, d At Tidep.

ayahs.text: Ma skaddben k, ini: "Mass nnwen d Bab uêunu iwsâan, ur ipwexxiô ssexv iS, af ugdud ibe$wviyen".
ayahs.translation: Ma skaddben k, ini: "Mass nnwen d Bab uêunu iwsâan, ur ipwexxiô ssexv iS, af ugdud ibe$wviyen".

ayahs.text: Ad inin imcurak: "lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, nekwni akked imezwura nne$, ur ncurek, ur negdel acemma". Akka ay skaddben imezwura nnsen, armi jeôôben ssexv nne£. Ini: "day tesâam tussna ar a$ d tesseknem? Teppeddum kan d nnwaya, kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan".
ayahs.translation: Ad inin imcurak: "lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, nekwni akked imezwura nne$, ur ncurek, ur negdel acemma". Akka ay skaddben imezwura nnsen, armi jeôôben ssexv nne£. Ini: "day tesâam tussna ar a$ d tesseknem? Teppeddum kan d nnwaya, kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan".

ayahs.text: Ini: "n Öebbi timenna tunûiêin. Lemmer i S ihwi, yili Inha kwen akw".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "n Öebbi timenna tunûiêin. Lemmer i S ihwi, yili Inha kwen akw".

ayahs.text: Ini: "awit ed inagan nnwen, ara icehhden ar Öebbi Igdel ayagi". Ma cehhden, ur cehhed yidsen. Ur teddu d lhawiyya n wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, akked wid ur numin s laxeôt, u pparan tanudda i Mass nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "awit ed inagan nnwen, ara icehhden ar Öebbi Igdel ayagi". Ma cehhden, ur cehhed yidsen. Ur teddu d lhawiyya n wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, akked wid ur numin s laxeôt, u pparan tanudda i Mass nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "yyaw, ad ini$. I wen Igdel Mass nnwen: ur aS tepcarakem acemma; elhut ar imawlan nnwen; ur neqqet tarwa nnwen, di tigullelt - d Nekwni ara kwen Iôeéqen yidsen -, ur ppaéet ar lâaô, d uvhiô ne$ d uffir; ur neqqet amdan, d ayen Igdel Öebbi, siwa ma s lêeqq". Ar waya i kwen Iweûûa, amar a pfehmem.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "yyaw, ad ini$. I wen Igdel Mass nnwen: ur aS tepcarakem acemma; elhut ar imawlan nnwen; ur neqqet tarwa nnwen, di tigullelt - d Nekwni ara kwen Iôeéqen yidsen -, ur ppaéet ar lâaô, d uvhiô ne$ d uffir; ur neqqet amdan, d ayen Igdel Öebbi, siwa ma s lêeqq". Ar waya i kwen Iweûûa, amar a pfehmem.

ayahs.text: Ur pqeôôibet s ayla ugujil, siwa s wayen ilhan, alamma immeêtel. Weznet, ktilet s lewqama. Ur Nepkellif amdan siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ma thedôem d, weznet, xas ma $eô llzem nnwen. Qadôet lemâahda n Öebbi. Iweûûa kwen $ef waya, amar a d temmektim.
ayahs.translation: Ur pqeôôibet s ayla ugujil, siwa s wayen ilhan, alamma immeêtel. Weznet, ktilet s lewqama. Ur Nepkellif amdan siwa ar wayen iwumi izmer. Ma thedôem d, weznet, xas ma $eô llzem nnwen. Qadôet lemâahda n Öebbi. Iweûûa kwen $ef waya, amar a d temmektim.

ayahs.text: D wagi ay d abrid iW uwqim, ddut degs. Ur teddut d iberdan ara kwen isîixôen seg ubrid iS. Iweûûa kwen $ef waya, amar a pêezzbem.
ayahs.translation: D wagi ay d abrid iW uwqim, ddut degs. Ur teddut d iberdan ara kwen isîixôen seg ubrid iS. Iweûûa kwen $ef waya, amar a pêezzbem.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Tewqem i wid imaânen, tfeûûel yal cci, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Amar ad amnen s timlilit n Mass nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Tewqem i wid imaânen, tfeûûel yal cci, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Amar ad amnen s timlilit n Mass nnsen.

ayahs.text: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers ip id, teôqa. Ihi, ddut yides, êezzbet, amar fellawen aêunu.
ayahs.translation: Tagi d Tazmamt, Nessers ip id, teôqa. Ihi, ddut yides, êezzbet, amar fellawen aêunu.

ayahs.text: Ur d teqqaôem ara: "ters ed kan Tezmamt $eô sin leoyus, uqbel nne$, ur neéôi d acu sselmaden".
ayahs.translation: Ur d teqqaôem ara: "ters ed kan Tezmamt $eô sin leoyus, uqbel nne$, ur neéôi d acu sselmaden".

ayahs.text: Ne$ a d tinim: "lemmer id ters Tazmamt $uône$, yili nif iten akken nepwanha". Ni$ iusa kwen id ubeggen, s$uô Mass nnwen, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Anwa idensen sennig win iskaddben issekniyen n Öebbi, u iooa iten? A Nqeîîi wid iooan issekniyen nne£, s yir aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen la ppaooan.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ a d tinim: "lemmer id ters Tazmamt $uône$, yili nif iten akken nepwanha". Ni$ iusa kwen id ubeggen, s$uô Mass nnwen, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Anwa idensen sennig win iskaddben issekniyen n Öebbi, u iooa iten? A Nqeîîi wid iooan issekniyen nne£, s yir aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen la ppaooan.

ayahs.text: D acu pôaoun, siwa ma ten id asent lmalayek, ne$ a d Ias Mass ik, ne$ a d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik? Ass ideg ara d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik, ur infaâ umdan liman is, ma, iu$ lêal, ur iumin ara, ne$ ur iksib lxiô, di liman is. Ini: "gganit, nekwni, ih, la nepgani".
ayahs.translation: D acu pôaoun, siwa ma ten id asent lmalayek, ne$ a d Ias Mass ik, ne$ a d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik? Ass ideg ara d asen kra issekniyen n Mass ik, ur infaâ umdan liman is, ma, iu$ lêal, ur iumin ara, ne$ ur iksib lxiô, di liman is. Ini: "gganit, nekwni, ih, la nepgani".

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ibvan ddin nnsen, u gan ikabaren, ur tepkkiv yidsen deg wacemma. Lameô nnsen ar Öebbi kan, sinna, a ten Ixebbeô $ef wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ibvan ddin nnsen, u gan ikabaren, ur tepkkiv yidsen deg wacemma. Lameô nnsen ar Öebbi kan, sinna, a ten Ixebbeô $ef wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Win id iusan s yise$, ines mraw i t icban; win id iusan s tucmip, ad ippuqeîîi s tin kan i p icban; nitni ur pwadensen.
ayahs.translation: Win id iusan s yise$, ines mraw i t icban; win id iusan s tucmip, ad ippuqeîîi s tin kan i p icban; nitni ur pwadensen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "nek, Inha iyi Mass iw, ar ubrid uwqim, d ddin n ddwam, win n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep, ur nelli seg imcurak".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "nek, Inha iyi Mass iw, ar ubrid uwqim, d ddin n ddwam, win n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep, ur nelli seg imcurak".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ih, taéallit iw, iseflan iw, tudert iw, tameppant iw, i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ih, taéallit iw, iseflan iw, tudert iw, tameppant iw, i Öebbi, Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: Ur aS illi ucarek. Pwamôe$ d s waya: nek d amduâ amenzu".
ayahs.translation: Ur aS illi ucarek. Pwamôe$ d s waya: nek d amduâ amenzu".

ayahs.text: Ini: "day b$i$ mass, war Öebbi? U Neppa d Mass n yal cci". Ur ikesseb yal yiman, siwa mgal is. Ur ipbibbi win ibubben taâkkwemt n wayev. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen, tu$alin nnwen. Sinna, a kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen tellam temgaradem.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "day b$i$ mass, war Öebbi? U Neppa d Mass n yal cci". Ur ikesseb yal yiman, siwa mgal is. Ur ipbibbi win ibubben taâkkwemt n wayev. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen, tu$alin nnwen. Sinna, a kwen Ixebbeô $ef wayen tellam temgaradem.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i kwen Irran d igensas di tmurt. Irra, kra segwen, tiseddaôin sennig wiyav, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb $ef wayen i wen Ifka. Ih, Mass ik Ip$awal deg uâaqeb. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i kwen Irran d igensas di tmurt. Irra, kra segwen, tiseddaôin sennig wiyav, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb $ef wayen i wen Ifka. Ih, Mass ik Ip$awal deg uâaqeb. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Almû.
verses.translation: Almû.

verses.text: Tazmamt ters ed $uôek, ur teppili segs lhejna deg idmaren ik, iwakken a pnabiv yis; u d asmekti i lmumnin.
verses.translation: Tazmamt ters ed $uôek, ur teppili segs lhejna deg idmaren ik, iwakken a pnabiv yis; u d asmekti i lmumnin.

verses.text: Ddut d wayen id irsen $uôwen, s$uô Mass nnwen. Ur teddut d imawlan, war Neppa. Drus id tesmektayem.
verses.translation: Ddut d wayen id irsen $uôwen, s$uô Mass nnwen. Ur teddut d imawlan, war Neppa. Drus id tesmektayem.

verses.text: Acêal n temdinin ay Nessenger. Tusa ten id tiyta nne£, deg ives nnsen, ne$ deg uqeggel nnsen.
verses.translation: Acêal n temdinin ay Nessenger. Tusa ten id tiyta nne£, deg ives nnsen, ne$ deg uqeggel nnsen.

verses.text: Ti$ôi nnsen, mi ten id tusa tiyta nne£, siwa mi d nnan: "ih, nella d imednas".
verses.translation: Ti$ôi nnsen, mi ten id tusa tiyta nne£, siwa mi d nnan: "ih, nella d imednas".

verses.text: War ccekk, a Nesteqsi wid u$uô id Nuzen, a Nesteqsi imazanen.
verses.translation: War ccekk, a Nesteqsi wid u$uô id Nuzen, a Nesteqsi imazanen.

verses.text: War ccekk, ad asen Neêku, s tmusni, ur Nelli N$ab.
verses.translation: War ccekk, ad asen Neêku, s tmusni, ur Nelli N$ab.

verses.text: Awzan, assen, d tidep. Wid iwumi ééayet lweznat nnsen, widak d wid irebêen.
verses.translation: Awzan, assen, d tidep. Wid iwumi ééayet lweznat nnsen, widak d wid irebêen.

verses.text: Wid iwumi fessuset lweznat nnsen, widak d wid ixesôen iman nnsen, seg akken sednasen issekniyen nne£.
verses.translation: Wid iwumi fessuset lweznat nnsen, widak d wid ixesôen iman nnsen, seg akken sednasen issekniyen nne£.
