verses.text: Ni$, s tidep, Nesrekd ikwen di tmurt, Nerra yawen, degs, tamâict nnwen. Drus ay tesnemmirem.
verses.translation: Ni$, s tidep, Nesrekd ikwen di tmurt, Nerra yawen, degs, tamâict nnwen. Drus ay tesnemmirem.

verses.text: Ni$, s tidep, Nxelq ikwen, sinna, Nmesl ikwen, sinna, Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem"! Knant, siwa Iblis. Ur illi seg wid iknan.
verses.translation: Ni$, s tidep, Nxelq ikwen, sinna, Nmesl ikwen, sinna, Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem"! Knant, siwa Iblis. Ur illi seg wid iknan.

verses.text: Inna: "acu k iîîfen ur tekniv ara, mi k d Umôe$"? Inna d: "Nek, ife$ t. Txelqev iyi si tmes, Txelqev t si talaxt".
verses.translation: Inna: "acu k iîîfen ur tekniv ara, mi k d Umôe$"? Inna d: "Nek, ife$ t. Txelqev iyi si tmes, Txelqev t si talaxt".

verses.text: Inna: "ihi, ûûub segs! Ur ak ippunefk ara a ppesme$wôev iman ik, degs. Effe$, keçç seg wid ixuûen"!
verses.translation: Inna: "ihi, ûûub segs! Ur ak ippunefk ara a ppesme$wôev iman ik, degs. Effe$, keçç seg wid ixuûen"!

verses.text: Inna: "Eoo iyi, ar ass ideg ara d kkren".
verses.translation: Inna: "Eoo iyi, ar ass ideg ara d kkren".

verses.text: Inna: "keçç, ih, seg wid ara iqqimen".
verses.translation: Inna: "keçç, ih, seg wid ara iqqimen".

verses.text: Inna d: "imi iyi Tâammdev a$ewwu, ad asen qqime$, war ccekk, deg ubrid iK uwqim.
verses.translation: Inna d: "imi iyi Tâammdev a$ewwu, ad asen qqime$, war ccekk, deg ubrid iK uwqim.

verses.text: Sinna, ad asen d tekke$ zdat, deffir, yeffus, zelmev. Ur Teppafev, $eô tugwti segsen, asnemmer".
verses.translation: Sinna, ad asen d tekke$ zdat, deffir, yeffus, zelmev. Ur Teppafev, $eô tugwti segsen, asnemmer".

verses.text: Inna: "effe$ segs, d ameêquô ippuvegôen! War ccekk, ad Acaôe$ Loahennama s wid, segsen, i k ivefôen, akked yiswen akw.
verses.translation: Inna: "effe$ segs, d ameêquô ippuvegôen! War ccekk, ad Acaôe$ Loahennama s wid, segsen, i k ivefôen, akked yiswen akw.

verses.text: A Adem, ezde$ Loennet, keçç akked tmeîîut ik, eççet seg wayen i wen ihwan. Ur pqeôôibet ttejôa agi, mulac a ppilim seg imednas".
verses.translation: A Adem, ezde$ Loennet, keçç akked tmeîîut ik, eççet seg wayen i wen ihwan. Ur pqeôôibet ttejôa agi, mulac a ppilim seg imednas".

verses.text: I$ewwa ten Cciîan, iwakken ad asen d iban âaryan nnsen i illan iffer. Inna: "Ikkes awen, kan, Mass nnwen, ttejôa agi, iwakken ur teppilim d lmalayek, ne$ ur tepwekkiôem".
verses.translation: I$ewwa ten Cciîan, iwakken ad asen d iban âaryan nnsen i illan iffer. Inna: "Ikkes awen, kan, Mass nnwen, ttejôa agi, iwakken ur teppilim d lmalayek, ne$ ur tepwekkiôem".

verses.text: Iggul asen: "nek, i kunwi, d unûiê".
verses.translation: Iggul asen: "nek, i kunwi, d unûiê".

verses.text: Isdull iten s u$uôôu. Mi âaôven si ttejôa nni, walan iman nnsen aâran. Lhan d la pcuddun, $ef iman nnsen, afriwen n Loennet. Issawel asen d Mass nnsen: "day ur awen Gdile$ ara ttejôa nni? Ad awen Ini$: war ccekk, Cciîan, i kunwi, d acengu n ûûeê".
verses.translation: Isdull iten s u$uôôu. Mi âaôven si ttejôa nni, walan iman nnsen aâran. Lhan d la pcuddun, $ef iman nnsen, afriwen n Loennet. Issawel asen d Mass nnsen: "day ur awen Gdile$ ara ttejôa nni? Ad awen Ini$: war ccekk, Cciîan, i kunwi, d acengu n ûûeê".

verses.text: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! Nvuôô iman nne$. Ma ur a$ Tsemmêev, ur Têunev fella$, a nili seg imexsuôen".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! Nvuôô iman nne$. Ma ur a$ Tsemmêev, ur Têunev fella$, a nili seg imexsuôen".

verses.text: Inna: "erset! Kra d icenga n kra. A pzed$em di tmurt, a ppezhum, tallit kan".
verses.translation: Inna: "erset! Kra d icenga n kra. A pzed$em di tmurt, a ppezhum, tallit kan".

verses.text: Irna: "degs a ppidirem, degs a ppemmtem, segs a d teff$em".
verses.translation: Irna: "degs a ppidirem, degs a ppemmtem, segs a d teff$em".

verses.text: A tarwa n Adem! Ni$ Nessers awen ed aceîîiv ara kwen issôen, ôôêuê, akked uceîîiv uêezzeb. Wagi yif iten". Ayagi seg issekniyen n Öebbi, amar a d mmektin.
verses.translation: A tarwa n Adem! Ni$ Nessers awen ed aceîîiv ara kwen issôen, ôôêuê, akked uceîîiv uêezzeb. Wagi yif iten". Ayagi seg issekniyen n Öebbi, amar a d mmektin.

verses.text: A tarwa n Adem! £uôwat a kwen ihewwel Cciîan, akken id issuffe$ imezwura nnwen si Loennet! Ikkes asen iceîîiven nnsen, iwakken ad asen issken âaryan nnsen. Neppa, war ccekk, ipwali kwen - neppa akked ccetla s - seg wanda ur ten tepwalim. Ni$ Nerra ccwaîen d imawlan n wid ur numin.
verses.translation: A tarwa n Adem! £uôwat a kwen ihewwel Cciîan, akken id issuffe$ imezwura nnwen si Loennet! Ikkes asen iceîîiven nnsen, iwakken ad asen issken âaryan nnsen. Neppa, war ccekk, ipwali kwen - neppa akked ccetla s - seg wanda ur ten tepwalim. Ni$ Nerra ccwaîen d imawlan n wid ur numin.

verses.text: Mi xedmen ayen n dir, ad inin: "nufa d akka ar imezwura nne$, u Öebbi Iumeô a$ d $uôes. Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, ur Ippameô ar wayen n dir. Day a d tinim $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
verses.translation: Mi xedmen ayen n dir, ad inin: "nufa d akka ar imezwura nne$, u Öebbi Iumeô a$ d $uôes. Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, ur Ippameô ar wayen n dir. Day a d tinim $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?

verses.text: Ini: "Iumeô ed Öebbi lmizan. Zzit $uôeS udmawen nnwen di yal lekni, nujet $uôeS. £uôeS, s ddin iûfan. Akken ikwen id Ixleq, a ppu$alem".
verses.translation: Ini: "Iumeô ed Öebbi lmizan. Zzit $uôeS udmawen nnwen di yal lekni, nujet $uôeS. £uôeS, s ddin iûfan. Akken ikwen id Ixleq, a ppu$alem".

verses.text: Arbaâ Inha it, arbaâ iura ttelfan fellas. Nitni, s tidep, rran ccwaîen d iêbiben, war Öebbi. U $ilen nitni, war ccekk, pwanhan.
verses.translation: Arbaâ Inha it, arbaâ iura ttelfan fellas. Nitni, s tidep, rran ccwaîen d iêbiben, war Öebbi. U $ilen nitni, war ccekk, pwanhan.

verses.text: A tarwa n Adem! Ccebêet i yal lekni, eççet, esswet, ur sîuqqutet. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid isîuqquten.
verses.translation: A tarwa n Adem! Ccebêet i yal lekni, eççet, esswet, ur sîuqqutet. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid isîuqquten.

verses.text: Ini: "anwa i igedlen ccbaêa n Öebbi, id Issuffe$ i imdanen iS, akked ôôeéq ilhan"? Ini: "ayagi, di tmeddurt n ddunit, i wid iumnen. I nitni kan ass n tnekra". Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
verses.translation: Ini: "anwa i igedlen ccbaêa n Öebbi, id Issuffe$ i imdanen iS, akked ôôeéq ilhan"? Ini: "ayagi, di tmeddurt n ddunit, i wid iumnen. I nitni kan ass n tnekra". Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen i ugdud issnen.

verses.text: Ini: "Mass iw Igdel kan ayen n dir, d uvhiô ne$ d uffir, abekkav, tem$weô war ssebba, a pcarkem i Öebbi ayen iwumi ur d irs udabu, a ppinim $ef Öebbi ayen ur tessinem".
verses.translation: Ini: "Mass iw Igdel kan ayen n dir, d uvhiô ne$ d uffir, abekkav, tem$weô war ssebba, a pcarkem i Öebbi ayen iwumi ur d irs udabu, a ppinim $ef Öebbi ayen ur tessinem".

verses.text: Yal lois isâa lajel. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen s ssaâa, ur t id ééaéan.
verses.translation: Yal lois isâa lajel. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen s ssaâa, ur t id ééaéan.

verses.text: A tarwa n Adem! Ma usan kwen id imazanen segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen iW, wid ipêezziben, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: A tarwa n Adem! Ma usan kwen id imazanen segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen iW, wid ipêezziben, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, u sme$wôen iman nnsen fellasen, widak d at tmes, nitni degs ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, u sme$wôen iman nnsen fellasen, widak d at tmes, nitni degs ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Widak, a ten iêaz umur i sen iuran di Tezmamt. Alamma, mi ten id usan imceggâen nne£, ad ddmen leôwaê nnsen, ad inin: "anida ten wid u$uô tepnujum, war Öebbi"? A d inin: "ur ten nufi". Ad cehhden, $ef yiman nnsen, ar nitni llan d ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Widak, a ten iêaz umur i sen iuran di Tezmamt. Alamma, mi ten id usan imceggâen nne£, ad ddmen leôwaê nnsen, ad inin: "anida ten wid u$uô tepnujum, war Öebbi"? A d inin: "ur ten nufi". Ad cehhden, $ef yiman nnsen, ar nitni llan d ijehliyen.

verses.text: Inna: "kecmet di tmes ar leoyus n leonun akked yimdanen, i kwen id izwaren"! Yal tikelt ara ikcem lois, ad ixzu gma s. Alamma, mi mlalen degs akw, ad yini uneggaru nnsen $ef umezwaru nnsen: "a Mass nne$! Wigi telfen a$, Aâqeb iten s tmes, berdayen". Inna: "i yal yiwen berdayen, maca ur teéôim ara".
verses.translation: Inna: "kecmet di tmes ar leoyus n leonun akked yimdanen, i kwen id izwaren"! Yal tikelt ara ikcem lois, ad ixzu gma s. Alamma, mi mlalen degs akw, ad yini uneggaru nnsen $ef umezwaru nnsen: "a Mass nne$! Wigi telfen a$, Aâqeb iten s tmes, berdayen". Inna: "i yal yiwen berdayen, maca ur teéôim ara".

verses.text: Inna umezwaru nnsen i uneggaru nnsen: "ur kwen smenyafen i nekwni, ihi jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tkeppbem".
verses.translation: Inna umezwaru nnsen i uneggaru nnsen: "ur kwen smenyafen i nekwni, ihi jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tkeppbem".

verses.text: Ih, wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, u sme$wôen iman nnsen fellasen, ur asen tellin tibbura igenni, ur keçmen Loennet, skud ur iâadda ara ul$em di tiî n tsegnit. Akka ay Nepqeîîi ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, u sme$wôen iman nnsen fellasen, ur asen tellin tibbura igenni, ur keçmen Loennet, skud ur iâadda ara ul$em di tiî n tsegnit. Akka ay Nepqeîîi ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: I nitni ameîôeê di Loahennama, ad $ummen s tmes. Akka ay Nepqeîîi imednas.
verses.translation: I nitni ameîôeê di Loahennama, ad $ummen s tmes. Akka ay Nepqeîîi imednas.

verses.text: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan - ur Nepkellif i umdan siwa ayen iwumi izmer - widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan - ur Nepkellif i umdan siwa ayen iwumi izmer - widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.

verses.text: A Nekkes i d igwran n dd$el, deg idmaren nnsen. Isaffen ad ppazzalen ddawat sen. Ad inin: "ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Inhan $eô waya. Ur nepwanhu, lemmer ur a$ Inha ara Öebbi. Ni$ usan d imazanen n Mass nne$, s tidep". Ad pwanecden: "appan Loennet, tweôtem p, ilmend n wayen txeddmem".
verses.translation: A Nekkes i d igwran n dd$el, deg idmaren nnsen. Isaffen ad ppazzalen ddawat sen. Ad inin: "ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Inhan $eô waya. Ur nepwanhu, lemmer ur a$ Inha ara Öebbi. Ni$ usan d imazanen n Mass nne$, s tidep". Ad pwanecden: "appan Loennet, tweôtem p, ilmend n wayen txeddmem".

verses.text: At Loennet ad siwlen i at tmes: "ni$ nufa i $ Iâahed Mass nne$, s tidep. Ma tufam ayen i wen Iâahed Mass nnwen, s tidep"? A inin: "Ih". Iberreê uberraê garasen: "xezzu n Öebbi i imednas,
verses.translation: At Loennet ad siwlen i at tmes: "ni$ nufa i $ Iâahed Mass nne$, s tidep. Ma tufam ayen i wen Iâahed Mass nnwen, s tidep"? A inin: "Ih". Iberreê uberraê garasen: "xezzu n Öebbi i imednas,

verses.text: wid iîîeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi, ssaramen t d uâwij, u nekôen laxeôt".
verses.translation: wid iîîeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi, ssaramen t d uâwij, u nekôen laxeôt".

verses.text: Garasen ssteô. £ef iqacucen, irgazen, ssnen ten akw, ar ûûiffat nnsen. Ad siwlen i at Loennet: "tifrat fellawen"! Ur p keççmen, xas ssarmen.
verses.translation: Garasen ssteô. £ef iqacucen, irgazen, ssnen ten akw, ar ûûiffat nnsen. Ad siwlen i at Loennet: "tifrat fellawen"! Ur p keççmen, xas ssarmen.

verses.text: Mi zzint wallen nnsen ar at tmes, ad inin: "a Mass nne$! Ur a$ Ppara s agdud imednas"!
verses.translation: Mi zzint wallen nnsen ar at tmes, ad inin: "a Mass nne$! Ur a$ Ppara s agdud imednas"!

verses.text: Ad siwlen at iqacucen i irgazen, ssnen ten ar ûûiffat nnsen. Ad inin: "acu i wen d issuli wayen tjemâam akked wayen tzuxxem"?
verses.translation: Ad siwlen at iqacucen i irgazen, ssnen ten ar ûûiffat nnsen. Ad inin: "acu i wen d issuli wayen tjemâam akked wayen tzuxxem"?

verses.text: Day wigi d wid i$ef teggulem, ar ur sen ippak Öebbi aêunu? "Kecmet Loennet, ur teppagwadem, ur t$weblem".
verses.translation: Day wigi d wid i$ef teggulem, ar ur sen ippak Öebbi aêunu? "Kecmet Loennet, ur teppagwadem, ur t$weblem".

verses.text: At tmes ad siwlen i at Loennet: "smiret ed fellane$ aman, ne$ seg wayen is ikwen I$at Öebbi". Ad inin: "Öebbi, s tidep, Igdel iten i ijehliyen,
verses.translation: At tmes ad siwlen i at Loennet: "smiret ed fellane$ aman, ne$ seg wayen is ikwen I$at Öebbi". Ad inin: "Öebbi, s tidep, Igdel iten i ijehliyen,

verses.text: wid irran ddin nnsen d zzhu, d urar, u t$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit". Ihi, assa, a ten Neppu, akken ppun timlilit n wass nnsen agi, u nekôen issekniyen nne£.
verses.translation: wid irran ddin nnsen d zzhu, d urar, u t$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit". Ihi, assa, a ten Neppu, akken ppun timlilit n wass nnsen agi, u nekôen issekniyen nne£.

verses.text: Ni$ Nusa ten id s Tezmamt, Nfeûûel ip s tussna. D nnhaya, d aêunu i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nusa ten id s Tezmamt, Nfeûûel ip s tussna. D nnhaya, d aêunu i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Day la pôaoun kan veôôu s? Ass n tisin n veôôu s, ad inin wid illan, iu$ lêal, ppun p: "ni$ usan d imazanen n Mass nne$, s tidep. Day nesâa imcafâen ara $ icafâen, ne$ ad a$ rren, a nexdem ayen mgirrden wayen nxeddem"? Ni$ sxeûôen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
verses.translation: Day la pôaoun kan veôôu s? Ass n tisin n veôôu s, ad inin wid illan, iu$ lêal, ppun p: "ni$ usan d imazanen n Mass nne$, s tidep. Day nesâa imcafâen ara $ icafâen, ne$ ad a$ rren, a nexdem ayen mgirrden wayen nxeddem"? Ni$ sxeûôen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

verses.text: S tidep, Mass nnwen d Öebbi. Ixelq ed tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan, sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Ip$ummu iv s wass, ip$awalen $uôes. Iîij, aggur, akked yitran unzen i lameô iS. Day maççi ineS lxelq akked lameô? D Asaâdi Öebbi, Mass imavalen!
verses.translation: S tidep, Mass nnwen d Öebbi. Ixelq ed tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan, sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Ip$ummu iv s wass, ip$awalen $uôes. Iîij, aggur, akked yitran unzen i lameô iS. Day maççi ineS lxelq akked lameô? D Asaâdi Öebbi, Mass imavalen!

verses.text: Naâret Mass nnwen, s wannuz, di tbavnit. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.
verses.translation: Naâret Mass nnwen, s wannuz, di tbavnit. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.

verses.text: Ur ssefsadet di tmurt deffir useêôet is. Naâôet eP, s tugwdi d usirem. Aêunu n Öebbi, s tidep, ar tama n lâuûam.
verses.translation: Ur ssefsadet di tmurt deffir useêôet is. Naâôet eP, s tugwdi d usirem. Aêunu n Öebbi, s tidep, ar tama n lâuûam.

verses.text: D Neppa id Ippaznen avu, d abecceô s uêunu S. Alamma, ma ibbub ed asigna aéayan, Nenheô it ar tmurt immuten. Nesse$li d syis aman. Nessuffe$ ed yissen yal ppemôa. Akka ay d Nessuffu$ lmeggtin, amendeô ma d tesmektim.
verses.translation: D Neppa id Ippaznen avu, d abecceô s uêunu S. Alamma, ma ibbub ed asigna aéayan, Nenheô it ar tmurt immuten. Nesse$li d syis aman. Nessuffe$ ed yissen yal ppemôa. Akka ay d Nessuffu$ lmeggtin, amendeô ma d tesmektim.

verses.text: Di tmurt lâali, teff$en d im$an is, ma Irad Öebbi. Di tin icemten, teff$en d kan d iweqweqen. Akka ay Nepbeggin issekniyen i ugdud isnemmiren.
verses.translation: Di tmurt lâali, teff$en d im$an is, ma Irad Öebbi. Di tin icemten, teff$en d kan d iweqweqen. Akka ay Nepbeggin issekniyen i ugdud isnemmiren.

verses.translation: Nnan imvebbôen n ugdud is: "$uône$, s tidep, aql ak di ttelfan n ûûeê".

verses.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ur illi dgi ttelfan. Maca nek d amazan s$uô Mass imavalen.

verses.translation: Bbwi$ awen d tibratin n Mass iw, a kwen neûêe$. Ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.

verses.translation: Nnan imvebbôen, wid ijehlen seg ugdud is: "s tidep, $uône$, deg k tisselbi; $uône$, ih, keçç seg wid iskiddiben".

verses.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ur dgi tisselbi. Maca nek d amazan s$uô Mass imavalen.

verses.translation: Bbwi$ awen d tibratin n Mass iw. Nek, i kunwi, d aneûûaê muman.

verses.text: Mmektit ed mi kwen Irra d igensas, deffir Âad. Isseqâad ikwen di tmurt, tepparram lebôuj di swaêel, teqqazem ixxamen deg durar. Ihi, mmektit ed lxiô n Öebbi, ur ssexsaôet tamurt, s usefsed".

verses.translation: Imvebbôen seg ugdud is, wid isme$awôen iman nnsen, nnan i wuôhifen, wid segsen iumnen: "day teéôam ar ÛüÜaliê d amazan s$uô Mass is"? Nnan: "ih, numen s wayen is id ippuceggaâ".

verses.translation: Tewwet iten zzenzla, gwran d, deg ixxamen nnsen, d loeppat.

verses.translation: I Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "day a txeddmem lâaô ur ixdim yiwen, uqbel nnwen, deg imavalen?

verses.translation: Ih, kunwi tpeddum ar irgazen, tcehwam ten, war tilawin. Kunwi, ih, d agdud izegren tilas".

verses.translation: Tiririt n ugdud is siwa nnan: "ssuff$et pen si temdint nnwen, nitni d imdanen issaramen tezdeg".

verses.translation: Nsellek it, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is, teqqim akked wid igwran.

verses.text: Imvebbôen n ugdud n Ferâun, nnan: "day a ppeooev Musa akked ugdud is, ad ssefsaden di tmurt, a kwen ooen, keçç akked iôebbiten ik"? Inna: "a nene$ arrac nnsen, a nessider tilawin nnsen. Nekwni, sennig sen, d iqehhaôen".
verses.translation: Imvebbôen n ugdud n Ferâun, nnan: "day a ppeooev Musa akked ugdud is, ad ssefsaden di tmurt, a kwen ooen, keçç akked iôebbiten ik"? Inna: "a nene$ arrac nnsen, a nessider tilawin nnsen. Nekwni, sennig sen, d iqehhaôen".

verses.text: Inna Musa i ugdud is: "ppret afus n Öebbi, u ûebôet. Tamurt, war ccekk, n Öebbi. A p iwôet win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Taggara i wid ipêezziben".
verses.translation: Inna Musa i ugdud is: "ppret afus n Öebbi, u ûebôet. Tamurt, war ccekk, n Öebbi. A p iwôet win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Taggara i wid ipêezziben".

verses.text: Nnan: "njaf uqbel a $ d tasev, u deffir tisin ik". Inna: "amar Mass nnwen ad Ine$ acengu nnwen, a kwen Irr d igensas di tmurt, ad Iwali amek ara txedmem".
verses.translation: Nnan: "njaf uqbel a $ d tasev, u deffir tisin ik". Inna: "amar Mass nnwen ad Ine$ acengu nnwen, a kwen Irr d igensas di tmurt, ad Iwali amek ara txedmem".

verses.text: Newwet, d$a, lois n Ferâun s iseggwasen n llaé, akked nneqs n ppemôa, amar a d mmektin.
verses.translation: Newwet, d$a, lois n Ferâun s iseggwasen n llaé, akked nneqs n ppemôa, amar a d mmektin.

verses.text: Ma iusa ten id ise$, ad inin: "nne$ wagi". Ma tusa ten id tucmip, a p sbibben i Musa akked wid illan yides. Ayen iveôôun yidsen, day maççi ar Öebbi kan? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Ma iusa ten id ise$, ad inin: "nne$ wagi". Ma tusa ten id tucmip, a p sbibben i Musa akked wid illan yides. Ayen iveôôun yidsen, day maççi ar Öebbi kan? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.

verses.text: Nnan: " wicqa assekni ara d tawiv, ur a$ tepseêêirev yis. Nekwni, ur neppamen yisek".
verses.translation: Nnan: " wicqa assekni ara d tawiv, ur a$ tepseêêirev yis. Nekwni, ur neppamen yisek".

verses.translation: Nuzen asen aêemmal, ajôad, tilkin, imqweôqwôen, idammen, d issekniyen ifeûlen. Sme$wôen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud ibe$wviyen.

verses.translation: Mi tevôa yidsen twa$it, qqaôen: "a Musa! Nâaô Mass ik i nekwni, s wayen i k Iâahed. Ma tekksev a$ tawa$it, a namen yisek, a nazen yidek At Isôail".

verses.text: Mi sen Nekkes tawa$it, ar lajel iten iggunin, atnan nitni xedâan.
verses.translation: Mi sen Nekkes tawa$it, ar lajel iten iggunin, atnan nitni xedâan.

verses.text: Nerra d segsen ppaô, N$emq iten deg ill, imi skaddben issekniyen nne£, ur d celâen degsen.
verses.translation: Nerra d segsen ppaô, N$emq iten deg ill, imi skaddben issekniyen nne£, ur d celâen degsen.

verses.translation: Nessewôet i ugdud i illan qehôen t, igmav akked ituram n tmurt, i Neôqa. Itam wawal ûûam n Mass ik, $ef At Isôail, ilmend n wayen ûebôen. Nhudd ayen iûennaâ Ferâun akked ugdud is, u wayen bennun.

verses.translation: Wigi, s tidep, ad inger wayen ideg llan, ad inqev wayen xeddmen".

verses.text: Inna: "day awen budde$ ôebbi, war Öebbi, u Neppa Ismenyaf ikwen $ef imavalen"?
verses.translation: Inna: "day awen budde$ ôebbi, war Öebbi, u Neppa Ismenyaf ikwen $ef imavalen"?

verses.translation: Mi kwen Nsellek si lois n Ferâun, sukken fellawen aâaqeb uqsiê mavi; neqqen arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Deg waya, ajeôôeb s$uô Mass nnwen ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Nemlal akked Musa kravet wavan, Nerna yasen mraw. Tebbwev tallit n Mass is, kuzet wavan. Inna Musa i gma s Haôun: "enûef iyi ar ugdud iw, exdem ayen ilhan, ur teddu d ubrid ifessaden".
verses.translation: Nemlal akked Musa kravet wavan, Nerna yasen mraw. Tebbwev tallit n Mass is, kuzet wavan. Inna Musa i gma s Haôun: "enûef iyi ar ugdud iw, exdem ayen ilhan, ur teddu d ubrid ifessaden".

verses.text: Mi d iusa Musa ar temlilit nne£, u Immeslay as Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Ssenâat iyi d, a K wali$". Inna d: "ur iyI tepwaliv, d awez$i, maca muqel s adrar. Ma iqqim deg umekkan is, ad iyI twaliv". Mi d Iusa Mass is s adrar, Irra t d saêel. I$li Musa, ixsef. Mi d iuki, inna: "gedha s yiseK! Utube$ K, nek d amezwaru n lmumnin".
verses.translation: Mi d iusa Musa ar temlilit nne£, u Immeslay as Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Ssenâat iyi d, a K wali$". Inna d: "ur iyI tepwaliv, d awez$i, maca muqel s adrar. verses.translation: Nura yas, di tlewêin, si yal cci, anabi akked ufeûûel n yal cci. Ddem itent s tezmert, ameô i ugdud ik a tent iîîef s lmaâna nnsent. Ad awen Ssekne$ tanezdu$t iballa$en.

verses.text: Ad Veôôfe$, seg issekniyen iW, wid isme$wôen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. Mi walan yal assekni, ur ppamnen yis. Ma walan abrid uûwib, ur teddun degs. Ma walan abrid n le$wlav, a t awin. Ayagi, acku, s tidep, skaddben issekniyen nne£, ur d celâen degsen.
verses.translation: Ad Veôôfe$, seg issekniyen iW, wid isme$wôen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. Mi walan yal assekni, ur ppamnen yis. Ma walan abrid uûwib, ur teddun degs. Ma walan abrid n le$wlav, a t awin. Ayagi, acku, s tidep, skaddben issekniyen nne£, ur d celâen degsen.

verses.text: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, akked temlilit n laxeôt, ur swin igiten nnsen. Day a ten kafin $ef wayen ur nelli d ayen xeddmen?
verses.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, akked temlilit n laxeôt, ur swin igiten nnsen. Day a ten kafin $ef wayen ur nelli d ayen xeddmen?

verses.text: Agdud n Musa, deffir es, isbedd, s ôôêuê is, aâjmi bu loeppa isrugmuten. Day ur walan ara ar, s tidep, ur asen d ipmeslay, ur la ten inehhu s abrid? Âabden t, llan d imednas.
verses.translation: Agdud n Musa, deffir es, isbedd, s ôôêuê is, aâjmi bu loeppa isrugmuten. Day ur walan ara ar, s tidep, ur asen d ipmeslay, ur la ten inehhu s abrid? Âabden t, llan d imednas.

verses.text: Mi ppuêeccmen, u walan ar, zi$ nnetlafen, nnan: "ma ur Iêun ara fella$ Mass nne$, ma ur a$ Isemmeê ara, war ccekk, a nu$al seg imexsuôen".
verses.translation: Mi ppuêeccmen, u walan ar, zi$ nnetlafen, nnan: "ma ur Iêun ara fella$ Mass nne$, ma ur a$ Isemmeê ara, war ccekk, a nu$al seg imexsuôen".

verses.translation: Mi d iu$al Musa ar ugdud is, s wurrif akked lêemûa, inna: "ay d ucmit wayen is iyi tneûfem, deffir iw! Teb$am a d i$iwwel lameô n Mass nnwen"? verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Semmeê ane$, nek akked gma, Ssekcem a$ ar uêunu K. Keçç, Tifev akw wid ipêunun".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Semmeê ane$, nek akked gma, Ssekcem a$ ar uêunu K. Keçç, Tifev akw wid ipêunun".

verses.translation: Ih, wid iâabden aâajmi, a d i$li fellasen wurrif n Mass nnsen, ad ndellen di tmeddurt n ddunit. Akka ay Nepqeîîi wid id isnulfuyen.

verses.translation: Wid ixedmen tucmitin, sinna, steôoâen deffir sent, u umnen, Mass ik, s tidep, deffir sent, ar Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.translation: Mi irs wurrif is, iddem ed Musa tilewêin. Di tira nnsent, nnhaya akked uêunu i wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen.

verses.translation: Ifren ed Musa ûatet irgazen seg ugdud is, ad mlilen yidne£. Mi ten tewwet zzenzla, inna: "a Mass iw! Lemmer i K ihwi, yili, iu$ lêal, Ten$iv ten, u Tegliv yissi. verses.translation: wid iteddun d Umazan, Nnbi ur ne$ôi, i ufan iura $uôsen di Tuôa akked Linoil". Iumeô asen d lqanun, Itekkes asen ayen n dir. Iêell asen lâali, igdel asen dduni. verses.translation: Deg ugdud n Musa, arbaâ iteddu s tidep. U syis ay pêuddun.

Nesbur iten s usigna, Nessers asen d lmenna akked ifeôôuoen: "eççet seg wayen ilhan, is ikwen N$at". Ur a£ dnisen, maca la ddennisen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: Nessemfaôaq iten $ef mrawsin laâôac, n leoyus. Mi s issuter ugdud is tissit, Nweêêa i Musa: ewwet aéôu s tâakwaz ik. verses.translation: Wid idensen segsen, neûfen awalen s wid ur nelli d wid i sen nnan. Nuzen asen tiyta seg igenni, ilmend n wayen ddennisen.

verses.translation: Steqsi ten $ef temdint i illan $ef rrif n yill, mi ur d rzin di ssebt, mi ten id usan iselman nnsen, walan ten, ass n ssebt. Ass, war ssebt, ur ten id ppasen. Akka ay ten Njeôôeb, deg wayen ssexsaôen.

verses.translation: Nessemfaôaq iten di tmurt, d leoyus, garasen wid imaânen, garasen wid ur nemâin. Njeôôeb iten s ise$iyen akked tucmitin, amar a d u$alen s abrid.

verses.translation: Wid iîîfen di Tezmamt, ipéallan, s tidep, ur Nveggiâ arraz n lâuûam.

verses.translation: Mi Nessuli adrar sennig sen, amzun d tili, $ilen, s tidep, ara d i$li fellasen. Ïîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, smektit ed ayen illan degs, amar a pêezzbem.

verses.translation: Mi d Iddem Mass ik, si tgeééal n tarwa n Adem, dderya nnsen, Inna yasen a d cehhden $ef yiman nnsen: "day ur Lli$ ara d Mass nnwen"? Nnan: "ih, ncehhed". Akka ur d teqqaôem ara, ass n tnekra: "s tidep, ayagi d ayen ur neéôi".

verses.text: Ne$ a d tinim: "d imezwura nne$ kan i icurken, zik. Nekwni d tarwa deffir sen. Day a$ Ten$ev, ilmend n wayen xedmen wid iôejjnen"?
verses.translation: Ne$ a d tinim: "d imezwura nne$ kan i icurken, zik. Nekwni d tarwa deffir sen. Day a$ Ten$ev, ilmend n wayen xedmen wid iôejjnen"?

verses.text: Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen, amar a d u$alen s abrid.
verses.translation: Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen, amar a d u$alen s abrid.

verses.text: Eêku yasen d tadyant n win iwumi Nefka issekniyen nne£. Irra ten akin. Idda yides Cciîan, iu$al seg wid i$eôqen.
verses.translation: Eêku yasen d tadyant n win iwumi Nefka issekniyen nne£. Irra ten akin. Idda yides Cciîan, iu$al seg wid i$eôqen.

verses.text: Lemmer i £ ihwi, Nessuli t yissen. Maca, ib$a tamurt, idda d lhawiyya s. Ihi, amedya s am win n waydi, ma teddiv p fellas, ad ilehhet, ma teooiv t, ad ilehhet. D wagi ay d amedya n ugdud i iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Eêku d tadyant, amar a d mmektin.
verses.translation: Lemmer i £ ihwi, Nessuli t yissen. Maca, ib$a tamurt, idda d lhawiyya s. Ihi, amedya s am win n waydi, ma teddiv p fellas, ad ilehhet, ma teooiv t, ad ilehhet. D wagi ay d amedya n ugdud i iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Eêku d tadyant, amar a d mmektin.

verses.text: Agdud iskaddben issekniyen nne£, d yir amedya. Pddennisen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: Agdud iskaddben issekniyen nne£, d yir amedya. Pddennisen iman nnsen.

verses.text: Win Inha Öebbi, ihi, idda d ubrid. Wid Itlef Öebbi, nitni d imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Win Inha Öebbi, ihi, idda d ubrid. Wid Itlef Öebbi, nitni d imexsuôen.

verses.text: Ni$ Neswejd ed, i Loahennama, aîas n leonun akked yimdanen. Sâan ulawen, ur fehhmen yissen; sâan allen, ur pwalin yissent; sâan imeééu$en, ur sellen yissen. Nitni am lmal, ne$ nnetlafen kteô. Wigi d i$wefliyen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Neswejd ed, i Loahennama, aîas n leonun akked yimdanen. Sâan ulawen, ur fehhmen yissen; sâan allen, ur pwalin yissent; sâan imeééu$en, ur sellen yissen. Nitni am lmal, ne$ nnetlafen kteô. Wigi d i$wefliyen.

verses.text: I Öebbi, ismawen ûûam. Naâôet eP, yissen. Veôôfet seg wid issexsaôen ismawen iS. Ad ppuqeîîin $ef wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: I Öebbi, ismawen ûûam. Naâôet eP, yissen. Veôôfet seg wid issexsaôen ismawen iS. Ad ppuqeîîin $ef wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Deg wayen Nexleq, yiwen n lois ivfeô tidep. Ipêuddu syis.
verses.translation: Deg wayen Nexleq, yiwen n lois ivfeô tidep. Ipêuddu syis.

verses.text: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, a ten Nawi, cwiî, cwiî, ar wanda ur éôin.
verses.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, a ten Nawi, cwiî, cwiî, ar wanda ur éôin.

verses.text: Ad asen Fke$ lmudda. Ih, ticeôkep iW d tunûiêt.
verses.translation: Ad asen Fke$ lmudda. Ih, ticeôkep iW d tunûiêt.

verses.text: Day ur d tepmeyyizem ara? Ur illi umeddakwel nnwen d aôehbani. Neppa, d aneddaô kan ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Day ur d tepmeyyizem ara? Ur illi umeddakwel nnwen d aôehbani. Neppa, d aneddaô kan ipbegginen.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen Ixleq Öebbi n cci? Ni$, ahat, iqeôb ed lajel nnsen. Anwa awal, deffir wagi, ar amnen?
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen Ixleq Öebbi n cci? Ni$, ahat, iqeôb ed lajel nnsen. Anwa awal, deffir wagi, ar amnen?

verses.text: Win Itlef Öebbi, ur Isâi nnahi. A ten Ioo ad hemlen di tjehli nnsen.
verses.translation: Win Itlef Öebbi, ur Isâi nnahi. A ten Ioo ad hemlen di tjehli nnsen.

verses.text: A k steqsayen $ef yimir, melmi ara d yili. Ini: "i t Iéôan siwa Mass iw. D Neppa kan a t id Isseknen, di lweqt is. Ad iaéay di tmurt akked igenwan. Ur kwen id ippawev siwa deqzalla". A k steqsayen amzun tesâiv asali fellas. Ini: "i t Issnen siwa ÔÖebbi", maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
verses.translation: A k steqsayen $ef yimir, melmi ara d yili. Ini: "i t Iéôan siwa Mass iw. D Neppa kan a t id Isseknen, di lweqt is. Ad iaéay di tmurt akked igenwan. Ur kwen id ippawev siwa deqzalla". A k steqsayen amzun tesâiv asali fellas. Ini: "i t Issnen siwa ÔÖebbi", maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.

verses.text: Ini: "ur ksibe$ i iman iw, aba$uô ne$ vveôô, kkes ed ayen Irad Öebbi. Lemmer ssine$ tabavnit, ad ôwu$ lxiô, ur iyi ipnal ixmiô. Nek d aneddaô kan, u d abcir, i ugdud iumnen".
verses.translation: Ini: "ur ksibe$ i iman iw, aba$uô ne$ vveôô, kkes ed ayen Irad Öebbi. Lemmer ssine$ tabavnit, ad ôwu$ lxiô, ur iyi ipnal ixmiô. Nek d aneddaô kan, u d abcir, i ugdud iumnen".

verses.text: D Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiwen n yiman. Iddem ed segs tameîîut is, ad izde$ yides. Mi insa yides, tebbwi tadist tafessast; telêa yis. Mi d teûbeê ééayet, naâôen Öebbi: "a Mass nne$! Ma Tefkiv a$ d aâeôvi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".
verses.translation: D Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiwen n yiman. Iddem ed segs tameîîut is, ad izde$ yides. Mi insa yides, tebbwi tadist tafessast; telêa yis. Mi d teûbeê ééayet, naâôen Öebbi: "a Mass nne$! Ma Tefkiv a$ d aâeôvi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".

verses.text: Mi sen d Ifka aâeôdi, rran aS icriken s wayen i sen d Ifka. I aâlay Öebbi, sennig wayen pcaraken!
verses.translation: Mi sen d Ifka aâeôdi, rran aS icriken s wayen i sen d Ifka. I aâlay Öebbi, sennig wayen pcaraken!

verses.text: Day ad carken ayen ur nexliq acemma, u d nitni i ipwaxelqen?
verses.translation: Day ad carken ayen ur nexliq acemma, u d nitni i ipwaxelqen?

verses.text: Ur zmiren a ten âiwnen, ne$ ad âiwnen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: Ur zmiren a ten âiwnen, ne$ ad âiwnen iman nnsen.

verses.text: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur teddun yidwen. Iâuva fellawen ma tnecdem ten, ne$ ma tessusmem.
verses.translation: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur teddun yidwen. Iâuva fellawen ma tnecdem ten, ne$ ma tessusmem.

verses.text: S tidep, wigi tnaâôem, war Öebbi, d imdanen am kunwi. Naâret pen, ma ad awen d rren, maday tessawalem tidep.
verses.translation: S tidep, wigi tnaâôem, war Öebbi, d imdanen am kunwi. Naâret pen, ma ad awen d rren, maday tessawalem tidep.

verses.text: Day sâan ivaôen, ad lêun fellasen, ne$ sâan ifassen, ad ddmen yissen, ne$ sâan allen, ad walin yisent, ne$ sâan imeééu$en, ad slen yissen. Ini: "naâret icriken nnwen, sinna, andit iyi. Ur iyi sganayet".
verses.translation: Day sâan ivaôen, ad lêun fellasen, ne$ sâan ifassen, ad ddmen yissen, ne$ sâan allen, ad walin yisent, ne$ sâan imeééu$en, ad slen yissen. Ini: "naâret icriken nnwen, sinna, andit iyi. Ur iyi sganayet".

verses.text: Ih, Bab iw d Öebbi id Issersen Tazmamt, i Iêemmlen lâuûam.
verses.translation: Ih, Bab iw d Öebbi id Issersen Tazmamt, i Iêemmlen lâuûam.

verses.text: Wid tnaâôem, war Neppa, ur zmiren a kwen âawnen, ne$ ad âawnen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: Wid tnaâôem, war Neppa, ur zmiren a kwen âawnen, ne$ ad âawnen iman nnsen.

verses.text: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur sellen. A ten twaliv a k id pmuqulen, nitni ur pwalin.
verses.translation: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur sellen. A ten twaliv a k id pmuqulen, nitni ur pwalin.

verses.text: Ddem ayen ilhan, ameô ar lewqama, veôôef i wid ur nessin.
verses.translation: Ddem ayen ilhan, ameô ar lewqama, veôôef i wid ur nessin.

verses.text: Ma ilaâj ik Cciîan ar dduni, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ma ilaâj ik Cciîan ar dduni, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ih, wid ipêezziben, ma innul iten urbaâ n ccwaîen, a d mmektin, d$a ad asen llint wallen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ipêezziben, ma innul iten urbaâ n ccwaîen, a d mmektin, d$a ad asen llint wallen.

verses.text: Zgan $elîen atmaten nnsen, d$a nitni ur xevvun.
verses.translation: Zgan $elîen atmaten nnsen, d$a nitni ur xevvun.

verses.text: Ma ur asen d tebbwiv ara assekni, ad ak inin: "acimi ur t id isnulfa ara"? Ini: "teddu$ kan d wayen iyi d ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass iw". Wagi, s$uô Mass nnwen, d tafat, d nnhaya, d aêunu, i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: Ma ur asen d tebbwiv ara assekni, ad ak inin: "acimi ur t id isnulfa ara"? Ini: "teddu$ kan d wayen iyi d ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass iw". Wagi, s$uô Mass nnwen, d tafat, d nnhaya, d aêunu, i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Ma qqaôen Leqwôan ssemêesset as, ssusmet, amar fellawen aêunu.
verses.translation: Ma qqaôen Leqwôan ssemêesset as, ssusmet, amar fellawen aêunu.

verses.text: Mmekti d Mass ik, deg iman ik, s wannuz akked lxuf, s wawal irsen, taûebêit, tameddit. Ur ppili seg i$wefliyen.
verses.translation: Mmekti d Mass ik, deg iman ik, s wannuz akked lxuf, s wawal irsen, taûebêit, tameddit. Ur ppili seg i$wefliyen.

verses.text: Ih, wid illan ar Mass ik, ur sme$wôen ara iman nnsen, $ef uâbad iS. Sbuccuâen T, i Neppa kennun.
verses.translation: Ih, wid illan ar Mass ik, ur sme$wôen ara iman nnsen, $ef uâbad iS. Sbuccuâen T, i Neppa kennun.

ayahs.text: Almû.
ayahs.translation: Almû.

ayahs.text: Tazmamt ters ed $uôek, ur teppili segs lhejna deg idmaren ik, iwakken a pnabiv yis; u d asmekti i lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Tazmamt ters ed $uôek, ur teppili segs lhejna deg idmaren ik, iwakken a pnabiv yis; u d asmekti i lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ddut d wayen id irsen $uôwen, s$uô Mass nnwen. Ur teddut d imawlan, war Neppa. Drus id tesmektayem.
ayahs.translation: Ddut d wayen id irsen $uôwen, s$uô Mass nnwen. Ur teddut d imawlan, war Neppa. Drus id tesmektayem.

ayahs.text: Acêal n temdinin ay Nessenger. Tusa ten id tiyta nne£, deg ives nnsen, ne$ deg uqeggel nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Acêal n temdinin ay Nessenger. Tusa ten id tiyta nne£, deg ives nnsen, ne$ deg uqeggel nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ti$ôi nnsen, mi ten id tusa tiyta nne£, siwa mi d nnan: "ih, nella d imednas".
ayahs.translation: Ti$ôi nnsen, mi ten id tusa tiyta nne£, siwa mi d nnan: "ih, nella d imednas".

ayahs.text: War ccekk, a Nesteqsi wid u$uô id Nuzen, a Nesteqsi imazanen.
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, a Nesteqsi wid u$uô id Nuzen, a Nesteqsi imazanen.

ayahs.text: War ccekk, ad asen Neêku, s tmusni, ur Nelli N$ab.
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, ad asen Neêku, s tmusni, ur Nelli N$ab.

ayahs.text: Awzan, assen, d tidep. Wid iwumi ééayet lweznat nnsen, widak d wid irebêen.
ayahs.translation: Awzan, assen, d tidep. Wid iwumi ééayet lweznat nnsen, widak d wid irebêen.

ayahs.text: Wid iwumi fessuset lweznat nnsen, widak d wid ixesôen iman nnsen, seg akken sednasen issekniyen nne£.
ayahs.translation: Wid iwumi fessuset lweznat nnsen, widak d wid ixesôen iman nnsen, seg akken sednasen issekniyen nne£.

ayahs.text: Ni$, s tidep, Nesrekd ikwen di tmurt, Nerra yawen, degs, tamâict nnwen. Drus ay tesnemmirem.
ayahs.translation: Ni$, s tidep, Nesrekd ikwen di tmurt, Nerra yawen, degs, tamâict nnwen. Drus ay tesnemmirem.

ayahs.text: Ni$, s tidep, Nxelq ikwen, sinna, Nmesl ikwen, sinna, Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem"! Knant, siwa Iblis. Ur illi seg wid iknan.
ayahs.translation: Ni$, s tidep, Nxelq ikwen, sinna, Nmesl ikwen, sinna, Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem"! Knant, siwa Iblis. Ur illi seg wid iknan.

ayahs.text: Inna: "acu k iîîfen ur tekniv ara, mi k d Umôe$"? Inna d: "Nek, ife$ t. Txelqev iyi si tmes, Txelqev t si talaxt".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "acu k iîîfen ur tekniv ara, mi k d Umôe$"? Inna d: "Nek, ife$ t. Txelqev iyi si tmes, Txelqev t si talaxt".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ihi, ûûub segs! Ur ak ippunefk ara a ppesme$wôev iman ik, degs. Effe$, keçç seg wid ixuûen"!
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ihi, ûûub segs! Ur ak ippunefk ara a ppesme$wôev iman ik, degs. Effe$, keçç seg wid ixuûen"!

ayahs.text: Inna: "Eoo iyi, ar ass ideg ara d kkren".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "Eoo iyi, ar ass ideg ara d kkren".

ayahs.text: Inna: "keçç, ih, seg wid ara iqqimen".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "keçç, ih, seg wid ara iqqimen".

ayahs.text: Inna d: "imi iyi Tâammdev a$ewwu, ad asen qqime$, war ccekk, deg ubrid iK uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Inna d: "imi iyi Tâammdev a$ewwu, ad asen qqime$, war ccekk, deg ubrid iK uwqim.

ayahs.text: Sinna, ad asen d tekke$ zdat, deffir, yeffus, zelmev. Ur Teppafev, $eô tugwti segsen, asnemmer".
ayahs.translation: Sinna, ad asen d tekke$ zdat, deffir, yeffus, zelmev. Ur Teppafev, $eô tugwti segsen, asnemmer".

ayahs.text: Inna: "effe$ segs, d ameêquô ippuvegôen! War ccekk, ad Acaôe$ Loahennama s wid, segsen, i k ivefôen, akked yiswen akw.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "effe$ segs, d ameêquô ippuvegôen! War ccekk, ad Acaôe$ Loahennama s wid, segsen, i k ivefôen, akked yiswen akw.

ayahs.text: A Adem, ezde$ Loennet, keçç akked tmeîîut ik, eççet seg wayen i wen ihwan. Ur pqeôôibet ttejôa agi, mulac a ppilim seg imednas".
ayahs.translation: A Adem, ezde$ Loennet, keçç akked tmeîîut ik, eççet seg wayen i wen ihwan. Ur pqeôôibet ttejôa agi, mulac a ppilim seg imednas".

ayahs.text: I$ewwa ten Cciîan, iwakken ad asen d iban âaryan nnsen i illan iffer. Inna: "Ikkes awen, kan, Mass nnwen, ttejôa agi, iwakken ur teppilim d lmalayek, ne$ ur tepwekkiôem".
ayahs.translation: I$ewwa ten Cciîan, iwakken ad asen d iban âaryan nnsen i illan iffer. Inna: "Ikkes awen, kan, Mass nnwen, ttejôa agi, iwakken ur teppilim d lmalayek, ne$ ur tepwekkiôem".

ayahs.text: Iggul asen: "nek, i kunwi, d unûiê".
ayahs.translation: Iggul asen: "nek, i kunwi, d unûiê".

ayahs.text: Isdull iten s u$uôôu. Mi âaôven si ttejôa nni, walan iman nnsen aâran. Lhan d la pcuddun, $ef iman nnsen, afriwen n Loennet. Issawel asen d Mass nnsen: "day ur awen Gdile$ ara ttejôa nni? Ad awen Ini$: war ccekk, Cciîan, i kunwi, d acengu n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: Isdull iten s u$uôôu. Mi âaôven si ttejôa nni, walan iman nnsen aâran. Lhan d la pcuddun, $ef iman nnsen, afriwen n Loennet. Issawel asen d Mass nnsen: "day ur awen Gdile$ ara ttejôa nni? Ad awen Ini$: war ccekk, Cciîan, i kunwi, d acengu n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! Nvuôô iman nne$. Ma ur a$ Tsemmêev, ur Têunev fella$, a nili seg imexsuôen".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! Nvuôô iman nne$. Ma ur a$ Tsemmêev, ur Têunev fella$, a nili seg imexsuôen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "erset! Kra d icenga n kra. A pzed$em di tmurt, a ppezhum, tallit kan".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "erset! Kra d icenga n kra. A pzed$em di tmurt, a ppezhum, tallit kan".

ayahs.text: Irna: "degs a ppidirem, degs a ppemmtem, segs a d teff$em".
ayahs.translation: Irna: "degs a ppidirem, degs a ppemmtem, segs a d teff$em".

ayahs.text: A tarwa n Adem! Ni$ Nessers awen ed aceîîiv ara kwen issôen, ôôêuê, akked uceîîiv uêezzeb. Wagi yif iten". Ayagi seg issekniyen n Öebbi, amar a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: A tarwa n Adem! Ni$ Nessers awen ed aceîîiv ara kwen issôen, ôôêuê, akked uceîîiv uêezzeb. Wagi yif iten". Ayagi seg issekniyen n Öebbi, amar a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: A tarwa n Adem! £uôwat a kwen ihewwel Cciîan, akken id issuffe$ imezwura nnwen si Loennet! Ikkes asen iceîîiven nnsen, iwakken ad asen issken âaryan nnsen. Neppa, war ccekk, ipwali kwen - neppa akked ccetla s - seg wanda ur ten tepwalim. Ni$ Nerra ccwaîen d imawlan n wid ur numin.
ayahs.translation: A tarwa n Adem! £uôwat a kwen ihewwel Cciîan, akken id issuffe$ imezwura nnwen si Loennet! Ikkes asen iceîîiven nnsen, iwakken ad asen issken âaryan nnsen. Neppa, war ccekk, ipwali kwen - neppa akked ccetla s - seg wanda ur ten tepwalim. Ni$ Nerra ccwaîen d imawlan n wid ur numin.

ayahs.text: Mi xedmen ayen n dir, ad inin: "nufa d akka ar imezwura nne$, u Öebbi Iumeô a$ d $uôes. Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, ur Ippameô ar wayen n dir. Day a d tinim $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
ayahs.translation: Mi xedmen ayen n dir, ad inin: "nufa d akka ar imezwura nne$, u Öebbi Iumeô a$ d $uôes. Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, ur Ippameô ar wayen n dir. Day a d tinim $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?

ayahs.text: Ini: "Iumeô ed Öebbi lmizan. Zzit $uôeS udmawen nnwen di yal lekni, nujet $uôeS. £uôeS, s ddin iûfan. Akken ikwen id Ixleq, a ppu$alem".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "Iumeô ed Öebbi lmizan. Zzit $uôeS udmawen nnwen di yal lekni, nujet $uôeS. £uôeS, s ddin iûfan. Akken ikwen id Ixleq, a ppu$alem".

ayahs.text: Arbaâ Inha it, arbaâ iura ttelfan fellas. Nitni, s tidep, rran ccwaîen d iêbiben, war Öebbi. U $ilen nitni, war ccekk, pwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Arbaâ Inha it, arbaâ iura ttelfan fellas. Nitni, s tidep, rran ccwaîen d iêbiben, war Öebbi. U $ilen nitni, war ccekk, pwanhan.

ayahs.text: A tarwa n Adem! Ccebêet i yal lekni, eççet, esswet, ur sîuqqutet. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid isîuqquten.
ayahs.translation: A tarwa n Adem! Ccebêet i yal lekni, eççet, esswet, ur sîuqqutet. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid isîuqquten.

ayahs.text: Ini: "anwa i igedlen ccbaêa n Öebbi, id Issuffe$ i imdanen iS, akked ôôeéq ilhan"? Ini: "ayagi, di tmeddurt n ddunit, i wid iumnen. I nitni kan ass n tnekra". Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "anwa i igedlen ccbaêa n Öebbi, id Issuffe$ i imdanen iS, akked ôôeéq ilhan"? Ini: "ayagi, di tmeddurt n ddunit, i wid iumnen. I nitni kan ass n tnekra". Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen i ugdud issnen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "Mass iw Igdel kan ayen n dir, d uvhiô ne$ d uffir, abekkav, tem$weô war ssebba, a pcarkem i Öebbi ayen iwumi ur d irs udabu, a ppinim $ef Öebbi ayen ur tessinem".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "Mass iw Igdel kan ayen n dir, d uvhiô ne$ d uffir, abekkav, tem$weô war ssebba, a pcarkem i Öebbi ayen iwumi ur d irs udabu, a ppinim $ef Öebbi ayen ur tessinem".

ayahs.text: Yal lois isâa lajel. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen s ssaâa, ur t id ééaéan.
ayahs.translation: Yal lois isâa lajel. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen s ssaâa, ur t id ééaéan.

ayahs.text: A tarwa n Adem! Ma usan kwen id imazanen segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen iW, wid ipêezziben, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: A tarwa n Adem! Ma usan kwen id imazanen segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen iW, wid ipêezziben, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, u sme$wôen iman nnsen fellasen, widak d at tmes, nitni degs ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, u sme$wôen iman nnsen fellasen, widak d at tmes, nitni degs ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Widak, a ten iêaz umur i sen iuran di Tezmamt. Alamma, mi ten id usan imceggâen nne£, ad ddmen leôwaê nnsen, ad inin: "anida ten wid u$uô tepnujum, war Öebbi"? A d inin: "ur ten nufi". Ad cehhden, $ef yiman nnsen, ar nitni llan d ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ iskaddben issekniyen iS? Widak, a ten iêaz umur i sen iuran di Tezmamt. Alamma, mi ten id usan imceggâen nne£, ad ddmen leôwaê nnsen, ad inin: "anida ten wid u$uô tepnujum, war Öebbi"? A d inin: "ur ten nufi". Ad cehhden, $ef yiman nnsen, ar nitni llan d ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Inna: "kecmet di tmes ar leoyus n leonun akked yimdanen, i kwen id izwaren"! Yal tikelt ara ikcem lois, ad ixzu gma s. Alamma, mi mlalen degs akw, ad yini uneggaru nnsen $ef umezwaru nnsen: "a Mass nne$! Wigi telfen a$, Aâqeb iten s tmes, berdayen". Inna: "i yal yiwen berdayen, maca ur teéôim ara".

Alamma, mi mlalen degs akw, ad yini uneggaru nnsen $ef umezwaru nnsen: "a Mass nne$! Wigi telfen a$, Aâqeb iten s tmes, berdayen". Inna: "i yal yiwen berdayen, maca ur teéôim ara".

ayahs.text: Inna umezwaru nnsen i uneggaru nnsen: "ur kwen smenyafen i nekwni, ihi jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tkeppbem".
ayahs.translation: Inna umezwaru nnsen i uneggaru nnsen: "ur kwen smenyafen i nekwni, ihi jeôôbet aâaqeb, ilmend n wayen tkeppbem".

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, u sme$wôen iman nnsen fellasen, ur asen tellin tibbura igenni, ur keçmen Loennet, skud ur iâadda ara ul$em di tiî n tsegnit. Akka ay Nepqeîîi ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, u sme$wôen iman nnsen fellasen, ur asen tellin tibbura igenni, ur keçmen Loennet, skud ur iâadda ara ul$em di tiî n tsegnit. Akka ay Nepqeîîi ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: I nitni ameîôeê di Loahennama, ad $ummen s tmes. Akka ay Nepqeîîi imednas.
ayahs.translation: I nitni ameîôeê di Loahennama, ad $ummen s tmes. Akka ay Nepqeîîi imednas.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan - ur Nepkellif i umdan siwa ayen iwumi izmer - widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan - ur Nepkellif i umdan siwa ayen iwumi izmer - widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: A Nekkes i d igwran n dd$el, deg idmaren nnsen. Isaffen ad ppazzalen ddawat sen. Ad inin: "ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Inhan $eô waya. Ur nepwanhu, lemmer ur a$ Inha ara Öebbi. Ni$ usan d imazanen n Mass nne$, s tidep". Ad pwanecden: "appan Loennet, tweôtem p, ilmend n wayen txeddmem".
ayahs.translation: A Nekkes i d igwran n dd$el, deg idmaren nnsen. Isaffen ad ppazzalen ddawat sen. Ad inin: "ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Inhan $eô waya. Ur nepwanhu, lemmer ur a$ Inha ara Öebbi. Ni$ usan d imazanen n Mass nne$, s tidep". Ad pwanecden: "appan Loennet, tweôtem p, ilmend n wayen txeddmem".

ayahs.text: At Loennet ad siwlen i at tmes: "ni$ nufa i $ Iâahed Mass nne$, s tidep. Ma tufam ayen i wen Iâahed Mass nnwen, s tidep"? A inin: "Ih". Iberreê uberraê garasen: "xezzu n Öebbi i imednas,
ayahs.translation: At Loennet ad siwlen i at tmes: "ni$ nufa i $ Iâahed Mass nne$, s tidep. Ma tufam ayen i wen Iâahed Mass nnwen, s tidep"? A inin: "Ih". Iberreê uberraê garasen: "xezzu n Öebbi i imednas,

ayahs.text: wid iîîeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi, ssaramen t d uâwij, u nekôen laxeôt".
ayahs.translation: wid iîîeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi, ssaramen t d uâwij, u nekôen laxeôt".

ayahs.text: Garasen ssteô. £ef iqacucen, irgazen, ssnen ten akw, ar ûûiffat nnsen. Ad siwlen i at Loennet: "tifrat fellawen"! Ur p keççmen, xas ssarmen.
ayahs.translation: Garasen ssteô. £ef iqacucen, irgazen, ssnen ten akw, ar ûûiffat nnsen. Ad siwlen i at Loennet: "tifrat fellawen"! Ur p keççmen, xas ssarmen.

ayahs.text: Mi zzint wallen nnsen ar at tmes, ad inin: "a Mass nne$! Ur a$ Ppara s agdud imednas"!
ayahs.translation: Mi zzint wallen nnsen ar at tmes, ad inin: "a Mass nne$! Ur a$ Ppara s agdud imednas"!

ayahs.text: Ad siwlen at iqacucen i irgazen, ssnen ten ar ûûiffat nnsen. Ad inin: "acu i wen d issuli wayen tjemâam akked wayen tzuxxem"?
ayahs.translation: Ad siwlen at iqacucen i irgazen, ssnen ten ar ûûiffat nnsen. Ad inin: "acu i wen d issuli wayen tjemâam akked wayen tzuxxem"?

ayahs.text: Day wigi d wid i$ef teggulem, ar ur sen ippak Öebbi aêunu? "Kecmet Loennet, ur teppagwadem, ur t$weblem".
ayahs.translation: Day wigi d wid i$ef teggulem, ar ur sen ippak Öebbi aêunu? "Kecmet Loennet, ur teppagwadem, ur t$weblem".

ayahs.text: At tmes ad siwlen i at Loennet: "smiret ed fellane$ aman, ne$ seg wayen is ikwen I$at Öebbi". Ad inin: "Öebbi, s tidep, Igdel iten i ijehliyen,
ayahs.translation: At tmes ad siwlen i at Loennet: "smiret ed fellane$ aman, ne$ seg wayen is ikwen I$at Öebbi". Ad inin: "Öebbi, s tidep, Igdel iten i ijehliyen,

ayahs.text: wid irran ddin nnsen d zzhu, d urar, u t$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit". Ihi, assa, a ten Neppu, akken ppun timlilit n wass nnsen agi, u nekôen issekniyen nne£.
ayahs.translation: wid irran ddin nnsen d zzhu, d urar, u t$uôô iten tmeddurt n ddunit". Ihi, assa, a ten Neppu, akken ppun timlilit n wass nnsen agi, u nekôen issekniyen nne£.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nusa ten id s Tezmamt, Nfeûûel ip s tussna. D nnhaya, d aêunu i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nusa ten id s Tezmamt, Nfeûûel ip s tussna. D nnhaya, d aêunu i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Day la pôaoun kan veôôu s? Ass n tisin n veôôu s, ad inin wid illan, iu$ lêal, ppun p: "ni$ usan d imazanen n Mass nne$, s tidep. Day nesâa imcafâen ara $ icafâen, ne$ ad a$ rren, a nexdem ayen mgirrden wayen nxeddem"? Ni$ sxeûôen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: Day la pôaoun kan veôôu s? Ass n tisin n veôôu s, ad inin wid illan, iu$ lêal, ppun p: "ni$ usan d imazanen n Mass nne$, s tidep. Day nesâa imcafâen ara $ icafâen, ne$ ad a$ rren, a nexdem ayen mgirrden wayen nxeddem"? Ni$ sxeûôen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: S tidep, Mass nnwen d Öebbi. Ixelq ed tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan, sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Ip$ummu iv s wass, ip$awalen $uôes. Iîij, aggur, akked yitran unzen i lameô iS. Day maççi ineS lxelq akked lameô? D Asaâdi Öebbi, Mass imavalen!
ayahs.translation: S tidep, Mass nnwen d Öebbi. Ixelq ed tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan, sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Ip$ummu iv s wass, ip$awalen $uôes. Iîij, aggur, akked yitran unzen i lameô iS. Day maççi ineS lxelq akked lameô? D Asaâdi Öebbi, Mass imavalen!

ayahs.text: Naâret Mass nnwen, s wannuz, di tbavnit. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.
ayahs.translation: Naâret Mass nnwen, s wannuz, di tbavnit. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara wid izegren tilas.

ayahs.text: Ur ssefsadet di tmurt deffir useêôet is. Naâôet eP, s tugwdi d usirem. Aêunu n Öebbi, s tidep, ar tama n lâuûam.
ayahs.translation: Ur ssefsadet di tmurt deffir useêôet is. Naâôet eP, s tugwdi d usirem. Aêunu n Öebbi, s tidep, ar tama n lâuûam.

ayahs.text: D Neppa id Ippaznen avu, d abecceô s uêunu S. Alamma, ma ibbub ed asigna aéayan, Nenheô it ar tmurt immuten. Nesse$li d syis aman. Nessuffe$ ed yissen yal ppemôa. Akka ay d Nessuffu$ lmeggtin, amendeô ma d tesmektim.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa id Ippaznen avu, d abecceô s uêunu S. Alamma, ma ibbub ed asigna aéayan, Nenheô it ar tmurt immuten. Nesse$li d syis aman. Nessuffe$ ed yissen yal ppemôa. Akka ay d Nessuffu$ lmeggtin, amendeô ma d tesmektim.

ayahs.text: Di tmurt lâali, teff$en d im$an is, ma Irad Öebbi. Di tin icemten, teff$en d kan d iweqweqen. Akka ay Nepbeggin issekniyen i ugdud isnemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Di tmurt lâali, teff$en d im$an is, ma Irad Öebbi. Di tin icemten, teff$en d kan d iweqweqen. Akka ay Nepbeggin issekniyen i ugdud isnemmiren.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê i ugdud is. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi war Neppa. Nek ugade$ fellawen aâaqeb, ass ameqwôaêan".
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê i ugdud is. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi war Neppa. Nek ugade$ fellawen aâaqeb, ass ameqwôaêan".

ayahs.text: Nnan imvebbôen n ugdud is: "$uône$, s tidep, aql ak di ttelfan n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: Nnan imvebbôen n ugdud is: "$uône$, s tidep, aql ak di ttelfan n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ur illi dgi ttelfan. Maca nek d amazan s$uô Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ur illi dgi ttelfan. Maca nek d amazan s$uô Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: Bbwi$ awen d tibratin n Mass iw, a kwen neûêe$. Ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Bbwi$ awen d tibratin n Mass iw, a kwen neûêe$. Ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: Day twehmem mi kwen id iusa usmekti s$uô Mass nnwen, ibbwi t id urgaz segwen, iwakken a kwen inabi, iwakken a pêezzbem, amar fellawen aêunu"?
ayahs.translation: Day twehmem mi kwen id iusa usmekti s$uô Mass nnwen, ibbwi t id urgaz segwen, iwakken a kwen inabi, iwakken a pêezzbem, amar fellawen aêunu"?

ayahs.text: Skaddben t. Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuô. Ne$meq wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Nitni, s tidep, d agdud ader$al.
ayahs.translation: Skaddben t. Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuô. Ne$meq wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Nitni, s tidep, d agdud ader$al.

ayahs.text: Ar Âad, gmat sen Hud. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Day ur tepêezziben ara"?
ayahs.translation: Ar Âad, gmat sen Hud. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Day ur tepêezziben ara"?

ayahs.text: Nnan imvebbôen, wid ijehlen seg ugdud is: "s tidep, $uône$, deg k tisselbi; $uône$, ih, keçç seg wid iskiddiben".
ayahs.translation: Nnan imvebbôen, wid ijehlen seg ugdud is: "s tidep, $uône$, deg k tisselbi; $uône$, ih, keçç seg wid iskiddiben".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ur dgi tisselbi. Maca nek d amazan s$uô Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Ur dgi tisselbi. Maca nek d amazan s$uô Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: Bbwi$ awen d tibratin n Mass iw. Nek, i kunwi, d aneûûaê muman.
ayahs.translation: Bbwi$ awen d tibratin n Mass iw. Nek, i kunwi, d aneûûaê muman.

ayahs.text: Day twehmem mi kwen id iusa usmekti s$uô Mass nnwen, ibbwi t id urgaz segwen, iwakken a kwen inabi. Mmektit ed mi kwen Irra d igensas, deffir ugdud n Nuê. Isem$weô aîas lqedd nnwen. Mmektit ed lxiô n Öebbi, amar a prebêem".
ayahs.translation: Day twehmem mi kwen id iusa usmekti s$uô Mass nnwen, ibbwi t id urgaz segwen, iwakken a kwen inabi. Mmektit ed mi kwen Irra d igensas, deffir ugdud n Nuê. Isem$weô aîas lqedd nnwen. Mmektit ed lxiô n Öebbi, amar a prebêem".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "day a$ d tusiv, iwakken a naâbed Öebbi Yiwen, a neoo ayen llan âabden imezwura nne$? Awi ya$ d ayen is la $ tessagwadev, ma d tidep ay tessawalev".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "day a$ d tusiv, iwakken a naâbed Öebbi Yiwen, a neoo ayen llan âabden imezwura nne$? Awi ya$ d ayen is la $ tessagwadev, ma d tidep ay tessawalev".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ni$ iwwet ikwen id ddell akked zzâaf s$uô Mass nnwen. Day ad iyi namren $ef ismawen i tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen, i wid iwumi ur d Issers Öebbi kra udabu. Ihi, gganit, nek yidwen seg wid ara igganin".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ni$ iwwet ikwen id ddell akked zzâaf s$uô Mass nnwen. Day ad iyi namren $ef ismawen i tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen, i wid iwumi ur d Issers Öebbi kra udabu. Ihi, gganit, nek yidwen seg wid ara igganin".

ayahs.text: Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, s uêunu s$uône£. Nessenger wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, ur nelli d lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, s uêunu s$uône£. Nessenger wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, ur nelli d lmumnin.

ayahs.text: £uô Tamud, gmat sen Üaliê. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi war Neppa. Ni$ iusa kwen id ubeggen s$uô Mass nnwen. Tal$wemt agi n Öebbi, d assekni i kunwi. Ooet ep a ppeçç di tmurt n Öebbi. Ur p îîuôôut, mulac a kwen iêaz uâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: £uô Tamud, gmat sen Üaliê. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi war Neppa. Ni$ iusa kwen id ubeggen s$uô Mass nnwen. Tal$wemt agi n Öebbi, d assekni i kunwi. Ooet ep a ppeçç di tmurt n Öebbi. Ur p îîuôôut, mulac a kwen iêaz uâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Mmektit ed mi kwen Irra d igensas, deffir Âad. Isseqâad ikwen di tmurt, tepparram lebôuj di swaêel, teqqazem ixxamen deg durar. Ihi, mmektit ed lxiô n Öebbi, ur ssexsaôet tamurt, s usefsed".
ayahs.translation: Mmektit ed mi kwen Irra d igensas, deffir Âad. Isseqâad ikwen di tmurt, tepparram lebôuj di swaêel, teqqazem ixxamen deg durar. Ihi, mmektit ed lxiô n Öebbi, ur ssexsaôet tamurt, s usefsed".

ayahs.text: Imvebbôen seg ugdud is, wid isme$awôen iman nnsen, nnan i wuôhifen, wid segsen iumnen: "day teéôam ar ÛüÜaliê d amazan s$uô Mass is"? Nnan: "ih, numen s wayen is id ippuceggaâ".
ayahs.translation: Imvebbôen seg ugdud is, wid isme$awôen iman nnsen, nnan i wuôhifen, wid segsen iumnen: "day teéôam ar ÛüÜaliê d amazan s$uô Mass is"? Nnan: "ih, numen s wayen is id ippuceggaâ".

ayahs.text: Nnan imzuxiyen: "nekwni, s tidep, nenkeô ayen is tumnem".
ayahs.translation: Nnan imzuxiyen: "nekwni, s tidep, nenkeô ayen is tumnem".

ayahs.text: Ëerrfen avaô n tel$wemt, gelzen lameô n Mass nnsen. Nnan: "a Üaliê, awi ya$ d ayen is la $ tessagwadev, ma d amazan ay telliv".
ayahs.translation: Ëerrfen avaô n tel$wemt, gelzen lameô n Mass nnsen. Nnan: "a Üaliê, awi ya$ d ayen is la $ tessagwadev, ma d amazan ay telliv".

ayahs.text: Tewwet iten zzenzla, gwran d, deg ixxamen nnsen, d loeppat.
ayahs.translation: Tewwet iten zzenzla, gwran d, deg ixxamen nnsen, d loeppat.

ayahs.text: Iwexxeô asen, u inna: "a yagdud iw! Ni$ ssawve$ awen d tabôap n Mass iw, neûêe$ kwen, maca ur têemmlem ara win ineûêen".
ayahs.translation: Iwexxeô asen, u inna: "a yagdud iw! Ni$ ssawve$ awen d tabôap n Mass iw, neûêe$ kwen, maca ur têemmlem ara win ineûêen".

ayahs.text: I Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "day a txeddmem lâaô ur ixdim yiwen, uqbel nnwen, deg imavalen?
ayahs.translation: I Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "day a txeddmem lâaô ur ixdim yiwen, uqbel nnwen, deg imavalen?

ayahs.text: Ih, kunwi tpeddum ar irgazen, tcehwam ten, war tilawin. Kunwi, ih, d agdud izegren tilas".
ayahs.translation: Ih, kunwi tpeddum ar irgazen, tcehwam ten, war tilawin. Kunwi, ih, d agdud izegren tilas".

ayahs.text: Tiririt n ugdud is siwa nnan: "ssuff$et pen si temdint nnwen, nitni d imdanen issaramen tezdeg".
ayahs.translation: Tiririt n ugdud is siwa nnan: "ssuff$et pen si temdint nnwen, nitni d imdanen issaramen tezdeg".

ayahs.text: Nsellek it, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is, teqqim akked wid igwran.
ayahs.translation: Nsellek it, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is, teqqim akked wid igwran.

ayahs.text: Nesse$li d fellasen ageffur…Wali amek tevôa d ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: Nesse$li d fellasen ageffur…Wali amek tevôa d ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: £uô Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi war Neppa. Ni$ iusa kwen id ubeggen s$uô Mass nnwen. Ktilet, weznet, s lewqama. Ur îîuôôut medden di cci nnsen, ur ssefsadet di tmurt, deffir useêôet is. I kunwi yif it wayagi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
ayahs.translation: £uô Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi war Neppa. Ni$ iusa kwen id ubeggen s$uô Mass nnwen. Ktilet, weznet, s lewqama. Ur îîuôôut medden di cci nnsen, ur ssefsadet di tmurt, deffir useêôet is. I kunwi yif it wayagi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

ayahs.text: Ur p$imit di yal abrid, tessagwadem u tessefôa$em seg ubrid n Öebbi, wid iumnen yiS. Teb$am t d uâwij. Mmektit ed mi tellam d takwemmict, Iketteô ikwen. Walit amek tevôa taggara ifessaden.

ayahs.translation: Nnan imvebbôen, wid ijehlen, n ugdud is: "ma teddam d Cuâayeb, war ccekk a pxesôem."

ayahs.translation: Tewwet iten zzenzla, gwran d, deg ixxamen nnsen, d loeppat.

ayahs.translation: Wid iskaddben Cuâayeb, u$alen amzun ur zdi$en. Wid iskaddben Cuâayeb, d nitni ay d imexûuôen.

ayahs.text: Iwexxeô asen, u inna: "a yagdud iw! Ni$ ssawve$ awen d tibôatin n Mass iw, neûêe$ kwen. Amek ara $weble$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen"?
ayahs.translation: Iwexxeô asen, u inna: "a yagdud iw! Ni$ ssawve$ awen d tibôatin n Mass iw, neûêe$ kwen. Amek ara $weble$ $ef ugdud ijehliyen"?

ayahs.text: Ur Nuzen ara nnbi ar temdint, mebla ma Newwet imezda$ is s cedda, akked lemveôôa, amar ad êiwten.
ayahs.translation: Ur Nuzen ara nnbi ar temdint, mebla ma Newwet imezda$ is s cedda, akked lemveôôa, amar ad êiwten.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Nerra ise$ deg umkan n tucmip, armi wexxôen, nnan: "ni$ jeôôben imezwura nne$ lemveôôa akked ttrika". Newwet iten deqzalla, nitni ur bnin.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Nerra ise$ deg umkan n tucmip, armi wexxôen, nnan: "ni$ jeôôben imezwura nne$ lemveôôa akked ttrika". Newwet iten deqzalla, nitni ur bnin.

ayahs.text: Lemmer kan uminen u êezzben imezda$ n temdinin, war ccekk, ad asen Nelli lbaôakat seg igenni akked tmurt. Maca, skaddben. Nessemêalleq asen, ilmend n wayen keppben.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer kan uminen u êezzben imezda$ n temdinin, war ccekk, ad asen Nelli lbaôakat seg igenni akked tmurt. Maca, skaddben. Nessemêalleq asen, ilmend n wayen keppben.

ayahs.text: Day $ilen imezda$ n temdinin, ur ten id teppawev tiyta nne£, deg yiv, nitni îîsen?
ayahs.translation: Day $ilen imezda$ n temdinin, ur ten id teppawev tiyta nne£, deg yiv, nitni îîsen?

ayahs.text: Ne$ day $ilen imezda$ n temdinin, ur ten id teppawev tiyta nne£, deg wazal, nitni ppuraren?
ayahs.translation: Ne$ day $ilen imezda$ n temdinin, ur ten id teppawev tiyta nne£, deg wazal, nitni ppuraren?

ayahs.text: Day $ilen sellken i tandit n Öebbi? Siwa agdud i ixesôen, i i$ilen sellken i tandit n Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Day $ilen sellken i tandit n Öebbi? Siwa agdud i ixesôen, i i$ilen sellken i tandit n Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Ne$ day ur d Iban ara, i wid ara iweôten tamurt, deffir imezda$ is, ar, ma ihwa ya£, a ten Newwet $ef ibekkaven nnsen, a Nesle$ ulawen nnsen, d$a nitni ur sellen?
ayahs.translation: Ne$ day ur d Iban ara, i wid ara iweôten tamurt, deffir imezda$ is, ar, ma ihwa ya£, a ten Newwet $ef ibekkaven nnsen, a Nesle$ ulawen nnsen, d$a nitni ur sellen?

ayahs.text: D timdinin agi, i$ef ak Nêekku, si teqûivin nnsent. Ni$ usan $uôsent imazanen nnsent, s ubeggen. Ur llint d tid ara iamnen deg wayen skaddbent uqbel. Akka i Iselle$ Öebbi ulawen ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: D timdinin agi, i$ef ak Nêekku, si teqûivin nnsent. Ni$ usan $uôsent imazanen nnsent, s ubeggen. Ur llint d tid ara iamnen deg wayen skaddbent uqbel. Akka i Iselle$ Öebbi ulawen ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ur Nufi nnesba ar tegwti nnsen. Nufa, tegwti nnsen, d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Ur Nufi nnesba ar tegwti nnsen. Nufa, tegwti nnsen, d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Sinna, deffir sen, Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nne£, ar Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Densen ten. Wali amek tevôa d ifessaden.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, deffir sen, Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nne£, ar Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Densen ten. Wali amek tevôa d ifessaden.

ayahs.text: Inna Musa: "a Ferâun! Nek d amazan s$uô Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Inna Musa: "a Ferâun! Nek d amazan s$uô Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: D ûûeê, ur qqaôe$, $ef Öebbi, siwa tidep. Ih, usi$ kwen id, s ubeggen n Mass nnwen. Ihi, azen yidi At Isôail".
ayahs.translation: D ûûeê, ur qqaôe$, $ef Öebbi, siwa tidep. Ih, usi$ kwen id, s ubeggen n Mass nnwen. Ihi, azen yidi At Isôail".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ma tusiv d s ussekni, zzi t id, ma tessawalav tidep".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ma tusiv d s ussekni, zzi t id, ma tessawalav tidep".

ayahs.text: Iveggeô taâkwazt is, appan d azrem n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Iveggeô taâkwazt is, appan d azrem n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Issuffe$ ed afus is, iban ed d amellal i imnezhen.
ayahs.translation: Issuffe$ ed afus is, iban ed d amellal i imnezhen.

ayahs.text: Nnan d imvebbôen n ugdud n Ferâun: "wagi, s tidep, d aseêêar amusnaw".
ayahs.translation: Nnan d imvebbôen n ugdud n Ferâun: "wagi, s tidep, d aseêêar amusnaw".

ayahs.text: "Ib$a a kwen issuffe$ si tmurt nnwen, d acu t lameô nnwen"?
ayahs.translation: "Ib$a a kwen issuffe$ si tmurt nnwen, d acu t lameô nnwen"?

ayahs.text: Nnan: "anef as, neppa akked gma s. Azen iberraêen ar temdinin,
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "anef as, neppa akked gma s. Azen iberraêen ar temdinin,

ayahs.text: ad ak d awin yal aseêêar amusnaw".
ayahs.translation: ad ak d awin yal aseêêar amusnaw".

ayahs.text: Usan d iseêêaren n Ferâun, nnan: "s tidep, ad a$ tkafiv, ma d nekwni ara i$elben"?
ayahs.translation: Usan d iseêêaren n Ferâun, nnan: "s tidep, ad a$ tkafiv, ma d nekwni ara i$elben"?

ayahs.text: Inna: "ih, u, s tidep, a ppilim d iqôiben".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ih, u, s tidep, a ppilim d iqôiben".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Musa! A pveggôev keçç, ne$ a nveggeô nekwni"?
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Musa! A pveggôev keçç, ne$ a nveggeô nekwni"?

ayahs.text: Inna: "veggôet"! Mi veggôen, sdehcen allen n l$aci, ssagwden ten. Bbwin d ssêur anect ilat.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "veggôet"! Mi veggôen, sdehcen allen n l$aci, ssagwden ten. Bbwin d ssêur anect ilat.

ayahs.text: Nweêêa i Musa: "veggeô taâkwazt ik"! Apan tesseblaâ ayen d ûenâan.
ayahs.translation: Nweêêa i Musa: "veggeô taâkwazt ik"! Apan tesseblaâ ayen d ûenâan.

ayahs.text: Tûaô tidep, inqev wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Tûaô tidep, inqev wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Akka ay pwa$elben. U$alen ar deffir, d unqisen.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay pwa$elben. U$alen ar deffir, d unqisen.

ayahs.text: £lin iseêêaren, knan.
ayahs.translation: £lin iseêêaren, knan.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "numen s Mass imavalen,
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "numen s Mass imavalen,

ayahs.text: Mass n Musa akked Haôun".
ayahs.translation: Mass n Musa akked Haôun".

ayahs.translation: Inna Ferâun: "day tumnem yis, uqbel ma âammde$ awen? Ayagi, war ccekk, d tifxep. Tundim p di temdint, iwakken a ppessuff$em, segs, imezda$ is. Ihi, deqqal a ppeéôem.

ayahs.text: War ccekk, ad awen gezme$ afus ssya, avaô ssya. Sinna, ih, a kwen semmôe$ akw $ef imudag".
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, ad awen gezme$ afus ssya, avaô ssya. Sinna, ih, a kwen semmôe$ akw $ef imudag".

ayahs.translation: Nnan: "nekwni a nu$al ar Mass nne$.

ayahs.translation: Terriv d ppaô segne$, imi kan numen s issekniyen n Mass nne$, mi $ d usan. A Mass nne$! Azen a$ d ûûbeô, Ddem leôwaê nne$ d imvuâen".

ayahs.text: Imvebbôen n ugdud n Ferâun, nnan: "day a ppeooev Musa akked ugdud is, ad ssefsaden di tmurt, a kwen ooen, keçç akked iôebbiten ik"? Inna: "a nene$ arrac nnsen, a nessider tilawin nnsen. Nekwni, sennig sen, d iqehhaôen".
ayahs.translation: Imvebbôen n ugdud n Ferâun, nnan: "day a ppeooev Musa akked ugdud is, ad ssefsaden di tmurt, a kwen ooen, keçç akked iôebbiten ik"? Inna: "a nene$ arrac nnsen, a nessider tilawin nnsen. Nekwni, sennig sen, d iqehhaôen".

ayahs.translation: Inna Musa i ugdud is: "ppret afus n Öebbi, u ûebôet. Tamurt, war ccekk, n Öebbi. A p iwôet win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Taggara i wid ipêezziben".

ayahs.translation: Nnan: "njaf uqbel a $ d tasev, u deffir tisin ik". Inna: "amar Mass nnwen ad Ine$ acengu nnwen, a kwen Irr d igensas di tmurt, ad Iwali amek ara txedmem".

ayahs.text: Newwet, d$a, lois n Ferâun s iseggwasen n llaé, akked nneqs n ppemôa, amar a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Newwet, d$a, lois n Ferâun s iseggwasen n llaé, akked nneqs n ppemôa, amar a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: Ma iusa ten id ise$, ad inin: "nne$ wagi". Ma tusa ten id tucmip, a p sbibben i Musa akked wid illan yides. Ayen iveôôun yidsen, day maççi ar Öebbi kan? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Ma iusa ten id ise$, ad inin: "nne$ wagi". Ma tusa ten id tucmip, a p sbibben i Musa akked wid illan yides. Ayen iveôôun yidsen, day maççi ar Öebbi kan? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.

ayahs.translation: Nnan: " wicqa assekni ara d tawiv, ur a$ tepseêêirev yis. Nekwni, ur neppamen yisek".

ayahs.translation: Nuzen asen aêemmal, ajôad, tilkin, imqweôqwôen, idammen, d issekniyen ifeûlen. Sme$wôen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.translation: Mi tevôa yidsen twa$it, qqaôen: "a Musa! Nâaô Mass ik i nekwni, s wayen i k Iâahed. Ma tekksev a$ tawa$it, a namen yisek, a nazen yidek At Isôail".

ayahs.translation: Mi sen Nekkes tawa$it, ar lajel iten iggunin, atnan nitni xedâan.

ayahs.translation: Nerra d segsen ppaô, N$emq iten deg ill, imi skaddben issekniyen nne£, ur d celâen degsen.

ayahs.text: Nessewôet i ugdud i illan qehôen t, igmav akked ituram n tmurt, i Neôqa. Itam wawal ûûam n Mass ik, $ef At Isôail, ilmend n wayen ûebôen. Nhudd ayen iûennaâ Ferâun akked ugdud is, u wayen bennun.
ayahs.translation: Nessewôet i ugdud i illan qehôen t, igmav akked ituram n tmurt, i Neôqa. Itam wawal ûûam n Mass ik, $ef At Isôail, ilmend n wayen ûebôen. Nhudd ayen iûennaâ Ferâun akked ugdud is, u wayen bennun.

ayahs.translation: Nesâadda ill i At Isôail. Mmugren d agdud i iâabden tiâancuôin is. Nnan: "a Musa! Err ane$ ôebbi am iôebbiten nnsen". Inna: "kunwi, s tidep, d agdud ur nessin.

ayahs.translation: Wigi, s tidep, ad inger wayen ideg llan, ad inqev wayen xeddmen".

ayahs.translation: Inna: "day awen budde$ ôebbi, war Öebbi, u Neppa Ismenyaf ikwen $ef imavalen"?

ayahs.text: Mi kwen Nsellek si lois n Ferâun, sukken fellawen aâaqeb uqsiê mavi; neqqen arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Deg waya, ajeôôeb s$uô Mass nnwen ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Mi kwen Nsellek si lois n Ferâun, sukken fellawen aâaqeb uqsiê mavi; neqqen arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Deg waya, ajeôôeb s$uô Mass nnwen ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Nemlal akked Musa kravet wavan, Nerna yasen mraw. Tebbwev tallit n Mass is, kuzet wavan. Inna Musa i gma s Haôun: "enûef iyi ar ugdud iw, exdem ayen ilhan, ur teddu d ubrid ifessaden".
ayahs.translation: Nemlal akked Musa kravet wavan, Nerna yasen mraw. Tebbwev tallit n Mass is, kuzet wavan. Inna Musa i gma s Haôun: "enûef iyi ar ugdud iw, exdem ayen ilhan, ur teddu d ubrid ifessaden".

ayahs.translation: Mi d iusa Musa ar temlilit nne£, u Immeslay as Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Ssenâat iyi d, a K wali$". Inna d: "ur iyI tepwaliv, d awez$i, maca muqel s adrar. ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Musa! Aql I Smenyafe$ k $ef imdanen, i tebôatin iW, i wawal iW. Ddem ayen i k d Fki$, ili seg wid isnemmiren".

ayahs.text: Nura yas, di tlewêin, si yal cci, anabi akked ufeûûel n yal cci. Ddem itent s tezmert, ameô i ugdud ik a tent iîîef s lmaâna nnsent. Ad awen Ssekne$ tanezdu$t iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Nura yas, di tlewêin, si yal cci, anabi akked ufeûûel n yal cci. Ddem itent s tezmert, ameô i ugdud ik a tent iîîef s lmaâna nnsent. Ad awen Ssekne$ tanezdu$t iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Ad Veôôfe$, seg issekniyen iW, wid isme$wôen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. Mi walan yal assekni, ur ppamnen yis. Ma walan abrid uûwib, ur teddun degs. Ma walan abrid n le$wlav, a t awin. Ayagi, acku, s tidep, skaddben issekniyen nne£, ur d celâen degsen.
ayahs.translation: Ad Veôôfe$, seg issekniyen iW, wid isme$wôen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. Mi walan yal assekni, ur ppamnen yis. Ma walan abrid uûwib, ur teddun degs. Ma walan abrid n le$wlav, a t awin. Ayagi, acku, s tidep, skaddben issekniyen nne£, ur d celâen degsen.

ayahs.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, akked temlilit n laxeôt, ur swin igiten nnsen. Day a ten kafin $ef wayen ur nelli d ayen xeddmen?

ayahs.text: Agdud n Musa, deffir es, isbedd, s ôôêuê is, aâjmi bu loeppa isrugmuten. Day ur walan ara ar, s tidep, ur asen d ipmeslay, ur la ten inehhu s abrid? Âabden t, llan d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Agdud n Musa, deffir es, isbedd, s ôôêuê is, aâjmi bu loeppa isrugmuten. Day ur walan ara ar, s tidep, ur asen d ipmeslay, ur la ten inehhu s abrid? Âabden t, llan d imednas.

Iveggeô tilewêin, iîîef gma s seg uqeôôu, ijebt it id $uôes. Inna d: "a mmi s n yimma, s tidep, iêqeô iyi ugdud, qôib iyi n$an. Ur ssefôaê icenga yissi. Ur iyi pparra seg ugdud imednas".
ayahs.translation: Mi d iu$al Musa ar ugdud is, s wurrif akked lêemûa, inna: "ay d ucmit wayen is iyi tneûfem, deffir iw! Teb$am a d i$iwwel lameô n Mass nnwen"? Iveggeô tilewêin, iîîef gma s seg uqeôôu, ijebt it id $uôes. Inna d: "a mmi s n yimma, s tidep, iêqeô iyi ugdud, qôib iyi n$an. Ur ssefôaê icenga yissi. Ur iyi pparra seg ugdud imednas".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Semmeê ane$, nek akked gma, Ssekcem a$ ar uêunu K. Keçç, Tifev akw wid ipêunun".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Semmeê ane$, nek akked gma, Ssekcem a$ ar uêunu K. Keçç, Tifev akw wid ipêunun".

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iâabden aâajmi, a d i$li fellasen wurrif n Mass nnsen, ad ndellen di tmeddurt n ddunit. Akka ay Nepqeîîi wid id isnulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iâabden aâajmi, a d i$li fellasen wurrif n Mass nnsen, ad ndellen di tmeddurt n ddunit. Akka ay Nepqeîîi wid id isnulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Wid ixedmen tucmitin, sinna, steôoâen deffir sent, u umnen, Mass ik, s tidep, deffir sent, ar Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Wid ixedmen tucmitin, sinna, steôoâen deffir sent, u umnen, Mass ik, s tidep, deffir sent, ar Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Mi irs wurrif is, iddem ed Musa tilewêin. Di tira nnsent, nnhaya akked uêunu i wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Mi irs wurrif is, iddem ed Musa tilewêin. Di tira nnsent, nnhaya akked uêunu i wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ifren ed Musa ûatet irgazen seg ugdud is, ad mlilen yidne£. Mi ten tewwet zzenzla, inna: "a Mass iw! Lemmer i K ihwi, yili, iu$ lêal, Ten$iv ten, u Tegliv yissi. Day ad a$ Temêuv, ilmend n wayen xedmen ije$lufen segne$? Wagi d ahewwel iK kan, Tettellifev syis win i K ihwan, Tnehhuv win i K ihwan. Keçç d Bab nne$, Semmeê a$, Ëun fella$, Keçç Tifev akw wid ipsemmiêen.
ayahs.translation: Ifren ed Musa ûatet irgazen seg ugdud is, ad mlilen yidne£. Mi ten tewwet zzenzla, inna: "a Mass iw! Lemmer i K ihwi, yili, iu$ lêal, Ten$iv ten, u Tegliv yissi. Day ad a$ Temêuv, ilmend n wayen xedmen ije$lufen segne$? Wagi d ahewwel iK kan, Tettellifev syis win i K ihwan, Tnehhuv win i K ihwan. Keçç d Bab nne$, Semmeê a$, Ëun fella$, Keçç Tifev akw wid ipsemmiêen.

ayahs.text: Aru ya$ ise$ di ddunit, di laxeôt; aql a$ nu$al ed $uôeK". Inna d: "aâaqeb iW, a t Sâaddi$ $ef win iyI ihwan. Aêunu W ijemmel yal cci. A t Aru$ i wid ipêezziben, ipzekkin, akked wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£,
ayahs.translation: Aru ya$ ise$ di ddunit, di laxeôt; aql a$ nu$al ed $uôeK". Inna d: "aâaqeb iW, a t Sâaddi$ $ef win iyI ihwan. Aêunu W ijemmel yal cci. A t Aru$ i wid ipêezziben, ipzekkin, akked wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£,

ayahs.text: wid iteddun d Umazan, Nnbi ur ne$ôi, i ufan iura $uôsen di Tuôa akked Linoil". Iumeô asen d lqanun, Itekkes asen ayen n dir. Iêell asen lâali, igdel asen dduni. Ikkes asen aruz akked lqid nnsen. Ihi, wid iumnen yis, i t iâawnen, i t isellken, iddan d tafat id irsen yides, widak d imerbaê.
ayahs.translation: wid iteddun d Umazan, Nnbi ur ne$ôi, i ufan iura $uôsen di Tuôa akked Linoil". Iumeô asen d lqanun, Itekkes asen ayen n dir. Iêell asen lâali, igdel asen dduni. Ikkes asen aruz akked lqid nnsen. Ihi, wid iumnen yis, i t iâawnen, i t isellken, iddan d tafat id irsen yides, widak d imerbaê.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yimdanen! Nek d Amazan n Öebbi $uôwen meôôa. Neppa, ineS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Issidir, Ineqq". Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Nnbi ur ne$ôi, i iumnen s Öebbi akked wawal iS. Ddut yides, amar a ppepwanhum.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen! Nek d Amazan n Öebbi $uôwen meôôa. Neppa, ineS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Issidir, Ineqq". Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Nnbi ur ne$ôi, i iumnen s Öebbi akked wawal iS. Ddut yides, amar a ppepwanhum.

ayahs.text: Deg ugdud n Musa, arbaâ iteddu s tidep. U syis ay pêuddun.
ayahs.translation: Deg ugdud n Musa, arbaâ iteddu s tidep. U syis ay pêuddun.

ayahs.text: Nessemfaôaq iten $ef mrawsin laâôac, n leoyus. Mi s issuter ugdud is tissit, Nweêêa i Musa: ewwet aéôu s tâakwaz ik. F$ent ed segs mrawsnat tliwa; akka, yal amdan iéôa anda ara issew. Nesbur iten s usigna, Nessers asen d lmenna akked ifeôôuoen: "eççet seg wayen ilhan, is ikwen N$at". Ur a£ dnisen, maca la ddennisen iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Nessemfaôaq iten $ef mrawsin laâôac, n leoyus. Mi s issuter ugdud is tissit, Nweêêa i Musa: ewwet aéôu s tâakwaz ik. F$ent ed segs mrawsnat tliwa; akka, yal amdan iéôa anda ara issew. Nesbur iten s usigna, Nessers asen d lmenna akked ifeôôuoen: "eççet seg wayen ilhan, is ikwen N$at". Ur a£ dnisen, maca la ddennisen iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Mi pwanecden: "zed$et di temdint agi, eççet segs, ayen i wen ihwan, init: "laâfu"! Âaddit di tebburt, s lekni. Ad awen Nsemmeê tuccva nnwen. A Nernu i lâuûam".
ayahs.translation: Mi pwanecden: "zed$et di temdint agi, eççet segs, ayen i wen ihwan, init: "laâfu"! Âaddit di tebburt, s lekni. Ad awen Nsemmeê tuccva nnwen. A Nernu i lâuûam".

ayahs.text: Wid idensen segsen, neûfen awalen s wid ur nelli d wid i sen nnan. Nuzen asen tiyta seg igenni, ilmend n wayen ddennisen.
ayahs.translation: Wid idensen segsen, neûfen awalen s wid ur nelli d wid i sen nnan. Nuzen asen tiyta seg igenni, ilmend n wayen ddennisen.

ayahs.text: Steqsi ten $ef temdint i illan $ef rrif n yill, mi ur d rzin di ssebt, mi ten id usan iselman nnsen, walan ten, ass n ssebt. Ass, war ssebt, ur ten id ppasen. Akka ay ten Njeôôeb, deg wayen ssexsaôen.
ayahs.translation: Steqsi ten $ef temdint i illan $ef rrif n yill, mi ur d rzin di ssebt, mi ten id usan iselman nnsen, walan ten, ass n ssebt. Ass, war ssebt, ur ten id ppasen. Akka ay ten Njeôôeb, deg wayen ssexsaôen.

ayahs.text: Mi d inna lois, segsen: "iwumi la tepnabim agdud ara Isqucc Öebbi, ne$ ara Iâaqeb s leqseê"? Nnan: "d aste$feô ar Mass nnwen, amar ad êezzben".
ayahs.translation: Mi d inna lois, segsen: "iwumi la tepnabim agdud ara Isqucc Öebbi, ne$ ara Iâaqeb s leqseê"? Nnan: "d aste$feô ar Mass nnwen, amar ad êezzben".

ayahs.text: Mi ppun ayen i$ef pwafekkôen, Nsellek wid itekksen ayen n dir, Nesâadda aâaqeb adiran $ef imednas, ilmend n wayen ssexsaôen.
ayahs.translation: Mi ppun ayen i$ef pwafekkôen, Nsellek wid itekksen ayen n dir, Nesâadda aâaqeb adiran $ef imednas, ilmend n wayen ssexsaôen.

ayahs.text: Mi sme$wôen iman nnsen $ef wayen i sen ipwakksen, Nenna yasen: "ilit d uddawen ucmiten"!
ayahs.translation: Mi sme$wôen iman nnsen $ef wayen i sen ipwakksen, Nenna yasen: "ilit d uddawen ucmiten"!

ayahs.text: Mi Ixebbeô Mass ik, ard asen d Iazen ara ten iâaqben, s ééuô, alamma d ass n tnekra. Mass ik, s tidep, Ip$awal ar uâaqeb. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Mi Ixebbeô Mass ik, ard asen d Iazen ara ten iâaqben, s ééuô, alamma d ass n tnekra. Mass ik, s tidep, Ip$awal ar uâaqeb. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Nessemfaôaq iten di tmurt, d leoyus, garasen wid imaânen, garasen wid ur nemâin. Njeôôeb iten s ise$iyen akked tucmitin, amar a d u$alen s abrid.
ayahs.translation: Nessemfaôaq iten di tmurt, d leoyus, garasen wid imaânen, garasen wid ur nemâin. Njeôôeb iten s ise$iyen akked tucmitin, amar a d u$alen s abrid.

ayahs.text: Neûfen ten, deffir sen, ineûûafen i iweôten Tazmamt. Ppaddamen lerbaê n ddunit, qqaôen: "ad a$ semmêen". Ma rnan usan ten id lerbaê, am widen, a ten ddmen. Day ur âahden ara s Tezmamt, ard tidep kan, ara inin $ef Öebbi? U lemden i illan degs. Ppif axxam aneggaru, i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tfehmem ara?
ayahs.translation: Neûfen ten, deffir sen, ineûûafen i iweôten Tazmamt. Ppaddamen lerbaê n ddunit, qqaôen: "ad a$ semmêen". Ma rnan usan ten id lerbaê, am widen, a ten ddmen. Day ur âahden ara s Tezmamt, ard tidep kan, ara inin $ef Öebbi? U lemden i illan degs. Ppif axxam aneggaru, i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tfehmem ara?

ayahs.text: Wid iîîfen di Tezmamt, ipéallan, s tidep, ur Nveggiâ arraz n lâuûam.
ayahs.translation: Wid iîîfen di Tezmamt, ipéallan, s tidep, ur Nveggiâ arraz n lâuûam.

ayahs.text: Mi Nessuli adrar sennig sen, amzun d tili, $ilen, s tidep, ara d i$li fellasen. Ïîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, smektit ed ayen illan degs, amar a pêezzbem.
ayahs.translation: Mi Nessuli adrar sennig sen, amzun d tili, $ilen, s tidep, ara d i$li fellasen. Ïîfet nezzeh ayen i wen Nefka, smektit ed ayen illan degs, amar a pêezzbem.

ayahs.text: Mi d Iddem Mass ik, si tgeééal n tarwa n Adem, dderya nnsen, Inna yasen a d cehhden $ef yiman nnsen: "day ur Lli$ ara d Mass nnwen"? Nnan: "ih, ncehhed". Akka ur d teqqaôem ara, ass n tnekra: "s tidep, ayagi d ayen ur neéôi".
