ayahs.translation: Mi d Iddem Mass ik, si tgeééal n tarwa n Adem, dderya nnsen, Inna yasen a d cehhden $ef yiman nnsen: "day ur Lli$ ara d Mass nnwen"? Nnan: "ih, ncehhed". Akka ur d teqqaôem ara, ass n tnekra: "s tidep, ayagi d ayen ur neéôi".

ayahs.text: Ne$ a d tinim: "d imezwura nne$ kan i icurken, zik. Nekwni d tarwa deffir sen. Day a$ Ten$ev, ilmend n wayen xedmen wid iôejjnen"?
ayahs.translation: Ne$ a d tinim: "d imezwura nne$ kan i icurken, zik. Nekwni d tarwa deffir sen. Day a$ Ten$ev, ilmend n wayen xedmen wid iôejjnen"?

ayahs.text: Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen, amar a d u$alen s abrid.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen, amar a d u$alen s abrid.

ayahs.text: Eêku yasen d tadyant n win iwumi Nefka issekniyen nne£. Irra ten akin. Idda yides Cciîan, iu$al seg wid i$eôqen.
ayahs.translation: Eêku yasen d tadyant n win iwumi Nefka issekniyen nne£. Irra ten akin. Idda yides Cciîan, iu$al seg wid i$eôqen.

ayahs.text: Lemmer i £ ihwi, Nessuli t yissen. Maca, ib$a tamurt, idda d lhawiyya s. Ihi, amedya s am win n waydi, ma teddiv p fellas, ad ilehhet, ma teooiv t, ad ilehhet. D wagi ay d amedya n ugdud i iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Eêku d tadyant, amar a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i £ ihwi, Nessuli t yissen. Maca, ib$a tamurt, idda d lhawiyya s. Ihi, amedya s am win n waydi, ma teddiv p fellas, ad ilehhet, ma teooiv t, ad ilehhet. D wagi ay d amedya n ugdud i iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Eêku d tadyant, amar a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: Agdud iskaddben issekniyen nne£, d yir amedya. Pddennisen iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Agdud iskaddben issekniyen nne£, d yir amedya. Pddennisen iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Win Inha Öebbi, ihi, idda d ubrid. Wid Itlef Öebbi, nitni d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Win Inha Öebbi, ihi, idda d ubrid. Wid Itlef Öebbi, nitni d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Neswejd ed, i Loahennama, aîas n leonun akked yimdanen. Sâan ulawen, ur fehhmen yissen; sâan allen, ur pwalin yissent; sâan imeééu$en, ur sellen yissen. Nitni am lmal, ne$ nnetlafen kteô. Wigi d i$wefliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Neswejd ed, i Loahennama, aîas n leonun akked yimdanen. Sâan ulawen, ur fehhmen yissen; sâan allen, ur pwalin yissent; sâan imeééu$en, ur sellen yissen. Nitni am lmal, ne$ nnetlafen kteô. Wigi d i$wefliyen.

ayahs.text: I Öebbi, ismawen ûûam. Naâôet eP, yissen. Veôôfet seg wid issexsaôen ismawen iS. Ad ppuqeîîin $ef wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: I Öebbi, ismawen ûûam. Naâôet eP, yissen. Veôôfet seg wid issexsaôen ismawen iS. Ad ppuqeîîin $ef wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Deg wayen Nexleq, yiwen n lois ivfeô tidep. Ipêuddu syis.
ayahs.translation: Deg wayen Nexleq, yiwen n lois ivfeô tidep. Ipêuddu syis.

ayahs.text: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, a ten Nawi, cwiî, cwiî, ar wanda ur éôin.
ayahs.translation: Wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£, a ten Nawi, cwiî, cwiî, ar wanda ur éôin.

ayahs.text: Ad asen Fke$ lmudda. Ih, ticeôkep iW d tunûiêt.
ayahs.translation: Ad asen Fke$ lmudda. Ih, ticeôkep iW d tunûiêt.

ayahs.text: Day ur d tepmeyyizem ara? Ur illi umeddakwel nnwen d aôehbani. Neppa, d aneddaô kan ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Day ur d tepmeyyizem ara? Ur illi umeddakwel nnwen d aôehbani. Neppa, d aneddaô kan ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen Ixleq Öebbi n cci? Ni$, ahat, iqeôb ed lajel nnsen. Anwa awal, deffir wagi, ar amnen?
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen Ixleq Öebbi n cci? Ni$, ahat, iqeôb ed lajel nnsen. Anwa awal, deffir wagi, ar amnen?

ayahs.text: Win Itlef Öebbi, ur Isâi nnahi. A ten Ioo ad hemlen di tjehli nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Win Itlef Öebbi, ur Isâi nnahi. A ten Ioo ad hemlen di tjehli nnsen.

ayahs.text: A k steqsayen $ef yimir, melmi ara d yili. Ini: "i t Iéôan siwa Mass iw. D Neppa kan a t id Isseknen, di lweqt is. Ad iaéay di tmurt akked igenwan. Ur kwen id ippawev siwa deqzalla". A k steqsayen amzun tesâiv asali fellas. Ini: "i t Issnen siwa ÔÖebbi", maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: A k steqsayen $ef yimir, melmi ara d yili. Ini: "i t Iéôan siwa Mass iw. D Neppa kan a t id Isseknen, di lweqt is. Ad iaéay di tmurt akked igenwan. Ur kwen id ippawev siwa deqzalla". A k steqsayen amzun tesâiv asali fellas. Ini: "i t Issnen siwa ÔÖebbi", maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur ksibe$ i iman iw, aba$uô ne$ vveôô, kkes ed ayen Irad Öebbi. Lemmer ssine$ tabavnit, ad ôwu$ lxiô, ur iyi ipnal ixmiô. Nek d aneddaô kan, u d abcir, i ugdud iumnen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur ksibe$ i iman iw, aba$uô ne$ vveôô, kkes ed ayen Irad Öebbi. Lemmer ssine$ tabavnit, ad ôwu$ lxiô, ur iyi ipnal ixmiô. Nek d aneddaô kan, u d abcir, i ugdud iumnen".

ayahs.text: D Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiwen n yiman. Iddem ed segs tameîîut is, ad izde$ yides. Mi insa yides, tebbwi tadist tafessast; telêa yis. Mi d teûbeê ééayet, naâôen Öebbi: "a Mass nne$! Ma Tefkiv a$ d aâeôvi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".
ayahs.translation: D Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen si yiwen n yiman. Iddem ed segs tameîîut is, ad izde$ yides. Mi insa yides, tebbwi tadist tafessast; telêa yis. Mi d teûbeê ééayet, naâôen Öebbi: "a Mass nne$! Ma Tefkiv a$ d aâeôvi, war ccekk, a nili seg wid isnemmiren".

ayahs.text: Mi sen d Ifka aâeôdi, rran aS icriken s wayen i sen d Ifka. I aâlay Öebbi, sennig wayen pcaraken!
ayahs.translation: Mi sen d Ifka aâeôdi, rran aS icriken s wayen i sen d Ifka. I aâlay Öebbi, sennig wayen pcaraken!

ayahs.text: Day ad carken ayen ur nexliq acemma, u d nitni i ipwaxelqen?
ayahs.translation: Day ad carken ayen ur nexliq acemma, u d nitni i ipwaxelqen?

ayahs.text: Ur zmiren a ten âiwnen, ne$ ad âiwnen iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ur zmiren a ten âiwnen, ne$ ad âiwnen iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur teddun yidwen. Iâuva fellawen ma tnecdem ten, ne$ ma tessusmem.
ayahs.translation: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur teddun yidwen. Iâuva fellawen ma tnecdem ten, ne$ ma tessusmem.

ayahs.text: S tidep, wigi tnaâôem, war Öebbi, d imdanen am kunwi. Naâret pen, ma ad awen d rren, maday tessawalem tidep.
ayahs.translation: S tidep, wigi tnaâôem, war Öebbi, d imdanen am kunwi. Naâret pen, ma ad awen d rren, maday tessawalem tidep.

ayahs.text: Day sâan ivaôen, ad lêun fellasen, ne$ sâan ifassen, ad ddmen yissen, ne$ sâan allen, ad walin yisent, ne$ sâan imeééu$en, ad slen yissen. Ini: "naâret icriken nnwen, sinna, andit iyi. Ur iyi sganayet".
ayahs.translation: Day sâan ivaôen, ad lêun fellasen, ne$ sâan ifassen, ad ddmen yissen, ne$ sâan allen, ad walin yisent, ne$ sâan imeééu$en, ad slen yissen. Ini: "naâret icriken nnwen, sinna, andit iyi. Ur iyi sganayet".

ayahs.text: Ih, Bab iw d Öebbi id Issersen Tazmamt, i Iêemmlen lâuûam.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Bab iw d Öebbi id Issersen Tazmamt, i Iêemmlen lâuûam.

ayahs.text: Wid tnaâôem, war Neppa, ur zmiren a kwen âawnen, ne$ ad âawnen iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Wid tnaâôem, war Neppa, ur zmiren a kwen âawnen, ne$ ad âawnen iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur sellen. A ten twaliv a k id pmuqulen, nitni ur pwalin.
ayahs.translation: Ma tnecdem ten ar nnhaya, ur sellen. A ten twaliv a k id pmuqulen, nitni ur pwalin.

ayahs.text: Ddem ayen ilhan, ameô ar lewqama, veôôef i wid ur nessin.
ayahs.translation: Ddem ayen ilhan, ameô ar lewqama, veôôef i wid ur nessin.

ayahs.text: Ma ilaâj ik Cciîan ar dduni, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ma ilaâj ik Cciîan ar dduni, ppkel $ef Öebbi. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ipêezziben, ma innul iten urbaâ n ccwaîen, a d mmektin, d$a ad asen llint wallen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ipêezziben, ma innul iten urbaâ n ccwaîen, a d mmektin, d$a ad asen llint wallen.

ayahs.text: Zgan $elîen atmaten nnsen, d$a nitni ur xevvun.
ayahs.translation: Zgan $elîen atmaten nnsen, d$a nitni ur xevvun.

ayahs.text: Ma ur asen d tebbwiv ara assekni, ad ak inin: "acimi ur t id isnulfa ara"? Ini: "teddu$ kan d wayen iyi d ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass iw". Wagi, s$uô Mass nnwen, d tafat, d nnhaya, d aêunu, i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Ma ur asen d tebbwiv ara assekni, ad ak inin: "acimi ur t id isnulfa ara"? Ini: "teddu$ kan d wayen iyi d ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass iw". Wagi, s$uô Mass nnwen, d tafat, d nnhaya, d aêunu, i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Ma qqaôen Leqwôan ssemêesset as, ssusmet, amar fellawen aêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ma qqaôen Leqwôan ssemêesset as, ssusmet, amar fellawen aêunu.

ayahs.text: Mmekti d Mass ik, deg iman ik, s wannuz akked lxuf, s wawal irsen, taûebêit, tameddit. Ur ppili seg i$wefliyen.
ayahs.translation: Mmekti d Mass ik, deg iman ik, s wannuz akked lxuf, s wawal irsen, taûebêit, tameddit. Ur ppili seg i$wefliyen.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid illan ar Mass ik, ur sme$wôen ara iman nnsen, $ef uâbad iS. Sbuccuâen T, i Neppa kennun.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid illan ar Mass ik, ur sme$wôen ara iman nnsen, $ef uâbad iS. Sbuccuâen T, i Neppa kennun.

verses.text: Steqsan k $ef rrbeê. Ini: "rrbeê i Öebbi akked Umazan. Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, elhut garawen, a$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
verses.translation: Steqsan k $ef rrbeê. Ini: "rrbeê i Öebbi akked Umazan. Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, elhut garawen, a$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".

verses.text: Lmumnin d wid kan iwumi ippergigi wul nnsen, ma Ipwabder ed Öebbi. Ma $ôan asen issekniyen iS, ad innerni liman nnsen. £ef Mass nnsen, ay ppeklen.
verses.translation: Lmumnin d wid kan iwumi ippergigi wul nnsen, ma Ipwabder ed Öebbi. Ma $ôan asen issekniyen iS, ad innerni liman nnsen. £ef Mass nnsen, ay ppeklen.

verses.text: Wid ibedden i téallit, ipûeôôifen seg wayen is iten N$at.
verses.translation: Wid ibedden i téallit, ipûeôôifen seg wayen is iten N$at.

verses.text: Wigi d ûûeê, d lmumnin. I nitni, ar Mass nnsen, tiseddaôin, ssmaê, akked l$it uùkyis.
verses.translation: Wigi d ûûeê, d lmumnin. I nitni, ar Mass nnsen, tiseddaôin, ssmaê, akked l$it uùkyis.

verses.text: Akken ik id Issuffe$ Mass ik, seg uxxam ik, s tidep, wanag ur ib$i urbaâ si lmumnin.
verses.translation: Akken ik id Issuffe$ Mass ik, seg uxxam ik, s tidep, wanag ur ib$i urbaâ si lmumnin.

verses.text: La k pnamaren $ef tidep, deffir ubeggen is, amzun kan pwanehôen ar tmeppant, nitni pêekkiôen.
verses.translation: La k pnamaren $ef tidep, deffir ubeggen is, amzun kan pwanehôen ar tmeppant, nitni pêekkiôen.

verses.text: Mi wen Iâahed Öebbi, ara ppili nnwen, yiwet si snat n trebbuyaâ, tessarmem a ppili nnwen tin ur nepwaselleê. Öebbi Ib$a a d itebbet tidep s wawalen iS, ad ôéen wakali ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Mi wen Iâahed Öebbi, ara ppili nnwen, yiwet si snat n trebbuyaâ, tessarmem a ppili nnwen tin ur nepwaselleê. Öebbi Ib$a a d itebbet tidep s wawalen iS, ad ôéen wakali ijehliyen.

verses.text: A ppili tidep, ad inqev lbaîel, xas ugin ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: A ppili tidep, ad inqev lbaîel, xas ugin ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Mi tepprem afus s$uô Mass nnwen, Ijaweb awen d: "Nek ad awen Fke$ agim lmalayek, mestebâant".
verses.translation: Mi tepprem afus s$uô Mass nnwen, Ijaweb awen d: "Nek ad awen Fke$ agim lmalayek, mestebâant".

verses.text: Irra t kan Öebbi d abecceô iwakken ad nnevmanen yis wulawen nnwen. Ur illi l$elb, siwa s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Irra t kan Öebbi d abecceô iwakken ad nnevmanen yis wulawen nnwen. Ur illi l$elb, siwa s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Mi kwen I$umm s yives, d îîmana s$uôeS; Isse$li d fellawen aman seg igenni; a kwen Izzizdeg yissen, ad Issebâad, fellawen, a$way n Cciîan, ad Isseohed ulawen nnwen, ad Itebbet, yissen, isurifen.
verses.translation: Mi kwen I$umm s yives, d îîmana s$uôeS; Isse$li d fellawen aman seg igenni; a kwen Izzizdeg yissen, ad Issebâad, fellawen, a$way n Cciîan, ad Isseohed ulawen nnwen, ad Itebbet, yissen, isurifen.

verses.text: Mi Iweêêa Mass ik i lmalayek: "Nek yidkwent; tebbtemt wid iumnen. Ad Skecme$ tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen. Ewwtemt sennig tmegrav, ewwtemt ar ixfawen ivudan".
verses.translation: Mi Iweêêa Mass ik i lmalayek: "Nek yidkwent; tebbtemt wid iumnen. Ad Skecme$ tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen. Ewwtemt sennig tmegrav, ewwtemt ar ixfawen ivudan".

verses.text: Ayagi, acku nitni, s tidep, xuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS. I win ixuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ihi, Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.
verses.translation: Ayagi, acku nitni, s tidep, xuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS. I win ixuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ihi, Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.

verses.text: Wagi i kunwi, jeôôbet ep! U i ijehliyen, aâaqeb n tmes.
verses.translation: Wagi i kunwi, jeôôbet ep! U i ijehliyen, aâaqeb n tmes.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d wid ijehlen la d éeddmen, ur sen reggwlet.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d wid ijehlen la d éeddmen, ur sen reggwlet.

verses.text: Win i sen irewlen, assen, siwa ma la issewjad i umennu$, ne$ ma ikcem s arbaâ, winna, a t immager wurrif n Öebbi; axxam is d Loahennama, a yir tu$alin!
verses.translation: Win i sen irewlen, assen, siwa ma la issewjad i umennu$, ne$ ma ikcem s arbaâ, winna, a t immager wurrif n Öebbi; axxam is d Loahennama, a yir tu$alin!

verses.text: Ur ten tennu$em, maca d Öebbi iten Innu$en. Ur teôoimev mi tôeomev, maca Öebbi Iôoem, iwakken ad Ijeôôeb lmumnin s ujeôôeb umâin s$uôeS. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ur ten tennu$em, maca d Öebbi iten Innu$en. Ur teôoimev mi tôeomev, maca Öebbi Iôoem, iwakken ad Ijeôôeb lmumnin s ujeôôeb umâin s$uôeS. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Akka, Ih, Öebbi Issadar ticeôkep ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Akka, Ih, Öebbi Issadar ticeôkep ijehliyen.

verses.text: Tessutrem l$elb, atan iusa kwen id. Ma tfukkem, ppif i kunwi. Ma tu$alem, a Nu$al. Ula iwumi tent, bippa, trebbuyaâ nnwen, xas îîuqtent. Ih, Öebbi Idda d lmumnin.
verses.translation: Tessutrem l$elb, atan iusa kwen id. Ma tfukkem, ppif i kunwi. Ma tu$alem, a Nu$al. Ula iwumi tent, bippa, trebbuyaâ nnwen, xas îîuqtent. Ih, Öebbi Idda d lmumnin.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur T ppaooat, u kunwi tsellem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur T ppaooat, u kunwi tsellem.

verses.text: Ur ppilit am wid innan: "nesla", nitni ur sellen.
verses.translation: Ur ppilit am wid innan: "nesla", nitni ur sellen.

verses.text: £eô Öebbi, s tidep, ineggura imexlaq d iâeééugen, d igugam, ur nfehhem.
verses.translation: £eô Öebbi, s tidep, ineggura imexlaq d iâeééugen, d igugam, ur nfehhem.

verses.text: Lemmer Iéôi Öebbi degsen lxiô, yili Irra ten sellen. Ma Irra ten sellen, war ccekk, ad akwren avaô, u nitni aâûan.
verses.translation: Lemmer Iéôi Öebbi degsen lxiô, yili Irra ten sellen. Ma Irra ten sellen, war ccekk, ad akwren avaô, u nitni aâûan.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Jawbet i Öebbi akked Umazan, ma Inced ikwen ar wayen ikwen issidiren. Cfut ar Öebbi Ippili ger umdan akked wul is. £uôeS, Neppa, s tidep, ara tepwafessrem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Jawbet i Öebbi akked Umazan, ma Inced ikwen ar wayen ikwen issidiren. Cfut ar Öebbi Ippili ger umdan akked wul is. £uôeS, Neppa, s tidep, ara tepwafessrem.

verses.text: Ëezzbet i uhewwel. Ur ipêaz ara kan imednas segwen, weêêedsen. Cfut ar Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.
verses.translation: Ëezzbet i uhewwel. Ur ipêaz ara kan imednas segwen, weêêedsen. Cfut ar Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.

verses.text: Mmektit ed mi, kunwi, drus ay tellam, d uôhifen di tmurt, teppagwadem a kwen xevfen medden. Iûûeô ikwen, Isellek ikwen s l$elb iS, I$at ikwen s wayen ilhan, amender ma a ppesnemmrem.
verses.translation: Mmektit ed mi, kunwi, drus ay tellam, d uôhifen di tmurt, teppagwadem a kwen xevfen medden. Iûûeô ikwen, Isellek ikwen s l$elb iS, I$at ikwen s wayen ilhan, amender ma a ppesnemmrem.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pxeyyinet Öebbi akked Umazan, ur pxeyyinet lamanat nnwen, kunwi teéôam.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pxeyyinet Öebbi akked Umazan, ur pxeyyinet lamanat nnwen, kunwi teéôam.

verses.text: Cfut ar, ayla nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d ahewwel kan, u ar £uô Öebbi, ôôaîeb ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Cfut ar, ayla nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d ahewwel kan, u ar £uô Öebbi, ôôaîeb ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ma têezzbem i Öebbi, ad awen Ifk afraz, ad awen Imêu tucmitin nnwen, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma têezzbem i Öebbi, ad awen Ifk afraz, ad awen Imêu tucmitin nnwen, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Ma ppandin ak, wid ijehlen, iwakken a k êebsen, ne$ a k n$en, ne$ a k ssuff$en; ppandin u Öebbi Ippandi. Öebbi Yif akw imendayen.
verses.translation: Ma ppandin ak, wid ijehlen, iwakken a k êebsen, ne$ a k n$en, ne$ a k ssuff$en; ppandin u Öebbi Ippandi. Öebbi Yif akw imendayen.

verses.text: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£, ad inin: "ih, nesla. Ma ihwa ya$ a d nini am ayagi. Ayagi, s tidep, siwa d timucuha imezwura".
verses.translation: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£, ad inin: "ih, nesla. Ma ihwa ya$ a d nini am ayagi. Ayagi, s tidep, siwa d timucuha imezwura".

verses.text: Mi nnan: "a Öebbi, ma illa wagi d tidep s$uôeK, Sse$li d, fella$, id$a$en seg igenni, ne$ Awi a$ d aâaqeb aqeôêan".
verses.translation: Mi nnan: "a Öebbi, ma illa wagi d tidep s$uôeK, Sse$li d, fella$, id$a$en seg igenni, ne$ Awi a$ d aâaqeb aqeôêan".

verses.text: Ur illi Öebbi d win ara ten Iâaqben, skud telliv garasen. Ur Illi Öebbi d win ara Ipâaqben ma nitni la suturen ssmaê.
verses.translation: Ur illi Öebbi d win ara ten Iâaqben, skud telliv garasen. Ur Illi Öebbi d win ara Ipâaqben ma nitni la suturen ssmaê.

verses.text: Acimi ur ten Ipâaqab ara Öebbi, u nitni swexxiôen si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ur llin d imawlan is. Imawlan is, d wid kan ipêezziben. Maca, tegwti segsen ur éôin.
verses.translation: Acimi ur ten Ipâaqab ara Öebbi, u nitni swexxiôen si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ur llin d imawlan is. Imawlan is, d wid kan ipêezziben. Maca, tegwti segsen ur éôin.

verses.text: Taéallit nnsen deg Uxxam, siwa aseffeô akked llir. Jeôôbet aâaqeb, $ef wayen tjehhlem.
verses.translation: Taéallit nnsen deg Uxxam, siwa aseffeô akked llir. Jeôôbet aâaqeb, $ef wayen tjehhlem.

verses.text: Ih, wid ijehlen pûeôôifen ayla nnsen, iwakken ad veôôfen seg ubrid n Öebbi. A t ûeôôfen, ad asen iu$al d lexsaôa. Sinna, ad ppu$elben. Wid ijehlen ad pwafessren di Loahennama.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen pûeôôifen ayla nnsen, iwakken ad veôôfen seg ubrid n Öebbi. A t ûeôôfen, ad asen iu$al d lexsaôa. Sinna, ad ppu$elben. Wid ijehlen ad pwafessren di Loahennama.

verses.text: Iwakken ad Ifrez Öebbi dduni d lâali, ad Irr ixabiten, wa $ef wa, a ten Izdi akw, a ten Irr ar Loahennama. Widak d imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Iwakken ad Ifrez Öebbi dduni d lâali, ad Irr ixabiten, wa $ef wa, a ten Izdi akw, a ten Irr ar Loahennama. Widak d imexsuôen.

verses.text: Ini i wid ijehlen: "ma fukken, ad awen Isemmeê ayen iâaddan; ma u$alen, ihi, akken tevôa d imezwura".
verses.translation: Ini i wid ijehlen: "ma fukken, ad awen Isemmeê ayen iâaddan; ma u$alen, ihi, akken tevôa d imezwura".

verses.text: Nna$et pen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iu$al ddin s lekmal is, i Öebbi. Ma êebsen, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ay xeddmen.
verses.translation: Nna$et pen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iu$al ddin s lekmal is, i Öebbi. Ma êebsen, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ay xeddmen.

verses.text: Ma wexxôen, cfut ar Öebbi d Bab nnwen, Bab amxalef, Asellak amxalef.
verses.translation: Ma wexxôen, cfut ar Öebbi d Bab nnwen, Bab amxalef, Asellak amxalef.

verses.text: Akken ib$u yili wayen id t$eltem n cci, cfut amur wis smus n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked llzem, igujilen, ime$ban, win d ibbwi ubrid; ma illa tumnem s Öebbi akked wayen id Nessers i umdan nne£, ass n ufraz, ass ideg mlalent snat n trebbuyaâ. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Akken ib$u yili wayen id t$eltem n cci, cfut amur wis smus n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked llzem, igujilen, ime$ban, win d ibbwi ubrid; ma illa tumnem s Öebbi akked wayen id Nessers i umdan nne£, ass n ufraz, ass ideg mlalent snat n trebbuyaâ. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Mi tellam di loiha taqôibt, u nitni agwemmav, imnayen seddawat wen, xas temyefkem ppaâud, tzeglem timlilit. Maca, iwakken ad Isâaddi Öebbi lameô ara iâaddin, ad immet win immuten, s ubeggen, ad yidir win idren, s ubeggen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Mi tellam di loiha taqôibt, u nitni agwemmav, imnayen seddawat wen, xas temyefkem ppaâud, tzeglem timlilit. Maca, iwakken ad Isâaddi Öebbi lameô ara iâaddin, ad immet win immuten, s ubeggen, ad yidir win idren, s ubeggen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Mi k ten id Issenâat Öebbi, d takwemmict, di targit ik ... Lemmer ik ten id Issenâat qwan, war ccekk, a pfeclem, a ppemnamarem $ef lameô. Maca, Öebbi Ijbeô ikwen. Ih, Neppa Issen i illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Mi k ten id Issenâat Öebbi, d takwemmict, di targit ik ... Lemmer ik ten id Issenâat qwan, war ccekk, a pfeclem, a ppemnamarem $ef lameô. Maca, Öebbi Ijbeô ikwen. Ih, Neppa Issen i illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: Mi wen ten Issenâat, mi ten temmugrem, twalam ten d takwemmict. Iééeméi kwen ar tmu$li nnsen, iwakken ad Isâaddi Öebbi lameô ara iâaddin. Ar Öebbi ppu$alen lumuô.
verses.translation: Mi wen ten Issenâat, mi ten temmugrem, twalam ten d takwemmict. Iééeméi kwen ar tmu$li nnsen, iwakken ad Isâaddi Öebbi lameô ara iâaddin. Ar Öebbi ppu$alen lumuô.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d arbaâ, tebbtet, mmektit ed aîas Öebbi, amar a prebêem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d arbaâ, tebbtet, mmektit ed aîas Öebbi, amar a prebêem.

verses.text: A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur ppemnamaret. Mulac a pfeclem, a pnegfem. Üebôet! S tidep, Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.
verses.translation: A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur ppemnamaret. Mulac a pfeclem, a pnegfem. Üebôet! S tidep, Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.

verses.text: Ur ppilit am wid id iff$en s tem$weô, seg ixxamen nnsen, iwakken a ten id walin medden. Swexxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Öebbi Izzi i wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ur ppilit am wid id iff$en s tem$weô, seg ixxamen nnsen, iwakken a ten id walin medden. Swexxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Öebbi Izzi i wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Mi sen icebbeê Cciîan igiten nnsen, u inna: "ur kwen i$elleb yiwen seg imdanen, ass agi. Nek d amalal nnwen". Mi mwalant snat trebbuyaâ, iuker avaô, inna: "nek xvi$ kwen, nek wala$ ayen ur twalam, nek ugade$ Öebbi. Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb".
verses.translation: Mi sen icebbeê Cciîan igiten nnsen, u inna: "ur kwen i$elleb yiwen seg imdanen, ass agi. Nek d amalal nnwen". Mi mwalant snat trebbuyaâ, iuker avaô, inna: "nek xvi$ kwen, nek wala$ ayen ur twalam, nek ugade$ Öebbi. Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb".

verses.text: Mi nnan ixabiten akked imehzulen n wul: "wigi, i$uôô iten ddin nnsen". Win ippeklen $ef Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Mi nnan ixabiten akked imehzulen n wul: "wigi, i$uôô iten ddin nnsen". Win ippeklen $ef Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Lemmer a pwaliv mara ddment lmalayek leôwaê n wid ijehlen, ad kkatent udmawen nnsen, izugar nnsen. "Jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt!
verses.translation: Lemmer a pwaliv mara ddment lmalayek leôwaê n wid ijehlen, ad kkatent udmawen nnsen, izugar nnsen. "Jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt!

verses.text: Ayagi ilmend n wayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen", u Öebbi ur pdennis imdanen.
verses.translation: Ayagi ilmend n wayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen", u Öebbi ur pdennis imdanen.

verses.text: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi. Issemêaleq asen Öebbi s ibekkaven nnsen. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, Iqseê deg uâaqeb.
verses.translation: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi. Issemêaleq asen Öebbi s ibekkaven nnsen. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, Iqseê deg uâaqeb.

verses.text: Akka, acku Öebbi ur Ipbeddil l$it is I$at agdud, alamma bedlen i illan deg iman nnsen. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Akka, acku Öebbi ur Ipbeddil l$it is I$at agdud, alamma bedlen i illan deg iman nnsen. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen n Mass nnsen. Nen$a ten s ibekkaven nnsen, Ne$meq agdud n Ferâun; llan akw d imednas.
verses.translation: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen n Mass nnsen. Nen$a ten s ibekkaven nnsen, Ne$meq agdud n Ferâun; llan akw d imednas.

verses.text: £uô Öebbi, imexlaq ucmiten mavi, d wid ijehlen, d$a ur uminen,
verses.translation: £uô Öebbi, imexlaq ucmiten mavi, d wid ijehlen, d$a ur uminen,

verses.text: wid ukud tgiv lemâahda, sinna, di yal tikelt, neqven lemâahda nnsen, u nitni ur pêezziben.
verses.translation: wid ukud tgiv lemâahda, sinna, di yal tikelt, neqven lemâahda nnsen, u nitni ur pêezziben.

verses.text: Ma tugarev ten di îôad, sserwel yissen wid i ten id ivefôen, amar a d mmektin.
verses.translation: Ma tugarev ten di îôad, sserwel yissen wid i ten id ivefôen, amar a d mmektin.

verses.text: Ma tugadev lexdaâ seg ugdud, err iten akin, s tezdeg. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara ixeddaâen.
verses.translation: Ma tugadev lexdaâ seg ugdud, err iten akin, s tezdeg. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara ixeddaâen.

verses.text: Ur p$ilin menâan, wid ijehlen. Nitni, s tidep, ur zmiren.
verses.translation: Ur p$ilin menâan, wid ijehlen. Nitni, s tidep, ur zmiren.

verses.text: Heggit asen d ayen iwumi tzemrem n lemêella akked yimnayen, a ppessagwdem yissen acengu n Öebbi, acengu nnwen, akked wiyav, war segsen, ur tessinem; Öebbi Issen iten. Ayen tseddqem n cci, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad awen d iu$al. Kunwi ur tepwadensem.
verses.translation: Heggit asen d ayen iwumi tzemrem n lemêella akked yimnayen, a ppessagwdem yissen acengu n Öebbi, acengu nnwen, akked wiyav, war segsen, ur tessinem; Öebbi Issen iten. Ayen tseddqem n cci, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad awen d iu$al. Kunwi ur tepwadensem.

verses.text: Ma nudan talwit, nadi ep. Ppkel $ef Öebbi. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ma nudan talwit, nadi ep. Ppkel $ef Öebbi. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ma b$an a k xedâan, ihi, âammed $ef Öebbi, Neppa i k Ifkan afus s tallalt iS, akked lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ma b$an a k xedâan, ihi, âammed $ef Öebbi, Neppa i k Ifkan afus s tallalt iS, akked lmumnin.

verses.text: Issemlal ulawen nnsen. Lemmer a pûeôfev i illan akw di tmurt, ur tessemliliv ulawen nnsen. Maca, Öebbi Issemlal iten. Neppa, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Issemlal ulawen nnsen. Lemmer a pûeôfev i illan akw di tmurt, ur tessemliliv ulawen nnsen. Maca, Öebbi Issemlal iten. Neppa, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Âammed $ef Öebbi, keçç, akked wid iddan yidek si lmumnin.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Âammed $ef Öebbi, keçç, akked wid iddan yidek si lmumnin.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Eg lêir i lmumnin, ad nna$en. Ma llan segwen warem iûebôiyen, ad rnun snat twinas. Ma llan segwen twinas, ad rnun agim n wid ijehlen, acku, nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Eg lêir i lmumnin, ad nna$en. Ma llan segwen warem iûebôiyen, ad rnun snat twinas. Ma llan segwen twinas, ad rnun agim n wid ijehlen, acku, nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.

verses.text: Tura, Issafes Öebbi fellawen. Iéôa tella garawen rrehma. Ihi, ma llan segwen twinas iûebôiyen, ad rnun snat twinas, ma llan segwen agim, ad rnun sin igima, ma Irad Öebbi. Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.
verses.translation: Tura, Issafes Öebbi fellawen. Iéôa tella garawen rrehma. Ihi, ma llan segwen twinas iûebôiyen, ad rnun snat twinas, ma llan segwen agim, ad rnun sin igima, ma Irad Öebbi. Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.

verses.text: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi ad isâu imeêbas, alamma pwa$elben di tmurt. Teb$am tukci n ddunit. Öebbi Ib$a laxeôt. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi ad isâu imeêbas, alamma pwa$elben di tmurt. Teb$am tukci n ddunit. Öebbi Ib$a laxeôt. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Lemmer maççi d ayen iuran s$uô Öebbi, izwar ed, yili a kwen iwwet uâaqeb abarar, ilmend n wayen tebbwim.
verses.translation: Lemmer maççi d ayen iuran s$uô Öebbi, izwar ed, yili a kwen iwwet uâaqeb abarar, ilmend n wayen tebbwim.

verses.text: Eççet ayen ilhan, iêellen, seg wayen i t$elltem, êezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Eççet ayen ilhan, iêellen, seg wayen i t$elltem, êezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Ini i wid teîîfem seg imeêbas: "ma Iufa Öebbi lxiô deg ulawen nnwen, ad awen Ifk ayen yifen ayen i wen ipwakksen, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Ini i wid teîîfem seg imeêbas: "ma Iufa Öebbi lxiô deg ulawen nnwen, ad awen Ifk ayen yifen ayen i wen ipwakksen, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

verses.text: Ma b$an a k xedâan, ni$ iu$ lêal xedâen Öebbi. D$a, Ikkes asen ôôay. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ma b$an a k xedâan, ni$ iu$ lêal xedâen Öebbi. D$a, Ikkes asen ôôay. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ih, wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden s wayla nnsen, akked yiman nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Wid iumnen ur unagen, ur awen llin d imeddukwal, s wacemma, alamma unagen. Ma ppren afus nnwen di ddin, iwata yawen ad asen tefkem afus, siwa mgal agdud ukud tâaqdem. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden s wayla nnsen, akked yiman nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Wid iumnen ur unagen, ur awen llin d imeddukwal, s wacemma, alamma unagen. Ma ppren afus nnwen di ddin, iwata yawen ad asen tefkem afus, siwa mgal agdud ukud tâaqdem. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Wid ijehlen d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Ma ur tgim ara akka, a ppili lfetna di tmurt, akked usefsed ameqwôan.
verses.translation: Wid ijehlen d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Ma ur tgim ara akka, a ppili lfetna di tmurt, akked usefsed ameqwôan.

verses.text: Wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak, s tidep, d lmumnin. I nitni ssmaê akked l$it ukyis.
verses.translation: Wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak, s tidep, d lmumnin. I nitni ssmaê akked l$it ukyis.

verses.text: Wid iumnen syin $er da, u unagen, u juhden yidwen, widak segwen. Llzem ppemyilin kteô di Tezmamt n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Izôa yal cci.
verses.translation: Wid iumnen syin $er da, u unagen, u juhden yidwen, widak segwen. Llzem ppemyilin kteô di Tezmamt n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Izôa yal cci.

ayahs.text: Steqsan k $ef rrbeê. Ini: "rrbeê i Öebbi akked Umazan. Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, elhut garawen, a$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".
ayahs.translation: Steqsan k $ef rrbeê. Ini: "rrbeê i Öebbi akked Umazan. Ihi, êezzbet i Öebbi, elhut garawen, a$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ma d lmumnin ay tellam".

ayahs.text: Lmumnin d wid kan iwumi ippergigi wul nnsen, ma Ipwabder ed Öebbi. Ma $ôan asen issekniyen iS, ad innerni liman nnsen. £ef Mass nnsen, ay ppeklen.
ayahs.translation: Lmumnin d wid kan iwumi ippergigi wul nnsen, ma Ipwabder ed Öebbi. Ma $ôan asen issekniyen iS, ad innerni liman nnsen. £ef Mass nnsen, ay ppeklen.

ayahs.text: Wid ibedden i téallit, ipûeôôifen seg wayen is iten N$at.
ayahs.translation: Wid ibedden i téallit, ipûeôôifen seg wayen is iten N$at.

ayahs.text: Wigi d ûûeê, d lmumnin. I nitni, ar Mass nnsen, tiseddaôin, ssmaê, akked l$it uùkyis.
ayahs.translation: Wigi d ûûeê, d lmumnin. I nitni, ar Mass nnsen, tiseddaôin, ssmaê, akked l$it uùkyis.

ayahs.text: Akken ik id Issuffe$ Mass ik, seg uxxam ik, s tidep, wanag ur ib$i urbaâ si lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Akken ik id Issuffe$ Mass ik, seg uxxam ik, s tidep, wanag ur ib$i urbaâ si lmumnin.

ayahs.text: La k pnamaren $ef tidep, deffir ubeggen is, amzun kan pwanehôen ar tmeppant, nitni pêekkiôen.
ayahs.translation: La k pnamaren $ef tidep, deffir ubeggen is, amzun kan pwanehôen ar tmeppant, nitni pêekkiôen.

ayahs.text: Mi wen Iâahed Öebbi, ara ppili nnwen, yiwet si snat n trebbuyaâ, tessarmem a ppili nnwen tin ur nepwaselleê. Öebbi Ib$a a d itebbet tidep s wawalen iS, ad ôéen wakali ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Mi wen Iâahed Öebbi, ara ppili nnwen, yiwet si snat n trebbuyaâ, tessarmem a ppili nnwen tin ur nepwaselleê. Öebbi Ib$a a d itebbet tidep s wawalen iS, ad ôéen wakali ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: A ppili tidep, ad inqev lbaîel, xas ugin ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: A ppili tidep, ad inqev lbaîel, xas ugin ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: Mi tepprem afus s$uô Mass nnwen, Ijaweb awen d: "Nek ad awen Fke$ agim lmalayek, mestebâant".
ayahs.translation: Mi tepprem afus s$uô Mass nnwen, Ijaweb awen d: "Nek ad awen Fke$ agim lmalayek, mestebâant".

ayahs.text: Irra t kan Öebbi d abecceô iwakken ad nnevmanen yis wulawen nnwen. Ur illi l$elb, siwa s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Irra t kan Öebbi d abecceô iwakken ad nnevmanen yis wulawen nnwen. Ur illi l$elb, siwa s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Mi kwen I$umm s yives, d îîmana s$uôeS; Isse$li d fellawen aman seg igenni; a kwen Izzizdeg yissen, ad Issebâad, fellawen, a$way n Cciîan, ad Isseohed ulawen nnwen, ad Itebbet, yissen, isurifen.
ayahs.translation: Mi kwen I$umm s yives, d îîmana s$uôeS; Isse$li d fellawen aman seg igenni; a kwen Izzizdeg yissen, ad Issebâad, fellawen, a$way n Cciîan, ad Isseohed ulawen nnwen, ad Itebbet, yissen, isurifen.

ayahs.text: Mi Iweêêa Mass ik i lmalayek: "Nek yidkwent; tebbtemt wid iumnen. Ad Skecme$ tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen. Ewwtemt sennig tmegrav, ewwtemt ar ixfawen ivudan".
ayahs.translation: Mi Iweêêa Mass ik i lmalayek: "Nek yidkwent; tebbtemt wid iumnen. Ad Skecme$ tugdi deg ulawen n wid ijehlen. Ewwtemt sennig tmegrav, ewwtemt ar ixfawen ivudan".

ayahs.text: Ayagi, acku nitni, s tidep, xuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS. I win ixuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ihi, Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, acku nitni, s tidep, xuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS. I win ixuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ihi, Öebbi Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Wagi i kunwi, jeôôbet ep! U i ijehliyen, aâaqeb n tmes.
ayahs.translation: Wagi i kunwi, jeôôbet ep! U i ijehliyen, aâaqeb n tmes.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d wid ijehlen la d éeddmen, ur sen reggwlet.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d wid ijehlen la d éeddmen, ur sen reggwlet.

ayahs.text: Win i sen irewlen, assen, siwa ma la issewjad i umennu$, ne$ ma ikcem s arbaâ, winna, a t immager wurrif n Öebbi; axxam is d Loahennama, a yir tu$alin!
ayahs.translation: Win i sen irewlen, assen, siwa ma la issewjad i umennu$, ne$ ma ikcem s arbaâ, winna, a t immager wurrif n Öebbi; axxam is d Loahennama, a yir tu$alin!

ayahs.text: Ur ten tennu$em, maca d Öebbi iten Innu$en. Ur teôoimev mi tôeomev, maca Öebbi Iôoem, iwakken ad Ijeôôeb lmumnin s ujeôôeb umâin s$uôeS. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ur ten tennu$em, maca d Öebbi iten Innu$en. Ur teôoimev mi tôeomev, maca Öebbi Iôoem, iwakken ad Ijeôôeb lmumnin s ujeôôeb umâin s$uôeS. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Akka, Ih, Öebbi Issadar ticeôkep ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Akka, Ih, Öebbi Issadar ticeôkep ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Tessutrem l$elb, atan iusa kwen id. Ma tfukkem, ppif i kunwi. Ma tu$alem, a Nu$al. Ula iwumi tent, bippa, trebbuyaâ nnwen, xas îîuqtent. Ih, Öebbi Idda d lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Tessutrem l$elb, atan iusa kwen id. Ma tfukkem, ppif i kunwi. Ma tu$alem, a Nu$al. Ula iwumi tent, bippa, trebbuyaâ nnwen, xas îîuqtent. Ih, Öebbi Idda d lmumnin.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur T ppaooat, u kunwi tsellem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur T ppaooat, u kunwi tsellem.

ayahs.text: Ur ppilit am wid innan: "nesla", nitni ur sellen.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppilit am wid innan: "nesla", nitni ur sellen.

ayahs.text: £eô Öebbi, s tidep, ineggura imexlaq d iâeééugen, d igugam, ur nfehhem.
ayahs.translation: £eô Öebbi, s tidep, ineggura imexlaq d iâeééugen, d igugam, ur nfehhem.

ayahs.text: Lemmer Iéôi Öebbi degsen lxiô, yili Irra ten sellen. Ma Irra ten sellen, war ccekk, ad akwren avaô, u nitni aâûan.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer Iéôi Öebbi degsen lxiô, yili Irra ten sellen. Ma Irra ten sellen, war ccekk, ad akwren avaô, u nitni aâûan.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Jawbet i Öebbi akked Umazan, ma Inced ikwen ar wayen ikwen issidiren. Cfut ar Öebbi Ippili ger umdan akked wul is. £uôeS, Neppa, s tidep, ara tepwafessrem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Jawbet i Öebbi akked Umazan, ma Inced ikwen ar wayen ikwen issidiren. Cfut ar Öebbi Ippili ger umdan akked wul is. £uôeS, Neppa, s tidep, ara tepwafessrem.

ayahs.text: Ëezzbet i uhewwel. Ur ipêaz ara kan imednas segwen, weêêedsen. Cfut ar Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: Ëezzbet i uhewwel. Ur ipêaz ara kan imednas segwen, weêêedsen. Cfut ar Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Mmektit ed mi, kunwi, drus ay tellam, d uôhifen di tmurt, teppagwadem a kwen xevfen medden. Iûûeô ikwen, Isellek ikwen s l$elb iS, I$at ikwen s wayen ilhan, amender ma a ppesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: Mmektit ed mi, kunwi, drus ay tellam, d uôhifen di tmurt, teppagwadem a kwen xevfen medden. Iûûeô ikwen, Isellek ikwen s l$elb iS, I$at ikwen s wayen ilhan, amender ma a ppesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pxeyyinet Öebbi akked Umazan, ur pxeyyinet lamanat nnwen, kunwi teéôam.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pxeyyinet Öebbi akked Umazan, ur pxeyyinet lamanat nnwen, kunwi teéôam.

ayahs.text: Cfut ar, ayla nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d ahewwel kan, u ar £uô Öebbi, ôôaîeb ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Cfut ar, ayla nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d ahewwel kan, u ar £uô Öebbi, ôôaîeb ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ma têezzbem i Öebbi, ad awen Ifk afraz, ad awen Imêu tucmitin nnwen, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma têezzbem i Öebbi, ad awen Ifk afraz, ad awen Imêu tucmitin nnwen, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi d Bab n lfevl ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Ma ppandin ak, wid ijehlen, iwakken a k êebsen, ne$ a k n$en, ne$ a k ssuff$en; ppandin u Öebbi Ippandi. Öebbi Yif akw imendayen.
ayahs.translation: Ma ppandin ak, wid ijehlen, iwakken a k êebsen, ne$ a k n$en, ne$ a k ssuff$en; ppandin u Öebbi Ippandi. Öebbi Yif akw imendayen.

ayahs.text: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£, ad inin: "ih, nesla. Ma ihwa ya$ a d nini am ayagi. Ayagi, s tidep, siwa d timucuha imezwura".
ayahs.translation: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£, ad inin: "ih, nesla. Ma ihwa ya$ a d nini am ayagi. Ayagi, s tidep, siwa d timucuha imezwura".

ayahs.text: Mi nnan: "a Öebbi, ma illa wagi d tidep s$uôeK, Sse$li d, fella$, id$a$en seg igenni, ne$ Awi a$ d aâaqeb aqeôêan".
ayahs.translation: Mi nnan: "a Öebbi, ma illa wagi d tidep s$uôeK, Sse$li d, fella$, id$a$en seg igenni, ne$ Awi a$ d aâaqeb aqeôêan".

ayahs.text: Ur illi Öebbi d win ara ten Iâaqben, skud telliv garasen. Ur Illi Öebbi d win ara Ipâaqben ma nitni la suturen ssmaê.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi Öebbi d win ara ten Iâaqben, skud telliv garasen. Ur Illi Öebbi d win ara Ipâaqben ma nitni la suturen ssmaê.

ayahs.text: Acimi ur ten Ipâaqab ara Öebbi, u nitni swexxiôen si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ur llin d imawlan is. Imawlan is, d wid kan ipêezziben. Maca, tegwti segsen ur éôin.
ayahs.translation: Acimi ur ten Ipâaqab ara Öebbi, u nitni swexxiôen si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ur llin d imawlan is. Imawlan is, d wid kan ipêezziben. Maca, tegwti segsen ur éôin.

ayahs.text: Taéallit nnsen deg Uxxam, siwa aseffeô akked llir. Jeôôbet aâaqeb, $ef wayen tjehhlem.
ayahs.translation: Taéallit nnsen deg Uxxam, siwa aseffeô akked llir. Jeôôbet aâaqeb, $ef wayen tjehhlem.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen pûeôôifen ayla nnsen, iwakken ad veôôfen seg ubrid n Öebbi. A t ûeôôfen, ad asen iu$al d lexsaôa. Sinna, ad ppu$elben. Wid ijehlen ad pwafessren di Loahennama.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen pûeôôifen ayla nnsen, iwakken ad veôôfen seg ubrid n Öebbi. A t ûeôôfen, ad asen iu$al d lexsaôa. Sinna, ad ppu$elben. Wid ijehlen ad pwafessren di Loahennama.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad Ifrez Öebbi dduni d lâali, ad Irr ixabiten, wa $ef wa, a ten Izdi akw, a ten Irr ar Loahennama. Widak d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad Ifrez Öebbi dduni d lâali, ad Irr ixabiten, wa $ef wa, a ten Izdi akw, a ten Irr ar Loahennama. Widak d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Ini i wid ijehlen: "ma fukken, ad awen Isemmeê ayen iâaddan; ma u$alen, ihi, akken tevôa d imezwura".
ayahs.translation: Ini i wid ijehlen: "ma fukken, ad awen Isemmeê ayen iâaddan; ma u$alen, ihi, akken tevôa d imezwura".

ayahs.text: Nna$et pen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iu$al ddin s lekmal is, i Öebbi. Ma êebsen, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ay xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Nna$et pen alamma tfukk lfetna, u iu$al ddin s lekmal is, i Öebbi. Ma êebsen, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipwali ay xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ma wexxôen, cfut ar Öebbi d Bab nnwen, Bab amxalef, Asellak amxalef.
ayahs.translation: Ma wexxôen, cfut ar Öebbi d Bab nnwen, Bab amxalef, Asellak amxalef.

ayahs.text: Akken ib$u yili wayen id t$eltem n cci, cfut amur wis smus n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked llzem, igujilen, ime$ban, win d ibbwi ubrid; ma illa tumnem s Öebbi akked wayen id Nessers i umdan nne£, ass n ufraz, ass ideg mlalent snat n trebbuyaâ. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Akken ib$u yili wayen id t$eltem n cci, cfut amur wis smus n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked llzem, igujilen, ime$ban, win d ibbwi ubrid; ma illa tumnem s Öebbi akked wayen id Nessers i umdan nne£, ass n ufraz, ass ideg mlalent snat n trebbuyaâ. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Mi tellam di loiha taqôibt, u nitni agwemmav, imnayen seddawat wen, xas temyefkem ppaâud, tzeglem timlilit. Maca, iwakken ad Isâaddi Öebbi lameô ara iâaddin, ad immet win immuten, s ubeggen, ad yidir win idren, s ubeggen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Mi tellam di loiha taqôibt, u nitni agwemmav, imnayen seddawat wen, xas temyefkem ppaâud, tzeglem timlilit. Maca, iwakken ad Isâaddi Öebbi lameô ara iâaddin, ad immet win immuten, s ubeggen, ad yidir win idren, s ubeggen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Mi k ten id Issenâat Öebbi, d takwemmict, di targit ik ... Lemmer ik ten id Issenâat qwan, war ccekk, a pfeclem, a ppemnamarem $ef lameô. Maca, Öebbi Ijbeô ikwen. Ih, Neppa Issen i illan deg idmaren.
ayahs.translation: Mi k ten id Issenâat Öebbi, d takwemmict, di targit ik ... Lemmer ik ten id Issenâat qwan, war ccekk, a pfeclem, a ppemnamarem $ef lameô. Maca, Öebbi Ijbeô ikwen. Ih, Neppa Issen i illan deg idmaren.

ayahs.text: Mi wen ten Issenâat, mi ten temmugrem, twalam ten d takwemmict. Iééeméi kwen ar tmu$li nnsen, iwakken ad Isâaddi Öebbi lameô ara iâaddin. Ar Öebbi ppu$alen lumuô.
ayahs.translation: Mi wen ten Issenâat, mi ten temmugrem, twalam ten d takwemmict. Iééeméi kwen ar tmu$li nnsen, iwakken ad Isâaddi Öebbi lameô ara iâaddin. Ar Öebbi ppu$alen lumuô.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d arbaâ, tebbtet, mmektit ed aîas Öebbi, amar a prebêem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma temmugrem d arbaâ, tebbtet, mmektit ed aîas Öebbi, amar a prebêem.

ayahs.text: A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur ppemnamaret. Mulac a pfeclem, a pnegfem. Üebôet! S tidep, Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.
ayahs.translation: A$et awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur ppemnamaret. Mulac a pfeclem, a pnegfem. Üebôet! S tidep, Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.

ayahs.text: Ur ppilit am wid id iff$en s tem$weô, seg ixxamen nnsen, iwakken a ten id walin medden. Swexxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Öebbi Izzi i wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppilit am wid id iff$en s tem$weô, seg ixxamen nnsen, iwakken a ten id walin medden. Swexxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Öebbi Izzi i wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Mi sen icebbeê Cciîan igiten nnsen, u inna: "ur kwen i$elleb yiwen seg imdanen, ass agi. Nek d amalal nnwen". Mi mwalant snat trebbuyaâ, iuker avaô, inna: "nek xvi$ kwen, nek wala$ ayen ur twalam, nek ugade$ Öebbi. Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb".
ayahs.translation: Mi sen icebbeê Cciîan igiten nnsen, u inna: "ur kwen i$elleb yiwen seg imdanen, ass agi. Nek d amalal nnwen". Mi mwalant snat trebbuyaâ, iuker avaô, inna: "nek xvi$ kwen, nek wala$ ayen ur twalam, nek ugade$ Öebbi. Öebbi Iqseê deg uâaqeb".

ayahs.text: Mi nnan ixabiten akked imehzulen n wul: "wigi, i$uôô iten ddin nnsen". Win ippeklen $ef Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Mi nnan ixabiten akked imehzulen n wul: "wigi, i$uôô iten ddin nnsen". Win ippeklen $ef Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Lemmer a pwaliv mara ddment lmalayek leôwaê n wid ijehlen, ad kkatent udmawen nnsen, izugar nnsen. "Jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt!
ayahs.translation: Lemmer a pwaliv mara ddment lmalayek leôwaê n wid ijehlen, ad kkatent udmawen nnsen, izugar nnsen. "Jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt!

ayahs.text: Ayagi ilmend n wayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen", u Öebbi ur pdennis imdanen.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi ilmend n wayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen", u Öebbi ur pdennis imdanen.

ayahs.text: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi. Issemêaleq asen Öebbi s ibekkaven nnsen. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, Iqseê deg uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Nekôen issekniyen n Öebbi. Issemêaleq asen Öebbi s ibekkaven nnsen. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, Iqseê deg uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Akka, acku Öebbi ur Ipbeddil l$it is I$at agdud, alamma bedlen i illan deg iman nnsen. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Akka, acku Öebbi ur Ipbeddil l$it is I$at agdud, alamma bedlen i illan deg iman nnsen. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen n Mass nnsen. Nen$a ten s ibekkaven nnsen, Ne$meq agdud n Ferâun; llan akw d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Am tikli n ugdud n Ferâun akked wid i ten id izwaren. Skaddben issekniyen n Mass nnsen. Nen$a ten s ibekkaven nnsen, Ne$meq agdud n Ferâun; llan akw d imednas.

ayahs.text: £uô Öebbi, imexlaq ucmiten mavi, d wid ijehlen, d$a ur uminen,
ayahs.translation: £uô Öebbi, imexlaq ucmiten mavi, d wid ijehlen, d$a ur uminen,

ayahs.text: wid ukud tgiv lemâahda, sinna, di yal tikelt, neqven lemâahda nnsen, u nitni ur pêezziben.
ayahs.translation: wid ukud tgiv lemâahda, sinna, di yal tikelt, neqven lemâahda nnsen, u nitni ur pêezziben.

ayahs.text: Ma tugarev ten di îôad, sserwel yissen wid i ten id ivefôen, amar a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Ma tugarev ten di îôad, sserwel yissen wid i ten id ivefôen, amar a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: Ma tugadev lexdaâ seg ugdud, err iten akin, s tezdeg. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara ixeddaâen.
ayahs.translation: Ma tugadev lexdaâ seg ugdud, err iten akin, s tezdeg. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara ixeddaâen.

ayahs.text: Ur p$ilin menâan, wid ijehlen. Nitni, s tidep, ur zmiren.
ayahs.translation: Ur p$ilin menâan, wid ijehlen. Nitni, s tidep, ur zmiren.

ayahs.text: Heggit asen d ayen iwumi tzemrem n lemêella akked yimnayen, a ppessagwdem yissen acengu n Öebbi, acengu nnwen, akked wiyav, war segsen, ur tessinem; Öebbi Issen iten. Ayen tseddqem n cci, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad awen d iu$al. Kunwi ur tepwadensem.
ayahs.translation: Heggit asen d ayen iwumi tzemrem n lemêella akked yimnayen, a ppessagwdem yissen acengu n Öebbi, acengu nnwen, akked wiyav, war segsen, ur tessinem; Öebbi Issen iten. Ayen tseddqem n cci, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad awen d iu$al. Kunwi ur tepwadensem.

ayahs.text: Ma nudan talwit, nadi ep. Ppkel $ef Öebbi. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ma nudan talwit, nadi ep. Ppkel $ef Öebbi. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ma b$an a k xedâan, ihi, âammed $ef Öebbi, Neppa i k Ifkan afus s tallalt iS, akked lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ma b$an a k xedâan, ihi, âammed $ef Öebbi, Neppa i k Ifkan afus s tallalt iS, akked lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Issemlal ulawen nnsen. Lemmer a pûeôfev i illan akw di tmurt, ur tessemliliv ulawen nnsen. Maca, Öebbi Issemlal iten. Neppa, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Issemlal ulawen nnsen. Lemmer a pûeôfev i illan akw di tmurt, ur tessemliliv ulawen nnsen. Maca, Öebbi Issemlal iten. Neppa, s tidep, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Âammed $ef Öebbi, keçç, akked wid iddan yidek si lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Âammed $ef Öebbi, keçç, akked wid iddan yidek si lmumnin.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Eg lêir i lmumnin, ad nna$en. Ma llan segwen warem iûebôiyen, ad rnun snat twinas. Ma llan segwen twinas, ad rnun agim n wid ijehlen, acku, nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Eg lêir i lmumnin, ad nna$en. Ma llan segwen warem iûebôiyen, ad rnun snat twinas. Ma llan segwen twinas, ad rnun agim n wid ijehlen, acku, nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.

ayahs.text: Tura, Issafes Öebbi fellawen. Iéôa tella garawen rrehma. Ihi, ma llan segwen twinas iûebôiyen, ad rnun snat twinas, ma llan segwen agim, ad rnun sin igima, ma Irad Öebbi. Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.
ayahs.translation: Tura, Issafes Öebbi fellawen. Iéôa tella garawen rrehma. Ihi, ma llan segwen twinas iûebôiyen, ad rnun snat twinas, ma llan segwen agim, ad rnun sin igima, ma Irad Öebbi. Öebbi ar iûebôiyen.

ayahs.text: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi ad isâu imeêbas, alamma pwa$elben di tmurt. Teb$am tukci n ddunit. Öebbi Ib$a laxeôt. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi ad isâu imeêbas, alamma pwa$elben di tmurt. Teb$am tukci n ddunit. Öebbi Ib$a laxeôt. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Lemmer maççi d ayen iuran s$uô Öebbi, izwar ed, yili a kwen iwwet uâaqeb abarar, ilmend n wayen tebbwim.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer maççi d ayen iuran s$uô Öebbi, izwar ed, yili a kwen iwwet uâaqeb abarar, ilmend n wayen tebbwim.

ayahs.text: Eççet ayen ilhan, iêellen, seg wayen i t$elltem, êezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Eççet ayen ilhan, iêellen, seg wayen i t$elltem, êezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Ini i wid teîîfem seg imeêbas: "ma Iufa Öebbi lxiô deg ulawen nnwen, ad awen Ifk ayen yifen ayen i wen ipwakksen, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Ini i wid teîîfem seg imeêbas: "ma Iufa Öebbi lxiô deg ulawen nnwen, ad awen Ifk ayen yifen ayen i wen ipwakksen, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

ayahs.text: Ma b$an a k xedâan, ni$ iu$ lêal xedâen Öebbi. D$a, Ikkes asen ôôay. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ma b$an a k xedâan, ni$ iu$ lêal xedâen Öebbi. D$a, Ikkes asen ôôay. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden s wayla nnsen, akked yiman nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Wid iumnen ur unagen, ur awen llin d imeddukwal, s wacemma, alamma unagen. Ma ppren afus nnwen di ddin, iwata yawen ad asen tefkem afus, siwa mgal agdud ukud tâaqdem. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden s wayla nnsen, akked yiman nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Wid iumnen ur unagen, ur awen llin d imeddukwal, s wacemma, alamma unagen. Ma ppren afus nnwen di ddin, iwata yawen ad asen tefkem afus, siwa mgal agdud ukud tâaqdem. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Wid ijehlen d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Ma ur tgim ara akka, a ppili lfetna di tmurt, akked usefsed ameqwôan.
ayahs.translation: Wid ijehlen d imeddukwal bwaygarasen. Ma ur tgim ara akka, a ppili lfetna di tmurt, akked usefsed ameqwôan.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak, s tidep, d lmumnin. I nitni ssmaê akked l$it ukyis.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen, iunagen, ijuhden deg ubrid n Öebbi, wid isnubgten u fkan afus, widak, s tidep, d lmumnin. I nitni ssmaê akked l$it ukyis.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen syin $er da, u unagen, u juhden yidwen, widak segwen. Llzem ppemyilin kteô di Tezmamt n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Izôa yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen syin $er da, u unagen, u juhden yidwen, widak segwen. Llzem ppemyilin kteô di Tezmamt n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Izôa yal cci.

verses.text: Öebbi akked Umazan iS kksen aêeppem i imcurak ukud tâaqqdem.
verses.translation: Öebbi akked Umazan iS kksen aêeppem i imcurak ukud tâaqqdem.

verses.text: Ddut di tmurt kué wagguren. Cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Öebbi, u Öebbi ad Isdull ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ddut di tmurt kué wagguren. Cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Öebbi, u Öebbi ad Isdull ijehliyen.

verses.text: Aberreê i medden, s$uô Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ass n êioo ameqwôaêan, ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, kksen aêeppem i imcurak. "Ma testeôoâam, ppif i kunwi, ma twexxôem, cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Öebbi". Becceô wid ijehlen s uâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Aberreê i medden, s$uô Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ass n êioo ameqwôaêan, ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, kksen aêeppem i imcurak. "Ma testeôoâam, ppif i kunwi, ma twexxôem, cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Öebbi". Becceô wid ijehlen s uâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Kkes ed wid ukud tâaqqdem seg imcurak, sinna ur kwen bbwiven s wacemma, ur ullen yiwen mgal nnwen. Ïîfet di lemâahda nnsen ar lmudda s. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Kkes ed wid ukud tâaqqdem seg imcurak, sinna ur kwen bbwiven s wacemma, ur ullen yiwen mgal nnwen. Ïîfet di lemâahda nnsen ar lmudda s. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Mi âaddan wagguren iôqan, nna$et imcurak anda ten tufam. Ïîfet pen, êeôset pen, andit asen yal taxettalt. Ma steôoâan, ééulen, zekkan, ooet asen abrid. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Mi âaddan wagguren iôqan, nna$et imcurak anda ten tufam. Ïîfet pen, êeôset pen, andit asen yal taxettalt. Ma steôoâan, ééulen, zekkan, ooet asen abrid. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ma issuter ak laânaya, yiwen seg imcurak, êareb fellas, ard issel i wawal n Öebbi, sinna, ssiwev it s amkan is n laman. Akka, acku nitni, s tidep, d agdud ur nessin.
verses.translation: Ma issuter ak laânaya, yiwen seg imcurak, êareb fellas, ard issel i wawal n Öebbi, sinna, ssiwev it s amkan is n laman. Akka, acku nitni, s tidep, d agdud ur nessin.

verses.text: Amek ara tili i imcurak, lemâahda s$uô Öebbi u s$uô Umazan iS, siwa wid tâahdem ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Skud sweqmen yidwen, sweqmet yidsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Amek ara tili i imcurak, lemâahda s$uô Öebbi u s$uô Umazan iS, siwa wid tâahdem ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Skud sweqmen yidwen, sweqmet yidsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Amek, mi kwen $elben, ur kwen qudôen ilmend n yi$es, ne$ n lemâahda. Öuvan kwen s imawen nnsen; ulawen nnsen ugin. Tegwti segsen d iballa$en.
verses.translation: Amek, mi kwen $elben, ur kwen qudôen ilmend n yi$es, ne$ n lemâahda. Öuvan kwen s imawen nnsen; ulawen nnsen ugin. Tegwti segsen d iballa$en.

verses.text: U$en s issekniyen n Öebbi ayen ôxisen. Ssefôa$en $ef ubrid iS. S tidep, ay dir wayen xeddmen nitni!
verses.translation: U$en s issekniyen n Öebbi ayen ôxisen. Ssefôa$en $ef ubrid iS. S tidep, ay dir wayen xeddmen nitni!

verses.text: Ur qudôen lmumen ilmend n yi$es, ne$ n lemâahda. Wigi, ih, d wid izegren tilas.
verses.translation: Ur qudôen lmumen ilmend n yi$es, ne$ n lemâahda. Wigi, ih, d wid izegren tilas.

verses.text: Ma steôoâan, ééulen, zekkan, d atmaten nnwen di ddin. Nepfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
verses.translation: Ma steôoâan, ééulen, zekkan, d atmaten nnwen di ddin. Nepfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.

verses.text: Ma sêenten tagalit nnsen, deffir lemâahda nnsen, u wwten di ddin nnwen, nna$et iqweôôa n tijehli. Nitni, s tidep, ur ppaîafen di tgallit. Amar ad fukken.
verses.translation: Ma sêenten tagalit nnsen, deffir lemâahda nnsen, u wwten di ddin nnwen, nna$et iqweôôa n tijehli. Nitni, s tidep, ur ppaîafen di tgallit. Amar ad fukken.

verses.text: Day ur tepna$em ara agdud i isêenten tagalit nnsen, u ib$an ad ssuff$en Amazan, u nitni heomen kwen d imezwura? Day ten tugadem? D Öebbi i iklalen a T tagwadem, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
verses.translation: Day ur tepna$em ara agdud i isêenten tagalit nnsen, u ib$an ad ssuff$en Amazan, u nitni heomen kwen d imezwura? Day ten tugadem? D Öebbi i iklalen a T tagwadem, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

verses.text: Nna$et pen, a ten Iâaqeb Öebbi s ufus nnwen, a ten Ixzu, a kwen Iserbeê fellasen, ad Icfu idmaren n ugdud n lmumnin.
verses.translation: Nna$et pen, a ten Iâaqeb Öebbi s ufus nnwen, a ten Ixzu, a kwen Iserbeê fellasen, ad Icfu idmaren n ugdud n lmumnin.

verses.text: Ad Ikkes urrif n wulawen nnsen. Öebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ad Ikkes urrif n wulawen nnsen. Öebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Day t$ilem a ppepwaterkem, wanag ur Iéôi Öebbi wid, degwen, ijuhden, ur neddi d imawlan, war Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked lmumnin? Öebbi Iéôa ay txeddmem.
verses.translation: Day t$ilem a ppepwaterkem, wanag ur Iéôi Öebbi wid, degwen, ijuhden, ur neddi d imawlan, war Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked lmumnin? Öebbi Iéôa ay txeddmem.

verses.text: Ur issefk ara i imcurak ad kecmen leowamaâ n Öebbi, ad cehhden $ef tijehli nnsen. Widak neqven igiten nnsen, di tmes ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Ur issefk ara i imcurak ad kecmen leowamaâ n Öebbi, ad cehhden $ef tijehli nnsen. Widak neqven igiten nnsen, di tmes ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Ara ikecmen kan leowamaâ n Öebbi, d wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, iééulen, izekkan, ippagwaden siwa Öebbi. Ahat wigi ad ilin seg wid ipwanhan.
verses.translation: Ara ikecmen kan leowamaâ n Öebbi, d wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, iééulen, izekkan, ippagwaden siwa Öebbi. Ahat wigi ad ilin seg wid ipwanhan.

verses.text: Day terram win i isswan iéaâlak, i ibedden i Loamaâ n Lêaôam, am win iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru u innu$ deg ubrid n Öebbi? Ur aâdilen ar Öebbi. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
verses.translation: Day terram win i isswan iéaâlak, i ibedden i Loamaâ n Lêaôam, am win iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru u innu$ deg ubrid n Öebbi? Ur aâdilen ar Öebbi. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

verses.text: Wid iumnen, iunagen, u nnu$en deg ubrid n Öebbi s wayla nnsen akked iman nnsen, aâlay umekkan nnsen, ar Öebbi. Wigi d wid ara irebêen.
verses.translation: Wid iumnen, iunagen, u nnu$en deg ubrid n Öebbi s wayla nnsen akked iman nnsen, aâlay umekkan nnsen, ar Öebbi. Wigi d wid ara irebêen.

verses.text: Ibecceô iten Mass nnsen s uêunu s$uôeS, akked llza, akked leonanat, degsen ssaâd imezgi;
verses.translation: Ibecceô iten Mass nnsen s uêunu s$uôeS, akked llza, akked leonanat, degsen ssaâd imezgi;

verses.text: ad wekkôen degsen i lebda. Ih, ar Öebbi, arraz ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: ad wekkôen degsen i lebda. Ih, ar Öebbi, arraz ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d imawlan, ibabaten nnwen akked watmaten nnwen, ma smenyafen tijehli i liman. Wid segwen i ten iran d imawlan, ad ilin, nitni, d imednas.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d imawlan, ibabaten nnwen akked watmaten nnwen, ma smenyafen tijehli i liman. Wid segwen i ten iran d imawlan, ad ilin, nitni, d imednas.

verses.text: Ini: "maday, sennig Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked umennu$ deg ubrid iS, ay têemmlem ibabaten nnwen, tarwa nnwen, atmaten nnwen, tilawin nnwen, alag nnwen, ayla i tkesbem, ttjaôa i tugadem a ppe$li, tinezdu$in i kwen iâaoben, ihi, gganit ar d Ias Öebbi, s lameô iS. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.
verses.translation: Ini: "maday, sennig Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked umennu$ deg ubrid iS, ay têemmlem ibabaten nnwen, tarwa nnwen, atmaten nnwen, tilawin nnwen, alag nnwen, ayla i tkesbem, ttjaôa i tugadem a ppe$li, tinezdu$in i kwen iâaoben, ihi, gganit ar d Ias Öebbi, s lameô iS. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.

verses.text: Ni$ Isrebê ikwen Öebbi deg waîas imukan, akked wass n Ëunain, mi kwen taâoeb îîaqa nnwen. Ur awen d tebbwi acemma. Tamurt iwsâan, tu$al awen tediyeq. D$a tezzim d, trewlem.
verses.translation: Ni$ Isrebê ikwen Öebbi deg waîas imukan, akked wass n Ëunain, mi kwen taâoeb îîaqa nnwen. Ur awen d tebbwi acemma. Tamurt iwsâan, tu$al awen tediyeq. D$a tezzim d, trewlem.

verses.text: Sinna, Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS $ef Umazan iS, akked lmumnin, Issers ed iâsekôiwen ur tepwalim. Iâaqeb wid ijehlen. D wagi ay d aqeîîi ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Sinna, Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS $ef Umazan iS, akked lmumnin, Issers ed iâsekôiwen ur tepwalim. Iâaqeb wid ijehlen. D wagi ay d aqeîîi ijehliyen.

verses.text: Sinna, deffir waya, Öebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Sinna, deffir waya, Öebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Imcurak maâfunit kan. Ur d pqeôôiben ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam, mara ifukk useggwas agi nnsen. Ma tugadem lqella, a kwen I$it Öebbi, s lfevl iS, ma ihwa yaS. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Imcurak maâfunit kan. Ur d pqeôôiben ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam, mara ifukk useggwas agi nnsen. Ma tugadem lqella, a kwen I$it Öebbi, s lfevl iS, ma ihwa yaS. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Nna$et wid ur numin ara s Öebbi, u s wass aneggaru, ur pgeddilen ayen Igdel Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur xeddmen ddin n tidep, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, alamma xelûen tabzert s war amunnu, d imejjîuêen.
verses.translation: Nna$et wid ur numin ara s Öebbi, u s wass aneggaru, ur pgeddilen ayen Igdel Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur xeddmen ddin n tidep, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, alamma xelûen tabzert s war amunnu, d imejjîuêen.

verses.text: Nnan wudayen: "Âuzayeô d mmi S n Öebbi". Nnan imasiêiyen: "lmasiê d mmi S n Öebbi". Ayagi, nnan t id s imawen nnsen. Ppaâwaden d awal n wid ijehlen, n zik. A ten Ine$ Öebbi! Acêal îeôôifen!
verses.translation: Nnan wudayen: "Âuzayeô d mmi S n Öebbi". Nnan imasiêiyen: "lmasiê d mmi S n Öebbi". Ayagi, nnan t id s imawen nnsen. Ppaâwaden d awal n wid ijehlen, n zik. A ten Ine$ Öebbi! Acêal îeôôifen!

verses.text: Rran lquôôaê nnsen, ixelwiyen nnsen, lmasiê mmi s n Meryem, d imawlan war Öebbi. Pwamôen kan ad âabden Öebbi Yiwen; ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Gedha syiS, seg wayen pcaraken!
verses.translation: Rran lquôôaê nnsen, ixelwiyen nnsen, lmasiê mmi s n Meryem, d imawlan war Öebbi. Pwamôen kan ad âabden Öebbi Yiwen; ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Gedha syiS, seg wayen pcaraken!

verses.text: B$an s yimawen nnsen ad ssexsin tafat n Öebbi. I Ib$a Öebbi, ad Itim kan tafat iS, di nneqwma ijehliyen.
verses.translation: B$an s yimawen nnsen ad ssexsin tafat n Öebbi. I Ib$a Öebbi, ad Itim kan tafat iS, di nneqwma ijehliyen.

verses.text: D Neppa id Iuznen Amazan iS, s nnhaya akked ddin n tidep, iwakken a t Issifer $ef ddin meôôa, xas ugin ijehliyen.
verses.translation: D Neppa id Iuznen Amazan iS, s nnhaya akked ddin n tidep, iwakken a t Issifer $ef ddin meôôa, xas ugin ijehliyen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Aîas n lqweôôaê d ixelwiyen, s tidep, teppen d aêerfi ayla n medden. U îeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Wid ixeznen ddheb d lfeîîa, ur ten pseddiqen deg ubrid n Öebbi, becceô iten s uâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Aîas n lqweôôaê d ixelwiyen, s tidep, teppen d aêerfi ayla n medden. U îeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Wid ixeznen ddheb d lfeîîa, ur ten pseddiqen deg ubrid n Öebbi, becceô iten s uâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara ô$en di tmes n Loahennama, ad kwin, yissen, inyiren nnsen, ibeôdiyen nnsen, iârar nnsen. "D ayagi ay txezznem i iman nnwen. Jeôôbet ayen txezznem!"
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara ô$en di tmes n Loahennama, ad kwin, yissen, inyiren nnsen, ibeôdiyen nnsen, iârar nnsen. "D ayagi ay txezznem i iman nnwen. Jeôôbet ayen txezznem!"

verses.text: Ih, ar Öebbi, amvan n wagguren: mrawsin; di Tezmamt n Öebbi, ass ideg Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan. Garasen, kué ôqan. D wagi ay d ddin n ddwam. Ur ddenniset iman nnwen degsen. Nna$et ijehliyen $ef ccfa, akken i kwen nnu$en $ef ccfa. Cfut, Öebbi Iteddu d wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Ih, ar Öebbi, amvan n wagguren: mrawsin; di Tezmamt n Öebbi, ass ideg Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan. Garasen, kué ôqan. D wagi ay d ddin n ddwam. Ur ddenniset iman nnwen degsen. Nna$et ijehliyen $ef ccfa, akken i kwen nnu$en $ef ccfa. Cfut, Öebbi Iteddu d wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Aswexxeô n waggur d timerniwt kan n tijehli. Nnetlafen yis wid ijehlen. Aseggwas a t êellen, aseggwas a t gedlen, iwakken ad wafqen amvan n wayen Igdel Öebbi. Ad êellen ayen Igdel Öebbi. Âaoben ten yir igiten nnsen. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Aswexxeô n waggur d timerniwt kan n tijehli. Nnetlafen yis wid ijehlen. Aseggwas a t êellen, aseggwas a t gedlen, iwakken ad wafqen amvan n wayen Igdel Öebbi. Ad êellen ayen Igdel Öebbi. Âaoben ten yir igiten nnsen. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Acu kwen iu$en? Ma nnan awen: "hejjmet ar ubrid n Öebbi", a ppebrum i iman nnwen. Day kwen taâoeb tmeddurt n ddunit, sennig tin n laxeôt? Zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit d amejîiîuê kan, zdat win n laxeôt.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Acu kwen iu$en? Ma nnan awen: "hejjmet ar ubrid n Öebbi", a ppebrum i iman nnwen. Day kwen taâoeb tmeddurt n ddunit, sennig tin n laxeôt? Zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit d amejîiîuê kan, zdat win n laxeôt.

verses.text: Ma ur tehjjimem ara, a kwen Iâaqeb s lqeôê, a d Iawi agdud nniven, deg umekkan nnwen. Ur T teîîuôum s wacemma. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ma ur tehjjimem ara, a kwen Iâaqeb s lqeôê, a d Iawi agdud nniven, deg umekkan nnwen. Ur T teîîuôum s wacemma. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ma ur t tsellkem, ihi, Isellek it Öebbi, mi t ssuff$en wid ijehlen. Wissin n sin, mi llan deg ifri, mi inna i umeddakwel is: "kkes a$wbel, Öebbi, s tidep, yidne$". Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS fellas, Iâawen it s iâsekriwen, ur ten twalam. Isse$li mavi awal n wid ijehlen. Awal n Öebbi, neppa, aâlay sennig akw. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ma ur t tsellkem, ihi, Isellek it Öebbi, mi t ssuff$en wid ijehlen. Wissin n sin, mi llan deg ifri, mi inna i umeddakwel is: "kkes a$wbel, Öebbi, s tidep, yidne$". Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS fellas, Iâawen it s iâsekriwen, ur ten twalam. Isse$li mavi awal n wid ijehlen. Awal n Öebbi, neppa, aâlay sennig akw. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Hejjmet fessusit u ééayit, juhdet s wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ppif wakka i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.
verses.translation: Hejjmet fessusit u ééayit, juhdet s wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ppif wakka i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.

verses.text: Lemmer d aba$uô isehlen, d inig wezzilen, yili vefôen k in. Maca, $wezzif fellasen umecwaô. Ad ggalen s Öebbi: "lemmer nezmir, yili neffe$ yidwen". Nn$an iman nnsen, Öebbi Iéôa ar nitni, war ccekk, d ikeddaben.
verses.translation: Lemmer d aba$uô isehlen, d inig wezzilen, yili vefôen k in. Maca, $wezzif fellasen umecwaô. Ad ggalen s Öebbi: "lemmer nezmir, yili neffe$ yidwen". Nn$an iman nnsen, Öebbi Iéôa ar nitni, war ccekk, d ikeddaben.

verses.text: Ad ak Isemmeê Öebbi! Acimi i sen tserêev? Ard ak d iban anwi innan tidep, a ppissinev ikeddaben.
verses.translation: Ad ak Isemmeê Öebbi! Acimi i sen tserêev? Ard ak d iban anwi innan tidep, a ppissinev ikeddaben.

verses.text: Ur ak d ssutren ara tsriê, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, mi juhden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Öebbi Issen wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Ur ak d ssutren ara tsriê, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, mi juhden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Öebbi Issen wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: I k issutren tsriê, d wid ur numin s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Cukken wulawen nnsen, d$a, s ucukku nnsen, kukran.
verses.translation: I k issutren tsriê, d wid ur numin s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Cukken wulawen nnsen, d$a, s ucukku nnsen, kukran.

verses.text: Lemmer b$in tuff$a, yili heggan as d ayen ilaqen. Maca, Iugi Öebbi ad ppucegâan, Iurez iten. Nnan asen: "qqimet d wid iqqimen".
verses.translation: Lemmer b$in tuff$a, yili heggan as d ayen ilaqen. Maca, Iugi Öebbi ad ppucegâan, Iurez iten. Nnan asen: "qqimet d wid iqqimen".

verses.text: Lemmer ffi$en yidwen, ar awen rnun siwa ccwal. War ccekk, ad kecmen garawen, b$an ahewwel nnwen. Kra segwen ssemêasen asen. Öebbi Issen imednas.
verses.translation: Lemmer ffi$en yidwen, ar awen rnun siwa ccwal. War ccekk, ad kecmen garawen, b$an ahewwel nnwen. Kra segwen ssemêasen asen. Öebbi Issen imednas.

verses.text: Ni$ b$an, si zik, ahewwel. Sxeôben ak lumuô, armi d tusa tidep. Ivehô ed lameô n Öebbi, nitni ur b$in.
verses.translation: Ni$ b$an, si zik, ahewwel. Sxeôben ak lumuô, armi d tusa tidep. Ivehô ed lameô n Öebbi, nitni ur b$in.

verses.text: Garasen win id innan: "serreê iyi, ur iyi gar di lfetna"! Day ur $lin ara di lfetna? Loahennama, s tidep, a ppezzi i ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Garasen win id innan: "serreê iyi, ur iyi gar di lfetna"! Day ur $lin ara di lfetna? Loahennama, s tidep, a ppezzi i ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ma iusa k id yise$ ad $weblen. Ma tusa k id twa$it, ad inin: "ni$, iu$ lêal, neqva lameô nne$". Ad wexxôen, zzhan.
verses.translation: Ma iusa k id yise$ ad $weblen. Ma tusa k id twa$it, ad inin: "ni$, iu$ lêal, neqva lameô nne$". Ad wexxôen, zzhan.

verses.text: Ini: "ur a$ ipêaz wacemma, siwa ayen i $ Iura Öebbi". Neppa d Bab nne$. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ini: "ur a$ ipêaz wacemma, siwa ayen i $ Iura Öebbi". Neppa d Bab nne$. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.

verses.text: Ini: "acu teggunim ad ivôu yidne$, siwa yiwen si sin ise$iyen? Nekwni negguni a kwen Iwwet Öebbi, s uâaqeb ara d iasen s$uôeS, ne$ seg ifassen nne$. Ihi gganit, nekwni a neggani yidwen".
verses.translation: Ini: "acu teggunim ad ivôu yidne$, siwa yiwen si sin ise$iyen? Nekwni negguni a kwen Iwwet Öebbi, s uâaqeb ara d iasen s$uôeS, ne$ seg ifassen nne$. Ihi gganit, nekwni a neggani yidwen".

verses.text: Ini: "seddqet, teb$am ne$ tugim, d ayen ur neppwaqbal segwen, d awez$i. Kunwi, s tidep, d agdud iballa$en".
verses.translation: Ini: "seddqet, teb$am ne$ tugim, d ayen ur neppwaqbal segwen, d awez$i. Kunwi, s tidep, d agdud iballa$en".

verses.text: Ay sen ikksen a tepwaqbal ssadaqa nnsen, imi kan jehlen, s tidep, ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u s laâgez kan ay d ppasen ar tpéallit, s usmiglez kan ay pseddiqen.
verses.translation: Ay sen ikksen a tepwaqbal ssadaqa nnsen, imi kan jehlen, s tidep, ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u s laâgez kan ay d ppasen ar tpéallit, s usmiglez kan ay pseddiqen.

verses.text: Ur k ippaâoab wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Ib$a kan Öebbi a ten Iâaqeb yissen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ad iffe$ ôôuê nnsen, nitni d ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ur k ippaâoab wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Ib$a kan Öebbi a ten Iâaqeb yissen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ad iffe$ ôôuê nnsen, nitni d ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ad ggalen s Öebbi, ar nitni, war ccekk, segwen. Ur nitni segwen, maca d agdud iugaden.
verses.translation: Ad ggalen s Öebbi, ar nitni, war ccekk, segwen. Ur nitni segwen, maca d agdud iugaden.

verses.text: Lemmer ad afen ssôan, ne$ ifran, ne$ anda ara kecmen, ad ôuêen $uôes s tazla.
verses.translation: Lemmer ad afen ssôan, ne$ ifran, ne$ anda ara kecmen, ad ôuêen $uôes s tazla.

verses.text: Garasen, wid ikkaten deg k, $ef ssadaqat. Ma ippunefk asen segsent, ad ôavin, ma ur asen ippunefk, ad neêwen.
verses.translation: Garasen, wid ikkaten deg k, $ef ssadaqat. Ma ippunefk asen segsent, ad ôavin, ma ur asen ippunefk, ad neêwen.

verses.text: Lemmer nitni, s tidep, ôuvan ayen i sen Ifka Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u nnan d: "nesteqnaâ s Öebbi. Ad a$ d Ifk, si lfevl iS, Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ih, d Öebbi i$ef neô$eb".
verses.translation: Lemmer nitni, s tidep, ôuvan ayen i sen Ifka Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u nnan d: "nesteqnaâ s Öebbi. Ad a$ d Ifk, si lfevl iS, Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ih, d Öebbi i$ef neô$eb".

verses.text: Ssadaqat siwa i ime$ban, iéawaliyen, i wid ice$wlen degsent, i usemlili n wulawen, i userreê imeêbas, i imeîîulba, i ubrid n Öebbi, i win d ifka ubrid. D aêeppem s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ssadaqat siwa i ime$ban, iéawaliyen, i wid ice$wlen degsent, i usemlili n wulawen, i userreê imeêbas, i imeîîulba, i ubrid n Öebbi, i win d ifka ubrid. D aêeppem s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Garasen, wid icettmen deg Umazan, qqaôen: "neppa d aêessas". Ini: "d aêessas n lxiô i kunwi. Iumen s Öebbi, iumen lmumnin. D aêunu i wid iumnen segwen". I wid icettmen deg Umazan n Öebbi, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Garasen, wid icettmen deg Umazan, qqaôen: "neppa d aêessas". Ini: "d aêessas n lxiô i kunwi. Iumen s Öebbi, iumen lmumnin. D aêunu i wid iumnen segwen". I wid icettmen deg Umazan n Öebbi, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ad awen ggalen s Öebbi, iwakken a kwen ôavin. Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Iklal kteô a T ôavin, lemmer llin d lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ad awen ggalen s Öebbi, iwakken a kwen ôavin. Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Iklal kteô a T ôavin, lemmer llin d lmumnin.

verses.text: Day ur éôin ara ar, win ixuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, i neppa times n Loahennama, ad iwekkeô degs? D wagi ay d ddell abarar.
verses.translation: Day ur éôin ara ar, win ixuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, i neppa times n Loahennama, ad iwekkeô degs? D wagi ay d ddell abarar.

verses.text: Ixabiten ugaden ad asen d ters tsuôep, ad asen tessken i illan deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "mmaâlket. Öebbi, s tidep, a d Issuffe$ ayen tugadem".
verses.translation: Ixabiten ugaden ad asen d ters tsuôep, ad asen tessken i illan deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "mmaâlket. Öebbi, s tidep, a d Issuffe$ ayen tugadem".

verses.text: Ma testeqsav ten, a d inin, war ccekk: "la nheddeô kan, nepqessiô". Ini: "day la tettihim di Öebbi akked issekniyen iS, akked Umazan iS?
verses.translation: Ma testeqsav ten, a d inin, war ccekk: "la nheddeô kan, nepqessiô". Ini: "day la tettihim di Öebbi akked issekniyen iS, akked Umazan iS?

verses.text: Ur steôoiâat. Ni$ tu$alem ar tijehli, deffir liman nnwen". Ma Nsemmeê i urbaâ segwen, a Naâqeb arbaâ, imi nitni llan d ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Ur steôoiâat. Ni$ tu$alem ar tijehli, deffir liman nnwen". Ma Nsemmeê i urbaâ segwen, a Naâqeb arbaâ, imi nitni llan d ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Ixabiten akked txabitin, wa ippameô i wa, ayen n dir, ppemyegdalen lewqama, pcuddun ifassen nnsen. Ppun Öebbi, Ippu ten. Ih, ixabiten d iballa$en.
verses.translation: Ixabiten akked txabitin, wa ippameô i wa, ayen n dir, ppemyegdalen lewqama, pcuddun ifassen nnsen. Ppun Öebbi, Ippu ten. Ih, ixabiten d iballa$en.

verses.text: Iwaââed Öebbi, i ixabiten, txabitin, akked ijehliyen, times n Loahennama, degs ad wekkôen. Beôka ten. Ixza ten Öebbi. Fellasen aâaqeb imezgi,
verses.translation: Iwaââed Öebbi, i ixabiten, txabitin, akked ijehliyen, times n Loahennama, degs ad wekkôen. Beôka ten. Ixza ten Öebbi. Fellasen aâaqeb imezgi,

verses.text: am imezwura nnwen. Llan ifen kwen tazmert, $elben kwen ayla, tarwa. Zhan deg umur nnsen, tezham deg umur nnwen, akken zhan imezwura nnwen deg umur nnsen. Teccvem akken ccven nitni. Widak, mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeôt. Widak d imexsuôen.
verses.translation: am imezwura nnwen. Llan ifen kwen tazmert, $elben kwen ayla, tarwa. Zhan deg umur nnsen, tezham deg umur nnwen, akken zhan imezwura nnwen deg umur nnsen. Teccvem akken ccven nitni. Widak, mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeôt. Widak d imexsuôen.

verses.text: Day ur ten id iusa ara usali imezwura nnsen? Agdud n Nuê, Âad, Tamud, agdud n Ibôahim, At Median, tid ippin. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen. Ur ten Idennis Öebbi, maca llan dennisen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: Day ur ten id iusa ara usali imezwura nnsen? Agdud n Nuê, Âad, Tamud, agdud n Ibôahim, At Median, tid ippin. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen. Ur ten Idennis Öebbi, maca llan dennisen iman nnsen.

verses.text: Lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, d imeddukal wa n wa. Ppamôen lewqama, pgeddilen ayen n dir. Péallan, pzekkin, ppa$en awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Wigi, ad Iêun Öebbi fellasen. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, d imeddukal wa n wa. Ppamôen lewqama, pgeddilen ayen n dir. Péallan, pzekkin, ppa$en awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Wigi, ad Iêun Öebbi fellasen. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Iwaââed Öebbi i lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen; ixxamen igerzen di leonanat n Âaden, akked llza s$uô Öebbi - iten i$elben akw -. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Iwaââed Öebbi i lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen; ixxamen igerzen di leonanat n Âaden, akked llza s$uô Öebbi - iten i$elben akw -. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Jahed ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Iqsiê $uôsen. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d taggara tucmip!
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Jahed ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Iqsiê $uôsen. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d taggara tucmip!

verses.text: Ggulen s Öebbi ur d nnin, wanag nnan awal n tijehli. Jehlen deffir wannuz nnsen. Vemâen ayen iwumi ur wâan. Ur êzinen imi iten I$at, si lfevl iS, Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma steôoâen, yif it i nitni. Ma wexxôen, a ten Iâaqeb Öebbi s leqôeê, di ddunit, di laxeôt. Ur sâun, di tmurt, bab ne$ amâiwen.
verses.translation: Ggulen s Öebbi ur d nnin, wanag nnan awal n tijehli. Jehlen deffir wannuz nnsen. Vemâen ayen iwumi ur wâan. Ur êzinen imi iten I$at, si lfevl iS, Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma steôoâen, yif it i nitni. Ma wexxôen, a ten Iâaqeb Öebbi s leqôeê, di ddunit, di laxeôt. Ur sâun, di tmurt, bab ne$ amâiwen.

verses.text: Garasen, wid iâahden Öebbi: "ma Ifka ya$ d, si lfevl iS, a nseddeq, a nili si lâuûam".
verses.translation: Garasen, wid iâahden Öebbi: "ma Ifka ya$ d, si lfevl iS, a nseddeq, a nili si lâuûam".

verses.text: Mi sen Ifka si lfevl iS, a t bexwlen, ad wexxôen, ad namren.
verses.translation: Mi sen Ifka si lfevl iS, a t bexwlen, ad wexxôen, ad namren.

verses.text: Issegwra yasen d tanaâuôt deg ulawen nnsen, ar ass ideg ara mlilen yideS, imi xed$an Öebbi deg wayen i S âahden, imi llan skiddiben.
verses.translation: Issegwra yasen d tanaâuôt deg ulawen nnsen, ar ass ideg ara mlilen yideS, imi xed$an Öebbi deg wayen i S âahden, imi llan skiddiben.

verses.text: Day ur éôin ara Öebbi Issen sser nnsen akked wayen qqaôen u, ar Öebbi Issen tibavniyin?
verses.translation: Day ur éôin ara Öebbi Issen sser nnsen akked wayen qqaôen u, ar Öebbi Issen tibavniyin?

verses.text: Wid ipqeôôiven di lmumnin i ib$an ad seddqen, u deg wid i iufan siwa tazmert nnsen, d$a ttihin fellasen; ad Ittihi Öebbi fellasen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Wid ipqeôôiven di lmumnin i ib$an ad seddqen, u deg wid i iufan siwa tazmert nnsen, d$a ttihin fellasen; ad Ittihi Öebbi fellasen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ssuter ad ppusemmêen, ne$ qqim. Ma tessutrev ûavet iberdan, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, d awez$i. Akka, imi nitni jehlen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.
verses.translation: Ssuter ad ppusemmêen, ne$ qqim. Ma tessutrev ûavet iberdan, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, d awez$i. Akka, imi nitni jehlen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.

verses.text: Wid igwran, feôêen mi llan deffir Umazan n Öebbi. Ugin ad nna$en s wayla nnsen akked teôwiêt nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Nnan: "Ur pôuêut deg una$uô". Ini: "times n Loahennama teêma kteô, lemmer day fehhmen".
verses.translation: Wid igwran, feôêen mi llan deffir Umazan n Öebbi. Ugin ad nna$en s wayla nnsen akked teôwiêt nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Nnan: "Ur pôuêut deg una$uô". Ini: "times n Loahennama teêma kteô, lemmer day fehhmen".

verses.text: Anef ad vsen cwiî, ad run aîas, d aqeîîi n wayen keppben.
verses.translation: Anef ad vsen cwiî, ad run aîas, d aqeîîi n wayen keppben.

verses.text: Ma Irra k id Öebbi ar urbaâ segsen, u ssutren ak d tsriê ad ff$en, ini: "d awez$i, ur teppeff$em yidi, ur tepna$em acengu yidi. Akken, kunwi, iâoeb ikwen i$imi, abrid amenzu, ihi, qqimet akked ineggura.
