verses.translation: Ma Irra k id Öebbi ar urbaâ segsen, u ssutren ak d tsriê ad ff$en, ini: "d awez$i, ur teppeff$em yidi, ur tepna$em acengu yidi. Akken, kunwi, iâoeb ikwen i$imi, abrid amenzu, ihi, qqimet akked ineggura.

verses.text: Ur péalla $ef yiwen degsen, ma immut, d awez$i. Ur pbedda ar tenîelt is. Nitni, s tidep, jehlen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, mmuten nitni d iballa$en.
verses.translation: Ur péalla $ef yiwen degsen, ma immut, d awez$i. Ur pbedda ar tenîelt is. Nitni, s tidep, jehlen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, mmuten nitni d iballa$en.

verses.text: Ur k ippaâoab wayla nnsen, ne$ dderya nnsen. Öebbi Ib$a kan a ten Iâaqeb yissen di ddunit, ad asen teffe$ taôwiêt nitni d ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ur k ippaâoab wayla nnsen, ne$ dderya nnsen. Öebbi Ib$a kan a ten Iâaqeb yissen di ddunit, ad asen teffe$ taôwiêt nitni d ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ma ters ed tsuôep: "amnet s Öebbi, jahdet akked Umazan iS", imeôkantiyen nnsen a k ssutren tsriê, ad inin: "anef ane$ ar wid iqqimen".
verses.translation: Ma ters ed tsuôep: "amnet s Öebbi, jahdet akked Umazan iS", imeôkantiyen nnsen a k ssutren tsriê, ad inin: "anef ane$ ar wid iqqimen".

verses.text: Öuvan ad ilin akked wid igwran. Ppusel$en wulawen nnsen, ur fehhmen.
verses.translation: Öuvan ad ilin akked wid igwran. Ppusel$en wulawen nnsen, ur fehhmen.

verses.text: Maca, amazan akked wid iumnen yides, jehden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Widak, nnsen lxiô. Widak, d nitni ara irebêen.
verses.translation: Maca, amazan akked wid iumnen yides, jehden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Widak, nnsen lxiô. Widak, d nitni ara irebêen.

verses.text: Ihegga yasen d Öebbi leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Ihegga yasen d Öebbi leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Wid id iufan ssebba, seg waâôaben n ucluê, usan d, ad asen ifk tsriê. Wid iskaddben Öebbi akked Umazan iS, qqimen. Wid ijehlen, segsen, ad sâaddin aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Wid id iufan ssebba, seg waâôaben n ucluê, usan d, ad asen ifk tsriê. Wid iskaddben Öebbi akked Umazan iS, qqimen. Wid ijehlen, segsen, ad sâaddin aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ur telli tuzzma $ef uôhifen, imuvan, wid ur nufi ara fken, ma neûêen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur telli tuzzma $ef iâaôviyen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ur telli tuzzma $ef uôhifen, imuvan, wid ur nufi ara fken, ma neûêen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur telli tuzzma $ef iâaôviyen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Am akken, i wid ik id iusan a ten tneqqlev, tenniv: "ur awen ufi$ ara kwen ineqqlen". U$alen, allen feggvent seg imeîîawen, $weblen imi ur ufin ara sedqen.
verses.translation: Am akken, i wid ik id iusan a ten tneqqlev, tenniv: "ur awen ufi$ ara kwen ineqqlen". U$alen, allen feggvent seg imeîîawen, $weblen imi ur ufin ara sedqen.

verses.text: Tuzzma kan $ef wid ik issuturen tsriê, nitni d imeôkantiyen. Öuvan ad ilin akked ineggura. Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, d$a ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Tuzzma kan $ef wid ik issuturen tsriê, nitni d imeôkantiyen. Öuvan ad ilin akked ineggura. Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, d$a ur ssinen.

verses.text: Ad awen ssutren ssmaê, ma tu$alem d $uôsen. Ini: "ur ssuturet ssmaê, ur kwen numin d awez$i. Ni$ Imla ya$ Öebbi asali nnwen. Ad Iéeô Öebbi akked Umazan iS, igiten nnwen. Sinna, a ppu$alem ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".
verses.translation: Ad awen ssutren ssmaê, ma tu$alem d $uôsen. Ini: "ur ssuturet ssmaê, ur kwen numin d awez$i. Ni$ Imla ya$ Öebbi asali nnwen. Ad Iéeô Öebbi akked Umazan iS, igiten nnwen. Sinna, a ppu$alem ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".

verses.text: Ad awen gren Öebbi, mi d tu$alem $uôsen, iwakken ad asen tanfem. Wexxeôt asen; nitni, s tidep, d laâôuô; axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d aqeîîi n wayen keppben.
verses.translation: Ad awen gren Öebbi, mi d tu$alem $uôsen, iwakken ad asen tanfem. Wexxeôt asen; nitni, s tidep, d laâôuô; axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d aqeîîi n wayen keppben.

verses.text: Ad awen ggalen iwakken a ten tôavim. Ma tôuvam ten, ihi, Öebbi ur Ipôavi agdud iballa$en.
verses.translation: Ad awen ggalen iwakken a ten tôavim. Ma tôuvam ten, ihi, Öebbi ur Ipôavi agdud iballa$en.

verses.text: Aâôaben n ucluê zaden di tijehli akked nnxayel, zeggwiren ar uzgar n tilas id Issers Öebbi i Umazan iS. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Aâôaben n ucluê zaden di tijehli akked nnxayel, zeggwiren ar uzgar n tilas id Issers Öebbi i Umazan iS. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, wid iêesben ayen seddqen d tabzert. Ggunin a ppekêes fellawen teswiât. Fellasen abeddel adiran n teswiât! Öebbi Issel, Issen.
verses.translation: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, wid iêesben ayen seddqen d tabzert. Ggunin a ppekêes fellawen teswiât. Fellasen abeddel adiran n teswiât! Öebbi Issel, Issen.

verses.text: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, wid iumnen s Öebbi d wass aneggaru, êesben ayen seddqen a ten iééié ar Öebbi akked téilla Umazan. Day maççi, s tidep, d ayen ara ten iééiéen? A ten Issekcem Öebbi deg uêunu S. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, wid iumnen s Öebbi d wass aneggaru, êesben ayen seddqen a ten iééié ar Öebbi akked téilla Umazan. Day maççi, s tidep, d ayen ara ten iééiéen? A ten Issekcem Öebbi deg uêunu S. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Imenza i izwaren, seg iminigen, imâiwnen, akked wid i ten iâanden ar lewqama, Iôuva ten Öebbi, ôuvan T. Ihegga yasen d leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen, i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Imenza i izwaren, seg iminigen, imâiwnen, akked wid i ten iâanden ar lewqama, Iôuva ten Öebbi, ôuvan T. Ihegga yasen d leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen, i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, i wen d izzin, llan at sin wudmawen, akw ger imezda$ n Lmadina. Zgan di nnxayel. Ur ten tessinev. Nekwni, Nessen iten. A ten Nâaqeb berdayen, sinna, ad ppunefken i uâaqeb abarar.
verses.translation: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, i wen d izzin, llan at sin wudmawen, akw ger imezda$ n Lmadina. Zgan di nnxayel. Ur ten tessinev. Nekwni, Nessen iten. A ten Nâaqeb berdayen, sinna, ad ppunefken i uâaqeb abarar.

verses.text: Wiyad qaôôen s ibekkaven nnsen, ssemlalen igi ilhan d win nniven icemten. Izmer Öebbi ad asen Issuref. S tidep, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Wiyad qaôôen s ibekkaven nnsen, ssemlalen igi ilhan d win nniven icemten. Izmer Öebbi ad asen Issuref. S tidep, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Eddem ed ssadaqa seg wayla nnsen, a ten tezzizdeg, a ten tûeffi. èÈéal ilmend nnsen. Ih, tiéilla k d talwit nnsen. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Eddem ed ssadaqa seg wayla nnsen, a ten tezzizdeg, a ten tûeffi. èÈéal ilmend nnsen. Ih, tiéilla k d talwit nnsen. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Day ur éôin ara Öebbi, Neppa, Iqebbel asteôoaâ s$uô ixdimen iS? Ippaîaf ssadaqat. Ih, Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Day ur éôin ara Öebbi, Neppa, Iqebbel asteôoaâ s$uô ixdimen iS? Ippaîaf ssadaqat. Ih, Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ini: "xedmet! Ad Iwali igiten nnwen, Öebbi, Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Tu$alin nnwen ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".
verses.translation: Ini: "xedmet! Ad Iwali igiten nnwen, Öebbi, Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Tu$alin nnwen ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".

verses.text: Wiyav pganin lameô n Öebbi, a ten Iâaqeb, ne$ ad asen Issuref. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Wiyav pganin lameô n Öebbi, a ten Iâaqeb, ne$ ad asen Issuref. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Wid irran loamaâ i lemveôôa akked tijehli, i lefôaq ger lmumnin; d taxettalt i wid, iu$ lêal, llan pna$en Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad ggalen, war ccekk: "ay neb$a siwa lewqama". Ad Icehhed Öebbi ar nitni, s tidep, d ikeddaben.
verses.translation: Wid irran loamaâ i lemveôôa akked tijehli, i lefôaq ger lmumnin; d taxettalt i wid, iu$ lêal, llan pna$en Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad ggalen, war ccekk: "ay neb$a siwa lewqama". Ad Icehhed Öebbi ar nitni, s tidep, d ikeddaben.

verses.text: Ur ppili, degs, d awez$i. Iklal kteô, tilin ik, loamaâ ibnan $ef uêezzeb, seg wass amenzu. Degs irgazen i iêemmlen ad izdigen. Öebbi Iêemmel izedganen.
verses.translation: Ur ppili, degs, d awez$i. Iklal kteô, tilin ik, loamaâ ibnan $ef uêezzeb, seg wass amenzu. Degs irgazen i iêemmlen ad izdigen. Öebbi Iêemmel izedganen.

verses.text: Day win issersen lebni s $ef uêezzeb i Öebbi akked llza, ur yif ara win issersen lebni s $ef rrif n ucôuf ara iseggxen? Iseggex yis ar tmes n Loahennama. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
verses.translation: Day win issersen lebni s $ef uêezzeb i Öebbi akked llza, ur yif ara win issersen lebni s $ef rrif n ucôuf ara iseggxen? Iseggex yis ar tmes n Loahennama. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

verses.text: Izga lebni, bnan, ippara ccekk deg ulawen nnsen, alamma gezmen wulawen nnsen. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Izga lebni, bnan, ippara ccekk deg ulawen nnsen, alamma gezmen wulawen nnsen. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ih, Öebbi Iu$ ar lmumnin, iman nnsen akked wayla nnsen, imi Loennet i nitni. Pna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Nn$an, pwan$an. D lemâahda fellas, s tidep, di Tuôa, di Linoil akked Leqwôan. Anwa yifen Öebbi di tuîîfa n lemâahda s? Feôêet, ihi, di ssuq tsewwqem. Wagi d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi Iu$ ar lmumnin, iman nnsen akked wayla nnsen, imi Loennet i nitni. Pna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Nn$an, pwan$an. D lemâahda fellas, s tidep, di Tuôa, di Linoil akked Leqwôan. Anwa yifen Öebbi di tuîîfa n lemâahda s? Feôêet, ihi, di ssuq tsewwqem. Wagi d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Wid isteôoâen, wid iâabden, wid ipcekkiôen, ixelwiyen, wid iîîinizen, wid ikennun, wid ippamôen lewqama, wid ipgeddilen ayen n dir, wid ipêaraben $ef tlisa n Öebbi ... Becceô lmumnin.
verses.translation: Wid isteôoâen, wid iâabden, wid ipcekkiôen, ixelwiyen, wid iîîinizen, wid ikennun, wid ippamôen lewqama, wid ipgeddilen ayen n dir, wid ipêaraben $ef tlisa n Öebbi ... Becceô lmumnin.

verses.text: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi akked wid iumnen, ad ssutren ad pwasemmêen imcurak, xas ppilin asen, ma iban asen d ar, nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.
verses.translation: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi akked wid iumnen, ad ssutren ad pwasemmêen imcurak, xas ppilin asen, ma iban asen d ar, nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.

verses.text: Ibôahim ur issuter ara ad ipwasemmeê baba s, siwa ilmend n lemâahda i s ifka. Mi s d iban ar neppa d acengu n Öebbi, ifra p yides. Ibôahim, war ccekk, ippanez, iêellem.
verses.translation: Ibôahim ur issuter ara ad ipwasemmeê baba s, siwa ilmend n lemâahda i s ifka. Mi s d iban ar neppa d acengu n Öebbi, ifra p yides. Ibôahim, war ccekk, ippanez, iêellem.

verses.text: Ur p Ixeddem Öebbi, ad Itlef agdud mbaâd ma Inha ten, alamma i sen Ibeggen acu ara êezzben. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen yal cci.
verses.translation: Ur p Ixeddem Öebbi, ad Itlef agdud mbaâd ma Inha ten, alamma i sen Ibeggen acu ara êezzben. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen yal cci.

verses.text: Ih, Öebbi, IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, Issidir, Ineqq. Ur awen illi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ amâiwen.
verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi, IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, Issidir, Ineqq. Ur awen illi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ amâiwen.

verses.text: Ni$ Issuref Öebbi i Nnbi akked iminigen, akked imâiwnen i iddan yides, di lweqt uwâiô, mbaâd ma qôib nneqlaben wulawen n urbaâ segsen. Sinna, Issuref asen. Ih, Neppa, i nitni, dUmâin, d'Aênin.
verses.translation: Ni$ Issuref Öebbi i Nnbi akked iminigen, akked imâiwnen i iddan yides, di lweqt uwâiô, mbaâd ma qôib nneqlaben wulawen n urbaâ segsen. Sinna, Issuref asen. Ih, Neppa, i nitni, dUmâin, d'Aênin.

verses.text: U i krav id igwran, armi, tamurt iwsâan, tediyyeq fellasen. Vaqen deg iman nnsen. Ufan ur illi ssôan si Öebbi, siwa Neppa. Sinna, Issuref asen, akken ad steôoâen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: U i krav id igwran, armi, tamurt iwsâan, tediyyeq fellasen. Vaqen deg iman nnsen. Ufan ur illi ssôan si Öebbi, siwa Neppa. Sinna, Issuref asen, akken ad steôoâen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ilit seg imawlan n tidep.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ilit seg imawlan n tidep.

verses.text: Ur issefk ara i imezda$ n Lmadina, d wayen i sen d izzin n waâôaben n ucluê, ad gwrin deffir Umazan n Öebbi, ne$ ad smenyafen iman nnsen i iman is. Ayagi, acku ur ten ipêaz fad, ne$ âaggu, ne$ llaé, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur keçmen akal ara isserfun ijehliyen, ur ppaîîafen acemma s$uô ucengu, siwa ma dayen i sen iuran d igi n wayen ilhan. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Isôuêu arraz iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Ur issefk ara i imezda$ n Lmadina, d wayen i sen d izzin n waâôaben n ucluê, ad gwrin deffir Umazan n Öebbi, ne$ ad smenyafen iman nnsen i iman is. Ayagi, acku ur ten ipêaz fad, ne$ âaggu, ne$ llaé, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur keçmen akal ara isserfun ijehliyen, ur ppaîîafen acemma s$uô ucengu, siwa ma dayen i sen iuran d igi n wayen ilhan. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Isôuêu arraz iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Ur pûeôôifen cwiî ne$ aîas, ur zeggren asif, siwa ma iura yasen, iwakken a ten Ikafi Öebbi $ef wayen ilhan deg wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ur pûeôôifen cwiî ne$ aîas, ur zeggren asif, siwa ma iura yasen, iwakken a ten Ikafi Öebbi $ef wayen ilhan deg wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Ur Issefk ara i lmumnin ad ff$en akw. Awufan ad iffe$ ugraw si yal arbaâ, ad $bun di ddin, ad nabin agdud nnsen, mara u$alen $uôsen. Amar ad steêdren.
verses.translation: Ur Issefk ara i lmumnin ad ff$en akw. Awufan ad iffe$ ugraw si yal arbaâ, ad $bun di ddin, ad nabin agdud nnsen, mara u$alen $uôsen. Amar ad steêdren.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Nna$et ijehliyen i kwen iqeôben. Ad afen, $uôwen, teqseê. Cfut, Öebbi Ippili d wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Nna$et ijehliyen i kwen iqeôben. Ad afen, $uôwen, teqseê. Cfut, Öebbi Ippili d wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Mi d ters tsuôep, llan garasen wid iqqaôen: "anwa degwen, iwumi terna tagi, di liman"? Ma d wid iumnen, terna yasen liman, u nitni feôêen.
verses.translation: Mi d ters tsuôep, llan garasen wid iqqaôen: "anwa degwen, iwumi terna tagi, di liman"? Ma d wid iumnen, terna yasen liman, u nitni feôêen.

verses.text: Ma d wid iwumi blan wulawen, terna ammus i wammus nnsen. Mmuten u nitni d ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ma d wid iwumi blan wulawen, terna ammus i wammus nnsen. Mmuten u nitni d ijehliyen.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara, ar nitni la d sskaren lfetna, yal aseggwas, yiwen ubrid ne$ berdayen? Sinna, ur steôoiâen, ur d smektayen.
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara, ar nitni la d sskaren lfetna, yal aseggwas, yiwen ubrid ne$ berdayen? Sinna, ur steôoiâen, ur d smektayen.

verses.text: Mi d ters tsuôep, ad mesmuqalen: "day illa yiwen ikwen id Ipwalin"? Sinna, ad wexxôen. Isswexxeô Öebbi ulawen nnsen, imi nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.
verses.translation: Mi d ters tsuôep, ad mesmuqalen: "day illa yiwen ikwen id Ipwalin"? Sinna, ad wexxôen. Isswexxeô Öebbi ulawen nnsen, imi nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.

verses.text: Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan seg iman nnwen. èéay fellas laâtab nnwen. Ipêarab fellawen, d umâin, d aênin i lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan seg iman nnwen. èéay fellas laâtab nnwen. Ipêarab fellawen, d umâin, d aênin i lmumnin.

verses.text: Ma wexxôen, ini: "Iqadd iyi Öebbi. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. FellaS ppekle$. Neppa d Mass n usgeld ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Ma wexxôen, ini: "Iqadd iyi Öebbi. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. FellaS ppekle$. Neppa d Mass n usgeld ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Öebbi akked Umazan iS kksen aêeppem i imcurak ukud tâaqqdem.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi akked Umazan iS kksen aêeppem i imcurak ukud tâaqqdem.

ayahs.text: Ddut di tmurt kué wagguren. Cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Öebbi, u Öebbi ad Isdull ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ddut di tmurt kué wagguren. Cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Öebbi, u Öebbi ad Isdull ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Aberreê i medden, s$uô Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ass n êioo ameqwôaêan, ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, kksen aêeppem i imcurak. "Ma testeôoâam, ppif i kunwi, ma twexxôem, cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Öebbi". Becceô wid ijehlen s uâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Aberreê i medden, s$uô Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ass n êioo ameqwôaêan, ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, kksen aêeppem i imcurak. "Ma testeôoâam, ppif i kunwi, ma twexxôem, cfut ar kunwi ur tesfunnugem i Öebbi". Becceô wid ijehlen s uâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Kkes ed wid ukud tâaqqdem seg imcurak, sinna ur kwen bbwiven s wacemma, ur ullen yiwen mgal nnwen. Ïîfet di lemâahda nnsen ar lmudda s. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed wid ukud tâaqqdem seg imcurak, sinna ur kwen bbwiven s wacemma, ur ullen yiwen mgal nnwen. Ïîfet di lemâahda nnsen ar lmudda s. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Mi âaddan wagguren iôqan, nna$et imcurak anda ten tufam. Ïîfet pen, êeôset pen, andit asen yal taxettalt. Ma steôoâan, ééulen, zekkan, ooet asen abrid. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Mi âaddan wagguren iôqan, nna$et imcurak anda ten tufam. Ïîfet pen, êeôset pen, andit asen yal taxettalt. Ma steôoâan, ééulen, zekkan, ooet asen abrid. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ma issuter ak laânaya, yiwen seg imcurak, êareb fellas, ard issel i wawal n Öebbi, sinna, ssiwev it s amkan is n laman. Akka, acku nitni, s tidep, d agdud ur nessin.
ayahs.translation: Ma issuter ak laânaya, yiwen seg imcurak, êareb fellas, ard issel i wawal n Öebbi, sinna, ssiwev it s amkan is n laman. Akka, acku nitni, s tidep, d agdud ur nessin.

ayahs.text: Amek ara tili i imcurak, lemâahda s$uô Öebbi u s$uô Umazan iS, siwa wid tâahdem ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Skud sweqmen yidwen, sweqmet yidsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Amek ara tili i imcurak, lemâahda s$uô Öebbi u s$uô Umazan iS, siwa wid tâahdem ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam. Skud sweqmen yidwen, sweqmet yidsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Amek, mi kwen $elben, ur kwen qudôen ilmend n yi$es, ne$ n lemâahda. Öuvan kwen s imawen nnsen; ulawen nnsen ugin. Tegwti segsen d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Amek, mi kwen $elben, ur kwen qudôen ilmend n yi$es, ne$ n lemâahda. Öuvan kwen s imawen nnsen; ulawen nnsen ugin. Tegwti segsen d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: U$en s issekniyen n Öebbi ayen ôxisen. Ssefôa$en $ef ubrid iS. S tidep, ay dir wayen xeddmen nitni!
ayahs.translation: U$en s issekniyen n Öebbi ayen ôxisen. Ssefôa$en $ef ubrid iS. S tidep, ay dir wayen xeddmen nitni!

ayahs.text: Ur qudôen lmumen ilmend n yi$es, ne$ n lemâahda. Wigi, ih, d wid izegren tilas.
ayahs.translation: Ur qudôen lmumen ilmend n yi$es, ne$ n lemâahda. Wigi, ih, d wid izegren tilas.

ayahs.text: Ma steôoâan, ééulen, zekkan, d atmaten nnwen di ddin. Nepfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
ayahs.translation: Ma steôoâan, ééulen, zekkan, d atmaten nnwen di ddin. Nepfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.

ayahs.text: Ma sêenten tagalit nnsen, deffir lemâahda nnsen, u wwten di ddin nnwen, nna$et iqweôôa n tijehli. Nitni, s tidep, ur ppaîafen di tgallit. Amar ad fukken.
ayahs.translation: Ma sêenten tagalit nnsen, deffir lemâahda nnsen, u wwten di ddin nnwen, nna$et iqweôôa n tijehli. Nitni, s tidep, ur ppaîafen di tgallit. Amar ad fukken.

ayahs.text: Day ur tepna$em ara agdud i isêenten tagalit nnsen, u ib$an ad ssuff$en Amazan, u nitni heomen kwen d imezwura? Day ten tugadem? D Öebbi i iklalen a T tagwadem, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
ayahs.translation: Day ur tepna$em ara agdud i isêenten tagalit nnsen, u ib$an ad ssuff$en Amazan, u nitni heomen kwen d imezwura? Day ten tugadem? D Öebbi i iklalen a T tagwadem, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

ayahs.text: Nna$et pen, a ten Iâaqeb Öebbi s ufus nnwen, a ten Ixzu, a kwen Iserbeê fellasen, ad Icfu idmaren n ugdud n lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Nna$et pen, a ten Iâaqeb Öebbi s ufus nnwen, a ten Ixzu, a kwen Iserbeê fellasen, ad Icfu idmaren n ugdud n lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ad Ikkes urrif n wulawen nnsen. Öebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ad Ikkes urrif n wulawen nnsen. Öebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Day t$ilem a ppepwaterkem, wanag ur Iéôi Öebbi wid, degwen, ijuhden, ur neddi d imawlan, war Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked lmumnin? Öebbi Iéôa ay txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Day t$ilem a ppepwaterkem, wanag ur Iéôi Öebbi wid, degwen, ijuhden, ur neddi d imawlan, war Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked lmumnin? Öebbi Iéôa ay txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ur issefk ara i imcurak ad kecmen leowamaâ n Öebbi, ad cehhden $ef tijehli nnsen. Widak neqven igiten nnsen, di tmes ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Ur issefk ara i imcurak ad kecmen leowamaâ n Öebbi, ad cehhden $ef tijehli nnsen. Widak neqven igiten nnsen, di tmes ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Ara ikecmen kan leowamaâ n Öebbi, d wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, iééulen, izekkan, ippagwaden siwa Öebbi. Ahat wigi ad ilin seg wid ipwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Ara ikecmen kan leowamaâ n Öebbi, d wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, iééulen, izekkan, ippagwaden siwa Öebbi. Ahat wigi ad ilin seg wid ipwanhan.

ayahs.text: Day terram win i isswan iéaâlak, i ibedden i Loamaâ n Lêaôam, am win iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru u innu$ deg ubrid n Öebbi? Ur aâdilen ar Öebbi. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
ayahs.translation: Day terram win i isswan iéaâlak, i ibedden i Loamaâ n Lêaôam, am win iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru u innu$ deg ubrid n Öebbi? Ur aâdilen ar Öebbi. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen, iunagen, u nnu$en deg ubrid n Öebbi s wayla nnsen akked iman nnsen, aâlay umekkan nnsen, ar Öebbi. Wigi d wid ara irebêen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen, iunagen, u nnu$en deg ubrid n Öebbi s wayla nnsen akked iman nnsen, aâlay umekkan nnsen, ar Öebbi. Wigi d wid ara irebêen.

ayahs.text: Ibecceô iten Mass nnsen s uêunu s$uôeS, akked llza, akked leonanat, degsen ssaâd imezgi;
ayahs.translation: Ibecceô iten Mass nnsen s uêunu s$uôeS, akked llza, akked leonanat, degsen ssaâd imezgi;

ayahs.text: ad wekkôen degsen i lebda. Ih, ar Öebbi, arraz ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: ad wekkôen degsen i lebda. Ih, ar Öebbi, arraz ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d imawlan, ibabaten nnwen akked watmaten nnwen, ma smenyafen tijehli i liman. Wid segwen i ten iran d imawlan, ad ilin, nitni, d imednas.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur pparat d imawlan, ibabaten nnwen akked watmaten nnwen, ma smenyafen tijehli i liman. Wid segwen i ten iran d imawlan, ad ilin, nitni, d imednas.

ayahs.text: Ini: "maday, sennig Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked umennu$ deg ubrid iS, ay têemmlem ibabaten nnwen, tarwa nnwen, atmaten nnwen, tilawin nnwen, alag nnwen, ayla i tkesbem, ttjaôa i tugadem a ppe$li, tinezdu$in i kwen iâaoben, ihi, gganit ar d Ias Öebbi, s lameô iS. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "maday, sennig Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked umennu$ deg ubrid iS, ay têemmlem ibabaten nnwen, tarwa nnwen, atmaten nnwen, tilawin nnwen, alag nnwen, ayla i tkesbem, ttjaôa i tugadem a ppe$li, tinezdu$in i kwen iâaoben, ihi, gganit ar d Ias Öebbi, s lameô iS. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Isrebê ikwen Öebbi deg waîas imukan, akked wass n Ëunain, mi kwen taâoeb îîaqa nnwen. Ur awen d tebbwi acemma. Tamurt iwsâan, tu$al awen tediyeq. D$a tezzim d, trewlem.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Isrebê ikwen Öebbi deg waîas imukan, akked wass n Ëunain, mi kwen taâoeb îîaqa nnwen. Ur awen d tebbwi acemma. Tamurt iwsâan, tu$al awen tediyeq. D$a tezzim d, trewlem.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS $ef Umazan iS, akked lmumnin, Issers ed iâsekôiwen ur tepwalim. Iâaqeb wid ijehlen. D wagi ay d aqeîîi ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS $ef Umazan iS, akked lmumnin, Issers ed iâsekôiwen ur tepwalim. Iâaqeb wid ijehlen. D wagi ay d aqeîîi ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Sinna, deffir waya, Öebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, deffir waya, Öebbi Issuruf i win i S ihwan. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Imcurak maâfunit kan. Ur d pqeôôiben ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam, mara ifukk useggwas agi nnsen. Ma tugadem lqella, a kwen I$it Öebbi, s lfevl iS, ma ihwa yaS. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Imcurak maâfunit kan. Ur d pqeôôiben ar Loamaâ n Lêaôam, mara ifukk useggwas agi nnsen. Ma tugadem lqella, a kwen I$it Öebbi, s lfevl iS, ma ihwa yaS. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Nna$et wid ur numin ara s Öebbi, u s wass aneggaru, ur pgeddilen ayen Igdel Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur xeddmen ddin n tidep, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, alamma xelûen tabzert s war amunnu, d imejjîuêen.
ayahs.translation: Nna$et wid ur numin ara s Öebbi, u s wass aneggaru, ur pgeddilen ayen Igdel Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur xeddmen ddin n tidep, seg wid iwumi teppunefk Tezmamt, alamma xelûen tabzert s war amunnu, d imejjîuêen.

ayahs.text: Nnan wudayen: "Âuzayeô d mmi S n Öebbi". Nnan imasiêiyen: "lmasiê d mmi S n Öebbi". Ayagi, nnan t id s imawen nnsen. Ppaâwaden d awal n wid ijehlen, n zik. A ten Ine$ Öebbi! Acêal îeôôifen!
ayahs.translation: Nnan wudayen: "Âuzayeô d mmi S n Öebbi". Nnan imasiêiyen: "lmasiê d mmi S n Öebbi". Ayagi, nnan t id s imawen nnsen. Ppaâwaden d awal n wid ijehlen, n zik. A ten Ine$ Öebbi! Acêal îeôôifen!

ayahs.text: Rran lquôôaê nnsen, ixelwiyen nnsen, lmasiê mmi s n Meryem, d imawlan war Öebbi. Pwamôen kan ad âabden Öebbi Yiwen; ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Gedha syiS, seg wayen pcaraken!
ayahs.translation: Rran lquôôaê nnsen, ixelwiyen nnsen, lmasiê mmi s n Meryem, d imawlan war Öebbi. Pwamôen kan ad âabden Öebbi Yiwen; ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Gedha syiS, seg wayen pcaraken!

ayahs.text: B$an s yimawen nnsen ad ssexsin tafat n Öebbi. I Ib$a Öebbi, ad Itim kan tafat iS, di nneqwma ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: B$an s yimawen nnsen ad ssexsin tafat n Öebbi. I Ib$a Öebbi, ad Itim kan tafat iS, di nneqwma ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: D Neppa id Iuznen Amazan iS, s nnhaya akked ddin n tidep, iwakken a t Issifer $ef ddin meôôa, xas ugin ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa id Iuznen Amazan iS, s nnhaya akked ddin n tidep, iwakken a t Issifer $ef ddin meôôa, xas ugin ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Aîas n lqweôôaê d ixelwiyen, s tidep, teppen d aêerfi ayla n medden. U îeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Wid ixeznen ddheb d lfeîîa, ur ten pseddiqen deg ubrid n Öebbi, becceô iten s uâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Aîas n lqweôôaê d ixelwiyen, s tidep, teppen d aêerfi ayla n medden. U îeôôifen seg ubrid n Öebbi. Wid ixeznen ddheb d lfeîîa, ur ten pseddiqen deg ubrid n Öebbi, becceô iten s uâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara ô$en di tmes n Loahennama, ad kwin, yissen, inyiren nnsen, ibeôdiyen nnsen, iârar nnsen. "D ayagi ay txezznem i iman nnwen. Jeôôbet ayen txezznem!"
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara ô$en di tmes n Loahennama, ad kwin, yissen, inyiren nnsen, ibeôdiyen nnsen, iârar nnsen. "D ayagi ay txezznem i iman nnwen. Jeôôbet ayen txezznem!"

ayahs.text: Ih, ar Öebbi, amvan n wagguren: mrawsin; di Tezmamt n Öebbi, ass ideg Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan. Garasen, kué ôqan. D wagi ay d ddin n ddwam. Ur ddenniset iman nnwen degsen. Nna$et ijehliyen $ef ccfa, akken i kwen nnu$en $ef ccfa. Cfut, Öebbi Iteddu d wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ar Öebbi, amvan n wagguren: mrawsin; di Tezmamt n Öebbi, ass ideg Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan. Garasen, kué ôqan. D wagi ay d ddin n ddwam. Ur ddenniset iman nnwen degsen. Nna$et ijehliyen $ef ccfa, akken i kwen nnu$en $ef ccfa. Cfut, Öebbi Iteddu d wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Aswexxeô n waggur d timerniwt kan n tijehli. Nnetlafen yis wid ijehlen. Aseggwas a t êellen, aseggwas a t gedlen, iwakken ad wafqen amvan n wayen Igdel Öebbi. Ad êellen ayen Igdel Öebbi. Âaoben ten yir igiten nnsen. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Aswexxeô n waggur d timerniwt kan n tijehli. Nnetlafen yis wid ijehlen. Aseggwas a t êellen, aseggwas a t gedlen, iwakken ad wafqen amvan n wayen Igdel Öebbi. Ad êellen ayen Igdel Öebbi. Âaoben ten yir igiten nnsen. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Acu kwen iu$en? Ma nnan awen: "hejjmet ar ubrid n Öebbi", a ppebrum i iman nnwen. Day kwen taâoeb tmeddurt n ddunit, sennig tin n laxeôt? Zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit d amejîiîuê kan, zdat win n laxeôt.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Acu kwen iu$en? Ma nnan awen: "hejjmet ar ubrid n Öebbi", a ppebrum i iman nnwen. Day kwen taâoeb tmeddurt n ddunit, sennig tin n laxeôt? Zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit d amejîiîuê kan, zdat win n laxeôt.

ayahs.text: Ma ur tehjjimem ara, a kwen Iâaqeb s lqeôê, a d Iawi agdud nniven, deg umekkan nnwen. Ur T teîîuôum s wacemma. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ma ur tehjjimem ara, a kwen Iâaqeb s lqeôê, a d Iawi agdud nniven, deg umekkan nnwen. Ur T teîîuôum s wacemma. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ma ur t tsellkem, ihi, Isellek it Öebbi, mi t ssuff$en wid ijehlen. Wissin n sin, mi llan deg ifri, mi inna i umeddakwel is: "kkes a$wbel, Öebbi, s tidep, yidne$". Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS fellas, Iâawen it s iâsekriwen, ur ten twalam. Isse$li mavi awal n wid ijehlen. Awal n Öebbi, neppa, aâlay sennig akw. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ma ur t tsellkem, ihi, Isellek it Öebbi, mi t ssuff$en wid ijehlen. Wissin n sin, mi llan deg ifri, mi inna i umeddakwel is: "kkes a$wbel, Öebbi, s tidep, yidne$". Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS fellas, Iâawen it s iâsekriwen, ur ten twalam. Isse$li mavi awal n wid ijehlen. Awal n Öebbi, neppa, aâlay sennig akw. Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Hejjmet fessusit u ééayit, juhdet s wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ppif wakka i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.
ayahs.translation: Hejjmet fessusit u ééayit, juhdet s wayla nnwen akked yiman nnwen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ppif wakka i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.

ayahs.text: Lemmer d aba$uô isehlen, d inig wezzilen, yili vefôen k in. Maca, $wezzif fellasen umecwaô. Ad ggalen s Öebbi: "lemmer nezmir, yili neffe$ yidwen". Nn$an iman nnsen, Öebbi Iéôa ar nitni, war ccekk, d ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer d aba$uô isehlen, d inig wezzilen, yili vefôen k in. Maca, $wezzif fellasen umecwaô. Ad ggalen s Öebbi: "lemmer nezmir, yili neffe$ yidwen". Nn$an iman nnsen, Öebbi Iéôa ar nitni, war ccekk, d ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: Ad ak Isemmeê Öebbi! Acimi i sen tserêev? Ard ak d iban anwi innan tidep, a ppissinev ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: Ad ak Isemmeê Öebbi! Acimi i sen tserêev? Ard ak d iban anwi innan tidep, a ppissinev ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: Ur ak d ssutren ara tsriê, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, mi juhden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Öebbi Issen wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Ur ak d ssutren ara tsriê, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru, mi juhden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Öebbi Issen wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: I k issutren tsriê, d wid ur numin s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Cukken wulawen nnsen, d$a, s ucukku nnsen, kukran.
ayahs.translation: I k issutren tsriê, d wid ur numin s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Cukken wulawen nnsen, d$a, s ucukku nnsen, kukran.

ayahs.text: Lemmer b$in tuff$a, yili heggan as d ayen ilaqen. Maca, Iugi Öebbi ad ppucegâan, Iurez iten. Nnan asen: "qqimet d wid iqqimen".
ayahs.translation: Lemmer b$in tuff$a, yili heggan as d ayen ilaqen. Maca, Iugi Öebbi ad ppucegâan, Iurez iten. Nnan asen: "qqimet d wid iqqimen".

ayahs.text: Lemmer ffi$en yidwen, ar awen rnun siwa ccwal. War ccekk, ad kecmen garawen, b$an ahewwel nnwen. Kra segwen ssemêasen asen. Öebbi Issen imednas.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer ffi$en yidwen, ar awen rnun siwa ccwal. War ccekk, ad kecmen garawen, b$an ahewwel nnwen. Kra segwen ssemêasen asen. Öebbi Issen imednas.

ayahs.text: Ni$ b$an, si zik, ahewwel. Sxeôben ak lumuô, armi d tusa tidep. Ivehô ed lameô n Öebbi, nitni ur b$in.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ b$an, si zik, ahewwel. Sxeôben ak lumuô, armi d tusa tidep. Ivehô ed lameô n Öebbi, nitni ur b$in.

ayahs.text: Garasen win id innan: "serreê iyi, ur iyi gar di lfetna"! Day ur $lin ara di lfetna? Loahennama, s tidep, a ppezzi i ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Garasen win id innan: "serreê iyi, ur iyi gar di lfetna"! Day ur $lin ara di lfetna? Loahennama, s tidep, a ppezzi i ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ma iusa k id yise$ ad $weblen. Ma tusa k id twa$it, ad inin: "ni$, iu$ lêal, neqva lameô nne$". Ad wexxôen, zzhan.
ayahs.translation: Ma iusa k id yise$ ad $weblen. Ma tusa k id twa$it, ad inin: "ni$, iu$ lêal, neqva lameô nne$". Ad wexxôen, zzhan.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur a$ ipêaz wacemma, siwa ayen i $ Iura Öebbi". Neppa d Bab nne$. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur a$ ipêaz wacemma, siwa ayen i $ Iura Öebbi". Neppa d Bab nne$. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ini: "acu teggunim ad ivôu yidne$, siwa yiwen si sin ise$iyen? Nekwni negguni a kwen Iwwet Öebbi, s uâaqeb ara d iasen s$uôeS, ne$ seg ifassen nne$. Ihi gganit, nekwni a neggani yidwen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "acu teggunim ad ivôu yidne$, siwa yiwen si sin ise$iyen? Nekwni negguni a kwen Iwwet Öebbi, s uâaqeb ara d iasen s$uôeS, ne$ seg ifassen nne$. Ihi gganit, nekwni a neggani yidwen".

ayahs.text: Ini: "seddqet, teb$am ne$ tugim, d ayen ur neppwaqbal segwen, d awez$i. Kunwi, s tidep, d agdud iballa$en".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "seddqet, teb$am ne$ tugim, d ayen ur neppwaqbal segwen, d awez$i. Kunwi, s tidep, d agdud iballa$en".

ayahs.text: Ay sen ikksen a tepwaqbal ssadaqa nnsen, imi kan jehlen, s tidep, ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u s laâgez kan ay d ppasen ar tpéallit, s usmiglez kan ay pseddiqen.
ayahs.translation: Ay sen ikksen a tepwaqbal ssadaqa nnsen, imi kan jehlen, s tidep, ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u s laâgez kan ay d ppasen ar tpéallit, s usmiglez kan ay pseddiqen.

ayahs.text: Ur k ippaâoab wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Ib$a kan Öebbi a ten Iâaqeb yissen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ad iffe$ ôôuê nnsen, nitni d ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ur k ippaâoab wayla nnsen, ne$ tarwa nnsen. Ib$a kan Öebbi a ten Iâaqeb yissen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ad iffe$ ôôuê nnsen, nitni d ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ad ggalen s Öebbi, ar nitni, war ccekk, segwen. Ur nitni segwen, maca d agdud iugaden.
ayahs.translation: Ad ggalen s Öebbi, ar nitni, war ccekk, segwen. Ur nitni segwen, maca d agdud iugaden.

ayahs.text: Lemmer ad afen ssôan, ne$ ifran, ne$ anda ara kecmen, ad ôuêen $uôes s tazla.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer ad afen ssôan, ne$ ifran, ne$ anda ara kecmen, ad ôuêen $uôes s tazla.

ayahs.text: Garasen, wid ikkaten deg k, $ef ssadaqat. Ma ippunefk asen segsent, ad ôavin, ma ur asen ippunefk, ad neêwen.
ayahs.translation: Garasen, wid ikkaten deg k, $ef ssadaqat. Ma ippunefk asen segsent, ad ôavin, ma ur asen ippunefk, ad neêwen.

ayahs.text: Lemmer nitni, s tidep, ôuvan ayen i sen Ifka Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u nnan d: "nesteqnaâ s Öebbi. Ad a$ d Ifk, si lfevl iS, Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ih, d Öebbi i$ef neô$eb".
ayahs.translation: Lemmer nitni, s tidep, ôuvan ayen i sen Ifka Öebbi akked Umazan iS, u nnan d: "nesteqnaâ s Öebbi. Ad a$ d Ifk, si lfevl iS, Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ih, d Öebbi i$ef neô$eb".

ayahs.text: Ssadaqat siwa i ime$ban, iéawaliyen, i wid ice$wlen degsent, i usemlili n wulawen, i userreê imeêbas, i imeîîulba, i ubrid n Öebbi, i win d ifka ubrid. D aêeppem s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ssadaqat siwa i ime$ban, iéawaliyen, i wid ice$wlen degsent, i usemlili n wulawen, i userreê imeêbas, i imeîîulba, i ubrid n Öebbi, i win d ifka ubrid. D aêeppem s$uô Öebbi. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Garasen, wid icettmen deg Umazan, qqaôen: "neppa d aêessas". Ini: "d aêessas n lxiô i kunwi. Iumen s Öebbi, iumen lmumnin. D aêunu i wid iumnen segwen". I wid icettmen deg Umazan n Öebbi, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Garasen, wid icettmen deg Umazan, qqaôen: "neppa d aêessas". Ini: "d aêessas n lxiô i kunwi. Iumen s Öebbi, iumen lmumnin. D aêunu i wid iumnen segwen". I wid icettmen deg Umazan n Öebbi, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ad awen ggalen s Öebbi, iwakken a kwen ôavin. Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Iklal kteô a T ôavin, lemmer llin d lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ad awen ggalen s Öebbi, iwakken a kwen ôavin. Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Iklal kteô a T ôavin, lemmer llin d lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Day ur éôin ara ar, win ixuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, i neppa times n Loahennama, ad iwekkeô degs? D wagi ay d ddell abarar.
ayahs.translation: Day ur éôin ara ar, win ixuûmen Öebbi akked Umazan iS, i neppa times n Loahennama, ad iwekkeô degs? D wagi ay d ddell abarar.

ayahs.text: Ixabiten ugaden ad asen d ters tsuôep, ad asen tessken i illan deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "mmaâlket. Öebbi, s tidep, a d Issuffe$ ayen tugadem".
ayahs.translation: Ixabiten ugaden ad asen d ters tsuôep, ad asen tessken i illan deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "mmaâlket. Öebbi, s tidep, a d Issuffe$ ayen tugadem".

ayahs.text: Ma testeqsav ten, a d inin, war ccekk: "la nheddeô kan, nepqessiô". Ini: "day la tettihim di Öebbi akked issekniyen iS, akked Umazan iS?
ayahs.translation: Ma testeqsav ten, a d inin, war ccekk: "la nheddeô kan, nepqessiô". Ini: "day la tettihim di Öebbi akked issekniyen iS, akked Umazan iS?

ayahs.text: Ur steôoiâat. Ni$ tu$alem ar tijehli, deffir liman nnwen". Ma Nsemmeê i urbaâ segwen, a Naâqeb arbaâ, imi nitni llan d ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: Ur steôoiâat. Ni$ tu$alem ar tijehli, deffir liman nnwen". Ma Nsemmeê i urbaâ segwen, a Naâqeb arbaâ, imi nitni llan d ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: Ixabiten akked txabitin, wa ippameô i wa, ayen n dir, ppemyegdalen lewqama, pcuddun ifassen nnsen. Ppun Öebbi, Ippu ten. Ih, ixabiten d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Ixabiten akked txabitin, wa ippameô i wa, ayen n dir, ppemyegdalen lewqama, pcuddun ifassen nnsen. Ppun Öebbi, Ippu ten. Ih, ixabiten d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Iwaââed Öebbi, i ixabiten, txabitin, akked ijehliyen, times n Loahennama, degs ad wekkôen. Beôka ten. Ixza ten Öebbi. Fellasen aâaqeb imezgi,
ayahs.translation: Iwaââed Öebbi, i ixabiten, txabitin, akked ijehliyen, times n Loahennama, degs ad wekkôen. Beôka ten. Ixza ten Öebbi. Fellasen aâaqeb imezgi,

ayahs.text: am imezwura nnwen. Llan ifen kwen tazmert, $elben kwen ayla, tarwa. Zhan deg umur nnsen, tezham deg umur nnwen, akken zhan imezwura nnwen deg umur nnsen. Teccvem akken ccven nitni. Widak, mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeôt. Widak d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: am imezwura nnwen. Llan ifen kwen tazmert, $elben kwen ayla, tarwa. Zhan deg umur nnsen, tezham deg umur nnwen, akken zhan imezwura nnwen deg umur nnsen. Teccvem akken ccven nitni. Widak, mêan igiten nnsen di ddunit, di laxeôt. Widak d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Day ur ten id iusa ara usali imezwura nnsen? Agdud n Nuê, Âad, Tamud, agdud n Ibôahim, At Median, tid ippin. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen. Ur ten Idennis Öebbi, maca llan dennisen iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Day ur ten id iusa ara usali imezwura nnsen? Agdud n Nuê, Âad, Tamud, agdud n Ibôahim, At Median, tid ippin. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen. Ur ten Idennis Öebbi, maca llan dennisen iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, d imeddukal wa n wa. Ppamôen lewqama, pgeddilen ayen n dir. Péallan, pzekkin, ppa$en awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Wigi, ad Iêun Öebbi fellasen. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, d imeddukal wa n wa. Ppamôen lewqama, pgeddilen ayen n dir. Péallan, pzekkin, ppa$en awal i Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Wigi, ad Iêun Öebbi fellasen. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Iwaââed Öebbi i lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen; ixxamen igerzen di leonanat n Âaden, akked llza s$uô Öebbi - iten i$elben akw -. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Iwaââed Öebbi i lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen; ixxamen igerzen di leonanat n Âaden, akked llza s$uô Öebbi - iten i$elben akw -. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Jahed ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Iqsiê $uôsen. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d taggara tucmip!
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Jahed ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Iqsiê $uôsen. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d taggara tucmip!

ayahs.text: Ggulen s Öebbi ur d nnin, wanag nnan awal n tijehli. Jehlen deffir wannuz nnsen. Vemâen ayen iwumi ur wâan. Ur êzinen imi iten I$at, si lfevl iS, Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma steôoâen, yif it i nitni. Ma wexxôen, a ten Iâaqeb Öebbi s leqôeê, di ddunit, di laxeôt. Ur sâun, di tmurt, bab ne$ amâiwen.
ayahs.translation: Ggulen s Öebbi ur d nnin, wanag nnan awal n tijehli. Jehlen deffir wannuz nnsen. Vemâen ayen iwumi ur wâan. Ur êzinen imi iten I$at, si lfevl iS, Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma steôoâen, yif it i nitni. Ma wexxôen, a ten Iâaqeb Öebbi s leqôeê, di ddunit, di laxeôt. Ur sâun, di tmurt, bab ne$ amâiwen.

ayahs.text: Garasen, wid iâahden Öebbi: "ma Ifka ya$ d, si lfevl iS, a nseddeq, a nili si lâuûam".
ayahs.translation: Garasen, wid iâahden Öebbi: "ma Ifka ya$ d, si lfevl iS, a nseddeq, a nili si lâuûam".

ayahs.text: Mi sen Ifka si lfevl iS, a t bexwlen, ad wexxôen, ad namren.
ayahs.translation: Mi sen Ifka si lfevl iS, a t bexwlen, ad wexxôen, ad namren.

ayahs.text: Issegwra yasen d tanaâuôt deg ulawen nnsen, ar ass ideg ara mlilen yideS, imi xed$an Öebbi deg wayen i S âahden, imi llan skiddiben.
ayahs.translation: Issegwra yasen d tanaâuôt deg ulawen nnsen, ar ass ideg ara mlilen yideS, imi xed$an Öebbi deg wayen i S âahden, imi llan skiddiben.

ayahs.text: Day ur éôin ara Öebbi Issen sser nnsen akked wayen qqaôen u, ar Öebbi Issen tibavniyin?
ayahs.translation: Day ur éôin ara Öebbi Issen sser nnsen akked wayen qqaôen u, ar Öebbi Issen tibavniyin?

ayahs.text: Wid ipqeôôiven di lmumnin i ib$an ad seddqen, u deg wid i iufan siwa tazmert nnsen, d$a ttihin fellasen; ad Ittihi Öebbi fellasen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Wid ipqeôôiven di lmumnin i ib$an ad seddqen, u deg wid i iufan siwa tazmert nnsen, d$a ttihin fellasen; ad Ittihi Öebbi fellasen. Fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ssuter ad ppusemmêen, ne$ qqim. Ma tessutrev ûavet iberdan, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, d awez$i. Akka, imi nitni jehlen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Ssuter ad ppusemmêen, ne$ qqim. Ma tessutrev ûavet iberdan, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, d awez$i. Akka, imi nitni jehlen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Wid igwran, feôêen mi llan deffir Umazan n Öebbi. Ugin ad nna$en s wayla nnsen akked teôwiêt nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Nnan: "Ur pôuêut deg una$uô". Ini: "times n Loahennama teêma kteô, lemmer day fehhmen".
ayahs.translation: Wid igwran, feôêen mi llan deffir Umazan n Öebbi. Ugin ad nna$en s wayla nnsen akked teôwiêt nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Nnan: "Ur pôuêut deg una$uô". Ini: "times n Loahennama teêma kteô, lemmer day fehhmen".

ayahs.text: Anef ad vsen cwiî, ad run aîas, d aqeîîi n wayen keppben.
ayahs.translation: Anef ad vsen cwiî, ad run aîas, d aqeîîi n wayen keppben.

ayahs.text: Ma Irra k id Öebbi ar urbaâ segsen, u ssutren ak d tsriê ad ff$en, ini: "d awez$i, ur teppeff$em yidi, ur tepna$em acengu yidi. Akken, kunwi, iâoeb ikwen i$imi, abrid amenzu, ihi, qqimet akked ineggura.
ayahs.translation: Ma Irra k id Öebbi ar urbaâ segsen, u ssutren ak d tsriê ad ff$en, ini: "d awez$i, ur teppeff$em yidi, ur tepna$em acengu yidi. Akken, kunwi, iâoeb ikwen i$imi, abrid amenzu, ihi, qqimet akked ineggura.

ayahs.text: Ur péalla $ef yiwen degsen, ma immut, d awez$i. Ur pbedda ar tenîelt is. Nitni, s tidep, jehlen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, mmuten nitni d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Ur péalla $ef yiwen degsen, ma immut, d awez$i. Ur pbedda ar tenîelt is. Nitni, s tidep, jehlen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, mmuten nitni d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Ur k ippaâoab wayla nnsen, ne$ dderya nnsen. Öebbi Ib$a kan a ten Iâaqeb yissen di ddunit, ad asen teffe$ taôwiêt nitni d ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ur k ippaâoab wayla nnsen, ne$ dderya nnsen. Öebbi Ib$a kan a ten Iâaqeb yissen di ddunit, ad asen teffe$ taôwiêt nitni d ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ma ters ed tsuôep: "amnet s Öebbi, jahdet akked Umazan iS", imeôkantiyen nnsen a k ssutren tsriê, ad inin: "anef ane$ ar wid iqqimen".
ayahs.translation: Ma ters ed tsuôep: "amnet s Öebbi, jahdet akked Umazan iS", imeôkantiyen nnsen a k ssutren tsriê, ad inin: "anef ane$ ar wid iqqimen".

ayahs.text: Öuvan ad ilin akked wid igwran. Ppusel$en wulawen nnsen, ur fehhmen.
ayahs.translation: Öuvan ad ilin akked wid igwran. Ppusel$en wulawen nnsen, ur fehhmen.

ayahs.text: Maca, amazan akked wid iumnen yides, jehden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Widak, nnsen lxiô. Widak, d nitni ara irebêen.
ayahs.translation: Maca, amazan akked wid iumnen yides, jehden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Widak, nnsen lxiô. Widak, d nitni ara irebêen.

ayahs.text: Ihegga yasen d Öebbi leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Ihegga yasen d Öebbi leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Wid id iufan ssebba, seg waâôaben n ucluê, usan d, ad asen ifk tsriê. Wid iskaddben Öebbi akked Umazan iS, qqimen. Wid ijehlen, segsen, ad sâaddin aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Wid id iufan ssebba, seg waâôaben n ucluê, usan d, ad asen ifk tsriê. Wid iskaddben Öebbi akked Umazan iS, qqimen. Wid ijehlen, segsen, ad sâaddin aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ur telli tuzzma $ef uôhifen, imuvan, wid ur nufi ara fken, ma neûêen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur telli tuzzma $ef iâaôviyen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ur telli tuzzma $ef uôhifen, imuvan, wid ur nufi ara fken, ma neûêen ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ur telli tuzzma $ef iâaôviyen. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Am akken, i wid ik id iusan a ten tneqqlev, tenniv: "ur awen ufi$ ara kwen ineqqlen". U$alen, allen feggvent seg imeîîawen, $weblen imi ur ufin ara sedqen.
ayahs.translation: Am akken, i wid ik id iusan a ten tneqqlev, tenniv: "ur awen ufi$ ara kwen ineqqlen". U$alen, allen feggvent seg imeîîawen, $weblen imi ur ufin ara sedqen.

ayahs.text: Tuzzma kan $ef wid ik issuturen tsriê, nitni d imeôkantiyen. Öuvan ad ilin akked ineggura. Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, d$a ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Tuzzma kan $ef wid ik issuturen tsriê, nitni d imeôkantiyen. Öuvan ad ilin akked ineggura. Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, d$a ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Ad awen ssutren ssmaê, ma tu$alem d $uôsen. Ini: "ur ssuturet ssmaê, ur kwen numin d awez$i. Ni$ Imla ya$ Öebbi asali nnwen. Ad Iéeô Öebbi akked Umazan iS, igiten nnwen. Sinna, a ppu$alem ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".
ayahs.translation: Ad awen ssutren ssmaê, ma tu$alem d $uôsen. Ini: "ur ssuturet ssmaê, ur kwen numin d awez$i. Ni$ Imla ya$ Öebbi asali nnwen. Ad Iéeô Öebbi akked Umazan iS, igiten nnwen. Sinna, a ppu$alem ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".

ayahs.text: Ad awen gren Öebbi, mi d tu$alem $uôsen, iwakken ad asen tanfem. Wexxeôt asen; nitni, s tidep, d laâôuô; axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d aqeîîi n wayen keppben.
ayahs.translation: Ad awen gren Öebbi, mi d tu$alem $uôsen, iwakken ad asen tanfem. Wexxeôt asen; nitni, s tidep, d laâôuô; axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d aqeîîi n wayen keppben.

ayahs.text: Ad awen ggalen iwakken a ten tôavim. Ma tôuvam ten, ihi, Öebbi ur Ipôavi agdud iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Ad awen ggalen iwakken a ten tôavim. Ma tôuvam ten, ihi, Öebbi ur Ipôavi agdud iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Aâôaben n ucluê zaden di tijehli akked nnxayel, zeggwiren ar uzgar n tilas id Issers Öebbi i Umazan iS. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Aâôaben n ucluê zaden di tijehli akked nnxayel, zeggwiren ar uzgar n tilas id Issers Öebbi i Umazan iS. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, wid iêesben ayen seddqen d tabzert. Ggunin a ppekêes fellawen teswiât. Fellasen abeddel adiran n teswiât! Öebbi Issel, Issen.
ayahs.translation: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, wid iêesben ayen seddqen d tabzert. Ggunin a ppekêes fellawen teswiât. Fellasen abeddel adiran n teswiât! Öebbi Issel, Issen.

ayahs.text: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, wid iumnen s Öebbi d wass aneggaru, êesben ayen seddqen a ten iééié ar Öebbi akked téilla Umazan. Day maççi, s tidep, d ayen ara ten iééiéen? A ten Issekcem Öebbi deg uêunu S. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, wid iumnen s Öebbi d wass aneggaru, êesben ayen seddqen a ten iééié ar Öebbi akked téilla Umazan. Day maççi, s tidep, d ayen ara ten iééiéen? A ten Issekcem Öebbi deg uêunu S. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Imenza i izwaren, seg iminigen, imâiwnen, akked wid i ten iâanden ar lewqama, Iôuva ten Öebbi, ôuvan T. Ihegga yasen d leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen, i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Imenza i izwaren, seg iminigen, imâiwnen, akked wid i ten iâanden ar lewqama, Iôuva ten Öebbi, ôuvan T. Ihegga yasen d leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen degsen, i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, i wen d izzin, llan at sin wudmawen, akw ger imezda$ n Lmadina. Zgan di nnxayel. Ur ten tessinev. Nekwni, Nessen iten. A ten Nâaqeb berdayen, sinna, ad ppunefken i uâaqeb abarar.
ayahs.translation: Ger waâôaben n ucluê, i wen d izzin, llan at sin wudmawen, akw ger imezda$ n Lmadina. Zgan di nnxayel. Ur ten tessinev. Nekwni, Nessen iten. A ten Nâaqeb berdayen, sinna, ad ppunefken i uâaqeb abarar.

ayahs.text: Wiyad qaôôen s ibekkaven nnsen, ssemlalen igi ilhan d win nniven icemten. Izmer Öebbi ad asen Issuref. S tidep, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Wiyad qaôôen s ibekkaven nnsen, ssemlalen igi ilhan d win nniven icemten. Izmer Öebbi ad asen Issuref. S tidep, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Eddem ed ssadaqa seg wayla nnsen, a ten tezzizdeg, a ten tûeffi. èÈéal ilmend nnsen. Ih, tiéilla k d talwit nnsen. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Eddem ed ssadaqa seg wayla nnsen, a ten tezzizdeg, a ten tûeffi. èÈéal ilmend nnsen. Ih, tiéilla k d talwit nnsen. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Day ur éôin ara Öebbi, Neppa, Iqebbel asteôoaâ s$uô ixdimen iS? Ippaîaf ssadaqat. Ih, Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Day ur éôin ara Öebbi, Neppa, Iqebbel asteôoaâ s$uô ixdimen iS? Ippaîaf ssadaqat. Ih, Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ini: "xedmet! Ad Iwali igiten nnwen, Öebbi, Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Tu$alin nnwen ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "xedmet! Ad Iwali igiten nnwen, Öebbi, Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Tu$alin nnwen ar Umusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir, ad awen Imel ayen txeddmem".

ayahs.text: Wiyav pganin lameô n Öebbi, a ten Iâaqeb, ne$ ad asen Issuref. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Wiyav pganin lameô n Öebbi, a ten Iâaqeb, ne$ ad asen Issuref. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Wid irran loamaâ i lemveôôa akked tijehli, i lefôaq ger lmumnin; d taxettalt i wid, iu$ lêal, llan pna$en Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad ggalen, war ccekk: "ay neb$a siwa lewqama". Ad Icehhed Öebbi ar nitni, s tidep, d ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: Wid irran loamaâ i lemveôôa akked tijehli, i lefôaq ger lmumnin; d taxettalt i wid, iu$ lêal, llan pna$en Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad ggalen, war ccekk: "ay neb$a siwa lewqama". Ad Icehhed Öebbi ar nitni, s tidep, d ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: Ur ppili, degs, d awez$i. Iklal kteô, tilin ik, loamaâ ibnan $ef uêezzeb, seg wass amenzu. Degs irgazen i iêemmlen ad izdigen. Öebbi Iêemmel izedganen.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppili, degs, d awez$i. Iklal kteô, tilin ik, loamaâ ibnan $ef uêezzeb, seg wass amenzu. Degs irgazen i iêemmlen ad izdigen. Öebbi Iêemmel izedganen.

ayahs.text: Day win issersen lebni s $ef uêezzeb i Öebbi akked llza, ur yif ara win issersen lebni s $ef rrif n ucôuf ara iseggxen? Iseggex yis ar tmes n Loahennama. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
ayahs.translation: Day win issersen lebni s $ef uêezzeb i Öebbi akked llza, ur yif ara win issersen lebni s $ef rrif n ucôuf ara iseggxen? Iseggex yis ar tmes n Loahennama. Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

ayahs.text: Izga lebni, bnan, ippara ccekk deg ulawen nnsen, alamma gezmen wulawen nnsen. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Izga lebni, bnan, ippara ccekk deg ulawen nnsen, alamma gezmen wulawen nnsen. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi Iu$ ar lmumnin, iman nnsen akked wayla nnsen, imi Loennet i nitni. Pna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Nn$an, pwan$an. D lemâahda fellas, s tidep, di Tuôa, di Linoil akked Leqwôan. Anwa yifen Öebbi di tuîîfa n lemâahda s? Feôêet, ihi, di ssuq tsewwqem. Wagi d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi Iu$ ar lmumnin, iman nnsen akked wayla nnsen, imi Loennet i nitni. Pna$en deg ubrid n Öebbi. Nn$an, pwan$an. D lemâahda fellas, s tidep, di Tuôa, di Linoil akked Leqwôan. Anwa yifen Öebbi di tuîîfa n lemâahda s? Feôêet, ihi, di ssuq tsewwqem. Wagi d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Wid isteôoâen, wid iâabden, wid ipcekkiôen, ixelwiyen, wid iîîinizen, wid ikennun, wid ippamôen lewqama, wid ipgeddilen ayen n dir, wid ipêaraben $ef tlisa n Öebbi ... Becceô lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Wid isteôoâen, wid iâabden, wid ipcekkiôen, ixelwiyen, wid iîîinizen, wid ikennun, wid ippamôen lewqama, wid ipgeddilen ayen n dir, wid ipêaraben $ef tlisa n Öebbi ... Becceô lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi akked wid iumnen, ad ssutren ad pwasemmêen imcurak, xas ppilin asen, ma iban asen d ar, nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.
ayahs.translation: Ur issefk ara i Nnbi akked wid iumnen, ad ssutren ad pwasemmêen imcurak, xas ppilin asen, ma iban asen d ar, nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.

ayahs.text: Ibôahim ur issuter ara ad ipwasemmeê baba s, siwa ilmend n lemâahda i s ifka. Mi s d iban ar neppa d acengu n Öebbi, ifra p yides. Ibôahim, war ccekk, ippanez, iêellem.
ayahs.translation: Ibôahim ur issuter ara ad ipwasemmeê baba s, siwa ilmend n lemâahda i s ifka. Mi s d iban ar neppa d acengu n Öebbi, ifra p yides. Ibôahim, war ccekk, ippanez, iêellem.

ayahs.text: Ur p Ixeddem Öebbi, ad Itlef agdud mbaâd ma Inha ten, alamma i sen Ibeggen acu ara êezzben. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ur p Ixeddem Öebbi, ad Itlef agdud mbaâd ma Inha ten, alamma i sen Ibeggen acu ara êezzben. Öebbi, s tidep, Issen yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi, IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, Issidir, Ineqq. Ur awen illi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ amâiwen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi, IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan, Issidir, Ineqq. Ur awen illi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ amâiwen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Issuref Öebbi i Nnbi akked iminigen, akked imâiwnen i iddan yides, di lweqt uwâiô, mbaâd ma qôib nneqlaben wulawen n urbaâ segsen. Sinna, Issuref asen. Ih, Neppa, i nitni, dUmâin, d'Aênin.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Issuref Öebbi i Nnbi akked iminigen, akked imâiwnen i iddan yides, di lweqt uwâiô, mbaâd ma qôib nneqlaben wulawen n urbaâ segsen. Sinna, Issuref asen. Ih, Neppa, i nitni, dUmâin, d'Aênin.

ayahs.text: U i krav id igwran, armi, tamurt iwsâan, tediyyeq fellasen. Vaqen deg iman nnsen. Ufan ur illi ssôan si Öebbi, siwa Neppa. Sinna, Issuref asen, akken ad steôoâen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: U i krav id igwran, armi, tamurt iwsâan, tediyyeq fellasen. Vaqen deg iman nnsen. Ufan ur illi ssôan si Öebbi, siwa Neppa. Sinna, Issuref asen, akken ad steôoâen. Öebbi, s tidep, Issuruf, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ilit seg imawlan n tidep.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, ilit seg imawlan n tidep.

ayahs.text: Ur issefk ara i imezda$ n Lmadina, d wayen i sen d izzin n waâôaben n ucluê, ad gwrin deffir Umazan n Öebbi, ne$ ad smenyafen iman nnsen i iman is. Ayagi, acku ur ten ipêaz fad, ne$ âaggu, ne$ llaé, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur keçmen akal ara isserfun ijehliyen, ur ppaîîafen acemma s$uô ucengu, siwa ma dayen i sen iuran d igi n wayen ilhan. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Isôuêu arraz iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Ur issefk ara i imezda$ n Lmadina, d wayen i sen d izzin n waâôaben n ucluê, ad gwrin deffir Umazan n Öebbi, ne$ ad smenyafen iman nnsen i iman is. Ayagi, acku ur ten ipêaz fad, ne$ âaggu, ne$ llaé, deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ur keçmen akal ara isserfun ijehliyen, ur ppaîîafen acemma s$uô ucengu, siwa ma dayen i sen iuran d igi n wayen ilhan. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Isôuêu arraz iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Ur pûeôôifen cwiî ne$ aîas, ur zeggren asif, siwa ma iura yasen, iwakken a ten Ikafi Öebbi $ef wayen ilhan deg wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ur pûeôôifen cwiî ne$ aîas, ur zeggren asif, siwa ma iura yasen, iwakken a ten Ikafi Öebbi $ef wayen ilhan deg wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ur Issefk ara i lmumnin ad ff$en akw. Awufan ad iffe$ ugraw si yal arbaâ, ad $bun di ddin, ad nabin agdud nnsen, mara u$alen $uôsen. Amar ad steêdren.
ayahs.translation: Ur Issefk ara i lmumnin ad ff$en akw. Awufan ad iffe$ ugraw si yal arbaâ, ad $bun di ddin, ad nabin agdud nnsen, mara u$alen $uôsen. Amar ad steêdren.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Nna$et ijehliyen i kwen iqeôben. Ad afen, $uôwen, teqseê. Cfut, Öebbi Ippili d wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Nna$et ijehliyen i kwen iqeôben. Ad afen, $uôwen, teqseê. Cfut, Öebbi Ippili d wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Mi d ters tsuôep, llan garasen wid iqqaôen: "anwa degwen, iwumi terna tagi, di liman"? Ma d wid iumnen, terna yasen liman, u nitni feôêen.
ayahs.translation: Mi d ters tsuôep, llan garasen wid iqqaôen: "anwa degwen, iwumi terna tagi, di liman"? Ma d wid iumnen, terna yasen liman, u nitni feôêen.

ayahs.text: Ma d wid iwumi blan wulawen, terna ammus i wammus nnsen. Mmuten u nitni d ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ma d wid iwumi blan wulawen, terna ammus i wammus nnsen. Mmuten u nitni d ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara, ar nitni la d sskaren lfetna, yal aseggwas, yiwen ubrid ne$ berdayen? Sinna, ur steôoiâen, ur d smektayen.
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara, ar nitni la d sskaren lfetna, yal aseggwas, yiwen ubrid ne$ berdayen? Sinna, ur steôoiâen, ur d smektayen.

ayahs.text: Mi d ters tsuôep, ad mesmuqalen: "day illa yiwen ikwen id Ipwalin"? Sinna, ad wexxôen. Isswexxeô Öebbi ulawen nnsen, imi nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.
ayahs.translation: Mi d ters tsuôep, ad mesmuqalen: "day illa yiwen ikwen id Ipwalin"? Sinna, ad wexxôen. Isswexxeô Öebbi ulawen nnsen, imi nitni d agdud ur nfehhem.

ayahs.text: Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan seg iman nnwen. èéay fellas laâtab nnwen. Ipêarab fellawen, d umâin, d aênin i lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ iusa kwen id Umazan seg iman nnwen. èéay fellas laâtab nnwen. Ipêarab fellawen, d umâin, d aênin i lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ma wexxôen, ini: "Iqadd iyi Öebbi. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. FellaS ppekle$. Neppa d Mass n usgeld ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Ma wexxôen, ini: "Iqadd iyi Öebbi. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. FellaS ppekle$. Neppa d Mass n usgeld ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Alô, wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt tuûwibt.
verses.translation: Alô, wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt tuûwibt.

verses.text: Day d lwehma, i medden, ma Nweêêa n i urgaz nnsen: "nabi imdanen, becceô wid iumnen ar ad afen arraz umâin ar Mass nnsen"? Nnan ijehliyen: "wagi, s tidep, d aseêêar n ûûeê".
verses.translation: Day d lwehma, i medden, ma Nweêêa n i urgaz nnsen: "nabi imdanen, becceô wid iumnen ar ad afen arraz umâin ar Mass nnsen"? Nnan ijehliyen: "wagi, s tidep, d aseêêar n ûûeê".

verses.text: Ih, Mass nnwen d Öebbi, i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld, Iseyyi lameô. Ur illi umcafaâ siwa ma Iâammed as. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eP. Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
verses.translation: Ih, Mass nnwen d Öebbi, i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld, Iseyyi lameô. Ur illi umcafaâ siwa ma Iâammed as. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eP. Day ur d tesmektayem ara?

verses.text: £uôeS akw tu$alin nnwen. Lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ih, Inezzu axlaq, Ippales, iwakken ad Ikafi wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, s lmizan. I wid ijehlen, tissit iô$an, aâaqeb aqeôêan, imi llan jehlen.
verses.translation: £uôeS akw tu$alin nnwen. Lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ih, Inezzu axlaq, Ippales, iwakken ad Ikafi wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, s lmizan. I wid ijehlen, tissit iô$an, aâaqeb aqeôêan, imi llan jehlen.

verses.text: D Neppa i Irran iîij d lefnaô, aggur d tafat. Iwezn as tiswaâin, iwakken a ppissinem amvan iseggwasen, akked leêsab. Ur Ixliq Öebbi ayagi, siwa s tidep. Ipfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
verses.translation: D Neppa i Irran iîij d lefnaô, aggur d tafat. Iwezn as tiswaâin, iwakken a ppissinem amvan iseggwasen, akked leêsab. Ur Ixliq Öebbi ayagi, siwa s tidep. Ipfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.

verses.text: S tidep, di lemgarda ger yiv akked wass, akked wayen Ixleq Öebbi di tmurt akked igenwan, ard issekniyen i ugdud i ipêezziben.
verses.translation: S tidep, di lemgarda ger yiv akked wass, akked wayen Ixleq Öebbi di tmurt akked igenwan, ard issekniyen i ugdud i ipêezziben.

verses.text: Ih, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, i tqennaâ tmeddurt di ddunit, u rekden degs, d wid i istehzan $ef issekniyen nne£.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, i tqennaâ tmeddurt di ddunit, u rekden degs, d wid i istehzan $ef issekniyen nne£.

verses.text: Wigi, axxam nnsen di tmes, ilmend n wayen keppben.
verses.translation: Wigi, axxam nnsen di tmes, ilmend n wayen keppben.

verses.text: Ih, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Inhu Mass nnsen, s liman nnsen. Ad ppazzalen isaffen seddawat sen, di leonanat isaâdiyen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Inhu Mass nnsen, s liman nnsen. Ad ppazzalen isaffen seddawat sen, di leonanat isaâdiyen.

verses.text: Anuju nnsen degs: "gedha s yissek a Öebbi"! Azul nnsen d: "tifrat". Anuju nnsen aneggaru: "ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen".
verses.translation: Anuju nnsen degs: "gedha s yissek a Öebbi"! Azul nnsen d: "tifrat". Anuju nnsen aneggaru: "ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen".

verses.text: Lemmer ad Iaâoel Öebbi cceôô ar imdanen, akken nitni êaren $ef lxiô, yili ibbwev asen lajel nnsen. A Nanef i wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, ad ddebdben di lbe$wv nnsen.
verses.translation: Lemmer ad Iaâoel Öebbi cceôô ar imdanen, akken nitni êaren $ef lxiô, yili ibbwev asen lajel nnsen. A Nanef i wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, ad ddebdben di lbe$wv nnsen.

verses.text: Amdan, ma iêuza t ccqa, ad a£ £ d isiwel, iééel, iqqim ne$ ibedd. Mi s Nekkes ccqa s, ad iteddu amzun ur d inuj $uône£ilmend n ccqa i t iêuzan. Akka ay ppucebêen igiten nnsen i imaâfan.
verses.translation: Amdan, ma iêuza t ccqa, ad a£ £ d isiwel, iééel, iqqim ne$ ibedd. Mi s Nekkes ccqa s, ad iteddu amzun ur d inuj $uône£ilmend n ccqa i t iêuzan. Akka ay ppucebêen igiten nnsen i imaâfan.

verses.text: Ni$ Nesqucc isuta, uqbel nnwen, imi densen. Ussan d $uôsen imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, ur llin d wid ara iamnen. Akka ay Nepqeîîi agdud ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nesqucc isuta, uqbel nnwen, imi densen. Ussan d $uôsen imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, ur llin d wid ara iamnen. Akka ay Nepqeîîi agdud ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Sinna, Nerra kwen d igensas di tmurt, deffir sen, a Nwali amek ara txedmem.
verses.translation: Sinna, Nerra kwen d igensas di tmurt, deffir sen, a Nwali amek ara txedmem.

verses.text: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, ad inin: "awi d Leqwôan nniven, ne$ beddel it". Ini: "ur felli a t beddle$, s leb$i n yiman iw. Teddu$ kan akked wayen iyi d ippuweêêan. Nek ugade$, ma xedâa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".
verses.translation: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, ad inin: "awi d Leqwôan nniven, ne$ beddel it". Ini: "ur felli a t beddle$, s leb$i n yiman iw. Teddu$ kan akked wayen iyi d ippuweêêan. Nek ugade$, ma xedâa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".

verses.text: Ini: "lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur awen t id mli$, ur awen t id mmekti$. Ni$ zed$e$ yidwen tameddurt, uqbel is. Day ur tfehmem ara"?
verses.translation: Ini: "lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur awen t id mli$, ur awen t id mmekti$. Ni$ zed$e$ yidwen tameddurt, uqbel is. Day ur tfehmem ara"?

verses.text: Anwa i idensen kteô, ger win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ win inekôen issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebêen ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Anwa i idensen kteô, ger win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ win inekôen issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebêen ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: La âabden, war Öebbi, ayen ur ten neîîuôu, ur ten nenfaâ. La qqaôen: "wigi d imcafâen nne$ ar Öebbi". Ini: "day a pxebbôem Öebbi $ef wayen ur Issin, di tmurt akked igenwan"? Gedha s yiS! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
verses.translation: La âabden, war Öebbi, ayen ur ten neîîuôu, ur ten nenfaâ. La qqaôen: "wigi d imcafâen nne$ ar Öebbi". Ini: "day a pxebbôem Öebbi $ef wayen ur Issin, di tmurt akked igenwan"? Gedha s yiS! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!

verses.text: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois kan. Sinna, mgaraden. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal, s$uô Mass ik, ad yili uêuddu, garasen, $ef wayen i$ef mgaraden.
verses.translation: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois kan. Sinna, mgaraden. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal, s$uô Mass ik, ad yili uêuddu, garasen, $ef wayen i$ef mgaraden.

verses.text: La qqaôen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes ussekni n Mass is"! Ini: "tabavnit ar Öebbi kan. Ihi, gganit. Nek, yidwen, seg wid iggunin".
verses.translation: La qqaôen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes ussekni n Mass is"! Ini: "tabavnit ar Öebbi kan. Ihi, gganit. Nek, yidwen, seg wid iggunin".

verses.text: Ma Nesêess i imdanen aêunu, deffir twa$it i ten iêuzan, atnan la ppandin i issekniyen nne£. Ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Ip$awal di tiêeôci". Imersulen nne£, s tidep, pparun ayen teppandim.
verses.translation: Ma Nesêess i imdanen aêunu, deffir twa$it i ten iêuzan, atnan la ppandin i issekniyen nne£. Ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Ip$awal di tiêeôci". Imersulen nne£, s tidep, pparun ayen teppandim.

verses.text: Neppa i kwen Ippawin di lberr, di yill. Alamma, mi tellam di lembwabeô, teppedum degsen s wavu uûwib, feôêen yis, tusa d tbucivant $uôsen, ppasent ed lemwao $uôsen, si yal tama, êulfan a d tezzi fellasen. Naâôen Öebbi, s lqaâida i Neppa: "ma Tsellkev a$ si tagi, ar a nili seg wid isnemmiren".
verses.translation: Neppa i kwen Ippawin di lberr, di yill. Alamma, mi tellam di lembwabeô, teppedum degsen s wavu uûwib, feôêen yis, tusa d tbucivant $uôsen, ppasent ed lemwao $uôsen, si yal tama, êulfan a d tezzi fellasen. Naâôen Öebbi, s lqaâida i Neppa: "ma Tsellkev a$ si tagi, ar a nili seg wid isnemmiren".

verses.text: Mi ten Isellek, imiren u$alen be$wven di tmurt, war ssebba. A yimdanen! Lbe$wv nnwen, siwa $ef yiman nnwen. Zzhu di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, $uône£ tu$alin nnwen, ad awen Nmel ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Mi ten Isellek, imiren u$alen be$wven di tmurt, war ssebba. A yimdanen! Lbe$wv nnwen, siwa $ef yiman nnwen. Zzhu di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, $uône£ tu$alin nnwen, ad awen Nmel ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Amedya n tmeddurt di ddunit, am aman kan. Nesse$li ten id seg igenni, xelven akked im$an n tmurt, iseg teppen imdanen akked lmal. Mi tcebbeê tmurt, tu$al d tuzyint, $ilen, imezda$ is, ar deg ufus nnsen ay tella. Iusa p id lameô nne£, deg iv, ne$ deg wass, Nerra p d ahicuô, amzun ur teoouoeg ass izeryen. Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen i ugdud ipxemmimen.
verses.translation: Amedya n tmeddurt di ddunit, am aman kan. Nesse$li ten id seg igenni, xelven akked im$an n tmurt, iseg teppen imdanen akked lmal. Mi tcebbeê tmurt, tu$al d tuzyint, $ilen, imezda$ is, ar deg ufus nnsen ay tella. Iusa p id lameô nne£, deg iv, ne$ deg wass, Nerra p d ahicuô, amzun ur teoouoeg ass izeryen. Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen i ugdud ipxemmimen.

verses.text: Inecced Öebbi s axxam n tifrat. Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Inecced Öebbi s axxam n tifrat. Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.

verses.text: I wid iweqmen, lewqama, ternuv as. Udmawen nnsen, ur ten ipnal bufsus, ne$ ddell. Widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: I wid iweqmen, lewqama, ternuv as. Udmawen nnsen, ur ten ipnal bufsus, ne$ ddell. Widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Aqeîîi n wid id ibbwin tucmitin, d tucmip itent icban. Ad ndellen. Ur sâun amenêul ar Öebbi. Amzun $ummen wudmawen nnsen, s ccevyat n yiv iberkanen. Widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Aqeîîi n wid id ibbwin tucmitin, d tucmip itent icban. Ad ndellen. Ur sâun amenêul ar Öebbi. Amzun $ummen wudmawen nnsen, s ccevyat n yiv iberkanen. Widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara ten Nfesser akw, a Nini, imiren, i wid icurken: "imukan nnwen, kunwi akked icriken nnwen"! Sinna Nessemfaôaq iten. A d inin, icriken nnsen: "maççi d nekwni ay tâabdem.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Nfesser akw, a Nini, imiren, i wid icurken: "imukan nnwen, kunwi akked icriken nnwen"! Sinna Nessemfaôaq iten. A d inin, icriken nnsen: "maççi d nekwni ay tâabdem.

verses.text: Ad Iqadd Öebbi, d Anagi garane$ yidwen, ar ur d necliâ deg uâbbed nnwen".
verses.translation: Ad Iqadd Öebbi, d Anagi garane$ yidwen, ar ur d necliâ deg uâbbed nnwen".

verses.text: Din, yal amdan ad iwali ayen iwasa. Ad u$alen ar Öebbi, Bab nnsen n tidep. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
verses.translation: Din, yal amdan ad iwali ayen iwasa. Ad u$alen ar Öebbi, Bab nnsen n tidep. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

verses.text: Ini: "anwa ikwen Ip$itin seg igenni akked tmurt? Anwa ay d Bab n tmejjin akked yiéôi? Anwa id Issuffu$en amuddir si lmegget, id Issuffu$en lmegget seg umuddir? Anwa i Iseyyin lameô"? A d inin: "d Öebbi". Ini: "ihi, day ur tepêezzibem ara"?
verses.translation: Ini: "anwa ikwen Ip$itin seg igenni akked tmurt? Anwa ay d Bab n tmejjin akked yiéôi? Anwa id Issuffu$en amuddir si lmegget, id Issuffu$en lmegget seg umuddir? Anwa i Iseyyin lameô"? A d inin: "d Öebbi". Ini: "ihi, day ur tepêezzibem ara"?

verses.text: D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen n tidep. Deffir tidep, acu i illan, siwa ttelfan? Ihi, acimi texdâam?
verses.translation: D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen n tidep. Deffir tidep, acu i illan, siwa ttelfan? Ihi, acimi texdâam?

verses.text: Akka i iûaô wawal n Mass ik, $ef wid ixedmen tucmitin. Ih, nitni ur ppamnen.
verses.translation: Akka i iûaô wawal n Mass ik, $ef wid ixedmen tucmitin. Ih, nitni ur ppamnen.

verses.text: Ini: "day illa ger icriken nnwen, win id inzan lxelq, sinna, iules as d"? Ini: "Öebbi inezzu lxelq, sinna, Ippales as d. Ihi, amek ara twexxôem"?
verses.translation: Ini: "day illa ger icriken nnwen, win id inzan lxelq, sinna, iules as d"? Ini: "Öebbi inezzu lxelq, sinna, Ippales as d. Ihi, amek ara twexxôem"?

verses.text: Ini: "day illa, ger icriken nnwen, win i inehhun ar tidep"? Ini: "Öebbi Inehhu ar tidep. Win Inehhun ar tidep, day ur Yif ara, akken Iklal tikli yideS, win ur nennehhu, siwa ma ipwanha? Acu ikwen iu$en? Amek tepseyyim"?
verses.translation: Ini: "day illa, ger icriken nnwen, win i inehhun ar tidep"? Ini: "Öebbi Inehhu ar tidep. Win Inehhun ar tidep, day ur Yif ara, akken Iklal tikli yideS, win ur nennehhu, siwa ma ipwanha? Acu ikwen iu$en? Amek tepseyyim"?

verses.text: Tegwti, segsen, teddun kan d nnwaya. Nnwaya, war ccekk, ur tebbwi acemma si tidep. Ih, Öebbi Issen acu xeddmen.
verses.translation: Tegwti, segsen, teddun kan d nnwaya. Nnwaya, war ccekk, ur tebbwi acemma si tidep. Ih, Öebbi Issen acu xeddmen.

verses.text: Leqwôan agi ur d innulfa ara, war Öebbi. Maca, d atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d afeûûel n Tezmamt, ur degs ccekk, s$uô Mass imavalen.
verses.translation: Leqwôan agi ur d innulfa ara, war Öebbi. Maca, d atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d afeûûel n Tezmamt, ur degs ccekk, s$uô Mass imavalen.

verses.text: Ne$ la qqaôen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed tasuôep i t icban, neccdet seg wanda tzemrem, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep".
verses.translation: Ne$ la qqaôen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed tasuôep i t icban, neccdet seg wanda tzemrem, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep".

verses.text: Xaîi, skaddben ayen ur nekcim di tmusni nnsen, ur ten id iusi usefhem is. Akka ay skaddben, wid i ten id izwaren. Wali, ihi, amek tevôa d imednas.
verses.translation: Xaîi, skaddben ayen ur nekcim di tmusni nnsen, ur ten id iusi usefhem is. Akka ay skaddben, wid i ten id izwaren. Wali, ihi, amek tevôa d imednas.

verses.text: Garasen, wid iumnen yis; garasen, wid ur numin yis. Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen ifessaden.
verses.translation: Garasen, wid iumnen yis; garasen, wid ur numin yis. Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen ifessaden.

verses.text: Ma skaddben k, ini: "i nek igiten iw, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur teppkam deg wayen xedme$, ur ppka$ deg wayen txedmem".
verses.translation: Ma skaddben k, ini: "i nek igiten iw, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur teppkam deg wayen xedme$, ur ppka$ deg wayen txedmem".

verses.text: Garasen, llan wid i k issemêasen. Day tzemrev a pperrev ad slen iâeééugen, ma llan ur fehhmen?
verses.translation: Garasen, llan wid i k issemêasen. Day tzemrev a pperrev ad slen iâeééugen, ma llan ur fehhmen?

verses.text: Garasen, llan wid i k ipmuqulen. Day tzemrev a ppenhuv ider$alen, ma llan ur pwalin?
verses.translation: Garasen, llan wid i k ipmuqulen. Day tzemrev a ppenhuv ider$alen, ma llan ur pwalin?

verses.text: Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iddennis imdanen, s wacemma, maca imdanen densen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iddennis imdanen, s wacemma, maca imdanen densen iman nnsen.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, amzun sâaddan kan saâa n wass, ad msaâqalen. Ni$ xesôen wid iskaddben timlilit d Öebbi. Ur pwanhan.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, amzun sâaddan kan saâa n wass, ad msaâqalen. Ni$ xesôen wid iskaddben timlilit d Öebbi. Ur pwanhan.

verses.text: Ad ak Nessken kra seg wayen i sen Nâahed, ne$ a k id Nawi $uône£. Ihi, $uône£ tu$alin nnsen. Sinna, Öebbi d Anagi n wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ad ak Nessken kra seg wayen i sen Nâahed, ne$ a k id Nawi $uône£. Ihi, $uône£ tu$alin nnsen. Sinna, Öebbi d Anagi n wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: I yal lois, amazan. Ma iusa d umazan nnsen, a ppefru garasen s lmizan, ur pwadensen.
verses.translation: I yal lois, amazan. Ma iusa d umazan nnsen, a ppefru garasen s lmizan, ur pwadensen.

verses.text: Qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma tessawalem tidep?
verses.translation: Qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma tessawalem tidep?

verses.text: Ini: "ur mlike$ i iman iw vveôô, ne$ aba$uô, siwa ayen Ib$a Öebbi. Yal lois s lajel is". Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen s saâa, ur t id sseqôaben.
verses.translation: Ini: "ur mlike$ i iman iw vveôô, ne$ aba$uô, siwa ayen Ib$a Öebbi. Yal lois s lajel is". Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen s saâa, ur t id sseqôaben.

verses.text: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb iS, deg iv, ne$ deg wass? Acimi êaren $uôeS ibe$wviyen?
verses.translation: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb iS, deg iv, ne$ deg wass? Acimi êaren $uôeS ibe$wviyen?

verses.text: D$a, ma iusa d, a ppamnem yis? Tura, aql akwen t$eûbem fellas".
verses.translation: D$a, ma iusa d, a ppamnem yis? Tura, aql akwen t$eûbem fellas".

verses.text: Sinna, ad asen inin i wid idensen: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n lebda. Ma teppuqeîîan siwa kan $ef wayen tkeppbem"?
verses.translation: Sinna, ad asen inin i wid idensen: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n lebda. Ma teppuqeîîan siwa kan $ef wayen tkeppbem"?

verses.text: Steqsayen k: "d tidep ayagi"? Ini: "ih, s Mass iw, ar ayagi d tidep! Kunwi ur tezmirem i usfunneg".
verses.translation: Steqsayen k: "d tidep ayagi"? Ini: "ih, s Mass iw, ar ayagi d tidep! Kunwi ur tezmirem i usfunneg".

verses.text: Xas ad isâu, yal amdan idensen, i illan di tmurt, ur d ifeddu yis. Ffren nndama mi walan aâaqeb. Aêuddu garasen, s lmizan, ur pwadensen.
verses.translation: Xas ad isâu, yal amdan idensen, i illan di tmurt, ur d ifeddu yis. Ffren nndama mi walan aâaqeb. Aêuddu garasen, s lmizan, ur pwadensen.

verses.text: Day, s tidep, maççi n Öebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ih, day lemâahda n Öebbi maççi d tidep? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Day, s tidep, maççi n Öebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ih, day lemâahda n Öebbi maççi d tidep? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.

verses.text: Neppa Issidir, Ineqq. £uôeS ara tu$alem.
verses.translation: Neppa Issidir, Ineqq. £uôeS ara tu$alem.

verses.text: A yimdanen! Ni$ iusa kwen id unabi s$uô Mass nnwen, akked ccfa n wayen iblan ulawen, akked nnhaya, akked uêunu i lmumnin.
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Ni$ iusa kwen id unabi s$uô Mass nnwen, akked ccfa n wayen iblan ulawen, akked nnhaya, akked uêunu i lmumnin.

verses.text: Ini: "s lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, s waya, xas ad feôêen". Yif ayen pkemmimen.
verses.translation: Ini: "s lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, s waya, xas ad feôêen". Yif ayen pkemmimen.

verses.text: Ini: "twalam ayen i wen d Issers Öebbi n ôôeéq? Terram segs leêlal d leêôam". Ini: "Iâammed awen Öebbi, ne$ tesnulfam d $ef Öebbi"?
verses.translation: Ini: "twalam ayen i wen d Issers Öebbi n ôôeéq? Terram segs leêlal d leêôam". Ini: "Iâammed awen Öebbi, ne$ tesnulfam d $ef Öebbi"?

verses.text: Acu ara meyyzen, ass n tnekra, wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Ih, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl af imdanen, maca tegwti segsen ur snemmiren.
verses.translation: Acu ara meyyzen, ass n tnekra, wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Ih, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl af imdanen, maca tegwti segsen ur snemmiren.

verses.text: Ur teppiliv di liêala, ur temmalev si Leqwôan, ur tepce$wilem di kra, mebla ma Nella d Inagan nnwen, mara tweqmem. Lmizan ubelkim di tmurt u deg igenni, ur idrig i Mass ik. Akken seddaw waya, ne$ sennig es. Akw, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Ur teppiliv di liêala, ur temmalev si Leqwôan, ur tepce$wilem di kra, mebla ma Nella d Inagan nnwen, mara tweqmem. Lmizan ubelkim di tmurt u deg igenni, ur idrig i Mass ik. Akken seddaw waya, ne$ sennig es. Akw, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.

verses.text: Ih, s tidep, iêbiben n Öebbi ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
verses.translation: Ih, s tidep, iêbiben n Öebbi ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

verses.text: Wid iumnen u llan êezzben,
verses.translation: Wid iumnen u llan êezzben,

verses.text: a ten beccôen s lxiô di tmeddurt n ddunit, di laxeôt. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawalen n Öebbi. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: a ten beccôen s lxiô di tmeddurt n ddunit, di laxeôt. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawalen n Öebbi. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Ur k i$webbel wawal nnsen. Ih, tazmert akw n Öebbi. Neppa Isell, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ur k i$webbel wawal nnsen. Ih, tazmert akw n Öebbi. Neppa Isell, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: S tidep, day maççi n Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt? D acu îîafaôen wid ipnujun, war Öebbi, ar icriken? Ïîafaôen kan nnwaya. Oaââlen kan.
verses.translation: S tidep, day maççi n Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt? D acu îîafaôen wid ipnujun, war Öebbi, ar icriken? Ïîafaôen kan nnwaya. Oaââlen kan.

verses.text: Neppa, i wen Irran iv i ureyyeê nnwen, ass iwakken a pwalim. Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i ugdud isellen.
verses.translation: Neppa, i wen Irran iv i ureyyeê nnwen, ass iwakken a pwalim. Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i ugdud isellen.

verses.text: Nnan: "Öebbi Isâa aqcic. Gedha s yiS! Neppa d Ameôkanti. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ur tesâim adabu $ef waya. Day a d tinim $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
verses.translation: Nnan: "Öebbi Isâa aqcic. Gedha s yiS! Neppa d Ameôkanti. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ur tesâim adabu $ef waya. Day a d tinim $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?

verses.text: Ini: "s tidep, wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ur rebêen".
verses.translation: Ini: "s tidep, wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ur rebêen".
