verses.text: Zzhu di ddunit, sinna, $uône£ tu$alin nnsen. D$a, ad asen Nsâaddi aâaqeb uqsiê, imi llan jehlen.
verses.translation: Zzhu di ddunit, sinna, $uône£ tu$alin nnsen. D$a, ad asen Nsâaddi aâaqeb uqsiê, imi llan jehlen.

verses.text: Eêku yasen d tadyant n Nuê, mi inna i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Ma ééayit fellawen tilin iw, akked usmekti w n issekniyen n Öebbi, $ef Öebbi ppekle$, ihi, zduklet lameô nnwen akked icriken nnwen. Sinna, ur awen teppili lhejna $ef lameô nnwen, d$a, frut ep felli, ur iyi sganit.
verses.translation: Eêku yasen d tadyant n Nuê, mi inna i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Ma ééayit fellawen tilin iw, akked usmekti w n issekniyen n Öebbi, $ef Öebbi ppekle$, ihi, zduklet lameô nnwen akked icriken nnwen. Sinna, ur awen teppili lhejna $ef lameô nnwen, d$a, frut ep felli, ur iyi sganit.

verses.text: Ma twexxôem, ur awen ssuture$ taqdiât. Ih, taqdiât iw ar Öebbi kan. Felli lameô ad ili$ seg imvuâen.
verses.translation: Ma twexxôem, ur awen ssuture$ taqdiât. Ih, taqdiât iw ar Öebbi kan. Felli lameô ad ili$ seg imvuâen.

verses.text: Skaddben t. Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuô. Nerra ten d igensas. Ne$meq wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Wali amek tevôa d wid ippunedôen.
verses.translation: Skaddben t. Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuô. Nerra ten d igensas. Ne$meq wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Wali amek tevôa d wid ippunedôen.

verses.text: Sinna, deffir es, Nuzen ed imazanen ar igduden nnsen. Usan ten id s ubeggen. Ur ssawven ad amnen $ef wayen nekôen zik. Akka ay Nselle$ ulawen ixabiten.
verses.translation: Sinna, deffir es, Nuzen ed imazanen ar igduden nnsen. Usan ten id s ubeggen. Ur ssawven ad amnen $ef wayen nekôen zik. Akka ay Nselle$ ulawen ixabiten.

verses.text: Sinna, deffir sen, Nuzen ed Musa akked Haôun, ar Ferâun akked imvebbôen is, s issekniyen nne£. Sme$wôen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Sinna, deffir sen, Nuzen ed Musa akked Haôun, ar Ferâun akked imvebbôen is, s issekniyen nne£. Sme$wôen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Mi ten id tusa tidep, s$uône£, nnan: "wagi, ih, d ssêur n ûûeê".
verses.translation: Mi ten id tusa tidep, s$uône£, nnan: "wagi, ih, d ssêur n ûûeê".

verses.text: Inna Musa: "day a tinim d ssêur wagi, i tidep mi kwen id tusa"? Ur rebêen iseêêaren.
verses.translation: Inna Musa: "day a tinim d ssêur wagi, i tidep mi kwen id tusa"? Ur rebêen iseêêaren.

verses.text: Nnan: "day d tusiv $uône$, ad a$ tesîixxôev seg wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$, a ppu$alem, di sin, d imeqwôanen di tmurt? Ur numin, nekwni, yiswen".
verses.translation: Nnan: "day d tusiv $uône$, ad a$ tesîixxôev seg wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$, a ppu$alem, di sin, d imeqwôanen di tmurt? Ur numin, nekwni, yiswen".

verses.text: Inna Ferâun: "awit iyi d yal aseêêar amusnaw".
verses.translation: Inna Ferâun: "awit iyi d yal aseêêar amusnaw".

verses.text: Mi d usan iseêêaren, inna yasen Musa: "veggôet ara tveggôem"!
verses.translation: Mi d usan iseêêaren, inna yasen Musa: "veggôet ara tveggôem"!

verses.text: Mi veggôen, inna Musa: "ayen d tebbwim d ssêur. S tidep, a t Inqev Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi ur Issewqam ara igiten ifessaden.
verses.translation: Mi veggôen, inna Musa: "ayen d tebbwim d ssêur. S tidep, a t Inqev Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi ur Issewqam ara igiten ifessaden.

verses.text: Öebbi Itebbit tidep, s wawal iS, xas ugin ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Öebbi Itebbit tidep, s wawal iS, xas ugin ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: I iumnen s Musa, siwa tarwa seg ugdud is, ilmend n tugdi uhewwel n Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ih, Ferâun d abe$wvi di tmurt. Neppa, s tidep, seg imaâfan.
verses.translation: I iumnen s Musa, siwa tarwa seg ugdud is, ilmend n tugdi uhewwel n Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ih, Ferâun d abe$wvi di tmurt. Neppa, s tidep, seg imaâfan.

verses.text: Inna Musa: "a yagdud iw! Ma teppamnem s Öebbi, ppeklet fellaS ma d imvuâen ay tellam".
verses.translation: Inna Musa: "a yagdud iw! Ma teppamnem s Öebbi, ppeklet fellaS ma d imvuâen ay tellam".

verses.text: Nnan: "neppkel $ef Öebbi. A Mass nne$, ur a$ ppara d ahewwel i ugdud imednas;
verses.translation: Nnan: "neppkel $ef Öebbi. A Mass nne$, ur a$ ppara d ahewwel i ugdud imednas;

verses.text: Sellek a$, s uêunu K, seg ugdud ijehliyen".
verses.translation: Sellek a$, s uêunu K, seg ugdud ijehliyen".

verses.text: Nweêêa i Musa akked gma s: "ebnut ixxamen i ugdud nnwen di Maûeô, erret ixxamen nnwen ar lqibla, beddet i téallit. Becceô lmumnin".
verses.translation: Nweêêa i Musa akked gma s: "ebnut ixxamen i ugdud nnwen di Maûeô, erret ixxamen nnwen ar lqibla, beddet i téallit. Becceô lmumnin".

verses.text: Inna Musa: "a Mass nne$! S tidep, Tefkiv i Ferâun akked imvebbôen is, ôôêuê akked wayla di tmeddurt n ddunit, a Mass nne$, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid iK. A Mass nne$, Squcc ayla nnsen, S$eô ulawen nnsen, ur ppamnen alamma walan aâaqeb aqeôêan".
verses.translation: Inna Musa: "a Mass nne$! S tidep, Tefkiv i Ferâun akked imvebbôen is, ôôêuê akked wayla di tmeddurt n ddunit, a Mass nne$, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid iK. A Mass nne$, Squcc ayla nnsen, S$eô ulawen nnsen, ur ppamnen alamma walan aâaqeb aqeôêan".

verses.text: Inna: "ih, tepwaqbel tnaâôit nnwen. Ddut di lewqam, ur teddut d ubrid n wid ur nessin".
verses.translation: Inna: "ih, tepwaqbel tnaâôit nnwen. Ddut di lewqam, ur teddut d ubrid n wid ur nessin".

verses.text: Nezzger At Isôail di yill. Vefôen ten Ferâun akked iâsekôiwen is, s leb$wev d lewâaôa. Armi ibbwev ad i$meq, inna: "umne$! Ih, ur illi ôebbi siwa Win is umnen At Isôail. Nek seg imvuâen".
verses.translation: Nezzger At Isôail di yill. Vefôen ten Ferâun akked iâsekôiwen is, s leb$wev d lewâaôa. Armi ibbwev ad i$meq, inna: "umne$! Ih, ur illi ôebbi siwa Win is umnen At Isôail. Nek seg imvuâen".

verses.text: Tura! Ni$ zik taâûav, telliv seg ifessaden.
verses.translation: Tura! Ni$ zik taâûav, telliv seg ifessaden.

verses.text: Assa, a Nsellek loeppa k, a d tegwri d assekni i wid ara k id ineûfen. Aîas n medden, s tidep, stehzan deg issekniyen nne£.
verses.translation: Assa, a Nsellek loeppa k, a d tegwri d assekni i wid ara k id ineûfen. Aîas n medden, s tidep, stehzan deg issekniyen nne£.

verses.text: Ni$ Nessers At Isôail deg umkan umâin, u N$at iten s wayen ilhan. Ur mgaraden armi ten id tusa tussna. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ilmend n wayen i$ef llan mgaraden.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nessers At Isôail deg umkan umâin, u N$at iten s wayen ilhan. Ur mgaraden armi ten id tusa tussna. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ilmend n wayen i$ef llan mgaraden.

verses.text: Ma tcukkev $ef wayen i k ed Nessers, steqsi wid i iqqaôen Tazmamt, uqbel ik. Ni$ tusa k id tidep, s$uô Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.
verses.translation: Ma tcukkev $ef wayen i k ed Nessers, steqsi wid i iqqaôen Tazmamt, uqbel ik. Ni$ tusa k id tidep, s$uô Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.

verses.text: Ur ppili seg wid i iskaddben issekniyen n Öebbi, a ppiliv seg imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Ur ppili seg wid i iskaddben issekniyen n Öebbi, a ppiliv seg imexsuôen.

verses.text: Ih, wid i$ef iûaô Wawal n Mass ik, ur ppamnen,
verses.translation: Ih, wid i$ef iûaô Wawal n Mass ik, ur ppamnen,

verses.text: xas usan ten id akw issekniyen, alamma walan aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: xas usan ten id akw issekniyen, alamma walan aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: A lemmer telli temdint iumnen, u infaâ p liman is, siwa agdud n Yunes! Mi umnen, Nveôôef segsen aâaqeb imdelli di tmeddurt n ddunit. Neooa ten zzhan tallit kan.
verses.translation: A lemmer telli temdint iumnen, u infaâ p liman is, siwa agdud n Yunes! Mi umnen, Nveôôef segsen aâaqeb imdelli di tmeddurt n ddunit. Neooa ten zzhan tallit kan.

verses.text: Ma ihwa yaS i Mass ik, ad amnen wid illan di ddunit, akken ma llan. Day a pêeppmev, keçç, i imdanen ad amnen?
verses.translation: Ma ihwa yaS i Mass ik, ad amnen wid illan di ddunit, akken ma llan. Day a pêeppmev, keçç, i imdanen ad amnen?

verses.text: Ur ippamen umdan siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Isdullu wid ur nfehhem ara.
verses.translation: Ur ippamen umdan siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Isdullu wid ur nfehhem ara.

verses.text: Ini: "walit i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ula iwumi issekniyen akked ineddiôen, i ugdud ur neppamen".
verses.translation: Ini: "walit i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ula iwumi issekniyen akked ineddiôen, i ugdud ur neppamen".

verses.text: Day a pganin kan amedya n wussan n wid i ten id izwaren? Ini: "gganit, nek yidwen, seg wid ipganin".
verses.translation: Day a pganin kan amedya n wussan n wid i ten id izwaren? Ini: "gganit, nek yidwen, seg wid ipganin".

verses.text: Sinna, a Nsellek imazanen nne£, akked wid iumnen. Akka ay d lwajeb fella£, a Nsellek lmumnin.
verses.translation: Sinna, a Nsellek imazanen nne£, akked wid iumnen. Akka ay d lwajeb fella£, a Nsellek lmumnin.

verses.text: Ini: "a yimdanen! Ma tcukkem di ddin iw, nek ur âabde$ wid tâabdem, war Öebbi. Maca, âabde$ Öebbi ara Idmen leôwaê nnwen. Pwamôe$ ad ili$ si lmumnin".
verses.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen! Ma tcukkem di ddin iw, nek ur âabde$ wid tâabdem, war Öebbi. Maca, âabde$ Öebbi ara Idmen leôwaê nnwen. Pwamôe$ ad ili$ si lmumnin".

verses.text: Sbedd udem ik i ddin, s umili ar tidep, ur ppili seg imcurak.
verses.translation: Sbedd udem ik i ddin, s umili ar tidep, ur ppili seg imcurak.

verses.text: Ur pnuju, war Öebbi, ar wayen ur k inefâan, ur k iîîuôôun. Ma txedmev akken, keçç, imiren, a ppiliv seg imednas.
verses.translation: Ur pnuju, war Öebbi, ar wayen ur k inefâan, ur k iîîuôôun. Ma txedmev akken, keçç, imiren, a ppiliv seg imednas.

verses.text: Ma Isâadda fellak Öebbi ccqa, ur ak illi ujebbaô siwa Neppa. Ma Irad ak lxiô, ur illi usebîîel i lfevl iS. Ippak it i win i S ihwan, deg ixdimen iS. Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ma Isâadda fellak Öebbi ccqa, ur ak illi ujebbaô siwa Neppa. Ma Irad ak lxiô, ur illi usebîîel i lfevl iS. Ippak it i win i S ihwan, deg ixdimen iS. Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ini: "a yimdanen! Ni$ tusa kwen id tidep s$uô Mass nnwen! Win ipwanhan, ipwanha kan i iman is; win innetlafen, innetlef kan i iman is. Ur lli$, nek, d awkil nnwen".
verses.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen! Ni$ tusa kwen id tidep s$uô Mass nnwen! Win ipwanhan, ipwanha kan i iman is; win innetlafen, innetlef kan i iman is. Ur lli$, nek, d awkil nnwen".

verses.text: Ddu d wayen ik ed ippuweêêan, eûbeô ard Iêudd Öebbi. Neppa, Yif akw imêaddan.
verses.translation: Ddu d wayen ik ed ippuweêêan, eûbeô ard Iêudd Öebbi. Neppa, Yif akw imêaddan.

ayahs.text: Alô, wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt tuûwibt.
ayahs.translation: Alô, wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt tuûwibt.

ayahs.text: Day d lwehma, i medden, ma Nweêêa n i urgaz nnsen: "nabi imdanen, becceô wid iumnen ar ad afen arraz umâin ar Mass nnsen"? Nnan ijehliyen: "wagi, s tidep, d aseêêar n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: Day d lwehma, i medden, ma Nweêêa n i urgaz nnsen: "nabi imdanen, becceô wid iumnen ar ad afen arraz umâin ar Mass nnsen"? Nnan ijehliyen: "wagi, s tidep, d aseêêar n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Ih, Mass nnwen d Öebbi, i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld, Iseyyi lameô. Ur illi umcafaâ siwa ma Iâammed as. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eP. Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
ayahs.translation: Ih, Mass nnwen d Öebbi, i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld, Iseyyi lameô. Ur illi umcafaâ siwa ma Iâammed as. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eP. Day ur d tesmektayem ara?

ayahs.text: £uôeS akw tu$alin nnwen. Lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ih, Inezzu axlaq, Ippales, iwakken ad Ikafi wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, s lmizan. I wid ijehlen, tissit iô$an, aâaqeb aqeôêan, imi llan jehlen.
ayahs.translation: £uôeS akw tu$alin nnwen. Lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ih, Inezzu axlaq, Ippales, iwakken ad Ikafi wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, s lmizan. I wid ijehlen, tissit iô$an, aâaqeb aqeôêan, imi llan jehlen.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i Irran iîij d lefnaô, aggur d tafat. Iwezn as tiswaâin, iwakken a ppissinem amvan iseggwasen, akked leêsab. Ur Ixliq Öebbi ayagi, siwa s tidep. Ipfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i Irran iîij d lefnaô, aggur d tafat. Iwezn as tiswaâin, iwakken a ppissinem amvan iseggwasen, akked leêsab. Ur Ixliq Öebbi ayagi, siwa s tidep. Ipfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud issnen.

ayahs.text: S tidep, di lemgarda ger yiv akked wass, akked wayen Ixleq Öebbi di tmurt akked igenwan, ard issekniyen i ugdud i ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: S tidep, di lemgarda ger yiv akked wass, akked wayen Ixleq Öebbi di tmurt akked igenwan, ard issekniyen i ugdud i ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, i tqennaâ tmeddurt di ddunit, u rekden degs, d wid i istehzan $ef issekniyen nne£.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, i tqennaâ tmeddurt di ddunit, u rekden degs, d wid i istehzan $ef issekniyen nne£.

ayahs.text: Wigi, axxam nnsen di tmes, ilmend n wayen keppben.
ayahs.translation: Wigi, axxam nnsen di tmes, ilmend n wayen keppben.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Inhu Mass nnsen, s liman nnsen. Ad ppazzalen isaffen seddawat sen, di leonanat isaâdiyen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Inhu Mass nnsen, s liman nnsen. Ad ppazzalen isaffen seddawat sen, di leonanat isaâdiyen.

ayahs.text: Anuju nnsen degs: "gedha s yissek a Öebbi"! Azul nnsen d: "tifrat". Anuju nnsen aneggaru: "ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen".
ayahs.translation: Anuju nnsen degs: "gedha s yissek a Öebbi"! Azul nnsen d: "tifrat". Anuju nnsen aneggaru: "ccekôan i Öebbi, Mass imavalen".

ayahs.text: Lemmer ad Iaâoel Öebbi cceôô ar imdanen, akken nitni êaren $ef lxiô, yili ibbwev asen lajel nnsen. A Nanef i wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, ad ddebdben di lbe$wv nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer ad Iaâoel Öebbi cceôô ar imdanen, akken nitni êaren $ef lxiô, yili ibbwev asen lajel nnsen. A Nanef i wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, ad ddebdben di lbe$wv nnsen.

ayahs.text: Amdan, ma iêuza t ccqa, ad a£ £ d isiwel, iééel, iqqim ne$ ibedd. Mi s Nekkes ccqa s, ad iteddu amzun ur d inuj $uône£ilmend n ccqa i t iêuzan. Akka ay ppucebêen igiten nnsen i imaâfan.
ayahs.translation: Amdan, ma iêuza t ccqa, ad a£ £ d isiwel, iééel, iqqim ne$ ibedd. Mi s Nekkes ccqa s, ad iteddu amzun ur d inuj $uône£ilmend n ccqa i t iêuzan. Akka ay ppucebêen igiten nnsen i imaâfan.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nesqucc isuta, uqbel nnwen, imi densen. Ussan d $uôsen imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, ur llin d wid ara iamnen. Akka ay Nepqeîîi agdud ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nesqucc isuta, uqbel nnwen, imi densen. Ussan d $uôsen imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, ur llin d wid ara iamnen. Akka ay Nepqeîîi agdud ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Nerra kwen d igensas di tmurt, deffir sen, a Nwali amek ara txedmem.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Nerra kwen d igensas di tmurt, deffir sen, a Nwali amek ara txedmem.

ayahs.text: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, ad inin: "awi d Leqwôan nniven, ne$ beddel it". Ini: "ur felli a t beddle$, s leb$i n yiman iw. Teddu$ kan akked wayen iyi d ippuweêêan. Nek ugade$, ma xedâa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".
ayahs.translation: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, wid ur negguni ara timlilit yidne£, ad inin: "awi d Leqwôan nniven, ne$ beddel it". Ini: "ur felli a t beddle$, s leb$i n yiman iw. Teddu$ kan akked wayen iyi d ippuweêêan. Nek ugade$, ma xedâa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".

ayahs.text: Ini: "lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur awen t id mli$, ur awen t id mmekti$. Ni$ zed$e$ yidwen tameddurt, uqbel is. Day ur tfehmem ara"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur awen t id mli$, ur awen t id mmekti$. Ni$ zed$e$ yidwen tameddurt, uqbel is. Day ur tfehmem ara"?

ayahs.text: Anwa i idensen kteô, ger win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ win inekôen issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebêen ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: Anwa i idensen kteô, ger win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ win inekôen issekniyen iS? Ih, ur rebêen ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: La âabden, war Öebbi, ayen ur ten neîîuôu, ur ten nenfaâ. La qqaôen: "wigi d imcafâen nne$ ar Öebbi". Ini: "day a pxebbôem Öebbi $ef wayen ur Issin, di tmurt akked igenwan"? Gedha s yiS! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
ayahs.translation: La âabden, war Öebbi, ayen ur ten neîîuôu, ur ten nenfaâ. La qqaôen: "wigi d imcafâen nne$ ar Öebbi". Ini: "day a pxebbôem Öebbi $ef wayen ur Issin, di tmurt akked igenwan"? Gedha s yiS! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!

ayahs.text: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois kan. Sinna, mgaraden. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal, s$uô Mass ik, ad yili uêuddu, garasen, $ef wayen i$ef mgaraden.
ayahs.translation: Llan imdanen d yiwen n lois kan. Sinna, mgaraden. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal, s$uô Mass ik, ad yili uêuddu, garasen, $ef wayen i$ef mgaraden.

ayahs.text: La qqaôen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes ussekni n Mass is"! Ini: "tabavnit ar Öebbi kan. Ihi, gganit. Nek, yidwen, seg wid iggunin".
ayahs.translation: La qqaôen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes ussekni n Mass is"! Ini: "tabavnit ar Öebbi kan. Ihi, gganit. Nek, yidwen, seg wid iggunin".

ayahs.text: Ma Nesêess i imdanen aêunu, deffir twa$it i ten iêuzan, atnan la ppandin i issekniyen nne£. Ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Ip$awal di tiêeôci". Imersulen nne£, s tidep, pparun ayen teppandim.
ayahs.translation: Ma Nesêess i imdanen aêunu, deffir twa$it i ten iêuzan, atnan la ppandin i issekniyen nne£. Ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Ip$awal di tiêeôci". Imersulen nne£, s tidep, pparun ayen teppandim.

ayahs.text: Neppa i kwen Ippawin di lberr, di yill. ayahs.translation: Neppa i kwen Ippawin di lberr, di yill. ayahs.text: Mi ten Isellek, imiren u$alen be$wven di tmurt, war ssebba. A yimdanen! Lbe$wv nnwen, siwa $ef yiman nnwen. Zzhu di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, $uône£ tu$alin nnwen, ad awen Nmel ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Mi ten Isellek, imiren u$alen be$wven di tmurt, war ssebba. A yimdanen! Lbe$wv nnwen, siwa $ef yiman nnwen. Zzhu di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, $uône£ tu$alin nnwen, ad awen Nmel ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Amedya n tmeddurt di ddunit, am aman kan. Nesse$li ten id seg igenni, xelven akked im$an n tmurt, iseg teppen imdanen akked lmal. Mi tcebbeê tmurt, tu$al d tuzyint, $ilen, imezda$ is, ar deg ufus nnsen ay tella. Iusa p id lameô nne£, deg iv, ne$ deg wass, Nerra p d ahicuô, amzun ur teoouoeg ass izeryen. Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen i ugdud ipxemmimen.
ayahs.translation: Amedya n tmeddurt di ddunit, am aman kan. Nesse$li ten id seg igenni, xelven akked im$an n tmurt, iseg teppen imdanen akked lmal. Mi tcebbeê tmurt, tu$al d tuzyint, $ilen, imezda$ is, ar deg ufus nnsen ay tella. Iusa p id lameô nne£, deg iv, ne$ deg wass, Nerra p d ahicuô, amzun ur teoouoeg ass izeryen. Akka ay Nfeûûel issekniyen i ugdud ipxemmimen.

ayahs.text: Inecced Öebbi s axxam n tifrat. Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Inecced Öebbi s axxam n tifrat. Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: I wid iweqmen, lewqama, ternuv as. Udmawen nnsen, ur ten ipnal bufsus, ne$ ddell. Widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: I wid iweqmen, lewqama, ternuv as. Udmawen nnsen, ur ten ipnal bufsus, ne$ ddell. Widak, d at Loennet, nitni, degs ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Aqeîîi n wid id ibbwin tucmitin, d tucmip itent icban. Ad ndellen. Ur sâun amenêul ar Öebbi. Amzun $ummen wudmawen nnsen, s ccevyat n yiv iberkanen. Widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Aqeîîi n wid id ibbwin tucmitin, d tucmip itent icban. Ad ndellen. Ur sâun amenêul ar Öebbi. Amzun $ummen wudmawen nnsen, s ccevyat n yiv iberkanen. Widak d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara ten Nfesser akw, a Nini, imiren, i wid icurken: "imukan nnwen, kunwi akked icriken nnwen"! Sinna Nessemfaôaq iten. A d inin, icriken nnsen: "maççi d nekwni ay tâabdem.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Nfesser akw, a Nini, imiren, i wid icurken: "imukan nnwen, kunwi akked icriken nnwen"! Sinna Nessemfaôaq iten. A d inin, icriken nnsen: "maççi d nekwni ay tâabdem.

ayahs.text: Ad Iqadd Öebbi, d Anagi garane$ yidwen, ar ur d necliâ deg uâbbed nnwen".
ayahs.translation: Ad Iqadd Öebbi, d Anagi garane$ yidwen, ar ur d necliâ deg uâbbed nnwen".

ayahs.text: Din, yal amdan ad iwali ayen iwasa. Ad u$alen ar Öebbi, Bab nnsen n tidep. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: Din, yal amdan ad iwali ayen iwasa. Ad u$alen ar Öebbi, Bab nnsen n tidep. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "anwa ikwen Ip$itin seg igenni akked tmurt? Anwa ay d Bab n tmejjin akked yiéôi? Anwa id Issuffu$en amuddir si lmegget, id Issuffu$en lmegget seg umuddir? Anwa i Iseyyin lameô"? A d inin: "d Öebbi". Ini: "ihi, day ur tepêezzibem ara"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "anwa ikwen Ip$itin seg igenni akked tmurt? Anwa ay d Bab n tmejjin akked yiéôi? Anwa id Issuffu$en amuddir si lmegget, id Issuffu$en lmegget seg umuddir? Anwa i Iseyyin lameô"? A d inin: "d Öebbi". Ini: "ihi, day ur tepêezzibem ara"?

ayahs.text: D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen n tidep. Deffir tidep, acu i illan, siwa ttelfan? Ihi, acimi texdâam?
ayahs.translation: D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen n tidep. Deffir tidep, acu i illan, siwa ttelfan? Ihi, acimi texdâam?

ayahs.text: Akka i iûaô wawal n Mass ik, $ef wid ixedmen tucmitin. Ih, nitni ur ppamnen.
ayahs.translation: Akka i iûaô wawal n Mass ik, $ef wid ixedmen tucmitin. Ih, nitni ur ppamnen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "day illa ger icriken nnwen, win id inzan lxelq, sinna, iules as d"? Ini: "Öebbi inezzu lxelq, sinna, Ippales as d. Ihi, amek ara twexxôem"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "day illa ger icriken nnwen, win id inzan lxelq, sinna, iules as d"? Ini: "Öebbi inezzu lxelq, sinna, Ippales as d. Ihi, amek ara twexxôem"?

ayahs.text: Ini: "day illa, ger icriken nnwen, win i inehhun ar tidep"? Ini: "Öebbi Inehhu ar tidep. Win Inehhun ar tidep, day ur Yif ara, akken Iklal tikli yideS, win ur nennehhu, siwa ma ipwanha? Acu ikwen iu$en? Amek tepseyyim"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "day illa, ger icriken nnwen, win i inehhun ar tidep"? Ini: "Öebbi Inehhu ar tidep. Win Inehhun ar tidep, day ur Yif ara, akken Iklal tikli yideS, win ur nennehhu, siwa ma ipwanha? Acu ikwen iu$en? Amek tepseyyim"?

ayahs.text: Tegwti, segsen, teddun kan d nnwaya. Nnwaya, war ccekk, ur tebbwi acemma si tidep. Ih, Öebbi Issen acu xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Tegwti, segsen, teddun kan d nnwaya. Nnwaya, war ccekk, ur tebbwi acemma si tidep. Ih, Öebbi Issen acu xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Leqwôan agi ur d innulfa ara, war Öebbi. Maca, d atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d afeûûel n Tezmamt, ur degs ccekk, s$uô Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Leqwôan agi ur d innulfa ara, war Öebbi. Maca, d atebbet n wayen it id izwaren, d afeûûel n Tezmamt, ur degs ccekk, s$uô Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: Ne$ la qqaôen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed tasuôep i t icban, neccdet seg wanda tzemrem, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep".
ayahs.translation: Ne$ la qqaôen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed tasuôep i t icban, neccdet seg wanda tzemrem, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep".

ayahs.text: Xaîi, skaddben ayen ur nekcim di tmusni nnsen, ur ten id iusi usefhem is. Akka ay skaddben, wid i ten id izwaren. Wali, ihi, amek tevôa d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi, skaddben ayen ur nekcim di tmusni nnsen, ur ten id iusi usefhem is. Akka ay skaddben, wid i ten id izwaren. Wali, ihi, amek tevôa d imednas.

ayahs.text: Garasen, wid iumnen yis; garasen, wid ur numin yis. Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen ifessaden.
ayahs.translation: Garasen, wid iumnen yis; garasen, wid ur numin yis. Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen ifessaden.

ayahs.text: Ma skaddben k, ini: "i nek igiten iw, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur teppkam deg wayen xedme$, ur ppka$ deg wayen txedmem".
ayahs.translation: Ma skaddben k, ini: "i nek igiten iw, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur teppkam deg wayen xedme$, ur ppka$ deg wayen txedmem".

ayahs.text: Garasen, llan wid i k issemêasen. Day tzemrev a pperrev ad slen iâeééugen, ma llan ur fehhmen?
ayahs.translation: Garasen, llan wid i k issemêasen. Day tzemrev a pperrev ad slen iâeééugen, ma llan ur fehhmen?

ayahs.text: Garasen, llan wid i k ipmuqulen. Day tzemrev a ppenhuv ider$alen, ma llan ur pwalin?
ayahs.translation: Garasen, llan wid i k ipmuqulen. Day tzemrev a ppenhuv ider$alen, ma llan ur pwalin?

ayahs.text: Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iddennis imdanen, s wacemma, maca imdanen densen iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iddennis imdanen, s wacemma, maca imdanen densen iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, amzun sâaddan kan saâa n wass, ad msaâqalen. Ni$ xesôen wid iskaddben timlilit d Öebbi. Ur pwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, amzun sâaddan kan saâa n wass, ad msaâqalen. Ni$ xesôen wid iskaddben timlilit d Öebbi. Ur pwanhan.

ayahs.text: Ad ak Nessken kra seg wayen i sen Nâahed, ne$ a k id Nawi $uône£. Ihi, $uône£ tu$alin nnsen. Sinna, Öebbi d Anagi n wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ad ak Nessken kra seg wayen i sen Nâahed, ne$ a k id Nawi $uône£. Ihi, $uône£ tu$alin nnsen. Sinna, Öebbi d Anagi n wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: I yal lois, amazan. Ma iusa d umazan nnsen, a ppefru garasen s lmizan, ur pwadensen.
ayahs.translation: I yal lois, amazan. Ma iusa d umazan nnsen, a ppefru garasen s lmizan, ur pwadensen.

ayahs.text: Qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma tessawalem tidep?
ayahs.translation: Qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma tessawalem tidep?

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur mlike$ i iman iw vveôô, ne$ aba$uô, siwa ayen Ib$a Öebbi. Yal lois s lajel is". Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen s saâa, ur t id sseqôaben.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur mlike$ i iman iw vveôô, ne$ aba$uô, siwa ayen Ib$a Öebbi. Yal lois s lajel is". Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen s saâa, ur t id sseqôaben.

ayahs.text: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb iS, deg iv, ne$ deg wass? Acimi êaren $uôeS ibe$wviyen?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "acu twalam, ma iusa kwen id uâaqeb iS, deg iv, ne$ deg wass? Acimi êaren $uôeS ibe$wviyen?

ayahs.text: D$a, ma iusa d, a ppamnem yis? Tura, aql akwen t$eûbem fellas".
ayahs.translation: D$a, ma iusa d, a ppamnem yis? Tura, aql akwen t$eûbem fellas".

ayahs.text: Sinna, ad asen inin i wid idensen: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n lebda. Ma teppuqeîîan siwa kan $ef wayen tkeppbem"?
ayahs.translation: Sinna, ad asen inin i wid idensen: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n lebda. Ma teppuqeîîan siwa kan $ef wayen tkeppbem"?

ayahs.text: Steqsayen k: "d tidep ayagi"? Ini: "ih, s Mass iw, ar ayagi d tidep! Kunwi ur tezmirem i usfunneg".
ayahs.translation: Steqsayen k: "d tidep ayagi"? Ini: "ih, s Mass iw, ar ayagi d tidep! Kunwi ur tezmirem i usfunneg".

ayahs.text: Xas ad isâu, yal amdan idensen, i illan di tmurt, ur d ifeddu yis. Ffren nndama mi walan aâaqeb. Aêuddu garasen, s lmizan, ur pwadensen.
ayahs.translation: Xas ad isâu, yal amdan idensen, i illan di tmurt, ur d ifeddu yis. Ffren nndama mi walan aâaqeb. Aêuddu garasen, s lmizan, ur pwadensen.

ayahs.text: Day, s tidep, maççi n Öebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ih, day lemâahda n Öebbi maççi d tidep? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Day, s tidep, maççi n Öebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ih, day lemâahda n Öebbi maççi d tidep? Maca, tegwti segsen ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Neppa Issidir, Ineqq. £uôeS ara tu$alem.
ayahs.translation: Neppa Issidir, Ineqq. £uôeS ara tu$alem.

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Ni$ iusa kwen id unabi s$uô Mass nnwen, akked ccfa n wayen iblan ulawen, akked nnhaya, akked uêunu i lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Ni$ iusa kwen id unabi s$uô Mass nnwen, akked ccfa n wayen iblan ulawen, akked nnhaya, akked uêunu i lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ini: "s lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, s waya, xas ad feôêen". Yif ayen pkemmimen.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "s lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, s waya, xas ad feôêen". Yif ayen pkemmimen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "twalam ayen i wen d Issers Öebbi n ôôeéq? Terram segs leêlal d leêôam". Ini: "Iâammed awen Öebbi, ne$ tesnulfam d $ef Öebbi"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "twalam ayen i wen d Issers Öebbi n ôôeéq? Terram segs leêlal d leêôam". Ini: "Iâammed awen Öebbi, ne$ tesnulfam d $ef Öebbi"?

ayahs.text: Acu ara meyyzen, ass n tnekra, wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Ih, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl af imdanen, maca tegwti segsen ur snemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Acu ara meyyzen, ass n tnekra, wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Ih, Öebbi d Bab n lfevl af imdanen, maca tegwti segsen ur snemmiren.

ayahs.text: Ur teppiliv di liêala, ur temmalev si Leqwôan, ur tepce$wilem di kra, mebla ma Nella d Inagan nnwen, mara tweqmem. Lmizan ubelkim di tmurt u deg igenni, ur idrig i Mass ik. Akken seddaw waya, ne$ sennig es. Akw, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Ur teppiliv di liêala, ur temmalev si Leqwôan, ur tepce$wilem di kra, mebla ma Nella d Inagan nnwen, mara tweqmem. Lmizan ubelkim di tmurt u deg igenni, ur idrig i Mass ik. Akken seddaw waya, ne$ sennig es. Akw, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Ih, s tidep, iêbiben n Öebbi ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, s tidep, iêbiben n Öebbi ur ppagwaden, ur $weblen.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen u llan êezzben,
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen u llan êezzben,

ayahs.text: a ten beccôen s lxiô di tmeddurt n ddunit, di laxeôt. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawalen n Öebbi. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: a ten beccôen s lxiô di tmeddurt n ddunit, di laxeôt. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawalen n Öebbi. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Ur k i$webbel wawal nnsen. Ih, tazmert akw n Öebbi. Neppa Isell, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ur k i$webbel wawal nnsen. Ih, tazmert akw n Öebbi. Neppa Isell, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: S tidep, day maççi n Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt? D acu îîafaôen wid ipnujun, war Öebbi, ar icriken? Ïîafaôen kan nnwaya. Oaââlen kan.
ayahs.translation: S tidep, day maççi n Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt? D acu îîafaôen wid ipnujun, war Öebbi, ar icriken? Ïîafaôen kan nnwaya. Oaââlen kan.

ayahs.text: Neppa, i wen Irran iv i ureyyeê nnwen, ass iwakken a pwalim. Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i ugdud isellen.
ayahs.translation: Neppa, i wen Irran iv i ureyyeê nnwen, ass iwakken a pwalim. Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i ugdud isellen.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "Öebbi Isâa aqcic. Gedha s yiS! Neppa d Ameôkanti. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ur tesâim adabu $ef waya. Day a d tinim $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "Öebbi Isâa aqcic. Gedha s yiS! Neppa d Ameôkanti. IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ur tesâim adabu $ef waya. Day a d tinim $ef Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?

ayahs.text: Ini: "s tidep, wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ur rebêen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "s tidep, wid id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ur rebêen".

ayahs.text: Zzhu di ddunit, sinna, $uône£ tu$alin nnsen. D$a, ad asen Nsâaddi aâaqeb uqsiê, imi llan jehlen.
ayahs.translation: Zzhu di ddunit, sinna, $uône£ tu$alin nnsen. D$a, ad asen Nsâaddi aâaqeb uqsiê, imi llan jehlen.

ayahs.text: Eêku yasen d tadyant n Nuê, mi inna i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Ma ééayit fellawen tilin iw, akked usmekti w n issekniyen n Öebbi, $ef Öebbi ppekle$, ihi, zduklet lameô nnwen akked icriken nnwen. Sinna, ur awen teppili lhejna $ef lameô nnwen, d$a, frut ep felli, ur iyi sganit.
ayahs.translation: Eêku yasen d tadyant n Nuê, mi inna i ugdud is: "a yagdud iw! Ma ééayit fellawen tilin iw, akked usmekti w n issekniyen n Öebbi, $ef Öebbi ppekle$, ihi, zduklet lameô nnwen akked icriken nnwen. Sinna, ur awen teppili lhejna $ef lameô nnwen, d$a, frut ep felli, ur iyi sganit.

ayahs.text: Ma twexxôem, ur awen ssuture$ taqdiât. Ih, taqdiât iw ar Öebbi kan. Felli lameô ad ili$ seg imvuâen.
ayahs.translation: Ma twexxôem, ur awen ssuture$ taqdiât. Ih, taqdiât iw ar Öebbi kan. Felli lameô ad ili$ seg imvuâen.

ayahs.text: Skaddben t. Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuô. Nerra ten d igensas. Ne$meq wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Wali amek tevôa d wid ippunedôen.
ayahs.translation: Skaddben t. Nsellek it, akked wid illan yides, di lbabuô. Nerra ten d igensas. Ne$meq wid iskaddben issekniyen nne£. Wali amek tevôa d wid ippunedôen.

ayahs.text: Sinna, deffir es, Nuzen ed imazanen ar igduden nnsen. Usan ten id s ubeggen. Ur ssawven ad amnen $ef wayen nekôen zik. Akka ay Nselle$ ulawen ixabiten.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, deffir es, Nuzen ed imazanen ar igduden nnsen. Usan ten id s ubeggen. Ur ssawven ad amnen $ef wayen nekôen zik. Akka ay Nselle$ ulawen ixabiten.

ayahs.text: Sinna, deffir sen, Nuzen ed Musa akked Haôun, ar Ferâun akked imvebbôen is, s issekniyen nne£. Sme$wôen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, deffir sen, Nuzen ed Musa akked Haôun, ar Ferâun akked imvebbôen is, s issekniyen nne£. Sme$wôen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: Mi ten id tusa tidep, s$uône£, nnan: "wagi, ih, d ssêur n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: Mi ten id tusa tidep, s$uône£, nnan: "wagi, ih, d ssêur n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Inna Musa: "day a tinim d ssêur wagi, i tidep mi kwen id tusa"? Ur rebêen iseêêaren.
ayahs.translation: Inna Musa: "day a tinim d ssêur wagi, i tidep mi kwen id tusa"? Ur rebêen iseêêaren.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "day d tusiv $uône$, ad a$ tesîixxôev seg wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$, a ppu$alem, di sin, d imeqwôanen di tmurt? Ur numin, nekwni, yiswen".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "day d tusiv $uône$, ad a$ tesîixxôev seg wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$, a ppu$alem, di sin, d imeqwôanen di tmurt? Ur numin, nekwni, yiswen".

ayahs.text: Inna Ferâun: "awit iyi d yal aseêêar amusnaw".
ayahs.translation: Inna Ferâun: "awit iyi d yal aseêêar amusnaw".

ayahs.text: Mi d usan iseêêaren, inna yasen Musa: "veggôet ara tveggôem"!
ayahs.translation: Mi d usan iseêêaren, inna yasen Musa: "veggôet ara tveggôem"!

ayahs.text: Mi veggôen, inna Musa: "ayen d tebbwim d ssêur. S tidep, a t Inqev Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi ur Issewqam ara igiten ifessaden.
ayahs.translation: Mi veggôen, inna Musa: "ayen d tebbwim d ssêur. S tidep, a t Inqev Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi ur Issewqam ara igiten ifessaden.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Itebbit tidep, s wawal iS, xas ugin ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Itebbit tidep, s wawal iS, xas ugin ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: I iumnen s Musa, siwa tarwa seg ugdud is, ilmend n tugdi uhewwel n Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ih, Ferâun d abe$wvi di tmurt. Neppa, s tidep, seg imaâfan.
ayahs.translation: I iumnen s Musa, siwa tarwa seg ugdud is, ilmend n tugdi uhewwel n Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ih, Ferâun d abe$wvi di tmurt. Neppa, s tidep, seg imaâfan.

ayahs.text: Inna Musa: "a yagdud iw! Ma teppamnem s Öebbi, ppeklet fellaS ma d imvuâen ay tellam".
ayahs.translation: Inna Musa: "a yagdud iw! Ma teppamnem s Öebbi, ppeklet fellaS ma d imvuâen ay tellam".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "neppkel $ef Öebbi. A Mass nne$, ur a$ ppara d ahewwel i ugdud imednas;
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "neppkel $ef Öebbi. A Mass nne$, ur a$ ppara d ahewwel i ugdud imednas;

ayahs.text: Sellek a$, s uêunu K, seg ugdud ijehliyen".
ayahs.translation: Sellek a$, s uêunu K, seg ugdud ijehliyen".

ayahs.text: Nweêêa i Musa akked gma s: "ebnut ixxamen i ugdud nnwen di Maûeô, erret ixxamen nnwen ar lqibla, beddet i téallit. Becceô lmumnin".
ayahs.translation: Nweêêa i Musa akked gma s: "ebnut ixxamen i ugdud nnwen di Maûeô, erret ixxamen nnwen ar lqibla, beddet i téallit. Becceô lmumnin".

ayahs.text: Inna Musa: "a Mass nne$! S tidep, Tefkiv i Ferâun akked imvebbôen is, ôôêuê akked wayla di tmeddurt n ddunit, a Mass nne$, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid iK. A Mass nne$, Squcc ayla nnsen, S$eô ulawen nnsen, ur ppamnen alamma walan aâaqeb aqeôêan".
ayahs.translation: Inna Musa: "a Mass nne$! S tidep, Tefkiv i Ferâun akked imvebbôen is, ôôêuê akked wayla di tmeddurt n ddunit, a Mass nne$, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid iK. A Mass nne$, Squcc ayla nnsen, S$eô ulawen nnsen, ur ppamnen alamma walan aâaqeb aqeôêan".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ih, tepwaqbel tnaâôit nnwen. Ddut di lewqam, ur teddut d ubrid n wid ur nessin".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ih, tepwaqbel tnaâôit nnwen. Ddut di lewqam, ur teddut d ubrid n wid ur nessin".

ayahs.text: Nezzger At Isôail di yill. Vefôen ten Ferâun akked iâsekôiwen is, s leb$wev d lewâaôa. Armi ibbwev ad i$meq, inna: "umne$! Ih, ur illi ôebbi siwa Win is umnen At Isôail. Nek seg imvuâen".
ayahs.translation: Nezzger At Isôail di yill. Vefôen ten Ferâun akked iâsekôiwen is, s leb$wev d lewâaôa. Armi ibbwev ad i$meq, inna: "umne$! Ih, ur illi ôebbi siwa Win is umnen At Isôail. Nek seg imvuâen".

ayahs.text: Tura! Ni$ zik taâûav, telliv seg ifessaden.
ayahs.translation: Tura! Ni$ zik taâûav, telliv seg ifessaden.

ayahs.text: Assa, a Nsellek loeppa k, a d tegwri d assekni i wid ara k id ineûfen. Aîas n medden, s tidep, stehzan deg issekniyen nne£.
ayahs.translation: Assa, a Nsellek loeppa k, a d tegwri d assekni i wid ara k id ineûfen. Aîas n medden, s tidep, stehzan deg issekniyen nne£.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nessers At Isôail deg umkan umâin, u N$at iten s wayen ilhan. Ur mgaraden armi ten id tusa tussna. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ilmend n wayen i$ef llan mgaraden.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nessers At Isôail deg umkan umâin, u N$at iten s wayen ilhan. Ur mgaraden armi ten id tusa tussna. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ilmend n wayen i$ef llan mgaraden.

ayahs.text: Ma tcukkev $ef wayen i k ed Nessers, steqsi wid i iqqaôen Tazmamt, uqbel ik. Ni$ tusa k id tidep, s$uô Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.
ayahs.translation: Ma tcukkev $ef wayen i k ed Nessers, steqsi wid i iqqaôen Tazmamt, uqbel ik. Ni$ tusa k id tidep, s$uô Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcukkun.

ayahs.text: Ur ppili seg wid i iskaddben issekniyen n Öebbi, a ppiliv seg imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppili seg wid i iskaddben issekniyen n Öebbi, a ppiliv seg imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid i$ef iûaô Wawal n Mass ik, ur ppamnen,
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid i$ef iûaô Wawal n Mass ik, ur ppamnen,

ayahs.text: xas usan ten id akw issekniyen, alamma walan aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: xas usan ten id akw issekniyen, alamma walan aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: A lemmer telli temdint iumnen, u infaâ p liman is, siwa agdud n Yunes! Mi umnen, Nveôôef segsen aâaqeb imdelli di tmeddurt n ddunit. Neooa ten zzhan tallit kan.
ayahs.translation: A lemmer telli temdint iumnen, u infaâ p liman is, siwa agdud n Yunes! Mi umnen, Nveôôef segsen aâaqeb imdelli di tmeddurt n ddunit. Neooa ten zzhan tallit kan.

ayahs.text: Ma ihwa yaS i Mass ik, ad amnen wid illan di ddunit, akken ma llan. Day a pêeppmev, keçç, i imdanen ad amnen?
ayahs.translation: Ma ihwa yaS i Mass ik, ad amnen wid illan di ddunit, akken ma llan. Day a pêeppmev, keçç, i imdanen ad amnen?

ayahs.text: Ur ippamen umdan siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Isdullu wid ur nfehhem ara.
ayahs.translation: Ur ippamen umdan siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Isdullu wid ur nfehhem ara.

ayahs.text: Ini: "walit i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ula iwumi issekniyen akked ineddiôen, i ugdud ur neppamen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "walit i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ula iwumi issekniyen akked ineddiôen, i ugdud ur neppamen".

ayahs.text: Day a pganin kan amedya n wussan n wid i ten id izwaren? Ini: "gganit, nek yidwen, seg wid ipganin".
ayahs.translation: Day a pganin kan amedya n wussan n wid i ten id izwaren? Ini: "gganit, nek yidwen, seg wid ipganin".

ayahs.text: Sinna, a Nsellek imazanen nne£, akked wid iumnen. Akka ay d lwajeb fella£, a Nsellek lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, a Nsellek imazanen nne£, akked wid iumnen. Akka ay d lwajeb fella£, a Nsellek lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yimdanen! Ma tcukkem di ddin iw, nek ur âabde$ wid tâabdem, war Öebbi. Maca, âabde$ Öebbi ara Idmen leôwaê nnwen. Pwamôe$ ad ili$ si lmumnin".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen! Ma tcukkem di ddin iw, nek ur âabde$ wid tâabdem, war Öebbi. Maca, âabde$ Öebbi ara Idmen leôwaê nnwen. Pwamôe$ ad ili$ si lmumnin".

ayahs.text: Sbedd udem ik i ddin, s umili ar tidep, ur ppili seg imcurak.
ayahs.translation: Sbedd udem ik i ddin, s umili ar tidep, ur ppili seg imcurak.

ayahs.text: Ur pnuju, war Öebbi, ar wayen ur k inefâan, ur k iîîuôôun. Ma txedmev akken, keçç, imiren, a ppiliv seg imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ur pnuju, war Öebbi, ar wayen ur k inefâan, ur k iîîuôôun. Ma txedmev akken, keçç, imiren, a ppiliv seg imednas.

ayahs.text: Ma Isâadda fellak Öebbi ccqa, ur ak illi ujebbaô siwa Neppa. Ma Irad ak lxiô, ur illi usebîîel i lfevl iS. Ippak it i win i S ihwan, deg ixdimen iS. Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ma Isâadda fellak Öebbi ccqa, ur ak illi ujebbaô siwa Neppa. Ma Irad ak lxiô, ur illi usebîîel i lfevl iS. Ippak it i win i S ihwan, deg ixdimen iS. Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yimdanen! Ni$ tusa kwen id tidep s$uô Mass nnwen! Win ipwanhan, ipwanha kan i iman is; win innetlafen, innetlef kan i iman is. Ur lli$, nek, d awkil nnwen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen! Ni$ tusa kwen id tidep s$uô Mass nnwen! Win ipwanhan, ipwanha kan i iman is; win innetlafen, innetlef kan i iman is. Ur lli$, nek, d awkil nnwen".

ayahs.text: Ddu d wayen ik ed ippuweêêan, eûbeô ard Iêudd Öebbi. Neppa, Yif akw imêaddan.
ayahs.translation: Ddu d wayen ik ed ippuweêêan, eûbeô ard Iêudd Öebbi. Neppa, Yif akw imêaddan.

verses.text: Alô. Tazmamt, issekniyen iS ppuûewwben, sinna, ppufeûûlen s$uô Uûwib i Ipwaxebbôen.
verses.translation: Alô. Tazmamt, issekniyen iS ppuûewwben, sinna, ppufeûûlen s$uô Uûwib i Ipwaxebbôen.

verses.text: Ur âabdet siwa Öebbi. Nek, s$uôeS $uôwen, d aneddaô u d abcir.
verses.translation: Ur âabdet siwa Öebbi. Nek, s$uôeS $uôwen, d aneddaô u d abcir.

verses.text: Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, steôoâet aS, ad Ifeôôeo fellawen afeôôeo ilhan, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ippak lfevl iS i yal bab n lfevl. Ma twexxôem, nekk ugade$ a ppeppuâqbem, ass ameqwran.
verses.translation: Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, steôoâet aS, ad Ifeôôeo fellawen afeôôeo ilhan, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ippak lfevl iS i yal bab n lfevl. Ma twexxôem, nekk ugade$ a ppeppuâqbem, ass ameqwran.

verses.text: Tu$alin nnwen, ar Öebbi. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Tu$alin nnwen, ar Öebbi. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Day nitni, s tidep, ur snefvasen ara idmaren nnsen, iwakken ad ffren fellaS? Xas $ummen s iceîîiven nnsen, day ur Iéôa ara ayen teffren akked wayen d qqaôen? Neppa, s tidep, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Day nitni, s tidep, ur snefvasen ara idmaren nnsen, iwakken ad ffren fellaS? Xas $ummen s iceîîiven nnsen, day ur Iéôa ara ayen teffren akked wayen d qqaôen? Neppa, s tidep, Issen i illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: Ur illi lweêc di tmurt, mebla ma illa ôôeéq is ar Öebbi. Issen tanezdu$t is, tanîelt is. Meôôa, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Ur illi lweêc di tmurt, mebla ma illa ôôeéq is ar Öebbi. Issen tanezdu$t is, tanîelt is. Meôôa, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.

verses.text: D Neppa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Asgeld iS illa $ef waman. A kwen Ijeôôeb anwi segwen ara ixedmen ayen ilhan, sennig wiyav. Ma tenniv: "ih, kunwi a d tekkrem deffir tmeppant nnwen", wid ijehlen, war ccekk, a d inin: "ayagi, kan, d ssêur n ûûeê".
verses.translation: D Neppa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Asgeld iS illa $ef waman. A kwen Ijeôôeb anwi segwen ara ixedmen ayen ilhan, sennig wiyav. Ma tenniv: "ih, kunwi a d tekkrem deffir tmeppant nnwen", wid ijehlen, war ccekk, a d inin: "ayagi, kan, d ssêur n ûûeê".

verses.text: Ma Neswexxeô asen aâaqeb ar imir ipwassnen, war ccekk, a d inin: "d acu iT iîîfen"? Ass ideg ara ten id iawev, day illa wa ara ten iveôôfen segs? Ad asen izzi wayen i$ef pmmaâliken.
verses.translation: Ma Neswexxeô asen aâaqeb ar imir ipwassnen, war ccekk, a d inin: "d acu iT iîîfen"? Ass ideg ara ten id iawev, day illa wa ara ten iveôôfen segs? Ad asen izzi wayen i$ef pmmaâliken.

verses.text: Ma Nesêess i umdan aêunu nne¨£, sinna, Nekkes as t, atan ad iayes, ad ijhel.
verses.translation: Ma Nesêess i umdan aêunu nne¨£, sinna, Nekkes as t, atan ad iayes, ad ijhel.

verses.text: Ma Nesêess as l$it, deffir twa$it i t innulen, atan ad yini: "fukkent felli lemêayen", d$a, neppa, ad ifôeê, ad izux.
verses.translation: Ma Nesêess as l$it, deffir twa$it i t innulen, atan ad yini: "fukkent felli lemêayen", d$a, neppa, ad ifôeê, ad izux.

verses.text: Kkes ed wid iûebbôen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. I widak ssmaê akked tikci meqqwôen.
verses.translation: Kkes ed wid iûebbôen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. I widak ssmaê akked tikci meqqwôen.

verses.text: Ahat teppaoav kra n wayen ik ed ippuweêêan. Pzemmiven yis idmaren ik mara qqaôen: "a lemmer i s d irs ugerruj, ne$ idda d, yides, lmelk"! Keçç d aneddaô kan. Öebbi d Awkil n yal cci.
verses.translation: Ahat teppaoav kra n wayen ik ed ippuweêêan. Pzemmiven yis idmaren ik mara qqaôen: "a lemmer i s d irs ugerruj, ne$ idda d, yides, lmelk"! Keçç d aneddaô kan. Öebbi d Awkil n yal cci.

verses.text: Ne$ ad inin: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed, s usnulfu, mraw n tsuôtin am neppa. Naâôet ayen iwumi tzemrem, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep".
verses.translation: Ne$ ad inin: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed, s usnulfu, mraw n tsuôtin am neppa. Naâôet ayen iwumi tzemrem, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep".

verses.text: Ma ur awen d rran ara, cfut ar irs ed kan s tussna n Öebbi, ar ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Ihi, ma kunwi d imvuâen?
verses.translation: Ma ur awen d rran ara, cfut ar irs ed kan s tussna n Öebbi, ar ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Ihi, ma kunwi d imvuâen?

verses.text: I wid ib$an tameddurt n ddunit akked ôôêuê is, a Nkafi, degs, igiten nnsen, ur asen Ntekkes.
verses.translation: I wid ib$an tameddurt n ddunit akked ôôêuê is, a Nkafi, degs, igiten nnsen, ur asen Ntekkes.

verses.text: Widak, ur ppafen, di laxeôt, siwa times. Ad i$li wayen ûenâen degs; inqev wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Widak, ur ppafen, di laxeôt, siwa times. Ad i$li wayen ûenâen degs; inqev wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Day win iddan d ubeggen, s$uô Mass is, u immal as t unagi s$uôeS…? U, uqbel is, Tazmamt n Musa, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Wigi umnen yis. Win i p inekôen, seg ikubar, ppaâud is d times. Ur ppili di ccekk fellas. Neppa, ih, d tidep s$uô Mass ik. Maca, tegwti n medden ur ppamnen.
verses.translation: Day win iddan d ubeggen, s$uô Mass is, u immal as t unagi s$uôeS…? U, uqbel is, Tazmamt n Musa, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Wigi umnen yis. Win i p inekôen, seg ikubar, ppaâud is d times. Ur ppili di ccekk fellas. Neppa, ih, d tidep s$uô Mass ik. Maca, tegwti n medden ur ppamnen.

verses.text: Anwa idensen sennig win id isnulfan tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Wigi a d rsen i Mass nnsen. A d inin inagan: "d wigi i iskaddben $ef Mass nnsen". Day Öebbi ur Ixezzu yara imednas?
verses.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win id isnulfan tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Wigi a d rsen i Mass nnsen. A d inin inagan: "d wigi i iskaddben $ef Mass nnsen". Day Öebbi ur Ixezzu yara imednas?

verses.text: I isîixxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, i t issarmen d uâwij, nitni ur uminen s laxeôt?
verses.translation: I isîixxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, i t issarmen d uâwij, nitni ur uminen s laxeôt?

verses.text: Wigi, ur sfunnugen di tmurt, ur asen illi bab, war Öebbi. Fellasen aâaqeb ar wayev. Ur zmiren ad slen, ur pwalin.
verses.translation: Wigi, ur sfunnugen di tmurt, ur asen illi bab, war Öebbi. Fellasen aâaqeb ar wayev. Ur zmiren ad slen, ur pwalin.

verses.text: D wigi i isxesôen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
verses.translation: D wigi i isxesôen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

verses.text: Ur illi ccekk, ih, nitni ad xesôen, di laxeôt, sennig wiyav.
verses.translation: Ur illi ccekk, ih, nitni ad xesôen, di laxeôt, sennig wiyav.

verses.text: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u unzen aS i Mass nnsen, widak d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u unzen aS i Mass nnsen, widak d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Amedya n snat n trebbuyaâ am uder$al, uâééug, akked win ipwalin, win isellen. Day âadlen sin imedyaten agi? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
verses.translation: Amedya n snat n trebbuyaâ am uder$al, uâééug, akked win ipwalin, win isellen. Day âadlen sin imedyaten agi? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?

verses.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê i ugdud is: "nek d aneddaô nnwen ipbegginen,
verses.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê i ugdud is: "nek d aneddaô nnwen ipbegginen,

verses.text: iwakken ur tâabdem siwa Öebbi. Nek ugaded aâaqeb fellawen, ass aqeôhan".
verses.translation: iwakken ur tâabdem siwa Öebbi. Nek ugaded aâaqeb fellawen, ass aqeôhan".

verses.text: Nnan imvebbôen, wid ijehlen, seg ugdud is: "keçç, $uône$, d amdan am nekwni. Nwala, d ôôdiyen nne$, kan, war ameyyez, i k ivefôen. Ur nwala s wacu i $ tifem. Xaîi, nêesb ikwen d ikeddaben".
verses.translation: Nnan imvebbôen, wid ijehlen, seg ugdud is: "keçç, $uône$, d amdan am nekwni. Nwala, d ôôdiyen nne$, kan, war ameyyez, i k ivefôen. Ur nwala s wacu i $ tifem. Xaîi, nêesb ikwen d ikeddaben".

verses.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aêunu s$uôeS. Idreg fellawen. Day a t nêeppem fellawen, ma kunwi tugim t?
verses.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aêunu s$uôeS. Idreg fellawen. Day a t nêeppem fellawen, ma kunwi tugim t?

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssuture$ ayla, ilmend is; taqdiât iw ar Öebbi kan. Ur ppara$, nek, wid iumnen. S tidep, ad mlilen d Mass nnsen. Maca, nek wala$ kwen d agdud ur nessin.
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssuture$ ayla, ilmend is; taqdiât iw ar Öebbi kan. Ur ppara$, nek, wid iumnen. S tidep, ad mlilen d Mass nnsen. Maca, nek wala$ kwen d agdud ur nessin.

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Öebbi, lemmer i ten rri$ akin, day ur d tesmektayem ara?
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Öebbi, lemmer i ten rri$ akin, day ur d tesmektayem ara?

verses.text: Ur awen qqaôe$: $uôi lexzayen n Öebbi. Ur ssine$ tabavnit. Ur qqaôe$: nek d lmelk. Ur qqaôe$ i wid êeqôent wallen nnwen: ur asen Ippak ara Öebbi lxiô, d awez$i. Yif akw Öebbi akken Iéôa, i illan deg iman nnsen. Mulac ad ili$ seg imednas".
verses.translation: Ur awen qqaôe$: $uôi lexzayen n Öebbi. Ur ssine$ tabavnit. Ur qqaôe$: nek d lmelk. Ur qqaôe$ i wid êeqôent wallen nnwen: ur asen Ippak ara Öebbi lxiô, d awez$i. Yif akw Öebbi akken Iéôa, i illan deg iman nnsen. Mulac ad ili$ seg imednas".

verses.text: Nnan: "a Nuê! Ni$ tnamrev a$, tessugtev a$ anamer. Ihi, awi ya$ d ayen i $ tâahdev, ma tessawalev tidep".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a Nuê! Ni$ tnamrev a$, tessugtev a$ anamer. Ihi, awi ya$ d ayen i $ tâahdev, ma tessawalev tidep".

verses.text: Inna: "d Öebbi kan ar awen t id Iawin, ma ihwa yaS. Kunwi ur tesfunnugem.
verses.translation: Inna: "d Öebbi kan ar awen t id Iawin, ma ihwa yaS. Kunwi ur tesfunnugem.

verses.text: Xas b$i$ a kwen neûêe$, ur tesfaydayam seg wanûaê iw, ma Ib$a Öebbi a kwen Itlef. Neppa d Mass nnwen; tu$alin nnwen $uôeS".
verses.translation: Xas b$i$ a kwen neûêe$, ur tesfaydayam seg wanûaê iw, ma Ib$a Öebbi a kwen Itlef. Neppa d Mass nnwen; tu$alin nnwen $uôeS".

verses.text: Ne$ qqaôen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "ma snulfa$ t id, lbe$wv iw i yiri w. Nek, ur ppka$ di lbe$wv nnwen".
verses.translation: Ne$ qqaôen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "ma snulfa$ t id, lbe$wv iw i yiri w. Nek, ur ppka$ di lbe$wv nnwen".

verses.text: Ippuweêêa d i Nuê: "ur ippamen yiwen, d awez$i, seg ugdud ik, siwa wid illan umnen. Ihi, ur k icqi wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ippuweêêa d i Nuê: "ur ippamen yiwen, d awez$i, seg ugdud ik, siwa wid illan umnen. Ihi, ur k icqi wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Eûnaâ lbabuô, ger wallen nne£, s uweêêi nne£. Ur iyI d pmeslay $ef wid idensen, war ccekk, ad $emqen".
verses.translation: Eûnaâ lbabuô, ger wallen nne£, s uweêêi nne£. Ur iyI d pmeslay $ef wid idensen, war ccekk, ad $emqen".

verses.text: La iûennaâ lbabuô. Yal tikelt ara âaddin $uôes imvebbôen n ugdud is, tkaâriren fellas. Inna: "ma temmaâlkem degne$, ihi, a nemmaâlek degwen akken temmaâlkem.
verses.translation: La iûennaâ lbabuô. Yal tikelt ara âaddin $uôes imvebbôen n ugdud is, tkaâriren fellas. Inna: "ma temmaâlkem degne$, ihi, a nemmaâlek degwen akken temmaâlkem.

verses.text: Deqqal a ppeéôem, u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, ara iêaz uâaqeb imezgi".
verses.translation: Deqqal a ppeéôem, u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, ara iêaz uâaqeb imezgi".

verses.text: Alamma, mi d iusa lameô nne£, la pfeggiven igwefran d ihedman, Nenna: "awi degs tayuga n yal ûûenf, tawacult ik - siwa wid i$ef id izwar wawal -, akked wid iumnen". Drus kan i iumnen yides.
verses.translation: Alamma, mi d iusa lameô nne£, la pfeggiven igwefran d ihedman, Nenna: "awi degs tayuga n yal ûûenf, tawacult ik - siwa wid i$ef id izwar wawal -, akked wid iumnen". Drus kan i iumnen yides.

verses.text: Inna: "rekbet degs, s yisem n Öebbi, acali s akked trusi s. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
verses.translation: Inna: "rekbet degs, s yisem n Öebbi, acali s akked trusi s. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

verses.text: Icula yissen, di lemwao anect idurar. Issawel Nuê i mmi s, i illan weêdes: "a mmi ali d yidne$, ur teppiliv ar ijehliyen"!
verses.translation: Icula yissen, di lemwao anect idurar. Issawel Nuê i mmi s, i illan weêdes: "a mmi ali d yidne$, ur teppiliv ar ijehliyen"!

verses.text: Inna: "ûûôan iw d adrar, ad iyi isellek seg waman". Inna: "assa, ulac leslak si lameô n Öebbi, siwa i win i$ef Iêun". Âaddant lemwao garasen. Iûebê ed seg wid ipwa$emqen.
verses.translation: Inna: "ûûôan iw d adrar, ad iyi isellek seg waman". Inna: "assa, ulac leslak si lameô n Öebbi, siwa i win i$ef Iêun". Âaddant lemwao garasen. Iûebê ed seg wid ipwa$emqen.

verses.text: Nnan: "a tamurt, seblaâ aman im, a yigenni eûûfu". Aman zzren. Iûaô lameô: irs $ef Loudi. Iffe$ uberraê: akin agdud imednas!
verses.translation: Nnan: "a tamurt, seblaâ aman im, a yigenni eûûfu". Aman zzren. Iûaô lameô: irs $ef Loudi. Iffe$ uberraê: akin agdud imednas!

verses.text: Inuj Nuê ar Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Ni$ mmi n twacult iw. Ih, lemâahda K d tidep, Keçç Tifev akw imêaddan".
verses.translation: Inuj Nuê ar Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Ni$ mmi n twacult iw. Ih, lemâahda K d tidep, Keçç Tifev akw imêaddan".

verses.text: Inna: "a Nuê! Neppa, s tidep, ur illi n wacult ik. Ih, neppa ur ixdim ayen ilhan. Ihi, ur iyI d steqsay $ef wayen ur tessinev. Nek a k Ssakwaye$, ur teppiliv seg wid ur nessin".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Nuê! Neppa, s tidep, ur illi n wacult ik. Ih, neppa ur ixdim ayen ilhan. Ihi, ur iyI d steqsay $ef wayen ur tessinev. Nek a k Ssakwaye$, ur teppiliv seg wid ur nessin".

verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Ili di lâawen iw, iwakken ur K id steqsaye$ $ef wayen ur ssine$. Ma ur iyi Tsemmêev, ur Têunev felli, ad ili$ seg imexsuôen".

verses.text: Nnan d: "a Nuê! Ers ed s tifrat s$uône£, akked lbaôaka, fellak akw $ef leoyus i illan yidek. Kra n legyus, a ten N$it. Sinna, fellasen s$uône£, aâaqeb aqeôêan".
verses.translation: Nnan d: "a Nuê! Ers ed s tifrat s$uône£, akked lbaôaka, fellak akw $ef leoyus i illan yidek. Kra n legyus, a ten N$it. Sinna, fellasen s$uône£, aâaqeb aqeôêan".

verses.text: Tagi si teqûivin n tbavnit, Nweêêa yak tent. Ur tent tessinev, keçç, ne$ agdud ik, uqbel wagi. Ihi, eûbeô, taggara, war ccekk, i wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Tagi si teqûivin n tbavnit, Nweêêa yak tent. Ur tent tessinev, keçç, ne$ agdud ik, uqbel wagi. Ihi, eûbeô, taggara, war ccekk, i wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: I Âad, gmat sen Hud, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan.
verses.translation: I Âad, gmat sen Hud, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan.

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssuture$ taqdiât $ef waya. Taqdiât iw ar Win kan, iyi d Ixelqen. Day ur tefhimem ara?
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssuture$ taqdiât $ef waya. Taqdiât iw ar Win kan, iyi d Ixelqen. Day ur tefhimem ara?

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, sinna, steôoâet aS. Ad awen d Isse$li ageffur d ihedman, ad awen irnu tazmert i tezmert nnwen. Ur ppu$alet d ibe$wviyen".
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, sinna, steôoâet aS. Ad awen d Isse$li ageffur d ihedman, ad awen irnu tazmert i tezmert nnwen. Ur ppu$alet d ibe$wviyen".

verses.text: Nnan as: "a Hud! Ur a$ d tusid s ubeggen, ur neppaoa, nekwni, iôebbiten nne$, ilmend n wawal ik, ur numin yisek.
verses.translation: Nnan as: "a Hud! Ur a$ d tusid s ubeggen, ur neppaoa, nekwni, iôebbiten nne$, ilmend n wawal ik, ur numin yisek.

verses.text: Neqqaô kan, d kra iôebbiten nne$, i k i$eôqen". Inna: "nek, Anagi w d Öebbi, u cehhdet ar ur ppka$ ara deg wayen tepcarakem,
verses.translation: Neqqaô kan, d kra iôebbiten nne$, i k i$eôqen". Inna: "nek, Anagi w d Öebbi, u cehhdet ar ur ppka$ ara deg wayen tepcarakem,

verses.text: war Neppa. Ihi, andit iyi akken ma tellam, sinna ur iyi sganayet.
verses.translation: war Neppa. Ihi, andit iyi akken ma tellam, sinna ur iyi sganayet.

verses.text: Nek, ppekle$ af Öebbi, Mass iw u Mass nnwen. Ur illi umexluq ur Iîîif seg ixef is. Ih, Mass iw deg ubrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Nek, ppekle$ af Öebbi, Mass iw u Mass nnwen. Ur illi umexluq ur Iîîif seg ixef is. Ih, Mass iw deg ubrid uwqim.

verses.text: Ma wexxôen, ni$ ssawve$ awen d ayen i$ef id ppuceggâa$ $uôwen. A d Inûef, Mass iw, agdud war kunwi. Ur T teîîuôum s wacemma. Mass iw, s tidep, d Amêareb n yal cci".
verses.translation: Ma wexxôen, ni$ ssawve$ awen d ayen i$ef id ppuceggâa$ $uôwen. A d Inûef, Mass iw, agdud war kunwi. Ur T teîîuôum s wacemma. Mass iw, s tidep, d Amêareb n yal cci".

verses.text: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Hud akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£. Nsellek iten seg uâaqeb uwâiô.
verses.translation: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Hud akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£. Nsellek iten seg uâaqeb uwâiô.

verses.text: Akka Âad. Nekôen issekniyen n Mass nnsen, âuûan imazanen iS. Ddan d lameô n yal aqehhaô iggernennen.
verses.translation: Akka Âad. Nekôen issekniyen n Mass nnsen, âuûan imazanen iS. Ddan d lameô n yal aqehhaô iggernennen.

verses.text: A ten ivfeô xezzu di ddunit agi, u deg wass n tnekra. Day, war ccekk, ur jhilen ara Âad, ar Mass nnsen? Day maççi: "akin Âad, agdud n Hud"?
verses.translation: A ten ivfeô xezzu di ddunit agi, u deg wass n tnekra. Day, war ccekk, ur jhilen ara Âad, ar Mass nnsen? Day maççi: "akin Âad, agdud n Hud"?

verses.text: I Tamud, gmat sen ÛüÜaliê, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Neppa Ixelq ikwen seg wakal, Izzde$ ikwen fellas. Ssutret aS ssmaê, sinna, steôoâet aS. Mass iw, s tidep, Iqeôb ed, Ippara d awal.
verses.translation: I Tamud, gmat sen ÛüÜaliê, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Neppa Ixelq ikwen seg wakal, Izzde$ ikwen fellas. Ssutret aS ssmaê, sinna, steôoâet aS. Mass iw, s tidep, Iqeôb ed, Ippara d awal.

verses.text: Nnan as: "a Üaliê, ni$ telliv garane$, uqbel aya, d asirem nne$. Day ad a$ tekksev aâbad n wayen âabden imezwura nne$? Nekwni, s tidep, aql a$ di ccekk imcebbwel, $ef wayen u$uô la $ tneccdev".
verses.translation: Nnan as: "a Üaliê, ni$ telliv garane$, uqbel aya, d asirem nne$. Day ad a$ tekksev aâbad n wayen âabden imezwura nne$? Nekwni, s tidep, aql a$ di ccekk imcebbwel, $ef wayen u$uô la $ tneccdev".

verses.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aêunu s$uôeS. Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Öebbi, ma aâûa$ $uôeS? Iyi ternam, siwa taxessaôt.
verses.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aêunu s$uôeS. Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Öebbi, ma aâûa$ $uôeS? Iyi ternam, siwa taxessaôt.

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Tagi d tal$wemt n Öebbi, d assekni i kunwi. Eooet ep a ppeks di tmurt n Öebbi. Ur p pjeyyifet, mulac a kwen id isami uâaqeb iqeôben".
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Tagi d tal$wemt n Öebbi, d assekni i kunwi. Eooet ep a ppeks di tmurt n Öebbi. Ur p pjeyyifet, mulac a kwen id isami uâaqeb iqeôben".

verses.text: Gezmen as ivaôen. Inna: "zhut deg ixxamen nnwen, krav wussan. Apan lemâahda ur nepwankaô".
verses.translation: Gezmen as ivaôen. Inna: "zhut deg ixxamen nnwen, krav wussan. Apan lemâahda ur nepwankaô".

verses.text: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Üaliê akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£, si ddell n wass nni. Ih, Mass ik d Uohid, d Uzmir.
verses.translation: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Üaliê akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£, si ddell n wass nni. Ih, Mass ik d Uohid, d Uzmir.

verses.text: Asu$u iwwet wid idensen, gwran d d imeslax deg ixxamen nnsen,
verses.translation: Asu$u iwwet wid idensen, gwran d d imeslax deg ixxamen nnsen,

verses.text: amzun ur rbiêen degsen. Day, s tidep, ur jhilen ara Tamud, ar Mass nnsen? Day maççi: "akin Tamud"?
verses.translation: amzun ur rbiêen degsen. Day, s tidep, ur jhilen ara Tamud, ar Mass nnsen? Day maççi: "akin Tamud"?

verses.text: Ni$ usan d imceggâen nne£ ar Ibôahim, s ubecceô. Nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "tifrat"! Ur iâaîîel ara ibbwi d aâjmi icwin.
verses.translation: Ni$ usan d imceggâen nne£ ar Ibôahim, s ubecceô. Nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "tifrat"! Ur iâaîîel ara ibbwi d aâjmi icwin.

verses.text: Mi iwala ifassen nnsen ur d ééilen ara $uôes, isêassef iten, iugad iten. Nnan: "ur ppagwad, nekwni neppuceggaâ ed ar ugdud n Luî".
verses.translation: Mi iwala ifassen nnsen ur d ééilen ara $uôes, isêassef iten, iugad iten. Nnan: "ur ppagwad, nekwni neppuceggaâ ed ar ugdud n Luî".

verses.text: Tameîîut is tbedd, tevûa. Nbecceô ip s Isêaq, akked Yaâqub, deffir Isêaq.
verses.translation: Tameîîut is tbedd, tevûa. Nbecceô ip s Isêaq, akked Yaâqub, deffir Isêaq.

verses.text: Tenna: "a lêif iw, day a d arwe$, nek d tam$aôt, u argaz agi inu, wesser? Ayagi, s tidep, d lwehma"!
verses.translation: Tenna: "a lêif iw, day a d arwe$, nek d tam$aôt, u argaz agi inu, wesser? Ayagi, s tidep, d lwehma"!

verses.text: Nnan: "day twehmev di lameô n Öebbi? Aêunu n Öebbi, akked lbaôaka S, fellawen ay at uxxam. Ih, Neppa d Amaâzuz, Mucaâ".
verses.translation: Nnan: "day twehmev di lameô n Öebbi? Aêunu n Öebbi, akked lbaôaka S, fellawen ay at uxxam. Ih, Neppa d Amaâzuz, Mucaâ".

verses.text: Mi s tekkes tugwdi i Ibôahim, u iusa t id ubecceô, inumer a£ $ef ugdud n Luî.
verses.translation: Mi s tekkes tugwdi i Ibôahim, u iusa t id ubecceô, inumer a£ $ef ugdud n Luî.

verses.text: Ibôahim, s tidep, iêellem, ippanez, isteôoiâ.
verses.translation: Ibôahim, s tidep, iêellem, ippanez, isteôoiâ.

verses.text: "A Ibôahim, ur keççem deg waya. Ni$ iusa d lameô n Mass ik. Nitni, a ten id ias uâaqeb, war tifrat".
verses.translation: "A Ibôahim, ur keççem deg waya. Ni$ iusa d lameô n Mass ik. Nitni, a ten id ias uâaqeb, war tifrat".

verses.text: Mi usan imceggâen nne£ ar Luî, innu$ben, ur isâi i$il a ten ifukk. Inna: "wagi d ass uwâiô".
verses.translation: Mi usan imceggâen nne£ ar Luî, innu$ben, ur isâi i$il a ten ifukk. Inna: "wagi d ass uwâiô".

verses.text: Iusa d ugdud is, zeêfen d $uôes. Llan, zik, xeddmen tucmitin. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Atent an issi, nitenti zeddigit, i kunwi. Ëezbet i Öebbi, ur iyi pêeccimet ar inebgawen iw. Day ur illi ara, garawen, urgaz aêesbi"?
verses.translation: Iusa d ugdud is, zeêfen d $uôes. Llan, zik, xeddmen tucmitin. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Atent an issi, nitenti zeddigit, i kunwi. Ëezbet i Öebbi, ur iyi pêeccimet ar inebgawen iw. Day ur illi ara, garawen, urgaz aêesbi"?

verses.text: Nnan: "ni$ teéôiv ur nesâi lêeqq deg issi k. Keçç, s tidep, teéôiv d acu neb$a".
verses.translation: Nnan: "ni$ teéôiv ur nesâi lêeqq deg issi k. Keçç, s tidep, teéôiv d acu neb$a".

verses.text: Inna: "a lemmer i wen zmire$, ne$ sâi$ tayep ioehden"!
verses.translation: Inna: "a lemmer i wen zmire$, ne$ sâi$ tayep ioehden"!

verses.text: Nnan: "a Luî, nekwni d imceggâen n Mass ik. Ur k id ppawven. Öuê akked twacult ik, deg iv. Yiwen degwen ur d itezzi! Kkes ed tameîîut ik. Neppat, s tidep, a ppepwwet s wayen ara ten iwwten. Ih, ppaâud nnsen, taûebêit. Ni$ tqeôb ed tûebêit"?
verses.translation: Nnan: "a Luî, nekwni d imceggâen n Mass ik. Ur k id ppawven. Öuê akked twacult ik, deg iv. Yiwen degwen ur d itezzi! Kkes ed tameîîut ik. Neppat, s tidep, a ppepwwet s wayen ara ten iwwten. Ih, ppaâud nnsen, taûebêit. Ni$ tqeôb ed tûebêit"?

verses.text: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nesredm ip. Nesse$li d fellas abruri n yiéôa ibelbaven n talaxt.
verses.translation: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nesredm ip. Nesse$li d fellas abruri n yiéôa ibelbaven n talaxt.

verses.text: Pwanesxen ar Mass ik. Nitni, ur bâiden i imednas.
verses.translation: Pwanesxen ar Mass ik. Nitni, ur bâiden i imednas.

verses.text: I Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Ur ssenqaset di lkil akked lmizan. Nek, wala$ kwen teôwam, u ugade$ fellawen aâaqeb, ass itezzin.
verses.translation: I Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Ur ssenqaset di lkil akked lmizan. Nek, wala$ kwen teôwam, u ugade$ fellawen aâaqeb, ass itezzin.

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Ktilet, weznet, s lewqama. Ur îîuôôut imdanen deg wayla nnsen, ur pdenniset, tessefsadem di tmurt.
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Ktilet, weznet, s lewqama. Ur îîuôôut imdanen deg wayla nnsen, ur pdenniset, tessefsadem di tmurt.

verses.text: Yif it i kunwi wayen d iqqimen i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam. Ur lli$, nek, d amêareb nnwen".
verses.translation: Yif it i kunwi wayen d iqqimen i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam. Ur lli$, nek, d amêareb nnwen".

verses.text: Nnan: "a Cuâayeb, day a$ umôen wawalen ik, a neoo ayen âabden imezwura nne$? Ne$ a nexdem, deg wayla nne$, ayen ur a$ nehwi? Keçç, s tidep, d uêlim, d uûwib".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a Cuâayeb, day a$ umôen wawalen ik, a neoo ayen âabden imezwura nne$? Ne$ a nexdem, deg wayla nne$, ayen ur a$ nehwi? Keçç, s tidep, d uêlim, d uûwib".

verses.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam, ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? I$at iyi yis, l$it imaânen. Ur b$i$ a kwen mgirrde$, siwa $ef wayen i wen gedle$. B$i$ kan, s wayen zemre$, ad awen ûegme$ tikli. Lâawen iw s$uô Öebbi kan. Ppekle$ fellaS, utube$ T.
verses.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam, ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? I$at iyi yis, l$it imaânen. Ur b$i$ a kwen mgirrde$, siwa $ef wayen i wen gedle$. B$i$ kan, s wayen zemre$, ad awen ûegme$ tikli. Lâawen iw s$uô Öebbi kan. Ppekle$ fellaS, utube$ T.

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Awer kwen teppara nnmara w d ibe$wviyen, a ppevôu yidwen akken tevôa d ugdud n Nuê, ne$ win n Hud, ne$ win n Üaliê! Agdud n Luî, ur ibâad ara segwen.
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Awer kwen teppara nnmara w d ibe$wviyen, a ppevôu yidwen akken tevôa d ugdud n Nuê, ne$ win n Hud, ne$ win n Üaliê! Agdud n Luî, ur ibâad ara segwen.

verses.text: Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, sinna, steroâet aS. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipêunu, Ipêemmil".
verses.translation: Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, sinna, steroâet aS. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipêunu, Ipêemmil".

verses.text: Nnan: "a Cuâayeb, ur nefhim ara aîas n wayen id tenniv. Aql a$ nwala k d uôhif garane$. Lemmer maççi d alag ik, war ccekk, a k neôoem. Ur a$ tezmirev".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a Cuâayeb, ur nefhim ara aîas n wayen id tenniv. Aql a$ nwala k d uôhif garane$. Lemmer maççi d alag ik, war ccekk, a k neôoem. Ur a$ tezmirev".

verses.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Day Öebbi, $uôwen, yif iT walag iw, di tezmert? Terram T ar deffir n waârur nnwen. Mass iw, s tidep, Izzi i wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Day Öebbi, $uôwen, yif iT walag iw, di tezmert? Terram T ar deffir n waârur nnwen. Mass iw, s tidep, Izzi i wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Xedmet deg umekkan nnwen, nek ad xedme$. Deqqal a ppeéôem, u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, anwa ay d akeddab. Âasset, nek, yidwen, ad âasse$".
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Xedmet deg umekkan nnwen, nek ad xedme$. Deqqal a ppeéôem, u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, anwa ay d akeddab. Âasset, nek, yidwen, ad âasse$".

verses.translation: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Cuâayeb akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£. Asu$u iwwet wid idensen, gwran d d imeslax deg ixxamen nnsen,

verses.text: amzun ur rbiêen degsen. Day maççi: "akin Madian"! Am: "akin Tamud"?
verses.translation: amzun ur rbiêen degsen. Day maççi: "akin Madian"! Am: "akin Tamud"?

verses.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nne£, akked udabu n ûûeê,
verses.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nne£, akked udabu n ûûeê,

verses.text: $uô Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ddan d lameô n Ferâun. Lameô n Ferâun ur illi d uûwib.
verses.translation: $uô Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ddan d lameô n Ferâun. Lameô n Ferâun ur illi d uûwib.

verses.text: Ad izwir i ugdud is, ass n tnekra, a ten inheô ar usario n tmes. A yasario ucmit u$uô pwanehôen!
verses.translation: Ad izwir i ugdud is, ass n tnekra, a ten inheô ar usario n tmes. A yasario ucmit u$uô pwanehôen!

verses.text: A ten ivfeô xezzu di tagi, u deg wass n tnekra. A tikci tucmip ippunefken!
verses.translation: A ten ivfeô xezzu di tagi, u deg wass n tnekra. A tikci tucmip ippunefken!

verses.text: Ayagi, si teqûivin n temdinin, i k d Nessawal. Garasent tid ibedden, tid ipwamegren.
verses.translation: Ayagi, si teqûivin n temdinin, i k d Nessawal. Garasent tid ibedden, tid ipwamegren.

verses.text: Ur ten Nednis. Maca, densen iman nnsen. Ur ten nefâan s wacemma, iôebbiten nnsen i la naâôen, war Öebbi, mi d iusa lameô n Mass ik. I sen rnan, siwa ssxev.
verses.translation: Ur ten Nednis. Maca, densen iman nnsen. Ur ten nefâan s wacemma, iôebbiten nnsen i la naâôen, war Öebbi, mi d iusa lameô n Mass ik. I sen rnan, siwa ssxev.

verses.text: Akka tiyta n Mass ik. Mi Iwwet timdinin i idensen, s tidep, tiyta S teqôeê, teqseê.
verses.translation: Akka tiyta n Mass ik. Mi Iwwet timdinin i idensen, s tidep, tiyta S teqôeê, teqseê.

verses.text: Ih, deg waya, assekni i wid iugaden aâaqeb n laxeôt. Ass nni, d ass unejmaâ n yimdanen. Ass nni, d ass n ccada.
verses.translation: Ih, deg waya, assekni i wid iugaden aâaqeb n laxeôt. Ass nni, d ass unejmaâ n yimdanen. Ass nni, d ass n ccada.

verses.text: A t Neswexxeô kan ar lajel iuran.
verses.translation: A t Neswexxeô kan ar lajel iuran.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara d ias, ur d ipmeslay yiwen, siwa ma s tesriê iS. Ad ilin igeswaêen, isaâdiyen.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara d ias, ur d ipmeslay yiwen, siwa ma s tesriê iS. Ad ilin igeswaêen, isaâdiyen.

verses.text: Wanag igeswaêen ad ilin di tmes, s unazaâ d imeîîi,
verses.translation: Wanag igeswaêen ad ilin di tmes, s unazaâ d imeîîi,

verses.text: ad wekkôen dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. Ih, Mass ik Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
verses.translation: ad wekkôen dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. Ih, Mass ik Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.

verses.text: Wanag isaâdiyen, di Loennet, ad wekkôen, dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. D tikci n war tilas.
verses.translation: Wanag isaâdiyen, di Loennet, ad wekkôen, dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. D tikci n war tilas.

verses.text: Ur k ikeççem ccekk $ef wayen âabden widak. Ayen âabden am wayen âabden imezwura nnsen, zik. War ccekk, ad asen Nefk amur nnsen, ur inqis.
verses.translation: Ur k ikeççem ccekk $ef wayen âabden widak. Ayen âabden am wayen âabden imezwura nnsen, zik. War ccekk, ad asen Nefk amur nnsen, ur inqis.

verses.text: Ni$, s tidep, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal s$uô Mass ik, yili useyyi garasen. Haaten, ih, di ccekk imcebbwel fellas.
verses.translation: Ni$, s tidep, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal s$uô Mass ik, yili useyyi garasen. Haaten, ih, di ccekk imcebbwel fellas.

verses.text: War ccekk, akken ma llan, ad Ikafi Mass ik igiten nnsen, s lmizan. Neppa, s tidep, Issen ayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: War ccekk, akken ma llan, ad Ikafi Mass ik igiten nnsen, s lmizan. Neppa, s tidep, Issen ayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Ihi, ili d uwqim, akken i k ippunefk lameô, keçç akked wid isteôoâen yidek. Ur be$wvet. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali ay txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ihi, ili d uwqim, akken i k ippunefk lameô, keçç akked wid isteôoâen yidek. Ur be$wvet. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali ay txeddmem.

verses.text: Ur pqeôôibet ar wid idensen, a kwen tnal tmes! Ur tesâim bab, war Öebbi, ihi, ur tepwasellkem.
verses.translation: Ur pqeôôibet ar wid idensen, a kwen tnal tmes! Ur tesâim bab, war Öebbi, ihi, ur tepwasellkem.

verses.text: èéal ûbeê, tameddit, kra n lewqat n yiv. S tidep, ise$iyen neqqven tucmitin. Ayagi d asmekti i wid ismektayen.
verses.translation: èéal ûbeê, tameddit, kra n lewqat n yiv. S tidep, ise$iyen neqqven tucmitin. Ayagi d asmekti i wid ismektayen.

verses.text: Eûbeô! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iveggiâ taqdiât n lâuûam.
verses.translation: Eûbeô! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iveggiâ taqdiât n lâuûam.

verses.text: A lemmer llan, di tsuta i kwen id izwaren, imezgiyen ineqqven asefsed di tmurt! Qlilit kan seg wid Nsellek segsen. Wid idensen ddan akked wayen i ten izhan, u$alen d ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: A lemmer llan, di tsuta i kwen id izwaren, imezgiyen ineqqven asefsed di tmurt! Qlilit kan seg wid Nsellek segsen. Wid idensen ddan akked wayen i ten izhan, u$alen d ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Ur Isquccu ara Mass ik timdinin, d aêerfi, ma llan imezda$ nnsent d lâuûam.
verses.translation: Ur Isquccu ara Mass ik timdinin, d aêerfi, ma llan imezda$ nnsent d lâuûam.

verses.text: Lemmer i S ihwi i Mass ik, ad Irr imdanen d yiwen n lois. Zgan mgarraden.
verses.translation: Lemmer i S ihwi i Mass ik, ad Irr imdanen d yiwen n lois. Zgan mgarraden.

verses.text: Kkes ed wid i$ef Iêun Mass ik. Ixelq iten i wayagi. Itam wawal n Mass ik: "ad Acaôe$ Loahennama, war ccekk, s leonun akked yimdanen mejmulen".
verses.translation: Kkes ed wid i$ef Iêun Mass ik. Ixelq iten i wayagi. Itam wawal n Mass ik: "ad Acaôe$ Loahennama, war ccekk, s leonun akked yimdanen mejmulen".

verses.text: Ayen akw i k ed Neêka n tmucuha imazanen, iwakken a Ntebbet ul ik, yissent. Id iusan dagi d tidep, d anabi u d asmekti i lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ayen akw i k ed Neêka n tmucuha imazanen, iwakken a Ntebbet ul ik, yissent. Id iusan dagi d tidep, d anabi u d asmekti i lmumnin.

verses.text: Ini i wid ur numin ara: "xedmet ay tzemrem, nekwni s tidep, la nxeddem.
verses.translation: Ini i wid ur numin ara: "xedmet ay tzemrem, nekwni s tidep, la nxeddem.

verses.text: Gganit, nekwni la nepgani".
verses.translation: Gganit, nekwni la nepgani".

verses.text: N Öebbi tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. £uôeS ara u$alen akw lumuô. Ihi, âabed iT, ppkel fellaS. Ur I$effel ara Mass ik, $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: N Öebbi tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. £uôeS ara u$alen akw lumuô. Ihi, âabed iT, ppkel fellaS. Ur I$effel ara Mass ik, $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Alô. Tazmamt, issekniyen iS ppuûewwben, sinna, ppufeûûlen s$uô Uûwib i Ipwaxebbôen.
ayahs.translation: Alô. Tazmamt, issekniyen iS ppuûewwben, sinna, ppufeûûlen s$uô Uûwib i Ipwaxebbôen.

ayahs.text: Ur âabdet siwa Öebbi. Nek, s$uôeS $uôwen, d aneddaô u d abcir.
ayahs.translation: Ur âabdet siwa Öebbi. Nek, s$uôeS $uôwen, d aneddaô u d abcir.

ayahs.text: Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, steôoâet aS, ad Ifeôôeo fellawen afeôôeo ilhan, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ippak lfevl iS i yal bab n lfevl. Ma twexxôem, nekk ugade$ a ppeppuâqbem, ass ameqwran.
ayahs.translation: Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, steôoâet aS, ad Ifeôôeo fellawen afeôôeo ilhan, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ippak lfevl iS i yal bab n lfevl. Ma twexxôem, nekk ugade$ a ppeppuâqbem, ass ameqwran.

ayahs.text: Tu$alin nnwen, ar Öebbi. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Tu$alin nnwen, ar Öebbi. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Day nitni, s tidep, ur snefvasen ara idmaren nnsen, iwakken ad ffren fellaS? Xas $ummen s iceîîiven nnsen, day ur Iéôa ara ayen teffren akked wayen d qqaôen? Neppa, s tidep, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
ayahs.translation: Day nitni, s tidep, ur snefvasen ara idmaren nnsen, iwakken ad ffren fellaS? Xas $ummen s iceîîiven nnsen, day ur Iéôa ara ayen teffren akked wayen d qqaôen? Neppa, s tidep, Issen i illan deg idmaren.

ayahs.text: Ur illi lweêc di tmurt, mebla ma illa ôôeéq is ar Öebbi. Issen tanezdu$t is, tanîelt is. Meôôa, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi lweêc di tmurt, mebla ma illa ôôeéq is ar Öebbi. Issen tanezdu$t is, tanîelt is. Meôôa, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Asgeld iS illa $ef waman. A kwen Ijeôôeb anwi segwen ara ixedmen ayen ilhan, sennig wiyav. Ma tenniv: "ih, kunwi a d tekkrem deffir tmeppant nnwen", wid ijehlen, war ccekk, a d inin: "ayagi, kan, d ssêur n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan di sdis wussan. Asgeld iS illa $ef waman. A kwen Ijeôôeb anwi segwen ara ixedmen ayen ilhan, sennig wiyav. Ma tenniv: "ih, kunwi a d tekkrem deffir tmeppant nnwen", wid ijehlen, war ccekk, a d inin: "ayagi, kan, d ssêur n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Ma Neswexxeô asen aâaqeb ar imir ipwassnen, war ccekk, a d inin: "d acu iT iîîfen"? Ass ideg ara ten id iawev, day illa wa ara ten iveôôfen segs? Ad asen izzi wayen i$ef pmmaâliken.
ayahs.translation: Ma Neswexxeô asen aâaqeb ar imir ipwassnen, war ccekk, a d inin: "d acu iT iîîfen"? Ass ideg ara ten id iawev, day illa wa ara ten iveôôfen segs? Ad asen izzi wayen i$ef pmmaâliken.

ayahs.text: Ma Nesêess i umdan aêunu nne¨£, sinna, Nekkes as t, atan ad iayes, ad ijhel.
ayahs.translation: Ma Nesêess i umdan aêunu nne¨£, sinna, Nekkes as t, atan ad iayes, ad ijhel.

ayahs.text: Ma Nesêess as l$it, deffir twa$it i t innulen, atan ad yini: "fukkent felli lemêayen", d$a, neppa, ad ifôeê, ad izux.
ayahs.translation: Ma Nesêess as l$it, deffir twa$it i t innulen, atan ad yini: "fukkent felli lemêayen", d$a, neppa, ad ifôeê, ad izux.

ayahs.text: Kkes ed wid iûebbôen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. I widak ssmaê akked tikci meqqwôen.
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed wid iûebbôen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. I widak ssmaê akked tikci meqqwôen.

ayahs.text: Ahat teppaoav kra n wayen ik ed ippuweêêan. Pzemmiven yis idmaren ik mara qqaôen: "a lemmer i s d irs ugerruj, ne$ idda d, yides, lmelk"! Keçç d aneddaô kan. Öebbi d Awkil n yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ahat teppaoav kra n wayen ik ed ippuweêêan. Pzemmiven yis idmaren ik mara qqaôen: "a lemmer i s d irs ugerruj, ne$ idda d, yides, lmelk"! Keçç d aneddaô kan. Öebbi d Awkil n yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ne$ ad inin: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed, s usnulfu, mraw n tsuôtin am neppa. Naâôet ayen iwumi tzemrem, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep".
ayahs.translation: Ne$ ad inin: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "awit ed, s usnulfu, mraw n tsuôtin am neppa. Naâôet ayen iwumi tzemrem, war Öebbi, ma tessawalem tidep".

ayahs.text: Ma ur awen d rran ara, cfut ar irs ed kan s tussna n Öebbi, ar ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Ihi, ma kunwi d imvuâen?
ayahs.translation: Ma ur awen d rran ara, cfut ar irs ed kan s tussna n Öebbi, ar ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Ihi, ma kunwi d imvuâen?

ayahs.text: I wid ib$an tameddurt n ddunit akked ôôêuê is, a Nkafi, degs, igiten nnsen, ur asen Ntekkes.
ayahs.translation: I wid ib$an tameddurt n ddunit akked ôôêuê is, a Nkafi, degs, igiten nnsen, ur asen Ntekkes.

ayahs.text: Widak, ur ppafen, di laxeôt, siwa times. Ad i$li wayen ûenâen degs; inqev wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Widak, ur ppafen, di laxeôt, siwa times. Ad i$li wayen ûenâen degs; inqev wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Day win iddan d ubeggen, s$uô Mass is, u immal as t unagi s$uôeS…? U, uqbel is, Tazmamt n Musa, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Wigi umnen yis. Win i p inekôen, seg ikubar, ppaâud is d times. Ur ppili di ccekk fellas. Neppa, ih, d tidep s$uô Mass ik. Maca, tegwti n medden ur ppamnen.
ayahs.translation: Day win iddan d ubeggen, s$uô Mass is, u immal as t unagi s$uôeS…? U, uqbel is, Tazmamt n Musa, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Wigi umnen yis. Win i p inekôen, seg ikubar, ppaâud is d times. Ur ppili di ccekk fellas. Neppa, ih, d tidep s$uô Mass ik. Maca, tegwti n medden ur ppamnen.

ayahs.text: Anwa idensen sennig win id isnulfan tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Wigi a d rsen i Mass nnsen. A d inin inagan: "d wigi i iskaddben $ef Mass nnsen". Day Öebbi ur Ixezzu yara imednas?
