ayahs.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win id isnulfan tikerkas $ef Öebbi? Wigi a d rsen i Mass nnsen. A d inin inagan: "d wigi i iskaddben $ef Mass nnsen". Day Öebbi ur Ixezzu yara imednas?

ayahs.text: I isîixxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, i t issarmen d uâwij, nitni ur uminen s laxeôt?
ayahs.translation: I isîixxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, i t issarmen d uâwij, nitni ur uminen s laxeôt?

ayahs.text: Wigi, ur sfunnugen di tmurt, ur asen illi bab, war Öebbi. Fellasen aâaqeb ar wayev. Ur zmiren ad slen, ur pwalin.
ayahs.translation: Wigi, ur sfunnugen di tmurt, ur asen illi bab, war Öebbi. Fellasen aâaqeb ar wayev. Ur zmiren ad slen, ur pwalin.

ayahs.text: D wigi i isxesôen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: D wigi i isxesôen iman nnsen. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Ur illi ccekk, ih, nitni ad xesôen, di laxeôt, sennig wiyav.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi ccekk, ih, nitni ad xesôen, di laxeôt, sennig wiyav.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u unzen aS i Mass nnsen, widak d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, u unzen aS i Mass nnsen, widak d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen.

ayahs.text: Amedya n snat n trebbuyaâ am uder$al, uâééug, akked win ipwalin, win isellen. Day âadlen sin imedyaten agi? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
ayahs.translation: Amedya n snat n trebbuyaâ am uder$al, uâééug, akked win ipwalin, win isellen. Day âadlen sin imedyaten agi? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê i ugdud is: "nek d aneddaô nnwen ipbegginen,
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê i ugdud is: "nek d aneddaô nnwen ipbegginen,

ayahs.text: iwakken ur tâabdem siwa Öebbi. Nek ugaded aâaqeb fellawen, ass aqeôhan".
ayahs.translation: iwakken ur tâabdem siwa Öebbi. Nek ugaded aâaqeb fellawen, ass aqeôhan".

ayahs.text: Nnan imvebbôen, wid ijehlen, seg ugdud is: "keçç, $uône$, d amdan am nekwni. Nwala, d ôôdiyen nne$, kan, war ameyyez, i k ivefôen. Ur nwala s wacu i $ tifem. Xaîi, nêesb ikwen d ikeddaben".
ayahs.translation: Nnan imvebbôen, wid ijehlen, seg ugdud is: "keçç, $uône$, d amdan am nekwni. Nwala, d ôôdiyen nne$, kan, war ameyyez, i k ivefôen. Ur nwala s wacu i $ tifem. Xaîi, nêesb ikwen d ikeddaben".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aêunu s$uôeS. Idreg fellawen. Day a t nêeppem fellawen, ma kunwi tugim t?
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aêunu s$uôeS. Idreg fellawen. Day a t nêeppem fellawen, ma kunwi tugim t?

ayahs.text: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssuture$ ayla, ilmend is; taqdiât iw ar Öebbi kan. Ur ppara$, nek, wid iumnen. S tidep, ad mlilen d Mass nnsen. Maca, nek wala$ kwen d agdud ur nessin.
ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssuture$ ayla, ilmend is; taqdiât iw ar Öebbi kan. Ur ppara$, nek, wid iumnen. S tidep, ad mlilen d Mass nnsen. Maca, nek wala$ kwen d agdud ur nessin.

ayahs.text: A yagdud iw! Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Öebbi, lemmer i ten rri$ akin, day ur d tesmektayem ara?
ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Öebbi, lemmer i ten rri$ akin, day ur d tesmektayem ara?

ayahs.text: Ur awen qqaôe$: $uôi lexzayen n Öebbi. Ur ssine$ tabavnit. Ur qqaôe$: nek d lmelk. Ur qqaôe$ i wid êeqôent wallen nnwen: ur asen Ippak ara Öebbi lxiô, d awez$i. Yif akw Öebbi akken Iéôa, i illan deg iman nnsen. Mulac ad ili$ seg imednas".
ayahs.translation: Ur awen qqaôe$: $uôi lexzayen n Öebbi. Ur ssine$ tabavnit. Ur qqaôe$: nek d lmelk. Ur qqaôe$ i wid êeqôent wallen nnwen: ur asen Ippak ara Öebbi lxiô, d awez$i. Yif akw Öebbi akken Iéôa, i illan deg iman nnsen. Mulac ad ili$ seg imednas".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Nuê! Ni$ tnamrev a$, tessugtev a$ anamer. Ihi, awi ya$ d ayen i $ tâahdev, ma tessawalev tidep".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Nuê! Ni$ tnamrev a$, tessugtev a$ anamer. Ihi, awi ya$ d ayen i $ tâahdev, ma tessawalev tidep".

ayahs.text: Inna: "d Öebbi kan ar awen t id Iawin, ma ihwa yaS. Kunwi ur tesfunnugem.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "d Öebbi kan ar awen t id Iawin, ma ihwa yaS. Kunwi ur tesfunnugem.

ayahs.text: Xas b$i$ a kwen neûêe$, ur tesfaydayam seg wanûaê iw, ma Ib$a Öebbi a kwen Itlef. Neppa d Mass nnwen; tu$alin nnwen $uôeS".
ayahs.translation: Xas b$i$ a kwen neûêe$, ur tesfaydayam seg wanûaê iw, ma Ib$a Öebbi a kwen Itlef. Neppa d Mass nnwen; tu$alin nnwen $uôeS".

ayahs.text: Ne$ qqaôen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "ma snulfa$ t id, lbe$wv iw i yiri w. Nek, ur ppka$ di lbe$wv nnwen".
ayahs.translation: Ne$ qqaôen: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "ma snulfa$ t id, lbe$wv iw i yiri w. Nek, ur ppka$ di lbe$wv nnwen".

ayahs.text: Ippuweêêa d i Nuê: "ur ippamen yiwen, d awez$i, seg ugdud ik, siwa wid illan umnen. Ihi, ur k icqi wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ippuweêêa d i Nuê: "ur ippamen yiwen, d awez$i, seg ugdud ik, siwa wid illan umnen. Ihi, ur k icqi wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Eûnaâ lbabuô, ger wallen nne£, s uweêêi nne£. Ur iyI d pmeslay $ef wid idensen, war ccekk, ad $emqen".
ayahs.translation: Eûnaâ lbabuô, ger wallen nne£, s uweêêi nne£. Ur iyI d pmeslay $ef wid idensen, war ccekk, ad $emqen".

ayahs.text: La iûennaâ lbabuô. Yal tikelt ara âaddin $uôes imvebbôen n ugdud is, tkaâriren fellas. Inna: "ma temmaâlkem degne$, ihi, a nemmaâlek degwen akken temmaâlkem.
ayahs.translation: La iûennaâ lbabuô. Yal tikelt ara âaddin $uôes imvebbôen n ugdud is, tkaâriren fellas. Inna: "ma temmaâlkem degne$, ihi, a nemmaâlek degwen akken temmaâlkem.

ayahs.text: Deqqal a ppeéôem, u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, ara iêaz uâaqeb imezgi".
ayahs.translation: Deqqal a ppeéôem, u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, ara iêaz uâaqeb imezgi".

ayahs.text: Alamma, mi d iusa lameô nne£, la pfeggiven igwefran d ihedman, Nenna: "awi degs tayuga n yal ûûenf, tawacult ik - siwa wid i$ef id izwar wawal -, akked wid iumnen". Drus kan i iumnen yides.
ayahs.translation: Alamma, mi d iusa lameô nne£, la pfeggiven igwefran d ihedman, Nenna: "awi degs tayuga n yal ûûenf, tawacult ik - siwa wid i$ef id izwar wawal -, akked wid iumnen". Drus kan i iumnen yides.

ayahs.text: Inna: "rekbet degs, s yisem n Öebbi, acali s akked trusi s. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "rekbet degs, s yisem n Öebbi, acali s akked trusi s. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

ayahs.text: Icula yissen, di lemwao anect idurar. Issawel Nuê i mmi s, i illan weêdes: "a mmi ali d yidne$, ur teppiliv ar ijehliyen"!
ayahs.translation: Icula yissen, di lemwao anect idurar. Issawel Nuê i mmi s, i illan weêdes: "a mmi ali d yidne$, ur teppiliv ar ijehliyen"!

ayahs.text: Inna: "ûûôan iw d adrar, ad iyi isellek seg waman". Inna: "assa, ulac leslak si lameô n Öebbi, siwa i win i$ef Iêun". Âaddant lemwao garasen. Iûebê ed seg wid ipwa$emqen.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ûûôan iw d adrar, ad iyi isellek seg waman". Inna: "assa, ulac leslak si lameô n Öebbi, siwa i win i$ef Iêun". Âaddant lemwao garasen. Iûebê ed seg wid ipwa$emqen.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a tamurt, seblaâ aman im, a yigenni eûûfu". Aman zzren. Iûaô lameô: irs $ef Loudi. Iffe$ uberraê: akin agdud imednas!
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a tamurt, seblaâ aman im, a yigenni eûûfu". Aman zzren. Iûaô lameô: irs $ef Loudi. Iffe$ uberraê: akin agdud imednas!

ayahs.text: Inuj Nuê ar Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Ni$ mmi n twacult iw. Ih, lemâahda K d tidep, Keçç Tifev akw imêaddan".
ayahs.translation: Inuj Nuê ar Mass is, inna: "a Mass iw! Ni$ mmi n twacult iw. Ih, lemâahda K d tidep, Keçç Tifev akw imêaddan".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Nuê! Neppa, s tidep, ur illi n wacult ik. Ih, neppa ur ixdim ayen ilhan. Ihi, ur iyI d steqsay $ef wayen ur tessinev. Nek a k Ssakwaye$, ur teppiliv seg wid ur nessin".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Nuê! Neppa, s tidep, ur illi n wacult ik. Ih, neppa ur ixdim ayen ilhan. Ihi, ur iyI d steqsay $ef wayen ur tessinev. Nek a k Ssakwaye$, ur teppiliv seg wid ur nessin".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Ili di lâawen iw, iwakken ur K id steqsaye$ $ef wayen ur ssine$. Ma ur iyi Tsemmêev, ur Têunev felli, ad ili$ seg imexsuôen".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Ili di lâawen iw, iwakken ur K id steqsaye$ $ef wayen ur ssine$. Ma ur iyi Tsemmêev, ur Têunev felli, ad ili$ seg imexsuôen".

ayahs.text: Nnan d: "a Nuê! Ers ed s tifrat s$uône£, akked lbaôaka, fellak akw $ef leoyus i illan yidek. Kra n legyus, a ten N$it. Sinna, fellasen s$uône£, aâaqeb aqeôêan".
ayahs.translation: Nnan d: "a Nuê! Ers ed s tifrat s$uône£, akked lbaôaka, fellak akw $ef leoyus i illan yidek. Kra n legyus, a ten N$it. Sinna, fellasen s$uône£, aâaqeb aqeôêan".

ayahs.text: Tagi si teqûivin n tbavnit, Nweêêa yak tent. Ur tent tessinev, keçç, ne$ agdud ik, uqbel wagi. Ihi, eûbeô, taggara, war ccekk, i wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Tagi si teqûivin n tbavnit, Nweêêa yak tent. Ur tent tessinev, keçç, ne$ agdud ik, uqbel wagi. Ihi, eûbeô, taggara, war ccekk, i wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: I Âad, gmat sen Hud, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan.
ayahs.translation: I Âad, gmat sen Hud, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Kunwi tesnulfuyem d kan.

ayahs.text: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssuture$ taqdiât $ef waya. Taqdiât iw ar Win kan, iyi d Ixelqen. Day ur tefhimem ara?
ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Ur awen ssuture$ taqdiât $ef waya. Taqdiât iw ar Win kan, iyi d Ixelqen. Day ur tefhimem ara?

ayahs.text: A yagdud iw! Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, sinna, steôoâet aS. Ad awen d Isse$li ageffur d ihedman, ad awen irnu tazmert i tezmert nnwen. Ur ppu$alet d ibe$wviyen".
ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, sinna, steôoâet aS. Ad awen d Isse$li ageffur d ihedman, ad awen irnu tazmert i tezmert nnwen. Ur ppu$alet d ibe$wviyen".

ayahs.text: Nnan as: "a Hud! Ur a$ d tusid s ubeggen, ur neppaoa, nekwni, iôebbiten nne$, ilmend n wawal ik, ur numin yisek.
ayahs.translation: Nnan as: "a Hud! Ur a$ d tusid s ubeggen, ur neppaoa, nekwni, iôebbiten nne$, ilmend n wawal ik, ur numin yisek.

ayahs.text: Neqqaô kan, d kra iôebbiten nne$, i k i$eôqen". Inna: "nek, Anagi w d Öebbi, u cehhdet ar ur ppka$ ara deg wayen tepcarakem,
ayahs.translation: Neqqaô kan, d kra iôebbiten nne$, i k i$eôqen". Inna: "nek, Anagi w d Öebbi, u cehhdet ar ur ppka$ ara deg wayen tepcarakem,

ayahs.text: war Neppa. Ihi, andit iyi akken ma tellam, sinna ur iyi sganayet.
ayahs.translation: war Neppa. Ihi, andit iyi akken ma tellam, sinna ur iyi sganayet.

ayahs.text: Nek, ppekle$ af Öebbi, Mass iw u Mass nnwen. Ur illi umexluq ur Iîîif seg ixef is. Ih, Mass iw deg ubrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Nek, ppekle$ af Öebbi, Mass iw u Mass nnwen. Ur illi umexluq ur Iîîif seg ixef is. Ih, Mass iw deg ubrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Ma wexxôen, ni$ ssawve$ awen d ayen i$ef id ppuceggâa$ $uôwen. A d Inûef, Mass iw, agdud war kunwi. Ur T teîîuôum s wacemma. Mass iw, s tidep, d Amêareb n yal cci".
ayahs.translation: Ma wexxôen, ni$ ssawve$ awen d ayen i$ef id ppuceggâa$ $uôwen. A d Inûef, Mass iw, agdud war kunwi. Ur T teîîuôum s wacemma. Mass iw, s tidep, d Amêareb n yal cci".

ayahs.text: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Hud akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£. Nsellek iten seg uâaqeb uwâiô.
ayahs.translation: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Hud akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£. Nsellek iten seg uâaqeb uwâiô.

ayahs.text: Akka Âad. Nekôen issekniyen n Mass nnsen, âuûan imazanen iS. Ddan d lameô n yal aqehhaô iggernennen.
ayahs.translation: Akka Âad. Nekôen issekniyen n Mass nnsen, âuûan imazanen iS. Ddan d lameô n yal aqehhaô iggernennen.

ayahs.text: A ten ivfeô xezzu di ddunit agi, u deg wass n tnekra. Day, war ccekk, ur jhilen ara Âad, ar Mass nnsen? Day maççi: "akin Âad, agdud n Hud"?
ayahs.translation: A ten ivfeô xezzu di ddunit agi, u deg wass n tnekra. Day, war ccekk, ur jhilen ara Âad, ar Mass nnsen? Day maççi: "akin Âad, agdud n Hud"?

ayahs.text: I Tamud, gmat sen ÛüÜaliê, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Neppa Ixelq ikwen seg wakal, Izzde$ ikwen fellas. Ssutret aS ssmaê, sinna, steôoâet aS. Mass iw, s tidep, Iqeôb ed, Ippara d awal.
ayahs.translation: I Tamud, gmat sen ÛüÜaliê, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Neppa Ixelq ikwen seg wakal, Izzde$ ikwen fellas. Ssutret aS ssmaê, sinna, steôoâet aS. Mass iw, s tidep, Iqeôb ed, Ippara d awal.

ayahs.text: Nnan as: "a Üaliê, ni$ telliv garane$, uqbel aya, d asirem nne$. Day ad a$ tekksev aâbad n wayen âabden imezwura nne$? Nekwni, s tidep, aql a$ di ccekk imcebbwel, $ef wayen u$uô la $ tneccdev".
ayahs.translation: Nnan as: "a Üaliê, ni$ telliv garane$, uqbel aya, d asirem nne$. Day ad a$ tekksev aâbad n wayen âabden imezwura nne$? Nekwni, s tidep, aql a$ di ccekk imcebbwel, $ef wayen u$uô la $ tneccdev".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aêunu s$uôeS. Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Öebbi, ma aâûa$ $uôeS? Iyi ternam, siwa taxessaôt.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? Ifka yi d aêunu s$uôeS. Acu ara yi isellken seg ufus n Öebbi, ma aâûa$ $uôeS? Iyi ternam, siwa taxessaôt.

ayahs.text: A yagdud iw! Tagi d tal$wemt n Öebbi, d assekni i kunwi. Eooet ep a ppeks di tmurt n Öebbi. Ur p pjeyyifet, mulac a kwen id isami uâaqeb iqeôben".
ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Tagi d tal$wemt n Öebbi, d assekni i kunwi. Eooet ep a ppeks di tmurt n Öebbi. Ur p pjeyyifet, mulac a kwen id isami uâaqeb iqeôben".

ayahs.text: Gezmen as ivaôen. Inna: "zhut deg ixxamen nnwen, krav wussan. Apan lemâahda ur nepwankaô".
ayahs.translation: Gezmen as ivaôen. Inna: "zhut deg ixxamen nnwen, krav wussan. Apan lemâahda ur nepwankaô".

ayahs.text: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Üaliê akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£, si ddell n wass nni. Ih, Mass ik d Uohid, d Uzmir.
ayahs.translation: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Üaliê akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£, si ddell n wass nni. Ih, Mass ik d Uohid, d Uzmir.

ayahs.text: Asu$u iwwet wid idensen, gwran d d imeslax deg ixxamen nnsen,
ayahs.translation: Asu$u iwwet wid idensen, gwran d d imeslax deg ixxamen nnsen,

ayahs.text: amzun ur rbiêen degsen. Day, s tidep, ur jhilen ara Tamud, ar Mass nnsen? Day maççi: "akin Tamud"?
ayahs.translation: amzun ur rbiêen degsen. Day, s tidep, ur jhilen ara Tamud, ar Mass nnsen? Day maççi: "akin Tamud"?

ayahs.text: Ni$ usan d imceggâen nne£ ar Ibôahim, s ubecceô. Nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "tifrat"! Ur iâaîîel ara ibbwi d aâjmi icwin.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ usan d imceggâen nne£ ar Ibôahim, s ubecceô. Nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "tifrat"! Ur iâaîîel ara ibbwi d aâjmi icwin.

ayahs.text: Mi iwala ifassen nnsen ur d ééilen ara $uôes, isêassef iten, iugad iten. Nnan: "ur ppagwad, nekwni neppuceggaâ ed ar ugdud n Luî".
ayahs.translation: Mi iwala ifassen nnsen ur d ééilen ara $uôes, isêassef iten, iugad iten. Nnan: "ur ppagwad, nekwni neppuceggaâ ed ar ugdud n Luî".

ayahs.text: Tameîîut is tbedd, tevûa. Nbecceô ip s Isêaq, akked Yaâqub, deffir Isêaq.
ayahs.translation: Tameîîut is tbedd, tevûa. Nbecceô ip s Isêaq, akked Yaâqub, deffir Isêaq.

ayahs.text: Tenna: "a lêif iw, day a d arwe$, nek d tam$aôt, u argaz agi inu, wesser? Ayagi, s tidep, d lwehma"!
ayahs.translation: Tenna: "a lêif iw, day a d arwe$, nek d tam$aôt, u argaz agi inu, wesser? Ayagi, s tidep, d lwehma"!

ayahs.text: Nnan: "day twehmev di lameô n Öebbi? Aêunu n Öebbi, akked lbaôaka S, fellawen ay at uxxam. Ih, Neppa d Amaâzuz, Mucaâ".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "day twehmev di lameô n Öebbi? Aêunu n Öebbi, akked lbaôaka S, fellawen ay at uxxam. Ih, Neppa d Amaâzuz, Mucaâ".

ayahs.text: Mi s tekkes tugwdi i Ibôahim, u iusa t id ubecceô, inumer a£ $ef ugdud n Luî.
ayahs.translation: Mi s tekkes tugwdi i Ibôahim, u iusa t id ubecceô, inumer a£ $ef ugdud n Luî.

ayahs.text: Ibôahim, s tidep, iêellem, ippanez, isteôoiâ.
ayahs.translation: Ibôahim, s tidep, iêellem, ippanez, isteôoiâ.

ayahs.text: "A Ibôahim, ur keççem deg waya. Ni$ iusa d lameô n Mass ik. Nitni, a ten id ias uâaqeb, war tifrat".
ayahs.translation: "A Ibôahim, ur keççem deg waya. Ni$ iusa d lameô n Mass ik. Nitni, a ten id ias uâaqeb, war tifrat".

ayahs.text: Mi usan imceggâen nne£ ar Luî, innu$ben, ur isâi i$il a ten ifukk. Inna: "wagi d ass uwâiô".
ayahs.translation: Mi usan imceggâen nne£ ar Luî, innu$ben, ur isâi i$il a ten ifukk. Inna: "wagi d ass uwâiô".

ayahs.text: Iusa d ugdud is, zeêfen d $uôes. Llan, zik, xeddmen tucmitin. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Atent an issi, nitenti zeddigit, i kunwi. Ëezbet i Öebbi, ur iyi pêeccimet ar inebgawen iw. Day ur illi ara, garawen, urgaz aêesbi"?
ayahs.translation: Iusa d ugdud is, zeêfen d $uôes. Llan, zik, xeddmen tucmitin. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Atent an issi, nitenti zeddigit, i kunwi. Ëezbet i Öebbi, ur iyi pêeccimet ar inebgawen iw. Day ur illi ara, garawen, urgaz aêesbi"?

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ni$ teéôiv ur nesâi lêeqq deg issi k. Keçç, s tidep, teéôiv d acu neb$a".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ni$ teéôiv ur nesâi lêeqq deg issi k. Keçç, s tidep, teéôiv d acu neb$a".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a lemmer i wen zmire$, ne$ sâi$ tayep ioehden"!
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a lemmer i wen zmire$, ne$ sâi$ tayep ioehden"!

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Luî, nekwni d imceggâen n Mass ik. Ur k id ppawven. Öuê akked twacult ik, deg iv. Yiwen degwen ur d itezzi! Kkes ed tameîîut ik. Neppat, s tidep, a ppepwwet s wayen ara ten iwwten. Ih, ppaâud nnsen, taûebêit. Ni$ tqeôb ed tûebêit"?
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Luî, nekwni d imceggâen n Mass ik. Ur k id ppawven. Öuê akked twacult ik, deg iv. Yiwen degwen ur d itezzi! Kkes ed tameîîut ik. Neppat, s tidep, a ppepwwet s wayen ara ten iwwten. Ih, ppaâud nnsen, taûebêit. Ni$ tqeôb ed tûebêit"?

ayahs.text: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nesredm ip. Nesse$li d fellas abruri n yiéôa ibelbaven n talaxt.
ayahs.translation: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nesredm ip. Nesse$li d fellas abruri n yiéôa ibelbaven n talaxt.

ayahs.text: Pwanesxen ar Mass ik. Nitni, ur bâiden i imednas.
ayahs.translation: Pwanesxen ar Mass ik. Nitni, ur bâiden i imednas.

ayahs.text: I Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Ur ssenqaset di lkil akked lmizan. Nek, wala$ kwen teôwam, u ugade$ fellawen aâaqeb, ass itezzin.
ayahs.translation: I Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb, inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi! Ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Ur ssenqaset di lkil akked lmizan. Nek, wala$ kwen teôwam, u ugade$ fellawen aâaqeb, ass itezzin.

ayahs.text: A yagdud iw! Ktilet, weznet, s lewqama. Ur îîuôôut imdanen deg wayla nnsen, ur pdenniset, tessefsadem di tmurt.
ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Ktilet, weznet, s lewqama. Ur îîuôôut imdanen deg wayla nnsen, ur pdenniset, tessefsadem di tmurt.

ayahs.text: Yif it i kunwi wayen d iqqimen i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam. Ur lli$, nek, d amêareb nnwen".
ayahs.translation: Yif it i kunwi wayen d iqqimen i Öebbi, ma d lmumnin ay tellam. Ur lli$, nek, d amêareb nnwen".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Cuâayeb, day a$ umôen wawalen ik, a neoo ayen âabden imezwura nne$? Ne$ a nexdem, deg wayla nne$, ayen ur a$ nehwi? Keçç, s tidep, d uêlim, d uûwib".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Cuâayeb, day a$ umôen wawalen ik, a neoo ayen âabden imezwura nne$? Ne$ a nexdem, deg wayla nne$, ayen ur a$ nehwi? Keçç, s tidep, d uêlim, d uûwib".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam, ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? I$at iyi yis, l$it imaânen. Ur b$i$ a kwen mgirrde$, siwa $ef wayen i wen gedle$. B$i$ kan, s wayen zemre$, ad awen ûegme$ tikli. Lâawen iw s$uô Öebbi kan. Ppekle$ fellaS, utube$ T.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acu twalam, ma ddi$ d ubeggen n Mass iw? I$at iyi yis, l$it imaânen. Ur b$i$ a kwen mgirrde$, siwa $ef wayen i wen gedle$. B$i$ kan, s wayen zemre$, ad awen ûegme$ tikli. Lâawen iw s$uô Öebbi kan. Ppekle$ fellaS, utube$ T.

ayahs.text: A yagdud iw! Awer kwen teppara nnmara w d ibe$wviyen, a ppevôu yidwen akken tevôa d ugdud n Nuê, ne$ win n Hud, ne$ win n Üaliê! Agdud n Luî, ur ibâad ara segwen.
ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Awer kwen teppara nnmara w d ibe$wviyen, a ppevôu yidwen akken tevôa d ugdud n Nuê, ne$ win n Hud, ne$ win n Üaliê! Agdud n Luî, ur ibâad ara segwen.

ayahs.text: Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, sinna, steroâet aS. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipêunu, Ipêemmil".
ayahs.translation: Ssutret ssmaê i Mass nnwen, sinna, steroâet aS. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipêunu, Ipêemmil".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Cuâayeb, ur nefhim ara aîas n wayen id tenniv. Aql a$ nwala k d uôhif garane$. Lemmer maççi d alag ik, war ccekk, a k neôoem. Ur a$ tezmirev".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Cuâayeb, ur nefhim ara aîas n wayen id tenniv. Aql a$ nwala k d uôhif garane$. Lemmer maççi d alag ik, war ccekk, a k neôoem. Ur a$ tezmirev".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Day Öebbi, $uôwen, yif iT walag iw, di tezmert? Terram T ar deffir n waârur nnwen. Mass iw, s tidep, Izzi i wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Day Öebbi, $uôwen, yif iT walag iw, di tezmert? Terram T ar deffir n waârur nnwen. Mass iw, s tidep, Izzi i wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: A yagdud iw! Xedmet deg umekkan nnwen, nek ad xedme$. Deqqal a ppeéôem, u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, anwa ay d akeddab. Âasset, nek, yidwen, ad âasse$".
ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Xedmet deg umekkan nnwen, nek ad xedme$. Deqqal a ppeéôem, u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, anwa ay d akeddab. Âasset, nek, yidwen, ad âasse$".

ayahs.text: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Cuâayeb akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£. Asu$u iwwet wid idensen, gwran d d imeslax deg ixxamen nnsen,
ayahs.translation: Mi d iusa lameô nne£, Nsellek Cuâayeb akked wid iumnen yides, s uêunu s$uône£. Asu$u iwwet wid idensen, gwran d d imeslax deg ixxamen nnsen,

ayahs.text: amzun ur rbiêen degsen. Day maççi: "akin Madian"! Am: "akin Tamud"?
ayahs.translation: amzun ur rbiêen degsen. Day maççi: "akin Madian"! Am: "akin Tamud"?

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nne£, akked udabu n ûûeê,
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nne£, akked udabu n ûûeê,

ayahs.text: $uô Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ddan d lameô n Ferâun. Lameô n Ferâun ur illi d uûwib.
ayahs.translation: $uô Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ddan d lameô n Ferâun. Lameô n Ferâun ur illi d uûwib.

ayahs.text: Ad izwir i ugdud is, ass n tnekra, a ten inheô ar usario n tmes. A yasario ucmit u$uô pwanehôen!
ayahs.translation: Ad izwir i ugdud is, ass n tnekra, a ten inheô ar usario n tmes. A yasario ucmit u$uô pwanehôen!

ayahs.text: A ten ivfeô xezzu di tagi, u deg wass n tnekra. A tikci tucmip ippunefken!
ayahs.translation: A ten ivfeô xezzu di tagi, u deg wass n tnekra. A tikci tucmip ippunefken!

ayahs.text: Ayagi, si teqûivin n temdinin, i k d Nessawal. Garasent tid ibedden, tid ipwamegren.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, si teqûivin n temdinin, i k d Nessawal. Garasent tid ibedden, tid ipwamegren.

ayahs.text: Ur ten Nednis. Maca, densen iman nnsen. Ur ten nefâan s wacemma, iôebbiten nnsen i la naâôen, war Öebbi, mi d iusa lameô n Mass ik. I sen rnan, siwa ssxev.
ayahs.translation: Ur ten Nednis. Maca, densen iman nnsen. Ur ten nefâan s wacemma, iôebbiten nnsen i la naâôen, war Öebbi, mi d iusa lameô n Mass ik. I sen rnan, siwa ssxev.

ayahs.text: Akka tiyta n Mass ik. Mi Iwwet timdinin i idensen, s tidep, tiyta S teqôeê, teqseê.
ayahs.translation: Akka tiyta n Mass ik. Mi Iwwet timdinin i idensen, s tidep, tiyta S teqôeê, teqseê.

ayahs.text: Ih, deg waya, assekni i wid iugaden aâaqeb n laxeôt. Ass nni, d ass unejmaâ n yimdanen. Ass nni, d ass n ccada.
ayahs.translation: Ih, deg waya, assekni i wid iugaden aâaqeb n laxeôt. Ass nni, d ass unejmaâ n yimdanen. Ass nni, d ass n ccada.

ayahs.text: A t Neswexxeô kan ar lajel iuran.
ayahs.translation: A t Neswexxeô kan ar lajel iuran.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara d ias, ur d ipmeslay yiwen, siwa ma s tesriê iS. Ad ilin igeswaêen, isaâdiyen.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d ias, ur d ipmeslay yiwen, siwa ma s tesriê iS. Ad ilin igeswaêen, isaâdiyen.

ayahs.text: Wanag igeswaêen ad ilin di tmes, s unazaâ d imeîîi,
ayahs.translation: Wanag igeswaêen ad ilin di tmes, s unazaâ d imeîîi,

ayahs.text: ad wekkôen dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. Ih, Mass ik Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
ayahs.translation: ad wekkôen dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. Ih, Mass ik Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.

ayahs.text: Wanag isaâdiyen, di Loennet, ad wekkôen, dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. D tikci n war tilas.
ayahs.translation: Wanag isaâdiyen, di Loennet, ad wekkôen, dinna, ayen ara dumen tmurt akked igenwan, siwa ma ur Irad ara Mass ik. D tikci n war tilas.

ayahs.text: Ur k ikeççem ccekk $ef wayen âabden widak. Ayen âabden am wayen âabden imezwura nnsen, zik. War ccekk, ad asen Nefk amur nnsen, ur inqis.
ayahs.translation: Ur k ikeççem ccekk $ef wayen âabden widak. Ayen âabden am wayen âabden imezwura nnsen, zik. War ccekk, ad asen Nefk amur nnsen, ur inqis.

ayahs.text: Ni$, s tidep, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal s$uô Mass ik, yili useyyi garasen. Haaten, ih, di ccekk imcebbwel fellas.
ayahs.translation: Ni$, s tidep, Nefka Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal s$uô Mass ik, yili useyyi garasen. Haaten, ih, di ccekk imcebbwel fellas.

ayahs.text: War ccekk, akken ma llan, ad Ikafi Mass ik igiten nnsen, s lmizan. Neppa, s tidep, Issen ayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, akken ma llan, ad Ikafi Mass ik igiten nnsen, s lmizan. Neppa, s tidep, Issen ayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ihi, ili d uwqim, akken i k ippunefk lameô, keçç akked wid isteôoâen yidek. Ur be$wvet. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali ay txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ihi, ili d uwqim, akken i k ippunefk lameô, keçç akked wid isteôoâen yidek. Ur be$wvet. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali ay txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ur pqeôôibet ar wid idensen, a kwen tnal tmes! Ur tesâim bab, war Öebbi, ihi, ur tepwasellkem.
ayahs.translation: Ur pqeôôibet ar wid idensen, a kwen tnal tmes! Ur tesâim bab, war Öebbi, ihi, ur tepwasellkem.

ayahs.text: èéal ûbeê, tameddit, kra n lewqat n yiv. S tidep, ise$iyen neqqven tucmitin. Ayagi d asmekti i wid ismektayen.
ayahs.translation: èéal ûbeê, tameddit, kra n lewqat n yiv. S tidep, ise$iyen neqqven tucmitin. Ayagi d asmekti i wid ismektayen.

ayahs.text: Eûbeô! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iveggiâ taqdiât n lâuûam.
ayahs.translation: Eûbeô! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iveggiâ taqdiât n lâuûam.

ayahs.text: A lemmer llan, di tsuta i kwen id izwaren, imezgiyen ineqqven asefsed di tmurt! Qlilit kan seg wid Nsellek segsen. Wid idensen ddan akked wayen i ten izhan, u$alen d ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: A lemmer llan, di tsuta i kwen id izwaren, imezgiyen ineqqven asefsed di tmurt! Qlilit kan seg wid Nsellek segsen. Wid idensen ddan akked wayen i ten izhan, u$alen d ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: Ur Isquccu ara Mass ik timdinin, d aêerfi, ma llan imezda$ nnsent d lâuûam.
ayahs.translation: Ur Isquccu ara Mass ik timdinin, d aêerfi, ma llan imezda$ nnsent d lâuûam.

ayahs.text: Lemmer i S ihwi i Mass ik, ad Irr imdanen d yiwen n lois. Zgan mgarraden.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i S ihwi i Mass ik, ad Irr imdanen d yiwen n lois. Zgan mgarraden.

ayahs.text: Kkes ed wid i$ef Iêun Mass ik. Ixelq iten i wayagi. Itam wawal n Mass ik: "ad Acaôe$ Loahennama, war ccekk, s leonun akked yimdanen mejmulen".
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed wid i$ef Iêun Mass ik. Ixelq iten i wayagi. Itam wawal n Mass ik: "ad Acaôe$ Loahennama, war ccekk, s leonun akked yimdanen mejmulen".

ayahs.text: Ayen akw i k ed Neêka n tmucuha imazanen, iwakken a Ntebbet ul ik, yissent. Id iusan dagi d tidep, d anabi u d asmekti i lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ayen akw i k ed Neêka n tmucuha imazanen, iwakken a Ntebbet ul ik, yissent. Id iusan dagi d tidep, d anabi u d asmekti i lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ini i wid ur numin ara: "xedmet ay tzemrem, nekwni s tidep, la nxeddem.
ayahs.translation: Ini i wid ur numin ara: "xedmet ay tzemrem, nekwni s tidep, la nxeddem.

ayahs.text: Gganit, nekwni la nepgani".
ayahs.translation: Gganit, nekwni la nepgani".

ayahs.text: N Öebbi tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. £uôeS ara u$alen akw lumuô. Ihi, âabed iT, ppkel fellaS. Ur I$effel ara Mass ik, $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. £uôeS ara u$alen akw lumuô. Ihi, âabed iT, ppkel fellaS. Ur I$effel ara Mass ik, $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Alô. Wigi d issekniyen n Tazmamt ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Alô. Wigi d issekniyen n Tazmamt ipbegginen.

verses.text: Ih, Nessader it id d Leqwôan, s taâôabt, amar a pfehmem.
verses.translation: Ih, Nessader it id d Leqwôan, s taâôabt, amar a pfehmem.

verses.text: Nekwni Nêekku yak tiêkayin igerzen mavi, deg wayen i k Nweêêa di Leqwôan agi, xas telliv, uqbel is, seg wid istehzan.
verses.translation: Nekwni Nêekku yak tiêkayin igerzen mavi, deg wayen i k Nweêêa di Leqwôan agi, xas telliv, uqbel is, seg wid istehzan.

verses.text: Mi inna Yusef i baba s: "a baba! Nek wala$ mrawyan itran, iîij, akked waggur, wala$ ten knan iyi".
verses.translation: Mi inna Yusef i baba s: "a baba! Nek wala$ mrawyan itran, iîij, akked waggur, wala$ ten knan iyi".

verses.text: Inna: "a mmi! Ur êekku ayen twalav i watmaten ik, ad ak andin ticeôkep. Cciîan, s tidep, d acengu n ûûeê n umdan.
verses.translation: Inna: "a mmi! Ur êekku ayen twalav i watmaten ik, ad ak andin ticeôkep. Cciîan, s tidep, d acengu n ûûeê n umdan.

verses.text: Akka, a k Ifren Mass ik, u ak Isselmed asefru n temsal, u ad Itim l$it iS, i keçç akked twacult n Yaâqub, akken it Itam, zik, af lejdud ik: Ibôahim akked Isêaq. Mass ik, s tidep, d Amusnaw, d Uûwib".
verses.translation: Akka, a k Ifren Mass ik, u ak Isselmed asefru n temsal, u ad Itim l$it iS, i keçç akked twacult n Yaâqub, akken it Itam, zik, af lejdud ik: Ibôahim akked Isêaq. Mass ik, s tidep, d Amusnaw, d Uûwib".

verses.text: Ni$, di Yusef akked watma s, illa ussekni i wid isteqsayen.
verses.translation: Ni$, di Yusef akked watma s, illa ussekni i wid isteqsayen.

verses.text: Mi nnan: "war ccekk, ifen a$, Yusef akked gma s, akken iten iêemmel babat nne$, u nekwni d îîeôma. Babat nne$, s tidep, haat di ttelfan n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Mi nnan: "war ccekk, ifen a$, Yusef akked gma s, akken iten iêemmel babat nne$, u nekwni d îîeôma. Babat nne$, s tidep, haat di ttelfan n ûûeê.

verses.text: En$et Yusef, ne$ nfut ep si tmurt, a d ilhu degwen babat wen, sinna, a ppu$alem d imdanen ixeddmen ayen ilhan".
verses.translation: En$et Yusef, ne$ nfut ep si tmurt, a d ilhu degwen babat wen, sinna, a ppu$alem d imdanen ixeddmen ayen ilhan".

verses.text: Inna win d immeslayen, degsen: "ur neqqet Yusef, veggôet ep ar lqaâa n wannu. Ma tgam akka, a t iddem yiwen umsebrid".
verses.translation: Inna win d immeslayen, degsen: "ur neqqet Yusef, veggôet ep ar lqaâa n wannu. Ma tgam akka, a t iddem yiwen umsebrid".

verses.text: Nnan: "a babat nne$, acu k iu$en, ur a$ tuminev ara, $ef Yusef. Nekwni, fellas, s tidep, d unûiêen.
verses.translation: Nnan: "a babat nne$, acu k iu$en, ur a$ tuminev ara, $ef Yusef. Nekwni, fellas, s tidep, d unûiêen.

verses.text: Sseddu t yidne$ azekka, ad izhu, ad iurar. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nêareb fellas".
verses.translation: Sseddu t yidne$ azekka, ad izhu, ad iurar. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nêareb fellas".

verses.text: Inna: "nek, s tidep, $weble$ ma tebbwim t yidwen, ugade$ a t içç lweêc, kunwi testehzam degs".
verses.translation: Inna: "nek, s tidep, $weble$ ma tebbwim t yidwen, ugade$ a t içç lweêc, kunwi testehzam degs".

verses.text: Nnan: "ma içça t lweêc, u nekwni d îîeôma, s tidep a nili d imexsuôen".
verses.translation: Nnan: "ma içça t lweêc, u nekwni d îîeôma, s tidep a nili d imexsuôen".

verses.text: Mi t bbwin, mwafaqen a t rôen ar lqaâa n wannu, Nweêêa yas: "ad asen temlev, s tidep, lameô agi nnsen, nitni ur éôin".
verses.translation: Mi t bbwin, mwafaqen a t rôen ar lqaâa n wannu, Nweêêa yas: "ad asen temlev, s tidep, lameô agi nnsen, nitni ur éôin".

verses.text: U$alen d tameddit, ar babat sen, pprun.
verses.translation: U$alen d tameddit, ar babat sen, pprun.

verses.text: Nnan: "a babat nne$, s tidep, nôuê a nemzizzel, neooa Yusef ar lqecc nne$, içça t lweêc. Ur a$ teppamnev, xas nenna d tidep".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a babat nne$, s tidep, nôuê a nemzizzel, neooa Yusef ar lqecc nne$, içça t lweêc. Ur a$ teppamnev, xas nenna d tidep".

verses.text: Bbwin d tasedrit is, degs idamen n rrya. Inna: "xaîi! D iman nnwen i wen d iccacven lameô. Ilha ûûbeô. Anuju $eô Öebbi, mgal ayen d teêkam".
verses.translation: Bbwin d tasedrit is, degs idamen n rrya. Inna: "xaîi! D iman nnwen i wen d iccacven lameô. Ilha ûûbeô. Anuju $eô Öebbi, mgal ayen d teêkam".

verses.text: Usan d iminigen, uznen win id ippagwmen, issader ssvel is. Inna: "a lxiô, wagi d aqcic"! Ffren t, amzun d sselâa. Öebbi Iéôa acu xeddmen.
verses.translation: Usan d iminigen, uznen win id ippagwmen, issader ssvel is. Inna: "a lxiô, wagi d aqcic"! Ffren t, amzun d sselâa. Öebbi Iéôa acu xeddmen.

verses.text: Zzenzen t, s ôôxa, s kra iûuôdiyen. Ur as fkin ara azal.
verses.translation: Zzenzen t, s ôôxa, s kra iûuôdiyen. Ur as fkin ara azal.

verses.text: Inna, i tmeîîut is, Umaûôi i t iu$en: "eôêeb yis, amar ad a$ infaâ, at nerr d mmit nne$". Akka ay Nesseqâad Yusef di tmurt, iwakken ad as Nesseêfev asefru n temsal. Öebbi d Amezwaru s lameô iS, maca tegwti n medden ur éôin ara.
verses.translation: Inna, i tmeîîut is, Umaûôi i t iu$en: "eôêeb yis, amar ad a$ infaâ, at nerr d mmit nne$". Akka ay Nesseqâad Yusef di tmurt, iwakken ad as Nesseêfev asefru n temsal. Öebbi d Amezwaru s lameô iS, maca tegwti n medden ur éôin ara.

verses.text: Mi d immeêtel, Nefka yas ûûwab, tussna. Akka ay Nepkafi iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Mi d immeêtel, Nefka yas ûûwab, tussna. Akka ay Nepkafi iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Teb$a t tin u$ur izde$. Terra tibbura, u tenna: "eyya keçç"! Inna: "ad iyi Ineooi Öebbi! Ni$ bab iw iôêeb yissi. S tidep, ur rebêen imednas".
verses.translation: Teb$a t tin u$ur izde$. Terra tibbura, u tenna: "eyya keçç"! Inna: "ad iyi Ineooi Öebbi! Ni$ bab iw iôêeb yissi. S tidep, ur rebêen imednas".

verses.text: S tidep, teb$a t, u neppa ib$a p, lemmer ur iwala ara atebbet n Mass is. Akka, iwakken a Nessebâad fellas tuccva, lâaô. Neppa, s tidep, seg imdanen nne£ izedganen.
verses.translation: S tidep, teb$a t, u neppa ib$a p, lemmer ur iwala ara atebbet n Mass is. Akka, iwakken a Nessebâad fellas tuccva, lâaô. Neppa, s tidep, seg imdanen nne£ izedganen.

verses.text: Uzzlen ar tebburt, tcerreg as tasedrit is, si zdeffir. Mmugren, argaz is, ar tebburt. Tenna: "acu ay d aqeîîi n win iâabwlen ad iccmet tawacult ik, siwa lêebs ne$ aâaqeb aqeôêan"?
verses.translation: Uzzlen ar tebburt, tcerreg as tasedrit is, si zdeffir. Mmugren, argaz is, ar tebburt. Tenna: "acu ay d aqeîîi n win iâabwlen ad iccmet tawacult ik, siwa lêebs ne$ aâaqeb aqeôêan"?

verses.text: Inna: "d neppat iyi ib$an". Icuhhed ed yiwen unagi si twacult is: "ma teqqeôs tsedrit si zdat, tenna d tidep, u neppa d akeddab.
verses.translation: Inna: "d neppat iyi ib$an". Icuhhed ed yiwen unagi si twacult is: "ma teqqeôs tsedrit si zdat, tenna d tidep, u neppa d akeddab.

verses.text: Ma teqqeôs tsedrit si zdeffir, teskaddeb, u neppa seg at tidep".
verses.translation: Ma teqqeôs tsedrit si zdeffir, teskaddeb, u neppa seg at tidep".

verses.text: Mi iwala teqqeôs tsedrit si zdeffir, inna: "ayagi, war ccekk, si nncub nnkwent. Ih, nncub nnkwent d timeqwôaêanin.
verses.translation: Mi iwala teqqeôs tsedrit si zdeffir, inna: "ayagi, war ccekk, si nncub nnkwent. Ih, nncub nnkwent d timeqwôaêanin.

verses.text: A Yusef, ppu ayagi, u kem ssuter ssmaê ubekkav im. Kem, s tidep, teccvev".
verses.translation: A Yusef, ppu ayagi, u kem ssuter ssmaê ubekkav im. Kem, s tidep, teccvev".

verses.text: La qqaôent tlawin, di temdint: "tameîîut umdebbeô têemmel acrik is. Teshebl ip tayri. F akken nwala, appan, s tidep, di ttelfan n ûûeê".
verses.translation: La qqaôent tlawin, di temdint: "tameîîut umdebbeô têemmel acrik is. Teshebl ip tayri. F akken nwala, appan, s tidep, di ttelfan n ûûeê".

verses.text: Mi tesla s nncub nnsent, tuzen $uôsent, thegga yasent tanalt. I yal yiwet segsent, tefka tafrut. Tenna: "effe$ ed garasent". Mi t walant, isdehc itent, jerêent ifassen nnsent, nnant: "êaca Öebbi, wagi maççi d amdan, wagi siwa d lmelk ukyis".
verses.translation: Mi tesla s nncub nnsent, tuzen $uôsent, thegga yasent tanalt. I yal yiwet segsent, tefka tafrut. Tenna: "effe$ ed garasent". Mi t walant, isdehc itent, jerêent ifassen nnsent, nnant: "êaca Öebbi, wagi maççi d amdan, wagi siwa d lmelk ukyis".

verses.text: Tenna: "d wagi i$ef iyi tlummemt. Ih, b$i$ t, neppa iqqim zeddig. Ma ur ixdim ara ay s umôe$, war ccekk, ad ipwaêbes, ad ipwaêqeô".
verses.translation: Tenna: "d wagi i$ef iyi tlummemt. Ih, b$i$ t, neppa iqqim zeddig. Ma ur ixdim ara ay s umôe$, war ccekk, ad ipwaêbes, ad ipwaêqeô".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Smenyafe$ lêebs i wayen u$ur iyi d ssawalent. Ma ur Tesbaâdev ara felli nncub nnsent, ad male$ $uôsent, ad ili$ seg wid ur nessin".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Smenyafe$ lêebs i wayen u$ur iyi d ssawalent. Ma ur Tesbaâdev ara felli nncub nnsent, ad male$ $uôsent, ad ili$ seg wid ur nessin".

verses.text: Ijaweb as d Mass is. Issebâad fellas nncub nnsent. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ijaweb as d Mass is. Issebâad fellas nncub nnsent. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Sinna, mi ten usan issekniyen, ufan, war ccekk, ilaq a t irr ar lêebs, kra n tallit.
verses.translation: Sinna, mi ten usan issekniyen, ufan, war ccekk, ilaq a t irr ar lêebs, kra n tallit.

verses.text: Kecmen yides, ar lêebs, sin ilmeéiyen. Inna yiwen degsen: "nek wala$ iman iw, la teééme$ ccôab". Inna d wayev: "nek wala$ iman iw, la ppawi$ a$ôum $ef uqeôôu w, la teppen segs ifrax. Ssefru ya$ p id. Ih, nwala k seg iâaôviyen".
verses.translation: Kecmen yides, ar lêebs, sin ilmeéiyen. Inna yiwen degsen: "nek wala$ iman iw, la teééme$ ccôab". Inna d wayev: "nek wala$ iman iw, la ppawi$ a$ôum $ef uqeôôu w, la teppen segs ifrax. Ssefru ya$ p id. Ih, nwala k seg iâaôviyen".

verses.text: Inna: "seg wayen iyi ss$eô Mass iw, ad awen p id ssefru$, uqbel a kwen id iawev lqut i wen ppakken. Nek ooi$ ddin n ugdud ur numin s Öebbi, u nitni nekôen laxeôt.
verses.translation: Inna: "seg wayen iyi ss$eô Mass iw, ad awen p id ssefru$, uqbel a kwen id iawev lqut i wen ppakken. Nek ooi$ ddin n ugdud ur numin s Öebbi, u nitni nekôen laxeôt.

verses.text: Ddi$ d ddin n lejdud iw: Ibôahim, Isêaq akked Yaâqub. Ur a$ ippunefk a nezdukkel acemma i Öebbi. Ayagi si lfevl n Öebbi fellane$, akw $ef imdanen. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.
verses.translation: Ddi$ d ddin n lejdud iw: Ibôahim, Isêaq akked Yaâqub. Ur a$ ippunefk a nezdukkel acemma i Öebbi. Ayagi si lfevl n Öebbi fellane$, akw $ef imdanen. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.

verses.text: A yimeddukwal iw n lêebs, menyif imawlan imfaôaqen, ne$ Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô?
verses.translation: A yimeddukwal iw n lêebs, menyif imawlan imfaôaqen, ne$ Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô?

verses.text: Ay tâabdem, war Neppa, d ismawen kan i sen tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen. Ur asen d Issers ara Öebbi kra udabu. Lêukm ar Öebbi kan. Iumeô ed ur tâabdem, siwa Neppa. D wagi ay d ddin uûwib, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Ay tâabdem, war Neppa, d ismawen kan i sen tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen. Ur asen d Issers ara Öebbi kra udabu. Lêukm ar Öebbi kan. Iumeô ed ur tâabdem, siwa Neppa. D wagi ay d ddin uûwib, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.

verses.text: A yimeddukwal iw n lêebs, wanag yiwen degwen ad ismiri ccôab, i bab is, wayev ad ippusemmeô $ef umidag, ifrax ad nneqben aqeôôu s. Ippuseyya lameô $ef wayen iyi d testeqsam".
verses.translation: A yimeddukwal iw n lêebs, wanag yiwen degwen ad ismiri ccôab, i bab is, wayev ad ippusemmeô $ef umidag, ifrax ad nneqben aqeôôu s. Ippuseyya lameô $ef wayen iyi d testeqsam".

verses.text: Inna i win iêûa ad islek, segsen: "ar bab ik, smekti iyi d". Cciîan iseppu t, ur t id ismekti ar bab is. Irna, di lêebs, kra iseggwasen.
verses.translation: Inna i win iêûa ad islek, segsen: "ar bab ik, smekti iyi d". Cciîan iseppu t, ur t id ismekti ar bab is. Irna, di lêebs, kra iseggwasen.

verses.text: Inna ugellid: "nek wala$ ûa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teppent ûa tuvâifin, akked ûa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyav d tiqquôanin. A yimvebbôen, ssefrut iyi d targit, ma tellam seg wid issefruyen tirga".
verses.translation: Inna ugellid: "nek wala$ ûa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teppent ûa tuvâifin, akked ûa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyav d tiqquôanin. A yimvebbôen, ssefrut iyi d targit, ma tellam seg wid issefruyen tirga".

verses.text: Nnan: "d tirga iwlellsen. Ur nelli d imusnawen i usefru n tirga".
verses.translation: Nnan: "d tirga iwlellsen. Ur nelli d imusnawen i usefru n tirga".

verses.text: Win i isellken si sin nni, armi tallit id immekti, inna: "nek, ad awen d awi$ asefru ines, aznet iyi.
verses.translation: Win i isellken si sin nni, armi tallit id immekti, inna: "nek, ad awen d awi$ asefru ines, aznet iyi.

verses.text: A Yusef, bab n tidep, ssefru ya$ d: ûa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teppent ûa tuvâifin, akked ûa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyav d tiqquôanin. Amar, ma u$ale$ ar imdanen, amar ad éôen".
verses.translation: A Yusef, bab n tidep, ssefru ya$ d: ûa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teppent ûa tuvâifin, akked ûa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyav d tiqquôanin. Amar, ma u$ale$ ar imdanen, amar ad éôen".

verses.text: Inna: "zerâat ûa iseggwasen imyevfaôen. Ayen tzerâam, eooet ep di tyedrin is, siwa cwiî ara teççem.
verses.translation: Inna: "zerâat ûa iseggwasen imyevfaôen. Ayen tzerâam, eooet ep di tyedrin is, siwa cwiî ara teççem.

verses.text: Sinna, deffir sen, a d asen ûa iwaâôen. Ad ççen ayen i sen theggam siwa cwiî, seg wayen txeznem.
verses.translation: Sinna, deffir sen, a d asen ûa iwaâôen. Ad ççen ayen i sen theggam siwa cwiî, seg wayen txeznem.

verses.text: Sinna a d ias, deffir waya, useggwas n tallalt i medden, ideg ara éden".
verses.translation: Sinna a d ias, deffir waya, useggwas n tallalt i medden, ideg ara éden".

verses.text: Inna ugellid: "awit ep id $uôi". Mi t id iusa umersul, inna: "u$al ar bab ik, u steqsi t acu ay d l$eôv n tlawin i ijerêen ifassen nnsent. Mass iw, s tidep, Issen nncub nnsent".
verses.translation: Inna ugellid: "awit ep id $uôi". Mi t id iusa umersul, inna: "u$al ar bab ik, u steqsi t acu ay d l$eôv n tlawin i ijerêen ifassen nnsent. Mass iw, s tidep, Issen nncub nnsent".

verses.text: Inna: "acu ara d tinimt mi teb$amt Yusef"? Nnant: "êaca Öebbi, ur nufi $uôes tuccva". Tenna d tmeîîut umvebbeô: "tura, a d tban tidep. D nek i t ib$an, ma d neppa, s tidep, d bab n tidep".
verses.translation: Inna: "acu ara d tinimt mi teb$amt Yusef"? Nnant: "êaca Öebbi, ur nufi $uôes tuccva". Tenna d tmeîîut umvebbeô: "tura, a d tban tidep. D nek i t ib$an, ma d neppa, s tidep, d bab n tidep".

verses.text: "Akka, iwakken ad iéeô ur t xdiâa$ ara s tuffra. Öebbi ur Inehhu nncub n lxeyyan.
verses.translation: "Akka, iwakken ad iéeô ur t xdiâa$ ara s tuffra. Öebbi ur Inehhu nncub n lxeyyan.

verses.text: Ur pzekki$ iman iw. Tanefsit, s tidep, tezzu$uô ar tuccva, siwa ma Iêun Mass iw. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
verses.translation: Ur pzekki$ iman iw. Tanefsit, s tidep, tezzu$uô ar tuccva, siwa ma Iêun Mass iw. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

verses.text: Inna ugellid: "awit ep id $uôi, d laâtiq iw". Mi s immeslay, inna: "keçç, assa, nefka yak adabu, laman".
verses.translation: Inna ugellid: "awit ep id $uôi, d laâtiq iw". Mi s immeslay, inna: "keçç, assa, nefka yak adabu, laman".

verses.text: Inna: "wekkel iyi $ef lemxazen n tmurt, nek d amêareb amusnaw".
verses.translation: Inna: "wekkel iyi $ef lemxazen n tmurt, nek d amêareb amusnaw".

verses.text: Akka ay Nesseqâad Yusef di tmurt, ad izde$ anda i s ihwa. Nepêunu $ef win i £ ihwan, ur Nesôuêu arraz iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Akka ay Nesseqâad Yusef di tmurt, ad izde$ anda i s ihwa. Nepêunu $ef win i £ ihwan, ur Nesôuêu arraz iâaôviyen.

verses.text: S tidep, arraz n laxeôt yif it, i wid iumnen u llan pêezziben.
verses.translation: S tidep, arraz n laxeôt yif it, i wid iumnen u llan pêezziben.

verses.text: Usan watmaten n Yusef, kecmen $uôes, iâqel iten, nitni ur t âqilen.
verses.translation: Usan watmaten n Yusef, kecmen $uôes, iâqel iten, nitni ur t âqilen.

verses.text: Mi sen ifka ppâabgat nnsen, inna: "awit iyi d gmat wen s babat wen. Day ur twalam ara zade$ awen lkil, u, nek, ife$ akw wid isnebgaten?
verses.translation: Mi sen ifka ppâabgat nnsen, inna: "awit iyi d gmat wen s babat wen. Day ur twalam ara zade$ awen lkil, u, nek, ife$ akw wid isnebgaten?

verses.text: Ma ur iyi t id tebbwim ara, ur awen nepktili $uôi, ur iyi d tepsamim ".
verses.translation: Ma ur iyi t id tebbwim ara, ur awen nepktili $uôi, ur iyi d tepsamim ".

verses.text: Nnan: "a nêawet baba s fellas; akka ara nexdem".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a nêawet baba s fellas; akka ara nexdem".

verses.text: Inna i iqeddacen is: "rret selâa nnsen deg icekkaôen nnsen, amar a p âaqlen mara awven ar twacult nnsen, amar a d u$alen".
verses.translation: Inna i iqeddacen is: "rret selâa nnsen deg icekkaôen nnsen, amar a p âaqlen mara awven ar twacult nnsen, amar a d u$alen".

verses.text: Mi bbwven ar babat sen, nnan: "a babat nne$, igdel fella$ lkil, azen gmat nne$ yidne$, iwakken a d nektil. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nêareb fellas".
verses.translation: Mi bbwven ar babat sen, nnan: "a babat nne$, igdel fella$ lkil, azen gmat nne$ yidne$, iwakken a d nektil. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nêareb fellas".

verses.text: Inna: "day a kwen amne$ fellas, akken i kwen umne$, zik, $ef gma s? Öebbi Yif akw imêaraben. Neppa Iphunu sennig akw iêninen".
verses.translation: Inna: "day a kwen amne$ fellas, akken i kwen umne$, zik, $ef gma s? Öebbi Yif akw imêaraben. Neppa Iphunu sennig akw iêninen".

verses.text: Mi ldin lqecc nnsen, ufan tu$al iten id selâa nnsen. Nnan: "a babat nne$, ur neb$i tagi, selâa nne$ tu$al a$ d. A d nessikrer i twacult nne$, a nêareb $ef gmat nne$, a d nernu ppâabga n ul$wem. Tagi d ppâabga tushilt".
verses.translation: Mi ldin lqecc nnsen, ufan tu$al iten id selâa nnsen. Nnan: "a babat nne$, ur neb$i tagi, selâa nne$ tu$al a$ d. A d nessikrer i twacult nne$, a nêareb $ef gmat nne$, a d nernu ppâabga n ul$wem. Tagi d ppâabga tushilt".

verses.text: Inna: "ur t sedduye$ yidwen, d awez$i, siwa ma tcubkem iyi s Öebbi, ard a yi t id terrem, siwa ma zzin awen". Mi s âahden, inna: "Öebbi d Awkil $ef wayen id nenna".
verses.translation: Inna: "ur t sedduye$ yidwen, d awez$i, siwa ma tcubkem iyi s Öebbi, ard a yi t id terrem, siwa ma zzin awen". Mi s âahden, inna: "Öebbi d Awkil $ef wayen id nenna".

verses.text: Inna: "a tarwa, ur keççmet si yiwet n tebburt, kecmet si tebbura imgarraden. Ula i wen xedme$, bippa, ar loiha n Öebbi. Aêuddu siwa win n Öebbi. FellaS ppekle$, fellaS ay ppeklen wid ippkalen".
verses.translation: Inna: "a tarwa, ur keççmet si yiwet n tebburt, kecmet si tebbura imgarraden. Ula i wen xedme$, bippa, ar loiha n Öebbi. Aêuddu siwa win n Öebbi. FellaS ppekle$, fellaS ay ppeklen wid ippkalen".

verses.text: Mi kecmen akken i sen iumeô babat sen, ula i sen ixdem, bippa, ar loiha n Öebbi. D ayen ilezmen kan i iseyya Yaqub, deg iman is. Neppa, s tidep, isâa tamusni i s Nesselmed, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Mi kecmen akken i sen iumeô babat sen, ula i sen ixdem, bippa, ar loiha n Öebbi. D ayen ilezmen kan i iseyya Yaqub, deg iman is. Neppa, s tidep, isâa tamusni i s Nesselmed, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.

verses.text: Mi kecmen ar Yusef, ibbwi gma s $uôes, inna: "nekkini d gma k, ur $webbel $ef wayen xeddmen".
verses.translation: Mi kecmen ar Yusef, ibbwi gma s $uôes, inna: "nekkini d gma k, ur $webbel $ef wayen xeddmen".

verses.text: Mi sen ifka ppâabgat nnsen, irra taqbuct deg ucekkaô n gma s. Sinna, iberreê uberraê: "a yat terkaf, kunwi, war ccekk, d imakwaren"!
verses.translation: Mi sen ifka ppâabgat nnsen, irra taqbuct deg ucekkaô n gma s. Sinna, iberreê uberraê: "a yat terkaf, kunwi, war ccekk, d imakwaren"!

verses.text: Nnan, u zzin $uôsen: "d acu tesôuêem"?
verses.translation: Nnan, u zzin $uôsen: "d acu tesôuêem"?

verses.text: Nnan: "nesôuê taqbuct ugellid. Win ip id ibbwin, ad as nefk ppâabga n ul$wem. Nek, vemne$ t".
verses.translation: Nnan: "nesôuê taqbuct ugellid. Win ip id ibbwin, ad as nefk ppâabga n ul$wem. Nek, vemne$ t".

verses.text: Nnan: "s Öebbi, nni$ teéôam ur d nusa ara a nessefsed tamurt, ur nelli d imakwaren".
verses.translation: Nnan: "s Öebbi, nni$ teéôam ur d nusa ara a nessefsed tamurt, ur nelli d imakwaren".

verses.text: Nnan: "d acu ay d aqeîîi s, ma teskadbem"?
verses.translation: Nnan: "d acu ay d aqeîîi s, ma teskadbem"?

verses.text: Nnan: " aqeîîi n win i p ibbwin di tcekkaôt is, d yiman is. Akka ay nepkafi imednas".
verses.translation: Nnan: " aqeîîi n win i p ibbwin di tcekkaôt is, d yiman is. Akka ay nepkafi imednas".

verses.text: Ibda la ipqellib icekkaôen, uqbel win n gma s, sinna, issuffe$ ip id seg ucekkaô n gma s. Akka ay Nefka ticeôkep i Yusef. Ur izmir ad iîîef gma s, s lqanun ugellid, siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Nessalay, tiseddaôin, win i £ihwan. Sennig bu tussna, illa Umusnaw.
verses.translation: Ibda la ipqellib icekkaôen, uqbel win n gma s, sinna, issuffe$ ip id seg ucekkaô n gma s. Akka ay Nefka ticeôkep i Yusef. Ur izmir ad iîîef gma s, s lqanun ugellid, siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Nessalay, tiseddaôin, win i £ihwan. Sennig bu tussna, illa Umusnaw.

verses.text: Nnan: "ma iuker, ni$ iuker, zik, yiwen n watma s". Iffer ip Yusef $uôes, ur asen p id inna ara. Inna: "aql akwen deg yir êala. Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa ayen d teqqaôem".
verses.translation: Nnan: "ma iuker, ni$ iuker, zik, yiwen n watma s". Iffer ip Yusef $uôes, ur asen p id inna ara. Inna: "aql akwen deg yir êala. Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa ayen d teqqaôem".

verses.text: Nnan: "a yameqwôan, baba s, s tidep, wesser. Eîîef yiwen segne$ deg umekkan is. Nwala k, ih, telliv si lâuûam".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a yameqwôan, baba s, s tidep, wesser. Eîîef yiwen segne$ deg umekkan is. Nwala k, ih, telliv si lâuûam".

verses.text: Inna: "ur a$ Iâammed Öebbi a neîîef, siwa win u$uô nufa ta$awsa nne$. Mulac, war ccekk, a nili d imednas".
verses.translation: Inna: "ur a$ Iâammed Öebbi a neîîef, siwa win u$uô nufa ta$awsa nne$. Mulac, war ccekk, a nili d imednas".

verses.text: Mi uysen segs, mcawaôen, inna umeqwôan segsen: "day ur teéôim ara, ar babat wen tcubkem t s Öebbi, u, zik, tveggâam Yusef? Ihi, ur pôuêu$ si tmurt a, d awez$i, alamma iserreê iyi baba, ne$ Ifra Öebbi felli. Neppa, Yif akw imêaddan.
verses.translation: Mi uysen segs, mcawaôen, inna umeqwôan segsen: "day ur teéôim ara, ar babat wen tcubkem t s Öebbi, u, zik, tveggâam Yusef? Ihi, ur pôuêu$ si tmurt a, d awez$i, alamma iserreê iyi baba, ne$ Ifra Öebbi felli. Neppa, Yif akw imêaddan.

verses.text: U$alet ar babat wen, tinem as: a babat nne$, mmi k, s tidep, iuker. Ncehhed kan $ef wayen neéôa, ur nessawev i tbavnit.
verses.translation: U$alet ar babat wen, tinem as: a babat nne$, mmi k, s tidep, iuker. Ncehhed kan $ef wayen neéôa, ur nessawev i tbavnit.

verses.text: Steqsi tamdint ideg i nella, akked terkift ukud nedda. Ih, d tidep, ay d nenna".
verses.translation: Steqsi tamdint ideg i nella, akked terkift ukud nedda. Ih, d tidep, ay d nenna".

verses.text: Inna: "xaîi! Lameô seg iman nnwen. Ilha ûûbeô. Amar Öebbi a yi ten id Iawi akw. Neppa, s tidep, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw".
verses.translation: Inna: "xaîi! Lameô seg iman nnwen. Ilha ûûbeô. Amar Öebbi a yi ten id Iawi akw. Neppa, s tidep, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw".

verses.text: Ijuneb iten, u inna: "a lêif iw $ef Yusef"! Allen is ijegger itent u$ilif, innu$ben.
verses.translation: Ijuneb iten, u inna: "a lêif iw $ef Yusef"! Allen is ijegger itent u$ilif, innu$ben.

verses.text: Nnan: "s Öebbi, tezgiv tesmektayev d Yusef, alamma tu$alev d amuvin, ne$ seg wid immuten".
verses.translation: Nnan: "s Öebbi, tezgiv tesmektayev d Yusef, alamma tu$alev d amuvin, ne$ seg wid immuten".

verses.text: Inna: "la pcetki$ kan i Öebbi, s uneémi w akked u$wbel iw. Ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Inna: "la pcetki$ kan i Öebbi, s uneémi w akked u$wbel iw. Ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.

verses.text: A yarraw iw, ôuêet, steqsit $ef Yusef akked gma s. Ur ppayset di tecvaî n Öebbi. Ih, i ippaysen di tecvaî n Öebbi, siwa agdud ijehliyen".
verses.translation: A yarraw iw, ôuêet, steqsit $ef Yusef akked gma s. Ur ppayset di tecvaî n Öebbi. Ih, i ippaysen di tecvaî n Öebbi, siwa agdud ijehliyen".

verses.text: Mi bbwven $uôes, nnan as: "a yameqwôan, nekwni akked twacult nne$, nepwa$. Nusa d s selâa ôxisen, semd as lkil, seddeq a$. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipkafi wid ipseddiqen".
verses.translation: Mi bbwven $uôes, nnan as: "a yameqwôan, nekwni akked twacult nne$, nepwa$. Nusa d s selâa ôxisen, semd as lkil, seddeq a$. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipkafi wid ipseddiqen".

verses.text: Inna: "teéôam i tgam i Yusef akked gma s, mi kunwi, d wid ur nessin"?
verses.translation: Inna: "teéôam i tgam i Yusef akked gma s, mi kunwi, d wid ur nessin"?

verses.text: Nnan: "keçç, s tidep, maççi d Yusef "? Inna: "nek d Yusef, atan gma. Ni$ I$at a$ Öebbi. Ih, wid ipêezziben, wid iûebbôen ... Öebbi, s tidep, ur Isôuêu arraz iâaôviyen".
verses.translation: Nnan: "keçç, s tidep, maççi d Yusef "? Inna: "nek d Yusef, atan gma. Ni$ I$at a$ Öebbi. Ih, wid ipêezziben, wid iûebbôen ... Öebbi, s tidep, ur Isôuêu arraz iâaôviyen".

verses.text: Nnan: "s Öebbi ar k Ismenyaf Öebbi garane$. Nekwni, s tidep, neccev".
verses.translation: Nnan: "s Öebbi ar k Ismenyaf Öebbi garane$. Nekwni, s tidep, neccev".

verses.text: Inna: "ur telli tiyta degwen, assa. Ad awen Isemmeê Öebbi! Neppa Yif akw wid ipêunun.
verses.translation: Inna: "ur telli tiyta degwen, assa. Ad awen Isemmeê Öebbi! Neppa Yif akw wid ipêunun.

verses.text: Awit tasedrit iw agi, erret ep $ef udem n baba, ad iêlu yiéôi s. Aset ed $uôi, s twacult nnwen, meôôa".
verses.translation: Awit tasedrit iw agi, erret ep $ef udem n baba, ad iêlu yiéôi s. Aset ed $uôi, s twacult nnwen, meôôa".

verses.text: Mi teqlaâ terkift, babat sen ibda la iqqaô: "nek, s tidep, sraêe$ rriêa n Yusef, awi d kan ur teqqaôem ara: la isxeôwiv".
verses.translation: Mi teqlaâ terkift, babat sen ibda la iqqaô: "nek, s tidep, sraêe$ rriêa n Yusef, awi d kan ur teqqaôem ara: la isxeôwiv".

verses.text: Nnan: "s Öebbi, ar k mazal di ttelfan ik n zik".
verses.translation: Nnan: "s Öebbi, ar k mazal di ttelfan ik n zik".

verses.text: Mi d iusa ubcir, issers as p $ef udem is, llint ed wallen is, inna: "day ur awen nni$ ara: nek ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
verses.translation: Mi d iusa ubcir, issers as p $ef udem is, llint ed wallen is, inna: "day ur awen nni$ ara: nek ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?

verses.text: Nnan as: "a babat nne$, ssuter ad a$ pwasemmêen ibekkaven nne$. S tidep, nella d imednab".
verses.translation: Nnan as: "a babat nne$, ssuter ad a$ pwasemmêen ibekkaven nne$. S tidep, nella d imednab".

verses.text: Inna: "deqqal ad ssutre$, i Mass iw, ad awen Isemmeê. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
verses.translation: Inna: "deqqal ad ssutre$, i Mass iw, ad awen Isemmeê. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

verses.text: Mi bbwven ar Yusef, isteôêeb s imawlan is. Inna: "kecmet ar Maseô, di laman, ma Irad Öebbi".
verses.translation: Mi bbwven ar Yusef, isteôêeb s imawlan is. Inna: "kecmet ar Maseô, di laman, ma Irad Öebbi".

verses.text: Issuli imawlan is ar usgeld. £lin, knan as. Inna: "a baba! D wagi ay d asefru n targit iw, n zik. Ni$ Issuffe$ ip Mass iw! Ni$ Iga yi leqôaô mi yi d Issuffe$ si lêebs. Ikkes ikwen id si sseêôa, deffir tismin i isker Cciîan, gari d watma. Mass iw, s tidep, d Laîif i win i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Issuli imawlan is ar usgeld. £lin, knan as. Inna: "a baba! D wagi ay d asefru n targit iw, n zik. Ni$ Issuffe$ ip Mass iw! Ni$ Iga yi leqôaô mi yi d Issuffe$ si lêebs. Ikkes ikwen id si sseêôa, deffir tismin i isker Cciîan, gari d watma. Mass iw, s tidep, d Laîif i win i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: A Mass iw, ni$ Tefkiv iyi si tgelda, Tesêefvev iyi asefru n temsal. Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Keçç, d Bab iw di ddunit, di laxeôt, Eddem ôôuê iw d amvua, Ssiwev iyi ar wid imaânen".
verses.translation: A Mass iw, ni$ Tefkiv iyi si tgelda, Tesêefvev iyi asefru n temsal. Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Keçç, d Bab iw di ddunit, di laxeôt, Eddem ôôuê iw d amvua, Ssiwev iyi ar wid imaânen".

verses.text: Tagi, si teêkayin n tbavnit, Nweêêa yak p in. Ur telliv $uôsen, mi mwafaqen a p andin.
verses.translation: Tagi, si teêkayin n tbavnit, Nweêêa yak p in. Ur telliv $uôsen, mi mwafaqen a p andin.

verses.text: Tegwti n yimdanen, xas tâapbev, ur ppamnen.
verses.translation: Tegwti n yimdanen, xas tâapbev, ur ppamnen.

verses.text: Ur asen ssutur kra n teqdiât. Neppa, d asmekti kan i imavalen.
verses.translation: Ur asen ssutur kra n teqdiât. Neppa, d asmekti kan i imavalen.

verses.text: I illan deg issekniyen di tmurt akked igenwan! La teddun fellasen, maca wexxôen asen.
verses.translation: I illan deg issekniyen di tmurt akked igenwan! La teddun fellasen, maca wexxôen asen.

verses.text: Tegwti, segsen, ur ppamnen s Öebbi, siwa ma curken.
verses.translation: Tegwti, segsen, ur ppamnen s Öebbi, siwa ma curken.

verses.text: Day ppeklen ur asen isburru yara uâaqeb n Öebbi, ne$ ur ten id ippas ara yimir, deqzalla, ur pfaqan?
verses.translation: Day ppeklen ur asen isburru yara uâaqeb n Öebbi, ne$ ur ten id ippas ara yimir, deqzalla, ur pfaqan?

verses.text: Ini: "wagi d abrid iw, la pnuju$ ar Öebbi ad Ildi allen, i nek akked wid iddan yidi. Gedha s Öebbi! Ur lli$ seg wid ipcaraken".
verses.translation: Ini: "wagi d abrid iw, la pnuju$ ar Öebbi ad Ildi allen, i nek akked wid iddan yidi. Gedha s Öebbi! Ur lli$ seg wid ipcaraken".

verses.text: Nuzen ed kan, uqbel ik, irgazen seg imezda$ n temdinin, iwumi Nweêêa. Day ur unagen ara di tmurt, ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren? Ih, pifxiô axxam aneggaru i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tefhimem ara?
verses.translation: Nuzen ed kan, uqbel ik, irgazen seg imezda$ n temdinin, iwumi Nweêêa. Day ur unagen ara di tmurt, ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren? Ih, pifxiô axxam aneggaru i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tefhimem ara?

verses.text: Alamma, mi uysen imazanen, u meyyzen ar skaddben ten, tusa ten id tallalt s$uône£. Nepsellik win i £ ihwan. Ur ipwakkas ara ssxev nne£, i ugdud ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Alamma, mi uysen imazanen, u meyyzen ar skaddben ten, tusa ten id tallalt s$uône£. Nepsellik win i £ ihwan. Ur ipwakkas ara ssxev nne£, i ugdud ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Ni$, di teêkayin nnsen, illa uselmed i yuâqilen. Ur telli d awal id innulfan. Neppat tetebbet ed ay d izwaren, tfeûûel ed yal cci. D nnhaya u d aêunu i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: Ni$, di teêkayin nnsen, illa uselmed i yuâqilen. Ur telli d awal id innulfan. Neppat tetebbet ed ay d izwaren, tfeûûel ed yal cci. D nnhaya u d aêunu i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Alô. Wigi d issekniyen n Tazmamt ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Alô. Wigi d issekniyen n Tazmamt ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Nessader it id d Leqwôan, s taâôabt, amar a pfehmem.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Nessader it id d Leqwôan, s taâôabt, amar a pfehmem.

ayahs.text: Nekwni Nêekku yak tiêkayin igerzen mavi, deg wayen i k Nweêêa di Leqwôan agi, xas telliv, uqbel is, seg wid istehzan.
ayahs.translation: Nekwni Nêekku yak tiêkayin igerzen mavi, deg wayen i k Nweêêa di Leqwôan agi, xas telliv, uqbel is, seg wid istehzan.

ayahs.text: Mi inna Yusef i baba s: "a baba! Nek wala$ mrawyan itran, iîij, akked waggur, wala$ ten knan iyi".
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Yusef i baba s: "a baba! Nek wala$ mrawyan itran, iîij, akked waggur, wala$ ten knan iyi".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a mmi! Ur êekku ayen twalav i watmaten ik, ad ak andin ticeôkep. Cciîan, s tidep, d acengu n ûûeê n umdan.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a mmi! Ur êekku ayen twalav i watmaten ik, ad ak andin ticeôkep. Cciîan, s tidep, d acengu n ûûeê n umdan.

ayahs.text: Akka, a k Ifren Mass ik, u ak Isselmed asefru n temsal, u ad Itim l$it iS, i keçç akked twacult n Yaâqub, akken it Itam, zik, af lejdud ik: Ibôahim akked Isêaq. Mass ik, s tidep, d Amusnaw, d Uûwib".
ayahs.translation: Akka, a k Ifren Mass ik, u ak Isselmed asefru n temsal, u ad Itim l$it iS, i keçç akked twacult n Yaâqub, akken it Itam, zik, af lejdud ik: Ibôahim akked Isêaq. Mass ik, s tidep, d Amusnaw, d Uûwib".

ayahs.text: Ni$, di Yusef akked watma s, illa ussekni i wid isteqsayen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$, di Yusef akked watma s, illa ussekni i wid isteqsayen.

ayahs.text: Mi nnan: "war ccekk, ifen a$, Yusef akked gma s, akken iten iêemmel babat nne$, u nekwni d îîeôma. Babat nne$, s tidep, haat di ttelfan n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Mi nnan: "war ccekk, ifen a$, Yusef akked gma s, akken iten iêemmel babat nne$, u nekwni d îîeôma. Babat nne$, s tidep, haat di ttelfan n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: En$et Yusef, ne$ nfut ep si tmurt, a d ilhu degwen babat wen, sinna, a ppu$alem d imdanen ixeddmen ayen ilhan".
ayahs.translation: En$et Yusef, ne$ nfut ep si tmurt, a d ilhu degwen babat wen, sinna, a ppu$alem d imdanen ixeddmen ayen ilhan".

ayahs.text: Inna win d immeslayen, degsen: "ur neqqet Yusef, veggôet ep ar lqaâa n wannu. Ma tgam akka, a t iddem yiwen umsebrid".
ayahs.translation: Inna win d immeslayen, degsen: "ur neqqet Yusef, veggôet ep ar lqaâa n wannu. Ma tgam akka, a t iddem yiwen umsebrid".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a babat nne$, acu k iu$en, ur a$ tuminev ara, $ef Yusef. Nekwni, fellas, s tidep, d unûiêen.
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a babat nne$, acu k iu$en, ur a$ tuminev ara, $ef Yusef. Nekwni, fellas, s tidep, d unûiêen.

ayahs.text: Sseddu t yidne$ azekka, ad izhu, ad iurar. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nêareb fellas".
ayahs.translation: Sseddu t yidne$ azekka, ad izhu, ad iurar. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nêareb fellas".

ayahs.text: Inna: "nek, s tidep, $weble$ ma tebbwim t yidwen, ugade$ a t içç lweêc, kunwi testehzam degs".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "nek, s tidep, $weble$ ma tebbwim t yidwen, ugade$ a t içç lweêc, kunwi testehzam degs".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ma içça t lweêc, u nekwni d îîeôma, s tidep a nili d imexsuôen".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ma içça t lweêc, u nekwni d îîeôma, s tidep a nili d imexsuôen".

ayahs.text: Mi t bbwin, mwafaqen a t rôen ar lqaâa n wannu, Nweêêa yas: "ad asen temlev, s tidep, lameô agi nnsen, nitni ur éôin".
ayahs.translation: Mi t bbwin, mwafaqen a t rôen ar lqaâa n wannu, Nweêêa yas: "ad asen temlev, s tidep, lameô agi nnsen, nitni ur éôin".

ayahs.text: U$alen d tameddit, ar babat sen, pprun.
ayahs.translation: U$alen d tameddit, ar babat sen, pprun.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a babat nne$, s tidep, nôuê a nemzizzel, neooa Yusef ar lqecc nne$, içça t lweêc. Ur a$ teppamnev, xas nenna d tidep".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a babat nne$, s tidep, nôuê a nemzizzel, neooa Yusef ar lqecc nne$, içça t lweêc. Ur a$ teppamnev, xas nenna d tidep".

ayahs.text: Bbwin d tasedrit is, degs idamen n rrya. Inna: "xaîi! D iman nnwen i wen d iccacven lameô. Ilha ûûbeô. Anuju $eô Öebbi, mgal ayen d teêkam".
ayahs.translation: Bbwin d tasedrit is, degs idamen n rrya. Inna: "xaîi! D iman nnwen i wen d iccacven lameô. Ilha ûûbeô. Anuju $eô Öebbi, mgal ayen d teêkam".

ayahs.text: Usan d iminigen, uznen win id ippagwmen, issader ssvel is. Inna: "a lxiô, wagi d aqcic"! Ffren t, amzun d sselâa. Öebbi Iéôa acu xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Usan d iminigen, uznen win id ippagwmen, issader ssvel is. Inna: "a lxiô, wagi d aqcic"! Ffren t, amzun d sselâa. Öebbi Iéôa acu xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Zzenzen t, s ôôxa, s kra iûuôdiyen. Ur as fkin ara azal.
ayahs.translation: Zzenzen t, s ôôxa, s kra iûuôdiyen. Ur as fkin ara azal.

ayahs.text: Inna, i tmeîîut is, Umaûôi i t iu$en: "eôêeb yis, amar ad a$ infaâ, at nerr d mmit nne$". Akka ay Nesseqâad Yusef di tmurt, iwakken ad as Nesseêfev asefru n temsal. Öebbi d Amezwaru s lameô iS, maca tegwti n medden ur éôin ara.
ayahs.translation: Inna, i tmeîîut is, Umaûôi i t iu$en: "eôêeb yis, amar ad a$ infaâ, at nerr d mmit nne$". Akka ay Nesseqâad Yusef di tmurt, iwakken ad as Nesseêfev asefru n temsal. Öebbi d Amezwaru s lameô iS, maca tegwti n medden ur éôin ara.

ayahs.text: Mi d immeêtel, Nefka yas ûûwab, tussna. Akka ay Nepkafi iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Mi d immeêtel, Nefka yas ûûwab, tussna. Akka ay Nepkafi iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Teb$a t tin u$ur izde$. Terra tibbura, u tenna: "eyya keçç"! Inna: "ad iyi Ineooi Öebbi! Ni$ bab iw iôêeb yissi. S tidep, ur rebêen imednas".
ayahs.translation: Teb$a t tin u$ur izde$. Terra tibbura, u tenna: "eyya keçç"! Inna: "ad iyi Ineooi Öebbi! Ni$ bab iw iôêeb yissi. S tidep, ur rebêen imednas".

ayahs.text: S tidep, teb$a t, u neppa ib$a p, lemmer ur iwala ara atebbet n Mass is. Akka, iwakken a Nessebâad fellas tuccva, lâaô. Neppa, s tidep, seg imdanen nne£ izedganen.
ayahs.translation: S tidep, teb$a t, u neppa ib$a p, lemmer ur iwala ara atebbet n Mass is. Akka, iwakken a Nessebâad fellas tuccva, lâaô. Neppa, s tidep, seg imdanen nne£ izedganen.

ayahs.text: Uzzlen ar tebburt, tcerreg as tasedrit is, si zdeffir. Mmugren, argaz is, ar tebburt. Tenna: "acu ay d aqeîîi n win iâabwlen ad iccmet tawacult ik, siwa lêebs ne$ aâaqeb aqeôêan"?
ayahs.translation: Uzzlen ar tebburt, tcerreg as tasedrit is, si zdeffir. Mmugren, argaz is, ar tebburt. Tenna: "acu ay d aqeîîi n win iâabwlen ad iccmet tawacult ik, siwa lêebs ne$ aâaqeb aqeôêan"?

ayahs.text: Inna: "d neppat iyi ib$an". Icuhhed ed yiwen unagi si twacult is: "ma teqqeôs tsedrit si zdat, tenna d tidep, u neppa d akeddab.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "d neppat iyi ib$an". Icuhhed ed yiwen unagi si twacult is: "ma teqqeôs tsedrit si zdat, tenna d tidep, u neppa d akeddab.

ayahs.text: Ma teqqeôs tsedrit si zdeffir, teskaddeb, u neppa seg at tidep".
ayahs.translation: Ma teqqeôs tsedrit si zdeffir, teskaddeb, u neppa seg at tidep".

ayahs.text: Mi iwala teqqeôs tsedrit si zdeffir, inna: "ayagi, war ccekk, si nncub nnkwent. Ih, nncub nnkwent d timeqwôaêanin.
ayahs.translation: Mi iwala teqqeôs tsedrit si zdeffir, inna: "ayagi, war ccekk, si nncub nnkwent. Ih, nncub nnkwent d timeqwôaêanin.

ayahs.text: A Yusef, ppu ayagi, u kem ssuter ssmaê ubekkav im. Kem, s tidep, teccvev".
ayahs.translation: A Yusef, ppu ayagi, u kem ssuter ssmaê ubekkav im. Kem, s tidep, teccvev".

ayahs.text: La qqaôent tlawin, di temdint: "tameîîut umdebbeô têemmel acrik is. Teshebl ip tayri. F akken nwala, appan, s tidep, di ttelfan n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: La qqaôent tlawin, di temdint: "tameîîut umdebbeô têemmel acrik is. Teshebl ip tayri. F akken nwala, appan, s tidep, di ttelfan n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Mi tesla s nncub nnsent, tuzen $uôsent, thegga yasent tanalt. I yal yiwet segsent, tefka tafrut. Tenna: "effe$ ed garasent". Mi t walant, isdehc itent, jerêent ifassen nnsent, nnant: "êaca Öebbi, wagi maççi d amdan, wagi siwa d lmelk ukyis".
ayahs.translation: Mi tesla s nncub nnsent, tuzen $uôsent, thegga yasent tanalt. I yal yiwet segsent, tefka tafrut. Tenna: "effe$ ed garasent". Mi t walant, isdehc itent, jerêent ifassen nnsent, nnant: "êaca Öebbi, wagi maççi d amdan, wagi siwa d lmelk ukyis".

ayahs.text: Tenna: "d wagi i$ef iyi tlummemt. Ih, b$i$ t, neppa iqqim zeddig. Ma ur ixdim ara ay s umôe$, war ccekk, ad ipwaêbes, ad ipwaêqeô".
ayahs.translation: Tenna: "d wagi i$ef iyi tlummemt. Ih, b$i$ t, neppa iqqim zeddig. Ma ur ixdim ara ay s umôe$, war ccekk, ad ipwaêbes, ad ipwaêqeô".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Smenyafe$ lêebs i wayen u$ur iyi d ssawalent. Ma ur Tesbaâdev ara felli nncub nnsent, ad male$ $uôsent, ad ili$ seg wid ur nessin".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Smenyafe$ lêebs i wayen u$ur iyi d ssawalent. Ma ur Tesbaâdev ara felli nncub nnsent, ad male$ $uôsent, ad ili$ seg wid ur nessin".

ayahs.text: Ijaweb as d Mass is. Issebâad fellas nncub nnsent. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ijaweb as d Mass is. Issebâad fellas nncub nnsent. Neppa, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Sinna, mi ten usan issekniyen, ufan, war ccekk, ilaq a t irr ar lêebs, kra n tallit.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, mi ten usan issekniyen, ufan, war ccekk, ilaq a t irr ar lêebs, kra n tallit.

ayahs.text: Kecmen yides, ar lêebs, sin ilmeéiyen. Inna yiwen degsen: "nek wala$ iman iw, la teééme$ ccôab". Inna d wayev: "nek wala$ iman iw, la ppawi$ a$ôum $ef uqeôôu w, la teppen segs ifrax. Ssefru ya$ p id. Ih, nwala k seg iâaôviyen".
ayahs.translation: Kecmen yides, ar lêebs, sin ilmeéiyen. Inna yiwen degsen: "nek wala$ iman iw, la teééme$ ccôab". Inna d wayev: "nek wala$ iman iw, la ppawi$ a$ôum $ef uqeôôu w, la teppen segs ifrax. Ssefru ya$ p id. Ih, nwala k seg iâaôviyen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "seg wayen iyi ss$eô Mass iw, ad awen p id ssefru$, uqbel a kwen id iawev lqut i wen ppakken. Nek ooi$ ddin n ugdud ur numin s Öebbi, u nitni nekôen laxeôt.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "seg wayen iyi ss$eô Mass iw, ad awen p id ssefru$, uqbel a kwen id iawev lqut i wen ppakken. Nek ooi$ ddin n ugdud ur numin s Öebbi, u nitni nekôen laxeôt.

ayahs.text: Ddi$ d ddin n lejdud iw: Ibôahim, Isêaq akked Yaâqub. Ur a$ ippunefk a nezdukkel acemma i Öebbi. Ayagi si lfevl n Öebbi fellane$, akw $ef imdanen. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Ddi$ d ddin n lejdud iw: Ibôahim, Isêaq akked Yaâqub. Ur a$ ippunefk a nezdukkel acemma i Öebbi. Ayagi si lfevl n Öebbi fellane$, akw $ef imdanen. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen ur snemmiren.

ayahs.text: A yimeddukwal iw n lêebs, menyif imawlan imfaôaqen, ne$ Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô?
ayahs.translation: A yimeddukwal iw n lêebs, menyif imawlan imfaôaqen, ne$ Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô?

ayahs.text: Ay tâabdem, war Neppa, d ismawen kan i sen tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen. Ur asen d Issers ara Öebbi kra udabu. Lêukm ar Öebbi kan. Iumeô ed ur tâabdem, siwa Neppa. D wagi ay d ddin uûwib, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Ay tâabdem, war Neppa, d ismawen kan i sen tefkam, kunwi akked imezwura nnwen. Ur asen d Issers ara Öebbi kra udabu. Lêukm ar Öebbi kan. Iumeô ed ur tâabdem, siwa Neppa. D wagi ay d ddin uûwib, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: A yimeddukwal iw n lêebs, wanag yiwen degwen ad ismiri ccôab, i bab is, wayev ad ippusemmeô $ef umidag, ifrax ad nneqben aqeôôu s. Ippuseyya lameô $ef wayen iyi d testeqsam".
ayahs.translation: A yimeddukwal iw n lêebs, wanag yiwen degwen ad ismiri ccôab, i bab is, wayev ad ippusemmeô $ef umidag, ifrax ad nneqben aqeôôu s. Ippuseyya lameô $ef wayen iyi d testeqsam".

ayahs.text: Inna i win iêûa ad islek, segsen: "ar bab ik, smekti iyi d". Cciîan iseppu t, ur t id ismekti ar bab is. Irna, di lêebs, kra iseggwasen.
ayahs.translation: Inna i win iêûa ad islek, segsen: "ar bab ik, smekti iyi d". Cciîan iseppu t, ur t id ismekti ar bab is. Irna, di lêebs, kra iseggwasen.

ayahs.text: Inna ugellid: "nek wala$ ûa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teppent ûa tuvâifin, akked ûa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyav d tiqquôanin. A yimvebbôen, ssefrut iyi d targit, ma tellam seg wid issefruyen tirga".
ayahs.translation: Inna ugellid: "nek wala$ ûa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teppent ûa tuvâifin, akked ûa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyav d tiqquôanin. A yimvebbôen, ssefrut iyi d targit, ma tellam seg wid issefruyen tirga".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "d tirga iwlellsen. Ur nelli d imusnawen i usefru n tirga".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "d tirga iwlellsen. Ur nelli d imusnawen i usefru n tirga".

ayahs.text: Win i isellken si sin nni, armi tallit id immekti, inna: "nek, ad awen d awi$ asefru ines, aznet iyi.
ayahs.translation: Win i isellken si sin nni, armi tallit id immekti, inna: "nek, ad awen d awi$ asefru ines, aznet iyi.

ayahs.text: A Yusef, bab n tidep, ssefru ya$ d: ûa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teppent ûa tuvâifin, akked ûa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyav d tiqquôanin. Amar, ma u$ale$ ar imdanen, amar ad éôen".
ayahs.translation: A Yusef, bab n tidep, ssefru ya$ d: ûa testan tiqebwaniyin, la tent teppent ûa tuvâifin, akked ûa tyedrin tizegzawin, tiyav d tiqquôanin. Amar, ma u$ale$ ar imdanen, amar ad éôen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "zerâat ûa iseggwasen imyevfaôen. Ayen tzerâam, eooet ep di tyedrin is, siwa cwiî ara teççem.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "zerâat ûa iseggwasen imyevfaôen. Ayen tzerâam, eooet ep di tyedrin is, siwa cwiî ara teççem.

ayahs.text: Sinna, deffir sen, a d asen ûa iwaâôen. Ad ççen ayen i sen theggam siwa cwiî, seg wayen txeznem.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, deffir sen, a d asen ûa iwaâôen. Ad ççen ayen i sen theggam siwa cwiî, seg wayen txeznem.

ayahs.text: Sinna a d ias, deffir waya, useggwas n tallalt i medden, ideg ara éden".
ayahs.translation: Sinna a d ias, deffir waya, useggwas n tallalt i medden, ideg ara éden".

ayahs.text: Inna ugellid: "awit ep id $uôi". Mi t id iusa umersul, inna: "u$al ar bab ik, u steqsi t acu ay d l$eôv n tlawin i ijerêen ifassen nnsent. Mass iw, s tidep, Issen nncub nnsent".
ayahs.translation: Inna ugellid: "awit ep id $uôi". Mi t id iusa umersul, inna: "u$al ar bab ik, u steqsi t acu ay d l$eôv n tlawin i ijerêen ifassen nnsent. Mass iw, s tidep, Issen nncub nnsent".

ayahs.text: Inna: "acu ara d tinimt mi teb$amt Yusef"? Nnant: "êaca Öebbi, ur nufi $uôes tuccva". Tenna d tmeîîut umvebbeô: "tura, a d tban tidep. D nek i t ib$an, ma d neppa, s tidep, d bab n tidep".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "acu ara d tinimt mi teb$amt Yusef"? Nnant: "êaca Öebbi, ur nufi $uôes tuccva". Tenna d tmeîîut umvebbeô: "tura, a d tban tidep. D nek i t ib$an, ma d neppa, s tidep, d bab n tidep".

ayahs.text: "Akka, iwakken ad iéeô ur t xdiâa$ ara s tuffra. Öebbi ur Inehhu nncub n lxeyyan.
ayahs.translation: "Akka, iwakken ad iéeô ur t xdiâa$ ara s tuffra. Öebbi ur Inehhu nncub n lxeyyan.

ayahs.text: Ur pzekki$ iman iw. Tanefsit, s tidep, tezzu$uô ar tuccva, siwa ma Iêun Mass iw. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
ayahs.translation: Ur pzekki$ iman iw. Tanefsit, s tidep, tezzu$uô ar tuccva, siwa ma Iêun Mass iw. Mass iw, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

ayahs.text: Inna ugellid: "awit ep id $uôi, d laâtiq iw". Mi s immeslay, inna: "keçç, assa, nefka yak adabu, laman".
ayahs.translation: Inna ugellid: "awit ep id $uôi, d laâtiq iw". Mi s immeslay, inna: "keçç, assa, nefka yak adabu, laman".

ayahs.text: Inna: "wekkel iyi $ef lemxazen n tmurt, nek d amêareb amusnaw".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "wekkel iyi $ef lemxazen n tmurt, nek d amêareb amusnaw".

ayahs.text: Akka ay Nesseqâad Yusef di tmurt, ad izde$ anda i s ihwa. Nepêunu $ef win i £ ihwan, ur Nesôuêu arraz iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay Nesseqâad Yusef di tmurt, ad izde$ anda i s ihwa. Nepêunu $ef win i £ ihwan, ur Nesôuêu arraz iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: S tidep, arraz n laxeôt yif it, i wid iumnen u llan pêezziben.
ayahs.translation: S tidep, arraz n laxeôt yif it, i wid iumnen u llan pêezziben.

ayahs.text: Usan watmaten n Yusef, kecmen $uôes, iâqel iten, nitni ur t âqilen.
ayahs.translation: Usan watmaten n Yusef, kecmen $uôes, iâqel iten, nitni ur t âqilen.

ayahs.text: Mi sen ifka ppâabgat nnsen, inna: "awit iyi d gmat wen s babat wen. Day ur twalam ara zade$ awen lkil, u, nek, ife$ akw wid isnebgaten?
ayahs.translation: Mi sen ifka ppâabgat nnsen, inna: "awit iyi d gmat wen s babat wen. Day ur twalam ara zade$ awen lkil, u, nek, ife$ akw wid isnebgaten?

ayahs.text: Ma ur iyi t id tebbwim ara, ur awen nepktili $uôi, ur iyi d tepsamim ".
ayahs.translation: Ma ur iyi t id tebbwim ara, ur awen nepktili $uôi, ur iyi d tepsamim ".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a nêawet baba s fellas; akka ara nexdem".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a nêawet baba s fellas; akka ara nexdem".

ayahs.text: Inna i iqeddacen is: "rret selâa nnsen deg icekkaôen nnsen, amar a p âaqlen mara awven ar twacult nnsen, amar a d u$alen".
ayahs.translation: Inna i iqeddacen is: "rret selâa nnsen deg icekkaôen nnsen, amar a p âaqlen mara awven ar twacult nnsen, amar a d u$alen".

ayahs.text: Mi bbwven ar babat sen, nnan: "a babat nne$, igdel fella$ lkil, azen gmat nne$ yidne$, iwakken a d nektil. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nêareb fellas".
ayahs.translation: Mi bbwven ar babat sen, nnan: "a babat nne$, igdel fella$ lkil, azen gmat nne$ yidne$, iwakken a d nektil. Nekwni, war ccekk, a nêareb fellas".

ayahs.text: Inna: "day a kwen amne$ fellas, akken i kwen umne$, zik, $ef gma s? Öebbi Yif akw imêaraben. Neppa Iphunu sennig akw iêninen".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "day a kwen amne$ fellas, akken i kwen umne$, zik, $ef gma s? Öebbi Yif akw imêaraben. Neppa Iphunu sennig akw iêninen".

ayahs.text: Mi ldin lqecc nnsen, ufan tu$al iten id selâa nnsen. Nnan: "a babat nne$, ur neb$i tagi, selâa nne$ tu$al a$ d. A d nessikrer i twacult nne$, a nêareb $ef gmat nne$, a d nernu ppâabga n ul$wem. Tagi d ppâabga tushilt".
ayahs.translation: Mi ldin lqecc nnsen, ufan tu$al iten id selâa nnsen. Nnan: "a babat nne$, ur neb$i tagi, selâa nne$ tu$al a$ d. A d nessikrer i twacult nne$, a nêareb $ef gmat nne$, a d nernu ppâabga n ul$wem. Tagi d ppâabga tushilt".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ur t sedduye$ yidwen, d awez$i, siwa ma tcubkem iyi s Öebbi, ard a yi t id terrem, siwa ma zzin awen". Mi s âahden, inna: "Öebbi d Awkil $ef wayen id nenna".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ur t sedduye$ yidwen, d awez$i, siwa ma tcubkem iyi s Öebbi, ard a yi t id terrem, siwa ma zzin awen". Mi s âahden, inna: "Öebbi d Awkil $ef wayen id nenna".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a tarwa, ur keççmet si yiwet n tebburt, kecmet si tebbura imgarraden. Ula i wen xedme$, bippa, ar loiha n Öebbi. Aêuddu siwa win n Öebbi. FellaS ppekle$, fellaS ay ppeklen wid ippkalen".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a tarwa, ur keççmet si yiwet n tebburt, kecmet si tebbura imgarraden. Ula i wen xedme$, bippa, ar loiha n Öebbi. Aêuddu siwa win n Öebbi. FellaS ppekle$, fellaS ay ppeklen wid ippkalen".

ayahs.text: Mi kecmen akken i sen iumeô babat sen, ula i sen ixdem, bippa, ar loiha n Öebbi. D ayen ilezmen kan i iseyya Yaqub, deg iman is. Neppa, s tidep, isâa tamusni i s Nesselmed, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Mi kecmen akken i sen iumeô babat sen, ula i sen ixdem, bippa, ar loiha n Öebbi. D ayen ilezmen kan i iseyya Yaqub, deg iman is. Neppa, s tidep, isâa tamusni i s Nesselmed, maca tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Mi kecmen ar Yusef, ibbwi gma s $uôes, inna: "nekkini d gma k, ur $webbel $ef wayen xeddmen".
ayahs.translation: Mi kecmen ar Yusef, ibbwi gma s $uôes, inna: "nekkini d gma k, ur $webbel $ef wayen xeddmen".

ayahs.text: Mi sen ifka ppâabgat nnsen, irra taqbuct deg ucekkaô n gma s. Sinna, iberreê uberraê: "a yat terkaf, kunwi, war ccekk, d imakwaren"!
ayahs.translation: Mi sen ifka ppâabgat nnsen, irra taqbuct deg ucekkaô n gma s. Sinna, iberreê uberraê: "a yat terkaf, kunwi, war ccekk, d imakwaren"!

ayahs.text: Nnan, u zzin $uôsen: "d acu tesôuêem"?
ayahs.translation: Nnan, u zzin $uôsen: "d acu tesôuêem"?

ayahs.text: Nnan: "nesôuê taqbuct ugellid. Win ip id ibbwin, ad as nefk ppâabga n ul$wem. Nek, vemne$ t".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "nesôuê taqbuct ugellid. Win ip id ibbwin, ad as nefk ppâabga n ul$wem. Nek, vemne$ t".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "s Öebbi, nni$ teéôam ur d nusa ara a nessefsed tamurt, ur nelli d imakwaren".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "s Öebbi, nni$ teéôam ur d nusa ara a nessefsed tamurt, ur nelli d imakwaren".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "d acu ay d aqeîîi s, ma teskadbem"?
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "d acu ay d aqeîîi s, ma teskadbem"?

ayahs.text: Nnan: " aqeîîi n win i p ibbwin di tcekkaôt is, d yiman is. Akka ay nepkafi imednas".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: " aqeîîi n win i p ibbwin di tcekkaôt is, d yiman is. Akka ay nepkafi imednas".

ayahs.text: Ibda la ipqellib icekkaôen, uqbel win n gma s, sinna, issuffe$ ip id seg ucekkaô n gma s. Akka ay Nefka ticeôkep i Yusef. Ur izmir ad iîîef gma s, s lqanun ugellid, siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Nessalay, tiseddaôin, win i £ihwan. Sennig bu tussna, illa Umusnaw.
