ayahs.translation: Ibda la ipqellib icekkaôen, uqbel win n gma s, sinna, issuffe$ ip id seg ucekkaô n gma s. Akka ay Nefka ticeôkep i Yusef. Ur izmir ad iîîef gma s, s lqanun ugellid, siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Nessalay, tiseddaôin, win i £ihwan. Sennig bu tussna, illa Umusnaw.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ma iuker, ni$ iuker, zik, yiwen n watma s". Iffer ip Yusef $uôes, ur asen p id inna ara. Inna: "aql akwen deg yir êala. Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa ayen d teqqaôem".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ma iuker, ni$ iuker, zik, yiwen n watma s". Iffer ip Yusef $uôes, ur asen p id inna ara. Inna: "aql akwen deg yir êala. Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa ayen d teqqaôem".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a yameqwôan, baba s, s tidep, wesser. Eîîef yiwen segne$ deg umekkan is. Nwala k, ih, telliv si lâuûam".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a yameqwôan, baba s, s tidep, wesser. Eîîef yiwen segne$ deg umekkan is. Nwala k, ih, telliv si lâuûam".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ur a$ Iâammed Öebbi a neîîef, siwa win u$uô nufa ta$awsa nne$. Mulac, war ccekk, a nili d imednas".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ur a$ Iâammed Öebbi a neîîef, siwa win u$uô nufa ta$awsa nne$. Mulac, war ccekk, a nili d imednas".

ayahs.text: Mi uysen segs, mcawaôen, inna umeqwôan segsen: "day ur teéôim ara, ar babat wen tcubkem t s Öebbi, u, zik, tveggâam Yusef? Ihi, ur pôuêu$ si tmurt a, d awez$i, alamma iserreê iyi baba, ne$ Ifra Öebbi felli. Neppa, Yif akw imêaddan.
ayahs.translation: Mi uysen segs, mcawaôen, inna umeqwôan segsen: "day ur teéôim ara, ar babat wen tcubkem t s Öebbi, u, zik, tveggâam Yusef? Ihi, ur pôuêu$ si tmurt a, d awez$i, alamma iserreê iyi baba, ne$ Ifra Öebbi felli. Neppa, Yif akw imêaddan.

ayahs.text: U$alet ar babat wen, tinem as: a babat nne$, mmi k, s tidep, iuker. Ncehhed kan $ef wayen neéôa, ur nessawev i tbavnit.
ayahs.translation: U$alet ar babat wen, tinem as: a babat nne$, mmi k, s tidep, iuker. Ncehhed kan $ef wayen neéôa, ur nessawev i tbavnit.

ayahs.text: Steqsi tamdint ideg i nella, akked terkift ukud nedda. Ih, d tidep, ay d nenna".
ayahs.translation: Steqsi tamdint ideg i nella, akked terkift ukud nedda. Ih, d tidep, ay d nenna".

ayahs.text: Inna: "xaîi! Lameô seg iman nnwen. Ilha ûûbeô. Amar Öebbi a yi ten id Iawi akw. Neppa, s tidep, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "xaîi! Lameô seg iman nnwen. Ilha ûûbeô. Amar Öebbi a yi ten id Iawi akw. Neppa, s tidep, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw".

ayahs.text: Ijuneb iten, u inna: "a lêif iw $ef Yusef"! Allen is ijegger itent u$ilif, innu$ben.
ayahs.translation: Ijuneb iten, u inna: "a lêif iw $ef Yusef"! Allen is ijegger itent u$ilif, innu$ben.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "s Öebbi, tezgiv tesmektayev d Yusef, alamma tu$alev d amuvin, ne$ seg wid immuten".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "s Öebbi, tezgiv tesmektayev d Yusef, alamma tu$alev d amuvin, ne$ seg wid immuten".

ayahs.text: Inna: "la pcetki$ kan i Öebbi, s uneémi w akked u$wbel iw. Ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "la pcetki$ kan i Öebbi, s uneémi w akked u$wbel iw. Ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: A yarraw iw, ôuêet, steqsit $ef Yusef akked gma s. Ur ppayset di tecvaî n Öebbi. Ih, i ippaysen di tecvaî n Öebbi, siwa agdud ijehliyen".
ayahs.translation: A yarraw iw, ôuêet, steqsit $ef Yusef akked gma s. Ur ppayset di tecvaî n Öebbi. Ih, i ippaysen di tecvaî n Öebbi, siwa agdud ijehliyen".

ayahs.text: Mi bbwven $uôes, nnan as: "a yameqwôan, nekwni akked twacult nne$, nepwa$. Nusa d s selâa ôxisen, semd as lkil, seddeq a$. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipkafi wid ipseddiqen".
ayahs.translation: Mi bbwven $uôes, nnan as: "a yameqwôan, nekwni akked twacult nne$, nepwa$. Nusa d s selâa ôxisen, semd as lkil, seddeq a$. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipkafi wid ipseddiqen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "teéôam i tgam i Yusef akked gma s, mi kunwi, d wid ur nessin"?
ayahs.translation: Inna: "teéôam i tgam i Yusef akked gma s, mi kunwi, d wid ur nessin"?

ayahs.text: Nnan: "keçç, s tidep, maççi d Yusef "? Inna: "nek d Yusef, atan gma. Ni$ I$at a$ Öebbi. Ih, wid ipêezziben, wid iûebbôen ... Öebbi, s tidep, ur Isôuêu arraz iâaôviyen".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "keçç, s tidep, maççi d Yusef "? Inna: "nek d Yusef, atan gma. Ni$ I$at a$ Öebbi. Ih, wid ipêezziben, wid iûebbôen ... Öebbi, s tidep, ur Isôuêu arraz iâaôviyen".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "s Öebbi ar k Ismenyaf Öebbi garane$. Nekwni, s tidep, neccev".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "s Öebbi ar k Ismenyaf Öebbi garane$. Nekwni, s tidep, neccev".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ur telli tiyta degwen, assa. Ad awen Isemmeê Öebbi! Neppa Yif akw wid ipêunun.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ur telli tiyta degwen, assa. Ad awen Isemmeê Öebbi! Neppa Yif akw wid ipêunun.

ayahs.text: Awit tasedrit iw agi, erret ep $ef udem n baba, ad iêlu yiéôi s. Aset ed $uôi, s twacult nnwen, meôôa".
ayahs.translation: Awit tasedrit iw agi, erret ep $ef udem n baba, ad iêlu yiéôi s. Aset ed $uôi, s twacult nnwen, meôôa".

ayahs.text: Mi teqlaâ terkift, babat sen ibda la iqqaô: "nek, s tidep, sraêe$ rriêa n Yusef, awi d kan ur teqqaôem ara: la isxeôwiv".
ayahs.translation: Mi teqlaâ terkift, babat sen ibda la iqqaô: "nek, s tidep, sraêe$ rriêa n Yusef, awi d kan ur teqqaôem ara: la isxeôwiv".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "s Öebbi, ar k mazal di ttelfan ik n zik".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "s Öebbi, ar k mazal di ttelfan ik n zik".

ayahs.text: Mi d iusa ubcir, issers as p $ef udem is, llint ed wallen is, inna: "day ur awen nni$ ara: nek ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?
ayahs.translation: Mi d iusa ubcir, issers as p $ef udem is, llint ed wallen is, inna: "day ur awen nni$ ara: nek ssne$, s$uô Öebbi, ayen ur tessinem"?

ayahs.text: Nnan as: "a babat nne$, ssuter ad a$ pwasemmêen ibekkaven nne$. S tidep, nella d imednab".
ayahs.translation: Nnan as: "a babat nne$, ssuter ad a$ pwasemmêen ibekkaven nne$. S tidep, nella d imednab".

ayahs.text: Inna: "deqqal ad ssutre$, i Mass iw, ad awen Isemmeê. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "deqqal ad ssutre$, i Mass iw, ad awen Isemmeê. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu".

ayahs.text: Mi bbwven ar Yusef, isteôêeb s imawlan is. Inna: "kecmet ar Maseô, di laman, ma Irad Öebbi".
ayahs.translation: Mi bbwven ar Yusef, isteôêeb s imawlan is. Inna: "kecmet ar Maseô, di laman, ma Irad Öebbi".

ayahs.text: Issuli imawlan is ar usgeld. £lin, knan as. Inna: "a baba! D wagi ay d asefru n targit iw, n zik. Ni$ Issuffe$ ip Mass iw! Ni$ Iga yi leqôaô mi yi d Issuffe$ si lêebs. Ikkes ikwen id si sseêôa, deffir tismin i isker Cciîan, gari d watma. Mass iw, s tidep, d Laîif i win i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Issuli imawlan is ar usgeld. £lin, knan as. Inna: "a baba! D wagi ay d asefru n targit iw, n zik. Ni$ Issuffe$ ip Mass iw! Ni$ Iga yi leqôaô mi yi d Issuffe$ si lêebs. Ikkes ikwen id si sseêôa, deffir tismin i isker Cciîan, gari d watma. Mass iw, s tidep, d Laîif i win i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: A Mass iw, ni$ Tefkiv iyi si tgelda, Tesêefvev iyi asefru n temsal. Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Keçç, d Bab iw di ddunit, di laxeôt, Eddem ôôuê iw d amvua, Ssiwev iyi ar wid imaânen".
ayahs.translation: A Mass iw, ni$ Tefkiv iyi si tgelda, Tesêefvev iyi asefru n temsal. Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Keçç, d Bab iw di ddunit, di laxeôt, Eddem ôôuê iw d amvua, Ssiwev iyi ar wid imaânen".

ayahs.text: Tagi, si teêkayin n tbavnit, Nweêêa yak p in. Ur telliv $uôsen, mi mwafaqen a p andin.
ayahs.translation: Tagi, si teêkayin n tbavnit, Nweêêa yak p in. Ur telliv $uôsen, mi mwafaqen a p andin.

ayahs.text: Tegwti n yimdanen, xas tâapbev, ur ppamnen.
ayahs.translation: Tegwti n yimdanen, xas tâapbev, ur ppamnen.

ayahs.text: Ur asen ssutur kra n teqdiât. Neppa, d asmekti kan i imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Ur asen ssutur kra n teqdiât. Neppa, d asmekti kan i imavalen.

ayahs.text: I illan deg issekniyen di tmurt akked igenwan! La teddun fellasen, maca wexxôen asen.
ayahs.translation: I illan deg issekniyen di tmurt akked igenwan! La teddun fellasen, maca wexxôen asen.

ayahs.text: Tegwti, segsen, ur ppamnen s Öebbi, siwa ma curken.
ayahs.translation: Tegwti, segsen, ur ppamnen s Öebbi, siwa ma curken.

ayahs.text: Day ppeklen ur asen isburru yara uâaqeb n Öebbi, ne$ ur ten id ippas ara yimir, deqzalla, ur pfaqan?
ayahs.translation: Day ppeklen ur asen isburru yara uâaqeb n Öebbi, ne$ ur ten id ippas ara yimir, deqzalla, ur pfaqan?

ayahs.text: Ini: "wagi d abrid iw, la pnuju$ ar Öebbi ad Ildi allen, i nek akked wid iddan yidi. Gedha s Öebbi! Ur lli$ seg wid ipcaraken".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "wagi d abrid iw, la pnuju$ ar Öebbi ad Ildi allen, i nek akked wid iddan yidi. Gedha s Öebbi! Ur lli$ seg wid ipcaraken".

ayahs.text: Nuzen ed kan, uqbel ik, irgazen seg imezda$ n temdinin, iwumi Nweêêa. Day ur unagen ara di tmurt, ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren? Ih, pifxiô axxam aneggaru i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tefhimem ara?
ayahs.translation: Nuzen ed kan, uqbel ik, irgazen seg imezda$ n temdinin, iwumi Nweêêa. Day ur unagen ara di tmurt, ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren? Ih, pifxiô axxam aneggaru i wid ipêezziben. Day ur tefhimem ara?

ayahs.text: Alamma, mi uysen imazanen, u meyyzen ar skaddben ten, tusa ten id tallalt s$uône£. Nepsellik win i £ ihwan. Ur ipwakkas ara ssxev nne£, i ugdud ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: Alamma, mi uysen imazanen, u meyyzen ar skaddben ten, tusa ten id tallalt s$uône£. Nepsellik win i £ ihwan. Ur ipwakkas ara ssxev nne£, i ugdud ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: Ni$, di teêkayin nnsen, illa uselmed i yuâqilen. Ur telli d awal id innulfan. Neppat tetebbet ed ay d izwaren, tfeûûel ed yal cci. D nnhaya u d aêunu i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$, di teêkayin nnsen, illa uselmed i yuâqilen. Ur telli d awal id innulfan. Neppat tetebbet ed ay d izwaren, tfeûûel ed yal cci. D nnhaya u d aêunu i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Almô. Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt. Ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep, maca tegwti n medden ur ppamnen.
verses.translation: Almô. Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt. Ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep, maca tegwti n medden ur ppamnen.

verses.text: Öebbi i Issulin igenwan war tigwejda ara twalim, sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Iêeppem i yiîij d waggur ad ddun, akw, ar lajel ipwassnen. Iseyyi lameô, Ipfeûûil issekniyen, amar a pepputebbtem $ef temlilit d Mass nnwen.
verses.translation: Öebbi i Issulin igenwan war tigwejda ara twalim, sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Iêeppem i yiîij d waggur ad ddun, akw, ar lajel ipwassnen. Iseyyi lameô, Ipfeûûil issekniyen, amar a pepputebbtem $ef temlilit d Mass nnwen.

verses.text: Neppa i Isswesâen tamurt. Irra degs idurar, isaffen. Irra tayuga di yal ppemôa. Ip$ummu ass s yiv. Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i ugdud ipxemmimen.
verses.translation: Neppa i Isswesâen tamurt. Irra degs idurar, isaffen. Irra tayuga di yal ppemôa. Ip$ummu ass s yiv. Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i ugdud ipxemmimen.

verses.text: Di tmurt, tibêirin tioiratin, leonanat n téuôin, nnaâma, tizdayin, v$an ne$ ur v$in, cerken aman nnsen. Nesmenyaf kra i kra, i wuççi. Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.
verses.translation: Di tmurt, tibêirin tioiratin, leonanat n téuôin, nnaâma, tizdayin, v$an ne$ ur v$in, cerken aman nnsen. Nesmenyaf kra i kra, i wuççi. Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.

verses.text: Ma twehmev, issewham ay d qqaôen: "ma nu$al d akal, day fella$, s tidep, lxelq amaynut"? D wigi i inekôen Mass nnsen. Wigi, azaglu $ef tmegôav. Wigi d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.
verses.translation: Ma twehmev, issewham ay d qqaôen: "ma nu$al d akal, day fella$, s tidep, lxelq amaynut"? D wigi i inekôen Mass nnsen. Wigi, azaglu $ef tmegôav. Wigi d at tmes, nitni, degs, ad wekkôen.

verses.text: Sêaren k ar tucmip, uqbel ise$. Ni$ vôant am tigi, uqbel nnsen. Mass ik, s tidep, $uôeS ssmaê i imdanen deg wayen ccven. Mass ik, s tidep, Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.
verses.translation: Sêaren k ar tucmip, uqbel ise$. Ni$ vôant am tigi, uqbel nnsen. Mass ik, s tidep, $uôeS ssmaê i imdanen deg wayen ccven. Mass ik, s tidep, Iwâaô deg uâaqeb.

verses.text: La qqaôen wid ijehlen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes ussekni, s$uô Mass is". Keçç, d aneddaô kan. I yal agdud, win inehhun.
verses.translation: La qqaôen wid ijehlen: "a lemmer id irs $uôes ussekni, s$uô Mass is". Keçç, d aneddaô kan. I yal agdud, win inehhun.

verses.text: Öebbi Iéôa i illan di yal tadist, amek teddun inzikmiren. Yal cci, $uôeS, s lmizan.
verses.translation: Öebbi Iéôa i illan di yal tadist, amek teddun inzikmiren. Yal cci, $uôeS, s lmizan.

verses.text: Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir. Ameqwôan, Aâlayan.
verses.translation: Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir. Ameqwôan, Aâlayan.

verses.text: Iâuva segwen win i$emven awal, d win it iberêen, win iffren deg iv, d win d ivehôen deg wass.
verses.translation: Iâuva segwen win i$emven awal, d win it iberêen, win iffren deg iv, d win d ivehôen deg wass.

verses.text: Isâa iâssasen zdat es, deffir es, pêaraben fellas, s lameô n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Ipbeddil i illan deg ugdud, alamma bedlen i illan deg iman nnsen. Ma Irad Öebbi ayen n dir, i ugdud, ur t itekkes yiwen. Ur sâin amâiwen, war Neppa.
verses.translation: Isâa iâssasen zdat es, deffir es, pêaraben fellas, s lameô n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Ipbeddil i illan deg ugdud, alamma bedlen i illan deg iman nnsen. Ma Irad Öebbi ayen n dir, i ugdud, ur t itekkes yiwen. Ur sâin amâiwen, war Neppa.

verses.text: D Neppa i wen d Ippawin lebôaq, degs tugdi, asirem. Isskar ed asigna aéayan.
verses.translation: D Neppa i wen d Ippawin lebôaq, degs tugdi, asirem. Isskar ed asigna aéayan.

verses.text: Tesbuccuâ aS termegt, s ccekôan, akken lmalayek, seg wakken ugadent eP. Ippazen ed ssiâqat, Ipêaz yisent win i S ihwan. Nitni pnamaren $ef Öebbi. Neppa teqseê tezmert iS.
verses.translation: Tesbuccuâ aS termegt, s ccekôan, akken lmalayek, seg wakken ugadent eP. Ippazen ed ssiâqat, Ipêaz yisent win i S ihwan. Nitni pnamaren $ef Öebbi. Neppa teqseê tezmert iS.

verses.text: £uô Neppa, anuju n tidep. Wid u$uô la pnujun, war Neppa, ur asen d pparan s wacemma. Am win issendin ifassen i waman, ib$a ad awven s imi s, ur ibbwiv ar leb$i s. Anuju ijehliyen ar ttelfan kan.
verses.translation: £uô Neppa, anuju n tidep. Wid u$uô la pnujun, war Neppa, ur asen d pparan s wacemma. Am win issendin ifassen i waman, ib$a ad awven s imi s, ur ibbwiv ar leb$i s. Anuju ijehliyen ar ttelfan kan.

verses.text: I Öebbi la kennun wid illan di tmurt akked igenwan, b$an ne$ ugin, akked tili nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit.
verses.translation: I Öebbi la kennun wid illan di tmurt akked igenwan, b$an ne$ ugin, akked tili nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit.

verses.text: Ini: "anwa ay d Mass n tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi. Ihi day a pperrem d iêbiben, war Neppa, wid ur nemlik, i yiman nnsen, aba$uô ne$ vveôô"? Ini: "day iaâdel uder$al akked win ipwalin? Ne$, day âadlent tillas akked tafat? Ne$, rran imcurak i Öebbi, i ixelqen am lxelq iS, ufan t ippemcabi"? Ini: "d Öebbi i Ixelqen yal cci. D Neppa ay d Yiwen, d Aqehhaô".

verses.text: Isse$lay ed aman, seg igenni. Serrun deg $ezôan, s leqdeô nnsen. Acercuô ippawi ikuftan ippifliwen. Ppemcabin ikuftan ar wayen fessin di tmes, iwakken ad ûenâen ôôêuê ne$ dduzan. Akka ay d Isskan Öebbi tidep akked tkerkas. Ihi ikuftan ad ppuveggôen, ma d wayen inefâen medden, a d igwri di tmurt. Akka ay d Ippak Öebbi imedyaten.
verses.translation: Isse$lay ed aman, seg igenni. Serrun deg $ezôan, s leqdeô nnsen. Acercuô ippawi ikuftan ippifliwen. Ppemcabin ikuftan ar wayen fessin di tmes, iwakken ad ûenâen ôôêuê ne$ dduzan. Akka ay d Isskan Öebbi tidep akked tkerkas. Ihi ikuftan ad ppuveggôen, ma d wayen inefâen medden, a d igwri di tmurt. Akka ay d Ippak Öebbi imedyaten.

verses.text: Lfayeq i wid ijawben i Mass nnsen. Wid ur aS njaweb ara, xas ad sâun i illan akw di tmurt, berdayen, ur ten id ifeddu. I widak, leêsab adiran. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A tanezdu$t tucmip!
verses.translation: Lfayeq i wid ijawben i Mass nnsen. Wid ur aS njaweb ara, xas ad sâun i illan akw di tmurt, berdayen, ur ten id ifeddu. I widak, leêsab adiran. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A tanezdu$t tucmip!

verses.text: Day win iéôan ar ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep, am win idre$len? Siwa uâqilen id ismektayen.
verses.translation: Day win iéôan ar ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep, am win idre$len? Siwa uâqilen id ismektayen.

verses.text: Wid iîîfen di laâqed n Öebbi, ur pôuéun nnesba.
verses.translation: Wid iîîfen di laâqed n Öebbi, ur pôuéun nnesba.

verses.text: Wid issemlilen ayen id Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, u ppagwaden Mass nnsen, u ppagwaden aqeîîi adiran.
verses.translation: Wid issemlilen ayen id Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, u ppagwaden Mass nnsen, u ppagwaden aqeîîi adiran.

verses.text: Wid iûebôen, ssaramen udem n Mass nnsen, bedden i téallit, pseddiqen seg wayen is iten N$at, s tuffra u âinâni, swexxiôen tucmip s yise$. I nitni, agwav s Axxam.
verses.translation: Wid iûebôen, ssaramen udem n Mass nnsen, bedden i téallit, pseddiqen seg wayen is iten N$at, s tuffra u âinâni, swexxiôen tucmip s yise$. I nitni, agwav s Axxam.

verses.text: Leonanat n Âaden ara kecmen, akked wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, seg ibabaten nnsen, si tlawin nnsen, si tarwa nnsen. Lmalayek a d ppasent $uôsen si yal tabburt.
verses.translation: Leonanat n Âaden ara kecmen, akked wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, seg ibabaten nnsen, si tlawin nnsen, si tarwa nnsen. Lmalayek a d ppasent $uôsen si yal tabburt.

verses.text: Tifrat fellawen, ilmend n wayen tûebôem! D asaâdi, wagwav s Axxam!
verses.translation: Tifrat fellawen, ilmend n wayen tûebôem! D asaâdi, wagwav s Axxam!

verses.text: Wid ipôuéun laâqed n Öebbi, deffir lemwafaqa s, wid igezmen ayen d Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, u ssefsaden di tmurt, wigi, i nitni xezzu, i nitni yir axxam.
verses.translation: Wid ipôuéun laâqed n Öebbi, deffir lemwafaqa s, wid igezmen ayen d Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, u ssefsaden di tmurt, wigi, i nitni xezzu, i nitni yir axxam.

verses.text: Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Taâoeb iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Tameddurt n ddunit, d urar kan, zdat laxeôt.
verses.translation: Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Taâoeb iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Tameddurt n ddunit, d urar kan, zdat laxeôt.

verses.translation: La qqaôen wid ijehlen: "a lemmer id iris, $uôes, ussekni s$uô Mass is"! Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, Itellif win i S ihwan. Inehhu $uôeS, wid isteôoiâen,

verses.text: wid iumnen, iwumi itheddin wul, mara d mmektin Öebbi". Ni$, s usmekti n Öebbi, pheddinen wulawen.
verses.translation: wid iumnen, iwumi itheddin wul, mara d mmektin Öebbi". Ni$, s usmekti n Öebbi, pheddinen wulawen.

verses.translation: Ssaâd, akked taggara igerzen, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan.

verses.translation: Akka ay k id Nuzen, i lois id zwaren leoyus, ad asen temlev, ayen ik d Nweêêa. Nitni jehlen $uô Uênin. Ini: "Neppa d Mass iw, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa; ppekle$ fellaS, asteôoaâ iw $uôeS".

verses.text: A lemmer kan Leqwôan isselêa idurar, iceqqeq tamurt, ne$ issenîeq ed lmeggtin! Xaîi! Lumuô akw i Öebbi. Day ur éôin ara wid iumnen, ar, ma ihwa yaS, Öebbi ad Inhu medden meôôa? verses.translation: Ni$ mmaâlken, uqbel ik, deg imazanen. Ooi$ lmudda i wid ijehlen, sinna, Ïîfe$ ten. A yaâaqeb iW imiren!

verses.translation: Iseffev u Itebbit Öebbi ay S ihwan. £uôeS tayimmap n Tezmamt.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i wen d Ippawin lebôaq, degs tugdi, asirem. Isskar ed asigna aéayan.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i wen d Ippawin lebôaq, degs tugdi, asirem. Isskar ed asigna aéayan.

ayahs.text: Tesbuccuâ aS termegt, s ccekôan, akken lmalayek, seg wakken ugadent eP. Ippazen ed ssiâqat, Ipêaz yisent win i S ihwan. Nitni pnamaren $ef Öebbi. Neppa teqseê tezmert iS.
ayahs.translation: Tesbuccuâ aS termegt, s ccekôan, akken lmalayek, seg wakken ugadent eP. Ippazen ed ssiâqat, Ipêaz yisent win i S ihwan. Nitni pnamaren $ef Öebbi. Neppa teqseê tezmert iS.

ayahs.text: £uô Neppa, anuju n tidep. Wid u$uô la pnujun, war Neppa, ur asen d pparan s wacemma. Am win issendin ifassen i waman, ib$a ad awven s imi s, ur ibbwiv ar leb$i s. Anuju ijehliyen ar ttelfan kan.
ayahs.translation: £uô Neppa, anuju n tidep. Wid u$uô la pnujun, war Neppa, ur asen d pparan s wacemma. Am win issendin ifassen i waman, ib$a ad awven s imi s, ur ibbwiv ar leb$i s. Anuju ijehliyen ar ttelfan kan.

ayahs.text: I Öebbi la kennun wid illan di tmurt akked igenwan, b$an ne$ ugin, akked tili nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit.
ayahs.translation: I Öebbi la kennun wid illan di tmurt akked igenwan, b$an ne$ ugin, akked tili nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit.

ayahs.text: Ini: "anwa ay d Mass n tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi. Ihi day a pperrem d iêbiben, war Neppa, wid ur nemlik, i yiman nnsen, aba$uô ne$ vveôô"? Ini: "day iaâdel uder$al akked win ipwalin? Ne$, day âadlent tillas akked tafat? Ne$, rran imcurak i Öebbi, i ixelqen am lxelq iS, ufan t ippemcabi"? Ini: "d Öebbi i Ixelqen yal cci. D Neppa ay d Yiwen, d Aqehhaô".

D Neppa ay d Yiwen, d Aqehhaô".

ayahs.text: Isse$lay ed aman, seg igenni. Serrun deg $ezôan, s leqdeô nnsen. Acercuô ippawi ikuftan ippifliwen. Ppemcabin ikuftan ar wayen fessin di tmes, iwakken ad ûenâen ôôêuê ne$ dduzan. Akka ay d Isskan Öebbi tidep akked tkerkas. Ihi ikuftan ad ppuveggôen, ma d wayen inefâen medden, a d igwri di tmurt. Akka ay d Ippak Öebbi imedyaten.
ayahs.translation: Isse$lay ed aman, seg igenni. Serrun deg $ezôan, s leqdeô nnsen. Acercuô ippawi ikuftan ippifliwen. Ppemcabin ikuftan ar wayen fessin di tmes, iwakken ad ûenâen ôôêuê ne$ dduzan. ayahs.text: Lfayeq i wid ijawben i Mass nnsen. Wid ur aS njaweb ara, xas ad sâun i illan akw di tmurt, berdayen, ur ten id ifeddu. I widak, leêsab adiran. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A tanezdu$t tucmip!
ayahs.translation: Lfayeq i wid ijawben i Mass nnsen. Wid ur aS njaweb ara, xas ad sâun i illan akw di tmurt, berdayen, ur ten id ifeddu. I widak, leêsab adiran. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A tanezdu$t tucmip!

ayahs.text: Day win iéôan ar ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep, am win idre$len? Siwa uâqilen id ismektayen.
ayahs.translation: Day win iéôan ar ayen i k d irsen, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep, am win idre$len? Siwa uâqilen id ismektayen.

ayahs.text: Wid iîîfen di laâqed n Öebbi, ur pôuéun nnesba.
ayahs.translation: Wid iîîfen di laâqed n Öebbi, ur pôuéun nnesba.

ayahs.text: Wid issemlilen ayen id Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, u ppagwaden Mass nnsen, u ppagwaden aqeîîi adiran.
ayahs.translation: Wid issemlilen ayen id Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, u ppagwaden Mass nnsen, u ppagwaden aqeîîi adiran.

ayahs.text: Wid iûebôen, ssaramen udem n Mass nnsen, bedden i téallit, pseddiqen seg wayen is iten N$at, s tuffra u âinâni, swexxiôen tucmip s yise$. I nitni, agwav s Axxam.
ayahs.translation: Wid iûebôen, ssaramen udem n Mass nnsen, bedden i téallit, pseddiqen seg wayen is iten N$at, s tuffra u âinâni, swexxiôen tucmip s yise$. I nitni, agwav s Axxam.

ayahs.text: Leonanat n Âaden ara kecmen, akked wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, seg ibabaten nnsen, si tlawin nnsen, si tarwa nnsen. Lmalayek a d ppasent $uôsen si yal tabburt.
ayahs.translation: Leonanat n Âaden ara kecmen, akked wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, seg ibabaten nnsen, si tlawin nnsen, si tarwa nnsen. Lmalayek a d ppasent $uôsen si yal tabburt.

ayahs.text: Tifrat fellawen, ilmend n wayen tûebôem! D asaâdi, wagwav s Axxam!
ayahs.translation: Tifrat fellawen, ilmend n wayen tûebôem! D asaâdi, wagwav s Axxam!

ayahs.text: Wid ipôuéun laâqed n Öebbi, deffir lemwafaqa s, wid igezmen ayen d Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, u ssefsaden di tmurt, wigi, i nitni xezzu, i nitni yir axxam.
ayahs.translation: Wid ipôuéun laâqed n Öebbi, deffir lemwafaqa s, wid igezmen ayen d Iumeô Öebbi ad imlil, u ssefsaden di tmurt, wigi, i nitni xezzu, i nitni yir axxam.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Taâoeb iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Tameddurt n ddunit, d urar kan, zdat laxeôt.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Taâoeb iten tmeddurt n ddunit. Tameddurt n ddunit, d urar kan, zdat laxeôt.

ayahs.translation: La qqaôen wid ijehlen: "a lemmer id iris, $uôes, ussekni s$uô Mass is"! Ini: "Öebbi, s tidep, Itellif win i S ihwan. Inehhu $uôeS, wid isteôoiâen,

ayahs.text: wid iumnen, iwumi itheddin wul, mara d mmektin Öebbi". Ni$, s usmekti n Öebbi, pheddinen wulawen.
ayahs.translation: wid iumnen, iwumi itheddin wul, mara d mmektin Öebbi". Ni$, s usmekti n Öebbi, pheddinen wulawen.

ayahs.text: Ssaâd, akked taggara igerzen, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan.
ayahs.translation: Ssaâd, akked taggara igerzen, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan.

ayahs.text: Akka ay k id Nuzen, i lois id zwaren leoyus, ad asen temlev, ayen ik d Nweêêa. Nitni jehlen $uô Uênin. Ini: "Neppa d Mass iw, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa; ppekle$ fellaS, asteôoaâ iw $uôeS".
ayahs.translation: Akka ay k id Nuzen, i lois id zwaren leoyus, ad asen temlev, ayen ik d Nweêêa. Nitni jehlen $uô Uênin. Ini: "Neppa d Mass iw, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa; ppekle$ fellaS, asteôoaâ iw $uôeS".

ayahs.text: A lemmer kan Leqwôan isselêa idurar, iceqqeq tamurt, ne$ issenîeq ed lmeggtin! Xaîi! Lumuô akw i Öebbi. Day ur éôin ara wid iumnen, ar, ma ihwa yaS, Öebbi ad Inhu medden meôôa? Zgan wid ijehlen a ten tewwet ssixîa, ilmend n wayen xeddmen. Ne$ a ppevôu ar tama n yixxamen nnsen, alamma tusa d lemâahda n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Ipzeggil ppaâud.
ayahs.translation: A lemmer kan Leqwôan isselêa idurar, iceqqeq tamurt, ne$ issenîeq ed lmeggtin! Xaîi! Lumuô akw i Öebbi. Day ur éôin ara wid iumnen, ar, ma ihwa yaS, Öebbi ad Inhu medden meôôa? Zgan wid ijehlen a ten tewwet ssixîa, ilmend n wayen xeddmen. Ne$ a ppevôu ar tama n yixxamen nnsen, alamma tusa d lemâahda n Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Ipzeggil ppaâud.

ayahs.text: Ni$ mmaâlken, uqbel ik, deg imazanen. Ooi$ lmudda i wid ijehlen, sinna, Ïîfe$ ten. A yaâaqeb iW imiren!
ayahs.translation: Ni$ mmaâlken, uqbel ik, deg imazanen. Ooi$ lmudda i wid ijehlen, sinna, Ïîfe$ ten. A yaâaqeb iW imiren!

ayahs.translation: Amek tga Loennet i ippuweââden i wid iêezzben: ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen, lqut is akked tili s, d imezgiyen. D tagi ay d taggara n wid iêezzben. Taggara ijehliyen, d times.

ayahs.text: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, ad feôêen s wayen i k d irsen. Illa wayen ugin kra ikabaren. Ini: "pwamôe$ kan ad âabde$ Öebbi, ur aS pcarake$. Pnuju$ $uôeS, tu$alin iw $uôeS".
ayahs.translation: Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, ad feôêen s wayen i k d irsen. Illa wayen ugin kra ikabaren. Ini: "pwamôe$ kan ad âabde$ Öebbi, ur aS pcarake$. Pnuju$ $uôeS, tu$alin iw $uôeS".

ayahs.translation: Akka ay t id Nessers, d ûûwab, s taâôabt. Ma teddiv d lhawiyya nnsen, deffir tisin n tussna $uôek, ur k ipfukku bab ne$ asettaô, seg ufus n Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed imazanen, uqbel ik, Nefka yasen tilawin, tarwa. Ur ippunefk ara i umazan a d iawi assekni siwa ma Iâammed Öebbi. Yal lajel s Tezmamt is.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed imazanen, uqbel ik, Nefka yasen tilawin, tarwa. Ur ippunefk ara i umazan a d iawi assekni siwa ma Iâammed Öebbi. Yal lajel s Tezmamt is.

ayahs.translation: Iseffev u Itebbit Öebbi ay S ihwan. £uôeS tayimmap n Tezmamt.

ayahs.translation: Ama Nessken ak kra n wayen i sen Nâahed, ama Neddem ôôuê ik, ay fellak kan d isallen, ay fella£ d aqeîîi.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara Neppas ed ar tmurt, Nessenqas di leryaf is? Öebbi Ipseyyi; yiwen ur ipnamar aseyyi iS. Neppa, Ip$awal di leêsab.
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara Neppas ed ar tmurt, Nessenqas di leryaf is? Öebbi Ipseyyi; yiwen ur ipnamar aseyyi iS. Neppa, Ip$awal di leêsab.

ayahs.text: Ni$ ppandin wid i ten id izwaren. Tiêeôci, akw, ar Öebbi. Iéôa i ikseb yal iman. Ad éôen ijehliyen anwa ara iawven s Axxam.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ ppandin wid i ten id izwaren. Tiêeôci, akw, ar Öebbi. Iéôa i ikseb yal iman. Ad éôen ijehliyen anwa ara iawven s Axxam.

ayahs.text: Qqaôen wid ijehlen: "ur telliv d amazan". Ini: "ad Iqadd Öebbi d Anagi gari yidwen, akked kra isâan tussna n Tazmamt".
ayahs.translation: Qqaôen wid ijehlen: "ur telliv d amazan". Ini: "ad Iqadd Öebbi d Anagi gari yidwen, akked kra isâan tussna n Tazmamt".

verses.text: Alô. Tazmamt, Nessers ak p id, iwakken a ppessuff$ev imdanen si tillas ar tafat, s wannuf n Mass nnsen, s abrid n Wuzmir, Amaâzuz,
verses.translation: Alô. Tazmamt, Nessers ak p id, iwakken a ppessuff$ev imdanen si tillas ar tafat, s wannuf n Mass nnsen, s abrid n Wuzmir, Amaâzuz,

verses.translation: Öebbi ilan i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. A ssxev ijehliyen, ilmend uâaqeb uqsiê,

verses.translation: Ur d Nuzen amazan, siwa s tmeslayt n ugdud is, iwakken ad asen ibeggen. Öebbi Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.translation: Ih, ni$ Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nne£: "ssuffe$ agdud ik, si tillas ar tafat. Mmekti yas d ussan n Öebbi". Deg waya, war ccekk, d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.

verses.text: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, mi kwen Isellek si lois n Ferâun, i issuken fellawen lhemm uqsiê. Zellun arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Deg waya, s$uô Mass nnwen, d cedda tameqwôaêant".
verses.translation: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, mi kwen Isellek si lois n Ferâun, i issuken fellawen lhemm uqsiê. Zellun arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Deg waya, s$uô Mass nnwen, d cedda tameqwôaêant".

verses.translation: Mi d Inna Mass nnwen: "ma tesnemmrem, ih, ad awen Rnu$. Ma tjehlem, aâaqeb iW, war ccekk, ad iwâaô".

verses.translation: Inna Musa: "ma tjehlem, kunwi akked wid n tmurt meôôa, ihi, Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz".

verses.text: Amedya n wid ijehlen, ar Mass nnsen: igiten nnsen am i$i$den i$ef iédem wavu, ass n tbucivant. Ur d ppawin acemma, seg wayen kesben. D wagi ay d ttelfan u$miq.
verses.translation: Amedya n wid ijehlen, ar Mass nnsen: igiten nnsen am i$i$den i$ef iédem wavu, ass n tbucivant. Ur d ppawin acemma, seg wayen kesben. D wagi ay d ttelfan u$miq.

verses.text: Day ur twalav ara, Öebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep? Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes, a d Iawi lxelq amaynut.
verses.translation: Day ur twalav ara, Öebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep? Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes, a d Iawi lxelq amaynut.

verses.text: Ayagi, i Öebbi, ur illi d ayen izzenzafen.
verses.translation: Ayagi, i Öebbi, ur illi d ayen izzenzafen.

verses.text: A d rsen akw zdat Öebbi. Ad inin uôhifen i imzuxiyen: "s tidep, nella nedda yidwen, ma tzemrem ad a$ tsellkem kra, seg uâaqeb n Öebbi"? A d inin: "lemmer i $ Inha Öebbi, yili nwelleh ikwen. Iâuva fella$, neêmeq ne$ neûbeô, ur a$ illi ssôan".
verses.translation: A d rsen akw zdat Öebbi. Ad inin uôhifen i imzuxiyen: "s tidep, nella nedda yidwen, ma tzemrem ad a$ tsellkem kra, seg uâaqeb n Öebbi"? A d inin: "lemmer i $ Inha Öebbi, yili nwelleh ikwen. Iâuva fella$, neêmeq ne$ neûbeô, ur a$ illi ssôan".

verses.text: Mi isuyya lameô, a d yini Cciîan: "Öebbi, d ûûeê, Iweââd awen lemâahda n tidep. Weââde$ awen, $uôe$ kwen. Ur sâi$ adabu fellawen, siwa anecced nnwen. Tu$em awal iw. Ur iyi plummut, lummet iman nnwen. Ur zmire$ a kwen âawne$, ur tezmirem ad iyi tâawnem. Nekôe$ wid iyi tepcarakem, zik. I imednas, s tidep, aâaqeb aqeôêan".
verses.translation: Mi isuyya lameô, a d yini Cciîan: "Öebbi, d ûûeê, Iweââd awen lemâahda n tidep. Weââde$ awen, $uôe$ kwen. Ur sâi$ adabu fellawen, siwa anecced nnwen. Tu$em awal iw. Ur iyi plummut, lummet iman nnwen. Ur zmire$ a kwen âawne$, ur tezmirem ad iyi tâawnem. Nekôe$ wid iyi tepcarakem, zik. I imednas, s tidep, aâaqeb aqeôêan".

verses.text: Ad skecmen wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen dinna, s wannuf n Mass nnsen. Azul nnsen dinna d: "tifrat"!
verses.translation: Ad skecmen wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, ad wekkôen dinna, s wannuf n Mass nnsen. Azul nnsen dinna d: "tifrat"!

verses.text: Day ur twalav ara, amek id Ifka Öebbi amedya? Awal lâali am ttejôa lâali, iéuôan is ôûan, iferkawen is di tegnewt.
verses.translation: Day ur twalav ara, amek id Ifka Öebbi amedya? Awal lâali am ttejôa lâali, iéuôan is ôûan, iferkawen is di tegnewt.

verses.text: Teppak ed lfakia s, di yal imir, s wannuf n Mass is. Ippawi d Öebbi imedyaten i imdanen, amar a d mmektin.
verses.translation: Teppak ed lfakia s, di yal imir, s wannuf n Mass is. Ippawi d Öebbi imedyaten i imdanen, amar a d mmektin.

verses.text: Amedya n wawal ucmit, am ttejôa tucmip, teqlaâ sennig wakal, war leqôaô.
verses.translation: Amedya n wawal ucmit, am ttejôa tucmip, teqlaâ sennig wakal, war leqôaô.

verses.text: Öebbi Itebbit wid iumnen s wawal utebbet, di tmeddurt n ddunit akked laxeôt. Öebbi Itellif imednas. Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
verses.translation: Öebbi Itebbit wid iumnen s wawal utebbet, di tmeddurt n ddunit akked laxeôt. Öebbi Itellif imednas. Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.

verses.text: Day ur twalav ara wid ineûfen l$it n Öebbi, s tijehli? Ssersen agdud nnsen deg uxxam n twa$it.
verses.translation: Day ur twalav ara wid ineûfen l$it n Öebbi, s tijehli? Ssersen agdud nnsen deg uxxam n twa$it.

verses.text: Loahennama ad ô$en degs: a yir leqôaô!
verses.translation: Loahennama ad ô$en degs: a yir leqôaô!

verses.text: Gan aS i Öebbi tanudda, iwakken ad telfen seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhut! S tidep, leqôaô nnwen d times".
verses.translation: Gan aS i Öebbi tanudda, iwakken ad telfen seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhut! S tidep, leqôaô nnwen d times".

verses.text: Ini i imdanen iW iumnen, ad bedden i téallit, ad seddqen seg wayen iten N$at, s tuffra u âinani, uqbel a d ias wass ideg ur illi ssuq, ur telli tdukli.
verses.translation: Ini i imdanen iW iumnen, ad bedden i téallit, ad seddqen seg wayen iten N$at, s tuffra u âinani, uqbel a d ias wass ideg ur illi ssuq, ur telli tdukli.

verses.text: Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, id Isse$layen aman seg igenni, Issufu$ ed yissen ppemôa, d ôôeéq i kunwi. Inub fellawen s isaffen, u s lbabuô i iteddun di yill, s lameô iS.
verses.translation: Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, id Isse$layen aman seg igenni, Issufu$ ed yissen ppemôa, d ôôeéq i kunwi. Inub fellawen s isaffen, u s lbabuô i iteddun di yill, s lameô iS.

verses.text: Inub fellawen s yiîij d waggur, d imezgiyen. Inub fellawen s yiv akked wass.
verses.translation: Inub fellawen s yiîij d waggur, d imezgiyen. Inub fellawen s yiv akked wass.

verses.text: Ifka yawen seg wayen akw i S tessutrem. Ma pêesbem l$it n Mass nnwen, ur tessawavem. Ih, amdan, s tidep, d amednus, d ajehli.
verses.translation: Ifka yawen seg wayen akw i S tessutrem. Ma pêesbem l$it n Mass nnwen, ur tessawavem. Ih, amdan, s tidep, d amednus, d ajehli.

verses.text: Mi inna Ibôahim: "a Mass iw! Err tamdint agi d tin n laman, Âatq a$, nek d warraw iw, seg wannuz n tâancuôin.
verses.translation: Mi inna Ibôahim: "a Mass iw! Err tamdint agi d tin n laman, Âatq a$, nek d warraw iw, seg wannuz n tâancuôin.

verses.text: A Mass iw, nitenti, s tidep, telfent aîas n medden. Win iddan yidi, neppa, s tidep, sgi. Win iyi âuûan, Keçç, s tidep, Tepsemmiêev, Tepêunuv.
verses.translation: A Mass iw, nitenti, s tidep, telfent aîas n medden. Win iddan yidi, neppa, s tidep, sgi. Win iyi âuûan, Keçç, s tidep, Tepsemmiêev, Tepêunuv.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Nek rri$ tanezdu$t, i kra n warraw iw, di te$zut ibuôen, ar Uxxam iK iôqan. A Mass nne$! Iwakken ad bedden i téallit. Err ulawen n kra n medden, ad iêninen $uôsen, £it iten s ppemôat, amar ad snemmren.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Nek rri$ tanezdu$t, i kra n warraw iw, di te$zut ibuôen, ar Uxxam iK iôqan. A Mass nne$! Iwakken ad bedden i téallit. Err ulawen n kra n medden, ad iêninen $uôsen, £it iten s ppemôat, amar ad snemmren.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, Teéôiv ayen neffer akked wayen nenna. Ur iffir wacemma i Öebbi, di tmurt ne$ deg igenni.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, Teéôiv ayen neffer akked wayen nenna. Ur iffir wacemma i Öebbi, di tmurt ne$ deg igenni.

verses.text: Ccekôan i Öebbi iyi d Ifkan, di tewser iw, Ismaâil akked Isêaq. Mass iw, s tidep, Issemêas i tnaâôit.
verses.translation: Ccekôan i Öebbi iyi d Ifkan, di tewser iw, Ismaâil akked Isêaq. Mass iw, s tidep, Issemêas i tnaâôit.

verses.text: A Mass iw, Err iyi ad bedde$ i téallit. Akked kra, si tarwa w. A Mass iw, Steôêeb s unuju w.
verses.translation: A Mass iw, Err iyi ad bedde$ i téallit. Akked kra, si tarwa w. A Mass iw, Steôêeb s unuju w.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Semmeê ane$, nek d lwaldin iw, akked lmumnin, ass ideg ara d ias uqeîîi".
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Semmeê ane$, nek d lwaldin iw, akked lmumnin, ass ideg ara d ias uqeîîi".

verses.text: Ur p$ili ar I$fel Öebbi, $ef wayen xeddmen imednas. Iooa ten kan, ar ass ideg ara beêêren allen.
verses.translation: Ur p$ili ar I$fel Öebbi, $ef wayen xeddmen imednas. Iooa ten kan, ar ass ideg ara beêêren allen.

verses.text: Ad p$awalen, iqweôôa ff$en d, allen ur ferzent, ulawen d ilmawen.
verses.translation: Ad p$awalen, iqweôôa ff$en d, allen ur ferzent, ulawen d ilmawen.

verses.text: Nabi imdanen af wass ideg ara ten id yas uâaqeb. Ad inin wid idensen: "a Mass nne$! Efk ane$ lmudda wezzilen, a d njaweb i unabi K, a neddu d imazanen". "Day ur teggulem ara kunwi, zik, ar ur tep$abem?
verses.translation: Nabi imdanen af wass ideg ara ten id yas uâaqeb. Ad inin wid idensen: "a Mass nne$! Efk ane$ lmudda wezzilen, a d njaweb i unabi K, a neddu d imazanen". "Day ur teggulem ara kunwi, zik, ar ur tep$abem?

verses.text: Tzed$em ixxamen n wid ivuôôen iman nnsen. U Nbeggen awen d amek i sen Nga, u Nefka yawen d imedyaten".
verses.translation: Tzed$em ixxamen n wid ivuôôen iman nnsen. U Nbeggen awen d amek i sen Nga, u Nefka yawen d imedyaten".

verses.text: Ni$ undin ccbukat nnsen. Ccbukat nnsen haatent ar Öebbi, xas ma ccbukat nnsen d tid ara isse$lin idurar.
verses.translation: Ni$ undin ccbukat nnsen. Ccbukat nnsen haatent ar Öebbi, xas ma ccbukat nnsen d tid ara isse$lin idurar.

verses.text: £uôek a p$ilev Öebbi ad Izgel lemâahda S, i imazanen. S tidep, Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.
verses.translation: £uôek a p$ilev Öebbi ad Izgel lemâahda S, i imazanen. S tidep, Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.

verses.text: Ass ideg tamurt a ppu$al maççi d tamurt; akken igenwan; a d asen ar Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.
verses.translation: Ass ideg tamurt a ppu$al maççi d tamurt; akken igenwan; a d asen ar Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.

verses.text: A pwaliv, assen, ibe$wviyen pwaqqnen wa $er wa.
verses.translation: A pwaliv, assen, ibe$wviyen pwaqqnen wa $er wa.

verses.text: Lebsa nnsen d qevôan, times t$umm udmawen nnsen.
verses.translation: Lebsa nnsen d qevôan, times t$umm udmawen nnsen.

verses.text: Iwakken ad Ikafi Öebbi yal amdan, $ef wayen ikseb. Öebbi, s tidep, Ip$awal di leêsab.
verses.translation: Iwakken ad Ikafi Öebbi yal amdan, $ef wayen ikseb. Öebbi, s tidep, Ip$awal di leêsab.

verses.text: Wagi d anecced i imdanen, ad pwanedôen yis, ad éôen ar siwa Neppa ay d Öebbi Yiwen, a d mmektin uâqilen.
verses.translation: Wagi d anecced i imdanen, ad pwanedôen yis, ad éôen ar siwa Neppa ay d Öebbi Yiwen, a d mmektin uâqilen.

ayahs.text: Alô. Tazmamt, Nessers ak p id, iwakken a ppessuff$ev imdanen si tillas ar tafat, s wannuf n Mass nnsen, s abrid n Wuzmir, Amaâzuz,
ayahs.translation: Alô. Tazmamt, Nessers ak p id, iwakken a ppessuff$ev imdanen si tillas ar tafat, s wannuf n Mass nnsen, s abrid n Wuzmir, Amaâzuz,

ayahs.text: Öebbi ilan i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. A ssxev ijehliyen, ilmend uâaqeb uqsiê,
ayahs.translation: Öebbi ilan i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. A ssxev ijehliyen, ilmend uâaqeb uqsiê,

ayahs.text: i ismenyafen tameddurt n ddunit wala laxeôt, i iswexxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, u ssaramen t d uâwij! Widak, atnan di ttelfan u$miq.

ayahs.text: Ur d Nuzen amazan, siwa s tmeslayt n ugdud is, iwakken ad asen ibeggen. Öebbi Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ur d Nuzen amazan, siwa s tmeslayt n ugdud is, iwakken ad asen ibeggen. Öebbi Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ih, ni$ Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nne£: "ssuffe$ agdud ik, si tillas ar tafat. Mmekti yas d ussan n Öebbi". Deg waya, war ccekk, d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ni$ Nuzen ed Musa, s issekniyen nne£: "ssuffe$ agdud ik, si tillas ar tafat. Mmekti yas d ussan n Öebbi". Deg waya, war ccekk, d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.

ayahs.translation: Mi inna Musa i ugdud is: "mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi, mi kwen Isellek si lois n Ferâun, i issuken fellawen lhemm uqsiê. Zellun arrac nnwen, ssidiren tilawin nnwen. Deg waya, s$uô Mass nnwen, d cedda tameqwôaêant".

ayahs.translation: Mi d Inna Mass nnwen: "ma tesnemmrem, ih, ad awen Rnu$. Ma tjehlem, aâaqeb iW, war ccekk, ad iwâaô".

ayahs.translation: Inna Musa: "ma tjehlem, kunwi akked wid n tmurt meôôa, ihi, Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz".

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara, amek id Ifka Öebbi amedya? Awal lâali am ttejôa lâali, iéuôan is ôûan, iferkawen is di tegnewt.
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara, amek id Ifka Öebbi amedya? Awal lâali am ttejôa lâali, iéuôan is ôûan, iferkawen is di tegnewt.

ayahs.text: Teppak ed lfakia s, di yal imir, s wannuf n Mass is. Ippawi d Öebbi imedyaten i imdanen, amar a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Teppak ed lfakia s, di yal imir, s wannuf n Mass is. Ippawi d Öebbi imedyaten i imdanen, amar a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: Amedya n wawal ucmit, am ttejôa tucmip, teqlaâ sennig wakal, war leqôaô.
ayahs.translation: Amedya n wawal ucmit, am ttejôa tucmip, teqlaâ sennig wakal, war leqôaô.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Itebbit wid iumnen s wawal utebbet, di tmeddurt n ddunit akked laxeôt. Öebbi Itellif imednas. Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Itebbit wid iumnen s wawal utebbet, di tmeddurt n ddunit akked laxeôt. Öebbi Itellif imednas. Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara wid ineûfen l$it n Öebbi, s tijehli? Ssersen agdud nnsen deg uxxam n twa$it.
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara wid ineûfen l$it n Öebbi, s tijehli? Ssersen agdud nnsen deg uxxam n twa$it.

ayahs.text: Loahennama ad ô$en degs: a yir leqôaô!
ayahs.translation: Loahennama ad ô$en degs: a yir leqôaô!

ayahs.text: Gan aS i Öebbi tanudda, iwakken ad telfen seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhut! S tidep, leqôaô nnwen d times".
ayahs.translation: Gan aS i Öebbi tanudda, iwakken ad telfen seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhut! S tidep, leqôaô nnwen d times".

ayahs.text: Ini i imdanen iW iumnen, ad bedden i téallit, ad seddqen seg wayen iten N$at, s tuffra u âinani, uqbel a d ias wass ideg ur illi ssuq, ur telli tdukli.
ayahs.translation: Ini i imdanen iW iumnen, ad bedden i téallit, ad seddqen seg wayen iten N$at, s tuffra u âinani, uqbel a d ias wass ideg ur illi ssuq, ur telli tdukli.

ayahs.text: Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, id Isse$layen aman seg igenni, Issufu$ ed yissen ppemôa, d ôôeéq i kunwi. Inub fellawen s isaffen, u s lbabuô i iteddun di yill, s lameô iS.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, id Isse$layen aman seg igenni, Issufu$ ed yissen ppemôa, d ôôeéq i kunwi. Inub fellawen s isaffen, u s lbabuô i iteddun di yill, s lameô iS.

ayahs.text: Inub fellawen s yiîij d waggur, d imezgiyen. Inub fellawen s yiv akked wass.
ayahs.translation: Inub fellawen s yiîij d waggur, d imezgiyen. Inub fellawen s yiv akked wass.

ayahs.text: Ifka yawen seg wayen akw i S tessutrem. Ma pêesbem l$it n Mass nnwen, ur tessawavem. Ih, amdan, s tidep, d amednus, d ajehli.
ayahs.translation: Ifka yawen seg wayen akw i S tessutrem. Ma pêesbem l$it n Mass nnwen, ur tessawavem. Ih, amdan, s tidep, d amednus, d ajehli.

ayahs.text: Mi inna Ibôahim: "a Mass iw! Err tamdint agi d tin n laman, Âatq a$, nek d warraw iw, seg wannuz n tâancuôin.
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Ibôahim: "a Mass iw! Err tamdint agi d tin n laman, Âatq a$, nek d warraw iw, seg wannuz n tâancuôin.

ayahs.text: A Mass iw, nitenti, s tidep, telfent aîas n medden. Win iddan yidi, neppa, s tidep, sgi. Win iyi âuûan, Keçç, s tidep, Tepsemmiêev, Tepêunuv.
ayahs.translation: A Mass iw, nitenti, s tidep, telfent aîas n medden. Win iddan yidi, neppa, s tidep, sgi. Win iyi âuûan, Keçç, s tidep, Tepsemmiêev, Tepêunuv.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Nek rri$ tanezdu$t, i kra n warraw iw, di te$zut ibuôen, ar Uxxam iK iôqan. A Mass nne$! Iwakken ad bedden i téallit. Err ulawen n kra n medden, ad iêninen $uôsen, £it iten s ppemôat, amar ad snemmren.
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Nek rri$ tanezdu$t, i kra n warraw iw, di te$zut ibuôen, ar Uxxam iK iôqan. A Mass nne$! Iwakken ad bedden i téallit. Err ulawen n kra n medden, ad iêninen $uôsen, £it iten s ppemôat, amar ad snemmren.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, Teéôiv ayen neffer akked wayen nenna. Ur iffir wacemma i Öebbi, di tmurt ne$ deg igenni.
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, Teéôiv ayen neffer akked wayen nenna. Ur iffir wacemma i Öebbi, di tmurt ne$ deg igenni.

ayahs.text: Ccekôan i Öebbi iyi d Ifkan, di tewser iw, Ismaâil akked Isêaq. Mass iw, s tidep, Issemêas i tnaâôit.
ayahs.translation: Ccekôan i Öebbi iyi d Ifkan, di tewser iw, Ismaâil akked Isêaq. Mass iw, s tidep, Issemêas i tnaâôit.

ayahs.text: A Mass iw, Err iyi ad bedde$ i téallit. Akked kra, si tarwa w. A Mass iw, Steôêeb s unuju w.
ayahs.translation: A Mass iw, Err iyi ad bedde$ i téallit. Akked kra, si tarwa w. A Mass iw, Steôêeb s unuju w.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Semmeê ane$, nek d lwaldin iw, akked lmumnin, ass ideg ara d ias uqeîîi".
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Semmeê ane$, nek d lwaldin iw, akked lmumnin, ass ideg ara d ias uqeîîi".

ayahs.text: Ur p$ili ar I$fel Öebbi, $ef wayen xeddmen imednas. Iooa ten kan, ar ass ideg ara beêêren allen.
ayahs.translation: Ur p$ili ar I$fel Öebbi, $ef wayen xeddmen imednas. Iooa ten kan, ar ass ideg ara beêêren allen.

ayahs.text: Ad p$awalen, iqweôôa ff$en d, allen ur ferzent, ulawen d ilmawen.
ayahs.translation: Ad p$awalen, iqweôôa ff$en d, allen ur ferzent, ulawen d ilmawen.

ayahs.text: Nabi imdanen af wass ideg ara ten id yas uâaqeb. Ad inin wid idensen: "a Mass nne$! Efk ane$ lmudda wezzilen, a d njaweb i unabi K, a neddu d imazanen". "Day ur teggulem ara kunwi, zik, ar ur tep$abem?
ayahs.translation: Nabi imdanen af wass ideg ara ten id yas uâaqeb. Ad inin wid idensen: "a Mass nne$! Efk ane$ lmudda wezzilen, a d njaweb i unabi K, a neddu d imazanen". "Day ur teggulem ara kunwi, zik, ar ur tep$abem?

ayahs.text: Tzed$em ixxamen n wid ivuôôen iman nnsen. U Nbeggen awen d amek i sen Nga, u Nefka yawen d imedyaten".
ayahs.translation: Tzed$em ixxamen n wid ivuôôen iman nnsen. U Nbeggen awen d amek i sen Nga, u Nefka yawen d imedyaten".

ayahs.text: Ni$ undin ccbukat nnsen. Ccbukat nnsen haatent ar Öebbi, xas ma ccbukat nnsen d tid ara isse$lin idurar.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ undin ccbukat nnsen. Ccbukat nnsen haatent ar Öebbi, xas ma ccbukat nnsen d tid ara isse$lin idurar.

ayahs.text: £uôek a p$ilev Öebbi ad Izgel lemâahda S, i imazanen. S tidep, Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.
ayahs.translation: £uôek a p$ilev Öebbi ad Izgel lemâahda S, i imazanen. S tidep, Öebbi d Uzmir, Ippara d ppaô.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg tamurt a ppu$al maççi d tamurt; akken igenwan; a d asen ar Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg tamurt a ppu$al maççi d tamurt; akken igenwan; a d asen ar Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.

ayahs.text: A pwaliv, assen, ibe$wviyen pwaqqnen wa $er wa.
ayahs.translation: A pwaliv, assen, ibe$wviyen pwaqqnen wa $er wa.

ayahs.text: Lebsa nnsen d qevôan, times t$umm udmawen nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Lebsa nnsen d qevôan, times t$umm udmawen nnsen.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad Ikafi Öebbi yal amdan, $ef wayen ikseb. Öebbi, s tidep, Ip$awal di leêsab.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad Ikafi Öebbi yal amdan, $ef wayen ikseb. Öebbi, s tidep, Ip$awal di leêsab.

ayahs.text: Wagi d anecced i imdanen, ad pwanedôen yis, ad éôen ar siwa Neppa ay d Öebbi Yiwen, a d mmektin uâqilen.
ayahs.translation: Wagi d anecced i imdanen, ad pwanedôen yis, ad éôen ar siwa Neppa ay d Öebbi Yiwen, a d mmektin uâqilen.

verses.text: Alô. Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt, u d Leqwôan ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Alô. Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt, u d Leqwôan ipbegginen.

verses.text: Ahat wid ijehlen ssaramen ad ilin d imvuâen.
verses.translation: Ahat wid ijehlen ssaramen ad ilin d imvuâen.

verses.text: Eoo iten ad ççen, ad zhun, a ten issedhu usirem. Deqqal ad éôen.
verses.translation: Eoo iten ad ççen, ad zhun, a ten issedhu usirem. Deqqal ad éôen.

verses.text: Ur Nesquccu tamdint, siwa ma d ayen i s iuran, ipwassnen.
verses.translation: Ur Nesquccu tamdint, siwa ma d ayen i s iuran, ipwassnen.

verses.text: Ur illi lois ara d isqeôben, ne$ ara iswexxôen lajel is.
verses.translation: Ur illi lois ara d isqeôben, ne$ ara iswexxôen lajel is.

verses.text: Nnan: "a win u$uô d irs usmekti! Keçç, war ccekk, d aôehbani.
verses.translation: Nnan: "a win u$uô d irs usmekti! Keçç, war ccekk, d aôehbani.

verses.text: Acimi ur a$ d tusiv ara, s lmalayek, ma d tidep ay tessawalev"?
verses.translation: Acimi ur a$ d tusiv ara, s lmalayek, ma d tidep ay tessawalev"?

verses.text: Ur Nesrusu lmalayek, siwa s tidep. Imiren, ur pganin.
verses.translation: Ur Nesrusu lmalayek, siwa s tidep. Imiren, ur pganin.

verses.text: Ih, Nekwni Nessers ed asmekti. Ih, Nekwni a Nêareb fellas.
verses.translation: Ih, Nekwni Nessers ed asmekti. Ih, Nekwni a Nêareb fellas.

verses.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed, uqbel ik, i ikabaren imezwura.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed, uqbel ik, i ikabaren imezwura.

verses.text: Ur ten id ippas umazan, mebla ma ttahan fellas.
verses.translation: Ur ten id ippas umazan, mebla ma ttahan fellas.

verses.text: Akka ay t Nessekcam deg ulawen ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Akka ay t Nessekcam deg ulawen ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Ur uminen yis, ulamma ooan d imezwura tannumi.
verses.translation: Ur uminen yis, ulamma ooan d imezwura tannumi.

verses.text: Xas ad asen Nelli tabburt igenni, ad ppalin $uôes,
verses.translation: Xas ad asen Nelli tabburt igenni, ad ppalin $uôes,

verses.text: a d inin, war ccekk: "ittules iéôi nne$, ne$ nekwni d agdud iwumi sseêren".
verses.translation: a d inin, war ccekk: "ittules iéôi nne$, ne$ nekwni d agdud iwumi sseêren".

verses.text: Ni$ Nerra itran deg igenni. Ncebbeê iten i wid ipmuqulen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nerra itran deg igenni. Ncebbeê iten i wid ipmuqulen.

verses.text: Nesdari ten, si yal cciîan imenfi.
verses.translation: Nesdari ten, si yal cciîan imenfi.

verses.text: Kkes ed win d issemêessen s tufra, A p iddu, fellas, ujajiê n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Kkes ed win d issemêessen s tufra, A p iddu, fellas, ujajiê n ûûeê.

verses.text: Tamurt Nessewsaâ p; Nerra fellas idurar; Nessem$i d, degs, yal cci, s lmizan.
verses.translation: Tamurt Nessewsaâ p; Nerra fellas idurar; Nessem$i d, degs, yal cci, s lmizan.

verses.text: Nerra, degs, lqut i kunwi, akw i wid ur tecceççayem ara.
verses.translation: Nerra, degs, lqut i kunwi, akw i wid ur tecceççayem ara.

verses.text: Lexzayen n yal cci, $uône£ kan. Siwa s lkil ipwassnen i ten id Nesrusu.
verses.translation: Lexzayen n yal cci, $uône£ kan. Siwa s lkil ipwassnen i ten id Nesrusu.

verses.text: Nuzen ed avu isswayen. Nesse$li d aman seg igenni, yissen Nessew ikwen. Ur llin ara lexzayen is $uôwen.
verses.translation: Nuzen ed avu isswayen. Nesse$li d aman seg igenni, yissen Nessew ikwen. Ur llin ara lexzayen is $uôwen.

verses.text: Ih, d Nekwni i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. D Nekwni ay d Iweôôaten.
verses.translation: Ih, d Nekwni i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. D Nekwni ay d Iweôôaten.

verses.text: Ni$ Nessen imezwura nnwen, Nessen ineggura.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nessen imezwura nnwen, Nessen ineggura.

verses.text: Ih, Mass ik, Neppa, a ten id Ifser. Ih, Neppa, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ih, Mass ik, Neppa, a ten id Ifser. Ih, Neppa, d Bab n ûûwab, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ni$ Nexleq amdan si talaxt taberkant i meslen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nexleq amdan si talaxt taberkant i meslen.

verses.text: Nexleq loenn, iu$ lêal, si tmes n ccili.
verses.translation: Nexleq loenn, iu$ lêal, si tmes n ccili.

verses.text: Mi Inna Mass ik, i lmalayek: "Nek Xelqe$ amdan, si talaxt taberkant i meslen.
verses.translation: Mi Inna Mass ik, i lmalayek: "Nek Xelqe$ amdan, si talaxt taberkant i meslen.

verses.text: Mi t Mesle$, u Üûuve$ as si ôôuê iW, ersemt $uôes, knumt".
verses.translation: Mi t Mesle$, u Üûuve$ as si ôôuê iW, ersemt $uôes, knumt".

verses.text: Knant akw lmalayek, akken ma llant,
verses.translation: Knant akw lmalayek, akken ma llant,

verses.text: siwa Iblis, iugi ad yili ar wid iknan.
verses.translation: siwa Iblis, iugi ad yili ar wid iknan.

verses.text: Inna: "a yIblis, acu ik iu$en, ur telliv ar wid iknan"?
verses.translation: Inna: "a yIblis, acu ik iu$en, ur telliv ar wid iknan"?

verses.text: Inna: "ur kennu$ i umdan, i Txelqev si talaxt taberkant i meslen".
verses.translation: Inna: "ur kennu$ i umdan, i Txelqev si talaxt taberkant i meslen".

verses.text: Inna: "effe$ segs! Aql ak, ihi, d imenfi.
verses.translation: Inna: "effe$ segs! Aql ak, ihi, d imenfi.

verses.text: Ih, fellak ddell alamma d ass uqeîîi".
verses.translation: Ih, fellak ddell alamma d ass uqeîîi".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Eoo iyi alamma d ass n tnekra nnsen".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Eoo iyi alamma d ass n tnekra nnsen".

verses.text: Inna: "ih, keçç seg wid ipganin,
verses.translation: Inna: "ih, keçç seg wid ipganin,

verses.text: ar ass n yiùmir ipwassnen".
verses.translation: ar ass n yiùmir ipwassnen".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Imi yi Terriv d a$ewway, war ccekk, ad asen cebbêe$ ddunit, a ten $ewwu$, akken ma llan.
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Imi yi Terriv d a$ewway, war ccekk, ad asen cebbêe$ ddunit, a ten $ewwu$, akken ma llan.

verses.text: Kkes ed imdanen iK izedganen garasen".
verses.translation: Kkes ed imdanen iK izedganen garasen".

verses.text: Inna: "$uôI, wagi d abrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Inna: "$uôI, wagi d abrid uwqim.

verses.text: War ccekk, ur tesâiv adabu $ef imdanen iW, siwa wid i k ivefôen seg imjaêen".
verses.translation: War ccekk, ur tesâiv adabu $ef imdanen iW, siwa wid i k ivefôen seg imjaêen".

verses.text: Loahennama, s tidep, d ppaâud nnsen akw.
verses.translation: Loahennama, s tidep, d ppaâud nnsen akw.

verses.text: D m ûa tebbura; ar yal tabburt, s urbaâ ines.
verses.translation: D m ûa tebbura; ar yal tabburt, s urbaâ ines.

verses.text: Ih, wid ipêezziben, di leonanat akked tliwa:
verses.translation: Ih, wid ipêezziben, di leonanat akked tliwa:

verses.text: kecmet pen di tifrat, akked laman"!
verses.translation: kecmet pen di tifrat, akked laman"!

verses.text: Nekkes i illan d dd$el, deg idmaren nnsen. D atmaten, deg imîeôêen, mqabalen.
verses.translation: Nekkes i illan d dd$el, deg idmaren nnsen. D atmaten, deg imîeôêen, mqabalen.

verses.text: Ur âaggun degsen, ur ten id ssuffu$en segsen.
verses.translation: Ur âaggun degsen, ur ten id ssuffu$en segsen.

verses.text: Xebbeô ixdimen iW; Nek, s tidep, Psemmiêe$, Pêunu$.
verses.translation: Xebbeô ixdimen iW; Nek, s tidep, Psemmiêe$, Pêunu$.

verses.text: U aâaqeb iW d aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: U aâaqeb iW d aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Xebbeô iten $ef inebgawen n Ibôahim.
verses.translation: Xebbeô iten $ef inebgawen n Ibôahim.

verses.text: Mi kecmen $uôes, nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "s tidep, nugad ikwen".
verses.translation: Mi kecmen $uôes, nnan: "tifrat"! Inna: "s tidep, nugad ikwen".

verses.text: Nnan: "ur ppagwad, a k nbecceô kan, s uqcic amusnaw".
verses.translation: Nnan: "ur ppagwad, a k nbecceô kan, s uqcic amusnaw".

verses.text: Inna: "tbecceôm iyi d, mi wessre$. Acu iyi d tbeccôem"?
verses.translation: Inna: "tbecceôm iyi d, mi wessre$. Acu iyi d tbeccôem"?

verses.text: Nnan: "Nbecceô ik id, s tidep, ur ppili seg wid iuysen".
verses.translation: Nnan: "Nbecceô ik id, s tidep, ur ppili seg wid iuysen".

verses.text: Inna: "anwa iuysen aêunu n Mass is, siwa im$eôôqen"?
verses.translation: Inna: "anwa iuysen aêunu n Mass is, siwa im$eôôqen"?

verses.text: Inna: "d acu ay d lmeqsud nnwen, a yimceggâen"?
verses.translation: Inna: "d acu ay d lmeqsud nnwen, a yimceggâen"?

verses.text: Nnan: "Nekwni, s tidep, neppuceggaâ d s agdud ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Nnan: "Nekwni, s tidep, neppuceggaâ d s agdud ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Kkes ed tawacult n Luî, ara nsellek akw,
verses.translation: Kkes ed tawacult n Luî, ara nsellek akw,

verses.text: siwa tameîîut is. Ih, Nseyya a ppili, neppat, seg ineggura".
verses.translation: siwa tameîîut is. Ih, Nseyya a ppili, neppat, seg ineggura".

verses.text: Mi ôuêen imceggâen ar twacult n Luî,
verses.translation: Mi ôuêen imceggâen ar twacult n Luî,

verses.text: inna: "kunwi, s tidep, d imdanen ur nessin".
verses.translation: inna: "kunwi, s tidep, d imdanen ur nessin".

verses.text: Nnan: "xaîi, Nusa d, $uôek, s wayen rran di ccekk.
verses.translation: Nnan: "xaîi, Nusa d, $uôek, s wayen rran di ccekk.

verses.text: Nusa d, $uôek, s tidep. Nekwni, war ccekk, nessawal tidep.
verses.translation: Nusa d, $uôek, s tidep. Nekwni, war ccekk, nessawal tidep.

verses.text: Öuê akked twacult ik, mi mazal yiv. Ddu deffir sen. Ur d itezzi yiwen degwen! Âaddit anda i wen ippunefk lameô".
verses.translation: Öuê akked twacult ik, mi mazal yiv. Ddu deffir sen. Ur d itezzi yiwen degwen! Âaddit anda i wen ippunefk lameô".

verses.text: Nseyya yas lameô agi: a d gwrin ad pwagezmen wakali.
verses.translation: Nseyya yas lameô agi: a d gwrin ad pwagezmen wakali.

verses.text: Usan d, imezda$ n temdint, feôêen.
verses.translation: Usan d, imezda$ n temdint, feôêen.

verses.text: Inna: "wigi, s tidep, d inebgawen iw, ur iyi cmmatet.
verses.translation: Inna: "wigi, s tidep, d inebgawen iw, ur iyi cmmatet.

verses.text: Ëezbet i Öebbi, ur iyi sdullut"!
verses.translation: Ëezbet i Öebbi, ur iyi sdullut"!

verses.text: Nnan: "day ur ak negdil ara imdanen"?
verses.translation: Nnan: "day ur ak negdil ara imdanen"?

verses.text: Issrusu d lmalayek s ôôuê si lameô iS, $ef win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS: "Nedôet ar ur illi ôebbi siwa Nek. Ihi, êezzbet iyI".
verses.translation: Issrusu d lmalayek s ôôuê si lameô iS, $ef win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS: "Nedôet ar ur illi ôebbi siwa Nek. Ihi, êezzbet iyI".

verses.text: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ay Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
verses.translation: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ay Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!

verses.text: Ixelq ed amdan si tiqqit; atan iu$al aS, d axûim n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Ixelq ed amdan si tiqqit; atan iu$al aS, d axûim n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ixelq awen d lmal, segsen iceîîiven iêman, aba$uô, u, segsen, teppeppem.
verses.translation: Ixelq awen d lmal, segsen iceîîiven iêman, aba$uô, u, segsen, teppeppem.

verses.text: D ccbaêa nnwen mara ten id terrem, u mara ten teksem.
verses.translation: D ccbaêa nnwen mara ten id terrem, u mara ten teksem.

verses.text: Ppawin tiâkkwmin nnwen ar tmurt ur teppawvem, siwa ma tâapbem. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, d Umâin, d Aênin.
verses.translation: Ppawin tiâkkwmin nnwen ar tmurt ur teppawvem, siwa ma tâapbem. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, d Umâin, d Aênin.

verses.text: Iâewdiwen, iserdyan, i$wyal, i rrekba nnwen akked ccbaêa. Ixelleq ayen ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Iâewdiwen, iserdyan, i$wyal, i rrekba nnwen akked ccbaêa. Ixelleq ayen ur tessinem.

verses.text: D Öebbi i Ippawin d ubrid. Ff$en segs. Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Inhu meôôa.
verses.translation: D Öebbi i Ippawin d ubrid. Ff$en segs. Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Inhu meôôa.

verses.text: D Neppa i wen d Isse$layen aman seg igenni. Segsen tissit nnwen, segsen ttjuô i itepp lmal.
verses.translation: D Neppa i wen d Isse$layen aman seg igenni. Segsen tissit nnwen, segsen ttjuô i itepp lmal.

verses.text: Isskar awen d yissen nnaâma, azemmur, tizdayin, tiéuôin, akked yal ppemôa. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ipxemmimen.
verses.translation: Isskar awen d yissen nnaâma, azemmur, tizdayin, tiéuôin, akked yal ppemôa. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ipxemmimen.

verses.text: Inub awen d s yiv akked wass, iîij akked waggur. Itran ppemnuben s lameô iS. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.
verses.translation: Inub awen d s yiv akked wass, iîij akked waggur. Itran ppemnuben s lameô iS. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.

verses.text: I wen d Ixleq di tmurt, degs initen imgarraden. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ismektayen.
verses.translation: I wen d Ixleq di tmurt, degs initen imgarraden. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ismektayen.

verses.text: D Neppa i Inuben s yill, iwakken a pteppem, segs, aksum aleqqaq, a d teksem, segs, rrêuê i teppeqqnem. A pwaliv lbabuô ipcerrig it, iwakken a pnadim si lfevl iS, amar a ppesnemmrem.
verses.translation: D Neppa i Inuben s yill, iwakken a pteppem, segs, aksum aleqqaq, a d teksem, segs, rrêuê i teppeqqnem. A pwaliv lbabuô ipcerrig it, iwakken a pnadim si lfevl iS, amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.text: Issers idurar $ef tmurt, ur teppembwiwil yiswen; isaffen, iberdan, amar a ppepwanham;
verses.translation: Issers idurar $ef tmurt, ur teppembwiwil yiswen; isaffen, iberdan, amar a ppepwanham;

verses.text: timuliwin: s yitran, nitni pwanhan.
verses.translation: timuliwin: s yitran, nitni pwanhan.

verses.text: Day Win Ixelqen am win ur nxelleq? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?
verses.translation: Day Win Ixelqen am win ur nxelleq? Day ur d tesmektayem ara?

verses.text: Lemmer a pêesbem l$it n Öebbi, ur tezmirem. Ih, Öebbi, war ccekk, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Lemmer a pêesbem l$it n Öebbi, ur tezmirem. Ih, Öebbi, war ccekk, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Öebbi Iéôa ayen teffrem akked wayen teqqaôem.
verses.translation: Öebbi Iéôa ayen teffrem akked wayen teqqaôem.

verses.text: Wid u$uô pnujun, war Öebbi, ur illi wayen xelqen. D nitni i ipwaxelqen.
verses.translation: Wid u$uô pnujun, war Öebbi, ur illi wayen xelqen. D nitni i ipwaxelqen.

verses.text: D lmeggtin ur d imuddiren, ur éôin melmi ara ten id ssekren.
verses.translation: D lmeggtin ur d imuddiren, ur éôin melmi ara ten id ssekren.

verses.text: Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, d ulawen nnsen i iugin. U nitni pzzuxun.
verses.translation: Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, d ulawen nnsen i iugin. U nitni pzzuxun.

verses.text: War ccekk, Öebbi Iéôa ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaôen. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara imzuxiyen.
verses.translation: War ccekk, Öebbi Iéôa ayen teffren, akked wayen qqaôen. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara imzuxiyen.

verses.text: Ma nnan asen: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? Qqaôen: "d timucuha imezwura".
verses.translation: Ma nnan asen: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? Qqaôen: "d timucuha imezwura".

verses.text: Ad bibben, ass n tnekra, tiâakkwmin nnsen, s pmam nnsent, akked wumur si tâakkwmin n wid telfen, mebla ma faqen. Day maççi dir it wayen bubben?
verses.translation: Ad bibben, ass n tnekra, tiâakkwmin nnsen, s pmam nnsent, akked wumur si tâakkwmin n wid telfen, mebla ma faqen. Day maççi dir it wayen bubben?

verses.text: Ih, undin p, wid i ten id izwaren. Öebbi Iaâtad lebni nnsen, si llsas. I$li d ssqef fellasen. Iusa ten id uâaqeb seg wanda ur bnin.
verses.translation: Ih, undin p, wid i ten id izwaren. Öebbi Iaâtad lebni nnsen, si llsas. I$li d ssqef fellasen. Iusa ten id uâaqeb seg wanda ur bnin.

verses.translation: Sinna, ass n tnekra, a ten Idull, ad Yini: "anda ten icriken iW, i$ef temnamarem"? Nnan imawlan n tussna: "war ccekk, ddell akked ddens, assa, $ef ijehliyen

verses.text: iwumi ddment lmalayek leôwaê, nitni densen iman nnsen". A d ssutren tifrat: "ur nexdim kra n tucmip". Xaîi, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: iwumi ddment lmalayek leôwaê, nitni densen iman nnsen". A d ssutren tifrat: "ur nexdim kra n tucmip". Xaîi, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama; degs a pwekkôem. A yicmet uxxam imzuxiyen!
verses.translation: Kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama; degs a pwekkôem. A yicmet uxxam imzuxiyen!

verses.text: Ad inin i wid ipêezziben: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d lxiô". I wid imaânen, ise$ di ddunit agi. Pifxiô, war ccekk, axxam aneggaru. Ay d umâin uxxam n wid ipêezziben!
verses.translation: Ad inin i wid ipêezziben: "d acu id Issers Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d lxiô". I wid imaânen, ise$ di ddunit agi. Pifxiô, war ccekk, axxam aneggaru. Ay d umâin uxxam n wid ipêezziben!

verses.text: Ad kecmen leonanat n Âaden, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen; degsen, i nitni, ayen i sen ihwan. Akka i Ipkafi Öebbi wid ipêezziben,
verses.translation: Ad kecmen leonanat n Âaden, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen; degsen, i nitni, ayen i sen ihwan. Akka i Ipkafi Öebbi wid ipêezziben,

verses.translation: wid iwumi ddment lmalayek leôwaê, nitni maânen, ad asen inint: "tifrat fellawen! Kecmet Loennet, ilmend n wayen txeddmem".

verses.text: Day a pôaoun kan tisin n lmalayek $uôsen, ne$ a d iawev lameô n Mass ik? Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Ur ten Idnis Öebbi, maca densen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: Day a pôaoun kan tisin n lmalayek $uôsen, ne$ a d iawev lameô n Mass ik? Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Ur ten Idnis Öebbi, maca densen iman nnsen.

verses.text: D tucmitin xeddmen, i ten iwwten. Izzi yasen wayen i$ef pmmaâliken.
verses.translation: D tucmitin xeddmen, i ten iwwten. Izzi yasen wayen i$ef pmmaâliken.

verses.text: Nnan wid ipcaraken: "Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur naâbed acemma, war Neppa, nekwni akked imezwura nne$. Ur negdel acemma, war ayen Igdel". Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Day illa wayen iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal ipbegginen?
verses.translation: Nnan wid ipcaraken: "Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, ur naâbed acemma, war Neppa, nekwni akked imezwura nne$. Ur negdel acemma, war ayen Igdel". Akka ay xedmen imezwura nnsen. Day illa wayen iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal ipbegginen?

verses.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed amazan i yal lois: "âabdet Öebbi, janbet iôebbiten n tkerkas". Garasen, llan wid Inha Öebbi; garasen, wid i$ef iura ttelfan. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d inekkaôen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed amazan i yal lois: "âabdet Öebbi, janbet iôebbiten n tkerkas". Garasen, llan wid Inha Öebbi; garasen, wid i$ef iura ttelfan. Iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d inekkaôen.

verses.text: Xas tôe$wbev $ef nnhaya nnsen, Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu wid Itlef. Ur asen illi usettaô.
verses.translation: Xas tôe$wbev $ef nnhaya nnsen, Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu wid Itlef. Ur asen illi usettaô.

verses.text: Ggulen s Öebbi, liman iûeêêan nnsen, ar ur d Ippara ara Öebbi wid immuten. Xaîi, lemâahda fellas d tidep, maca tegwti n medden ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Ggulen s Öebbi, liman iûeêêan nnsen, ar ur d Ippara ara Öebbi wid immuten. Xaîi, lemâahda fellas d tidep, maca tegwti n medden ur ssinen.

verses.translation: Iwakken ad asen d ibeggen ayen i$ef mgarraden, iwakken ad éôen wid ijehlen, ar nitni, war ccekk, llan d ikeddaben.

verses.translation: Awal nne£ kan, i t$awsa, ma Neb$a p, ad as Nini: "ili"! A ppili.

verses.translation: Wid iunagen i Öebbi, mbaâd ma pwadensen, a ten Nesserked di ddunit s yise$. Arraz n laxeôt a t i$leb, war ccekk, lemmer éôin

verses.translation: wid iûebôen u ppeklen $ef Mass nnsen.

verses.translation: Id Nuzen, uqbel ik, siwa irgazen iwumi Nweêêa. Steqsit imawlan usmekti, ma ur teéôim ara.

verses.translation: S ubeggen akked Ihellilen, Nuzen ak d asmekti, iwakken a pbeggnev i medden, ayen i sen d irsen, amar a d mmektin.

verses.translation: Wid iundin tucmitin, aâni $ilen ur Iôemmu ara Öebbi di tmurt, ne$ ur ten id ippawev ara uâaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin?

verses.text: Ne$ ur ten id ikkat ara di cce$l nnsen, ur sfunnugen?
verses.translation: Ne$ ur ten id ikkat ara di cce$l nnsen, ur sfunnugen?

verses.text: Ne$ ur ten ikkat ara cwiî, cwiî. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, Issuruf, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ne$ ur ten ikkat ara cwiî, cwiî. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, Issuruf, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara ayen akw Ixleq Öebbi, ippara tili s yeffus, zelmev; tkennu i Öebbi, s wannuz.
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara ayen akw Ixleq Öebbi, ippara tili s yeffus, zelmev; tkennu i Öebbi, s wannuz.

verses.text: I Öebbi ikennu meôôa wayen illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt, imexlaq akked lmalayek. Nitni ur sme$wôen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: I Öebbi ikennu meôôa wayen illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt, imexlaq akked lmalayek. Nitni ur sme$wôen iman nnsen.

verses.text: Ppagwaden Mass nnsen, sennig sen, xeddmen ayen i sen ippumôen.
verses.translation: Ppagwaden Mass nnsen, sennig sen, xeddmen ayen i sen ippumôen.

verses.text: Inna Öebbi: "ur sâut sin iôebbiten. Neppa, d Öebbi Yiwen kan. Ihi, Nek, agwadet iyI".
verses.translation: Inna Öebbi: "ur sâut sin iôebbiten. Neppa, d Öebbi Yiwen kan. Ihi, Nek, agwadet iyI".

verses.text: IneS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ddin, ineS i lebda. Day a têezzbem i war Öebbi?
verses.translation: IneS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ddin, ineS i lebda. Day a têezzbem i war Öebbi?

verses.text: S$uô Öebbi, ayen akw ikwen i$aten. D$a mi kwen têuza lemveôôa, $uôeS ay tnedhem.
verses.translation: S$uô Öebbi, ayen akw ikwen i$aten. D$a mi kwen têuza lemveôôa, $uôeS ay tnedhem.

verses.translation: Sinna, mi wen Ikkes lemveôôa, arbaâ segwen, atnan pcaraken i Mass nnsen.

verses.translation: Nekôen, akka, i sen Nefka. Zhut, deqqal a ppeéôem.

verses.translation: La qesden, i wur ssinen, amur seg wayen is iten Neôzeq. S Öebbi, ar fellawen asteqsi, $ef wayen id tesnulfuyem!

verses.translation: Gern aS d, i Öebbi, tullas. Gedha s yiS! I nitni, ayen ssarmen.

verses.text: Ma becceôn yiwen s teqcict, ad yibrik wudem is, ad iqbeô.
verses.translation: Ma becceôn yiwen s teqcict, ad yibrik wudem is, ad iqbeô.

verses.translation: Ad iveôôef iman is, si medden, ilmend n yir usali it id ibbwven. A p ijmaâ, tamara, ne$ a p irr seddaw wakal? Ay dir wamek debbiôen!

verses.text: I wid ur numin ara s laxert: amedya ucmit. I Öebbi: amedya aâlayen mavi. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: I wid ur numin ara s laxert: amedya ucmit. I Öebbi: amedya aâlayen mavi. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Öebbi, lemmer Ipqissi medden, $ef ddens nnsen, ur d Ippaoa, degs, amexluq. Maca, Iswexxiô iten ar lajel ipwassnen. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen, ur t id seqôaben, s ssaâa.
verses.translation: Öebbi, lemmer Ipqissi medden, $ef ddens nnsen, ur d Ippaoa, degs, amexluq. Maca, Iswexxiô iten ar lajel ipwassnen. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ur t swexxiôen, ur t id seqôaben, s ssaâa.

verses.text: Garen aS d, i Öebbi, ayen keôhen. Skaddben yilsawen nnsen, mi qqaôen ar ayen ilhan, nnsen. Ay nnsen, war ccekk, d times. Ih, nitni ad zwiren.
verses.translation: Garen aS d, i Öebbi, ayen keôhen. Skaddben yilsawen nnsen, mi qqaôen ar ayen ilhan, nnsen. Ay nnsen, war ccekk, d times. Ih, nitni ad zwiren.

verses.translation: S Öebbi, ni$ Nuzen ed, i leoyus, uqbel ik. Cciîan icebbeê asen igiten nnsen. Assa, d bab nnsen. I nitni, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.translation: Nessader ak edTazmamt, iwakken kan ad asen tbeggnev ayen i$ef mgarraden, akw i nnhaya akked uêunu i ugdud iumnen.

verses.translation: Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni. Issader yissen akal, deffir tmeppant is. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud isellen.

verses.translation: Ih, ameyyez, i kunwi, di lmal. Nesswa kwen s wayen illan deg ufwad nnsen, ger lfert d idamen, i$i iûfan, aéidan i wid itessen.

verses.translation: Si ppemôa n tezdayin akked tfeôôant, teppawim d ayen iûûekôen, akked ôôezq igerzen. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ifehmen.

verses.translation: Iweêêa Mass ik i tzizwa: "gemt ixxamen deg durar, di ttjuô, di te$wôasin.
