verses.translation: Sinna, eççemt si yal ppemôa. Ddumt s wannuz, iberdan n Mass nnkwent. Iteffe$ ed seg iâabbav nnsent ayen tessen, n yal ini, degs êellu i imdanen". Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ipxemmimen.

verses.text: Ixelq ikwen Öebbi, sinna, ad awen Iddem ôôuê. Kra, segwen, ad ccerfeffen mavi, alamma ur ppissinen acemma mbaâd ma ssnen. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Aêernuk.
verses.translation: Ixelq ikwen Öebbi, sinna, ad awen Iddem ôôuê. Kra, segwen, ad ccerfeffen mavi, alamma ur ppissinen acemma mbaâd ma ssnen. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Aêernuk.

verses.text: Öebbi Ismenyaf ad I$it kra i wiyav. Wid Ismenyaf, ur ilaq ara ad rren, ôôeéq nnsen, i waklan nnsen, d$a ad âadlen yidsen. Day ara nekôen l$it n Öebbi?
verses.translation: Öebbi Ismenyaf ad I$it kra i wiyav. Wid Ismenyaf, ur ilaq ara ad rren, ôôeéq nnsen, i waklan nnsen, d$a ad âadlen yidsen. Day ara nekôen l$it n Öebbi?

verses.text: Iga yawen Öebbi, seg iman nnwen, tilawin nnwen. Ifka yawen, si tlawin nnwen, arraw d warraw n warraw. Iôeéq ikwen s wayen ilhan. Day ad amnen di tkerkas, ad nekôen l$it n Öebbi?
verses.translation: Iga yawen Öebbi, seg iman nnwen, tilawin nnwen. Ifka yawen, si tlawin nnwen, arraw d warraw n warraw. Iôeéq ikwen s wayen ilhan. Day ad amnen di tkerkas, ad nekôen l$it n Öebbi?

verses.text: Âabden, war Öebbi, wid ur nesâi acemma, swayes ara ten ôeéqen, si tmurt akked igenwan, u ur zmiren.
verses.translation: Âabden, war Öebbi, wid ur nesâi acemma, swayes ara ten ôeéqen, si tmurt akked igenwan, u ur zmiren.

verses.text: Ur d ppawit imedyaten i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Ur d ppawit imedyaten i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.

verses.text: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n wakli, d ayla, ur izmir i wacemma, akked yiwen iwumi Nefka, s $uône£, ôôeéq ilhan. Ipseddiq, segs, s tuffra ne$ âinani. Day âadlen? Ccekôan i Öebbi. Maca, tegwti, segsen, ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n wakli, d ayla, ur izmir i wacemma, akked yiwen iwumi Nefka, s $uône£, ôôeéq ilhan. Ipseddiq, segs, s tuffra ne$ âinani. Day âadlen? Ccekôan i Öebbi. Maca, tegwti, segsen, ur ssinen.

verses.text: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n sin irgazen. Yiwen d agugam, ur izmir i wacemma. D taâkkwemt i bab is. Anda it iuzen, ur d ippawi lxiô. Day iaâdel akked win ippamôen lêeqq, u neppa deg ubrid uwqim?
verses.translation: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n sin irgazen. Yiwen d agugam, ur izmir i wacemma. D taâkkwemt i bab is. Anda it iuzen, ur d ippawi lxiô. Day iaâdel akked win ippamôen lêeqq, u neppa deg ubrid uwqim?

verses.text: N Öebbi tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Lameô n yimir, am unqaj n tiî kan, ne$ ur ibbwiv. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: N Öebbi tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Lameô n yimir, am unqaj n tiî kan, ne$ ur ibbwiv. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Öebbi Issuffe$ ikwen id si tâabbav n tyimmatin nnwen, ur tessinem acemma. Ifka yawen timejjin, iéôi, ul, amar a ppesnemmrem.
verses.translation: Öebbi Issuffe$ ikwen id si tâabbav n tyimmatin nnwen, ur tessinem acemma. Ifka yawen timejjin, iéôi, ul, amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara ifôax, têeppem fellasen lhawa igenni, ur ten iîîif yiwen siwa Öebbi? Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara ifôax, têeppem fellasen lhawa igenni, ur ten iîîif yiwen siwa Öebbi? Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Öebbi Irra yawen ixxamen nnwen d tanezdu$t. Irra yawen ixxamen, s igwelman n lmal nnwen. Fessusit, ass n yinig, d wass uqeggel. Taduî nnsen, ccâaô nnsen, inéaden nnsen, i leêwal akked dduzan, tallit kan.
verses.translation: Öebbi Irra yawen ixxamen nnwen d tanezdu$t. Irra yawen ixxamen, s igwelman n lmal nnwen. Fessusit, ass n yinig, d wass uqeggel. Taduî nnsen, ccâaô nnsen, inéaden nnsen, i leêwal akked dduzan, tallit kan.

verses.text: Deg wayen Ixleq, Öebbi Ifka yawen d tili. Irra yawen, deg idurar, ûûôanat. Ifka yawen iceîîiven i kwen isdarayen seg u$amac, iceîîiven i kwen ipfukkun si lbe$wv nnwen. Akka, ad awen Itim l$it iS. Amar a ppanzem.
verses.translation: Deg wayen Ixleq, Öebbi Ifka yawen d tili. Irra yawen, deg idurar, ûûôanat. Ifka yawen iceîîiven i kwen isdarayen seg u$amac, iceîîiven i kwen ipfukkun si lbe$wv nnwen. Akka, ad awen Itim l$it iS. Amar a ppanzem.

verses.text: Ma wexxôen, i illan fellak, siwa awal ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Ma wexxôen, i illan fellak, siwa awal ipbegginen.

verses.text: Âaqlen l$it n Öebbi, sinna, nekôen t. Tegwti, degsen, d ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Âaqlen l$it n Öebbi, sinna, nekôen t. Tegwti, degsen, d ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, si yal lois, anagi, imiren ur ippili tesriê i wid ijehlen, u nitni ur ste$fiôen
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, si yal lois, anagi, imiren ur ippili tesriê i wid ijehlen, u nitni ur ste$fiôen

verses.text: Mi walan, imednas, aâaqeb, ur ippifsus fellasen, ur ppestaâfun.
verses.translation: Mi walan, imednas, aâaqeb, ur ippifsus fellasen, ur ppestaâfun.

verses.text: Mi walan, wid ipcaraken, wid curken, ad inin: "a Mass nne$! D wigi i d icriken nne$ u$uô nepnuju, war Keçç". Ad asen d rren: "kunwi, war ccekk, d ikeddaben".
verses.translation: Mi walan, wid ipcaraken, wid curken, ad inin: "a Mass nne$! D wigi i d icriken nne$ u$uô nepnuju, war Keçç". Ad asen d rren: "kunwi, war ccekk, d ikeddaben".

verses.text: Assen, ad fken mayna i Öebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
verses.translation: Assen, ad fken mayna i Öebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

verses.text: Wid ijehlen, u sîixxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, Nerna yasen aâaqeb sennig wayev, ilmend n wayen ssefsaden.
verses.translation: Wid ijehlen, u sîixxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, Nerna yasen aâaqeb sennig wayev, ilmend n wayen ssefsaden.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, i yal lois, anagi segsen, fellasen, a k id Nawi d anagi mgal wigi. Nessers ak d Tazmamt, d abeggen n yal cci, d nnhaya, d aêunu, u d abecceô i imvuâen.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, i yal lois, anagi segsen, fellasen, a k id Nawi d anagi mgal wigi. Nessers ak d Tazmamt, d abeggen n yal cci, d nnhaya, d aêunu, u d abecceô i imvuâen.

verses.text: Ih, Öebbi Iumeô ed lêeqq, akked lewqama, talalt i llzem. Igdel tucmitin, ayen n dir, ddeôk. A kwen Ipnabi, amar a d temmektim.
verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi Iumeô ed lêeqq, akked lewqama, talalt i llzem. Igdel tucmitin, ayen n dir, ddeôk. A kwen Ipnabi, amar a d temmektim.

verses.text: Eîîfet di lemâahda n Öebbi ma tâahdem. Ur êentet di tgallit ma tetebbtem, u tcubkem Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa acu txeddmem.
verses.translation: Eîîfet di lemâahda n Öebbi ma tâahdem. Ur êentet di tgallit ma tetebbtem, u tcubkem Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa acu txeddmem.

verses.text: Ur cebbut tin ifsin lxiv is, mbaâd ma tcudd it, s loehd. Tepparam tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen: ad ikk lois sennig wayev. Öebbi Ipjeôôib ikwen kan, yis. War ccekk, ad awen Ibeggen, ass n tnekra, ayen i$ef temgarradem.
verses.translation: Ur cebbut tin ifsin lxiv is, mbaâd ma tcudd it, s loehd. Tepparam tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen: ad ikk lois sennig wayev. Öebbi Ipjeôôib ikwen kan, yis. War ccekk, ad awen Ibeggen, ass n tnekra, ayen i$ef temgarradem.

verses.text: Lemmer i S ihwi, i Öebbi, a kwen Irr d yiwen n lois. Maca, Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. S tidep, a ppepusteqsim $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Lemmer i S ihwi, i Öebbi, a kwen Irr d yiwen n lois. Maca, Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. S tidep, a ppepusteqsim $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ur pparat tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen. Ad iccev uvaô mbaâd ma iîîef. A pjeôbem tawa$it, ilmend n wayen tveôôfem seg ubrid n Öebbi. I kunwi, aâaqeb abarar.
verses.translation: Ur pparat tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen. Ad iccev uvaô mbaâd ma iîîef. A pjeôbem tawa$it, ilmend n wayen tveôôfem seg ubrid n Öebbi. I kunwi, aâaqeb abarar.

verses.text: Ur ppa$et s lemâahda n Öebbi ayen ôxisen. Ih, yif it i kunwi wayen illan $eô Öebbi, lemmer teéôim.
verses.translation: Ur ppa$et s lemâahda n Öebbi ayen ôxisen. Ih, yif it i kunwi wayen illan $eô Öebbi, lemmer teéôim.

verses.text: Ayen illan $uôwen, ad ifukk; ayen illan $eô Öebbi, ad idum. War ccekk, a Nkafi wid iûebôen, s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
verses.translation: Ayen illan $uôwen, ad ifukk; ayen illan $eô Öebbi, ad idum. War ccekk, a Nkafi wid iûebôen, s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.

verses.text: Wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta, u umnen, a ten Nessider di tmeddurt tumâint, a ten Nkafi s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
verses.translation: Wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta, u umnen, a ten Nessider di tmeddurt tumâint, a ten Nkafi s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.

verses.text: Mara te$ôev Leqwôan, ssuter a k Iaâteq Öebbi, si Cciîan imenfi.
verses.translation: Mara te$ôev Leqwôan, ssuter a k Iaâteq Öebbi, si Cciîan imenfi.

verses.text: Neppa, s tidep, ur isâi adabu $ef wid iumnen, i ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen.
verses.translation: Neppa, s tidep, ur isâi adabu $ef wid iumnen, i ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen.

verses.text: Adabu ines, $ef wid kan i t irran d bab, d wid i S ipcaraken.
verses.translation: Adabu ines, $ef wid kan i t irran d bab, d wid i S ipcaraken.

verses.text: Ma Nbeddel assekni s ussekni, u Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen id Issers, a d inin: "keçç, d win kan id isnulfuyen". Xaîi! Tegwti, degsen, ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Ma Nbeddel assekni s ussekni, u Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen id Issers, a d inin: "keçç, d win kan id isnulfuyen". Xaîi! Tegwti, degsen, ur ssinen.

verses.text: Ini: "Issers it id ôôuê iôqan, s$uô Mass ik, s tidep, iwakken ad itebbet wid iumnen; d nnhaya u d abecceô i imvuâen".
verses.translation: Ini: "Issers it id ôôuê iôqan, s$uô Mass ik, s tidep, iwakken ad itebbet wid iumnen; d nnhaya u d abecceô i imvuâen".

verses.text: Ih, Neéôa, qqaôen: "d amdan kan it isselmaden". Tameslayt n win d gren, d tabeôôanit, wagi d awal aâôab n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Ih, Neéôa, qqaôen: "d amdan kan it isselmaden". Tameslayt n win d gren, d tabeôôanit, wagi d awal aâôab n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ih, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi, ur ten Inehhu Öebbi. I nitni, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi, ur ten Inehhu Öebbi. I nitni, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ih, gren d kan tikerkas, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi. Widak, d nitni ay d ikeddaben.
verses.translation: Ih, gren d kan tikerkas, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi. Widak, d nitni ay d ikeddaben.

verses.text: Win inekôen Öebbi, deffir liman is, siwa ma êeppmen fellas, u ul is izga iumen…. Ma d wid illin idmaren nnsen, ar tijehli, ad Izâaf Öebbi fellasen. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.
verses.translation: Win inekôen Öebbi, deffir liman is, siwa ma êeppmen fellas, u ul is izga iumen…. Ma d wid illin idmaren nnsen, ar tijehli, ad Izâaf Öebbi fellasen. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.

verses.text: Ayagi, acku smenyafen tameddurt n ddunit i laxeôt. Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ayagi, acku smenyafen tameddurt n ddunit i laxeôt. Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.

verses.text: D wigi iwumi Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, timejjin nnsen, iéôi nnsen. Wigi d i$efliyen.
verses.translation: D wigi iwumi Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, timejjin nnsen, iéôi nnsen. Wigi d i$efliyen.

verses.text: War ccekk, nitni, di laxeôt, ad ilin d imexsuôen.
verses.translation: War ccekk, nitni, di laxeôt, ad ilin d imexsuôen.

verses.text: Sinna, Mass ik, s tidep, i wid iunagen mbaâd ma thewwlen, sinna juhden, ûebôen; ih, Mass ik, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Sinna, Mass ik, s tidep, i wid iunagen mbaâd ma thewwlen, sinna juhden, ûebôen; ih, Mass ik, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara d ias, yal yiwen, ad inamer $ef yiman is, u yal yiwen ad iîîukafi $ef wayen ixdem, nitni ur pwadensen.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara d ias, yal yiwen, ad inamer $ef yiman is, u yal yiwen ad iîîukafi $ef wayen ixdem, nitni ur pwadensen.

verses.text: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n temdint, i illan di laman u îîmana. Ippas ip id ôôeéq is, s lufa, si yal tama. Tenkeô l$it n Öebbi. Isukk Öebbi fellas tawa$it n llaé akked lweêc, ilmend n wayen la ûûenâan.
verses.translation: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n temdint, i illan di laman u îîmana. Ippas ip id ôôeéq is, s lufa, si yal tama. Tenkeô l$it n Öebbi. Isukk Öebbi fellas tawa$it n llaé akked lweêc, ilmend n wayen la ûûenâan.

verses.text: Ni$ iusa ten id umazan, segsen. Skaddben t, iwwet iten uâaqeb, nitni densen.
verses.translation: Ni$ iusa ten id umazan, segsen. Skaddben t, iwwet iten uâaqeb, nitni densen.

verses.text: Eççet seg wayen is ikwen I$at Öebbi, i iêellen, i imaânen. Snemmret l$it n Öebbi, ma d Neppa ay tâabdem.
verses.translation: Eççet seg wayen is ikwen I$at Öebbi, i iêellen, i imaânen. Snemmret l$it n Öebbi, ma d Neppa ay tâabdem.

verses.text: I yawen Igdel siwa loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, akked wayen id irsen s yisem ur nelli d win n Öebbi. Ma d win terra tmara, ur ijuô, ur inufeq, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: I yawen Igdel siwa loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, akked wayen id irsen s yisem ur nelli d win n Öebbi. Ma d win terra tmara, ur ijuô, ur inufeq, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ur qqaôet tikerkas id ppawin ilsawen nnwen: "aya d leêlal, aya d leêôam". A d tegrem tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Wid id iggaren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ur rebêen.
verses.translation: Ur qqaôet tikerkas id ppawin ilsawen nnwen: "aya d leêlal, aya d leêôam". A d tegrem tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Wid id iggaren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ur rebêen.

verses.text: Drus ara zhun, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Drus ara zhun, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: I wudayen, Negdel ayen i$ef i k Neêka, iu$ lêal. Ur ten Nednis, maca nitni ddennisen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: I wudayen, Negdel ayen i$ef i k Neêka, iu$ lêal. Ur ten Nednis, maca nitni ddennisen iman nnsen.

verses.text: Sinna, Mass ik, i wid ixedmen cceôô, ur ssinen, d$a steôoâen deffir waya, u sweqmen, Mass ik, war ccekk, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Sinna, Mass ik, i wid ixedmen cceôô, ur ssinen, d$a steôoâen deffir waya, u sweqmen, Mass ik, war ccekk, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ibôahim, ih, d amdan i imalen ar tidep, i iunzen i Öebbi. Ur illi seg imcurak.
verses.translation: Ibôahim, ih, d amdan i imalen ar tidep, i iunzen i Öebbi. Ur illi seg imcurak.

verses.text: Isnemmar l$it iS. Ifren it u Inha t s abrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Isnemmar l$it iS. Ifren it u Inha t s abrid uwqim.

verses.text: Nefka yas di ddunit ise$, u, di laxeôt, neppa, s tidep, ad yili seg izedganen.
verses.translation: Nefka yas di ddunit ise$, u, di laxeôt, neppa, s tidep, ad yili seg izedganen.

verses.text: Sinna, Nweêêa yak d a ppedduv d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak.
verses.translation: Sinna, Nweêêa yak d a ppedduv d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak.

verses.text: Ssebt, iu$al kan i wid imgarraden fellas. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen llan mgarraden.
verses.translation: Ssebt, iu$al kan i wid imgarraden fellas. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen llan mgarraden.

verses.text: Enced s abrid n Mass ik, s ûûwab akked nnhaya tumâint. Mmeslay iten, s yiles aéidan mavi. Ih, Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i iff$en seg ubrid iS. Neppa Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i ipwanhan.
verses.translation: Enced s abrid n Mass ik, s ûûwab akked nnhaya tumâint. Mmeslay iten, s yiles aéidan mavi. Ih, Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i iff$en seg ubrid iS. Neppa Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i ipwanhan.

verses.text: Ma tâaqbem, âaqbet akken teppuâaqbem. Ma tûebôem, yif it i iûebôiyen.
verses.translation: Ma tâaqbem, âaqbet akken teppuâaqbem. Ma tûebôem, yif it i iûebôiyen.

verses.text: Eûbeô. Üûebô ik s Öebbi kan. Ur $webben ilmend nnsen, ur pveyyiq si tcengal nnsen.
verses.translation: Eûbeô. Üûebô ik s Öebbi kan. Ur $webben ilmend nnsen, ur pveyyiq si tcengal nnsen.

verses.text: Ih, Öebbi Atan ar wid ipêezziben, akked wid issewqamen.
verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi Atan ar wid ipêezziben, akked wid issewqamen.

ayahs.text: Ad ias lameô n Öebbi, ur pêirit $uôes. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aâlay, sennig wayen pcaraken.
ayahs.translation: Ad ias lameô n Öebbi, ur pêirit $uôes. Gedha s yiS! Ay Aâlay, sennig wayen pcaraken.

ayahs.text: Issrusu d lmalayek s ôôuê si lameô iS, $ef win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS: "Nedôet ar ur illi ôebbi siwa Nek. Ihi, êezzbet iyI".
ayahs.translation: Issrusu d lmalayek s ôôuê si lameô iS, $ef win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS: "Nedôet ar ur illi ôebbi siwa Nek. Ihi, êezzbet iyI".

ayahs.text: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ay Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
ayahs.translation: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ay Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!

ayahs.text: Ixelq ed amdan si tiqqit; atan iu$al aS, d axûim n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Ixelq ed amdan si tiqqit; atan iu$al aS, d axûim n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ixelq awen d lmal, segsen iceîîiven iêman, aba$uô, u, segsen, teppeppem.
ayahs.translation: Ixelq awen d lmal, segsen iceîîiven iêman, aba$uô, u, segsen, teppeppem.

ayahs.text: D ccbaêa nnwen mara ten id terrem, u mara ten teksem.
ayahs.translation: D ccbaêa nnwen mara ten id terrem, u mara ten teksem.

ayahs.text: Ppawin tiâkkwmin nnwen ar tmurt ur teppawvem, siwa ma tâapbem. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, d Umâin, d Aênin.
ayahs.translation: Ppawin tiâkkwmin nnwen ar tmurt ur teppawvem, siwa ma tâapbem. Ih, Mass nnwen, war ccekk, d Umâin, d Aênin.

ayahs.text: Iâewdiwen, iserdyan, i$wyal, i rrekba nnwen akked ccbaêa. Ixelleq ayen ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Iâewdiwen, iserdyan, i$wyal, i rrekba nnwen akked ccbaêa. Ixelleq ayen ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: D Öebbi i Ippawin d ubrid. Ff$en segs. Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Inhu meôôa.
ayahs.translation: D Öebbi i Ippawin d ubrid. Ff$en segs. Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Inhu meôôa.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i wen d Isse$layen aman seg igenni. Segsen tissit nnwen, segsen ttjuô i itepp lmal.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i wen d Isse$layen aman seg igenni. Segsen tissit nnwen, segsen ttjuô i itepp lmal.

ayahs.text: Isskar awen d yissen nnaâma, azemmur, tizdayin, tiéuôin, akked yal ppemôa. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ipxemmimen.
ayahs.translation: Isskar awen d yissen nnaâma, azemmur, tizdayin, tiéuôin, akked yal ppemôa. Deg waya, s tidep, assekni i ugdud ipxemmimen.

ayahs.text: Inub awen d s yiv akked wass, iîij akked waggur. Itran ppemnuben s lameô iS. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.
ayahs.translation: Inub awen d s yiv akked wass, iîij akked waggur. Itran ppemnuben s lameô iS. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara ifôax, têeppem fellasen lhawa igenni, ur ten iîîif yiwen siwa Öebbi? Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara ifôax, têeppem fellasen lhawa igenni, ur ten iîîif yiwen siwa Öebbi? Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Irra yawen ixxamen nnwen d tanezdu$t. Irra yawen ixxamen, s igwelman n lmal nnwen. Fessusit, ass n yinig, d wass uqeggel. Taduî nnsen, ccâaô nnsen, inéaden nnsen, i leêwal akked dduzan, tallit kan.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Irra yawen ixxamen nnwen d tanezdu$t. Irra yawen ixxamen, s igwelman n lmal nnwen. Fessusit, ass n yinig, d wass uqeggel. Taduî nnsen, ccâaô nnsen, inéaden nnsen, i leêwal akked dduzan, tallit kan.

ayahs.text: Deg wayen Ixleq, Öebbi Ifka yawen d tili. Irra yawen, deg idurar, ûûôanat. Ifka yawen iceîîiven i kwen isdarayen seg u$amac, iceîîiven i kwen ipfukkun si lbe$wv nnwen. Akka, ad awen Itim l$it iS. Amar a ppanzem.
ayahs.translation: Deg wayen Ixleq, Öebbi Ifka yawen d tili. Irra yawen, deg idurar, ûûôanat. Ifka yawen iceîîiven i kwen isdarayen seg u$amac, iceîîiven i kwen ipfukkun si lbe$wv nnwen. Akka, ad awen Itim l$it iS. Amar a ppanzem.

ayahs.text: Ma wexxôen, i illan fellak, siwa awal ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Ma wexxôen, i illan fellak, siwa awal ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Âaqlen l$it n Öebbi, sinna, nekôen t. Tegwti, degsen, d ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Âaqlen l$it n Öebbi, sinna, nekôen t. Tegwti, degsen, d ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, si yal lois, anagi, imiren ur ippili tesriê i wid ijehlen, u nitni ur ste$fiôen
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, si yal lois, anagi, imiren ur ippili tesriê i wid ijehlen, u nitni ur ste$fiôen

ayahs.text: Mi walan, imednas, aâaqeb, ur ippifsus fellasen, ur ppestaâfun.
ayahs.translation: Mi walan, imednas, aâaqeb, ur ippifsus fellasen, ur ppestaâfun.

ayahs.text: Mi walan, wid ipcaraken, wid curken, ad inin: "a Mass nne$! D wigi i d icriken nne$ u$uô nepnuju, war Keçç". Ad asen d rren: "kunwi, war ccekk, d ikeddaben".
ayahs.translation: Mi walan, wid ipcaraken, wid curken, ad inin: "a Mass nne$! D wigi i d icriken nne$ u$uô nepnuju, war Keçç". Ad asen d rren: "kunwi, war ccekk, d ikeddaben".

ayahs.text: Assen, ad fken mayna i Öebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: Assen, ad fken mayna i Öebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Wid ijehlen, u sîixxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, Nerna yasen aâaqeb sennig wayev, ilmend n wayen ssefsaden.
ayahs.translation: Wid ijehlen, u sîixxiôen seg ubrid n Öebbi, Nerna yasen aâaqeb sennig wayev, ilmend n wayen ssefsaden.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, i yal lois, anagi segsen, fellasen, a k id Nawi d anagi mgal wigi. Nessers ak d Tazmamt, d abeggen n yal cci, d nnhaya, d aêunu, u d abecceô i imvuâen.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d Nessker, i yal lois, anagi segsen, fellasen, a k id Nawi d anagi mgal wigi. Nessers ak d Tazmamt, d abeggen n yal cci, d nnhaya, d aêunu, u d abecceô i imvuâen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi Iumeô ed lêeqq, akked lewqama, talalt i llzem. Igdel tucmitin, ayen n dir, ddeôk. A kwen Ipnabi, amar a d temmektim.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi Iumeô ed lêeqq, akked lewqama, talalt i llzem. Igdel tucmitin, ayen n dir, ddeôk. A kwen Ipnabi, amar a d temmektim.

ayahs.text: Eîîfet di lemâahda n Öebbi ma tâahdem. Ur êentet di tgallit ma tetebbtem, u tcubkem Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa acu txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Eîîfet di lemâahda n Öebbi ma tâahdem. Ur êentet di tgallit ma tetebbtem, u tcubkem Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa acu txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ur cebbut tin ifsin lxiv is, mbaâd ma tcudd it, s loehd. Tepparam tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen: ad ikk lois sennig wayev. Öebbi Ipjeôôib ikwen kan, yis. War ccekk, ad awen Ibeggen, ass n tnekra, ayen i$ef temgarradem.
ayahs.translation: Ur cebbut tin ifsin lxiv is, mbaâd ma tcudd it, s loehd. Tepparam tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen: ad ikk lois sennig wayev. Öebbi Ipjeôôib ikwen kan, yis. War ccekk, ad awen Ibeggen, ass n tnekra, ayen i$ef temgarradem.

ayahs.text: Lemmer i S ihwi, i Öebbi, a kwen Irr d yiwen n lois. Maca, Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. S tidep, a ppepusteqsim $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i S ihwi, i Öebbi, a kwen Irr d yiwen n lois. Maca, Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. S tidep, a ppepusteqsim $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ur pparat tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen. Ad iccev uvaô mbaâd ma iîîef. A pjeôbem tawa$it, ilmend n wayen tveôôfem seg ubrid n Öebbi. I kunwi, aâaqeb abarar.
ayahs.translation: Ur pparat tagallit nnwen i umkellex garawen. Ad iccev uvaô mbaâd ma iîîef. A pjeôbem tawa$it, ilmend n wayen tveôôfem seg ubrid n Öebbi. I kunwi, aâaqeb abarar.

ayahs.text: Ur ppa$et s lemâahda n Öebbi ayen ôxisen. Ih, yif it i kunwi wayen illan $eô Öebbi, lemmer teéôim.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppa$et s lemâahda n Öebbi ayen ôxisen. Ih, yif it i kunwi wayen illan $eô Öebbi, lemmer teéôim.

ayahs.text: Ayen illan $uôwen, ad ifukk; ayen illan $eô Öebbi, ad idum. War ccekk, a Nkafi wid iûebôen, s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
ayahs.translation: Ayen illan $uôwen, ad ifukk; ayen illan $eô Öebbi, ad idum. War ccekk, a Nkafi wid iûebôen, s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.

ayahs.text: Wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta, u umnen, a ten Nessider di tmeddurt tumâint, a ten Nkafi s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
ayahs.translation: Wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeô ne$ d nnta, u umnen, a ten Nessider di tmeddurt tumâint, a ten Nkafi s wazal n wayen xeddmen ifuqen.

ayahs.text: Mara te$ôev Leqwôan, ssuter a k Iaâteq Öebbi, si Cciîan imenfi.
ayahs.translation: Mara te$ôev Leqwôan, ssuter a k Iaâteq Öebbi, si Cciîan imenfi.

ayahs.text: Neppa, s tidep, ur isâi adabu $ef wid iumnen, i ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Neppa, s tidep, ur isâi adabu $ef wid iumnen, i ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen.

ayahs.text: Adabu ines, $ef wid kan i t irran d bab, d wid i S ipcaraken.
ayahs.translation: Adabu ines, $ef wid kan i t irran d bab, d wid i S ipcaraken.

ayahs.text: Ma Nbeddel assekni s ussekni, u Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen id Issers, a d inin: "keçç, d win kan id isnulfuyen". Xaîi! Tegwti, degsen, ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Ma Nbeddel assekni s ussekni, u Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen id Issers, a d inin: "keçç, d win kan id isnulfuyen". Xaîi! Tegwti, degsen, ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "Issers it id ôôuê iôqan, s$uô Mass ik, s tidep, iwakken ad itebbet wid iumnen; d nnhaya u d abecceô i imvuâen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "Issers it id ôôuê iôqan, s$uô Mass ik, s tidep, iwakken ad itebbet wid iumnen; d nnhaya u d abecceô i imvuâen".

ayahs.text: Ih, Neéôa, qqaôen: "d amdan kan it isselmaden". Tameslayt n win d gren, d tabeôôanit, wagi d awal aâôab n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Neéôa, qqaôen: "d amdan kan it isselmaden". Tameslayt n win d gren, d tabeôôanit, wagi d awal aâôab n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi, ur ten Inehhu Öebbi. I nitni, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi, ur ten Inehhu Öebbi. I nitni, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ih, gren d kan tikerkas, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi. Widak, d nitni ay d ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: Ih, gren d kan tikerkas, wid ur numin ara s issekniyen n Öebbi. Widak, d nitni ay d ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: Win inekôen Öebbi, deffir liman is, siwa ma êeppmen fellas, u ul is izga iumen…. Ma d wid illin idmaren nnsen, ar tijehli, ad Izâaf Öebbi fellasen. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.
ayahs.translation: Win inekôen Öebbi, deffir liman is, siwa ma êeppmen fellas, u ul is izga iumen…. Ma d wid illin idmaren nnsen, ar tijehli, ad Izâaf Öebbi fellasen. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, acku smenyafen tameddurt n ddunit i laxeôt. Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, acku smenyafen tameddurt n ddunit i laxeôt. Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: D wigi iwumi Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, timejjin nnsen, iéôi nnsen. Wigi d i$efliyen.
ayahs.translation: D wigi iwumi Isle$ Öebbi ulawen nnsen, timejjin nnsen, iéôi nnsen. Wigi d i$efliyen.

ayahs.text: War ccekk, nitni, di laxeôt, ad ilin d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, nitni, di laxeôt, ad ilin d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Mass ik, s tidep, i wid iunagen mbaâd ma thewwlen, sinna juhden, ûebôen; ih, Mass ik, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Mass ik, s tidep, i wid iunagen mbaâd ma thewwlen, sinna juhden, ûebôen; ih, Mass ik, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara d ias, yal yiwen, ad inamer $ef yiman is, u yal yiwen ad iîîukafi $ef wayen ixdem, nitni ur pwadensen.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d ias, yal yiwen, ad inamer $ef yiman is, u yal yiwen ad iîîukafi $ef wayen ixdem, nitni ur pwadensen.

ayahs.text: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n temdint, i illan di laman u îîmana. Ippas ip id ôôeéq is, s lufa, si yal tama. Tenkeô l$it n Öebbi. Isukk Öebbi fellas tawa$it n llaé akked lweêc, ilmend n wayen la ûûenâan.
ayahs.translation: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n temdint, i illan di laman u îîmana. Ippas ip id ôôeéq is, s lufa, si yal tama. Tenkeô l$it n Öebbi. Isukk Öebbi fellas tawa$it n llaé akked lweêc, ilmend n wayen la ûûenâan.

ayahs.text: Ni$ iusa ten id umazan, segsen. Skaddben t, iwwet iten uâaqeb, nitni densen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ iusa ten id umazan, segsen. Skaddben t, iwwet iten uâaqeb, nitni densen.

ayahs.text: Eççet seg wayen is ikwen I$at Öebbi, i iêellen, i imaânen. Snemmret l$it n Öebbi, ma d Neppa ay tâabdem.
ayahs.translation: Eççet seg wayen is ikwen I$at Öebbi, i iêellen, i imaânen. Snemmret l$it n Öebbi, ma d Neppa ay tâabdem.

ayahs.text: I yawen Igdel siwa loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, akked wayen id irsen s yisem ur nelli d win n Öebbi. Ma d win terra tmara, ur ijuô, ur inufeq, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: I yawen Igdel siwa loifa, idim, aksum n yilef, akked wayen id irsen s yisem ur nelli d win n Öebbi. Ma d win terra tmara, ur ijuô, ur inufeq, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ur qqaôet tikerkas id ppawin ilsawen nnwen: "aya d leêlal, aya d leêôam". A d tegrem tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Wid id iggaren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ur rebêen.
ayahs.translation: Ur qqaôet tikerkas id ppawin ilsawen nnwen: "aya d leêlal, aya d leêôam". A d tegrem tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Wid id iggaren tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ur rebêen.

ayahs.text: Drus ara zhun, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Drus ara zhun, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: I wudayen, Negdel ayen i$ef i k Neêka, iu$ lêal. Ur ten Nednis, maca nitni ddennisen iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: I wudayen, Negdel ayen i$ef i k Neêka, iu$ lêal. Ur ten Nednis, maca nitni ddennisen iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Mass ik, i wid ixedmen cceôô, ur ssinen, d$a steôoâen deffir waya, u sweqmen, Mass ik, war ccekk, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Mass ik, i wid ixedmen cceôô, ur ssinen, d$a steôoâen deffir waya, u sweqmen, Mass ik, war ccekk, deffir waya, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ibôahim, ih, d amdan i imalen ar tidep, i iunzen i Öebbi. Ur illi seg imcurak.
ayahs.translation: Ibôahim, ih, d amdan i imalen ar tidep, i iunzen i Öebbi. Ur illi seg imcurak.

ayahs.text: Isnemmar l$it iS. Ifren it u Inha t s abrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Isnemmar l$it iS. Ifren it u Inha t s abrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Nefka yas di ddunit ise$, u, di laxeôt, neppa, s tidep, ad yili seg izedganen.
ayahs.translation: Nefka yas di ddunit ise$, u, di laxeôt, neppa, s tidep, ad yili seg izedganen.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Nweêêa yak d a ppedduv d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Nweêêa yak d a ppedduv d ddin n Ibôahim, i imalen ar tidep. Ur illi seg imcurak.

ayahs.text: Ssebt, iu$al kan i wid imgarraden fellas. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen llan mgarraden.
ayahs.translation: Ssebt, iu$al kan i wid imgarraden fellas. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen llan mgarraden.

ayahs.text: Enced s abrid n Mass ik, s ûûwab akked nnhaya tumâint. Mmeslay iten, s yiles aéidan mavi. Ih, Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i iff$en seg ubrid iS. Neppa Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i ipwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Enced s abrid n Mass ik, s ûûwab akked nnhaya tumâint. Mmeslay iten, s yiles aéidan mavi. Ih, Mass ik Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i iff$en seg ubrid iS. Neppa Yif akw akken Issen, anwi i ipwanhan.

ayahs.text: Ma tâaqbem, âaqbet akken teppuâaqbem. Ma tûebôem, yif it i iûebôiyen.
ayahs.translation: Ma tâaqbem, âaqbet akken teppuâaqbem. Ma tûebôem, yif it i iûebôiyen.

ayahs.text: Eûbeô. Üûebô ik s Öebbi kan. Ur $webben ilmend nnsen, ur pveyyiq si tcengal nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Eûbeô. Üûebô ik s Öebbi kan. Ur $webben ilmend nnsen, ur pveyyiq si tcengal nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi Atan ar wid ipêezziben, akked wid issewqamen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi Atan ar wid ipêezziben, akked wid issewqamen.

verses.text: Gedha s Win Ibbwin amdan iS, d iminig n yiv, si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ar Loamaâ ibaâden mavi, ideg Neôqa i as d izzin, iwakken ad as Nessken, seg issekniyen nne£. Ih, Neppa, d Win Isellen, Ipwalin.
verses.translation: Gedha s Win Ibbwin amdan iS, d iminig n yiv, si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ar Loamaâ ibaâden mavi, ideg Neôqa i as d izzin, iwakken ad as Nessken, seg issekniyen nne£. Ih, Neppa, d Win Isellen, Ipwalin.

verses.text: Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, u Nerra p d nnhaya i At Isôail. "Ur sâut awkil, war Nek".
verses.translation: Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, u Nerra p d nnhaya i At Isôail. "Ur sâut awkil, war Nek".

verses.text: D tarwa n wid i Nebbwi akked Nuê. Neppa, s tidep, d amdan isnemmiren.
verses.translation: D tarwa n wid i Nebbwi akked Nuê. Neppa, s tidep, d amdan isnemmiren.

verses.text: Nsseyya di Tezmamt, i At Isôail: "war ccekk, a ppesfesdem, di tmurt, berdayen, u aîas ara tesme$wôem iman nnwen".
verses.translation: Nsseyya di Tezmamt, i At Isôail: "war ccekk, a ppesfesdem, di tmurt, berdayen, u aîas ara tesme$wôem iman nnwen".

verses.text: Mi d iusa usefsed amenzu segsen, Nuzen awen d imdanen nne£, s loehd uqsiê, kecmen ixxamen; lemâahda tevôa.
verses.translation: Mi d iusa usefsed amenzu segsen, Nuzen awen d imdanen nne£, s loehd uqsiê, kecmen ixxamen; lemâahda tevôa.

verses.text: Sinna, Nerra d ppaô nnwen, segsen. Nebbwi yawen d ayla, tarwa. Nesîuqqet iâsekôiwen nnwen.
verses.translation: Sinna, Nerra d ppaô nnwen, segsen. Nebbwi yawen d ayla, tarwa. Nesîuqqet iâsekôiwen nnwen.

verses.text: Ma tmaânem, i iman nnwen, ma tdensem, i iman nnwen. Mi d tusa lemâahda taneggarut, ssexven udmawen nnwen, kecmen Loamaâ, akken i t kecmen abrid amenzu; hudden, wakali, ayen is ipzuxxun.
verses.translation: Ma tmaânem, i iman nnwen, ma tdensem, i iman nnwen. Mi d tusa lemâahda taneggarut, ssexven udmawen nnwen, kecmen Loamaâ, akken i t kecmen abrid amenzu; hudden, wakali, ayen is ipzuxxun.

verses.text: Ahat Mass nnwen ad Iêun fellawen. Ma tulsem, a Nales. Nerra Loahennama d lêebs i ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ahat Mass nnwen ad Iêun fellawen. Ma tulsem, a Nales. Nerra Loahennama d lêebs i ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ih, Leqwôan agi inehhu ar wayen iweqmen mavi, ibecceô lmumnin i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni akafi meqqwôen.
verses.translation: Ih, Leqwôan agi inehhu ar wayen iweqmen mavi, ibecceô lmumnin i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni akafi meqqwôen.

verses.text: Wanag wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, Nhegga yasen d aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Wanag wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, Nhegga yasen d aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Amdan issawal i cceôô, akken issawal i lxiô. Amdan izga d aêemmaq.
verses.translation: Amdan issawal i cceôô, akken issawal i lxiô. Amdan izga d aêemmaq.

verses.text: Nerra, iv akked wass, d sin issekniyen. Assekni n yiv Nerra d tellis, Nerra win n wass d win ipwalin, iwakken a pnadim lfevl n Mass nnwen, a ppissinem amvan iseggwasen, akked leêsab. Yal ta$awsa, Nfeûûel ip akken iwata.
verses.translation: Nerra, iv akked wass, d sin issekniyen. Assekni n yiv Nerra d tellis, Nerra win n wass d win ipwalin, iwakken a pnadim lfevl n Mass nnwen, a ppissinem amvan iseggwasen, akked leêsab. Yal ta$awsa, Nfeûûel ip akken iwata.

verses.text: I yal amdan, Ncudd as lbext is s amgarv is. Ass n tnekra, ad as d Nessuffe$ tazmamt ara iaf teldi.
verses.translation: I yal amdan, Ncudd as lbext is s amgarv is. Ass n tnekra, ad as d Nessuffe$ tazmamt ara iaf teldi.

verses.text: "£eô tazmamt ik! Tqaddev, assa, s yiman ik, i uqeîîi k".
verses.translation: "£eô tazmamt ik! Tqaddev, assa, s yiman ik, i uqeîîi k".

verses.text: Win ipwanhan, i iman is kan, win innetlafen, innetlaf mgal iman is kan. Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev. Ur Nekkat, alamma Nuzen amazan.
verses.translation: Win ipwanhan, i iman is kan, win innetlafen, innetlaf mgal iman is kan. Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev. Ur Nekkat, alamma Nuzen amazan.

verses.text: Ma Neb$a a Nesqucc tamdint, Neppak lameô i isâiyen is, ad xedmen, degs, cceôô. Ad iâaddi fellas Wawal, a p Nhudd wakali.
verses.translation: Ma Neb$a a Nesqucc tamdint, Neppak lameô i isâiyen is, ad xedmen, degs, cceôô. Ad iâaddi fellas Wawal, a p Nhudd wakali.

verses.text: Acêal n tsuta ay Nesqucc, deffir Nuê! Ad Iqadd Mass ik, i tussna akked tmeéôiwt ibekkaven n imdanen iS.
verses.translation: Acêal n tsuta ay Nesqucc, deffir Nuê! Ad Iqadd Mass ik, i tussna akked tmeéôiwt ibekkaven n imdanen iS.

verses.text: Win ib$an taêemmaqt, Nezzazzal as degs, i £ ihwan, i win i £ Neb$a. Sinna, Nerra yas Loahennama ad din iô$, indell, ippuveggeô.
verses.translation: Win ib$an taêemmaqt, Nezzazzal as degs, i £ ihwan, i win i £ Neb$a. Sinna, Nerra yas Loahennama ad din iô$, indell, ippuveggeô.

verses.text: Win ib$an laxeôt, iaâzem fellas yal laâzem, u neppa iumen; widak, tajmilt i laâzem nnsen.
verses.translation: Win ib$an laxeôt, iaâzem fellas yal laâzem, u neppa iumen; widak, tajmilt i laâzem nnsen.

verses.text: I akw, i wigi d wiyav, Nwessaâ tikci s$uô Mass ik. Tikci n Mass ik, ur meêdudet.
verses.translation: I akw, i wigi d wiyav, Nwessaâ tikci s$uô Mass ik. Tikci n Mass ik, ur meêdudet.

verses.text: Wali amek Nesmenyaf kra i wiyav. War ccekk, di laxeôt, lfeôq d usmenyef, ad ilin sennig waya.
verses.translation: Wali amek Nesmenyaf kra i wiyav. War ccekk, di laxeôt, lfeôq d usmenyef, ad ilin sennig waya.

verses.text: Ur sâu, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, mulac a ppu$alev d imdelli, d imveggaâ.
verses.translation: Ur sâu, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, mulac a ppu$alev d imdelli, d imveggaâ.

verses.text: Iseyya d Mass ik: ur tâabdem siwa Neppa, elhut ar imawlan. Ma, $uôek wesser yiwen, ne$ ma wessren i sin, ur asen qqaô: "ttfuh"! Ur ten ppara. Mmeslay asen s lkyasa.
verses.translation: Iseyya d Mass ik: ur tâabdem siwa Neppa, elhut ar imawlan. Ma, $uôek wesser yiwen, ne$ ma wessren i sin, ur asen qqaô: "ttfuh"! Ur ten ppara. Mmeslay asen s lkyasa.

verses.text: Zger fellasen tacvat n lmaênana. Ini: "a Mass iw! Ëun fellasen, akken iyi d ssekren d amejtuê".
verses.translation: Zger fellasen tacvat n lmaênana. Ini: "a Mass iw! Ëun fellasen, akken iyi d ssekren d amejtuê".

verses.text: Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Issen, i illan deg iman nnwen. Ma telham, Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê wid isteôoiâen.
verses.translation: Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Issen, i illan deg iman nnwen. Ma telham, Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê wid isteôoiâen.

verses.text: Efk i llezm ik amur is, akw i ume$bun akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Ur pjeggiê d ajeggeê.
verses.translation: Efk i llezm ik amur is, akw i ume$bun akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Ur pjeggiê d ajeggeê.

verses.text: Ijeggaêen, s tidep, d atmaten n Cciîan. Cciîan ijhel ar Mass is.
verses.translation: Ijeggaêen, s tidep, d atmaten n Cciîan. Cciîan ijhel ar Mass is.

verses.text: Ma tfuôqev ten, tôe$bev u tegguniv aêunu s$uô Mass ik, ini yasen awal aéidan.
verses.translation: Ma tfuôqev ten, tôe$bev u tegguniv aêunu s$uô Mass ik, ini yasen awal aéidan.

verses.text: Ur pcuddu afus ik ar yiri k, ur as berru aîas, mulac a ppu$alev d ambaûi, d ame$bun.
verses.translation: Ur pcuddu afus ik ar yiri k, ur as berru aîas, mulac a ppu$alev d ambaûi, d ame$bun.

verses.text: S tidep, Mass ik I$ennu win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali, Issen imdanen iS.
verses.translation: S tidep, Mass ik I$ennu win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali, Issen imdanen iS.

verses.text: Ur Neqqet arraw nnwen, ma tugadem tiggulelt. D Nekwni ara ten Iôezqen, kunwi yidsen. Ih, timen$iwt nnsen d tucmip meqqwôen.
verses.translation: Ur Neqqet arraw nnwen, ma tugadem tiggulelt. D Nekwni ara ten Iôezqen, kunwi yidsen. Ih, timen$iwt nnsen d tucmip meqqwôen.

verses.text: Ur zennut, d ayen n dir, d abrid ucmit.
verses.translation: Ur zennut, d ayen n dir, d abrid ucmit.

verses.text: Ur neqqet amdan i wen Igdel Öebbi, siwa ma di tidep. Win ipwan$an s le$deô, ihi, a Nefk adabu i walag is. Ur ipjuôôu di tmen$iwt, ihi, neppa, ad ippusellek.
verses.translation: Ur neqqet amdan i wen Igdel Öebbi, siwa ma di tidep. Win ipwan$an s le$deô, ihi, a Nefk adabu i walag is. Ur ipjuôôu di tmen$iwt, ihi, neppa, ad ippusellek.

verses.text: Ur pnalet ayla ugujil, siwa ar wayen imaânen, ar d immeêtel. Qadôet lemâahda; ih, lemâahda s usteqsi.
verses.translation: Ur pnalet ayla ugujil, siwa ar wayen imaânen, ar d immeêtel. Qadôet lemâahda; ih, lemâahda s usteqsi.

verses.text: Qadôet lkil ma tektalem, weznet s lmizan imaânen. Yif it wakka, a ppelhu taggara.
verses.translation: Qadôet lkil ma tektalem, weznet s lmizan imaânen. Yif it wakka, a ppelhu taggara.

verses.text: Ur îîafaô ayen ur tessinev. Timejjin, iéôi, ul, s tidep, ad ppuseqsin akw.
verses.translation: Ur îîafaô ayen ur tessinev. Timejjin, iéôi, ul, s tidep, ad ppuseqsin akw.

verses.text: Ur teddu di tmurt, d amzuxxi. Ih, keçç ur tezmirev, d awez$i, a pneqôev tamurt, ne$ a ppessiwvev laâli idurar.
verses.translation: Ur teddu di tmurt, d amzuxxi. Ih, keçç ur tezmirev, d awez$i, a pneqôev tamurt, ne$ a ppessiwvev laâli idurar.

verses.text: Adiran, deg waya akw, Ikerh it Mass ik.
verses.translation: Adiran, deg waya akw, Ikerh it Mass ik.

verses.text: Ayagi, seg wayen i k Iweêêa Mass ik, n ûûwab. Ur ppara, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, mulac a ppepwaveggôev ar Loahennama d ambaûi, d amnafeq.
verses.translation: Ayagi, seg wayen i k Iweêêa Mass ik, n ûûwab. Ur ppara, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, mulac a ppepwaveggôev ar Loahennama d ambaûi, d amnafeq.

verses.text: Day wen d Ifren Mass nnwen arrac, u Iddem, i iman iS, tullas, si lmalayek? S tidep, kunwi tegrem d awal anecilat.
verses.translation: Day wen d Ifren Mass nnwen arrac, u Iddem, i iman iS, tullas, si lmalayek? S tidep, kunwi tegrem d awal anecilat.

verses.text: Ih, ay d Nebbwi di Leqwôan agi, iwakken a d mmektin. I yasen d irna, siwa a$unfu.
verses.translation: Ih, ay d Nebbwi di Leqwôan agi, iwakken a d mmektin. I yasen d irna, siwa a$unfu.

verses.text: Ini: "lemmer llin yides iôebbiten, akken la d qqaôen, yili ad nadin abrid ara ten iawin ar n Bab n usgeld".
verses.translation: Ini: "lemmer llin yides iôebbiten, akken la d qqaôen, yili ad nadin abrid ara ten iawin ar n Bab n usgeld".

verses.text: Gedha s yiS, aîas i Aâlay sennig wayen d qqaôen!
verses.translation: Gedha s yiS, aîas i Aâlay sennig wayen d qqaôen!

verses.text: Ppanzen aS igenwan di ûa, tamurt, u wayen illan degsen. Ur illi wayen ur aS neppanez, ur T Nesbuccuâ s ccekôan. Maca, ur tfehmem ara annuz nnsen. Ih, Neppa Iêellem, Ipsemmiê.
verses.translation: Ppanzen aS igenwan di ûa, tamurt, u wayen illan degsen. Ur illi wayen ur aS neppanez, ur T Nesbuccuâ s ccekôan. Maca, ur tfehmem ara annuz nnsen. Ih, Neppa Iêellem, Ipsemmiê.

verses.text: Mara teqqaôev Leqwôan, Neppara, garak d wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, aêurrim abavni.
verses.translation: Mara teqqaôev Leqwôan, Neppara, garak d wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, aêurrim abavni.

verses.text: Nerra $ef ulawen nnsen ssteô, iwakken ur t fehmen; di tmejjin nnsen, tiâéegt. Ma tesmektiv d, di Leqwôan, Mass ik d Yiwen, ad zzin akin, s u$unfu.
verses.translation: Nerra $ef ulawen nnsen ssteô, iwakken ur t fehmen; di tmejjin nnsen, tiâéegt. Ma tesmektiv d, di Leqwôan, Mass ik d Yiwen, ad zzin akin, s u$unfu.

verses.text: Nekwni, Nif akw akken Neéôa, acu iwumi sellen, mara k ssemêasen, mara hedôen, mi qqaôen imednas: "la teppeddum kan d urgaz iwumi sseêren".
verses.translation: Nekwni, Nif akw akken Neéôa, acu iwumi sellen, mara k ssemêasen, mara hedôen, mi qqaôen imednas: "la teppeddum kan d urgaz iwumi sseêren".

verses.translation: Wali amek i k d bbwin imedyaten. Nnetlafen. Ur zmiren ad afen abrid.

verses.translation: Ini i imdanen iw ad inin awal ifuqen. Cciîan, s tidep, isskar ameôéi garasen. Ih, Cciîan d acengu n ûûeê i umdan.

verses.translation: Mass ik Yif akw akken Iéôa i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Ni$ Nesmenyaf kra n lambiyya i wiyav. I Dawed Nefka Ihellilen.

verses.translation: Wigi u$uô la pnujun, la pqelliben ppawil ara ten isqeôben nezzeh ar Mass nnsen. Ssaramen aêunu S, ppagwaden aâaqeb iS". Ih, aâaqeb n Mass ik, issagwad.

verses.translation: Ur telli temdint ur Nesquccu, uqbel ass n tnekra, ne$ ur Nâaqeb s leqseê. Ayagi iura di Tezmamt.

verses.translation: I £ iîîfen $ef uceggaâ issekniyen, d nnkeô nnsen, kan, s$uô imezwura. Nuzen ed tal$wemt i Tamud, d ayen pwalin. Densen p. Ur d Neppazen issekniyen siwa i ussigwed.

verses.text: Mi k Nenna: "Mass ik, s tidep, Izzi i imdanen". Ma dayen i k Nerra teéôiv t, d ahewwel kan i medden. Akken ttejôa tamenâult di Leqwôan. Nessagwad iten. Ay sen d irennu siwa nnfaq ameqwôan.
verses.translation: Mi k Nenna: "Mass ik, s tidep, Izzi i imdanen". Ma dayen i k Nerra teéôiv t, d ahewwel kan i medden. Akken ttejôa tamenâult di Leqwôan. Nessagwad iten. Ay sen d irennu siwa nnfaq ameqwôan.

verses.translation: Inna: "Öuê! Wid, segsen, i iddan yidek, ihi, aqeîîi nnwen d Loahennama, d aqeîîi meqqwôen.

verses.translation: Laâaj win iwumi tzemôev, degsen, s ta$wect ik. £ewwes fellasen s imnayen ik, d iterrasen ik. Ecrek yidsen ayla, tarwa. Âahed asen". I yasen iâahed Cciîan, siwa a$uôôu.

verses.translation: " Ma d imdanen iW, ur tesâiv adabu fellasen". Mass ik Iqadd d Awkil.

verses.translation: Mass nnwen, i wen Isselêayen lbabuô di yill, a pnadim lfevl iS. Ih, Neppa Ipêunu fellawen.

verses.translation: Ne$ day t$ilem ur kwen id Ippara ara tikelt nniven, ad awen d Iazen aûeôûaô, a kwen I$mes ilmend n tijehli nnwen, sinna ur teppafem, mgal a£, amalal?

verses.translation: Ni$ Nkeyyes tarwa n Adem. Nebbwi ten di lberr, di yill, N$at iten s wayen ilhan, Nesmenyaf iten, nezzeh, i waîas seg wid i Nexleq.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara Nenced akw imdanen, s imvebôen nnsen; win id tusa tezmamt is yeffus is, widak ad $ôen tazmamt nnsen, ur pwadensen s tissegnit;
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara Nenced akw imdanen, s imvebôen nnsen; win id tusa tezmamt is yeffus is, widak ad $ôen tazmamt nnsen, ur pwadensen s tissegnit;

verses.translation: S tidep, qôib i k hewwlen $ef wayen i k d Nweêêa, a d tesnulfuv ayen nniven, mgal a£. D$a, a k rren d aêbib.

verses.translation: Lemmer ur k Ntebbet ara, qôib tmalev cwiî $uôsen.

verses.translation: Yili ad ak Nesâaddi tudert akked tmeppant, berdayen, sinna, ur teppafev, mgal a£, w ara k isellken.

verses.translation: Ih, qôib i k id srewlen si tmurt, a k id ssuff$en segs. Yili cwiî kan ara d gwrin, deffir ek.

verses.translation: Bedd i téallit mi istu$la yiîij, alamma d tellis n yiv. Leqwôan, tafrara. Ih, Leqwôan, tafrara, isâa inagan.

verses.translation: Aâwez yis kra n yiv, d nnafila k, amar a k id Irr Mass ik, deg umkan i pcekkiôen.

verses.translation: Nesrusu d, si Leqwôan, ayen illan d êellu akked uêunu i lmumnin. I irennu, i imednas, siwa lexsaôa.

verses.translation: Ma N$at amdan ad iwexxeô, ad iveôôef iman is. Ma iêuza t wugur ad iayes.

verses.translation: Ini: "yal yiwen ixeddem akken ipwali. Mass nnwen Yif akw akken i Issen anwa i ipwanhan kteô".

verses.translation: Steqsan k id $ef ôôuê. Ini: "ôôuê si lameô n Mass iw. Drus kan n tmusni i wen ippunefken".

verses.translation: Ini: "lemmer ad mlilen imdanen akked leonun, iwakken a d awin am Leqwôan agi, ur d ppawin i t icban, xas mâawanen".

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka d i imdanen, di Leqwôan agi, si yal imedyaten. Tegwti n yimdanen ur b$in, siwa tijehli.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka d i imdanen, di Leqwôan agi, si yal imedyaten. Tegwti n yimdanen ur b$in, siwa tijehli.

verses.text: Nnan: "ur k neppamen alamma tesfeggvev a$ d a$balu, si tmurt;
verses.translation: Nnan: "ur k neppamen alamma tesfeggvev a$ d a$balu, si tmurt;

verses.text: ne$, tesâiv leonan n tezdayin akked tfeôôant, ideg feggven isaffen;
verses.translation: ne$, tesâiv leonan n tezdayin akked tfeôôant, ideg feggven isaffen;

verses.text: ne$, a d tesse$liv igenni d ifeûlan, akken i $ tzuxxev; ne$, a d tasev s Öebbi akked lmalayek, zdat nne$;
verses.translation: ne$, a d tesse$liv igenni d ifeûlan, akken i $ tzuxxev; ne$, a d tasev s Öebbi akked lmalayek, zdat nne$;

verses.text: Ne$ a ppesâuv axxam imzewweq, ne$ a ppaliv s igenni. Ur neppamen, s walluy ik, alamma tessersev ane$ d tazmamt ara n$eô". Ini: "gedha s Mass iw! Day lli$ d ayen nniven, siwa d amdan amazan"?
verses.translation: Ne$ a ppesâuv axxam imzewweq, ne$ a ppaliv s igenni. Ur neppamen, s walluy ik, alamma tessersev ane$ d tazmamt ara n$eô". Ini: "gedha s Mass iw! Day lli$ d ayen nniven, siwa d amdan amazan"?

verses.text: I iîîfen imdanen ur uminen, mi ten id tusa nnhaya, mara d inin kan: "Iuzen ed Öebbi amdan d amazan".
verses.translation: I iîîfen imdanen ur uminen, mi ten id tusa nnhaya, mara d inin kan: "Iuzen ed Öebbi amdan d amazan".

verses.text: Ini: "lemmer llint, di tmurt, lmalayek, teddunt di laman, yili Nessers asent ed, seg igenni, lmelk amazan".
verses.translation: Ini: "lemmer llint, di tmurt, lmalayek, teddunt di laman, yili Nessers asent ed, seg igenni, lmelk amazan".

verses.text: Ini: "Iqadd Mass iw d Anagi, gari yidwen. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali imdanen iS, Issen iten".
verses.translation: Ini: "Iqadd Mass iw d Anagi, gari yidwen. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali imdanen iS, Issen iten".

verses.text: Win Inha Öebbi, atan idda d ubrid. Wid Itlef, ur asen teppafev imawlan, war Neppa, d awez$i. A ten id Nefser ass n tnekra $ef udmawen nnsen, dre$len, gugmen, âaégen. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama. Mi tenqes tmes, ad asen Nernu ajajiê.
verses.translation: Win Inha Öebbi, atan idda d ubrid. Wid Itlef, ur asen teppafev imawlan, war Neppa, d awez$i. A ten id Nefser ass n tnekra $ef udmawen nnsen, dre$len, gugmen, âaégen. Axxam nnsen d Loahennama. Mi tenqes tmes, ad asen Nernu ajajiê.

verses.text: D wagi ay d aqeîîi nnsen, imi nekôen issekniyen nne£, u nnan: "day mi nu$al d i$san, d a$webbaô, a d nu$al di lxelq amaynut"?
verses.translation: D wagi ay d aqeîîi nnsen, imi nekôen issekniyen nne£, u nnan: "day mi nu$al d i$san, d a$webbaô, a d nu$al di lxelq amaynut"?

verses.text: Ne$, day ur walan ara ar Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, Izmer a d Ixleq i ten icban? Irra yasen lajel, ur degs ccekk. Ur b$in imednas, siwa tijehli.
verses.translation: Ne$, day ur walan ara ar Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, Izmer a d Ixleq i ten icban? Irra yasen lajel, ur degs ccekk. Ur b$in imednas, siwa tijehli.

verses.text: Ini: "lemmer tesâim igerrujen uêunu n Mass iw, ur ten tepnalem, a ppagwadem a ten tûeôôfem. Amdan izga d imceêêi".
verses.translation: Ini: "lemmer tesâim igerrujen uêunu n Mass iw, ur ten tepnalem, a ppagwadem a ten tûeôôfem. Amdan izga d imceêêi".

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka, i Musa, tza issekniyen iberrzen. Steqsi At Isôail. Mi d iusa $uôsen, inna yas Ferâun: "a Musa! Nek, wala$, war ccekk, seêêern ak".
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka, i Musa, tza issekniyen iberrzen. Steqsi At Isôail. Mi d iusa $uôsen, inna yas Ferâun: "a Musa! Nek, wala$, war ccekk, seêêern ak".

verses.text: Inna: "ni$ teéôiv ur d issers yiwen wigi, d tiftilin, siwa Mass n tmurt akked igenwan. Nek, wala$, a Ferâun, war ccekk, tîeêênev".
verses.translation: Inna: "ni$ teéôiv ur d issers yiwen wigi, d tiftilin, siwa Mass n tmurt akked igenwan. Nek, wala$, a Ferâun, war ccekk, tîeêênev".

verses.text: Ib$a a ten iééaâ si tmurt, N$emmeq it, akked wid iddan yides, meôôa.
verses.translation: Ib$a a ten iééaâ si tmurt, N$emmeq it, akked wid iddan yides, meôôa.

verses.text: Deffir es, Nenna i At Isôail: "zed$et tamurt. Mi d tusa lemâahda n laxeôt, a kwen id Nawi, d îayfat".
verses.translation: Deffir es, Nenna i At Isôail: "zed$et tamurt. Mi d tusa lemâahda n laxeôt, a kwen id Nawi, d îayfat".

verses.text: Nessers it id s tidep. S tidep, ay d irs. Nuzen ik id, kan, i ubecceô d uneddeô.
verses.translation: Nessers it id s tidep. S tidep, ay d irs. Nuzen ik id, kan, i ubecceô d uneddeô.

verses.text: Leqwôan Nfeôq it, iwakken a t temlev i medden, s laâqel. Nessader it id, s l$eôv.
verses.translation: Leqwôan Nfeôq it, iwakken a t temlev i medden, s laâqel. Nessader it id, s l$eôv.

verses.text: Ini: "amnet yis, ne$ qqimet". Ih, ma mlan t i wid tebbwev tussna, uqbel is, ad $lin $ef udmawen, knan.
verses.translation: Ini: "amnet yis, ne$ qqimet". Ih, ma mlan t i wid tebbwev tussna, uqbel is, ad $lin $ef udmawen, knan.

verses.text: Ad inin: "gedha s Mass nne$! Tûaô lemâahda n Mass nne$".
verses.translation: Ad inin: "gedha s Mass nne$! Tûaô lemâahda n Mass nne$".

verses.text: Ad $lin $ef udmawen s imeîîawen. Ad innerni wannuz nnsen.
verses.translation: Ad $lin $ef udmawen s imeîîawen. Ad innerni wannuz nnsen.

verses.text: Ini: "nujet $er Öebbi, ne$ nujet $er Uênin. Akken tnujem, ineS ismawen imaânen yifen akw wiyav". Di téallit ik, ur saâlay ûûut ik, ur t ssrusu. Ad isker kan.
verses.translation: Ini: "nujet $er Öebbi, ne$ nujet $er Uênin. Akken tnujem, ineS ismawen imaânen yifen akw wiyav". Di téallit ik, ur saâlay ûûut ik, ur t ssrusu. Ad isker kan.

verses.text: Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi, ur Nesâi aqcic, ur Nesâi acrik di tgelda, ur Nesâi bab mgal asdullu". Ssem$weô iT yal tem$weô.
verses.translation: Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi, ur Nesâi aqcic, ur Nesâi acrik di tgelda, ur Nesâi bab mgal asdullu". Ssem$weô iT yal tem$weô.

ayahs.text: Gedha s Win Ibbwin amdan iS, d iminig n yiv, si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ar Loamaâ ibaâden mavi, ideg Neôqa i as d izzin, iwakken ad as Nessken, seg issekniyen nne£. Ih, Neppa, d Win Isellen, Ipwalin.
ayahs.translation: Gedha s Win Ibbwin amdan iS, d iminig n yiv, si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ar Loamaâ ibaâden mavi, ideg Neôqa i as d izzin, iwakken ad as Nessken, seg issekniyen nne£. Ih, Neppa, d Win Isellen, Ipwalin.

ayahs.text: Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, u Nerra p d nnhaya i At Isôail. "Ur sâut awkil, war Nek".
ayahs.translation: Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, u Nerra p d nnhaya i At Isôail. "Ur sâut awkil, war Nek".

ayahs.text: D tarwa n wid i Nebbwi akked Nuê. Neppa, s tidep, d amdan isnemmiren.
ayahs.translation: D tarwa n wid i Nebbwi akked Nuê. Neppa, s tidep, d amdan isnemmiren.

ayahs.text: Nsseyya di Tezmamt, i At Isôail: "war ccekk, a ppesfesdem, di tmurt, berdayen, u aîas ara tesme$wôem iman nnwen".
ayahs.translation: Nsseyya di Tezmamt, i At Isôail: "war ccekk, a ppesfesdem, di tmurt, berdayen, u aîas ara tesme$wôem iman nnwen".

ayahs.text: Mi d iusa usefsed amenzu segsen, Nuzen awen d imdanen nne£, s loehd uqsiê, kecmen ixxamen; lemâahda tevôa.
ayahs.translation: Mi d iusa usefsed amenzu segsen, Nuzen awen d imdanen nne£, s loehd uqsiê, kecmen ixxamen; lemâahda tevôa.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Nerra d ppaô nnwen, segsen. Nebbwi yawen d ayla, tarwa. Nesîuqqet iâsekôiwen nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Nerra d ppaô nnwen, segsen. Nebbwi yawen d ayla, tarwa. Nesîuqqet iâsekôiwen nnwen.

ayahs.text: Ma tmaânem, i iman nnwen, ma tdensem, i iman nnwen. Mi d tusa lemâahda taneggarut, ssexven udmawen nnwen, kecmen Loamaâ, akken i t kecmen abrid amenzu; hudden, wakali, ayen is ipzuxxun.
ayahs.translation: Ma tmaânem, i iman nnwen, ma tdensem, i iman nnwen. Mi d tusa lemâahda taneggarut, ssexven udmawen nnwen, kecmen Loamaâ, akken i t kecmen abrid amenzu; hudden, wakali, ayen is ipzuxxun.

ayahs.text: Ahat Mass nnwen ad Iêun fellawen. Ma tulsem, a Nales. Nerra Loahennama d lêebs i ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ahat Mass nnwen ad Iêun fellawen. Ma tulsem, a Nales. Nerra Loahennama d lêebs i ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Leqwôan agi inehhu ar wayen iweqmen mavi, ibecceô lmumnin i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni akafi meqqwôen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Leqwôan agi inehhu ar wayen iweqmen mavi, ibecceô lmumnin i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar i nitni akafi meqqwôen.

ayahs.text: Wanag wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, Nhegga yasen d aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Wanag wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, Nhegga yasen d aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Amdan issawal i cceôô, akken issawal i lxiô. Amdan izga d aêemmaq.
ayahs.translation: Amdan issawal i cceôô, akken issawal i lxiô. Amdan izga d aêemmaq.

ayahs.text: Nerra, iv akked wass, d sin issekniyen. Assekni n yiv Nerra d tellis, Nerra win n wass d win ipwalin, iwakken a pnadim lfevl n Mass nnwen, a ppissinem amvan iseggwasen, akked leêsab. Yal ta$awsa, Nfeûûel ip akken iwata.
ayahs.translation: Nerra, iv akked wass, d sin issekniyen. Assekni n yiv Nerra d tellis, Nerra win n wass d win ipwalin, iwakken a pnadim lfevl n Mass nnwen, a ppissinem amvan iseggwasen, akked leêsab. Yal ta$awsa, Nfeûûel ip akken iwata.

ayahs.text: I yal amdan, Ncudd as lbext is s amgarv is. Ass n tnekra, ad as d Nessuffe$ tazmamt ara iaf teldi.
ayahs.translation: I yal amdan, Ncudd as lbext is s amgarv is. Ass n tnekra, ad as d Nessuffe$ tazmamt ara iaf teldi.

ayahs.text: "£eô tazmamt ik! Tqaddev, assa, s yiman ik, i uqeîîi k".
ayahs.translation: "£eô tazmamt ik! Tqaddev, assa, s yiman ik, i uqeîîi k".

ayahs.text: Win ipwanhan, i iman is kan, win innetlafen, innetlaf mgal iman is kan. Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev. Ur Nekkat, alamma Nuzen amazan.
ayahs.translation: Win ipwanhan, i iman is kan, win innetlafen, innetlaf mgal iman is kan. Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev. Ur Nekkat, alamma Nuzen amazan.

ayahs.text: Ma Neb$a a Nesqucc tamdint, Neppak lameô i isâiyen is, ad xedmen, degs, cceôô. Ad iâaddi fellas Wawal, a p Nhudd wakali.
ayahs.translation: Ma Neb$a a Nesqucc tamdint, Neppak lameô i isâiyen is, ad xedmen, degs, cceôô. Ad iâaddi fellas Wawal, a p Nhudd wakali.

ayahs.text: Acêal n tsuta ay Nesqucc, deffir Nuê! Ad Iqadd Mass ik, i tussna akked tmeéôiwt ibekkaven n imdanen iS.
ayahs.translation: Acêal n tsuta ay Nesqucc, deffir Nuê! Ad Iqadd Mass ik, i tussna akked tmeéôiwt ibekkaven n imdanen iS.

ayahs.text: Win ib$an taêemmaqt, Nezzazzal as degs, i £ ihwan, i win i £ Neb$a. Sinna, Nerra yas Loahennama ad din iô$, indell, ippuveggeô.
ayahs.translation: Win ib$an taêemmaqt, Nezzazzal as degs, i £ ihwan, i win i £ Neb$a. Sinna, Nerra yas Loahennama ad din iô$, indell, ippuveggeô.

ayahs.text: Win ib$an laxeôt, iaâzem fellas yal laâzem, u neppa iumen; widak, tajmilt i laâzem nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Win ib$an laxeôt, iaâzem fellas yal laâzem, u neppa iumen; widak, tajmilt i laâzem nnsen.

ayahs.text: I akw, i wigi d wiyav, Nwessaâ tikci s$uô Mass ik. Tikci n Mass ik, ur meêdudet.
ayahs.translation: I akw, i wigi d wiyav, Nwessaâ tikci s$uô Mass ik. Tikci n Mass ik, ur meêdudet.

ayahs.text: Wali amek Nesmenyaf kra i wiyav. War ccekk, di laxeôt, lfeôq d usmenyef, ad ilin sennig waya.
ayahs.translation: Wali amek Nesmenyaf kra i wiyav. War ccekk, di laxeôt, lfeôq d usmenyef, ad ilin sennig waya.

ayahs.text: Ur sâu, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, mulac a ppu$alev d imdelli, d imveggaâ.
ayahs.translation: Ur sâu, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, mulac a ppu$alev d imdelli, d imveggaâ.

ayahs.text: Iseyya d Mass ik: ur tâabdem siwa Neppa, elhut ar imawlan. Ma, $uôek wesser yiwen, ne$ ma wessren i sin, ur asen qqaô: "ttfuh"! Ur ten ppara. Mmeslay asen s lkyasa.
ayahs.translation: Iseyya d Mass ik: ur tâabdem siwa Neppa, elhut ar imawlan. Ma, $uôek wesser yiwen, ne$ ma wessren i sin, ur asen qqaô: "ttfuh"! Ur ten ppara. Mmeslay asen s lkyasa.

ayahs.text: Zger fellasen tacvat n lmaênana. Ini: "a Mass iw! Ëun fellasen, akken iyi d ssekren d amejtuê".
ayahs.translation: Zger fellasen tacvat n lmaênana. Ini: "a Mass iw! Ëun fellasen, akken iyi d ssekren d amejtuê".

ayahs.text: Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Issen, i illan deg iman nnwen. Ma telham, Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê wid isteôoiâen.
ayahs.translation: Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Issen, i illan deg iman nnwen. Ma telham, Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê wid isteôoiâen.

ayahs.text: Efk i llezm ik amur is, akw i ume$bun akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Ur pjeggiê d ajeggeê.
ayahs.translation: Efk i llezm ik amur is, akw i ume$bun akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Ur pjeggiê d ajeggeê.

ayahs.text: Ijeggaêen, s tidep, d atmaten n Cciîan. Cciîan ijhel ar Mass is.
ayahs.translation: Ijeggaêen, s tidep, d atmaten n Cciîan. Cciîan ijhel ar Mass is.

ayahs.text: Ma tfuôqev ten, tôe$bev u tegguniv aêunu s$uô Mass ik, ini yasen awal aéidan.
ayahs.translation: Ma tfuôqev ten, tôe$bev u tegguniv aêunu s$uô Mass ik, ini yasen awal aéidan.

ayahs.text: Ur pcuddu afus ik ar yiri k, ur as berru aîas, mulac a ppu$alev d ambaûi, d ame$bun.
ayahs.translation: Ur pcuddu afus ik ar yiri k, ur as berru aîas, mulac a ppu$alev d ambaûi, d ame$bun.

ayahs.text: S tidep, Mass ik I$ennu win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali, Issen imdanen iS.
ayahs.translation: S tidep, Mass ik I$ennu win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali, Issen imdanen iS.

ayahs.text: Ur Neqqet arraw nnwen, ma tugadem tiggulelt. D Nekwni ara ten Iôezqen, kunwi yidsen. Ih, timen$iwt nnsen d tucmip meqqwôen.
ayahs.translation: Ur Neqqet arraw nnwen, ma tugadem tiggulelt. D Nekwni ara ten Iôezqen, kunwi yidsen. Ih, timen$iwt nnsen d tucmip meqqwôen.

ayahs.text: Ur zennut, d ayen n dir, d abrid ucmit.
ayahs.translation: Ur zennut, d ayen n dir, d abrid ucmit.

ayahs.text: Ur neqqet amdan i wen Igdel Öebbi, siwa ma di tidep. Win ipwan$an s le$deô, ihi, a Nefk adabu i walag is. Ur ipjuôôu di tmen$iwt, ihi, neppa, ad ippusellek.
ayahs.translation: Ur neqqet amdan i wen Igdel Öebbi, siwa ma di tidep. Win ipwan$an s le$deô, ihi, a Nefk adabu i walag is. Ur ipjuôôu di tmen$iwt, ihi, neppa, ad ippusellek.

ayahs.text: Ur pnalet ayla ugujil, siwa ar wayen imaânen, ar d immeêtel. Qadôet lemâahda; ih, lemâahda s usteqsi.
ayahs.translation: Ur pnalet ayla ugujil, siwa ar wayen imaânen, ar d immeêtel. Qadôet lemâahda; ih, lemâahda s usteqsi.

ayahs.text: Qadôet lkil ma tektalem, weznet s lmizan imaânen. Yif it wakka, a ppelhu taggara.
ayahs.translation: Qadôet lkil ma tektalem, weznet s lmizan imaânen. Yif it wakka, a ppelhu taggara.

ayahs.text: Ur îîafaô ayen ur tessinev. Timejjin, iéôi, ul, s tidep, ad ppuseqsin akw.
ayahs.translation: Ur îîafaô ayen ur tessinev. Timejjin, iéôi, ul, s tidep, ad ppuseqsin akw.

ayahs.text: Ur teddu di tmurt, d amzuxxi. Ih, keçç ur tezmirev, d awez$i, a pneqôev tamurt, ne$ a ppessiwvev laâli idurar.
ayahs.translation: Ur teddu di tmurt, d amzuxxi. Ih, keçç ur tezmirev, d awez$i, a pneqôev tamurt, ne$ a ppessiwvev laâli idurar.

ayahs.text: Adiran, deg waya akw, Ikerh it Mass ik.
ayahs.translation: Adiran, deg waya akw, Ikerh it Mass ik.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, seg wayen i k Iweêêa Mass ik, n ûûwab. Ur ppara, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, mulac a ppepwaveggôev ar Loahennama d ambaûi, d amnafeq.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, seg wayen i k Iweêêa Mass ik, n ûûwab. Ur ppara, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, mulac a ppepwaveggôev ar Loahennama d ambaûi, d amnafeq.

ayahs.text: Day wen d Ifren Mass nnwen arrac, u Iddem, i iman iS, tullas, si lmalayek? S tidep, kunwi tegrem d awal anecilat.
ayahs.translation: Day wen d Ifren Mass nnwen arrac, u Iddem, i iman iS, tullas, si lmalayek? S tidep, kunwi tegrem d awal anecilat.

ayahs.text: Ih, ay d Nebbwi di Leqwôan agi, iwakken a d mmektin. I yasen d irna, siwa a$unfu.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ay d Nebbwi di Leqwôan agi, iwakken a d mmektin. I yasen d irna, siwa a$unfu.

ayahs.text: Ini: "lemmer llin yides iôebbiten, akken la d qqaôen, yili ad nadin abrid ara ten iawin ar n Bab n usgeld".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "lemmer llin yides iôebbiten, akken la d qqaôen, yili ad nadin abrid ara ten iawin ar n Bab n usgeld".

ayahs.text: Gedha s yiS, aîas i Aâlay sennig wayen d qqaôen!
ayahs.translation: Gedha s yiS, aîas i Aâlay sennig wayen d qqaôen!

ayahs.text: Ppanzen aS igenwan di ûa, tamurt, u wayen illan degsen. Ur illi wayen ur aS neppanez, ur T Nesbuccuâ s ccekôan. Maca, ur tfehmem ara annuz nnsen. Ih, Neppa Iêellem, Ipsemmiê.
ayahs.translation: Ppanzen aS igenwan di ûa, tamurt, u wayen illan degsen. Ur illi wayen ur aS neppanez, ur T Nesbuccuâ s ccekôan. Maca, ur tfehmem ara annuz nnsen. Ih, Neppa Iêellem, Ipsemmiê.

ayahs.text: Mara teqqaôev Leqwôan, Neppara, garak d wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, aêurrim abavni.
ayahs.translation: Mara teqqaôev Leqwôan, Neppara, garak d wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, aêurrim abavni.

ayahs.text: Nerra $ef ulawen nnsen ssteô, iwakken ur t fehmen; di tmejjin nnsen, tiâéegt. Ma tesmektiv d, di Leqwôan, Mass ik d Yiwen, ad zzin akin, s u$unfu.
ayahs.translation: Nerra $ef ulawen nnsen ssteô, iwakken ur t fehmen; di tmejjin nnsen, tiâéegt. Ma tesmektiv d, di Leqwôan, Mass ik d Yiwen, ad zzin akin, s u$unfu.

ayahs.text: Nekwni, Nif akw akken Neéôa, acu iwumi sellen, mara k ssemêasen, mara hedôen, mi qqaôen imednas: "la teppeddum kan d urgaz iwumi sseêren".
