verses.translation: A ppâaggen i wid innan: "Öebbi Isâa mmi S".

verses.text: Ur illi wayen ssnen fellas; akken, imezwura nnsen. D awal uqbiê id iff$en seg imawen nnsen. D tikerkas kan ay ssawalen.
verses.translation: Ur illi wayen ssnen fellas; akken, imezwura nnsen. D awal uqbiê id iff$en seg imawen nnsen. D tikerkas kan ay ssawalen.

verses.text: Ahat a phelkev iman ik, ar loiha nnsen, a p$weblev, imi ur uminen ara s usali agi?
verses.translation: Ahat a phelkev iman ik, ar loiha nnsen, a p$weblev, imi ur uminen ara s usali agi?

verses.text: Ni$ Nerra i illan di tmurt, d ccbaêa ines, iwakken a Néeô menyif iten, ar igiten ilhan.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nerra i illan di tmurt, d ccbaêa ines, iwakken a Néeô menyif iten, ar igiten ilhan.

verses.text: A Nu$al a Nerr, i illan degs, d akal ibuôen.
verses.translation: A Nu$al a Nerr, i illan degs, d akal ibuôen.

verses.text: Ne$ t$ilev d At yifri kan, akked Öaqim, ay d lwehma, ger issekniyen nne£?
verses.translation: Ne$ t$ilev d At yifri kan, akked Öaqim, ay d lwehma, ger issekniyen nne£?

verses.text: Mi ssôen iman nnsen ilmeéiyen deg ifri, nnan: "a Mass nne$! Efk ane$ d aêunu s$uôeK; Err a$ lameô nne$ d uûwib".
verses.translation: Mi ssôen iman nnsen ilmeéiyen deg ifri, nnan: "a Mass nne$! Efk ane$ d aêunu s$uôeK; Err a$ lameô nne$ d uûwib".

verses.text: Deg ifri, Nesle$ imeééu$en nnsen, acêal iseggwasen.
verses.translation: Deg ifri, Nesle$ imeééu$en nnsen, acêal iseggwasen.

verses.text: Sinna, Nessker iten id, a Néeô anta, ger snat n trebbuyaâ, i iêesben acêal qqimen.
verses.translation: Sinna, Nessker iten id, a Néeô anta, ger snat n trebbuyaâ, i iêesben acêal qqimen.

verses.text: Nekwni, ad ak Neêku, s tidep, taqsiî nnsen. Nitni, ih, d ilmeéiyen, umnen s Mass nnsen. Nerna yasen nnhaya.
verses.translation: Nekwni, ad ak Neêku, s tidep, taqsiî nnsen. Nitni, ih, d ilmeéiyen, umnen s Mass nnsen. Nerna yasen nnhaya.

verses.text: Nesseohed ulawen nnsen, mi kren nnan: "Mass nne$ d Mass n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur nepnuju, d awez$i, ar ôebbi, war Neppa, mulac a d nini awal dduni.
verses.translation: Nesseohed ulawen nnsen, mi kren nnan: "Mass nne$ d Mass n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur nepnuju, d awez$i, ar ôebbi, war Neppa, mulac a d nini awal dduni.

verses.text: Widak d agdud nne$. Âabden iôebbiten, war Neppa. Ay$eô ur a$ d bbwin, fellasen, adabu n ûûeê? Anwa i idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi?
verses.translation: Widak d agdud nne$. Âabden iôebbiten, war Neppa. Ay$eô ur a$ d bbwin, fellasen, adabu n ûûeê? Anwa i idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi?

verses.text: Mi ten tfuôqem, nitni akked wayen âabden war Öebbi, essôet iman nwen deg ifri. Ad awen Izraâ, Mass nnwen, seg uêunu S. Ad awen Iheggi amwanes i lameô nnwen".
verses.translation: Mi ten tfuôqem, nitni akked wayen âabden war Öebbi, essôet iman nwen deg ifri. Ad awen Izraâ, Mass nnwen, seg uêunu S. Ad awen Iheggi amwanes i lameô nnwen".

verses.text: A pwaliv iîij, mi d inqeô, iwexxeô i ifri nnsen, ar yeffus. Mi i$li, ad asen iâaddi $eô zelmev. Nitni, din, di littsaâ. Ayagi seg issekniyen n Öebbi. Win Inha Öebbi, neppa ipwanha; win Itlef, ur isâi, d awez$i, bab ara t inhun.
verses.translation: A pwaliv iîij, mi d inqeô, iwexxeô i ifri nnsen, ar yeffus. Mi i$li, ad asen iâaddi $eô zelmev. Nitni, din, di littsaâ. Ayagi seg issekniyen n Öebbi. Win Inha Öebbi, neppa ipwanha; win Itlef, ur isâi, d awez$i, bab ara t inhun.

verses.text: Ad as tiniv ukin, nitni îîsen. Ntezzi ten yeffus, zelmev. Aydi nnsen, $ef umnaô, iééel ivaôen is. Lemmer a ten twaliv, ad asen trewlev, si tugdi; a k terkeb, segsen, lefqaâ.
verses.translation: Ad as tiniv ukin, nitni îîsen. Ntezzi ten yeffus, zelmev. Aydi nnsen, $ef umnaô, iééel ivaôen is. Lemmer a ten twaliv, ad asen trewlev, si tugdi; a k terkeb, segsen, lefqaâ.

verses.text: Akka ay ten id Nessenker, iwakken ad mesteqsin. Inna yiwen segsen: "acêal n lweqt ay tesâaddam"? Nnan d: "nesâadda ass ne$ ur ibbwiv wass". Nnan: "Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Izôa ay tesâaddam. Aznet ar temdint, yiwen segwen, s idrimen agi nnwen. Ad iwali anwa lqut iûfan mavi, ad awen d iawi ôôeéq, segs. Ad iêader iman is, iwakken ur awen ipfaq yiwen.
verses.translation: Akka ay ten id Nessenker, iwakken ad mesteqsin. Inna yiwen segsen: "acêal n lweqt ay tesâaddam"? Nnan d: "nesâadda ass ne$ ur ibbwiv wass". Nnan: "Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Izôa ay tesâaddam. Aznet ar temdint, yiwen segwen, s idrimen agi nnwen. Ad iwali anwa lqut iûfan mavi, ad awen d iawi ôôeéq, segs. Ad iêader iman is, iwakken ur awen ipfaq yiwen.

verses.text: Nitni, war ccekk, ma éôan kwen, a kwen ôeomen, ne$ a kwen rren ar ddin nnsen, d$a ur trebêen, d awez$i".
verses.translation: Nitni, war ccekk, ma éôan kwen, a kwen ôeomen, ne$ a kwen rren ar ddin nnsen, d$a ur trebêen, d awez$i".

verses.text: Akka ay sen ten Nessken, iwakken ad éôen ar lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep; u, $ef yimir, ur illi ccekk. Mi mqellaân $ef lameô nnsen, nnan: "bnut axxam sennig sen. Mass nnsen Yif akw akken iten Issen". Nnan wid iwumi iâadda wawal, $ef lameô nnsen: "a nerr, ihi, lemqam sennig sen".
verses.translation: Akka ay sen ten Nessken, iwakken ad éôen ar lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep; u, $ef yimir, ur illi ccekk. Mi mqellaân $ef lameô nnsen, nnan: "bnut axxam sennig sen. Mass nnsen Yif akw akken iten Issen". Nnan wid iwumi iâadda wawal, $ef lameô nnsen: "a nerr, ihi, lemqam sennig sen".

verses.text: Ad inin: "di krav yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis kué"; u ad inin: "di semus yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis sdis", pqelliben tabavnit. U ad inin: "di ûa yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis îam". Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Iéôa amvan nnsen. Drus kan i t iéôan". Ur pnamar fellasen, siwa $ef wayen id ivehôen. Ur ppesteqsay yiwen fellasen.
verses.translation: Ad inin: "di krav yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis kué"; u ad inin: "di semus yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis sdis", pqelliben tabavnit. U ad inin: "di ûa yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis îam". Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Iéôa amvan nnsen. Drus kan i t iéôan". Ur pnamar fellasen, siwa $ef wayen id ivehôen. Ur ppesteqsay yiwen fellasen.

verses.text: Ur qqaô ta$awsa a p xedme$, s tidep, azekka,
verses.translation: Ur qqaô ta$awsa a p xedme$, s tidep, azekka,

verses.text: siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Mmekti d Mass ik, ma teppuv. Ini: "amar ad iyi Inhu Mass iw, ar wayen yifen ayagi di ûûwab".
verses.translation: siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Mmekti d Mass ik, ma teppuv. Ini: "amar ad iyi Inhu Mass iw, ar wayen yifen ayagi di ûûwab".

verses.text: Sâaddan, deg ifri nnsen, krav twinas iseggwasen, rnan tza nniven.
verses.translation: Sâaddan, deg ifri nnsen, krav twinas iseggwasen, rnan tza nniven.

verses.text: Ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa, acêal sâaddan. IneS tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Amek Neppa Ipwali, Isell! Ur sâin bab, war Neppa. Ur Izdukkul yiwen i useyyi S".
verses.translation: Ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa, acêal sâaddan. IneS tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Amek Neppa Ipwali, Isell! Ur sâin bab, war Neppa. Ur Izdukkul yiwen i useyyi S".

verses.text: Mel ayen ik ed ippuweêêan, si Tezmamt n Mass ik. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Ur teppafev ssôan, war Neppa, d awez$i.
verses.translation: Mel ayen ik ed ippuweêêan, si Tezmamt n Mass ik. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Ur teppafev ssôan, war Neppa, d awez$i.

verses.text: Üebbeô iman ik, akked wid ipnujun ar Mass nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit, pnadin udem iS. Ur ten tekkes si ger wallen ik, a pvemâav lefnun n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ur ssemêas i win iwumi Nesse$fel ul is, ar usmekti nne£, i iddan d lhawiyya s, iwumi iffuhri lameô.
verses.translation: Üebbeô iman ik, akked wid ipnujun ar Mass nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit, pnadin udem iS. Ur ten tekkes si ger wallen ik, a pvemâav lefnun n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ur ssemêas i win iwumi Nesse$fel ul is, ar usmekti nne£, i iddan d lhawiyya s, iwumi iffuhri lameô.

verses.text: Ini: "tidep s$uô Mass nnwen. Ad iamen win ib$an, ad ijhel win ib$an". Ih, Nhegga d times, i imednas; ad asen zzin iêeoouoa s. Ma ppren d, ad asen ppunefken waman am uzzal ifsin. Ad cwin wudmawen nnsen. A tissit tamcumt, a tanezdu$t tucmip!
verses.translation: Ini: "tidep s$uô Mass nnwen. Ad iamen win ib$an, ad ijhel win ib$an". Ih, Nhegga d times, i imednas; ad asen zzin iêeoouoa s. Ma ppren d, ad asen ppunefken waman am uzzal ifsin. Ad cwin wudmawen nnsen. A tissit tamcumt, a tanezdu$t tucmip!

verses.text: Ih, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, s tidep, ur Nveggiâ akafi n win ixedmen ayen ilhan.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, s tidep, ur Nveggiâ akafi n win ixedmen ayen ilhan.

verses.text: I wigi, leonanat n Âaden, ddaw sen isaffen ppazzalen. Ad qqnen, dinna, imeqyasen n ddheb, ad lsen iceîîiven izegzawen n leêrir, êewcen s ddheb. Ad élen, degs, $ef imîeôêen izewwqen. A lebsa lâali, a tanezdu$t tumâint!
verses.translation: I wigi, leonanat n Âaden, ddaw sen isaffen ppazzalen. Ad qqnen, dinna, imeqyasen n ddheb, ad lsen iceîîiven izegzawen n leêrir, êewcen s ddheb. Ad élen, degs, $ef imîeôêen izewwqen. A lebsa lâali, a tanezdu$t tumâint!

verses.text: Awi yasen d amedya n sin irgazen. I yiwen, Nefka snat tebêirin n téuôin, Nezzi yasent tizdayin, Nerra iger garasent.
verses.translation: Awi yasen d amedya n sin irgazen. I yiwen, Nefka snat tebêirin n téuôin, Nezzi yasent tizdayin, Nerra iger garasent.

verses.text: Yal tibêirt teppak ed l$ella s, ur ipxuûûu, segs, wacemma. Nesfeggev asif garasent.
verses.translation: Yal tibêirt teppak ed l$ella s, ur ipxuûûu, segs, wacemma. Nesfeggev asif garasent.

verses.text: I$ellet ed ppemôa. Inna i umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "$elbe$ k taôkunt, iffe$ k alag".
verses.translation: I$ellet ed ppemôa. Inna i umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "$elbe$ k taôkunt, iffe$ k alag".

verses.text: Idens iman is mi ikcem leonan is, inna: "ur cukke$ ara, d awez$i, ad iqucc wayagi.
verses.translation: Idens iman is mi ikcem leonan is, inna: "ur cukke$ ara, d awez$i, ad iqucc wayagi.

verses.text: Ur cukke$ ara ad yili yimir, u ma bbwve$ ar Mass iw, ard affe$, war ccekk, ayen yifen aya, deg umekkan is".
verses.translation: Ur cukke$ ara ad yili yimir, u ma bbwve$ ar Mass iw, ard affe$, war ccekk, ayen yifen aya, deg umekkan is".

verses.text: Inna yas umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "day tnekôev Win ik Ixelqen seg wakal, sinna, si tiqqit, sinna, Imessel ik d argaz?
verses.translation: Inna yas umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "day tnekôev Win ik Ixelqen seg wakal, sinna, si tiqqit, sinna, Imessel ik d argaz?

verses.text: Maca, Neppa d Öebbi, Mass iw. Ur pcarake$ yiwen, i Mass iw.
verses.translation: Maca, Neppa d Öebbi, Mass iw. Ur pcarake$ yiwen, i Mass iw.

verses.text: Lemmer id tenniv, mi tkecmev ar tebêirt ik: akken Irad Öebbi. Ur telli tezmert siwa s$uô Öebbi. Ma twalav iyi d, nek, tifev iyi ayla, tarwa,
verses.translation: Lemmer id tenniv, mi tkecmev ar tebêirt ik: akken Irad Öebbi. Ur telli tezmert siwa s$uô Öebbi. Ma twalav iyi d, nek, tifev iyi ayla, tarwa,

verses.text: Izmer Mass iw ad iyi d Ifk ayen i ifen tibêirt ik. A d Iazen $uôes ssxev, seg igenni, a ppu$al d aêecraruf issiccigen;
verses.translation: Izmer Mass iw ad iyi d Ifk ayen i ifen tibêirt ik. A d Iazen $uôes ssxev, seg igenni, a ppu$al d aêecraruf issiccigen;

verses.text: ne$, ad zzren waman is, ur ten teppafev, d awez$i".
verses.translation: ne$, ad zzren waman is, ur ten teppafev, d awez$i".

verses.text: Tqucc l$ella s. D$a la izeyyeô ifassen is, $ef wayen iseôôef fellas. Tqucc tfeôôant is. Inna: "a yamxix iw, a lemmer ur curke$ yiwen, i Mass iw"!
verses.translation: Tqucc l$ella s. D$a la izeyyeô ifassen is, $ef wayen iseôôef fellas. Tqucc tfeôôant is. Inna: "a yamxix iw, a lemmer ur curke$ yiwen, i Mass iw"!

verses.text: Ur as illi urbaâ ara t isellken, war Öebbi. Ur isellek iman is.
verses.translation: Ur as illi urbaâ ara t isellken, war Öebbi. Ur isellek iman is.

verses.text: Akka, laânaya s$uô Öebbi, Tidep. Yif akw i ukafi, Yif akw i taggara.
verses.translation: Akka, laânaya s$uô Öebbi, Tidep. Yif akw i ukafi, Yif akw i taggara.

verses.text: Awi yasen d amedya n tmeddurt n ddunit. Am aman id Nesse$li seg igenni. Eâluâlen yissen im$an n tmurt. D$a u$alen d asa$uô, issebruzzaâ iten wavu. Ni$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Awi yasen d amedya n tmeddurt n ddunit. Am aman id Nesse$li seg igenni. Eâluâlen yissen im$an n tmurt. D$a u$alen d asa$uô, issebruzzaâ iten wavu. Ni$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ayla akked dderya d ccbaêa n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ar Mass ik, leûlaê idumen ifen ten i ukafi, ifen ten i tmeôoiwt.
verses.translation: Ayla akked dderya d ccbaêa n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ar Mass ik, leûlaê idumen ifen ten i ukafi, ifen ten i tmeôoiwt.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara Nesselêu idurar, a pwaliv tamurt d aza$aô. A ten Nefser, ur Neppaoa yiwen segsen.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara Nesselêu idurar, a pwaliv tamurt d aza$aô. A ten Nefser, ur Neppaoa yiwen segsen.

verses.text: A d rsen zdat Mass ik, d leûfuf: "ni$ tusam a£ d, akken ikwen Nexleq tikelt tamenzut. Irna tetebbtem ar ur awen Neppara ppaâud, d awez$i".
verses.translation: A d rsen zdat Mass ik, d leûfuf: "ni$ tusam a£ d, akken ikwen Nexleq tikelt tamenzut. Irna tetebbtem ar ur awen Neppara ppaâud, d awez$i".

verses.text: Ters ed Tezmamt. A pwaliv ibe$wviyen s uêebbiô, $ef wayen illan degs. Qqaôen: "a yamxix nne$! Acimi tazmamt agi ur teooi ayen meééiyen, u wayen meqqwôen, armi ten teêseb"? Ufan illa wayen xedmen. Mass ik ur Idennis yiwen.
verses.translation: Ters ed Tezmamt. A pwaliv ibe$wviyen s uêebbiô, $ef wayen illan degs. Qqaôen: "a yamxix nne$! Acimi tazmamt agi ur teooi ayen meééiyen, u wayen meqqwôen, armi ten teêseb"? Ufan illa wayen xedmen. Mass ik ur Idennis yiwen.

verses.text: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem", knant, siwa Iblis. Neppa, si leonun, iaâûa lameô n Mass is. Day a ten terrem, neppa akked tarwa s, d imawlan, war Nek? U nitni d icenga nnwen! D abdil ucmit n imednas.
verses.translation: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem", knant, siwa Iblis. Neppa, si leonun, iaâûa lameô n Mass is. Day a ten terrem, neppa akked tarwa s, d imawlan, war Nek? U nitni d icenga nnwen! D abdil ucmit n imednas.

verses.text: Ur ten Rri$ d inagan n lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, ne$ n lxelq nnsen. Ur Ïîife$ im$eôôqen d imâiwnen.
verses.translation: Ur ten Rri$ d inagan n lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, ne$ n lxelq nnsen. Ur Ïîife$ im$eôôqen d imâiwnen.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara d Yini: "neccdet wid iyI terram d icriken iW". Ad asen siwlen, ur asen d pparan. Nerra, garasen, asif n twa$it.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara d Yini: "neccdet wid iyI terram d icriken iW". Ad asen siwlen, ur asen d pparan. Nerra, garasen, asif n twa$it.

verses.text: Ibe$wviyen ad walin times. ÊëËûan ar nitni, degs, ara $lin. Ur ppafen, segs, tisensert.
verses.translation: Ibe$wviyen ad walin times. ÊëËûan ar nitni, degs, ara $lin. Ur ppafen, segs, tisensert.

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka d, di Leqwôan agi, yal amedya, i imdanen. Maca, ipnamar umdan sennig akw.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka d, di Leqwôan agi, yal amedya, i imdanen. Maca, ipnamar umdan sennig akw.

verses.text: D acu i iîîfen imdanen ad amnen, mi ten id tusa nnhaya, u ad ste$fôen Mass nnsen? Ar ten id tas kan, tin ivôan d imezwura, ne$ ar d irs, zdat sen, uâaqeb?
verses.translation: D acu i iîîfen imdanen ad amnen, mi ten id tusa nnhaya, u ad ste$fôen Mass nnsen? Ar ten id tas kan, tin ivôan d imezwura, ne$ ar d irs, zdat sen, uâaqeb?

verses.text: Ur Neppazen imazanen, siwa i ubecceô d uneddeô. Wid ijehlen pnamaren, s tkerkas, îîeggiôen yissent tidep. Pmaâliken $ef issekniyen iW, akked wayen i$ef ppunedôen.
verses.translation: Ur Neppazen imazanen, siwa i ubecceô d uneddeô. Wid ijehlen pnamaren, s tkerkas, îîeggiôen yissent tidep. Pmaâliken $ef issekniyen iW, akked wayen i$ef ppunedôen.

verses.text: Anwa idensen sennig win iwumi d pwafekkôen issekniyen n Mass is, iwexxeô asen, u ippu i ixdem ufus is. Ih, Nerra aêurrim $ef wulawen nnsen, ur t fehhmen; akked tiâéegt deg imeééu$en nnsen. Ma tneccdev ten ar nnhaya, ur pwanhan, d awez$i.
verses.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win iwumi d pwafekkôen issekniyen n Mass is, iwexxeô asen, u ippu i ixdem ufus is. Ih, Nerra aêurrim $ef wulawen nnsen, ur t fehhmen; akked tiâéegt deg imeééu$en nnsen. Ma tneccdev ten ar nnhaya, ur pwanhan, d awez$i.

verses.text: Mass ik Ipsemmiêen, d Bab uêunu. Lemmer ad Iêud fellasen ilmend n wayen kesben, ad I$iwel ar uâaqeb nnsen. Maca, sâan ppaâud, ur ppafen segs tisensert.
verses.translation: Mass ik Ipsemmiêen, d Bab uêunu. Lemmer ad Iêud fellasen ilmend n wayen kesben, ad I$iwel ar uâaqeb nnsen. Maca, sâan ppaâud, ur ppafen segs tisensert.

verses.text: Timdinin nni i Nesqucc mi densent, Nga ppaâud i usquccu nnsent.
verses.translation: Timdinin nni i Nesqucc mi densent, Nga ppaâud i usquccu nnsent.

verses.text: Mi inna Musa i uqeddac is: "ur êebbse$ alamma bbwve$ ar umlili n sin ilellen, xas ad sâaddi$ tallit".
verses.translation: Mi inna Musa i uqeddac is: "ur êebbse$ alamma bbwve$ ar umlili n sin ilellen, xas ad sâaddi$ tallit".

verses.text: Mi bbwven ar umlili nnsen, ppun aslem nnsen. Iu$al ar yill d ilelli.
verses.translation: Mi bbwven ar umlili nnsen, ppun aslem nnsen. Iu$al ar yill d ilelli.

verses.text: Mi zegren, inna i uqeddac is: "awi a$ d imekli nne$, ni$ naâteb deg inig nne$ agi".
verses.translation: Mi zegren, inna i uqeddac is: "awi a$ d imekli nne$, ni$ naâteb deg inig nne$ agi".

verses.text: Inna: "ur twalav ara, mi nreyyeê ar teéôut, nek ppu$ en aslem? D Cciîan kan iyi isseppun ur ak nni$. Ibbwi abrid is ar yill, d lwehma"!
verses.translation: Inna: "ur twalav ara, mi nreyyeê ar teéôut, nek ppu$ en aslem? D Cciîan kan iyi isseppun ur ak nni$. Ibbwi abrid is ar yill, d lwehma"!

verses.text: Inna: "d ayagi ay neb$a". D$a u$alen d $ef isurifen nnsen.
verses.translation: Inna: "d ayagi ay neb$a". D$a u$alen d $ef isurifen nnsen.

verses.text: Ufan d amdan seg imdanen nne£, iwumi Nefka aêunu s$uône£. Neslemd as tussna i illan $uône£.
verses.translation: Ufan d amdan seg imdanen nne£, iwumi Nefka aêunu s$uône£. Neslemd as tussna i illan $uône£.

verses.text: Inna yas Musa: "Ma ad ddu$ yidek, ad iyi tesêefvev ay tesnev n ûûwab"?
verses.translation: Inna yas Musa: "Ma ad ddu$ yidek, ad iyi tesêefvev ay tesnev n ûûwab"?

verses.text: Inna d: "keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev.
verses.translation: Inna d: "keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev.

verses.text: Amek ara tûebôev i wayen i$ef ur tesâiv asali"?
verses.translation: Amek ara tûebôev i wayen i$ef ur tesâiv asali"?

verses.text: Inna: "ad iyi tafev, ma Irad Öebbi, d aûebôi. Ur pnaqwame$ lameô ik".
verses.translation: Inna: "ad iyi tafev, ma Irad Öebbi, d aûebôi. Ur pnaqwame$ lameô ik".

verses.text: Inna: "ma teddiv yidi, ur iyi d steqsay $ef wacemma, alamma smekti$ k id fellas".
verses.translation: Inna: "ma teddiv yidi, ur iyi d steqsay $ef wacemma, alamma smekti$ k id fellas".

verses.text: Lêan, armi rekben di lbabuô. Ixeôq it. Inna: "txeôqev t, iwakken ad $evûen l$aci s! Ni$ ayen txedmev d dduni".
verses.translation: Lêan, armi rekben di lbabuô. Ixeôq it. Inna: "txeôqev t, iwakken ad $evûen l$aci s! Ni$ ayen txedmev d dduni".

verses.text: Inna: "day ur ak nni$ ara, keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev, d awez$i"?
verses.translation: Inna: "day ur ak nni$ ara, keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev, d awez$i"?

verses.text: Inna: "ur iyi pqasa imi ppu$, ur ssukku lwaâôan $ef lameô iw".
verses.translation: Inna: "ur iyi pqasa imi ppu$, ur ssukku lwaâôan $ef lameô iw".

verses.text: Lêan, armi d mmugren ileméi. In$a t. Inna: "ten$iv amdan ur nen$i yiwen! Ni$ d ayen idensen ay txedmev".
verses.translation: Lêan, armi d mmugren ileméi. In$a t. Inna: "ten$iv amdan ur nen$i yiwen! Ni$ d ayen idensen ay txedmev".

verses.text: Inna: "day ur ak nni$ ara, keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev, d awez$i"?
verses.translation: Inna: "day ur ak nni$ ara, keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev, d awez$i"?

verses.text: Inna: "ma steqsa$ k $ef t$awsa, deffir ta, ur teddu yidi. Ni$ ssutre$ ak d ssmaê".
verses.translation: Inna: "ma steqsa$ k $ef t$awsa, deffir ta, ur teddu yidi. Ni$ ssutre$ ak d ssmaê".

verses.text: Lêan, armi bbwven ar imezda$ n yiwet n temdint, ssutren asen lqut. Ugin a ten snubgten. Ufan en lêiv, qôib ad i$li. Iûeggem it. Inna: "ma teb$iv, tzemrev a ppepwaxellûev $ef waya".
verses.translation: Lêan, armi bbwven ar imezda$ n yiwet n temdint, ssutren asen lqut. Ugin a ten snubgten. Ufan en lêiv, qôib ad i$li. Iûeggem it. Inna: "ma teb$iv, tzemrev a ppepwaxellûev $ef waya".

verses.text: Inna: "Tura a nemfaôaq. Ad ak d fke$ lmaâna n wayen i$ef ur tezmirev a pûebôev, d awez$i".
verses.translation: Inna: "Tura a nemfaôaq. Ad ak d fke$ lmaâna n wayen i$ef ur tezmirev a pûebôev, d awez$i".

verses.text: Lbabuô nni, n igellilen i ixedmen di yill. B$i$ a t ôée$, acku yiwen ugellid, deffir sen, itekkes yal lbabuô, s yi$il.
verses.translation: Lbabuô nni, n igellilen i ixedmen di yill. B$i$ a t ôée$, acku yiwen ugellid, deffir sen, itekkes yal lbabuô, s yi$il.

verses.text: Wanag ileméi nni, llan imawlan is d lmumnin. Nugad ad iêeppem fellasen tinufqa, tijehli.
verses.translation: Wanag ileméi nni, llan imawlan is d lmumnin. Nugad ad iêeppem fellasen tinufqa, tijehli.

verses.text: Neb$a ad asen d Irr, Mass nnsen, it yifen: win iûfan, iqeôben nezzeh aêunu.
verses.translation: Neb$a ad asen d Irr, Mass nnsen, it yifen: win iûfan, iqeôben nezzeh aêunu.

verses.text: Wanag lêiv, n sin warrac igujilen n temdint. Illa ugerruj seddaw as, i nitni. Babat sen d argaz ilhan. Mass ik Ib$a, ard im$uôen, ara d ssuff$en agerruj nnsen. D aêunu s$uô Mass ik. Ur t xdime$ s lameô iw. D tagi ay d lmaâna n wayen i$ef ur tezmiôev a pûebôev".
verses.translation: Wanag lêiv, n sin warrac igujilen n temdint. Illa ugerruj seddaw as, i nitni. Babat sen d argaz ilhan. Mass ik Ib$a, ard im$uôen, ara d ssuff$en agerruj nnsen. D aêunu s$uô Mass ik. Ur t xdime$ s lameô iw. D tagi ay d lmaâna n wayen i$ef ur tezmiôev a pûebôev".

verses.text: Steqsan k $ef Bu sin wacciwen. Ini: "ad awen d awi$, fellas, asmekti".
verses.translation: Steqsan k $ef Bu sin wacciwen. Ini: "ad awen d awi$, fellas, asmekti".

verses.text: S tidep, Nefka yas di tmurt, u Nsehhel as iberdan di yal cci.
verses.translation: S tidep, Nefka yas di tmurt, u Nsehhel as iberdan di yal cci.

verses.text: Iîîef yiwen n ubrid,
verses.translation: Iîîef yiwen n ubrid,

verses.text: armi sanda i$elli yiîij. Iufa i$elli $ef tala ilu$en. Iufa n $uôes agdud. Nenna: "a Bu sin wacciwen, âaqeb iten, ne$ lhu $uôsen".
verses.translation: armi sanda i$elli yiîij. Iufa i$elli $ef tala ilu$en. Iufa n $uôes agdud. Nenna: "a Bu sin wacciwen, âaqeb iten, ne$ lhu $uôsen".

verses.text: Inna: "win idensen a t nâaqeb, sinna, ad iu$al ar Mass is at Iâaqeb aâaqeb unekkaô.
verses.translation: Inna: "win idensen a t nâaqeb, sinna, ad iu$al ar Mass is at Iâaqeb aâaqeb unekkaô.

verses.text: Wanag i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, akafi igerzen. Ad as Nini i isehlen si lameô nne£".
verses.translation: Wanag i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, akafi igerzen. Ad as Nini i isehlen si lameô nne£".

verses.text: Sinna, ilêa d yiwen n ubrid,
verses.translation: Sinna, ilêa d yiwen n ubrid,

verses.text: armi sanda d ineqqeô yiîij. Iufa n ineqqeô ed $ef ugdud, iwumi ur Nefki ar at isdarin segs.
verses.translation: armi sanda d ineqqeô yiîij. Iufa n ineqqeô ed $ef ugdud, iwumi ur Nefki ar at isdarin segs.

verses.text: Am akka. Ni$ ibbwev a£ d akw usali s.
verses.translation: Am akka. Ni$ ibbwev a£ d akw usali s.

verses.text: Sinna, idda d yiwen n ubrid,
verses.translation: Sinna, idda d yiwen n ubrid,

verses.text: armi ibbwev ger sin iêdiden. Iufa, deffir sen, agdud qôib ur fehhmen awal.
verses.translation: armi ibbwev ger sin iêdiden. Iufa, deffir sen, agdud qôib ur fehhmen awal.

verses.text: Nnan: "a Bu sin wacciwen, s tidep, Iaouo akked Maouo la ssefsaden di tmurt. A k nxelleû ma terriv ûûuô garane$ yidsen".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a Bu sin wacciwen, s tidep, Iaouo akked Maouo la ssefsaden di tmurt. A k nxelleû ma terriv ûûuô garane$ yidsen".

verses.text: Inna: "yif it iyi Ifka Mass iw. Efket iyi afus, ad rre$ ûûuô garawen yidsen.
verses.translation: Inna: "yif it iyi Ifka Mass iw. Efket iyi afus, ad rre$ ûûuô garawen yidsen.

verses.text: Awit iyi d tiqaùmtin n wuzzal alamma irgel wayen illan ger idurar". Inna: "ûuvet alamma tekker degs tmes. Awit iyi d ad smire$ fellas nnêas ifsin".
verses.translation: Awit iyi d tiqaùmtin n wuzzal alamma irgel wayen illan ger idurar". Inna: "ûuvet alamma tekker degs tmes. Awit iyi d ad smire$ fellas nnêas ifsin".

verses.text: D$a ur zmiren a t id zegren, ur zmiren a t id flun.
verses.translation: D$a ur zmiren a t id zegren, ur zmiren a t id flun.

verses.text: Inna: "ayagi d aêunu s$uô Mass iw. Mi d tusa lemâahda n Mass iw, a t Isawi. Lemâahda n Mass iw d tidep".
verses.translation: Inna: "ayagi d aêunu s$uô Mass iw. Mi d tusa lemâahda n Mass iw, a t Isawi. Lemâahda n Mass iw d tidep".

verses.text: Assen, a ten Neoo ad ddehmen wa $ef wa. Aûuvu di lbuq, d$a a ten Nessemlil akw.
verses.translation: Assen, a ten Neoo ad ddehmen wa $ef wa. Aûuvu di lbuq, d$a a ten Nessemlil akw.

verses.text: A d Nessken nezzeh Loahennama, assen, i ijehliyen,
verses.translation: A d Nessken nezzeh Loahennama, assen, i ijehliyen,

verses.text: wid iwumi sêurrment wallen nnsen, mgal asmekti W. Llan ur zmiren i usemêes.
verses.translation: wid iwumi sêurrment wallen nnsen, mgal asmekti W. Llan ur zmiren i usemêes.

verses.text: Day $ilen, wid ijehlen, ad rren imdanen iW, d imawlan war Nek? Ih, Nhegga Loahennama, d axxam i ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Day $ilen, wid ijehlen, ad rren imdanen iW, d imawlan war Nek? Ih, Nhegga Loahennama, d axxam i ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ini: "ad awen mle$ at igiten imexsuôen sennig wiyav?
verses.translation: Ini: "ad awen mle$ at igiten imexsuôen sennig wiyav?

verses.text: Wid iwumi iweddeô laâtab nnsen di tmeddurt n ddunit, wanag nitni nwan gerzen igi"?
verses.translation: Wid iwumi iweddeô laâtab nnsen di tmeddurt n ddunit, wanag nitni nwan gerzen igi"?

verses.text: Widak d wid i inekôen issekniyen n Mass nnsen, akked temlilit yideS. Mêan igiten nnsen. Ur ten Nwezzen, ass n tnekra.
verses.translation: Widak d wid i inekôen issekniyen n Mass nnsen, akked temlilit yideS. Mêan igiten nnsen. Ur ten Nwezzen, ass n tnekra.

verses.text: Atan uqeîîi nnsen: Loahennama, imi jehlen, u mmaâlken deg issekniyen iW, akked imazanen iW.
verses.translation: Atan uqeîîi nnsen: Loahennama, imi jehlen, u mmaâlken deg issekniyen iW, akked imazanen iW.

verses.text: Ma d wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, axxam nnsen d leonanat n Loennet.
verses.translation: Ma d wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, axxam nnsen d leonanat n Loennet.

verses.text: Degs ad wekkôen, ur ssuturen ayen nniven.
verses.translation: Degs ad wekkôen, ur ssuturen ayen nniven.

verses.text: Ini: "lemmer ill d lmidad, i wawalen n Mass iw, ad iqqaô yill, uqbel ad fukken wawalen n Mass iw, xas a d nawi i t icban n lmidad".
verses.translation: Ini: "lemmer ill d lmidad, i wawalen n Mass iw, ad iqqaô yill, uqbel ad fukken wawalen n Mass iw, xas a d nawi i t icban n lmidad".

verses.text: Ini: "nek d amdan kan, am kunwi. Weêêan iyi d ar Öebbi nnwen, d Öebbi Yiwen. Win issaramen timlilit n Mass is, ad ixdem ayen ilhan, ur ipcarak yiwen deg waâbad n Mass is".
verses.translation: Ini: "nek d amdan kan, am kunwi. Weêêan iyi d ar Öebbi nnwen, d Öebbi Yiwen. Win issaramen timlilit n Mass is, ad ixdem ayen ilhan, ur ipcarak yiwen deg waâbad n Mass is".

ayahs.text: Ccekôan i Öebbi, id Issersen Tazmamt, i uxdim iS. Aâwaj, degs, ur Irri.
ayahs.translation: Ccekôan i Öebbi, id Issersen Tazmamt, i uxdim iS. Aâwaj, degs, ur Irri.

ayahs.text: Tewqem, iwakken a ppâaggen $ef ssxev uwâiô, s$uôeS; u a pbecceô lmumnin ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar nnsen warraz igerzen.
ayahs.translation: Tewqem, iwakken a ppâaggen $ef ssxev uwâiô, s$uôeS; u a pbecceô lmumnin ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar nnsen warraz igerzen.

ayahs.text: Ad ilin degs, i lebda.
ayahs.translation: Ad ilin degs, i lebda.

ayahs.text: A ppâaggen i wid innan: "Öebbi Isâa mmi S".
ayahs.translation: A ppâaggen i wid innan: "Öebbi Isâa mmi S".

ayahs.text: Ur illi wayen ssnen fellas; akken, imezwura nnsen. D awal uqbiê id iff$en seg imawen nnsen. D tikerkas kan ay ssawalen.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi wayen ssnen fellas; akken, imezwura nnsen. D awal uqbiê id iff$en seg imawen nnsen. D tikerkas kan ay ssawalen.

ayahs.text: Ahat a phelkev iman ik, ar loiha nnsen, a p$weblev, imi ur uminen ara s usali agi?
ayahs.translation: Ahat a phelkev iman ik, ar loiha nnsen, a p$weblev, imi ur uminen ara s usali agi?

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nerra i illan di tmurt, d ccbaêa ines, iwakken a Néeô menyif iten, ar igiten ilhan.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nerra i illan di tmurt, d ccbaêa ines, iwakken a Néeô menyif iten, ar igiten ilhan.

ayahs.text: A Nu$al a Nerr, i illan degs, d akal ibuôen.
ayahs.translation: A Nu$al a Nerr, i illan degs, d akal ibuôen.

ayahs.text: Ne$ t$ilev d At yifri kan, akked Öaqim, ay d lwehma, ger issekniyen nne£?
ayahs.translation: Ne$ t$ilev d At yifri kan, akked Öaqim, ay d lwehma, ger issekniyen nne£?

ayahs.text: Mi ssôen iman nnsen ilmeéiyen deg ifri, nnan: "a Mass nne$! Efk ane$ d aêunu s$uôeK; Err a$ lameô nne$ d uûwib".
ayahs.translation: Mi ssôen iman nnsen ilmeéiyen deg ifri, nnan: "a Mass nne$! Efk ane$ d aêunu s$uôeK; Err a$ lameô nne$ d uûwib".

ayahs.text: Deg ifri, Nesle$ imeééu$en nnsen, acêal iseggwasen.
ayahs.translation: Deg ifri, Nesle$ imeééu$en nnsen, acêal iseggwasen.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Nessker iten id, a Néeô anta, ger snat n trebbuyaâ, i iêesben acêal qqimen.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Nessker iten id, a Néeô anta, ger snat n trebbuyaâ, i iêesben acêal qqimen.

ayahs.text: Nekwni, ad ak Neêku, s tidep, taqsiî nnsen. Nitni, ih, d ilmeéiyen, umnen s Mass nnsen. Nerna yasen nnhaya.
ayahs.translation: Nekwni, ad ak Neêku, s tidep, taqsiî nnsen. Nitni, ih, d ilmeéiyen, umnen s Mass nnsen. Nerna yasen nnhaya.

ayahs.text: Nesseohed ulawen nnsen, mi kren nnan: "Mass nne$ d Mass n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur nepnuju, d awez$i, ar ôebbi, war Neppa, mulac a d nini awal dduni.
ayahs.translation: Nesseohed ulawen nnsen, mi kren nnan: "Mass nne$ d Mass n tmurt akked igenwan. Ur nepnuju, d awez$i, ar ôebbi, war Neppa, mulac a d nini awal dduni.

ayahs.text: Widak d agdud nne$. Âabden iôebbiten, war Neppa. Ay$eô ur a$ d bbwin, fellasen, adabu n ûûeê? Anwa i idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi?
ayahs.translation: Widak d agdud nne$. Âabden iôebbiten, war Neppa. Ay$eô ur a$ d bbwin, fellasen, adabu n ûûeê? Anwa i idensen sennig win id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi?

ayahs.text: Mi ten tfuôqem, nitni akked wayen âabden war Öebbi, essôet iman nwen deg ifri. Ad awen Izraâ, Mass nnwen, seg uêunu S. Ad awen Iheggi amwanes i lameô nnwen".
ayahs.translation: Mi ten tfuôqem, nitni akked wayen âabden war Öebbi, essôet iman nwen deg ifri. Ad awen Izraâ, Mass nnwen, seg uêunu S. Ad awen Iheggi amwanes i lameô nnwen".

ayahs.text: A pwaliv iîij, mi d inqeô, iwexxeô i ifri nnsen, ar yeffus. Mi i$li, ad asen iâaddi $eô zelmev. Nitni, din, di littsaâ. Ayagi seg issekniyen n Öebbi. Win Inha Öebbi, neppa ipwanha; win Itlef, ur isâi, d awez$i, bab ara t inhun.
ayahs.translation: A pwaliv iîij, mi d inqeô, iwexxeô i ifri nnsen, ar yeffus. Mi i$li, ad asen iâaddi $eô zelmev. Nitni, din, di littsaâ. Ayagi seg issekniyen n Öebbi. Win Inha Öebbi, neppa ipwanha; win Itlef, ur isâi, d awez$i, bab ara t inhun.

ayahs.text: Ad as tiniv ukin, nitni îîsen. Ntezzi ten yeffus, zelmev. Aydi nnsen, $ef umnaô, iééel ivaôen is. Lemmer a ten twaliv, ad asen trewlev, si tugdi; a k terkeb, segsen, lefqaâ.
ayahs.translation: Ad as tiniv ukin, nitni îîsen. Ntezzi ten yeffus, zelmev. Aydi nnsen, $ef umnaô, iééel ivaôen is. Lemmer a ten twaliv, ad asen trewlev, si tugdi; a k terkeb, segsen, lefqaâ.

ayahs.text: Akka ay ten id Nessenker, iwakken ad mesteqsin. Inna yiwen segsen: "acêal n lweqt ay tesâaddam"? Nnan d: "nesâadda ass ne$ ur ibbwiv wass". Nnan: "Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Izôa ay tesâaddam. Aznet ar temdint, yiwen segwen, s idrimen agi nnwen. Ad iwali anwa lqut iûfan mavi, ad awen d iawi ôôeéq, segs. Ad iêader iman is, iwakken ur awen ipfaq yiwen.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay ten id Nessenker, iwakken ad mesteqsin. Inna yiwen segsen: "acêal n lweqt ay tesâaddam"? Nnan d: "nesâadda ass ne$ ur ibbwiv wass". Nnan: "Mass nnwen Yif akw akken Izôa ay tesâaddam. Aznet ar temdint, yiwen segwen, s idrimen agi nnwen. Ad iwali anwa lqut iûfan mavi, ad awen d iawi ôôeéq, segs. Ad iêader iman is, iwakken ur awen ipfaq yiwen.

ayahs.text: Nitni, war ccekk, ma éôan kwen, a kwen ôeomen, ne$ a kwen rren ar ddin nnsen, d$a ur trebêen, d awez$i".
ayahs.translation: Nitni, war ccekk, ma éôan kwen, a kwen ôeomen, ne$ a kwen rren ar ddin nnsen, d$a ur trebêen, d awez$i".

ayahs.text: Akka ay sen ten Nessken, iwakken ad éôen ar lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep; u, $ef yimir, ur illi ccekk. Mi mqellaân $ef lameô nnsen, nnan: "bnut axxam sennig sen. Mass nnsen Yif akw akken iten Issen". Nnan wid iwumi iâadda wawal, $ef lameô nnsen: "a nerr, ihi, lemqam sennig sen".
ayahs.translation: Akka ay sen ten Nessken, iwakken ad éôen ar lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep; u, $ef yimir, ur illi ccekk. Mi mqellaân $ef lameô nnsen, nnan: "bnut axxam sennig sen. Mass nnsen Yif akw akken iten Issen". Nnan wid iwumi iâadda wawal, $ef lameô nnsen: "a nerr, ihi, lemqam sennig sen".

ayahs.text: Ad inin: "di krav yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis kué"; u ad inin: "di semus yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis sdis", pqelliben tabavnit. U ad inin: "di ûa yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis îam". Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Iéôa amvan nnsen. Drus kan i t iéôan". Ur pnamar fellasen, siwa $ef wayen id ivehôen. Ur ppesteqsay yiwen fellasen.
ayahs.translation: Ad inin: "di krav yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis kué"; u ad inin: "di semus yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis sdis", pqelliben tabavnit. U ad inin: "di ûa yidsen, aydi nnsen d wis îam". Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Iéôa amvan nnsen. Drus kan i t iéôan". Ur pnamar fellasen, siwa $ef wayen id ivehôen. Ur ppesteqsay yiwen fellasen.

ayahs.text: Ur qqaô ta$awsa a p xedme$, s tidep, azekka,
ayahs.translation: Ur qqaô ta$awsa a p xedme$, s tidep, azekka,

ayahs.text: siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Mmekti d Mass ik, ma teppuv. Ini: "amar ad iyi Inhu Mass iw, ar wayen yifen ayagi di ûûwab".
ayahs.translation: siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Mmekti d Mass ik, ma teppuv. Ini: "amar ad iyi Inhu Mass iw, ar wayen yifen ayagi di ûûwab".

ayahs.text: Sâaddan, deg ifri nnsen, krav twinas iseggwasen, rnan tza nniven.
ayahs.translation: Sâaddan, deg ifri nnsen, krav twinas iseggwasen, rnan tza nniven.

ayahs.text: Ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa, acêal sâaddan. IneS tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Amek Neppa Ipwali, Isell! Ur sâin bab, war Neppa. Ur Izdukkul yiwen i useyyi S".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Iéôa, acêal sâaddan. IneS tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Amek Neppa Ipwali, Isell! Ur sâin bab, war Neppa. Ur Izdukkul yiwen i useyyi S".

ayahs.text: Mel ayen ik ed ippuweêêan, si Tezmamt n Mass ik. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Ur teppafev ssôan, war Neppa, d awez$i.
ayahs.translation: Mel ayen ik ed ippuweêêan, si Tezmamt n Mass ik. Ur illi ubeddel deg wawal iS. Ur teppafev ssôan, war Neppa, d awez$i.

ayahs.text: Üebbeô iman ik, akked wid ipnujun ar Mass nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit, pnadin udem iS. Ur ten tekkes si ger wallen ik, a pvemâav lefnun n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ur ssemêas i win iwumi Nesse$fel ul is, ar usmekti nne£, i iddan d lhawiyya s, iwumi iffuhri lameô.
ayahs.translation: Üebbeô iman ik, akked wid ipnujun ar Mass nnsen, taûebêit, tameddit, pnadin udem iS. Ur ten tekkes si ger wallen ik, a pvemâav lefnun n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ur ssemêas i win iwumi Nesse$fel ul is, ar usmekti nne£, i iddan d lhawiyya s, iwumi iffuhri lameô.

ayahs.text: Ini: "tidep s$uô Mass nnwen. Ad iamen win ib$an, ad ijhel win ib$an". Ih, Nhegga d times, i imednas; ad asen zzin iêeoouoa s. Ma ppren d, ad asen ppunefken waman am uzzal ifsin. Ad cwin wudmawen nnsen. A tissit tamcumt, a tanezdu$t tucmip!
ayahs.translation: Ini: "tidep s$uô Mass nnwen. Ad iamen win ib$an, ad ijhel win ib$an". Ih, Nhegga d times, i imednas; ad asen zzin iêeoouoa s. Ma ppren d, ad asen ppunefken waman am uzzal ifsin. Ad cwin wudmawen nnsen. A tissit tamcumt, a tanezdu$t tucmip!

ayahs.text: Ih, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, s tidep, ur Nveggiâ akafi n win ixedmen ayen ilhan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, s tidep, ur Nveggiâ akafi n win ixedmen ayen ilhan.

ayahs.text: I wigi, leonanat n Âaden, ddaw sen isaffen ppazzalen. Ad qqnen, dinna, imeqyasen n ddheb, ad lsen iceîîiven izegzawen n leêrir, êewcen s ddheb. Ad élen, degs, $ef imîeôêen izewwqen. A lebsa lâali, a tanezdu$t tumâint!
ayahs.translation: I wigi, leonanat n Âaden, ddaw sen isaffen ppazzalen. Ad qqnen, dinna, imeqyasen n ddheb, ad lsen iceîîiven izegzawen n leêrir, êewcen s ddheb. Ad élen, degs, $ef imîeôêen izewwqen. A lebsa lâali, a tanezdu$t tumâint!

ayahs.text: Awi yasen d amedya n sin irgazen. I yiwen, Nefka snat tebêirin n téuôin, Nezzi yasent tizdayin, Nerra iger garasent.
ayahs.translation: Awi yasen d amedya n sin irgazen. I yiwen, Nefka snat tebêirin n téuôin, Nezzi yasent tizdayin, Nerra iger garasent.

ayahs.text: Yal tibêirt teppak ed l$ella s, ur ipxuûûu, segs, wacemma. Nesfeggev asif garasent.
ayahs.translation: Yal tibêirt teppak ed l$ella s, ur ipxuûûu, segs, wacemma. Nesfeggev asif garasent.

ayahs.text: I$ellet ed ppemôa. Inna i umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "$elbe$ k taôkunt, iffe$ k alag".
ayahs.translation: I$ellet ed ppemôa. Inna i umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "$elbe$ k taôkunt, iffe$ k alag".

ayahs.text: Idens iman is mi ikcem leonan is, inna: "ur cukke$ ara, d awez$i, ad iqucc wayagi.
ayahs.translation: Idens iman is mi ikcem leonan is, inna: "ur cukke$ ara, d awez$i, ad iqucc wayagi.

ayahs.text: Ur cukke$ ara ad yili yimir, u ma bbwve$ ar Mass iw, ard affe$, war ccekk, ayen yifen aya, deg umekkan is".
ayahs.translation: Ur cukke$ ara ad yili yimir, u ma bbwve$ ar Mass iw, ard affe$, war ccekk, ayen yifen aya, deg umekkan is".

ayahs.text: Inna yas umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "day tnekôev Win ik Ixelqen seg wakal, sinna, si tiqqit, sinna, Imessel ik d argaz?
ayahs.translation: Inna yas umdakwel is, mi s immeslay: "day tnekôev Win ik Ixelqen seg wakal, sinna, si tiqqit, sinna, Imessel ik d argaz?

ayahs.text: Maca, Neppa d Öebbi, Mass iw. Ur pcarake$ yiwen, i Mass iw.
ayahs.translation: Maca, Neppa d Öebbi, Mass iw. Ur pcarake$ yiwen, i Mass iw.

ayahs.text: Lemmer id tenniv, mi tkecmev ar tebêirt ik: akken Irad Öebbi. Ur telli tezmert siwa s$uô Öebbi. Ma twalav iyi d, nek, tifev iyi ayla, tarwa,
ayahs.translation: Lemmer id tenniv, mi tkecmev ar tebêirt ik: akken Irad Öebbi. Ur telli tezmert siwa s$uô Öebbi. Ma twalav iyi d, nek, tifev iyi ayla, tarwa,

ayahs.text: Izmer Mass iw ad iyi d Ifk ayen i ifen tibêirt ik. A d Iazen $uôes ssxev, seg igenni, a ppu$al d aêecraruf issiccigen;
ayahs.translation: Izmer Mass iw ad iyi d Ifk ayen i ifen tibêirt ik. A d Iazen $uôes ssxev, seg igenni, a ppu$al d aêecraruf issiccigen;

ayahs.text: ne$, ad zzren waman is, ur ten teppafev, d awez$i".
ayahs.translation: ne$, ad zzren waman is, ur ten teppafev, d awez$i".

ayahs.text: Tqucc l$ella s. D$a la izeyyeô ifassen is, $ef wayen iseôôef fellas. Tqucc tfeôôant is. Inna: "a yamxix iw, a lemmer ur curke$ yiwen, i Mass iw"!
ayahs.translation: Tqucc l$ella s. D$a la izeyyeô ifassen is, $ef wayen iseôôef fellas. Tqucc tfeôôant is. Inna: "a yamxix iw, a lemmer ur curke$ yiwen, i Mass iw"!

ayahs.text: Ur as illi urbaâ ara t isellken, war Öebbi. Ur isellek iman is.
ayahs.translation: Ur as illi urbaâ ara t isellken, war Öebbi. Ur isellek iman is.

ayahs.text: Akka, laânaya s$uô Öebbi, Tidep. Yif akw i ukafi, Yif akw i taggara.
ayahs.translation: Akka, laânaya s$uô Öebbi, Tidep. Yif akw i ukafi, Yif akw i taggara.

ayahs.text: Awi yasen d amedya n tmeddurt n ddunit. Am aman id Nesse$li seg igenni. Eâluâlen yissen im$an n tmurt. D$a u$alen d asa$uô, issebruzzaâ iten wavu. Ni$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Awi yasen d amedya n tmeddurt n ddunit. Am aman id Nesse$li seg igenni. Eâluâlen yissen im$an n tmurt. D$a u$alen d asa$uô, issebruzzaâ iten wavu. Ni$ Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ayla akked dderya d ccbaêa n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ar Mass ik, leûlaê idumen ifen ten i ukafi, ifen ten i tmeôoiwt.
ayahs.translation: Ayla akked dderya d ccbaêa n tmeddurt n ddunit. Ar Mass ik, leûlaê idumen ifen ten i ukafi, ifen ten i tmeôoiwt.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara Nesselêu idurar, a pwaliv tamurt d aza$aô. A ten Nefser, ur Neppaoa yiwen segsen.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara Nesselêu idurar, a pwaliv tamurt d aza$aô. A ten Nefser, ur Neppaoa yiwen segsen.

ayahs.text: A d rsen zdat Mass ik, d leûfuf: "ni$ tusam a£ d, akken ikwen Nexleq tikelt tamenzut. Irna tetebbtem ar ur awen Neppara ppaâud, d awez$i".
ayahs.translation: A d rsen zdat Mass ik, d leûfuf: "ni$ tusam a£ d, akken ikwen Nexleq tikelt tamenzut. Irna tetebbtem ar ur awen Neppara ppaâud, d awez$i".

ayahs.text: Ters ed Tezmamt. A pwaliv ibe$wviyen s uêebbiô, $ef wayen illan degs. Qqaôen: "a yamxix nne$! Acimi tazmamt agi ur teooi ayen meééiyen, u wayen meqqwôen, armi ten teêseb"? Ufan illa wayen xedmen. Mass ik ur Idennis yiwen.
ayahs.translation: Ters ed Tezmamt. A pwaliv ibe$wviyen s uêebbiô, $ef wayen illan degs. Qqaôen: "a yamxix nne$! Acimi tazmamt agi ur teooi ayen meééiyen, u wayen meqqwôen, armi ten teêseb"? Ufan illa wayen xedmen. Mass ik ur Idennis yiwen.

ayahs.text: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem", knant, siwa Iblis. Neppa, si leonun, iaâûa lameô n Mass is. Day a ten terrem, neppa akked tarwa s, d imawlan, war Nek? U nitni d icenga nnwen! D abdil ucmit n imednas.
ayahs.translation: Mi Nenna i lmalayek: "knumt i Adem", knant, siwa Iblis. Neppa, si leonun, iaâûa lameô n Mass is. Day a ten terrem, neppa akked tarwa s, d imawlan, war Nek? U nitni d icenga nnwen! D abdil ucmit n imednas.

ayahs.text: Ur ten Rri$ d inagan n lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, ne$ n lxelq nnsen. Ur Ïîife$ im$eôôqen d imâiwnen.
ayahs.translation: Ur ten Rri$ d inagan n lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, ne$ n lxelq nnsen. Ur Ïîife$ im$eôôqen d imâiwnen.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara d Yini: "neccdet wid iyI terram d icriken iW". Ad asen siwlen, ur asen d pparan. Nerra, garasen, asif n twa$it.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d Yini: "neccdet wid iyI terram d icriken iW". Ad asen siwlen, ur asen d pparan. Nerra, garasen, asif n twa$it.

ayahs.text: Ibe$wviyen ad walin times. ÊëËûan ar nitni, degs, ara $lin. Ur ppafen, segs, tisensert.
ayahs.translation: Ibe$wviyen ad walin times. ÊëËûan ar nitni, degs, ara $lin. Ur ppafen, segs, tisensert.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nefka d, di Leqwôan agi, yal amedya, i imdanen. Maca, ipnamar umdan sennig akw.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka d, di Leqwôan agi, yal amedya, i imdanen. Maca, ipnamar umdan sennig akw.

ayahs.text: D acu i iîîfen imdanen ad amnen, mi ten id tusa nnhaya, u ad ste$fôen Mass nnsen? Ar ten id tas kan, tin ivôan d imezwura, ne$ ar d irs, zdat sen, uâaqeb?
ayahs.translation: D acu i iîîfen imdanen ad amnen, mi ten id tusa nnhaya, u ad ste$fôen Mass nnsen? Ar ten id tas kan, tin ivôan d imezwura, ne$ ar d irs, zdat sen, uâaqeb?

ayahs.text: Ur Neppazen imazanen, siwa i ubecceô d uneddeô. Wid ijehlen pnamaren, s tkerkas, îîeggiôen yissent tidep. Pmaâliken $ef issekniyen iW, akked wayen i$ef ppunedôen.
ayahs.translation: Ur Neppazen imazanen, siwa i ubecceô d uneddeô. Wid ijehlen pnamaren, s tkerkas, îîeggiôen yissent tidep. Pmaâliken $ef issekniyen iW, akked wayen i$ef ppunedôen.

ayahs.text: Anwa idensen sennig win iwumi d pwafekkôen issekniyen n Mass is, iwexxeô asen, u ippu i ixdem ufus is. Ih, Nerra aêurrim $ef wulawen nnsen, ur t fehhmen; akked tiâéegt deg imeééu$en nnsen. Ma tneccdev ten ar nnhaya, ur pwanhan, d awez$i.
ayahs.translation: Anwa idensen sennig win iwumi d pwafekkôen issekniyen n Mass is, iwexxeô asen, u ippu i ixdem ufus is. Ih, Nerra aêurrim $ef wulawen nnsen, ur t fehhmen; akked tiâéegt deg imeééu$en nnsen. Ma tneccdev ten ar nnhaya, ur pwanhan, d awez$i.

ayahs.text: Mass ik Ipsemmiêen, d Bab uêunu. Lemmer ad Iêud fellasen ilmend n wayen kesben, ad I$iwel ar uâaqeb nnsen. Maca, sâan ppaâud, ur ppafen segs tisensert.
ayahs.translation: Mass ik Ipsemmiêen, d Bab uêunu. Lemmer ad Iêud fellasen ilmend n wayen kesben, ad I$iwel ar uâaqeb nnsen. Maca, sâan ppaâud, ur ppafen segs tisensert.

ayahs.text: Timdinin nni i Nesqucc mi densent, Nga ppaâud i usquccu nnsent.
ayahs.translation: Timdinin nni i Nesqucc mi densent, Nga ppaâud i usquccu nnsent.

ayahs.text: Mi inna Musa i uqeddac is: "ur êebbse$ alamma bbwve$ ar umlili n sin ilellen, xas ad sâaddi$ tallit".
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Musa i uqeddac is: "ur êebbse$ alamma bbwve$ ar umlili n sin ilellen, xas ad sâaddi$ tallit".

ayahs.text: Mi bbwven ar umlili nnsen, ppun aslem nnsen. Iu$al ar yill d ilelli.
ayahs.translation: Mi bbwven ar umlili nnsen, ppun aslem nnsen. Iu$al ar yill d ilelli.

ayahs.text: Mi zegren, inna i uqeddac is: "awi a$ d imekli nne$, ni$ naâteb deg inig nne$ agi".
ayahs.translation: Mi zegren, inna i uqeddac is: "awi a$ d imekli nne$, ni$ naâteb deg inig nne$ agi".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ur twalav ara, mi nreyyeê ar teéôut, nek ppu$ en aslem? D Cciîan kan iyi isseppun ur ak nni$. Ibbwi abrid is ar yill, d lwehma"!
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ur twalav ara, mi nreyyeê ar teéôut, nek ppu$ en aslem? D Cciîan kan iyi isseppun ur ak nni$. Ibbwi abrid is ar yill, d lwehma"!

ayahs.text: Inna: "d ayagi ay neb$a". D$a u$alen d $ef isurifen nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "d ayagi ay neb$a". D$a u$alen d $ef isurifen nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ufan d amdan seg imdanen nne£, iwumi Nefka aêunu s$uône£. Neslemd as tussna i illan $uône£.
ayahs.translation: Ufan d amdan seg imdanen nne£, iwumi Nefka aêunu s$uône£. Neslemd as tussna i illan $uône£.

ayahs.text: Inna yas Musa: "Ma ad ddu$ yidek, ad iyi tesêefvev ay tesnev n ûûwab"?
ayahs.translation: Inna yas Musa: "Ma ad ddu$ yidek, ad iyi tesêefvev ay tesnev n ûûwab"?

ayahs.text: Inna d: "keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev.
ayahs.translation: Inna d: "keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev.

ayahs.text: Amek ara tûebôev i wayen i$ef ur tesâiv asali"?
ayahs.translation: Amek ara tûebôev i wayen i$ef ur tesâiv asali"?

ayahs.text: Inna: "ad iyi tafev, ma Irad Öebbi, d aûebôi. Ur pnaqwame$ lameô ik".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ad iyi tafev, ma Irad Öebbi, d aûebôi. Ur pnaqwame$ lameô ik".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ma teddiv yidi, ur iyi d steqsay $ef wacemma, alamma smekti$ k id fellas".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ma teddiv yidi, ur iyi d steqsay $ef wacemma, alamma smekti$ k id fellas".

ayahs.text: Lêan, armi rekben di lbabuô. Ixeôq it. Inna: "txeôqev t, iwakken ad $evûen l$aci s! Ni$ ayen txedmev d dduni".
ayahs.translation: Lêan, armi rekben di lbabuô. Ixeôq it. Inna: "txeôqev t, iwakken ad $evûen l$aci s! Ni$ ayen txedmev d dduni".

ayahs.text: Inna: "day ur ak nni$ ara, keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev, d awez$i"?
ayahs.translation: Inna: "day ur ak nni$ ara, keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev, d awez$i"?

ayahs.text: Inna: "ur iyi pqasa imi ppu$, ur ssukku lwaâôan $ef lameô iw".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ur iyi pqasa imi ppu$, ur ssukku lwaâôan $ef lameô iw".

ayahs.text: Lêan, armi d mmugren ileméi. In$a t. Inna: "ten$iv amdan ur nen$i yiwen! Ni$ d ayen idensen ay txedmev".
ayahs.translation: Lêan, armi d mmugren ileméi. In$a t. Inna: "ten$iv amdan ur nen$i yiwen! Ni$ d ayen idensen ay txedmev".

ayahs.text: Inna: "day ur ak nni$ ara, keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev, d awez$i"?
ayahs.translation: Inna: "day ur ak nni$ ara, keçç, s tidep, ur tezmiôev, yidi, a pûebôev, d awez$i"?

ayahs.text: Inna: "ma steqsa$ k $ef t$awsa, deffir ta, ur teddu yidi. Ni$ ssutre$ ak d ssmaê".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ma steqsa$ k $ef t$awsa, deffir ta, ur teddu yidi. Ni$ ssutre$ ak d ssmaê".

ayahs.text: Lêan, armi bbwven ar imezda$ n yiwet n temdint, ssutren asen lqut. Ugin a ten snubgten. Ufan en lêiv, qôib ad i$li. Iûeggem it. Inna: "ma teb$iv, tzemrev a ppepwaxellûev $ef waya".
ayahs.translation: Lêan, armi bbwven ar imezda$ n yiwet n temdint, ssutren asen lqut. Ugin a ten snubgten. Ufan en lêiv, qôib ad i$li. Iûeggem it. Inna: "ma teb$iv, tzemrev a ppepwaxellûev $ef waya".

ayahs.text: Inna: "Tura a nemfaôaq. Ad ak d fke$ lmaâna n wayen i$ef ur tezmirev a pûebôev, d awez$i".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "Tura a nemfaôaq. Ad ak d fke$ lmaâna n wayen i$ef ur tezmirev a pûebôev, d awez$i".

ayahs.text: Lbabuô nni, n igellilen i ixedmen di yill. B$i$ a t ôée$, acku yiwen ugellid, deffir sen, itekkes yal lbabuô, s yi$il.
ayahs.translation: Lbabuô nni, n igellilen i ixedmen di yill. B$i$ a t ôée$, acku yiwen ugellid, deffir sen, itekkes yal lbabuô, s yi$il.

ayahs.text: Wanag ileméi nni, llan imawlan is d lmumnin. Nugad ad iêeppem fellasen tinufqa, tijehli.
ayahs.translation: Wanag ileméi nni, llan imawlan is d lmumnin. Nugad ad iêeppem fellasen tinufqa, tijehli.

ayahs.text: Neb$a ad asen d Irr, Mass nnsen, it yifen: win iûfan, iqeôben nezzeh aêunu.
ayahs.translation: Neb$a ad asen d Irr, Mass nnsen, it yifen: win iûfan, iqeôben nezzeh aêunu.

ayahs.text: Wanag lêiv, n sin warrac igujilen n temdint. Illa ugerruj seddaw as, i nitni. Babat sen d argaz ilhan. Mass ik Ib$a, ard im$uôen, ara d ssuff$en agerruj nnsen. D aêunu s$uô Mass ik. Ur t xdime$ s lameô iw. D tagi ay d lmaâna n wayen i$ef ur tezmiôev a pûebôev".
ayahs.translation: Wanag lêiv, n sin warrac igujilen n temdint. Illa ugerruj seddaw as, i nitni. Babat sen d argaz ilhan. Mass ik Ib$a, ard im$uôen, ara d ssuff$en agerruj nnsen. D aêunu s$uô Mass ik. Ur t xdime$ s lameô iw. D tagi ay d lmaâna n wayen i$ef ur tezmiôev a pûebôev".

ayahs.text: Steqsan k $ef Bu sin wacciwen. Ini: "ad awen d awi$, fellas, asmekti".
ayahs.translation: Steqsan k $ef Bu sin wacciwen. Ini: "ad awen d awi$, fellas, asmekti".

ayahs.text: S tidep, Nefka yas di tmurt, u Nsehhel as iberdan di yal cci.
ayahs.translation: S tidep, Nefka yas di tmurt, u Nsehhel as iberdan di yal cci.

ayahs.text: Iîîef yiwen n ubrid,
ayahs.translation: Iîîef yiwen n ubrid,

ayahs.text: armi sanda i$elli yiîij. Iufa i$elli $ef tala ilu$en. Iufa n $uôes agdud. Nenna: "a Bu sin wacciwen, âaqeb iten, ne$ lhu $uôsen".
ayahs.translation: armi sanda i$elli yiîij. Iufa i$elli $ef tala ilu$en. Iufa n $uôes agdud. Nenna: "a Bu sin wacciwen, âaqeb iten, ne$ lhu $uôsen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "win idensen a t nâaqeb, sinna, ad iu$al ar Mass is at Iâaqeb aâaqeb unekkaô.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "win idensen a t nâaqeb, sinna, ad iu$al ar Mass is at Iâaqeb aâaqeb unekkaô.

ayahs.text: Wanag i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, akafi igerzen. Ad as Nini i isehlen si lameô nne£".
ayahs.translation: Wanag i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, akafi igerzen. Ad as Nini i isehlen si lameô nne£".

ayahs.text: Sinna, ilêa d yiwen n ubrid,
ayahs.translation: Sinna, ilêa d yiwen n ubrid,

ayahs.text: armi sanda d ineqqeô yiîij. Iufa n ineqqeô ed $ef ugdud, iwumi ur Nefki ar at isdarin segs.
ayahs.translation: armi sanda d ineqqeô yiîij. Iufa n ineqqeô ed $ef ugdud, iwumi ur Nefki ar at isdarin segs.

ayahs.text: Am akka. Ni$ ibbwev a£ d akw usali s.
ayahs.translation: Am akka. Ni$ ibbwev a£ d akw usali s.

ayahs.text: Sinna, idda d yiwen n ubrid,
ayahs.translation: Sinna, idda d yiwen n ubrid,

ayahs.text: armi ibbwev ger sin iêdiden. Iufa, deffir sen, agdud qôib ur fehhmen awal.
ayahs.translation: armi ibbwev ger sin iêdiden. Iufa, deffir sen, agdud qôib ur fehhmen awal.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Bu sin wacciwen, s tidep, Iaouo akked Maouo la ssefsaden di tmurt. A k nxelleû ma terriv ûûuô garane$ yidsen".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Bu sin wacciwen, s tidep, Iaouo akked Maouo la ssefsaden di tmurt. A k nxelleû ma terriv ûûuô garane$ yidsen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "yif it iyi Ifka Mass iw. Efket iyi afus, ad rre$ ûûuô garawen yidsen.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "yif it iyi Ifka Mass iw. Efket iyi afus, ad rre$ ûûuô garawen yidsen.

ayahs.translation: Awit iyi d tiqaùmtin n wuzzal alamma irgel wayen illan ger idurar". Inna: "ûuvet alamma tekker degs tmes. Awit iyi d ad smire$ fellas nnêas ifsin".

ayahs.text: D$a ur zmiren a t id zegren, ur zmiren a t id flun.
ayahs.translation: D$a ur zmiren a t id zegren, ur zmiren a t id flun.

ayahs.translation: Inna: "ayagi d aêunu s$uô Mass iw. Mi d tusa lemâahda n Mass iw, a t Isawi. Lemâahda n Mass iw d tidep".

ayahs.translation: Assen, a ten Neoo ad ddehmen wa $ef wa. Aûuvu di lbuq, d$a a ten Nessemlil akw.

ayahs.text: A d Nessken nezzeh Loahennama, assen, i ijehliyen,
ayahs.translation: A d Nessken nezzeh Loahennama, assen, i ijehliyen,

ayahs.text: wid iwumi sêurrment wallen nnsen, mgal asmekti W. Llan ur zmiren i usemêes.
ayahs.translation: wid iwumi sêurrment wallen nnsen, mgal asmekti W. Llan ur zmiren i usemêes.

ayahs.translation: Day $ilen, wid ijehlen, ad rren imdanen iW, d imawlan war Nek? Ih, Nhegga Loahennama, d axxam i ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ad awen mle$ at igiten imexsuôen sennig wiyav?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ad awen mle$ at igiten imexsuôen sennig wiyav?

ayahs.translation: Wid iwumi iweddeô laâtab nnsen di tmeddurt n ddunit, wanag nitni nwan gerzen igi"?

ayahs.translation: Widak d wid i inekôen issekniyen n Mass nnsen, akked temlilit yideS. Mêan igiten nnsen. Ur ten Nwezzen, ass n tnekra.

ayahs.text: Atan uqeîîi nnsen: Loahennama, imi jehlen, u mmaâlken deg issekniyen iW, akked imazanen iW.
ayahs.translation: Atan uqeîîi nnsen: Loahennama, imi jehlen, u mmaâlken deg issekniyen iW, akked imazanen iW.

ayahs.text: Ma d wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, axxam nnsen d leonanat n Loennet.
ayahs.translation: Ma d wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, axxam nnsen d leonanat n Loennet.

ayahs.text: Degs ad wekkôen, ur ssuturen ayen nniven.
ayahs.translation: Degs ad wekkôen, ur ssuturen ayen nniven.

ayahs.text: Ini: "lemmer ill d lmidad, i wawalen n Mass iw, ad iqqaô yill, uqbel ad fukken wawalen n Mass iw, xas a d nawi i t icban n lmidad".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "lemmer ill d lmidad, i wawalen n Mass iw, ad iqqaô yill, uqbel ad fukken wawalen n Mass iw, xas a d nawi i t icban n lmidad".

ayahs.text: Ini: "nek d amdan kan, am kunwi. Weêêan iyi d ar Öebbi nnwen, d Öebbi Yiwen. Win issaramen timlilit n Mass is, ad ixdem ayen ilhan, ur ipcarak yiwen deg waâbad n Mass is".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "nek d amdan kan, am kunwi. Weêêan iyi d ar Öebbi nnwen, d Öebbi Yiwen. Win issaramen timlilit n Mass is, ad ixdem ayen ilhan, ur ipcarak yiwen deg waâbad n Mass is".

verses.text: Khiâû.
verses.translation: Khiâû.

verses.text: Asmekti uêunu n Mass ik, i umdan iS Zakarya;
verses.translation: Asmekti uêunu n Mass ik, i umdan iS Zakarya;

verses.text: mi iger, i Mass is, ti$ôi tabavnit.
verses.translation: mi iger, i Mass is, ti$ôi tabavnit.

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! S tidep, ôéent laâvam iw, aqeôôu iôeq si ccib. A Mass iw! Anuju $uôeK uroin iyi isnu$ben.
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! S tidep, ôéent laâvam iw, aqeôôu iôeq si ccib. A Mass iw! Anuju $uôeK uroin iyi isnu$ben.

verses.text: Nek ugade$ llzem iw, deffir i. Tameîîut iw d tiâiqeôt. Efk iyi d lfeôx s$uôeK;
verses.translation: Nek ugade$ llzem iw, deffir i. Tameîîut iw d tiâiqeôt. Efk iyi d lfeôx s$uôeK;

verses.text: ad iyi iwôet, ad iwôet si twacult n Yaâqub. Err it, a Mass iw, d win iôuvan".
verses.translation: ad iyi iwôet, ad iwôet si twacult n Yaâqub. Err it, a Mass iw, d win iôuvan".

verses.translation: "A Zakarya, s tidep, Nbecceô ik s uqcic, ism is Yeêya. Ur Nefki, i yiwen, ism agi, uqbel is".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic, tameîîut iw d tiâiqeôt, u nek $emqe$ di tewser"?
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Amek ara sâu$ aqcic, tameîîut iw d tiâiqeôt, u nek $emqe$ di tewser"?

verses.text: Inna: "Akka. Inna d Mass ik: ayagi ishel fellI. Ni$ Xelqe$ k, zik, ur telliv d acemma".
verses.translation: Inna: "Akka. Inna d Mass ik: ayagi ishel fellI. Ni$ Xelqe$ k, zik, ur telliv d acemma".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d assekni". Inna: "assekni ik, ur tepmeslayev i medden, krav wavan, ur tuvnev".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi d assekni". Inna: "assekni ik, ur tepmeslayev i medden, krav wavan, ur tuvnev".

verses.text: Iffe$ ed ar ugdud is, si lemqam. Iweêêa yasen ad anzen ûûbeê, tameddit".
verses.translation: Iffe$ ed ar ugdud is, si lemqam. Iweêêa yasen ad anzen ûûbeê, tameddit".

verses.text: "A Yeêya, eîîef Tazmamt, s loehd". D ûûebyan, Nefka yas ûûwab,
verses.translation: "A Yeêya, eîîef Tazmamt, s loehd". D ûûebyan, Nefka yas ûûwab,

verses.translation: lmaênana akked ûûfawa, s$uône£. Ipêezzib;

verses.translation: ibedd i imawlan is; ur illi d aqehhaô ne$ d amâaûi.

verses.text: Tifrat fellas asmi d ilul, asmi ara immet, asmi ara d iu$al d amuddir!
verses.translation: Tifrat fellas asmi d ilul, asmi ara immet, asmi ara d iu$al d amuddir!

verses.translation: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Meryem, asmi taâzel iman is, si twacult is, di tama ugmuv.

verses.text: Terra ssteô garas yidsen. Nuzen as d ôôuê nne£. £uôes, amzun d amdan ifuqen.
verses.translation: Terra ssteô garas yidsen. Nuzen as d ôôuê nne£. £uôes, amzun d amdan ifuqen.

verses.text: Tenna: "ad iyi Ëerz Uênin, segk, ma tepêezzibev".
verses.translation: Tenna: "ad iyi Ëerz Uênin, segk, ma tepêezzibev".

verses.translation: Inna: "nek, d amersul kan n Mass im, ad am fke$ aqcic iûfan".

verses.translation: Tenna: "amek ara sâu$ aqcic, ur iyi innul umdan, ur lli$ d tazennant"?

verses.text: Inna: "Akka. Inna d Mass im: ayagi, ishel fellI. A t Nerr d assekni i medden, d aêunu s$uône£. D lameô ippuêeppmen".
verses.translation: Inna: "Akka. Inna d Mass im: ayagi, ishel fellI. A t Nerr d assekni i medden, d aêunu s$uône£. D lameô ippuêeppmen".

verses.text: Tebbwi tadist; syis taâzel iman is, di tama ibaâden.
verses.translation: Tebbwi tadist; syis taâzel iman is, di tama ibaâden.

verses.text: Bdan p id inzikmiren ar loedra n tezdayt. Tenna: "anna$ lemmer mmute$, uqbel ayagi, ad pwappu$ akw"!
verses.translation: Bdan p id inzikmiren ar loedra n tezdayt. Tenna: "anna$ lemmer mmute$, uqbel ayagi, ad pwappu$ akw"!

verses.translation: Issawel as d, seddaw as: "kkes a$wbel, ih, Mass im Irra i$éeô, seddaw am.

verses.translation: Hucc, ar $uôem, loedra n tezdayt, ad am d i$li ppmeô amaynut ibwan.

verses.translation: Eçç, ssew, ssefôeê iéôi m. Ma twalav yiwen n umdan, ini as: nek, s tidep, uéame$ i Uênin, ur pmeslaye$, assa, i umdan".

verses.translation: Tôuê yis ar ugdud is, tebbwi t. Nnan: "a Meryem! Ni$ tusiv d, s temsalt ihejjnen.

verses.translation: A ultmas n Haôun, ur illi baba m d argaz ucmit, ur telli imma m d tazennant".

verses.translation: Teswâad $uôes. Nnan: "amek ara nemmeslay i ûûebyan di dduê"?

verses.text: Inna: "nek d amdan n Öebbi. Ifka yi d Tazmamt. Irra yi d nnbi.
verses.translation: Inna: "nek d amdan n Öebbi. Ifka yi d Tazmamt. Irra yi d nnbi.

verses.translation: Iôqa yi anda lli$. Iweûûa yi taéallit, u zzakat, skud mazal iyi d amuddir.

verses.translation: Ad bedde$ i yimma. Ur iyi Irri d aqehhaô, ne$ d ccaqi.

verses.translation: Tifrat felli asmi d lule$, asmi ara mmte$, asmi ara d u$ale$ d amuddir"!

verses.translation: D wagi ay d Âisa, mmi s n Meryem. D awal n tidep, i$ef cukken.

verses.translation: Ur iûwib ara, i Öebbi, ad Isâu kra n mmi S. Gedha syiS! Ma Iseyya lameô, ad as Yini kan: "ili"! Ad yili.

verses.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, d Mass iw, d Mass nnwen. Ihi, âabdet eP. D wagi ay d abrid uwqim.

verses.translation: Mgarraden ikabaren garasen. A tawa$it n wid ijehlen, mara walin ass abarar!

verses.translation: Ara slen, ara walin, ass ideg ara d asen $uône£! Maca, imednas, assa, di ttelfan s ûûeê.

verses.translation: Nabi ten, $ef ass n ssixîa, mara iûaô lameô. Nitni, di l$eflan, nitni ur uminen.

verses.translation: Ih, d Nekwni, ara Iweôten tamurt akked wayen illan fellas. £uône£ tu$alin nnsen.

verses.translation: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Ibôahim. Ih, Neppa, illa d bab n tidep, d nnbi.

verses.translation: Mi inna i baba s: "a baba! Acimi tâabdev win ur nsell, ur nepwali, ur k ip$itin s wacemma?

verses.translation: Ih, a baba, Nek ippunefk iyi d, si tmusni, ayen ur ak neppunefk. Ihi ddu yidi, a k nhu$ ar ubrid ilhan.

verses.translation: A baba! Ur âabbed Cciîan. Ni$ Cciîan illa d amâaûu i Uênin.

verses.translation: A baba! Nek, ugade$ a k iwwet uâaqeb n Uênin, a ppiliv d ameddakwel n Cciîan".

verses.translation: Inna d: "day tugiv keçç, a Ibôahim, iôebbiten iw? Ma ur tfukkev ara, war ccekk, a k ôeome$! Ïixxeô iyi tallit $wezzifen".

verses.translation: Inna: "ili di tifrat. Ad ssutre$ i Mass iw, ad ak Isemmeê. Neppa, s tidep, Iâuzz iyi.

verses.translation: Ad âazle$ iman iw segwen, akked wayen tepnujum, war Öebbi. Ad naâôe$ Mass iw, ahat, s unuju w, ar Mass iw, ur $webne$ ara".

verses.text: Mi iaâzel iman is segsen akked wayen âabden, war Öebbi, Nefka yas Isêaq akked Yaâqub. Yal yiwen, Nerra t d nnbi.
verses.translation: Mi iaâzel iman is segsen akked wayen âabden, war Öebbi, Nefka yas Isêaq akked Yaâqub. Yal yiwen, Nerra t d nnbi.

verses.text: Nefka yasen seg uêunu nne£. Nerna yasen ccekôan umâin, lfayeq.
verses.translation: Nefka yasen seg uêunu nne£. Nerna yasen ccekôan umâin, lfayeq.

verses.text: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Musa. Ih, neppa, illa d aâeôvi, d amazan, d nnbi.
verses.translation: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Musa. Ih, neppa, illa d aâeôvi, d amazan, d nnbi.

verses.text: Nessawel as d, si îîeôf ayeffus n udrar. Nessqeôb it id, ad as Nmel.
verses.translation: Nessawel as d, si îîeôf ayeffus n udrar. Nessqeôb it id, ad as Nmel.

verses.translation: Nefka yas, seg uêunu nne£, gma s, Haôun, d nnbi.

verses.text: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Ismaâil. Ih, neppa, illa d win ippaîafen di lemâahda s, d amazan, d nnbi.
verses.translation: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Ismaâil. Ih, neppa, illa d win ippaîafen di lemâahda s, d amazan, d nnbi.

verses.text: Iumeô i twacult is, taéallit, zzakat. Iôuva t Mass is.
verses.translation: Iumeô i twacult is, taéallit, zzakat. Iôuva t Mass is.

verses.translation: Smekti d, di Tezmamt, Idris. Ih, neppa, illa d bab n tidep, d nnbi.

verses.text: Nessuli t s amkan aâlayen.
verses.translation: Nessuli t s amkan aâlayen.

verses.text: D wigi i I$at Öebbi, ger lambiyya, ger tarwa n Adem, ger wid i Nebbwi akked Nuê, ger tarwa n Ibôahim, akked Isôail, ger wid Nenha u Nefren. Ma $ôan asen issekniyen n Uênin, ad $lin knan, s imeîîawen.
verses.translation: D wigi i I$at Öebbi, ger lambiyya, ger tarwa n Adem, ger wid i Nebbwi akked Nuê, ger tarwa n Ibôahim, akked Isôail, ger wid Nenha u Nefren. Ma $ôan asen issekniyen n Uênin, ad $lin knan, s imeîîawen.

verses.text: Lxwelf nnsen d asatu i iooan taéallit, ddan d ccehwiyyat. Ad magren ttelfan.
verses.translation: Lxwelf nnsen d asatu i iooan taéallit, ddan d ccehwiyyat. Ad magren ttelfan.

verses.text: Kkes ed wid isteôoâen, iumnen, xeddmen ayen ilhan. Wigi, ad kecmen Loennet, ur pwadensen s wacemma.
verses.translation: Kkes ed wid isteôoâen, iumnen, xeddmen ayen ilhan. Wigi, ad kecmen Loennet, ur pwadensen s wacemma.

verses.text: Leonanat n Âaden i Iwaââed Uênin, i imdanen iS, di tbavnit. Lemâahda S, s tidep, a ppevôu.
verses.translation: Leonanat n Âaden i Iwaââed Uênin, i imdanen iS, di tbavnit. Lemâahda S, s tidep, a ppevôu.

verses.text: Ur sellen, degs, i yir awal, siwa: "tifrat"! Dinna, lqut nnsen, ûûbeê, tameddit.
verses.translation: Ur sellen, degs, i yir awal, siwa: "tifrat"! Dinna, lqut nnsen, ûûbeê, tameddit.

verses.text: D tagi ay d Loennet, ara Nerr d lweôt, i wid ipêezziben, seg imdanen nne£.
verses.translation: D tagi ay d Loennet, ara Nerr d lweôt, i wid ipêezziben, seg imdanen nne£.

verses.text: Ur d nepûubbu, siwa ma s lameô n Mass ik. IneS i illan zdat nne$, i illan deffir nne$, akked wayen illan garasen. Mass ik ur Iteppu.
verses.translation: Ur d nepûubbu, siwa ma s lameô n Mass ik. IneS i illan zdat nne$, i illan deffir nne$, akked wayen illan garasen. Mass ik ur Iteppu.

verses.text: Mass n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Ihi, âabed iT, ili d imezgi deg uâbad iS. Day tesnev win isâan ism iS?
verses.translation: Mass n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Ihi, âabed iT, ili d imezgi deg uâbad iS. Day tesnev win isâan ism iS?

verses.translation: La iqqaô umdan: "ma mmute$, day a yi d ssuff$en d amuddir"?

verses.translation: Day ur icfa ara umdan, ar t id Nxelq, zik, ur illi d acemma?

verses.text: S Mass ik, ara ten Nefser, nitni akked cwaîen. Sinna, a ten Nerr ad zzin i Loahennama, $ef tgwecrar.
verses.translation: S Mass ik, ara ten Nefser, nitni akked cwaîen. Sinna, a ten Nerr ad zzin i Loahennama, $ef tgwecrar.

verses.text: Sinna, a d Nekkes, si yal arbaâ, wid ibe$wven nezzeh, ar Uênin.
verses.translation: Sinna, a d Nekkes, si yal arbaâ, wid ibe$wven nezzeh, ar Uênin.

verses.text: Sinna, d Nekwni, war ccekk, i Isnen sennig akw, imenza ar tmeô$iwt.
verses.translation: Sinna, d Nekwni, war ccekk, i Isnen sennig akw, imenza ar tmeô$iwt.

verses.text: Akken tellam, a pqeôbem $uôes. Akka, ar Mass ik, d aseyyi imuêeppmen.

ayahs.translation: S tidep, neppuweêêa d, ar ad ippuâaqeb win inekôen, iwexxôen".

ayahs.translation: Eççet, ekset lmal nnwen. Deg waya, s tidep, d issekniyen i imawlan n ddehn.

ayahs.translation: Segs, Nxelq ikwen; degs, a kwen Nerr; segs, a kwen id Nessuffe$, tikelt nniven.

ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nessken as akw issekniyen nne£ inkeô, iugi.

ayahs.translation: Inna: "day a$ d tusiv, s ssêur ik, a Musa, ad a$ tessuff$ev seg wakal nne$?

ayahs.text: War ccekk, ad ak d nawi ssêur i t icban. Err garane$ yidek ppaâud, deg umekkan iwulmen, ur t nezgal, ur t tezgalev".
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, ad ak d nawi ssêur i t icban. Err garane$ yidek ppaâud, deg umekkan iwulmen, ur t nezgal, ur t tezgalev".

ayahs.translation: Inna: "ppaâud nnwen ass n tme$ôa, a d mlilen medden, di tûebêit".

ayahs.text: Izzi Ferâun, ijmaâ ed ccbukat is, d$a iusa d.
ayahs.translation: Izzi Ferâun, ijmaâ ed ccbukat is, d$a iusa d.

ayahs.translation: Inna yasen Musa:"a tawa$it nnwen! Ur d garet tikerkas $ef Öebbi, a kwen Isxev s uâaqeb. Ni$ ad ixseô win d igren".

ayahs.translation: Mcawaôen f lameô nnsen, ffren ayen mmeslayen.

ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ihi, sin agi d iseêêaren, b$an a kwen ssuff$en seg wakal nnwen, s ssêur nnsen. Ad kksen abrid nnwen amxallef.

ayahs.translation: Jemâat ed ccbukat nnwen, sinna aset ed d leûfuf. Ni$ ad irbeê, assa, win iufraren"!

ayahs.translation: Inna: "xaîi, veggôet"! Si ssêur nnsen, iwala amzun leêêun imraren akked tâakwzin nnsen.

ayahs.translation: Musa, deg iman is, iêus i lxuf.

ayahs.translation: Nenna: "ur ppagwad! Keçç, s tidep, sennig sen.

ayahs.translation: Ih, numen s Mass nne$, iwakken ad a$ Isemmeê tuccva nne$, akked wayen n ssêur i têeppmev fellane$. Pifxiô Öebbi d Imezgi".

ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nweêêa i Musa: "ôuê, deg iv, akked imdanen iW. Egg asen abrid akiwan, di yill. Ur ppagwad a kwen in vefôen, ur ppiwêic".

ayahs.translation: Ferâun, s iâsekôiwen is, vefôen ten. Isseblaâ ten yill, içça ten.

ayahs.translation: Itlef Ferâun agdud is, ur inhi.

ayahs.translation: A yAt Isôail! Ni$ Nsellek ikwen seg ucangu nnwen. Nefka yawen ppaâud, ar loiha tayeffus n udrar. Nessers awen d lmenna, ifeôôuoen.

ayahs.text: Eççet si lmakla ilhan, i s ikwen N$at. Ur zegret tilas fellas, mulac a kwen immager urrif iW. Win immuger urrif iW, ni$ igrareb.
ayahs.translation: Eççet si lmakla ilhan, i s ikwen N$at. Ur zegret tilas fellas, mulac a kwen immager urrif iW. Win immuger urrif iW, ni$ igrareb.

ayahs.translation: U Nek, s tidep, Psemmiêe$ i win isteôoâen, iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d$a ipwanha.

ayahs.translation: "Acu i k i$eûben seg ugdud ik, a Musa"?

ayahs.translation: Inna: "zgan deffir i. £awle$ d $ureK, a Mass iw, iwakken a Pôaviv".

ayahs.translation: Inna: "ih, ni$ Njeôôeb agdud ik, deffir ek. Itelf iten Usamiri".

ayahs.text: Iu$al ed Musa s agdud is, s zzâaf d wumri. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Day ur awen Ifka ara, Mass nnwen, lemâahda lâali? Day tâaîîel fellawen lemâahda? Ne$ day teb$am a kwen immager urrif n Mass nnwen? Tzeglem ppaâud iw".
ayahs.translation: Iu$al ed Musa s agdud is, s zzâaf d wumri. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Day ur awen Ifka ara, Mass nnwen, lemâahda lâali? Day tâaîîel fellawen lemâahda? Ne$ day teb$am a kwen immager urrif n Mass nnwen? Tzeglem ppaâud iw".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ur nezgil ppaâud ik, s leb$i nne$. Maca, nbubb tiâakkwmin n ôôêuê n ugdud, d$a nveggeô iten. Akken i iveggeô Usamiri".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ur nezgil ppaâud ik, s leb$i nne$. Maca, nbubb tiâakkwmin n ôôêuê n ugdud, d$a nveggeô iten. Akken i iveggeô Usamiri".

ayahs.text: Issuffe$ asen d aâejmi, d ameslux isrugmuten. Nnan: "wagi d ôebbi nnwen u d ôebbi n Musa. Ippu".
ayahs.translation: Issuffe$ asen d aâejmi, d ameslux isrugmuten. Nnan: "wagi d ôebbi nnwen u d ôebbi n Musa. Ippu".

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara, ur asen d ippara awal, ur izmir a ten ivuôô, ne$ a ten infaâ?
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara, ur asen d ippara awal, ur izmir a ten ivuôô, ne$ a ten infaâ?

ayahs.text: Ni$ Haôun inna yasen, uqbel: "a yagdud iw! Teppuhewwlem kan, yis. Mass nnwen, s tidep, d Aênin. Ddut yidi, vefôet lameô iw".
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Haôun inna yasen, uqbel: "a yagdud iw! Teppuhewwlem kan, yis. Mass nnwen, s tidep, d Aênin. Ddut yidi, vefôet lameô iw".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ur tnepfukku akaber is, d awez$i, alamma iu$al ed Musa $uône$".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ur tnepfukku akaber is, d awez$i, alamma iu$al ed Musa $uône$".

ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Haôun! D acu i k iîîfen, mi ten twalav nnetlafen?

ayahs.translation: Day ur teddiv ara yidi? Day tugiv lameô iw"?

ayahs.text: Inna: "a mmi s n yimma! Ur iyi ppaîîaf si tamart iw, ne$ seg uqeôôu w. Nek, s tideps, ugade$ ad iyi d tiniv: tessemfaôaqev At Isôail, ur tu$ev awal iw".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a mmi s n yimma! Ur iyi ppaîîaf si tamart iw, ne$ seg uqeôôu w. Nek, s tideps, ugade$ ad iyi d tiniv: tessemfaôaqev At Isôail, ur tu$ev awal iw".

ayahs.text: Inna: "d acu t leqsed ik a Usamiri"?
ayahs.translation: Inna: "d acu t leqsed ik a Usamiri"?

ayahs.translation: Inna: "wala$ ayen ur walan. Ddme$ d tummeét n lateô umazan, veggôe$ p. Akka ay êusse$ deg iman iw".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ôuê ihi, a ppevôu yidek di tmeddurt a ppeqqaôev: ur iyi pnalet! U, s tidep, $uôek ppaâud ik ur tezmirev a t tzeglev. Muqel ôebbi ik, u$uô mazal teqqimev, ard a t nesseô$, a t ssebruzzaâ ar yill, wakali".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ôuê ihi, a ppevôu yidek di tmeddurt a ppeqqaôev: ur iyi pnalet! U, s tidep, $uôek ppaâud ik ur tezmirev a t tzeglev. Muqel ôebbi ik, u$uô mazal teqqimev, ard a t nesseô$, a t ssebruzzaâ ar yill, wakali".

ayahs.text: Mass nnwen, siwa Öebbi. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Tamusni S tjemmel yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Mass nnwen, siwa Öebbi. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Tamusni S tjemmel yal cci.

ayahs.translation: Akka i k Nêekku, seg isallen n zik. Ni$ Nefka yak d, s$uône£, asmekti.

ayahs.text: Win i s iwexxôen, ad iâabbi taâkkwemt, ass n tnekra.
ayahs.translation: Win i s iwexxôen, ad iâabbi taâkkwemt, ass n tnekra.

ayahs.text: Ad wekkôen dinna. Ay dir ip fellasen ppaâbga, ass n tnekra!
ayahs.translation: Ad wekkôen dinna. Ay dir ip fellasen ppaâbga, ass n tnekra!

ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d ûuven di lbuq, a d Nefser ibe$wviyen, zgezwen assen.

ayahs.translation: Ad swecwicen wa i wa: "mraw kan i teqqimem".

ayahs.text: Nekwni, Nif akw akken Nessen, ayen d qqaôen, mi sen inna yiwen umxallef degsen: "teqqimem kan ibwass".
ayahs.translation: Nekwni, Nif akw akken Nessen, ayen d qqaôen, mi sen inna yiwen umxallef degsen: "teqqimem kan ibwass".

ayahs.text: Steqsayen k $ef idurar. Ini: "a ten Issebruzzaâ Mass iw, d iwzan.
ayahs.translation: Steqsayen k $ef idurar. Ini: "a ten Issebruzzaâ Mass iw, d iwzan.

ayahs.text: A ten Irr d aza$aô ibuôen.
ayahs.translation: A ten Irr d aza$aô ibuôen.

ayahs.text: Ur tepwaliv degs i iâawjen, ne$ i izzren".

Ma Nesse$li d ageffur fellas, ad ikker, ad icuff, a d ifk tayuga n yal ûûenf uziyn n le$ôus.
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Ma di ccekk ay tellam f tnekra, ihi, Nekwni, s tidep, Nxelq ikwen seg wakal, sinna, si tiqqit n l$ella, sinna, seg urgan, sinna, si tecriêt, texleq ur texliq, iwakken ad awen Nbeggen. Neppara, di tâabbuvin, ayen i £ ihwan, alamma d lajel ipwassnen. Sinna, Nessuffu$ ikwen id d llufanat, sinna a ppim$uôem. Segwen llan wid ippemmten, u segwen win ara iawven d awessur, ard ur ippisin acemma seg wayen issen. A pwalid akal d a$uôaô. Ma Nesse$li d ageffur fellas, ad ikker, ad icuff, a d ifk tayuga n yal ûûenf uziyn n le$ôus.

verses.text: Ayagi, acku Öebbi d Tidep. D Neppa id Issidiren lmeggtin. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ayagi, acku Öebbi d Tidep. D Neppa id Issidiren lmeggtin. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: U imir a d ias, war ccekk fellas. U Öebbi a d Issker wid illan di tneîlin.
verses.translation: U imir a d ias, war ccekk fellas. U Öebbi a d Issker wid illan di tneîlin.

verses.text: Ger imdanen, illa win ipnamaren $ef Öebbi, war tamusni, ne$ nnhaya, ne$ Tazmamt ifeten.
verses.translation: Ger imdanen, illa win ipnamaren $ef Öebbi, war tamusni, ne$ nnhaya, ne$ Tazmamt ifeten.

verses.text: Icuff aqenduô, iwakken ad itlef seg ubrid n Öebbi. Fellas xezzu di ddunit. Deg wass n tnekra, a Nessuk fellas aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt.
verses.translation: Icuff aqenduô, iwakken ad itlef seg ubrid n Öebbi. Fellas xezzu di ddunit. Deg wass n tnekra, a Nessuk fellas aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt.

verses.text: Ayagi, $ef wayen id urwen ifassen ik. U Öebbi ur Idennis imdanen.
verses.translation: Ayagi, $ef wayen id urwen ifassen ik. U Öebbi ur Idennis imdanen.

verses.text: Ger yimdanen, win iâabden Öebbi, $ef rrif. Ma iusa t id lxiô, ad ithenni yis. Ma iusa t id uhewwel, ad iswexxeô udem is. Öuêent as, ddunit, laxeôt. Ayagi d lexsaôa n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Ger yimdanen, win iâabden Öebbi, $ef rrif. Ma iusa t id lxiô, ad ithenni yis. Ma iusa t id uhewwel, ad iswexxeô udem is. Öuêent as, ddunit, laxeôt. Ayagi d lexsaôa n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ipnuju, war Öebbi, ar wayen ur t neîîuôôu, ur t neffaâ. D wagi ay d ttelfan u$miq.
verses.translation: Ipnuju, war Öebbi, ar wayen ur t neîîuôôu, ur t neffaâ. D wagi ay d ttelfan u$miq.

verses.text: Ipnuju ar bu vveôô izwaren aba$uô ines. Ay d bab ucmit, ay d acrik ucmit.
verses.translation: Ipnuju ar bu vveôô izwaren aba$uô ines. Ay d bab ucmit, ay d acrik ucmit.

verses.text: Öebbi, s tidep, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ixeddem ayen Ib$a.
verses.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ixeddem ayen Ib$a.

verses.text: Win i oaâlen ur t Ipsellik ara Öebbi, di ddunit, di laxeôt, ad iâalleq amrar s igenni, sinna, ad igzem nnefs is. Ad iéeô ma tiêêeôci s temêa ayen i t irêan.
verses.translation: Win i oaâlen ur t Ipsellik ara Öebbi, di ddunit, di laxeôt, ad iâalleq amrar s igenni, sinna, ad igzem nnefs is. Ad iéeô ma tiêêeôci s temêa ayen i t irêan.

verses.text: Akka ay t id Nessader, d issekniyen iberrzen. U Öebbi, s tidep, Inehhu win i S ihwan.
verses.translation: Akka ay t id Nessader, d issekniyen iberrzen. U Öebbi, s tidep, Inehhu win i S ihwan.

verses.text: Ih, ass n tnekra, ad Iêudd Öebbi ger wid iumnen, udayen, iûabiyen, imasiêiyen, u iâabbaden n tmes, wid ipcaraken. Öebbi, s tidep, Iwala yal cci.
verses.translation: Ih, ass n tnekra, ad Iêudd Öebbi ger wid iumnen, udayen, iûabiyen, imasiêiyen, u iâabbaden n tmes, wid ipcaraken. Öebbi, s tidep, Iwala yal cci.

verses.text: Ur twalav ara knan i Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt: iîij, aggur, itran, idurar, ttjuô, lêayawan, aîas n yimdanen. Aâaqeb d lewoeb $ef aîas. Win Isdull Öebbi, ur illi w ara t iâuzzen. Ih, Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
verses.translation: Ur twalav ara knan i Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt: iîij, aggur, itran, idurar, ttjuô, lêayawan, aîas n yimdanen. Aâaqeb d lewoeb $ef aîas. Win Isdull Öebbi, ur illi w ara t iâuzzen. Ih, Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.

verses.text: Atnan sin ixûimen ppemqellaân $ef Mass nnsen. S tmes ay pwafeûlen iceîîiven n wid ijehlen. Ad mmiren, $ef iqweôôa nnsen, waman iô$an
verses.translation: Atnan sin ixûimen ppemqellaân $ef Mass nnsen. S tmes ay pwafeûlen iceîîiven n wid ijehlen. Ad mmiren, $ef iqweôôa nnsen, waman iô$an

verses.text: ara issefsin ayen illan deg iâabbav nnsen, akked igwelman.
verses.translation: ara issefsin ayen illan deg iâabbav nnsen, akked igwelman.

verses.text: I nitni, ijekwaven n wuzzal.
verses.translation: I nitni, ijekwaven n wuzzal.

verses.text: Yal tikelt ara ssirmen a d ff$en segs, seg wakken meênen, a ten rren $uôes: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt"!
verses.translation: Yal tikelt ara ssirmen a d ff$en segs, seg wakken meênen, a ten rren $uôes: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt"!

verses.text: Öebbi, s tidep, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Degs ad qqnen imeqyasen n ddheb d lyaqut. Leêrir deg iceîîiven nnsen.
verses.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Degs ad qqnen imeqyasen n ddheb d lyaqut. Leêrir deg iceîîiven nnsen.

verses.text: Pwanhan s awal umâin, pwanhan s abrid Umaâzuz.
verses.translation: Pwanhan s awal umâin, pwanhan s abrid Umaâzuz.

verses.text: Ih, i wid ijehlen i issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, akked Loamaâ n Lêaôam, i Nerra i imdanen, ama d amezda$ n din, ama d abeôôani; i win ib$an degs tijehli, s ddens, a Nesâaddi aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ih, i wid ijehlen i issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, akked Loamaâ n Lêaôam, i Nerra i imdanen, ama d amezda$ n din, ama d abeôôani; i win ib$an degs tijehli, s ddens, a Nesâaddi aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Mi Nhegga i Ibôahim, amkan n Uxxam: "ur iyI pcarak acemma! Zizdeg axxam iW i wid idewwiôen, wid ibedden, wid iîîinizen, iknan.
verses.translation: Mi Nhegga i Ibôahim, amkan n Uxxam: "ur iyI pcarak acemma! Zizdeg axxam iW i wid idewwiôen, wid ibedden, wid iîîinizen, iknan.

verses.translation: Enced medden ar lêio. A d asen $uôek $ef uvaô, ne$ $ef yal amerkub ulîif. A d asen si yal abrid ibaâden.

verses.text: Ad cehhden $ef l$it nnsen. A d smektin ism n Öebbi, deg ussan ipwassnen, $ef ubhim n lmal i sen Ifka. Eççet segs, cceççet ame$bun, aéawali.
verses.translation: Ad cehhden $ef l$it nnsen. A d smektin ism n Öebbi, deg ussan ipwassnen, $ef ubhim n lmal i sen Ifka. Eççet segs, cceççet ame$bun, aéawali.

verses.text: Sinna, ad ssirden, ad qenâen asirem nnsen, ad dewwôen i Uxxam aqdim".
verses.translation: Sinna, ad ssirden, ad qenâen asirem nnsen, ad dewwôen i Uxxam aqdim".

verses.translation: Akka. Win ippâuzzun ayen Igdel Öebbi, ilha yas kteô, ar Mass is. Ëellen awen lmal, siwa wid i wen mlan. Janbet lâaô n tâancuôin, janbet awal n ééuô;

verses.translation: am wid imalen ar tidep ar Öebbi, ur aS pcaraken. Win ipcaraken i Öebbi, amzun i$li d seg igenni, u iccelqef it ufôux, ne$ inheô it wavu, s amekkan lqayen.

verses.translation: Akka. Win ippâuzzun isekkiren n Öebbi, ihi, d aêezzeb n wulawen.

verses.translation: I kunwi degs aba$uô ar lajel ipwassnen, sinna, îêegga nnsen ar Uxxam aqdim.

verses.translation: I yal lois, Nefka asekkir, iwakken a d smektin ism n Öebbi, $ef ubhim n lmal is iten N$at. Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Ihi, anzet aS. Becceô itubiyen,

verses.translation: wid iwumi ppergigin wulawen nnsen mara d mmektin Öebbi, wid iûebbôen i wayen iten iu$en, wid ipéallan u pseddiqen seg wayen is iten N$at.

verses.translation: Lmal iqebbwan, Nerra yawen ten, seg isekkiren n Öebbi. Degsen lfayda i kunwi. Bedret fellasen isem n Öebbi, mara d rsen. Mi $lin $ef ibeôdiyen nnsen, eççet segsen, cceççet aâîîaô, aéawali. Akka ay d Nenub fellawen yissen, amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.translation: Ur ippawev ar Öebbi uksum nnsen, ne$ idamen nnsen, d awez$i. Ara T iawven, d aêezzeb nnwen. Am akka, Inub fellawen yissen, iwakken ad aS tgem ccan i Öebbi, ilmend n nnhaya nnwen s$uôeS. Becceô wid imaânen.

verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi Ipfukku wid iumnen. Ih, Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara yal lxayen ajehli.
