verses.translation: Tsriê i wid ipwawwven imi pwadensen - Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer a ten Isellek -,

verses.translation: wid id ssuff$en seg ixxamen nnsen, war ssebba, imi kan qqaôen: "Mass nne$ d Öebbi". verses.translation: Wid, ma Nessqâad iten di tmurt, bedden i téallit, pzekkin, ppamôen lewqama, gedlen tuccva. Ar Öebbi ara d gwrin lumuô.

verses.translation: agdud n Ibôahim, akked ugdud n Luî,

verses.translation: At Madyan. Skaddben Musa. Fki$ lmudda i ijehliyen, sinna, Zzi$ d fellasen. A tuzzma W imiren!

verses.translation: Acêal n temdinin ay Nesqucc imi densent. Haatent ppint. Xlan lebyar, akked lebruo uohiden.

verses.translation: Day ur unagen ara di tmurt? Ad sâun, $ef waya, ulawen ad fehmen yissen, imeééu$en ara islen yissen. Maca, maççi d allen, d ulawen deg idmaren i idre$len.

verses.translation: B$an k a d tesqeôbev aâaqeb. Öebbi ur Ipzeggil lemâahda S, d awez$i. Ni$ ass, ar Mass ik, am agim iseggwasen, s leêsab nnwen.

verses.translation: Acêal n temdinin iwumi Fki$ lmudda, u irna densent. Sinna, Zzi$ fellasent. £uôI tu$alin.

verses.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen! Nek, $uôwen, d aneddaô kan ipbegginen".

verses.text: I wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.
verses.translation: I wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.

verses.translation: Wid iaânan asfunneg issekniyen nne£, widak d at ujajiê.

verses.translation: Ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, amazan ne$ nnbi, mebla ma ikecm ed Cciîan, deg wayen imenna, ma imenna. Itekkes Öebbi ayen d issekcam Cciîan, sinna, Itebbit issekniyen iS. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.translation: Iwakken ad Irr aggway n Cciîan d ahewwel, i at wulawen iblan akked at wulawen aquôan. Ih, imednas atnan di t$ennant tu$miqt.

verses.translation: Iwakken ad éôen wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni, ar neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass ik. Ad amnen yis. Ad as anzen wulawen nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Inehhu wid iumnen, s abrid uwqim.

verses.text: Zgan wid ijehlen di ccekk fellas, ar ten id ias yimir, deqzalla, ne$ ibbwev iten id uâaqeb n wass abarar.
verses.translation: Zgan wid ijehlen di ccekk fellas, ar ten id ias yimir, deqzalla, ne$ ibbwev iten id uâaqeb n wass abarar.

verses.text: Assen, tagelda i Öebbi. Ad Iêudd garasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di Loennet n ssuâada.
verses.translation: Assen, tagelda i Öebbi. Ad Iêudd garasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di Loennet n ssuâada.

verses.translation: I wid ijehlen, iskaddben issekniyen nne£, aâaqeb isdullun.

verses.text: Wid iunagen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, sinna, pwan$an ne$ mmuten, a ten I$it Öebbi, war ccekk, s ôôeéq umâin. Ih, Öebbi Yif akw im$iten.
verses.translation: Wid iunagen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, sinna, pwan$an ne$ mmuten, a ten I$it Öebbi, war ccekk, s ôôeéq umâin. Ih, Öebbi Yif akw im$iten.

verses.translation: A ten Issekcem anekcum ara ôadin. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, Iêellem.

verses.text: Akka. Win iâaqben akken ippuâaqeb, sinna, ipwadnes, war ccekk, a t Isellek Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipqili, Ipsemmiê.
verses.translation: Akka. Win iâaqben akken ippuâaqeb, sinna, ipwadnes, war ccekk, a t Isellek Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipqili, Ipsemmiê.

verses.text: Akka, acku Öebbi Issekcam iv deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiv. U Öebbi Issel, Ipwali.
verses.translation: Akka, acku Öebbi Issekcam iv deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiv. U Öebbi Issel, Ipwali.

verses.text: Akka, acku Öebbi d tidep, ma d ayen u$uô pnujun, war Neppa, d tikerkas. Ih, Öebbi d Aâlâyan, d Ameqwôan.
verses.translation: Akka, acku Öebbi d tidep, ma d ayen u$uô pnujun, war Neppa, d tikerkas. Ih, Öebbi d Aâlâyan, d Ameqwôan.

verses.text: Day ur twalav ara Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni, d$a izzegzew wakal? Ih, Öebbi d Laîif, Iéôa.
verses.translation: Day ur twalav ara Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni, d$a izzegzew wakal? Ih, Öebbi d Laîif, Iéôa.

verses.text: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ih, Öebbi, ar Neppa d Asâay d Amaâzuz.
verses.translation: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ih, Öebbi, ar Neppa d Asâay d Amaâzuz.

verses.text: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Inub ed fellawen s wayen illan di tmurt, akked lbabur ippazalen di yill, s lameô iS. Iîîef igenni ur d i$elli f tmurt, siwa ma Iunef as. Ih, Öebbi, war ccekk, Issuruf u Ipêunu i imdanen.
verses.translation: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Inub ed fellawen s wayen illan di tmurt, akked lbabur ippazalen di yill, s lameô iS. Iîîef igenni ur d i$elli f tmurt, siwa ma Iunef as. Ih, Öebbi, war ccekk, Issuruf u Ipêunu i imdanen.

verses.text: D Neppa ikwen Issadren, sinna, ara kwen In$en, sinna, ara kwen id Issadren. Amdan, s tidep, d ajehli.
verses.translation: D Neppa ikwen Issadren, sinna, ara kwen In$en, sinna, ara kwen id Issadren. Amdan, s tidep, d ajehli.

verses.translation: I yal lois, Nefka asekkir, teddun degs. Ulay$eô i k pna$en $ef lameô. Nuj ar Mass ik; ih, aql ak, keçç, di nnhaya tuwqimt.

verses.translation: Ma numren k, ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Öebbi ad Iêudd garawen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen tellam temgarradem".
verses.translation: Öebbi ad Iêudd garawen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen tellam temgarradem".

verses.text: Day ur teéôiv ara Öebbi Issen i illan deg igenni akked tmurt? Ayagi, s tidep, di Tezmamt. Ih, ayagi ishel i Öebbi.
verses.translation: Day ur teéôiv ara Öebbi Issen i illan deg igenni akked tmurt? Ayagi, s tidep, di Tezmamt. Ih, ayagi ishel i Öebbi.

verses.text: La âabden, war Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu, ayen ur ssinen. Imednas, ur illi wa ara ten isellken.
verses.translation: La âabden, war Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu, ayen ur ssinen. Imednas, ur illi wa ara ten isellken.

verses.text: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, a pâaqlev asmmummi deg udmawen n wid ijehlen. Qôib ad éevmen $ef wid i sen iqqaôen issekniyen nne£. Ini: "a kwen xebbôe$ af wayen i$elben aya: times i Iâahed Öebbi i wid ijehlen". A tu$alin tucmip!
verses.translation: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, a pâaqlev asmmummi deg udmawen n wid ijehlen. Qôib ad éevmen $ef wid i sen iqqaôen issekniyen nne£. Ini: "a kwen xebbôe$ af wayen i$elben aya: times i Iâahed Öebbi i wid ijehlen". A tu$alin tucmip!

verses.text: A yimdanen! Ippunefk ed umedya, selt as d: ih, wid u$uô tepnujum, war Öebbi, ur zmiren, d awez$i, a d xelqen izi, xas mlalen $ef waya. Ma illa wayen i sen iuker yizi, ur zmiren ad as t id kksen. D uôhif umsuter, d uôhif win issuter.
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Ippunefk ed umedya, selt as d: ih, wid u$uô tepnujum, war Öebbi, ur zmiren, d awez$i, a d xelqen izi, xas mlalen $ef waya. Ma illa wayen i sen iuker yizi, ur zmiren ad as t id kksen. D uôhif umsuter, d uôhif win issuter.

verses.text: Ur qudôen ara Öebbi, azal n lqedô iS. Ih, Öebbi d Uohid, d Uzmir.
verses.translation: Ur qudôen ara Öebbi, azal n lqedô iS. Ih, Öebbi d Uohid, d Uzmir.

verses.text: Öebbi Iferren imazanen ger lmalayek, u ger imdanen. Ih, Öebbi Issel, Ipwali.
verses.translation: Öebbi Iferren imazanen ger lmalayek, u ger imdanen. Ih, Öebbi Issel, Ipwali.

verses.text: Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ar Öebbi ad u$alen lumuô.
verses.translation: Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ar Öebbi ad u$alen lumuô.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ïîinzet u knut, âabdet Mass nnwen, xedmet lxiô, amar a prebêem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ïîinzet u knut, âabdet Mass nnwen, xedmet lxiô, amar a prebêem.

verses.text: Jahdet ar Öebbi lêeqq ujahed iS. Neppa Ifren ikwen. Ur kwen Ihejjen ara di ddin, ddin ubabat wen Ibôahim. Neppa, i wen isemman, zik, imvuâen. Deg waya, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen, u a ppilim d inagan n medden. Ihi, ééallet, zekkit, teîîfem di Öebbi. Neppa d Bab nnwen. D Bab amxallef, d Asellak amxallef.
verses.translation: Jahdet ar Öebbi lêeqq ujahed iS. Neppa Ifren ikwen. Ur kwen Ihejjen ara di ddin, ddin ubabat wen Ibôahim. Neppa, i wen isemman, zik, imvuâen. Deg waya, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen, u a ppilim d inagan n medden. Ihi, ééallet, zekkit, teîîfem di Öebbi. Neppa d Bab nnwen. D Bab amxallef, d Asellak amxallef.

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Ëezzbet i Mass nnwen, zzenzla n yimir, stidep, d tadyant tabarart.
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Ëezzbet i Mass nnwen, zzenzla n yimir, stidep, d tadyant tabarart.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara p twalim, yal timôebbit a ppeppu win tessuîîuv, yal tadist a ppexseô. A pwaliv imdanen ssekôen, ur sskiôen. Maca, aâaqeb n Öebbi iwâaô.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara p twalim, yal timôebbit a ppeppu win tessuîîuv, yal tadist a ppexseô. A pwaliv imdanen ssekôen, ur sskiôen. Maca, aâaqeb n Öebbi iwâaô.

ayahs.text: Ger yimdanen, illa win ipnamaren $ef Öebbi, war tamusni. Iteddu d yal cciîan imcebbwel.
ayahs.translation: Ger yimdanen, illa win ipnamaren $ef Öebbi, war tamusni. Iteddu d yal cciîan imcebbwel.

ayahs.text: Iura fellas: "ar wagi, win i t irran d bab is, ara t itlef, s tidep, u a t inheô ar uâaqeb ujajiê".
ayahs.translation: Iura fellas: "ar wagi, win i t irran d bab is, ara t itlef, s tidep, u a t inheô ar uâaqeb ujajiê".

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Ma di ccekk ay tellam f tnekra, ihi, Nekwni, s tidep, Nxelq ikwen seg wakal, sinna, si tiqqit n l$ella, sinna, seg urgan, sinna, si tecriêt, texleq ur texliq, iwakken ad awen Nbeggen. Neppara, di tâabbuvin, ayen i £ ihwan, alamma d lajel ipwassnen. Sinna, Nessuffu$ ikwen id d llufanat, sinna a ppim$uôem. Segwen llan wid ippemmten, u segwen win ara iawven d awessur, ard ur ippisin acemma seg wayen issen. A pwalid akal d a$uôaô. Ma Nesse$li d ageffur fellas, ad ikker, ad icuff, a d ifk tayuga n yal ûûenf uziyn n le$ôus.
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Ma di ccekk ay tellam f tnekra, ihi, Nekwni, s tidep, Nxelq ikwen seg wakal, sinna, si tiqqit n l$ella, sinna, seg urgan, sinna, si tecriêt, texleq ur texliq, iwakken ad awen Nbeggen. Neppara, di tâabbuvin, ayen i £ ihwan, alamma d lajel ipwassnen. Sinna, Nessuffu$ ikwen id d llufanat, sinna a ppim$uôem. Segwen llan wid ippemmten, u segwen win ara iawven d awessur, ard ur ippisin acemma seg wayen issen. A pwalid akal d a$uôaô. Ma Nesse$li d ageffur fellas, ad ikker, ad icuff, a d ifk tayuga n yal ûûenf uziyn n le$ôus.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, acku Öebbi d Tidep. D Neppa id Issidiren lmeggtin. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, acku Öebbi d Tidep. D Neppa id Issidiren lmeggtin. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: U imir a d ias, war ccekk fellas. U Öebbi a d Issker wid illan di tneîlin.
ayahs.translation: U imir a d ias, war ccekk fellas. U Öebbi a d Issker wid illan di tneîlin.

ayahs.text: Ger imdanen, illa win ipnamaren $ef Öebbi, war tamusni, ne$ nnhaya, ne$ Tazmamt ifeten.
ayahs.translation: Ger imdanen, illa win ipnamaren $ef Öebbi, war tamusni, ne$ nnhaya, ne$ Tazmamt ifeten.

ayahs.text: Icuff aqenduô, iwakken ad itlef seg ubrid n Öebbi. Fellas xezzu di ddunit. Deg wass n tnekra, a Nessuk fellas aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt.
ayahs.translation: Icuff aqenduô, iwakken ad itlef seg ubrid n Öebbi. Fellas xezzu di ddunit. Deg wass n tnekra, a Nessuk fellas aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, $ef wayen id urwen ifassen ik. U Öebbi ur Idennis imdanen.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, $ef wayen id urwen ifassen ik. U Öebbi ur Idennis imdanen.

ayahs.text: Ger yimdanen, win iâabden Öebbi, $ef rrif. Ma iusa t id lxiô, ad ithenni yis. Ma iusa t id uhewwel, ad iswexxeô udem is. Öuêent as, ddunit, laxeôt. Ayagi d lexsaôa n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Ger yimdanen, win iâabden Öebbi, $ef rrif. Ma iusa t id lxiô, ad ithenni yis. Ma iusa t id uhewwel, ad iswexxeô udem is. Öuêent as, ddunit, laxeôt. Ayagi d lexsaôa n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ipnuju, war Öebbi, ar wayen ur t neîîuôôu, ur t neffaâ. D wagi ay d ttelfan u$miq.
ayahs.translation: Ipnuju, war Öebbi, ar wayen ur t neîîuôôu, ur t neffaâ. D wagi ay d ttelfan u$miq.

ayahs.text: Ipnuju ar bu vveôô izwaren aba$uô ines. Ay d bab ucmit, ay d acrik ucmit.
ayahs.translation: Ipnuju ar bu vveôô izwaren aba$uô ines. Ay d bab ucmit, ay d acrik ucmit.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, s tidep, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ixeddem ayen Ib$a.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, i ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ixeddem ayen Ib$a.

ayahs.text: Win i oaâlen ur t Ipsellik ara Öebbi, di ddunit, di laxeôt, ad iâalleq amrar s igenni, sinna, ad igzem nnefs is. Ad iéeô ma tiêêeôci s temêa ayen i t irêan.
ayahs.translation: Win i oaâlen ur t Ipsellik ara Öebbi, di ddunit, di laxeôt, ad iâalleq amrar s igenni, sinna, ad igzem nnefs is. Ad iéeô ma tiêêeôci s temêa ayen i t irêan.

ayahs.text: Akka ay t id Nessader, d issekniyen iberrzen. U Öebbi, s tidep, Inehhu win i S ihwan.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay t id Nessader, d issekniyen iberrzen. U Öebbi, s tidep, Inehhu win i S ihwan.

ayahs.text: Ih, ass n tnekra, ad Iêudd Öebbi ger wid iumnen, udayen, iûabiyen, imasiêiyen, u iâabbaden n tmes, wid ipcaraken. Öebbi, s tidep, Iwala yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ass n tnekra, ad Iêudd Öebbi ger wid iumnen, udayen, iûabiyen, imasiêiyen, u iâabbaden n tmes, wid ipcaraken. Öebbi, s tidep, Iwala yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ur twalav ara knan i Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt: iîij, aggur, itran, idurar, ttjuô, lêayawan, aîas n yimdanen. Aâaqeb d lewoeb $ef aîas. Win Isdull Öebbi, ur illi w ara t iâuzzen. Ih, Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.
ayahs.translation: Ur twalav ara knan i Öebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt: iîij, aggur, itran, idurar, ttjuô, lêayawan, aîas n yimdanen. Aâaqeb d lewoeb $ef aîas. Win Isdull Öebbi, ur illi w ara t iâuzzen. Ih, Öebbi Ixeddem ayen i S ihwan.

ayahs.text: Atnan sin ixûimen ppemqellaân $ef Mass nnsen. S tmes ay pwafeûlen iceîîiven n wid ijehlen. Ad mmiren, $ef iqweôôa nnsen, waman iô$an
ayahs.translation: Atnan sin ixûimen ppemqellaân $ef Mass nnsen. S tmes ay pwafeûlen iceîîiven n wid ijehlen. Ad mmiren, $ef iqweôôa nnsen, waman iô$an

ayahs.text: ara issefsin ayen illan deg iâabbav nnsen, akked igwelman.
ayahs.translation: ara issefsin ayen illan deg iâabbav nnsen, akked igwelman.

ayahs.text: I nitni, ijekwaven n wuzzal.
ayahs.translation: I nitni, ijekwaven n wuzzal.

ayahs.text: Yal tikelt ara ssirmen a d ff$en segs, seg wakken meênen, a ten rren $uôes: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt"!
ayahs.translation: Yal tikelt ara ssirmen a d ff$en segs, seg wakken meênen, a ten rren $uôes: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmeô$iwt"!

ayahs.text: Öebbi, s tidep, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Degs ad qqnen imeqyasen n ddheb d lyaqut. Leêrir deg iceîîiven nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Degs ad qqnen imeqyasen n ddheb d lyaqut. Leêrir deg iceîîiven nnsen.

ayahs.text: Pwanhan s awal umâin, pwanhan s abrid Umaâzuz.
ayahs.translation: Pwanhan s awal umâin, pwanhan s abrid Umaâzuz.

ayahs.text: Ih, i wid ijehlen i issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, akked Loamaâ n Lêaôam, i Nerra i imdanen, ama d amezda$ n din, ama d abeôôani; i win ib$an degs tijehli, s ddens, a Nesâaddi aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, i wid ijehlen i issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, akked Loamaâ n Lêaôam, i Nerra i imdanen, ama d amezda$ n din, ama d abeôôani; i win ib$an degs tijehli, s ddens, a Nesâaddi aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Mi Nhegga i Ibôahim, amkan n Uxxam: "ur iyI pcarak acemma! Zizdeg axxam iW i wid idewwiôen, wid ibedden, wid iîîinizen, iknan.
ayahs.translation: Mi Nhegga i Ibôahim, amkan n Uxxam: "ur iyI pcarak acemma! Zizdeg axxam iW i wid idewwiôen, wid ibedden, wid iîîinizen, iknan.

ayahs.text: Enced medden ar lêio. A d asen $uôek $ef uvaô, ne$ $ef yal amerkub ulîif. A d asen si yal abrid ibaâden.
ayahs.translation: Enced medden ar lêio. A d asen $uôek $ef uvaô, ne$ $ef yal amerkub ulîif. A d asen si yal abrid ibaâden.

ayahs.text: Ad cehhden $ef l$it nnsen. A d smektin ism n Öebbi, deg ussan ipwassnen, $ef ubhim n lmal i sen Ifka. Eççet segs, cceççet ame$bun, aéawali.
ayahs.translation: Ad cehhden $ef l$it nnsen. A d smektin ism n Öebbi, deg ussan ipwassnen, $ef ubhim n lmal i sen Ifka. Eççet segs, cceççet ame$bun, aéawali.

ayahs.text: Sinna, ad ssirden, ad qenâen asirem nnsen, ad dewwôen i Uxxam aqdim".
ayahs.translation: Sinna, ad ssirden, ad qenâen asirem nnsen, ad dewwôen i Uxxam aqdim".

ayahs.text: Akka. Win ippâuzzun ayen Igdel Öebbi, ilha yas kteô, ar Mass is. Ëellen awen lmal, siwa wid i wen mlan. Janbet lâaô n tâancuôin, janbet awal n ééuô;
ayahs.translation: Akka. Win ippâuzzun ayen Igdel Öebbi, ilha yas kteô, ar Mass is. Ëellen awen lmal, siwa wid i wen mlan. Janbet lâaô n tâancuôin, janbet awal n ééuô;

ayahs.text: am wid imalen ar tidep ar Öebbi, ur aS pcaraken. Win ipcaraken i Öebbi, amzun i$li d seg igenni, u iccelqef it ufôux, ne$ inheô it wavu, s amekkan lqayen.
ayahs.translation: am wid imalen ar tidep ar Öebbi, ur aS pcaraken. Win ipcaraken i Öebbi, amzun i$li d seg igenni, u iccelqef it ufôux, ne$ inheô it wavu, s amekkan lqayen.

ayahs.text: Akka. Win ippâuzzun isekkiren n Öebbi, ihi, d aêezzeb n wulawen.
ayahs.translation: Akka. Win ippâuzzun isekkiren n Öebbi, ihi, d aêezzeb n wulawen.

ayahs.text: I kunwi degs aba$uô ar lajel ipwassnen, sinna, îêegga nnsen ar Uxxam aqdim.
ayahs.translation: I kunwi degs aba$uô ar lajel ipwassnen, sinna, îêegga nnsen ar Uxxam aqdim.

ayahs.text: I yal lois, Nefka asekkir, iwakken a d smektin ism n Öebbi, $ef ubhim n lmal is iten N$at. Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Ihi, anzet aS. Becceô itubiyen,
ayahs.translation: I yal lois, Nefka asekkir, iwakken a d smektin ism n Öebbi, $ef ubhim n lmal is iten N$at. Öebbi nnwen d Öebbi Yiwen. Ihi, anzet aS. Becceô itubiyen,

ayahs.text: wid iwumi ppergigin wulawen nnsen mara d mmektin Öebbi, wid iûebbôen i wayen iten iu$en, wid ipéallan u pseddiqen seg wayen is iten N$at.
ayahs.translation: wid iwumi ppergigin wulawen nnsen mara d mmektin Öebbi, wid iûebbôen i wayen iten iu$en, wid ipéallan u pseddiqen seg wayen is iten N$at.

ayahs.text: Lmal iqebbwan, Nerra yawen ten, seg isekkiren n Öebbi. Degsen lfayda i kunwi. Bedret fellasen isem n Öebbi, mara d rsen. Mi $lin $ef ibeôdiyen nnsen, eççet segsen, cceççet aâîîaô, aéawali. Akka ay d Nenub fellawen yissen, amar a ppesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: Lmal iqebbwan, Nerra yawen ten, seg isekkiren n Öebbi. Degsen lfayda i kunwi. Bedret fellasen isem n Öebbi, mara d rsen. Mi $lin $ef ibeôdiyen nnsen, eççet segsen, cceççet aâîîaô, aéawali. Akka ay d Nenub fellawen yissen, amar a ppesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: Ur ippawev ar Öebbi uksum nnsen, ne$ idamen nnsen, d awez$i. Ara T iawven, d aêezzeb nnwen. Am akka, Inub fellawen yissen, iwakken ad aS tgem ccan i Öebbi, ilmend n nnhaya nnwen s$uôeS. Becceô wid imaânen.
ayahs.translation: Ur ippawev ar Öebbi uksum nnsen, ne$ idamen nnsen, d awez$i. Ara T iawven, d aêezzeb nnwen. Am akka, Inub fellawen yissen, iwakken ad aS tgem ccan i Öebbi, ilmend n nnhaya nnwen s$uôeS. Becceô wid imaânen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi Ipfukku wid iumnen. Ih, Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara yal lxayen ajehli.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi Ipfukku wid iumnen. Ih, Öebbi ur Iêemmel ara yal lxayen ajehli.

ayahs.text: Tsriê i wid ipwawwven imi pwadensen - Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer a ten Isellek -,
ayahs.translation: Tsriê i wid ipwawwven imi pwadensen - Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer a ten Isellek -,

ayahs.text: wid id ssuff$en seg ixxamen nnsen, war ssebba, imi kan qqaôen: "Mass nne$ d Öebbi". Lemmer ur Iswexxiô ara Öebbi imdanen, kra s kra, ara ipwahudden, war ccekk, d tiqwebtin, timezgida, lemûellat, lowamaâ ideg d smektayen, aîas, ism n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ippaâwan win iT ippaâwanen. Öebbi, s tidep, d Uohid, d Uzmir.
ayahs.translation: wid id ssuff$en seg ixxamen nnsen, war ssebba, imi kan qqaôen: "Mass nne$ d Öebbi". Lemmer ur Iswexxiô ara Öebbi imdanen, kra s kra, ara ipwahudden, war ccekk, d tiqwebtin, timezgida, lemûellat, lowamaâ ideg d smektayen, aîas, ism n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ippaâwan win iT ippaâwanen. Öebbi, s tidep, d Uohid, d Uzmir.

ayahs.text: Wid, ma Nessqâad iten di tmurt, bedden i téallit, pzekkin, ppamôen lewqama, gedlen tuccva. Ar Öebbi ara d gwrin lumuô.
ayahs.translation: Wid, ma Nessqâad iten di tmurt, bedden i téallit, pzekkin, ppamôen lewqama, gedlen tuccva. Ar Öebbi ara d gwrin lumuô.

ayahs.text: Ma skaddben k, ni$ skaddben, uqbel nnsen, igduden n Nuê, Âad, akked Tamud,
ayahs.translation: Ma skaddben k, ni$ skaddben, uqbel nnsen, igduden n Nuê, Âad, akked Tamud,

ayahs.text: agdud n Ibôahim, akked ugdud n Luî,
ayahs.translation: agdud n Ibôahim, akked ugdud n Luî,

ayahs.text: At Madyan. Skaddben Musa. Fki$ lmudda i ijehliyen, sinna, Zzi$ d fellasen. A tuzzma W imiren!
ayahs.translation: At Madyan. Skaddben Musa. Fki$ lmudda i ijehliyen, sinna, Zzi$ d fellasen. A tuzzma W imiren!

ayahs.text: Acêal n temdinin ay Nesqucc imi densent. Haatent ppint. Xlan lebyar, akked lebruo uohiden.
ayahs.translation: Acêal n temdinin ay Nesqucc imi densent. Haatent ppint. Xlan lebyar, akked lebruo uohiden.

ayahs.text: Day ur unagen ara di tmurt? Ad sâun, $ef waya, ulawen ad fehmen yissen, imeééu$en ara islen yissen. Maca, maççi d allen, d ulawen deg idmaren i idre$len.
ayahs.translation: Day ur unagen ara di tmurt? Ad sâun, $ef waya, ulawen ad fehmen yissen, imeééu$en ara islen yissen. Maca, maççi d allen, d ulawen deg idmaren i idre$len.

ayahs.text: B$an k a d tesqeôbev aâaqeb. Öebbi ur Ipzeggil lemâahda S, d awez$i. Ni$ ass, ar Mass ik, am agim iseggwasen, s leêsab nnwen.
ayahs.translation: B$an k a d tesqeôbev aâaqeb. Öebbi ur Ipzeggil lemâahda S, d awez$i. Ni$ ass, ar Mass ik, am agim iseggwasen, s leêsab nnwen.

ayahs.text: Acêal n temdinin iwumi Fki$ lmudda, u irna densent. Sinna, Zzi$ fellasent. £uôI tu$alin.
ayahs.translation: Acêal n temdinin iwumi Fki$ lmudda, u irna densent. Sinna, Zzi$ fellasent. £uôI tu$alin.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yimdanen! Nek, $uôwen, d aneddaô kan ipbegginen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen! Nek, $uôwen, d aneddaô kan ipbegginen".

ayahs.text: I wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.
ayahs.translation: I wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.

ayahs.text: Wid iaânan asfunneg issekniyen nne£, widak d at ujajiê.
ayahs.translation: Wid iaânan asfunneg issekniyen nne£, widak d at ujajiê.

ayahs.text: Ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, amazan ne$ nnbi, mebla ma ikecm ed Cciîan, deg wayen imenna, ma imenna. Itekkes Öebbi ayen d issekcam Cciîan, sinna, Itebbit issekniyen iS. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, amazan ne$ nnbi, mebla ma ikecm ed Cciîan, deg wayen imenna, ma imenna. Itekkes Öebbi ayen d issekcam Cciîan, sinna, Itebbit issekniyen iS. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad Irr aggway n Cciîan d ahewwel, i at wulawen iblan akked at wulawen aquôan. Ih, imednas atnan di t$ennant tu$miqt.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad Irr aggway n Cciîan d ahewwel, i at wulawen iblan akked at wulawen aquôan. Ih, imednas atnan di t$ennant tu$miqt.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad éôen wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni, ar neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass ik. Ad amnen yis. Ad as anzen wulawen nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Inehhu wid iumnen, s abrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad éôen wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni, ar neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass ik. Ad amnen yis. Ad as anzen wulawen nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Inehhu wid iumnen, s abrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Zgan wid ijehlen di ccekk fellas, ar ten id ias yimir, deqzalla, ne$ ibbwev iten id uâaqeb n wass abarar.
ayahs.translation: Zgan wid ijehlen di ccekk fellas, ar ten id ias yimir, deqzalla, ne$ ibbwev iten id uâaqeb n wass abarar.

ayahs.text: Assen, tagelda i Öebbi. Ad Iêudd garasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di Loennet n ssuâada.
ayahs.translation: Assen, tagelda i Öebbi. Ad Iêudd garasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di Loennet n ssuâada.

ayahs.text: I wid ijehlen, iskaddben issekniyen nne£, aâaqeb isdullun.
ayahs.translation: I wid ijehlen, iskaddben issekniyen nne£, aâaqeb isdullun.

ayahs.text: Wid iunagen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, sinna, pwan$an ne$ mmuten, a ten I$it Öebbi, war ccekk, s ôôeéq umâin. Ih, Öebbi Yif akw im$iten.
ayahs.translation: Wid iunagen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, sinna, pwan$an ne$ mmuten, a ten I$it Öebbi, war ccekk, s ôôeéq umâin. Ih, Öebbi Yif akw im$iten.

ayahs.text: A ten Issekcem anekcum ara ôadin. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, Iêellem.
ayahs.translation: A ten Issekcem anekcum ara ôadin. Ih, Öebbi d Amusnaw, Iêellem.

ayahs.text: Akka. Win iâaqben akken ippuâaqeb, sinna, ipwadnes, war ccekk, a t Isellek Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipqili, Ipsemmiê.
ayahs.translation: Akka. Win iâaqben akken ippuâaqeb, sinna, ipwadnes, war ccekk, a t Isellek Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipqili, Ipsemmiê.

ayahs.text: Akka, acku Öebbi Issekcam iv deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiv. U Öebbi Issel, Ipwali.
ayahs.translation: Akka, acku Öebbi Issekcam iv deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiv. U Öebbi Issel, Ipwali.

ayahs.text: Akka, acku Öebbi d tidep, ma d ayen u$uô pnujun, war Neppa, d tikerkas. Ih, Öebbi d Aâlâyan, d Ameqwôan.
ayahs.translation: Akka, acku Öebbi d tidep, ma d ayen u$uô pnujun, war Neppa, d tikerkas. Ih, Öebbi d Aâlâyan, d Ameqwôan.

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni, d$a izzegzew wakal? Ih, Öebbi d Laîif, Iéôa.
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni, d$a izzegzew wakal? Ih, Öebbi d Laîif, Iéôa.

ayahs.text: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ih, Öebbi, ar Neppa d Asâay d Amaâzuz.
ayahs.translation: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ih, Öebbi, ar Neppa d Asâay d Amaâzuz.

ayahs.text: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Inub ed fellawen s wayen illan di tmurt, akked lbabur ippazalen di yill, s lameô iS. Iîîef igenni ur d i$elli f tmurt, siwa ma Iunef as. Ih, Öebbi, war ccekk, Issuruf u Ipêunu i imdanen.
ayahs.translation: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Inub ed fellawen s wayen illan di tmurt, akked lbabur ippazalen di yill, s lameô iS. Iîîef igenni ur d i$elli f tmurt, siwa ma Iunef as. Ih, Öebbi, war ccekk, Issuruf u Ipêunu i imdanen.

ayahs.text: D Neppa ikwen Issadren, sinna, ara kwen In$en, sinna, ara kwen id Issadren. Amdan, s tidep, d ajehli.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa ikwen Issadren, sinna, ara kwen In$en, sinna, ara kwen id Issadren. Amdan, s tidep, d ajehli.

ayahs.text: I yal lois, Nefka asekkir, teddun degs. Ulay$eô i k pna$en $ef lameô. Nuj ar Mass ik; ih, aql ak, keçç, di nnhaya tuwqimt.
ayahs.translation: I yal lois, Nefka asekkir, teddun degs. Ulay$eô i k pna$en $ef lameô. Nuj ar Mass ik; ih, aql ak, keçç, di nnhaya tuwqimt.

ayahs.text: Ma numren k, ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ma numren k, ini: "Öebbi Yif akw akken Issen ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Öebbi ad Iêudd garawen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen tellam temgarradem".
ayahs.translation: Öebbi ad Iêudd garawen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen tellam temgarradem".

ayahs.text: Day ur teéôiv ara Öebbi Issen i illan deg igenni akked tmurt? Ayagi, s tidep, di Tezmamt. Ih, ayagi ishel i Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Day ur teéôiv ara Öebbi Issen i illan deg igenni akked tmurt? Ayagi, s tidep, di Tezmamt. Ih, ayagi ishel i Öebbi.

ayahs.text: La âabden, war Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu, ayen ur ssinen. Imednas, ur illi wa ara ten isellken.
ayahs.translation: La âabden, war Öebbi, ayen iwumi ur d Issers adabu, ayen ur ssinen. Imednas, ur illi wa ara ten isellken.

ayahs.text: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, a pâaqlev asmmummi deg udmawen n wid ijehlen. Qôib ad éevmen $ef wid i sen iqqaôen issekniyen nne£. Ini: "a kwen xebbôe$ af wayen i$elben aya: times i Iâahed Öebbi i wid ijehlen". A tu$alin tucmip!
ayahs.translation: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, a pâaqlev asmmummi deg udmawen n wid ijehlen. Qôib ad éevmen $ef wid i sen iqqaôen issekniyen nne£. Ini: "a kwen xebbôe$ af wayen i$elben aya: times i Iâahed Öebbi i wid ijehlen". A tu$alin tucmip!

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Ippunefk ed umedya, selt as d: ih, wid u$uô tepnujum, war Öebbi, ur zmiren, d awez$i, a d xelqen izi, xas mlalen $ef waya. Ma illa wayen i sen iuker yizi, ur zmiren ad as t id kksen. D uôhif umsuter, d uôhif win issuter.
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Ippunefk ed umedya, selt as d: ih, wid u$uô tepnujum, war Öebbi, ur zmiren, d awez$i, a d xelqen izi, xas mlalen $ef waya. Ma illa wayen i sen iuker yizi, ur zmiren ad as t id kksen. D uôhif umsuter, d uôhif win issuter.

ayahs.text: Ur qudôen ara Öebbi, azal n lqedô iS. Ih, Öebbi d Uohid, d Uzmir.
ayahs.translation: Ur qudôen ara Öebbi, azal n lqedô iS. Ih, Öebbi d Uohid, d Uzmir.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Iferren imazanen ger lmalayek, u ger imdanen. Ih, Öebbi Issel, Ipwali.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Iferren imazanen ger lmalayek, u ger imdanen. Ih, Öebbi Issel, Ipwali.

ayahs.text: Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ar Öebbi ad u$alen lumuô.
ayahs.translation: Issen i illan zdat sen, i illan deffir sen. Ar Öebbi ad u$alen lumuô.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ïîinzet u knut, âabdet Mass nnwen, xedmet lxiô, amar a prebêem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ïîinzet u knut, âabdet Mass nnwen, xedmet lxiô, amar a prebêem.

ayahs.text: Jahdet ar Öebbi lêeqq ujahed iS. Neppa Ifren ikwen. Ur kwen Ihejjen ara di ddin, ddin ubabat wen Ibôahim. Neppa, i wen isemman, zik, imvuâen. Deg waya, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen, u a ppilim d inagan n medden. Ihi, ééallet, zekkit, teîîfem di Öebbi. Neppa d Bab nnwen. D Bab amxallef, d Asellak amxallef.
ayahs.translation: Jahdet ar Öebbi lêeqq ujahed iS. Neppa Ifren ikwen. Ur kwen Ihejjen ara di ddin, ddin ubabat wen Ibôahim. Neppa, i wen isemman, zik, imvuâen. Deg waya, ad yili Umazan d anagi nnwen, u a ppilim d inagan n medden. Ihi, ééallet, zekkit, teîîfem di Öebbi. Neppa d Bab nnwen. D Bab amxallef, d Asellak amxallef.

verses.text: Ni$ lmumnin rebêen.
verses.translation: Ni$ lmumnin rebêen.

verses.translation: Wid ipéallan s wannuz;

verses.translation: wid ijunben yir awal;

verses.translation: wid ipzekkin;

verses.translation: wid iêurben af tuzzuft nnsen

verses.translation: - siwa ar tlawin nnsen, ne$ taklatin nnsen. Akka, ur degsen tiyta;

verses.translation: wid ib$an sennig waya, widak zegren tilisa -,

verses.translation: wid ipqadaren lamanat nnsen, u lemâahda nnsen;

verses.translation: wid iwennâen tiéilla nnsen.

verses.translation: wid ara iweôten Loennet, degs ad wekkôen.

verses.translation: Ni$ Nexleq amdan, seg ufûil n talaxt,

verses.translation: sinna, Nerra t d tiqqit deg umekkan n laman;

verses.translation: sinna, tiqqit Nxelq ip d argen; d$a, argen Nxelq it d acelleqluq; d$a, acelleqluq Nxelq it d i$san; d$a, Nessels aksum i yi$san. Sinna, Nxelq it d lxelq amaynut. Ad Ibarek Öebbi, Imxeyyeô ixellaqen!

verses.translation: Sinna, deffir waya, war ccekk, a ppemmtem.

verses.translation: Sinna, ih, ass n tnekra, a d tu$alem.

verses.translation: Ni$ Nexleq, sennig wen, ûa iberdan. Ur Nelli, $ef uxlaq, seg i$wefliyen.

verses.translation: Nessader ed, seg igenni, aman s lmizan. Naâteq iten di tmurt. Nezmer a ten Nessôuê.

verses.translation: Nxelq awen, yissen, leonanat n tezdayin akked téuôin; degsen, i kunwi, aîas n yizwayen, teppeppem segsen;

verses.translation: Akked ttejôa, id iff$en seg udrar n Sina. Teppak ed zzit u ddhin, i wid iteppen.

verses.translation: Ih, di lmal, aselmed i kunwi. Nesswa kwen s wayen illan deg iâabbav nnsen. Aîas n uba$uô degsen, i kunwi. Teppeppem segsen.

verses.translation: Fellasen, u $ef lbabuô, ppawin kwen.

verses.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê i ugdud is. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi. Ur awen illi ôebbi, war Neppa. Day ur tepêezziben ara"?

verses.translation: Nnan imvebbôen ijehliyen, n ugdud is: "wagi d amdan kan, am kunwi; ib$a a d ikk sennig wen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, a d Issers lmalayek. Ur nesli s waya, ar lejdud nne$ imezwura.

verses.translation: Neppa d argaz kan aôehbani. Qaôaâet ep, tallit kan".

verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Awes iyi, skaddben iyi".

verses.translation: Nweêêa yas d: "eûnaâ lbabuô, ger wallen nne£, s uweêêi nne£. Mi d iusa lameô nne£, la pfeggiven igwefran, d ihedman, awi degs, tayuga n yal ûûenf, akked twacult ik, siwa wid, segsen, i$ef id izwar wawal. Ur iyI d steqsay af wid idensen, nitni, war ccekk, ad pwa$evsen.

verses.text: Mi tâanncev di lbabur, keçç akked wid illan yidek, ini: ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Iselken seg ugdud imednas".
verses.translation: Mi tâanncev di lbabur, keçç akked wid illan yidek, ini: ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Iselken seg ugdud imednas".

verses.translation: Ini: "a Mass iw! Ssers iyi deg umekkan iôqan; Keçç Tifev akw wid issrusun".

verses.text: War ccekk, ayagi, d issekniyen, u Nekwni, Nezga d wid ipjeôôiben.
verses.translation: War ccekk, ayagi, d issekniyen, u Nekwni, Nezga d wid ipjeôôiben.

verses.translation: Sinna, Nxelq ed, deffir sen, isuta nniven.

verses.translation: Nuzen asen d amazan, segsen: "âabdet Öebbi, ur tesâim ôebbi, war Neppa. Day ur tepêezzibem ara"?

verses.text: Nnan imvebbôen ijehliyen n ugdud is, wid iugin u inekôen timlilit n laxeôt, wid Ne$na di tmeddurt n ddunit: "wagi d amdan kan am kunwi, itepp seg wayen teppeppem, itess seg wayen teppessem.
verses.translation: Nnan imvebbôen ijehliyen n ugdud is, wid iugin u inekôen timlilit n laxeôt, wid Ne$na di tmeddurt n ddunit: "wagi d amdan kan am kunwi, itepp seg wayen teppeppem, itess seg wayen teppessem.

verses.text: Ma tessemêessem i umdan i kwen icban, war ccekk, kunwi seg imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Ma tessemêessem i umdan i kwen icban, war ccekk, kunwi seg imexsuôen.

verses.translation: Day i wen iâahed ard a d teff$em mara temmtem, tu$alem d akal, d i$san?

verses.translation: Ibâad, Ibâad, ayen i wen ippuwaââden.

verses.translation: I illan kan, d tameddurt n ddunit. A nemmet, a nidir, nekwni ur d neppenkar.

verses.translation: Neppa, d argaz kan id igren tikerkas $ef Öebbi. Nekwni, ur numin yis".

verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Awes iyi, skaddben iyi".

verses.translation: Inna: "garane$ d cwiî, a d gwrin di nndama".

verses.translation: Iwwet iten usu$u, s tidep. Nerra ten d rrmim. Err akin, agdud imednas!

verses.translation: Sinna, Nxelq ed, deffir sen, isuta nniven.

verses.translation: Lois ur d isseqôab, ur iswexxiô, lajel is.

verses.translation: Sinna, Nuzen ed imazanen nne£, wa deffir wa. Yal tikelt ideg ara d ias umazan, ar lois is, a t skiddben. Nerra ten mestebâan, Nerra ten d tidyanin. Err akin, agdud ur neppamen!

verses.translation: Sinna, Nuzen ed Musa akked gma s Haôun, s issekniyen nne£, akked udabu n ûûeê,

verses.translation: $eô Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Sme$wôen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud amzuxxi.

verses.translation: Nnan: "Day a namen sin imdanen am nekwni, u agdud nnsen d aklan nne$"?

verses.translation: Skaddben ten, d$a u$alen seg wid ipwan$an.

verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, amar ad pwanhun.

verses.translation: Nerra mmi s n Meryem, akked imma s, d assekni. Nesduri ten di ti$ilt, degs laman d waman.

verses.translation: A yimazanen, eççet seg wayen imaânen, xedmet ayen ilhan, Nek, èôi$ ayen txeddmem.

verses.translation: Lois agi nnwen, s tidep, d lois yiwen. Nek, d Mass nnwen, ihi êezbet iyI.

verses.translation: Bvan lameô nnsen garasen, mi mfaôaqen. Yal akabar ifôeê s wayla s.

verses.translation: Eoo iten di maylellif nnsen, tallit kan.

verses.translation: ad asen Nezzazal lxiô? Xaîi, ur faqen.

ayahs.translation: Iwwet iten usu$u, s tidep. Nerra ten d rrmim. Err akin, agdud imednas!

ayahs.translation: Sinna, Nxelq ed, deffir sen, isuta nniven.

ayahs.translation: Lois ur d isseqôab, ur iswexxiô, lajel is.

ayahs.translation: Sinna, Nuzen ed imazanen nne£, wa deffir wa. Yal tikelt ideg ara d ias umazan, ar lois is, a t skiddben. Nerra ten mestebâan, Nerra ten d tidyanin. Err akin, agdud ur neppamen!

ayahs.translation: $eô Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Sme$wôen iman nnsen. Llan d agdud amzuxxi.

ayahs.translation: Nnan: "Day a namen sin imdanen am nekwni, u agdud nnsen d aklan nne$"?

ayahs.translation: Skaddben ten, d$a u$alen seg wid ipwan$an.

ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, amar ad pwanhun.

ayahs.translation: Nerra mmi s n Meryem, akked imma s, d assekni. Nesduri ten di ti$ilt, degs laman d waman.

ayahs.translation: A yimazanen, eççet seg wayen imaânen, xedmet ayen ilhan, Nek, èôi$ ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.translation: Lois agi nnwen, s tidep, d lois yiwen. Nek, d Mass nnwen, ihi êezbet iyI.

ayahs.translation: Bvan lameô nnsen garasen, mi mfaôaqen. Yal akabar ifôeê s wayla s.

ayahs.translation: Eoo iten di maylellif nnsen, tallit kan.

ayahs.translation: Day $ilen mi sen Nefka ayla, tarwa,

ayahs.translation: ad asen Nezzazal lxiô? Xaîi, ur faqen.

ayahs.translation: Ih, wid, si tugwdi n Mass nnsen, pêadaren,

ayahs.translation: wid iumnen s issekniyen n Mass nnsen,

ayahs.translation: wid ur nepcarak i Mass nnsen,

ayahs.translation: wid ippaken ayen fkan, ulawen nnsen ugaden mi, nitni, ad u$alen ar Mass nnsen,

ayahs.translation: widak, pêirin ar lxiô u, $uôes, zeggwiren.

ayahs.translation: Ur Nepkellif taôwiêt, siwa ar wayen iwumi tezmer. £uône£ Tazmamt, tessawal tidep. Nitni ur twadensen.

ayahs.translation: Maca, ulawen nnsen di maylellif, $ef tagi. U rnan yir igiten i waya, a ten xedmen.

ayahs.translation: Alamma, mi Nesâadda aâaqeb $ef isâayen nnsen, a d su$en.

ayahs.translation: "Ur psu$ut, ass agi, kunwi, segne$, ur tepwasellkem.

ayahs.text: Ni$ mlan awen issekniyen iW, trewlem asen,
ayahs.translation: Ni$ mlan awen issekniyen iW, trewlem asen,

ayahs.translation: tesme$wôem iman nnwen fellasen. Teppaâwazem, tekkatem".

ayahs.translation: Day ur meyyzen ara Awal? Day ur ten id iusa ara, wayen ur d nusi ar lejdud nnsen imezwura?

ayahs.text: Ne$ day ur ssinen ara amazan nnsen, imi t nekôen?
ayahs.translation: Ne$ day ur ssinen ara amazan nnsen, imi t nekôen?

ayahs.translation: Ne$ qqaôen: "ikcem it loenn"? Xaîi, iusa ten id s tidep. Tegwti degsen, kerhen tidep.

ayahs.text: Lemmer tedda tidep d lhawiyyat nnsen, war ccekk, tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan degsen, ad fesden. Xaîi, Nebbwi yasen d asmekti nnsen. Nitni asmekti nnsen ooan t.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer tedda tidep d lhawiyyat nnsen, war ccekk, tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan degsen, ad fesden. Xaîi, Nebbwi yasen d asmekti nnsen. Nitni asmekti nnsen ooan t.

ayahs.translation: Ne$, ad asen tessutrev taqdiât? Ppif taqdiât n Mass ik. Neppa Yif akw iôeééaqen.

ayahs.translation: Keçç, s tidep, la ten tneccdev s abrid uwqim.

ayahs.translation: Wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, s tidep, ff$en i ubrid.

ayahs.translation: Xas Nêun fellasen, u Nekkes asen ccqa nnsen, ad vellelen di leqheô nnsen, ad ddebdeben.

ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nesâadda fellasen aâaqeb. Ur knan i Mass nnsen, ur nujen.

ayahs.translation: Armi, mara asen Nelli tabburt uâaqeb iqesêen, imiren, degs, ad aysen.

ayahs.translation: Neppa i wen Ixelqen timesliwt, iéôi, ulawen. Drus ay tesnemmirem.

ayahs.translation: Neppa ikwen Iwezzâen di tmurt. £uôeS ara tepwafesrem.

ayahs.translation: Neppa i Issidiren, i Ineqqen. IneS afraz n yiv akked wass. Day ur tefhimem ara?

ayahs.translation: Xaîi. Nnan akken d nnan imezwura.

ayahs.translation: Nnan: "Ma nemmut, nu$al d akal, d i$san, day a $ d ssekren?

ayahs.translation: Ni$ ippuâahed wayagi i nekwni, akw, zik, i imezwura nne$. Ayagi, siwa d timucuha imezwura".

ayahs.translation: Ini: "wi p ilan tmurt, akked wayen illan degs, ma tessnem"?

ayahs.translation: A d inin: "d Öebbi". Ini: "ihi, day ur d tesmektayem ara"?

ayahs.translation: Ini: "anwa ay d Mass n ûa igenwan? Mass n usgeld ameqwôaêan"?

ayahs.translation: A d inin: "d Öebbi". Ini: "ihi, day ur tepêezzibem ara"?

ayahs.translation: Ini: "anwa i Isâan tagelda n yal cci, ger ifassen iS; Neppa Ipêarab, ur illi uêareb fellaS, ma teppissinem"?

ayahs.translation: A d inin: "d Öebbi". Ini: "ihi, acimi tepwamelkem"?

ayahs.text: Xaîi! Nefka yasen tidep, nitni, war ccek, d ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! Nefka yasen tidep, nitni, war ccek, d ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: Ur Isâi Öebbi mmi S. Ur illi ôebbi ar tama S. Mulac yal ôebbi ad iawi ayen id ixleq, wa ad iagwar wa. Gedha s Öebbi, seg wayen id snulfuyen!
ayahs.translation: Ur Isâi Öebbi mmi S. Ur illi ôebbi ar tama S. Mulac yal ôebbi ad iawi ayen id ixleq, wa ad iagwar wa. Gedha s Öebbi, seg wayen id snulfuyen!

ayahs.translation: Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir. D Aâlayan, sennig wayen pcaraken.

ayahs.translation: Ini: "a Mass iw! Lemmer a yi d Tesseknev acu i sen ippuâahden.

ayahs.translation: A Mass iw, ur iyi Ppara deg ugdud imednas".

ayahs.translation: "S tidep, Nezmer ad ak Nessken acu i sen Nâahed".

ayahs.translation: Err akin tucmip s lfayeq. Nekwni Neéôa, sennig wiyav, ayen d snulfuyen.

ayahs.translation: Ini: "a Mass iw! Ëerz iyi seg u$wayen n ccwaîen. Êë

ayahs.translation: Ëerz iyi, a Mass iw! Ur dgi ppilin".

ayahs.translation: Armi, mi d tusa tmeppant yiwen degsen, inna: "a Mass iw! Err iyi,

ayahs.translation: amar ad xedme$ ayen ilhan deg wayen ooi$". Xaîi, d awal kan id inna. Tella, deffir es, tse$lit, alamma d ass n tnekra.

ayahs.translation: Ma ûuven di lbuq, assen, ur ppemyilin, ur pmesteqsayen.

ayahs.translation: Wid iwumi ééay lmizan nnsen, nitni rebêen.

ayahs.translation: Wid iwumi fessus lmizan nnsen, d nitni i issexsôen iman nnsen. Di Loahennama ad wekkôen.

ayahs.translation: A ppesser$ tmes udmawen nnsen, ad asen zelgen icenfiren.

ayahs.translation: Day ur awen qaren ara issekniyen iW, wanag la ten tnekôem?

ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! I$leb ane$ ccum nne$. Nella d agdud im$eôqen.

ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Ssuffe$ ane$ segs. Ma nesnager, ihi, d imednas ay nella".

ayahs.translation: Ad Yini: "qqimet degs, ur pmeslayet"!

ayahs.translation: Ih, illa urbaâ n imdanen iW i iqqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Numen. Semmeê ane$, Ëun fella$, Keçç Tifev akw wid ipêunun".

ayahs.translation: Tettihim fellasen armi i wen sseppun asmekti W, u tdessem degsen.

ayahs.translation: Nek, assa, Kufa$ ten $ef wayen ûebôen. D nitni, war ccekk, ay d imerbaê.

ayahs.translation: Inna: "acêal iseggwasen i teqqimem deg wakal"?

ayahs.translation: Nnan: "Neqqim ass, ne$ ur ibbwiv wass, steqsi wid iêepben".

ayahs.translation: Inna: "cwiî kan ay teqqimen, lemmer, s tidep, day tessinem".

ayahs.translation: Day t$ilem Nxelq ikwen, kan, di rrayaâ; ar ur d teppu$alem $uône£?

ayahs.text: Ay Meqqweô Öebbi, Agellid, Tidep! Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa, Mass n usgeld ukyis.
ayahs.translation: Ay Meqqweô Öebbi, Agellid, Tidep! Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa, Mass n usgeld ukyis.

ayahs.text: Win inaâôen, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, ur isâi ppbut fellas, aqeîîi s ar Mass is kan. Ih, ur rebêen ara ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Win inaâôen, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven, ur isâi ppbut fellas, aqeîîi s ar Mass is kan. Ih, ur rebêen ara ijehliyen.

ayahs.translation: Ini: "a Mass iw! Semmeê u Ëun. Keçç, Tifev akw wid ipêunun".

verses.text: Tasurep, Nessader ip id, Nêeppem ip id; Nessader ed, degs, issekniyen iberrzen, amar a d temmektim.
verses.translation: Tasurep, Nessader ip id, Nêeppem ip id; Nessader ed, degs, issekniyen iberrzen, amar a d temmektim.

verses.text: Tin ne$ win iznan, jekwvet, yal yiwen segsen, tawinest iberdan; ur kwen p$aven $ef udem n Öebbi, ma tellam tumnem s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Arbaâ n lmumnin, ad yili d anagi uâaqeb nnsen.
verses.translation: Tin ne$ win iznan, jekwvet, yal yiwen segsen, tawinest iberdan; ur kwen p$aven $ef udem n Öebbi, ma tellam tumnem s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Arbaâ n lmumnin, ad yili d anagi uâaqeb nnsen.

verses.translation: Win iznan ur ippa$ siwa tin iznan, ne$ tamcarekt. Tin iznan ur p ippa$ siwa win iznan, ne$ amcarek. Ipwagdel waya i lmumnin.

verses.translation: Wid itehmen tiâaôviyin, d$a ur d bbwin kué inagan, jekwvet pen îamet iberdan; ur qeblet ccada nnsen, d awez$i. Widen d iballa$en.

verses.text: Kkes ed wid isteôoâen, deffir waya, u xedmen lfayeq. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Kkes ed wid isteôoâen, deffir waya, u xedmen lfayeq. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Wid itehmen tilawin nnsen, ur sâin inagan, siwa iman nnsen, yiwen segsen ad iggal s Öebbi, kué iberdan, ar neppa d bab n tidep,
verses.translation: Wid itehmen tilawin nnsen, ur sâin inagan, siwa iman nnsen, yiwen segsen ad iggal s Öebbi, kué iberdan, ar neppa d bab n tidep,

verses.translation: akked ubrid wis smus ar a t Ixzu Öebbi ma iskaddeb.

verses.text: Ur teppuâaqeb tmeîîut, ma teggul s Öebbi, kué iberdan, ar neppa seg wid iskadben,
verses.translation: Ur teppuâaqeb tmeîîut, ma teggul s Öebbi, kué iberdan, ar neppa seg wid iskadben,
