verses.translation: akked ubrid, wis smus ar fellas zzâaf n Öebbi, ma issawel ed tidep.

verses.text: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S! Öebbi, s tidep, Issuruf, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S! Öebbi, s tidep, Issuruf, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ih, wid isweûlen tikerkas, d agraw segwen. Ur p$ilit d cceôô i kunwi, xaîi, d lxiô nnwen. Yal yiwen, degsen, ibbwi ayen ibbwi ubekkav. Aâaqeb abarar i win, segsen, i ibbwin amur ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Ih, wid isweûlen tikerkas, d agraw segwen. Ur p$ilit d cceôô i kunwi, xaîi, d lxiô nnwen. Yal yiwen, degsen, ibbwi ayen ibbwi ubekkav. Aâaqeb abarar i win, segsen, i ibbwin amur ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: A lemmer lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, mi s slan, meyyzen lxiô, deg iman nnsen, u nnan: "wagi d tikerkas ibanen"!
verses.translation: A lemmer lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, mi s slan, meyyzen lxiô, deg iman nnsen, u nnan: "wagi d tikerkas ibanen"!

verses.text: A lemmer d bbwin, fellas, kué inagan! Ma ur d bbwin ara inagan, ar Öebbi, wigi, d ikeddaben.
verses.translation: A lemmer d bbwin, fellas, kué inagan! Ma ur d bbwin ara inagan, ar Öebbi, wigi, d ikeddaben.

verses.text: Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, di ddunit akked laxeôt, a ppesâaddim aâaqeb abarar $ef wayen i$ef temcawaôem.
verses.translation: Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, di ddunit akked laxeôt, a ppesâaddim aâaqeb abarar $ef wayen i$ef temcawaôem.

verses.text: Mi p id teggarem s yilsawen nnwen, u teqqaôen s imawen nnwen ayen ur tessinem, t$ilem d ulac. Neppa, ar Öebbi, d abarar.
verses.translation: Mi p id teggarem s yilsawen nnwen, u teqqaôen s imawen nnwen ayen ur tessinem, t$ilem d ulac. Neppa, ar Öebbi, d abarar.

verses.text: Lemmer, mi as teslam, tennam: "ur a$ issefk ara umeslay $ef waya! Gedha s yiseK! Wagi d acehrir abarar".
verses.translation: Lemmer, mi as teslam, tennam: "ur a$ issefk ara umeslay $ef waya! Gedha s yiseK! Wagi d acehrir abarar".

verses.text: Inuba kwen Öebbi ur teppalsem, am akka, d awez$i, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
verses.translation: Inuba kwen Öebbi ur teppalsem, am akka, d awez$i, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

verses.text: Ipbeggin awen Öebbi issekniyen. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ipbeggin awen Öebbi issekniyen. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ih, wid ib$an a d iazel lâaô, ar wid iumnen, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan di ddunit, di laxeôt. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ib$an a d iazel lâaô, ar wid iumnen, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan di ddunit, di laxeôt. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.

verses.text: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S! U Öebbi d Umâin, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S! U Öebbi d Umâin, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur teddut di lateô n Cciîan. Win iteddun di lateô n Cciîan, ar la iteddu di lâaô akked tuccva. Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, ur ippizdig degwen yiwen, d awez$i. Maca, Öebbi Izzizdig win i S ihwan. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur teddut di lateô n Cciîan. Win iteddun di lateô n Cciîan, ar la iteddu di lâaô akked tuccva. Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, ur ippizdig degwen yiwen, d awez$i. Maca, Öebbi Izzizdig win i S ihwan. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Wid, degwen, iwumi ippunefk lfevl akked terkunt, ur pgalan $ef tikci i llzem, i ime$ban, i wid iunagen deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ad semmêen, ad ssurfen. Day ur têemmlem ara mara awen Isemmeê Öebbi? Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Wid, degwen, iwumi ippunefk lfevl akked terkunt, ur pgalan $ef tikci i llzem, i ime$ban, i wid iunagen deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ad semmêen, ad ssurfen. Day ur têemmlem ara mara awen Isemmeê Öebbi? Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ih, wid ipqeôôiven tilawin zeddigen, istehzan, iumnen, ad pwaxzun di ddunit, di laxeôt. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ipqeôôiven tilawin zeddigen, istehzan, iumnen, ad pwaxzun di ddunit, di laxeôt. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara d cehhden $ef igiten nnsen, ilsawen nnsen, ifassen nnsen, ivaôen nnsen,
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara d cehhden $ef igiten nnsen, ilsawen nnsen, ifassen nnsen, ivaôen nnsen,

verses.text: assen, ad asen Ifk Öebbi ayen ppalasen, s tidep. Ad éôen ar Öebbi d Tidep ibanen.
verses.translation: assen, ad asen Ifk Öebbi ayen ppalasen, s tidep. Ad éôen ar Öebbi d Tidep ibanen.

verses.text: Yir tlawin i yir irgazen, yir irgazen i yir tlawin. Tilawin n lâali i irgazen n lâali, irgazen lâali i tlawin n lâali. Wigi ur ppkan deg wayen qqaôen. I nitni, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.
verses.translation: Yir tlawin i yir irgazen, yir irgazen i yir tlawin. Tilawin n lâali i irgazen n lâali, irgazen lâali i tlawin n lâali. Wigi ur ppkan deg wayen qqaôen. I nitni, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur keçmet ixxamen ur nelli nnwen, alamma s tsriê, u alamma tselmem $ef imawlan nnsen. Ppif akka i kunwi, amar a d tesmektim.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur keçmet ixxamen ur nelli nnwen, alamma s tsriê, u alamma tselmem $ef imawlan nnsen. Ppif akka i kunwi, amar a d tesmektim.

verses.text: Ma ur tufim êedd degsen, ur keçmet alamma s tsriê. Ma nnan awen d: "u$alet", u$alet. Yif it wakka i ûûfawa nnwen. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ma ur tufim êedd degsen, ur keçmet alamma s tsriê. Ma nnan awen d: "u$alet", u$alet. Yif it wakka i ûûfawa nnwen. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma tkecmem ixxamen ur nepwazde$, ma tella t$awsa nnwen degsen. Öebbi Iéôa acu d teqqaôem, u wacu teppeffrem.
verses.translation: Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma tkecmem ixxamen ur nepwazde$, ma tella t$awsa nnwen degsen. Öebbi Iéôa acu d teqqaôem, u wacu teppeffrem.

verses.text: Ini i wid iumnen ad brun i wallen nnsen, ad ssôen tuzzuft nnsen. Yif it wakka i ûûfawa nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ini i wid iumnen ad brun i wallen nnsen, ad ssôen tuzzuft nnsen. Yif it wakka i ûûfawa nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Ini i tid iumnen ad brunt i wallen nnsent, ad ssôent tuzzuft nnsent, ur d sskanent, di zzin nnsent, siwa ayen d ivehôen segs, ad $umment idmaren nnsent. Ur d sskanent ccbuê nnsent, siwa i irgazen nnsent, ne$ ibabaten nnsent, ne$ im$aôen nnsent, ne$ iqcicen nnsent, ne$ irbiben nnsent, ne$ atmaten nnsent, ne$ iqcicen n watmaten nnsent, ne$ wid n tsetmatin nnsent, ne$ tiqeddacin nnsent, ne$ taklatin nnsent, ne$ iqeddacen imudduzen, ne$ arrac ur nelleméi. Ur kkatent dderz, ad ipwassen zzin nnsent uffir. Steôoâet akw i Öebbi, a lmumnin, amar a prebêem.
verses.translation: Ini i tid iumnen ad brunt i wallen nnsent, ad ssôent tuzzuft nnsent, ur d sskanent, di zzin nnsent, siwa ayen d ivehôen segs, ad $umment idmaren nnsent. Ur d sskanent ccbuê nnsent, siwa i irgazen nnsent, ne$ ibabaten nnsent, ne$ im$aôen nnsent, ne$ iqcicen nnsent, ne$ irbiben nnsent, ne$ atmaten nnsent, ne$ iqcicen n watmaten nnsent, ne$ wid n tsetmatin nnsent, ne$ tiqeddacin nnsent, ne$ taklatin nnsent, ne$ iqeddacen imudduzen, ne$ arrac ur nelleméi. Ur kkatent dderz, ad ipwassen zzin nnsent uffir. Steôoâet akw i Öebbi, a lmumnin, amar a prebêem.

verses.text: Jewoet i iâzriyen nnwen, akked wid imaânen seg waklan nnwen, akked teklatin nnwen. Ma d ime$ban ay llan, a ten Iôéeq Öebbi, s lfevl iS. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Jewoet i iâzriyen nnwen, akked wid imaânen seg waklan nnwen, akked teklatin nnwen. Ma d ime$ban ay llan, a ten Iôéeq Öebbi, s lfevl iS. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Wid ur nufa ara ar a$en, ad ûebôen ar ten id Iôéeq Öebbi, s lfevl iS. Wid, seg waklan nnwen, i ib$an ad asen tarum aserreê, arut asen ma teéôam ten, d at lxiô ay llan. Fket asen seg ayla i wen Ifka Öebbi. Ur pêeppimet $ef teklatin nnwen, tiquêbit, i rrbeê nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ma b$ant tezdeg. Ma têeppmen, Öebbi, deffir uêeppem nnsent, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Wid ur nufa ara ar a$en, ad ûebôen ar ten id Iôéeq Öebbi, s lfevl iS. Wid, seg waklan nnwen, i ib$an ad asen tarum aserreê, arut asen ma teéôam ten, d at lxiô ay llan. Fket asen seg ayla i wen Ifka Öebbi. Ur pêeppimet $ef teklatin nnwen, tiquêbit, i rrbeê nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ma b$ant tezdeg. Ma têeppmen, Öebbi, deffir uêeppem nnsent, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ni$ Nessader awen ed issekniyen iberrzen, akked umedya n wid iâacen uqbel nnwen, d anabi i wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nessader awen ed issekniyen iberrzen, akked umedya n wid iâacen uqbel nnwen, d anabi i wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Öebbi d tafat n tmurt akked igenwan. Amedya n tafat iS d takwap degs taftilt. Taftilt daxel n tqeôâap. Taqeôâap, amzun d itri acôaôaq, tecâal it ttejôa iôqan, tazemmurt ur nelli n ugmuv ne$ n utaram. Qôib a pfet zzit is, ur p tennul tmes. Tafat $ef tafat. Ippawi Öebbi win i S ihwan ar tafat iS. Ippak ed Öebbi imedyaten i medden. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.
verses.translation: Öebbi d tafat n tmurt akked igenwan. Amedya n tafat iS d takwap degs taftilt. Taftilt daxel n tqeôâap. Taqeôâap, amzun d itri acôaôaq, tecâal it ttejôa iôqan, tazemmurt ur nelli n ugmuv ne$ n utaram. Qôib a pfet zzit is, ur p tennul tmes. Tafat $ef tafat. Ippawi Öebbi win i S ihwan ar tafat iS. Ippak ed Öebbi imedyaten i medden. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.

verses.text: Deg ixxamen i Ib$a Öebbi ad ufraren, ideg ara d immekti yisem iS, sbuccuâen T ssbeê, tameddit.
verses.translation: Deg ixxamen i Ib$a Öebbi ad ufraren, ideg ara d immekti yisem iS, sbuccuâen T ssbeê, tameddit.

verses.text: Irgazen ur tes$afal ttjaôa, ne$ ssuq, $ef usmekti n Öebbi, $ef téallit, $ef zzakat; ppagwaden ass, ideg ara nehwwalen wallen akked wulawen.
verses.translation: Irgazen ur tes$afal ttjaôa, ne$ ssuq, $ef usmekti n Öebbi, $ef téallit, $ef zzakat; ppagwaden ass, ideg ara nehwwalen wallen akked wulawen.

verses.text: Iwakken a ten Ikafi Öebbi $ef wayen xeddmen d amxallef, ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, war aktili.
verses.translation: Iwakken a ten Ikafi Öebbi $ef wayen xeddmen d amxallef, ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, war aktili.

verses.text: Igiten n wid ijehlen, am aylal deg uza$aô. Win ifuden, ad i$il d aman. Alamma mi ibbwev $uôes, ur ippaf acemma. A n iaf Öebbi, Issuli as leêsab is. Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
verses.translation: Igiten n wid ijehlen, am aylal deg uza$aô. Win ifuden, ad i$il d aman. Alamma mi ibbwev $uôes, ur ippaf acemma. A n iaf Öebbi, Issuli as leêsab is. Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

verses.text: Ne$ am tillas di yill le$miq. T$umm it lmuja, sufella lmuja, sufella asigna. Tillas sennig tiyav. Ma issuffe$ ed afus is, ur issawev a t iwali. Win iwumi ur Iga ara Öebbi tafat, ur isâi tafat.
verses.translation: Ne$ am tillas di yill le$miq. T$umm it lmuja, sufella lmuja, sufella asigna. Tillas sennig tiyav. Ma issuffe$ ed afus is, ur issawev a t iwali. Win iwumi ur Iga ara Öebbi tafat, ur isâi tafat.

verses.text: Day ur twalav ara, sbuccuâen Öebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ifrax deg waffug. Issen taéallit akked usbuccaâ n yal yiwen. Öebbi Iéôa ayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Day ur twalav ara, sbuccuâen Öebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ifrax deg waffug. Issen taéallit akked usbuccaâ n yal yiwen. Öebbi Iéôa ayen xeddmen.

verses.text: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. £uô öÖebbi tu$alin.
verses.translation: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. £uô öÖebbi tu$alin.

verses.text: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Isselêay asigna, sinna, a t Izdi, sinna, a t Issem$weô? D$a a pwaliv ageffur a d iffe$ si zdaxel is. Isrusu d, seg idurar igenni, abruri. Ad Iwwet yis, win i S ihwan, a t Iveôôef $ef win i S ihwan. Tafat n lebôaq iS qôib a ppeglu s yiéôi.
verses.translation: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Isselêay asigna, sinna, a t Izdi, sinna, a t Issem$weô? D$a a pwaliv ageffur a d iffe$ si zdaxel is. Isrusu d, seg idurar igenni, abruri. Ad Iwwet yis, win i S ihwan, a t Iveôôef $ef win i S ihwan. Tafat n lebôaq iS qôib a ppeglu s yiéôi.

verses.text: Öebbi Ismizwar iv akked wass. Deg wayagi, s tidep, d aselmed i wid isâan iéôi.
verses.translation: Öebbi Ismizwar iv akked wass. Deg wayagi, s tidep, d aselmed i wid isâan iéôi.

verses.text: Öebbi Ixleq akw lêayawan, seg waman. Garasen, illa win ippeênunufen $ef uâabbuv is, win ileêêun $ef sin ivaôôen, win ileêêun $ef kué. Ixelleq Öebbi ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Öebbi Ixleq akw lêayawan, seg waman. Garasen, illa win ippeênunufen $ef uâabbuv is, win ileêêun $ef sin ivaôôen, win ileêêun $ef kué. Ixelleq Öebbi ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ni$ Nessader ed issekniyen iberrzen. Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nessader ed issekniyen iberrzen. Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.

verses.text: Qqaôen: "numen s Öebbi akked Umazan, nu$ awal". Sinna, deffir waya, iwexxeô urbaâ segsen. Wigi ur llin d lmumnin.
verses.translation: Qqaôen: "numen s Öebbi akked Umazan, nu$ awal". Sinna, deffir waya, iwexxeô urbaâ segsen. Wigi ur llin d lmumnin.

verses.text: Mi pwanecden ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, arbaâ segsen iwexxeô.
verses.translation: Mi pwanecden ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, arbaâ segsen iwexxeô.

verses.text: Ma sâan lêeqq, a d asen $uôes, d imvuâen.
verses.translation: Ma sâan lêeqq, a d asen $uôes, d imvuâen.

verses.text: Day helken wulawen nnsen, ne$ cukken, ne$ ugaden a ten Isneêyaf Öebbi akked Umazan iS? Xaîi, widak d imednas.
verses.translation: Day helken wulawen nnsen, ne$ cukken, ne$ ugaden a ten Isneêyaf Öebbi akked Umazan iS? Xaîi, widak d imednas.

verses.text: Timenna n lmumnin, mara ssutren aêuddu n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, d tigi kan: "nesla, nôuva". D wigi ay d imerbaê.
verses.translation: Timenna n lmumnin, mara ssutren aêuddu n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, d tigi kan: "nesla, nôuva". D wigi ay d imerbaê.

verses.text: Win iôuvan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ippagwaden Öebbi, ipêezziben, nitni d isaâdiyen.
verses.translation: Win iôuvan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ippagwaden Öebbi, ipêezziben, nitni d isaâdiyen.

verses.text: Ggulen s Öebbi, tagallit meqqwôen, ar ma tumôev asen, ard ad ff$en, war ccekk. Ini: "ur pgallat, annuz ipwassen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen txeddmem".
verses.translation: Ggulen s Öebbi, tagallit meqqwôen, ar ma tumôev asen, ard ad ff$en, war ccekk. Ini: "ur pgallat, annuz ipwassen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen txeddmem".

verses.text: Ini: "ôavit Öebbi, ôavit Amazan". Ma wexxôen, fellas, neppa, ayen kan i s sbabben, fellawen kunwi ayen i wen sbabben. Ma tôuvam T, a ppeppwanhum. I iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Ini: "ôavit Öebbi, ôavit Amazan". Ma wexxôen, fellas, neppa, ayen kan i s sbabben, fellawen kunwi ayen i wen sbabben. Ma tôuvam T, a ppeppwanhum. I iwatan i Umazan, siwa awal ipbegginen.

verses.text: Iâahed Öebbi, i wid iumnen segwen, u xedmen ayen ilhan, ara ten Irr, war ccekk, d igensas di tmurt, akken Irra wid i ten id izwaren; ara ad asen Isseqâad ddin nnsen i$ef i ten Iôuva; ar ad asen Issegwri laman, deffir tugdi. Âabden iyI, ur iyI pcaraken acemma. Wid ijehlen, deffir waya, widak d iballa$en.
verses.translation: Iâahed Öebbi, i wid iumnen segwen, u xedmen ayen ilhan, ara ten Irr, war ccekk, d igensas di tmurt, akken Irra wid i ten id izwaren; ara ad asen Isseqâad ddin nnsen i$ef i ten Iôuva; ar ad asen Issegwri laman, deffir tugdi. Âabden iyI, ur iyI pcaraken acemma. Wid ijehlen, deffir waya, widak d iballa$en.

verses.text: Beddet i téallit, zekkit, a$et awal i Umazan. Amar aêunu fellawen.
verses.translation: Beddet i téallit, zekkit, a$et awal i Umazan. Amar aêunu fellawen.

verses.text: £uôwat a p$ilem wid ijehlen sfunnugen di tmurt. Axxam nnsen d times. A tu$alin tucmip!
verses.translation: £uôwat a p$ilem wid ijehlen sfunnugen di tmurt. Axxam nnsen d times. A tu$alin tucmip!

verses.text: A wid iumnen! S uâammed nnwen ara d kecmen, $uôwen, waklan nnwen akw wid, degwen, ur nebli$ ara, krav iberdan ideg ur telsim ara: uqbel taéallit n tafrara, $ef îîhuô mara tekksem iceîîiven, deffir téallit n lâica. Ulac u$ilif fellawen ne$ fellasen, ma wa iéuô wa, deffir lewqat agi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Öebbi issekniyen. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! S uâammed nnwen ara d kecmen, $uôwen, waklan nnwen akw wid, degwen, ur nebli$ ara, krav iberdan ideg ur telsim ara: uqbel taéallit n tafrara, $ef îîhuô mara tekksem iceîîiven, deffir téallit n lâica. Ulac u$ilif fellawen ne$ fellasen, ma wa iéuô wa, deffir lewqat agi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Öebbi issekniyen. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ma bel$en warrac nnwen, s uâammed nnwen, am wid i ten id izwaren. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Öebbi issekniyen iS. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ma bel$en warrac nnwen, s uâammed nnwen, am wid i ten id izwaren. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Öebbi issekniyen iS. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ulac u$ilif $ef tâuqaô i iâaddan i jwao, ma kksent iceîîiven nnsent, mebla ma sseknent ccbuê nnsent. Ma setêant, yif it i nitenti. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Ulac u$ilif $ef tâuqaô i iâaddan i jwao, ma kksent iceîîiven nnsent, mebla ma sseknent ccbuê nnsent. Ma setêant, yif it i nitenti. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ur telli tiyta deg uder$al, ne$ deg urejdal, ne$ deg umuvin, ne$ degwen, ma teççam deg ixxamen nnwen, deg wid n ibabaten nnwen, deg wid n tyimmatin nnwen, deg wid n watmaten nnwen, deg wid n tsetmatin nnwen, deg wid iâammiten nnwen, deg wid n tâammitin nnwen, deg wid ixaliten nnwen, deg wid n txaltitin nnwen, deg wid ideg tesâam tisura, ar uêbib nnwen. Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma teççam d agraw, ne$ d ifôiden. Mara tkecmen ixxamen, msalamet s wazul iôqan, aêmayan, s$uô Öebbi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Öebbi issekniyen. Amar a pfehmem.
verses.translation: Ur telli tiyta deg uder$al, ne$ deg urejdal, ne$ deg umuvin, ne$ degwen, ma teççam deg ixxamen nnwen, deg wid n ibabaten nnwen, deg wid n tyimmatin nnwen, deg wid n watmaten nnwen, deg wid n tsetmatin nnwen, deg wid iâammiten nnwen, deg wid n tâammitin nnwen, deg wid ixaliten nnwen, deg wid n txaltitin nnwen, deg wid ideg tesâam tisura, ar uêbib nnwen. Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma teççam d agraw, ne$ d ifôiden. Mara tkecmen ixxamen, msalamet s wazul iôqan, aêmayan, s$uô Öebbi. Akka i wen d Ibeggen Öebbi issekniyen. Amar a pfehmem.

verses.text: Lmumnin, siwa wid iumnen s Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma llan yides $ef lameô iten icerken, ur pôuêun alamma ssutren as tsriê. Ih, wid i k issuturen tsriê, d nitni i iumnen s Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma ssutren ak tsriê, $ef kra iten iaânan, serreê i win i k ihwan, segsen. Ssuter i Öebbi ad sen Isemmeê. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Lmumnin, siwa wid iumnen s Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma llan yides $ef lameô iten icerken, ur pôuêun alamma ssutren as tsriê. Ih, wid i k issuturen tsriê, d nitni i iumnen s Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ma ssutren ak tsriê, $ef kra iten iaânan, serreê i win i k ihwan, segsen. Ssuter i Öebbi ad sen Isemmeê. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ur êepbet asiwwel garawen i Umazan, am mara temsawalem. Ih, Iéôa Öebbi wid, segwen, ippensaren s tuffra. Ad steêdren wid mgirrden lameô iS: ad ppuhewwlen, ne$ ad sâaddin aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ur êepbet asiwwel garawen i Umazan, am mara temsawalem. Ih, Iéôa Öebbi wid, segwen, ippensaren s tuffra. Ad steêdren wid mgirrden lameô iS: ad ppuhewwlen, ne$ ad sâaddin aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ih, day maççi n Öebbi, i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ni$ Iéôa amek tellam $uôeS. Ass n tu$alin nnsen $uôeS, ad asen Imel d acu xedmen. Öebbi Issen yal cci.
verses.translation: Ih, day maççi n Öebbi, i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ni$ Iéôa amek tellam $uôeS. Ass n tu$alin nnsen $uôeS, ad asen Imel d acu xedmen. Öebbi Issen yal cci.

ayahs.text: Tasurep, Nessader ip id, Nêeppem ip id; Nessader ed, degs, issekniyen iberrzen, amar a d temmektim.
ayahs.translation: Tasurep, Nessader ip id, Nêeppem ip id; Nessader ed, degs, issekniyen iberrzen, amar a d temmektim.

ayahs.text: Tin ne$ win iznan, jekwvet, yal yiwen segsen, tawinest iberdan; ur kwen p$aven $ef udem n Öebbi, ma tellam tumnem s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Arbaâ n lmumnin, ad yili d anagi uâaqeb nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Tin ne$ win iznan, jekwvet, yal yiwen segsen, tawinest iberdan; ur kwen p$aven $ef udem n Öebbi, ma tellam tumnem s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Arbaâ n lmumnin, ad yili d anagi uâaqeb nnsen.

ayahs.text: Win iznan ur ippa$ siwa tin iznan, ne$ tamcarekt. Tin iznan ur p ippa$ siwa win iznan, ne$ amcarek. Ipwagdel waya i lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Win iznan ur ippa$ siwa tin iznan, ne$ tamcarekt. Tin iznan ur p ippa$ siwa win iznan, ne$ amcarek. Ipwagdel waya i lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Wid itehmen tiâaôviyin, d$a ur d bbwin kué inagan, jekwvet pen îamet iberdan; ur qeblet ccada nnsen, d awez$i. Widen d iballa$en.
ayahs.translation: Wid itehmen tiâaôviyin, d$a ur d bbwin kué inagan, jekwvet pen îamet iberdan; ur qeblet ccada nnsen, d awez$i. Widen d iballa$en.

ayahs.text: Kkes ed wid isteôoâen, deffir waya, u xedmen lfayeq. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Kkes ed wid isteôoâen, deffir waya, u xedmen lfayeq. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Wid itehmen tilawin nnsen, ur sâin inagan, siwa iman nnsen, yiwen segsen ad iggal s Öebbi, kué iberdan, ar neppa d bab n tidep,
ayahs.translation: Wid itehmen tilawin nnsen, ur sâin inagan, siwa iman nnsen, yiwen segsen ad iggal s Öebbi, kué iberdan, ar neppa d bab n tidep,

ayahs.text: akked ubrid wis smus ar a t Ixzu Öebbi ma iskaddeb.
ayahs.translation: akked ubrid wis smus ar a t Ixzu Öebbi ma iskaddeb.

ayahs.text: Ur teppuâaqeb tmeîîut, ma teggul s Öebbi, kué iberdan, ar neppa seg wid iskadben,
ayahs.translation: Ur teppuâaqeb tmeîîut, ma teggul s Öebbi, kué iberdan, ar neppa seg wid iskadben,

ayahs.text: akked ubrid, wis smus ar fellas zzâaf n Öebbi, ma issawel ed tidep.
ayahs.translation: akked ubrid, wis smus ar fellas zzâaf n Öebbi, ma issawel ed tidep.

ayahs.text: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S! Öebbi, s tidep, Issuruf, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S! Öebbi, s tidep, Issuruf, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid isweûlen tikerkas, d agraw segwen. Ur p$ilit d cceôô i kunwi, xaîi, d lxiô nnwen. Yal yiwen, degsen, ibbwi ayen ibbwi ubekkav. Aâaqeb abarar i win, segsen, i ibbwin amur ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid isweûlen tikerkas, d agraw segwen. Ur p$ilit d cceôô i kunwi, xaîi, d lxiô nnwen. Yal yiwen, degsen, ibbwi ayen ibbwi ubekkav. Aâaqeb abarar i win, segsen, i ibbwin amur ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: A lemmer lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, mi s slan, meyyzen lxiô, deg iman nnsen, u nnan: "wagi d tikerkas ibanen"!
ayahs.translation: A lemmer lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, mi s slan, meyyzen lxiô, deg iman nnsen, u nnan: "wagi d tikerkas ibanen"!

ayahs.text: A lemmer d bbwin, fellas, kué inagan! Ma ur d bbwin ara inagan, ar Öebbi, wigi, d ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: A lemmer d bbwin, fellas, kué inagan! Ma ur d bbwin ara inagan, ar Öebbi, wigi, d ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, di ddunit akked laxeôt, a ppesâaddim aâaqeb abarar $ef wayen i$ef temcawaôem.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, di ddunit akked laxeôt, a ppesâaddim aâaqeb abarar $ef wayen i$ef temcawaôem.

ayahs.text: Mi p id teggarem s yilsawen nnwen, u teqqaôen s imawen nnwen ayen ur tessinem, t$ilem d ulac. Neppa, ar Öebbi, d abarar.
ayahs.translation: Mi p id teggarem s yilsawen nnwen, u teqqaôen s imawen nnwen ayen ur tessinem, t$ilem d ulac. Neppa, ar Öebbi, d abarar.

ayahs.text: Lemmer, mi as teslam, tennam: "ur a$ issefk ara umeslay $ef waya! Gedha s yiseK! Wagi d acehrir abarar".
ayahs.translation: Lemmer, mi as teslam, tennam: "ur a$ issefk ara umeslay $ef waya! Gedha s yiseK! Wagi d acehrir abarar".

ayahs.text: Inuba kwen Öebbi ur teppalsem, am akka, d awez$i, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.
ayahs.translation: Inuba kwen Öebbi ur teppalsem, am akka, d awez$i, ma d lmumnin ay tellam.

ayahs.text: Ipbeggin awen Öebbi issekniyen. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ipbeggin awen Öebbi issekniyen. Öebbi d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ib$an a d iazel lâaô, ar wid iumnen, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan di ddunit, di laxeôt. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ib$an a d iazel lâaô, ar wid iumnen, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan di ddunit, di laxeôt. Öebbi Issen, kunwi ur tessinem.

ayahs.text: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S! U Öebbi d Umâin, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: A lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S! U Öebbi d Umâin, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur teddut di lateô n Cciîan. Win iteddun di lateô n Cciîan, ar la iteddu di lâaô akked tuccva. Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, ur ippizdig degwen yiwen, d awez$i. Maca, Öebbi Izzizdig win i S ihwan. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur teddut di lateô n Cciîan. Win iteddun di lateô n Cciîan, ar la iteddu di lâaô akked tuccva. Lemmer ur illi fellawen lfevl n Öebbi akked uêunu S, ur ippizdig degwen yiwen, d awez$i. Maca, Öebbi Izzizdig win i S ihwan. Öebbi Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Wid, degwen, iwumi ippunefk lfevl akked terkunt, ur pgalan $ef tikci i llzem, i ime$ban, i wid iunagen deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ad semmêen, ad ssurfen. Day ur têemmlem ara mara awen Isemmeê Öebbi? Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Wid, degwen, iwumi ippunefk lfevl akked terkunt, ur pgalan $ef tikci i llzem, i ime$ban, i wid iunagen deg ubrid n Öebbi. Ad semmêen, ad ssurfen. Day ur têemmlem ara mara awen Isemmeê Öebbi? Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ipqeôôiven tilawin zeddigen, istehzan, iumnen, ad pwaxzun di ddunit, di laxeôt. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ipqeôôiven tilawin zeddigen, istehzan, iumnen, ad pwaxzun di ddunit, di laxeôt. Fellasen aâaqeb abarar.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara d cehhden $ef igiten nnsen, ilsawen nnsen, ifassen nnsen, ivaôen nnsen,
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d cehhden $ef igiten nnsen, ilsawen nnsen, ifassen nnsen, ivaôen nnsen,

ayahs.text: assen, ad asen Ifk Öebbi ayen ppalasen, s tidep. Ad éôen ar Öebbi d Tidep ibanen.
ayahs.translation: assen, ad asen Ifk Öebbi ayen ppalasen, s tidep. Ad éôen ar Öebbi d Tidep ibanen.

ayahs.text: Yir tlawin i yir irgazen, yir irgazen i yir tlawin. Tilawin n lâali i irgazen n lâali, irgazen lâali i tlawin n lâali. Wigi ur ppkan deg wayen qqaôen. I nitni, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.
ayahs.translation: Yir tlawin i yir irgazen, yir irgazen i yir tlawin. Tilawin n lâali i irgazen n lâali, irgazen lâali i tlawin n lâali. Wigi ur ppkan deg wayen qqaôen. I nitni, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur keçmet ixxamen ur nelli nnwen, alamma s tsriê, u alamma tselmem $ef imawlan nnsen. Ppif akka i kunwi, amar a d tesmektim.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur keçmet ixxamen ur nelli nnwen, alamma s tsriê, u alamma tselmem $ef imawlan nnsen. Ppif akka i kunwi, amar a d tesmektim.

ayahs.text: Ma ur tufim êedd degsen, ur keçmet alamma s tsriê. Ma nnan awen d: "u$alet", u$alet. Yif it wakka i ûûfawa nnwen. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ma ur tufim êedd degsen, ur keçmet alamma s tsriê. Ma nnan awen d: "u$alet", u$alet. Yif it wakka i ûûfawa nnwen. Öebbi Iéôa ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma tkecmem ixxamen ur nepwazde$, ma tella t$awsa nnwen degsen. Öebbi Iéôa acu d teqqaôem, u wacu teppeffrem.
ayahs.translation: Ulac u$ilif fellawen ma tkecmem ixxamen ur nepwazde$, ma tella t$awsa nnwen degsen. Öebbi Iéôa acu d teqqaôem, u wacu teppeffrem.

ayahs.text: Ini i wid iumnen ad brun i wallen nnsen, ad ssôen tuzzuft nnsen. Yif it wakka i ûûfawa nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ini i wid iumnen ad brun i wallen nnsen, ad ssôen tuzzuft nnsen. Yif it wakka i ûûfawa nnsen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa ayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ini i tid iumnen ad brunt i wallen nnsent, ad ssôent tuzzuft nnsent, ur d sskanent, di zzin nnsent, siwa ayen d ivehôen segs, ad $umment idmaren nnsent. Ur d sskanent ccbuê nnsent, siwa i irgazen nnsent, ne$ ibabaten nnsent, ne$ im$aôen nnsent, ne$ iqcicen nnsent, ne$ irbiben nnsent, ne$ atmaten nnsent, ne$ iqcicen n watmaten nnsent, ne$ wid n tsetmatin nnsent, ne$ tiqeddacin nnsent, ne$ taklatin nnsent, ne$ iqeddacen imudduzen, ne$ arrac ur nelleméi. Ur kkatent dderz, ad ipwassen zzin nnsent uffir. Steôoâet akw i Öebbi, a lmumnin, amar a prebêem.
ayahs.translation: Ini i tid iumnen ad brunt i wallen nnsent, ad ssôent tuzzuft nnsent, ur d sskanent, di zzin nnsent, siwa ayen d ivehôen segs, ad $umment idmaren nnsent. Ur d sskanent ccbuê nnsent, siwa i irgazen nnsent, ne$ ibabaten nnsent, ne$ im$aôen nnsent, ne$ iqcicen nnsent, ne$ irbiben nnsent, ne$ atmaten nnsent, ne$ iqcicen n watmaten nnsent, ne$ wid n tsetmatin nnsent, ne$ tiqeddacin nnsent, ne$ taklatin nnsent, ne$ iqeddacen imudduzen, ne$ arrac ur nelleméi. Ur kkatent dderz, ad ipwassen zzin nnsent uffir. Steôoâet akw i Öebbi, a lmumnin, amar a prebêem.

ayahs.text: Jewoet i iâzriyen nnwen, akked wid imaânen seg waklan nnwen, akked teklatin nnwen. Ma d ime$ban ay llan, a ten Iôéeq Öebbi, s lfevl iS. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Jewoet i iâzriyen nnwen, akked wid imaânen seg waklan nnwen, akked teklatin nnwen. Ma d ime$ban ay llan, a ten Iôéeq Öebbi, s lfevl iS. Öebbi d Ajemmal, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Wid ur nufa ara ar a$en, ad ûebôen ar ten id Iôéeq Öebbi, s lfevl iS. Wid, seg waklan nnwen, i ib$an ad asen tarum aserreê, arut asen ma teéôam ten, d at lxiô ay llan. Fket asen seg ayla i wen Ifka Öebbi. Ur pêeppimet $ef teklatin nnwen, tiquêbit, i rrbeê nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ma b$ant tezdeg. Ma têeppmen, Öebbi, deffir uêeppem nnsent, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Wid ur nufa ara ar a$en, ad ûebôen ar ten id Iôéeq Öebbi, s lfevl iS. Wid, seg waklan nnwen, i ib$an ad asen tarum aserreê, arut asen ma teéôam ten, d at lxiô ay llan. Fket asen seg ayla i wen Ifka Öebbi. Ur pêeppimet $ef teklatin nnwen, tiquêbit, i rrbeê nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit, ma b$ant tezdeg. Ma têeppmen, Öebbi, deffir uêeppem nnsent, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nessader awen ed issekniyen iberrzen, akked umedya n wid iâacen uqbel nnwen, d anabi i wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nessader awen ed issekniyen iberrzen, akked umedya n wid iâacen uqbel nnwen, d anabi i wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Öebbi d tafat n tmurt akked igenwan. Amedya n tafat iS d takwap degs taftilt. Taftilt daxel n tqeôâap. Taqeôâap, amzun d itri acôaôaq, tecâal it ttejôa iôqan, tazemmurt ur nelli n ugmuv ne$ n utaram. Qôib a pfet zzit is, ur p tennul tmes. Tafat $ef tafat. Ippawi Öebbi win i S ihwan ar tafat iS. Ippak ed Öebbi imedyaten i medden. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi d tafat n tmurt akked igenwan. Amedya n tafat iS d takwap degs taftilt. Taftilt daxel n tqeôâap. Taqeôâap, amzun d itri acôaôaq, tecâal it ttejôa iôqan, tazemmurt ur nelli n ugmuv ne$ n utaram. Qôib a pfet zzit is, ur p tennul tmes. Tafat $ef tafat. Ippawi Öebbi win i S ihwan ar tafat iS. Ippak ed Öebbi imedyaten i medden. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.

ayahs.text: Deg ixxamen i Ib$a Öebbi ad ufraren, ideg ara d immekti yisem iS, sbuccuâen T ssbeê, tameddit.
ayahs.translation: Deg ixxamen i Ib$a Öebbi ad ufraren, ideg ara d immekti yisem iS, sbuccuâen T ssbeê, tameddit.

ayahs.text: Irgazen ur tes$afal ttjaôa, ne$ ssuq, $ef usmekti n Öebbi, $ef téallit, $ef zzakat; ppagwaden ass, ideg ara nehwwalen wallen akked wulawen.
ayahs.translation: Irgazen ur tes$afal ttjaôa, ne$ ssuq, $ef usmekti n Öebbi, $ef téallit, $ef zzakat; ppagwaden ass, ideg ara nehwwalen wallen akked wulawen.

ayahs.text: Iwakken a ten Ikafi Öebbi $ef wayen xeddmen d amxallef, ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, war aktili.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken a ten Ikafi Öebbi $ef wayen xeddmen d amxallef, ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, war aktili.

ayahs.text: Igiten n wid ijehlen, am aylal deg uza$aô. Win ifuden, ad i$il d aman. Alamma mi ibbwev $uôes, ur ippaf acemma. A n iaf Öebbi, Issuli as leêsab is. Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
ayahs.translation: Igiten n wid ijehlen, am aylal deg uza$aô. Win ifuden, ad i$il d aman. Alamma mi ibbwev $uôes, ur ippaf acemma. A n iaf Öebbi, Issuli as leêsab is. Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

ayahs.text: Ne$ am tillas di yill le$miq. T$umm it lmuja, sufella lmuja, sufella asigna. Tillas sennig tiyav. Ma issuffe$ ed afus is, ur issawev a t iwali. Win iwumi ur Iga ara Öebbi tafat, ur isâi tafat.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ am tillas di yill le$miq. T$umm it lmuja, sufella lmuja, sufella asigna. Tillas sennig tiyav. Ma issuffe$ ed afus is, ur issawev a t iwali. Win iwumi ur Iga ara Öebbi tafat, ur isâi tafat.

ayahs.text: Day ur twalav ara, sbuccuâen Öebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ifrax deg waffug. Issen taéallit akked usbuccaâ n yal yiwen. Öebbi Iéôa ayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Day ur twalav ara, sbuccuâen Öebbi i illan di tmurt akked igenwan? Ifrax deg waffug. Issen taéallit akked usbuccaâ n yal yiwen. Öebbi Iéôa ayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. £uô öÖebbi tu$alin.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. £uô öÖebbi tu$alin.

ayahs.text: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Isselêay asigna, sinna, a t Izdi, sinna, a t Issem$weô? D$a a pwaliv ageffur a d iffe$ si zdaxel is. Isrusu d, seg idurar igenni, abruri. Ad Iwwet yis, win i S ihwan, a t Iveôôef $ef win i S ihwan. Tafat n lebôaq iS qôib a ppeglu s yiéôi.
ayahs.translation: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Isselêay asigna, sinna, a t Izdi, sinna, a t Issem$weô? D$a a pwaliv ageffur a d iffe$ si zdaxel is. Isrusu d, seg idurar igenni, abruri. Ad Iwwet yis, win i S ihwan, a t Iveôôef $ef win i S ihwan. Tafat n lebôaq iS qôib a ppeglu s yiéôi.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Ismizwar iv akked wass. Deg wayagi, s tidep, d aselmed i wid isâan iéôi.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Ismizwar iv akked wass. Deg wayagi, s tidep, d aselmed i wid isâan iéôi.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Ixleq akw lêayawan, seg waman. Garasen, illa win ippeênunufen $ef uâabbuv is, win ileêêun $ef sin ivaôôen, win ileêêun $ef kué. Ixelleq Öebbi ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Ixleq akw lêayawan, seg waman. Garasen, illa win ippeênunufen $ef uâabbuv is, win ileêêun $ef sin ivaôôen, win ileêêun $ef kué. Ixelleq Öebbi ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nessader ed issekniyen iberrzen. Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nessader ed issekniyen iberrzen. Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan, ar ubrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Qqaôen: "numen s Öebbi akked Umazan, nu$ awal". Sinna, deffir waya, iwexxeô urbaâ segsen. Wigi ur llin d lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Qqaôen: "numen s Öebbi akked Umazan, nu$ awal". Sinna, deffir waya, iwexxeô urbaâ segsen. Wigi ur llin d lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Mi pwanecden ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, arbaâ segsen iwexxeô.
ayahs.translation: Mi pwanecden ar Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, arbaâ segsen iwexxeô.

ayahs.text: Ma sâan lêeqq, a d asen $uôes, d imvuâen.
ayahs.translation: Ma sâan lêeqq, a d asen $uôes, d imvuâen.

ayahs.text: Day helken wulawen nnsen, ne$ cukken, ne$ ugaden a ten Isneêyaf Öebbi akked Umazan iS? Xaîi, widak d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Day helken wulawen nnsen, ne$ cukken, ne$ ugaden a ten Isneêyaf Öebbi akked Umazan iS? Xaîi, widak d imednas.

ayahs.text: Timenna n lmumnin, mara ssutren aêuddu n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, d tigi kan: "nesla, nôuva". D wigi ay d imerbaê.
ayahs.translation: Timenna n lmumnin, mara ssutren aêuddu n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ad Iêudd garasen, d tigi kan: "nesla, nôuva". D wigi ay d imerbaê.

ayahs.text: Win iôuvan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ippagwaden Öebbi, ipêezziben, nitni d isaâdiyen.
ayahs.translation: Win iôuvan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ippagwaden Öebbi, ipêezziben, nitni d isaâdiyen.

verses.translation: Nnan: "nekwni d imawlan n tezmert, nesâa lemêella tuqsiêt. Lameô i kem. Muqel d acu ara d tseyyiv".

verses.text: Tenna: "s tidep, igeldan ssefsaden tamdint ara kecmen. Sdullun imdanen is lâali. Akka ay xeddmen.
verses.translation: Tenna: "s tidep, igeldan ssefsaden tamdint ara kecmen. Sdullun imdanen is lâali. Akka ay xeddmen.

verses.text: Nek, ad asen azne$ tarzeft, ad aôou$ acu ara d awin imcegâan".
verses.translation: Nek, ad asen azne$ tarzeft, ad aôou$ acu ara d awin imcegâan".

verses.text: Mi tebbwev ar Sliman, inna: "day ad iyi tâawnem s terkunt? Ayen i yi Ifka Öebbi, yif ayen i wen Ifka. D kunwi kan i ifeôêen, s terzeft nnwen.
verses.translation: Mi tebbwev ar Sliman, inna: "day ad iyi tâawnem s terkunt? Ayen i yi Ifka Öebbi, yif ayen i wen Ifka. D kunwi kan i ifeôêen, s terzeft nnwen.

verses.text: U$al $uôsen. Ih, a nôuê $uôsen s lâaskeô, iwumi ur zmiren. A ten id nessuffe$, syenna, ndellen, d imejîuêen".
verses.translation: U$al $uôsen. Ih, a nôuê $uôsen s lâaskeô, iwumi ur zmiren. A ten id nessuffe$, syenna, ndellen, d imejîuêen".

verses.text: Inna: "a yimvebbôen, anwa degwen, ara yi d iawin asgeld is, uqbel a yi d asen d imvuâen"?
verses.translation: Inna: "a yimvebbôen, anwa degwen, ara yi d iawin asgeld is, uqbel a yi d asen d imvuâen"?

verses.text: Aâfrit si leonun, inna d: "ad ak t id awi$, uqbel ma tekkrev seg umekkan ik. I wayagi, war ccekk, nek d uzmir muman".
verses.translation: Aâfrit si leonun, inna d: "ad ak t id awi$, uqbel ma tekkrev seg umekkan ik. I wayagi, war ccekk, nek d uzmir muman".

verses.text: Inna d bab n tmusni si Tezmamt: "nek ad ak t id awi$, uqbel a pfukkev asmeômec". Mi t iwala irs ed $uôes, inna: "wagi si lfevl n Mass iw, ad iyi ijeôôeb ma ad snemmre$, ne$ ma ad jehle$. Win isnemmren, isnemmer kan i iman is. Win ijehl, ihi, Mass iw d Asâay, d Ukyis".
verses.translation: Inna d bab n tmusni si Tezmamt: "nek ad ak t id awi$, uqbel a pfukkev asmeômec". Mi t iwala irs ed $uôes, inna: "wagi si lfevl n Mass iw, ad iyi ijeôôeb ma ad snemmre$, ne$ ma ad jehle$. Win isnemmren, isnemmer kan i iman is. Win ijehl, ihi, Mass iw d Asâay, d Ukyis".

verses.text: Inna: "bedlet as udem usgeld is, a néeô ma tepwanha, ne$ haap seg wid ur nepwanha".
verses.translation: Inna: "bedlet as udem usgeld is, a néeô ma tepwanha, ne$ haap seg wid ur nepwanha".

verses.text: Mi d tusa, nnan as: "day am wagi, usgeld inem"? Terra d: "amzun d neppa". "Tusa ya$ d tmusni, uqbel neppat, nuzen.
verses.translation: Mi d tusa, nnan as: "day am wagi, usgeld inem"? Terra d: "amzun d neppa". "Tusa ya$ d tmusni, uqbel neppat, nuzen.

verses.text: Isôuê ip wayen tunez, war Öebbi. Tella, s tidep, seg ugdud ijehliyen".
verses.translation: Isôuê ip wayen tunez, war Öebbi. Tella, s tidep, seg ugdud ijehliyen".

verses.text: Nnan as: "ekcem ar lbeôo"! Mi t twala, t$il degs aman; tesban ed ifadden is. Inna: "s tidep, d lbeôo ulelluc imzin". Tenna: "a Mass iw! Ih, dense$ iman iw. Akked Sliman, unze$ aS i Öebbi, Mass imavalen".
verses.translation: Nnan as: "ekcem ar lbeôo"! Mi t twala, t$il degs aman; tesban ed ifadden is. Inna: "s tidep, d lbeôo ulelluc imzin". Tenna: "a Mass iw! Ih, dense$ iman iw. Akked Sliman, unze$ aS i Öebbi, Mass imavalen".

verses.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed, i Tamud, gmat sen Üaliê: "âabdet Öebbi"! Maca, rran snat n trebbuya$, ppemnamarent.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed, i Tamud, gmat sen Üaliê: "âabdet Öebbi"! Maca, rran snat n trebbuya$, ppemnamarent.

verses.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acimi tep$awalem ar tucmip, uqbel ise$? Lemmer a ppeste$fôem Öebbi, ahat aêunu fellawen".
verses.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acimi tep$awalem ar tucmip, uqbel ise$? Lemmer a ppeste$fôem Öebbi, ahat aêunu fellawen".

verses.text: Nnan: "tkeêêesev a$, keçç akked wi iddan yidek". Inna: "lfal nnwen ar Öebbi, u kunwi d agdud ara ippuhewwlen".
verses.translation: Nnan: "tkeêêesev a$, keçç akked wi iddan yidek". Inna: "lfal nnwen ar Öebbi, u kunwi d agdud ara ippuhewwlen".

verses.text: Llan, di temdint, tza iterrasen i issefsaden di tmurt, ur pleqqimen.
verses.translation: Llan, di temdint, tza iterrasen i issefsaden di tmurt, ur pleqqimen.

verses.text: Nnan: "yyaw a nemmesgal s Öebbi, ard a neévem deg iv fellas, neppa akked twacult is. Sinna, a nini i bab is: ur nelli d inagan n tmen$iwt n tawacult is. Ih, nekwni, d imawlan n tidep".
verses.translation: Nnan: "yyaw a nemmesgal s Öebbi, ard a neévem deg iv fellas, neppa akked twacult is. Sinna, a nini i bab is: ur nelli d inagan n tmen$iwt n tawacult is. Ih, nekwni, d imawlan n tidep".

verses.text: Undin ticeôkep, Nundi ticeôkep, nitni ur faqen.
verses.translation: Undin ticeôkep, Nundi ticeôkep, nitni ur faqen.

verses.text: Wali amek tevôa di tceôkep nnsen. Nen$ed iten, nitni, akked ugdud nnsen, meôôa.
verses.translation: Wali amek tevôa di tceôkep nnsen. Nen$ed iten, nitni, akked ugdud nnsen, meôôa.

verses.text: Atnan hudden ixxamen nnsen, ilmend n ddens nnsen. Deg wayagi, war ccekk, assekni i ugdud issnen.
verses.translation: Atnan hudden ixxamen nnsen, ilmend n ddens nnsen. Deg wayagi, war ccekk, assekni i ugdud issnen.

verses.text: Nsellek wid iumnen u llan pêezziben.
verses.translation: Nsellek wid iumnen u llan pêezziben.

verses.text: I Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "teppeddum ar wayen n dir, u kunwi tepwalim.
verses.translation: I Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "teppeddum ar wayen n dir, u kunwi tepwalim.

verses.text: Ih, kunwi teppeddum ar irgazen, teb$am ten, war tilawin. Ih, kunwi d agdud ur nessin".
verses.translation: Ih, kunwi teppeddum ar irgazen, teb$am ten, war tilawin. Ih, kunwi d agdud ur nessin".

verses.text: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "ssuff$et tawacult n Luî, si temdint nnwen, nitni d imdanen i ib$an tezdeg".
verses.translation: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "ssuff$et tawacult n Luî, si temdint nnwen, nitni d imdanen i ib$an tezdeg".

verses.text: Nsellek it, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is. Nseyya a ppili seg wid igwran.
verses.translation: Nsellek it, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is. Nseyya a ppili seg wid igwran.

verses.text: Nesse$li d fellasen ageffur. I icmet ugeffur n wid ippunedôen!
verses.translation: Nesse$li d fellasen ageffur. I icmet ugeffur n wid ippunedôen!

verses.text: Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi. Talwit i imdanen iS, wid Ifren". Ppif Öebbi, ne$ ayen pcaraken?
verses.translation: Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi. Talwit i imdanen iS, wid Ifren". Ppif Öebbi, ne$ ayen pcaraken?

verses.text: Day Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i wen d Isse$lin aman, seg igenni - Nessenkar, yissen, iqwiôen ippembehwaoen, ur teêwaoem a d tessem$im ttjuô is -, day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Maca, nitni d agdud issaâdalen.
verses.translation: Day Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i wen d Isse$lin aman, seg igenni - Nessenkar, yissen, iqwiôen ippembehwaoen, ur teêwaoem a d tessem$im ttjuô is -, day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Maca, nitni d agdud issaâdalen.

verses.text: Day Win Irran tamurt d tanezdu$t, Irra degs isaffen, Irra yas idurar, Irra agadir ger sin ilellen, day illa ôebbi ar tama n Öebbi? Xaîi, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Day Win Irran tamurt d tanezdu$t, Irra degs isaffen, Irra yas idurar, Irra agadir ger sin ilellen, day illa ôebbi ar tama n Öebbi? Xaîi, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.

verses.text: Day Win Issemêasen i umevôuô, mara S d isiwel; Itekksen ayen n dir; i kwen Ipparan d igensas di tmurt; day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Drus id tesmektayem.
verses.translation: Day Win Issemêasen i umevôuô, mara S d isiwel; Itekksen ayen n dir; i kwen Ipparan d igensas di tmurt; day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Drus id tesmektayem.

verses.text: Day Win i kwen Inehhun, di tillas n lberr akked yill, id Ippaznen avu, d abecceô n ccira uêunu S; day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Ay Aâlay Öebbi, sennig wayen pcaraken!
verses.translation: Day Win i kwen Inehhun, di tillas n lberr akked yill, id Ippaznen avu, d abecceô n ccira uêunu S; day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Ay Aâlay Öebbi, sennig wayen pcaraken!

verses.text: Day Win Ibeddun lxelq, sinna, Ippales as; ikwen I$aten seg igenni akked tmurt; day illa ôebbi ar tama n Öebbi? Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tidep"!
verses.translation: Day Win Ibeddun lxelq, sinna, Ippales as; ikwen I$aten seg igenni akked tmurt; day illa ôebbi ar tama n Öebbi? Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tidep"!

verses.text: Ini: "tabavnit, di tmurt akked igenwan, ur p issin yiwen siwa Öebbi. Ur éôin melmi ara d kkren".
verses.translation: Ini: "tabavnit, di tmurt akked igenwan, ur p issin yiwen siwa Öebbi. Ur éôin melmi ara d kkren".

verses.text: Ih, tamusni nnsen ur tessawev ar laxeôt? Xaîi, nitni di ccekk fellas. Xaîi, nitni, fellas, dre$len.
verses.translation: Ih, tamusni nnsen ur tessawev ar laxeôt? Xaîi, nitni di ccekk fellas. Xaîi, nitni, fellas, dre$len.

verses.text: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ma nu$al d akal, am imezwura nne$, s tidep, fella$ tanekra?
verses.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ma nu$al d akal, am imezwura nne$, s tidep, fella$ tanekra?

verses.text: Ni$ waââden a$ aya, i nekwni akw i imezwura nne$, zik. Ayagi, d timucuha kan imenza".
verses.translation: Ni$ waââden a$ aya, i nekwni akw i imezwura nne$, zik. Ayagi, d timucuha kan imenza".

verses.text: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d ibe$wviyen".
verses.translation: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d ibe$wviyen".

verses.text: Ur $webben fellasen, ur pxiqqi ilmend n nncub nnsen.
verses.translation: Ur $webben fellasen, ur pxiqqi ilmend n nncub nnsen.

verses.text: Nnan: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma d tidep ay tessawalem"?
verses.translation: Nnan: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma d tidep ay tessawalem"?

verses.text: Ini: "kra n wayen i$ef têarem, ahat atan ivfeô kwen id".
verses.translation: Ini: "kra n wayen i$ef têarem, ahat atan ivfeô kwen id".

verses.text: Mass ik, s tidep, meqqweô lfevl iS, $ef imdanen. Maca, tegwti degsen ur snemmiren.
verses.translation: Mass ik, s tidep, meqqweô lfevl iS, $ef imdanen. Maca, tegwti degsen ur snemmiren.

verses.text: Mass ik, s tidep, Iéôa ayen teffren idmaren nnsen, akked wayen d qqaôen.
verses.translation: Mass ik, s tidep, Iéôa ayen teffren idmaren nnsen, akked wayen d qqaôen.

verses.text: Ur illi wayen iffren, deg igenni akked tmurt, ur nuri di Tezmamt ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Ur illi wayen iffren, deg igenni akked tmurt, ur nuri di Tezmamt ipbegginen.

verses.text: Ih, Leqwôan agi iêekku d i At Isôail, tegwti n wayen i$ef mgarraden.
verses.translation: Ih, Leqwôan agi iêekku d i At Isôail, tegwti n wayen i$ef mgarraden.

verses.text: Neppa, war ccekk, ard nnhaya akked uêunu i lmumnin.
verses.translation: Neppa, war ccekk, ard nnhaya akked uêunu i lmumnin.

verses.text: Mass ik, s tidep, ad Iseyyi garasen s uêuddu S. Neppa d Uzmir, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Mass ik, s tidep, ad Iseyyi garasen s uêuddu S. Neppa d Uzmir, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ppkel $ef Öebbi, ih, aql ak di tidep ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Ppkel $ef Öebbi, ih, aql ak di tidep ipbegginen.

verses.text: Ih, keçç, ur tepparav lmeggtin ad slen, ur tepparav iâeééugen ad slen i wancad, ma wexxôen.
verses.translation: Ih, keçç, ur tepparav lmeggtin ad slen, ur tepparav iâeééugen ad slen i wancad, ma wexxôen.

verses.text: Ur fellak nnhaya ider$alen, mgal ttelfan nnsen. Ara islen, siwa wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£. Nitni d imvuâen.
verses.translation: Ur fellak nnhaya ider$alen, mgal ttelfan nnsen. Ara islen, siwa wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£. Nitni d imvuâen.

verses.text: Mi iûaô wawal fellasen, ad asen d Nessuffe$ lweêc si tmurt; ad asen yini ar imdanen ur metbutit $ef issekniyen nne£.
verses.translation: Mi iûaô wawal fellasen, ad asen d Nessuffe$ lweêc si tmurt; ad asen yini ar imdanen ur metbutit $ef issekniyen nne£.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara d Nefser, si yal lois, arbaâ n wid inekôen issekniyen nne£, d tirni,
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara d Nefser, si yal lois, arbaâ n wid inekôen issekniyen nne£, d tirni,

verses.text: alamma, mi d usan, ad Yini: "day tnekôem issekniyen iW, ur ten teskecmem di tmusni? Ne$ d acu tellam txeddmem"?
verses.translation: alamma, mi d usan, ad Yini: "day tnekôem issekniyen iW, ur ten teskecmem di tmusni? Ne$ d acu tellam txeddmem"?

verses.text: Iûaô wawal fellasen, imi densen. Ur d pmeslayen.
verses.translation: Iûaô wawal fellasen, imi densen. Ur d pmeslayen.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara ar Nerra yasen iv i ureyyeê nnsen, ass iwakken ad walin? Deg wayagi, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara ar Nerra yasen iv i ureyyeê nnsen, ass iwakken ad walin? Deg wayagi, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Ass uûuvu n lbuq, ad iagwad i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, siwa wid i S ihwan i Öebbi. A d asen akw $uôeS, s uêiwet.
verses.translation: Ass uûuvu n lbuq, ad iagwad i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, siwa wid i S ihwan i Öebbi. A d asen akw $uôeS, s uêiwet.

verses.text: A pwaliv idurar i t$ilev sebken, la teddun am usigna. D igi n Öebbi i Iûegmen yal cci. Neppa, s tidep, Iéôa d acu txedmem.
verses.translation: A pwaliv idurar i t$ilev sebken, la teddun am usigna. D igi n Öebbi i Iûegmen yal cci. Neppa, s tidep, Iéôa d acu txedmem.

verses.text: Win id iusan s ise$, ad iawi it yifen. Widak, assen, mevmunit si tugdi.
verses.translation: Win id iusan s ise$, ad iawi it yifen. Widak, assen, mevmunit si tugdi.

verses.text: Wid id iusan s tucmip, ad ppin wudmawen nnsen ar tmes. Ni$ a ppeppuqeîîim kan $ef wayen txeddmem?
verses.translation: Wid id iusan s tucmip, ad ppin wudmawen nnsen ar tmes. Ni$ a ppeppuqeîîim kan $ef wayen txeddmem?

verses.text: Pwamôe$ kan ad âabde$ Mass n temdint agi, i Iôqa. IneS yal cci. Pwamôe$ d ad ili$ seg imduâen,
verses.translation: Pwamôe$ kan ad âabde$ Mass n temdint agi, i Iôqa. IneS yal cci. Pwamôe$ d ad ili$ seg imduâen,

verses.text: ad male$ Leqwôan. Win ipwanhan, ipwanha kan i iman is. Win innetlafen, ini: "nek d aneddaô kan".
verses.translation: ad male$ Leqwôan. Win ipwanhan, ipwanha kan i iman is. Win innetlafen, ini: "nek d aneddaô kan".

verses.text: Ini: "a neckeô Öebbi. Ad awen Issken issekniyen iS. A ten tâaqlem". Mass ik ur I$effel ara $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ini: "a neckeô Öebbi. Ad awen Issken issekniyen iS. A ten tâaqlem". Mass ik ur I$effel ara $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ïs. Atnan issekniyen n Leqwôan, akked Tezmamt ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Ïs. Atnan issekniyen n Leqwôan, akked Tezmamt ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: D nnhaya u d abecceô i lmumnin:
ayahs.translation: D nnhaya u d abecceô i lmumnin:

ayahs.text: wid ibedden i téallit, ippaken zzakat, ipputebbten $ef laxeôt nnsen.
ayahs.translation: wid ibedden i téallit, ippaken zzakat, ipputebbten $ef laxeôt nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, Ncebbeê asen igiten nnsen, d$a ddebdeben.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, Ncebbeê asen igiten nnsen, d$a ddebdeben.

ayahs.text: Widak, fellasen aâaqeb ucmit mavi. Di laxeôt, d nitni ara ixesôen ugwar.
ayahs.translation: Widak, fellasen aâaqeb ucmit mavi. Di laxeôt, d nitni ara ixesôen ugwar.

ayahs.text: S tidep, keçç iusa k id Leqwôan, s$uô Bab n ûûwab, Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: S tidep, keçç iusa k id Leqwôan, s$uô Bab n ûûwab, Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Mi inna Musa i twacult is: "nek wala$ times, ad awen d awi$, segs, asali, ne$ ad awen d awi$ asafu iôeqqen, amar a ppesseêmum".
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Musa i twacult is: "nek wala$ times, ad awen d awi$, segs, asali, ne$ ad awen d awi$ asafu iôeqqen, amar a ppesseêmum".

ayahs.text: Mi ibbwev $uôes, ipwanced: "ad iôqu wayen illan di tmes, akked wayen i as d izzin. Gedha s Öebbi, Mass imavalen!
ayahs.translation: Mi ibbwev $uôes, ipwanced: "ad iôqu wayen illan di tmes, akked wayen i as d izzin. Gedha s Öebbi, Mass imavalen!

ayahs.text: A Musa! Ih, Nek d Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: A Musa! Ih, Nek d Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Veggeô taâkwazt ik"! Mi p iwala la tesseêôiîiw, amzun d azrem, ibren, ur iwexxeô. "A Musa! Ur ppagwad! Ar $uôI, ih, ur ppagwaden imazanen,
ayahs.translation: Veggeô taâkwazt ik"! Mi p iwala la tesseêôiîiw, amzun d azrem, ibren, ur iwexxeô. "A Musa! Ur ppagwad! Ar $uôI, ih, ur ppagwaden imazanen,

ayahs.text: siwa win idensen, sinna, iu$al iwqem, deffir tuccva. Nek, s tidep, Psemmiêe$, Pêunnu$.
ayahs.translation: siwa win idensen, sinna, iu$al iwqem, deffir tuccva. Nek, s tidep, Psemmiêe$, Pêunnu$.

ayahs.text: Ger afus ik di loib ik, a d iffe$ d amellal, ur ihlik. Si tza issekniyen, i Ferâun akked ugdud is. Nitni, war ccekk, d agdud icemten".
ayahs.translation: Ger afus ik di loib ik, a d iffe$ d amellal, ur ihlik. Si tza issekniyen, i Ferâun akked ugdud is. Nitni, war ccekk, d agdud icemten".

ayahs.text: Mi ten id usan issekniyen nne£, âinani, nnan: "wagi iban d ssêur".
ayahs.translation: Mi ten id usan issekniyen nne£, âinani, nnan: "wagi iban d ssêur".

ayahs.text: Ugin ten s ddens d pnefxa, u, deg iman nnsen, pputebbten. Wali, ihi, amek tevôa d ifessaden.
ayahs.translation: Ugin ten s ddens d pnefxa, u, deg iman nnsen, pputebbten. Wali, ihi, amek tevôa d ifessaden.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nefka tamusni i Dawed akked Sliman. Nnan: "ccekôan i Öebbi, i a$ Ismenyafen i waîaû n yimdanen iumnen".
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka tamusni i Dawed akked Sliman. Nnan: "ccekôan i Öebbi, i a$ Ismenyafen i waîaû n yimdanen iumnen".

ayahs.text: Sliman iwôet Dawed, u inna: "a yimdanen! Nepwaselmed tutlayt n yifôax; ippunefk a$ si yal cci. Ayagi, s tidep, ard lfevl n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: Sliman iwôet Dawed, u inna: "a yimdanen! Nepwaselmed tutlayt n yifôax; ippunefk a$ si yal cci. Ayagi, s tidep, ard lfevl n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Pwajemmlen d, i Sliman, i²âsekôiwen is si leonun, imdanen, ifôax. Mdarraren.
ayahs.translation: Pwajemmlen d, i Sliman, i²âsekôiwen is si leonun, imdanen, ifôax. Mdarraren.

ayahs.text: Armi, mi bbwven ar te$zut n twevfin, tenna d tweîuft: "a yaweîîuf, kecmemt ar ixxamen nnkwent, mulac, war ccekk, a kwent iéd Sliman, neppa akked iâsekôiwen is, ur faqen".
ayahs.translation: Armi, mi bbwven ar te$zut n twevfin, tenna d tweîuft: "a yaweîîuf, kecmemt ar ixxamen nnkwent, mulac, war ccekk, a kwent iéd Sliman, neppa akked iâsekôiwen is, ur faqen".

ayahs.text: Icmumeê, ivûa, $ef wayen d tenna. Inna: "a Mass iw! Err iyi ad snemmre$ l$it iK, is i $ T$atev, nek akked imawlan iw; ad xedme$ ise$ ara Tôaviv; Ssekcem iyi, s uêunu K, ar imdanen iK imaânen".
ayahs.translation: Icmumeê, ivûa, $ef wayen d tenna. Inna: "a Mass iw! Err iyi ad snemmre$ l$it iK, is i $ T$atev, nek akked imawlan iw; ad xedme$ ise$ ara Tôaviv; Ssekcem iyi, s uêunu K, ar imdanen iK imaânen".

ayahs.text: Issefqed ifôax, inna: "acimi ur wala$ ara iççibib, day d l$ayeb?
ayahs.translation: Issefqed ifôax, inna: "acimi ur wala$ ara iççibib, day d l$ayeb?

ayahs.text: War ccekk, ad sâaddi$ fellas aâaqeb uqsiê, ne$ a t zlu$, ne$ a d iawi tasebbiwt tubrizt".
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, ad sâaddi$ fellas aâaqeb uqsiê, ne$ a t zlu$, ne$ a d iawi tasebbiwt tubrizt".

ayahs.text: Ur iâaîîel ara. Inna d: "fehme$ ayen ur tefhimev. Usi$ d $uôek si Saba, s usali unûiê.
ayahs.translation: Ur iâaîîel ara. Inna d: "fehme$ ayen ur tefhimev. Usi$ d $uôek si Saba, s usali unûiê.

ayahs.text: Ih, ufi$ en tameîîut d tagelliî nnsen. Ippunefk as si yal cci. £uôes asgeld abarar.
ayahs.translation: Ih, ufi$ en tameîîut d tagelliî nnsen. Ippunefk as si yal cci. £uôes asgeld abarar.

ayahs.text: Ufi$ p in, neppat akked ugdud is, la kennun i yiîij, war Öebbi. Cciîan icebbeê asen igiten nnsen. Iveôf iten seg ubrid, d$a nitni ur pwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Ufi$ p in, neppat akked ugdud is, la kennun i yiîij, war Öebbi. Cciîan icebbeê asen igiten nnsen. Iveôf iten seg ubrid, d$a nitni ur pwanhan.

ayahs.text: Acimi ur knan ara i Öebbi, id Issufu$en lesrar, di tmurt akked igenwan, i Iéôan ayen teppeffrem u ayen d tepberriêem?
ayahs.translation: Acimi ur knan ara i Öebbi, id Issufu$en lesrar, di tmurt akked igenwan, i Iéôan ayen teppeffrem u ayen d tepberriêem?

ayahs.text: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Mass n usgeld ameqwôaêan".
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Mass n usgeld ameqwôaêan".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a néeô ma tessawlev d tidep, ne$ ma keçç seg ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a néeô ma tessawlev d tidep, ne$ ma keçç seg ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: Öuê s tebôap iw agi, veggeô asen p, sinna, wexxeô asen, wali acu ara d rren".
ayahs.translation: Öuê s tebôap iw agi, veggeô asen p, sinna, wexxeô asen, wali acu ara d rren".

ayahs.text: Tenna: "a yimvebbôen, tepwaveggeô iyi d tebôap tukyist.
ayahs.translation: Tenna: "a yimvebbôen, tepwaveggeô iyi d tebôap tukyist.

ayahs.text: Ih, s$uô Sliman. Apan: s yisem n Öebbi Aênin Ipêunun.
ayahs.translation: Ih, s$uô Sliman. Apan: s yisem n Öebbi Aênin Ipêunun.

ayahs.text: Ur ssem$waôet ara iman nnwen $uôi, aset ed $uôi, d imvuâen".
ayahs.translation: Ur ssem$waôet ara iman nnwen $uôi, aset ed $uôi, d imvuâen".

ayahs.text: Tenna: "a yimvebbôen, fket ed ôôay nnwen af lameô iw. Ur pseyyi$ lameô, siwa garawen".
ayahs.translation: Tenna: "a yimvebbôen, fket ed ôôay nnwen af lameô iw. Ur pseyyi$ lameô, siwa garawen".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "nekwni d imawlan n tezmert, nesâa lemêella tuqsiêt. Lameô i kem. Muqel d acu ara d tseyyiv".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "nekwni d imawlan n tezmert, nesâa lemêella tuqsiêt. Lameô i kem. Muqel d acu ara d tseyyiv".

ayahs.text: Tenna: "s tidep, igeldan ssefsaden tamdint ara kecmen. Sdullun imdanen is lâali. Akka ay xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Tenna: "s tidep, igeldan ssefsaden tamdint ara kecmen. Sdullun imdanen is lâali. Akka ay xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Nek, ad asen azne$ tarzeft, ad aôou$ acu ara d awin imcegâan".
ayahs.translation: Nek, ad asen azne$ tarzeft, ad aôou$ acu ara d awin imcegâan".

ayahs.text: Mi tebbwev ar Sliman, inna: "day ad iyi tâawnem s terkunt? Ayen i yi Ifka Öebbi, yif ayen i wen Ifka. D kunwi kan i ifeôêen, s terzeft nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Mi tebbwev ar Sliman, inna: "day ad iyi tâawnem s terkunt? Ayen i yi Ifka Öebbi, yif ayen i wen Ifka. D kunwi kan i ifeôêen, s terzeft nnwen.

ayahs.text: U$al $uôsen. Ih, a nôuê $uôsen s lâaskeô, iwumi ur zmiren. A ten id nessuffe$, syenna, ndellen, d imejîuêen".
ayahs.translation: U$al $uôsen. Ih, a nôuê $uôsen s lâaskeô, iwumi ur zmiren. A ten id nessuffe$, syenna, ndellen, d imejîuêen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a yimvebbôen, anwa degwen, ara yi d iawin asgeld is, uqbel a yi d asen d imvuâen"?
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a yimvebbôen, anwa degwen, ara yi d iawin asgeld is, uqbel a yi d asen d imvuâen"?

ayahs.text: Aâfrit si leonun, inna d: "ad ak t id awi$, uqbel ma tekkrev seg umekkan ik. I wayagi, war ccekk, nek d uzmir muman".
ayahs.translation: Aâfrit si leonun, inna d: "ad ak t id awi$, uqbel ma tekkrev seg umekkan ik. I wayagi, war ccekk, nek d uzmir muman".

ayahs.text: Inna d bab n tmusni si Tezmamt: "nek ad ak t id awi$, uqbel a pfukkev asmeômec". Mi t iwala irs ed $uôes, inna: "wagi si lfevl n Mass iw, ad iyi ijeôôeb ma ad snemmre$, ne$ ma ad jehle$. Win isnemmren, isnemmer kan i iman is. Win ijehl, ihi, Mass iw d Asâay, d Ukyis".
ayahs.translation: Inna d bab n tmusni si Tezmamt: "nek ad ak t id awi$, uqbel a pfukkev asmeômec". Mi t iwala irs ed $uôes, inna: "wagi si lfevl n Mass iw, ad iyi ijeôôeb ma ad snemmre$, ne$ ma ad jehle$. Win isnemmren, isnemmer kan i iman is. Win ijehl, ihi, Mass iw d Asâay, d Ukyis".

ayahs.text: Inna: "bedlet as udem usgeld is, a néeô ma tepwanha, ne$ haap seg wid ur nepwanha".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "bedlet as udem usgeld is, a néeô ma tepwanha, ne$ haap seg wid ur nepwanha".

ayahs.text: Mi d tusa, nnan as: "day am wagi, usgeld inem"? Terra d: "amzun d neppa". "Tusa ya$ d tmusni, uqbel neppat, nuzen.
ayahs.translation: Mi d tusa, nnan as: "day am wagi, usgeld inem"? Terra d: "amzun d neppa". "Tusa ya$ d tmusni, uqbel neppat, nuzen.

ayahs.text: Isôuê ip wayen tunez, war Öebbi. Tella, s tidep, seg ugdud ijehliyen".
ayahs.translation: Isôuê ip wayen tunez, war Öebbi. Tella, s tidep, seg ugdud ijehliyen".

ayahs.text: Nnan as: "ekcem ar lbeôo"! Mi t twala, t$il degs aman; tesban ed ifadden is. Inna: "s tidep, d lbeôo ulelluc imzin". Tenna: "a Mass iw! Ih, dense$ iman iw. Akked Sliman, unze$ aS i Öebbi, Mass imavalen".
ayahs.translation: Nnan as: "ekcem ar lbeôo"! Mi t twala, t$il degs aman; tesban ed ifadden is. Inna: "s tidep, d lbeôo ulelluc imzin". Tenna: "a Mass iw! Ih, dense$ iman iw. Akked Sliman, unze$ aS i Öebbi, Mass imavalen".

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed, i Tamud, gmat sen Üaliê: "âabdet Öebbi"! Maca, rran snat n trebbuya$, ppemnamarent.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed, i Tamud, gmat sen Üaliê: "âabdet Öebbi"! Maca, rran snat n trebbuya$, ppemnamarent.

ayahs.text: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acimi tep$awalem ar tucmip, uqbel ise$? Lemmer a ppeste$fôem Öebbi, ahat aêunu fellawen".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a yagdud iw! Acimi tep$awalem ar tucmip, uqbel ise$? Lemmer a ppeste$fôem Öebbi, ahat aêunu fellawen".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "tkeêêesev a$, keçç akked wi iddan yidek". Inna: "lfal nnwen ar Öebbi, u kunwi d agdud ara ippuhewwlen".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "tkeêêesev a$, keçç akked wi iddan yidek". Inna: "lfal nnwen ar Öebbi, u kunwi d agdud ara ippuhewwlen".

ayahs.text: Llan, di temdint, tza iterrasen i issefsaden di tmurt, ur pleqqimen.
ayahs.translation: Llan, di temdint, tza iterrasen i issefsaden di tmurt, ur pleqqimen.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "yyaw a nemmesgal s Öebbi, ard a neévem deg iv fellas, neppa akked twacult is. Sinna, a nini i bab is: ur nelli d inagan n tmen$iwt n tawacult is. Ih, nekwni, d imawlan n tidep".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "yyaw a nemmesgal s Öebbi, ard a neévem deg iv fellas, neppa akked twacult is. Sinna, a nini i bab is: ur nelli d inagan n tmen$iwt n tawacult is. Ih, nekwni, d imawlan n tidep".

ayahs.text: Undin ticeôkep, Nundi ticeôkep, nitni ur faqen.
ayahs.translation: Undin ticeôkep, Nundi ticeôkep, nitni ur faqen.

ayahs.text: Wali amek tevôa di tceôkep nnsen. Nen$ed iten, nitni, akked ugdud nnsen, meôôa.
ayahs.translation: Wali amek tevôa di tceôkep nnsen. Nen$ed iten, nitni, akked ugdud nnsen, meôôa.

ayahs.text: Atnan hudden ixxamen nnsen, ilmend n ddens nnsen. Deg wayagi, war ccekk, assekni i ugdud issnen.
ayahs.translation: Atnan hudden ixxamen nnsen, ilmend n ddens nnsen. Deg wayagi, war ccekk, assekni i ugdud issnen.

ayahs.text: Nsellek wid iumnen u llan pêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Nsellek wid iumnen u llan pêezziben.

ayahs.text: I Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "teppeddum ar wayen n dir, u kunwi tepwalim.
ayahs.translation: I Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "teppeddum ar wayen n dir, u kunwi tepwalim.

ayahs.text: Ih, kunwi teppeddum ar irgazen, teb$am ten, war tilawin. Ih, kunwi d agdud ur nessin".
ayahs.translation: Ih, kunwi teppeddum ar irgazen, teb$am ten, war tilawin. Ih, kunwi d agdud ur nessin".

ayahs.text: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "ssuff$et tawacult n Luî, si temdint nnwen, nitni d imdanen i ib$an tezdeg".
ayahs.translation: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "ssuff$et tawacult n Luî, si temdint nnwen, nitni d imdanen i ib$an tezdeg".

ayahs.text: Nsellek it, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is. Nseyya a ppili seg wid igwran.
ayahs.translation: Nsellek it, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is. Nseyya a ppili seg wid igwran.

ayahs.text: Nesse$li d fellasen ageffur. I icmet ugeffur n wid ippunedôen!
ayahs.translation: Nesse$li d fellasen ageffur. I icmet ugeffur n wid ippunedôen!

ayahs.text: Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi. Talwit i imdanen iS, wid Ifren". Ppif Öebbi, ne$ ayen pcaraken?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi. Talwit i imdanen iS, wid Ifren". Ppif Öebbi, ne$ ayen pcaraken?

ayahs.text: Day Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i wen d Isse$lin aman, seg igenni - Nessenkar, yissen, iqwiôen ippembehwaoen, ur teêwaoem a d tessem$im ttjuô is -, day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Maca, nitni d agdud issaâdalen.
ayahs.translation: Day Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i wen d Isse$lin aman, seg igenni - Nessenkar, yissen, iqwiôen ippembehwaoen, ur teêwaoem a d tessem$im ttjuô is -, day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Maca, nitni d agdud issaâdalen.

ayahs.text: Day Win Irran tamurt d tanezdu$t, Irra degs isaffen, Irra yas idurar, Irra agadir ger sin ilellen, day illa ôebbi ar tama n Öebbi? Xaîi, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Day Win Irran tamurt d tanezdu$t, Irra degs isaffen, Irra yas idurar, Irra agadir ger sin ilellen, day illa ôebbi ar tama n Öebbi? Xaîi, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Day Win Issemêasen i umevôuô, mara S d isiwel; Itekksen ayen n dir; i kwen Ipparan d igensas di tmurt; day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Drus id tesmektayem.
ayahs.translation: Day Win Issemêasen i umevôuô, mara S d isiwel; Itekksen ayen n dir; i kwen Ipparan d igensas di tmurt; day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Drus id tesmektayem.

ayahs.text: Day Win i kwen Inehhun, di tillas n lberr akked yill, id Ippaznen avu, d abecceô n ccira uêunu S; day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Ay Aâlay Öebbi, sennig wayen pcaraken!
ayahs.translation: Day Win i kwen Inehhun, di tillas n lberr akked yill, id Ippaznen avu, d abecceô n ccira uêunu S; day illa ôebbi, ar tama n Öebbi? Ay Aâlay Öebbi, sennig wayen pcaraken!

ayahs.text: Day Win Ibeddun lxelq, sinna, Ippales as; ikwen I$aten seg igenni akked tmurt; day illa ôebbi ar tama n Öebbi? Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tidep"!
ayahs.translation: Day Win Ibeddun lxelq, sinna, Ippales as; ikwen I$aten seg igenni akked tmurt; day illa ôebbi ar tama n Öebbi? Ini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen, ma tessawalem tidep"!

ayahs.text: Ini: "tabavnit, di tmurt akked igenwan, ur p issin yiwen siwa Öebbi. Ur éôin melmi ara d kkren".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "tabavnit, di tmurt akked igenwan, ur p issin yiwen siwa Öebbi. Ur éôin melmi ara d kkren".

ayahs.text: Ih, tamusni nnsen ur tessawev ar laxeôt? Xaîi, nitni di ccekk fellas. Xaîi, nitni, fellas, dre$len.
ayahs.translation: Ih, tamusni nnsen ur tessawev ar laxeôt? Xaîi, nitni di ccekk fellas. Xaîi, nitni, fellas, dre$len.

ayahs.text: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ma nu$al d akal, am imezwura nne$, s tidep, fella$ tanekra?
ayahs.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ma nu$al d akal, am imezwura nne$, s tidep, fella$ tanekra?

ayahs.text: Ni$ waââden a$ aya, i nekwni akw i imezwura nne$, zik. Ayagi, d timucuha kan imenza".
ayahs.translation: Ni$ waââden a$ aya, i nekwni akw i imezwura nne$, zik. Ayagi, d timucuha kan imenza".

ayahs.text: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d ibe$wviyen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek tevôa d ibe$wviyen".

ayahs.text: Ur $webben fellasen, ur pxiqqi ilmend n nncub nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ur $webben fellasen, ur pxiqqi ilmend n nncub nnsen.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma d tidep ay tessawalem"?
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma d tidep ay tessawalem"?

ayahs.text: Ini: "kra n wayen i$ef têarem, ahat atan ivfeô kwen id".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "kra n wayen i$ef têarem, ahat atan ivfeô kwen id".

ayahs.text: Mass ik, s tidep, meqqweô lfevl iS, $ef imdanen. Maca, tegwti degsen ur snemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Mass ik, s tidep, meqqweô lfevl iS, $ef imdanen. Maca, tegwti degsen ur snemmiren.

ayahs.text: Mass ik, s tidep, Iéôa ayen teffren idmaren nnsen, akked wayen d qqaôen.
ayahs.translation: Mass ik, s tidep, Iéôa ayen teffren idmaren nnsen, akked wayen d qqaôen.

ayahs.text: Ur illi wayen iffren, deg igenni akked tmurt, ur nuri di Tezmamt ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi wayen iffren, deg igenni akked tmurt, ur nuri di Tezmamt ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Leqwôan agi iêekku d i At Isôail, tegwti n wayen i$ef mgarraden.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Leqwôan agi iêekku d i At Isôail, tegwti n wayen i$ef mgarraden.

ayahs.text: Neppa, war ccekk, ard nnhaya akked uêunu i lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Neppa, war ccekk, ard nnhaya akked uêunu i lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Mass ik, s tidep, ad Iseyyi garasen s uêuddu S. Neppa d Uzmir, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Mass ik, s tidep, ad Iseyyi garasen s uêuddu S. Neppa d Uzmir, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ppkel $ef Öebbi, ih, aql ak di tidep ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Ppkel $ef Öebbi, ih, aql ak di tidep ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Ih, keçç, ur tepparav lmeggtin ad slen, ur tepparav iâeééugen ad slen i wancad, ma wexxôen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, keçç, ur tepparav lmeggtin ad slen, ur tepparav iâeééugen ad slen i wancad, ma wexxôen.

ayahs.text: Ur fellak nnhaya ider$alen, mgal ttelfan nnsen. Ara islen, siwa wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£. Nitni d imvuâen.
ayahs.translation: Ur fellak nnhaya ider$alen, mgal ttelfan nnsen. Ara islen, siwa wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£. Nitni d imvuâen.

ayahs.text: Mi iûaô wawal fellasen, ad asen d Nessuffe$ lweêc si tmurt; ad asen yini ar imdanen ur metbutit $ef issekniyen nne£.
ayahs.translation: Mi iûaô wawal fellasen, ad asen d Nessuffe$ lweêc si tmurt; ad asen yini ar imdanen ur metbutit $ef issekniyen nne£.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara d Nefser, si yal lois, arbaâ n wid inekôen issekniyen nne£, d tirni,
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d Nefser, si yal lois, arbaâ n wid inekôen issekniyen nne£, d tirni,

ayahs.text: alamma, mi d usan, ad Yini: "day tnekôem issekniyen iW, ur ten teskecmem di tmusni? Ne$ d acu tellam txeddmem"?
ayahs.translation: alamma, mi d usan, ad Yini: "day tnekôem issekniyen iW, ur ten teskecmem di tmusni? Ne$ d acu tellam txeddmem"?

ayahs.text: Iûaô wawal fellasen, imi densen. Ur d pmeslayen.
ayahs.translation: Iûaô wawal fellasen, imi densen. Ur d pmeslayen.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara ar Nerra yasen iv i ureyyeê nnsen, ass iwakken ad walin? Deg wayagi, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara ar Nerra yasen iv i ureyyeê nnsen, ass iwakken ad walin? Deg wayagi, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Ass uûuvu n lbuq, ad iagwad i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, siwa wid i S ihwan i Öebbi. A d asen akw $uôeS, s uêiwet.
ayahs.translation: Ass uûuvu n lbuq, ad iagwad i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, siwa wid i S ihwan i Öebbi. A d asen akw $uôeS, s uêiwet.

ayahs.text: A pwaliv idurar i t$ilev sebken, la teddun am usigna. D igi n Öebbi i Iûegmen yal cci. Neppa, s tidep, Iéôa d acu txedmem.
ayahs.translation: A pwaliv idurar i t$ilev sebken, la teddun am usigna. D igi n Öebbi i Iûegmen yal cci. Neppa, s tidep, Iéôa d acu txedmem.

ayahs.text: Win id iusan s ise$, ad iawi it yifen. Widak, assen, mevmunit si tugdi.
ayahs.translation: Win id iusan s ise$, ad iawi it yifen. Widak, assen, mevmunit si tugdi.

ayahs.text: Wid id iusan s tucmip, ad ppin wudmawen nnsen ar tmes. Ni$ a ppeppuqeîîim kan $ef wayen txeddmem?
ayahs.translation: Wid id iusan s tucmip, ad ppin wudmawen nnsen ar tmes. Ni$ a ppeppuqeîîim kan $ef wayen txeddmem?

ayahs.text: Pwamôe$ kan ad âabde$ Mass n temdint agi, i Iôqa. IneS yal cci. Pwamôe$ d ad ili$ seg imduâen,
ayahs.translation: Pwamôe$ kan ad âabde$ Mass n temdint agi, i Iôqa. IneS yal cci. Pwamôe$ d ad ili$ seg imduâen,

ayahs.text: ad male$ Leqwôan. Win ipwanhan, ipwanha kan i iman is. Win innetlafen, ini: "nek d aneddaô kan".
ayahs.translation: ad male$ Leqwôan. Win ipwanhan, ipwanha kan i iman is. Win innetlafen, ini: "nek d aneddaô kan".

ayahs.text: Ini: "a neckeô Öebbi. Ad awen Issken issekniyen iS. A ten tâaqlem". Mass ik ur I$effel ara $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a neckeô Öebbi. Ad awen Issken issekniyen iS. A ten tâaqlem". Mass ik ur I$effel ara $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ïsm.
verses.translation: Ïsm.

verses.text: Atnan issekniyen n Tezmamt ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Atnan issekniyen n Tezmamt ipbegginen.

verses.text: Ad ak d Neêku si teqûiî n Musa akked Ferâun, s tidep, i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: Ad ak d Neêku si teqûiî n Musa akked Ferâun, s tidep, i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Ih, Ferâun issem$weô iman is di tmurt; imezda$ ifeôq iten d iêôumen. Isrewrew îayfa segsen, izellu arrac nnsen, issidir tilawin nnsen. Ih, neppa seg ifessaden.
verses.translation: Ih, Ferâun issem$weô iman is di tmurt; imezda$ ifeôq iten d iêôumen. Isrewrew îayfa segsen, izellu arrac nnsen, issidir tilawin nnsen. Ih, neppa seg ifessaden.

verses.text: Neb$a a Nfeôôeo $ef wid irewrwen di tmurt, a ten Nerr d imeqwôanen, a ten Nerr d iweôôaten.
verses.translation: Neb$a a Nfeôôeo $ef wid irewrwen di tmurt, a ten Nerr d imeqwôanen, a ten Nerr d iweôôaten.

verses.text: A ten Nesseqâad di tmurt. A Nessken i Ferâun, Haman, akked iâsekôiwen nnsen, ayen ppagwaden segsen.
verses.translation: A ten Nesseqâad di tmurt. A Nessken i Ferâun, Haman, akked iâsekôiwen nnsen, ayen ppagwaden segsen.

verses.text: Nweêêa i imma s n Musa: "ssuîîev it, sinna, ma tugadev fellas, err it ar wasif. Ur ppagwad, ur $webben. Ad am t id Nerr, u a t Nerr seg imazanen".
verses.translation: Nweêêa i imma s n Musa: "ssuîîev it, sinna, ma tugadev fellas, err it ar wasif. Ur ppagwad, ur $webben. Ad am t id Nerr, u a t Nerr seg imazanen".

verses.text: Teddem it twacult n Ferâun. Ad asen iu$al d acengu, d a$ilif. Ih, Ferâun, Haman, akked iâsekôiwen nnsen llan d imsaben.
verses.translation: Teddem it twacult n Ferâun. Ad asen iu$al d acengu, d a$ilif. Ih, Ferâun, Haman, akked iâsekôiwen nnsen llan d imsaben.

verses.text: Tenna tmeîîut n Ferâun: "d nnûib n tiî, i nek akked keçç. Ur tneqq, ahat ad a$ infaâ, ne$ a t nerr d mmit nne$". Nitni ur faqen ara.
verses.translation: Tenna tmeîîut n Ferâun: "d nnûib n tiî, i nek akked keçç. Ur tneqq, ahat ad a$ infaâ, ne$ a t nerr d mmit nne$". Nitni ur faqen ara.

verses.text: Temmar ed tasa n yimma s n Musa. Qôib it id tessken, lemmer ur Nzeyyeô ara ul is, iwakken a ppili si lmumnin.
verses.translation: Temmar ed tasa n yimma s n Musa. Qôib it id tessken, lemmer ur Nzeyyeô ara ul is, iwakken a ppili si lmumnin.

verses.text: Tenna i ultma s: "evfeô it"! Teqquôa t si mbâid, nitni ur faqen.
verses.translation: Tenna i ultma s: "evfeô it"! Teqquôa t si mbâid, nitni ur faqen.

verses.text: Uqbel, Negdel as tid iûûuîuven. Tenna: "ad awen ssekne$ axxam ar awen itkwelfen fellas, u nitni ad as bedden"?
verses.translation: Uqbel, Negdel as tid iûûuîuven. Tenna: "ad awen ssekne$ axxam ar awen itkwelfen fellas, u nitni ad as bedden"?

verses.text: Nerra t id i imma s, iwakken ad as kkawent wallen is, ur t$webben, iwakken a péeô ar lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Nerra t id i imma s, iwakken ad as kkawent wallen is, ur t$webben, iwakken a péeô ar lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.

verses.text: Mi meqqweô, ittaâqel, Nefka yas tussna, ûûwab. Akka ay Nepkafi imdanen lâali.
verses.translation: Mi meqqweô, ittaâqel, Nefka yas tussna, ûûwab. Akka ay Nepkafi imdanen lâali.

verses.text: Ikcem tamdint, di lweqt ideg stehzan imezda$ is. Iufa n sin irgazen pna$en, yiwen seg uêôum is, wayev seg icenga s. Win n uêôum is, issuter as d afus, mgal win n icenga s. Iwwet it Musa s lbunia, in$a t. Inna: "ayagi, seg igi n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu n ûûeê, itellifen".
verses.translation: Ikcem tamdint, di lweqt ideg stehzan imezda$ is. Iufa n sin irgazen pna$en, yiwen seg uêôum is, wayev seg icenga s. Win n uêôum is, issuter as d afus, mgal win n icenga s. Iwwet it Musa s lbunia, in$a t. Inna: "ayagi, seg igi n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu n ûûeê, itellifen".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek dense$ iman iw, Semmeê iyi". Isemmeê as. Ih, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek dense$ iman iw, Semmeê iyi". Isemmeê as. Ih, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! S l$it iK felli, ur ppili$, d awez$i, si loiha ibe$wviyen".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! S l$it iK felli, ur ppili$, d awez$i, si loiha ibe$wviyen".

verses.text: Iufa d iman is di temdint, iugad, iquôaâ. Atan a d ipâaggiv $uôes, win i s d issutren afus, ass izeryen. Inna yas Musa: "keçç, s tidep, d im$eôôeq n ûûeê".
verses.translation: Iufa d iman is di temdint, iugad, iquôaâ. Atan a d ipâaggiv $uôes, win i s d issutren afus, ass izeryen. Inna yas Musa: "keçç, s tidep, d im$eôôeq n ûûeê".

verses.text: Acengu nnsen, mi ib$a a t iwwet, inna d: "a Musa! Day teb$iv ad iyi ten$ev, akken ten$iv yiwen, ivelli? Teb$iv kan a ppiliv d aqehhaô di tmurt, ur teb$iv ara a ppiliv seg iâaôviyen".
verses.translation: Acengu nnsen, mi ib$a a t iwwet, inna d: "a Musa! Day teb$iv ad iyi ten$ev, akken ten$iv yiwen, ivelli? Teb$iv kan a ppiliv d aqehhaô di tmurt, ur teb$iv ara a ppiliv seg iâaôviyen".

verses.text: Iusa d urgaz si îîerf n temdint, ippazal. Inna d: "a Musa! S tidep, imvebbôen mlalen $ef loal ik, a k n$en. Effe$, nek, seg wid ik ipweûûin".
verses.translation: Iusa d urgaz si îîerf n temdint, ippazal. Inna d: "a Musa! S tidep, imvebbôen mlalen $ef loal ik, a k n$en. Effe$, nek, seg wid ik ipweûûin".

verses.text: Iffe$ segs, iugad, iquôaâ. Inna: "a Mass iw! Sellek iyi seg ugdud imednas".
verses.translation: Iffe$ segs, iugad, iquôaâ. Inna: "a Mass iw! Sellek iyi seg ugdud imednas".

verses.text: Mi ibbwi tikli ar Madian, inna: "ahat Mass iw ad iyi Iawi d ubrid umâin".
verses.translation: Mi ibbwi tikli ar Madian, inna: "ahat Mass iw ad iyi Iawi d ubrid umâin".

verses.text: Mi ibbwev s aman n Madian, iufa n arbaâ n l$aci, la sswan. Iufa, di îîerf nnsen, snat n tlawin, îîfent lmal nnsent. Inna: "d acu txeddmemt"? Nnant ed: "ur nesswa alamma wexxôen imeksawen. Babat ne$ d am$aô ameqwôan".
verses.translation: Mi ibbwev s aman n Madian, iufa n arbaâ n l$aci, la sswan. Iufa, di îîerf nnsen, snat n tlawin, îîfent lmal nnsent. Inna: "d acu txeddmemt"? Nnant ed: "ur nesswa alamma wexxôen imeksawen. Babat ne$ d am$aô ameqwôan".

verses.text: Issew asent, iu$al ar tili, inna: "a Mass iw! Nek ôe$be$ $ef yal lxiô, ar iyi d Tessersev".
verses.translation: Issew asent, iu$al ar tili, inna: "a Mass iw! Nek ôe$be$ $ef yal lxiô, ar iyi d Tessersev".

verses.text: Tusa t id yiwet segsent, s tikli ikukran, tenna: "atan ak d issawal baba, a k ikafi imi $ tesswev". Mi iôuê $uôes, u iêka yas i ivôan, inna: "ur ppagwad, tepwasellkev seg ugdud imednas".
verses.translation: Tusa t id yiwet segsent, s tikli ikukran, tenna: "atan ak d issawal baba, a k ikafi imi $ tesswev". Mi iôuê $uôes, u iêka yas i ivôan, inna: "ur ppagwad, tepwasellkev seg ugdud imednas".

verses.text: Yiwet segsent, tenna: "a baba! Eîîef it d acrik, ih, yif icriken ik, iohed, muman".
verses.translation: Yiwet segsent, tenna: "a baba! Eîîef it d acrik, ih, yif icriken ik, iohed, muman".

verses.text: Inna: "b$i$, nek, ad ak fke$ yiwet si yissi yagi, s cceôt a pxedmev $uôi îam iseggwasen. Ma tessawdev mraw, s leb$i k. Ur b$i$ a k hejjne$. Ad ak ili$, ma Irad Öebbi, seg iâaôviyen".
verses.translation: Inna: "b$i$, nek, ad ak fke$ yiwet si yissi yagi, s cceôt a pxedmev $uôi îam iseggwasen. Ma tessawdev mraw, s leb$i k. Ur b$i$ a k hejjne$. Ad ak ili$, ma Irad Öebbi, seg iâaôviyen".

verses.text: Irra: "ayagi, gari yidek. A tin sâadda$ ger snat n tallitin, ur ippili felli u$ilif. Öebbi d Awkil, $ef wayen id nenna".
verses.translation: Irra: "ayagi, gari yidek. A tin sâadda$ ger snat n tallitin, ur ippili felli u$ilif. Öebbi d Awkil, $ef wayen id nenna".

verses.text: Mi ifukk Musa tallit, u iseyyeê akked twacult is, iwala times ar tama n udrar. Inna i twacult is: "qqimet, wala$ times, ahat ad awen d awi$, segs, asali ne$ asafu, amar a ppesseêmum".
verses.translation: Mi ifukk Musa tallit, u iseyyeê akked twacult is, iwala times ar tama n udrar. Inna i twacult is: "qqimet, wala$ times, ahat ad awen d awi$, segs, asali ne$ asafu, amar a ppesseêmum".

verses.text: Mi ibbwev $uôes, ipwanced ed si ttejôa, di rif ayeffus n te$zut, deg umviq iôqan: "a Musa! S tidep, Nek d Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
verses.translation: Mi ibbwev $uôes, ipwanced ed si ttejôa, di rif ayeffus n te$zut, deg umviq iôqan: "a Musa! S tidep, Nek d Öebbi, Mass imavalen.

verses.text: Veggeô taâkwazt ik". Mi p iwala, la tesseêôiîiw amzun d azrem, ibren ur iwexxeô. "A Musa! Qeddem, ur ppagwad, aql ak, ih, di laman.
verses.translation: Veggeô taâkwazt ik". Mi p iwala, la tesseêôiîiw amzun d azrem, ibren ur iwexxeô. "A Musa! Qeddem, ur ppagwad, aql ak, ih, di laman.
