verses.text: Err afus ik di loib ik, a d iffe$ d amellal, ur ihlik. Sseqôeb ed $uôek i$il ik, ad ak tekkes tugwdi. Tigi d sin n ppbut s$uô Mass ik, i Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ih, nitni d agdud iballa$en".
verses.translation: Err afus ik di loib ik, a d iffe$ d amellal, ur ihlik. Sseqôeb ed $uôek i$il ik, ad ak tekkes tugwdi. Tigi d sin n ppbut s$uô Mass ik, i Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ih, nitni d agdud iballa$en".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek n$i$ yiwen segsen, ugade$ ad iyi n$en.
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek n$i$ yiwen segsen, ugade$ ad iyi n$en.

verses.text: Gma Harun yif iyi afeûûeê umeslay. Azen it id yidi d amâiwen, ad iyi tebbet. Nek ugade$ ad iyi nekôen".
verses.translation: Gma Harun yif iyi afeûûeê umeslay. Azen it id yidi d amâiwen, ad iyi tebbet. Nek ugade$ ad iyi nekôen".

verses.text: Inna: "a Nesseohed tayepp ik s gma k. Ad awen Nefk, i sin, adabu; ur kwen id ppawven. S issekniyen nne£, d kunwi akked wid iddan yidwen ara irebêen".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Nesseohed tayepp ik s gma k. Ad awen Nefk, i sin, adabu; ur kwen id ppawven. S issekniyen nne£, d kunwi akked wid iddan yidwen ara irebêen".

verses.text: Mi ibbwev $uôsen Musa, s issekniyen iberrzen, nnan: "ayagi, siwa ssêur id innulfan. Ur nesli s waya, $uô ibabaten nne$ imezwura".
verses.translation: Mi ibbwev $uôsen Musa, s issekniyen iberrzen, nnan: "ayagi, siwa ssêur id innulfan. Ur nesli s waya, $uô ibabaten nne$ imezwura".

verses.text: Inna Musa: "Mass iw Iéôa sennig wiyav, anwa iwumi Ifka nnhaya s$uôeS, anwa ara d igwrin deg Uxxam. Imednas, s tidep, ur rebêen".
verses.translation: Inna Musa: "Mass iw Iéôa sennig wiyav, anwa iwumi Ifka nnhaya s$uôeS, anwa ara d igwrin deg Uxxam. Imednas, s tidep, ur rebêen".

verses.text: Inna Ferâun: "a yimvebbôen, ur awen mli$ ara kra n ôebbi, war nekkini. Ecâal iyi times ar talaxt, a Haman; bnu yi lbeôo aâlayen; ahat ad ali$ ar ÖÔebbi n Musa. Nek, s tidep, êesbe$ t seg wid iskiddiben".
verses.translation: Inna Ferâun: "a yimvebbôen, ur awen mli$ ara kra n ôebbi, war nekkini. Ecâal iyi times ar talaxt, a Haman; bnu yi lbeôo aâlayen; ahat ad ali$ ar ÖÔebbi n Musa. Nek, s tidep, êesbe$ t seg wid iskiddiben".

verses.text: Neppa, akked iâsekôiwen is, sme$wôen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. £ilen, ar nitni, ur d ppu$alen $uône£.
verses.translation: Neppa, akked iâsekôiwen is, sme$wôen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. £ilen, ar nitni, ur d ppu$alen $uône£.

verses.text: Neppa, akked iâsekôiwen is, Neîîef iten. Nger iten ar yill. Wali amek tevôa d imednas.
verses.translation: Neppa, akked iâsekôiwen is, Neîîef iten. Nger iten ar yill. Wali amek tevôa d imednas.

verses.text: Nerra ten d imeqwôanen i ineccden ar tmes. Ass n tnekra, ur ppusellken.
verses.translation: Nerra ten d imeqwôanen i ineccden ar tmes. Ass n tnekra, ur ppusellken.

verses.text: Neqqen asen xezzu di ddunit agi. Ass n tnekra, nitni seg ucmiten.
verses.translation: Neqqen asen xezzu di ddunit agi. Ass n tnekra, nitni seg ucmiten.

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, mbaâd ma Nesqucc isuta imezwura. D tafat i imdanen, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Amar a d mmektin.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, mbaâd ma Nesqucc isuta imezwura. D tafat i imdanen, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Amar a d mmektin.

verses.text: Ur telliv ara di loiha utaram, mi Nseyya lameô i Musa. Ur telliv seg inagan.
verses.translation: Ur telliv ara di loiha utaram, mi Nseyya lameô i Musa. Ur telliv seg inagan.

verses.text: Maca, Nxelq ed tisuta, $wezzif laâmeô nnsent. Ur tellid seg imezda$ n Madian, la sen teqqarev issekniyen nne£. Maca, Nella Neppazen.
verses.translation: Maca, Nxelq ed tisuta, $wezzif laâmeô nnsent. Ur tellid seg imezda$ n Madian, la sen teqqarev issekniyen nne£. Maca, Nella Neppazen.

verses.text: Ur telliv ar tama n udrar, mi d Nessawel. Maca d aêunu s$uô Mass ik, iwakken a pnedrev agdud, u$uô ur d iusi uneddaô, uqbel ik. Amar a d mmektin.
verses.translation: Ur telliv ar tama n udrar, mi d Nessawel. Maca d aêunu s$uô Mass ik, iwakken a pnedrev agdud, u$uô ur d iusi uneddaô, uqbel ik. Amar a d mmektin.

verses.text: Mulac, ma têuza ten tiyta id urwen ifassen nnsen, a d inin: "a Mass nne$! A lemmer i $ d Tuznev amazan, a neddu d issekniyen iK, a nili seg wid iumnen"!
verses.translation: Mulac, ma têuza ten tiyta id urwen ifassen nnsen, a d inin: "a Mass nne$! A lemmer i $ d Tuznev amazan, a neddu d issekniyen iK, a nili seg wid iumnen"!

verses.text: Mi ten id tusa tidep s$uône£, nnan: "a lemmer id iusi am wayen id iusan i Musa"! Day ur ugin ara, zik, ayen id iusan i Musa? Nnan: "d sin ssêurat". Mwafaqen, nnan: "nekwni nugi ten i sin".
verses.translation: Mi ten id tusa tidep s$uône£, nnan: "a lemmer id iusi am wayen id iusan i Musa"! Day ur ugin ara, zik, ayen id iusan i Musa? Nnan: "d sin ssêurat". Mwafaqen, nnan: "nekwni nugi ten i sin".

verses.text: Ini: "awit ed Tazmamt, s$uô Öebbi, i yifen snat agi, i nnhaya, ad ddu$ yides, ma tessawalem tidep".
verses.translation: Ini: "awit ed Tazmamt, s$uô Öebbi, i yifen snat agi, i nnhaya, ad ddu$ yides, ma tessawalem tidep".

verses.text: Ma ur ak d rran ara, efhem ar ddan kan d lhawiyyat nnsen. Anwa innetlafen, sennig win iteddun d lhawiyya s, war nnhaya s$uô Öebbi? Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
verses.translation: Ma ur ak d rran ara, efhem ar ddan kan d lhawiyyat nnsen. Anwa innetlafen, sennig win iteddun d lhawiyya s, war nnhaya s$uô Öebbi? Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

verses.text: Aql a£ Nessawwev asen awal, amendeô ma d mmektin.
verses.translation: Aql a£ Nessawwev asen awal, amendeô ma d mmektin.

verses.text: Umnen yis wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, uqbel tagi.
verses.translation: Umnen yis wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, uqbel tagi.

verses.text: Ma $ôan asen t, ad inin: "numen yis. Ih, ar neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass nne$. Uqbel is, s tidep, nella d imvuâen".
verses.translation: Ma $ôan asen t, ad inin: "numen yis. Ih, ar neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass nne$. Uqbel is, s tidep, nella d imvuâen".

verses.text: Wigi a ten id ias ukafi nnsen berdayen, $ef wayen ûebôen, swexxiôen tucmip s yise$, u seg wayen iten N$at, pseddiqen.
verses.translation: Wigi a ten id ias ukafi nnsen berdayen, $ef wayen ûebôen, swexxiôen tucmip s yise$, u seg wayen iten N$at, pseddiqen.

verses.text: Mi slan i yir awal, ad as veôfen, u qaôen: "i nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Fellawen talwit. Ur neô$eb $ef at war tussna".
verses.translation: Mi slan i yir awal, ad as veôfen, u qaôen: "i nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Fellawen talwit. Ur neô$eb $ef at war tussna".

verses.text: Keçç, s tidep, ur tnehhuv win têemlev. Maca, Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan. Neppa, Yif akw akken Iéôa wid ipwanhan.
verses.translation: Keçç, s tidep, ur tnehhuv win têemlev. Maca, Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan. Neppa, Yif akw akken Iéôa wid ipwanhan.

verses.text: Nnan: "ma nedda d nnhaya yidek, a nepwaxvef seg wakal nne$". Day ur ten Nesseqâad ara di loamaâ n laman, u$uô d ppawvent yal l$ellat? D l$it s$uône£. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur éôin.
verses.translation: Nnan: "ma nedda d nnhaya yidek, a nepwaxvef seg wakal nne$". Day ur ten Nesseqâad ara di loamaâ n laman, u$uô d ppawvent yal l$ellat? D l$it s$uône£. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur éôin.

verses.text: Acêal Nesqucc n temdininn, cerrâent di temâict nnsent. Atnan ixxamen nnsen, ay ten ized$en, deffir sen, siwa ixeîîayen. D Nekwni ay d iweôôaten.
verses.translation: Acêal Nesqucc n temdininn, cerrâent di temâict nnsent. Atnan ixxamen nnsen, ay ten ized$en, deffir sen, siwa ixeîîayen. D Nekwni ay d iweôôaten.

verses.text: Ur Isquccu Mass ik timdinin, alamma iuzen i imezda$ nnsent, amazan i sen immalen issekniyen nne£. Ur Nesquccu timdinin, mebla ma llan imezda$ nnsent, d imednas.
verses.translation: Ur Isquccu Mass ik timdinin, alamma iuzen i imezda$ nnsent, amazan i sen immalen issekniyen nne£. Ur Nesquccu timdinin, mebla ma llan imezda$ nnsent, d imednas.

verses.text: Kra n wayen i wen ippunefken n cci, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuê is. Ayen illan $eô Öebbi, yif it, ad idum kter. Day ur pmeyyizen ara?
verses.translation: Kra n wayen i wen ippunefken n cci, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuê is. Ayen illan $eô Öebbi, yif it, ad idum kter. Day ur pmeyyizen ara?

verses.text: Day win iwumi Nefka lemâahda igerzen, u immuger ip, am win i Nezha s l$it n tmeddurt n ddunit; sinna, ass n tnekra, neppa seg wid ara d irsen?
verses.translation: Day win iwumi Nefka lemâahda igerzen, u immuger ip, am win i Nezha s l$it n tmeddurt n ddunit; sinna, ass n tnekra, neppa seg wid ara d irsen?

verses.text: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "anda ten wid iyY tepcarakem, u tellam tepkabarem"?
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "anda ten wid iyY tepcarakem, u tellam tepkabarem"?

verses.text: A d inin wid i$ef iûaô wawal: "a Mass nne$! Wigi i njeggeê, njeggeê iten, akken i nepwajeggeê. A nzekki $ureK: maççi d nekwni ay âabden".
verses.translation: A d inin wid i$ef iûaô wawal: "a Mass nne$! Wigi i njeggeê, njeggeê iten, akken i nepwajeggeê. A nzekki $ureK: maççi d nekwni ay âabden".

verses.text: Ad asen inin: "naâôet wid tepcarakem". Ad ten naâôen, ur asen d pparan. Walan aâaqeb. A lemmer llan pwanhan!
verses.translation: Ad asen inin: "naâôet wid tepcarakem". Ad ten naâôen, ur asen d pparan. Walan aâaqeb. A lemmer llan pwanhan!

verses.text: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "acu d terram i imazanen"?
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "acu d terram i imazanen"?

verses.text: Assen, ad dergen fellasen isalen, nitni ur pmesteqsayen.
verses.translation: Assen, ad dergen fellasen isalen, nitni ur pmesteqsayen.

verses.text: Ma d win isteôoâen, iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, ahat ad yili seg imerbaê.
verses.translation: Ma d win isteôoâen, iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, ahat ad yili seg imerbaê.

verses.text: Mass ik Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan, u Ismenyafa. Ur ten id iûaê usmenyif. Gedha s Öebbi! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
verses.translation: Mass ik Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan, u Ismenyafa. Ur ten id iûaê usmenyif. Gedha s Öebbi! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!

verses.text: Mass ik Iéôa ayen iffren deg idmaren nnsen, akked wayen cennâen.
verses.translation: Mass ik Iéôa ayen iffren deg idmaren nnsen, akked wayen cennâen.

verses.text: Neppa d Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. I Neppa, annuz di tmezwarut, u di tneggarut. I Neppa aêuddu, $uôeS tu$alin nnwen.
verses.translation: Neppa d Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. I Neppa, annuz di tmezwarut, u di tneggarut. I Neppa aêuddu, $uôeS tu$alin nnwen.

verses.text: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Isse$li d Öebbi iv imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ara wen d iawin tafat? Day ur tsellem ara"?
verses.translation: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Isse$li d Öebbi iv imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ara wen d iawin tafat? Day ur tsellem ara"?

verses.text: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Issuli Öebbi ass imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ara wen d iawin iv, a ppestaâfum degs? Day ur tepwalim ara"?
verses.translation: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Issuli Öebbi ass imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ara wen d iawin iv, a ppestaâfum degs? Day ur tepwalim ara"?

verses.text: Seg uêunu S, Iga yawen iv akked wass, i ustaâfu nnwen, akked unadi n lfevl iS. Amar a ppesnemmrem.
verses.translation: Seg uêunu S, Iga yawen iv akked wass, i ustaâfu nnwen, akked unadi n lfevl iS. Amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad asen Yini: "anda ten wid iyY tepcarakem, u tellam tepkabarem"?
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad asen Yini: "anda ten wid iyY tepcarakem, u tellam tepkabarem"?

verses.text: A d Nawi anagi, si yal lois. A Nini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen". Ad éôen ar tidep n Öebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
verses.translation: A d Nawi anagi, si yal lois. A Nini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen". Ad éôen ar tidep n Öebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

verses.text: Ih, Qaôun illa seg ugdud n Musa. Iqehô iten. Nefka yas igerrujen; s tezmert ugraw ioehden, arfad n tsura nnsen. Mi s inna ugdud is: "ur zehhu! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara izehwaniyen.
verses.translation: Ih, Qaôun illa seg ugdud n Musa. Iqehô iten. Nefka yas igerrujen; s tezmert ugraw ioehden, arfad n tsura nnsen. Mi s inna ugdud is: "ur zehhu! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara izehwaniyen.

verses.text: Deg wayen i k Ifka Öebbi, nadi axxam aneggaru. Ur teppu amur ik, di ddunit. Elhu, akken i Ilha Öebbi $uôek. Ur ssaram lefsad di tmurt. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ifessaden".
verses.translation: Deg wayen i k Ifka Öebbi, nadi axxam aneggaru. Ur teppu amur ik, di ddunit. Elhu, akken i Ilha Öebbi $uôek. Ur ssaram lefsad di tmurt. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ifessaden".

verses.text: Inna: "ippunefk iyi kan, ilmend n tmusni i sâi$". Day ur iéôa ara ar Öebbi Isqucc, uqbel is, ger isuta, wid i t iugaren di tezmert, isemmden kteô? Ur illi usteqsi ibe$wviyen, af ibekkaven nnsen.
verses.translation: Inna: "ippunefk iyi kan, ilmend n tmusni i sâi$". Day ur iéôa ara ar Öebbi Isqucc, uqbel is, ger isuta, wid i t iugaren di tezmert, isemmden kteô? Ur illi usteqsi ibe$wviyen, af ibekkaven nnsen.

verses.text: Iffe$ ed s agdud is, s ôôêuê is. Wid ib$an tameddurt n ddunit, nnan: "awufan nesâa am wayen ippunefken i Qaôun! Ih, neppa d bab n terkunt tabarart".
verses.translation: Iffe$ ed s agdud is, s ôôêuê is. Wid ib$an tameddurt n ddunit, nnan: "awufan nesâa am wayen ippunefken i Qaôun! Ih, neppa d bab n terkunt tabarart".

verses.text: Wid, iwumi teppunefk tmusni, nnan: "a ssexv nnwen! Ppwab n Öebbi yif it, i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ara d iûaê siwa win iûebôen".
verses.translation: Wid, iwumi teppunefk tmusni, nnan: "a ssexv nnwen! Ppwab n Öebbi yif it, i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ara d iûaê siwa win iûebôen".

verses.text: Nger it seddaw tmurt, neppa akked uxxam is. Ur as telli terbaât ara t isellken, war Öebbi. Ur illi seg wid ipselliken iman nnsen.
verses.translation: Nger it seddaw tmurt, neppa akked uxxam is. Ur as telli terbaât ara t isellken, war Öebbi. Ur illi seg wid ipselliken iman nnsen.

verses.text: Wid issaramen amkan is, ivelli nni, u$alen nnan: "zi$ Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u iwezzen. Lemmer ur a$ I$at ara Öebbi, yili Iger a$ seddaw tmurt. Ih, ur rebêen ijehliyen".
verses.translation: Wid issaramen amkan is, ivelli nni, u$alen nnan: "zi$ Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u iwezzen. Lemmer ur a$ I$at ara Öebbi, yili Iger a$ seddaw tmurt. Ih, ur rebêen ijehliyen".

verses.text: Axxam nni aneggaru, a t Nerr i wid ijunben tem$weô akked usefsed, di tmurt. Tirect i wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Axxam nni aneggaru, a t Nerr i wid ijunben tem$weô akked usefsed, di tmurt. Tirect i wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Win id iusan s yise$, ad iawi ayen it yifen. Win id iusan s tucmip, ihi, ad ppuqeîîin wid ixedmen tucmitin, $ef wayen kan xeddmen.
verses.translation: Win id iusan s yise$, ad iawi ayen it yifen. Win id iusan s tucmip, ihi, ad ppuqeîîin wid ixedmen tucmitin, $ef wayen kan xeddmen.

verses.text: Ih, Win Ilezmen fellak Leqwôan, war ccekk, a k id Irr s axxam. Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Issen anwa id iusan s nnhaya, anwa i illan di ttelfan n ûûeê".
verses.translation: Ih, Win Ilezmen fellak Leqwôan, war ccekk, a k id Irr s axxam. Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Issen anwa id iusan s nnhaya, anwa i illan di ttelfan n ûûeê".

verses.text: Ur tessarmev ara, ad ak ed ters Tezmamt, lemmer maççi d aêunu s$uô Mass ik. Ur ppili d amâiwen ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Ur tessarmev ara, ad ak ed ters Tezmamt, lemmer maççi d aêunu s$uô Mass ik. Ur ppili d amâiwen ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ur k swexxiôen seg issekniyen n Öebbi, deffir trusi nnsen $uôek. Nuj ar Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcaraken.
verses.translation: Ur k swexxiôen seg issekniyen n Öebbi, deffir trusi nnsen $uôek. Nuj ar Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcaraken.

verses.text: Ur nâaô, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven. Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa. Yal cci ad inger, siwa udem iS. IneS aêuddu. £ureS ara tu$alem.
verses.translation: Ur nâaô, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven. Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa. Yal cci ad inger, siwa udem iS. IneS aêuddu. £ureS ara tu$alem.

ayahs.text: Ïsm.
ayahs.translation: Ïsm.

ayahs.text: Atnan issekniyen n Tezmamt ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Atnan issekniyen n Tezmamt ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Ad ak d Neêku si teqûiî n Musa akked Ferâun, s tidep, i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Ad ak d Neêku si teqûiî n Musa akked Ferâun, s tidep, i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Ferâun issem$weô iman is di tmurt; imezda$ ifeôq iten d iêôumen. Isrewrew îayfa segsen, izellu arrac nnsen, issidir tilawin nnsen. Ih, neppa seg ifessaden.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Ferâun issem$weô iman is di tmurt; imezda$ ifeôq iten d iêôumen. Isrewrew îayfa segsen, izellu arrac nnsen, issidir tilawin nnsen. Ih, neppa seg ifessaden.

ayahs.text: Neb$a a Nfeôôeo $ef wid irewrwen di tmurt, a ten Nerr d imeqwôanen, a ten Nerr d iweôôaten.
ayahs.translation: Neb$a a Nfeôôeo $ef wid irewrwen di tmurt, a ten Nerr d imeqwôanen, a ten Nerr d iweôôaten.

ayahs.text: A ten Nesseqâad di tmurt. A Nessken i Ferâun, Haman, akked iâsekôiwen nnsen, ayen ppagwaden segsen.
ayahs.translation: A ten Nesseqâad di tmurt. A Nessken i Ferâun, Haman, akked iâsekôiwen nnsen, ayen ppagwaden segsen.

ayahs.text: Nweêêa i imma s n Musa: "ssuîîev it, sinna, ma tugadev fellas, err it ar wasif. Ur ppagwad, ur $webben. Ad am t id Nerr, u a t Nerr seg imazanen".
ayahs.translation: Nweêêa i imma s n Musa: "ssuîîev it, sinna, ma tugadev fellas, err it ar wasif. Ur ppagwad, ur $webben. Ad am t id Nerr, u a t Nerr seg imazanen".

ayahs.text: Teddem it twacult n Ferâun. Ad asen iu$al d acengu, d a$ilif. Ih, Ferâun, Haman, akked iâsekôiwen nnsen llan d imsaben.
ayahs.translation: Teddem it twacult n Ferâun. Ad asen iu$al d acengu, d a$ilif. Ih, Ferâun, Haman, akked iâsekôiwen nnsen llan d imsaben.

ayahs.text: Tenna tmeîîut n Ferâun: "d nnûib n tiî, i nek akked keçç. Ur tneqq, ahat ad a$ infaâ, ne$ a t nerr d mmit nne$". Nitni ur faqen ara.
ayahs.translation: Tenna tmeîîut n Ferâun: "d nnûib n tiî, i nek akked keçç. Ur tneqq, ahat ad a$ infaâ, ne$ a t nerr d mmit nne$". Nitni ur faqen ara.

ayahs.text: Temmar ed tasa n yimma s n Musa. Qôib it id tessken, lemmer ur Nzeyyeô ara ul is, iwakken a ppili si lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Temmar ed tasa n yimma s n Musa. Qôib it id tessken, lemmer ur Nzeyyeô ara ul is, iwakken a ppili si lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Tenna i ultma s: "evfeô it"! Teqquôa t si mbâid, nitni ur faqen.
ayahs.translation: Tenna i ultma s: "evfeô it"! Teqquôa t si mbâid, nitni ur faqen.

ayahs.text: Uqbel, Negdel as tid iûûuîuven. Tenna: "ad awen ssekne$ axxam ar awen itkwelfen fellas, u nitni ad as bedden"?
ayahs.translation: Uqbel, Negdel as tid iûûuîuven. Tenna: "ad awen ssekne$ axxam ar awen itkwelfen fellas, u nitni ad as bedden"?

ayahs.text: Nerra t id i imma s, iwakken ad as kkawent wallen is, ur t$webben, iwakken a péeô ar lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Nerra t id i imma s, iwakken ad as kkawent wallen is, ur t$webben, iwakken a péeô ar lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Mi meqqweô, ittaâqel, Nefka yas tussna, ûûwab. Akka ay Nepkafi imdanen lâali.
ayahs.translation: Mi meqqweô, ittaâqel, Nefka yas tussna, ûûwab. Akka ay Nepkafi imdanen lâali.

ayahs.text: Ikcem tamdint, di lweqt ideg stehzan imezda$ is. Iufa n sin irgazen pna$en, yiwen seg uêôum is, wayev seg icenga s. Win n uêôum is, issuter as d afus, mgal win n icenga s. Iwwet it Musa s lbunia, in$a t. Inna: "ayagi, seg igi n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu n ûûeê, itellifen".
ayahs.translation: Ikcem tamdint, di lweqt ideg stehzan imezda$ is. Iufa n sin irgazen pna$en, yiwen seg uêôum is, wayev seg icenga s. Win n uêôum is, issuter as d afus, mgal win n icenga s. Iwwet it Musa s lbunia, in$a t. Inna: "ayagi, seg igi n Cciîan. Neppa, s tidep, d acengu n ûûeê, itellifen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek dense$ iman iw, Semmeê iyi". Isemmeê as. Ih, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek dense$ iman iw, Semmeê iyi". Isemmeê as. Ih, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! S l$it iK felli, ur ppili$, d awez$i, si loiha ibe$wviyen".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! S l$it iK felli, ur ppili$, d awez$i, si loiha ibe$wviyen".

ayahs.text: Iufa d iman is di temdint, iugad, iquôaâ. Atan a d ipâaggiv $uôes, win i s d issutren afus, ass izeryen. Inna yas Musa: "keçç, s tidep, d im$eôôeq n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: Iufa d iman is di temdint, iugad, iquôaâ. Atan a d ipâaggiv $uôes, win i s d issutren afus, ass izeryen. Inna yas Musa: "keçç, s tidep, d im$eôôeq n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Acengu nnsen, mi ib$a a t iwwet, inna d: "a Musa! Day teb$iv ad iyi ten$ev, akken ten$iv yiwen, ivelli? Teb$iv kan a ppiliv d aqehhaô di tmurt, ur teb$iv ara a ppiliv seg iâaôviyen".
ayahs.translation: Acengu nnsen, mi ib$a a t iwwet, inna d: "a Musa! Day teb$iv ad iyi ten$ev, akken ten$iv yiwen, ivelli? Teb$iv kan a ppiliv d aqehhaô di tmurt, ur teb$iv ara a ppiliv seg iâaôviyen".

ayahs.text: Iusa d urgaz si îîerf n temdint, ippazal. Inna d: "a Musa! S tidep, imvebbôen mlalen $ef loal ik, a k n$en. Effe$, nek, seg wid ik ipweûûin".
ayahs.translation: Iusa d urgaz si îîerf n temdint, ippazal. Inna d: "a Musa! S tidep, imvebbôen mlalen $ef loal ik, a k n$en. Effe$, nek, seg wid ik ipweûûin".

ayahs.text: Iffe$ segs, iugad, iquôaâ. Inna: "a Mass iw! Sellek iyi seg ugdud imednas".
ayahs.translation: Iffe$ segs, iugad, iquôaâ. Inna: "a Mass iw! Sellek iyi seg ugdud imednas".

ayahs.text: Mi ibbwi tikli ar Madian, inna: "ahat Mass iw ad iyi Iawi d ubrid umâin".
ayahs.translation: Mi ibbwi tikli ar Madian, inna: "ahat Mass iw ad iyi Iawi d ubrid umâin".

ayahs.text: Mi ibbwev s aman n Madian, iufa n arbaâ n l$aci, la sswan. Iufa, di îîerf nnsen, snat n tlawin, îîfent lmal nnsent. Inna: "d acu txeddmemt"? Nnant ed: "ur nesswa alamma wexxôen imeksawen. Babat ne$ d am$aô ameqwôan".
ayahs.translation: Mi ibbwev s aman n Madian, iufa n arbaâ n l$aci, la sswan. Iufa, di îîerf nnsen, snat n tlawin, îîfent lmal nnsent. Inna: "d acu txeddmemt"? Nnant ed: "ur nesswa alamma wexxôen imeksawen. Babat ne$ d am$aô ameqwôan".

ayahs.text: Issew asent, iu$al ar tili, inna: "a Mass iw! Nek ôe$be$ $ef yal lxiô, ar iyi d Tessersev".
ayahs.translation: Issew asent, iu$al ar tili, inna: "a Mass iw! Nek ôe$be$ $ef yal lxiô, ar iyi d Tessersev".

ayahs.text: Tusa t id yiwet segsent, s tikli ikukran, tenna: "atan ak d issawal baba, a k ikafi imi $ tesswev". Mi iôuê $uôes, u iêka yas i ivôan, inna: "ur ppagwad, tepwasellkev seg ugdud imednas".
ayahs.translation: Tusa t id yiwet segsent, s tikli ikukran, tenna: "atan ak d issawal baba, a k ikafi imi $ tesswev". Mi iôuê $uôes, u iêka yas i ivôan, inna: "ur ppagwad, tepwasellkev seg ugdud imednas".

ayahs.text: Yiwet segsent, tenna: "a baba! Eîîef it d acrik, ih, yif icriken ik, iohed, muman".
ayahs.translation: Yiwet segsent, tenna: "a baba! Eîîef it d acrik, ih, yif icriken ik, iohed, muman".

ayahs.text: Inna: "b$i$, nek, ad ak fke$ yiwet si yissi yagi, s cceôt a pxedmev $uôi îam iseggwasen. Ma tessawdev mraw, s leb$i k. Ur b$i$ a k hejjne$. Ad ak ili$, ma Irad Öebbi, seg iâaôviyen".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "b$i$, nek, ad ak fke$ yiwet si yissi yagi, s cceôt a pxedmev $uôi îam iseggwasen. Ma tessawdev mraw, s leb$i k. Ur b$i$ a k hejjne$. Ad ak ili$, ma Irad Öebbi, seg iâaôviyen".

ayahs.text: Irra: "ayagi, gari yidek. A tin sâadda$ ger snat n tallitin, ur ippili felli u$ilif. Öebbi d Awkil, $ef wayen id nenna".
ayahs.translation: Irra: "ayagi, gari yidek. A tin sâadda$ ger snat n tallitin, ur ippili felli u$ilif. Öebbi d Awkil, $ef wayen id nenna".

ayahs.text: Mi ifukk Musa tallit, u iseyyeê akked twacult is, iwala times ar tama n udrar. Inna i twacult is: "qqimet, wala$ times, ahat ad awen d awi$, segs, asali ne$ asafu, amar a ppesseêmum".
ayahs.translation: Mi ifukk Musa tallit, u iseyyeê akked twacult is, iwala times ar tama n udrar. Inna i twacult is: "qqimet, wala$ times, ahat ad awen d awi$, segs, asali ne$ asafu, amar a ppesseêmum".

ayahs.text: Mi ibbwev $uôes, ipwanced ed si ttejôa, di rif ayeffus n te$zut, deg umviq iôqan: "a Musa! S tidep, Nek d Öebbi, Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Mi ibbwev $uôes, ipwanced ed si ttejôa, di rif ayeffus n te$zut, deg umviq iôqan: "a Musa! S tidep, Nek d Öebbi, Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: Veggeô taâkwazt ik". Mi p iwala, la tesseêôiîiw amzun d azrem, ibren ur iwexxeô. "A Musa! Qeddem, ur ppagwad, aql ak, ih, di laman.
ayahs.translation: Veggeô taâkwazt ik". Mi p iwala, la tesseêôiîiw amzun d azrem, ibren ur iwexxeô. "A Musa! Qeddem, ur ppagwad, aql ak, ih, di laman.

ayahs.text: Err afus ik di loib ik, a d iffe$ d amellal, ur ihlik. Sseqôeb ed $uôek i$il ik, ad ak tekkes tugwdi. Tigi d sin n ppbut s$uô Mass ik, i Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ih, nitni d agdud iballa$en".
ayahs.translation: Err afus ik di loib ik, a d iffe$ d amellal, ur ihlik. Sseqôeb ed $uôek i$il ik, ad ak tekkes tugwdi. Tigi d sin n ppbut s$uô Mass ik, i Ferâun akked imvebbôen is. Ih, nitni d agdud iballa$en".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek n$i$ yiwen segsen, ugade$ ad iyi n$en.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Nek n$i$ yiwen segsen, ugade$ ad iyi n$en.

ayahs.text: Gma Harun yif iyi afeûûeê umeslay. Azen it id yidi d amâiwen, ad iyi tebbet. Nek ugade$ ad iyi nekôen".
ayahs.translation: Gma Harun yif iyi afeûûeê umeslay. Azen it id yidi d amâiwen, ad iyi tebbet. Nek ugade$ ad iyi nekôen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Nesseohed tayepp ik s gma k. Ad awen Nefk, i sin, adabu; ur kwen id ppawven. S issekniyen nne£, d kunwi akked wid iddan yidwen ara irebêen".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Nesseohed tayepp ik s gma k. Ad awen Nefk, i sin, adabu; ur kwen id ppawven. S issekniyen nne£, d kunwi akked wid iddan yidwen ara irebêen".

ayahs.text: Mi ibbwev $uôsen Musa, s issekniyen iberrzen, nnan: "ayagi, siwa ssêur id innulfan. Ur nesli s waya, $uô ibabaten nne$ imezwura".
ayahs.translation: Mi ibbwev $uôsen Musa, s issekniyen iberrzen, nnan: "ayagi, siwa ssêur id innulfan. Ur nesli s waya, $uô ibabaten nne$ imezwura".

ayahs.text: Inna Musa: "Mass iw Iéôa sennig wiyav, anwa iwumi Ifka nnhaya s$uôeS, anwa ara d igwrin deg Uxxam. Imednas, s tidep, ur rebêen".
ayahs.translation: Inna Musa: "Mass iw Iéôa sennig wiyav, anwa iwumi Ifka nnhaya s$uôeS, anwa ara d igwrin deg Uxxam. Imednas, s tidep, ur rebêen".

ayahs.text: Inna Ferâun: "a yimvebbôen, ur awen mli$ ara kra n ôebbi, war nekkini. Ecâal iyi times ar talaxt, a Haman; bnu yi lbeôo aâlayen; ahat ad ali$ ar ÖÔebbi n Musa. Nek, s tidep, êesbe$ t seg wid iskiddiben".
ayahs.translation: Inna Ferâun: "a yimvebbôen, ur awen mli$ ara kra n ôebbi, war nekkini. Ecâal iyi times ar talaxt, a Haman; bnu yi lbeôo aâlayen; ahat ad ali$ ar ÖÔebbi n Musa. Nek, s tidep, êesbe$ t seg wid iskiddiben".

ayahs.text: Neppa, akked iâsekôiwen is, sme$wôen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. £ilen, ar nitni, ur d ppu$alen $uône£.
ayahs.translation: Neppa, akked iâsekôiwen is, sme$wôen iman nnsen di tmurt, war ssebba. £ilen, ar nitni, ur d ppu$alen $uône£.

ayahs.text: Neppa, akked iâsekôiwen is, Neîîef iten. Nger iten ar yill. Wali amek tevôa d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Neppa, akked iâsekôiwen is, Neîîef iten. Nger iten ar yill. Wali amek tevôa d imednas.

ayahs.text: Nerra ten d imeqwôanen i ineccden ar tmes. Ass n tnekra, ur ppusellken.
ayahs.translation: Nerra ten d imeqwôanen i ineccden ar tmes. Ass n tnekra, ur ppusellken.

ayahs.text: Neqqen asen xezzu di ddunit agi. Ass n tnekra, nitni seg ucmiten.
ayahs.translation: Neqqen asen xezzu di ddunit agi. Ass n tnekra, nitni seg ucmiten.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, mbaâd ma Nesqucc isuta imezwura. D tafat i imdanen, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Amar a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka Tazmamt i Musa, mbaâd ma Nesqucc isuta imezwura. D tafat i imdanen, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Amar a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: Ur telliv ara di loiha utaram, mi Nseyya lameô i Musa. Ur telliv seg inagan.
ayahs.translation: Ur telliv ara di loiha utaram, mi Nseyya lameô i Musa. Ur telliv seg inagan.

ayahs.text: Maca, Nxelq ed tisuta, $wezzif laâmeô nnsent. Ur tellid seg imezda$ n Madian, la sen teqqarev issekniyen nne£. Maca, Nella Neppazen.
ayahs.translation: Maca, Nxelq ed tisuta, $wezzif laâmeô nnsent. Ur tellid seg imezda$ n Madian, la sen teqqarev issekniyen nne£. Maca, Nella Neppazen.

ayahs.text: Ur telliv ar tama n udrar, mi d Nessawel. Maca d aêunu s$uô Mass ik, iwakken a pnedrev agdud, u$uô ur d iusi uneddaô, uqbel ik. Amar a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Ur telliv ar tama n udrar, mi d Nessawel. Maca d aêunu s$uô Mass ik, iwakken a pnedrev agdud, u$uô ur d iusi uneddaô, uqbel ik. Amar a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: Mulac, ma têuza ten tiyta id urwen ifassen nnsen, a d inin: "a Mass nne$! A lemmer i $ d Tuznev amazan, a neddu d issekniyen iK, a nili seg wid iumnen"!
ayahs.translation: Mulac, ma têuza ten tiyta id urwen ifassen nnsen, a d inin: "a Mass nne$! A lemmer i $ d Tuznev amazan, a neddu d issekniyen iK, a nili seg wid iumnen"!

ayahs.text: Mi ten id tusa tidep s$uône£, nnan: "a lemmer id iusi am wayen id iusan i Musa"! Day ur ugin ara, zik, ayen id iusan i Musa? Nnan: "d sin ssêurat". Mwafaqen, nnan: "nekwni nugi ten i sin".
ayahs.translation: Mi ten id tusa tidep s$uône£, nnan: "a lemmer id iusi am wayen id iusan i Musa"! Day ur ugin ara, zik, ayen id iusan i Musa? Nnan: "d sin ssêurat". Mwafaqen, nnan: "nekwni nugi ten i sin".

ayahs.text: Ini: "awit ed Tazmamt, s$uô Öebbi, i yifen snat agi, i nnhaya, ad ddu$ yides, ma tessawalem tidep".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "awit ed Tazmamt, s$uô Öebbi, i yifen snat agi, i nnhaya, ad ddu$ yides, ma tessawalem tidep".

ayahs.text: Ma ur ak d rran ara, efhem ar ddan kan d lhawiyyat nnsen. Anwa innetlafen, sennig win iteddun d lhawiyya s, war nnhaya s$uô Öebbi? Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ma ur ak d rran ara, efhem ar ddan kan d lhawiyyat nnsen. Anwa innetlafen, sennig win iteddun d lhawiyya s, war nnhaya s$uô Öebbi? Öebbi, s tidep, ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

ayahs.text: Aql a£ Nessawwev asen awal, amendeô ma d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Aql a£ Nessawwev asen awal, amendeô ma d mmektin.

ayahs.text: Umnen yis wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, uqbel tagi.
ayahs.translation: Umnen yis wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, uqbel tagi.

ayahs.text: Ma $ôan asen t, ad inin: "numen yis. Ih, ar neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass nne$. Uqbel is, s tidep, nella d imvuâen".
ayahs.translation: Ma $ôan asen t, ad inin: "numen yis. Ih, ar neppa d tidep, s$uô Mass nne$. Uqbel is, s tidep, nella d imvuâen".

ayahs.text: Wigi a ten id ias ukafi nnsen berdayen, $ef wayen ûebôen, swexxiôen tucmip s yise$, u seg wayen iten N$at, pseddiqen.
ayahs.translation: Wigi a ten id ias ukafi nnsen berdayen, $ef wayen ûebôen, swexxiôen tucmip s yise$, u seg wayen iten N$at, pseddiqen.

ayahs.text: Mi slan i yir awal, ad as veôfen, u qaôen: "i nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Fellawen talwit. Ur neô$eb $ef at war tussna".
ayahs.translation: Mi slan i yir awal, ad as veôfen, u qaôen: "i nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Fellawen talwit. Ur neô$eb $ef at war tussna".

ayahs.text: Keçç, s tidep, ur tnehhuv win têemlev. Maca, Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan. Neppa, Yif akw akken Iéôa wid ipwanhan.
ayahs.translation: Keçç, s tidep, ur tnehhuv win têemlev. Maca, Öebbi Inehhu win i S ihwan. Neppa, Yif akw akken Iéôa wid ipwanhan.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ma nedda d nnhaya yidek, a nepwaxvef seg wakal nne$". Day ur ten Nesseqâad ara di loamaâ n laman, u$uô d ppawvent yal l$ellat? D l$it s$uône£. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur éôin.
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ma nedda d nnhaya yidek, a nepwaxvef seg wakal nne$". Day ur ten Nesseqâad ara di loamaâ n laman, u$uô d ppawvent yal l$ellat? D l$it s$uône£. Maca, tegwti degsen, ur éôin.

ayahs.text: Acêal Nesqucc n temdininn, cerrâent di temâict nnsent. Atnan ixxamen nnsen, ay ten ized$en, deffir sen, siwa ixeîîayen. D Nekwni ay d iweôôaten.
ayahs.translation: Acêal Nesqucc n temdininn, cerrâent di temâict nnsent. Atnan ixxamen nnsen, ay ten ized$en, deffir sen, siwa ixeîîayen. D Nekwni ay d iweôôaten.

ayahs.text: Ur Isquccu Mass ik timdinin, alamma iuzen i imezda$ nnsent, amazan i sen immalen issekniyen nne£. Ur Nesquccu timdinin, mebla ma llan imezda$ nnsent, d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ur Isquccu Mass ik timdinin, alamma iuzen i imezda$ nnsent, amazan i sen immalen issekniyen nne£. Ur Nesquccu timdinin, mebla ma llan imezda$ nnsent, d imednas.

ayahs.text: Kra n wayen i wen ippunefken n cci, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuê is. Ayen illan $eô Öebbi, yif it, ad idum kter. Day ur pmeyyizen ara?
ayahs.translation: Kra n wayen i wen ippunefken n cci, d zzhu n tmeddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuê is. Ayen illan $eô Öebbi, yif it, ad idum kter. Day ur pmeyyizen ara?

ayahs.text: Day win iwumi Nefka lemâahda igerzen, u immuger ip, am win i Nezha s l$it n tmeddurt n ddunit; sinna, ass n tnekra, neppa seg wid ara d irsen?
ayahs.translation: Day win iwumi Nefka lemâahda igerzen, u immuger ip, am win i Nezha s l$it n tmeddurt n ddunit; sinna, ass n tnekra, neppa seg wid ara d irsen?

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "anda ten wid iyY tepcarakem, u tellam tepkabarem"?
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "anda ten wid iyY tepcarakem, u tellam tepkabarem"?

ayahs.text: A d inin wid i$ef iûaô wawal: "a Mass nne$! Wigi i njeggeê, njeggeê iten, akken i nepwajeggeê. A nzekki $ureK: maççi d nekwni ay âabden".
ayahs.translation: A d inin wid i$ef iûaô wawal: "a Mass nne$! Wigi i njeggeê, njeggeê iten, akken i nepwajeggeê. A nzekki $ureK: maççi d nekwni ay âabden".

ayahs.text: Ad asen inin: "naâôet wid tepcarakem". Ad ten naâôen, ur asen d pparan. Walan aâaqeb. A lemmer llan pwanhan!
ayahs.translation: Ad asen inin: "naâôet wid tepcarakem". Ad ten naâôen, ur asen d pparan. Walan aâaqeb. A lemmer llan pwanhan!

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "acu d terram i imazanen"?
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad Yini: "acu d terram i imazanen"?

ayahs.text: Assen, ad dergen fellasen isalen, nitni ur pmesteqsayen.
ayahs.translation: Assen, ad dergen fellasen isalen, nitni ur pmesteqsayen.

ayahs.text: Ma d win isteôoâen, iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, ahat ad yili seg imerbaê.
ayahs.translation: Ma d win isteôoâen, iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, ahat ad yili seg imerbaê.

ayahs.text: Mass ik Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan, u Ismenyafa. Ur ten id iûaê usmenyif. Gedha s Öebbi! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
ayahs.translation: Mass ik Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan, u Ismenyafa. Ur ten id iûaê usmenyif. Gedha s Öebbi! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!

ayahs.text: Mass ik Iéôa ayen iffren deg idmaren nnsen, akked wayen cennâen.
ayahs.translation: Mass ik Iéôa ayen iffren deg idmaren nnsen, akked wayen cennâen.

ayahs.text: Neppa d Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. I Neppa, annuz di tmezwarut, u di tneggarut. I Neppa aêuddu, $uôeS tu$alin nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Neppa d Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. I Neppa, annuz di tmezwarut, u di tneggarut. I Neppa aêuddu, $uôeS tu$alin nnwen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Isse$li d Öebbi iv imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ara wen d iawin tafat? Day ur tsellem ara"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Isse$li d Öebbi iv imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ara wen d iawin tafat? Day ur tsellem ara"?

ayahs.text: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Issuli Öebbi ass imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ara wen d iawin iv, a ppestaâfum degs? Day ur tepwalim ara"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "acu tmeyyzem, ma Issuli Öebbi ass imezgi, fellawen, alamma d ass n tnekra? Anwa ôebbi, war Öebbi, ara wen d iawin iv, a ppestaâfum degs? Day ur tepwalim ara"?

ayahs.text: Seg uêunu S, Iga yawen iv akked wass, i ustaâfu nnwen, akked unadi n lfevl iS. Amar a ppesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: Seg uêunu S, Iga yawen iv akked wass, i ustaâfu nnwen, akked unadi n lfevl iS. Amar a ppesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad asen Yini: "anda ten wid iyY tepcarakem, u tellam tepkabarem"?
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara sen d Isiwel, ad asen Yini: "anda ten wid iyY tepcarakem, u tellam tepkabarem"?

ayahs.text: A d Nawi anagi, si yal lois. A Nini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen". Ad éôen ar tidep n Öebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: A d Nawi anagi, si yal lois. A Nini: "awit ed atebbet nnwen". Ad éôen ar tidep n Öebbi. Itelf iten wayen d snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Qaôun illa seg ugdud n Musa. Iqehô iten. Nefka yas igerrujen; s tezmert ugraw ioehden, arfad n tsura nnsen. Mi s inna ugdud is: "ur zehhu! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara izehwaniyen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Qaôun illa seg ugdud n Musa. Iqehô iten. Nefka yas igerrujen; s tezmert ugraw ioehden, arfad n tsura nnsen. Mi s inna ugdud is: "ur zehhu! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara izehwaniyen.

ayahs.text: Deg wayen i k Ifka Öebbi, nadi axxam aneggaru. Ur teppu amur ik, di ddunit. Elhu, akken i Ilha Öebbi $uôek. Ur ssaram lefsad di tmurt. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ifessaden".
ayahs.translation: Deg wayen i k Ifka Öebbi, nadi axxam aneggaru. Ur teppu amur ik, di ddunit. Elhu, akken i Ilha Öebbi $uôek. Ur ssaram lefsad di tmurt. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ifessaden".

ayahs.text: Inna: "ippunefk iyi kan, ilmend n tmusni i sâi$". Day ur iéôa ara ar Öebbi Isqucc, uqbel is, ger isuta, wid i t iugaren di tezmert, isemmden kteô? Ur illi usteqsi ibe$wviyen, af ibekkaven nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "ippunefk iyi kan, ilmend n tmusni i sâi$". Day ur iéôa ara ar Öebbi Isqucc, uqbel is, ger isuta, wid i t iugaren di tezmert, isemmden kteô? Ur illi usteqsi ibe$wviyen, af ibekkaven nnsen.

ayahs.text: Iffe$ ed s agdud is, s ôôêuê is. Wid ib$an tameddurt n ddunit, nnan: "awufan nesâa am wayen ippunefken i Qaôun! Ih, neppa d bab n terkunt tabarart".
ayahs.translation: Iffe$ ed s agdud is, s ôôêuê is. Wid ib$an tameddurt n ddunit, nnan: "awufan nesâa am wayen ippunefken i Qaôun! Ih, neppa d bab n terkunt tabarart".

ayahs.text: Wid, iwumi teppunefk tmusni, nnan: "a ssexv nnwen! Ppwab n Öebbi yif it, i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ara d iûaê siwa win iûebôen".
ayahs.translation: Wid, iwumi teppunefk tmusni, nnan: "a ssexv nnwen! Ppwab n Öebbi yif it, i win iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ara d iûaê siwa win iûebôen".

ayahs.text: Nger it seddaw tmurt, neppa akked uxxam is. Ur as telli terbaât ara t isellken, war Öebbi. Ur illi seg wid ipselliken iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Nger it seddaw tmurt, neppa akked uxxam is. Ur as telli terbaât ara t isellken, war Öebbi. Ur illi seg wid ipselliken iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Wid issaramen amkan is, ivelli nni, u$alen nnan: "zi$ Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u iwezzen. Lemmer ur a$ I$at ara Öebbi, yili Iger a$ seddaw tmurt. Ih, ur rebêen ijehliyen".
ayahs.translation: Wid issaramen amkan is, ivelli nni, u$alen nnan: "zi$ Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u iwezzen. Lemmer ur a$ I$at ara Öebbi, yili Iger a$ seddaw tmurt. Ih, ur rebêen ijehliyen".

ayahs.text: Axxam nni aneggaru, a t Nerr i wid ijunben tem$weô akked usefsed, di tmurt. Tirect i wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Axxam nni aneggaru, a t Nerr i wid ijunben tem$weô akked usefsed, di tmurt. Tirect i wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Win id iusan s yise$, ad iawi ayen it yifen. Win id iusan s tucmip, ihi, ad ppuqeîîin wid ixedmen tucmitin, $ef wayen kan xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Win id iusan s yise$, ad iawi ayen it yifen. Win id iusan s tucmip, ihi, ad ppuqeîîin wid ixedmen tucmitin, $ef wayen kan xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Win Ilezmen fellak Leqwôan, war ccekk, a k id Irr s axxam. Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Issen anwa id iusan s nnhaya, anwa i illan di ttelfan n ûûeê".
ayahs.translation: Ih, Win Ilezmen fellak Leqwôan, war ccekk, a k id Irr s axxam. Ini: "Mass iw Yif akw akken Issen anwa id iusan s nnhaya, anwa i illan di ttelfan n ûûeê".

ayahs.text: Ur tessarmev ara, ad ak ed ters Tezmamt, lemmer maççi d aêunu s$uô Mass ik. Ur ppili d amâiwen ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Ur tessarmev ara, ad ak ed ters Tezmamt, lemmer maççi d aêunu s$uô Mass ik. Ur ppili d amâiwen ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ur k swexxiôen seg issekniyen n Öebbi, deffir trusi nnsen $uôek. Nuj ar Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcaraken.
ayahs.translation: Ur k swexxiôen seg issekniyen n Öebbi, deffir trusi nnsen $uôek. Nuj ar Mass ik, ur ppili seg wid ipcaraken.

ayahs.text: Ur nâaô, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven. Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa. Yal cci ad inger, siwa udem iS. IneS aêuddu. £ureS ara tu$alem.
ayahs.translation: Ur nâaô, ar tama n Öebbi, ôebbi nniven. Ur illi ôebbi, siwa Neppa. Yal cci ad inger, siwa udem iS. IneS aêuddu. £ureS ara tu$alem.

verses.text: Alm.
verses.translation: Alm.

verses.text: Day $ilen imdanen a ten ooen qqaôen: "numen", u nitni ur ppuhewwlen?
verses.translation: Day $ilen imdanen a ten ooen qqaôen: "numen", u nitni ur ppuhewwlen?

verses.text: Ni$ Nhewwel wid i ten id izwaren. War ccekk, ad Yissin Öebbi wid iqqaôen tidep, ad Yissin ikeddaben.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nhewwel wid i ten id izwaren. War ccekk, ad Yissin Öebbi wid iqqaôen tidep, ad Yissin ikeddaben.

verses.text: Ne$ $ilen ad a£ zwiren wid ixedmen tucmitin? Dir it wayen pêuddun.
verses.translation: Ne$ $ilen ad a£ zwiren wid ixedmen tucmitin? Dir it wayen pêuddun.

verses.text: Win iggunin timlilit akked Öebbi, s tidep, a d ias, war ccekk, lajel n Öebbi. Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Win iggunin timlilit akked Öebbi, s tidep, a d ias, war ccekk, lajel n Öebbi. Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Win ijuhden, ijuhed kan i iman is. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêwao ara imavalen.
verses.translation: Win ijuhden, ijuhed kan i iman is. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêwao ara imavalen.

verses.text: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, ad asen Nekkes tucmitin nnsen, a ten Nkafi $ef wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
verses.translation: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, ad asen Nekkes tucmitin nnsen, a ten Nkafi $ef wayen xeddmen ifuqen.

verses.text: Nweûûa amdan ar lewqama, s imawlan is. Ma lezmen fellak, ad iyI tcarkev ayen ur tessinev, ur asen ppa$ awal. Tu$alin nnwen, $uôI. Ad awen Mle$ acu txeddmem.
verses.translation: Nweûûa amdan ar lewqama, s imawlan is. Ma lezmen fellak, ad iyI tcarkev ayen ur tessinev, ur asen ppa$ awal. Tu$alin nnwen, $uôI. Ad awen Mle$ acu txeddmem.

verses.text: Wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, a ten Nessekcem ar iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, a ten Nessekcem ar iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Ger imdanen, wid iqqaôen: "numen s Öebbi". Ma meênen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad êesben ahewwel n medden, d aâaqeb n Öebbi. Mi d iusa l$elb, s$uô Mass ik, ar ad inin: "ih, nella yidwen". Day ur Iéôa ara Öebbi, i illan deg idmaren imavalen?
verses.translation: Ger imdanen, wid iqqaôen: "numen s Öebbi". Ma meênen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad êesben ahewwel n medden, d aâaqeb n Öebbi. Mi d iusa l$elb, s$uô Mass ik, ar ad inin: "ih, nella yidwen". Day ur Iéôa ara Öebbi, i illan deg idmaren imavalen?

verses.text: War ccekk, Öebbi Issen wid iumnen, Issen ixabiten.
verses.translation: War ccekk, Öebbi Issen wid iumnen, Issen ixabiten.

verses.text: Nnan wid ijehlen, i wid iumnen: "ddut d ubrid nne$, a nbibb tuccva nnwen". Nitni ur pbibbin acemma, si tuccva nnsen. S tidep, nitni d ikeddaben.
verses.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen, i wid iumnen: "ddut d ubrid nne$, a nbibb tuccva nnwen". Nitni ur pbibbin acemma, si tuccva nnsen. S tidep, nitni d ikeddaben.

verses.text: War ccekk, ad bibben tiâekkwmin nnsen, akked tiâekkwmin nniven. Ih, ad ppusteqsin, ass n tnekra, af wayen id snulfuyen.
verses.translation: War ccekk, ad bibben tiâekkwmin nnsen, akked tiâekkwmin nniven. Ih, ad ppusteqsin, ass n tnekra, af wayen id snulfuyen.

verses.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê, i ugdud is. Izde$ yides, agim kkes ed smuset iseggwasen. Ibbwi ten uêemmal, nitni d imednas.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê, i ugdud is. Izde$ yides, agim kkes ed smuset iseggwasen. Ibbwi ten uêemmal, nitni d imednas.

verses.text: Nsellek it, neppa akked wid iddan di lbabuô. Nerra t d assekni i imavalen.
verses.translation: Nsellek it, neppa akked wid iddan di lbabuô. Nerra t d assekni i imavalen.

verses.text: Ibôahim, mi inna i ugdud is: "âabdet Öebbi, êezzbet aS. Yif it wakka, i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.
verses.translation: Ibôahim, mi inna i ugdud is: "âabdet Öebbi, êezzbet aS. Yif it wakka, i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.

verses.text: Tâabdem kan tiâancuôin, war Öebbi. Tesnulfam d tikerkas. Ih, wid tâabdem, war Öebbi, ur zmiren a kwen $iten. Ssutret l$it i Öebbi, âabdet eP, snemmret aS. £uôeS ara tu$alem.
verses.translation: Tâabdem kan tiâancuôin, war Öebbi. Tesnulfam d tikerkas. Ih, wid tâabdem, war Öebbi, ur zmiren a kwen $iten. Ssutret l$it i Öebbi, âabdet eP, snemmret aS. £uôeS ara tu$alem.

verses.text: Ma tnekôem, ihi, uqbel nnwen, nekôen leoyus". I iwatan, i umazan, siwa assiwev ubeggen.
verses.translation: Ma tnekôem, ihi, uqbel nnwen, nekôen leoyus". I iwatan, i umazan, siwa assiwev ubeggen.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara, amek id Inezzu Öebbi lxelq, sinna, Ippales as. Ih, ayagi, i Öebbi, d ushil.
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara, amek id Inezzu Öebbi lxelq, sinna, Ippales as. Ih, ayagi, i Öebbi, d ushil.

verses.text: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek id Inza lxelq. Sinna, Öebbi a d Iawi lxelq aneggaru. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci".
verses.translation: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek id Inza lxelq. Sinna, Öebbi a d Iawi lxelq aneggaru. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci".

verses.text: Ikkat win i S ihwan; Ipêunu $ef win i S ihwan. £ureS jebbu nnwen.
verses.translation: Ikkat win i S ihwan; Ipêunu $ef win i S ihwan. £ureS jebbu nnwen.

verses.text: Ur tesfunnugem, kunwi, di tmurt, ne$ deg igenni. Ur tesâim, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.
verses.translation: Ur tesfunnugem, kunwi, di tmurt, ne$ deg igenni. Ur tesâim, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.

verses.text: Wid iugin issekniyen n Öebbi, akked temlilit yideS, widak ad aysen aêunu W. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Wid iugin issekniyen n Öebbi, akked temlilit yideS, widak ad aysen aêunu W. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "en$et ep, ne$ sseô$et ep". Isellek it Öebbi, si tmes. Deg waya, s tidep, d assekni i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "en$et ep, ne$ sseô$et ep". Isellek it Öebbi, si tmes. Deg waya, s tidep, d assekni i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Inna: "teddmem kan tiâancuôin, war Öebbi. Temêemmalem di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, ass n tnekra, kra degwen ad nekôen wiyav, kra ad xzun wiyav. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi usellak".
verses.translation: Inna: "teddmem kan tiâancuôin, war Öebbi. Temêemmalem di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, ass n tnekra, kra degwen ad nekôen wiyav, kra ad xzun wiyav. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi usellak".

verses.text: Iumen it Luî. Inna: "nek, d iminig ar Mass iw. Ih, Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".
verses.translation: Iumen it Luî. Inna: "nek, d iminig ar Mass iw. Ih, Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".

verses.text: N$at it s Isêaq akked Yaâqub. I tarwas, Nefka lambiyya, Tazmamt. Nefka yas taqviât is, di ddunit; u neppa, di laxeôt, war ccekk, seg iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: N$at it s Isêaq akked Yaâqub. I tarwas, Nefka lambiyya, Tazmamt. Nefka yas taqviât is, di ddunit; u neppa, di laxeôt, war ccekk, seg iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "ih, aql akwen la txedmem lâaô, ur ixdim yiwen, zik, deg imavalen.
verses.translation: Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "ih, aql akwen la txedmem lâaô, ur ixdim yiwen, zik, deg imavalen.

verses.text: La teppeddum, ih, ar irgazen, tgezzmem abrid, txeddmem ayen icemten, deg igrawen nnwen". Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi nnan: "awi a$ d aâaqeb n Öebbi, ma telliv seg wid issawalen tidep".
verses.translation: La teppeddum, ih, ar irgazen, tgezzmem abrid, txeddmem ayen icemten, deg igrawen nnwen". Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi nnan: "awi a$ d aâaqeb n Öebbi, ma telliv seg wid issawalen tidep".

verses.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi afus, mgal agdud ifessaden".
verses.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi afus, mgal agdud ifessaden".

verses.text: Mi d usan imceggâen nne£, ar Ibôahim, s ubecceô, nnan as: "ih, a Nesqucc imezda$ n temdint agi. Imezda$ is, s tidep, d imednas".
verses.translation: Mi d usan imceggâen nne£, ar Ibôahim, s ubecceô, nnan as: "ih, a Nesqucc imezda$ n temdint agi. Imezda$ is, s tidep, d imednas".

verses.text: Inna d: "ni$ degs Luî". Nnan as: "Nekwni, Neéôa sennig akw, i illan degs. A t Naâteq, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is, ara yilin seg wid igwran".
verses.translation: Inna d: "ni$ degs Luî". Nnan as: "Nekwni, Neéôa sennig akw, i illan degs. A t Naâteq, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is, ara yilin seg wid igwran".

verses.text: Mi usan imceggâen nne£, ar Luî, i$wbel ilmend nnsen, ur izmir a ten ifukk. Nnan as: "ur ppagwad, ur $webbel. Nekwni a k Naâteq, keçç d twacult ik, siwa tameîîut ik, ara yilin seg wid igwran.
verses.translation: Mi usan imceggâen nne£, ar Luî, i$wbel ilmend nnsen, ur izmir a ten ifukk. Nnan as: "ur ppagwad, ur $webbel. Nekwni a k Naâteq, keçç d twacult ik, siwa tameîîut ik, ara yilin seg wid igwran.

verses.text: Ih, nekwni a d Nesse$li ssxev seg igenni, $ef imezda$ n temdint agi, ilmend n lâaô nnsen".
verses.translation: Ih, nekwni a d Nesse$li ssxev seg igenni, $ef imezda$ n temdint agi, ilmend n lâaô nnsen".

verses.text: Ni$ Neooa d segs, assekni iberrzen, i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Neooa d segs, assekni iberrzen, i ugdud ipmeyyizen.

verses.text: Ar Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi, gganit ass aneggaru, ur oouôut di tmurt d ifessaden!".
verses.translation: Ar Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi, gganit ass aneggaru, ur oouôut di tmurt d ifessaden!".

verses.text: Nekôen t. Tewwet iten zzenzla. Gwran d, d loeppat, deg ixxamen nnsen.
verses.translation: Nekôen t. Tewwet iten zzenzla. Gwran d, d loeppat, deg ixxamen nnsen.

verses.text: Âad akked Tamud - ni$ iban awen d seg ixxamen nnsen -, icebbeê asen Cciîan igiten nnsen. Issuffe$ iten seg ubrid, nitni pfeôôioen.
verses.translation: Âad akked Tamud - ni$ iban awen d seg ixxamen nnsen -, icebbeê asen Cciîan igiten nnsen. Issuffe$ iten seg ubrid, nitni pfeôôioen.

verses.text: Qaôun, Ferâun, Haman, ni$ iusa ten id Musa, s ubeggen. Sme$wôen iman nnsen, di tmurt, ur rbiêen.
verses.translation: Qaôun, Ferâun, Haman, ni$ iusa ten id Musa, s ubeggen. Sme$wôen iman nnsen, di tmurt, ur rbiêen.

verses.text: Yal wa, Newwet it $ef ubekkav is. Llan wid iwumi Nuzen tabucivant. Llan wid i iwwet usu$u. Llan wid i Nger seddaw wakal. Llan wid i Ne$meq. Maççi d Öebbi iten idensen, d nitni i idensen iman nnsen.
verses.translation: Yal wa, Newwet it $ef ubekkav is. Llan wid iwumi Nuzen tabucivant. Llan wid i iwwet usu$u. Llan wid i Nger seddaw wakal. Llan wid i Ne$meq. Maççi d Öebbi iten idensen, d nitni i idensen iman nnsen.

verses.text: Wid iteddun d imawlan, war Öebbi, cban rtila. Tebna tissist. Ihi, axxam ahcican mavi, d tissist n rtila, lemmer ssinen.
verses.translation: Wid iteddun d imawlan, war Öebbi, cban rtila. Tebna tissist. Ihi, axxam ahcican mavi, d tissist n rtila, lemmer ssinen.

verses.text: Ih, Öebbi Iéôa akw ayen u$uô naâôen, war Neppa. Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi Iéôa akw ayen u$uô naâôen, war Neppa. Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Imedyaten agi, Neppawi ten id, i l$aci. Siwa imusnawen ara ten ifehmen.
verses.translation: Imedyaten agi, Neppawi ten id, i l$aci. Siwa imusnawen ara ten ifehmen.

verses.text: Ixleq Öebbi tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ih, deg waya, assekni i lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ixleq Öebbi tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ih, deg waya, assekni i lmumnin.

verses.text: Mel ayen i k id ippuweêêan si Tezmamt. Bedd i téallit. Ih, taéallit teppekkes lâaô, tuccva. War ccek, iugar ip usmekti n Öebbi. Öebbi Iéôa acu tûenâam.
verses.translation: Mel ayen i k id ippuweêêan si Tezmamt. Bedd i téallit. Ih, taéallit teppekkes lâaô, tuccva. War ccek, iugar ip usmekti n Öebbi. Öebbi Iéôa acu tûenâam.

verses.text: Ur pnamaret At Tezmamt, siwa s wawal aéidan, siwa wid degsen idensen. Init: "numen s wayen id irsen $uône$, id irsen $uôwen. Öebbi nne$, akked Öebbi nnwen, Yiwen. Nekwni $uôeS d imvuâen".
verses.translation: Ur pnamaret At Tezmamt, siwa s wawal aéidan, siwa wid degsen idensen. Init: "numen s wayen id irsen $uône$, id irsen $uôwen. Öebbi nne$, akked Öebbi nnwen, Yiwen. Nekwni $uôeS d imvuâen".

verses.text: Akka ay ed Nessers, $uôek, Tazmamt. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, umnen yis. Ger wigi, kra umnen yis. I inekôen issekniyen nne£, siwa ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Akka ay ed Nessers, $uôek, Tazmamt. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, umnen yis. Ger wigi, kra umnen yis. I inekôen issekniyen nne£, siwa ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ur telliv temmalev kra n Tezmamt, uqbel tagi; ur p tepparuv, s uyeffus ik. Yili ad cukken inekkaôen.
verses.translation: Ur telliv temmalev kra n Tezmamt, uqbel tagi; ur p tepparuv, s uyeffus ik. Yili ad cukken inekkaôen.

verses.text: Xaîi, neppa d issekniyen iberrzen, deg idmaren n wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni. Siwa imednas, i inekôen issekniyen nne£.
verses.translation: Xaîi, neppa d issekniyen iberrzen, deg idmaren n wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni. Siwa imednas, i inekôen issekniyen nne£.

verses.text: Nnan: "a lemmer id rsen fellas, issekniyen s$uô Mass is"! Ini: "issekniyen ar Öebbi kan. Nek, d aneddaô kan, ipbegginen".
verses.translation: Nnan: "a lemmer id rsen fellas, issekniyen s$uô Mass is"! Ini: "issekniyen ar Öebbi kan. Nek, d aneddaô kan, ipbegginen".

verses.text: Ne$, ur steqnaâen ara s trusi $uôek, s$uône£, n Tezmamt, malen asen p. Deg waya, s tidep, aêunu, akked usmekti i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: Ne$, ur steqnaâen ara s trusi $uôek, s$uône£, n Tezmamt, malen asen p. Deg waya, s tidep, aêunu, akked usmekti i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Ini: "Iqadd Öebbi, d anagi gari yidwen. Issen i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Wid iumnen di tkerkas, u ugin Öebbi, widak d imexsuôen".
verses.translation: Ini: "Iqadd Öebbi, d anagi gari yidwen. Issen i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Wid iumnen di tkerkas, u ugin Öebbi, widak d imexsuôen".

verses.text: Sêirin k $ef uâaqeb. Lemmer maççi d lajel ipwassnen, a ten id ias uâaqeb. Ih, a ten id ias, deqzalla, ur bnin.
verses.translation: Sêirin k $ef uâaqeb. Lemmer maççi d lajel ipwassnen, a ten id ias uâaqeb. Ih, a ten id ias, deqzalla, ur bnin.

verses.text: Sêirin k $ef uâaqeb. Ih, Loahennama a ppezzi i ijehliyen
verses.translation: Sêirin k $ef uâaqeb. Ih, Loahennama a ppezzi i ijehliyen

verses.text: Ass ideg ar asen isbur uâaqeb, sennig sen, akw seddaw ivaôen nnsen, ad Yini: "jeôôbet ayen txeddmem".
verses.translation: Ass ideg ar asen isbur uâaqeb, sennig sen, akw seddaw ivaôen nnsen, ad Yini: "jeôôbet ayen txeddmem".

verses.text: A yimdanen iW iumnen, ni$ tamurt iW tewsaâ. Ihi, âabdet iyI, Nek.
verses.translation: A yimdanen iW iumnen, ni$ tamurt iW tewsaâ. Ihi, âabdet iyI, Nek.

verses.text: Yal iman, ad ijeôôeb tameppant; sinna, $uône£ a d tu$alem.
verses.translation: Yal iman, ad ijeôôeb tameppant; sinna, $uône£ a d tu$alem.

verses.text: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Nerr tanezdu$t di Loennet m t$uôfatin, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen, degs ad wekkôen. D asaâdi warraz n wid ixedmen lxiô,
verses.translation: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Nerr tanezdu$t di Loennet m t$uôfatin, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen, degs ad wekkôen. D asaâdi warraz n wid ixedmen lxiô,

verses.text: wid iûebôen, ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen.
verses.translation: wid iûebôen, ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen.

verses.text: Acêal n lewêuc, ur d neppawi ôôeéq nnsen. Öebbi Iôeéq iten, u Iôeéq ikwen. Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: Acêal n lewêuc, ur d neppawi ôôeéq nnsen. Öebbi Iôeéq iten, u Iôeéq ikwen. Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i Inuben s yiîij akked waggur"? A d inin, war ccekk: "d Öebbi". Ihi, acimi wexxôen?
verses.translation: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i Inuben s yiîij akked waggur"? A d inin, war ccekk: "d Öebbi". Ihi, acimi wexxôen?

verses.text: Öebbi Issugut l$it i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u Iwezzen as. Ih, Öebbi Issen yal cci.
verses.translation: Öebbi Issugut l$it i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u Iwezzen as. Ih, Öebbi Issen yal cci.

verses.text: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa id Isse$layen aman seg igenni, Issidir yissen akal, deffir tmeppant is"? A d inin, war ccekk, "d Öebbi". Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi". Maca, tegwti degsen, ur fhimen.
verses.translation: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa id Isse$layen aman seg igenni, Issidir yissen akal, deffir tmeppant is"? A d inin, war ccekk, "d Öebbi". Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi". Maca, tegwti degsen, ur fhimen.

verses.text: Tameddurt agi, di ddunit, siwa lhawiyya, d wurar. D axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, ay d amuddir, lemmer éôin.
verses.translation: Tameddurt agi, di ddunit, siwa lhawiyya, d wurar. D axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, ay d amuddir, lemmer éôin.

verses.text: Mara rekben di lbabuô, ad naâôen Öebbi, d idiniyen zeddigen $uôeS. Mi ten Isellek ar lberr, atnan la pcaraken.
verses.translation: Mara rekben di lbabuô, ad naâôen Öebbi, d idiniyen zeddigen $uôeS. Mi ten Isellek ar lberr, atnan la pcaraken.

verses.text: Ad nekôen ayen i sen Nefka, ad zhun, deqqal ad éôen.
verses.translation: Ad nekôen ayen i sen Nefka, ad zhun, deqqal ad éôen.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara, Nerra loamaâ n laman, wanag la pwaxvafen imdanen i sen d izzin? Day ad amnen di tkerkas, u ad nekôen l$it n Öebbi?
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara, Nerra loamaâ n laman, wanag la pwaxvafen imdanen i sen d izzin? Day ad amnen di tkerkas, u ad nekôen l$it n Öebbi?

verses.text: Anwa i idensen kteô: win id isnulfan tikerkas af Öebbi, ne$ win irran tidep d tikerkas, mi t id tusa? Day maççi d Loahennama ay d tanezdu$t i ijehliyen?
verses.translation: Anwa i idensen kteô: win id isnulfan tikerkas af Öebbi, ne$ win irran tidep d tikerkas, mi t id tusa? Day maççi d Loahennama ay d tanezdu$t i ijehliyen?

verses.text: Wid ijuhden ar loiha nne£, a ten Nenhu, war ccekk, s iberdan nne£. Ih, Öebbi Ippili ar lâuûam.
verses.translation: Wid ijuhden ar loiha nne£, a ten Nenhu, war ccekk, s iberdan nne£. Ih, Öebbi Ippili ar lâuûam.

ayahs.text: Alm.
ayahs.translation: Alm.

ayahs.text: Day $ilen imdanen a ten ooen qqaôen: "numen", u nitni ur ppuhewwlen?
ayahs.translation: Day $ilen imdanen a ten ooen qqaôen: "numen", u nitni ur ppuhewwlen?

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nhewwel wid i ten id izwaren. War ccekk, ad Yissin Öebbi wid iqqaôen tidep, ad Yissin ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nhewwel wid i ten id izwaren. War ccekk, ad Yissin Öebbi wid iqqaôen tidep, ad Yissin ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: Ne$ $ilen ad a£ zwiren wid ixedmen tucmitin? Dir it wayen pêuddun.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ $ilen ad a£ zwiren wid ixedmen tucmitin? Dir it wayen pêuddun.

ayahs.text: Win iggunin timlilit akked Öebbi, s tidep, a d ias, war ccekk, lajel n Öebbi. Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Win iggunin timlilit akked Öebbi, s tidep, a d ias, war ccekk, lajel n Öebbi. Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Win ijuhden, ijuhed kan i iman is. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêwao ara imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Win ijuhden, ijuhed kan i iman is. Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêwao ara imavalen.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, ad asen Nekkes tucmitin nnsen, a ten Nkafi $ef wayen xeddmen ifuqen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, ad asen Nekkes tucmitin nnsen, a ten Nkafi $ef wayen xeddmen ifuqen.

ayahs.text: Nweûûa amdan ar lewqama, s imawlan is. Ma lezmen fellak, ad iyI tcarkev ayen ur tessinev, ur asen ppa$ awal. Tu$alin nnwen, $uôI. Ad awen Mle$ acu txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Nweûûa amdan ar lewqama, s imawlan is. Ma lezmen fellak, ad iyI tcarkev ayen ur tessinev, ur asen ppa$ awal. Tu$alin nnwen, $uôI. Ad awen Mle$ acu txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, a ten Nessekcem ar iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan, war ccekk, a ten Nessekcem ar iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Ger imdanen, wid iqqaôen: "numen s Öebbi". Ma meênen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad êesben ahewwel n medden, d aâaqeb n Öebbi. Mi d iusa l$elb, s$uô Mass ik, ar ad inin: "ih, nella yidwen". Day ur Iéôa ara Öebbi, i illan deg idmaren imavalen?
ayahs.translation: Ger imdanen, wid iqqaôen: "numen s Öebbi". Ma meênen, deg ubrid n Öebbi, ad êesben ahewwel n medden, d aâaqeb n Öebbi. Mi d iusa l$elb, s$uô Mass ik, ar ad inin: "ih, nella yidwen". Day ur Iéôa ara Öebbi, i illan deg idmaren imavalen?

ayahs.text: War ccekk, Öebbi Issen wid iumnen, Issen ixabiten.
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, Öebbi Issen wid iumnen, Issen ixabiten.

ayahs.text: Nnan wid ijehlen, i wid iumnen: "ddut d ubrid nne$, a nbibb tuccva nnwen". Nitni ur pbibbin acemma, si tuccva nnsen. S tidep, nitni d ikeddaben.
ayahs.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen, i wid iumnen: "ddut d ubrid nne$, a nbibb tuccva nnwen". Nitni ur pbibbin acemma, si tuccva nnsen. S tidep, nitni d ikeddaben.

ayahs.text: War ccekk, ad bibben tiâekkwmin nnsen, akked tiâekkwmin nniven. Ih, ad ppusteqsin, ass n tnekra, af wayen id snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, ad bibben tiâekkwmin nnsen, akked tiâekkwmin nniven. Ih, ad ppusteqsin, ass n tnekra, af wayen id snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê, i ugdud is. Izde$ yides, agim kkes ed smuset iseggwasen. Ibbwi ten uêemmal, nitni d imednas.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed Nuê, i ugdud is. Izde$ yides, agim kkes ed smuset iseggwasen. Ibbwi ten uêemmal, nitni d imednas.

ayahs.text: Nsellek it, neppa akked wid iddan di lbabuô. Nerra t d assekni i imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Nsellek it, neppa akked wid iddan di lbabuô. Nerra t d assekni i imavalen.

ayahs.text: Ibôahim, mi inna i ugdud is: "âabdet Öebbi, êezzbet aS. Yif it wakka, i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.
ayahs.translation: Ibôahim, mi inna i ugdud is: "âabdet Öebbi, êezzbet aS. Yif it wakka, i kunwi, lemmer teéôim.

ayahs.text: Tâabdem kan tiâancuôin, war Öebbi. Tesnulfam d tikerkas. Ih, wid tâabdem, war Öebbi, ur zmiren a kwen $iten. Ssutret l$it i Öebbi, âabdet eP, snemmret aS. £uôeS ara tu$alem.
ayahs.translation: Tâabdem kan tiâancuôin, war Öebbi. Tesnulfam d tikerkas. Ih, wid tâabdem, war Öebbi, ur zmiren a kwen $iten. Ssutret l$it i Öebbi, âabdet eP, snemmret aS. £uôeS ara tu$alem.

ayahs.text: Ma tnekôem, ihi, uqbel nnwen, nekôen leoyus". I iwatan, i umazan, siwa assiwev ubeggen.
ayahs.translation: Ma tnekôem, ihi, uqbel nnwen, nekôen leoyus". I iwatan, i umazan, siwa assiwev ubeggen.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara, amek id Inezzu Öebbi lxelq, sinna, Ippales as. Ih, ayagi, i Öebbi, d ushil.
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara, amek id Inezzu Öebbi lxelq, sinna, Ippales as. Ih, ayagi, i Öebbi, d ushil.

ayahs.text: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek id Inza lxelq. Sinna, Öebbi a d Iawi lxelq aneggaru. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, walit amek id Inza lxelq. Sinna, Öebbi a d Iawi lxelq aneggaru. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci".

ayahs.text: Ikkat win i S ihwan; Ipêunu $ef win i S ihwan. £ureS jebbu nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Ikkat win i S ihwan; Ipêunu $ef win i S ihwan. £ureS jebbu nnwen.

ayahs.text: Ur tesfunnugem, kunwi, di tmurt, ne$ deg igenni. Ur tesâim, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Ur tesfunnugem, kunwi, di tmurt, ne$ deg igenni. Ur tesâim, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: Wid iugin issekniyen n Öebbi, akked temlilit yideS, widak ad aysen aêunu W. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Wid iugin issekniyen n Öebbi, akked temlilit yideS, widak ad aysen aêunu W. I widak, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "en$et ep, ne$ sseô$et ep". Isellek it Öebbi, si tmes. Deg waya, s tidep, d assekni i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi d nnan: "en$et ep, ne$ sseô$et ep". Isellek it Öebbi, si tmes. Deg waya, s tidep, d assekni i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Inna: "teddmem kan tiâancuôin, war Öebbi. Temêemmalem di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, ass n tnekra, kra degwen ad nekôen wiyav, kra ad xzun wiyav. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi usellak".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "teddmem kan tiâancuôin, war Öebbi. Temêemmalem di tmeddurt n ddunit, sinna, ass n tnekra, kra degwen ad nekôen wiyav, kra ad xzun wiyav. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi usellak".

ayahs.text: Iumen it Luî. Inna: "nek, d iminig ar Mass iw. Ih, Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".
ayahs.translation: Iumen it Luî. Inna: "nek, d iminig ar Mass iw. Ih, Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab".

ayahs.text: N$at it s Isêaq akked Yaâqub. I tarwas, Nefka lambiyya, Tazmamt. Nefka yas taqviât is, di ddunit; u neppa, di laxeôt, war ccekk, seg iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: N$at it s Isêaq akked Yaâqub. I tarwas, Nefka lambiyya, Tazmamt. Nefka yas taqviât is, di ddunit; u neppa, di laxeôt, war ccekk, seg iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "ih, aql akwen la txedmem lâaô, ur ixdim yiwen, zik, deg imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Luî, mi inna i ugdud is: "ih, aql akwen la txedmem lâaô, ur ixdim yiwen, zik, deg imavalen.

ayahs.text: La teppeddum, ih, ar irgazen, tgezzmem abrid, txeddmem ayen icemten, deg igrawen nnwen". Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi nnan: "awi a$ d aâaqeb n Öebbi, ma telliv seg wid issawalen tidep".
ayahs.translation: La teppeddum, ih, ar irgazen, tgezzmem abrid, txeddmem ayen icemten, deg igrawen nnwen". Tiririt n ugdud is, siwa mi nnan: "awi a$ d aâaqeb n Öebbi, ma telliv seg wid issawalen tidep".

ayahs.text: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi afus, mgal agdud ifessaden".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "a Mass iw! Efk iyi afus, mgal agdud ifessaden".

ayahs.text: Mi d usan imceggâen nne£, ar Ibôahim, s ubecceô, nnan as: "ih, a Nesqucc imezda$ n temdint agi. Imezda$ is, s tidep, d imednas".
ayahs.translation: Mi d usan imceggâen nne£, ar Ibôahim, s ubecceô, nnan as: "ih, a Nesqucc imezda$ n temdint agi. Imezda$ is, s tidep, d imednas".

ayahs.text: Inna d: "ni$ degs Luî". Nnan as: "Nekwni, Neéôa sennig akw, i illan degs. A t Naâteq, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is, ara yilin seg wid igwran".
ayahs.translation: Inna d: "ni$ degs Luî". Nnan as: "Nekwni, Neéôa sennig akw, i illan degs. A t Naâteq, neppa akked twacult is, siwa tameîîut is, ara yilin seg wid igwran".

ayahs.text: Mi usan imceggâen nne£, ar Luî, i$wbel ilmend nnsen, ur izmir a ten ifukk. Nnan as: "ur ppagwad, ur $webbel. Nekwni a k Naâteq, keçç d twacult ik, siwa tameîîut ik, ara yilin seg wid igwran.
ayahs.translation: Mi usan imceggâen nne£, ar Luî, i$wbel ilmend nnsen, ur izmir a ten ifukk. Nnan as: "ur ppagwad, ur $webbel. Nekwni a k Naâteq, keçç d twacult ik, siwa tameîîut ik, ara yilin seg wid igwran.

ayahs.text: Ih, nekwni a d Nesse$li ssxev seg igenni, $ef imezda$ n temdint agi, ilmend n lâaô nnsen".
ayahs.translation: Ih, nekwni a d Nesse$li ssxev seg igenni, $ef imezda$ n temdint agi, ilmend n lâaô nnsen".

ayahs.text: Ni$ Neooa d segs, assekni iberrzen, i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Neooa d segs, assekni iberrzen, i ugdud ipmeyyizen.

ayahs.text: Ar Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi, gganit ass aneggaru, ur oouôut di tmurt d ifessaden!".
ayahs.translation: Ar Madian, gmat sen Cuâayeb. Inna: "a yagdud iw! Âabdet Öebbi, gganit ass aneggaru, ur oouôut di tmurt d ifessaden!".

ayahs.text: Nekôen t. Tewwet iten zzenzla. Gwran d, d loeppat, deg ixxamen nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Nekôen t. Tewwet iten zzenzla. Gwran d, d loeppat, deg ixxamen nnsen.

ayahs.text: Âad akked Tamud - ni$ iban awen d seg ixxamen nnsen -, icebbeê asen Cciîan igiten nnsen. Issuffe$ iten seg ubrid, nitni pfeôôioen.
ayahs.translation: Âad akked Tamud - ni$ iban awen d seg ixxamen nnsen -, icebbeê asen Cciîan igiten nnsen. Issuffe$ iten seg ubrid, nitni pfeôôioen.

ayahs.text: Qaôun, Ferâun, Haman, ni$ iusa ten id Musa, s ubeggen. Sme$wôen iman nnsen, di tmurt, ur rbiêen.
ayahs.translation: Qaôun, Ferâun, Haman, ni$ iusa ten id Musa, s ubeggen. Sme$wôen iman nnsen, di tmurt, ur rbiêen.

ayahs.text: Yal wa, Newwet it $ef ubekkav is. Llan wid iwumi Nuzen tabucivant. Llan wid i iwwet usu$u. Llan wid i Nger seddaw wakal. Llan wid i Ne$meq. Maççi d Öebbi iten idensen, d nitni i idensen iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Yal wa, Newwet it $ef ubekkav is. Llan wid iwumi Nuzen tabucivant. Llan wid i iwwet usu$u. Llan wid i Nger seddaw wakal. Llan wid i Ne$meq. Maççi d Öebbi iten idensen, d nitni i idensen iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Wid iteddun d imawlan, war Öebbi, cban rtila. Tebna tissist. Ihi, axxam ahcican mavi, d tissist n rtila, lemmer ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Wid iteddun d imawlan, war Öebbi, cban rtila. Tebna tissist. Ihi, axxam ahcican mavi, d tissist n rtila, lemmer ssinen.

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi Iéôa akw ayen u$uô naâôen, war Neppa. Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi Iéôa akw ayen u$uô naâôen, war Neppa. Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Imedyaten agi, Neppawi ten id, i l$aci. Siwa imusnawen ara ten ifehmen.
ayahs.translation: Imedyaten agi, Neppawi ten id, i l$aci. Siwa imusnawen ara ten ifehmen.

ayahs.text: Ixleq Öebbi tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ih, deg waya, assekni i lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ixleq Öebbi tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Ih, deg waya, assekni i lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Mel ayen i k id ippuweêêan si Tezmamt. Bedd i téallit. Ih, taéallit teppekkes lâaô, tuccva. War ccek, iugar ip usmekti n Öebbi. Öebbi Iéôa acu tûenâam.
ayahs.translation: Mel ayen i k id ippuweêêan si Tezmamt. Bedd i téallit. Ih, taéallit teppekkes lâaô, tuccva. War ccek, iugar ip usmekti n Öebbi. Öebbi Iéôa acu tûenâam.

ayahs.text: Ur pnamaret At Tezmamt, siwa s wawal aéidan, siwa wid degsen idensen. Init: "numen s wayen id irsen $uône$, id irsen $uôwen. Öebbi nne$, akked Öebbi nnwen, Yiwen. Nekwni $uôeS d imvuâen".
ayahs.translation: Ur pnamaret At Tezmamt, siwa s wawal aéidan, siwa wid degsen idensen. Init: "numen s wayen id irsen $uône$, id irsen $uôwen. Öebbi nne$, akked Öebbi nnwen, Yiwen. Nekwni $uôeS d imvuâen".

ayahs.text: Akka ay ed Nessers, $uôek, Tazmamt. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, umnen yis. Ger wigi, kra umnen yis. I inekôen issekniyen nne£, siwa ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay ed Nessers, $uôek, Tazmamt. Wid iwumi Nefka Tazmamt, umnen yis. Ger wigi, kra umnen yis. I inekôen issekniyen nne£, siwa ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ur telliv temmalev kra n Tezmamt, uqbel tagi; ur p tepparuv, s uyeffus ik. Yili ad cukken inekkaôen.
ayahs.translation: Ur telliv temmalev kra n Tezmamt, uqbel tagi; ur p tepparuv, s uyeffus ik. Yili ad cukken inekkaôen.

ayahs.text: Xaîi, neppa d issekniyen iberrzen, deg idmaren n wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni. Siwa imednas, i inekôen issekniyen nne£.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi, neppa d issekniyen iberrzen, deg idmaren n wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni. Siwa imednas, i inekôen issekniyen nne£.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a lemmer id rsen fellas, issekniyen s$uô Mass is"! Ini: "issekniyen ar Öebbi kan. Nek, d aneddaô kan, ipbegginen".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a lemmer id rsen fellas, issekniyen s$uô Mass is"! Ini: "issekniyen ar Öebbi kan. Nek, d aneddaô kan, ipbegginen".

ayahs.text: Ne$, ur steqnaâen ara s trusi $uôek, s$uône£, n Tezmamt, malen asen p. Deg waya, s tidep, aêunu, akked usmekti i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Ne$, ur steqnaâen ara s trusi $uôek, s$uône£, n Tezmamt, malen asen p. Deg waya, s tidep, aêunu, akked usmekti i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "Iqadd Öebbi, d anagi gari yidwen. Issen i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Wid iumnen di tkerkas, u ugin Öebbi, widak d imexsuôen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "Iqadd Öebbi, d anagi gari yidwen. Issen i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Wid iumnen di tkerkas, u ugin Öebbi, widak d imexsuôen".

ayahs.text: Sêirin k $ef uâaqeb. Lemmer maççi d lajel ipwassnen, a ten id ias uâaqeb. Ih, a ten id ias, deqzalla, ur bnin.
ayahs.translation: Sêirin k $ef uâaqeb. Lemmer maççi d lajel ipwassnen, a ten id ias uâaqeb. Ih, a ten id ias, deqzalla, ur bnin.

ayahs.text: Sêirin k $ef uâaqeb. Ih, Loahennama a ppezzi i ijehliyen
ayahs.translation: Sêirin k $ef uâaqeb. Ih, Loahennama a ppezzi i ijehliyen

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ar asen isbur uâaqeb, sennig sen, akw seddaw ivaôen nnsen, ad Yini: "jeôôbet ayen txeddmem".
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ar asen isbur uâaqeb, sennig sen, akw seddaw ivaôen nnsen, ad Yini: "jeôôbet ayen txeddmem".

ayahs.text: A yimdanen iW iumnen, ni$ tamurt iW tewsaâ. Ihi, âabdet iyI, Nek.
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen iW iumnen, ni$ tamurt iW tewsaâ. Ihi, âabdet iyI, Nek.

ayahs.text: Yal iman, ad ijeôôeb tameppant; sinna, $uône£ a d tu$alem.
ayahs.translation: Yal iman, ad ijeôôeb tameppant; sinna, $uône£ a d tu$alem.

ayahs.text: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Nerr tanezdu$t di Loennet m t$uôfatin, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen, degs ad wekkôen. D asaâdi warraz n wid ixedmen lxiô,
ayahs.translation: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad asen Nerr tanezdu$t di Loennet m t$uôfatin, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen, degs ad wekkôen. D asaâdi warraz n wid ixedmen lxiô,

ayahs.text: wid iûebôen, ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen.
ayahs.translation: wid iûebôen, ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen.

ayahs.text: Acêal n lewêuc, ur d neppawi ôôeéq nnsen. Öebbi Iôeéq iten, u Iôeéq ikwen. Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Acêal n lewêuc, ur d neppawi ôôeéq nnsen. Öebbi Iôeéq iten, u Iôeéq ikwen. Neppa, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i Inuben s yiîij akked waggur"? A d inin, war ccekk: "d Öebbi". Ihi, acimi wexxôen?
ayahs.translation: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, i Inuben s yiîij akked waggur"? A d inin, war ccekk: "d Öebbi". Ihi, acimi wexxôen?

ayahs.text: Öebbi Issugut l$it i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u Iwezzen as. Ih, Öebbi Issen yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Issugut l$it i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, u Iwezzen as. Ih, Öebbi Issen yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa id Isse$layen aman seg igenni, Issidir yissen akal, deffir tmeppant is"? A d inin, war ccekk, "d Öebbi". Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi". Maca, tegwti degsen, ur fhimen.
ayahs.translation: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa id Isse$layen aman seg igenni, Issidir yissen akal, deffir tmeppant is"? A d inin, war ccekk, "d Öebbi". Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi". Maca, tegwti degsen, ur fhimen.

ayahs.text: Tameddurt agi, di ddunit, siwa lhawiyya, d wurar. D axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, ay d amuddir, lemmer éôin.
ayahs.translation: Tameddurt agi, di ddunit, siwa lhawiyya, d wurar. D axxam aneggaru, war ccekk, ay d amuddir, lemmer éôin.

ayahs.text: Mara rekben di lbabuô, ad naâôen Öebbi, d idiniyen zeddigen $uôeS. Mi ten Isellek ar lberr, atnan la pcaraken.
ayahs.translation: Mara rekben di lbabuô, ad naâôen Öebbi, d idiniyen zeddigen $uôeS. Mi ten Isellek ar lberr, atnan la pcaraken.

ayahs.text: Ad nekôen ayen i sen Nefka, ad zhun, deqqal ad éôen.
ayahs.translation: Ad nekôen ayen i sen Nefka, ad zhun, deqqal ad éôen.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara, Nerra loamaâ n laman, wanag la pwaxvafen imdanen i sen d izzin? Day ad amnen di tkerkas, u ad nekôen l$it n Öebbi?
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara, Nerra loamaâ n laman, wanag la pwaxvafen imdanen i sen d izzin? Day ad amnen di tkerkas, u ad nekôen l$it n Öebbi?

ayahs.text: Anwa i idensen kteô: win id isnulfan tikerkas af Öebbi, ne$ win irran tidep d tikerkas, mi t id tusa? Day maççi d Loahennama ay d tanezdu$t i ijehliyen?
ayahs.translation: Anwa i idensen kteô: win id isnulfan tikerkas af Öebbi, ne$ win irran tidep d tikerkas, mi t id tusa? Day maççi d Loahennama ay d tanezdu$t i ijehliyen?

ayahs.text: Wid ijuhden ar loiha nne£, a ten Nenhu, war ccekk, s iberdan nne£. Ih, Öebbi Ippili ar lâuûam.
ayahs.translation: Wid ijuhden ar loiha nne£, a ten Nenhu, war ccekk, s iberdan nne£. Ih, Öebbi Ippili ar lâuûam.

verses.text: Alm.
verses.translation: Alm.

verses.text: IôÔöumiyen rnan ten,
verses.translation: IôÔöumiyen rnan ten,

verses.text: deg wakal aqôib mavi. Deffir lexsaôa nnsen, ad rnun,
