ayahs.text: Seg issekniyen iS: Ixelq ikwen seg wakal. Aql akwen d imdanen tembwezzâam.
ayahs.translation: Seg issekniyen iS: Ixelq ikwen seg wakal. Aql akwen d imdanen tembwezzâam.

ayahs.text: Seg issekniyen iS: Ixelq awen, segwen, tiâggaltin nnwen, a pzed$em yidsent. Irra garawen tayri, lmaênana. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
ayahs.translation: Seg issekniyen iS: Ixelq awen, segwen, tiâggaltin nnwen, a pzed$em yidsent. Irra garawen tayri, lmaênana. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.

ayahs.text: Seg issekniyen iS: lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, amgirred ger tutlayin nnwen, akked initen nnwen. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i imusnawen.
ayahs.translation: Seg issekniyen iS: lxelq n tmurt akked igenwan, amgirred ger tutlayin nnwen, akked initen nnwen. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i imusnawen.

ayahs.text: Seg issekniyen iS: ives nnwen deg iv, deg wass, anadi nnwen n lfevl iS. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud isellen.
ayahs.translation: Seg issekniyen iS: ives nnwen deg iv, deg wass, anadi nnwen n lfevl iS. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud isellen.

ayahs.text: Seg issekniyen iS: Issenâat awen lebôaq, degs tugdi, asirem. Issadar ed aman seg igenni, Issidir yissen akal, deffir tmeppant is. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.
ayahs.translation: Seg issekniyen iS: Issenâat awen lebôaq, degs tugdi, asirem. Issadar ed aman seg igenni, Issidir yissen akal, deffir tmeppant is. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud ifehmen.

ayahs.text: Seg issekniyen iS: s lameô iS, igenni akked tmurt bedden. Sinna, ma Isawel awen d, yiwen usiwel, seg wakal kunwi a d teff$em.
ayahs.translation: Seg issekniyen iS: s lameô iS, igenni akked tmurt bedden. Sinna, ma Isawel awen d, yiwen usiwel, seg wakal kunwi a d teff$em.

ayahs.text: IneS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Akken ma llan, unzen aS.
ayahs.translation: IneS i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Akken ma llan, unzen aS.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i Inezzun lxelq, sinna Ippales it id. D ayen i S isehlen mavi. IneS umedya aâlayan, di tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i Inezzun lxelq, sinna Ippales it id. D ayen i S isehlen mavi. IneS umedya aâlayan, di tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ibbwi yawen d amedya, seg iman nnwen: day tcerkem d waklan nnwen, ayen i s ikwen N$at, d$a tâadlem yidsen? Day ten teppagwadem, akken teppemyagwadem garawen? Akka ay Nepfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud ipxemmimen.
ayahs.translation: Ibbwi yawen d amedya, seg iman nnwen: day tcerkem d waklan nnwen, ayen i s ikwen N$at, d$a tâadlem yidsen? Day ten teppagwadem, akken teppemyagwadem garawen? Akka ay Nepfeûûil issekniyen i ugdud ipxemmimen.

ayahs.text: Xaîi! Wid idensen teddun d lhawiyyat nnsen, ur ssinen. Anwa ara inhun wid Itlef Öebbi? Ur sâin imâiwnen.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! Wid idensen teddun d lhawiyyat nnsen, ur ssinen. Anwa ara inhun wid Itlef Öebbi? Ur sâin imâiwnen.

ayahs.text: Smil udem ik adini ar tidep, d lxelq n Öebbi akken id Ixleq imdanen. Ur illi ubeddel, di lxelq n Öebbi. Wagi d ddin amxallef, maca, tegwti n medden ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Smil udem ik adini ar tidep, d lxelq n Öebbi akken id Ixleq imdanen. Ur illi ubeddel, di lxelq n Öebbi. Wagi d ddin amxallef, maca, tegwti n medden ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: D imvuâen iS, êezzbet aS, beddet i téallit, ur ppilit seg wid ipcaraken,
ayahs.translation: D imvuâen iS, êezzbet aS, beddet i téallit, ur ppilit seg wid ipcaraken,

ayahs.text: seg wid ifeôqen ddin nnsen. U$alen d îayfat, yal akabar icôeê s wayen isâa.
ayahs.translation: seg wid ifeôqen ddin nnsen. U$alen d îayfat, yal akabar icôeê s wayen isâa.

ayahs.text: Imdanen, ma iwwet iten wugur, ad naâôen Mass nnsen, d imvuâen iS. Sinna, ma Isêess asen aêunu, s$uôeS, a pwaliv arbaâ degsen pcaraken i Mass nnsen,
ayahs.translation: Imdanen, ma iwwet iten wugur, ad naâôen Mass nnsen, d imvuâen iS. Sinna, ma Isêess asen aêunu, s$uôeS, a pwaliv arbaâ degsen pcaraken i Mass nnsen,

ayahs.text: iwakken ad nekôen i sen Nefka. Zhut! Deqqal a ppeéôem.
ayahs.translation: iwakken ad nekôen i sen Nefka. Zhut! Deqqal a ppeéôem.

ayahs.text: Ne$ Nessader asen ed amvebbeô, i ipmeslayen $ef wayen i S pcaraken.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ Nessader asen ed amvebbeô, i ipmeslayen $ef wayen i S pcaraken.

ayahs.text: Mi Nesêess aêunu i imdanen, ad ceôêen yis. Ma têuza ten tucmip, seg wayen id urwen ifassen nnsen, ad aysen.
ayahs.translation: Mi Nesêess aêunu i imdanen, ad ceôêen yis. Ma têuza ten tucmip, seg wayen id urwen ifassen nnsen, ad aysen.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara ar Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara ar Öebbi Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Efk as leêqq is i llezm ik, i ume$bun, i win id ibbwi ubrid. Ppif akka i wid ib$an udem n Öebbi. D widak ay d imerbaê.
ayahs.translation: Efk as leêqq is i llezm ik, i ume$bun, i win id ibbwi ubrid. Ppif akka i wid ib$an udem n Öebbi. D widak ay d imerbaê.

ayahs.text: Ayen teppakem n rrba, iwakken ad issem$weô ayla n medden, ar Öebbi ur issim$uô ara. Ayen tepzekkim $ef udem n Öebbi, d ayen ara ibuôekten.
ayahs.translation: Ayen teppakem n rrba, iwakken ad issem$weô ayla n medden, ar Öebbi ur issim$uô ara. Ayen tepzekkim $ef udem n Öebbi, d ayen ara ibuôekten.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, ikwen id Ixelqen, sinna, ikwen I$aten, sinna, ara kwen In$en, sinna, ara kwen id Issidren. Day ara ixdem kra, seg waya, yiwen seg wid tepcarakem? Gedha s yiS, Aâlayan sennig wid pcaraken!
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, ikwen id Ixelqen, sinna, ikwen I$aten, sinna, ara kwen In$en, sinna, ara kwen id Issidren. Day ara ixdem kra, seg waya, yiwen seg wid tepcarakem? Gedha s yiS, Aâlayan sennig wid pcaraken!

ayahs.text: Ivehô ed lefsad di lberr u di yill seg wayen id urwen ifassen n medden, iwakken ad Isukk fellasen kra seg wayen xedmen, amar a d u$alen s abrid.
ayahs.translation: Ivehô ed lefsad di lberr u di yill seg wayen id urwen ifassen n medden, iwakken ad Isukk fellasen kra seg wayen xedmen, amar a d u$alen s abrid.

ayahs.text: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, muqlet amek tevôa d imezwura. Tegwti, segsen, pcaraken".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "iniget di tmurt, muqlet amek tevôa d imezwura. Tegwti, segsen, pcaraken".

ayahs.text: Err udem ik ar ddin amxallef, uqbel a d ias s$uô Öebbi, ass ur nepwexxiô. Assen, ad pwaferzen.
ayahs.translation: Err udem ik ar ddin amxallef, uqbel a d ias s$uô Öebbi, ass ur nepwexxiô. Assen, ad pwaferzen.

ayahs.text: Win ijehlen, tijehli s mgal is; wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, gemren i iman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Win ijehlen, tijehli s mgal is; wid ixeddmen ayen ilhan, gemren i iman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad Ikafi, s lfevl iS, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad Ikafi, s lfevl iS, wid iumnen u xeddmen ayen ilhan. Neppa, s tidep, ur Iêemmel ara ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Seg issekniyen iS: Ippazen ed avu abcir, ad awen Isêess, cwiî, seg uêunu S; ad iaâjel lbabuô, s lameô iS. A pnadim lfevl iS, amar a ppesnemmrem.
ayahs.translation: Seg issekniyen iS: Ippazen ed avu abcir, ad awen Isêess, cwiî, seg uêunu S; ad iaâjel lbabuô, s lameô iS. A pnadim lfevl iS, amar a ppesnemmrem.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed, uqbel ik, imazanen i igduden nnsen. Usan ten id, s ubeggen. Nerra d ppaô seg wid ibe$wven. Aslak n lmumnin d lwaoeb nne£.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed, uqbel ik, imazanen i igduden nnsen. Usan ten id, s ubeggen. Nerra d ppaô seg wid ibe$wven. Aslak n lmumnin d lwaoeb nne£.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, id Ippaznen avu isselêayen asigna, a t ifser, deg igenni, akken i S ihwa, a t Issemfaôeq, a pwaliv ageffur a d iteffe$ segs. Mi t Issawev ar wid i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, a ten tafev ceôêen.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, id Ippaznen avu isselêayen asigna, a t ifser, deg igenni, akken i S ihwa, a t Issemfaôeq, a pwaliv ageffur a d iteffe$ segs. Mi t Issawev ar wid i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, a ten tafev ceôêen.

ayahs.text: Wanag, iu$ lêal, llan uysen, uqbel ad asen d i$li.
ayahs.translation: Wanag, iu$ lêal, llan uysen, uqbel ad asen d i$li.

ayahs.text: Wali lateô uêunu n Öebbi: amek id Issidir akal, deffir tmeppant is. Ih, d Win, s tidep, i Issidiren lmeggtin. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Wali lateô uêunu n Öebbi: amek id Issidir akal, deffir tmeppant is. Ih, d Win, s tidep, i Issidiren lmeggtin. Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Mara Nazen avu, ara walin ippiwôi$, a pdum, deffir es, tjehli nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Mara Nazen avu, ara walin ippiwôi$, a pdum, deffir es, tjehli nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ma d keçç, s tidep, ur tezmirev a pperrev lmeggtin ad slen, ne$ iâeééugen ad slen i tnaâôit, ma u$alen $er deffir.
ayahs.translation: Ma d keçç, s tidep, ur tezmirev a pperrev lmeggtin ad slen, ne$ iâeééugen ad slen i tnaâôit, ma u$alen $er deffir.

ayahs.text: Ur tezmirev a penhuv ider$alen, mgal ttelfan nnsen. Ara terrev ad ak slen, siwa wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£. Nitni d imvuâen.
ayahs.translation: Ur tezmirev a penhuv ider$alen, mgal ttelfan nnsen. Ara terrev ad ak slen, siwa wid iumnen s issekniyen nne£. Nitni d imvuâen.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, ikwen Ixelqen si ôehfan; sinna, deffir ôehfan, Irra tazmert; sinna, deffir tezmert, Irra ôehfan, akked ccib. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Neppa d Amusnaw, d Aêernuk.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, ikwen Ixelqen si ôehfan; sinna, deffir ôehfan, Irra tazmert; sinna, deffir tezmert, Irra ôehfan, akked ccib. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Neppa d Amusnaw, d Aêernuk.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara d ijbu yimir, ad gallen ibe$wviyen, ar siwa saâa segmi mmuten. Akka ay skiddiben.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d ijbu yimir, ad gallen ibe$wviyen, ar siwa saâa segmi mmuten. Akka ay skiddiben.

ayahs.text: Ad inin wid iwumi teppunefk tussna, akked liman: "ni$ teqqimem di Tezmamt n Öebbi, ar ass n tnekra. Wagi d ass n tnekra, maca tellam ur tessinem".
ayahs.translation: Ad inin wid iwumi teppunefk tussna, akked liman: "ni$ teqqimem di Tezmamt n Öebbi, ar ass n tnekra. Wagi d ass n tnekra, maca tellam ur tessinem".

ayahs.text: Assen, wid idensen, ur ten tepsellik nndama ne$ asuter n ssmaê.
ayahs.translation: Assen, wid idensen, ur ten tepsellik nndama ne$ asuter n ssmaê.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nefka, i medden, yal amedya di Leqwôan agi. Maca, mi sen d tebbwiv assekni, ad ak inin, war ccekk, wid ijehlen: "kunwi d wid ireoonen".
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka, i medden, yal amedya di Leqwôan agi. Maca, mi sen d tebbwiv assekni, ad ak inin, war ccekk, wid ijehlen: "kunwi d wid ireoonen".

ayahs.text: Akka i Iselle$ Öebbi ulawen n wid ur nessin.
ayahs.translation: Akka i Iselle$ Öebbi ulawen n wid ur nessin.

ayahs.text: Eûbeô, ih, lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ur k sêirin, wid ur nepputebbet!
ayahs.translation: Eûbeô, ih, lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ur k sêirin, wid ur nepputebbet!

verses.text: Alm.
verses.translation: Alm.

verses.text: Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt tuûwibt;
verses.translation: Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt tuûwibt;

verses.text: d nnhaya u d aêunu i iâaôviyen,
verses.translation: d nnhaya u d aêunu i iâaôviyen,

verses.text: wid ibedden i téallit, ipzekkin, ipputebbten af laxeôt.
verses.translation: wid ibedden i téallit, ipzekkin, ipputebbten af laxeôt.

verses.text: Wigi, di nnhaya s$uô Mass nnsen. Wigi, d isaâdiyen.
verses.translation: Wigi, di nnhaya s$uô Mass nnsen. Wigi, d isaâdiyen.

verses.text: Ger yimdanen, wid ippa$en awal n zzhu, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid n Öebbi, war tamusni. U fellas ttihin. I wigi, aâaqeb isdullun.
verses.translation: Ger yimdanen, wid ippa$en awal n zzhu, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid n Öebbi, war tamusni. U fellas ttihin. I wigi, aâaqeb isdullun.

verses.text: Ma mlan as issekniyen nne£, ad ibren s tem$weô, amzun ur asen isli, amzun âaégen as imeééu$en. Xebbeô it s uâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ma mlan as issekniyen nne£, ad ibren s tem$weô, amzun ur asen isli, amzun âaégen as imeééu$en. Xebbeô it s uâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ih, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat isaâdiyen.
verses.translation: Ih, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat isaâdiyen.

verses.text: Degsen ad wekkôen. Lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Degsen ad wekkôen. Lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ixleq igenwan, war tigejda ara twalim. Irra di tmurt idurar, iwakken ur tepzenzil ara yiswen. Iwezzaâ, degs, yal lxelq. Nessader ed aman seg igenni. Nessem$i d degs, yal tayuga tukyist.
verses.translation: Ixleq igenwan, war tigejda ara twalim. Irra di tmurt idurar, iwakken ur tepzenzil ara yiswen. Iwezzaâ, degs, yal lxelq. Nessader ed aman seg igenni. Nessem$i d degs, yal tayuga tukyist.

verses.text: Wagi d lxelq n Öebbi. Sseknet iyi d, acu d xelqen wid ur nelli d Neppa. Xaîi, imednas atnan di ttelfan n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Wagi d lxelq n Öebbi. Sseknet iyi d, acu d xelqen wid ur nelli d Neppa. Xaîi, imednas atnan di ttelfan n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka i Luqman ûûwab: "snemmer Öebbi. Win isnemmiren, isnemmir kan i iman is. Ma d wid ijehlen, ihi, Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz".
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka i Luqman ûûwab: "snemmer Öebbi. Win isnemmiren, isnemmir kan i iman is. Ma d wid ijehlen, ihi, Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz".

verses.text: Mi inna Luqman i mmi s, la t isselmad: "a mmi! Ur pcarak i Öebbi. Ccerk, s tidep, d ddens abarar".
verses.translation: Mi inna Luqman i mmi s, la t isselmad: "a mmi! Ur pcarak i Öebbi. Ccerk, s tidep, d ddens abarar".

verses.text: Nweûûa amdan $ef imawlan is. Imma s temêen s tadist is. Tuîva s, sin iseggwasen. Snemmer iyI, u i imawlan ik. Tu$alin $uôI.
verses.translation: Nweûûa amdan $ef imawlan is. Imma s temêen s tadist is. Tuîva s, sin iseggwasen. Snemmer iyI, u i imawlan ik. Tu$alin $uôI.

verses.text: Ma êeppmen fellak, ad iyI tcarkev ayen ur tessinev, ur asen teddu di leb$i. Illi yidsen d uwqim di ddunit. Ddu d ubrid n wid isteôoâen $uôI. Sinna, tu$alin nnwen $uôI, ad awen Mle$ ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ma êeppmen fellak, ad iyI tcarkev ayen ur tessinev, ur asen teddu di leb$i. Illi yidsen d uwqim di ddunit. Ddu d ubrid n wid isteôoâen $uôI. Sinna, tu$alin nnwen $uôI, ad awen Mle$ ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: "Ih, a mmi, xas am taéeyt uâaqqa ucceryad, ara yilin di teéôut, ne$ deg igenwan, ne$ di tmurt, a p id Iawi Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi d Laîif, Iéôa.
verses.translation: "Ih, a mmi, xas am taéeyt uâaqqa ucceryad, ara yilin di teéôut, ne$ deg igenwan, ne$ di tmurt, a p id Iawi Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi d Laîif, Iéôa.

verses.text: A mmi, bedd i téallit, ameô lewqama, îîixxeô i wayen n dir, eûbeô i wayen ara k id iasen! Aya, s tidep, seg uâzzem i lumuô.
verses.translation: A mmi, bedd i téallit, ameô lewqama, îîixxeô i wayen n dir, eûbeô i wayen ara k id iasen! Aya, s tidep, seg uâzzem i lumuô.

verses.text: Ur sxunzuô ar medden, ur teddu di tmurt s îî$aya! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel yal imnefxi, amzuxi.
verses.translation: Ur sxunzuô ar medden, ur teddu di tmurt s îî$aya! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel yal imnefxi, amzuxi.

verses.text: Iôqiq di tikli k, ssers ûûut ik! Ni$ ûûut ucmit mavi, d win n ye$yal".
verses.translation: Iôqiq di tikli k, ssers ûûut ik! Ni$ ûûut ucmit mavi, d win n ye$yal".

verses.text: Day ur twalam ara, Inub Öebbi fellawen s wayen akw illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt? Isserwa yawen l$it iS, uvhiô, uffir. U llan l$aci i ipnamaren $ef Öebbi, war tamusni, ne$ nnhaya, ne$ Tazmamt timnewweôt.
verses.translation: Day ur twalam ara, Inub Öebbi fellawen s wayen akw illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt? Isserwa yawen l$it iS, uvhiô, uffir. U llan l$aci i ipnamaren $ef Öebbi, war tamusni, ne$ nnhaya, ne$ Tazmamt timnewweôt.

verses.text: Ma nnan asen: "ddut akked wayen id Issader Öebbi", a d inin: "xaîi, a neddu akked wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$". I ma Cciîan atan la ten inecced ar uâaqeb n tmes?
verses.translation: Ma nnan asen: "ddut akked wayen id Issader Öebbi", a d inin: "xaîi, a neddu akked wayen id nufa ar imezwura nne$". I ma Cciîan atan la ten inecced ar uâaqeb n tmes?

verses.text: Win ifkan i Öebbi udem amvuâ, u neppa d aâeôvi, iîîef deg ufus iûeêêan mavi. Ar Öebbi, tu$alin n lumuô.
verses.translation: Win ifkan i Öebbi udem amvuâ, u neppa d aâeôvi, iîîef deg ufus iûeêêan mavi. Ar Öebbi, tu$alin n lumuô.

verses.text: Win ijehlen, ur k t$webben tjehli s! £uône£, tu$alin nnsen; ad asen Nini acu xedmen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Win ijehlen, ur k t$webben tjehli s! £uône£, tu$alin nnsen; ad asen Nini acu xedmen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: A ten Neoo ad zhun cwiî, sinna, a Nêeppem fellasen aâaqeb iwaâôen.
verses.translation: A ten Neoo ad zhun cwiî, sinna, a Nêeppem fellasen aâaqeb iwaâôen.

verses.text: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan"? A d inin, war ccekk: "d Öebbi". Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi". Maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Ma testeqûav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan"? A d inin, war ccekk: "d Öebbi". Ini: "ccekôan i Öebbi". Maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.

verses.text: I Öebbi i illan akw di tmurt akked igenwan. Ih, Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.

ayahs.text: Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt tuûwibt;
ayahs.translation: Wigi d issekniyen n Tezmamt tuûwibt;

ayahs.translation: d nnhaya u d aêunu i iâaôviyen,

ayahs.translation: wid ibedden i téallit, ipzekkin, ipputebbten af laxeôt.

ayahs.translation: Wigi, di nnhaya s$uô Mass nnsen. Wigi, d isaâdiyen.

ayahs.text: Ger yimdanen, wid ippa$en awal n zzhu, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid n Öebbi, war tamusni. U fellas ttihin. I wigi, aâaqeb isdullun.
ayahs.translation: Ger yimdanen, wid ippa$en awal n zzhu, iwakken ad nnetlafen seg ubrid n Öebbi, war tamusni. U fellas ttihin. I wigi, aâaqeb isdullun.

ayahs.translation: Ma mlan as issekniyen nne£, ad ibren s tem$weô, amzun ur asen isli, amzun âaégen as imeééu$en. Xebbeô it s uâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.translation: Ih, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat isaâdiyen.

ayahs.text: Degsen ad wekkôen. Lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Degsen ad wekkôen. Lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ixleq igenwan, war tigejda ara twalim. Irra di tmurt idurar, iwakken ur tepzenzil ara yiswen. Iwezzaâ, degs, yal lxelq. Nessader ed aman seg igenni. Nessem$i d degs, yal tayuga tukyist.
ayahs.translation: Ixleq igenwan, war tigejda ara twalim. Irra di tmurt idurar, iwakken ur tepzenzil ara yiswen. Iwezzaâ, degs, yal lxelq. Nessader ed aman seg igenni. Nessem$i d degs, yal tayuga tukyist.

ayahs.text: Wagi d lxelq n Öebbi. Sseknet iyi d, acu d xelqen wid ur nelli d Neppa. Xaîi, imednas atnan di ttelfan n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Wagi d lxelq n Öebbi. Sseknet iyi d, acu d xelqen wid ur nelli d Neppa. Xaîi, imednas atnan di ttelfan n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nefka i Luqman ûûwab: "snemmer Öebbi. Win isnemmiren, isnemmir kan i iman is. Ma d wid ijehlen, ihi, Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz".

ayahs.text: Mi inna Luqman i mmi s, la t isselmad: "a mmi! Ur pcarak i Öebbi. Ccerk, s tidep, d ddens abarar".
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Luqman i mmi s, la t isselmad: "a mmi! Ur pcarak i Öebbi. Ccerk, s tidep, d ddens abarar".

ayahs.text: Nweûûa amdan $ef imawlan is. Imma s temêen s tadist is. Tuîva s, sin iseggwasen. Snemmer iyI, u i imawlan ik. Tu$alin $uôI.

ayahs.text: Ur sxunzuô ar medden, ur teddu di tmurt s îî$aya! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel yal imnefxi, amzuxi.
ayahs.translation: Ur sxunzuô ar medden, ur teddu di tmurt s îî$aya! Öebbi, s tidep, ur Iêemmel yal imnefxi, amzuxi.

verses.text: Tarusi n Tezmamt, ur illi degs ccekk, s$uô Mass imavalen.
verses.translation: Tarusi n Tezmamt, ur illi degs ccekk, s$uô Mass imavalen.

verses.translation: Ne$ a d inin: "isnulfa p id". Xaîi, neppat, d tidep s$uô Mass ik, iwakken a pnedôev agdud u$uô ur d iusi ara uneddaô, uqbel ik, amar ad pwanhun.

verses.text: Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di sdis wussan; sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Ur tesâim, war Neppa, bab, ne$ amcafaâ. Day ula d tesmektayem ara?
verses.translation: Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di sdis wussan; sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Ur tesâim, war Neppa, bab, ne$ amcafaâ. Day ula d tesmektayem ara?

verses.text: A d Iseyyi lameô seg igenni ar tmurt; sinna, ad iu$al $uôeS deg ibwass, lmudda s: agim iseggwasen, s leêsab nnwen.
verses.translation: A d Iseyyi lameô seg igenni ar tmurt; sinna, ad iu$al $uôeS deg ibwass, lmudda s: agim iseggwasen, s leêsab nnwen.

verses.text: Akka, Umusnaw n wayen iffren, u n wayen ur neffir, Uzmir Ipêunun.
verses.translation: Akka, Umusnaw n wayen iffren, u n wayen ur neffir, Uzmir Ipêunun.

verses.text: I Iûûegmen akw ayen Ixleq. Inza d lxelq n umdan, si talaxt.
verses.translation: I Iûûegmen akw ayen Ixleq. Inza d lxelq n umdan, si talaxt.

verses.text: Sinna, Issuffe$ ed tarwa s si l$ella, degs cwiî n waman.
verses.translation: Sinna, Issuffe$ ed tarwa s si l$ella, degs cwiî n waman.

verses.text: Sinna, Imesl it, Iûûuv degs, si ôôuê iS. Irra yawen timesliwt, iéôi, ul. Drus ay tesnemmirem.
verses.translation: Sinna, Imesl it, Iûûuv degs, si ôôuê iS. Irra yawen timesliwt, iéôi, ul. Drus ay tesnemmirem.

verses.text: Nnan: "ma nweddeô di tmurt, day a d nepwaxleq tikelt nniven"? Xaîi, nekôen timlilit akked Mass nnsen.
verses.translation: Nnan: "ma nweddeô di tmurt, day a d nepwaxleq tikelt nniven"? Xaîi, nekôen timlilit akked Mass nnsen.

verses.text: Ini: "ad iddem ôôuê nnwen, lmelk n tmeppant i ippukelfen fellawen. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen a ppu$alem".
verses.translation: Ini: "ad iddem ôôuê nnwen, lmelk n tmeppant i ippukelfen fellawen. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen a ppu$alem".

verses.text: Lemmer a pwaliv ibe$wviyen, ad brun i iqweôôa nnsen, zdat Mass nnsen: "a Mass nne$! Nwala, nesla; Err ane$ a nexdem ayen ilhan. S tidep, numen".

verses.text: Lemmer i £ ihwi, yili Nefka, i yal ôôuê, nnhaya s. Maca, ad ivôu wayen Nni$: "war ccekk, ad Acaôe$ Loahennama s leonun akked yimdanen, mejmulen".
verses.translation: Lemmer i £ ihwi, yili Nefka, i yal ôôuê, nnhaya s. Maca, ad ivôu wayen Nni$: "war ccekk, ad Acaôe$ Loahennama s leonun akked yimdanen, mejmulen".

verses.text: Ihi, jeôôbet imi teppum a d temlilem d wass nnwen agi! Nekwni, ih, Neppu kwen. Jeôôbet aâaqeb, n lebda, ilmend n wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ihi, jeôôbet imi teppum a d temlilem d wass nnwen agi! Nekwni, ih, Neppu kwen. Jeôôbet aâaqeb, n lebda, ilmend n wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: I iumnen kan, s issekniyen nne£, d wid, mara ten id mmektin, ara weddin ad knun, ara isbucuâen Mass nnsen s ccekôan, nitni ur pzuxxun.
verses.translation: I iumnen kan, s issekniyen nne£, d wid, mara ten id mmektin, ara weddin ad knun, ara isbucuâen Mass nnsen s ccekôan, nitni ur pzuxxun.

verses.translation: Ppensaren d ibeôdiyen nnsen, seg imîeôêen, pnujun $eô Mass nnsen, s tugwdi d usirem. Seg wayen iten N$at, pseddiqen.

verses.text: Ur iéôi yiwen acu i sen Ffre$ n lfeôê. D arraz n wayen llan xeddmen.
verses.translation: Ur iéôi yiwen acu i sen Ffre$ n lfeôê. D arraz n wayen llan xeddmen.

verses.text: Win illan d lmumen, day am win illan d amed$ul? Ur aâdilen.
verses.translation: Win illan d lmumen, day am win illan d amed$ul? Ur aâdilen.

verses.text: Ihi, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat imôaêbiyen, ara zed$en, ilmend n wayen xeddmeùn.
verses.translation: Ihi, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat imôaêbiyen, ara zed$en, ilmend n wayen xeddmeùn.

verses.text: Wanag wid ide$wlen, di tmes ara zed$en. Yal tikelt ideg ara b$un a d ff$en segs, a ten rren $uôes, ad asen inin: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmes i tnekkôem".
verses.translation: Wanag wid ide$wlen, di tmes ara zed$en. Yal tikelt ideg ara b$un a d ff$en segs, a ten rren $uôes, ad asen inin: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmes i tnekkôem".

verses.text: Ih, a Nessukk fellasen aâaqeb aqôib mavi, war aâaqeb abarar. Ahat a d u$alen s abrid.
verses.translation: Ih, a Nessukk fellasen aâaqeb aqôib mavi, war aâaqeb abarar. Ahat a d u$alen s abrid.

verses.text: Anwa i idensen sennig n win iwumi d dekôen issekniyen n Mass is, iu$al iwexxeô asen? Ih, a d Nerr ppaô seg ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: Anwa i idensen sennig n win iwumi d dekôen issekniyen n Mass is, iu$al iwexxeô asen? Ih, a d Nerr ppaô seg ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa. Ur ppili di ccekk af temlilit yideS! Nerra p d nnhaya i At Isôail.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa. Ur ppili di ccekk af temlilit yideS! Nerra p d nnhaya i At Isôail.

verses.text: Nesbedd, segsen, iselmaden; nnehun s lameô nne£, mi ûebôen, u llan pputebbten $ef issekniyen nne£.
verses.translation: Nesbedd, segsen, iselmaden; nnehun s lameô nne£, mi ûebôen, u llan pputebbten $ef issekniyen nne£.

verses.text: Ih, Mass ik, Neppa, ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.
verses.translation: Ih, Mass ik, Neppa, ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.

verses.text: Day ur ten inha ara wayen Nesqucc isuta, uqbel nnsen? La leêêun $ef tnezdu$in nnsen. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen. Day ur sellen ara?
verses.translation: Day ur ten inha ara wayen Nesqucc isuta, uqbel nnsen? La leêêun $ef tnezdu$in nnsen. Deg waya, s tidep, issekniyen. Day ur sellen ara?

verses.text: Day ur zôin ara Neppawi aman s akal aquôan; Nessuffu$ ed, yissen, iâaqqayen; teppen, segsen, nitni akked lmal nnsen. Day ur pwalin ara?
verses.translation: Day ur zôin ara Neppawi aman s akal aquôan; Nessuffu$ ed, yissen, iâaqqayen; teppen, segsen, nitni akked lmal nnsen. Day ur pwalin ara?

verses.text: Qqaôen: "melmi l$elb agi, ma tessawalem tidep"?
verses.translation: Qqaôen: "melmi l$elb agi, ma tessawalem tidep"?

verses.text: Ini: "ass n l$elb, liman n wid ijehlen, ur ten infaâ; ur pganin".
verses.translation: Ini: "ass n l$elb, liman n wid ijehlen, ur ten infaâ; ur pganin".

verses.text: Ihi, wexxeô asen, ggani. Nitni, s tidep, la pganin.
verses.translation: Ihi, wexxeô asen, ggani. Nitni, s tidep, la pganin.

ayahs.text: Alm.
ayahs.translation: Alm.

ayahs.text: Tarusi n Tezmamt, ur illi degs ccekk, s$uô Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Tarusi n Tezmamt, ur illi degs ccekk, s$uô Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: Ne$ a d inin: "isnulfa p id". Xaîi, neppat, d tidep s$uô Mass ik, iwakken a pnedôev agdud u$uô ur d iusi ara uneddaô, uqbel ik, amar ad pwanhun.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ a d inin: "isnulfa p id". Xaîi, neppat, d tidep s$uô Mass ik, iwakken a pnedôev agdud u$uô ur d iusi ara uneddaô, uqbel ik, amar ad pwanhun.

ayahs.text: Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di sdis wussan; sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Ur tesâim, war Neppa, bab, ne$ amcafaâ. Day ula d tesmektayem ara?
ayahs.translation: Öebbi i Ixelqen tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, di sdis wussan; sinna, Iâannec $ef usgeld. Ur tesâim, war Neppa, bab, ne$ amcafaâ. Day ula d tesmektayem ara?

ayahs.text: A d Iseyyi lameô seg igenni ar tmurt; sinna, ad iu$al $uôeS deg ibwass, lmudda s: agim iseggwasen, s leêsab nnwen.
ayahs.translation: A d Iseyyi lameô seg igenni ar tmurt; sinna, ad iu$al $uôeS deg ibwass, lmudda s: agim iseggwasen, s leêsab nnwen.

ayahs.text: Akka, Umusnaw n wayen iffren, u n wayen ur neffir, Uzmir Ipêunun.
ayahs.translation: Akka, Umusnaw n wayen iffren, u n wayen ur neffir, Uzmir Ipêunun.

ayahs.text: I Iûûegmen akw ayen Ixleq. Inza d lxelq n umdan, si talaxt.
ayahs.translation: I Iûûegmen akw ayen Ixleq. Inza d lxelq n umdan, si talaxt.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Issuffe$ ed tarwa s si l$ella, degs cwiî n waman.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Issuffe$ ed tarwa s si l$ella, degs cwiî n waman.

ayahs.text: Sinna, Imesl it, Iûûuv degs, si ôôuê iS. Irra yawen timesliwt, iéôi, ul. Drus ay tesnemmirem.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, Imesl it, Iûûuv degs, si ôôuê iS. Irra yawen timesliwt, iéôi, ul. Drus ay tesnemmirem.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "ma nweddeô di tmurt, day a d nepwaxleq tikelt nniven"? Xaîi, nekôen timlilit akked Mass nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "ma nweddeô di tmurt, day a d nepwaxleq tikelt nniven"? Xaîi, nekôen timlilit akked Mass nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ad iddem ôôuê nnwen, lmelk n tmeppant i ippukelfen fellawen. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen a ppu$alem".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ad iddem ôôuê nnwen, lmelk n tmeppant i ippukelfen fellawen. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen a ppu$alem".

ayahs.text: Lemmer a pwaliv ibe$wviyen, ad brun i iqweôôa nnsen, zdat Mass nnsen: "a Mass nne$! Nwala, nesla; Err ane$ a nexdem ayen ilhan. S tidep, numen".
ayahs.translation: Lemmer a pwaliv ibe$wviyen, ad brun i iqweôôa nnsen, zdat Mass nnsen: "a Mass nne$! Nwala, nesla; Err ane$ a nexdem ayen ilhan. S tidep, numen".

ayahs.text: Lemmer i £ ihwi, yili Nefka, i yal ôôuê, nnhaya s. Maca, ad ivôu wayen Nni$: "war ccekk, ad Acaôe$ Loahennama s leonun akked yimdanen, mejmulen".
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i £ ihwi, yili Nefka, i yal ôôuê, nnhaya s. Maca, ad ivôu wayen Nni$: "war ccekk, ad Acaôe$ Loahennama s leonun akked yimdanen, mejmulen".

ayahs.text: Ihi, jeôôbet imi teppum a d temlilem d wass nnwen agi! Nekwni, ih, Neppu kwen. Jeôôbet aâaqeb, n lebda, ilmend n wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ihi, jeôôbet imi teppum a d temlilem d wass nnwen agi! Nekwni, ih, Neppu kwen. Jeôôbet aâaqeb, n lebda, ilmend n wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: I iumnen kan, s issekniyen nne£, d wid, mara ten id mmektin, ara weddin ad knun, ara isbucuâen Mass nnsen s ccekôan, nitni ur pzuxxun.
ayahs.translation: I iumnen kan, s issekniyen nne£, d wid, mara ten id mmektin, ara weddin ad knun, ara isbucuâen Mass nnsen s ccekôan, nitni ur pzuxxun.

ayahs.text: Ppensaren d ibeôdiyen nnsen, seg imîeôêen, pnujun $eô Mass nnsen, s tugwdi d usirem. Seg wayen iten N$at, pseddiqen.
ayahs.translation: Ppensaren d ibeôdiyen nnsen, seg imîeôêen, pnujun $eô Mass nnsen, s tugwdi d usirem. Seg wayen iten N$at, pseddiqen.

ayahs.text: Ur iéôi yiwen acu i sen Ffre$ n lfeôê. D arraz n wayen llan xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Ur iéôi yiwen acu i sen Ffre$ n lfeôê. D arraz n wayen llan xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Win illan d lmumen, day am win illan d amed$ul? Ur aâdilen.
ayahs.translation: Win illan d lmumen, day am win illan d amed$ul? Ur aâdilen.

ayahs.text: Ihi, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat imôaêbiyen, ara zed$en, ilmend n wayen xeddmeùn.
ayahs.translation: Ihi, i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, leonanat imôaêbiyen, ara zed$en, ilmend n wayen xeddmeùn.

ayahs.translation: Wanag wid ide$wlen, di tmes ara zed$en. Yal tikelt ideg ara b$un a d ff$en segs, a ten rren $uôes, ad asen inin: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmes i tnekkôem".

ayahs.translation: Ih, a Nessukk fellasen aâaqeb aqôib mavi, war aâaqeb abarar. Ahat a d u$alen s abrid.

ayahs.translation: Anwa i idensen sennig n win iwumi d dekôen issekniyen n Mass is, iu$al iwexxeô asen? Ih, a d Nerr ppaô seg ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa. Ur ppili di ccekk af temlilit yideS! Nerra p d nnhaya i At Isôail.

ayahs.translation: Nesbedd, segsen, iselmaden; nnehun s lameô nne£, mi ûebôen, u llan pputebbten $ef issekniyen nne£.

ayahs.translation: Ih, Mass ik, Neppa, ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.

ayahs.translation: Day ur zôin ara Neppawi aman s akal aquôan; Nessuffu$ ed, yissen, iâaqqayen; teppen, segsen, nitni akked lmal nnsen. Day ur pwalin ara?

ayahs.translation: Qqaôen: "melmi l$elb agi, ma tessawalem tidep"?

ayahs.translation: Ini: "ass n l$elb, liman n wid ijehlen, ur ten infaâ; ur pganin".

ayahs.text: Ihi, wexxeô asen, ggani. Nitni, s tidep, la pganin.
ayahs.translation: Ihi, wexxeô asen, ggani. Nitni, s tidep, la pganin.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Ëezzeb i Öebbi, ur ppa$ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Öebbi, s tidep, Izga d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Ëezzeb i Öebbi, ur ppa$ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Öebbi, s tidep, Izga d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ddu akked wayen i k d Ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass ik. Ih, Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txedmem.
verses.translation: Ddu akked wayen i k d Ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass ik. Ih, Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txedmem.

verses.text: Ppkel $ef Öebbi. Iqadd Öebbi d Awkil.
verses.translation: Ppkel $ef Öebbi. Iqadd Öebbi d Awkil.

verses.text: Ur Irra ara Öebbi sin wulawen di tfekka n urgaz. Ur Irra ara tilawin nnwen, i tmetlem ar iârar n tyimmatin nnwen, d tiyimmatin nnwen. Ur irra ara wid id tessekrem, d tarwa nnwen. Ayagi, d awal nnwen, seg imawen nnwen. Öebbi Issawal tidep. Neppa Ippawi d ubrid.
verses.translation: Ur Irra ara Öebbi sin wulawen di tfekka n urgaz. Ur Irra ara tilawin nnwen, i tmetlem ar iârar n tyimmatin nnwen, d tiyimmatin nnwen. Ur irra ara wid id tessekrem, d tarwa nnwen. Ayagi, d awal nnwen, seg imawen nnwen. Öebbi Issawal tidep. Neppa Ippawi d ubrid.

verses.text: Ssiwlet asen am ibabaten nnsen; akka i iwqem ar Öebbi. Ma ur tessinen ara anwi ay d ibabaten nnsen, atmaten nnwen di ddin, d iqôiben nnwen. Ur illi u$ilif $ef wayen teffalîam degs, siwa ayen âammden wulawen nnwen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ssiwlet asen am ibabaten nnsen; akka i iwqem ar Öebbi. Ma ur tessinen ara anwi ay d ibabaten nnsen, atmaten nnwen di ddin, d iqôiben nnwen. Ur illi u$ilif $ef wayen teffalîam degs, siwa ayen âammden wulawen nnwen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Nnbi iqôeb ar lmumnin, sennig iman nnsen. Tilawin is, d tiyimmatin nnsen. Wid ippemyilin, mqaôaben di Tezmamt n Öebbi, sennig lmumnin akked iminigen. Siwa ma tgam tajmilt i imeddukwal nnwen. Ayagi iura di Tezmamt.
verses.translation: Nnbi iqôeb ar lmumnin, sennig iman nnsen. Tilawin is, d tiyimmatin nnsen. Wid ippemyilin, mqaôaben di Tezmamt n Öebbi, sennig lmumnin akked iminigen. Siwa ma tgam tajmilt i imeddukwal nnwen. Ayagi iura di Tezmamt.

verses.text: Mi Neîîef si lambiyya lmitaq nnsen, u si keçç, si Nuê, Ibôahim, Musa, u si Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Neîîef segsen lmitaq lfayeq,
verses.translation: Mi Neîîef si lambiyya lmitaq nnsen, u si keçç, si Nuê, Ibôahim, Musa, u si Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Neîîef segsen lmitaq lfayeq,

verses.text: iwakken ad Iêtec imawlan n tidep, af tidep nnsen. Ihegga d, i ijehliyen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: iwakken ad Iêtec imawlan n tidep, af tidep nnsen. Ihegga d, i ijehliyen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi. Mi d usan $uôwen iâsekôiwen, Nuzen asen d avu, akked iâsekôiwen ur twalam. Öebbi Izga Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi. Mi d usan $uôwen iâsekôiwen, Nuzen asen d avu, akked iâsekôiwen ur twalam. Öebbi Izga Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Mi wen d kkan sennig wen, seddawat wen, mi zzint wallen, ulawen bbwven s ijuxax, tepmeyyizem yal ameyyez $ef Öebbi.
verses.translation: Mi wen d kkan sennig wen, seddawat wen, mi zzint wallen, ulawen bbwven s ijuxax, tepmeyyizem yal ameyyez $ef Öebbi.

verses.text: Dinna, ppwajeôôben lmumnin, enhezzen s leqseê.
verses.translation: Dinna, ppwajeôôben lmumnin, enhezzen s leqseê.

verses.text: Mi d nnan ixabiten, akked imehzulen n wul: "ay $ d Iwaââed Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, siwa a$uôôu".
verses.translation: Mi d nnan ixabiten, akked imehzulen n wul: "ay $ d Iwaââed Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, siwa a$uôôu".

verses.text: Mi d inna urbaâ segsen: "a yAt Yatrib, ur illi umekkan i kunwi, u$alet"! Kra segsen ssutren tsriê i Nnbi, nnan: "ih, ixxamen nne$ aâran". Nitni, ur llin aâran, b$an kan ad rewlen.
verses.translation: Mi d inna urbaâ segsen: "a yAt Yatrib, ur illi umekkan i kunwi, u$alet"! Kra segsen ssutren tsriê i Nnbi, nnan: "ih, ixxamen nne$ aâran". Nitni, ur llin aâran, b$an kan ad rewlen.

verses.text: Ma kecmen ten id, si leriaf is, sinna, ssutren asen ad xubten, ad xubten. Cwiî kan ara kukrun fellas.
verses.translation: Ma kecmen ten id, si leriaf is, sinna, ssutren asen ad xubten, ad xubten. Cwiî kan ara kukrun fellas.

verses.text: Ni$ llan âuhden s Öebbi, uqbel, ar ur ppu$alen ar deffir. Aâahed s Öebbi ad ippuqeîîi!
verses.translation: Ni$ llan âuhden s Öebbi, uqbel, ar ur ppu$alen ar deffir. Aâahed s Öebbi ad ippuqeîîi!

verses.text: Ini: "ur kwen tenfaâ trewla, ma trewlem si tmeppant, ne$ si îôad. Ara tezhum, siwa tallit wezzilen".
verses.translation: Ini: "ur kwen tenfaâ trewla, ma trewlem si tmeppant, ne$ si îôad. Ara tezhum, siwa tallit wezzilen".

verses.text: Ini: "anwa wa, ara kwen ikksen seg ufus n Öebbi, ma Ib$a yawen cceôô, ne$ Ib$a yawen aêunu"? Ur asen ppafen, war Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.
verses.translation: Ini: "anwa wa, ara kwen ikksen seg ufus n Öebbi, ma Ib$a yawen cceôô, ne$ Ib$a yawen aêunu"? Ur asen ppafen, war Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.

verses.text: Ni$ Öebbi Iéôa wid degwen, i ipâawwiqen, wid iqqaôen i watmaten nnsen: "Yyat $uône$"! Drus kan degsen, i ikecmen îôad.
verses.translation: Ni$ Öebbi Iéôa wid degwen, i ipâawwiqen, wid iqqaôen i watmaten nnsen: "Yyat $uône$"! Drus kan degsen, i ikecmen îôad.

verses.text: D imceêêiyen ar loiha nnwen. Ma tusa d tugdi, a ten twaliv la k pmuqulen, tezzint wallen nnsen, am win tessexciwit tmeppant. Ma tekkes tugdi, a kwen gezren s yilsawen uqviâen. D imceêêiyen $ef lxiô. Wigi, ur uminen ara. Ihi, Imêa Öebbi igiten nnsen. Ayagi, d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.
verses.translation: D imceêêiyen ar loiha nnwen. Ma tusa d tugdi, a ten twaliv la k pmuqulen, tezzint wallen nnsen, am win tessexciwit tmeppant. Ma tekkes tugdi, a kwen gezren s yilsawen uqviâen. D imceêêiyen $ef lxiô. Wigi, ur uminen ara. Ihi, Imêa Öebbi igiten nnsen. Ayagi, d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.

verses.text: £ilen ikabaren ur ôuêen ara. Lemmer a d asen ikabaren, ad ssirmen, ar nitni, di ûûeêôa ay llan, ar Waâôaben n ucluê, steqsayen fellawen. Lemmer llan yidwen, cwiî kan ara nna$en.
verses.translation: £ilen ikabaren ur ôuêen ara. Lemmer a d asen ikabaren, ad ssirmen, ar nitni, di ûûeêôa ay llan, ar Waâôaben n ucluê, steqsayen fellawen. Lemmer llan yidwen, cwiî kan ara nna$en.

verses.text: Ni$, i kunwi, Amazan n Öebbi d amedya amxallef i win ippaôoun Öebbi, akked was aneggaru, id ismektayen aîas Öebbi.
verses.translation: Ni$, i kunwi, Amazan n Öebbi d amedya amxallef i win ippaôoun Öebbi, akked was aneggaru, id ismektayen aîas Öebbi.

verses.text: Mi walan lmumnin ikabaren, nnan: "ayagi d ayen i $ d Iwaââed Öebbi, akked Umazan iS. Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, Ssawlen tidep". Ay sen irna kan, siwa liman akked wannuz.
verses.translation: Mi walan lmumnin ikabaren, nnan: "ayagi d ayen i $ d Iwaââed Öebbi, akked Umazan iS. Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, Ssawlen tidep". Ay sen irna kan, siwa liman akked wannuz.

verses.text: Ger lmumnin, llan irgazen i iîîfen deg wayen i$ef âuhden Öebbi. Garasen, wid iêellen timeôoiwt nnsen, garasen wid ipganin. Ur bedlen mavi.
verses.translation: Ger lmumnin, llan irgazen i iîîfen deg wayen i$ef âuhden Öebbi. Garasen, wid iêellen timeôoiwt nnsen, garasen wid ipganin. Ur bedlen mavi.

verses.text: Iwakken ad Ikafi Öebbi imawlan n tidep, $ef tidep nnsen, u ad Iâaqeb ixabiten, ma ihwa yaS, ne$ ad asen Issuref. Ih, Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Iwakken ad Ikafi Öebbi imawlan n tidep, $ef tidep nnsen, u ad Iâaqeb ixabiten, ma ihwa yaS, ne$ ad asen Issuref. Ih, Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Iééaâ Öebbi wid ijehlen, s iêecciô nnsen. Ur ppaddamen lxiô. Issuli Öebbi îôad i lmumnin. Öebbi Izga d Uohid, d Uzmir.
verses.translation: Iééaâ Öebbi wid ijehlen, s iêecciô nnsen. Ur ppaddamen lxiô. Issuli Öebbi îôad i lmumnin. Öebbi Izga d Uohid, d Uzmir.

verses.text: Issers ed, si lebôuj nnsen, wid i sen ifkan afus, seg wAt Tezmamt. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Arbaâ ten$am ten, arbaâ têebsem ten.
verses.translation: Issers ed, si lebôuj nnsen, wid i sen ifkan afus, seg wAt Tezmamt. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Arbaâ ten$am ten, arbaâ têebsem ten.

verses.text: Irra kwen tweôtem akal nnsen, ixxamen nnsen, ayla nnsen. D akal ur taâfisem. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Irra kwen tweôtem akal nnsen, ixxamen nnsen, ayla nnsen. D akal ur taâfisem. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik: "maday teb$amt tameddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuê is, yyamt a kwent $ite$, ad a kwent bru$, berru umâin.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik: "maday teb$amt tameddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuê is, yyamt a kwent $ite$, ad a kwent bru$, berru umâin.

verses.text: Ma illa teb$amt Öebbi, Amazan iS, akked uxxam aneggaru, ihi, Ihegga d Öebbi, i tâaôviyin, segkwent, arraz ameqwôaêan".
verses.translation: Ma illa teb$amt Öebbi, Amazan iS, akked uxxam aneggaru, ihi, Ihegga d Öebbi, i tâaôviyin, segkwent, arraz ameqwôaêan".

verses.text: A tilawin n Nnbi! Tid segkwent ara iawin abekkav ufviê, a ppeppuâaqeb berdayen. Ayagi d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.
verses.translation: A tilawin n Nnbi! Tid segkwent ara iawin abekkav ufviê, a ppeppuâaqeb berdayen. Ayagi d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.

verses.text: Tin segkwent i iunzen i Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, u txeddem ayen ilhan, ad as Nefk arraz berdayen, u Nhegga yas d l$it ukyis.
verses.translation: Tin segkwent i iunzen i Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, u txeddem ayen ilhan, ad as Nefk arraz berdayen, u Nhegga yas d l$it ukyis.

verses.text: A tilawin n Nnbi! Ur tellimt am tlawin nniven. Ma têezzbemt, ur teppeccvemt deg wawal, a kwent isirem umuvin n wul. Inimt awal uwqim.
verses.translation: A tilawin n Nnbi! Ur tellimt am tlawin nniven. Ma têezzbemt, ur teppeccvemt deg wawal, a kwent isirem umuvin n wul. Inimt awal uwqim.

verses.text: Ilimt deg ixxamen nnkwent. Ur pcebbiêemt acebbeê n at war tussna imenza. èÈéalemt, zekkimt, ôavimt Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ib$a kan Öebbi a kwent ipwakkes nnkel, a tawacult n Uxxam. U, a kwent Izzizdeg nezzeh.
verses.translation: Ilimt deg ixxamen nnkwent. Ur pcebbiêemt acebbeê n at war tussna imenza. èÈéalemt, zekkimt, ôavimt Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ib$a kan Öebbi a kwent ipwakkes nnkel, a tawacult n Uxxam. U, a kwent Izzizdeg nezzeh.

verses.text: Mmektitemt ed ayen i kwent $ôan, deg ixxamen nnkwent, n issekniyen n Öebbi, akw n ûûwab. Ih, Öebbi Izga d Laîif, Ippuxebbeô.
verses.translation: Mmektitemt ed ayen i kwent $ôan, deg ixxamen nnkwent, n issekniyen n Öebbi, akw n ûûwab. Ih, Öebbi Izga d Laîif, Ippuxebbeô.

verses.text: Ih, imvuâen, timvuâin, lmumnin argaz tameîîut, itubiyen, titubiyin, wid akked tid issawalen tidep, iûebôiyen, tiûebôiyin, wid akked tid ippagwaden, wid akked tid ipseddiqen, wid akked tid ippuéumen, wid akked tid ipêaraben $ef tuzzuft nnsen, wid akked tid id immektayen aîas Öebbi; i wigi, Ihegga d Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz abarar.
verses.translation: Ih, imvuâen, timvuâin, lmumnin argaz tameîîut, itubiyen, titubiyin, wid akked tid issawalen tidep, iûebôiyen, tiûebôiyin, wid akked tid ippagwaden, wid akked tid ipseddiqen, wid akked tid ippuéumen, wid akked tid ipêaraben $ef tuzzuft nnsen, wid akked tid id immektayen aîas Öebbi; i wigi, Ihegga d Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz abarar.

verses.text: Ur issefk ara i win, ne$ tin iumnen, ad smenyafen lameô nnsen, ma Iseyya d lameô Öebbi, akked Umazan iS. Win inuqmen Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, ni$ innetlaf ttelfan n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Ur issefk ara i win, ne$ tin iumnen, ad smenyafen lameô nnsen, ma Iseyya d lameô Öebbi, akked Umazan iS. Win inuqmen Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, ni$ innetlaf ttelfan n ûûeê.

verses.text: Mi tenniv i win I$at Öebbi, u t$atev: "jmaâ $uôek, tameîîut ik, êezzeb i Öebbi"; teffrev deg iman ik, ayen ara d Isban Öebbi. Tugadev medden. D Öebbi, i iwatan a T tagwadev. Mi s ibra Zayed, Njewo ik yides, iwakken ur teppili lhejna i lmumnin, ma u$en tilawin n wid id ssekren, mara ad sent brun. Ad iûaô lameô n Öebbi.
verses.translation: Mi tenniv i win I$at Öebbi, u t$atev: "jmaâ $uôek, tameîîut ik, êezzeb i Öebbi"; teffrev deg iman ik, ayen ara d Isban Öebbi. Tugadev medden. D Öebbi, i iwatan a T tagwadev. Mi s ibra Zayed, Njewo ik yides, iwakken ur teppili lhejna i lmumnin, ma u$en tilawin n wid id ssekren, mara ad sent brun. Ad iûaô lameô n Öebbi.

verses.text: Ur telli lhejna f Nnbi, deg wayen Iêeppem fellas Öebbi; d tannumi n Öebbi $ef imezwura. Lameô n Öebbi izga ipwafta.
verses.translation: Ur telli lhejna f Nnbi, deg wayen Iêeppem fellas Öebbi; d tannumi n Öebbi $ef imezwura. Lameô n Öebbi izga ipwafta.

verses.text: Wid issawaven tibôatin n Öebbi, i T ippagwaden, ur ppagwaden yiwen, siwa Öebbi. Öebbi Iqadd i uqeîîi.
verses.translation: Wid issawaven tibôatin n Öebbi, i T ippagwaden, ur ppagwaden yiwen, siwa Öebbi. Öebbi Iqadd i uqeîîi.

verses.text: Ur illi Muêemmed d ababat n yiwen seg irgazen nnwen, maca, d Amazan n Öebbi, u d aneggaru n lambiyya. Öebbi Izga Issen yal cci.
verses.translation: Ur illi Muêemmed d ababat n yiwen seg irgazen nnwen, maca, d Amazan n Öebbi, u d aneggaru n lambiyya. Öebbi Izga Issen yal cci.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed Öebbi, maççi d izli.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed Öebbi, maççi d izli.

verses.text: Sbuccuâet eP, ûûbeê, tameddit.
verses.translation: Sbuccuâet eP, ûûbeê, tameddit.

verses.text: D Neppa i d Inuben fellawen, akked lmalayek, iwakken a kwen Issuffe$ si tillas ar tafat. Izga Ipêunu $ef lmumnin.
verses.translation: D Neppa i d Inuben fellawen, akked lmalayek, iwakken a kwen Issuffe$ si tillas ar tafat. Izga Ipêunu $ef lmumnin.

verses.text: Asmi ara T magren, azul nnsen d: "tifrat"! Ihegga yasen d arraz ukyis.
verses.translation: Asmi ara T magren, azul nnsen d: "tifrat"! Ihegga yasen d arraz ukyis.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir u d aneddaô,
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir u d aneddaô,

verses.text: i ineccden ar Öebbi, s tsriê iS; d asavef icaâlen.
verses.translation: i ineccden ar Öebbi, s tsriê iS; d asavef icaâlen.

verses.text: Becceô lmumnin s lfevl ameqwôan i nitni, s$uô Öebbi.
verses.translation: Becceô lmumnin s lfevl ameqwôan i nitni, s$uô Öebbi.

verses.text: Ur ppa$ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Ur ssemêas, i ccum nnsen. Ppkel $ef Öebbi, Iqadd Öebbi d Awkil.
verses.translation: Ur ppa$ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Ur ssemêas, i ccum nnsen. Ppkel $ef Öebbi, Iqadd Öebbi d Awkil.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em tid iumnen, sinna, tebram asent, uqbel ma tennulem tent, ur fellawen ad asent têesbem tallit. £itet pent, serrêet asent, s wudem uwqim.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em tid iumnen, sinna, tebram asent, uqbel ma tennulem tent, ur fellawen ad asent têesbem tallit. £itet pent, serrêet asent, s wudem uwqim.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Nêell ak tilawin iwumi tefkiv tiqviâen nnsent, tiklatin ik, si tid i k Iqsed Öebbi, iss is n âam ik, tid n tâamtin ik, tid n xal ik, tid n txaltin ik iunagen yidek, tameîîut iumnen, ma tefka iman is i Nnbi, ma ib$a Nnbi a p ya$. D lemziyya i keçç, war lmumnin. Ni$ Neéôa acu i sen Nseyya af tlawin nnsen, akked teklatin nnsen. Iwakken ur teppili fellak lhejna. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Nêell ak tilawin iwumi tefkiv tiqviâen nnsent, tiklatin ik, si tid i k Iqsed Öebbi, iss is n âam ik, tid n tâamtin ik, tid n xal ik, tid n txaltin ik iunagen yidek, tameîîut iumnen, ma tefka iman is i Nnbi, ma ib$a Nnbi a p ya$. D lemziyya i keçç, war lmumnin. Ni$ Neéôa acu i sen Nseyya af tlawin nnsen, akked teklatin nnsen. Iwakken ur teppili fellak lhejna. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A ppesganiv tin i k ihwan segsent. A d tawiv $uôek tin i k ihwan, ne$ tin teb$iv si tid tâazlev. Ur fellak tuzzma. Akka i iwulem, iwakken ad qenâant, ur $webbnent, ad ôavint akw, ayen i sent tefkiv. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Öebbi Izga d Amusnaw, Iêellem.
verses.translation: A ppesganiv tin i k ihwan segsent. A d tawiv $uôek tin i k ihwan, ne$ tin teb$iv si tid tâazlev. Ur fellak tuzzma. Akka i iwulem, iwakken ad qenâant, ur $webbnent, ad ôavint akw, ayen i sent tefkiv. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Öebbi Izga d Amusnaw, Iêellem.

verses.text: Ur ak êellent tlawin, sya d asawen, ne$ abeddel n tlawin, xas tâaoeb ik ûûifa nnsent, siwa tiklatin ik. Öebbi Izga Issikid yal cci.
verses.translation: Ur ak êellent tlawin, sya d asawen, ne$ abeddel n tlawin, xas tâaoeb ik ûûifa nnsent, siwa tiklatin ik. Öebbi Izga Issikid yal cci.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur keççmet ar texxamin n Nnbi, ar awen iâammed, d inebgawen ar wuççi, ur teggunim. Maca, ma tepwâaôvem, kecmet. Mi teççam, sahlet; ur ssiôxiset ameslay. Ayagi, s tidep, iqelleq Nnbi. Isetêa segwen. Öebbi ur Ipsetêi $ef tidep. Ma tessutrem asent ta$awsa, ssutret ep deffir tsabert. Yif it wakka, i tezdeg n wulawen nnwen, akked wulawen nnsent. Ur awen ilaq ara a pjjerim Amazan n Öebbi, ne$ a ppa$em tilawin is, deffir es, d awez$i. Ayagi, ad yili, ar Öebbi, d lefviêa.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur keççmet ar texxamin n Nnbi, ar awen iâammed, d inebgawen ar wuççi, ur teggunim. Maca, ma tepwâaôvem, kecmet. Mi teççam, sahlet; ur ssiôxiset ameslay. Ayagi, s tidep, iqelleq Nnbi. Isetêa segwen. Öebbi ur Ipsetêi $ef tidep. Ma tessutrem asent ta$awsa, ssutret ep deffir tsabert. Yif it wakka, i tezdeg n wulawen nnwen, akked wulawen nnsent. Ur awen ilaq ara a pjjerim Amazan n Öebbi, ne$ a ppa$em tilawin is, deffir es, d awez$i. Ayagi, ad yili, ar Öebbi, d lefviêa.

verses.text: Ama tessknem d lêaoa, ne$ teffrem p, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa yal cci.
verses.translation: Ama tessknem d lêaoa, ne$ teffrem p, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa yal cci.

verses.text: Ur telli tiyta degsent af ibabaten nnsent, arraw nnsent, atmaten nnsent, arraw n wamaten nnsent, arraw n tsetmatin nnsent, tilawin nnsent, ticrikin nnsent. Ad êezzbent i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, d Anagi n yal cci.
verses.translation: Ur telli tiyta degsent af ibabaten nnsent, arraw nnsent, atmaten nnsent, arraw n wamaten nnsent, arraw n tsetmatin nnsent, tilawin nnsent, ticrikin nnsent. Ad êezzbent i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, d Anagi n yal cci.

verses.text: Öebbi akked lmalayek iS, s tidep, Nuban $ef Nnbi. A wid iumnen! Nubet fellas, ternum as azul aêmayan.
verses.translation: Öebbi akked lmalayek iS, s tidep, Nuban $ef Nnbi. A wid iumnen! Nubet fellas, ternum as azul aêmayan.

verses.text: Ih, wid ijjerin Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Ixza ten Öebbi, di ddunit, di laxeôt. Ihegga yasen d aâaqeb isdullun.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijjerin Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Ixza ten Öebbi, di ddunit, di laxeôt. Ihegga yasen d aâaqeb isdullun.

verses.text: Wid ijjerin lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, $ef wayen ur ksiben, ni$ bbwin acehrir akked ubekkav n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Wid ijjerin lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, $ef wayen ur ksiben, ni$ bbwin acehrir akked ubekkav n ûûeê.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik, i iss ik, i tlawin n lmumnin, ad jemâant ijufaô nnsent. Ppif akka, a tent âaqlen, ur tent pooerin. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik, i iss ik, i tlawin n lmumnin, ad jemâant ijufaô nnsent. Ppif akka, a tent âaqlen, ur tent pooerin. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ma ur êbisen ara ixabiten, imehzulen n wul, akked wid ipxeôôiven di Lmadina, ad ak Nebges $uôsen. Sinna, siwa cwiî n tallit ara yilin, degs, d loiran ik.
verses.translation: Ma ur êbisen ara ixabiten, imehzulen n wul, akked wid ipxeôôiven di Lmadina, ad ak Nebges $uôsen. Sinna, siwa cwiî n tallit ara yilin, degs, d loiran ik.

verses.text: Ad pwaxzun anda ten nufan, ad pwaîîfen, ad pwan$en akw.
verses.translation: Ad pwaxzun anda ten nufan, ad pwaîîfen, ad pwan$en akw.

verses.text: D tannumi n Öebbi ar wid iâaddan zik. Ur teppafev, d awez$i, abeddel, di tannumi n Öebbi.
verses.translation: D tannumi n Öebbi ar wid iâaddan zik. Ur teppafev, d awez$i, abeddel, di tannumi n Öebbi.

verses.text: Steqsan k imdanen, af yimir. Ini: "it Issnen siwa Öebbi". Anwa ad ak imlen, amar imir iqeôb ed?
verses.translation: Steqsan k imdanen, af yimir. Ini: "it Issnen siwa Öebbi". Anwa ad ak imlen, amar imir iqeôb ed?

verses.text: Öebbi, s tidep, Ixza ijehliyen, Ihegga yasen d u$ud.
verses.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, Ixza ijehliyen, Ihegga yasen d u$ud.

verses.text: Ad wekkôen degs, i lebda; ur ppafen bab, ne$ asettaô.
verses.translation: Ad wekkôen degs, i lebda; ur ppafen bab, ne$ asettaô.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara zzin wudmawen nnsen, ar tmes, ad inin: "a yamxix nne$! A lemmer nunez i Öebbi, u nunez i Umazan!
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara zzin wudmawen nnsen, ar tmes, ad inin: "a yamxix nne$! A lemmer nunez i Öebbi, u nunez i Umazan!

verses.text: Ad inin: "a Mass nne$! Nekwni nunez i igeldan nne$, i imeqwôanen nne$, telfen a$ ar yir abrid.
verses.translation: Ad inin: "a Mass nne$! Nekwni nunez i igeldan nne$, i imeqwôanen nne$, telfen a$ ar yir abrid.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Aâqeb iten berdayen, u Xzu ten s leqseê"!
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Aâqeb iten berdayen, u Xzu ten s leqseê"!

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ppilit am wid i ijjerin Musa. Izekka t Öebbi, seg wayen id nnan. Illa ar Öebbi d amxallef.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur ppilit am wid i ijjerin Musa. Izekka t Öebbi, seg wayen id nnan. Illa ar Öebbi d amxallef.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, tinim awal umâin.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, tinim awal umâin.

verses.text: Ad awen Iûeggem igiten nnwen, ad Isemmeê ibekkaven nnwen. Win iôuvan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ni$ ibbwi arraz ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Ad awen Iûeggem igiten nnwen, ad Isemmeê ibekkaven nnwen. Win iôuvan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ni$ ibbwi arraz ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Naâôev a nefk lamana i igenwan, i tmurt, i idurar. Ugin a p îîfen. Ugaden p. Ibubb ip umdan. Neppa ard amednus ur nessin.
verses.translation: Naâôev a nefk lamana i igenwan, i tmurt, i idurar. Ugin a p îîfen. Ugaden p. Ibubb ip umdan. Neppa ard amednus ur nessin.

verses.text: Ihi, ad Isâaddi Öebbi aâaqeb af ixabiten akked txabitin, wid akked tid ipcaraken. Ad Issuref Öebbi i wid akked tid iumnen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ihi, ad Isâaddi Öebbi aâaqeb af ixabiten akked txabitin, wid akked tid ipcaraken. Ad Issuref Öebbi i wid akked tid iumnen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Ëezzeb i Öebbi, ur ppa$ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Öebbi, s tidep, Izga d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Ëezzeb i Öebbi, ur ppa$ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Öebbi, s tidep, Izga d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ddu akked wayen i k d Ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass ik. Ih, Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txedmem.
ayahs.translation: Ddu akked wayen i k d Ippuweêêan, s$uô Mass ik. Ih, Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txedmem.

ayahs.text: Ppkel $ef Öebbi. Iqadd Öebbi d Awkil.
ayahs.translation: Ppkel $ef Öebbi. Iqadd Öebbi d Awkil.

ayahs.text: Ur Irra ara Öebbi sin wulawen di tfekka n urgaz. Ur Irra ara tilawin nnwen, i tmetlem ar iârar n tyimmatin nnwen, d tiyimmatin nnwen. Ur irra ara wid id tessekrem, d tarwa nnwen. Ayagi, d awal nnwen, seg imawen nnwen. Öebbi Issawal tidep. Neppa Ippawi d ubrid.
ayahs.translation: Ur Irra ara Öebbi sin wulawen di tfekka n urgaz. Ur Irra ara tilawin nnwen, i tmetlem ar iârar n tyimmatin nnwen, d tiyimmatin nnwen. Ur irra ara wid id tessekrem, d tarwa nnwen. Ayagi, d awal nnwen, seg imawen nnwen. Öebbi Issawal tidep. Neppa Ippawi d ubrid.

ayahs.text: Ssiwlet asen am ibabaten nnsen; akka i iwqem ar Öebbi. Ma ur tessinen ara anwi ay d ibabaten nnsen, atmaten nnwen di ddin, d iqôiben nnwen. Ur illi u$ilif $ef wayen teffalîam degs, siwa ayen âammden wulawen nnwen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ssiwlet asen am ibabaten nnsen; akka i iwqem ar Öebbi. Ma ur tessinen ara anwi ay d ibabaten nnsen, atmaten nnwen di ddin, d iqôiben nnwen. Ur illi u$ilif $ef wayen teffalîam degs, siwa ayen âammden wulawen nnwen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Nnbi iqôeb ar lmumnin, sennig iman nnsen. Tilawin is, d tiyimmatin nnsen. Wid ippemyilin, mqaôaben di Tezmamt n Öebbi, sennig lmumnin akked iminigen. Siwa ma tgam tajmilt i imeddukwal nnwen. Ayagi iura di Tezmamt.
ayahs.translation: Nnbi iqôeb ar lmumnin, sennig iman nnsen. Tilawin is, d tiyimmatin nnsen. Wid ippemyilin, mqaôaben di Tezmamt n Öebbi, sennig lmumnin akked iminigen. Siwa ma tgam tajmilt i imeddukwal nnwen. Ayagi iura di Tezmamt.

ayahs.text: Mi Neîîef si lambiyya lmitaq nnsen, u si keçç, si Nuê, Ibôahim, Musa, u si Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Neîîef segsen lmitaq lfayeq,
ayahs.translation: Mi Neîîef si lambiyya lmitaq nnsen, u si keçç, si Nuê, Ibôahim, Musa, u si Âisa, mmi s n Meryem, Neîîef segsen lmitaq lfayeq,

ayahs.text: iwakken ad Iêtec imawlan n tidep, af tidep nnsen. Ihegga d, i ijehliyen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: iwakken ad Iêtec imawlan n tidep, af tidep nnsen. Ihegga d, i ijehliyen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi. Mi d usan $uôwen iâsekôiwen, Nuzen asen d avu, akked iâsekôiwen ur twalam. Öebbi Izga Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed l$it ikwen I$at Öebbi. Mi d usan $uôwen iâsekôiwen, Nuzen asen d avu, akked iâsekôiwen ur twalam. Öebbi Izga Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Mi wen d kkan sennig wen, seddawat wen, mi zzint wallen, ulawen bbwven s ijuxax, tepmeyyizem yal ameyyez $ef Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Mi wen d kkan sennig wen, seddawat wen, mi zzint wallen, ulawen bbwven s ijuxax, tepmeyyizem yal ameyyez $ef Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Dinna, ppwajeôôben lmumnin, enhezzen s leqseê.
ayahs.translation: Dinna, ppwajeôôben lmumnin, enhezzen s leqseê.

ayahs.text: Mi d nnan ixabiten, akked imehzulen n wul: "ay $ d Iwaââed Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, siwa a$uôôu".
ayahs.translation: Mi d nnan ixabiten, akked imehzulen n wul: "ay $ d Iwaââed Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, siwa a$uôôu".

ayahs.text: Mi d inna urbaâ segsen: "a yAt Yatrib, ur illi umekkan i kunwi, u$alet"! Kra segsen ssutren tsriê i Nnbi, nnan: "ih, ixxamen nne$ aâran". Nitni, ur llin aâran, b$an kan ad rewlen.
ayahs.translation: Mi d inna urbaâ segsen: "a yAt Yatrib, ur illi umekkan i kunwi, u$alet"! Kra segsen ssutren tsriê i Nnbi, nnan: "ih, ixxamen nne$ aâran". Nitni, ur llin aâran, b$an kan ad rewlen.

ayahs.text: Ma kecmen ten id, si leriaf is, sinna, ssutren asen ad xubten, ad xubten. Cwiî kan ara kukrun fellas.
ayahs.translation: Ma kecmen ten id, si leriaf is, sinna, ssutren asen ad xubten, ad xubten. Cwiî kan ara kukrun fellas.

ayahs.text: Ni$ llan âuhden s Öebbi, uqbel, ar ur ppu$alen ar deffir. Aâahed s Öebbi ad ippuqeîîi!
ayahs.translation: Ni$ llan âuhden s Öebbi, uqbel, ar ur ppu$alen ar deffir. Aâahed s Öebbi ad ippuqeîîi!

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur kwen tenfaâ trewla, ma trewlem si tmeppant, ne$ si îôad. Ara tezhum, siwa tallit wezzilen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur kwen tenfaâ trewla, ma trewlem si tmeppant, ne$ si îôad. Ara tezhum, siwa tallit wezzilen".

ayahs.text: Ini: "anwa wa, ara kwen ikksen seg ufus n Öebbi, ma Ib$a yawen cceôô, ne$ Ib$a yawen aêunu"? Ur asen ppafen, war Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "anwa wa, ara kwen ikksen seg ufus n Öebbi, ma Ib$a yawen cceôô, ne$ Ib$a yawen aêunu"? Ur asen ppafen, war Öebbi, bab, ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Öebbi Iéôa wid degwen, i ipâawwiqen, wid iqqaôen i watmaten nnsen: "Yyat $uône$"! Drus kan degsen, i ikecmen îôad.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Öebbi Iéôa wid degwen, i ipâawwiqen, wid iqqaôen i watmaten nnsen: "Yyat $uône$"! Drus kan degsen, i ikecmen îôad.

ayahs.text: D imceêêiyen ar loiha nnwen. Ma tusa d tugdi, a ten twaliv la k pmuqulen, tezzint wallen nnsen, am win tessexciwit tmeppant. Ma tekkes tugdi, a kwen gezren s yilsawen uqviâen. D imceêêiyen $ef lxiô. Wigi, ur uminen ara. Ihi, Imêa Öebbi igiten nnsen. Ayagi, d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: D imceêêiyen ar loiha nnwen. Ma tusa d tugdi, a ten twaliv la k pmuqulen, tezzint wallen nnsen, am win tessexciwit tmeppant. Ma tekkes tugdi, a kwen gezren s yilsawen uqviâen. D imceêêiyen $ef lxiô. Wigi, ur uminen ara. Ihi, Imêa Öebbi igiten nnsen. Ayagi, d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.

ayahs.text: £ilen ikabaren ur ôuêen ara. Lemmer a d asen ikabaren, ad ssirmen, ar nitni, di ûûeêôa ay llan, ar Waâôaben n ucluê, steqsayen fellawen. Lemmer llan yidwen, cwiî kan ara nna$en.
ayahs.translation: £ilen ikabaren ur ôuêen ara. Lemmer a d asen ikabaren, ad ssirmen, ar nitni, di ûûeêôa ay llan, ar Waâôaben n ucluê, steqsayen fellawen. Lemmer llan yidwen, cwiî kan ara nna$en.

ayahs.text: Ni$, i kunwi, Amazan n Öebbi d amedya amxallef i win ippaôoun Öebbi, akked was aneggaru, id ismektayen aîas Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Ni$, i kunwi, Amazan n Öebbi d amedya amxallef i win ippaôoun Öebbi, akked was aneggaru, id ismektayen aîas Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Mi walan lmumnin ikabaren, nnan: "ayagi d ayen i $ d Iwaââed Öebbi, akked Umazan iS. Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, Ssawlen tidep". Ay sen irna kan, siwa liman akked wannuz.
ayahs.translation: Mi walan lmumnin ikabaren, nnan: "ayagi d ayen i $ d Iwaââed Öebbi, akked Umazan iS. Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, Ssawlen tidep". Ay sen irna kan, siwa liman akked wannuz.

ayahs.text: Ger lmumnin, llan irgazen i iîîfen deg wayen i$ef âuhden Öebbi. Garasen, wid iêellen timeôoiwt nnsen, garasen wid ipganin. Ur bedlen mavi.
ayahs.translation: Ger lmumnin, llan irgazen i iîîfen deg wayen i$ef âuhden Öebbi. Garasen, wid iêellen timeôoiwt nnsen, garasen wid ipganin. Ur bedlen mavi.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad Ikafi Öebbi imawlan n tidep, $ef tidep nnsen, u ad Iâaqeb ixabiten, ma ihwa yaS, ne$ ad asen Issuref. Ih, Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad Ikafi Öebbi imawlan n tidep, $ef tidep nnsen, u ad Iâaqeb ixabiten, ma ihwa yaS, ne$ ad asen Issuref. Ih, Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Iééaâ Öebbi wid ijehlen, s iêecciô nnsen. Ur ppaddamen lxiô. Issuli Öebbi îôad i lmumnin. Öebbi Izga d Uohid, d Uzmir.
ayahs.translation: Iééaâ Öebbi wid ijehlen, s iêecciô nnsen. Ur ppaddamen lxiô. Issuli Öebbi îôad i lmumnin. Öebbi Izga d Uohid, d Uzmir.

ayahs.text: Issers ed, si lebôuj nnsen, wid i sen ifkan afus, seg wAt Tezmamt. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Arbaâ ten$am ten, arbaâ têebsem ten.
ayahs.translation: Issers ed, si lebôuj nnsen, wid i sen ifkan afus, seg wAt Tezmamt. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Arbaâ ten$am ten, arbaâ têebsem ten.

ayahs.text: Irra kwen tweôtem akal nnsen, ixxamen nnsen, ayla nnsen. D akal ur taâfisem. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Irra kwen tweôtem akal nnsen, ixxamen nnsen, ayla nnsen. D akal ur taâfisem. Ih, Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik: "maday teb$amt tameddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuê is, yyamt a kwent $ite$, ad a kwent bru$, berru umâin.
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik: "maday teb$amt tameddurt n ddunit, akked ccbuê is, yyamt a kwent $ite$, ad a kwent bru$, berru umâin.

ayahs.text: Ma illa teb$amt Öebbi, Amazan iS, akked uxxam aneggaru, ihi, Ihegga d Öebbi, i tâaôviyin, segkwent, arraz ameqwôaêan".
ayahs.translation: Ma illa teb$amt Öebbi, Amazan iS, akked uxxam aneggaru, ihi, Ihegga d Öebbi, i tâaôviyin, segkwent, arraz ameqwôaêan".

ayahs.text: A tilawin n Nnbi! Tid segkwent ara iawin abekkav ufviê, a ppeppuâaqeb berdayen. Ayagi d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: A tilawin n Nnbi! Tid segkwent ara iawin abekkav ufviê, a ppeppuâaqeb berdayen. Ayagi d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Tin segkwent i iunzen i Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, u txeddem ayen ilhan, ad as Nefk arraz berdayen, u Nhegga yas d l$it ukyis.
ayahs.translation: Tin segkwent i iunzen i Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, u txeddem ayen ilhan, ad as Nefk arraz berdayen, u Nhegga yas d l$it ukyis.

ayahs.text: A tilawin n Nnbi! Ur tellimt am tlawin nniven. Ma têezzbemt, ur teppeccvemt deg wawal, a kwent isirem umuvin n wul. Inimt awal uwqim.
ayahs.translation: A tilawin n Nnbi! Ur tellimt am tlawin nniven. Ma têezzbemt, ur teppeccvemt deg wawal, a kwent isirem umuvin n wul. Inimt awal uwqim.

ayahs.text: Ilimt deg ixxamen nnkwent. Ur pcebbiêemt acebbeê n at war tussna imenza. èÈéalemt, zekkimt, ôavimt Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ib$a kan Öebbi a kwent ipwakkes nnkel, a tawacult n Uxxam. U, a kwent Izzizdeg nezzeh.
ayahs.translation: Ilimt deg ixxamen nnkwent. Ur pcebbiêemt acebbeê n at war tussna imenza. èÈéalemt, zekkimt, ôavimt Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ib$a kan Öebbi a kwent ipwakkes nnkel, a tawacult n Uxxam. U, a kwent Izzizdeg nezzeh.

ayahs.text: Mmektitemt ed ayen i kwent $ôan, deg ixxamen nnkwent, n issekniyen n Öebbi, akw n ûûwab. Ih, Öebbi Izga d Laîif, Ippuxebbeô.
ayahs.translation: Mmektitemt ed ayen i kwent $ôan, deg ixxamen nnkwent, n issekniyen n Öebbi, akw n ûûwab. Ih, Öebbi Izga d Laîif, Ippuxebbeô.

ayahs.text: Ih, imvuâen, timvuâin, lmumnin argaz tameîîut, itubiyen, titubiyin, wid akked tid issawalen tidep, iûebôiyen, tiûebôiyin, wid akked tid ippagwaden, wid akked tid ipseddiqen, wid akked tid ippuéumen, wid akked tid ipêaraben $ef tuzzuft nnsen, wid akked tid id immektayen aîas Öebbi; i wigi, Ihegga d Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz abarar.
ayahs.translation: Ih, imvuâen, timvuâin, lmumnin argaz tameîîut, itubiyen, titubiyin, wid akked tid issawalen tidep, iûebôiyen, tiûebôiyin, wid akked tid ippagwaden, wid akked tid ipseddiqen, wid akked tid ippuéumen, wid akked tid ipêaraben $ef tuzzuft nnsen, wid akked tid id immektayen aîas Öebbi; i wigi, Ihegga d Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz abarar.

ayahs.text: Ur issefk ara i win, ne$ tin iumnen, ad smenyafen lameô nnsen, ma Iseyya d lameô Öebbi, akked Umazan iS. Win inuqmen Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, ni$ innetlaf ttelfan n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Ur issefk ara i win, ne$ tin iumnen, ad smenyafen lameô nnsen, ma Iseyya d lameô Öebbi, akked Umazan iS. Win inuqmen Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, ni$ innetlaf ttelfan n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Mi tenniv i win I$at Öebbi, u t$atev: "jmaâ $uôek, tameîîut ik, êezzeb i Öebbi"; teffrev deg iman ik, ayen ara d Isban Öebbi. Tugadev medden. D Öebbi, i iwatan a T tagwadev. Mi s ibra Zayed, Njewo ik yides, iwakken ur teppili lhejna i lmumnin, ma u$en tilawin n wid id ssekren, mara ad sent brun. Ad iûaô lameô n Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Mi tenniv i win I$at Öebbi, u t$atev: "jmaâ $uôek, tameîîut ik, êezzeb i Öebbi"; teffrev deg iman ik, ayen ara d Isban Öebbi. Tugadev medden. D Öebbi, i iwatan a T tagwadev. Mi s ibra Zayed, Njewo ik yides, iwakken ur teppili lhejna i lmumnin, ma u$en tilawin n wid id ssekren, mara ad sent brun. Ad iûaô lameô n Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Ur telli lhejna f Nnbi, deg wayen Iêeppem fellas Öebbi; d tannumi n Öebbi $ef imezwura. Lameô n Öebbi izga ipwafta.
ayahs.translation: Ur telli lhejna f Nnbi, deg wayen Iêeppem fellas Öebbi; d tannumi n Öebbi $ef imezwura. Lameô n Öebbi izga ipwafta.

ayahs.text: Wid issawaven tibôatin n Öebbi, i T ippagwaden, ur ppagwaden yiwen, siwa Öebbi. Öebbi Iqadd i uqeîîi.
ayahs.translation: Wid issawaven tibôatin n Öebbi, i T ippagwaden, ur ppagwaden yiwen, siwa Öebbi. Öebbi Iqadd i uqeîîi.

ayahs.text: Ur illi Muêemmed d ababat n yiwen seg irgazen nnwen, maca, d Amazan n Öebbi, u d aneggaru n lambiyya. Öebbi Izga Issen yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ur illi Muêemmed d ababat n yiwen seg irgazen nnwen, maca, d Amazan n Öebbi, u d aneggaru n lambiyya. Öebbi Izga Issen yal cci.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed Öebbi, maççi d izli.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Mmektit ed Öebbi, maççi d izli.

ayahs.text: Sbuccuâet eP, ûûbeê, tameddit.
ayahs.translation: Sbuccuâet eP, ûûbeê, tameddit.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i d Inuben fellawen, akked lmalayek, iwakken a kwen Issuffe$ si tillas ar tafat. Izga Ipêunu $ef lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i d Inuben fellawen, akked lmalayek, iwakken a kwen Issuffe$ si tillas ar tafat. Izga Ipêunu $ef lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Asmi ara T magren, azul nnsen d: "tifrat"! Ihegga yasen d arraz ukyis.
ayahs.translation: Asmi ara T magren, azul nnsen d: "tifrat"! Ihegga yasen d arraz ukyis.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir u d aneddaô,
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir u d aneddaô,

ayahs.text: i ineccden ar Öebbi, s tsriê iS; d asavef icaâlen.
ayahs.translation: i ineccden ar Öebbi, s tsriê iS; d asavef icaâlen.

ayahs.text: Becceô lmumnin s lfevl ameqwôan i nitni, s$uô Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: Becceô lmumnin s lfevl ameqwôan i nitni, s$uô Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Ur ppa$ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Ur ssemêas, i ccum nnsen. Ppkel $ef Öebbi, Iqadd Öebbi d Awkil.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppa$ awal i ijehliyen akked ixabiten. Ur ssemêas, i ccum nnsen. Ppkel $ef Öebbi, Iqadd Öebbi d Awkil.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em tid iumnen, sinna, tebram asent, uqbel ma tennulem tent, ur fellawen ad asent têesbem tallit. £itet pent, serrêet asent, s wudem uwqim.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tu$em tid iumnen, sinna, tebram asent, uqbel ma tennulem tent, ur fellawen ad asent têesbem tallit. £itet pent, serrêet asent, s wudem uwqim.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Nêell ak tilawin iwumi tefkiv tiqviâen nnsent, tiklatin ik, si tid i k Iqsed Öebbi, iss is n âam ik, tid n tâamtin ik, tid n xal ik, tid n txaltin ik iunagen yidek, tameîîut iumnen, ma tefka iman is i Nnbi, ma ib$a Nnbi a p ya$. D lemziyya i keçç, war lmumnin. Ni$ Neéôa acu i sen Nseyya af tlawin nnsen, akked teklatin nnsen. Iwakken ur teppili fellak lhejna. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Nêell ak tilawin iwumi tefkiv tiqviâen nnsent, tiklatin ik, si tid i k Iqsed Öebbi, iss is n âam ik, tid n tâamtin ik, tid n xal ik, tid n txaltin ik iunagen yidek, tameîîut iumnen, ma tefka iman is i Nnbi, ma ib$a Nnbi a p ya$. D lemziyya i keçç, war lmumnin. Ni$ Neéôa acu i sen Nseyya af tlawin nnsen, akked teklatin nnsen. Iwakken ur teppili fellak lhejna. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A ppesganiv tin i k ihwan segsent. A d tawiv $uôek tin i k ihwan, ne$ tin teb$iv si tid tâazlev. Ur fellak tuzzma. Akka i iwulem, iwakken ad qenâant, ur $webbnent, ad ôavint akw, ayen i sent tefkiv. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Öebbi Izga d Amusnaw, Iêellem.
ayahs.translation: A ppesganiv tin i k ihwan segsent. A d tawiv $uôek tin i k ihwan, ne$ tin teb$iv si tid tâazlev. Ur fellak tuzzma. Akka i iwulem, iwakken ad qenâant, ur $webbnent, ad ôavint akw, ayen i sent tefkiv. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg ulawen nnwen. Öebbi Izga d Amusnaw, Iêellem.

ayahs.text: Ur ak êellent tlawin, sya d asawen, ne$ abeddel n tlawin, xas tâaoeb ik ûûifa nnsent, siwa tiklatin ik. Öebbi Izga Issikid yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ur ak êellent tlawin, sya d asawen, ne$ abeddel n tlawin, xas tâaoeb ik ûûifa nnsent, siwa tiklatin ik. Öebbi Izga Issikid yal cci.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur keççmet ar texxamin n Nnbi, ar awen iâammed, d inebgawen ar wuççi, ur teggunim. Maca, ma tepwâaôvem, kecmet. Mi teççam, sahlet; ur ssiôxiset ameslay. Ayagi, s tidep, iqelleq Nnbi. Isetêa segwen. Öebbi ur Ipsetêi $ef tidep. Ma tessutrem asent ta$awsa, ssutret ep deffir tsabert. Yif it wakka, i tezdeg n wulawen nnwen, akked wulawen nnsent. Ur awen ilaq ara a pjjerim Amazan n Öebbi, ne$ a ppa$em tilawin is, deffir es, d awez$i. Ayagi, ad yili, ar Öebbi, d lefviêa.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur keççmet ar texxamin n Nnbi, ar awen iâammed, d inebgawen ar wuççi, ur teggunim. Maca, ma tepwâaôvem, kecmet. Mi teççam, sahlet; ur ssiôxiset ameslay. Ayagi, s tidep, iqelleq Nnbi. Isetêa segwen. Öebbi ur Ipsetêi $ef tidep. Ma tessutrem asent ta$awsa, ssutret ep deffir tsabert. Yif it wakka, i tezdeg n wulawen nnwen, akked wulawen nnsent. Ur awen ilaq ara a pjjerim Amazan n Öebbi, ne$ a ppa$em tilawin is, deffir es, d awez$i. Ayagi, ad yili, ar Öebbi, d lefviêa.

ayahs.text: Ama tessknem d lêaoa, ne$ teffrem p, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ama tessknem d lêaoa, ne$ teffrem p, Öebbi, s tidep, Iéôa yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ur telli tiyta degsent af ibabaten nnsent, arraw nnsent, atmaten nnsent, arraw n wamaten nnsent, arraw n tsetmatin nnsent, tilawin nnsent, ticrikin nnsent. Ad êezzbent i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, d Anagi n yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ur telli tiyta degsent af ibabaten nnsent, arraw nnsent, atmaten nnsent, arraw n wamaten nnsent, arraw n tsetmatin nnsent, tilawin nnsent, ticrikin nnsent. Ad êezzbent i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, d Anagi n yal cci.

ayahs.text: Öebbi akked lmalayek iS, s tidep, Nuban $ef Nnbi. A wid iumnen! Nubet fellas, ternum as azul aêmayan.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi akked lmalayek iS, s tidep, Nuban $ef Nnbi. A wid iumnen! Nubet fellas, ternum as azul aêmayan.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijjerin Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Ixza ten Öebbi, di ddunit, di laxeôt. Ihegga yasen d aâaqeb isdullun.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijjerin Öebbi akked Umazan iS, Ixza ten Öebbi, di ddunit, di laxeôt. Ihegga yasen d aâaqeb isdullun.

ayahs.text: Wid ijjerin lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, $ef wayen ur ksiben, ni$ bbwin acehrir akked ubekkav n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Wid ijjerin lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, $ef wayen ur ksiben, ni$ bbwin acehrir akked ubekkav n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik, i iss ik, i tlawin n lmumnin, ad jemâant ijufaô nnsent. Ppif akka, a tent âaqlen, ur tent pooerin. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Ini i tlawin ik, i iss ik, i tlawin n lmumnin, ad jemâant ijufaô nnsent. Ppif akka, a tent âaqlen, ur tent pooerin. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ma ur êbisen ara ixabiten, imehzulen n wul, akked wid ipxeôôiven di Lmadina, ad ak Nebges $uôsen. Sinna, siwa cwiî n tallit ara yilin, degs, d loiran ik.
ayahs.translation: Ma ur êbisen ara ixabiten, imehzulen n wul, akked wid ipxeôôiven di Lmadina, ad ak Nebges $uôsen. Sinna, siwa cwiî n tallit ara yilin, degs, d loiran ik.

ayahs.text: Ad pwaxzun anda ten nufan, ad pwaîîfen, ad pwan$en akw.
ayahs.translation: Ad pwaxzun anda ten nufan, ad pwaîîfen, ad pwan$en akw.

ayahs.text: D tannumi n Öebbi ar wid iâaddan zik. Ur teppafev, d awez$i, abeddel, di tannumi n Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: D tannumi n Öebbi ar wid iâaddan zik. Ur teppafev, d awez$i, abeddel, di tannumi n Öebbi.

ayahs.text: Steqsan k imdanen, af yimir. Ini: "it Issnen siwa Öebbi". Anwa ad ak imlen, amar imir iqeôb ed?
ayahs.translation: Steqsan k imdanen, af yimir. Ini: "it Issnen siwa Öebbi". Anwa ad ak imlen, amar imir iqeôb ed?

ayahs.text: Öebbi, s tidep, Ixza ijehliyen, Ihegga yasen d u$ud.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, s tidep, Ixza ijehliyen, Ihegga yasen d u$ud.

ayahs.text: Ad wekkôen degs, i lebda; ur ppafen bab, ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Ad wekkôen degs, i lebda; ur ppafen bab, ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara zzin wudmawen nnsen, ar tmes, ad inin: "a yamxix nne$! A lemmer nunez i Öebbi, u nunez i Umazan!
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara zzin wudmawen nnsen, ar tmes, ad inin: "a yamxix nne$! A lemmer nunez i Öebbi, u nunez i Umazan!

ayahs.text: Ad inin: "a Mass nne$! Nekwni nunez i igeldan nne$, i imeqwôanen nne$, telfen a$ ar yir abrid.
ayahs.translation: Ad inin: "a Mass nne$! Nekwni nunez i igeldan nne$, i imeqwôanen nne$, telfen a$ ar yir abrid.

ayahs.text: A Mass nne$! Aâqeb iten berdayen, u Xzu ten s leqseê"!
ayahs.translation: A Mass nne$! Aâqeb iten berdayen, u Xzu ten s leqseê"!

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ppilit am wid i ijjerin Musa. Izekka t Öebbi, seg wayen id nnan. Illa ar Öebbi d amxallef.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur ppilit am wid i ijjerin Musa. Izekka t Öebbi, seg wayen id nnan. Illa ar Öebbi d amxallef.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, tinim awal umâin.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi, tinim awal umâin.

ayahs.text: Ad awen Iûeggem igiten nnwen, ad Isemmeê ibekkaven nnwen. Win iôuvan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ni$ ibbwi arraz ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Ad awen Iûeggem igiten nnwen, ad Isemmeê ibekkaven nnwen. Win iôuvan Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ni$ ibbwi arraz ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Naâôev a nefk lamana i igenwan, i tmurt, i idurar. Ugin a p îîfen. Ugaden p. Ibubb ip umdan. Neppa ard amednus ur nessin.
ayahs.translation: Naâôev a nefk lamana i igenwan, i tmurt, i idurar. Ugin a p îîfen. Ugaden p. Ibubb ip umdan. Neppa ard amednus ur nessin.

ayahs.text: Ihi, ad Isâaddi Öebbi aâaqeb af ixabiten akked txabitin, wid akked tid ipcaraken. Ad Issuref Öebbi i wid akked tid iumnen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ihi, ad Isâaddi Öebbi aâaqeb af ixabiten akked txabitin, wid akked tid ipcaraken. Ad Issuref Öebbi i wid akked tid iumnen. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ccekôan i Öebbi, i iIan i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. I Neppa, ccekôan di laxert. Neppa, d Bab n ûûwab, Ippuxebbeô.
verses.translation: Ccekôan i Öebbi, i iIan i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. I Neppa, ccekôan di laxert. Neppa, d Bab n ûûwab, Ippuxebbeô.

verses.text: Iéôa ayen ikeççmen di tmurt, ayen id iteff$en segs, ayen id iprusun seg igenni, ayen ippalin $uôes. Neppa Ipêunu, Ipsemmiê.
verses.translation: Iéôa ayen ikeççmen di tmurt, ayen id iteff$en segs, ayen id iprusun seg igenni, ayen ippalin $uôes. Neppa Ipêunu, Ipsemmiê.

verses.text: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur a$ d ippas yimir". Ini: "xaîi, s Mass iw, ara kwen id ias"! Amusnaw n tbavnit, ur idrig fellaS ubruy ubelkim, ama deg igenwan, ama di ddunit; ama seddaw wannect is, ama sennig es; akw, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur a$ d ippas yimir". Ini: "xaîi, s Mass iw, ara kwen id ias"! Amusnaw n tbavnit, ur idrig fellaS ubruy ubelkim, ama deg igenwan, ama di ddunit; ama seddaw wannect is, ama sennig es; akw, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.

verses.text: Ad Ikafi wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I wigi, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.
verses.translation: Ad Ikafi wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I wigi, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.

verses.text: Wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nne£, sfunnugen, widak, fellasen aâaqeb n twa$it taqeôêant.
verses.translation: Wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nne£, sfunnugen, widak, fellasen aâaqeb n twa$it taqeôêant.

verses.text: Wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni, walan ar ayen id irsen $uôek, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep. Ippawi s abrid n Uzmir, Amaâzuz.
verses.translation: Wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni, walan ar ayen id irsen $uôek, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep. Ippawi s abrid n Uzmir, Amaâzuz.

verses.text: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ad awen nessken argaz, ar awen d yinin ar ma teftutsem, yal aftutes, i kunwi lxelq amaynut?
verses.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ad awen nessken argaz, ar awen d yinin ar ma teftutsem, yal aftutes, i kunwi lxelq amaynut?

verses.text: Iger ed tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ d aôehbani"? Xaîi, wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, haaten deg uâaqeb, akked ttelfan u$miq.
verses.translation: Iger ed tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ d aôehbani"? Xaîi, wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, haaten deg uâaqeb, akked ttelfan u$miq.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara ayen illan zdat sen, u deffir sen, di tmurt akked igenwan? Ma ihwa ya£, a ten Nger seddaw tmurt, ne$ a d Nesse$li fellasen igezzim seg igenni. Deg wayagi, ih, d assekni i yal amdan ucâif.
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara ayen illan zdat sen, u deffir sen, di tmurt akked igenwan? Ma ihwa ya£, a ten Nger seddaw tmurt, ne$ a d Nesse$li fellasen igezzim seg igenni. Deg wayagi, ih, d assekni i yal amdan ucâif.

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka s$uône£ lfevl i Dawed. A yidurar, alset yides akked ifrax. Nerra yas uzzal d aleqqaq.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka s$uône£ lfevl i Dawed. A yidurar, alset yides akked ifrax. Nerra yas uzzal d aleqqaq.

verses.text: Eûnaâ tibedâiyin n wuzzal, qiss tindar. Xeddmet ayen ilhan. Nek, Pwali$ ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Eûnaâ tibedâiyin n wuzzal, qiss tindar. Xeddmet ayen ilhan. Nek, Pwali$ ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: I Sliman: avu. Win n ûûbeê, aggur; win n tmeddit, aggur. Nelli yas taâwint n nnêas. Kra n leonun ad xedmen fellas, s tsriê n Mass is. Win degsen, iveôfen i lameô nne£, Nessukk fellas, aâaqeb ujajiê.
verses.translation: I Sliman: avu. Win n ûûbeê, aggur; win n tmeddit, aggur. Nelli yas taâwint n nnêas. Kra n leonun ad xedmen fellas, s tsriê n Mass is. Win degsen, iveôfen i lameô nne£, Nessukk fellas, aâaqeb ujajiê.

verses.text: Xeddmen as ayen ib$a: leowamaâ, tiâancuôin, loefnat am iêvunen, ticcuytin iqaâden. Exdem s tnemmirt, a tawacult n Dawed, drus n yimdanen iW i isnemmiren!
verses.translation: Xeddmen as ayen ib$a: leowamaâ, tiâancuôin, loefnat am iêvunen, ticcuytin iqaâden. Exdem s tnemmirt, a tawacult n Dawed, drus n yimdanen iW i isnemmiren!

verses.text: Mi Nseyya fellas tameppant, ur as faqen ara immut, armi içça taâkwazt is, ubaââuc n wakal. Mi i$li, êulfan leonun ar, lemmer day ssinen tabavnit, ur qqimen deg uâaqeb isdullun.
verses.translation: Mi Nseyya fellas tameppant, ur as faqen ara immut, armi içça taâkwazt is, ubaââuc n wakal. Mi i$li, êulfan leonun ar, lemmer day ssinen tabavnit, ur qqimen deg uâaqeb isdullun.
