verses.text: Ni$, i Saba, assekni di tnezdu$in nnsen. Snat tebêirin, ta yeffus, ta zelmev. Eççet si l$it n Mass nnwen, u snemmret aS. Tamurt ilhan, Mass Ipsemmiêen.
verses.translation: Ni$, i Saba, assekni di tnezdu$in nnsen. Snat tebêirin, ta yeffus, ta zelmev. Eççet si l$it n Mass nnwen, u snemmret aS. Tamurt ilhan, Mass Ipsemmiêen.

verses.text: Wexxôen. Nuzen asen aêemmal n Âarim. Tibêirin nnsen, nerra tent d tibêirin id ippaken l$ella ôéagen, tammemayt, akked tzegwart taxeîîayt.
verses.translation: Wexxôen. Nuzen asen aêemmal n Âarim. Tibêirin nnsen, nerra tent d tibêirin id ippaken l$ella ôéagen, tammemayt, akked tzegwart taxeîîayt.

verses.text: Akka ay ten Nqeîîi $ef tijehli nnsen. Day a Nqeîîi wur nejhil?
verses.translation: Akka ay ten Nqeîîi $ef tijehli nnsen. Day a Nqeîîi wur nejhil?

verses.text: Nerra garasen u ger temdinin i$ef Nburek, timdinin id ivehôen. Nektal tikli garasent: "merêet degsent di laman, am yiv, am ass"!
verses.translation: Nerra garasen u ger temdinin i$ef Nburek, timdinin id ivehôen. Nektal tikli garasent: "merêet degsent di laman, am yiv, am ass"!

verses.text: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! Zzi$wzef tallit ger zziaôat nne$"! Densen iman nnsen. Nerra ten d tiqûivin. Nesqucc iten wakali. Ih, deg wayagi, war ccek, d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.
verses.translation: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! Zzi$wzef tallit ger zziaôat nne$"! Densen iman nnsen. Nerra ten d tiqûivin. Nesqucc iten wakali. Ih, deg wayagi, war ccek, d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.

verses.text: Ni$ Iblis itebbet ed, segsen, ameyyez is. Vefôen t, siwa arbaâ si lmumnin.
verses.translation: Ni$ Iblis itebbet ed, segsen, ameyyez is. Vefôen t, siwa arbaâ si lmumnin.

verses.text: Ur isâi kra udabu fellasen. Iwakken kan, a Nissin anwa iumnen s laxeôt, u anwa i illan, fellas, di ccekk. Mass ik Ipêarab af yal cci.
verses.translation: Ur isâi kra udabu fellasen. Iwakken kan, a Nissin anwa iumnen s laxeôt, u anwa i illan, fellas, di ccekk. Mass ik Ipêarab af yal cci.

verses.text: Ini: "naâret wid i tepkabarem, war Öebbi. Ur sâin taéeyt ubelkim, deg igenwan ne$ di tmurt; ur criken degsen; ur aS illi, garasen, umâiwen".
verses.translation: Ini: "naâret wid i tepkabarem, war Öebbi. Ur sâin taéeyt ubelkim, deg igenwan ne$ di tmurt; ur criken degsen; ur aS illi, garasen, umâiwen".

verses.text: Cafuâa, s$uôeS, tenfaâ kan win iwumi ip Irad. Alamma, ma tekkes tugdi seg wulawen nnsen, a d inin: "acu id Inna, Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d tidep, u Neppa d Aâlayen, d Ameqwôan".
verses.translation: Cafuâa, s$uôeS, tenfaâ kan win iwumi ip Irad. Alamma, ma tekkes tugdi seg wulawen nnsen, a d inin: "acu id Inna, Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d tidep, u Neppa d Aâlayen, d Ameqwôan".

verses.text: Ini: "anwa ikwen ip$aten, si tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi". Nekwni am kunwi, amendeô ma nella di nnhaya, ne$ di ttelfan n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Ini: "anwa ikwen ip$aten, si tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi". Nekwni am kunwi, amendeô ma nella di nnhaya, ne$ di ttelfan n ûûeê.

verses.text: Ini: "ur teppuqeîîim $ef wayen nfalîa, ur neppuqeîîi $ef wayen txeddmem".
verses.translation: Ini: "ur teppuqeîîim $ef wayen nfalîa, ur neppuqeîîi $ef wayen txeddmem".

verses.text: Ini: "ad a$ Issemlil Mass nne$, sinna, ad Iêudd garane$, s tidep. Neppa d Amêaddi Amusnaw".
verses.translation: Ini: "ad a$ Issemlil Mass nne$, sinna, ad Iêudd garane$, s tidep. Neppa d Amêaddi Amusnaw".

verses.text: Ini: "sseknet iyi d wid i tqeônem $uôeS, d icriken"! Xaîi, Neppa d Öebbi Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ini: "sseknet iyi d wid i tqeônem $uôeS, d icriken"! Xaîi, Neppa d Öebbi Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ur k id Nuzen, i imdanen, armi d uqniâ; a pbecôôev, a pnedôev. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen, ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Ur k id Nuzen, i imdanen, armi d uqniâ; a pbecôôev, a pnedôev. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen, ur ssinen.

verses.text: Qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma tessawalem tidep"?
verses.translation: Qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma tessawalem tidep"?

verses.text: Ini: "$uôwen ppaâud ass, ur tezmirem a t teswexxôem, ne$ a t id tesqeôbem, s saâa".
verses.translation: Ini: "$uôwen ppaâud ass, ur tezmirem a t teswexxôem, ne$ a t id tesqeôbem, s saâa".

verses.text: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur neppamen, d awez$i, s Leqwôan agi, ne$ s wayen it id izwaren". Lemmer a pwaliv mara bedden imednas, ar Mass nnsen, pmeslayen garasen. Ad inin uôhifen i imzuxiyen: "lemmer maççi d kunwi, yili nella d lmumnin".
verses.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur neppamen, d awez$i, s Leqwôan agi, ne$ s wayen it id izwaren". Lemmer a pwaliv mara bedden imednas, ar Mass nnsen, pmeslayen garasen. Ad inin uôhifen i imzuxiyen: "lemmer maççi d kunwi, yili nella d lmumnin".

verses.text: Ad inin imzuxiyen i uôhifen: "day d nekwni ikwen isfeô$en af nnhaya, mi kwen id iusa? Xaîi, tellam d ibe$wviyen".
verses.translation: Ad inin imzuxiyen i uôhifen: "day d nekwni ikwen isfeô$en af nnhaya, mi kwen id iusa? Xaîi, tellam d ibe$wviyen".

verses.text: Ad inin uôhifen, i imzuxiyen: "xaîi! Nncub, iv akked wass, mi têeppmem, fellane$, a nagwi Öebbi, u ad aS negg tanudda". Ffren nndama mi walan aâaqeb. Nerra tiqwlavin $ef imegôav n wid ijehlen. Day ara ppuqeîîin $ef wayen ur xdimen?
verses.translation: Ad inin uôhifen, i imzuxiyen: "xaîi! Nncub, iv akked wass, mi têeppmem, fellane$, a nagwi Öebbi, u ad aS negg tanudda". Ffren nndama mi walan aâaqeb. Nerra tiqwlavin $ef imegôav n wid ijehlen. Day ara ppuqeîîin $ef wayen ur xdimen?

verses.text: Ur Nuzen ara kra uneddaô ar temdint, mebla ma nnan imeôkantiyen is: "nekwni, ih, nugwi ayen is id teppuceggâam".
verses.translation: Ur Nuzen ara kra uneddaô ar temdint, mebla ma nnan imeôkantiyen is: "nekwni, ih, nugwi ayen is id teppuceggâam".

verses.text: Nnan: "nekwni, n$elb ik ayla, tarwa. Ur nelli d wid ara ippuqeîîin".
verses.translation: Nnan: "nekwni, n$elb ik ayla, tarwa. Ur nelli d wid ara ippuqeîîin".

verses.text: Ini: "ihi Mass iw Ip$iti win i S ihwan u Iwezzen; maca, tegwti n imdanen, ur ssinen".
verses.translation: Ini: "ihi Mass iw Ip$iti win i S ihwan u Iwezzen; maca, tegwti n imdanen, ur ssinen".

verses.text: Maççi d ayla nnwen, ne$ d tarwa nnwen, ara kwen id iééiéen nezzeh $uône£, siwa wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I nitni arraz berdayen, ilmend n wayen xedmen. Ad ilin, di laman, di t$uôfatin.
verses.translation: Maççi d ayla nnwen, ne$ d tarwa nnwen, ara kwen id iééiéen nezzeh $uône£, siwa wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I nitni arraz berdayen, ilmend n wayen xedmen. Ad ilin, di laman, di t$uôfatin.

verses.text: Ma d wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nne£, sfunnugen, widak a d rsen i uâaqeb.
verses.translation: Ma d wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nne£, sfunnugen, widak a d rsen i uâaqeb.

verses.text: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Ip$iti win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Iwezzen as. Ayen akw ara tefkem n cci, ad awen t id Irr. Neppa, Yif akw im$iten".
verses.translation: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Ip$iti win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Iwezzen as. Ayen akw ara tefkem n cci, ad awen t id Irr. Neppa, Yif akw im$iten".

verses.text: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, akken ma llan, imiren ad Yini i lmalayek: "wigi, day llan âabden kwent"?
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, akken ma llan, imiren ad Yini i lmalayek: "wigi, day llan âabden kwent"?

verses.text: A d inint: "gedha s yiseK! D Keçç ay d Bab nne$, war nitni. Xaîi, llan âabden leonun. Tegwti degsen umnen yissen".
verses.translation: A d inint: "gedha s yiseK! D Keçç ay d Bab nne$, war nitni. Xaîi, llan âabden leonun. Tegwti degsen umnen yissen".

verses.text: Assa, ur imlik yiwen i wayev, segwen, aba$uô ne$ ccqa. A Nini i wid idensen: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmes, i tellam tnekôem t"!
verses.translation: Assa, ur imlik yiwen i wayev, segwen, aba$uô ne$ ccqa. A Nini i wid idensen: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmes, i tellam tnekôem t"!

verses.text: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ ipbegginen, ad inin: "wagi d argaz kan, i ib$an a kwen istixeô, seg wayen llan âabden imezwura nnwen". Ad inin: "ayagi, siwa d tikerkas id innulfan". Wid ijehlen i tidep, mi ten id tusa, ad inin: "ayagi d ssêur n ûûeê kan"!
verses.translation: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ ipbegginen, ad inin: "wagi d argaz kan, i ib$an a kwen istixeô, seg wayen llan âabden imezwura nnwen". Ad inin: "ayagi, siwa d tikerkas id innulfan". Wid ijehlen i tidep, mi ten id tusa, ad inin: "ayagi d ssêur n ûûeê kan"!

verses.text: Ur asen Nefki tizmamin, ara lemden; ur asen d Nuzen, uqbel ik, aneddaô.
verses.translation: Ur asen Nefki tizmamin, ara lemden; ur asen d Nuzen, uqbel ik, aneddaô.

verses.text: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Ur asen tebbwiv ara tis mraw n wayen i ippunefken mi skaddben imazanen iW. A tuzzma W, imiren!
verses.translation: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Ur asen tebbwiv ara tis mraw n wayen i ippunefken mi skaddben imazanen iW. A tuzzma W, imiren!

verses.text: Ini: "ar yiwet kan, ara kwen nabi$: a pbeddem zdat Öebbi, di sin, ne$ weêêedwen; sinna, a d tesmektim. Ameddakwel nnwen ur illi d aôehbani. Neppa d aneddaô nnwen kan, uqbel aâaqeb uqsiê".
verses.translation: Ini: "ar yiwet kan, ara kwen nabi$: a pbeddem zdat Öebbi, di sin, ne$ weêêedwen; sinna, a d tesmektim. Ameddakwel nnwen ur illi d aôehbani. Neppa d aneddaô nnwen kan, uqbel aâaqeb uqsiê".

verses.text: Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ kra n teqdiât; apan nnwen. Ih, taqdiât iw, ar Öebbi kan. Neppa, $ef yal cci, d Anagi".
verses.translation: Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ kra n teqdiât; apan nnwen. Ih, taqdiât iw, ar Öebbi kan. Neppa, $ef yal cci, d Anagi".

verses.text: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Ipqeddim tidep, d Amusnaw n tbavnit".
verses.translation: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Ipqeddim tidep, d Amusnaw n tbavnit".

verses.text: Ini: "tusa d tidep, ur d nezzunt tkerkas, ur d ppalsent".
verses.translation: Ini: "tusa d tidep, ur d nezzunt tkerkas, ur d ppalsent".

verses.text: Ini: "ma nnetlafe$, nnetlafe$ kan i iman iw. Ma pwanha$, d ayen iyi d Iweêêa Mass iw. Neppa, ih, d Aqôib, Isell".
verses.translation: Ini: "ma nnetlafe$, nnetlafe$ kan i iman iw. Ma pwanha$, d ayen iyi d Iweêêa Mass iw. Neppa, ih, d Aqôib, Isell".

verses.text: Lemmer a pwaliv mi xelâan, tarewla ur telli. Pwaîîfen, si tama iqeôben.
verses.translation: Lemmer a pwaliv mi xelâan, tarewla ur telli. Pwaîîfen, si tama iqeôben.

verses.text: Nnan: "numen yis". Amek ara d ssiwven, si tama ibaâden?
verses.translation: Nnan: "numen yis". Amek ara d ssiwven, si tama ibaâden?

verses.text: Ni$ llan zik, nekôen t. Rran akin tabavnit, si tama ibaâden.
verses.translation: Ni$ llan zik, nekôen t. Rran akin tabavnit, si tama ibaâden.

verses.text: Ad yili ufûil, garasen d wayen ctaqen, akken tevôa, zik, d wid i ten icban. Ih, nitni llan di ccekk imcebbwel.
verses.translation: Ad yili ufûil, garasen d wayen ctaqen, akken tevôa, zik, d wid i ten icban. Ih, nitni llan di ccekk imcebbwel.

ayahs.text: Ccekôan i Öebbi, i iIan i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. I Neppa, ccekôan di laxert. Neppa, d Bab n ûûwab, Ippuxebbeô.
ayahs.translation: Ccekôan i Öebbi, i iIan i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. I Neppa, ccekôan di laxert. Neppa, d Bab n ûûwab, Ippuxebbeô.

ayahs.text: Iéôa ayen ikeççmen di tmurt, ayen id iteff$en segs, ayen id iprusun seg igenni, ayen ippalin $uôes. Neppa Ipêunu, Ipsemmiê.
ayahs.translation: Iéôa ayen ikeççmen di tmurt, ayen id iteff$en segs, ayen id iprusun seg igenni, ayen ippalin $uôes. Neppa Ipêunu, Ipsemmiê.

ayahs.text: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur a$ d ippas yimir". Ini: "xaîi, s Mass iw, ara kwen id ias"! Amusnaw n tbavnit, ur idrig fellaS ubruy ubelkim, ama deg igenwan, ama di ddunit; ama seddaw wannect is, ama sennig es; akw, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur a$ d ippas yimir". Ini: "xaîi, s Mass iw, ara kwen id ias"! Amusnaw n tbavnit, ur idrig fellaS ubruy ubelkim, ama deg igenwan, ama di ddunit; ama seddaw wannect is, ama sennig es; akw, di Tezmamt ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Ad Ikafi wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I wigi, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.
ayahs.translation: Ad Ikafi wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I wigi, ssmaê akked ôôeéq ukyis.

ayahs.text: Wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nne£, sfunnugen, widak, fellasen aâaqeb n twa$it taqeôêant.
ayahs.translation: Wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nne£, sfunnugen, widak, fellasen aâaqeb n twa$it taqeôêant.

ayahs.text: Wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni, walan ar ayen id irsen $uôek, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep. Ippawi s abrid n Uzmir, Amaâzuz.
ayahs.translation: Wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni, walan ar ayen id irsen $uôek, s$uô Mass ik, d tidep. Ippawi s abrid n Uzmir, Amaâzuz.

ayahs.text: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ad awen nessken argaz, ar awen d yinin ar ma teftutsem, yal aftutes, i kunwi lxelq amaynut?
ayahs.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen: "day ad awen nessken argaz, ar awen d yinin ar ma teftutsem, yal aftutes, i kunwi lxelq amaynut?

ayahs.text: Iger ed tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ d aôehbani"? Xaîi, wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, haaten deg uâaqeb, akked ttelfan u$miq.
ayahs.translation: Iger ed tikerkas $ef Öebbi, ne$ d aôehbani"? Xaîi, wid ur numin ara s laxeôt, haaten deg uâaqeb, akked ttelfan u$miq.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara ayen illan zdat sen, u deffir sen, di tmurt akked igenwan? Ma ihwa ya£, a ten Nger seddaw tmurt, ne$ a d Nesse$li fellasen igezzim seg igenni. Deg wayagi, ih, d assekni i yal amdan ucâif.
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara ayen illan zdat sen, u deffir sen, di tmurt akked igenwan? Ma ihwa ya£, a ten Nger seddaw tmurt, ne$ a d Nesse$li fellasen igezzim seg igenni. Deg wayagi, ih, d assekni i yal amdan ucâif.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nefka s$uône£ lfevl i Dawed. A yidurar, alset yides akked ifrax. Nerra yas uzzal d aleqqaq.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka s$uône£ lfevl i Dawed. A yidurar, alset yides akked ifrax. Nerra yas uzzal d aleqqaq.

ayahs.text: Eûnaâ tibedâiyin n wuzzal, qiss tindar. Xeddmet ayen ilhan. Nek, Pwali$ ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Eûnaâ tibedâiyin n wuzzal, qiss tindar. Xeddmet ayen ilhan. Nek, Pwali$ ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: I Sliman: avu. Win n ûûbeê, aggur; win n tmeddit, aggur. Nelli yas taâwint n nnêas. Kra n leonun ad xedmen fellas, s tsriê n Mass is. Win degsen, iveôfen i lameô nne£, Nessukk fellas, aâaqeb ujajiê.
ayahs.translation: I Sliman: avu. Win n ûûbeê, aggur; win n tmeddit, aggur. Nelli yas taâwint n nnêas. Kra n leonun ad xedmen fellas, s tsriê n Mass is. Win degsen, iveôfen i lameô nne£, Nessukk fellas, aâaqeb ujajiê.

ayahs.text: Xeddmen as ayen ib$a: leowamaâ, tiâancuôin, loefnat am iêvunen, ticcuytin iqaâden. Exdem s tnemmirt, a tawacult n Dawed, drus n yimdanen iW i isnemmiren!
ayahs.translation: Xeddmen as ayen ib$a: leowamaâ, tiâancuôin, loefnat am iêvunen, ticcuytin iqaâden. Exdem s tnemmirt, a tawacult n Dawed, drus n yimdanen iW i isnemmiren!

ayahs.text: Mi Nseyya fellas tameppant, ur as faqen ara immut, armi içça taâkwazt is, ubaââuc n wakal. Mi i$li, êulfan leonun ar, lemmer day ssinen tabavnit, ur qqimen deg uâaqeb isdullun.
ayahs.translation: Mi Nseyya fellas tameppant, ur as faqen ara immut, armi içça taâkwazt is, ubaââuc n wakal. Mi i$li, êulfan leonun ar, lemmer day ssinen tabavnit, ur qqimen deg uâaqeb isdullun.

ayahs.text: Ni$, i Saba, assekni di tnezdu$in nnsen. Snat tebêirin, ta yeffus, ta zelmev. Eççet si l$it n Mass nnwen, u snemmret aS. Tamurt ilhan, Mass Ipsemmiêen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$, i Saba, assekni di tnezdu$in nnsen. Snat tebêirin, ta yeffus, ta zelmev. Eççet si l$it n Mass nnwen, u snemmret aS. Tamurt ilhan, Mass Ipsemmiêen.

ayahs.text: Wexxôen. Nuzen asen aêemmal n Âarim. Tibêirin nnsen, nerra tent d tibêirin id ippaken l$ella ôéagen, tammemayt, akked tzegwart taxeîîayt.
ayahs.translation: Wexxôen. Nuzen asen aêemmal n Âarim. Tibêirin nnsen, nerra tent d tibêirin id ippaken l$ella ôéagen, tammemayt, akked tzegwart taxeîîayt.

ayahs.text: Akka ay ten Nqeîîi $ef tijehli nnsen. Day a Nqeîîi wur nejhil?
ayahs.translation: Akka ay ten Nqeîîi $ef tijehli nnsen. Day a Nqeîîi wur nejhil?

ayahs.text: Nerra garasen u ger temdinin i$ef Nburek, timdinin id ivehôen. Nektal tikli garasent: "merêet degsent di laman, am yiv, am ass"!
ayahs.translation: Nerra garasen u ger temdinin i$ef Nburek, timdinin id ivehôen. Nektal tikli garasent: "merêet degsent di laman, am yiv, am ass"!

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! Zzi$wzef tallit ger zziaôat nne$"! Densen iman nnsen. Nerra ten d tiqûivin. Nesqucc iten wakali. Ih, deg wayagi, war ccek, d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a Mass nne$! Zzi$wzef tallit ger zziaôat nne$"! Densen iman nnsen. Nerra ten d tiqûivin. Nesqucc iten wakali. Ih, deg wayagi, war ccek, d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Iblis itebbet ed, segsen, ameyyez is. Vefôen t, siwa arbaâ si lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Iblis itebbet ed, segsen, ameyyez is. Vefôen t, siwa arbaâ si lmumnin.

ayahs.text: Ur isâi kra udabu fellasen. Iwakken kan, a Nissin anwa iumnen s laxeôt, u anwa i illan, fellas, di ccekk. Mass ik Ipêarab af yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ur isâi kra udabu fellasen. Iwakken kan, a Nissin anwa iumnen s laxeôt, u anwa i illan, fellas, di ccekk. Mass ik Ipêarab af yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ini: "naâret wid i tepkabarem, war Öebbi. Ur sâin taéeyt ubelkim, deg igenwan ne$ di tmurt; ur criken degsen; ur aS illi, garasen, umâiwen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "naâret wid i tepkabarem, war Öebbi. Ur sâin taéeyt ubelkim, deg igenwan ne$ di tmurt; ur criken degsen; ur aS illi, garasen, umâiwen".

ayahs.text: Cafuâa, s$uôeS, tenfaâ kan win iwumi ip Irad. Alamma, ma tekkes tugdi seg wulawen nnsen, a d inin: "acu id Inna, Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d tidep, u Neppa d Aâlayen, d Ameqwôan".
ayahs.translation: Cafuâa, s$uôeS, tenfaâ kan win iwumi ip Irad. Alamma, ma tekkes tugdi seg wulawen nnsen, a d inin: "acu id Inna, Mass nnwen"? A d inin: "d tidep, u Neppa d Aâlayen, d Ameqwôan".

ayahs.text: Ini: "anwa ikwen ip$aten, si tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi". Nekwni am kunwi, amendeô ma nella di nnhaya, ne$ di ttelfan n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "anwa ikwen ip$aten, si tmurt akked igenwan"? Ini: "d Öebbi". Nekwni am kunwi, amendeô ma nella di nnhaya, ne$ di ttelfan n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur teppuqeîîim $ef wayen nfalîa, ur neppuqeîîi $ef wayen txeddmem".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur teppuqeîîim $ef wayen nfalîa, ur neppuqeîîi $ef wayen txeddmem".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ad a$ Issemlil Mass nne$, sinna, ad Iêudd garane$, s tidep. Neppa d Amêaddi Amusnaw".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ad a$ Issemlil Mass nne$, sinna, ad Iêudd garane$, s tidep. Neppa d Amêaddi Amusnaw".

ayahs.text: Ini: "sseknet iyi d wid i tqeônem $uôeS, d icriken"! Xaîi, Neppa d Öebbi Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "sseknet iyi d wid i tqeônem $uôeS, d icriken"! Xaîi, Neppa d Öebbi Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ur k id Nuzen, i imdanen, armi d uqniâ; a pbecôôev, a pnedôev. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen, ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Ur k id Nuzen, i imdanen, armi d uqniâ; a pbecôôev, a pnedôev. Maca, tegwti n yimdanen, ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma tessawalem tidep"?
ayahs.translation: Qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma tessawalem tidep"?

ayahs.text: Ini: "$uôwen ppaâud ass, ur tezmirem a t teswexxôem, ne$ a t id tesqeôbem, s saâa".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "$uôwen ppaâud ass, ur tezmirem a t teswexxôem, ne$ a t id tesqeôbem, s saâa".

ayahs.text: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur neppamen, d awez$i, s Leqwôan agi, ne$ s wayen it id izwaren". Lemmer a pwaliv mara bedden imednas, ar Mass nnsen, pmeslayen garasen. Ad inin uôhifen i imzuxiyen: "lemmer maççi d kunwi, yili nella d lmumnin".
ayahs.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur neppamen, d awez$i, s Leqwôan agi, ne$ s wayen it id izwaren". Lemmer a pwaliv mara bedden imednas, ar Mass nnsen, pmeslayen garasen. Ad inin uôhifen i imzuxiyen: "lemmer maççi d kunwi, yili nella d lmumnin".

ayahs.text: Ad inin imzuxiyen i uôhifen: "day d nekwni ikwen isfeô$en af nnhaya, mi kwen id iusa? Xaîi, tellam d ibe$wviyen".
ayahs.translation: Ad inin imzuxiyen i uôhifen: "day d nekwni ikwen isfeô$en af nnhaya, mi kwen id iusa? Xaîi, tellam d ibe$wviyen".

ayahs.text: Ad inin uôhifen, i imzuxiyen: "xaîi! Nncub, iv akked wass, mi têeppmem, fellane$, a nagwi Öebbi, u ad aS negg tanudda". Ffren nndama mi walan aâaqeb. Nerra tiqwlavin $ef imegôav n wid ijehlen. Day ara ppuqeîîin $ef wayen ur xdimen?
ayahs.translation: Ad inin uôhifen, i imzuxiyen: "xaîi! Nncub, iv akked wass, mi têeppmem, fellane$, a nagwi Öebbi, u ad aS negg tanudda". Ffren nndama mi walan aâaqeb. Nerra tiqwlavin $ef imegôav n wid ijehlen. Day ara ppuqeîîin $ef wayen ur xdimen?

ayahs.text: Ur Nuzen ara kra uneddaô ar temdint, mebla ma nnan imeôkantiyen is: "nekwni, ih, nugwi ayen is id teppuceggâam".
ayahs.translation: Ur Nuzen ara kra uneddaô ar temdint, mebla ma nnan imeôkantiyen is: "nekwni, ih, nugwi ayen is id teppuceggâam".

ayahs.text: Nnan: "nekwni, n$elb ik ayla, tarwa. Ur nelli d wid ara ippuqeîîin".
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "nekwni, n$elb ik ayla, tarwa. Ur nelli d wid ara ippuqeîîin".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ihi Mass iw Ip$iti win i S ihwan u Iwezzen; maca, tegwti n imdanen, ur ssinen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ihi Mass iw Ip$iti win i S ihwan u Iwezzen; maca, tegwti n imdanen, ur ssinen".

ayahs.text: Maççi d ayla nnwen, ne$ d tarwa nnwen, ara kwen id iééiéen nezzeh $uône£, siwa wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I nitni arraz berdayen, ilmend n wayen xedmen. Ad ilin, di laman, di t$uôfatin.
ayahs.translation: Maççi d ayla nnwen, ne$ d tarwa nnwen, ara kwen id iééiéen nezzeh $uône£, siwa wid iumnen, ixedmen ayen ilhan. I nitni arraz berdayen, ilmend n wayen xedmen. Ad ilin, di laman, di t$uôfatin.

ayahs.text: Ma d wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nne£, sfunnugen, widak a d rsen i uâaqeb.
ayahs.translation: Ma d wid ikkaten deg issekniyen nne£, sfunnugen, widak a d rsen i uâaqeb.

ayahs.text: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Ip$iti win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Iwezzen as. Ayen akw ara tefkem n cci, ad awen t id Irr. Neppa, Yif akw im$iten".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Ip$iti win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS. Iwezzen as. Ayen akw ara tefkem n cci, ad awen t id Irr. Neppa, Yif akw im$iten".

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, akken ma llan, imiren ad Yini i lmalayek: "wigi, day llan âabden kwent"?
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara ten Ifser, akken ma llan, imiren ad Yini i lmalayek: "wigi, day llan âabden kwent"?

ayahs.text: A d inint: "gedha s yiseK! D Keçç ay d Bab nne$, war nitni. Xaîi, llan âabden leonun. Tegwti degsen umnen yissen".
ayahs.translation: A d inint: "gedha s yiseK! D Keçç ay d Bab nne$, war nitni. Xaîi, llan âabden leonun. Tegwti degsen umnen yissen".

ayahs.text: Assa, ur imlik yiwen i wayev, segwen, aba$uô ne$ ccqa. A Nini i wid idensen: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmes, i tellam tnekôem t"!
ayahs.translation: Assa, ur imlik yiwen i wayev, segwen, aba$uô ne$ ccqa. A Nini i wid idensen: "jeôôbet aâaqeb n tmes, i tellam tnekôem t"!

ayahs.text: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ ipbegginen, ad inin: "wagi d argaz kan, i ib$an a kwen istixeô, seg wayen llan âabden imezwura nnwen". Ad inin: "ayagi, siwa d tikerkas id innulfan". Wid ijehlen i tidep, mi ten id tusa, ad inin: "ayagi d ssêur n ûûeê kan"!
ayahs.translation: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ ipbegginen, ad inin: "wagi d argaz kan, i ib$an a kwen istixeô, seg wayen llan âabden imezwura nnwen". Ad inin: "ayagi, siwa d tikerkas id innulfan". Wid ijehlen i tidep, mi ten id tusa, ad inin: "ayagi d ssêur n ûûeê kan"!

ayahs.text: Ur asen Nefki tizmamin, ara lemden; ur asen d Nuzen, uqbel ik, aneddaô.
ayahs.translation: Ur asen Nefki tizmamin, ara lemden; ur asen d Nuzen, uqbel ik, aneddaô.

ayahs.text: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Ur asen tebbwiv ara tis mraw n wayen i ippunefken mi skaddben imazanen iW. A tuzzma W, imiren!
ayahs.translation: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Ur asen tebbwiv ara tis mraw n wayen i ippunefken mi skaddben imazanen iW. A tuzzma W, imiren!

ayahs.text: Ini: "ar yiwet kan, ara kwen nabi$: a pbeddem zdat Öebbi, di sin, ne$ weêêedwen; sinna, a d tesmektim. Ameddakwel nnwen ur illi d aôehbani. Neppa d aneddaô nnwen kan, uqbel aâaqeb uqsiê".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ar yiwet kan, ara kwen nabi$: a pbeddem zdat Öebbi, di sin, ne$ weêêedwen; sinna, a d tesmektim. Ameddakwel nnwen ur illi d aôehbani. Neppa d aneddaô nnwen kan, uqbel aâaqeb uqsiê".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ kra n teqdiât; apan nnwen. Ih, taqdiât iw, ar Öebbi kan. Neppa, $ef yal cci, d Anagi".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ kra n teqdiât; apan nnwen. Ih, taqdiât iw, ar Öebbi kan. Neppa, $ef yal cci, d Anagi".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Ipqeddim tidep, d Amusnaw n tbavnit".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ih, Mass iw Ipqeddim tidep, d Amusnaw n tbavnit".

ayahs.text: Ini: "tusa d tidep, ur d nezzunt tkerkas, ur d ppalsent".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "tusa d tidep, ur d nezzunt tkerkas, ur d ppalsent".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ma nnetlafe$, nnetlafe$ kan i iman iw. Ma pwanha$, d ayen iyi d Iweêêa Mass iw. Neppa, ih, d Aqôib, Isell".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ma nnetlafe$, nnetlafe$ kan i iman iw. Ma pwanha$, d ayen iyi d Iweêêa Mass iw. Neppa, ih, d Aqôib, Isell".

ayahs.text: Lemmer a pwaliv mi xelâan, tarewla ur telli. Pwaîîfen, si tama iqeôben.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer a pwaliv mi xelâan, tarewla ur telli. Pwaîîfen, si tama iqeôben.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "numen yis". Amek ara d ssiwven, si tama ibaâden?
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "numen yis". Amek ara d ssiwven, si tama ibaâden?

ayahs.text: Ni$ llan zik, nekôen t. Rran akin tabavnit, si tama ibaâden.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ llan zik, nekôen t. Rran akin tabavnit, si tama ibaâden.

ayahs.text: Ad yili ufûil, garasen d wayen ctaqen, akken tevôa, zik, d wid i ten icban. Ih, nitni llan di ccekk imcebbwel.
ayahs.translation: Ad yili ufûil, garasen d wayen ctaqen, akken tevôa, zik, d wid i ten icban. Ih, nitni llan di ccekk imcebbwel.

verses.text: Ccekôan i Öebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, i Irran lmalayek d timersulin sut sin, krav, akked kué iferrawen. Irennu, di lxelq, ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ccekôan i Öebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, i Irran lmalayek d timersulin sut sin, krav, akked kué iferrawen. Irennu, di lxelq, ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ayen Ifka Öebbi uêunu, i medden, ur t itekkes yiwen. Ayen Iîîef, ur izmir yiwen a t id iazen, deffir eS. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ayen Ifka Öebbi uêunu, i medden, ur t itekkes yiwen. Ayen Iîîef, ur izmir yiwen a t id iazen, deffir eS. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: A yimdanen! Mmektit ed a$iti nnwen s$uô Öebbi. Day illa uxellaq, war Öebbi, ikwen iôeéqen seg igenni akked tmurt? Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, ihi acimi tessaâwajem?
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Mmektit ed a$iti nnwen s$uô Öebbi. Day illa uxellaq, war Öebbi, ikwen iôeéqen seg igenni akked tmurt? Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, ihi acimi tessaâwajem?

verses.text: Ma nekôen k, ni$ pwanekôen imazanen, uqbel ik. Ar Öebbi, ara qqlen lumuô.
verses.translation: Ma nekôen k, ni$ pwanekôen imazanen, uqbel ik. Ar Öebbi, ara qqlen lumuô.

verses.text: A yimdanen! Ih, lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ur kwen tep$uôôu tmeddurt n ddunit! Ur kwen ipkellix um$weôôi, af Öebbi!
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Ih, lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ur kwen tep$uôôu tmeddurt n ddunit! Ur kwen ipkellix um$weôôi, af Öebbi!

verses.text: Cciîan, s tidep, d acengu nnwen. Ëesbet ep d acengu. Issawal kan, i ukabar is, ad ilin seg wat tmes.
verses.translation: Cciîan, s tidep, d acengu nnwen. Ëesbet ep d acengu. Issawal kan, i ukabar is, ad ilin seg wat tmes.

verses.text: I wid ijehlen, aâaqeb uqsiê. I wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ssmaê akked warraz meqqwôen.
verses.translation: I wid ijehlen, aâaqeb uqsiê. I wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ssmaê akked warraz meqqwôen.

verses.text: Day win iwumi Icebbeê yir igiten is, iwakken ad ioâal gerzen…? S tidep, Öebbi Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. Ur hellek ara iman ik, fellasen. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa acu la ûûenâen.
verses.translation: Day win iwumi Icebbeê yir igiten is, iwakken ad ioâal gerzen…? S tidep, Öebbi Itellif win i S ihwan, Inehhu win i S ihwan. Ur hellek ara iman ik, fellasen. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa acu la ûûenâen.

verses.text: Öebbi i Ippaznen avu, issalayen asigna. Neppawi t ar tmurt immuten, Nessidir ed, yis, akal, deffir tmeppant is. Akka, tanekra.
verses.translation: Öebbi i Ippaznen avu, issalayen asigna. Neppawi t ar tmurt immuten, Nessidir ed, yis, akal, deffir tmeppant is. Akka, tanekra.

verses.text: Win ib$an tazmert, tazmert akw ar Öebbi. Awal ukyis ippali $uôeS. Igi ilhan, Iteg as ccan. Aâaqeb uqsiê i wid ippandin tucmitin. A ppemêu tandit nnsen.
verses.translation: Win ib$an tazmert, tazmert akw ar Öebbi. Awal ukyis ippali $uôeS. Igi ilhan, Iteg as ccan. Aâaqeb uqsiê i wid ippandin tucmitin. A ppemêu tandit nnsen.

verses.text: Ixelq ikwen Öebbi seg wakal; sinna, si tiqqit; sinna, Irra kwen d tiyugiwin. Ur treffed tadist, ur tepparew nnta, siwa ma Iéôa t. Ur Izzi$wzif laâmeô i umuddir, ur as t Issenqas, siwa ma di tezmamt. Ayagi, ih, d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.
verses.translation: Ixelq ikwen Öebbi seg wakal; sinna, si tiqqit; sinna, Irra kwen d tiyugiwin. Ur treffed tadist, ur tepparew nnta, siwa ma Iéôa t. Ur Izzi$wzif laâmeô i umuddir, ur as t Issenqas, siwa ma di tezmamt. Ayagi, ih, d ayen isehlen i Öebbi.

verses.text: Ur aâdilen sin ilellen: wa zeddig, éid, iwata i tissit; wayev d ameô$an, d aôéagan. Segsen teppeppem aksum aleqqaq, teppekksem d iâqqucen i teppeqnem. Twalav sfina tepcerrig iten, iwakken a pnadim lfevl iS. Amar a ppesnemmrem.
verses.translation: Ur aâdilen sin ilellen: wa zeddig, éid, iwata i tissit; wayev d ameô$an, d aôéagan. Segsen teppeppem aksum aleqqaq, teppekksem d iâqqucen i teppeqnem. Twalav sfina tepcerrig iten, iwakken a pnadim lfevl iS. Amar a ppesnemmrem.

verses.text: Issekcam iv deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiv. Iêeppem i yiîij akked waggur, ad lêun ar lajel ipwassnen. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda. Wid i tnaâôem, war Neppa, ur rebêen iclem utemôiw.
verses.translation: Issekcam iv deg wass, Issekcam ass deg yiv. Iêeppem i yiîij akked waggur, ad lêun ar lajel ipwassnen. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda. Wid i tnaâôem, war Neppa, ur rebêen iclem utemôiw.

verses.text: Ma tnaâôem ten, ur sellen i tnaâôit nnwen. Xas slan, ur awen d pparan. Ass n tnekra, ad nekôen ccerk nnwen. Ur k ipxebbiô yiwen am Win Ippuxebbôen.
verses.translation: Ma tnaâôem ten, ur sellen i tnaâôit nnwen. Xas slan, ur awen d pparan. Ass n tnekra, ad nekôen ccerk nnwen. Ur k ipxebbiô yiwen am Win Ippuxebbôen.

verses.text: A yimdanen! Kunwi d ime$ban zdat Öebbi. Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Kunwi d ime$ban zdat Öebbi. Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.

verses.text: Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes, a d Iawi lxelq amaynut.
verses.translation: Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes, a d Iawi lxelq amaynut.

verses.text: I Öebbi, ayagi, ur illi d aéayan.
verses.translation: I Öebbi, ayagi, ur illi d aéayan.

verses.text: Win ibubben ur ipbibbi taâkkwemt n wayev. Ma isuter ed afus win iâabban, ur s ipwakkas wacemma, xas ma si llezm is. Nabi kan wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen di tbavnit, u péallan. Win ipzekkin, i iman is kan i ipzekki. Tu$alin ar Öebbi.
verses.translation: Win ibubben ur ipbibbi taâkkwemt n wayev. Ma isuter ed afus win iâabban, ur s ipwakkas wacemma, xas ma si llezm is. Nabi kan wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen di tbavnit, u péallan. Win ipzekkin, i iman is kan i ipzekki. Tu$alin ar Öebbi.

verses.text: Ur iaâdil uder$al akked win ipwalin,
verses.translation: Ur iaâdil uder$al akked win ipwalin,

verses.text: ne$ tillas akked tafat,
verses.translation: ne$ tillas akked tafat,

verses.text: ne$ tili akked una$uô.
verses.translation: ne$ tili akked una$uô.

verses.text: Ur aâdilen imuddiren akked lmeggtin. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel i win i S ihwan. Keçç, ur tezmirev a ppeslev i wid illan di tneîlin.
verses.translation: Ur aâdilen imuddiren akked lmeggtin. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel i win i S ihwan. Keçç, ur tezmirev a ppeslev i wid illan di tneîlin.

verses.text: Keçç, d aneddaô kan.
verses.translation: Keçç, d aneddaô kan.

verses.text: Ih, Nuzen ik id, s tidep, d abeccaô, d aneddaô. Ur illi lois, mebla ma iusa t id uneddaô.
verses.translation: Ih, Nuzen ik id, s tidep, d abeccaô, d aneddaô. Ur illi lois, mebla ma iusa t id uneddaô.

verses.text: Ma skaddben k, ni$ skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, s Ihellilen, s Tezmamt timnewweôt.
verses.translation: Ma skaddben k, ni$ skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Usan ten id imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, s Ihellilen, s Tezmamt timnewweôt.

verses.text: D$a Ssemêalqe$ i wid ijehlen. Amek tuzzma W imiren!
verses.translation: D$a Ssemêalqe$ i wid ijehlen. Amek tuzzma W imiren!

verses.text: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Isse$li d aman seg igenni? Nessuffe$ ed, yissen, ppemôa n yal ini. Deg idurar, isôiden icebêanen, izegwa$en n yal ini, akked iberkanen mavi.
verses.translation: Ur twalav ara Öebbi Isse$li d aman seg igenni? Nessuffe$ ed, yissen, ppemôa n yal ini. Deg idurar, isôiden icebêanen, izegwa$en n yal ini, akked iberkanen mavi.

verses.text: Imdanen, lewêuc, lmal, n yal ini ula d nitni. Akka, ger imdanen iS, d imusnawen kan i ippagwaden Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, Ipsemmiê
verses.translation: Imdanen, lewêuc, lmal, n yal ini ula d nitni. Akka, ger imdanen iS, d imusnawen kan i ippagwaden Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi d Uzmir, Ipsemmiê

verses.text: Ih, wid iqqaôen Tazmamt n Öebbi, ipéallan, ipseddiqen seg wayen iten N$at, s tuffra ne$ âinani, ad ssirmen ttjaôa ur nepquccu.
verses.translation: Ih, wid iqqaôen Tazmamt n Öebbi, ipéallan, ipseddiqen seg wayen iten N$at, s tuffra ne$ âinani, ad ssirmen ttjaôa ur nepquccu.

verses.text: Akken ad asen Ifk tiqvaâin nnsen, ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ippara tajmilt.
verses.translation: Akken ad asen Ifk tiqvaâin nnsen, ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. Neppa, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ippara tajmilt.

verses.text: Ayen i k Nweêêa, si Tezmamt, d tidep id itebbten ayen ip id izwaren. Ih, Öebbi, $ef imdanen iS, Ippuxebbeô, Ipwali ten.
verses.translation: Ayen i k Nweêêa, si Tezmamt, d tidep id itebbten ayen ip id izwaren. Ih, Öebbi, $ef imdanen iS, Ippuxebbeô, Ipwali ten.

verses.text: Sinna, Nerra d iweôôaten n Tezmamt, wid Nefren, ger imdanen nne£. Garasen, llan win idensen iman is, garasen alemmas, garasen win izeggwiren ar lxiô, s wannuf n Öebbi. Wagi d lfevl ameqwôan.
verses.translation: Sinna, Nerra d iweôôaten n Tezmamt, wid Nefren, ger imdanen nne£. Garasen, llan win idensen iman is, garasen alemmas, garasen win izeggwiren ar lxiô, s wannuf n Öebbi. Wagi d lfevl ameqwôan.

verses.text: Loennet n Âaden, ara kecmen. Din, ad qqnen imeqyasen n ddheb, akked tyuqat. Leêrir, di lebsa nnsen.
verses.translation: Loennet n Âaden, ara kecmen. Din, ad qqnen imeqyasen n ddheb, akked tyuqat. Leêrir, di lebsa nnsen.

verses.text: Ad inin: "cekôan i Öebbi i Issaferen fella$ le$wben. Ih, Mass nne$ Ipsemmiê, Ippara tajmilt.
verses.translation: Ad inin: "cekôan i Öebbi i Issaferen fella$ le$wben. Ih, Mass nne$ Ipsemmiê, Ippara tajmilt.

verses.text: I a$ Irran, s lefvl iS, axxam i tnezdu$t; ur a$ ipnal, degs, wugur; ur a$ ipnal, degs, âaggu".
verses.translation: I a$ Irran, s lefvl iS, axxam i tnezdu$t; ur a$ ipnal, degs, wugur; ur a$ ipnal, degs, âaggu".

verses.text: I wid ijehlen, times n Loahennama. Ur tepfukku fellasen, ad mmten; ur ippifsus, fellasen, uâaqeb is. Akka, ay Nepqeîîi yal ajehli.
verses.translation: I wid ijehlen, times n Loahennama. Ur tepfukku fellasen, ad mmten; ur ippifsus, fellasen, uâaqeb is. Akka, ay Nepqeîîi yal ajehli.

verses.text: Degs, ad ppu$un: "a Mass nne$! Ssuffe$ ane$, a nexdem ayen ilhan, maççi am akken nella nxeddem"! Day ur awen Nesse$wzef ara laâmeô, akken a d immekti win id ismektayen? Iusa kwen id uneddaô. Ihi jeôôbet. I imednas, ur illi umâiwen.
verses.translation: Degs, ad ppu$un: "a Mass nne$! Ssuffe$ ane$, a nexdem ayen ilhan, maççi am akken nella nxeddem"! Day ur awen Nesse$wzef ara laâmeô, akken a d immekti win id ismektayen? Iusa kwen id uneddaô. Ihi jeôôbet. I imednas, ur illi umâiwen.

verses.text: Öebbi Issen tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa, s tidep, Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Öebbi Issen tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa, s tidep, Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: D Neppa i kwen Iran d igensas di tmurt. Win ijehlen, tijehli s mgal iman is. Tijehli ijehliyen, siwa a$unzu i trennu ar Mass nnsen. Tijehli ijehliyen, siwa taxessaôt i trennu.
verses.translation: D Neppa i kwen Iran d igensas di tmurt. Win ijehlen, tijehli s mgal iman is. Tijehli ijehliyen, siwa a$unzu i trennu ar Mass nnsen. Tijehli ijehliyen, siwa taxessaôt i trennu.

verses.text: Ini: "twalam icriken nnwen, la tnaâôem, war Öebbi; sseknet iyi d acu xelqen, si tmurt, ne$ ma sâan amur deg igenwan, ne$ ma Nefka yasen Tazmamt i sen d ipbegginen? Xaîi, aâahed imednas, garasen, d a$uôôu kan.
verses.translation: Ini: "twalam icriken nnwen, la tnaâôem, war Öebbi; sseknet iyi d acu xelqen, si tmurt, ne$ ma sâan amur deg igenwan, ne$ ma Nefka yasen Tazmamt i sen d ipbegginen? Xaîi, aâahed imednas, garasen, d a$uôôu kan.

verses.text: D Öebbi, s tidep, i Iîfen tamurt akked igenwan, ur $ellin ara. Lemmer ad $lin, ur illi yiwen, deffir eS, ara ten iîîfen. Neppa, ih, Izga Iêellem, Ipsemmiê.
verses.translation: D Öebbi, s tidep, i Iîfen tamurt akked igenwan, ur $ellin ara. Lemmer ad $lin, ur illi yiwen, deffir eS, ara ten iîîfen. Neppa, ih, Izga Iêellem, Ipsemmiê.

verses.text: Gullen s Öebbi, tagalit meqwôen, ar ma iusa ten id uneddaô, ar ad ddun d ubrid, sennig akw leoyus. Mi ten id iusa uneddaô, i asen d irna, siwa tugin,
verses.translation: Gullen s Öebbi, tagalit meqwôen, ar ma iusa ten id uneddaô, ar ad ddun d ubrid, sennig akw leoyus. Mi ten id iusa uneddaô, i asen d irna, siwa tugin,

verses.text: tem$weô di tmurt, akked tnaâuôt tucmip. Ur teppaîîaf tnaâuôt tucmip, siwa bab is. Day ur muqlen ara ar tannumi imezwura? Ur teppafev, d awez$i, abeddel di tannumi n Öebbi. Ur teppafev ara adewwel di tannumi n Öebbi.
verses.translation: tem$weô di tmurt, akked tnaâuôt tucmip. Ur teppaîîaf tnaâuôt tucmip, siwa bab is. Day ur muqlen ara ar tannumi imezwura? Ur teppafev, d awez$i, abeddel di tannumi n Öebbi. Ur teppafev ara adewwel di tannumi n Öebbi.

verses.text: Day ur unagen ara di tmurt, ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren? Llan $elben ten tazmert. Ur illi win ara sfunngen Öebbi, s wacemma, deg igenwan, ne$ di tmurt. Neppa, ih, Izga d Amusnaw, d Uzmir.
verses.translation: Day ur unagen ara di tmurt, ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren? Llan $elben ten tazmert. Ur illi win ara sfunngen Öebbi, s wacemma, deg igenwan, ne$ di tmurt. Neppa, ih, Izga d Amusnaw, d Uzmir.

verses.text: Lemmer Ipqeîîi Öebbi imdanen, $ef wayen kesben, ur Ippaooa kra n lxelq sufella n tmurt. Maca, Iswexxiô iten, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ihi, Öebbi, deg imdanen iS, Izga Ipwali.
verses.translation: Lemmer Ipqeîîi Öebbi imdanen, $ef wayen kesben, ur Ippaooa kra n lxelq sufella n tmurt. Maca, Iswexxiô iten, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ma iusa d lajel nnsen, ihi, Öebbi, deg imdanen iS, Izga Ipwali.

ayahs.text: Ccekôan i Öebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, i Irran lmalayek d timersulin sut sin, krav, akked kué iferrawen. Irennu, di lxelq, ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ccekôan i Öebbi, Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, i Irran lmalayek d timersulin sut sin, krav, akked kué iferrawen. Irennu, di lxelq, ayen i S ihwan. Öebbi, s tidep, Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ayen Ifka Öebbi uêunu, i medden, ur t itekkes yiwen. Ayen Iîîef, ur izmir yiwen a t id iazen, deffir eS. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Ayen Ifka Öebbi uêunu, i medden, ur t itekkes yiwen. Ayen Iîîef, ur izmir yiwen a t id iazen, deffir eS. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Mmektit ed a$iti nnwen s$uô Öebbi. Day illa uxellaq, war Öebbi, ikwen iôeéqen seg igenni akked tmurt? Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, ihi acimi tessaâwajem?
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Mmektit ed a$iti nnwen s$uô Öebbi. Day illa uxellaq, war Öebbi, ikwen iôeéqen seg igenni akked tmurt? Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, ihi acimi tessaâwajem?

ayahs.text: Ma nekôen k, ni$ pwanekôen imazanen, uqbel ik. Ar Öebbi, ara qqlen lumuô.
ayahs.translation: Ma nekôen k, ni$ pwanekôen imazanen, uqbel ik. Ar Öebbi, ara qqlen lumuô.

ayahs.text: A yimdanen! Ih, lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ur kwen tep$uôôu tmeddurt n ddunit! Ur kwen ipkellix um$weôôi, af Öebbi!
ayahs.translation: A yimdanen! Ih, lemâahda n Öebbi d tidep. Ur kwen tep$uôôu tmeddurt n ddunit! Ur kwen ipkellix um$weôôi, af Öebbi!

ayahs.text: Cciîan, s tidep, d acengu nnwen. Ëesbet ep d acengu. Issawal kan, i ukabar is, ad ilin seg wat tmes.
