ayahs.text: Inna: "fellak xezzu, alamma d ass iqeîîiyen".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "fellak xezzu, alamma d ass iqeîîiyen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "A Mass iw, eoo iyi ar ass ideg ara d kkren".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "A Mass iw, eoo iyi ar ass ideg ara d kkren".

ayahs.text: Inna: "keçç, ih, seg wid Ooi$
ayahs.translation: Inna: "keçç, ih, seg wid Ooi$

ayahs.text: ar ass n wukud ipwassnen".
ayahs.translation: ar ass n wukud ipwassnen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "s tezmert iK, a ten $ewwu$, akken ma llan,
ayahs.translation: Inna: "s tezmert iK, a ten $ewwu$, akken ma llan,

ayahs.text: siwa imdanen iK izedganen segsen".
ayahs.translation: siwa imdanen iK izedganen segsen".

ayahs.text: Inna: "tidep, d tidep ay Nni$.
ayahs.translation: Inna: "tidep, d tidep ay Nni$.

ayahs.text: Ad Acare$ Loahennama yissek, akked wid, segsen, i k ivefôen, akken ma llan".
ayahs.translation: Ad Acare$ Loahennama yissek, akked wid, segsen, i k ivefôen, akken ma llan".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ taqdiât af waya. Ur lli$, nek, seg wid ippestaâmilen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ taqdiât af waya. Ur lli$, nek, seg wid ippestaâmilen".

ayahs.text: Neppa, s tidep, d asmekti kan i imavalen.
ayahs.translation: Neppa, s tidep, d asmekti kan i imavalen.

ayahs.text: Mi tâadda tallit, war ccekk, a kwen id iawev usali s.
ayahs.translation: Mi tâadda tallit, war ccekk, a kwen id iawev usali s.

verses.text: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ih, Nessader ak d Tazmamt, s tidep. Ihi, aâbed Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.
verses.translation: Ih, Nessader ak d Tazmamt, s tidep. Ihi, aâbed Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.

verses.text: Day maççi i Öebbi laâqida? Wid ippaddamen imawlan, war Neppa, nnan: "naâbed iten kan, iwakken ad a$ rnun aseqôeb ar Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi ad Iêudd garasen, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden. Öebbi, war ccekk, ur Inehhu win illan d akeddab, d ajehli.
verses.translation: Day maççi i Öebbi laâqida? Wid ippaddamen imawlan, war Neppa, nnan: "naâbed iten kan, iwakken ad a$ rnun aseqôeb ar Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi ad Iêudd garasen, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden. Öebbi, war ccekk, ur Inehhu win illan d akeddab, d ajehli.

verses.text: Lemmer Ib$i Öebbi ad Isâu aqcic, yili Ifren, deg wayen Ixelleq, ayen i S ihwan. Gedha s yiS! Neppa d Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.
verses.translation: Lemmer Ib$i Öebbi ad Isâu aqcic, yili Ifren, deg wayen Ixelleq, ayen i S ihwan. Gedha s yiS! Neppa d Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.

verses.text: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Innev Iv i wass, Innev ass i yiv. Iêeppem i yiîij akked waggur, ad lêun, yal wa, ar lajel ipwassnen. Day Neppa maççi d Uzmir Ipsemmiêen?
verses.translation: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Innev Iv i wass, Innev ass i yiv. Iêeppem i yiîij akked waggur, ad lêun, yal wa, ar lajel ipwassnen. Day Neppa maççi d Uzmir Ipsemmiêen?

verses.text: Ixelq ikwen si yiwen n lxelq. Irra, segs, tislit is. Issers awen d îam n tyugiwin n lmal. Ixelq ikwen di tâabbuvin n tyimmatin nnwen, lxelq deffir lxelq, di krav n tellisat. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Amek ihi tugim?
verses.translation: Ixelq ikwen si yiwen n lxelq. Irra, segs, tislit is. Issers awen d îam n tyugiwin n lmal. Ixelq ikwen di tâabbuvin n tyimmatin nnwen, lxelq deffir lxelq, di krav n tellisat. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Amek ihi tugim?

verses.text: Ma tjehlem, Öebbi ur kwen Iêwao ara. Ur Ipôadi tijehli i imdanen iS. Ma tesnemmrem, a kwen Iôavi. Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev; sinna, ar Mass nnwen tu$alin nnwen; ad awen Imel acu txeddmem. Ih, Neppa, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Ma tjehlem, Öebbi ur kwen Iêwao ara. Ur Ipôadi tijehli i imdanen iS. Ma tesnemmrem, a kwen Iôavi. Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev; sinna, ar Mass nnwen tu$alin nnwen; ad awen Imel acu txeddmem. Ih, Neppa, Issen i illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: Amdan, ma iêuza t ccqa, ad inuj ar Mass is, d ucâif $uôes; sinna, ma I$at it s$uôeS, ad ippu ayen i$ef inuj $uôeS, uqbel; ad irr i Öebbi tanudda, ad innetlaf seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhu cwiî di tijehli k, ihi, keçç seg wat tmes".
verses.translation: Amdan, ma iêuza t ccqa, ad inuj ar Mass is, d ucâif $uôes; sinna, ma I$at it s$uôeS, ad ippu ayen i$ef inuj $uôeS, uqbel; ad irr i Öebbi tanudda, ad innetlaf seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhu cwiî di tijehli k, ihi, keçç seg wat tmes".

verses.text: Day win ippanzen deg iv, ikna u ibedd, ipêebbiô i laxeôt, issaram aêunu n Mass is…? Ini: "day âadlen wid issnen akked wid ur nessin? Ay d ismektayen, kan, d uâqilen".
verses.translation: Day win ippanzen deg iv, ikna u ibedd, ipêebbiô i laxeôt, issaram aêunu n Mass is…? Ini: "day âadlen wid issnen akked wid ur nessin? Ay d ismektayen, kan, d uâqilen".

verses.text: Ini: "a yimdanen iW iumnen, êezzbet i Mass nnwen. Ayen ilhan i wid imaânen di ddunit agi. Tamurt n Öebbi tewsaâ. Ihi, arraz, war aktili, ad ippunefk i iûebôiyen".
verses.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen iW iumnen, êezzbet i Mass nnwen. Ayen ilhan i wid imaânen di ddunit agi. Tamurt n Öebbi tewsaâ. Ihi, arraz, war aktili, ad ippunefk i iûebôiyen".

verses.text: Ini: "nek pwamôe$ d ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.
verses.translation: Ini: "nek pwamôe$ d ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.

verses.text: Pwamôe$ d, ad ili$ d amvuâ amenzu".
verses.translation: Pwamôe$ d, ad ili$ d amvuâ amenzu".

verses.text: Ini: "nek, ugade$, ma aâûa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".
verses.translation: Ini: "nek, ugade$, ma aâûa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".

verses.text: Ini: "ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.
verses.translation: Ini: "ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.

verses.text: Ihi, âabdet i wen ihwan, war Neppa". Ini: "imexsuôen d wid iwedôen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". Ni$ d tagi ay d taxessaôt n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Ihi, âabdet i wen ihwan, war Neppa". Ini: "imexsuôen d wid iwedôen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". Ni$ d tagi ay d taxessaôt n ûûeê.

verses.text: A$embabu n tmes, sennig sen, wayev seddawat sen. Ayagi, Issagwad yis Öebbi imdanen iS: a yimdanen iW, êezzbet iyI!
verses.translation: A$embabu n tmes, sennig sen, wayev seddawat sen. Ayagi, Issagwad yis Öebbi imdanen iS: a yimdanen iW, êezzbet iyI!

verses.text: Wid ijunben aâbad iôebbiten n tkerkas, u iutuben Öebbi, a ten id ias lfeôê. Ihi, ssefôeê imdanen iW
verses.translation: Wid ijunben aâbad iôebbiten n tkerkas, u iutuben Öebbi, a ten id ias lfeôê. Ihi, ssefôeê imdanen iW

verses.text: i issemêasen i wawal, teddun d ûûam ines. D wigi i Inha Öebbi, d wigi ay d uâqilen.
verses.translation: i issemêasen i wawal, teddun d ûûam ines. D wigi i Inha Öebbi, d wigi ay d uâqilen.

verses.text: Day win i$ef ippuseyya ad isâaddi aâaqeb, day a psellkev keçç, win illan di tmes?
verses.translation: Day win i$ef ippuseyya ad isâaddi aâaqeb, day a psellkev keçç, win illan di tmes?

verses.text: Ma d wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad sâun ti$uôfatin, bnant ta sennig ta, isaffen seddawat sent ppazzalen, d lemâahda n Öebbi. Öebbi ur Ixeîîu i lemâahda.
verses.translation: Ma d wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad sâun ti$uôfatin, bnant ta sennig ta, isaffen seddawat sent ppazzalen, d lemâahda n Öebbi. Öebbi ur Ixeîîu i lemâahda.

verses.text: Ur twalav ara, Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni, Issekcem iten ad sswen akal. Sinna, yissen, a d Issuffe$ im$an n yal ini, ara iu$alen ad isliwen. A ten twaliv d iwôa$en, sinna, a ten Irr d iquôanen. Deg waya, s tidep, asmekti i uâqilen.
verses.translation: Ur twalav ara, Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni, Issekcem iten ad sswen akal. Sinna, yissen, a d Issuffe$ im$an n yal ini, ara iu$alen ad isliwen. A ten twaliv d iwôa$en, sinna, a ten Irr d iquôanen. Deg waya, s tidep, asmekti i uâqilen.

verses.text: Day win iwumi Illi Öebbi, idmaren is, ar wannuz, d$a neppa di tafat s$uô Mass is…? A ssxev n at wulawen iqquôen, ur d smektayen Öebbi! Widak di ttelfan n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Day win iwumi Illi Öebbi, idmaren is, ar wannuz, d$a neppa di tafat s$uô Mass is…? A ssxev n at wulawen iqquôen, ur d smektayen Öebbi! Widak di ttelfan n ûûeê.

verses.text: Issader ed Öebbi ûûam n wawal. Tazmamt, degs acbi, allus. Ad ccirwen segs igwelman akked wulawen n wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen, sinna, igwelman akked wulawen nnsen ad iêninen ar usmekti n Öebbi. D tagi ay d nnhaya n Öebbi. Inehhu yis, win i S ihwan. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi wa ara t inhun.
verses.translation: Issader ed Öebbi ûûam n wawal. Tazmamt, degs acbi, allus. Ad ccirwen segs igwelman akked wulawen n wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen, sinna, igwelman akked wulawen nnsen ad iêninen ar usmekti n Öebbi. D tagi ay d nnhaya n Öebbi. Inehhu yis, win i S ihwan. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi wa ara t inhun.

verses.text: Day win ipêezziben, s wudem is, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra…? Ad inin i imednas: "jeôôbet ayen tkeppbem"!
verses.translation: Day win ipêezziben, s wudem is, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra…? Ad inin i imednas: "jeôôbet ayen tkeppbem"!

verses.text: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Iusa ten id uâaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin.
verses.translation: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Iusa ten id uâaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin.

verses.text: Issukk fellasen Öebbi aâaqeb, di tmeddurt n ddunit; war ccekk, aâaqeb n laxeôt iugar it, lemmer éeôôen!
verses.translation: Issukk fellasen Öebbi aâaqeb, di tmeddurt n ddunit; war ccekk, aâaqeb n laxeôt iugar it, lemmer éeôôen!

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka i imdanen, di Leqwôan agi, yal amedya, amar a d mmektin.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka i imdanen, di Leqwôan agi, yal amedya, amar a d mmektin.

verses.text: Leqwôan s taâôabt, ur degs tiââawji; amar ad êezzben.
verses.translation: Leqwôan s taâôabt, ur degs tiââawji; amar ad êezzben.

verses.text: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n urgaz icerken akked wid ipmeréan, u argaz di tifrat akked yiwen urgaz. Day âadlen sin imedyaten? Ccekôan i Öebbi. Xaîi, tegwti degsen ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n urgaz icerken akked wid ipmeréan, u argaz di tifrat akked yiwen urgaz. Day âadlen sin imedyaten? Ccekôan i Öebbi. Xaîi, tegwti degsen ur ssinen.

verses.text: War ccekk, keçç a ppemmtev, nitni ad mmten.
verses.translation: War ccekk, keçç a ppemmtev, nitni ad mmten.

verses.text: Sinna, kunwi, ass n tnekra, ar Mass nnwen, a ppemqellaâm.
verses.translation: Sinna, kunwi, ass n tnekra, ar Mass nnwen, a ppemqellaâm.

verses.text: Anwa i idensen sennig win iskaddben af Öebbi, iskaddben tidep ma tusa t id? Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam ijehliyen?
verses.translation: Anwa i idensen sennig win iskaddben af Öebbi, iskaddben tidep ma tusa t id? Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam ijehliyen?

verses.text: Wid id iusan s tidep, u pputebbten yis, wigi d wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Wid id iusan s tidep, u pputebbten yis, wigi d wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Ad sâun ayen b$an, ar Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d arraz iâaôviyen.
verses.translation: Ad sâun ayen b$an, ar Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d arraz iâaôviyen.

verses.text: Iwakken ad asen Ikkes Öebbi, ayen xedmen adiran mavi; a ten I$it s wayen xeddmen d amxallef.
verses.translation: Iwakken ad asen Ikkes Öebbi, ayen xedmen adiran mavi; a ten I$it s wayen xeddmen d amxallef.

verses.text: Day ur Ipqam ara Öebbi amdan iS? La k ssagwaden s wid, war Neppa. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi w ara t inhun.
verses.translation: Day ur Ipqam ara Öebbi amdan iS? La k ssagwaden s wid, war Neppa. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi w ara t inhun.

verses.text: Win Inha Öebbi, ur illi w ara t itelfen. Ni$ Öebbi d Uzmir, Bab n ppaô.
verses.translation: Win Inha Öebbi, ur illi w ara t itelfen. Ni$ Öebbi d Uzmir, Bab n ppaô.

verses.text: Ma testeqsav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan? Ad inin, war ccekk: d Öebbi". Ini: "ma twalam wigi tnaâôem, war Öebbi, day zemren, ma Ib$a yi Öebbi ccqa, ad kksen ccqa S? Ne$, ma Ib$a yi aêunu, ad ssbeîlen aêunu S"? Ini: "Iqennaâ iyi Öebbi; fellaS ay ppeklen wid ipkalen".
verses.translation: Ma testeqsav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan? Ad inin, war ccekk: d Öebbi". Ini: "ma twalam wigi tnaâôem, war Öebbi, day zemren, ma Ib$a yi Öebbi ccqa, ad kksen ccqa S? Ne$, ma Ib$a yi aêunu, ad ssbeîlen aêunu S"? Ini: "Iqennaâ iyi Öebbi; fellaS ay ppeklen wid ipkalen".

verses.text: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tennumen, nek la xeddme$". Deqqal a ppeéôem
verses.translation: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tennumen, nek la xeddme$". Deqqal a ppeéôem

verses.text: anwa u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, u$uô ara d irs uâaqeb imezgi.
verses.translation: anwa u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, u$uô ara d irs uâaqeb imezgi.

verses.text: Ih, Nessader ed $uôek, Tazmamt i medden, s tidets. Win ipwanhan, i iman is, win innetlafen, innetlaf kan, mgal is. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.
verses.translation: Ih, Nessader ed $uôek, Tazmamt i medden, s tidets. Win ipwanhan, i iman is, win innetlafen, innetlaf kan, mgal is. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.

verses.text: Öebbi Ippaddam leôwaê mara mmten, akked wid ur nemmut, deg ives nnsen. Iâatteq wid i$ef Iseyya tameppant, Ippara d wiyav, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ih, deg wayagi, ard issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
verses.translation: Öebbi Ippaddam leôwaê mara mmten, akked wid ur nemmut, deg ives nnsen. Iâatteq wid i$ef Iseyya tameppant, Ippara d wiyav, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ih, deg wayagi, ard issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.

verses.text: Ne$ ad ddmen, war Öebbi, imcafâan? Ini: "i ma ur sâin acemma, ur fhimen"?
verses.translation: Ne$ ad ddmen, war Öebbi, imcafâan? Ini: "i ma ur sâin acemma, ur fhimen"?

verses.text: Ini: "akw ccafuâa n Öebbi. IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Sinna, $uôeS ara tu$alem".
verses.translation: Ini: "akw ccafuâa n Öebbi. IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Sinna, $uôeS ara tu$alem".

verses.text: Mara d Ipwadder Öebbi Yiwen, ad zemven wulawen n wid ur numin ara s laxeôt. Ma pwadren d wid, war Neppa, imiren nitni ad ceôêen.
verses.translation: Mara d Ipwadder Öebbi Yiwen, ad zemven wulawen n wid ur numin ara s laxeôt. Ma pwadren d wid, war Neppa, imiren nitni ad ceôêen.

verses.text: Ini: "a Öebbi! Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Amusnaw n wayen iffren d wayen ivehôen, d Keçç ara Iêudden ger imdanen iK, $ef wayen llan mgarraden".
verses.translation: Ini: "a Öebbi! Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Amusnaw n wayen iffren d wayen ivehôen, d Keçç ara Iêudden ger imdanen iK, $ef wayen llan mgarraden".

verses.text: Wid idensen, lemmer nnsen ayen akw i illan di tmurt, rnu yas am neppa, ur ten id ifeddu, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra. Ad asen d iban, s$uô Öebbi, ayen i$ef ur bnin.
verses.translation: Wid idensen, lemmer nnsen ayen akw i illan di tmurt, rnu yas am neppa, ur ten id ifeddu, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra. Ad asen d iban, s$uô Öebbi, ayen i$ef ur bnin.

verses.text: Ad asen d banent tucmitin kesben, ad asen innev wayen i$ef ttahan.
verses.translation: Ad asen d banent tucmitin kesben, ad asen innev wayen i$ef ttahan.

verses.text: Ma iêuza umdan ccqa, ad a£ d inâaô. Sinna, ma Nezger tacvaî nne£ fellas, ad yini: "tusa yi d kan si tmusni". Xaîi! D ajeôôeb, maca aîas degsen ur ssinen.
verses.translation: Ma iêuza umdan ccqa, ad a£ d inâaô. Sinna, ma Nezger tacvaî nne£ fellas, ad yini: "tusa yi d kan si tmusni". Xaîi! D ajeôôeb, maca aîas degsen ur ssinen.

verses.text: Ni$ nnan t id imezwura nnsen. Acu i sen d ibbwi wayen keppben?
verses.translation: Ni$ nnan t id imezwura nnsen. Acu i sen d ibbwi wayen keppben?

verses.text: Iwwet iten wayen kesben n tucmitin. Wid idensen, seg wigi, a ten iwwet wayen kesben n tucmitin. Ur zmiren ad sfunngen.
verses.translation: Iwwet iten wayen kesben n tucmitin. Wid idensen, seg wigi, a ten iwwet wayen kesben n tucmitin. Ur zmiren ad sfunngen.

verses.text: Day ur éôin ara ar Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen? Ih, deg waya, ard issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
verses.translation: Day ur éôin ara ar Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen? Ih, deg waya, ard issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.

verses.text: Ini: "a yimdanen iw i ipêawalen mgal iman nnsen! Ur ppayset aêunu n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê akw ibekkaven. Ih, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen iw i ipêawalen mgal iman nnsen! Ur ppayset aêunu n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê akw ibekkaven. Ih, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Steôoâet i Mass nnwen, anzet aS, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, d$a ula ikwen isellken.
verses.translation: Steôoâet i Mass nnwen, anzet aS, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, d$a ula ikwen isellken.

verses.text: Ddut d ûûam n wayen i wen d irsen, s$uô Mass nnwen, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, deqzalla, kunwi ur tebnim";
verses.translation: Ddut d ûûam n wayen i wen d irsen, s$uô Mass nnwen, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, deqzalla, kunwi ur tebnim";

verses.text: u a d yini ôôuê: "a ssexv iw, $ef wayen stehza$ ar loiha n Öebbi! Lli$, s tidep, seg wid ittihin".
verses.translation: u a d yini ôôuê: "a ssexv iw, $ef wayen stehza$ ar loiha n Öebbi! Lli$, s tidep, seg wid ittihin".

verses.text: Ne$ a d yini: "lemmer iyi Inha Öebbi, yili lli$ seg wid ipêezziben".
verses.translation: Ne$ a d yini: "lemmer iyi Inha Öebbi, yili lli$ seg wid ipêezziben".

verses.text: Ne$ a d yini mara iwali aâaqeb: "lemmer iyi illi wallus, ad ili$ si lâuûam".
verses.translation: Ne$ a d yini mara iwali aâaqeb: "lemmer iyi illi wallus, ad ili$ si lâuûam".

verses.text: Xaîi! Usan k id issekniyen iW, teskaddbev ten, tzuxxev, telliv seg ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Xaîi! Usan k id issekniyen iW, teskaddbev ten, tzuxxev, telliv seg ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ass n tnekra, a pwaliv berrikit wudmawen n wid id igren tikerkas af Öebbi. Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam imzuxiyen?
verses.translation: Ass n tnekra, a pwaliv berrikit wudmawen n wid id igren tikerkas af Öebbi. Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam imzuxiyen?

verses.text: Ad Isellek Öebbi wid iêezzben; ar rebêen. Ur ten ikkat wugur, ur $webbnen.
verses.translation: Ad Isellek Öebbi wid iêezzben; ar rebêen. Ur ten ikkat wugur, ur $webbnen.

verses.text: Öebbi Ixleq yal cci. Neppa d Awkil n yal cci.
verses.translation: Öebbi Ixleq yal cci. Neppa d Awkil n yal cci.

verses.text: IneS tsura n tmurt akked igenwan. Wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, widak d imexsuôen.
verses.translation: IneS tsura n tmurt akked igenwan. Wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, widak d imexsuôen.

verses.text: Ini: "day ad yi tamôem ad âabde$, war Öebbi, a wid ur nessin"?
verses.translation: Ini: "day ad yi tamôem ad âabde$, war Öebbi, a wid ur nessin"?

verses.text: Ni$ iusa k id uweêêi, u $eô wid i k izwaren. Ma tcurkev, ad mêun igiten ik, a ppiliv seg imexsuôen.
verses.translation: Ni$ iusa k id uweêêi, u $eô wid i k izwaren. Ma tcurkev, ad mêun igiten ik, a ppiliv seg imexsuôen.

verses.text: Xaîi! Aâbed Öebbi. Ili seg wid isnemmiren.
verses.translation: Xaîi! Aâbed Öebbi. Ili seg wid isnemmiren.

verses.text: Ur qudôen ara Öebbi, azal n lqedô iS. Akw tamurt, ass n tnekra, di tumeét iS. Igenwan ad nnefvasen deg ufus iS ayeffus. Gedha s yiS! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
verses.translation: Ur qudôen ara Öebbi, azal n lqedô iS. Akw tamurt, ass n tnekra, di tumeét iS. Igenwan ad nnefvasen deg ufus iS ayeffus. Gedha s yiS! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!

verses.text: Aûuvu di lbuq: ad ixsef i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, kkes ed i S ihwan i Öebbi. Aûuvu nniven: nitni a d kkren pmuqulen.
verses.translation: Aûuvu di lbuq: ad ixsef i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, kkes ed i S ihwan i Öebbi. Aûuvu nniven: nitni a d kkren pmuqulen.

verses.text: A pfeooeo tmurt, si tafat n Mass is. A d ters Tezmamt, a d awin lambiyya akked inagan. Ad âaddin di ccôaâ, s tidep, ur pwadensen.
verses.translation: A pfeooeo tmurt, si tafat n Mass is. A d ters Tezmamt, a d awin lambiyya akked inagan. Ad âaddin di ccôaâ, s tidep, ur pwadensen.

verses.text: Yal yiwen ad i$ellet ayen ixdem. Neppa, Yif akw akken Issen, d acu xeddmen.
verses.translation: Yal yiwen ad i$ellet ayen ixdem. Neppa, Yif akw akken Issen, d acu xeddmen.

verses.text: Ad pwanehôen wid ijehlen, d igrawen, ar Loahennama. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "day ur kwen in usan ara imazanen, segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen n Mass nnwen, nedôen kwen af temlilit n wass nnwen agi"? A d inin: "Ih. Maca, ad iûaô wawal uâaqeb, af ijehliyen".
verses.translation: Ad pwanehôen wid ijehlen, d igrawen, ar Loahennama. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "day ur kwen in usan ara imazanen, segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen n Mass nnwen, nedôen kwen af temlilit n wass nnwen agi"? A d inin: "Ih. Maca, ad iûaô wawal uâaqeb, af ijehliyen".

verses.text: A d inin: "kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama! Degs, wekkôet". Ay d ucmit uxxam n imzuxiyen!
verses.translation: A d inin: "kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama! Degs, wekkôet". Ay d ucmit uxxam n imzuxiyen!

verses.text: Wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad pwanehôen ar Loennet, d igrawen. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "tifrat fellawen, tgerzem; kecmet ep, twekkôem"!
verses.translation: Wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad pwanehôen ar Loennet, d igrawen. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "tifrat fellawen, tgerzem; kecmet ep, twekkôem"!

verses.text: Ad inin: "ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Issawven lemâahda S. Ifka ya$ tamurt d lweôt; a nili, di Loennet, anda i $ ihwa. A yarraz asaâdi n wid ixeddmen lxiô!
verses.translation: Ad inin: "ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Issawven lemâahda S. Ifka ya$ tamurt d lweôt; a nili, di Loennet, anda i $ ihwa. A yarraz asaâdi n wid ixeddmen lxiô!

verses.text: A pwaliv lmalayek zzint ed i usgeld, sbuccuâent s ccekôan Mass nnsent. Iâadda ccôaâ garasen, s tidep. Ad inin: "a neckeô Öebbi, Mass imavalen".
verses.translation: A pwaliv lmalayek zzint ed i usgeld, sbuccuâent s ccekôan Mass nnsent. Iâadda ccôaâ garasen, s tidep. Ad inin: "a neckeô Öebbi, Mass imavalen".

ayahs.text: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ih, Nessader ak d Tazmamt, s tidep. Ihi, aâbed Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Nessader ak d Tazmamt, s tidep. Ihi, aâbed Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.

ayahs.text: Day maççi i Öebbi laâqida? Wid ippaddamen imawlan, war Neppa, nnan: "naâbed iten kan, iwakken ad a$ rnun aseqôeb ar Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi ad Iêudd garasen, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden. Öebbi, war ccekk, ur Inehhu win illan d akeddab, d ajehli.
ayahs.translation: Day maççi i Öebbi laâqida? Wid ippaddamen imawlan, war Neppa, nnan: "naâbed iten kan, iwakken ad a$ rnun aseqôeb ar Öebbi". Ih, Öebbi ad Iêudd garasen, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden. Öebbi, war ccekk, ur Inehhu win illan d akeddab, d ajehli.

ayahs.text: Lemmer Ib$i Öebbi ad Isâu aqcic, yili Ifren, deg wayen Ixelleq, ayen i S ihwan. Gedha s yiS! Neppa d Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer Ib$i Öebbi ad Isâu aqcic, yili Ifren, deg wayen Ixelleq, ayen i S ihwan. Gedha s yiS! Neppa d Öebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaô.

ayahs.text: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Innev Iv i wass, Innev ass i yiv. Iêeppem i yiîij akked waggur, ad lêun, yal wa, ar lajel ipwassnen. Day Neppa maççi d Uzmir Ipsemmiêen?
ayahs.translation: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Innev Iv i wass, Innev ass i yiv. Iêeppem i yiîij akked waggur, ad lêun, yal wa, ar lajel ipwassnen. Day Neppa maççi d Uzmir Ipsemmiêen?

ayahs.text: Ixelq ikwen si yiwen n lxelq. Irra, segs, tislit is. Issers awen d îam n tyugiwin n lmal. Ixelq ikwen di tâabbuvin n tyimmatin nnwen, lxelq deffir lxelq, di krav n tellisat. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Amek ihi tugim?
ayahs.translation: Ixelq ikwen si yiwen n lxelq. Irra, segs, tislit is. Issers awen d îam n tyugiwin n lmal. Ixelq ikwen di tâabbuvin n tyimmatin nnwen, lxelq deffir lxelq, di krav n tellisat. D wagi ay d Öebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. Amek ihi tugim?

ayahs.text: Ma tjehlem, Öebbi ur kwen Iêwao ara. Ur Ipôadi tijehli i imdanen iS. Ma tesnemmrem, a kwen Iôavi. Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev; sinna, ar Mass nnwen tu$alin nnwen; ad awen Imel acu txeddmem. Ih, Neppa, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
ayahs.translation: Ma tjehlem, Öebbi ur kwen Iêwao ara. Ur Ipôadi tijehli i imdanen iS. Ma tesnemmrem, a kwen Iôavi. Ur ipbibbi yiwen taâkkwemt n wayev; sinna, ar Mass nnwen tu$alin nnwen; ad awen Imel acu txeddmem. Ih, Neppa, Issen i illan deg idmaren.

ayahs.text: Amdan, ma iêuza t ccqa, ad inuj ar Mass is, d ucâif $uôes; sinna, ma I$at it s$uôeS, ad ippu ayen i$ef inuj $uôeS, uqbel; ad irr i Öebbi tanudda, ad innetlaf seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhu cwiî di tijehli k, ihi, keçç seg wat tmes".
ayahs.translation: Amdan, ma iêuza t ccqa, ad inuj ar Mass is, d ucâif $uôes; sinna, ma I$at it s$uôeS, ad ippu ayen i$ef inuj $uôeS, uqbel; ad irr i Öebbi tanudda, ad innetlaf seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhu cwiî di tijehli k, ihi, keçç seg wat tmes".

ayahs.text: Day win ippanzen deg iv, ikna u ibedd, ipêebbiô i laxeôt, issaram aêunu n Mass is…? Ini: "day âadlen wid issnen akked wid ur nessin? Ay d ismektayen, kan, d uâqilen".
ayahs.translation: Day win ippanzen deg iv, ikna u ibedd, ipêebbiô i laxeôt, issaram aêunu n Mass is…? Ini: "day âadlen wid issnen akked wid ur nessin? Ay d ismektayen, kan, d uâqilen".

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yimdanen iW iumnen, êezzbet i Mass nnwen. Ayen ilhan i wid imaânen di ddunit agi. Tamurt n Öebbi tewsaâ. Ihi, arraz, war aktili, ad ippunefk i iûebôiyen".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen iW iumnen, êezzbet i Mass nnwen. Ayen ilhan i wid imaânen di ddunit agi. Tamurt n Öebbi tewsaâ. Ihi, arraz, war aktili, ad ippunefk i iûebôiyen".

ayahs.text: Ini: "nek pwamôe$ d ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "nek pwamôe$ d ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.

ayahs.text: Pwamôe$ d, ad ili$ d amvuâ amenzu".
ayahs.translation: Pwamôe$ d, ad ili$ d amvuâ amenzu".

ayahs.text: Ini: "nek, ugade$, ma aâûa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "nek, ugade$, ma aâûa$ Mass iw, aâaqeb n wass ameqwôaêan".

ayahs.text: Ini: "ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "ad âabde$ Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa.

ayahs.text: Ihi, âabdet i wen ihwan, war Neppa". Ini: "imexsuôen d wid iwedôen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". Ni$ d tagi ay d taxessaôt n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Ihi, âabdet i wen ihwan, war Neppa". Ini: "imexsuôen d wid iwedôen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". Ni$ d tagi ay d taxessaôt n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: A$embabu n tmes, sennig sen, wayev seddawat sen. Ayagi, Issagwad yis Öebbi imdanen iS: a yimdanen iW, êezzbet iyI!
ayahs.translation: A$embabu n tmes, sennig sen, wayev seddawat sen. Ayagi, Issagwad yis Öebbi imdanen iS: a yimdanen iW, êezzbet iyI!

ayahs.text: Wid ijunben aâbad iôebbiten n tkerkas, u iutuben Öebbi, a ten id ias lfeôê. Ihi, ssefôeê imdanen iW
ayahs.translation: Wid ijunben aâbad iôebbiten n tkerkas, u iutuben Öebbi, a ten id ias lfeôê. Ihi, ssefôeê imdanen iW

ayahs.text: i issemêasen i wawal, teddun d ûûam ines. D wigi i Inha Öebbi, d wigi ay d uâqilen.
ayahs.translation: i issemêasen i wawal, teddun d ûûam ines. D wigi i Inha Öebbi, d wigi ay d uâqilen.

ayahs.text: Day win i$ef ippuseyya ad isâaddi aâaqeb, day a psellkev keçç, win illan di tmes?
ayahs.translation: Day win i$ef ippuseyya ad isâaddi aâaqeb, day a psellkev keçç, win illan di tmes?

ayahs.text: Ma d wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad sâun ti$uôfatin, bnant ta sennig ta, isaffen seddawat sent ppazzalen, d lemâahda n Öebbi. Öebbi ur Ixeîîu i lemâahda.
ayahs.translation: Ma d wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad sâun ti$uôfatin, bnant ta sennig ta, isaffen seddawat sent ppazzalen, d lemâahda n Öebbi. Öebbi ur Ixeîîu i lemâahda.

ayahs.text: Ur twalav ara, Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni, Issekcem iten ad sswen akal. Sinna, yissen, a d Issuffe$ im$an n yal ini, ara iu$alen ad isliwen. A ten twaliv d iwôa$en, sinna, a ten Irr d iquôanen. Deg waya, s tidep, asmekti i uâqilen.
ayahs.translation: Ur twalav ara, Öebbi Isse$li d aman, seg igenni, Issekcem iten ad sswen akal. Sinna, yissen, a d Issuffe$ im$an n yal ini, ara iu$alen ad isliwen. A ten twaliv d iwôa$en, sinna, a ten Irr d iquôanen. Deg waya, s tidep, asmekti i uâqilen.

ayahs.text: Day win iwumi Illi Öebbi, idmaren is, ar wannuz, d$a neppa di tafat s$uô Mass is…? A ssxev n at wulawen iqquôen, ur d smektayen Öebbi! Widak di ttelfan n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Day win iwumi Illi Öebbi, idmaren is, ar wannuz, d$a neppa di tafat s$uô Mass is…? A ssxev n at wulawen iqquôen, ur d smektayen Öebbi! Widak di ttelfan n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Issader ed Öebbi ûûam n wawal. Tazmamt, degs acbi, allus. Ad ccirwen segs igwelman akked wulawen n wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen, sinna, igwelman akked wulawen nnsen ad iêninen ar usmekti n Öebbi. D tagi ay d nnhaya n Öebbi. Inehhu yis, win i S ihwan. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi wa ara t inhun.
ayahs.translation: Issader ed Öebbi ûûam n wawal. Tazmamt, degs acbi, allus. Ad ccirwen segs igwelman akked wulawen n wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen, sinna, igwelman akked wulawen nnsen ad iêninen ar usmekti n Öebbi. D tagi ay d nnhaya n Öebbi. Inehhu yis, win i S ihwan. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi wa ara t inhun.

ayahs.text: Day win ipêezziben, s wudem is, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra…? Ad inin i imednas: "jeôôbet ayen tkeppbem"!
ayahs.translation: Day win ipêezziben, s wudem is, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra…? Ad inin i imednas: "jeôôbet ayen tkeppbem"!

ayahs.text: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Iusa ten id uâaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin.
ayahs.translation: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Iusa ten id uâaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin.

ayahs.text: Issukk fellasen Öebbi aâaqeb, di tmeddurt n ddunit; war ccekk, aâaqeb n laxeôt iugar it, lemmer éeôôen!
ayahs.translation: Issukk fellasen Öebbi aâaqeb, di tmeddurt n ddunit; war ccekk, aâaqeb n laxeôt iugar it, lemmer éeôôen!

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nefka i imdanen, di Leqwôan agi, yal amedya, amar a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka i imdanen, di Leqwôan agi, yal amedya, amar a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: Leqwôan s taâôabt, ur degs tiââawji; amar ad êezzben.
ayahs.translation: Leqwôan s taâôabt, ur degs tiââawji; amar ad êezzben.

ayahs.text: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n urgaz icerken akked wid ipmeréan, u argaz di tifrat akked yiwen urgaz. Day âadlen sin imedyaten? Ccekôan i Öebbi. Xaîi, tegwti degsen ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Ifka d Öebbi amedya n urgaz icerken akked wid ipmeréan, u argaz di tifrat akked yiwen urgaz. Day âadlen sin imedyaten? Ccekôan i Öebbi. Xaîi, tegwti degsen ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: War ccekk, keçç a ppemmtev, nitni ad mmten.
ayahs.translation: War ccekk, keçç a ppemmtev, nitni ad mmten.

ayahs.text: Sinna, kunwi, ass n tnekra, ar Mass nnwen, a ppemqellaâm.
ayahs.translation: Sinna, kunwi, ass n tnekra, ar Mass nnwen, a ppemqellaâm.

ayahs.text: Anwa i idensen sennig win iskaddben af Öebbi, iskaddben tidep ma tusa t id? Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam ijehliyen?
ayahs.translation: Anwa i idensen sennig win iskaddben af Öebbi, iskaddben tidep ma tusa t id? Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam ijehliyen?

ayahs.text: Wid id iusan s tidep, u pputebbten yis, wigi d wid ipêezziben.
ayahs.translation: Wid id iusan s tidep, u pputebbten yis, wigi d wid ipêezziben.

ayahs.text: Ad sâun ayen b$an, ar Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d arraz iâaôviyen.
ayahs.translation: Ad sâun ayen b$an, ar Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d arraz iâaôviyen.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad asen Ikkes Öebbi, ayen xedmen adiran mavi; a ten I$it s wayen xeddmen d amxallef.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad asen Ikkes Öebbi, ayen xedmen adiran mavi; a ten I$it s wayen xeddmen d amxallef.

ayahs.text: Day ur Ipqam ara Öebbi amdan iS? La k ssagwaden s wid, war Neppa. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi w ara t inhun.
ayahs.translation: Day ur Ipqam ara Öebbi amdan iS? La k ssagwaden s wid, war Neppa. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur illi w ara t inhun.

ayahs.text: Win Inha Öebbi, ur illi w ara t itelfen. Ni$ Öebbi d Uzmir, Bab n ppaô.
ayahs.translation: Win Inha Öebbi, ur illi w ara t itelfen. Ni$ Öebbi d Uzmir, Bab n ppaô.

ayahs.text: Ma testeqsav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan? Ad inin, war ccekk: d Öebbi". Ini: "ma twalam wigi tnaâôem, war Öebbi, day zemren, ma Ib$a yi Öebbi ccqa, ad kksen ccqa S? Ne$, ma Ib$a yi aêunu, ad ssbeîlen aêunu S"? Ini: "Iqennaâ iyi Öebbi; fellaS ay ppeklen wid ipkalen".
ayahs.translation: Ma testeqsav ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan? Ad inin, war ccekk: d Öebbi". Ini: "ma twalam wigi tnaâôem, war Öebbi, day zemren, ma Ib$a yi Öebbi ccqa, ad kksen ccqa S? Ne$, ma Ib$a yi aêunu, ad ssbeîlen aêunu S"? Ini: "Iqennaâ iyi Öebbi; fellaS ay ppeklen wid ipkalen".

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tennumen, nek la xeddme$". Deqqal a ppeéôem
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yagdud iw! Xedmet akken tennumen, nek la xeddme$". Deqqal a ppeéôem

ayahs.text: anwa u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, u$uô ara d irs uâaqeb imezgi.
ayahs.translation: anwa u$uô ara d ias uâaqeb ara t isdullen, u$uô ara d irs uâaqeb imezgi.

ayahs.text: Ih, Nessader ed $uôek, Tazmamt i medden, s tidets. Win ipwanhan, i iman is, win innetlafen, innetlaf kan, mgal is. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Nessader ed $uôek, Tazmamt i medden, s tidets. Win ipwanhan, i iman is, win innetlafen, innetlaf kan, mgal is. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Ippaddam leôwaê mara mmten, akked wid ur nemmut, deg ives nnsen. Iâatteq wid i$ef Iseyya tameppant, Ippara d wiyav, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ih, deg wayagi, ard issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Ippaddam leôwaê mara mmten, akked wid ur nemmut, deg ives nnsen. Iâatteq wid i$ef Iseyya tameppant, Ippara d wiyav, ar lajel ipwassnen. Ih, deg wayagi, ard issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.

ayahs.text: Ne$ ad ddmen, war Öebbi, imcafâan? Ini: "i ma ur sâin acemma, ur fhimen"?
ayahs.translation: Ne$ ad ddmen, war Öebbi, imcafâan? Ini: "i ma ur sâin acemma, ur fhimen"?

ayahs.text: Ini: "akw ccafuâa n Öebbi. IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Sinna, $uôeS ara tu$alem".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "akw ccafuâa n Öebbi. IneS tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Sinna, $uôeS ara tu$alem".

ayahs.text: Mara d Ipwadder Öebbi Yiwen, ad zemven wulawen n wid ur numin ara s laxeôt. Ma pwadren d wid, war Neppa, imiren nitni ad ceôêen.
ayahs.translation: Mara d Ipwadder Öebbi Yiwen, ad zemven wulawen n wid ur numin ara s laxeôt. Ma pwadren d wid, war Neppa, imiren nitni ad ceôêen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a Öebbi! Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Amusnaw n wayen iffren d wayen ivehôen, d Keçç ara Iêudden ger imdanen iK, $ef wayen llan mgarraden".
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a Öebbi! Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan, Amusnaw n wayen iffren d wayen ivehôen, d Keçç ara Iêudden ger imdanen iK, $ef wayen llan mgarraden".

ayahs.text: Wid idensen, lemmer nnsen ayen akw i illan di tmurt, rnu yas am neppa, ur ten id ifeddu, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra. Ad asen d iban, s$uô Öebbi, ayen i$ef ur bnin.
ayahs.translation: Wid idensen, lemmer nnsen ayen akw i illan di tmurt, rnu yas am neppa, ur ten id ifeddu, seg uâaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra. Ad asen d iban, s$uô Öebbi, ayen i$ef ur bnin.

ayahs.text: Ad asen d banent tucmitin kesben, ad asen innev wayen i$ef ttahan.
ayahs.translation: Ad asen d banent tucmitin kesben, ad asen innev wayen i$ef ttahan.

ayahs.text: Ma iêuza umdan ccqa, ad a£ d inâaô. Sinna, ma Nezger tacvaî nne£ fellas, ad yini: "tusa yi d kan si tmusni". Xaîi! D ajeôôeb, maca aîas degsen ur ssinen.
ayahs.translation: Ma iêuza umdan ccqa, ad a£ d inâaô. Sinna, ma Nezger tacvaî nne£ fellas, ad yini: "tusa yi d kan si tmusni". Xaîi! D ajeôôeb, maca aîas degsen ur ssinen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ nnan t id imezwura nnsen. Acu i sen d ibbwi wayen keppben?
ayahs.translation: Ni$ nnan t id imezwura nnsen. Acu i sen d ibbwi wayen keppben?

ayahs.text: Iwwet iten wayen kesben n tucmitin. Wid idensen, seg wigi, a ten iwwet wayen kesben n tucmitin. Ur zmiren ad sfunngen.
ayahs.translation: Iwwet iten wayen kesben n tucmitin. Wid idensen, seg wigi, a ten iwwet wayen kesben n tucmitin. Ur zmiren ad sfunngen.

ayahs.text: Day ur éôin ara ar Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen? Ih, deg waya, ard issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.
ayahs.translation: Day ur éôin ara ar Öebbi Ip$iti win i S ihwan, u Iwezzen? Ih, deg waya, ard issekniyen i ugdud iumnen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "a yimdanen iw i ipêawalen mgal iman nnsen! Ur ppayset aêunu n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê akw ibekkaven. Ih, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: Ini: "a yimdanen iw i ipêawalen mgal iman nnsen! Ur ppayset aêunu n Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ipsemmiê akw ibekkaven. Ih, Neppa Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Steôoâet i Mass nnwen, anzet aS, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, d$a ula ikwen isellken.
ayahs.translation: Steôoâet i Mass nnwen, anzet aS, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, d$a ula ikwen isellken.

ayahs.text: Ddut d ûûam n wayen i wen d irsen, s$uô Mass nnwen, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, deqzalla, kunwi ur tebnim";
ayahs.translation: Ddut d ûûam n wayen i wen d irsen, s$uô Mass nnwen, uqbel a kwen id ias uâaqeb, deqzalla, kunwi ur tebnim";

ayahs.text: u a d yini ôôuê: "a ssexv iw, $ef wayen stehza$ ar loiha n Öebbi! Lli$, s tidep, seg wid ittihin".
ayahs.translation: u a d yini ôôuê: "a ssexv iw, $ef wayen stehza$ ar loiha n Öebbi! Lli$, s tidep, seg wid ittihin".

ayahs.text: Ne$ a d yini: "lemmer iyi Inha Öebbi, yili lli$ seg wid ipêezziben".
ayahs.translation: Ne$ a d yini: "lemmer iyi Inha Öebbi, yili lli$ seg wid ipêezziben".

ayahs.text: Ne$ a d yini mara iwali aâaqeb: "lemmer iyi illi wallus, ad ili$ si lâuûam".
ayahs.translation: Ne$ a d yini mara iwali aâaqeb: "lemmer iyi illi wallus, ad ili$ si lâuûam".

ayahs.text: Xaîi! Usan k id issekniyen iW, teskaddbev ten, tzuxxev, telliv seg ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! Usan k id issekniyen iW, teskaddbev ten, tzuxxev, telliv seg ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ass n tnekra, a pwaliv berrikit wudmawen n wid id igren tikerkas af Öebbi. Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam imzuxiyen?
ayahs.translation: Ass n tnekra, a pwaliv berrikit wudmawen n wid id igren tikerkas af Öebbi. Day maççi di Loahennama, i illa uxxam imzuxiyen?

ayahs.text: Ad Isellek Öebbi wid iêezzben; ar rebêen. Ur ten ikkat wugur, ur $webbnen.
ayahs.translation: Ad Isellek Öebbi wid iêezzben; ar rebêen. Ur ten ikkat wugur, ur $webbnen.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Ixleq yal cci. Neppa d Awkil n yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Ixleq yal cci. Neppa d Awkil n yal cci.

ayahs.text: IneS tsura n tmurt akked igenwan. Wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, widak d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: IneS tsura n tmurt akked igenwan. Wid inekôen issekniyen n Öebbi, widak d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Ini: "day ad yi tamôem ad âabde$, war Öebbi, a wid ur nessin"?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "day ad yi tamôem ad âabde$, war Öebbi, a wid ur nessin"?

ayahs.text: Ni$ iusa k id uweêêi, u $eô wid i k izwaren. Ma tcurkev, ad mêun igiten ik, a ppiliv seg imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ iusa k id uweêêi, u $eô wid i k izwaren. Ma tcurkev, ad mêun igiten ik, a ppiliv seg imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Xaîi! Aâbed Öebbi. Ili seg wid isnemmiren.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi! Aâbed Öebbi. Ili seg wid isnemmiren.

ayahs.text: Ur qudôen ara Öebbi, azal n lqedô iS. Akw tamurt, ass n tnekra, di tumeét iS. Igenwan ad nnefvasen deg ufus iS ayeffus. Gedha s yiS! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!
ayahs.translation: Ur qudôen ara Öebbi, azal n lqedô iS. Akw tamurt, ass n tnekra, di tumeét iS. Igenwan ad nnefvasen deg ufus iS ayeffus. Gedha s yiS! I Aâlay sennig wayen pcaraken!

ayahs.text: Aûuvu di lbuq: ad ixsef i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, kkes ed i S ihwan i Öebbi. Aûuvu nniven: nitni a d kkren pmuqulen.
ayahs.translation: Aûuvu di lbuq: ad ixsef i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, kkes ed i S ihwan i Öebbi. Aûuvu nniven: nitni a d kkren pmuqulen.

ayahs.text: A pfeooeo tmurt, si tafat n Mass is. A d ters Tezmamt, a d awin lambiyya akked inagan. Ad âaddin di ccôaâ, s tidep, ur pwadensen.
ayahs.translation: A pfeooeo tmurt, si tafat n Mass is. A d ters Tezmamt, a d awin lambiyya akked inagan. Ad âaddin di ccôaâ, s tidep, ur pwadensen.

ayahs.text: Yal yiwen ad i$ellet ayen ixdem. Neppa, Yif akw akken Issen, d acu xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: Yal yiwen ad i$ellet ayen ixdem. Neppa, Yif akw akken Issen, d acu xeddmen.

ayahs.text: Ad pwanehôen wid ijehlen, d igrawen, ar Loahennama. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "day ur kwen in usan ara imazanen, segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen n Mass nnwen, nedôen kwen af temlilit n wass nnwen agi"? A d inin: "Ih. Maca, ad iûaô wawal uâaqeb, af ijehliyen".
ayahs.translation: Ad pwanehôen wid ijehlen, d igrawen, ar Loahennama. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "day ur kwen in usan ara imazanen, segwen, mmalen awen issekniyen n Mass nnwen, nedôen kwen af temlilit n wass nnwen agi"? A d inin: "Ih. Maca, ad iûaô wawal uâaqeb, af ijehliyen".

ayahs.text: A d inin: "kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama! Degs, wekkôet". Ay d ucmit uxxam n imzuxiyen!
ayahs.translation: A d inin: "kecmet si tebbura, ar Loahennama! Degs, wekkôet". Ay d ucmit uxxam n imzuxiyen!

ayahs.text: Wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad pwanehôen ar Loennet, d igrawen. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "tifrat fellawen, tgerzem; kecmet ep, twekkôem"!
ayahs.translation: Wid iêezzben i Mass nnsen, ad pwanehôen ar Loennet, d igrawen. Mi bbwven $uôes, u llint tebbura s, ad asen inin iâssasen is: "tifrat fellawen, tgerzem; kecmet ep, twekkôem"!

ayahs.text: Ad inin: "ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Issawven lemâahda S. Ifka ya$ tamurt d lweôt; a nili, di Loennet, anda i $ ihwa. A yarraz asaâdi n wid ixeddmen lxiô!
ayahs.translation: Ad inin: "ccekôan i Öebbi i $ Issawven lemâahda S. Ifka ya$ tamurt d lweôt; a nili, di Loennet, anda i $ ihwa. A yarraz asaâdi n wid ixeddmen lxiô!

ayahs.text: A pwaliv lmalayek zzint ed i usgeld, sbuccuâent s ccekôan Mass nnsent. Iâadda ccôaâ garasen, s tidep. Ad inin: "a neckeô Öebbi, Mass imavalen".
ayahs.translation: A pwaliv lmalayek zzint ed i usgeld, sbuccuâent s ccekôan Mass nnsent. Iâadda ccôaâ garasen, s tidep. Ad inin: "a neckeô Öebbi, Mass imavalen".

verses.text: Ëm.
verses.translation: Ëm.

verses.text: Tarusi n Tezmamt, s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Amusnaw;
verses.translation: Tarusi n Tezmamt, s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Amusnaw;

verses.text: Ipsemmiêen tuccva, Iqeblen nndama, Ipâaqaben s teqseê, Bab n terkunt. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. £uôeS taggara.
verses.translation: Ipsemmiêen tuccva, Iqeblen nndama, Ipâaqaben s teqseê, Bab n terkunt. Ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. £uôeS taggara.

verses.text: Siwa wid ijehlen i ipnamaren $ef issekniyen n Öebbi. Ur k ip$uôôu ucali nnsen, di tmurt.
verses.translation: Siwa wid ijehlen i ipnamaren $ef issekniyen n Öebbi. Ur k ip$uôôu ucali nnsen, di tmurt.

verses.text: Uqbel nitni, agdud n Nuê, akked ikabaren deffir sen, skaddben. Yal lois iclaâ ad ixvef amazan is. Ipnamar s tkerkas, iwakken, s yissent, ad iveggeô tidep. Ëekme$ ten. A tiyta W imiren!
verses.translation: Uqbel nitni, agdud n Nuê, akked ikabaren deffir sen, skaddben. Yal lois iclaâ ad ixvef amazan is. Ipnamar s tkerkas, iwakken, s yissent, ad iveggeô tidep. Ëekme$ ten. A tiyta W imiren!

verses.text: Akka iûaô wawal n Mass ik, af wid ijehlen. Nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.
verses.translation: Akka iûaô wawal n Mass ik, af wid ijehlen. Nitni, war ccekk, d at tmes.

verses.text: Tid irefden asgeld, akked tid i s izzin, sbuccuâen s ccekôan Mass nnsent, umnent yiS. Ssuturent ad pwasemmêen wid iumnen: "a Mass nne$! Terriv yal cci d aêunu, u d tamusni. Semmeê i wid isteôoâen u ddan d ubrid iK; Sellek iten seg uâaqeb n wu$ud.
verses.translation: Tid irefden asgeld, akked tid i s izzin, sbuccuâen s ccekôan Mass nnsent, umnent yiS. Ssuturent ad pwasemmêen wid iumnen: "a Mass nne$! Terriv yal cci d aêunu, u d tamusni. Semmeê i wid isteôoâen u ddan d ubrid iK; Sellek iten seg uâaqeb n wu$ud.

verses.text: A Mass nne$! Ssekcem iten ar leonanat n Âaden, i Tâahdev, i nitni, u i iâaôviyen seg ibabaten nnsen, tilawin nnsen, tarwa nnsen. Keçç, ih, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$! Ssekcem iten ar leonanat n Âaden, i Tâahdev, i nitni, u i iâaôviyen seg ibabaten nnsen, tilawin nnsen, tarwa nnsen. Keçç, ih, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Aâteq iten si tucmitin. Win Tâatqev, assen, si tucmitin, ni$ Têunev fellas. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan".
verses.translation: Aâteq iten si tucmitin. Win Tâatqev, assen, si tucmitin, ni$ Têunev fellas. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan".

verses.text: Ad pwanecden wid ijehlen: "taâdawt n Öebbi te$leb taâdawt bbwaygarawen. Mi tepwanecdem ar liman, tugim".
verses.translation: Ad pwanecden wid ijehlen: "taâdawt n Öebbi te$leb taâdawt bbwaygarawen. Mi tepwanecdem ar liman, tugim".

verses.text: A d inin: "a Mass nne$! Ten$iv a$ berdayen, Tessidrev a$ berdayen. Nqaôô s ibekkaven nne$. Day illa ubrid n tuff$a"?
verses.translation: A d inin: "a Mass nne$! Ten$iv a$ berdayen, Tessidrev a$ berdayen. Nqaôô s ibekkaven nne$. Day illa ubrid n tuff$a"?

verses.text: Akka, imi mara ipwanâaô Öebbi Yiwen, kunwi tjehlem. Mara S pcaraken, kunwi tumnem. Aêuddu ar Öebbi Aâlayen, Ameqwôan.
verses.translation: Akka, imi mara ipwanâaô Öebbi Yiwen, kunwi tjehlem. Mara S pcaraken, kunwi tumnem. Aêuddu ar Öebbi Aâlayen, Ameqwôan.

verses.text: D Neppa i wen Issnaâtan issekniyen iS. Issadar awen d l$it, seg igenni. Siwa win isteôoiâen, id ismektayen.
verses.translation: D Neppa i wen Issnaâtan issekniyen iS. Issadar awen d l$it, seg igenni. Siwa win isteôoiâen, id ismektayen.

verses.text: Nujet $uô Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa, xas ugin ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Nujet $uô Öebbi, s laâqida i Neppa, xas ugin ijehliyen.

verses.text: Aâlayen nnig idurra, Bab n usgeld, Ippak ôôuê s lameô iS, i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, iwakken ad indeô af wass umlili,
verses.translation: Aâlayen nnig idurra, Bab n usgeld, Ippak ôôuê s lameô iS, i win i S ihwan, deg imdanen iS, iwakken ad indeô af wass umlili,

verses.text: ass ideg ara d awven, ur illi wayen iffren, degsen, i Öebbi. W ip ilan tgelda, assen? D Öebbi, Yiwen, Aqehhaô.
verses.translation: ass ideg ara d awven, ur illi wayen iffren, degsen, i Öebbi. W ip ilan tgelda, assen? D Öebbi, Yiwen, Aqehhaô.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara ippuqeîîi yal iman $ef wayen ikseb; ur ippili ddens assen. Ih, Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara ippuqeîîi yal iman $ef wayen ikseb; ur ippili ddens assen. Ih, Öebbi Ip$awal deg uqeîîi.

verses.text: Nabi ten af ass aqôib, ideg ulawen ad rewlen s igerjumen, ad qebôen. Ur ippilli i imednas, uêbib ne$ amcafaâ, iwumi ara ssemêessen.
verses.translation: Nabi ten af ass aqôib, ideg ulawen ad rewlen s igerjumen, ad qebôen. Ur ippilli i imednas, uêbib ne$ amcafaâ, iwumi ara ssemêessen.

verses.text: Issen nncub n yiéôi, akked wayen teffren idmaren.
verses.translation: Issen nncub n yiéôi, akked wayen teffren idmaren.

verses.text: Öebbi Iferru s tidep. Wid ipnujun ar war Neppa, ur qeîîun acemma. Ih, Öebbi d Win Isellen, Ipwalin.
verses.translation: Öebbi Iferru s tidep. Wid ipnujun ar war Neppa, ur qeîîun acemma. Ih, Öebbi d Win Isellen, Ipwalin.

verses.text: Day ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren. Llan ifen ten tazmert, akked lateô, di tmurt. Issemêelleq asen Öebbi, ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Ur asen illi umêareb, mgal Öebbi.
verses.translation: Day ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek tevôa d wid i ten id izwaren. Llan ifen ten tazmert, akked lateô, di tmurt. Issemêelleq asen Öebbi, ilmend ibekkaven nnsen. Ur asen illi umêareb, mgal Öebbi.

verses.text: Akka, acku ppasen $uôsen, imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, u nitni jehlen. Issemêelleq asen Öebbi. Ih, Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab uâaqeb uqsiê.
verses.translation: Akka, acku ppasen $uôsen, imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, u nitni jehlen. Issemêelleq asen Öebbi. Ih, Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab uâaqeb uqsiê.

verses.text: Ni$ Nuzen ed Musa s issekniyen nne£, s udabu iberrzen,
verses.translation: Ni$ Nuzen ed Musa s issekniyen nne£, s udabu iberrzen,

verses.text: ar Ferâun, Haman, akked Qaôun. Nnan: "d aseêêar, d akeddab".
verses.translation: ar Ferâun, Haman, akked Qaôun. Nnan: "d aseêêar, d akeddab".

verses.text: Mi sen d iusa, s tidep s $uône£, nnan: "en$et arrac n wid iumnen yides, ssidret tilawin nnsen". Tandit ijehliyen siwa di ttelfan.
verses.translation: Mi sen d iusa, s tidep s $uône£, nnan: "en$et arrac n wid iumnen yides, ssidret tilawin nnsen". Tandit ijehliyen siwa di ttelfan.

verses.text: Inna Ferâun: "anfet iyi ad n$e$ Musa, xas ad inuj ar Mass is. Ugade$, nek, ad ibeddel ddin nnwen, ne$ a d issekcem lefsad di tmurt".
verses.translation: Inna Ferâun: "anfet iyi ad n$e$ Musa, xas ad inuj ar Mass is. Ugade$, nek, ad ibeddel ddin nnwen, ne$ a d issekcem lefsad di tmurt".

verses.text: Inna Musa: "nek, ad iyi Iûûeô Mass iw u Mass nnwen, si yal amzuxi, ur numin s wass uqeîîi".
verses.translation: Inna Musa: "nek, ad iyi Iûûeô Mass iw u Mass nnwen, si yal amzuxi, ur numin s wass uqeîîi".

verses.text: Inna urgaz lmumen, i iffren liman is, si twacult n Ferâun: "day a ppen$em argaz, imi d iqqaô: Mass iw d Öebbi, u irna ibbwi yawen d abeggen, s$uô Mass nnwen? Ma iskaddeb, lkedb is fellas. Ma issawel tidep, a kwen iêaz kra seg wayen ikwen issagwad. Öebbi ur Inehhu amaâfun iskiddiben.
verses.translation: Inna urgaz lmumen, i iffren liman is, si twacult n Ferâun: "day a ppen$em argaz, imi d iqqaô: Mass iw d Öebbi, u irna ibbwi yawen d abeggen, s$uô Mass nnwen? Ma iskaddeb, lkedb is fellas. Ma issawel tidep, a kwen iêaz kra seg wayen ikwen issagwad. Öebbi ur Inehhu amaâfun iskiddiben.

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Assa, nnwen tagelda, tufrarem di tmurt. W ad a$ isellken si tiyta n Öebbi, ma tusa ya$ d"? Inna d Ferâun: "i wen ssekne$ ayen kan wala$; s anda i kwen nehhu$, siwa ar ubrid imaânen".
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Assa, nnwen tagelda, tufrarem di tmurt. W ad a$ isellken si tiyta n Öebbi, ma tusa ya$ d"? Inna d Ferâun: "i wen ssekne$ ayen kan wala$; s anda i kwen nehhu$, siwa ar ubrid imaânen".

verses.text: Inna d win iumnen: "a yagdud iw! Nek, ugade$ fellak tin n wass ikabaren,
verses.translation: Inna d win iumnen: "a yagdud iw! Nek, ugade$ fellak tin n wass ikabaren,

verses.text: akken tevôa d ugdud n Nuê, Âad, Tamud, akked wid i ten id ivefôen. Öebbi ur Ib$a ara ddens i imdanen.
verses.translation: akken tevôa d ugdud n Nuê, Âad, Tamud, akked wid i ten id ivefôen. Öebbi ur Ib$a ara ddens i imdanen.

verses.text: A yagdud iw! Nek ugade$, ay kwen ippa$en, ass umnamar,
verses.translation: A yagdud iw! Nek ugade$, ay kwen ippa$en, ass umnamar,

verses.text: ass ideg ara trewlem ar deffir. Ur awen illi umêareb mgal Öebbi. Ur illi nnahi i win Itlef Öebbi".
verses.translation: ass ideg ara trewlem ar deffir. Ur awen illi umêareb mgal Öebbi. Ur illi nnahi i win Itlef Öebbi".

verses.text: Ni$ iusa kwen id Yusef, zik, s ubeggen. Tezgam di ccekk, $ef wayen i wen d ibbwi. Armi immut, tennam: "ur d Ippazen ara Öebbi amazan, deffir es, d awez$i". Akka i Itellif Öebbi amaâfun amcekki.
verses.translation: Ni$ iusa kwen id Yusef, zik, s ubeggen. Tezgam di ccekk, $ef wayen i wen d ibbwi. Armi immut, tennam: "ur d Ippazen ara Öebbi amazan, deffir es, d awez$i". Akka i Itellif Öebbi amaâfun amcekki.

verses.text: Wid ipnamaren issekniyen n Öebbi, ur ten id iusi udabu, nezzeh ara ten i$unfu Öebbi, akked wid iumnen. Akka ara Icemmaâ Öebbi, yal ul amzuxi, aâfrit.
verses.translation: Wid ipnamaren issekniyen n Öebbi, ur ten id iusi udabu, nezzeh ara ten i$unfu Öebbi, akked wid iumnen. Akka ara Icemmaâ Öebbi, yal ul amzuxi, aâfrit.

ayahs.text: Akka, acku ppasen $uôsen, imazanen nnsen, s ubeggen, u nitni jehlen. Issemêelleq asen Öebbi. Ih, Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab uâaqeb uqsiê.

Ma iskaddeb, lkedb is fellas. Ma issawel tidep, a kwen iêaz kra seg wayen ikwen issagwad. Öebbi ur Inehhu amaâfun iskiddiben.

ayahs.translation: A yagdud iw! Acu iyi bbwin, a kwen neccde$ ar leslak; kunwi, a yi tneccdem ar tmessi?

ayahs.translation: War ccekk, ayen u$uô a yi tneccdem, ur as iwata unuju di ddunit, u di laxeôt. Ih, tu$alin nne$ ar Öebbi. Imaâfan ard at tmes.

ayahs.translation: Ad inin: "day ur kwen id usan ara imazanen nnwen, s ubeggen"? Ad inin: "ih". Ad inin: "naâret"! Ar ttelfan, kan, tanaârit ijehliyen.

ayahs.translation: Nsellek wid iumnen, i illan pêezziben.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara ssemlilen ar tmessi, icenga n Öebbi, nitni ad pwajemmlen.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara ssemlilen ar tmessi, icenga n Öebbi, nitni ad pwajemmlen.

ayahs.text: Alamma, mara awven $uôes, ad cehhden fellasen, $ef wayen xeddmen, imeééu$en nnsen, allen nnsen, d igwelman nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Alamma, mara awven $uôes, ad cehhden fellasen, $ef wayen xeddmen, imeééu$en nnsen, allen nnsen, d igwelman nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ad inin i igwelman nnsen: "acimi id tcuhhdem fella$"? A d inin: "Issenîeq a$ d Öebbi, id Issentaqen yal cci. Neppa, Ixelq ikwen tikelt tamezwarut, u $uôeS ara tu$alem".
ayahs.translation: Ad inin i igwelman nnsen: "acimi id tcuhhdem fella$"? A d inin: "Issenîeq a$ d Öebbi, id Issentaqen yal cci. Neppa, Ixelq ikwen tikelt tamezwarut, u $uôeS ara tu$alem".

ayahs.text: Ur tezmirem ara a ppeffrem, ur cehhden fellawen imeééu$en nnwen, allen nnwen, akked igwelman nnwen. Maca, t$ilem ur Iéeô ara Öebbi, aîas n wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ur tezmirem ara a ppeffrem, ur cehhden fellawen imeééu$en nnwen, allen nnwen, akked igwelman nnwen. Maca, t$ilem ur Iéeô ara Öebbi, aîas n wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Akka ameyyez nnwen $ef Mass nnwen. Isqucc ikwen, tegwram d d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Akka ameyyez nnwen $ef Mass nnwen. Isqucc ikwen, tegwram d d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Xas ûebôen, di tmes ara zed$en. Ma ssutren ssmaê, ur llin d wid ara ipwaqeblen.
ayahs.translation: Xas ûebôen, di tmes ara zed$en. Ma ssutren ssmaê, ur llin d wid ara ipwaqeblen.

ayahs.text: Nefka yasen imeddukwal i sen icebbêen ayen illan zdat sen, akked wayen illan deffir sen. Iûaô fellasen wawal ger leoyus n yimdanen akw n leonun, i i$aben, uqbel nnsen. Ih, nitni d imexsuôen.
ayahs.translation: Nefka yasen imeddukwal i sen icebbêen ayen illan zdat sen, akked wayen illan deffir sen. Iûaô fellasen wawal ger leoyus n yimdanen akw n leonun, i i$aben, uqbel nnsen. Ih, nitni d imexsuôen.

ayahs.text: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur ssemêaset i Leqwôan agi. Ssekret fellas, ta$wegwa, ahat a prebêem".
ayahs.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen: "ur ssemêaset i Leqwôan agi. Ssekret fellas, ta$wegwa, ahat a prebêem".

ayahs.text: A Nessukk $ef wid ijehlen, aâaqeb uqsiê. A ten Nqeîîi sennig wayen xeddmen.
ayahs.translation: A Nessukk $ef wid ijehlen, aâaqeb uqsiê. A ten Nqeîîi sennig wayen xeddmen.

ayahs.text: D wagi ay d aqeîîi icenga n Öebbi: times; i nitni degs axxam n lebda; d aqeîîi, imi la nekôen issekniyen nne£.
ayahs.translation: D wagi ay d aqeîîi icenga n Öebbi: times; i nitni degs axxam n lebda; d aqeîîi, imi la nekôen issekniyen nne£.

ayahs.text: Ad inin, wid ijehlen: "a Mass nne$! Essken a$ wid i $ i$elîen, d loenn ne$ d amdan; a ten neôkev, ad u$alen seg wid indellen mavi".
ayahs.translation: Ad inin, wid ijehlen: "a Mass nne$! Essken a$ wid i $ i$elîen, d loenn ne$ d amdan; a ten neôkev, ad u$alen seg wid indellen mavi".

ayahs.text: Ih, wid innan: "Mass nne$ d Öebbi", sinna, nudan lewqama, a d rsent $uôsen lmalayek: "ur ppagwadet, ur $webblet; ppubeccôet s Loennet i wen ippuwaââden".
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid innan: "Mass nne$ d Öebbi", sinna, nudan lewqama, a d rsent $uôsen lmalayek: "ur ppagwadet, ur $webblet; ppubeccôet s Loennet i wen ippuwaââden".

ayahs.text: Nekwni d imawlan nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit u di laxeôt. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen i cedhant teôwiêin nnwen. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen tessutrem.
ayahs.translation: Nekwni d imawlan nnwen di tmeddurt n ddunit u di laxeôt. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen i cedhant teôwiêin nnwen. Dinna, i kunwi, ayen tessutrem.

ayahs.text: D tarusi s$uô Win Ipsemmiêen, Ipêunun.
ayahs.translation: D tarusi s$uô Win Ipsemmiêen, Ipêunun.

ayahs.text: Anwa yifen awal umâin n win inaâôen Öebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, id innan: "nek, ih, seg imvuâen".
ayahs.translation: Anwa yifen awal umâin n win inaâôen Öebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, id innan: "nek, ih, seg imvuâen".

ayahs.text: Ur iaâdil ise$ akked tucmip. Err ip akin, s wayen ip yifen. Ma tella cceêna, garak d yiwen, ad iu$al d aêbib i k iêemmlen.
ayahs.translation: Ur iaâdil ise$ akked tucmip. Err ip akin, s wayen ip yifen. Ma tella cceêna, garak d yiwen, ad iu$al d aêbib i k iêemmlen.

ayahs.text: Ur teppunefk siwa i wid iûebbôen. Ur teppunefk, siwa i bu sser abarar.
ayahs.translation: Ur teppunefk siwa i wid iûebbôen. Ur teppunefk, siwa i bu sser abarar.

ayahs.text: Ma iccacev ak Cciîan tuccva, ssuter laânaya n Öebbi. Ih, Neppa d win Isellen, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: Ma iccacev ak Cciîan tuccva, ssuter laânaya n Öebbi. Ih, Neppa d win Isellen, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: Seg issekniyen iS, ass akked yiv, iîij akked waggur. Ur kennut ara i yiîij, ne$ i waggur. Knut i Öebbi, iten id Ixelqen, ma d Neppa ay tâabbdem.
ayahs.translation: Seg issekniyen iS, ass akked yiv, iîij akked waggur. Ur kennut ara i yiîij, ne$ i waggur. Knut i Öebbi, iten id Ixelqen, ma d Neppa ay tâabbdem.

ayahs.text: Ma zuxxen, ihi, wid illan ar Mass ik, sbuccuâen T iv akked wass, ur âaggun.
ayahs.translation: Ma zuxxen, ihi, wid illan ar Mass ik, sbuccuâen T iv akked wass, ur âaggun.

ayahs.text: Seg issekniyen iS: a pwaliv, keçç, akal iqquô; lemmer ad as Nesse$li aman, a d iakwi, ad icuff. Win it id Issadren, d Win ara d Issidren lmeggtin. Ih, Neppa, Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Seg issekniyen iS: a pwaliv, keçç, akal iqquô; lemmer ad as Nesse$li aman, a d iakwi, ad icuff. Win it id Issadren, d Win ara d Issidren lmeggtin. Ih, Neppa, Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid issexûaôen issekniyen nne£, ur drigen fellane£. Menyif win ara ipwaveggôen ar tmes, ne$ win ara iasen di laman, ass n tnekra? Xedmet ayen i wen ihwan. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid issexûaôen issekniyen nne£, ur drigen fellane£. Menyif win ara ipwaveggôen ar tmes, ne$ win ara iasen di laman, ass n tnekra? Xedmet ayen i wen ihwan. Neppa, s tidep, Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Akka, wid inekôen asmekti, mi ten id iusa, u neppat ard Tazmamt tuzmirt.
ayahs.translation: Akka, wid inekôen asmekti, mi ten id iusa, u neppat ard Tazmamt tuzmirt.

ayahs.text: Ur d iusi le$wlav zdat es, ne$ deffir es. D tarusi s$uô Bab n ûûwab, Amaâzuz.
ayahs.translation: Ur d iusi le$wlav zdat es, ne$ deffir es. D tarusi s$uô Bab n ûûwab, Amaâzuz.

ayahs.text: Awal i k id iusan, d win kan id iusan imazanen, uqbel ik. Mass ik, ih, ard Bab n ssmaê, d Bab uâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Awal i k id iusan, d win kan id iusan imazanen, uqbel ik. Mass ik, ih, ard Bab n ssmaê, d Bab uâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Lemmer Nerri Leqwôan s tmeslayt tabeôôanit, a d inin: "lemmer feûûlen issekniyen iS s wawal abeôôani, u s taâôabt"? Ini: "neppa, i wid iumnen, d nnhaya u d ccafuâa. Wid ur numin ara, âaégent tmejjin nnsen. Neppa, i nitni, d tider$elt. Widak pwanecden seg umkan ibaâden".
ayahs.translation: Lemmer Nerri Leqwôan s tmeslayt tabeôôanit, a d inin: "lemmer feûûlen issekniyen iS s wawal abeôôani, u s taâôabt"? Ini: "neppa, i wid iumnen, d nnhaya u d ccafuâa. Wid ur numin ara, âaégent tmejjin nnsen. Neppa, i nitni, d tider$elt. Widak pwanecden seg umkan ibaâden".

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal s$uô Mass ik, yili tefra garasen. Nitni, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nefka yas Tazmamt i Musa. Mgarraden fellas. Lemmer ur d izwar ara wawal s$uô Mass ik, yili tefra garasen. Nitni, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.

ayahs.text: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win iccven, mgal iman is. Mass ik ur Idennis ara imdanen.
ayahs.translation: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win iccven, mgal iman is. Mass ik ur Idennis ara imdanen.

ayahs.text: £uôeS ay tella tmusni n yimir. Ur d iteffe$ uzway si txeddact is, ur treffed nnta tadist, ur tepparew, siwa ma Iéôa. Ass ideg ar asen Isiwel: "anda ten icriken iW"? A d inin: "ad aK nini, ur illi garane$ unagi".
ayahs.translation: £uôeS ay tella tmusni n yimir. Ur d iteffe$ uzway si txeddact is, ur treffed nnta tadist, ur tepparew, siwa ma Iéôa. Ass ideg ar asen Isiwel: "anda ten icriken iW"? A d inin: "ad aK nini, ur illi garane$ unagi".

ayahs.text: Iooa ten wayen u$uô pnujun zik. Fehmen, ur asen illi ssôan.
ayahs.translation: Iooa ten wayen u$uô pnujun zik. Fehmen, ur asen illi ssôan.

ayahs.text: Ur ifeccel ara umdan di tuppra n lxiô. Ma inul it lqeôê, ad iayes, ad innu$ben.
ayahs.translation: Ur ifeccel ara umdan di tuppra n lxiô. Ma inul it lqeôê, ad iayes, ad innu$ben.

ayahs.text: Ma Nseêess as aêunu nne£, deffir ccqa i t iêuzan, war ccekk, ad yini: "ayagi inu. Ur cukke$ ara imir a d ias. Ma bbwve$ s afus n Mass iw, ad afe$ $uôeS ûûam". Ih, a Nbeggen ayen xedmen, i wid ijehlen, u, ih, ad Nsâaddi fellasen aâaqeb iwaâôen.
ayahs.translation: Ma Nseêess as aêunu nne£, deffir ccqa i t iêuzan, war ccekk, ad yini: "ayagi inu. Ur cukke$ ara imir a d ias. Ma bbwve$ s afus n Mass iw, ad afe$ $uôeS ûûam". Ih, a Nbeggen ayen xedmen, i wid ijehlen, u, ih, ad Nsâaddi fellasen aâaqeb iwaâôen.

ayahs.text: Ma N$at amdan ad iwexxeô, izzi akin. Ma iêuza t lêif, ad ipnuju, irennu.
ayahs.translation: Ma N$at amdan ad iwexxeô, izzi akin. Ma iêuza t lêif, ad ipnuju, irennu.

ayahs.text: Ini: "tmeyyzem ma iusa d s$uô Öebbi, u kunwi tnekôem t"? Anwa innetlafen sennig win illan di ticuîna tu$miqt?
ayahs.translation: Ini: "tmeyyzem ma iusa d s$uô Öebbi, u kunwi tnekôem t"? Anwa innetlafen sennig win illan di ticuîna tu$miqt?

ayahs.text: Ad asen Nessken issekniyen nne£ di tmurt akked igenwan, u deg iman nnsen, alamma pputebbten ar neppa d tidep. Day ur Iqadd ara Mass ik mi Neppa, war ccekk, d Anagi n yal cci?
ayahs.translation: Ad asen Nessken issekniyen nne£ di tmurt akked igenwan, u deg iman nnsen, alamma pputebbten ar neppa d tidep. Day ur Iqadd ara Mass ik mi Neppa, war ccekk, d Anagi n yal cci?

ayahs.text: Day, s tidep, cukken timlilit d Mass nnsen? Day Neppa, s tidep, ur Izzi ara i yal cci?
ayahs.translation: Day, s tidep, cukken timlilit d Mass nnsen? Day Neppa, s tidep, ur Izzi ara i yal cci?

verses.text: Ëm.
verses.translation: Ëm.

verses.text: Âsq.
verses.translation: Âsq.

verses.text: Akka i Iweêêa i keçç, akked wid ik id izwaren, Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Akka i Iweêêa i keçç, akked wid ik id izwaren, Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Neppa, d Aâlayen, d Ameqwôahan.
verses.translation: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Neppa, d Aâlayen, d Ameqwôahan.

verses.text: Qôib ad ccergen igenwan seg ixfawen nnsen, mara d lhint lmalayek deg usbuccaâ s ccekôan n Mass nnsent, u ssuturent ad pwassemêen kra illan di tmurt. War ccekk, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu?
verses.translation: Qôib ad ccergen igenwan seg ixfawen nnsen, mara d lhint lmalayek deg usbuccaâ s ccekôan n Mass nnsent, u ssuturent ad pwassemêen kra illan di tmurt. War ccekk, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu?

verses.text: Wid irran imawlan, war Neppa, Iquôaâ ten Öebbi. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.
verses.translation: Wid irran imawlan, war Neppa, Iquôaâ ten Öebbi. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.

verses.text: Akka ay k n Nweêêa Leqwôan, s taâôabt, iwakken a pnedôev tayimmap n temdinin, akked wayen i s d izzin; a pnedôev af ass n temlilit, ur degs ccekk; arbaâ di Loennet, arbaâ deg ujajiê.
verses.translation: Akka ay k n Nweêêa Leqwôan, s taâôabt, iwakken a pnedôev tayimmap n temdinin, akked wayen i s d izzin; a pnedôev af ass n temlilit, ur degs ccekk; arbaâ di Loennet, arbaâ deg ujajiê.

verses.text: Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Izdukkel iten d yiwen n lois. Maca, ad Issekcem win i S ihwan ar uêunu S. Imednas, ur sâin bab ne$ asettaô.
verses.translation: Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Izdukkel iten d yiwen n lois. Maca, ad Issekcem win i S ihwan ar uêunu S. Imednas, ur sâin bab ne$ asettaô.

verses.text: Ne$ rran imawlan, war Neppa. Öebbi d Neppa ay d Bab, d Neppa i Issidiren lmeggtin, d Neppa i Izemren i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ne$ rran imawlan, war Neppa. Öebbi d Neppa ay d Bab, d Neppa i Issidiren lmeggtin, d Neppa i Izemren i yal cci.

verses.text: Ayen akw i$ef temgarradem, aêuddu s ar Öebbi. Akka Öebbi, Mass iw; fellaS ppekle$, $eô Neppa ay steôoiâe$.
verses.translation: Ayen akw i$ef temgarradem, aêuddu s ar Öebbi. Akka Öebbi, Mass iw; fellaS ppekle$, $eô Neppa ay steôoiâe$.

verses.text: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Seg iman nnwen Irra yawen tiyugiwin; si lmal nnwen, tiyugiwin. Isfukti kwen yisent. Ur illi wayen i T icban. Neppa Issel, Ipwali.
verses.translation: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Seg iman nnwen Irra yawen tiyugiwin; si lmal nnwen, tiyugiwin. Isfukti kwen yisent. Ur illi wayen i T icban. Neppa Issel, Ipwali.

verses.text: IneS tisura n tmurt akked igenwan. Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, Iwezzen. Ih, Neppa Issen yal cci.
verses.translation: IneS tisura n tmurt akked igenwan. Issugut ôôeéq i win i S ihwan, Iwezzen. Ih, Neppa Issen yal cci.

verses.text: Issers awen d, di ddin, ayen i$ef Iweûûa Nuê. Ayen i k Nweêêa, d ayen i$ef Nweûûa Ibôahim, Musa, akked Âisa: "sbeddet ddin, ur ppemgarradet fellas". èÈÈéay, i imcurak, wayen u$uô la ten tneccdev. Öebbi Ippawi $uôeS, win i S ihwan; Inehhu $uôeS, win isteôoiâen.
verses.translation: Issers awen d, di ddin, ayen i$ef Iweûûa Nuê. Ayen i k Nweêêa, d ayen i$ef Nweûûa Ibôahim, Musa, akked Âisa: "sbeddet ddin, ur ppemgarradet fellas". èÈÈéay, i imcurak, wayen u$uô la ten tneccdev. Öebbi Ippawi $uôeS, win i S ihwan; Inehhu $uôeS, win isteôoiâen.

verses.text: Ur mfaôaqen armi ten id tusa tussna. Ppemvuddun. Lemmer ur d izwar wawal s$uô Mass ik $ef lmijal ipwassnen, yili myefran. Ih, wid iweôten Tazmamt deffir sen, haaten, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.
verses.translation: Ur mfaôaqen armi ten id tusa tussna. Ppemvuddun. Lemmer ur d izwar wawal s$uô Mass ik $ef lmijal ipwassnen, yili myefran. Ih, wid iweôten Tazmamt deffir sen, haaten, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.

verses.text: Ilmend n waya, enced, ssewqem akken i tepwamôev, ur teddu d cchawi nnsen. Ini: "umne$ s wayen id Issader Öebbi n Tira. Pwamôe$ d ad wezne$ garawen. Öebbi d Mass nne$, u d Mass nnwen. I nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur teppili nnmara garane$. Öebbi ad a$ Issemlil. Tu$alin $uôeS".
verses.translation: Ilmend n waya, enced, ssewqem akken i tepwamôev, ur teddu d cchawi nnsen. Ini: "umne$ s wayen id Issader Öebbi n Tira. Pwamôe$ d ad wezne$ garawen. Öebbi d Mass nne$, u d Mass nnwen. I nekwni igiten nne$, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur teppili nnmara garane$. Öebbi ad a$ Issemlil. Tu$alin $uôeS".

verses.text: Wid ipnamaren af Öebbi, deffir wagwav n loawab $uôsen, ur teswi nnmara nnsen, ar Mass nnsen. Fellasen zzâaf, fellasen aâaqeb uqsiê.
verses.translation: Wid ipnamaren af Öebbi, deffir wagwav n loawab $uôsen, ur teswi nnmara nnsen, ar Mass nnsen. Fellasen zzâaf, fellasen aâaqeb uqsiê.

verses.text: Öebbi id Issadren Tazmamt, s tidep, akked lmizan. W ad ak imlen, ahat imir iqeôb ed?
verses.translation: Öebbi id Issadren Tazmamt, s tidep, akked lmizan. W ad ak imlen, ahat imir iqeôb ed?

verses.text: Ëaren $uôes wid ur numin ara yis. Ma d wid iumnen, ugaden t; éôan ar neppa d tidep. Ih, wid icukken deg imir, haaten, war ccekk, di ttelfan u$miq.
verses.translation: Ëaren $uôes wid ur numin ara yis. Ma d wid iumnen, ugaden t; éôan ar neppa d tidep. Ih, wid icukken deg imir, haaten, war ccekk, di ttelfan u$miq.

verses.text: Öebbi d Laîif i imdanen iS. Ip$iti win i S ihwan. Neppa d Uohid, d Uzmir.
verses.translation: Öebbi d Laîif i imdanen iS. Ip$iti win i S ihwan. Neppa d Uohid, d Uzmir.

verses.text: Win ib$an tayerza n laxeôt, ad as Nernu di tyerza ines. Win ib$an tayerza n ddunit, ad as Nefk segs. Ur as illi umur di laxeôt.
verses.translation: Win ib$an tayerza n laxeôt, ad as Nernu di tyerza ines. Win ib$an tayerza n ddunit, ad as Nefk segs. Ur as illi umur di laxeôt.

verses.text: Ne$ sâan icriken, sse$ôen ten di ddin ur Iqbil Öebbi? Lemmer ur d izwir ara wawal n ufraz, a p fru garasen. I imednas, war ccekk, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ne$ sâan icriken, sse$ôen ten di ddin ur Iqbil Öebbi? Lemmer ur d izwir ara wawal n ufraz, a p fru garasen. I imednas, war ccekk, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: A pwaliv imednas feqâen ilmend n wayen kesben, u neppa iddehm ed fellasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di tebêirin n leonanat. Nnsen i sen ihwan $uô Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d lfevl ameqwôan.
verses.translation: A pwaliv imednas feqâen ilmend n wayen kesben, u neppa iddehm ed fellasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di tebêirin n leonanat. Nnsen i sen ihwan $uô Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d lfevl ameqwôan.

verses.text: D wagi is Ipbecciô Öebbi imdanen iS, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ taqdiât, af waya, siwa lmaênana i llezm nnwen". Win ixedmen ise$, ad as Nernu degs lehhu. Öebbi, ih, Ipsemmiê, Ippara tajmilt.
verses.translation: D wagi is Ipbecciô Öebbi imdanen iS, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ini: "ur awen ssutre$ taqdiât, af waya, siwa lmaênana i llezm nnwen". Win ixedmen ise$, ad as Nernu degs lehhu. Öebbi, ih, Ipsemmiê, Ippara tajmilt.

verses.text: Ne$ a d inin: "isnulfa d tikerkas af Öebbi". Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, ad Icemmaâ ul ik. S wawal iS, ad Isqucc Öebbi tikerkas, ad Iêeqqeq tidep. Ih, Neppa Iéôa tababnit n idmaren.
verses.translation: Ne$ a d inin: "isnulfa d tikerkas af Öebbi". Ma ihwa yaS i Öebbi, ad Icemmaâ ul ik. S wawal iS, ad Isqucc Öebbi tikerkas, ad Iêeqqeq tidep. Ih, Neppa Iéôa tababnit n idmaren.

verses.text: D Neppa i Iqeblen nndama n yimdanen iS. Ipsemmiê tucmitin. Issen ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: D Neppa i Iqeblen nndama n yimdanen iS. Ipsemmiê tucmitin. Issen ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Issemêas i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb uqsiê.
verses.translation: Issemêas i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ad asen Irnu si lfevl iS. I ijehliyen, aâaqeb uqsiê.

verses.text: Ma Issuget Öebbi l$it i imdanen iS, ad be$wven di tmurt. Maca, Issrusu d, s lmizan, ayen i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa Ippuxebbeô $ef imdanen iS, Ipwali ten.
verses.translation: Ma Issuget Öebbi l$it i imdanen iS, ad be$wven di tmurt. Maca, Issrusu d, s lmizan, ayen i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa Ippuxebbeô $ef imdanen iS, Ipwali ten.

verses.text: D Neppa id Isse$layen ageffur mara aysen. Iweppaâ aêunu S. Neppa d Bab, d Amaâzuz.
verses.translation: D Neppa id Isse$layen ageffur mara aysen. Iweppaâ aêunu S. Neppa d Bab, d Amaâzuz.

verses.text: Seg issekniyen iS, lxelq n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan n lewêuc, degsen. Izmer Neppa, ma ihwa yaS, a ten id Issemlil.
verses.translation: Seg issekniyen iS, lxelq n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan n lewêuc, degsen. Izmer Neppa, ma ihwa yaS, a ten id Issemlil.

verses.text: Kra n tiyta ikwen iwwten, siwa ayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen. Aîas i Ipsemmiê.
verses.translation: Kra n tiyta ikwen iwwten, siwa ayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen. Aîas i Ipsemmiê.

verses.text: Ur tezmirem a ppesfunngem di tmurt. Ur awen illi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.
verses.translation: Ur tezmirem a ppesfunngem di tmurt. Ur awen illi, war Öebbi, bab ne$ asettaô.

verses.text: Seg issekniyen iS, ssfinat di yill, amzun d idurar.
verses.translation: Seg issekniyen iS, ssfinat di yill, amzun d idurar.

verses.text: Ma ihwa yaS ad Issens avu, ad êebsent, d tusbivin sufella s. War ccekk, ayagi d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.
verses.translation: Ma ihwa yaS ad Issens avu, ad êebsent, d tusbivin sufella s. War ccekk, ayagi d issekniyen i yal aûebôi isnemmiren.

verses.text: Ne$ a ten Issenger ilmend n wayen kesben. Aîas i Ipsemmiê.
verses.translation: Ne$ a ten Issenger ilmend n wayen kesben. Aîas i Ipsemmiê.

verses.text: Ad éôen wid ipnamaren $ef issekniyen nne£, ar ur asen illi ssôan.
verses.translation: Ad éôen wid ipnamaren $ef issekniyen nne£, ar ur asen illi ssôan.

verses.text: Ayen akw i wen ippunefken n wayla, d zzhu n tmeddurt di ddunit. Ayen illan ar Öebbi, yif it; ad idum kteô, i wid iumnen, ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen;
verses.translation: Ayen akw i wen ippunefken n wayla, d zzhu n tmeddurt di ddunit. Ayen illan ar Öebbi, yif it; ad idum kteô, i wid iumnen, ippeklen $ef Mass nnsen;

verses.text: wid ijunben ibekkaven ibararen, akked lâaô, u ssurufen i wid i ten isserfan;
verses.translation: wid ijunben ibekkaven ibararen, akked lâaô, u ssurufen i wid i ten isserfan;

verses.text: wid id ipjawaben i Mass nnsen, péallan, ppemcawaôen $ef lameô nnsen, pseddiqen seg wayen iten N$at;
verses.translation: wid id ipjawaben i Mass nnsen, péallan, ppemcawaôen $ef lameô nnsen, pseddiqen seg wayen iten N$at;

verses.text: wid, ma iusa ten lbe$wv, ad qablen.
verses.translation: wid, ma iusa ten lbe$wv, ad qablen.

verses.text: Aqeîîi n tucmip, d tucmip i p icban. Win isemmêen, issweqmen, arraz is ar Öebbi. Neppa, ih, ur Iêemmel ara imednas.
verses.translation: Aqeîîi n tucmip, d tucmip i p icban. Win isemmêen, issweqmen, arraz is ar Öebbi. Neppa, ih, ur Iêemmel ara imednas.

verses.text: Ma d wid id irran ppaô mi pwadensen, ur telli tiyta degsen.
verses.translation: Ma d wid id irran ppaô mi pwadensen, ur telli tiyta degsen.

verses.text: Tiyta, kan, deg wid ivuôôen imdanen, iqehôen di tmurt, war ssebba. I wigi, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Tiyta, kan, deg wid ivuôôen imdanen, iqehôen di tmurt, war ssebba. I wigi, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ma d win iûebôen, isemmêen, ayagi, s tidep, d aseyyi n lumuô.
verses.translation: Ma d win iûebôen, isemmêen, ayagi, s tidep, d aseyyi n lumuô.

verses.text: Win Itlef Öebbi, ur isâi bab, deffir eS. A pwaliv imednas, mara éôen aâaqeb, ad inin: "ma illa ubrid n tu$alin"?
verses.translation: Win Itlef Öebbi, ur isâi bab, deffir eS. A pwaliv imednas, mara éôen aâaqeb, ad inin: "ma illa ubrid n tu$alin"?

verses.text: A ten twaliv pwafessren fellas, ndellen, ggaren tiî s tugwdi. Ad inin wid iumnen: "imexsuôen, s tidep, d wid i sxesôen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". War ccekk, deg uâaqeb imezgi, ara yilin imednas.
verses.translation: A ten twaliv pwafessren fellas, ndellen, ggaren tiî s tugwdi. Ad inin wid iumnen: "imexsuôen, s tidep, d wid i sxesôen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". War ccekk, deg uâaqeb imezgi, ara yilin imednas.

verses.text: Ur asen llin imawlan, ara ten isellken, war Öebbi. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur isâi abrid.
verses.translation: Ur asen llin imawlan, ara ten isellken, war Öebbi. Win Itlef Öebbi, ur isâi abrid.

verses.text: Jawbet i Mass nnwen, uqbel a d ias, s$uô Öebbi, ass ur nepwexxiô. Ur awen ippili ssôan assen, ur tezmirem a pnekôem.
verses.translation: Jawbet i Mass nnwen, uqbel a d ias, s$uô Öebbi, ass ur nepwexxiô. Ur awen ippili ssôan assen, ur tezmirem a pnekôem.

verses.text: Ma numren, ur k id Nuzen ara d amêareb nnsen. Ay fellak, siwa timenna. Ih, mara Nesêess i umdan aêunu s$uône£, ad ifôeê yis. Mara t tsami tucmip, id bbwin ifassen is, s tidep, amdan ad ikaraâ.
verses.translation: Ma numren, ur k id Nuzen ara d amêareb nnsen. Ay fellak, siwa timenna. Ih, mara Nesêess i umdan aêunu s$uône£, ad ifôeê yis. Mara t tsami tucmip, id bbwin ifassen is, s tidep, amdan ad ikaraâ.

verses.text: N Öebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ippak nnta i win i S ihwan, Ippak ddkeô i win i S ihwan.
verses.translation: N Öebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Ippak nnta i win i S ihwan, Ippak ddkeô i win i S ihwan.

verses.text: Ne$ Ipcarak ddkeô d nnta. Isaâqaô win i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa Issen, Izmer.
verses.translation: Ne$ Ipcarak ddkeô d nnta. Isaâqaô win i S ihwan. Ih, Neppa Issen, Izmer.

verses.text: Ur ippunefk ara i umdan, ad as Immeslay Öebbi, siwa aweêêi, ne$ deffir ucembir, ne$ a d iazen amazan iwumi ara Iweêêi, s tsriê iS, ayen Ib$a. Ih, Neppa d Aâlayen, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Ur ippunefk ara i umdan, ad as Immeslay Öebbi, siwa aweêêi, ne$ deffir ucembir, ne$ a d iazen amazan iwumi ara Iweêêi, s tsriê iS, ayen Ib$a. Ih, Neppa d Aâlayen, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Akka ik d Nweêêa ôôuê, si lameô nne£; ur telliv d win issnen d acu p Tezmamt, ne$ liman. Maca, nerra p d tafat. Yis Nenehhu win i £ ihwan, seg imdanen nne£. Ih, d Keçç i ippawin d ubrid uwqim;
verses.translation: Akka ik d Nweêêa ôôuê, si lameô nne£; ur telliv d win issnen d acu p Tezmamt, ne$ liman. Maca, nerra p d tafat. Yis Nenehhu win i £ ihwan, seg imdanen nne£. Ih, d Keçç i ippawin d ubrid uwqim;

verses.text: abrid n Öebbi, i Isâan i illan di tmurt, i illan deg igenwan. War ccekk, ar Öebbi ay teddun lumuô.
verses.translation: abrid n Öebbi, i Isâan i illan di tmurt, i illan deg igenwan. War ccekk, ar Öebbi ay teddun lumuô.

ayahs.text: Ëm.
ayahs.translation: Ëm.

ayahs.text: Âsq.
ayahs.translation: Âsq.

ayahs.text: Akka i Iweêêa i keçç, akked wid ik id izwaren, Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Akka i Iweêêa i keçç, akked wid ik id izwaren, Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Neppa, d Aâlayen, d Ameqwôahan.
ayahs.translation: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Neppa, d Aâlayen, d Ameqwôahan.

ayahs.text: Qôib ad ccergen igenwan seg ixfawen nnsen, mara d lhint lmalayek deg usbuccaâ s ccekôan n Mass nnsent, u ssuturent ad pwassemêen kra illan di tmurt. War ccekk, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu?
ayahs.translation: Qôib ad ccergen igenwan seg ixfawen nnsen, mara d lhint lmalayek deg usbuccaâ s ccekôan n Mass nnsent, u ssuturent ad pwassemêen kra illan di tmurt. War ccekk, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu?

ayahs.text: Wid irran imawlan, war Neppa, Iquôaâ ten Öebbi. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Wid irran imawlan, war Neppa, Iquôaâ ten Öebbi. Ur telliv, keçç, d awkil nnsen.

ayahs.text: Akka ay k n Nweêêa Leqwôan, s taâôabt, iwakken a pnedôev tayimmap n temdinin, akked wayen i s d izzin; a pnedôev af ass n temlilit, ur degs ccekk; arbaâ di Loennet, arbaâ deg ujajiê.
ayahs.translation: Akka ay k n Nweêêa Leqwôan, s taâôabt, iwakken a pnedôev tayimmap n temdinin, akked wayen i s d izzin; a pnedôev af ass n temlilit, ur degs ccekk; arbaâ di Loennet, arbaâ deg ujajiê.

ayahs.text: Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Izdukkel iten d yiwen n lois. Maca, ad Issekcem win i S ihwan ar uêunu S. Imednas, ur sâin bab ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili Izdukkel iten d yiwen n lois. Maca, ad Issekcem win i S ihwan ar uêunu S. Imednas, ur sâin bab ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: Ne$ rran imawlan, war Neppa. Öebbi d Neppa ay d Bab, d Neppa i Issidiren lmeggtin, d Neppa i Izemren i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ne$ rran imawlan, war Neppa. Öebbi d Neppa ay d Bab, d Neppa i Issidiren lmeggtin, d Neppa i Izemren i yal cci.
