ayahs.translation: Akka, a ten Njewweo akked têuôtin lâin.

ayahs.text: A d ssutren, dinna, yal izwayen, di laman.
ayahs.translation: A d ssutren, dinna, yal izwayen, di laman.

ayahs.text: Ur pjeôôiben, dinna, tameppant, siwa tameppant tamezwarut. Isellek iten seg uâaqeb ujajiê.
ayahs.translation: Ur pjeôôiben, dinna, tameppant, siwa tameppant tamezwarut. Isellek iten seg uâaqeb ujajiê.

ayahs.text: D lfevl n Mass ik, d wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: D lfevl n Mass ik, d wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Nsehhel it kan, s tmeslayt ik, amendeô ma a d mmektin.
ayahs.translation: Nsehhel it kan, s tmeslayt ik, amendeô ma a d mmektin.

ayahs.text: Ggani, ula d nitni la pganin.
ayahs.translation: Ggani, ula d nitni la pganin.

verses.text: Ëm.
verses.translation: Ëm.

verses.text: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Di tmurt akked igenwan, s tidep, llan issekniyen i lmumnin.
verses.translation: Di tmurt akked igenwan, s tidep, llan issekniyen i lmumnin.

verses.text: Di lxelq nnwen, akked wayen id Issefôuôex n lewêuc, d issekniyen i ugdud ipputebbten.
verses.translation: Di lxelq nnwen, akked wayen id Issefôuôex n lewêuc, d issekniyen i ugdud ipputebbten.

verses.text: Di lemgarda n yiv akked wass, akked wayen id Issrusu Öebbi n ôôeéq, seg igenni - Issidir yis tamurt, deffir tmeppant is -, deg udewwel n wavu, issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.
verses.translation: Di lemgarda n yiv akked wass, akked wayen id Issrusu Öebbi n ôôeéq, seg igenni - Issidir yis tamurt, deffir tmeppant is -, deg udewwel n wavu, issekniyen i ugdud ipmeyyizen.

verses.text: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Öebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tidep. Anwa ameslay ara amnen, deffir Öebbi akked issekniyen iS?
verses.translation: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Öebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tidep. Anwa ameslay ara amnen, deffir Öebbi akked issekniyen iS?

verses.text: A ssxev n yal akeddab amednub!
verses.translation: A ssxev n yal akeddab amednub!

verses.text: Issemêas i issekniyen n Öebbi, qqaôen as ten, sinna, iggernen di tem$weô, amzun ur asen isli. Ihi, becceô it s uâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Issemêas i issekniyen n Öebbi, qqaôen as ten, sinna, iggernen di tem$weô, amzun ur asen isli. Ihi, becceô it s uâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ma illa wayen iwumi isla, seg issekniyen nne£, ad ittihi fellas. I widak, aâaqeb isdullun.
verses.translation: Ma illa wayen iwumi isla, seg issekniyen nne£, ad ittihi fellas. I widak, aâaqeb isdullun.

verses.text: Deffir sen Loahennama. Ur ten i$ennu s wacemma wayen kesben akked wayen rran d imawlan, war Öebbi. I nitni, aâaqeb abarar.
verses.translation: Deffir sen Loahennama. Ur ten i$ennu s wacemma wayen kesben akked wayen rran d imawlan, war Öebbi. I nitni, aâaqeb abarar.

verses.text: Tagi d nnhaya. Wid iugin issekniyen n Mass nnsen, fellasen aâaqeb n daâwessu taqeôêant.
verses.translation: Tagi d nnhaya. Wid iugin issekniyen n Mass nnsen, fellasen aâaqeb n daâwessu taqeôêant.

verses.text: Öebbi i Inuben fellawen s yill; ipcali, fellas, lbabuô, s lameô iS; a pnadim l$it iS. Amar a ppesnemrem!
verses.translation: Öebbi i Inuben fellawen s yill; ipcali, fellas, lbabuô, s lameô iS; a pnadim l$it iS. Amar a ppesnemrem!

verses.text: Inub fellawen s wayen akw illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt. Akw s$uôeS. S tidep, deg waya, d issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.
verses.translation: Inub fellawen s wayen akw illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt. Akw s$uôeS. S tidep, deg waya, d issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.

verses.text: Ini i wid iumnen ad semmêen i wid ur negguni ara ussan n Öebbi, iwakken ad Ikafi agdud $ef wayen keppben.
verses.translation: Ini i wid iumnen ad semmêen i wid ur negguni ara ussan n Öebbi, iwakken ad Ikafi agdud $ef wayen keppben.

verses.text: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win ifalîan, mgal is. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen tu$alin nnwen.
verses.translation: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win ifalîan, mgal is. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen tu$alin nnwen.

verses.text: Ni$ Nefka, i At Isôail, Tazmamt, ûûwab, lambiyya. Nôeéq iten s wayen ilhan. Nesmenyaf iten i imavalen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nefka, i At Isôail, Tazmamt, ûûwab, lambiyya. Nôeéq iten s wayen ilhan. Nesmenyaf iten i imavalen.

verses.text: Nefka yasen abeggen si Lameô. Ur mgarraden, armi i ten id tusa tmusni, wa iqheô wa. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.
verses.translation: Nefka yasen abeggen si Lameô. Ur mgarraden, armi i ten id tusa tmusni, wa iqheô wa. Ih, Mass ik ad Iêudd garasen, ass n tnekra, $ef wayen i$ef mgarraden.

verses.text: Sinna, Nebbwi k deg ubrid n Lameô. Ddu degs, ur teddu akked chawi n wid ur nessin.
verses.translation: Sinna, Nebbwi k deg ubrid n Lameô. Ddu degs, ur teddu akked chawi n wid ur nessin.

verses.text: Ih, nitni ur ak d ppawin acemma s$uô Öebbi. Imednas, ih, d imawlan wa n wa. Öebbi d Bab n wid ipêezziben.
verses.translation: Ih, nitni ur ak d ppawin acemma s$uô Öebbi. Imednas, ih, d imawlan wa n wa. Öebbi d Bab n wid ipêezziben.

verses.text: Ayagi d assekni i l$aci, d nnhaya u d aêunu i ugdud ipputebbten.
verses.translation: Ayagi d assekni i l$aci, d nnhaya u d aêunu i ugdud ipputebbten.

verses.text: Ne$ $ilen wid imôôeôen iman nnsen s tucmitin, a ten Neêseb am wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d imuddiren ne$ d lmeggtin. Dir it uêuddu nnsen.
verses.translation: Ne$ $ilen wid imôôeôen iman nnsen s tucmitin, a ten Neêseb am wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d imuddiren ne$ d lmeggtin. Dir it uêuddu nnsen.

verses.text: Öebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep, iwakken yal amdan ad ippuqeîîi af wayen ikseb. Nitni ur pwadensen.
verses.translation: Öebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep, iwakken yal amdan ad ippuqeîîi af wayen ikseb. Nitni ur pwadensen.

verses.text: Twalav win irran lhawiyya s d ôebbi is? Itelf it Öebbi, asali $uôeS. Iskweô as ul, timejjin, Irra yas aâbôuq af allen is. Anwa ara t inhun, deffir Öebbi? Day u la tesmektayem ara?
verses.translation: Twalav win irran lhawiyya s d ôebbi is? Itelf it Öebbi, asali $uôeS. Iskweô as ul, timejjin, Irra yas aâbôuq af allen is. Anwa ara t inhun, deffir Öebbi? Day u la tesmektayem ara?

verses.text: Nnan: "i illan kan, d tudert nne$, di ddunit. A nemmet, a nidir. Ad a$ in$en kan d akud". £ef ayagi, ur sâin kra n tmusni. Nitni $ilen kan.

verses.text: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, anamer nnsen, siwa mara d inin: "erret ed imezwura nne$, ma tessawalem tidep"!
verses.translation: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, anamer nnsen, siwa mara d inin: "erret ed imezwura nne$, ma tessawalem tidep"!

verses.text: Ini: "Öebbi Issidir ikwen, sinna, Ineqq ikwen. Sinna a kwen Issemlil ass n tnekra, ur illi degs ccekk". Maca, tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.

verses.text: N Öebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ass ideg ara d ias yimir, ass nni, ad xesôen ucmiten.

verses.text: A pwaliv yal lois $ef tgwecrar, yal lois ipwanced ar tezmamt is. Assa, a p$eltem ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: A pwaliv yal lois $ef tgwecrar, yal lois ipwanced ar tezmamt is. Assa, a p$eltem ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Tagi d tazmamt nne£, tessawal tidep fellawen. Nella Nepjerrid ayen akw txeddmem.

verses.text: Ihi, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Issekcem, Mass nnsen, s aêunu S. Wagi d rrbeê n ûûeê.

verses.text: Wanag wid ijehlen: "day ur awen $ôan ara issekniyen iW? Tesme$wôem iman nnwen, tellam d agdud ibe$wviyen".
verses.translation: Wanag wid ijehlen: "day ur awen $ôan ara issekniyen iW? Tesme$wôem iman nnwen, tellam d agdud ibe$wviyen".

verses.text: Mi nnan: "ih, lemâahda n Öebbi, d tidep; imir, ur degs ccekk", tennam: "ur neéôi d acu ay d imir; $uône$ d nnwaya kan, ur nepputebbet".

verses.text: Ad asen d vehôent tucmitin xedmen, ad asen izzi wayen i$ef ttihin.

verses.text: Ad asen Inin: "assa, a kwen Neppu, akken teppum timlilit n wass nnwen agi. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi useîîaô.

verses.text: Ayagi, acku kunwi la tettihim $ef issekniyen n Öebbi. T$uôô ikwen tudert n ddunit. Assa, ur d teff$en segs". Ur isti$fiô êedd fellasen.

ayahs.translation: Ad asen Inin: "assa, a kwen Neppu, akken teppum timlilit n wass nnwen agi. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi useîîaô.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, acku kunwi la tettihim $ef issekniyen n Öebbi. T$uôô ikwen tudert n ddunit. Assa, ur d teff$en segs". Ur isti$fiô êedd fellasen.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, acku kunwi la tettihim $ef issekniyen n Öebbi. T$uôô ikwen tudert n ddunit. Assa, ur d teff$en segs". Ur isti$fiô êedd fellasen.

ayahs.text: I Öebbi annuz, Mass igenwan, Mass n tmurt, Mass imavalen.
ayahs.translation: I Öebbi annuz, Mass igenwan, Mass n tmurt, Mass imavalen.

ayahs.text: I Neppa akw ayen iufraren, di tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: I Neppa akw ayen iufraren, di tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ëm.
verses.translation: Ëm.

verses.text: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Tarusi n Tezmamt s$uô Öebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ur Nexliq tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, siwa s tidep, ar lajel ipwassnen. Wid ijehlen numren ayen u$uô pwanedôen.
verses.translation: Ur Nexliq tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, siwa s tidep, ar lajel ipwassnen. Wid ijehlen numren ayen u$uô pwanedôen.

verses.text: Ini: "day ur twalam ara wigi u$uô la tepnujum, war Öebbi? Sseknet iyi d, d acu xelqen si tmurt, ne$ ma sâan amur deg igenwan? Awit iyi d tazmamt id izwaren tagi, ne$ lateô n tmusni, ma tessawalem tidep".
verses.translation: Ini: "day ur twalam ara wigi u$uô la tepnujum, war Öebbi? Sseknet iyi d, d acu xelqen si tmurt, ne$ ma sâan amur deg igenwan? Awit iyi d tazmamt id izwaren tagi, ne$ lateô n tmusni, ma tessawalem tidep".

verses.text: Anwa innetlafen sennig wid ipnujun, war Öebbi, $eô wayen ur asen d nepparra, ar ass n tnekra, u nitni stehzan deg unuju nnsen?
verses.translation: Anwa innetlafen sennig wid ipnujun, war Öebbi, $eô wayen ur asen d nepparra, ar ass n tnekra, u nitni stehzan deg unuju nnsen?

verses.text: Mara twafesrem imdanen, ad ilin d icenga nnsen, ad skiddben aâbad nnsen.
verses.translation: Mara twafesrem imdanen, ad ilin d icenga nnsen, ad skiddben aâbad nnsen.

verses.text: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, wid iugin tidep, mi ten id tusa, ad inin: "wagi d ssêur n ûûeê".
verses.translation: Ma $ôan asen issekniyen nne£ iberrzen, wid iugin tidep, mi ten id tusa, ad inin: "wagi d ssêur n ûûeê".

verses.text: Ne$ ad inin: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "lemmer it id snulfa$, ur tezmirem ad iyi tsellkem, s wacemma, si Öebbi. Neppa, Yif akw akken Issen, acu têekkum fellas. Iqadd Neppa d Anagi gari yidwen. Neppa, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ne$ ad inin: "isnulfa t id". Ini: "lemmer it id snulfa$, ur tezmirem ad iyi tsellkem, s wacemma, si Öebbi. Neppa, Yif akw akken Issen, acu têekkum fellas. Iqadd Neppa d Anagi gari yidwen. Neppa, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ini: "ur lli$, ger imazanen, d win id isnulfuyen. Ur éôi$ acu ara ivôun yidi, ne$ yidwen. La îîafaôe$, kan, ayen iyi d ippuweêêan. Aql i, kan, nek, d aneddaô ipbegginen".
verses.translation: Ini: "ur lli$, ger imazanen, d win id isnulfuyen. Ur éôi$ acu ara ivôun yidi, ne$ yidwen. La îîafaôe$, kan, ayen iyi d ippuweêêan. Aql i, kan, nek, d aneddaô ipbegginen".

verses.text: Ini: "meyyzet ma, ayagi, s$uô Öebbi, u tnekôem t? Icehhed unagi n At Isôail, $ef lmetl is, d$a iumen. Tesme$wrem iman nnwen". Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.
verses.translation: Ini: "meyyzet ma, ayagi, s$uô Öebbi, u tnekôem t? Icehhed unagi n At Isôail, $ef lmetl is, d$a iumen. Tesme$wrem iman nnwen". Ih, Öebbi ur Inehhu agdud imednas.

verses.text: Nnan wid ijehlen, i wid iumnen: "lemmer d ayen ilhan, ur a$ zeggwiren $uôes". Imi ur pwanhan ara syis, qqaôen: "ayagi d tikerkas n zik".
verses.translation: Nnan wid ijehlen, i wid iumnen: "lemmer d ayen ilhan, ur a$ zeggwiren $uôes". Imi ur pwanhan ara syis, qqaôen: "ayagi d tikerkas n zik".

verses.text: Uqbel is, Tazmamt n Musa, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Tagi d Tazmamt itebbiten, s wawalen n taâôabt, a ppendeô wid idensen, a ppessefôeê lâuûam.
verses.translation: Uqbel is, Tazmamt n Musa, d nnhaya u d aêunu. Tagi d Tazmamt itebbiten, s wawalen n taâôabt, a ppendeô wid idensen, a ppessefôeê lâuûam.

verses.text: Ih, wid iqqaôen: "Mass nne$ d Öebbi, d$a îfen degs, ur ppagaden, ur $weblen".
verses.translation: Ih, wid iqqaôen: "Mass nne$ d Öebbi, d$a îfen degs, ur ppagaden, ur $weblen".

verses.text: Widak d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen, d arraz n wayen xeddmen.
verses.translation: Widak d at Loennet, degs ad wekkôen, d arraz n wayen xeddmen.

verses.text: Nweûûa amdan ar lewqama s imawlan is. Imma s temêen s tadist, temêen di tinnufra. Ger tadist akked ujumi, caret wagguren. Armi ibbwev d anqaqôi, issawev kuéet isegwasen, inna: "a Mass iw! Eoo iyi a K snemmre$ af l$it i $ T$atev, nek akked lwaldin iw; ad xedme$ ayen ilhan ara K iôavin. Efk iyi d tarwa ilhan. Aql i utube$ K, aql i seg imvuâen".
verses.translation: Nweûûa amdan ar lewqama s imawlan is. Imma s temêen s tadist, temêen di tinnufra. Ger tadist akked ujumi, caret wagguren. Armi ibbwev d anqaqôi, issawev kuéet isegwasen, inna: "a Mass iw! Eoo iyi a K snemmre$ af l$it i $ T$atev, nek akked lwaldin iw; ad xedme$ ayen ilhan ara K iôavin. Efk iyi d tarwa ilhan. Aql i utube$ K, aql i seg imvuâen".

verses.text: £uô wigi, Nqebbel lmefruz igiten nnsen, a Nessuref i tucmitin nnsen, ger at Loennet; d lemâahda n tidep, i sen ippuwaââden.
verses.translation: £uô wigi, Nqebbel lmefruz igiten nnsen, a Nessuref i tucmitin nnsen, ger at Loennet; d lemâahda n tidep, i sen ippuwaââden.

verses.text: Win innan i imawlan is: "tfuh nnwen! Day yi tâahdem a d kkre$? Ni$ âaddan isuta uqbel i". Nitni teppren tacvaî n Öebbi: "a ssexv ik, amen! Ih, lmâahda n Öebbi, d tidep". A d yini: "ayagi, siwa tiêkayin imezwura".
verses.translation: Win innan i imawlan is: "tfuh nnwen! Day yi tâahdem a d kkre$? Ni$ âaddan isuta uqbel i". Nitni teppren tacvaî n Öebbi: "a ssexv ik, amen! Ih, lmâahda n Öebbi, d tidep". A d yini: "ayagi, siwa tiêkayin imezwura".

verses.text: D wigi i$ef iûaô wawal iaânan leoyus n leonun akked yimdanen, i ten id izwaren. Ih, nitni d imexsuôen.
verses.translation: D wigi i$ef iûaô wawal iaânan leoyus n leonun akked yimdanen, i ten id izwaren. Ih, nitni d imexsuôen.

verses.text: I akw tiseddarin n wayen xedmen, iwakken ad yili warraz igiten nnsen. Nitni ur pwadensen.
verses.translation: I akw tiseddarin n wayen xedmen, iwakken ad yili warraz igiten nnsen. Nitni ur pwadensen.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara kecmen ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "tvegâam tiéidanin i s tezham, di tmeddurt nnwen di ddunit. Assa, a ppeppuqeîîim s uâaqeb isdullun, imi tessem$waôem iman nnwen di tmurt, ur teklalem; imi tellam tbe$wlem".
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara kecmen ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "tvegâam tiéidanin i s tezham, di tmeddurt nnwen di ddunit. Assa, a ppeppuqeîîim s uâaqeb isdullun, imi tessem$waôem iman nnwen di tmurt, ur teklalem; imi tellam tbe$wlem".

verses.text: Mmekti d agmat n Âad, mi indeô agdud is deg igidan, u, s tidep, âaddan d ineddaôen zdat es, u zdeffir es: "siwa Öebbi ara tâabdem. Nek ugade$, fellawen, aâaqeb n wass abarar".
verses.translation: Mmekti d agmat n Âad, mi indeô agdud is deg igidan, u, s tidep, âaddan d ineddaôen zdat es, u zdeffir es: "siwa Öebbi ara tâabdem. Nek ugade$, fellawen, aâaqeb n wass abarar".

verses.text: Nnan d: "day a$ d tusiv, ad a$ tfaôqev akked iôebbiten nne$? Awi a$ d ayen i$ef la $ tessagwadev, ma tessawalev tidep"!
verses.translation: Nnan d: "day a$ d tusiv, ad a$ tfaôqev akked iôebbiten nne$? Awi a$ d ayen i$ef la $ tessagwadev, ma tessawalev tidep"!

verses.text: Inna: "tamusni ar Öebbi kan. Ssawve$ awen ayen i$ef id ppuceggâa$. Maca, wala$ kwen d agdud ur nessin".
verses.translation: Inna: "tamusni ar Öebbi kan. Ssawve$ awen ayen i$ef id ppuceggâa$. Maca, wala$ kwen d agdud ur nessin".

verses.text: Mi t walan d asigna id ileêêun ar t$wezza nnsen, nnan: "wagi d asigna ar a$ d iawin ageffur". Xaîi! D ayen i$ef têarem, d avu, degs aâaqeb aqeôêan;
verses.translation: Mi t walan d asigna id ileêêun ar t$wezza nnsen, nnan: "wagi d asigna ar a$ d iawin ageffur". Xaîi! D ayen i$ef têarem, d avu, degs aâaqeb aqeôêan;

verses.text: ad isqucc yal cci, s lameô n Mass is. Gwran d ur tepwaliv siwa ixxamen nnsen. Akka i Nepqeîîi igduden ibe$wviyen.
verses.translation: ad isqucc yal cci, s lameô n Mass is. Gwran d ur tepwaliv siwa ixxamen nnsen. Akka i Nepqeîîi igduden ibe$wviyen.

verses.text: Ni$ Nessakrer asen ayen ur awen Nessakrer. Nefka yasen imeééu$en, allen, akked wulawen. Ula i sen d bbwin deg wacemma imeééu$en, allen, akked wulawen, mi skaddben issekniyen n Öebbi. Ayen i$ef ttihin, izzi d fellasen.
verses.translation: Ni$ Nessakrer asen ayen ur awen Nessakrer. Nefka yasen imeééu$en, allen, akked wulawen. Ula i sen d bbwin deg wacemma imeééu$en, allen, akked wulawen, mi skaddben issekniyen n Öebbi. Ayen i$ef ttihin, izzi d fellasen.

verses.text: Ni$ nessenger akw timdinin i wen d izzin, u Nenewwel asent issekniyen, amar a d u$alent s abrid.
verses.translation: Ni$ nessenger akw timdinin i wen d izzin, u Nenewwel asent issekniyen, amar a d u$alent s abrid.

verses.text: Acimi ur ten sellken ara wid rran d iôebbiten iééaéan, war Öebbi? Xaîi! Ooan ten. D ayagi ay d tikerkas nnsen, u d wayen id snulfuyen.
verses.translation: Acimi ur ten sellken ara wid rran d iôebbiten iééaéan, war Öebbi? Xaîi! Ooan ten. D ayagi ay d tikerkas nnsen, u d wayen id snulfuyen.

verses.text: Mi k ed Nebbwi agraw n leonun, ad ssemêessen i Leqwôan; mi s êedôen, nnan: "êesset"! Mi ifukk, u$alen s agdud nnsen d ineddaôen.
verses.translation: Mi k ed Nebbwi agraw n leonun, ad ssemêessen i Leqwôan; mi s êedôen, nnan: "êesset"! Mi ifukk, u$alen s agdud nnsen d ineddaôen.

verses.text: Nnan: "a yagdud nne$, aql a$ nesla i Tezmamt id irsen, deffir Musa, id itebbten ayen ip id izwaren, i inehhun ar tidep akked ubrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Nnan: "a yagdud nne$, aql a$ nesla i Tezmamt id irsen, deffir Musa, id itebbten ayen ip id izwaren, i inehhun ar tidep akked ubrid uwqim.

verses.text: A yagdud nne$, erret awal i uberraê n Öebbi, amnet yiS, ad awen Isemmeê seg ibekkaven nnwen, a kwen Isellek seg uâaqeb aqeôêan".
verses.translation: A yagdud nne$, erret awal i uberraê n Öebbi, amnet yiS, ad awen Isemmeê seg ibekkaven nnwen, a kwen Isellek seg uâaqeb aqeôêan".

verses.text: Win isâaweégen i uberraê n Öebbi, ur ipsellik di tmurt, ur ippaf imawlan, war Neppa. Widak di ttelfan n ûûeê.
verses.translation: Win isâaweégen i uberraê n Öebbi, ur ipsellik di tmurt, ur ippaf imawlan, war Neppa. Widak di ttelfan n ûûeê.

verses.text: Day ur walan ara ar Öebbi d Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, ur Ifcil seg uxlaq nnsen? Izmer a d Issider lmeggtin. Ih, Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Day ur walan ara ar Öebbi d Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, ur Ifcil seg uxlaq nnsen? Izmer a d Issider lmeggtin. Ih, Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara d rsen, ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "maççi s tidep ayagi"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nne$"! A d Yini: "jeôôbet aâaqeb $ef wayen la tnekôem"!
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara d rsen, ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "maççi s tidep ayagi"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nne$"! A d Yini: "jeôôbet aâaqeb $ef wayen la tnekôem"!

verses.text: Eûbeô akken ûebôen wid iôeûmen seg imazanen. I nitni, ur p$awal. Ass ideg ara walin acu i sen ippuwaââden, amzun ur kminen siwa saâa n wass. D aberreê: "anwa ara ipwakksen, siwa agdud icemten"?
verses.translation: Eûbeô akken ûebôen wid iôeûmen seg imazanen. I nitni, ur p$awal. Ass ideg ara walin acu i sen ippuwaââden, amzun ur kminen siwa saâa n wass. D aberreê: "anwa ara ipwakksen, siwa agdud icemten"?

ayahs.translation: I akw tiseddarin n wayen xedmen, iwakken ad yili warraz igiten nnsen. Nitni ur pwadensen.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara kecmen ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "tvegâam tiéidanin i s tezham, di tmeddurt nnwen di ddunit. Assa, a ppeppuqeîîim s uâaqeb isdullun, imi tessem$waôem iman nnwen di tmurt, ur teklalem; imi tellam tbe$wlem".
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara kecmen ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "tvegâam tiéidanin i s tezham, di tmeddurt nnwen di ddunit. Assa, a ppeppuqeîîim s uâaqeb isdullun, imi tessem$waôem iman nnwen di tmurt, ur teklalem; imi tellam tbe$wlem".

ayahs.text: Mmekti d agmat n Âad, mi indeô agdud is deg igidan, u, s tidep, âaddan d ineddaôen zdat es, u zdeffir es: "siwa Öebbi ara tâabdem. Nek ugade$, fellawen, aâaqeb n wass abarar".
ayahs.translation: Mmekti d agmat n Âad, mi indeô agdud is deg igidan, u, s tidep, âaddan d ineddaôen zdat es, u zdeffir es: "siwa Öebbi ara tâabdem. Nek ugade$, fellawen, aâaqeb n wass abarar".

ayahs.text: Nnan d: "day a$ d tusiv, ad a$ tfaôqev akked iôebbiten nne$? Awi a$ d ayen i$ef la $ tessagwadev, ma tessawalev tidep"!
ayahs.translation: Nnan d: "day a$ d tusiv, ad a$ tfaôqev akked iôebbiten nne$? Awi a$ d ayen i$ef la $ tessagwadev, ma tessawalev tidep"!

ayahs.text: Inna: "tamusni ar Öebbi kan. Ssawve$ awen ayen i$ef id ppuceggâa$. Maca, wala$ kwen d agdud ur nessin".
ayahs.translation: Inna: "tamusni ar Öebbi kan. Ssawve$ awen ayen i$ef id ppuceggâa$. Maca, wala$ kwen d agdud ur nessin".

ayahs.text: Mi t walan d asigna id ileêêun ar t$wezza nnsen, nnan: "wagi d asigna ar a$ d iawin ageffur". Xaîi! D ayen i$ef têarem, d avu, degs aâaqeb aqeôêan;
ayahs.translation: Mi t walan d asigna id ileêêun ar t$wezza nnsen, nnan: "wagi d asigna ar a$ d iawin ageffur". Xaîi! D ayen i$ef têarem, d avu, degs aâaqeb aqeôêan;

ayahs.text: ad isqucc yal cci, s lameô n Mass is. Gwran d ur tepwaliv siwa ixxamen nnsen. Akka i Nepqeîîi igduden ibe$wviyen.
ayahs.translation: ad isqucc yal cci, s lameô n Mass is. Gwran d ur tepwaliv siwa ixxamen nnsen. Akka i Nepqeîîi igduden ibe$wviyen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Nessakrer asen ayen ur awen Nessakrer. Nefka yasen imeééu$en, allen, akked wulawen. Ula i sen d bbwin deg wacemma imeééu$en, allen, akked wulawen, mi skaddben issekniyen n Öebbi. Ayen i$ef ttihin, izzi d fellasen.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Nessakrer asen ayen ur awen Nessakrer. Nefka yasen imeééu$en, allen, akked wulawen. Ula i sen d bbwin deg wacemma imeééu$en, allen, akked wulawen, mi skaddben issekniyen n Öebbi. Ayen i$ef ttihin, izzi d fellasen.

ayahs.text: Ni$ nessenger akw timdinin i wen d izzin, u Nenewwel asent issekniyen, amar a d u$alent s abrid.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ nessenger akw timdinin i wen d izzin, u Nenewwel asent issekniyen, amar a d u$alent s abrid.

ayahs.text: Acimi ur ten sellken ara wid rran d iôebbiten iééaéan, war Öebbi? Xaîi! Ooan ten. D ayagi ay d tikerkas nnsen, u d wayen id snulfuyen.
ayahs.translation: Acimi ur ten sellken ara wid rran d iôebbiten iééaéan, war Öebbi? Xaîi! Ooan ten. D ayagi ay d tikerkas nnsen, u d wayen id snulfuyen.

ayahs.text: Mi k ed Nebbwi agraw n leonun, ad ssemêessen i Leqwôan; mi s êedôen, nnan: "êesset"! Mi ifukk, u$alen s agdud nnsen d ineddaôen.
ayahs.translation: Mi k ed Nebbwi agraw n leonun, ad ssemêessen i Leqwôan; mi s êedôen, nnan: "êesset"! Mi ifukk, u$alen s agdud nnsen d ineddaôen.

ayahs.text: Nnan: "a yagdud nne$, aql a$ nesla i Tezmamt id irsen, deffir Musa, id itebbten ayen ip id izwaren, i inehhun ar tidep akked ubrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Nnan: "a yagdud nne$, aql a$ nesla i Tezmamt id irsen, deffir Musa, id itebbten ayen ip id izwaren, i inehhun ar tidep akked ubrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: A yagdud nne$, erret awal i uberraê n Öebbi, amnet yiS, ad awen Isemmeê seg ibekkaven nnwen, a kwen Isellek seg uâaqeb aqeôêan".
ayahs.translation: A yagdud nne$, erret awal i uberraê n Öebbi, amnet yiS, ad awen Isemmeê seg ibekkaven nnwen, a kwen Isellek seg uâaqeb aqeôêan".

ayahs.text: Win isâaweégen i uberraê n Öebbi, ur ipsellik di tmurt, ur ippaf imawlan, war Neppa. Widak di ttelfan n ûûeê.
ayahs.translation: Win isâaweégen i uberraê n Öebbi, ur ipsellik di tmurt, ur ippaf imawlan, war Neppa. Widak di ttelfan n ûûeê.

ayahs.text: Day ur walan ara ar Öebbi d Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, ur Ifcil seg uxlaq nnsen? Izmer a d Issider lmeggtin. Ih, Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Day ur walan ara ar Öebbi d Win Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan, ur Ifcil seg uxlaq nnsen? Izmer a d Issider lmeggtin. Ih, Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara d rsen, ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "maççi s tidep ayagi"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nne$"! A d Yini: "jeôôbet aâaqeb $ef wayen la tnekôem"!
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara d rsen, ar tmes, wid ijehlen: "maççi s tidep ayagi"? A d inin: "ih, s Mass nne$"! A d Yini: "jeôôbet aâaqeb $ef wayen la tnekôem"!

ayahs.text: Eûbeô akken ûebôen wid iôeûmen seg imazanen. I nitni, ur p$awal. Ass ideg ara walin acu i sen ippuwaââden, amzun ur kminen siwa saâa n wass. D aberreê: "anwa ara ipwakksen, siwa agdud icemten"?
ayahs.translation: Eûbeô akken ûebôen wid iôeûmen seg imazanen. I nitni, ur p$awal. Ass ideg ara walin acu i sen ippuwaââden, amzun ur kminen siwa saâa n wass. D aberreê: "anwa ara ipwakksen, siwa agdud icemten"?

verses.text: Wid ijehlen, u ssefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, Itlef igiten nnsen.
verses.translation: Wid ijehlen, u ssefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, Itlef igiten nnsen.

verses.text: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, umnen s wayen id irsen ar Muêemmed, u neppa d tidep s$uô Mass nnsen; Issemsa yasen tucmitin nnsen, Iûeggem asen lêala nnsen.
verses.translation: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, umnen s wayen id irsen ar Muêemmed, u neppa d tidep s$uô Mass nnsen; Issemsa yasen tucmitin nnsen, Iûeggem asen lêala nnsen.

verses.text: Ayagi, acku wid ijehlen îîafaôen tikerkas; ma d wid iumnen, îîafaôen tidep n Mass nnsen. Akka id Ippak Öebbi imedyaten nnsen i imdanen.
verses.translation: Ayagi, acku wid ijehlen îîafaôen tikerkas; ma d wid iumnen, îîafaôen tidep n Mass nnsen. Akka id Ippak Öebbi imedyaten nnsen i imdanen.

verses.text: Mara d temlilem akked wid ijehlen, ewwtet ar tmegrav ar ten t$elbem. Arzet pen nezzeh. Sinna, d aserreê ne$ d feddu, alamma isers îôad tiâekkwmin is. Akka, lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili I$leb iten, maca a kwen Ijeôôeb, kra s kra. Wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur pôuêun igiten nnsen, d awez$i.
verses.translation: Mara d temlilem akked wid ijehlen, ewwtet ar tmegrav ar ten t$elbem. Arzet pen nezzeh. Sinna, d aserreê ne$ d feddu, alamma isers îôad tiâekkwmin is. Akka, lemmer i S ihwi i Öebbi, yili I$leb iten, maca a kwen Ijeôôeb, kra s kra. Wid ipwan$an deg ubrid n Öebbi, ur pôuêun igiten nnsen, d awez$i.

verses.text: A ten Inhu, ad Iûeggem lêala nnsen.
verses.translation: A ten Inhu, ad Iûeggem lêala nnsen.

verses.text: A ten Issekcem di Loennet i sen Imla.
verses.translation: A ten Issekcem di Loennet i sen Imla.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ma tefkam afus i Öebbi, ad awen Ifk afus, ad awen itebbet isurifen.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ma tefkam afus i Öebbi, ad awen Ifk afus, ad awen itebbet isurifen.

verses.text: Wid ijehlen, ay amxix nnsen, ad weddôen igiten nnsen.
verses.translation: Wid ijehlen, ay amxix nnsen, ad weddôen igiten nnsen.

verses.text: Ayagi, acku ugwin ayen id Issers Öebbi; ihi, Imêa igiten nnsen.
verses.translation: Ayagi, acku ugwin ayen id Issers Öebbi; ihi, Imêa igiten nnsen.

verses.text: Aâni ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek tevôa d imezwura nnsen? Issexv iten Öebbi. Am akka i ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Aâni ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek tevôa d imezwura nnsen? Issexv iten Öebbi. Am akka i ijehliyen.

verses.text: Ayagi, acku Öebbi d bab n wid iumnen. Ijehliyen, ur asen illi bab.
verses.translation: Ayagi, acku Öebbi d bab n wid iumnen. Ijehliyen, ur asen illi bab.

verses.text: Ih, Öebbi ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Wid ijehlen zehhun, teppen akken itepp lmal. D times ay d leqôaô nnsen.
verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Wid ijehlen zehhun, teppen akken itepp lmal. D times ay d leqôaô nnsen.

verses.text: Acêal n at temdinin i yifen, di tezmert, tamdint i k id iéâan! Nesqucc iten, ur asen illi useîîaô.
verses.translation: Acêal n at temdinin i yifen, di tezmert, tamdint i k id iéâan! Nesqucc iten, ur asen illi useîîaô.

verses.text: Day win illan ar ubeggen n Mass is, am win, iwumi ppucebbêen yir igiten is, u iîîafaôen chawi nnsen?
verses.translation: Day win illan ar ubeggen n Mass is, am win, iwumi ppucebbêen yir igiten is, u iîîafaôen chawi nnsen?

verses.text: Amek tga Loennet i ippuwaââden i wid ipêezziben: degs isaffen n waman ur nxeppeô, isaffen n yi$i ur tfessed lbenna s, isaffen n ccôab aéidan i wid itessen, isaffen n tament ippuneqqan. Degs, i nitni, yal ppemôa, akked ssmaê n Mass nnsen. Day am wid iwekkôen di tmes; sswan ten s waman ippayzagen, ara icergen afwad nnsen?
verses.translation: Amek tga Loennet i ippuwaââden i wid ipêezziben: degs isaffen n waman ur nxeppeô, isaffen n yi$i ur tfessed lbenna s, isaffen n ccôab aéidan i wid itessen, isaffen n tament ippuneqqan. Degs, i nitni, yal ppemôa, akked ssmaê n Mass nnsen. Day am wid iwekkôen di tmes; sswan ten s waman ippayzagen, ara icergen afwad nnsen?

verses.text: Llan garasen wid i k issemêasen. Sifat ff$en d s$uôek, ad inin i wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni: "d acu id inna kan, llinna"? Wigi d wid iwumi Isle$ Öebbi ulawen, teddun kan d chawi nnsen.
verses.translation: Llan garasen wid i k issemêasen. Sifat ff$en d s$uôek, ad inin i wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni: "d acu id inna kan, llinna"? Wigi d wid iwumi Isle$ Öebbi ulawen, teddun kan d chawi nnsen.

verses.text: Wid ipwanhan, Irna asen nnhaya, Ifka yasen aêezzeb nnsen.
verses.translation: Wid ipwanhan, Irna asen nnhaya, Ifka yasen aêezzeb nnsen.

verses.text: Day la pôaoun kan imir, a ten id ias, deqzalla? Ni$ usant ed licaôat is. Ma iusa d $uôsen, iwumi t usmekti nnsen?
verses.translation: Day la pôaoun kan imir, a ten id ias, deqzalla? Ni$ usant ed licaôat is. Ma iusa d $uôsen, iwumi t usmekti nnsen?

verses.text: Cfu ar, s tidep, ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi; ssuter ssmaê ubekkav ik, akked wid n lmumnin, argaz tameîîut. Öebbi Iéôa anda têebkem, akked wanda tberrkem.
verses.translation: Cfu ar, s tidep, ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi; ssuter ssmaê ubekkav ik, akked wid n lmumnin, argaz tameîîut. Öebbi Iéôa anda têebkem, akked wanda tberrkem.

verses.text: La qqaôen wid iumnen: "a lemmer a d ters tsuôep"! Maca, mi d ters tsuôep tuêkimt, ideg id ipwader umennu$, a pwaliv at wul iblan, la k id pmuqulen s tiî n win tessexcawat tmeppant. Yif it i nitni
verses.translation: La qqaôen wid iumnen: "a lemmer a d ters tsuôep"! Maca, mi d ters tsuôep tuêkimt, ideg id ipwader umennu$, a pwaliv at wul iblan, la k id pmuqulen s tiî n win tessexcawat tmeppant. Yif it i nitni

verses.text: wannuz, akked wawal uwqim. Mi ipwagzem ôôay, ma ssawlen tidep ar Öebbi yif it i nitni.
verses.translation: wannuz, akked wawal uwqim. Mi ipwagzem ôôay, ma ssawlen tidep ar Öebbi yif it i nitni.

verses.text: Day maççi, ma twexxôem, ahat a ppesfesdem tamurt, a pfaôqem alag nnwen?
verses.translation: Day maççi, ma twexxôem, ahat a ppesfesdem tamurt, a pfaôqem alag nnwen?

verses.text: Wigi d wid i Ixza Öebbi; Isgugem iten, Isder$el iéôi nnsen.
verses.translation: Wigi d wid i Ixza Öebbi; Isgugem iten, Isder$el iéôi nnsen.

verses.text: Day ur pmeyyizen ara Leqwôan, ne$ u$alent tsergal $ef wulawen?
verses.translation: Day ur pmeyyizen ara Leqwôan, ne$ u$alent tsergal $ef wulawen?

verses.text: Ih, wid ixedâan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya $uôsen, ikellex iten Cciîan. Iooa ten tallit.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ixedâan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya $uôsen, ikellex iten Cciîan. Iooa ten tallit.

verses.text: Ayagi, acku nitni nnan i wid iugin ayen d Issader Öebbi: "ad awen na$ awal di kra n lumuô". Öebbi Iéôa lesrar nnsen.
verses.translation: Ayagi, acku nitni nnan i wid iugin ayen d Issader Öebbi: "ad awen na$ awal di kra n lumuô". Öebbi Iéôa lesrar nnsen.

verses.text: Amek ihi, ma ddment lmalayek leôwaê nnsen, la ten kkatent ar udmawen nnsen, iârar nnsen?
verses.translation: Amek ihi, ma ddment lmalayek leôwaê nnsen, la ten kkatent ar udmawen nnsen, iârar nnsen?

verses.text: Akka, ihi, ddan akked wayen isserfayen Öebbi. Ugin llza S. D$a Isseôxes igiten nnsen.
verses.translation: Akka, ihi, ddan akked wayen isserfayen Öebbi. Ugin llza S. D$a Isseôxes igiten nnsen.

verses.text: Ne$ $ilen at wul amehzul, ard awez$i, ur d Issuffu$ ara Öebbi leb$wev nnsen?
verses.translation: Ne$ $ilen at wul amehzul, ard awez$i, ur d Issuffu$ ara Öebbi leb$wev nnsen?

verses.text: Lemmer i £ ihwi, ad ak ten id Nessken, war ccekk, a ten tâaqlev ar udem nnsen, a ten tâaqlev ar ûûenf umeslay. Öebbi Issen igiten nnwen.
verses.translation: Lemmer i £ ihwi, ad ak ten id Nessken, war ccekk, a ten tâaqlev ar udem nnsen, a ten tâaqlev ar ûûenf umeslay. Öebbi Issen igiten nnwen.

verses.text: S tidep, a kwen Njeôôeb, alamma Nessen imjuhad, akked iûebôiyen, segwen. A Njeôôeb isallen nnwen.
verses.translation: S tidep, a kwen Njeôôeb, alamma Nessen imjuhad, akked iûebôiyen, segwen. A Njeôôeb isallen nnwen.

verses.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, i inuqmen Amazan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya $uôsen, ur vuôôen Öebbi s wacemma. Ad Isseôxes igiten nnsen.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, i inuqmen Amazan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya $uôsen, ur vuôôen Öebbi s wacemma. Ad Isseôxes igiten nnsen.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan, ur ssiôxiset igiten nnwen!
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan, ur ssiôxiset igiten nnwen!

verses.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, sinna, mmuten d ijehliyen, war ccekk, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, d awez$i.
verses.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, sinna, mmuten d ijehliyen, war ccekk, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, d awez$i.

verses.text: Ur ppiôhifet, ur ssuturet tifrat, mara tilim d ine$laben! U Öebbi yidwen, ur kwen Ipêewwio, d awez$i, seg igiten nnwen.
verses.translation: Ur ppiôhifet, ur ssuturet tifrat, mara tilim d ine$laben! U Öebbi yidwen, ur kwen Ipêewwio, d awez$i, seg igiten nnwen.

verses.text: Tameddurt di ddunit, d urar kan, akked lhawiyya. Ma tumnem u têezbem, ad awen d Ifk arrazen nnwen. Ur awen issutur ayla nnwen.
verses.translation: Tameddurt di ddunit, d urar kan, akked lhawiyya. Ma tumnem u têezbem, ad awen d Ifk arrazen nnwen. Ur awen issutur ayla nnwen.

verses.text: Ma Issuter awen t, a kwen Icebbwel, a pcuêêem, a d iffe$ leb$wev nnwen.
verses.translation: Ma Issuter awen t, a kwen Icebbwel, a pcuêêem, a d iffe$ leb$wev nnwen.

verses.text: D kunwi i ipwanecden a pseddqem deg ubrid n Öebbi. Llan degwen wid ipcuêêun. Win ipcuêêun, ipcuêêu kan $ef yiman is. Öebbi d Asâay, kunwi d igellilen. Ma twexxôem, a kwen Ineûûef s ugdud ur nelli segwen. D$a ur ppemcabin $uôwen.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, acku ugwin ayen id Issers Öebbi; ihi, Imêa igiten nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, acku ugwin ayen id Issers Öebbi; ihi, Imêa igiten nnsen.

ayahs.text: Aâni ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek tevôa d imezwura nnsen? Issexv iten Öebbi. Am akka i ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Aâni ur nudan ara tamurt, ad walin amek tevôa d imezwura nnsen? Issexv iten Öebbi. Am akka i ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, acku Öebbi d bab n wid iumnen. Ijehliyen, ur asen illi bab.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, acku Öebbi d bab n wid iumnen. Ijehliyen, ur asen illi bab.

ayahs.text: Ih, Öebbi ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Wid ijehlen zehhun, teppen akken itepp lmal. D times ay d leqôaô nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi ad Issekcem wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Wid ijehlen zehhun, teppen akken itepp lmal. D times ay d leqôaô nnsen.

ayahs.text: Acêal n at temdinin i yifen, di tezmert, tamdint i k id iéâan! Nesqucc iten, ur asen illi useîîaô.
ayahs.translation: Acêal n at temdinin i yifen, di tezmert, tamdint i k id iéâan! Nesqucc iten, ur asen illi useîîaô.

ayahs.text: Day win illan ar ubeggen n Mass is, am win, iwumi ppucebbêen yir igiten is, u iîîafaôen chawi nnsen?
ayahs.translation: Day win illan ar ubeggen n Mass is, am win, iwumi ppucebbêen yir igiten is, u iîîafaôen chawi nnsen?

ayahs.text: Amek tga Loennet i ippuwaââden i wid ipêezziben: degs isaffen n waman ur nxeppeô, isaffen n yi$i ur tfessed lbenna s, isaffen n ccôab aéidan i wid itessen, isaffen n tament ippuneqqan. Degs, i nitni, yal ppemôa, akked ssmaê n Mass nnsen. Day am wid iwekkôen di tmes; sswan ten s waman ippayzagen, ara icergen afwad nnsen?
ayahs.translation: Amek tga Loennet i ippuwaââden i wid ipêezziben: degs isaffen n waman ur nxeppeô, isaffen n yi$i ur tfessed lbenna s, isaffen n ccôab aéidan i wid itessen, isaffen n tament ippuneqqan. Degs, i nitni, yal ppemôa, akked ssmaê n Mass nnsen. Day am wid iwekkôen di tmes; sswan ten s waman ippayzagen, ara icergen afwad nnsen?

ayahs.text: Llan garasen wid i k issemêasen. Sifat ff$en d s$uôek, ad inin i wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni: "d acu id inna kan, llinna"? Wigi d wid iwumi Isle$ Öebbi ulawen, teddun kan d chawi nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Llan garasen wid i k issemêasen. Sifat ff$en d s$uôek, ad inin i wid iwumi teppunefk tmusni: "d acu id inna kan, llinna"? Wigi d wid iwumi Isle$ Öebbi ulawen, teddun kan d chawi nnsen.

ayahs.text: Wid ipwanhan, Irna asen nnhaya, Ifka yasen aêezzeb nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Wid ipwanhan, Irna asen nnhaya, Ifka yasen aêezzeb nnsen.

ayahs.text: Day la pôaoun kan imir, a ten id ias, deqzalla? Ni$ usant ed licaôat is. Ma iusa d $uôsen, iwumi t usmekti nnsen?
ayahs.translation: Day la pôaoun kan imir, a ten id ias, deqzalla? Ni$ usant ed licaôat is. Ma iusa d $uôsen, iwumi t usmekti nnsen?

ayahs.text: Cfu ar, s tidep, ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi; ssuter ssmaê ubekkav ik, akked wid n lmumnin, argaz tameîîut. Öebbi Iéôa anda têebkem, akked wanda tberrkem.
ayahs.translation: Cfu ar, s tidep, ur illi ôebbi siwa Öebbi; ssuter ssmaê ubekkav ik, akked wid n lmumnin, argaz tameîîut. Öebbi Iéôa anda têebkem, akked wanda tberrkem.

ayahs.text: La qqaôen wid iumnen: "a lemmer a d ters tsuôep"! Maca, mi d ters tsuôep tuêkimt, ideg id ipwader umennu$, a pwaliv at wul iblan, la k id pmuqulen s tiî n win tessexcawat tmeppant. Yif it i nitni
ayahs.translation: La qqaôen wid iumnen: "a lemmer a d ters tsuôep"! Maca, mi d ters tsuôep tuêkimt, ideg id ipwader umennu$, a pwaliv at wul iblan, la k id pmuqulen s tiî n win tessexcawat tmeppant. Yif it i nitni

ayahs.text: wannuz, akked wawal uwqim. Mi ipwagzem ôôay, ma ssawlen tidep ar Öebbi yif it i nitni.
ayahs.translation: wannuz, akked wawal uwqim. Mi ipwagzem ôôay, ma ssawlen tidep ar Öebbi yif it i nitni.

ayahs.text: Day maççi, ma twexxôem, ahat a ppesfesdem tamurt, a pfaôqem alag nnwen?
ayahs.translation: Day maççi, ma twexxôem, ahat a ppesfesdem tamurt, a pfaôqem alag nnwen?

ayahs.text: Wigi d wid i Ixza Öebbi; Isgugem iten, Isder$el iéôi nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Wigi d wid i Ixza Öebbi; Isgugem iten, Isder$el iéôi nnsen.

ayahs.text: Day ur pmeyyizen ara Leqwôan, ne$ u$alent tsergal $ef wulawen?
ayahs.translation: Day ur pmeyyizen ara Leqwôan, ne$ u$alent tsergal $ef wulawen?

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ixedâan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya $uôsen, ikellex iten Cciîan. Iooa ten tallit.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ixedâan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya $uôsen, ikellex iten Cciîan. Iooa ten tallit.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, acku nitni nnan i wid iugin ayen d Issader Öebbi: "ad awen na$ awal di kra n lumuô". Öebbi Iéôa lesrar nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, acku nitni nnan i wid iugin ayen d Issader Öebbi: "ad awen na$ awal di kra n lumuô". Öebbi Iéôa lesrar nnsen.

ayahs.text: Amek ihi, ma ddment lmalayek leôwaê nnsen, la ten kkatent ar udmawen nnsen, iârar nnsen?
ayahs.translation: Amek ihi, ma ddment lmalayek leôwaê nnsen, la ten kkatent ar udmawen nnsen, iârar nnsen?

ayahs.text: Akka, ihi, ddan akked wayen isserfayen Öebbi. Ugin llza S. D$a Isseôxes igiten nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Akka, ihi, ddan akked wayen isserfayen Öebbi. Ugin llza S. D$a Isseôxes igiten nnsen.

ayahs.text: Ne$ $ilen at wul amehzul, ard awez$i, ur d Issuffu$ ara Öebbi leb$wev nnsen?
ayahs.translation: Ne$ $ilen at wul amehzul, ard awez$i, ur d Issuffu$ ara Öebbi leb$wev nnsen?

ayahs.text: Lemmer i £ ihwi, ad ak ten id Nessken, war ccekk, a ten tâaqlev ar udem nnsen, a ten tâaqlev ar ûûenf umeslay. Öebbi Issen igiten nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i £ ihwi, ad ak ten id Nessken, war ccekk, a ten tâaqlev ar udem nnsen, a ten tâaqlev ar ûûenf umeslay. Öebbi Issen igiten nnwen.

ayahs.text: S tidep, a kwen Njeôôeb, alamma Nessen imjuhad, akked iûebôiyen, segwen. A Njeôôeb isallen nnwen.
ayahs.translation: S tidep, a kwen Njeôôeb, alamma Nessen imjuhad, akked iûebôiyen, segwen. A Njeôôeb isallen nnwen.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, i inuqmen Amazan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya $uôsen, ur vuôôen Öebbi s wacemma. Ad Isseôxes igiten nnsen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, i inuqmen Amazan, deffir ubeggen n nnhaya $uôsen, ur vuôôen Öebbi s wacemma. Ad Isseôxes igiten nnsen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan, ur ssiôxiset igiten nnwen!
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan, ur ssiôxiset igiten nnwen!

ayahs.text: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, sinna, mmuten d ijehliyen, war ccekk, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, d awez$i.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid ijehlen, issefôa$en abrid n Öebbi, sinna, mmuten d ijehliyen, war ccekk, ur sen Ipsemmiê Öebbi, d awez$i.

ayahs.text: Ur ppiôhifet, ur ssuturet tifrat, mara tilim d ine$laben! U Öebbi yidwen, ur kwen Ipêewwio, d awez$i, seg igiten nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Ur ppiôhifet, ur ssuturet tifrat, mara tilim d ine$laben! U Öebbi yidwen, ur kwen Ipêewwio, d awez$i, seg igiten nnwen.

ayahs.text: Tameddurt di ddunit, d urar kan, akked lhawiyya. Ma tumnem u têezbem, ad awen d Ifk arrazen nnwen. Ur awen issutur ayla nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Tameddurt di ddunit, d urar kan, akked lhawiyya. Ma tumnem u têezbem, ad awen d Ifk arrazen nnwen. Ur awen issutur ayla nnwen.

ayahs.text: Ma Issuter awen t, a kwen Icebbwel, a pcuêêem, a d iffe$ leb$wev nnwen.
ayahs.translation: Ma Issuter awen t, a kwen Icebbwel, a pcuêêem, a d iffe$ leb$wev nnwen.

ayahs.text: D kunwi i ipwanecden a pseddqem deg ubrid n Öebbi. Llan degwen wid ipcuêêun. Win ipcuêêun, ipcuêêu kan $ef yiman is. Öebbi d Asâay, kunwi d igellilen. Ma twexxôem, a kwen Ineûûef s ugdud ur nelli segwen. D$a ur ppemcabin $uôwen.
ayahs.translation: D kunwi i ipwanecden a pseddqem deg ubrid n Öebbi. Llan degwen wid ipcuêêun. Win ipcuêêun, ipcuêêu kan $ef yiman is. Öebbi d Asâay, kunwi d igellilen. Ma twexxôem, a kwen Ineûûef s ugdud ur nelli segwen. D$a ur ppemcabin $uôwen.

verses.text: Ih, Nefya yak l$elb iberrzen,
verses.translation: Ih, Nefya yak l$elb iberrzen,

verses.text: iwakken ad Isemmeê Öebbi ibekkaven ik id izwaren akked wid igwran. Ad ak Itim l$it iS, a k Iawi d ubrid uwqim.
verses.translation: iwakken ad Isemmeê Öebbi ibekkaven ik id izwaren akked wid igwran. Ad ak Itim l$it iS, a k Iawi d ubrid uwqim.

verses.text: A k Iall Öebbi tallalt tuzmirt.
verses.translation: A k Iall Öebbi tallalt tuzmirt.

verses.text: D Neppa id Issersen talwit deg ulawen n lmumnin, iwakken ad yim$uô liman nnsen. N Öebbi Iâsekôiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga Iééeô, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: D Neppa id Issersen talwit deg ulawen n lmumnin, iwakken ad yim$uô liman nnsen. N Öebbi Iâsekôiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga Iééeô, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Iwakken ad Issekcem wid akked tid iumnen, ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. Ad asen Issemsu tucmitin nnsen. D wagi, ar Öebbi, ay d rrbeê abarar.
verses.translation: Iwakken ad Issekcem wid akked tid iumnen, ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. Ad asen Issemsu tucmitin nnsen. D wagi, ar Öebbi, ay d rrbeê abarar.

verses.text: Ad Iâaqeb ixabiten, tixabitin, imcurak, timcurak, wid id ipfekkiôen Öebbi yir afekkeô. Izzi yasen ddens. Irfa Öebbi fellasen, Ixza ten. Ihegga yasen d Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!
verses.translation: Ad Iâaqeb ixabiten, tixabitin, imcurak, timcurak, wid id ipfekkiôen Öebbi yir afekkeô. Izzi yasen ddens. Irfa Öebbi fellasen, Ixza ten. Ihegga yasen d Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!

verses.text: N Öebbi iâsekôiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: N Öebbi iâsekôiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ih, Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir, d aneddaô,
verses.translation: Ih, Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir, d aneddaô,

verses.text: iwakken a ppamnem s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, a T kfum, ad aS tanzem, a T tesbuccuâem taûebêit, tameddit.
verses.translation: iwakken a ppamnem s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, a T kfum, ad aS tanzem, a T tesbuccuâem taûebêit, tameddit.

verses.text: Wid iâaqden yidek âaqden kan d Öebbi. Afus n Öebbi nnig ufus nnsen. Win iêenten, d imanis kan i isseênet. Win iîîfen deg wayen i$ef iâuhed Öebbi, ad as Ifk arraz abarar.
verses.translation: Wid iâaqden yidek âaqden kan d Öebbi. Afus n Öebbi nnig ufus nnsen. Win iêenten, d imanis kan i isseênet. Win iîîfen deg wayen i$ef iâuhed Öebbi, ad as Ifk arraz abarar.

verses.text: Ad ak inin wid igwran, seg uâôaben n ucluê: "i $ ice$wlen, d ayla nne$ akked twaculin nne$. Ssuter a neppusemmeê". Qqaôen s yilsawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "anwa ara kwen iselken si Öebbi, s wacemma, ma Ib$a yawen vveôô, ne$ ma Ib$a yawen aba$uô? Xaîi, Izga Öebbi Ippuxebbeô af wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ad ak inin wid igwran, seg uâôaben n ucluê: "i $ ice$wlen, d ayla nne$ akked twaculin nne$. Ssuter a neppusemmeê". Qqaôen s yilsawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "anwa ara kwen iselken si Öebbi, s wacemma, ma Ib$a yawen vveôô, ne$ ma Ib$a yawen aba$uô? Xaîi, Izga Öebbi Ippuxebbeô af wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Xaîi, t$ilem Amazan akked lmumnin ur d ppu$alen ara, d awez$i, ar twaculin nnsen. Ayagi, issefôeê ulawen nnwen. Nnwaya nnwen dir ip. Kunwi d agdud imsenger.
verses.translation: Xaîi, t$ilem Amazan akked lmumnin ur d ppu$alen ara, d awez$i, ar twaculin nnsen. Ayagi, issefôeê ulawen nnwen. Nnwaya nnwen dir ip. Kunwi d agdud imsenger.

verses.text: Wid ur numin s Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, ihi, aql a£ Nhegga d ajajiê i ijehliyen.
verses.translation: Wid ur numin s Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, ihi, aql a£ Nhegga d ajajiê i ijehliyen.

verses.text: N Öebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan, Ipâuqub win i S ihwan. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: N Öebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan, Ipâuqub win i S ihwan. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A d inin wid igwran: "ma tôuêem a d t$eltem, ooet a$ a neddu yidwen". B$an ad bedlen awalen n Öebbi. Ini: "ur teppeddum yidne$, d awez$i. Akka ay d izwar wawal n Öebbi". A d inin: "teêsedm a$"! Xaîi, cwiî kan ay fehhmen.
verses.translation: A d inin wid igwran: "ma tôuêem a d t$eltem, ooet a$ a neddu yidwen". B$an ad bedlen awalen n Öebbi. Ini: "ur teppeddum yidne$, d awez$i. Akka ay d izwar wawal n Öebbi". A d inin: "teêsedm a$"! Xaîi, cwiî kan ay fehhmen.

verses.text: Ini i wid igwran, seg uâôaben n ucluê: "a ppepwanecdem s agdud amaâwaôu, uqsiê; a t tenna$em, ne$ ad anzen. Ma tu$em awal, ad awen Ifk Öebbi arraz igerzen. Ma twexxôem, akken twexxôem uqbel, a kwen Iâaqeb s lqeôê".
verses.translation: Ini i wid igwran, seg uâôaben n ucluê: "a ppepwanecdem s agdud amaâwaôu, uqsiê; a t tenna$em, ne$ ad anzen. Ma tu$em awal, ad awen Ifk Öebbi arraz igerzen. Ma twexxôem, akken twexxôem uqbel, a kwen Iâaqeb s lqeôê".

verses.text: Ur telli tiyta deg uder$al, ne$ deg urejdal, ne$ deg umuvin. Win iunzen i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, a t Issekcem di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Win iwexxôen, a t Iâaqeb s lqeôê.
verses.translation: Ur telli tiyta deg uder$al, ne$ deg urejdal, ne$ deg umuvin. Win iunzen i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, a t Issekcem di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Win iwexxôen, a t Iâaqeb s lqeôê.

verses.text: Ni$ Iôuva Öebbi lmumnin, mi âaqden yidek, seddaw ttejôa. Iéôa i illan deg ulawen nnsen, Issers d fellasen talwit, I$na ten s l$elb aqôib,
verses.translation: Ni$ Iôuva Öebbi lmumnin, mi âaqden yidek, seddaw ttejôa. Iéôa i illan deg ulawen nnsen, Issers d fellasen talwit, I$na ten s l$elb aqôib,

verses.text: akked waîas n lerbaê, ara îîfen. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: akked waîas n lerbaê, ara îîfen. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Iwaââed awen Öebbi a d teîîfem lerbaê aîas. I$awel awen d deg waya. Ikkes fellawen afus n medden. Akken ad yili ussekni i lmumnin, a kwen iawi d ubrid uwqim.
verses.translation: Iwaââed awen Öebbi a d teîîfem lerbaê aîas. I$awel awen d deg waya. Ikkes fellawen afus n medden. Akken ad yili ussekni i lmumnin, a kwen iawi d ubrid uwqim.

verses.text: Tayev, iwumi ur tezmirem, ihi, Izzi as Öebbi. Öebbi Izga Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Tayev, iwumi ur tezmirem, ihi, Izzi as Öebbi. Öebbi Izga Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Lemmer i kwen nnu$en wid ijehlen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur ppafen bab, ne$ asettaô.
verses.translation: Lemmer i kwen nnu$en wid ijehlen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur ppafen bab, ne$ asettaô.

verses.text: D tannumi n Öebbi i illan si zik. Ur teppafev abeddel, d awez$i, di tannumi n Öebbi.
verses.translation: D tannumi n Öebbi i illan si zik. Ur teppafev abeddel, d awez$i, di tannumi n Öebbi.

verses.text: D Neppa i Ikksen afus nnsen segwen, akked ufus nnwen segsen, di te$zut n Mekka, siwev Iss$elb ikwen fellasen. Öebbi Izga Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: D Neppa i Ikksen afus nnsen segwen, akked ufus nnwen segsen, di te$zut n Mekka, siwev Iss$elb ikwen fellasen. Öebbi Izga Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: D nitni i ijehlen. Swexxôen kwen si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ugin ad iawev usfel s amkan is. Lemmer maççi d lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, ur ten tessinem, a ten têazem ur teéôim; segsen a d tegwrim di le$ôuô - ni$ Öebbi Issekcam s aêunu S, win i S ihwan - lemmer mfaôaqen, yili, war ccekk, Nesâadda, $ef wid segsen ijehlen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: D nitni i ijehlen. Swexxôen kwen si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ugin ad iawev usfel s amkan is. Lemmer maççi d lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, ur ten tessinem, a ten têazem ur teéôim; segsen a d tegwrim di le$ôuô - ni$ Öebbi Issekcam s aêunu S, win i S ihwan - lemmer mfaôaqen, yili, war ccekk, Nesâadda, $ef wid segsen ijehlen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Mi rran wid ijehlen, aêernun deg ulawen nnsen, aêernun n war tussna, Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS af Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Iqqen asen awal uêezzeb. Iwata ten, klalen t. Öebbi Izga Iéôa yal cci.
verses.translation: Mi rran wid ijehlen, aêernun deg ulawen nnsen, aêernun n war tussna, Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS af Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Iqqen asen awal uêezzeb. Iwata ten, klalen t. Öebbi Izga Iéôa yal cci.

verses.text: Ni$ Issawev Öebbi, i Umazan iS, tamu$li s tidep: war ccekk, a pkecmem Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ma Irad Öebbi, di laman, iqweôôa nnwen ûûeîlen u qeôcen, ur teppagwadem. Iéôa ayen ur teéôim. Ihegga yawen d, ugwar aya, l$elb aqôib.
verses.translation: Ni$ Issawev Öebbi, i Umazan iS, tamu$li s tidep: war ccekk, a pkecmem Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ma Irad Öebbi, di laman, iqweôôa nnwen ûûeîlen u qeôcen, ur teppagwadem. Iéôa ayen ur teéôim. Ihegga yawen d, ugwar aya, l$elb aqôib.

verses.text: Neppa id Iuznen Amazan iS s nnhaya, akked ddin n tidep, iwakken a t Issifrer $ef ddin meôôa. Iqadd Öebbi d Anagi.
verses.translation: Neppa id Iuznen Amazan iS s nnhaya, akked ddin n tidep, iwakken a t Issifrer $ef ddin meôôa. Iqadd Öebbi d Anagi.

verses.text: Muêemmed d Amazan n Öebbi. Wid illan yides, qesêen ar ijehliyen, êninit garasen. A ten twaliv îîinizen, kennun, ssuturen lfevl s$uô Öebbi akked llza. Ccama nnsen, deg udmawen nnsen, d lateô n lekni. Ata wayen i ten icban di Tuôa akked wayen i ten icban di Linoil: am uâaqqa, iger ed im$i s, isoehd it. Ad iuzur, ad iâaooeô $ef yile$ is. Ippaâoab ifellaêen; i$webben yissen ijehliyen. Iwaââed Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz abarar, i wid degsen iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan.
verses.translation: Muêemmed d Amazan n Öebbi. Wid illan yides, qesêen ar ijehliyen, êninit garasen. A ten twaliv îîinizen, kennun, ssuturen lfevl s$uô Öebbi akked llza. Ccama nnsen, deg udmawen nnsen, d lateô n lekni. Ata wayen i ten icban di Tuôa akked wayen i ten icban di Linoil: am uâaqqa, iger ed im$i s, isoehd it. Ad iuzur, ad iâaooeô $ef yile$ is. Ippaâoab ifellaêen; i$webben yissen ijehliyen. Iwaââed Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz abarar, i wid degsen iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan.

ayahs.text: Ih, Nefya yak l$elb iberrzen,
ayahs.translation: Ih, Nefya yak l$elb iberrzen,

ayahs.text: iwakken ad Isemmeê Öebbi ibekkaven ik id izwaren akked wid igwran. Ad ak Itim l$it iS, a k Iawi d ubrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: iwakken ad Isemmeê Öebbi ibekkaven ik id izwaren akked wid igwran. Ad ak Itim l$it iS, a k Iawi d ubrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: A k Iall Öebbi tallalt tuzmirt.
ayahs.translation: A k Iall Öebbi tallalt tuzmirt.

ayahs.text: D Neppa id Issersen talwit deg ulawen n lmumnin, iwakken ad yim$uô liman nnsen. N Öebbi Iâsekôiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga Iééeô, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa id Issersen talwit deg ulawen n lmumnin, iwakken ad yim$uô liman nnsen. N Öebbi Iâsekôiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga Iééeô, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Iwakken ad Issekcem wid akked tid iumnen, ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. Ad asen Issemsu tucmitin nnsen. D wagi, ar Öebbi, ay d rrbeê abarar.
ayahs.translation: Iwakken ad Issekcem wid akked tid iumnen, ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad wekkôen. Ad asen Issemsu tucmitin nnsen. D wagi, ar Öebbi, ay d rrbeê abarar.

ayahs.text: Ad Iâaqeb ixabiten, tixabitin, imcurak, timcurak, wid id ipfekkiôen Öebbi yir afekkeô. Izzi yasen ddens. Irfa Öebbi fellasen, Ixza ten. Ihegga yasen d Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!
ayahs.translation: Ad Iâaqeb ixabiten, tixabitin, imcurak, timcurak, wid id ipfekkiôen Öebbi yir afekkeô. Izzi yasen ddens. Irfa Öebbi fellasen, Ixza ten. Ihegga yasen d Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!

ayahs.text: N Öebbi iâsekôiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi iâsekôiwen n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ih, Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir, d aneddaô,
ayahs.translation: Ih, Nuzen ik id d anagi, d abcir, d aneddaô,

ayahs.text: iwakken a ppamnem s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, a T kfum, ad aS tanzem, a T tesbuccuâem taûebêit, tameddit.
ayahs.translation: iwakken a ppamnem s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, a T kfum, ad aS tanzem, a T tesbuccuâem taûebêit, tameddit.

ayahs.text: Wid iâaqden yidek âaqden kan d Öebbi. Afus n Öebbi nnig ufus nnsen. Win iêenten, d imanis kan i isseênet. Win iîîfen deg wayen i$ef iâuhed Öebbi, ad as Ifk arraz abarar.
ayahs.translation: Wid iâaqden yidek âaqden kan d Öebbi. Afus n Öebbi nnig ufus nnsen. Win iêenten, d imanis kan i isseênet. Win iîîfen deg wayen i$ef iâuhed Öebbi, ad as Ifk arraz abarar.

ayahs.text: Ad ak inin wid igwran, seg uâôaben n ucluê: "i $ ice$wlen, d ayla nne$ akked twaculin nne$. Ssuter a neppusemmeê". Qqaôen s yilsawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "anwa ara kwen iselken si Öebbi, s wacemma, ma Ib$a yawen vveôô, ne$ ma Ib$a yawen aba$uô? Xaîi, Izga Öebbi Ippuxebbeô af wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ad ak inin wid igwran, seg uâôaben n ucluê: "i $ ice$wlen, d ayla nne$ akked twaculin nne$. Ssuter a neppusemmeê". Qqaôen s yilsawen nnsen, ayen ur nelli deg ulawen nnsen. Ini: "anwa ara kwen iselken si Öebbi, s wacemma, ma Ib$a yawen vveôô, ne$ ma Ib$a yawen aba$uô? Xaîi, Izga Öebbi Ippuxebbeô af wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Xaîi, t$ilem Amazan akked lmumnin ur d ppu$alen ara, d awez$i, ar twaculin nnsen. Ayagi, issefôeê ulawen nnwen. Nnwaya nnwen dir ip. Kunwi d agdud imsenger.
ayahs.translation: Xaîi, t$ilem Amazan akked lmumnin ur d ppu$alen ara, d awez$i, ar twaculin nnsen. Ayagi, issefôeê ulawen nnwen. Nnwaya nnwen dir ip. Kunwi d agdud imsenger.

ayahs.text: Wid ur numin s Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, ihi, aql a£ Nhegga d ajajiê i ijehliyen.
ayahs.translation: Wid ur numin s Öebbi, akked Umazan iS, ihi, aql a£ Nhegga d ajajiê i ijehliyen.

ayahs.text: N Öebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan, Ipâuqub win i S ihwan. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: N Öebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ipsemmiê i win i S ihwan, Ipâuqub win i S ihwan. Öebbi Izga Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A d inin wid igwran: "ma tôuêem a d t$eltem, ooet a$ a neddu yidwen". B$an ad bedlen awalen n Öebbi. Ini: "ur teppeddum yidne$, d awez$i. Akka ay d izwar wawal n Öebbi". A d inin: "teêsedm a$"! Xaîi, cwiî kan ay fehhmen.
ayahs.translation: A d inin wid igwran: "ma tôuêem a d t$eltem, ooet a$ a neddu yidwen". B$an ad bedlen awalen n Öebbi. Ini: "ur teppeddum yidne$, d awez$i. Akka ay d izwar wawal n Öebbi". A d inin: "teêsedm a$"! Xaîi, cwiî kan ay fehhmen.

ayahs.text: Ini i wid igwran, seg uâôaben n ucluê: "a ppepwanecdem s agdud amaâwaôu, uqsiê; a t tenna$em, ne$ ad anzen. Ma tu$em awal, ad awen Ifk Öebbi arraz igerzen. Ma twexxôem, akken twexxôem uqbel, a kwen Iâaqeb s lqeôê".
ayahs.translation: Ini i wid igwran, seg uâôaben n ucluê: "a ppepwanecdem s agdud amaâwaôu, uqsiê; a t tenna$em, ne$ ad anzen. Ma tu$em awal, ad awen Ifk Öebbi arraz igerzen. Ma twexxôem, akken twexxôem uqbel, a kwen Iâaqeb s lqeôê".

ayahs.text: Ur telli tiyta deg uder$al, ne$ deg urejdal, ne$ deg umuvin. Win iunzen i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, a t Issekcem di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Win iwexxôen, a t Iâaqeb s lqeôê.
ayahs.translation: Ur telli tiyta deg uder$al, ne$ deg urejdal, ne$ deg umuvin. Win iunzen i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, a t Issekcem di leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen. Win iwexxôen, a t Iâaqeb s lqeôê.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Iôuva Öebbi lmumnin, mi âaqden yidek, seddaw ttejôa. Iéôa i illan deg ulawen nnsen, Issers d fellasen talwit, I$na ten s l$elb aqôib,
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Iôuva Öebbi lmumnin, mi âaqden yidek, seddaw ttejôa. Iéôa i illan deg ulawen nnsen, Issers d fellasen talwit, I$na ten s l$elb aqôib,

ayahs.text: akked waîas n lerbaê, ara îîfen. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: akked waîas n lerbaê, ara îîfen. Öebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Iwaââed awen Öebbi a d teîîfem lerbaê aîas. I$awel awen d deg waya. Ikkes fellawen afus n medden. Akken ad yili ussekni i lmumnin, a kwen iawi d ubrid uwqim.
ayahs.translation: Iwaââed awen Öebbi a d teîîfem lerbaê aîas. I$awel awen d deg waya. Ikkes fellawen afus n medden. Akken ad yili ussekni i lmumnin, a kwen iawi d ubrid uwqim.

ayahs.text: Tayev, iwumi ur tezmirem, ihi, Izzi as Öebbi. Öebbi Izga Izmer i yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Tayev, iwumi ur tezmirem, ihi, Izzi as Öebbi. Öebbi Izga Izmer i yal cci.

ayahs.text: Lemmer i kwen nnu$en wid ijehlen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur ppafen bab, ne$ asettaô.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer i kwen nnu$en wid ijehlen, ad rewlen, sinna, ur ppafen bab, ne$ asettaô.

ayahs.text: D tannumi n Öebbi i illan si zik. Ur teppafev abeddel, d awez$i, di tannumi n Öebbi.
ayahs.translation: D tannumi n Öebbi i illan si zik. Ur teppafev abeddel, d awez$i, di tannumi n Öebbi.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i Ikksen afus nnsen segwen, akked ufus nnwen segsen, di te$zut n Mekka, siwev Iss$elb ikwen fellasen. Öebbi Izga Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i Ikksen afus nnsen segwen, akked ufus nnwen segsen, di te$zut n Mekka, siwev Iss$elb ikwen fellasen. Öebbi Izga Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: D nitni i ijehlen. Swexxôen kwen si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ugin ad iawev usfel s amkan is. Lemmer maççi d lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, ur ten tessinem, a ten têazem ur teéôim; segsen a d tegwrim di le$ôuô - ni$ Öebbi Issekcam s aêunu S, win i S ihwan - lemmer mfaôaqen, yili, war ccekk, Nesâadda, $ef wid segsen ijehlen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: D nitni i ijehlen. Swexxôen kwen si Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ugin ad iawev usfel s amkan is. Lemmer maççi d lmumnin, argaz tameîîut, ur ten tessinem, a ten têazem ur teéôim; segsen a d tegwrim di le$ôuô - ni$ Öebbi Issekcam s aêunu S, win i S ihwan - lemmer mfaôaqen, yili, war ccekk, Nesâadda, $ef wid segsen ijehlen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Mi rran wid ijehlen, aêernun deg ulawen nnsen, aêernun n war tussna, Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS af Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Iqqen asen awal uêezzeb. Iwata ten, klalen t. Öebbi Izga Iéôa yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Mi rran wid ijehlen, aêernun deg ulawen nnsen, aêernun n war tussna, Issers ed Öebbi talwit iS af Umazan iS, akked lmumnin. Iqqen asen awal uêezzeb. Iwata ten, klalen t. Öebbi Izga Iéôa yal cci.

ayahs.text: Ni$ Issawev Öebbi, i Umazan iS, tamu$li s tidep: war ccekk, a pkecmem Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ma Irad Öebbi, di laman, iqweôôa nnwen ûûeîlen u qeôcen, ur teppagwadem. Iéôa ayen ur teéôim. Ihegga yawen d, ugwar aya, l$elb aqôib.
ayahs.translation: Ni$ Issawev Öebbi, i Umazan iS, tamu$li s tidep: war ccekk, a pkecmem Loamaâ n Lêaôam, ma Irad Öebbi, di laman, iqweôôa nnwen ûûeîlen u qeôcen, ur teppagwadem. Iéôa ayen ur teéôim. Ihegga yawen d, ugwar aya, l$elb aqôib.

ayahs.text: Neppa id Iuznen Amazan iS s nnhaya, akked ddin n tidep, iwakken a t Issifrer $ef ddin meôôa. Iqadd Öebbi d Anagi.
ayahs.translation: Neppa id Iuznen Amazan iS s nnhaya, akked ddin n tidep, iwakken a t Issifrer $ef ddin meôôa. Iqadd Öebbi d Anagi.

ayahs.text: Muêemmed d Amazan n Öebbi. Wid illan yides, qesêen ar ijehliyen, êninit garasen. A ten twaliv îîinizen, kennun, ssuturen lfevl s$uô Öebbi akked llza. Ccama nnsen, deg udmawen nnsen, d lateô n lekni. Ata wayen i ten icban di Tuôa akked wayen i ten icban di Linoil: am uâaqqa, iger ed im$i s, isoehd it. Ad iuzur, ad iâaooeô $ef yile$ is. Ippaâoab ifellaêen; i$webben yissen ijehliyen. Iwaââed Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz abarar, i wid degsen iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan.
ayahs.translation: Muêemmed d Amazan n Öebbi. Wid illan yides, qesêen ar ijehliyen, êninit garasen. A ten twaliv îîinizen, kennun, ssuturen lfevl s$uô Öebbi akked llza. Ccama nnsen, deg udmawen nnsen, d lateô n lekni. Ata wayen i ten icban di Tuôa akked wayen i ten icban di Linoil: am uâaqqa, iger ed im$i s, isoehd it. Ad iuzur, ad iâaooeô $ef yile$ is. Ippaâoab ifellaêen; i$webben yissen ijehliyen. Iwaââed Öebbi ssmaê akked warraz abarar, i wid degsen iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur zeggwiret zdat Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur zeggwiret zdat Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur zzuhriyet tu$ac nnwen, sennig ta$wect n Nnbi. Ur zaââvet $uôes, akken tepzaââvam garawen, mulac ad mêun igiten nnwen, kunwi ur tfaqem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur zzuhriyet tu$ac nnwen, sennig ta$wect n Nnbi. Ur zaââvet $uôes, akken tepzaââvam garawen, mulac ad mêun igiten nnwen, kunwi ur tfaqem.

verses.text: Ih, wid issrusun ûut n ta$wect nnsen, ar Umazan n Öebbi, d wid iwumi Issefsi Öebbi ulawen nnsen, ar uêezzeb. Ad asen ippunefk ssmaê akked warraz abarar.
verses.translation: Ih, wid issrusun ûut n ta$wect nnsen, ar Umazan n Öebbi, d wid iwumi Issefsi Öebbi ulawen nnsen, ar uêezzeb. Ad asen ippunefk ssmaê akked warraz abarar.

verses.text: Ih, tegwti n wid ik n issawlen, deffir texxamin, ur pmeyyizen.
verses.translation: Ih, tegwti n wid ik n issawlen, deffir texxamin, ur pmeyyizen.

verses.text: Lemmer ûbiôen ard teff$ev $uôsen, ppif i nitni. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Lemmer ûbiôen ard teff$ev $uôsen, ppif i nitni. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Aballa$ ma ibbwi yawen d asali, ppuêeqqeqet, mulac a pvuôôem agdud, war tamusni, a ppu$alem tnedmem deg wayen txedmem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Aballa$ ma ibbwi yawen d asali, ppuêeqqeqet, mulac a pvuôôem agdud, war tamusni, a ppu$alem tnedmem deg wayen txedmem.

verses.text: Cfut illa garawen Umazan n Öebbi. Ma issemêes awen deg waîas n lumuô, a pjafem. Maca, Öebbi Issaâzez awen liman, Imelleê it deg ulawen nnwen, Isseôéeg awen tijehli, dd$el, lmaâûegga. Widak d wid ipwanhan.
verses.translation: Cfut illa garawen Umazan n Öebbi. Ma issemêes awen deg waîas n lumuô, a pjafem. Maca, Öebbi Issaâzez awen liman, Imelleê it deg ulawen nnwen, Isseôéeg awen tijehli, dd$el, lmaâûegga. Widak d wid ipwanhan.

verses.text: D lfevl s$uô Öebbi, d l$it. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: D lfevl s$uô Öebbi, d l$it. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ma nnu$ent snat n îayfat n lmumnin, êuddet pent. Ma tebw$ev yiwet degsent, $ef tayev, nna$et tin ibwe$ven alamma tevfeô lameô n Öebbi. Ma tevfeô it, ssemûalêet pent, s lmizan. Wezznet. Öebbi Iêemmel wid iwezznen.
verses.translation: Ma nnu$ent snat n îayfat n lmumnin, êuddet pent. Ma tebw$ev yiwet degsent, $ef tayev, nna$et tin ibwe$ven alamma tevfeô lameô n Öebbi. Ma tevfeô it, ssemûalêet pent, s lmizan. Wezznet. Öebbi Iêemmel wid iwezznen.

verses.text: Lmumnin d atmaten kan i illan. Ssemûalêet atmaten nnwen, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar fellawen aêunu.
verses.translation: Lmumnin d atmaten kan i illan. Ssemûalêet atmaten nnwen, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar fellawen aêunu.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! £uôwat ad imaâlek ugdud $ef wayev, ahat d widen i ten yifen. Ne$ tilawin $ef tiyav, ahat d tiden i tent yifen. Ur pqeôôidet iman nnwen, ur pmirgamet s tselleqwbin. Dir it isem n dd$el, anda illa liman. Wid ur nutub ara, d widak ay d imednas.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! £uôwat ad imaâlek ugdud $ef wayev, ahat d widen i ten yifen. Ne$ tilawin $ef tiyav, ahat d tiden i tent yifen. Ur pqeôôidet iman nnwen, ur pmirgamet s tselleqwbin. Dir it isem n dd$el, anda illa liman. Wid ur nutub ara, d widak ay d imednas.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Janbet aîas n nnwaya. Ih, nnwaya, tikwal, d abekkav. Ur ppemâassat ara. Ur kkatet wa deg wa. Day ib$u yiwen, degwen, ad içç aksum n gmas lmegget? A t tagwim. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Janbet aîas n nnwaya. Ih, nnwaya, tikwal, d abekkav. Ur ppemâassat ara. Ur kkatet wa deg wa. Day ib$u yiwen, degwen, ad içç aksum n gmas lmegget? A t tagwim. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.

verses.text: A yimdanen! Ni$ Nxelq ikwen si ddker akked nnta. Nerra kwen d igduden, d laâôac, a ppemyussanem. Ihi, ukyis nnwen amxallef, ar Öebbi, d win degwen ipêezziben sennig wiyav. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa, Ippuxebbeô.
verses.translation: A yimdanen! Ni$ Nxelq ikwen si ddker akked nnta. Nerra kwen d igduden, d laâôac, a ppemyussanem. Ihi, ukyis nnwen amxallef, ar Öebbi, d win degwen ipêezziben sennig wiyav. Ih, Öebbi Iéôa, Ippuxebbeô.

verses.text: Nnan uâôaben n ucluê: "numen". Ini: "ur tuminem". Maca init ed: "nunez"; ur ikcim ara liman ar wulawen nnwen. Ma tôuvam Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur awen Isôuêu acemma seg igiten nnwen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Nnan uâôaben n ucluê: "numen". Ini: "ur tuminem". Maca init ed: "nunez"; ur ikcim ara liman ar wulawen nnwen. Ma tôuvam Öebbi akked Umazan iS, ur awen Isôuêu acemma seg igiten nnwen. Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Lmumnin d wid kan iumnen s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, d$a, ur pcukun. Pna$en s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. D widak ay d imawlan n tidep.
verses.translation: Lmumnin d wid kan iumnen s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, d$a, ur pcukun. Pna$en s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen, deg ubrid n Öebbi. D widak ay d imawlan n tidep.

verses.text: Ini: "day ad aS temlem i Öebbi, ddin nnwen"? Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Issen yal cci.
verses.translation: Ini: "day ad aS temlem i Öebbi, ddin nnwen"? Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Öebbi Issen yal cci.

verses.text: Rran ak annuz nnsen, d tajmilt. Ini: "ur iyi telli tejmilt deg annuz nnwen. Xaîi, d Öebbi ikwen I$aten mi kwen Inha ar liman, ma d imawlan n tidep ay tellam".
verses.translation: Rran ak annuz nnsen, d tajmilt. Ini: "ur iyi telli tejmilt deg annuz nnwen. Xaîi, d Öebbi ikwen I$aten mi kwen Inha ar liman, ma d imawlan n tidep ay tellam".

verses.text: Ih, Öebbi Issen tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ih, Öebbi Issen tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur zeggwiret zdat Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur zeggwiret zdat Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Öebbi, s tidep, Issel, d Amusnaw.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur zzuhriyet tu$ac nnwen, sennig ta$wect n Nnbi. Ur zaââvet $uôes, akken tepzaââvam garawen, mulac ad mêun igiten nnwen, kunwi ur tfaqem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur zzuhriyet tu$ac nnwen, sennig ta$wect n Nnbi. Ur zaââvet $uôes, akken tepzaââvam garawen, mulac ad mêun igiten nnwen, kunwi ur tfaqem.

ayahs.text: Ih, wid issrusun ûut n ta$wect nnsen, ar Umazan n Öebbi, d wid iwumi Issefsi Öebbi ulawen nnsen, ar uêezzeb. Ad asen ippunefk ssmaê akked warraz abarar.
ayahs.translation: Ih, wid issrusun ûut n ta$wect nnsen, ar Umazan n Öebbi, d wid iwumi Issefsi Öebbi ulawen nnsen, ar uêezzeb. Ad asen ippunefk ssmaê akked warraz abarar.

ayahs.text: Ih, tegwti n wid ik n issawlen, deffir texxamin, ur pmeyyizen.
ayahs.translation: Ih, tegwti n wid ik n issawlen, deffir texxamin, ur pmeyyizen.

ayahs.translation: Lemmer ûbiôen ard teff$ev $uôsen, ppif i nitni. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Aballa$ ma ibbwi yawen d asali, ppuêeqqeqet, mulac a pvuôôem agdud, war tamusni, a ppu$alem tnedmem deg wayen txedmem.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Aballa$ ma ibbwi yawen d asali, ppuêeqqeqet, mulac a pvuôôem agdud, war tamusni, a ppu$alem tnedmem deg wayen txedmem.

ayahs.text: Cfut illa garawen Umazan n Öebbi. Ma issemêes awen deg waîas n lumuô, a pjafem. Maca, Öebbi Issaâzez awen liman, Imelleê it deg ulawen nnwen, Isseôéeg awen tijehli, dd$el, lmaâûegga. Widak d wid ipwanhan.

ayahs.translation: D lfevl s$uô Öebbi, d l$it. Öebbi Iéôa, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Ma nnu$ent snat n îayfat n lmumnin, êuddet pent. Ma tebw$ev yiwet degsent, $ef tayev, nna$et tin ibwe$ven alamma tevfeô lameô n Öebbi. Ma tevfeô it, ssemûalêet pent, s lmizan. Wezznet. Öebbi Iêemmel wid iwezznen.
ayahs.translation: Ma nnu$ent snat n îayfat n lmumnin, êuddet pent. Ma tebw$ev yiwet degsent, $ef tayev, nna$et tin ibwe$ven alamma tevfeô lameô n Öebbi. Ma tevfeô it, ssemûalêet pent, s lmizan. Wezznet. Öebbi Iêemmel wid iwezznen.

ayahs.text: Lmumnin d atmaten kan i illan. Ssemûalêet atmaten nnwen, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar fellawen aêunu.
ayahs.translation: Lmumnin d atmaten kan i illan. Ssemûalêet atmaten nnwen, êezzbet i Öebbi, amar fellawen aêunu.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! £uôwat ad imaâlek ugdud $ef wayev, ahat d widen i ten yifen. Ne$ tilawin $ef tiyav, ahat d tiden i tent yifen. Ur pqeôôidet iman nnwen, ur pmirgamet s tselleqwbin. Dir it isem n dd$el, anda illa liman. Wid ur nutub ara, d widak ay d imednas.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! £uôwat ad imaâlek ugdud $ef wayev, ahat d widen i ten yifen. Ne$ tilawin $ef tiyav, ahat d tiden i tent yifen. Ur pqeôôidet iman nnwen, ur pmirgamet s tselleqwbin. Dir it isem n dd$el, anda illa liman. Wid ur nutub ara, d widak ay d imednas.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Janbet aîas n nnwaya. Ih, nnwaya, tikwal, d abekkav. Ur ppemâassat ara. Ur kkatet wa deg wa. Day ib$u yiwen, degwen, ad içç aksum n gmas lmegget? A t tagwim. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Janbet aîas n nnwaya. Ih, nnwaya, tikwal, d abekkav. Ur ppemâassat ara. Ur kkatet wa deg wa. Day ib$u yiwen, degwen, ad içç aksum n gmas lmegget? A t tagwim. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Issuruf, Ipêunu.

ayahs.translation: Ih, Öebbi Issen tabavnit n tmurt akked igenwan. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

verses.translation: Ayen tgezmem n tezdayin akked wayen teooam beddent af iéuôan nnsent, s wannuf n Öebbi, iwakken a d Isdull iballa$en.

verses.text: Ayen i s Ifka Öebbi, s$uôsen, i Umazan iS, ur tebgisem fellas s ioedâen akked lemrakeb. Maca, Öebbi Ippak adabu i Umazan iS, $ef wid i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: Ayen i s Ifka Öebbi, s$uôsen, i Umazan iS, ur tebgisem fellas s ioedâen akked lemrakeb. Maca, Öebbi Ippak adabu i Umazan iS, $ef wid i S ihwan. Öebbi Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Ayen Ifka Öebbi i Umazan iS, s$uô at tuddar, n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, llezm is, igujilen, ime$ban, akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Iwakken ur ippu$al ara ger ifassen imeôkantiyen nnwen. Ayen i wen ifka Umazan, ddmet ep. Ayen i wen ikkes, kkset ep. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi, Iwâaô i uqeîîi.
verses.translation: Ayen Ifka Öebbi i Umazan iS, s$uô at tuddar, n Öebbi akked Umazan iS, llezm is, igujilen, ime$ban, akked win d ibbwi ubrid. Iwakken ur ippu$al ara ger ifassen imeôkantiyen nnwen. Ayen i wen ifka Umazan, ddmet ep. Ayen i wen ikkes, kkset ep. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi, Iwâaô i uqeîîi.

verses.text: I igellilen iminigen, id ssuff$en seg ixxamen nnsen akked seg wayla nnsen, ssaramen lfevl n Öebbi akked llza, fkan afus i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, d widak ay d imawlan n tidep.
verses.translation: I igellilen iminigen, id ssuff$en seg ixxamen nnsen akked seg wayla nnsen, ssaramen lfevl n Öebbi akked llza, fkan afus i Öebbi akked Umazan iS, d widak ay d imawlan n tidep.

verses.text: Wid ized$en ixxamen, iumnen uqbel nnsen, êemmlen wid id iunagen $uôsen. Ur néifen idmaren nnsen af wayen i sen ippunefken, smenyafen ten i iman nnsen, xas ma gwran d xuûûen. Wid irran akin ccêa af yiman nnsen, widak d imerbaê.
verses.translation: Wid ized$en ixxamen, iumnen uqbel nnsen, êemmlen wid id iunagen $uôsen. Ur néifen idmaren nnsen af wayen i sen ippunefken, smenyafen ten i iman nnsen, xas ma gwran d xuûûen. Wid irran akin ccêa af yiman nnsen, widak d imerbaê.

verses.text: Wid id iusan deffir sen, qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Semmeê a$, akked wamaten nne$, i $ d izwaren ar liman. Ur Ppara deg ulawen nne$, a$ullu n wid iumnen. A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, d Umâin Ipêunun".
verses.translation: Wid id iusan deffir sen, qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Semmeê a$, akked wamaten nne$, i $ d izwaren ar liman. Ur Ppara deg ulawen nne$, a$ullu n wid iumnen. A Mass nne$! Keçç, s tidep, d Umâin Ipêunun".

verses.text: Ur twalav ara ixabiten, la qqaôen i watmaten nnsen ijehlen, seg wAt Tezmamt: "ma ssuff$en kwen, ard a neffe$ yidwen, ur nessemêas i yiwen, d awez$i, mgal nnwen. Ma nnu$en kwen, ar ad awen nefk afus". Ad Icehhed Öebbi, ar nitni d ikeddaben.
verses.translation: Ur twalav ara ixabiten, la qqaôen i watmaten nnsen ijehlen, seg wAt Tezmamt: "ma ssuff$en kwen, ard a neffe$ yidwen, ur nessemêas i yiwen, d awez$i, mgal nnwen. Ma nnu$en kwen, ar ad awen nefk afus". Ad Icehhed Öebbi, ar nitni d ikeddaben.

verses.text: Ma ssuff$en ten, ur teff$en yidsen. Ma nnu$en ten, ur asen ppaken afus. Ma âawnen ten, ad rewlen; ihi, ur ppâawanen!
verses.translation: Ma ssuff$en ten, ur teff$en yidsen. Ma nnu$en ten, ur asen ppaken afus. Ma âawnen ten, ad rewlen; ihi, ur ppâawanen!

verses.text: D kunwi, sennig Öebbi, ay ugaden idmaren nnsen, ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nefhim.
verses.translation: D kunwi, sennig Öebbi, ay ugaden idmaren nnsen, ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nefhim.

verses.text: Ur kwen pna$en, ddukwlen, siwa ma di temdinin ippwaéeôben, ne$ deffir leswaô. Lbe$wv garasen qesseê. A pxilev dduklen, wanag rwin wulawen nnsen. Ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nepxemmim.
verses.translation: Ur kwen pna$en, ddukwlen, siwa ma di temdinin ippwaéeôben, ne$ deffir leswaô. Lbe$wv garasen qesseê. A pxilev dduklen, wanag rwin wulawen nnsen. Ayagi, acku nitni d agdud ur nepxemmim.

verses.text: Cban wid i ten id izwaren s cwiî kan, jeôôben lwexda igiten nnsen, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Cban wid i ten id izwaren s cwiî kan, jeôôben lwexda igiten nnsen, fellasen aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Cban Cciîan, mi s inna i umdan: "ejhel"! Mi ijhel, inna: "nek mgirrde$ k, nek ugade$ Öebbi, Mass imavalen"!
verses.translation: Cban Cciîan, mi s inna i umdan: "ejhel"! Mi ijhel, inna: "nek mgirrde$ k, nek ugade$ Öebbi, Mass imavalen"!

verses.text: D times, ih, ara yilin d taggara nnsen, ad wekkôen dinna. Ayagi d arraz imednas.
verses.translation: D times, ih, ara yilin d taggara nnsen, ad wekkôen dinna. Ayagi d arraz imednas.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Yal yiwen iwata ad iwali acu ihegga i uzekka. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Yal yiwen iwata ad iwali acu ihegga i uzekka. Ëezzbet i Öebbi. Ih, Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ur ppilit am wid ippun Öebbi. Irra ten, ppun iman nnsen. Widak d iballa$en.
verses.translation: Ur ppilit am wid ippun Öebbi. Irra ten, ppun iman nnsen. Widak d iballa$en.

verses.text: Ur aâdilen ara at tmes akked at Loennet. At Loennet d imerbaê.
verses.translation: Ur aâdilen ara at tmes akked at Loennet. At Loennet d imerbaê.

verses.text: Lemmer id Nessader Leqwôan agi af udrar, a t twaliv iunez, ifelleq, si tugdi n Öebbi. D wigi ay d imedyaten id Neppawi i medden, amar ad meyyzen.
verses.translation: Lemmer id Nessader Leqwôan agi af udrar, a t twaliv iunez, ifelleq, si tugdi n Öebbi. D wigi ay d imedyaten id Neppawi i medden, amar ad meyyzen.

verses.text: Neppa d Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir. Neppa, d Aênin Ipêunun.
verses.translation: Neppa d Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ur neffir. Neppa, d Aênin Ipêunun.

verses.text: D Neppa, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, ay d Agellid, d Ssid, d Tifrat, d Bab n liman, d Aâssas, d Uzmir, d Ajebbaô, d Ameqwôaêan. Gedha s Öebbi, mgal wayen pcaraken!
verses.translation: D Neppa, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa, ay d Agellid, d Ssid, d Tifrat, d Bab n liman, d Aâssas, d Uzmir, d Ajebbaô, d Ameqwôaêan. Gedha s Öebbi, mgal wayen pcaraken!

verses.text: Neppa d Öebbi, d Axellaq, d Bab usisi, d Amessal. I Neppa ismawen imxulaf mavi. Sbuccuâen T akw kra illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Neppa d Öebbi, d Axellaq, d Bab usisi, d Amessal. I Neppa ismawen imxulaf mavi. Sbuccuâen T akw kra illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Neppa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Sbuccuâen Öebbi kra illan deg igenwan, akked kra illan di tmurt. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Sbuccuâen Öebbi kra illan deg igenwan, akked kra illan di tmurt. Neppa d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: D Neppa i Issuff$en seg ixxamen nnsen wid ijehlen seg At Tezmamt, i ujemmal amezwaru. Ur tuminem ara ad ff$en. £ilen leswaô nnsen a ten sellken si Öebbi. Ikka yasen d Öebbi seg wanda ur bnin. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Hudden ixxamen nnsen, s ifassen nnsen, akked ifassen n lmumnin. Meyyzet a wid ipwalin!
ayahs.translation: D Neppa i Issuff$en seg ixxamen nnsen wid ijehlen seg At Tezmamt, i ujemmal amezwaru. Ur tuminem ara ad ff$en. £ilen leswaô nnsen a ten sellken si Öebbi. Ikka yasen d Öebbi seg wanda ur bnin. Issekcem tugdi deg ulawen nnsen. Hudden ixxamen nnsen, s ifassen nnsen, akked ifassen n lmumnin. Meyyzet a wid ipwalin!

ayahs.text: Lemmer ur asen Iura ara Öebbi neffu, yili Iqeîîa ten di ddunit, u, di laxeôt, fellasen aâaqeb n tmes.
ayahs.translation: Lemmer ur asen Iura ara Öebbi neffu, yili Iqeîîa ten di ddunit, u, di laxeôt, fellasen aâaqeb n tmes.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, acku numren Öebbi akked Umazan iS. Win inumren Öebbi, ihi, Öebbi, Iwâaô i uqeîîi.

english_meaning: She that is to be examined

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ddukulet d icenga W akked icenga nnwen. Teram ten d iêbiben, u nitni nekôen ayen id iusan, $uôwen, n tidep. Èèéaân Amazan, ééaân kwen, imi tumnem s Öebbi, Mass nnwen. Ma teff$em a ppenna$em deg ubrid iW, u tepnadim ôôva W, day a ten terrem, s tuffra, d iêbiben? Nek, Ife$ akw akken èôi$, ayen teffrem akked wayen tennam. Win, segwen, ixedmen akka, innetlaf seg ubrid umâin.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ur ddukulet d icenga W akked icenga nnwen. Teram ten d iêbiben, u nitni nekôen ayen id iusan, $uôwen, n tidep.
