Nek, Ife$ akw akken èôi$, ayen teffrem akked wayen tennam. Win, segwen, ixedmen akka, innetlaf seg ubrid umâin.

verses.text: Ma $elben kwen, ad u$alen d icenga nnwen, a kwen merten s ifassen nnsen akked yilsawen nnsen, ad ssirmen a pjehlem.
verses.translation: Ma $elben kwen, ad u$alen d icenga nnwen, a kwen merten s ifassen nnsen akked yilsawen nnsen, ad ssirmen a pjehlem.

verses.text: Ass n tnekra, ur kwen infaâ walag, ne$ tarwa nnwen, d awez$i. Ad Ifrez garawen. Öebbi Ipwali igiten nnwen.
verses.translation: Ass n tnekra, ur kwen infaâ walag, ne$ tarwa nnwen, d awez$i. Ad Ifrez garawen. Öebbi Ipwali igiten nnwen.

verses.text: Ni$ illa i kunwi umedya ucbiê di Ibôahim akked wid illan yides, mi nnan i ugdud nnsen: "nemgirred ikwen, kunwi akked wayen teppanzem, war Öebbi. Nenkeô ikwen. Taâdawt akked dd$el, ersen d garane$, i lebda, alamma tumnem s Öebbi Yiwen". Kkes ed awalen i inna Ibôahim, i baba s: "ad velbe$ a ppeppusemmêev, xas ur iyi Ikellef Öebbi, fellak, s wacemma". A Mass nne$! Ppkal nne$ fellaK; nutub iK; $uôeK tu$alin.
verses.translation: Ni$ illa i kunwi umedya ucbiê di Ibôahim akked wid illan yides, mi nnan i ugdud nnsen: "nemgirred ikwen, kunwi akked wayen teppanzem, war Öebbi. Nenkeô ikwen. Taâdawt akked dd$el, ersen d garane$, i lebda, alamma tumnem s Öebbi Yiwen". Kkes ed awalen i inna Ibôahim, i baba s: "ad velbe$ a ppeppusemmêev, xas ur iyi Ikellef Öebbi, fellak, s wacemma". A Mass nne$! Ppkal nne$ fellaK; nutub iK; $uôeK tu$alin.

verses.text: A Mass nne$ ur a$ Ppara d ahewwel i wid ijehlen. A Mass nne$! Semmeê a$. Ih, Keçç d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: A Mass nne$ ur a$ Ppara d ahewwel i wid ijehlen. A Mass nne$! Semmeê a$. Ih, Keçç d Uzmir, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Ni$, i kunwi, amedya nnsen ucbiê, i wid iggunin Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Ma d win iwexxôen, ihi, Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz!
verses.translation: Ni$, i kunwi, amedya nnsen ucbiê, i wid iggunin Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Ma d win iwexxôen, ihi, Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz!

verses.text: Ahat Öebbi ad Irr tadukli garawen akked wid, segsen, i illan d icenga nnwen. Öebbi d Uzmir, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: Ahat Öebbi ad Irr tadukli garawen akked wid, segsen, i illan d icenga nnwen. Öebbi d Uzmir, Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ur awen Ikkis ara Öebbi, a pmaânem u tweznem, ar wid ur kwen nepna$ di ddin, ur kwen nessuffu$ seg ixxamen nnwen. Öebbi, s tidep, Iêemmel wid iweznen.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ur ddukulet d icenga W akked icenga nnwen. Teram ten d iêbiben, u nitni nekôen ayen id iusan, $uôwen, n tidep. Èèéaân Amazan, ééaân kwen, imi tumnem s Öebbi, Mass nnwen. Ma teff$em a ppenna$em deg ubrid iW, u tepnadim ôôva W, day a ten terrem, s tuffra, d iêbiben? Nek, Ife$ akw akken èôi$, ayen teffrem akked wayen tennam. ayahs.text: Ni$ illa i kunwi umedya ucbiê di Ibôahim akked wid illan yides, mi nnan i ugdud nnsen: "nemgirred ikwen, kunwi akked wayen teppanzem, war Öebbi. Nenkeô ikwen. Taâdawt akked dd$el, ersen d garane$, i lebda, alamma tumnem s Öebbi Yiwen". Kkes ed awalen i inna Ibôahim, i baba s: "ad velbe$ a ppeppusemmêev, xas ur iyi Ikellef Öebbi, fellak, s wacemma". A Mass nne$! Ppkal nne$ fellaK; nutub iK; $uôeK tu$alin.

verses.text: I illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, sbuccuâen Öebbi. IneS tagelda; ineS wannuz; Neppa Izmer i yal cci.
verses.translation: I illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt, sbuccuâen Öebbi. IneS tagelda; ineS wannuz; Neppa Izmer i yal cci.

verses.text: Neppa ikwen Ixelqen; segwen ajehli, segwen lmumen. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Neppa ikwen Ixelqen; segwen ajehli, segwen lmumen. Öebbi Ipwali ayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Imsel ikwen, Iûeggem amsal nnwen. £uôeS tu$alin.
verses.translation: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tidep. Imsel ikwen, Iûeggem amsal nnwen. £uôeS tu$alin.

verses.text: Iéôa i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Iéôa ayen teffrem akked wayen tennam. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Iéôa i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Iéôa ayen teffrem akked wayen tennam. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: Ma iusa kwen id usali n wid illan, zik, d ijehliyen? Jeôben lwexda n tikli nnsen. Fellasen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
verses.translation: Ma iusa kwen id usali n wid illan, zik, d ijehliyen? Jeôben lwexda n tikli nnsen. Fellasen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

verses.text: Ayagi, imi sen ppasen imazanen nnsen s ubeggen. Nnan: "aâni d amdan ara $ inhun"? D$a jehlen, xedâan. Ur Iclaâ Öebbi. Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.
verses.translation: Ayagi, imi sen ppasen imazanen nnsen s ubeggen. Nnan: "aâni d amdan ara $ inhun"? D$a jehlen, xedâan. Ur Iclaâ Öebbi. Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.

verses.text: Pputebten ijehliyen ar, d awez$i, ur d pnekkaren. Ini: "xaîi! S Mass iw, ard a d tekkrem, sinna ard a ppepwaxebbôem $ef wayen txeddmem"! Ayagi, i Öebbi, d ushil.
verses.translation: Pputebten ijehliyen ar, d awez$i, ur d pnekkaren. Ini: "xaîi! S Mass iw, ard a d tekkrem, sinna ard a ppepwaxebbôem $ef wayen txeddmem"! Ayagi, i Öebbi, d ushil.

verses.text: Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked tafat id Nessers. Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked tafat id Nessers. Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: Ass ideg ara kwen Issemlil, i wass ujemmel, ass nni, d ass um$uôôu. Win iumnen s Öebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad as Ikkes tucmitin is, a t Issekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad iwekkeô i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
verses.translation: Ass ideg ara kwen Issemlil, i wass ujemmel, ass nni, d ass um$uôôu. Win iumnen s Öebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad as Ikkes tucmitin is, a t Issekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad iwekkeô i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

verses.text: Wid ijehlen u inekôen issekniyen nne£, widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen. A taggara icemten!
verses.translation: Wid ijehlen u inekôen issekniyen nne£, widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen. A taggara icemten!

verses.text: Ur d teppas twa$it, siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Win iumnen s Öebbi, ad Inhu ul is. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.
verses.translation: Ur d teppas twa$it, siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Win iumnen s Öebbi, ad Inhu ul is. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.

verses.text: A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan! Ma twexxôem, i iwatan kan, i Umazan nne£, siwa anabi ipbegginen.
verses.translation: A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan! Ma twexxôem, i iwatan kan, i Umazan nne£, siwa anabi ipbegginen.

verses.text: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
verses.translation: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! S tidep, kra n tlawin nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d icenga nnwen. Ëadret iman nnwen segsen! Ma tsemmêem, teppum, tsemmêem, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! S tidep, kra n tlawin nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d icenga nnwen. Ëadret iman nnwen segsen! Ma tsemmêem, teppum, tsemmêem, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Ayla nnwen akked dderya nnwen, d ahewwel kan, wanag, ar Öebbi, illa warraz ameqwôahan.
verses.translation: Ayla nnwen akked dderya nnwen, d ahewwel kan, wanag, ar Öebbi, illa warraz ameqwôahan.

verses.text: Ëezzbet i Öebbi ayen iwumi tzemrem. Ëesset, ôavit, seddqet! Yif it i iman nnwen. Wid ikksen ccêa i iman nnsen, widak d imerbaê.
verses.translation: Ëezzbet i Öebbi ayen iwumi tzemrem. Ëesset, ôavit, seddqet! Yif it i iman nnwen. Wid ikksen ccêa i iman nnsen, widak d imerbaê.

verses.text: Ma tôevlem i Öebbi aôeîîal igerzen, ad awen d Irr sin imuren, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi Iceffu, Iêellem.
verses.translation: Ma tôevlem i Öebbi aôeîîal igerzen, ad awen d Irr sin imuren, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi Iceffu, Iêellem.

verses.text: Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ivehôen, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Iéôa i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Iéôa ayen teffrem akked wayen tennam. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.
ayahs.translation: Iéôa i illan di tmurt akked igenwan. Iéôa ayen teffrem akked wayen tennam. Öebbi Iéôa i illan deg idmaren.

ayahs.text: Ma iusa kwen id usali n wid illan, zik, d ijehliyen? Jeôben lwexda n tikli nnsen. Fellasen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.
ayahs.translation: Ma iusa kwen id usali n wid illan, zik, d ijehliyen? Jeôben lwexda n tikli nnsen. Fellasen, aâaqeb aqeôêan.

ayahs.text: Ayagi, imi sen ppasen imazanen nnsen s ubeggen. Nnan: "aâni d amdan ara $ inhun"? D$a jehlen, xedâan. Ur Iclaâ Öebbi. Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.
ayahs.translation: Ayagi, imi sen ppasen imazanen nnsen s ubeggen. Nnan: "aâni d amdan ara $ inhun"? D$a jehlen, xedâan. Ur Iclaâ Öebbi. Öebbi d Asâay, d Amaâzuz.

ayahs.text: Pputebten ijehliyen ar, d awez$i, ur d pnekkaren. Ini: "xaîi! S Mass iw, ard a d tekkrem, sinna ard a ppepwaxebbôem $ef wayen txeddmem"! Ayagi, i Öebbi, d ushil.
ayahs.translation: Pputebten ijehliyen ar, d awez$i, ur d pnekkaren. Ini: "xaîi! S Mass iw, ard a d tekkrem, sinna ard a ppepwaxebbôem $ef wayen txeddmem"! Ayagi, i Öebbi, d ushil.

ayahs.text: Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked tafat id Nessers. Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: Ihi, amnet s Öebbi akked Umazan iS, akked tafat id Nessers. Öebbi Ippuxebbeô $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: Ass ideg ara kwen Issemlil, i wass ujemmel, ass nni, d ass um$uôôu. Win iumnen s Öebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad as Ikkes tucmitin is, a t Issekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad iwekkeô i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.
ayahs.translation: Ass ideg ara kwen Issemlil, i wass ujemmel, ass nni, d ass um$uôôu. Win iumnen s Öebbi, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad as Ikkes tucmitin is, a t Issekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ppazzalen, degsen ad iwekkeô i lebda. D wagi ay d rrbeê ameqwôaêan.

ayahs.text: Wid ijehlen u inekôen issekniyen nne£, widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen. A taggara icemten!
ayahs.translation: Wid ijehlen u inekôen issekniyen nne£, widak d at tmes, degs ad wekkôen. A taggara icemten!

ayahs.text: Ur d teppas twa$it, siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Win iumnen s Öebbi, ad Inhu ul is. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.
ayahs.translation: Ur d teppas twa$it, siwa ma Irad Öebbi. Win iumnen s Öebbi, ad Inhu ul is. Öebbi Iéôa yal cci.

ayahs.text: A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan! Ma twexxôem, i iwatan kan, i Umazan nne£, siwa anabi ipbegginen.
ayahs.translation: A$et awal i Öebbi, a$et awal i Umazan! Ma twexxôem, i iwatan kan, i Umazan nne£, siwa anabi ipbegginen.

ayahs.text: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi, ur illi ôebbi siwa Neppa. £ef Öebbi ara ppeklen lmumnin.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! S tidep, kra n tlawin nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d icenga nnwen. Ëadret iman nnwen segsen! Ma tsemmêem, teppum, tsemmêem, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! S tidep, kra n tlawin nnwen akked tarwa nnwen, d icenga nnwen. Ëadret iman nnwen segsen! Ma tsemmêem, teppum, tsemmêem, Öebbi, s tidep, Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Ayla nnwen akked dderya nnwen, d ahewwel kan, wanag, ar Öebbi, illa warraz ameqwôahan.
ayahs.translation: Ayla nnwen akked dderya nnwen, d ahewwel kan, wanag, ar Öebbi, illa warraz ameqwôahan.

ayahs.text: Ëezzbet i Öebbi ayen iwumi tzemrem. Ëesset, ôavit, seddqet! Yif it i iman nnwen. Wid ikksen ccêa i iman nnsen, widak d imerbaê.
ayahs.translation: Ëezzbet i Öebbi ayen iwumi tzemrem. Ëesset, ôavit, seddqet! Yif it i iman nnwen. Wid ikksen ccêa i iman nnsen, widak d imerbaê.

ayahs.text: Ma tôevlem i Öebbi aôeîîal igerzen, ad awen d Irr sin imuren, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi Iceffu, Iêellem.
ayahs.translation: Ma tôevlem i Öebbi aôeîîal igerzen, ad awen d Irr sin imuren, ad awen Isemmeê. Öebbi Iceffu, Iêellem.

ayahs.text: Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ivehôen, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Amusnaw n wayen iffren akked wayen ivehôen, Uzmir, Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Mara tebrum i tlawin, brut asent mara tâaddi tallit n tarda nnsent. Ëesbet tallit. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, Mass nnwen. Ur tent ssuffu$et si texxamin nnsent, ur d teff$ent, siwa ma, s tidep, ccvent. D tigi ay d tilisa n Öebbi. Win izegren tilisa n Öebbi, ni$ idens imanis. Ur teéôiv ara, ahat Öebbi a d Iazen lameô, ssyen $eô da.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Mara tebrum i tlawin, brut asent mara tâaddi tallit n tarda nnsent. Ëesbet tallit. Ëezzbet i Öebbi, Mass nnwen. Ur tent ssuffu$et si texxamin nnsent, ur d teff$ent, siwa ma, s tidep, ccvent. D tigi ay d tilisa n Öebbi. Win izegren tilisa n Öebbi, ni$ idens imanis. Ur teéôiv ara, ahat Öebbi a d Iazen lameô, ssyen $eô da.

verses.text: Mi ssawvent lajel nnsent, âacôet pent s lewqama, ne$ mfaôaqet yidsent, s lewqama. Awit ed sin inagan iêeqqiyen segwen, a d cehhden zdat Öebbi. Ataya wayen u$uô ppunedôen, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Win ipêezziben i Öebbi, ad as Ildi tibbura,
verses.translation: Mi ssawvent lajel nnsent, âacôet pent s lewqama, ne$ mfaôaqet yidsent, s lewqama. Awit ed sin inagan iêeqqiyen segwen, a d cehhden zdat Öebbi. Ataya wayen u$uô ppunedôen, wid iumnen s Öebbi akked wass aneggaru. Win ipêezziben i Öebbi, ad as Ildi tibbura,

verses.text: a t I$it s wanda ur iêtim. Win iîîfen di Öebbi, a t Iqennaâ. Ih, Öebbi Issâadday lameô iS. Ni$ Öebbi Iwzen yal cci.
verses.translation: a t I$it s wanda ur iêtim. Win iîîfen di Öebbi, a t Iqennaâ. Ih, Öebbi Issâadday lameô iS. Ni$ Öebbi Iwzen yal cci.

verses.text: I tigad, n tlawin nnwen, i iuysen tarda, ma illa ccekk, tallit ugani nnsent: krav wagguren. Akken i tid ur nebdi tarda. Tid ibbwin tadist, tallit nnsent ar tinnufra nnsent. Win ipêezziben i Öebbi, s lameô iS, ad as Istiser.
verses.translation: I tigad, n tlawin nnwen, i iuysen tarda, ma illa ccekk, tallit ugani nnsent: krav wagguren. Akken i tid ur nebdi tarda. Tid ibbwin tadist, tallit nnsent ar tinnufra nnsent. Win ipêezziben i Öebbi, s lameô iS, ad as Istiser.

verses.text: D wagi ay d lameô n Öebbi i wen d Issers. Win ipêezziben i Öebbi, ad as Ikkes tucmitin is, ad Issali arraz is.
verses.translation: D wagi ay d lameô n Öebbi i wen d Issers. Win ipêezziben i Öebbi, ad as Ikkes tucmitin is, ad Issali arraz is.

verses.text: Ad asent tefkem tanezdu$t anda tzed$em, akken tewâam. Ur tent îîuôôut s tririt nnsent ar lêeôs. Ma llant s tadist, ûeôôfet fellasent, alamma d tinnufra nnsent. Ma ssuîvent tarwa nnwen, efket asent taqdiât nnsent; mwafaqet s tiéeî. Ma temnamarem, a ppessuîîev tmeîîut nniven.
verses.translation: Ad asent tefkem tanezdu$t anda tzed$em, akken tewâam. Ur tent îîuôôut s tririt nnsent ar lêeôs. Ma llant s tadist, ûeôôfet fellasent, alamma d tinnufra nnsent. Ma ssuîvent tarwa nnwen, efket asent taqdiât nnsent; mwafaqet s tiéeî. Ma temnamarem, a ppessuîîev tmeîîut nniven.

verses.text: Bu udrim ad iûeôôef segs. Win ixuû ôôeéq ad iûeôôef seg wayen i s Ifka Öebbi. Ur Ipkellif Öebbi taôwiêt, siwa ar ayen i s Ifka. Öebbi ad Issuffe$ laâtab ar tafat.
verses.translation: Bu udrim ad iûeôôef segs. Win ixuû ôôeéq ad iûeôôef seg wayen i s Ifka Öebbi. Ur Ipkellif Öebbi taôwiêt, siwa ar ayen i s Ifka. Öebbi ad Issuffe$ laâtab ar tafat.

verses.text: Acêal n temdinin i inuqmen lameô n Mass nnsent akked imazanen iS! Nêuseb itent leêsab uqsiê. Nâaqeb itent s uâaqeb issexven.
verses.translation: Acêal n temdinin i inuqmen lameô n Mass nnsent akked imazanen iS! Nêuseb itent leêsab uqsiê. Nâaqeb itent s uâaqeb issexven.

verses.text: Jeôôbent lwexda igiten nnsent. D lexsaôa ay d iooa lameô nnsent.
verses.translation: Jeôôbent lwexda igiten nnsent. D lexsaôa ay d iooa lameô nnsent.

verses.text: A Nnbi! Ay$eô tgedlev ayen i k Iêell Öebbi? Tqennâav tilawin ik. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Ay$eô tgedlev ayen i k Iêell Öebbi? Tqennâav tilawin ik. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

verses.text: Öebbi Iêeppem fellawen a pêentem. Öebbi d Bab nnwen. Neppa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
verses.translation: Öebbi Iêeppem fellawen a pêentem. Öebbi d Bab nnwen. Neppa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

verses.text: Mi inna Nnbi sser, i yiwet si tlawin is, u temla, Öebbi Issken it i neppa. Ixebbeô s wumur, iffer amur, segs. Mi p iaâlem s waya, tenna: "wi k imlan aya"? Inna: "Imla yi t Win Issnen, Ippuxebbôen".
verses.translation: Mi inna Nnbi sser, i yiwet si tlawin is, u temla, Öebbi Issken it i neppa. Ixebbeô s wumur, iffer amur, segs. Mi p iaâlem s waya, tenna: "wi k imlan aya"? Inna: "Imla yi t Win Issnen, Ippuxebbôen".

verses.text: Ma tutubemt Öebbi, ihi knan wulawen n kwent. Ma tedduklemt as, ihi, d Öebbi ay d Bab is, u, deffir waya, ad ilin di talalt is: Jebrayen, ûûam n lmumnin, u lmalayek ad fkent afud.
verses.translation: Ma tutubemt Öebbi, ihi knan wulawen n kwent. Ma tedduklemt as, ihi, d Öebbi ay d Bab is, u, deffir waya, ad ilin di talalt is: Jebrayen, ûûam n lmumnin, u lmalayek ad fkent afud.

verses.text: Ma ibra yakwent, Izmer Öebbi ad as d Inûef s tlawin i kwent yifen, timvuâin, tid iumnen, ipéallan, iutuben, iâabden, ippuéumen, tid ijeôben tissulya, ne$ tiâazriyin.
verses.translation: Ma ibra yakwent, Izmer Öebbi ad as d Inûef s tlawin i kwent yifen, timvuâin, tid iumnen, ipéallan, iutuben, iâabden, ippuéumen, tid ijeôben tissulya, ne$ tiâazriyin.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Ëadret iman nnwen akked twacult nnwen, si tmes, is$aôen is d imdanen akked id$a$en! Fellas lmalayek tuohidin, tuqsiêin, ur nepwexxiô i wayen i sent Iumeô Öebbi, i ixedmen i sent ipwamôen.
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëadret iman nnwen akked twacult nnwen, si tmes, is$aôen is d imdanen akked id$a$en! Fellas lmalayek tuohidin, tuqsiêin, ur nepwexxiô i wayen i sent Iumeô Öebbi, i ixedmen i sent ipwamôen.

verses.text: A wid ijehlen, ulay$eô teste$fôem assa! A ppeppuqeîîim kan $ef wayen txeddmem.
verses.translation: A wid ijehlen, ulay$eô teste$fôem assa! A ppeppuqeîîim kan $ef wayen txeddmem.

verses.text: A wid iumnen! Utubet Öebbi, ppuba n ûûeê! Ahat Mass nnwen ad awen Ikkes tucmitin nnwen, u a kwen Issekcem ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Assen, Öebbi ur Isdullu Nnbi akked wid iumnen yides. Tafat nnsen teppeddu zdat sen, u yeffus nnsen. Ad qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Tim ane$ tafat nne$, Semmeê ane$; ih, Keçç, Tzemrev i yal cci".
verses.translation: A wid iumnen! Utubet Öebbi, ppuba n ûûeê! Ahat Mass nnwen ad awen Ikkes tucmitin nnwen, u a kwen Issekcem ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Assen, Öebbi ur Isdullu Nnbi akked wid iumnen yides. Tafat nnsen teppeddu zdat sen, u yeffus nnsen. Ad qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Tim ane$ tafat nne$, Semmeê ane$; ih, Keçç, Tzemrev i yal cci".

verses.text: A Nnbi! Nna$ ijehliyen akked ixabiten! Iqsiê $uôsen! Axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d tu$alin tucmip.
verses.translation: A Nnbi! Nna$ ijehliyen akked ixabiten! Iqsiê $uôsen! Axxam nnsen d Loahennama, d tu$alin tucmip.

verses.text: Ifka d Öebbi amedya i wid ijehlen: tameîîut n Nuê akked tmeîîut n Luî. Llant ger ifassen n sin imdanen, seg wid imaânen n imdanen nne$. £uüôôent pen. Ur zmiren a tent sselken s wacemma, seg ufus n Öebbi. Ancad: "kecmemt ar tmes akked wid ikecmen"!

verses.text: U Meryem ult Âimôan i izazdgen tuzzuft is. Nenfes $uôes si ôôuê nne£, tepputebbet $ef wawalen akked tezmamin n Mass is. Neppat seg wid ipéallan.
verses.translation: U Meryem ult Âimôan i izazdgen tuzzuft is. Nenfes $uôes si ôôuê nne£, tepputebbet $ef wawalen akked tezmamin n Mass is. Neppat seg wid ipéallan.

ayahs.text: A Nnbi! Ay$eô tgedlev ayen i k Iêell Öebbi? Tqennâav tilawin ik. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.
ayahs.translation: A Nnbi! Ay$eô tgedlev ayen i k Iêell Öebbi? Tqennâav tilawin ik. Öebbi Ipsemmiê, Ipêunu.

ayahs.text: Öebbi Iêeppem fellawen a pêentem. Öebbi d Bab nnwen. Neppa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.
ayahs.translation: Öebbi Iêeppem fellawen a pêentem. Öebbi d Bab nnwen. Neppa d Amusnaw, d Bab n ûûwab.

ayahs.text: Mi inna Nnbi sser, i yiwet si tlawin is, u temla, Öebbi Issken it i neppa. Ixebbeô s wumur, iffer amur, segs. Mi p iaâlem s waya, tenna: "wi k imlan aya"? Inna: "Imla yi t Win Issnen, Ippuxebbôen".
ayahs.translation: Mi inna Nnbi sser, i yiwet si tlawin is, u temla, Öebbi Issken it i neppa. Ixebbeô s wumur, iffer amur, segs. Mi p iaâlem s waya, tenna: "wi k imlan aya"? Inna: "Imla yi t Win Issnen, Ippuxebbôen".

ayahs.text: Ma tutubemt Öebbi, ihi knan wulawen n kwent. Ma tedduklemt as, ihi, d Öebbi ay d Bab is, u, deffir waya, ad ilin di talalt is: Jebrayen, ûûam n lmumnin, u lmalayek ad fkent afud.
ayahs.translation: Ma tutubemt Öebbi, ihi knan wulawen n kwent. Ma tedduklemt as, ihi, d Öebbi ay d Bab is, u, deffir waya, ad ilin di talalt is: Jebrayen, ûûam n lmumnin, u lmalayek ad fkent afud.

ayahs.text: Ma ibra yakwent, Izmer Öebbi ad as d Inûef s tlawin i kwent yifen, timvuâin, tid iumnen, ipéallan, iutuben, iâabden, ippuéumen, tid ijeôben tissulya, ne$ tiâazriyin.
ayahs.translation: Ma ibra yakwent, Izmer Öebbi ad as d Inûef s tlawin i kwent yifen, timvuâin, tid iumnen, ipéallan, iutuben, iâabden, ippuéumen, tid ijeôben tissulya, ne$ tiâazriyin.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Ëadret iman nnwen akked twacult nnwen, si tmes, is$aôen is d imdanen akked id$a$en! Fellas lmalayek tuohidin, tuqsiêin, ur nepwexxiô i wayen i sent Iumeô Öebbi, i ixedmen i sent ipwamôen.
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Ëadret iman nnwen akked twacult nnwen, si tmes, is$aôen is d imdanen akked id$a$en! Fellas lmalayek tuohidin, tuqsiêin, ur nepwexxiô i wayen i sent Iumeô Öebbi, i ixedmen i sent ipwamôen.

ayahs.text: A wid ijehlen, ulay$eô teste$fôem assa! A ppeppuqeîîim kan $ef wayen txeddmem.
ayahs.translation: A wid ijehlen, ulay$eô teste$fôem assa! A ppeppuqeîîim kan $ef wayen txeddmem.

ayahs.text: A wid iumnen! Utubet Öebbi, ppuba n ûûeê! Ahat Mass nnwen ad awen Ikkes tucmitin nnwen, u a kwen Issekcem ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. Assen, Öebbi ur Isdullu Nnbi akked wid iumnen yides. Tafat nnsen teppeddu zdat sen, u yeffus nnsen. Ad qqaôen: "a Mass nne$! Tim ane$ tafat nne$, Semmeê ane$; ih, Keçç, Tzemrev i yal cci".
ayahs.translation: A wid iumnen! Utubet Öebbi, ppuba n ûûeê! Ahat Mass nnwen ad awen Ikkes tucmitin nnwen, u a kwen Issekcem ar Loennet, ddaw as isaffen ppazzalen. verses.text: Iôqa Bu tgelda deg ufus iS, u Neppa, Izmer i yal cci;
verses.translation: Iôqa Bu tgelda deg ufus iS, u Neppa, Izmer i yal cci;

verses.text: i Ixelqen tameppant, tameddurt, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb: anwa degwen ara ixedmen igiten ilhan sennig wiyav. Neppa d Uzmir, Ipsemmiê;
verses.translation: i Ixelqen tameppant, tameddurt, iwakken a kwen Ijeôôeb: anwa degwen ara ixedmen igiten ilhan sennig wiyav. Neppa d Uzmir, Ipsemmiê;

verses.text: i Ixelqen ûa igenwan d idurra. Deg wayen Ixleq Uênin, ur tepwaliv ayen ixuûûen. Ernu sikked ma a pwaliv i$isiyen!
verses.translation: i Ixelqen ûa igenwan d idurra. Deg wayen Ixleq Uênin, ur tepwaliv ayen ixuûûen. Ernu sikked ma a pwaliv i$isiyen!

verses.text: Sinna, ger tiî ik berdayen. Iéôi a d iu$al $uôek, iêfa, u inzef.
verses.translation: Sinna, ger tiî ik berdayen. Iéôi a d iu$al $uôek, iêfa, u inzef.

verses.text: Ni$ Ncebbeê igenni aqôib s teftilin, Nôeooem yisent cwaîen, Nhegga yasen aâaqeb n tmes.
verses.translation: Ni$ Ncebbeê igenni aqôib s teftilin, Nôeooem yisent cwaîen, Nhegga yasen aâaqeb n tmes.

verses.text: I wid inekôen Mass nnsen, aâaqeb n Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!
verses.translation: I wid inekôen Mass nnsen, aâaqeb n Loahennama. A tu$alin tucmip!

verses.text: Mi pwaveggôen $uôes, ad slen la tesraâriâ, u neppat trekkem.
verses.translation: Mi pwaveggôen $uôes, ad slen la tesraâriâ, u neppat trekkem.

verses.text: Qôib a ppeftutes seg iûiv. Yal tikelt ara iwaveggeô $uôes urbaâ, a ten steqsin iâssasen is: "aâni ur kwen id iusi ara uneddaô"?
verses.translation: Qôib a ppeftutes seg iûiv. Yal tikelt ara iwaveggeô $uôes urbaâ, a ten steqsin iâssasen is: "aâni ur kwen id iusi ara uneddaô"?

verses.text: Ad inin: "ih, iusa ya$ d uneddaô, nenkeô u nenna: ur illi ay d Issuder Öebbi, aql akwen kan di le$wlav meqqwôen"!
verses.translation: Ad inin: "ih, iusa ya$ d uneddaô, nenkeô u nenna: ur illi ay d Issuder Öebbi, aql akwen kan di le$wlav meqqwôen"!

verses.text: U nnan: "lemmer nelli nsell ne$ nfehhem, ur nelli seg wat tmes".
verses.translation: U nnan: "lemmer nelli nsell ne$ nfehhem, ur nelli seg wat tmes".

verses.text: Qaôôen s ibekkaven nnsen. Asêaq i at tmes!
verses.translation: Qaôôen s ibekkaven nnsen. Asêaq i at tmes!

verses.text: Wanag, i wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen, di tbavnit, ssmaê akked warraz meqqwôen.
verses.translation: Wanag, i wid ippagwaden Mass nnsen, di tbavnit, ssmaê akked warraz meqqwôen.

verses.text: Hedôet s sser ne$ âinani, ihi, Neppa Iéôa ayen illan deg idmaren.
verses.translation: Hedôet s sser ne$ âinani, ihi, Neppa Iéôa ayen illan deg idmaren.

verses.text: Day ur Iéôi ara Win Ixelqen, Laîif Ippuxebbôen?
verses.translation: Day ur Iéôi ara Win Ixelqen, Laîif Ippuxebbôen?

verses.text: Neppa i wen Irran tamurt d tamvuât. Elêut deg ibraêen is, ççet si ôôeéq is. £uôeS tanekra.
verses.translation: Neppa i wen Irran tamurt d tamvuât. Elêut deg ibraêen is, ççet si ôôeéq is. £uôeS tanekra.

verses.text: Ma tepputebtem ar, Win Illan deg igenni, ad Irr tamurt a ppertem yiswen? Appan la teppembwiwil.
verses.translation: Ma tepputebtem ar, Win Illan deg igenni, ad Irr tamurt a ppertem yiswen? Appan la teppembwiwil.

verses.text: Ma tepputebtem, ar Win Illan deg igenni, awen d Iazen tabucivant n yid$a$en? D$a, a ppissinem anwa t unabi W.
verses.translation: Ma tepputebtem, ar Win Illan deg igenni, awen d Iazen tabucivant n yid$a$en? D$a, a ppissinem anwa t unabi W.

verses.text: Ni$ nekôen imezwura nnsen. Amek d Zzi$ fellasen!
verses.translation: Ni$ nekôen imezwura nnsen. Amek d Zzi$ fellasen!

verses.text: Ahat ur walan ara ifôax, sennig sen, d idurra, afriwen ceôqen, ur côiqen. Siwa Aênin iten Iîfen. Neppa, ih, Issikkid yal cci.
verses.translation: Ahat ur walan ara ifôax, sennig sen, d idurra, afriwen ceôqen, ur côiqen. Siwa Aênin iten Iîfen. Neppa, ih, Issikkid yal cci.

verses.text: Anwa wa ay d aâsekôiw nnwen, ara kwen isellken, war Aênin? Ijehliyen atnan kan di le$ôuô.
verses.translation: Anwa wa ay d aâsekôiw nnwen, ara kwen isellken, war Aênin? Ijehliyen atnan kan di le$ôuô.

verses.text: Anwa wa ara kwen iôeéqen ma Ijmaâ l$it iS? Maca, vellelen deg u$unfu akked leqbaêa.
verses.translation: Anwa wa ara kwen iôeéqen ma Ijmaâ l$it iS? Maca, vellelen deg u$unfu akked leqbaêa.

verses.text: Win iteddun, ibra i uqeôôu, day ipwanha sennig win iteddun, irfed aqeôôu, deg ubrid uwqim?
verses.translation: Win iteddun, ibra i uqeôôu, day ipwanha sennig win iteddun, irfed aqeôôu, deg ubrid uwqim?

verses.text: Ini: "d Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen. Irra yawen timejjin, allen, ulawen. Drus ay tesnemmirem"!
verses.translation: Ini: "d Neppa ikwen id Ixelqen. Irra yawen timejjin, allen, ulawen. Drus ay tesnemmirem"!

verses.text: Ini: "d Neppa ikwen isseftin di tmurt, ar $uôeS ara tepwafesrem".
verses.translation: Ini: "d Neppa ikwen isseftin di tmurt, ar $uôeS ara tepwafesrem".

verses.text: La qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma d tidep ay tessawalem"?
verses.translation: La qqaôen: "melmi lemâahda agi, ma d tidep ay tessawalem"?

verses.text: Ini: "i Iéôan siwa Öebbi. Nek d aneddaô kan ipbegginen.
verses.translation: Ini: "i Iéôan siwa Öebbi. Nek d aneddaô kan ipbegginen.

verses.text: Mara a t walin iqeôb ed, ad ndellen wudmawen n wid ijehlen. A d inin: "atan wayen tessuturem".
verses.translation: Mara a t walin iqeôb ed, ad ndellen wudmawen n wid ijehlen. A d inin: "atan wayen tessuturem".

verses.text: Ini: "ma twalam ma In$a ya$ Öebbi, nek d imeddukwal iw, ne$ ma Iêun fella$? Ihi, anwa ara isellken ijehliyen seg uâaqeb aqeôêan"?
verses.translation: Ini: "ma twalam ma In$a ya$ Öebbi, nek d imeddukwal iw, ne$ ma Iêun fella$? Ihi, anwa ara isellken ijehliyen seg uâaqeb aqeôêan"?

verses.text: Ini: "Neppa d Aênin, syiS numen, fellaS neppkel. A ppeéôem anwa i illan di ttelfan n ûûeê".
verses.translation: Ini: "Neppa d Aênin, syiS numen, fellaS neppkel. A ppeéôem anwa i illan di ttelfan n ûûeê".

verses.text: Ini: "ma twalam, lemmer ad zzren waman nnwen, w ar awen d iawin aman ippazalen"?
